hook: 导演尼尔·乔丹的这部 brilliant breakthrough 电影深入伦敦地下世界的核心，编织了一段扣人心弦、充满黑色风格的浪漫故事。演员鲍·霍斯金斯因对乔治的细腻脆弱、不那么粗犷的诠释——乔治最近出狱，被一个阴险的黑帮头目雇用，开车接送风尘女子西蒙娜（西蒙娜由凯西·蒂亚侬特饰演，她在这一角色中表现出色）——获得了众多荣誉，包括奥斯卡提名。乔治对优雅而神秘的西蒙娜的迷恋，让他在城市地下世界展开了一场危险的旅程，在那里，爱被视为可以被利用和背叛的弱点。乔丹的多彩对话和对生动而超现实细节的敏锐捕捉，赋予了《蒙娜丽莎》这部不寻常的浪漫故事一种梦幻般的光泽，讲述的是在一个冷漠世界中寻找温柔的受损人物的故事。
hook_en: The brilliant breakthrough film by writer-director Neil Jordan journeys into the dark heart of the London underworld to weave a gripping, noir-infused love story. Bob Hoskins received a multitude of honors—including an Oscar nomination—for his touchingly vulnerable, not-so-tough-guy portrayal of George, recently released from prison and hired by a sinister mob boss (Michael Caine) to chauffeur call girl Simone (Cathy Tyson, in a celebrated performance) between high-paying clients. George’s fascination with the elegant, enigmatic Simone leads him on a dangerous quest through the city’s underbelly, where love is a weakness to be exploited and betrayed. Jordan’s colorful dialogue and eye for evocatively surreal details lend a dreamlike sheen to Mona Lisa, an unconventionally romantic tale of damaged people searching for tenderness in an unforgiving world.

hook: 无畏的纪录片制片人劳拉·波伊特拉斯 (Laura Poitras) 一生对真理和正义的追求在一部关于艺术、行动主义和生存的史诗故事中得到了有力的体现。 《All the Beauty and the Bloodshed》与著名艺术家南·戈尔丁 (Nan Goldin) 合作制作，将 PAIN 的使命与戈尔丁 (Goldin) 的亲密旅程交织在一起。 PAIN 是她创立的一个倡导组织，旨在提高人们对亿万富翁萨克勒家族在持续的阿片类药物过量危机中不可或缺的作用的认识。通过这一切，她不可磨灭的照片以及对记忆和创伤的坦率反思揭示了她与拒绝保持沉默的边缘群体的坚定团结。
hook_en: Fearless documentary filmmaker Laura Poitras’s career-long pursuit of truth and justice finds powerful expression in an epic story of art, activism, and survival. Made in collaboration with renowned artist Nan Goldin, All the Beauty and the Bloodshed entwines the mission of PAIN—an advocacy group she founded to raise awareness about the billionaire Sackler family’s integral role in the ongoing crisis of opioid overdoses—with an intimate journey through Goldin’s life, from her rebellious adolescence and immersion in New York City’s thriving underground arts scene to her personal experiences of addiction and the AIDS epidemic. Through it all, her indelible photographs and candid reflections on memory and trauma reveal her unyielding solidarity with marginalized communities that refuse to remain silent.

hook: 凭借这部既令人痛心又抒情的处女作，扬·涅梅茨确立了自己在构成捷克斯洛伐克新浪潮的激进电影制片人中最不妥协的梦想家的地位。 《夜之钻石》改编自阿诺斯特·勒斯蒂格的小说，讲述了两个男孩从集中营的运输中逃出来，逃到周围的树林里，那里是充满敌意的地形，在那里，生存的残酷现实与梦想、记忆和视觉诗歌的片段共存。除了雅罗斯拉夫·库切拉（Jaroslav Kučera）和米罗斯拉夫·翁德日切克（Miroslav Ondříček）这两位捷克斯洛伐克电影界最有影响力的电影摄影师的精彩摄影作品之外，涅梅克创造性地运用了断裂式剪辑、省略式叙事和超现实主义手法，从这个简单的故事中剥离了背景，唤起了人们在夜色和雾气中迷失的惊慌失措的意识。
hook_en: With this simultaneously harrowing and lyrical debut feature, Jan Němec established himself as the most uncompromising visionary among the radical filmmakers who made up the Czechoslovak New Wave. Adapted from a novel by Arnošt Lustig, Diamonds of the Night closely tracks two boys who escape from a concentration-camp transport and flee into the surrounding woods, hostile terrain where the brute realities of survival coexist with dreams, memories, and fragments of visual poetry. Along with visceral camera work by Jaroslav Kučera and Miroslav Ondříček—two of Czechoslovak cinema’s most influential cinematographers—Němec makes inventive use of fractured editing, elliptical storytelling, and flights of surrealism as he strips context away from this bare-bones tale, evoking the panicked delirium of consciousness lost in night and fog.

hook: This holy grail for both documentary and theater aficionados offers a tantalizingly rare glimpse behind the Broadway curtain. 1970 年，史蒂芬·桑德海姆开创性的概念音乐剧《Company》成功首演后，著名作曲家兼作词家、导演哈罗德·普林斯 (Harold Prince)、剧中明星和一支大型管弦乐队都进入了曼哈顿录音室，这是百老汇悠久传统的一部分：制作原创演员专辑。接下来是一场马拉松式的会议，在后人的压力和桑德海姆冷酷严格的完美主义笼罩下，所有参与者都把自己推向了极限——包括戏剧传奇人物伊莱恩·斯特里奇(Elaine Stritch)，她克服焦虑和疲惫，录制了她标志性的“午餐的女士”表演。传奇电影制作人 D. A. Pennebaker 凭借令人兴奋的即时性，近距离展示了捕捉现场表演魔力的传奇人物、紧张的神经能量和爆炸性的创造力。
hook_en: This holy grail for both documentary and theater aficionados offers a tantalizingly rare glimpse behind the Broadway curtain. In 1970, right after the triumphant premiere of Stephen Sondheim’s groundbreaking concept musical Company, the renowned composer and lyricist, his director Harold Prince, the show’s stars, and a large pit orchestra all went into a Manhattan recording studio as part of a time-honored Broadway tradition: the making of the original cast album. What ensued was a marathon session in which, with the pressures of posterity and the coolly exacting Sondheim’s perfectionism hanging over them, all involved pushed themselves to the limit—including theater legend Elaine Stritch, who fought anxiety and exhaustion to record her iconic rendition of “The Ladies Who Lunch.” With thrilling immediacy, legendary filmmaker D. A. Pennebaker offers an up-close view of the larger-than-life personalities, frayed-nerve energy, and explosive creative intensity that go into capturing the magic of live performance.

hook: 纪录片制片人安德烈和雷米在本身上找到了理想的拍摄对象。他机智、老练、聪明、受人喜爱，而且还是一个连环杀手。当安德烈和雷米记录本的日常生活时，他们越来越多地卷入他的邪恶计划，牺牲了他们的客观性和道德。 《人咬狗》荣获 1992 年戛纳电影节国际影评人奖，备受争议，以其毫不畏惧的形象和对媒体暴力的尖锐讽刺震惊了全世界观众。
hook_en: Documentary filmmakers André and Rémy have found an ideal subject in Ben. He is witty, sophisticated, intelligent, well liked—and a serial killer. As André and Rémy document Ben’s routines, they become increasingly entwined in his vicious program, sacrificing their objectivity and their morality. Controversial winner of the International Critics’ Prize at the 1992 Cannes Film Festival, Man Bites Dog stunned audiences worldwide with its unflinching imagery and biting satire of media violence.

hook: 当查理·卓别林决定突破短片格式并制作他的第一部长片时，他已经是一位国际巨星。 《寻子记》不仅展示了卓别林的转折点，证明了他是一位严肃的电影导演，它仍然是无声电影富有表现力的杰作。在片中，他扮演了他可爱的流浪汉角色，这一次抚养了一个他从街头救出来的孤儿（年轻的杰​​出的杰基·库根）。卓别林和库根在这部感伤与闹剧的灵活结合中成为了奇迹般的搭档，正如片头片名所言，这部电影是“一部带着微笑的画面，也许还有一滴泪水”。
hook_en: Charlie Chaplin was already an international star when he decided to break out of the short-film format and make his first full-length feature. The Kid doesn’t merely show Chaplin at a turning point, when he proved that he was a serious film director—it remains an expressive masterwork of silent cinema. In it, he stars as his lovable Tramp character, this time raising an orphan (a remarkable young Jackie Coogan) he has rescued from the streets. Chaplin and Coogan make a miraculous pair in this nimble marriage of sentiment and slapstick, a film that is, as its opening title card states, “a picture with a smile—and perhaps, a tear.”

hook: 《孤独》是好莱坞黄金时代埋藏的宝藏，由一位鲜为人知但大胆且独一无二的电影制片人保罗·费霍斯（Paul Fejos）（同时也是一位探险家、人类学家和医生！） 创作。在与环球影业签订合同期间，费霍斯在国庆节周末为这部以滑稽的科尼岛为背景的可爱、基本无声的纽约市交响乐竭尽全力，采用了调色、叠加效果、实验性剪辑和流动摄像机（加上三个对话场景，是为了满足有声电影的新热潮而添加的）。多年来，《孤独》一直是电影节和电影院观众难得的享受，但现在才出现在家庭视频中。更为罕见的是费霍斯在环球影业拍摄的另外两部影片也包含在本次发行中：《最后的表演》和之前不完整的百老汇有声版本的重建，当时这是该工作室制作的最昂贵的电影。
hook_en: A buried treasure from Hollywood’s golden age, Lonesome is the creation of a little-known but audacious and one-of-a-kind filmmaker, Paul Fejos (also an explorer, anthropologist, and doctor!). While under contract at Universal, Fejos pulled out all the stops for this lovely, largely silent New York City symphony set in antic Coney Island during the Fourth of July weekend, employing color tinting, superimposition effects, experimental editing, and a roving camera (plus three dialogue scenes, added to satisfy the new craze for talkies). For years, Lonesome has been a rare treat for festival and cinematheque audiences, but it’s only now coming to home video. Rarer still are the two other Fejos films from his Universal years included in this release: The Last Performance and a reconstruction of the previously incomplete sound version of Broadway, in its time the most expensive film ever produced by the studio.

hook: 梦想之城的爱情故事。 。 。金发碧眼的贝蒂·埃尔姆斯（娜奥米·沃茨饰）刚刚抵达好莱坞成为一名电影明星，就遇到了一位患有失忆症的神秘黑发美女（劳拉·哈林饰）。与此同时，当两人着手解决第二个女人的身份时，电影制作人亚当·凯​​舍尔（贾斯汀·塞洛克斯饰）在选角他的最新项目时遇到了不祥的麻烦。大卫·林奇对洛杉矶梦工厂的描绘既诱人又可怕，是新千年真正的杰作之一，讲述了一个独一无二的关于爱、嫉妒和复仇的故事。
hook_en: A love story in the city of dreams . . . Blonde Betty Elms (Naomi Watts) has only just arrived in Hollywood to become a movie star when she meets an enigmatic brunette with amnesia (Laura Harring). Meanwhile, as the two set off to solve the second woman’s identity, filmmaker Adam Kesher (Justin Theroux) runs into ominous trouble while casting his latest project. David Lynch’s seductive and scary vision of Los Angeles’s dream factory is one of the true masterpieces of the new millennium, a tale of love, jealousy, and revenge like no other.

hook: 阿巴斯·基亚罗斯塔米（Abbas Kiarostami）在其无与伦比的职业生涯中探索了将幻想与现实以及模拟与真实分开的空间。起初，这位伊朗导演在东京拍摄的非凡而狡猾的《像恋爱中的人》似乎是他最直白的电影之一。然而，通过这个简单的故事，讲述了一个年轻学生、兼职应召女郎和一位祖父客户之间日益加深的联系，基亚罗斯塔米构建了一个关于情感和欲望的神秘而清晰的调查，就像他精湛的特写镜头和认证副本一样复杂，与善变的人心的运作有关。
hook_en: Abbas Kiarostami has spent his incomparable career exploring the spaces that separate illusion from reality and the simulated from the authentic. At first, his extraordinary and sly Like Someone in Love, which finds the Iranian director in Tokyo, may appear to be among his most straightforward films. Yet with this simple story of the growing bond between a young student and part-time call girl and a grandfatherly client, Kiarostami has constructed an enigmatic but crystalline investigation of affection and desire as complex as his masterful Close-up and Certified Copy in its engagement with the workings of the mercurial human heart.

hook: 雅克·塔蒂精心编排的、几乎无言的喜剧讲述了高科技时代的困惑，在《PlayTime》中达到了顶峰。为了这部历时近三年、耗资巨大的作品，塔蒂再次将可爱的老式于洛先生和许多其他迷失的灵魂推入一个令人困惑的现代世界，这次是巴黎。 《PlayTime》超宽画面的每一寸都充满了欢乐和创造力，是现代时代在遗忘边缘蹑手蹑脚的持久记录。
hook_en: Jacques Tati’s gloriously choreographed, nearly wordless comedies about confusion in an age of high technology reached their apotheosis with PlayTime. For this monumental achievement, a nearly three-year-long, bank-breaking production, Tati again thrust the lovably old-fashioned Monsieur Hulot, along with a host of other lost souls, into a baffling modern world, this time Paris. With every inch of its superwide frame crammed with hilarity and inventiveness, PlayTime is a lasting record of a modern era tiptoeing on the edge of oblivion.

hook: 《有趣的游戏》是迈克尔·哈内克最臭名昭著的挑衅，不遗余力地描述了一个资产阶级家庭被一对戴着白手套的年轻人囚禁在度假屋里的痛苦。在一系列不断升级的“游戏”中，这对施虐二人让受害者在一夜之间遭受难以言喻的身心折磨。这是一部入室盗窃惊悚片，该类型片中的流血威胁被渲染得令人反胃，即使刽子手打断剧情向观众讲话，这部电影也加剧了人们的震惊，让人们对电影从痛苦中榨取快乐并激发我们对暴行的胃口的方式感到不安。通过这部关于暴力和娱乐的有争议的论文，哈内克总结了他的电影哲学，让他的观众陷入了难以忍受的残酷场面。
hook_en: Michael Haneke’s most notorious provocation, Funny Games spares no detail in its depiction of the agony of a bourgeois family held captive at their vacation home by a pair of white-gloved young men. In a series of escalating “games,” the sadistic duo subject their victims to unspeakable physical and psychological torture over the course of a night. A home-invasion thriller in which the genre’s threat of bloodshed is made stomach-churningly real, the film ratchets up shocks even as its executioners interrupt the action to address the audience, drawing queasy attention to the way that cinema milks pleasure from pain and stokes our appetite for atrocity. With this controversial treatise on violence and entertainment, Haneke issued a summation of his cinematic philosophy, implicating his audience in a spectacle of unbearable cruelty.

hook: 爱森斯坦结合历史、俄罗斯民间叙事和沃尔特·迪士尼的技术，创作了这部描绘俄罗斯坚韧不拔的史诗。这个讲述条顿骑士被亚历山大·涅夫斯基战术 brilliance 打败的故事，深深触动了一个担忧纳粹德国崛起的苏联。这部冰上之战场景被广泛模仿，尤其是劳伦斯·奥利维尔在《哈姆雷特》中重现阿金基之战，冰上之战场景仍然是电影史上最著名的视听实验之一，完美地将动作与 Sergei Prokofiev 的激昂配乐融合在一起。
hook_en: Eisenstein drew on history, Russian folk narratives, and the techniques of Walt Disney to create this broadly painted epic of Russian resilience. This story of Teutonic knights vanquished by Prince Alexander Nevsky’s tactical brilliance resonated deeply with a Soviet Union concerned with the rise of Nazi Germany. Widely imitated—most notably by Laurence Olivier's Battle of Agincourt re-creation for Henry V—the Battle on the Ice scene remains one of the most famous audio-visual experiments in film history, perfectly blending action with the rousing score of Sergei Prokofiev.

hook: 玛莎·贝克（雪莉·斯托勒饰）阴沉、肥胖、孤独。出于对爱情的渴望，她加入了嘉莉姨妈的友谊俱乐部，并与雷·费尔南德斯（托尼·洛·比安科饰）建立了通信关系，雷·费尔南德斯是一位魅力十足、能说会道的人，可能是她的梦中情人，也可能是一个堕落的骗子。 《蜜月杀手》取材于一个令人震惊的真实故事，由自信而富有灵感的伦纳德·卡斯尔以纪录片风格的黑白镜头拍摄，这也是他唯一一次涉足电影制作。
hook_en: Martha Beck (Shirley Stoler) is sullen, overweight, and lonely. Desperate for affection, she joins Aunt Carrie’s Friendship Club and strikes up a correspondence with Ray Fernandez (Tony Lo Bianco), a charismatic smooth talker who could be the man of her dreams—or a degenerate con artist. Based on a shocking true story and shot in documentary-style black and white by the confident and inspired Leonard Kastle, in what would be his only foray into filmmaking, The Honeymoon Killers is a stark portrayal of the desperate lengths to which a lonely heart will go to find true love.

hook: 这部 existential 悲剧关注的是两个姐妹卡琳（英格丽·褒曼饰）和玛利亚（莉芙·乌尔曼饰），她们在为第三位妹妹阿格妮斯（哈瑞特·安德森饰）守夜，阿格妮斯正遭受癌症的折磨，只能在一位充满善意的仆人（卡莉·萨万饰）的怀抱中找到慰藉。这部电影情感饱满，是伯格曼最令人印象深刻的美学实验之一，《呼喊与细语》（该片还获得了斯文·努克维斯特的超凡色彩摄影奖）描绘了人类在面对死亡时的行为，它处于现实与噩梦、平静与恐怖之间的边缘。
hook_en: This existential wail of a drama concerns two sisters, Karin (Ingrid Thulin) and Maria (Liv Ullmann), keeping vigil for a third, Agnes (Harriet Andersson), who is dying of cancer and can find solace only in the arms of a beatific servant (Kari Sylwan). An intensely felt film that is one of Bergman’s most striking formal experiments, Cries and Whispers (which won an Oscar for the extraordinary color photography by Sven Nykvist) is a powerful depiction of human behavior in the face of death, positioned on the borders between reality and nightmare, tranquility and terror.

hook: 在这部充满心理冲击力的灾难史诗中，有史以来最伟大的生存电影之一，一架被击落的飞机是一群人在沙漠无情的阳光下唯一的保护。詹姆斯·斯图尔特是一位经验丰富的飞行员，他驾驶的飞往班加西的飞机——载着乘客的演员都是胡子拉碴的银幕偶像，包括理查德·阿滕伯勒、欧内斯特·博格宁、伊恩·班南、丹·杜里亚、彼得·芬奇和乔治·肯尼迪——在偏远的撒哈拉沙漠坠毁。随着幸存者之间的紧张局势不断发酵，他们发现自己被迫相信一位冷酷的逻辑工程师（哈迪·克鲁格饰），他将他们救出的计划可能过于疯狂，甚至可能会杀死他们所有人。 《凤凰飞翔》由好莱坞反传统人士罗伯特·奥尔德里奇执导，具有独特的冲击力，平衡了冒险与人类戏剧，对绝望男人之间的权威、荣誉和友情进行了令人惊讶而复杂的审视。
hook_en: A downed airplane is a motley group of men’s only protection from the relentless desert sun, in this psychologically charged disaster epic, one of the all-time great survival movies. James Stewart is the veteran pilot whose Benghazi-bound plane—carrying passengers played by an unshaven ensemble of screen icons including Richard Attenborough, Ernest Borgnine, Ian Bannen, Dan Duryea, Peter Finch, and George Kennedy—crash-lands in the remote Sahara. As tensions simmer among the survivors, they find themselves forced to trust a coldly logical engineer (Hardy Krüger) whose plan to get them out may just be crazy enough to work—or could kill them all. Directed with characteristic punch by Hollywood iconoclast Robert Aldrich, The Flight of the Phoenix balances adventure with human drama as it conducts a surprising and complex examination of authority, honor, and camaraderie among desperate men.

hook: 德国电影新偶像雷纳·沃纳·法斯宾德凭借令人惊叹的《四季商人》开启了他年轻职业生涯的新阶段。在这部痛苦却又尖刻有趣的电影中，法斯宾德记录了一位自我毁灭的前警察和退伍军人的衰落，他通过做水果摊贩努力维持家人的收支平衡。法斯宾德因一系列尖锐、快速制作的早期电影而受到赞誉，但在这部影片中，他花了更多的时间并打造了一种新的风格——以更复杂的剧本和叙事结构以及更复杂的摄影机使用为特色，并受到他最近发现的偶像道格拉斯·瑟克的作品的影响。结果是一部精心制作的、无情的社会讽刺剧。
hook_en: New German Cinema icon Rainer Werner Fassbinder kicked off a new phase of his young career when he made the startling The Merchant of Four Seasons. In this anguished yet mordantly funny film, Fassbinder charts the decline of a self-destructive former policeman and war veteran struggling to make ends meet for his family by working as a fruit vendor. Fassbinder had gained acclaim for a series of trenchant, quickly made early films, but for this one he took more time and forged a new style—featuring a more complexly woven script and narrative structure and more sophisticated use of the camera, and influenced by the work of his recently discovered idol, Douglas Sirk. The result is a meticulously made, unforgiving social satire.

hook: 20 世纪 70 年代初，雷纳·沃纳·法斯宾德发现了道格拉斯·塞克的美国情节剧，并受到其中的启发，开始以一种新的、更加强烈的情感语境进行创作。他职业生涯中这一时期的第一部也是最受欢迎的电影之一是《佩特拉·冯·康德的苦泪》，它平衡了对痛苦爱情的现实描述与舞台表演，这仍然忠于导演的实验戏剧根源。这部令人难忘、无情的剖析了傲慢的时装设计师（玛吉特·卡斯滕森饰）和美丽但冷酷的天真少女（汉娜·许古拉饰）之间的不平衡关系——以编剧兼导演对年轻演员的绝望迷恋为基础，以巧妙的性别逆转为基础——是一部真正的法斯宾德事件，以迈克尔·鲍尔豪斯精致的幽闭恐怖电影摄影和全女性的全力表演为特色。演员。
hook_en: In the early 1970s, Rainer Werner Fassbinder discovered the American melodramas of Douglas Sirk and was inspired by them to begin working in a new, more intensely emotional register. One of the first and best-loved films of this period in his career is The Bitter Tears of Petra von Kant, which balances a realistic depiction of tormented romance with staging that remains true to the director’s roots in experimental theater. This unforgettable, unforgiving dissection of the imbalanced relationship between a haughty fashion designer (Margit Carstensen) and a beautiful but icy ingenue (Hanna Schygulla)—based, in a sly gender reversal, on the writer-director’s own desperate obsession with a young actor—is a true Fassbinder affair, featuring exquisitely claustrophobic cinematography by Michael Ballhaus and full-throttle performances by an all-female cast.

hook: 《了不起的狐狸先生》讲述了一只聪明、敏捷、灵活且衣着异常考究的野生动物的故事。福克斯先生是一名强迫性的偷鸡贼，后来成为一名报纸记者，他和家人在一棵美丽的树上的一个新散兵坑里安顿下来，紧邻三个巨大的家禽养殖场，这三个养殖场的主人是三个凶残的农民：博吉斯、邦斯和比恩。狐狸先生根本无法抗拒。韦斯·安德森改编自罗尔德·达尔的经典儿童小说，是一部精心制作的定格动画作品，由乔治·克鲁尼、梅丽尔·斯特里普、詹森·舒瓦兹曼、威廉·达福、迈克尔·甘本和比尔·默里的充满活力的表演组成。
hook_en: Fantastic Mr. Fox is the story of a clever, quick, nimble, and exceptionally well-dressed wild animal. A compulsive chicken thief turned newspaper reporter, Mr. Fox settles down with his family in a new foxhole in a beautiful tree—directly adjacent to three enormous poultry farms owned by three ferociously vicious farmers: Boggis, Bunce, and Bean. Mr. Fox simply cannot resist. Wes Anderson’s adaptation of Roald Dahl’s classic children’s novel is a meticulous work of stop-motion animation featuring vibrant performances by George Clooney, Meryl Streep, Jason Schwartzman, Willem Dafoe, Michael Gambon, and Bill Murray.

hook: 在他最精心的表演之一中，彼得·塞勒斯扮演了心地纯洁、孩子气的钱斯，一个园丁，当他富有的监护人去世后，他被迫进入华盛顿特区的荒野。钱斯震惊地发现现实世界对遥控器的点击没有反应，在被一位大亨（梅尔文·道格拉斯，在奥斯卡获奖表演中扮演）的庇护下，偶然发现了现实世界对生活和政治的睿智宣言，而他的妻子（雪莉·麦克雷恩饰）则将钱斯视为她的欲望对象。这部讽刺作品改编自杰齐·科辛斯基的小说，既深感忧郁，又令人捧腹，是哈尔·阿什比 20 世纪 70 年代一系列出色电影的巅峰之作，也是对那十年塑造美国文化的理想、焦虑和媒体引发的妄想的精心审视。
hook_en: In one of his most finely tuned performances, Peter Sellers plays the pure-hearted, childlike Chance, a gardener who is forced into the wilds of Washington, D.C., when his wealthy guardian dies. Shocked to discover that the real world doesn’t respond to the click of a remote, Chance stumbles into celebrity after being taken under the wing of a tycoon (Melvyn Douglas, in an Oscar-winning performance), who mistakes his protégé’s horticultural mumblings for sagacious pronouncements on life and politics, and whose wife (Shirley MacLaine) targets Chance as the object of her desire. Adapted from a novel by Jerzy Kosinski, this satire, both deeply melancholy and hilarious, is the culmination of Hal Ashby’s remarkable string of films in the 1970s, and a carefully modulated examination of the ideals, anxieties, and media-fueled delusions that shaped American culture during that decade.

hook: 《活死人之夜》由恐怖片大师乔治·A·罗梅罗执导，由一群决心在匹兹堡郊外以微薄的预算拍摄而成，是独立电影的一个伟大故事：一部午夜热播的票房大片，成为有史以来最具影响力的电影之一。这是一个看似简单的故事，讲述了一群陌生人被困在农舍里，他们发现自己正在抵御一群刚刚死去的食肉食尸鬼，罗梅罗对 20 世纪 60 年代末美国的幽闭恐惧症视像实际上正在撕裂自己，改写了恐怖类型的规则，将可怕的血腥与尖锐的社会评论结合在一起，并通过让黑人演员（杜安·琼斯饰）担任主角而悄悄地开创了先河。现代艺术博物馆和电影基金会在乔治·卢卡斯家族基金会和塞莱斯特·巴托斯保护基金的资助下修复了《活死人之夜》。
hook_en: Shot outside Pittsburgh on a shoestring budget, by a band of filmmakers determined to make their mark, Night of the Living Dead, directed by horror master George A. Romero, is a great story of independent cinema: a midnight hit turned box-office smash that became one of the most influential films of all time. A deceptively simple tale of a group of strangers trapped in a farmhouse who find themselves fending off a horde of recently dead, flesh-eating ghouls, Romero’s claustrophobic vision of a late-1960s America literally tearing itself apart rewrote the rules of the horror genre, combining gruesome gore with acute social commentary and quietly breaking ground by casting a Black actor (Duane Jones) in its lead role. Night of the Living Dead was restored by the Museum of Modern Art and The Film Foundation, with funding provided by the George Lucas Family Foundation and the Celeste Bartos Preservation Fund.

hook: 芭芭拉·史翠珊 (Barbra Streisand) 执导的第二部长片广受好评，改编自帕特·康罗伊 (Pat Conroy) 的畅销小说，改编自帕特·康罗伊 (Pat Conroy) 的畅销小说，并担任该小说的制片人和主演。 汤姆·温戈 (尼克·诺尔特饰) 在妹妹试图自杀后被召唤到纽约，他必须充当她的记忆，正视他们南方童年的创伤，以便她的精神科医生苏珊·洛温斯坦博士 (史翠珊饰) 能够帮助她康复。但汤姆与洛温斯坦的会面将使他陷入长期压抑的痛苦的深渊，并重新唤醒他内心爱的可能性。诺尔特深情的表演获得七项奥斯卡奖提名，包括最佳影片和最佳男主角，
hook_en: For her acclaimed second feature as a director, Barbra Streisand crafted a sumptuous, emotionally wrenching adaptation of Pat Conroy’s best-selling novel—which she also produced and starred in. Summoned to New York after his sister attempts suicide, Tom Wingo (Nick Nolte) must serve as her memory, reckoning with the traumas of their southern childhood so that her psychiatrist, Dr. Susan Lowenstein (Streisand), can help her recover. But Tom’s sessions with Lowenstein will plunge him into the depths of his own long-repressed pain—and reawaken the possibility of love within him. Nominated for seven Academy Awards, including best picture and best actor for Nolte’s soulful performance,

hook: 这部由维姆·文德斯 (Wim Wenders) 创作数十年的科幻史诗片被视为终极公路电影，讲述了焦躁不安的克莱尔·图尔纳 (索尔维格·多马丁饰) 穿越各大洲，追捕一位神秘陌生人 (威廉·赫特饰)，她拥有一种可以让盲人重见光明并将梦境图像带入现实生活的装置。凭借不拘一格的配乐，聚集了众多导演最喜欢的音乐家，再加上罗比·穆勒 (Robby Müller) 的华丽摄影，这场在世界末日阴影下的令人屏息的冒险将英雄们带到了天涯海角，进入了他们自己灵魂的梦幻深处。 《直到世界末日》以 287 分钟的导演剪辑版完美呈现，作为文德斯的代表作，它占据了应有的地位，这是一首对影像的乐趣和危险的宇宙颂歌，也是对电影数字未来的先见之明。
hook_en: Conceived as the ultimate road movie, this decades-in-the-making science-fiction epic from Wim Wenders follows the restless Claire Tourneur (Solveig Dommartin) across continents as she pursues a mysterious stranger (William Hurt) in possession of a device that can make the blind see and bring dream images to waking life. With an eclectic soundtrack that gathers a host of the director’s favorite musicians, along with gorgeous cinematography by Robby Müller, this breathless adventure in the shadow of Armageddon takes its heroes to the ends of the earth and into the oneiric depths of their own souls. Presented here in its triumphant 287-minute director’s cut, Until the End of the World assumes its rightful place as Wenders’ magnum opus, a cosmic ode to the pleasures and perils of the image and a prescient meditation on cinema’s digital future.

hook: 迈克·李的《同时代》缓慢地描绘了撒切尔夫人统治下的英国经济衰退，是这位编剧兼导演在电视领域开创性作品的巅峰之作。伦敦东区的工薪阶层失业率很高，一对中年夫妇和他们的两个儿子在一间幽闭恐怖的公共住房里苦苦挣扎。随着兄弟俩（菲尔·丹尼尔斯和蒂姆·罗斯饰）的不满情绪日益高涨，利在他们日常生活中的无聊生活中加入了一些紧张的遭遇，其中包括与一位已经成为中产阶级的自命不凡的阿姨（玛丽昂·贝利饰）和一个濒临精神病边缘的胡言乱语的光头党（加里·奥德曼饰演的加里·奥德曼，这是他的第一个主要角色）。受利现在标志性的即兴创作过程的启发，并受到贝克特式对话的摇摇欲坠的节奏的推动，《同时》是对救济金生活的无情且常常非常有趣的审视。
hook_en: A slow-burning depiction of economic degradation in Thatcher’s England, Mike Leigh’s Meantime is the culmination of the writer-director’s pioneering work in television. Unemployment is rampant in London’s working-class East End, where a middle-aged couple and their two sons languish in a claustrophobic public-housing flat. As the brothers (Phil Daniels and Tim Roth) grow increasingly disaffected, Leigh punctuates the grinding boredom of their daily existence with tense encounters, including with a priggish aunt (Marion Bailey) who has managed to become middle-class and a blithering skinhead on the verge of psychosis (a scene-stealing Gary Oldman, in his first major role). Informed by Leigh’s now trademark improvisational process and propelled by the lurching rhythms of its Beckett-like dialogue, Meantime is an unrelenting, often blisteringly funny look at life on the dole.

hook: 通过《饥饿》，英国电影制作人和艺术家史蒂夫·麦奎因将历史上最具争议的政治反抗行为之一变成了令人震惊、难忘的电影体验。 1981 年，在北爱尔兰的梅兹监狱，27 岁的爱尔兰共和军成员鲍比·桑兹绝食抗议英国政府拒绝承认他和他的爱尔兰共和军囚犯为政治犯。麦奎因以一种纯粹体验性甚至抽象的方式戏剧化地描述了监狱的存在和桑兹的最后几天，一系列充满美丽和恐怖的图像。 《饥饿》以迈克尔·法斯宾德的精彩表演为特色，毫不畏缩、超然地描绘了人类愿意忍受的痛苦。
hook_en: With Hunger, British filmmaker and artist Steve McQueen has turned one of history’s most controversial acts of political defiance into a jarring, unforgettable cinematic experience. In Northern Ireland’s Maze prison in 1981, twenty-seven-year-old Irish Republican Army member Bobby Sands went on a hunger strike to protest the British government’s refusal to recognize him and his fellow IRA inmates as political prisoners. McQueen dramatizes prison existence and Sands’s final days in a way that is purely experiential, even abstract, a succession of images full of both beauty and horror. Featuring an intense performance by Michael Fassbender, Hunger is an unflinching, transcendent depiction of what a human being is willing to endure to be heard.

hook: 阿兰·德龙在《紫色正午》上映时正处于他最不可思议的美丽状态，并让他瞬间成为明星。这部成熟而丰富多彩的改编自帕特里夏·海史密斯的恶毒小说《才华横溢的雷普利先生》，由多才多艺的雷内·克莱门特执导，德隆饰演汤姆·雷普利，一个在罗马的两面派美国魔术师，他的任务是把他的特权、不顾一切的熟人菲利普·格林利夫（莫里斯·罗内饰）带回美国。最初看似无忧无虑的友谊故事很快就演变成一个充满诱惑、身份盗窃和谋杀的惊心动魄的传奇故事。 《紫色正午》以意大利沿海的华丽外景摄影为特色，制作精良，既充满悬疑又色情，让德隆扮演了一生难忘的角色。
hook_en: Alain Delon was at his most impossibly beautiful when Purple Noon was released and made him an instant star. This ripe, colorful adaptation of Patricia Highsmith’s vicious novel The Talented Mr. Ripley, directed by the versatile René Clément, stars Delon as Tom Ripley, a duplicitous American charmer in Rome on a mission to bring his privileged, devil-may-care acquaintance Philippe Greenleaf (Maurice Ronet) back to the United States. What initially seems a carefree tale of friendship soon morphs into a thrilling saga of seduction, identity theft, and murder. Featuring gorgeous location photography of coastal Italy, Purple Noon is crafted with a light touch that allows it to be at once suspenseful and erotic, and it gave Delon the role of a lifetime.

hook: 这部充满活力的成长电影以​​ Who 乐队的经典摇滚歌剧《Quadrophenia》为基础，描绘了 20 世纪 60 年代初期伦敦叛逆、毒品泛滥的现代亚文化。我们的反英雄是吉米（菲尔·丹尼尔斯饰），一个对家庭、工作和爱情都不满意的青少年。他把时间花在和那些着迷于衣服、服用药物、开摩托车的摩登朋友们身上，这群人对骑摩托车的摇滚乐手的反感导致了布莱顿的一场高潮骚乱。导演弗兰克·罗丹 (Franc Roddam) 这部风格粗犷的电影是一部关于青春叛逆和动荡的典型编年史，皮特·汤申德 (Pete Townshend) 的精彩歌曲（包括《I’ve Had Enough》、《5:15》和《Love Reign O’er Me》）提供了情感支持，斯汀和雷·温斯顿也出演了早期角色。
hook_en: The Who’s classic rock opera Quadrophenia was the basis for this invigorating coming-of-age movie and depiction of the defiant, drug-fueled mod subculture of early 1960s London. Our antihero is Jimmy (Phil Daniels), a teenager dissatisfied with family, work, and love. He spends his time knocking around with his clothes-obsessed, pill-popping, scooter-driving fellow mods, a group whose antipathy for the motorcycle-riding rockers leads to a climactic riot in Brighton. Director Franc Roddam’s rough-edged film is a quintessential chronicle of youthful rebellion and turmoil, with Pete Townshend’s brilliant songs (including “I’ve Had Enough,” “5:15,” and “Love Reign O’er Me”) providing emotional support, and featuring Sting and Ray Winstone in early roles.

hook: 这部引人入胜的戏剧取材于臭名昭著的现实生活事件，克里斯蒂安·蒙吉对信仰、狂热和冷漠进行了复杂的探究。在一座荒凉的罗马尼亚修道院里，年轻的修女沃伊奇察（科斯米娜·斯特拉坦饰）与她的前同伴阿丽娜（克里斯蒂娜·弗鲁图尔饰）重聚，后者计划带她去德国。但事实证明，沃伊奇察不愿意放弃她的使命，而阿丽娜则越来越不顾一切地想要重新获得自己的奉献精神，这使得局外人与修道院的苦行牧师产生了分歧，并引发了一场痛苦的、误导性的、残酷的拯救她灵魂的尝试。 《山外》是一部带有民间故事黑暗力量的自然主义悲剧，以电影新人 Flutur 和 Stratan（两人共同获得戛纳最佳女主角奖）之间令人担忧的动态为基础，有力地见证了具有不同目的的个人和无力帮助最需要帮助的人的机构。
hook_en: With this arresting drama based on notorious real-life events, Cristian Mungiu mounts a complex inquiry into faith, fanaticism, and indifference. At a desolate Romanian monastery, a young novice nun, Voichița (Cosmina Stratan), reunites with her former companion Alina (Cristina Flutur), who plans to take her to Germany. But Voichița proves unwilling to abandon her calling, and Alina becomes increasingly desperate to reclaim her devotion, putting the outsider at odds with the monastery’s ascetic priest—and precipitating a painfully misguided, brutal attempt to save her soul. A naturalistic tragedy with the dark force of a folktale, anchored by the fraught dynamic between cinema newcomers Flutur and Stratan (who shared the best actress prize at Cannes), Beyond the Hills bears powerful witness to individuals at cross-purposes and institutions ill-equipped to help those most in need.

hook: 卢奇诺·维斯康蒂 (Luchino Visconti) 的《豹子》(Il Gattopardo) 在美国家庭视频中首次亮相，堪称一部规模宏大的史诗。这部电影以怀旧、戏剧性和华丽的方式再现了意大利复兴运动的动荡岁月——当时贵族失去了控制，中产阶级崛起并形成了一个统一、民主的意大利。伯特·兰卡斯特饰演年迈的王子，眼睁睁地看着自己的文化和财富在新一代的面前日渐式微，而新一代的代表是他暴发户的侄子（阿兰·德龙饰）和他美丽的未婚妻（克劳迪娅·卡汀娜饰）。 《豹》荣获 1963 年戛纳电影节金棕榈奖，将朱塞佩·托马西·迪·兰佩杜萨的小说及其所讲述的历史翻译成一部真正的电影杰作。 Criterion Collection 很荣幸地以两个不同的版本呈现这部电影：维斯康蒂的原始意大利语版本，以及在美国发行的新修复的特别版中的替代英语版本。
hook_en: Making its long-awaited U.S. home video debut, Luchino Visconti’s The Leopard (Il Gattopardo) is an epic on the grandest possible scale. The film recreates, with nostalgia, drama, and opulence, the tumultuous years of Italy's Risorgimento—when the aristocracy lost its grip and the middle classes rose and formed a unified, democratic Italy. Burt Lancaster stars as the aging prince watching his culture and fortune wane in the face of a new generation, represented by his upstart nephew (Alain Delon) and his beautiful fiancée (Claudia Cardinale). Awarded the Palme d’Or at the 1963 Cannes Film Festival, The Leopard translates Giuseppe Tomasi di Lampedusa's novel, and the history it recounts, into a truly cinematic masterpiece. The Criterion Collection is proud to present the film in two distinct versions: Visconti’s original Italian version, and the alternate English-language version released in America in a newly restored special edition.

hook: 一位道德指南针摇摇欲坠的好莱坞制片厂高管（蒂姆·罗宾斯饰）发现自己陷入了犯罪境地，而在罗伯特·奥特曼这部尖刻的行业讽刺作品中，这种情况在他的电影项目中就很常见。 《玩家》根据迈克尔·托尔金的小说改编，融合了黑色电影和狡猾的内幕喜剧元素，既是一个俏皮时尚的谋杀故事，又是对其自身创作的评论，它拥有英雄配角（彼得·加拉格尔、乌比·戈德堡、格蕾塔·斯卡奇、迪恩·斯托克韦尔、弗莱德·沃德）和一系列明星客串，打造了一部令人惊叹的好莱坞名人录。这部错综复杂的盛大娱乐片（以美国电影最大胆、最受好评的开场镜头之一拉开序幕）标志着奥特曼在 20 世纪 90 年代初在商业上的成功回归。
hook_en: A Hollywood studio executive with a shaky moral compass (Tim Robbins) finds himself caught up in a criminal situation that would be right at home in one of his movie projects, in this biting industry satire from Robert Altman. Mixing elements of film noir with sly insider comedy, The Player, based on a novel by Michael Tolkin, functions as both a nifty stylish murder story and a commentary on its own making, and it is stocked with a heroic supporting cast (Peter Gallagher, Whoopi Goldberg, Greta Scacchi, Dean Stockwell, Fred Ward) and a lineup of star cameos that make for an astonishing Hollywood who’s who. This complexly woven grand entertainment (which kicks off with one of American cinema’s most audacious and acclaimed opening shots) was the film that marked Altman’s triumphant commercial comeback in the early 1990s.

hook: 这部充满动感的明朝阴谋故事，使武术电影制作艺术迈入了大胆的新领域。处决皇帝的国防部长后，一名攫取权力的太监派出刺客追踪受害者的孩子，直至中国北部边境的一个偏远地点。但这一嗜血的任务却被一群神秘的战士所困扰，他们到达现场，一心要伸张正义，保护无辜者。 《龙门客栈》是胡金铨从香港移居台湾后为寻求更多创作自由而拍摄的第一部电影，将有节奏的剪辑、细致的编舞、华丽的宽银幕构图与武侠类型中全新的精致结合在一起。它的巨大成功为经典公式注入了新的活力，并使胡锦涛成为中国电影最大胆的创新者之一。
hook_en: The art of martial-arts filmmaking took a leap into bold new territory with this action-packed tale of Ming-dynasty intrigue. After having the emperor’s minister of defense executed, a power-grabbing eunuch sends assassins to trail the victim’s children to a remote point on the northern Chinese border. But that bloodthirsty mission is confounded by a mysterious group of fighters who arrive on the scene, intent on delivering justice and defending the innocent. The first film King Hu made after moving to Taiwan from Hong Kong in search of more creative freedom, Dragon Inn (Long men kezhan) combines rhythmic editing, meticulous choreography, and gorgeous widescreen compositions with a refinement that was new to the wuxia genre. Its blockbuster success breathed new life into a classic formula and established Hu as one of Chinese cinema’s most audacious innovators.

hook: 没有哪个电影制片人能像马丁·斯科塞斯那样捕捉到纽约的宏伟和活力。凭借这段华丽的浪漫，他精心改编了另一位伟大的纽约艺术家伊迪丝·沃顿的作品，将她以镀金时代曼哈顿与世隔绝的世界为背景的悲剧小说变为现实。 《纯真年代》讲述了纽兰·阿彻（丹尼尔·戴·刘易斯饰）的故事，他与一位无辜的社交名流（薇诺娜·瑞德饰）订婚，这让他遵守了成长过程中的准则和仪式。但当她的表弟（米歇尔·菲佛饰）与丈夫分居后，带着丑闻来到镇上时，她点燃了纽兰从未知道的存在的激情。这部电影充满了精致的时代细节，对旧世界美国的残酷行为时而令人心碎，时而讽刺。
hook_en: No filmmaker captures the grandeur and energy of New York like Martin Scorsese. With this sumptuous romance, he meticulously adapted the work of another great New York artist, Edith Wharton, bringing to life her tragic novel set in the cloistered world of Gilded Age Manhattan. The Age of Innocence tells the story of Newland Archer (Daniel Day-Lewis), whose engagement to an innocent socialite (Winona Ryder) binds him to the codes and rituals of his upbringing. But when her cousin (Michelle Pfeiffer) arrives in town on a wave of scandal after separating from her husband, she ignites passions in Newland he never knew existed. Swelling with exquisite period detail, this film is an alternately heartbreaking and satirical look at the brutality of old-world America.

hook: 1966 年，米开朗基罗·安东尼奥尼 (Michelangelo Antonioni) 将他的存在主义倦怠移植到了摇摆不定的伦敦街头，拍摄了这部轰动国际的意大利电影制作人的第一部英语故事片。 《Blow-Up》是一部关于观看行为和图像制作艺术的反文化杰作，采用心理悬疑的形式，由大卫·海明斯 (David Hemmings) 饰演一位时尚摄影师，他在公园里跟踪两个恋人后，无意中在电影中捕捉到了一场死亡。安东尼奥尼一丝不苟的美学控制和令人陶醉的调色板为每一帧注入了生命力，赫比·汉考克的爵士乐声、瓦妮莎·雷德格雷夫优美的回避表演以及庭院鸟乐队的客串使这部电影成为一个来自过去时代的时光胶囊。 《Blow-Up》是对创作激情的一种诱人的沉浸，也是一部由最伟大的电影艺术家之一制作的精彩电影。
hook_en: In 1966, Michelangelo Antonioni transplanted his existentialist ennui to the streets of swinging London for this international sensation, the Italian filmmaker’s first English-language feature. A countercultural masterpiece about the act of seeing and the art of image making, Blow-Up takes the form of a psychological mystery, starring David Hemmings as a fashion photographer who unknowingly captures a death on film after following two lovers in a park. Antonioni’s meticulous aesthetic control and intoxicating color palette breathe life into every frame, and the jazzy sounds of Herbie Hancock, a beautifully evasive performance by Vanessa Redgrave, and a cameo by the Yardbirds make the film a transporting time capsule from a bygone era. Blow-Up is a seductive immersion into creative passion, and a brilliant film by one of cinema’s greatest artists.

hook: 1974 年，莱昂·加斯特 (Leon Gast) 前往非洲拍摄《扎伊尔 74》(Zaïre 74) 音乐节，该音乐节计划与史无前例的体育盛会“丛林之战”一起举办，在这场比赛中，职业生涯晚期的失败者穆罕默德·阿里 (Muhammad Ali) 将与年轻的拳王乔治·福尔曼 (George Foreman) 争夺拳击重量级冠军头衔——正如金沙萨的一块广告牌所说，“一场黑人国家中两个黑人之间的战斗，由黑人组织”。当主要赛事被推迟，延长了阿里在非洲的停留时间时，加斯特最终收集了宝贵的镜头，观察这位极具魅力的运动员为他职业生涯中最艰难的一场比赛之一进行训练，同时沉浸在自己作为美国黑人驻后殖民非洲大使的角色中。经过二十年的制作，《当我们是国王》对诺曼·梅勒和乔治·普林顿进行了采访，展示了这场战斗的轰动影响，完善了阿里的奥斯卡奖获奖肖像，捕捉了他的魅力、优雅和反抗。
hook_en: In 1974, Leon Gast traveled to Africa to film Zaïre 74, a music festival planned to accompany an unprecedented sports spectacle: the Rumble in the Jungle, in which late-career underdog Muhammad Ali would contend with the younger powerhouse George Foreman for the boxing heavyweight championship title—“a fight between two blacks in a black nation, organized by blacks,” as a Kinshasa billboard put it. When the main event was delayed, extending Ali’s stay in Africa, Gast wound up amassing a treasure trove of footage, observing the wildly charismatic athlete training for one of the toughest bouts of his career while basking in his role as black America’s proud ambassador to postcolonial Africa. Two decades in the making, When We Were Kings features interviews with Norman Mailer and George Plimpton that illustrate the sensational impact of the fight, rounding out an Academy Award–winning portrait of Ali that captures his charm, grace, and defiance.

hook: 这部由佐尔坦·科达 (Zoltán Korda) 执导的彩色特效片被认为是对 A. E. W. 梅森 (A. E. W. Mason) 1902 年关于大英帝国在非洲的冒险故事的经典冒险小说进行的众多改编中的最佳作品，也是亚历山大·科达 (Alexander Korda) 传奇制作公司伦敦电影公司 (London Films) 的最高成就。 《四根羽毛》以 19 世纪末为背景，讲述了一名年轻军官（约翰·克莱门茨饰）在向喀土穆进行大规模部署前夕辞职后被指控胆怯的痛苦经历；然后，他必须努力在同事（包括拉尔夫·理查森）和未婚妻（琼·杜普雷兹）眼中救赎自己。 《四根羽毛》由米克洛什·罗萨 (Miklós Rózsa) 创作音乐，由乔治·佩里纳尔 (Georges Périnal) 和奥斯蒙德·博拉戴尔 (Osmond Borradaile) 担任奥斯卡提名摄影，是一部惊心动魄、雷鸣般的史诗。
hook_en: This Technicolor spectacular, directed by Zoltán Korda, is considered the finest of the many adaptations of A. E. W. Mason’s classic 1902 adventure novel about the British empire’s exploits in Africa, and a crowning achievement of Alexander Korda’s legendary production company, London Films. Set at the end of the nineteenth century, The Four Feathers follows the travails of a young officer (John Clements) accused of cowardice after he resigns his post on the eve of a major deployment to Khartoum; he must then fight to redeem himself in the eyes of his fellow officers (including Ralph Richardson) and fiancée (June Duprez). Featuring music by Miklós Rózsa and Oscar-nominated cinematography by Georges Périnal and Osmond Borradaile, The Four Feathers is a thrilling, thunderous epic.

hook: 《隐藏的堡垒》是一场只有黑泽明才能制作的大型冒险故事，由无与伦比的三船敏郎饰演一名将军，负责保护战败家族的公主（凶猛的上原美纱饰），两人则在敌对领土上走私皇室宝藏。陪伴他们的是一对笨手笨脚、勾心斗角的农民，他们可能是也可能不是他们的朋友。这段惊心动魄的旅程是这位导演最喜爱的电影之一，对乔治·卢卡斯的《星球大战》产生了主要影响。 《隐藏的堡垒》巧妙地融合了黑泽明的标志性幽默、令人惊叹的动作和富有同情心的人性。
hook_en: A grand-scale adventure as only Akira Kurosawa could make one, The Hidden Fortress stars the inimitable Toshiro Mifune as a general charged with guarding his defeated clan’s princess (a fierce Misa Uehara) as the two smuggle royal treasure across hostile territory. Accompanying them are a pair of bumbling, conniving peasants who may or may not be their friends. This rip-roaring ride is among the director’s most beloved films and was a primary influence on George Lucas’s Star Wars. The Hidden Fortress delivers Kurosawa’s trademark deft blend of wry humor, breathtaking action, and compassionate humanity.

hook: 就在传奇电影制作人英格玛·伯格曼去世前四年，他在法罗岛的家中与瑞典纪录片导演玛丽·尼勒罗德坐在一起，讨论了他的工作、他的恐惧、他的遗憾以及他持续不断的艺术热情。这导致了这位著名的隐居导演所参与过的最令人惊叹的坦诚系列采访，后来被剪辑成长片《伯格曼岛》。尼勒罗德的电影深入、发人深省，充满了关于伯格曼作品及其个人生活的精选轶事，是对这位改变电影的人令人难忘的最后一瞥。
hook_en: Just four years before his death, legendary filmmaker Ingmar Bergman sat down with Swedish documentarian Marie Nyreröd at his home on Fårö Island to discuss his work, his fears, his regrets, and his ongoing artistic passion. This resulted in the most breathtakingly candid series of interviews that the famously reclusive director ever took part in, later edited into the feature-length film Bergman Island. In-depth, revealing, and packed with choice anecdotes about Bergman’s oeuvre, as well as his personal life, Nyreröd’s film is an unforgettable final glimpse of a man who transformed cinema.

hook: 吉列尔莫·德尔·托罗以引人入胜的方式演绎了所有现代神话中最经久不衰的神话之一——玛丽·雪莱的《弗兰肯斯坦》，为这个经典故事注入了新的人性深度，同时将其推向哥特式宏伟的耀眼高度。德尔·托罗在才华横溢但冷酷无情的维克多·弗兰肯斯坦（奥斯卡·艾萨克饰）和他从血肉中塑造出来然后残酷虐待的生物（雅各布·埃洛迪饰）的视角之间转换，动人地将这个传奇重新塑造为父子们努力摆脱创伤循环的故事。 《弗兰肯斯坦》是黑暗迷人的视觉发明和歌剧故事讲述数十年的胜利，也是多项奥斯卡奖的获得者，《弗兰肯斯坦》是一位长期被人与怪物融合的领域所吸引的导演的深刻个人宣言。
hook_en: Guillermo del Toro’s spellbinding take on one of the most enduring of all modern myths, Mary Shelley’s Frankenstein, imbues the classic tale with new depths of humanity while pushing it toward dazzling heights of gothic grandeur. Shifting between the perspectives of the brilliant but callous Victor Frankenstein (Oscar Isaac) and the creature (Jacob Elordi) he fashions from flesh and then cruelly mistreats, del Toro movingly reframes the legend as a story of fathers and sons struggling to break free from cycles of trauma. A decades-in-the-making triumph of darkly ravishing visual invention and operatic storytelling, and the winner of multiple Oscars, Frankenstein is a deeply personal statement from a director who has long been drawn to the realm where men and monsters merge.

hook: 费城侦探维吉尔·蒂布斯（西德尼·波蒂埃饰）穿过密西西比州斯巴达的偏远小镇，卷入了一起谋杀案。他与偏执的警察局长（罗德·斯泰格饰）结成了不稳定的联盟，警察局长面临着来自斯巴达敌对公民的越来越大的压力，要求他抓获凶手并将这名非裔美国闯入者赶出城镇。导演诺曼·杰维森在哈斯克尔·韦克斯勒生动的摄影、昆西·琼斯不拘一格的配乐和两场不可磨灭的主演表演的帮助下，将尖锐的社会评论融入到这部惊心动魄的警察程序中——波蒂埃的职业生涯定义性的强烈愤慨和道德权威的表现以及斯泰格的奥斯卡获奖大师级表演。 《炎热的夜晚》荣获五项奥斯卡金像奖，包括最佳影片奖，是民权时代最经久不衰的好莱坞电影之一。
hook_en: Passing through the backwoods town of Sparta, Mississippi, Philadelphia detective Virgil Tibbs (Sidney Poitier) becomes embroiled in a murder case. He forms an uneasy alliance with the bigoted police chief (Rod Steiger), who faces mounting pressure from Sparta’s hostile citizens to catch the killer and run the African American interloper out of town. Director Norman Jewison splices incisive social commentary into this thrilling police procedural with the help of Haskell Wexler’s vivid cinematography, Quincy Jones’s eclectic score, and two indelible lead performances—a career-defining display of seething indignation and moral authority from Poitier and an Oscar-winning masterclass in Method acting from Steiger. Winner of five Academy Awards, including for Best Picture, In the Heat of the Night is one of the most enduring Hollywood films of the civil rights era.

hook: 杨德昌的第二部长片是对一座夹在过去与现在之间的城市的悲惨剖析。 《台北物语》与杨的新台湾电影大师侯孝贤合作制作，讲述了在家族纺织企业工作的颓废棒球运动员（侯孝贤）和他的女友（蔡琴饰）之间日益加深的隔阂，而女友则坚持在房地产开发事业中向上流动。随着这对夫妇的结婚和移民梦想开始破灭，杨的目光照亮了家庭生活的不稳定和台湾全球化现代性的绝望。
hook_en: Edward Yang’s second feature is a mournful anatomy of a city caught between the past and the present. Made in collaboration with Yang’s fellow New Taiwan Cinema master Hou Hsiao-hsien, Taipei Story chronicles the growing estrangement between a washed-up baseball player (Hou, in a rare on-screen performance) working in his family’s textile business and his girlfriend (Tsai Chin), who clings to the upward mobility of her career in property development. As the couple’s dreams of marriage and emigration begin to unravel, Yang’s gaze illuminates the precariousness of domestic life and the desperation of Taiwan’s globalized modernity.

hook: 肖恩·贝克是当代电影界最重要的美国梦想家和阴谋家在资本主义承诺边缘挣扎的记录者，他凭借这个大胆的反灰姑娘故事达到了新的掌握高度——一部令人心痛的旋风新现实主义怪诞喜剧。在一场激动人心、明星诞生的表演中，米奇·麦迪逊 (Mikey Madison) 饰演阿诺拉 (Anora)，一位有进取心、满嘴脏话的布鲁克林色情舞者和性工作者，他的“不那么迷人的王子”以俄罗斯寡头的野孩子 (马克·艾德尔施泰因饰) 的形式出现。这是一个支离破碎的童话故事的开始——还有卡伦·卡拉古利安、尤拉·鲍里索夫和瓦切·托马斯扬的出色表演——彻底颠覆了阶级的残酷现实。阿诺拉荣获 2024 年戛纳电影节金棕榈奖，确认贝克是我们最杰出的导演之一。
hook_en: Contemporary cinema’s foremost chronicler of American dreamers and schemers hustling on the margins of capitalist promise, Sean Baker, reaches new heights of mastery with this audacious anti–Cinderella story—a whirlwind neorealist screwball comedy with an aching heart. In an electric, star-is-born performance, Mikey Madison soars as Anora, an enterprising, ferociously foulmouthed Brooklyn erotic dancer and sex worker whose Prince Not-So-Charming comes along in the form of a Russian oligarch’s wild-child son (Mark Eydelshteyn). This is the beginning of a fractured fairy tale—also featuring standout performances from Karren Karagulian, Yura Borisov, and Vache Tovmasyan—that turns the cruel realities of class inside out. Winner of the Palme d’Or at the 2024 Cannes Film Festival, Anora confirms Baker as one of our preeminent auteurs.

hook: 菲利普·考夫曼在他的电影版中，巧妙地平衡了细腻与色情，改编自米兰·昆德拉那部难以改编的小说《不能承受的生命之轻》。该片由考夫曼和让-克劳德·卡里耶改编，讲述了外科医生（丹尼尔·戴-刘易斯饰）如何挣扎于他的放荡情人（蕾娜·奥琳饰）和天真妻子（朱丽叶·比诺什饰）之间。这部私密史诗《不能承受的生命之轻》以机智、情感和毁灭性的真实揭露了人际关系的边界。
hook_en: Philip Kaufman achieves a delicate, erotic balance with his screen version of Milan Kundera’s “unfilmable” novel. Adapted by Kaufman and Jean-Claude Carrière, the film follows a womanizing surgeon (Daniel Day-Lewis) as he struggles with his free-spirited mistress (Lena Olin) and his childlike wife (Juliette Binoche). An intimate epic, The Unbearable Lightness of Being charts the frontiers of relationships with wit, emotion, and devastating honesty.

hook: 这是数字动画的巅峰之作，这种对反乌托邦未来的先见之明被包装在一个令人眼花缭乱的流行科幻爱情故事中，为我们这个陷入困境的千年创造了一个紧迫的寓言。现在是二十世纪，人类早已逃离地球前往外太空，只剩下瓦力这个最后一个能运行的垃圾压实机器人，开始清理这个污染严重的星球，一次清理一件垃圾。当他遇到 EVE（一个被派去探测植物生命的机器人同伴）时，两人踏上了星际探索之旅，将人类送回地球。 《机器人总动员》将我们带回到电影无声的起源和光年的未来，这是一首对爱和艺术治愈垂死世界的力量的高亢颂歌。
hook_en: A high-water mark of digital animation, this prescient vision of a dystopian future is packaged within a dazzling pop-science-fiction love story, making for an urgent fable for our troubled millennium. It’s the twenty-ninth century, and humans have long since fled Earth for outer space, leaving WALL•E, the last functioning trash-compacting robot, to go about the work of cleaning up a pollution-choked planet, one piece of garbage at a time. When he meets EVE, a fellow automaton sent to detect plant life, the pair are launched on an intergalactic quest to return humanity to Earth. Transporting us simultaneously back to cinema’s silent origins and light-years into the future, WALL•E is a soaring ode to the power of love and art to heal a dying world.

hook: 托德·索隆兹（Todd Solondz）的导演托德·索隆兹（Todd Solondz）对受伤的灵魂伸出援手寻求联系的描写，既令人不安又滑稽，同时又大胆地富有同情心，揭示了中产阶级郊区“常态”之下的存在主义空虚。包括菲利普·塞默·霍夫曼、简·亚当斯、拉拉·弗林·博伊尔、本·加扎拉和迪伦·贝克在内的非凡演员阵容，体现了一系列关系松散的新泽西越轨者、抑郁症患者和格格不入的人，其中包括一个沮丧的电话性爱害虫、一个隐藏恋童癖的美国父亲，以及一个有着可怕秘密的孤独女人，他们都只想要一件事：被爱。作为 20 世纪 90 年代最具争议的电影之一，《幸福》之所以令人不安，正是因为它敢于在那些最常被否认的人身上看到人性。
hook_en: As disturbingly funny as it is audaciously empathetic, auteur of unease Todd Solondz’s portrait of damaged souls reaching out for connection reveals the existential void underneath middle-class suburban “normalcy.” An extraordinary ensemble cast—including Philip Seymour Hoffman, Jane Adams, Lara Flynn Boyle, Ben Gazzara, and Dylan Baker—embodies an array of loosely connected New Jersey deviants, depressives, and misfits, among them a frustrated phone-sex pest, an all-American dad concealing his pedophilic urges, and a lonely woman with a grisly secret, all of whom want just one thing: to be loved. One of the most controversial films of the 1990s, the unflinching Happiness unnerves precisely because it dares to see the humanity in those most often denied it.

hook: 《鱿鱼和鲸鱼》以令人难以忍受的诚实记录了两个年轻兄弟在 20 世纪 80 年代布鲁克林公园坡长大的经历，他们在父母离婚的锯齿状轮廓中前行。诺亚·鲍姆巴赫广受好评的第三部长片标志着这位电影制片人的一个关键发展，他转向了越来越个人化的风格，这一举动为他赢得了奥斯卡最佳原创剧本奖提名。这部喜剧而辛酸的剧情片采用 Super 16 毫米镜头拍摄，由杰夫·丹尼尔斯、劳拉·琳妮、杰西·艾森伯格和欧文·克莱恩四人细致入微、低调地表演，充满自传元素，巧妙地捕捉了一个破裂家庭的心痛和困惑。
hook_en: With excruciating honesty, The Squid and the Whale chronicles the experiences of two young brothers growing up in 1980s Park Slope, Brooklyn, as they navigate the jagged contours of the divorce of their parents, both writers. The acclaimed third feature by Noah Baumbach marked a critical development for the filmmaker as he turned toward an increasingly personal style—a move that garnered him an Academy Award nomination for best original screenplay. Shot in Super 16 mm and featuring a quartet of nuanced, understated performances from Jeff Daniels, Laura Linney, Jesse Eisenberg, and Owen Kline, this comic and poignant drama, peppered with autobiographical elements, deftly captures the heartache and confusion of a fracturing family.

hook: 在导演艾拉·萨克斯 (Ira Sachs) 执导的这部极其原始的处女作中，种族、阶级和性取向的复杂性在孟菲斯社区内发生了碰撞。 《三角洲》以新现实主义的直接性讲述了一个乍一看似乎很简单的爱情故事：两个年轻人——未出柜的白人少年林肯（谢恩·格雷饰）和越南黑人移民明（唐灿饰）——在一个巡航地点相遇，并乘船沿着密西西比河踏上了夜间之旅。但很快，他们之间就出现了权力和特权的不平衡，影片发展成一个毁灭性的景象，讲述了迷失、受伤的灵魂在黑暗中寻求人类联系的故事。
hook_en: The complexities of race, class, and sexuality collide within a Memphis community in the strikingly raw debut feature from director Ira Sachs. With neorealist immediacy, The Delta tells what at first appears to be a simple love story: two young men—Lincoln (Shayne Gray), a closeted white teenager, and Minh (Thang Chan), a Black Vietnamese immigrant—meet at a cruising spot and embark on a nighttime journey by boat down the Mississippi River. But soon, imbalances of power and privilege emerge between them, as the film develops into a devastating vision of lost, wounded souls reaching out in the dark for human connection.

hook: 乔纳森·格雷泽的第二部长片是一部令人难忘的电影之谜，探索心灵的奥秘。妮可·基德曼演绎了精彩的多层次表演，饰演安娜，一位仍在哀悼十年前丈夫去世的寡妇，当她遇到了自称是他转世的十岁男孩肖恩（卡梅隆·布莱特饰）时，她陷入了与自己未解决的悲伤和欲望的痛苦对抗。 《诞生》以哈里斯·萨维德斯 (Harris Savides) 的绘画摄影和亚历山大·德斯普拉特 (Alexandre Desplat) 催眠般的管弦乐配乐为特色，以坚定不移的真诚演绎了其古怪的前提，对超越物质领域的爱的可能性产生了深刻的情感遐想。
hook_en: Jonathan Glazer’s second feature is a haunting cinematic enigma that explores the mysteries of the heart. Nicole Kidman delivers a masterfully multilayered performance as Anna, a widow still mourning the death of her husband a decade earlier when she meets Sean (Cameron Bright), a ten-year-old boy who claims to be his reincarnation—leading her into a wrenching confrontation with her own unresolved grief and desires. Featuring painterly cinematography by Harris Savides and a hypnotic orchestral score by Alexandre Desplat, Birth plays its outré premise with unflinching sincerity, yielding a profound emotional reverie on the possibilities of love beyond the physical realm.

hook: 成龙继《警察故事》取得巨大成功之后，又取得了更大的票房成功。陈家驹手下的单干警官家驹因其非正统的警务方法而被降职为低级交警，以示抗议。但没过多久，他又重新投入行动，争分夺秒地阻止一伙连环炸弹袭击者，并赢回他备受宠爱的女友梅（张曼玉，再次扮演明星角色）。 《警察故事 2》拥有史诗般的爆炸声、令人惊叹的 1980 年代电子配乐，以及令人惊叹的结局（将废弃仓库变成了真人大小的弹球机，其中有层叠的油桶、倒塌的脚手架和发射烟花），证实了成龙作为无与伦比的优雅和大胆表演者的地位。
hook_en: Jackie Chan followed up the massive success of Police Story with an even bigger box-office hit. Having been demoted to a lowly traffic cop for his, ahem, unorthodox policing methods, Chan’s go-it-alone officer Ka-Kui quits the force in protest. But it isn’t long before he’s back in action, racing the clock to stop a band of serial bombers and win back his much-put-upon girlfriend May (the phenomenal Maggie Cheung, reprising her star-making role). Boasting epic explosions, an awesomely 1980s electro soundtrack, and a showstopping finale—which turns an abandoned warehouse into a life-size pinball machine of cascading oil drums, collapsing scaffolds, and shooting fireworks—Police Story 2 confirmed Chan’s status as a performer of unparalleled grace and daring.

hook: 这部媒体讽刺剧由西德尼·吕美特执导，帕迪·查耶夫斯基的剧本精辟精辟，是企业主导的美​​国腐败灵魂的 X 光透视，它对当今愤怒驱动的新闻周期的预测具有惊人的先见之明。在一家陷入困境的电视网络，雄心勃勃的高管戴安娜·克里斯滕森（费·唐纳薇饰）发现自己受到了打击，因为心怀不满的新闻播音员霍华德·比尔（彼得·芬奇饰）不按剧本行事，将自己变成了一个疯狂的预言家，指责现代社会的弊病。但她能控制他们在广播中发动的民粹主义革命吗？这部无拘无束的新好莱坞经典影片获得了四项奥斯卡奖，包括唐纳薇、芬奇和查耶夫斯基，它仍然保持着无所畏惧的搞笑性和令人不安的相关性。
hook_en: This media satire, directed by Sidney Lumet from a brilliantly incisive script by Paddy Chayefsky, is an X-ray of the corrupted soul of a corporate-dominated America, startlingly prescient in its anticipation of today’s outrage-driven news cycle. At a struggling television network, ambitious executive Diana Christensen (Faye Dunaway) finds herself with a hit on her hands when disgruntled newscaster Howard Beale (Peter Finch) goes off script, transforming himself into a mad-as-hell prophet railing against the ills of modern society. But can she control the populist revolution they have unleashed on the airwaves? Garnering four Oscars, including for Dunaway, Finch, and Chayefsky, this no-holds-barred New Hollywood classic remains as fearlessly funny as it is unnervingly relevant.

hook: 科恩兄弟在这部冷静引人入胜、滑稽深刻的黑色惊悚片中窥探了原子时代的存在深渊。比利·鲍勃·松顿 (Billy Bob Thornton) 在一场精心设计的轻描淡写的表演中，饰演 20 世纪 40 年代加利福尼亚州一位心怀不满的理发师，他怀疑妻子（弗朗西斯·麦克多蒙德饰）对他不忠，导致他走上了勒索和谋杀的弯曲道路。乔尔和伊桑·科恩将表现主义的黑白和经典黑色电影的冷酷诗歌与他们自己对险恶、超现实的美国风格的独特感觉融为一体，为命运的残酷和我们在宇宙中的神秘地位创造了一个引人注目的愿景。
hook_en: The Coen brothers peer into the existential abyss of the atomic age in this coolly riveting, drolly profound noir thriller. In a performance of masterfully calibrated understatement, Billy Bob Thornton stars as a disaffected barber in 1940s California whose suspicion that his wife (Frances McDormand) is cheating on him leads him down a crooked path of blackmail and murder. Fusing the expressionistic black and white and hard-boiled poetry of classic noir with their own idiosyncratic feeling for sinister, surreal Americana, Joel and Ethan Coen craft an arresting vision of the cruelty of fate and the mystery of our place in the cosmos.

hook: 在克日什托夫·基斯洛夫斯基的《三色》三部曲的第一部电影中，朱丽叶·比诺什演绎了一场精彩的表演，她饰演的朱莉是一位因丈夫和年幼女儿的惨死而心痛不已的女人。但《蓝色》不仅仅是对悲伤的激烈研究；它也是一部关于悲伤的作品。这也是一个关于解放的故事，朱莉试图将自己从过去中解放出来，同时面对已故作曲家丈夫的生活真相。 《蓝色》由斯瓦沃米尔·伊齐亚克（Sławomir Idziak）以蓝宝石色调拍摄，并由兹比格涅夫·普雷斯纳（Zbigniew Preisner）配上非凡的歌剧配乐，给人一种压倒性的感官体验。
hook_en: Juliette Binoche gives a tour de force performance as Julie, a woman reeling from the tragic death of her husband and young daughter, in this first film from Krzysztof Kieślowski’s Three Colors trilogy. But Blue is more than just a blistering study of grief; it’s also a tale of liberation, as Julie attempts to free herself from the past while confronting truths about the life of her late husband, a composer. Shot in sapphire tones by Sławomir Idziak and set to an extraordinary operatic score by Zbigniew Preisner, Blue is an overwhelming sensory experience.

hook: 这部精彩的滑稽剧制作于音乐剧电影的早期，是当时最奢华、不拘一格、技术上最雄心勃勃的好莱坞制作之一。影片由当时被誉为“爵士乐之王”的乐队领队保罗·怀特曼 (Paul Whiteman) 主演，取材于百老汇综艺节目，呈现一系列精彩的小品、节奏男孩 (Rhythm Boys)（由年轻的宾·克罗斯比 (Bing Crosby) 主演）等表演以及管弦乐表演，所有这些都由资深戏剧导演约翰·默里·安德森 (John Murray Anderson) 精心打造。 《爵士乐之王》以最完整的形式呈现，并恢复了其早期特艺色彩的最初辉煌，为 20 世纪 30 年代初期美国主流流行文化看待自身的方式提供了精彩的快照。
hook_en: Made during the early years of the movie musical, this exuberant revue was one of the most extravagant, eclectic, and technically ambitious Hollywood productions of its day. Starring the bandleader Paul Whiteman, then widely celebrated as the King of Jazz, the film drew from Broadway variety shows to present a spectacular array of sketches, performances by such acts as the Rhythm Boys (featuring a young Bing Crosby), and orchestral numbers—all lavishly staged by veteran theater director John Murray Anderson. Presented here in the most complete form possible and restored to its original early-Technicolor glory, King of Jazz offers a fascinating snapshot of the way mainstream American popular culture viewed itself at the dawn of the 1930s.

hook: 一名巡回电影放映机修理工（吕迪格·沃格勒饰）救了一位抑郁症心理学家（汉斯·齐施勒饰）的命，后者将他的大众汽车开进了河里，他们最终一起上路，从一个德国乡村电影院到另一个电影院。一路上，两个人都在逃避自己的过去，并因共同的孤独而结下了不解之缘。 《公路之王》由电影摄影师罗比·穆勒 (Robby Müller) 以华丽的构图拍摄，献给弗里茨·朗 (Fritz Lang)，它是一封写给电影的情书，一个关于男性友谊的感人而有趣的故事，也是一个仍然饱受战争困扰的国家的写照。
hook_en: A roving film projector repairman (Rüdiger Vogler) saves the life of a depressed psychologist (Hanns Zischler) who has driven his Volkswagen into a river, and they end up on the road together, traveling from one rural German movie theater to another. Along the way, the two men, each running from his past, bond over their shared loneliness. Kings of the Road, captured in gorgeous compositions by cinematographer Robby Müller and dedicated to Fritz Lang, is a love letter to the cinema, a moving and funny tale of male friendship, and a portrait of a country still haunted by war.

hook: 香港最重要的导演之一吴宇森，把东西方类型熔成这部爆发力十足的动作杰作。香港巨星周润发饰演一个有良心的杀手；影片精微解剖腐败社会里的道德，并用慢镜头里编排精巧的枪战，点亮香港街头。
hook_en: Hong Kong’s preeminent director, John Woo, transforms genres from both the East and the West to create this explosive and masterful action film. Featuring Hong Kong’s greatest star, Chow Yun-fat, as a killer with a conscience, the film is an exquisite dissection of morals in a corrupt society, highlighted with slow-motion sequences of brilliantly choreographed gun battles on the streets of Hong Kong.

hook: 曼哈顿上城区的上班族保罗·哈克特（格里芬·邓恩饰）不顾一切地想要摆脱令人头脑麻木的日常生活，冒险前往市中心与一位神秘女子（罗姗娜·阿奎特饰）勾搭。他一生中最狂野的夜晚就这样开始了，离奇的事件——涉及地下艺术朋克、苦恼的女服务员、疯狂的索菲先生卡车司机和百吉饼和奶油奶酪镇纸——堆积起来，引发焦虑，阻碍了他回家的努力。在这部卡夫卡式的邪教经典中，马丁·斯科塞斯在迈克尔·鲍尔豪斯的动态摄影和琳达·费奥伦蒂诺、泰瑞·加尔、凯瑟琳·奥哈拉和约翰·赫德的抢镜配角的支持下，导演了一个关于错误身份的黑色喜剧故事，将 20 世纪 80 年代 SoHo 荒凉的夜晚世界变成了一个充满超现实威胁的波西米亚仙境。
hook_en: Desperate to escape his mind-numbing routine, uptown Manhattan office worker Paul Hackett (Griffin Dunne) ventures downtown for a hookup with a mystery woman (Rosanna Arquette). So begins the wildest night of his life, as bizarre occurrences—involving underground-art punks, a distressed waitress, a crazed Mister Softee truck driver, and a bagel-and-cream-cheese paperweight—pile up with anxiety-inducing relentlessness and thwart his attempts to get home. With this Kafkaesque cult classic, Martin Scorsese—abetted by Michael Ballhaus’s kinetic cinematography and scene-stealing supporting turns by Linda Fiorentino, Teri Garr, Catherine O’Hara, and John Heard—directed a darkly comic tale of mistaken identity, turning the desolate night world of 1980s SoHo into a bohemian wonderland of surreal menace.

hook: 嫉妒和暴力是这部幽闭恐惧症情节剧的中心舞台，这是一部以马尼拉贫民窟为背景的紧张的人物研究剧。利诺·布洛卡 (Lino Brocka) 精心描绘了一个天真无邪的女儿和她饱受女性蔑视的痛苦母亲的真实写照。 Insiang 过着以家务为主的平静生活，但在她被母亲的情人强奸并被自称照顾她的年轻人抛弃后，她进行了恶毒的报复。 《Insiang》是第一部在戛纳电影节上映的菲律宾电影，它对城市贫困的恶化进行了野蛮的评论，特别是对女性来说。《Insiang》由博洛尼亚电影中心/L'Immagine Ritrovata 修复。修复工作由电影基金会的世界电影项目和菲律宾电影发展委员会资助。
hook_en: Jealousy and violence take center stage in this claustrophobic melo­drama, a tautly constructed character study set in the slums of Manila. Lino Brocka crafts an eviscerating portrait of an innocent daughter and her bitter mother as women scorned. Insiang leads a quiet life dominated by household duties, but after she is raped by her mother’s lover and abandoned by the young man who claims to care for her, she exacts vicious revenge. A savage commentary on the degradations of urban poverty, especially for women, Insiang was the first Philippine film ever to play at Cannes.Insiang was restored by the Cineteca di Bologna/ L’Immagine Ritrovata. Restoration funded by The Film Foundation’s World Cinema Project and the Film Development Council of the Philippines.

hook: 《白色》是克日什托夫·基斯洛夫斯基的《三色》三部曲中最有趣也是最坚韧的电影，讲述了居住在法国的波兰移民卡罗尔·卡罗尔（兹比格涅夫·扎马霍夫斯基饰）的冒险故事。当他的妻子（朱莉·德尔佩饰）起诉他离婚（她的理由是：他们的婚姻从未圆房）时，这位倒霉的理发师选择离开巴黎前往他的家乡华沙，然后在纵火焚烧自己的沙龙后诬陷他纵火。这部电影继续记录了卡罗尔·卡罗尔精心策划的复仇情节，既是一部关于东欧和西欧经济不平等的令人发痒的黑色喜剧，也是对扭曲爱情的崇高遐想。
hook_en: The most playful and also the grittiest film of Krzysztof Kieślowski’s Three Colors trilogy, White follows the adventures of Karol Karol (Zbigniew Zamachowski), a Polish immigrant living in France. The hapless hairdresser opts to leave Paris for his native Warsaw when his wife (Julie Delpy) sues him for divorce (her reason: their marriage was never consummated) and then frames him for arson after setting her own salon ablaze. The film, which goes on to chronicle Karol Karol’s elaborate revenge plot, manages to be both a ticklish dark comedy about the economic inequalities of Eastern and Western Europe and a sublime reverie on twisted love.

hook: pulp小说家霍莉·马辛特来到阴暗的二战后维也纳，只为了调查他一个老朋友神秘死亡的真相，调查对象是一位黑市投机者哈利·利姆。从这里开始，这部传奇故事讲述了爱、欺骗和谋杀。多亏了约瑟夫·科特恩、阿丽达·瓦利和奥森·威尔斯的精彩表演；安东尼奥·卡拉斯感人的竖琴配乐；格雷姆·格林犀利的对话；以及罗伯特·克拉克对光影的戏剧性运用，《第三个人》由不凡的Carol Reed导演，随着时间的推移，这部影片的声望只增不减。
hook_en: Pulp novelist Holly Martins travels to shadowy, postwar Vienna, only to find himself investigating the mysterious death of an old friend, black-market opportunist Harry Lime—and thus begins this legendary tale of love, deception, and murder. Thanks to brilliant performances by Joseph Cotten, Alida Valli, and Orson Welles; Anton Karas's evocative zither score; Graham Greene’s razor-sharp dialogue; and Robert Krasker’s dramatic use of light and shadow, The Third Man, directed by the inimitable Carol Reed, only grows in stature as the years pass.

hook: 24 岁的路易斯·马勒 (Louis Malle) 在他的长片处女作中汇集了让娜·莫罗 (Jeanne Moreau) 令人着迷的表演、亨利·德卡 (Henri Decaë) 令人回味的摄影以及迈尔斯·戴维斯 (Miles Davis) 的传奇爵士乐配乐。马勒这部气氛浓郁的犯罪惊悚片发生在巴黎一个不安宁的夜晚，莫罗和莫里斯·罗内饰演一对恋人，他们谋杀丈夫（他的老板）的计划出了差错，引发了一系列事件，决定了他们的命运。作为导演和女明星的职业试金石，《绞刑架的电梯》是马勒不拘一格的作品的一个惊人的开始，它使莫罗成为银幕上最迷人的演员之一。
hook_en: For his feature debut, twenty-four-year-old Louis Malle brought together a mesmerizing performance by Jeanne Moreau, evocative cinematography by Henri Decaë, and a now legendary jazz score by Miles Davis. Taking place over the course of one restless Paris night, Malle’s richly atmospheric crime thriller stars Moreau and Maurice Ronet as lovers whose plan to murder her husband (his boss) goes awry, setting off a chain of events that seals their fate. A career touchstone for its director and female star, Elevator to the Gallows was an astonishing beginning to Malle’s eclectic body of work, and it established Moreau as one of the most captivating actors ever to grace the screen.

hook: 由迈克尔·西米诺执导的《天堂之门》令人惊叹地描绘了美国西部扩张的希望和危险，是好莱坞最雄心勃勃、最非正统的史诗片之一。克里斯·克里斯托弗森 (Kris Kristofferson) 将他饱经风霜的性感演绎为一名哈佛毕业生，搬到怀俄明州担任联邦元帅；在那里，他得知牛群大亨策划了一项得到政府批准的阴谋，他们为了夺取该地区的欧洲定居者的土地而杀害他们。由此产生的战斗取材于现实生活中 1892 年血腥的约翰逊县战争。《天堂之门》同样由伊莎贝尔·于佩尔和克里斯托弗·沃肯主演，是一部野蛮而迷人的西部电影故事。该版本呈现了完整的导演剪辑版，让今天的观众可以看到西米诺强有力的原创愿景。
hook_en: A breathtaking depiction of the promise and perils of America’s western expansion, Heaven’s Gate, directed by Michael Cimino, is among Hollywood’s most ambitious and unorthodox epics. Kris Kristofferson brings his weathered sensuality to the role of a Harvard graduate who relocates to Wyoming as a federal marshal; there, he learns of a government-sanctioned plot by cattle barons to kill the area’s European settlers for their land. The resulting battle is based on the bloody real-life Johnson County War of 1892. Also starring Isabelle Huppert and Christopher Walken, Heaven’s Gate is a savage and ravishingly shot take on western movie lore. This release presents the full director’s cut, letting viewers today see Cimino’s potent original vision.

hook: 表现主义的黑色摄影以噩梦般的品质充斥着David Lean的Oliver Twist ，适合其凄凉的工业环境。在狄更斯的经典故事中，一个孤儿从残酷的学徒生涯走向小偷的巢穴，寻找真正的家园。在这里，亚历克·吉尼斯（ Alec Guinness ）是典型的费金（ Fagin ） ，他在Criterion的数字传输中完全恢复了他备受争议的表现。
hook_en: Expressionistic noir photography suffuses David Lean’s Oliver Twist with a nightmarish quality, fitting its bleak, industrial setting. In Dickens’ classic tale, an orphan wends his way from cruel apprenticeship to den of thieves in search of a true home. Here Alec Guinness is the quintessential Fagin, his controversial performance fully restored in Criterion’s digital transfer.

hook: 1912年4月14日临近午夜，“不沉”的泰坦尼克号撞上冰山。不到三小时，它沉入海底，带走两千二百名乘客中的一千五百余人。罗伊·沃德·贝克根据沃尔特·洛德同名著作，以克制、敬畏与悲剧感描绘船的最后时刻。表演极为收敛，《难忘的一夜》是这部二十世纪巨灾在银幕上最细腻、也最好的演绎。
hook_en: On April 14, 1912, just before midnight, the “unsinkable” Titanic struck an iceberg. In less than three hours, it had plunged to the bottom of the sea, taking with it more than 1,500 of its 2,200 passengers. In his unforgettable rendering of Walter Lord’s book of the same name, the acclaimed British director Roy Ward Baker depicts with sensitivity, awe, and a fine sense of tragedy the ship’s last hours. Featuring remarkably restrained performances, A Night to Remember is cinema’s subtlest and best dramatization of this monumental twentieth-century catastrophe.

hook: 著名导演陈凯歌在这部关于激情、命运和艺术超越可能性的华丽传奇故事中，在社会动荡的大背景下展开了一段令人惊叹的亲密浪漫故事。 《霸王别姬》跨越了二十世纪中国五十年的历史，讲述了有抱负的演员程蝶衣（令人心碎的张国荣饰）和段小楼（张丰毅饰）从童年的残酷训练中脱颖而出，成为京剧明星的故事，生活反映了艺术，蝶衣对小楼的单恋和国家不断变化的政治潮流将他们卷入了自己的嫉妒和背叛的个人悲剧。第一部获得金棕榈奖的中国电影是最高水准的史诗电影制作——从视觉到情感，从画面到精致的画面都令人着迷。
hook_en: A breathtakingly intimate romance unfolds against a sweeping backdrop of social upheaval in renowned director Chen Kaige’s sumptuous saga of passion, fate, and the transcendent possi­bilities of art. Spanning fifty years of twentieth-century Chinese history, Farewell My Concubine follows aspiring actors Cheng Dieyi (a heartbreaking Leslie Cheung) and Duan Xiaolou (Zhang Fengyi) as they emerge from a childhood of brutal training to become Beijing-opera stars, with life mirroring art as Dieyi’s unrequited love for Xiaolou and the country’s changing political tides engulf them in their own personal tragedies of jealousy and betrayal. The first Chinese film to win the Palme d’Or is epic filmmaking of the highest order—visually and emotionally ravishing from frame to exquisite frame.

hook: 《红色》是对命运和机遇的炽热沉思，以宏大的方式结束了克日什托夫·基斯洛夫斯基的《三色》三部曲。艾琳·雅各布 (Irène Jacob) 在日内瓦饰演一位心灵甜美却忧郁的时装模特，她的生活与让·路易斯·特林蒂尼昂 (Jean-Louis Trintignant) 饰演的一位痛苦的退休法官的生活戏剧性地交织在一起。与此同时，就在街上，一个看似无关的嫉妒和背叛的故事正在展开。 《红色》是对伪造关系的深入观察，也是一位杰出电影制片人在其权力巅峰时期的精彩最后陈述。
hook_en: An incandescent meditation on fate and chance, Red closes Krzysztof Kieślowski’s Three Colors trilogy in grand fashion. Irène Jacob stars as a sweet-souled yet somber runway model in Geneva whose life dramatically intersects with that of a bitter retired judge, played by Jean‑Louis Trintignant. Meanwhile, just down the street, a seemingly unrelated story of jealousy and betrayal unfolds. Red is an intimate look at forged connections and a splendid final statement from a remarkable filmmaker at the height of his powers.

hook: 这部关于失踪及其后果的感性而引人注目的编年史让导演彼得·威尔（ Peter Weir ）登上了舞台，并帮助开创了澳大利亚电影的新时代。根据琼·林赛（ Joan Lindsay ） 1967年著名的小说《悬崖上的野餐》（ Picnic at Hanging Rock ） ，故事发生在二十世纪之交，讲述了一小群来自一所全女子大学的学生在圣瓦伦丁节郊游时消失的故事。与其说是一个谜，不如说是一次…
hook_en: This sensual and striking chronicle of a disappearance and its aftermath put director Peter Weir on the map and helped usher in a new era of Australian cinema. Based on an acclaimed 1967 novel by Joan Lindsay, Picnic at Hanging Rock is set at the turn of the twentieth century and concerns a small group of students from an all-female college who vanish, along with a chaperone, while on a St. Valentine’s Day outing. Less a mystery than a journey into the mystic, as well as an inquiry into issues of class and sexual repression in Australian society, Weir’s gorgeous, disquieting film is a work of poetic horror whose secrets haunt viewers to this day.

hook: Spinal Tap 已被认作英格兰最吵、也最守时的乐队。在这部传奇假纪录片《摇滚万岁》（现经精美修复）里，奈杰尔·塔夫内尔（克里斯托弗·盖斯特）、大卫·圣哈宾斯（迈克尔·麦基恩）与德里克·斯莫尔斯（哈里·希勒）踏上最后一次美国巡演，导演马蒂·迪贝尔吉（罗伯·莱纳）记下所有糗事、创作摩擦、日益稀少的观众，以及倒霉的鼓手。《摇滚万岁》把迪贝尔吉精彩的纪实风格，开到十一！
hook_en: Spinal Tap has come to be recognized as England’s loudest and most punctual band. In the legendary rockumentary This Is Spinal Tap, now beautifully restored, Nigel Tufnel (Christopher Guest), David St. Hubbins (Michael McKean), and Derek Smalls (Harry Shearer) embark on their final American tour, with filmmaker Marty DiBergi (Rob Reiner) capturing all the mishaps, creative tensions, dwindling crowds, and ill-fated drummers. This Is Spinal Tap takes DiBergi’s brilliant vérité style and turns it up to eleven!

hook: 布莱恩·德·帕尔玛凭借这部精湛的露骨色情惊悚片跻身美国悬疑电影制作的最高行列。 《盛装杀人》既幽默又恐怖，讲述了曼哈顿一名妇女被残忍谋杀的故事，以及她的精神科医生、她聪明的十几岁的儿子和目击犯罪的妓女如何试图拼凑出凶手仍然逍遥法外时发生的事情。凭借其精心制作的恐怖场景、性感的摄影作品和充满激情的配乐，《盛装杀人》是一部名副其实的恐怖交响曲，安吉·迪金森、迈克尔·凯恩和南希·艾伦的生动表演增强了这一点。
hook_en: Brian De Palma ascended to the highest ranks of American suspense filmmaking with this virtuoso, explicit erotic thriller. At once tongue in cheek and scary as hell, Dressed to Kill revolves around the grisly murder of a woman in Manhattan and how her psychiatrist, her brainiac teenage son, and the prostitute who witnessed the crime try to piece together what happened while the killer remains at large. With its masterfully executed scenes of horror, voluptuous camera work, and passionate score, Dressed to Kill is a veritable symphony of terror, enhanced by vivid performances by Angie Dickinson, Michael Caine, and Nancy Allen.

hook: 马丁·斯科塞斯的《基督的最后诱惑》，起初引发了巨大的争议，但如今这部影片可以被视为一部杰出的、深刻而个人的信仰作品。这部电影耗时十五年，改编自尼科斯·卡赞卡斯的里程碑式小说，想象了一种不同的耶稣基督的命运。该片有威尔·史密斯、芭芭拉·赫舍、哈维·凯特、哈利·丹尼斯·斯坦顿和大卫·鲍伊的精彩表演；有著名摄影师迈克尔·巴尔霍斯大胆的摄影；还有彼得·盖尔布的超凡配乐。
hook_en: The Last Temptation of Christ, by Martin Scorsese, is a towering achievement. Though it initially engendered enormous controversy, the film can now be viewed as the remarkable, profoundly personal work of faith that it is. This fifteen-year labor of love, an adaptation of Nikos Kazantzakis’s landmark novel that imagines an alternate fate for Jesus Christ, features outstanding performances by Willem Dafoe, Barbara Hershey, Harvey Keitel, Harry Dean Stanton, and David Bowie; bold cinematography by the great Michael Ballhaus; and a transcendent score by Peter Gabriel.

hook: 几十年来，约翰·沃特斯通过地下挑衅突破了低俗品味的界限，凭借这部富有感染力的不敬摇滚灵魂乐喜剧，在主流社会取得了令人惊讶的成功。那是 1962 年，唯一比蓬松的发型更重要的是席卷全国的流行舞蹈热潮。当巴尔的摩青少年特雷西·特恩布拉德（瑞奇·莱克饰）在当地电视舞会上一举成名时，她的激进自信和对种族融合的支持发起了一场席卷这座城市的运动。沃特斯在《发胶》中与无与伦比的神圣人物共同主演了一个极其有趣的双重角色，他发现沃特斯将他的疯狂颠覆性情感与新发现的泡泡糖甜蜜结合在一起，这可能是他最难以抗拒的电影。
hook_en: After decades of pushing the boundaries of bad taste with his underground provocations, John Waters found surprising mainstream success with this infectiously irreverent rock-and-soul comedy. It’s 1962, and the only things bigger than the bouffant hairdos are the popular dance crazes sweeping the nation. When Baltimore teen Tracy Turnblad (Ricki Lake) shoots to stardom on a local TV dance party, her radical self-confidence and support for racial integration launch a movement that takes the city by storm. Costarring the inimitable Divine in a fiercely funny double role, Hairspray finds Waters marrying his wildly subversive sensibility with a newfound bubblegum sweetness for what may be his most irresistible film.

hook: 这部双管齐下的《重庆森林》是 20 世纪 90 年代电影的标志性作品之一，也使王家卫一举成为偶像。两名被前恋人抛弃的心痛的香港警察（金城武和梁朝伟饰）在午夜快车外卖摊前相遇，空灵的精灵女服务员菲（王菲饰）在那里工作。王家卫的精彩拍摄和完全出人意料的魅力，一切都在其中，这巩固了华丽明星的性感魅力，并将菠萝罐头和妈妈和爸爸的“加州梦”永远变成了浪漫渴望的象征。
hook_en: The whiplash, double-pronged Chungking Express is one of the defining works of 1990s cinema and the film that made Wong Kar Wai an instant icon. Two heartsick Hong Kong cops (Takeshi Kaneshiro and Tony Leung Chiu Wai), both jilted by ex-lovers, cross paths at the Midnight Express take-out food stand, where the ethereal pixie waitress Faye (Faye Wong) works. Anything goes in Wong’s gloriously shot and utterly unexpected charmer, which cemented the sex appeal of its gorgeous stars and forever turned canned pineapple and the Mamas & the Papas’ “California Dreamin’ ” into tokens of romantic longing.

hook: 这部由罗曼·波兰斯基执导的多次荣获奥斯卡奖的影片是对托马斯·哈代的《德伯家的苔丝》的精妙、层次丰富的改编。一位意志坚强的农家女孩（娜塔莎·金斯基饰）被父亲派往当地一些贵族的庄园，利用他们家族出身的谣言。这次命运攸关的访问开启了一部关于性、阶级、背叛和复仇的史诗般的叙事，波兰斯基以深思熟虑和技巧将其展开。 《苔丝》由两位世界级电影摄影师杰弗里·昂斯沃斯（《歌舞表演》）和吉斯兰·克洛凯（奥·哈萨德·巴尔萨扎）打造，具有朴实的视觉质感，是一部充满田园之美和生动故事的作品。
hook_en: This multiple-Oscar-winning film by Roman Polanski is an exquisite, richly layered adaptation of Thomas Hardy’s Tess of the d’Urbervilles. A strong-willed peasant girl (Nastassja Kinski, in a gorgeous breakthrough) is sent by her father to the estate of some local aristocrats to capitalize on a rumor that their families are from the same line. This fateful visit commences an epic narrative of sex, class, betrayal, and revenge, which Polanski unfolds with deliberation and finesse. With its earthy visual textures, achieved by two world-class cinematographers—Geoffrey Unsworth (Cabaret) and Ghislain Cloquet (Au hasard Balthazar)—Tess is a work of great pastoral beauty as well as vivid storytelling.

hook: 当她最好的朋友兼室友苏珊（梅兰妮·梅隆饰）突然搬出去结婚时，她试图成为一名艺术家，同时在曼哈顿上西区担任成人礼摄影师以维持收支平衡，却发现自己在生活和爱情中都漂泊不定。 《女朋友》是克劳迪娅·威尔（克劳迪娅·威尔，1981 年以导演身份进入美国电影艺术与科学学院时，是仅有的四位获得此殊荣的女性之一）创造的美国独立电影奇迹，它对女性关系进行了极其真实的描绘，已成为整个子类型的电影和电视节目制作者的试金石，这些电影和电视节目讲述了年轻女性试图在大城市取得成功的故事。这本 1970 年代纽约时间胶囊以讽刺的幽默和令人耳目一新的坦率捕捉了女性生活和人际关系的复杂性和矛盾。
hook_en: When her best friend and roommate abruptly moves out to get married, Susan (Melanie Mayron), trying to be an artist while making ends meet as a bar mitzvah photographer on Manhattan’s Upper West Side, finds herself adrift in both life and love. A wonder of American independent cinema by Claudia Weill (who, when she was admitted to the Academy of Motion Picture Arts and Sciences as a director in 1981, was one of only four women ever to have received that honor), Girlfriends is a remarkably authentic vision of female relationships that has become a touchstone for makers of an entire subgenre of films and television shows about young women trying to make it in the big city. This 1970s New York time capsule captures the complexities and contradictions of women’s lives and relationships with wry humor and refreshing frankness.

hook: 编剧兼导演迈克·李 (Mike Leigh) 是一位观察纯真人性的专家，通过对塑造我们关系的大大小小的欺骗行为的探索，他的表现力和复杂性达到了新的水平。当小时候被收养的黑人验光师霍滕斯（玛丽安·让-巴蒂斯特饰）开始寻找自己的生母时，她没想到这会导致她找到辛西娅（布伦达·布莱斯，戛纳电影节最佳女演员奖获得者），一个孤独的白人工厂工人，她尝试拥抱失散多年的女儿，给她本已脆弱的家庭带来了冲击。 《秘密与谎言》诞生于强大演员阵容的艰苦排练和即兴创作过程中，是一部获得金棕榈奖的杰作，它展现了持续的紧张和宣泄，揭露了日常生活中的情感断层。
hook_en: An expert observer of unembellished humanity, writer-director Mike Leigh reached new levels of expressive power and intricacy with this exploration of the deceptions, small and large, that shape our relationships. When Hortense (Marianne Jean-Baptiste), a Black optometrist who was adopted as a child, begins the search for her birth mother, she doesn’t expect that it will lead her to Cynthia (Brenda Blethyn, winner of the Cannes Film Festival’s best actress award), a lonely white factory worker whose tentative embrace of her long-lost daughter sends shock waves through the rest of her already fragile family. Born from a painstaking process of rehearsal and improvisation with a powerhouse ensemble cast, Secrets & Lies is a Palme d’Or–winning tour de force of sustained tension and catharsis that lays bare the emotional fault lines running beneath everyday lives.

hook: 这部非凡的、有争议的、极其宽松的改编自彼得罗尼乌斯尼禄统治时期写的古典罗马讽刺作品的作品，费德里科·费里尼的职业生涯达到了新的古怪和辉煌水平。费里尼的《萨蒂里孔》讲述了两个泛性恋年轻人——英俊的学者恩科皮乌斯和他粗俗、贪得无厌的朋友阿斯克图斯——在一片自由形式的异教放纵的风景中的故事，其中包括性放荡、不敬虔的暴力和引人注​​目的怪诞。费里尼通过精湛的控制创造了明显的混乱，构建了一个感觉像科幻小说的奇怪的旧世界。
hook_en: Federico Fellini’s career achieved new levels of eccentricity and brilliance with this remarkable, controversial, extremely loose adaptation of Petronius’s classical Roman satire, written during the reign of Nero. An episodic barrage of sexual licentiousness, godless violence, and eye-catching grotesquerie, Fellini Satyricon follows the exploits of two pansexual young men—the handsome scholar Encolpius and his vulgar, insatiably lusty friend Ascyltus—as they move through a landscape of free-form pagan excess. Creating apparent chaos with exquisite control, Fellini constructs a weird old world that feels like science fiction.

hook: 迈克尔·鲍伊尔将英国电影带入了奇幻和想象的崇高领域，而在这部 groundbreaking 的 meta-cinematic 调查恐惧机制的开创性作品中，他转向了痴迷、窥探和暴力。摄影师兼导演马克·李（卡尔·鲍伊姆饰）手持他的杀手相机，杀害女性并记录她们的死亡——直到他爱上楼下的邻居，发现自己陷入了与内心黑暗冲动的斗争。这部在上映时受到厌恶，但后来被重新评价为杰作的《窥视者》，仍然令人震惊，它敢于让观众面对银幕上的暴力关系。
hook_en: Having brought British cinema into exalted realms of fantasy and imagination, Michael Powell took a dark detour into obsession, voyeurism, and violence with this groundbreaking metacinematic investigation into the mechanics of fear. Armed with his killer camera, photographer and filmmaker Mark Lewis (Carl Boehm) unleashes the traumas of his childhood by murdering women and recording their deaths—until he falls for his downstairs neighbor, and finds himself struggling against his dark compulsions. Received with revulsion upon its release only to be reclaimed as a masterpiece, the endlessly analyzed, still-shocking Peeping Tom dares viewers to confront their own relationship to the violence on-screen.

hook: 维姆·文德斯凭借《美国朋友》向混乱的好莱坞黑色电影致敬，该片改编自帕特里夏·海史密斯的小说《雷普利的游戏》。丹尼斯·霍珀饰演一名不道德的美国艺术品经销商，他将布鲁诺·甘茨饰演的身患绝症的德国普通人卷入肮脏的黑社会，为个人的轻视进行报复，但当两人卷入一场不断深化的谋杀阴谋时，他们形成了一种意想不到的联系。文德斯的这部国际大片在汉堡和巴黎取景，部分场景在肮脏的七十年代末纽约拍摄，是一部融合了西德和美国电影风格的精简犯罪故事，电影制作人让·厄斯塔什、塞缪尔·富勒和尼古拉斯·雷也在片中客串。
hook_en: Wim Wenders pays loving homage to rough-and-tumble Hollywood film noir with The American Friend, a loose adaptation of Patricia Highsmith’s novel Ripley’s Game. Dennis Hopper oozes quirky menace as an amoral American art dealer who entangles a terminally ill German everyman, played by Bruno Ganz, in a seedy criminal underworld as revenge for a personal slight—but when the two become embroiled in an ever-deepening murder plot, they form an unlikely bond. Filmed on location in Hamburg and Paris, with some scenes shot in grimy, late-seventies New York City, Wenders’s international breakout is a stripped-down crime story that mixes West German and American film flavors, and it features cameos by filmmakers Jean Eustache, Samuel Fuller, and Nicholas Ray.

hook: 比尔·福赛思凭借这部令人愉悦的古怪文化冲突喜剧让苏格兰电影名声大噪。 《本地英雄》取材于苏格兰生活和民间传说的流行表现，讲述了得克萨斯州石油公司高管麦克（彼得·里格特饰）的故事，他被他的疯子老板（伯特·兰卡斯特饰）派往苏格兰一个偏远的海滨村庄，奉命买下该镇并开发该地区的炼油厂。但当工作与娱乐融为一体时，麦克发现自己被风景如画的社区和古怪的居民所吸引，而德克萨斯州开始感觉非常遥远。在这部迷人的邪教热门作品中，充满了不间断的滑稽俏皮话和面无表情的笑料，福赛斯以现代普雷斯顿·斯特奇斯的讽刺神韵审视小镇生活的特质，并对保护、企业贪婪和我们留下的遗产进行了狡猾的评论。
hook_en: Bill Forsyth put Scottish cinema on the map with this delightfully eccentric culture-clash comedy. Riffing on popular representations of Scottish life and folklore, Local Hero follows the Texas oil executive Mac (Peter Riegert), who is dispatched by his crackpot boss (Burt Lancaster) to a remote seaside village in Scotland with orders to buy out the town and develop the region for an oil refinery. But as business mixes with pleasure, Mac finds himself enchanted by both the picturesque community and its oddball denizens—and Texas starts to feel awfully far away. Packed with a near nonstop stream of droll one-liners and deadpan gags, this enchanting cult hit finds Forsyth surveying the idiosyncrasies of small-town life with the satirical verve of a latter-day Preston Sturges, arriving at a sly commentary on conservation, corporate greed, and the legacies we leave behind.

hook: 史蒂芬·弗雷尔斯 (Stephen Frears) 处于 20 世纪 80 年代中期英国电影复兴的最前沿，而令人愉悦的突破性作品《我美丽的自助洗衣店》是他这一时期最伟大的胜利。弗雷尔斯的剧本由即将成为国际知名作家的哈尼夫·库雷什 (Hanif Kureishi) 编写，剧本层次丰富，讲述了一个不寻常的爱情故事，故事发生在一位年轻的南伦敦巴基斯坦男子（戈登·沃内克饰）和他儿时的朋友光头党（丹尼尔·戴·刘易斯饰）之间，前者决定开一家高档自助洗衣店，让家人感到自豪，后者自愿帮助他的梦想成为现实。这部文化冲突喜剧也是社会现实主义的颠覆性作品，敢于解决玛格丽特·撒切尔治下的英国的种族主义、恐同症和社会政治边缘化问题。
hook_en: Stephen Frears was at the forefront of the British cinematic revival of the mid-1980s, and the delightfully transgressive My Beautiful Laundrette is his greatest triumph of the period. Working from a richly layered script by Hanif Kureishi, who was soon to be an internationally renowned writer, Frears tells an uncommon love story that takes place between a young South London Pakistani man (Gordon Warnecke), who decides to open an upscale laundromat to make his family proud, and his childhood friend, a skinhead (Daniel Day-Lewis, in a breakthrough role) who volunteers to help make his dream a reality. This culture-clash comedy is also a subversive work of social realism that dares to address racism, homophobia, and sociopolitical marginalization in Margaret Thatcher’s England.

hook: 约阿希姆·特里尔（Joachim Trier）是当代电影界最伟大的人文主义者之一，他挖掘了国家和个人的历史和记忆层，为这部丰富而难以言表的感人故事讲述了一个家庭试图接受几代人的创伤和治愈的故事。母亲去世后，两姐妹必须面对关系疏远的父亲、著名电影制片人古斯塔夫·博格（斯特兰·斯卡斯加德饰）返回挪威的家。以演员诺拉（雷纳特·雷因斯维饰）为例，他希望通过让她出演自己的新电影来重新建立联系——这个项目既造成了新的伤口，又重新揭开了旧的伤口。特里尔的电影拥有包括英加·伊布斯多特·利利亚斯（Inga Ibsdotter Lilleaas）（在一场突破性表演中）和艾丽·范宁（Elle Fanning）在内的大师级演员阵容，巧妙地平衡了幽默和伤害的每个时刻，对过去在现在的回响以及艺术如何将痛苦转化为宣泄进行了令人惊叹的情感探索。
hook_en: Joachim Trier, one of contemporary cinema’s great humanists, excavates layers of history and memory—both national and personal—for this rich, ineffably moving story of one family’s attempts to come to terms with generations of trauma and healing. After the death of their mother, two sisters must contend with the return home to Norway of their estranged father, celebrated filmmaker Gustav Borg (Stellan Skarsgård). In the case of Nora (Renate Reinsve), an actor, he hopes to reconnect by casting her in his new film—a project that both inflicts fresh wounds and reopens old ones. With a virtuoso ensemble cast that also includes Inga Ibsdotter Lilleaas (in a breakout performance) and Elle Fanning, Trier’s film delicately balances each moment of humor and hurt, conducting a stunning emotional exploration of how the past echoes in the present and art can transform pain into catharsis.

hook: Merchant Ivory Productions 由导演 James Ivory 和制片人 Ismail Merchant 领导，凭借《看得见风景的房间》成为家喻户晓的名字，这是他们根据 E. M. Forster 小说改编的第一部非凡作品。十九岁天真无邪的海伦娜·伯翰·卡特 (Helena Bonham Carter) 饰演露西·霍尼彻奇 (Lucy Honeychurch)，她是一位年轻、思想独立、爱德华时代的上流社会女性，她正试图理清自己正在萌芽的浪漫感情，她在佛罗伦萨度假时遇到了一个神秘的自由精神者（朱利安·桑兹饰），而在回到更紧身的萨里时，她与她订婚了。这部风趣、性感、精致的艺术巨片拥有出色的配角阵容——包括西蒙·卡洛、朱迪·丹奇、丹霍姆·艾略特和玛吉·史密斯——并且仍然是智慧浪漫电影的试金石。
hook_en: Merchant Ivory Productions, led by director James Ivory and producer Ismail Merchant, became a household name with A Room with a View, the first of their extraordinary adaptations of E. M. Forster novels. A cherubic nineteen-year-old Helena Bonham Carter plays Lucy Honeychurch, a young, independent- minded, upper-class Edwardian woman who is trying to sort out her burgeoning romantic feelings, divided between an enigmatic free spirit (Julian Sands) she meets on vacation in Florence and the priggish bookworm (Daniel Day-Lewis) to whom she becomes engaged back in the more corseted Surrey. Funny, sexy, and sophisticated, this gargantuan art-house hit features a sublime supporting cast–including Simon Callow, Judi Dench, Denholm Elliott, and Maggie Smith–and remains a touchstone of intelligent romantic cinema.

hook: 特立独行的导演彼得·博格丹诺维奇在这部深受喜爱、轻松有趣的电影编年史中，深情地再现了 1930 年代沙尘暴的世界，讲述了电影中最不可思议的犯罪狂潮之一。现实生活中的瑞安和塔图姆·奥尼尔（塔图姆·奥尼尔，因其火花塞般的表演而成为史上最年轻的奥斯卡奖得主）父女以近乎音乐般的敏捷性互相较量，饰演一名兜售圣经的骗子和落入他照顾的早熟的、刚成为孤儿的假小子，很快就与她新发现的父亲角色的骗子技巧相媲美。 《纸月亮》拥有完美的时代细节、摄影师拉斯洛·科瓦奇 (László Kovács) 的闪亮单色图像，以及令人难忘的配角（包括无与伦比的玛德琳·卡恩 (Madeline Kahn)），以诙谐、充满爱的方式描绘了两个天生的骗子在大萧条时期的美国公路旅行中的故事。
hook_en: Maverick director Peter Bogdanovich affectionately recreates the world of the 1930s Dust Bowl in this beloved, briskly entertaining chronicle of one of cinema’s unlikeliest crime sprees. Real-life father and daughter Ryan and Tatum O’Neal (who became the youngest-ever Oscar winner for her spark-plug performance) play off each other with almost musical agility as a Bible-hawking con man and the precocious, recently orphaned tomboy who falls into his care—and soon rivals her newfound father figure’s skill as a swindler.
