With period-perfect detail, glowing monochrome imagery by cinematographer László Kovács, and a memorable supporting cast (including the inimitable Madeline Kahn), Paper Moon is a witty, loving portrait of two natural-born hustlers on a road trip through Depression-era America.

hook: 在这部由萨蒂亚吉特·雷 (Satyajit Ray) 编剧和导演的心理丰富的人物研究中，孟加拉电影明星乌塔姆·库马尔 (Uttam Kumar) 利用他现实世界中的名人来扮演阿林达姆·穆克吉 (Arindam Mukherjee)，一位即将首次失败的日场偶像。当慕克吉登上前往德里领奖的连夜火车时，一名记者（莎米拉·泰戈尔饰）接近他寻求独家采访，这引发了一场对话，让演员陷入了自我审视的道路。 《英雄》将悲伤的闪回、超现实的梦境序列与火车上其他乘客悄悄透露的故事无缝地结合在一起，是世界电影界最敏锐洞察力的电影制片人之一对艺术、名誉和遗憾的优雅沉思。
hook_en: In this psychologically rich character study, written and directed by Satyajit Ray, Bengali film star Uttam Kumar draws on his real-world celebrity to play Arindam Mukherjee, a matinee idol on the brink of his first flop. When Mukherjee boards an overnight train to Delhi to accept an award, a journalist (Sharmila Tagore) approaches him seeking an exclusive interview, which initiates a conversation that sends the actor reeling down a path of self-examination. Seamlessly integrating rueful flashbacks and surreal dream sequences with the quietly revelatory stories of the train’s other passengers, The Hero is a graceful meditation on art, fame, and regret from one of world cinema’s most keenly perceptive filmmakers.

hook: 一位拘谨的商人在纽约市中心的一家油腻的勺子里遇见了一位古怪、自由奔放的女人。她提出搭车回他的办公室，结果两人在午餐时间在汽车旅馆见面——这只是一段反复无常的州际公路旅行的开始，这段旅程让两人面对面地面对了隐藏的自我。由古怪的美国导演乔纳森·戴米执导的《狂野》以杰夫·丹尼尔斯、梅兰妮·格里菲斯和雷·利奥塔的精彩配乐和电子表演为特色，既是一部古怪的喜剧惊悚片，也是一个光芒四射的不合常理的爱情故事。
hook_en: A straitlaced businessman meets a quirky, free-spirited woman at a downtown New York greasy spoon. Her offer of a ride back to his office results in a lunchtime motel rendezvous—just the beginning of a capricious interstate road trip that brings the two face-to-face with their hidden selves. Featuring a killer soundtrack and electric performances from Jeff Daniels, Melanie Griffith, and Ray Liotta, Something Wild, directed by oddball American auteur Jonathan Demme, is both a kinky comic thriller and a radiantly off-kilter love story.

hook: 冷漠的日本青少年游客、疲惫不堪的意大利寡妇和心怀不满的英国移民都聚集在梦想之城——吉姆·贾木许的《神秘列车》中的孟菲斯。这部由导演惯用的精准和智慧的故事片以幽默的方式向 Stax Records 唱片公司、Sun Studio、Graceland、Carl Perkins 的故乡，当然还有像精灵一样主持这部电影的国王致敬。 《神秘列车》是贾木许最好的电影之一，这是对美国标志性鬼城的一次醉酒而美丽的朝圣，也是对它为世界带来的音乐的赞歌。
hook_en: Aloof teenage Japanese tourists, a frazzled Italian widow, and a disgruntled British immigrant all converge in the city of dreams—which, in Mystery Train, from Jim Jarmusch, is Memphis. Made with its director’s customary precision and wit, this triptych of stories pays playful tribute to the home of Stax Records, Sun Studio, Graceland, Carl Perkins, and, of course, the King, who presides over the film like a spirit. Mystery Train is one of Jarmusch’s very best movies, a boozy and beautiful pilgrimage to an iconic American ghost town and a paean to the music it gave the world.

hook: 戈弗雷·雷吉奥 (Godfrey Reggio) 的《Koyaanisqatsi》在各方面都是一部非传统的作品，但在 1983 年上映时还是引起了轰动。这部《Qatsi 三部曲》的第一部作品以导演、电影摄影师罗恩·弗里克 (Ron Fricke) 和作曲家菲利普·格拉斯 (Philip Glass) 创作的令人惊叹的拼贴画无言地调查了北半球快速变化的环境。它将观众从一个令人瞠目结舌的景象转移到另一个令人瞠目结舌的景象，从原始自然的图像转向描绘人类对技术日益依赖的其他图像。Koyaanisqatsi 的非正统方法（包括催眠延时摄影）使其从一个真正独特的角度来看待我们的世界。
hook_en: An unconventional work in every way, Godfrey Reggio’s Koyaanisqatsi was nevertheless a sensation when it was released in 1983. This first work of The Qatsi Trilogy wordlessly surveys the rapidly changing environments of the Northern Hemisphere, in an astonishing collage created by the director, cinematographer Ron Fricke, and composer Philip Glass. It shuttles viewers from one jaw-dropping vision to the next, moving from images of untouched nature to others depicting human beings’ increasing dependence on technology Koyaanisqatsi’s heterodox methods (including hypnotic time-lapse photography) make it a look at our world from a truly unique angle.

hook: 罗曼·波兰斯基对威廉·莎士比亚的悲剧进行了毫不畏惧的暴力改编，这部悲剧发生在中世纪的苏格兰，充满了残酷的野心和谋杀，充满了勇气和戏剧性。乔恩·芬奇和弗朗西斯卡·安妮斯的表演充满了愤怒和性感，饰演一位在队伍中崛起的功勋战士和他的奋发有为的妻子，共同密谋不惜一切手段夺取王位。这个版本的《麦克白》由波兰斯基和伟大的戏剧评论家兼剧作家肯尼思·泰南共同改编，以一系列令人惊叹、荒凉的不列颠岛风景为背景拍摄，是所有莎士比亚电影中最大气、最真实的一部。
hook_en: Roman Polanski imbues his unflinchingly violent adaptation of William Shakespeare’s tragedy of ruthless ambition and murder in medieval Scotland with grit and dramatic intensity. Jon Finch and Francesca Annis give performances charged with fury and sex appeal as a decorated warrior rising through the ranks and his driven wife, scheming together to take the throne by any means. Coadapted by Polanski and the great theater critic and dramaturge Kenneth Tynan, and shot against a series of stunning, stark British Isle landscapes, this version of Macbeth is among the most atmospheric and authentic of all Shakespeare films.

hook: 在前卫和早期视频实验的荒野中度过了十年之后，让-吕克·戈达尔带着这部由明星驱动的社会评论作品重返商业电影，同时保持了挑衅性的知识分子和形式上的前沿。 《每个男人都为自己》由让-克洛德·卡里埃和安妮·玛丽·米耶维尔撰写的剧本讲述了三个人的性生活和职业生活——电视导演（雅克·杜特龙克饰）、他的前女友（娜塔莉·贝伊饰）和妓女（伊莎贝尔·于佩尔饰）——创作了一个关于工作、人际关系和自由概念的冥想故事。戈达尔说，在他职业生涯二十年的时间里，这是他的“第二部第一部电影”。
hook_en: After a decade in the wilds of avant-garde and early video experimentation, Jean-Luc Godard returned to commercial cinema with this star-driven work of social commentary, while remaining defiantly intellectual and formally cutting-edge. Every Man for Himself, featuring a script by Jean-Claude Carrière and Anne-Marie Miéville, looks at the sexual and professional lives of three people—a television director (Jacques Dutronc), his ex-girlfriend (Nathalie Baye), and a prostitute (Isabelle Huppert)—to create a meditative story about work, relationships, and the notion of freedom. Made twenty years into his career, it was, Godard said, his “second first film.”

hook: 这是导演埃尔梅克·希纳巴耶夫 (Ermek Shinarbaev) 和编剧阿纳托利·金 (Anatoli Kim) 的第三次合作，讲述了一个跨越数十年的痴迷与暴力故事，一名孩子在韩国长大，为父亲第一个孩子的死报仇。这部令人难忘的寓言研究了日常邪恶，融入了哲学和诗歌，是第一部关注中亚朝鲜族侨民的苏联电影，也是哈萨克新浪潮的奠基之作。 《复仇》严谨而复杂，将明亮的意象与创造性的叙事元素编织在一起，对创伤代代相传的方式进行了令人难忘的冥想。
hook_en: A child is raised in Korea to avenge the death of his father’s first child in this decades-spanning tale of obsession and violence, the third collaboration between director Ermek Shinarbaev and writer Anatoli Kim. A study of everyday evil infused with philosophy and poetry, this haunting allegory was the first Soviet film to look at the Korean diaspora in central Asia, and a founding work of the Kazakh New Wave. Rigorous and complex, Revenge weaves luminous imagery with inventive narrative elements in an unforgettable meditation on the way trauma is passed down through generations.

hook: 乔尔·科恩和伊桑·科恩在不合时宜的美国展开了他们职业生涯中的黑色喜剧公路之旅，这部尖锐、冷酷的新黑色电影以德克萨斯州的某个地方为背景，在那里，一位卑鄙的酒吧老板用一个杀人的想法释放了一股暴力洪流。演员 M. 埃米特·沃尔什 (M. Emmet Walsh) 扮演一名狡猾的私家侦探，身穿黄色西装，戴着牛仔帽，没有道德指南针，在整个过程中显得尤为突出，而弗兰西斯·麦克多蒙德 (Frances McDormand) 狡猾的处女秀让她走上了明星之路。科恩兄弟几十年来作品的严谨剧本和创造性风格在他们的第一部电影中全部体现出来，电影摄影师巴里·索南菲尔德 (Barry Sonnenfeld) 放弃了黑白明暗对比，转而采用霓虹灯标志和自动点唱机颜色，与卡特·伯韦尔 (Carter Burwell) 令人难忘的配乐相结合，产生了恐怖而惊心动魄的效果。 《血色简单》融合了低俗小说和低成本恐怖片的元素，为新一代重塑了黑色电影，标志着一个将改变美国独立电影界的电影制作团队的到来。
hook_en: Joel and Ethan Coen’s career-long darkly comic road trip through misfit America began with this razor-sharp, hard-boiled neonoir set somewhere in Texas, where a sleazy bar owner releases a torrent of violence with one murderous thought. Actor M. Emmet Walsh looms over the proceedings as a slippery private eye with a yellow suit, a cowboy hat, and no moral compass, and Frances McDormand’s cunning debut performance set her on the road to stardom. The tight scripting and inventive style that have marked the Coens’ work for decades are all here in their first film, in which cinematographer Barry Sonnenfeld abandons black-and-white chiaroscuro for neon signs and jukebox colors that combine with Carter Burwell’s haunting score to lurid and thrilling effect. Blending elements from pulp fiction and low-budget horror flicks, Blood Simple reinvented the film noir for a new generation, marking the arrival of a filmmaking ensemble that would transform the American independent cinema scene.

hook: 在雅克·塔蒂的《交通》中，笨手笨脚的于洛先生一如既往地穿着棕褐色雨衣，戴着破旧的棕色帽子和雨伞，走在巴黎的高速公路和小路上。在这最后一次亮相中，于洛先生被聘为一家汽车公司的设计总监，并伴随着他的新产品（一辆配备了荒谬小玩意的“露营车”）参加了阿姆斯特丹的车展。当然，那里的道路布满了现代的不幸。这部职业生涯晚期的作品巧妙地展示了这位喜剧天才在视觉搞笑方面的专业时机和侧劈技巧，以及对技术疯狂的最后一瞥。
hook_en: In Jacques Tati’s Trafic, the bumbling Monsieur Hulot, kitted out as always with tan raincoat, beaten brown hat, and umbrella, takes to Paris’s highways and byways. In this, his final outing, Hulot is employed as an auto company’s director of design, and accompanies his new product (a “camping car” outfitted with absurd gadgetry) to an auto show in Amsterdam. Naturally, the road there is paved with modern-age mishaps. This late-career delight is a masterful demonstration of the comic genius’s expert timing and sidesplitting knack for visual gags, and a bemused last look at technology run amok.

hook: 尼尔·乔丹在情感上令人惊叹的国际轰动克服了独立电影和主流电影之间的障碍，成为 20 世纪 90 年代的标志性电影之一。 《哭泣的游戏》以北爱尔兰的动乱为背景，是一部像拼图盒一样的电影，探讨了忠诚、欲望和身份等复杂问题，并追踪了两个受伤灵魂之间发展的令人担忧的关系：弗格斯（斯蒂芬·雷饰）是一位饱受愧疚折磨的前爱尔兰共和军成员，迪尔（杰伊·戴维森饰）是人质的神秘女友，其死亡困扰着他。随着这部电影从政治剧情片到黑色惊悚片再到伤痕累累的爱情片的转变，出现了一种超越类型的东西：跨越所有界限的人类联系的深刻而不可磨灭的愿景。
hook_en: Neil Jordan’s emotionally stunning international sensation overcame the barriers between independent and mainstream cinema to become one of the defining films of the 1990s. Set against the turbulence of the Troubles in Northern Ireland, The Crying Game is a puzzle box of a film, examining complex questions of loyalty, desire, and identity as it traces the fraught relationship developing between two wounded souls: Fergus (Stephen Rea), a former Irish Republican Army member tormented by guilt, and Dil (the revelatory Jaye Davidson), the enigmatic girlfriend of the hostage whose death haunts him. As the film shape-shifts from political drama to noir-tinged thriller to bruising romance, what emerges is something beyond genre: a profound and indelible vision of human connection across all boundaries.

hook: 泰伦斯·马利克对 17 世纪早期美国的独特想象是一部令人惊叹的自然之美的作品，是对自然、暴力、爱情和文明的诗意沉思。它将英国探险家约翰·史密斯（科林·法瑞尔饰）和波瓦坦本地人波卡洪塔斯（Q’orianka Kilcher 饰）会面的虚构故事重新想象为精神平等之间的浪漫田园诗，然后跟随波卡洪塔斯嫁给约翰·罗尔夫（克里斯蒂安·贝尔饰）并移居英国。凭借制作设计师杰克·菲斯克对詹姆斯敦殖民地的原始再现和伊曼纽尔·卢贝兹基精彩的自然光线摄影，《新世界》是一部具有非凡力量和技术辉煌的电影，展示了马利克的视觉和哲学力量的顶峰。
hook_en: This singular vision of early seventeenth-century America from Terrence Malick is a work of astounding elemental beauty, a poetic meditation on nature, violence, love, and civilization. It reimagines the apocryphal story of the meeting of British explorer John Smith (Colin Farrell) and Powhatan native Pocahontas (Q’orianka Kilcher, in a revelatory performance) as a romantic idyll between spiritual equals, then follows Pocahontas as she marries John Rolfe (Christian Bale) and moves to England. With production designer Jack Fisk’s raw re-creation of the Jamestown colony and Emmanuel Lubezki’s marvelous, naturally lit cinematography, The New World is a film of uncommon power and technical splendor, one that shows Malick at the height of his visual and philosophical powers.

hook: 《范妮和亚历山大的制作》以引人入胜的视角审视了杰作的创作过程。这部长篇纪录片由英格玛·伯格曼亲自执导，记录了一位电影界真正杰出人物努力实现其巅峰之作的方法。伯格曼与他的许多长期合作者——包括电影摄影师斯文·尼克维斯特和演员厄兰·约瑟夫森、古纳尔·比约恩斯特兰德和哈里特·安德森——一起工作，《范妮和亚历山大的制作》是一部诙谐而富有启发性的电影制作人肖像。
hook_en: _The Making of Fanny and Alexander_ is a fascinating look at the creation of a masterpiece. Directed by Ingmar Bergman himself, this feature-length documentary chronicles the methods of one of cinema’s true luminaries as he labors to realize his crowning production. Featuring Bergman at work with many of his longtime collaborators—including cinematographer Sven Nykvist and actors Erland Josephson, Gunnar Björnstrand, and Harriet Andersson—The Making of Fanny and Alexander is a witty and revealing portrait of a virtuoso filmmaker.

hook: 在他突破性的第二部长片中，奉俊昊以令人兴奋的颠覆性、反流派的结果打破了警察的惯例。 《谋杀回忆》改编自 20 世纪 80 年代震惊农村社区的一系列连环杀人案的真实故事，由韩国新电影偶像宋康昊饰演当地警官，他不情愿地与经验丰富的首尔侦探（金相庆饰）联手调查这些罪行，带领每个人经历了长达数年的失败和挫折的痛苦旅程，最终将他推向了生存的边缘。奉俊昊将扣人心弦的程序与军事统治下日常生活荒谬生活的生动社会肖像结合起来，塑造了一段令人难忘的黑暗之旅，从黑色喜剧讽刺开始，到与深渊的一次令人心碎的遭遇结束。
hook_en: In his breakthrough second feature, Bong Joon Ho explodes the conventions of the policier with thrillingly subversive, genre-defying results. Based on the true story of a string of serial killings that rocked a rural community in the 1980s, Memories of Murder stars New Korean Cinema icon Song Kang Ho as the local officer who reluctantly joins forces with a seasoned Seoul detective (Kim Sang Kyung) to investigate the crimes—leading each man on a wrenching, yearslong odyssey of failure and frustration that will drive him to the existential edge. Combining a gripping procedural with a vivid social portrait of the everyday absurdity of life under military rule, Bong fashions a haunting journey into ever-deepening darkness that begins as a black-comic satire and ends as a soul-shattering encounter with the abyss.

hook: 罗曼·波兰斯基继他的国际突破《水中刀》之后，又讲述了这个充满争议、令人毛骨悚然的精神病故事。凯瑟琳·德纳芙饰演卡罗尔，一位脆弱、冷漠的年轻美女，当被度假的姐姐独自留在伦敦的公寓里时，她笑得很开心。她很快就被真实和想象的幽灵所困扰，她的疯狂变得暴力、歇斯底里。由于其令人不安的细节和波兰斯基善于将幽闭空间变成情感雷区，《排斥》是一部超现实的、令人费解的个人恐怖之旅，它仍然是电影界最令人震惊的心理惊悚片之一。
hook_en: Roman Polanski followed up his international breakthrough Knife in the Water with this controversial, chilling tale of psychosis. Catherine Deneuve is Carol, a fragile, frigid young beauty cracking up in her London flat when left alone by her vacationing sister. She is soon haunted by specters real and imagined, and her insanity grows to a violent, hysterical pitch. Thanks to its disturbing detail and Polanski’s adeptness at turning claustrophobic space into an emotional minefield, Repulsion is a surreal, mind-bending odyssey into personal horror, and it remains one of cinema’s most shocking psychological thrillers.

hook: 由吕克·达内和让·皮埃尔·达内兄弟组成的比利时电影制作团队凭借《罗塞塔》引起了人们的关注，这是一部紧张的真实剧情片，讲述了一位贫穷的年轻女子努力保住工作来养活自己和她酗酒的母亲的故事。这是一个快速而简单的故事，导演以原始、富有同理心的方式呈现了罗塞塔的绝望，自始至终镜头几乎都停在她的肩膀上。许多人效仿达内家族的风格，但很少有人能与之媲美。这部凶猛的电影在戛纳电影节上大获成功，为电影制片人赢得了金棕榈奖，并为顽强的埃米莉·德奎纳赢得了最佳女演员奖。
hook_en: The Belgian filmmaking team of brothers Luc and Jean-Pierre Dardenne turned heads with Rosetta, an intense vérité drama that closely follows a poor young woman struggling to hold on to a job to support herself and her alcoholic mother. It’s a swift and simple tale made revelatory by the raw, empathetic way in which the directors render Rosetta’s desperation, keeping the camera nearly perched on her shoulder throughout. Many have copied the Dardennes’ style, but few have equaled it. This ferocious film won big at Cannes, earning the Palme d’Or for the filmmakers and the best actress prize for the indomitable Émilie Dequenne.

hook: 罗曼·波兰斯基的第一部故事片是一部精彩的心理惊悚片，许多评论家仍然认为这是他最伟大的作品。故事很简单，但人物的情感和行为的含义却很深刻。当一名年轻的搭便车者与一对夫妇一起参加周末游艇旅行时，两个男人争夺女人的注意力，心理战爆发了。一场暴风雨迫使少数船员来到甲板下，紧张气氛达到了高潮。波兰斯基通过尖锐的对话和无情的探究镜头，对恐惧、羞辱、性和攻击性进行了令人不安的研究。这部非凡的导演处女作为波兰斯基赢得了全世界的赞誉，登上了《时代》杂志的封面，并获得了他的首次奥斯卡提名。
hook_en: Roman Polanski’s first feature is a brilliant psychological thriller that many critics still consider among his greatest work. The story is simple, yet the implications of its characters’ emotions and actions are profound. When a young hitchhiker joins a couple on a weekend yacht trip, psychological warfare breaks out as the two men compete for the woman’s attention. A storm forces the small crew below deck, and tension builds to a violent climax. With stinging dialogue and a mercilessly probing camera, Polanski creates a disturbing study of fear, humiliation, sexuality, and aggression. This remarkable directorial debut won Polanski worldwide acclaim, a place on the cover of Time, and his first Oscar nomination.

hook: 两姐妹——体弱多病、知识分子埃斯特（英格丽·图林饰）和感性务实的安娜（冈内尔·林德布洛姆饰）——与安娜年幼的儿子约翰（约尔根·林德斯特伦饰）一起乘火车前往一个似乎处于战争边缘的外国。为了应对陌生的环境，姐妹俩在争夺约翰的爱的同时，却留下了自己的恶习，这样做破坏了她们仅存的关系。英格玛·伯格曼的《沉默》被认为是当今最具性挑逗性的电影之一，它展现了令人窒息的精神空虚中情感孤立的令人不安的景象。
hook_en: Two sisters—the sickly, intellectual Ester (Ingrid Thulin) and the sensual, pragmatic Anna (Gunnel Lindblom)—travel by train with Anna’s young son, Johan (Jörgen Lindström), to a foreign country that appears to be on the brink of war. Attempting to cope with their alien surroundings, each sister is left to her own vices while they vie for Johan’s affection, and in so doing sabotage what little remains of their relationship. Regarded as one of the most sexually provocative films of its day, Ingmar Bergman’s The Silence offers a disturbing vision of emotional isolation in a suffocating spiritual void.

hook: 美国当代导演迈克尔·曼的大胆艺术感性在他凭借处女作《神偷》破门而出时就已经完全形成。詹姆斯·肯恩 (James Caan) 在他最引人入胜的表演之一中饰演一名严肃、有前科的职业小偷，计划在最后一分后离开犯罪世界，但他发现逃脱并不像他希望的那么简单。 《神偷》在霓虹灯和雨水打湿的街道、火花和钢铁中寻找催眠之美，毫不费力地建立了喜怒无常的时尚、触觉方法和戏剧性，这些也定义了曼恩后来的标志性电影，如《盗火线》、《局内人》、《阿里》和《最后的莫西干人》。
hook_en: The contemporary American auteur Michael Mann’s bold artistic sensibility was already fully formed when he burst out of the gate with Thief, his debut feature. James Caan stars, in one of his most riveting performances, as a no-nonsense ex-con professional thief planning to leave the criminal world behind after one last score—but he discovers that escape is not as simple as he’d hoped. Finding hypnotic beauty in neon and rain-slick streets, sparks and steel, Thief effortlessly established the moody stylishness, tactile approach, and drama that would also define such later iconic Mann films as Heat, The Insider, Ali, and The Last of the Mohicans.

hook: 这是 20 世纪 80 年代的终极电影之旅，英国叛逆者肯·拉塞尔 (Ken Russell) 的首部好莱坞作品（由传奇编剧帕迪·查耶夫斯基 (Paddy Chayefsky) 根据他自己的小说改编）部分是致幻的怪异故事，部分是奇闻趣事的生物故事，部分是超凡脱俗的爱情故事，所有这些都在狂热的气氛中进行。当研究员埃迪·杰瑟普（威廉·赫特饰）开始将自己作为他的思维扩展心理学实验的测试对象时，这让他踏上了从人类原始过去到意识外部极限的日益危险、物质驱动的奥德赛之旅。罗素将这一切想象成一个迷幻的超新星般的外在意象，涵盖了从异教到宇宙崇高的一切，最终在思想和心灵之间爆发脑电波的战斗中达到顶峰。
hook_en: The ultimate cinematic head trip of the 1980s, British renegade Ken Russell’s first Hollywood production—adapted by the legendary screenwriter Paddy Chayefsky from his own novel—is part hallucinogenic freak-out, part gonzo creature feature, part transcendent love story, all played at a fever pitch. When researcher Eddie Jessup (William Hurt) begins using himself as a test subject for his mind-expanding psychological experiments, it sends him on an increasingly dangerous, substance-fueled odyssey from humankind’s primordial past to the outer limits of consciousness. It’s all visualized by Russell in a psychedelic supernova of out-there imagery that encompasses everything from the pagan to the cosmic sublime, culminating in a brain-wave-blasting battle between the mind and the heart.

hook: 韦斯·安德森耀眼的第二部长片，是成长故事、法国新浪潮致敬与螺丝球喜剧的等份混合。十年级的马克斯·费舍尔（杰森·舒瓦兹曼）是拉什莫尔学院课外活动最多、功课却最差的学生。他面临开除，并与可爱的一年级教师（奥利维娅·威廉姆斯）和忧郁的白手起家富翁（比尔·默瑞，获奖演出）结下意想不到的友谊。配乐是经典英伦入侵曲，《青春年少》拒绝归类，以机智、情感深度与银幕风格，捕捉青春期的痛与欢。
hook_en: The dazzling sophomore film from Wes Anderson is equal parts coming-of-age story, French New Wave homage, and screwball comedy. Tenth grader Max Fischer (Jason Schwartzman) is Rushmore Academy’s most extracurricular student—and its least scholarly. He faces expulsion and enters into unlikely friendships with both a lovely first-grade teacher (Olivia Williams) and a melancholy self-made millionaire (Bill Murray, in an award-winning performance). Set to a soundtrack of classic British Invasion tunes, Rushmore defies categorization, capturing the pain and exuberance of adolescence with wit, emotional depth, and cinematic panache.

hook: 斯坦利·克莱默继获得奥斯卡奖的《纽伦堡审判》之后，对美国的贪婪进行了发人深省的调查。啊，我们在开玩笑吗？这是一个疯狂、疯狂、疯狂、疯狂的世界，讲述了一群陌生人为了埋藏的宝藏而拼尽全力的战斗，是有史以来最粗俗的电影，由无与伦比的演员阵容表演的一系列闹剧和罗宋汤腰带的俏皮话，其中包括米尔顿·伯利、希德·凯撒、埃塞尔·默曼、米基·鲁尼、斯宾塞·屈塞、乔纳森·温特斯和一大堆其他人喜剧传奇人物。就纯粹的愚蠢程度而言，克莱默这部极不典型的电影与其他任何电影都不一样，是一部令人兴奋的愚蠢史诗。
hook_en: Stanley Kramer followed his Oscar-winning Judgment at Nuremberg with this sobering investigation of American greed. Ah, who are we kidding? It’s a Mad, Mad, Mad, Mad World, about a group of strangers fighting tooth and nail over buried treasure, is the most grandly harebrained movie ever made, a pileup of slapstick and borscht-belt-y one-liners performed by a nonpareil cast, including Milton Berle, Sid Caesar, Ethel Merman, Mickey Rooney, Spencer Tracy, Jonathan Winters, and a boatload of other playing-to-the-rafters comedy legends. For sheer scale of silliness, Kramer’s wildly uncharacteristic film is unlike any other, an exhilarating epic of tomfoolery.

hook: 萨姆·佩金帕重新定义西部片类型的周期以这首沾满血迹和灰尘的美国西部挽歌结束，这首将他的叛逆风格与宿命论的结局感结合在一起。当新任执法官帕特·加勒特（詹姆斯·柯本饰）穿越平原追踪亡命之徒比利小子（克里斯·克里斯托弗森饰）时，他们的旧日友谊被扭曲成竞争，神秘的自由理想与新兴的统治阶级秩序发生冲突——这一切都伴随着鲍勃·迪伦（他也饰演善变的阿莉亚斯饰）令人难忘的配乐。 《帕特·加勒特》和《比利小子》在这里首次以三个不同的版本呈现，也许是这位特立独行的导演最丰富、最成熟的作品，一首厌世民谣，承载着历史演变为传奇的庄严重量。
hook_en: Sam Peckinpah’s cycle of genre-redefining westerns came to a close with this blood- and dust-caked elegy for the American West, which marries his renegade style with a fatalistic sense of finality. As newly minted lawman Pat Garrett (James Coburn) stalks the outlaw Billy the Kid (Kris Kristofferson) across the plains, their old friendship is twisted into rivalry, and mythic ideals of freedom come up against an emerging ruling-class order—all to the strains of a haunting soundtrack by Bob Dylan (who also appears as the mercurial Alias). Pat Garrett and Billy the Kid—presented here for the first time in three separate versions—stands as perhaps the maverick auteur’s richest, most mature work, a world-weary ballad that bears the solemn weight of history passing into legend.

hook: 在偏远岛屿度假时，女儿卡琳（哈丽特·安德森饰）发现父亲（古纳尔·比约恩斯特兰德饰）利用她的精神分裂症来达到自己的文学目的，脆弱的家庭关系受到了考验。当她时而清醒时而清醒时，卡琳的父亲、丈夫（马克斯·冯·西多饰）和弟弟（拉尔斯·帕斯加德饰）无法阻止她陷入精神疾病的深渊。奥斯卡最佳外语片奖得主《透过黑暗的玻璃》是英格玛·伯格曼关于信仰及其丧失的三部曲中的第一部作品，展现了一个坚定的愿景，讲述了一个家庭几近崩溃的情景，以及被无形的上帝存在进一步嘲笑的饱受折磨的心灵。
hook_en: While vacationing on a remote island retreat, a family finds its fragile ties tested when daughter Karin (an astonishing Harriet Andersson) discovers her father (Gunnar Björnstrand) has been using her schizophrenia for his own literary ends. As she drifts in and out of lucidity, Karin’s father, her husband (Max von Sydow), and her younger brother (Lars Passgård) are unable to prevent her descent into the abyss of mental illness. Winner of the Academy Award for best foreign-language film, Through a Glass Darkly, the first work in Ingmar Bergman’s trilogy on faith and the loss of it, presents an unflinching vision of a family’s near disintegration and a tortured psyche further taunted by the intangibility of God’s presence.

hook: 在布莱恩·德·帕尔马精心制作的引人入胜的《井喷》中，约翰·特拉沃尔塔奉献了他最伟大的表演之一，饰演一名相信自己意外录制了一场政治暗杀的电影音效师。为了揭开真相，他寻求一名可能的犯罪目击者（南希·艾伦饰）的帮助，而这位目击者本人也可能面临危险。 《井喷》是一部与众不同的美国偏执惊悚片，其华丽的风格、错综复杂的情节、深刻的人物塑造以及对 20 世纪 80 年代早期费城的真实回忆，也是对电影制作的邪恶反思。
hook_en: In the enthralling Blow Out, brilliantly crafted by Brian De Palma, John Travolta gives one of his greatest performances, as a film sound-effects man who believes he has accidentally recorded a political assassination. To uncover the truth, he enlists the help of a possible eyewitness to the crime (Nancy Allen), who may be in danger herself. With its jolting stylistic flourishes, intricate plot, profoundly felt characterizations, and gritty evocation of early-1980s Philadelphia, Blow Out is an American paranoia thriller unlike any other, as well as a devilish reflection on moviemaking.

hook: 凭借这部突破性的电影，吉姆·贾木许成为新兴独立电影界最激动人心的声音之一，也是一位对美国最另类的事物有着浓厚兴趣的公路电影诗人。贾木许跟随无根的匈牙利移民威利（约翰·卢里饰）、他的朋友埃迪（理查德·埃德森饰）和来访的十六岁表弟伊娃（埃斯特·巴林特饰），他们从纽约下东区漂流到白雪皑皑的伊利湖和佛罗里达州单调的海滩，无论他们最终到达哪里，他们总是设法少花点钱。 《天堂怪客》的结构是由电影摄影师汤姆·迪西洛以一系列黑白主镜头蚀刻而成的小插图，是一部冷漠喜剧和完美校准的极简主义的漫不经心的杰作。
hook_en: With this breakout film, Jim Jarmusch established himself as one of the most exciting voices in the burgeoning independent-film scene, a road-movie poet with an affinity for Americana at its most offbeat. Jarmusch follows rootless Hungarian émigré Willie (John Lurie), his pal Eddie (Richard Edson), and his visiting sixteen-year-old cousin, Eva (Eszter Balint), as they drift from New York’s Lower East Side to the snowy expanses of Lake Erie and the drab beaches of Florida, always managing to make the least of wherever they end up. Structured as a series of master-shot vignettes etched in black and white by cinematographer Tom DiCillo, Stranger Than Paradise is a nonchalant masterpiece of deadpan comedy and perfectly calibrated minimalism.

hook: 吉列尔莫·德尔·托罗在《克洛诺斯》中首次亮相，讲述了一个关于不朽观念的诱惑的非常非正统的故事，这是一部吉祥而大胆的故事片。善良的古董商赫苏斯·格里斯（费德里科·鲁皮饰）偶然发现了一件圣甲虫形状的古老黄金装置，很快他就发现自己成为了它邪恶、令人上瘾的力量的拥有者和受害者，同时也是一个名叫安吉尔（朗·普尔曼饰演的粗俗而疯狂的美国人饰演）的神秘目标。 《克洛诺斯》以奇妙的化妆效果和令人难以忘怀的意象为特色，德尔·托罗因此而闻名于世，《克洛诺斯》是一部黑暗、视觉丰富、情感迷人的奇幻作品。
hook_en: Guillermo del Toro made an auspicious and audacious feature debut with Cronos, a highly unorthodox tale about the seductiveness of the idea of immortality. Kindly antiques dealer Jesús Gris (Federico Luppi) happens upon an ancient golden device in the shape of a scarab, and soon finds himself the possessor and victim of its sinister, addictive powers, as well as the target of a mysterious American named Angel (a delightfully crude and deranged Ron Perlman). Featuring marvelous makeup effects and the haunting imagery for which del Toro has become world-renowned, Cronos is a dark, visually rich, and emotionally captivating fantasy.

hook: 英格玛·伯格曼的《处女泉》荣获奥斯卡最佳外语片奖，讲述了中世纪瑞典的信仰、复仇和野蛮的悲惨故事。导演以朴素的方式讲述了处女卡琳被强奸和谋杀的故事，以及她的父亲托雷对三名凶手进行残酷报复的故事。这部电影由马克斯·冯·赛多主演，由才华横溢的斯文·尼克维斯特拍摄，影片描绘了一个在异教和基督教之间摇摇欲坠的世界，既美丽又残酷。
hook_en: Winner of the Academy Award for best foreign-language film, Ingmar Bergman’s The Virgin Spring is a harrowing tale of faith, revenge, and savagery in medieval Sweden. With austere simplicity, the director tells the story of the rape and murder of the virgin Karin, and her father Töre’s ruthless pursuit of vengeance against the three killers. Starring Max von Sydow and photographed by the brilliant Sven Nykvist, the film is both beautiful and cruel in its depiction of a world teetering between paganism and Christianity.

hook: 阿兰·德龙饰演一名刚出狱的大盗，他遇到了臭名昭著的逃犯（吉安·玛丽亚·沃隆特饰）和酗酒的前警察（伊夫·蒙当饰）。这三个不太可能的三人组在不可能的情况下策划了一场抢劫，直到一名无情的检查员和他们自己的过去决定了他们的命运。 《红圈》以其令人尊敬的反英雄、冷静大气的摄影和令人惊叹的布景，成为让-皮埃尔·梅尔维尔（Jean-Pierre Melville）的典型电影，他是模糊、内省的犯罪电影大师。
hook_en: Alain Delon plays a master thief, fresh out of prison, who crosses paths with a notorious escapee (Gian Maria Volontè) and an alcoholic ex-cop (Yves Montand). The unlikely trio plot a heist, against impossible odds, until a relentless inspector and their own pasts seal their fates. With its honorable antiheroes, coolly atmospheric cinematography, and breathtaking set pieces, Le cercle rouge is the quintessential film by Jean-Pierre Melville—the master of ambiguous, introspective crime cinema.

hook: 在凭借曲折的复仇故事《记忆碎片》而引起轰动之前，克里斯托弗·诺兰以相当的精准和巧妙制作了这部低成本的 16 毫米黑白新电影。 《追随》讲述了一位失业的年轻作家在伦敦追踪陌生人的支离破碎的故事，为诺兰的导演勇气提供了无可辩驳的证据，希望他们能为他的第一部小说提供灵感。当他的一个不知情的对象把他引向一条黑暗的犯罪道路时，他得到的比他预想的要多。凭借坚韧的美学和即时制作的氛围（许多镜头只是在街上偷来的，路人不知道），《追随》是一次令人费解的心理之旅，展示了当今最受好评的电影制片人之一的非凡开端。
hook_en: Before he became a sensation with the twisty revenge story Memento, Christopher Nolan fashioned this low-budget, 16 mm black-and-white neonoir with comparable precision and cunning. Providing irrefutable evidence of Nolan’s directorial bravura, Following is the fragmented tale of an unemployed young writer who trails strangers through London, hoping that they will provide inspiration for his first novel. He gets more than he bargained for when one of his unwitting subjects leads him down a dark criminal path. With gritty aesthetics and a made-on-the-fly vibe (many shots were simply stolen on the streets, unbeknownst to passersby), Following is a mind- bending psychological journey that shows the remarkable beginnings of one of today’s most acclaimed filmmakers.

hook: 这个令人难忘的、受歌舞伎风格影响的日本民间传说故事发生在一个偏远的山村，那里食物匮乏，按照传统，年满七十岁的公民必须被抬到楢山山顶，然后留在那里等死。故事中心的牺牲长者是奥林（田中绢代饰），她是一位高贵而尽职的女人，在她日渐减少的日子里，为她忠诚的守寡儿子和一位受人尊敬的新婚妻子争取幸福。 《楢山之歌》几乎完全在精心设计的摄影棚中拍摄，色彩绚丽，宽银幕，是一部来自日本电影黄金时代的时尚而生动的正式作品，由充满活力的木下圭介执导。
hook_en: This haunting, kabuki-inflected version of a Japanese folk legend is set in a remote mountain village where food is scarce and tradition dictates that citizens who have reached their seventieth year must be carried to the summit of Mount Narayama and left there to die. The sacrificial elder at the center of the tale is Orin (Kinuyo Tanaka), a dignified and dutiful woman who spends her dwindling days securing the happiness of her loyal widowed son with a respectable new wife. Filmed almost entirely on cunningly designed studio sets, in brilliant color and widescreen, The Ballad of Narayama is a stylish and vividly formal work from Japan’s cinematic golden age, directed by the dynamic Keisuke Kinoshita.

hook: 《卡诺亚：可耻的记忆》是墨西哥最受推崇的政治电影作品之一，它重新演绎了上映前八年发生的真实事件，当时一群城市大学员工在徒步旅行时遭到圣米格尔卡诺亚村居民的恶意攻击，这些居民被一名腐败的牧师操纵，认为旅行者是共产主义革命者。导演费利佩·卡萨尔斯采用坚韧的纪录片风格来叙述卡诺亚的事件，同时提到政治镇压的气氛，这种气氛随后导致了墨西哥城学生抗议者的屠杀。由此产生的电影是对意识形态操纵、宗教狂热和大规模暴力的大胆评论，也是对恐怖的发自内心的表达。
hook_en: One of Mexico’s most highly regarded works of political cinema, Canoa: A Shameful Memory reimagines a real-life incident that had occurred just eight years before its release, when a group of urban university employees on a hiking trip were viciously attacked by residents of the village of San Miguel Canoa who had been manipulated by a corrupt priest into believing the travelers were communist revolutionaries. Director Felipe Cazals adopts a gritty documentary style to narrate the events in Canoa while referencing the climate of political repression that would lead to the massacre of student protesters in Mexico City shortly thereafter. The resulting film is a daring commentary on ideological manipulation, religious fanaticism, and mass violence, as well as a visceral expression of horror.

hook: 在上映了 15 部获得当地好评的电影之后，喜剧《夏夜的微笑》终于为英格玛·伯格曼迎来了国际观众。在世纪之交的瑞典，四名男子和四名女子试图驾驭吸引力法则。在乡下的一个周末，女人们串通一气，在感情问题上强迫男人们动手，一路上暴露了她们的自负和不安全感。 《夏夜的微笑》充满了瑞典银幕传奇人物古纳尔·比约恩斯特兰德和哈里特·安德森的调情和尖锐的俏皮话，是电影界最伟大的色情喜剧之一。
hook_en: After fifteen films that received mostly local acclaim, the comedy Smiles of a Summer Night at last ushered in an international audience for Ingmar Bergman. In turn-of-the-century Sweden, four men and four women attempt to navigate the laws of attraction. During a weekend in the country, the women collude to force the men’s hands in matters of the heart, exposing their pretensions and insecurities along the way. Chock-full of flirtatious propositions and sharp witticisms delivered by such Swedish screen legends as Gunnar Björnstrand and Harriet Andersson, Smiles of a Summer Night is one of cinema’s great erotic comedies.

hook: 《蜘蛛女之吻》以劳尔·朱利亚和奥斯卡奖得主威廉·赫特令人难忘的表演为特色，是一部充满激进同情心的作品，大胆扩展了爱、性别和革命的概念。影片改编自反传统作家曼努埃尔·普伊格的小说，由埃克托·巴班科执导，继《皮克斯特》在国际上取得突破后，在这部电影中，朱莉娅和赫特扮演瓦伦丁和莫利纳，他们是一位激进的左翼活动家，也是一位痴迷于电影的酷儿橱窗设计师，在军事独裁统治下被一起囚禁。两人逐渐建立了联系，改变了他们理解政治、性和男性气质的方式。这部灼热的人类戏剧将原始的现实主义与莫利纳富有想象力的逃亡融为一体，融入了华丽的电影幻想，提供了嵌入更广泛的政治斗争中的个人解放的强大愿景。
hook_en: Featuring indelible performances from Raul Julia and an Academy Award–winning William Hurt, Kiss of the Spider Woman is a work of radical compassion that boldly expands notions of love, gender, and revolution. In the film—directed by Héctor Babenco following his international breakthrough with Pixote, and adapted from the novel by the iconoclastic writer Manuel Puig—Julia and Hurt play Valentin and Molina, a militant leftist activist and a queer, cinema-obsessed window dresser, imprisoned together under a repressive military dictatorship. The two gradually forge a bond that transforms the way they both understand politics, sexuality, and masculinity. Blending raw realism with Molina’s imaginative escapes into sumptuous movie fantasy, this searing human drama offers a powerful vision of personal liberation embedded within broader political struggle.

hook: 三舟敏郎（ Toshiro Mifune ）在黑泽明（ Akira Kurosawa ）节奏紧凑、构图精美的三十郎（ Sanjuro ）中大摇大摆地咆哮，以获得辉煌的漫画效果。在这部与Yojimbo相伴的狡猾作品中，疲惫不堪的武士Sanjuro帮助一群理想主义的年轻战士淘汰了他们家族的邪恶影响，并在此过程中将他们的“适当”武士形象放在耳边。与其前身相比，这款经典角色的回归是桅杆，语气不那么厚颜无耻，但同样有趣…
hook_en: Toshiro Mifune swaggers and snarls to brilliant comic effect in Akira Kurosawa’s tightly paced, beautifully composed Sanjuro. In this sly companion piece to Yojimbo, jaded samurai Sanjuro helps an idealistic group of young warriors weed out their clan’s evil influences, and in the process turns their image of a “proper” samurai on its ear. Less brazen in tone than its predecessor but equally entertaining, this classic character’s return is a masterpiece in its own right.

hook: 日本新浪潮叛逆者筱田正宏在这部震撼人心的民间恐怖奇幻作品中，用自己奢华的视觉风格改造了经典歌舞伎故事。当一个孤独的旅行者（山崎努饰）偶然发现一个偏远的、遭受干旱的村庄时，他发现自己陷入了神话、神秘和魔法的漩涡中：附近的一个池塘里住着掌握着小镇居民命运的灵魂，包括恋人明（加藤刚饰）和尤里（歌舞伎传奇人物坂东玉三郎，他也扮演统治水面的空灵公主）。 《恶魔池塘》以电子音乐先驱富田勋的合成乐曲为背景，将戏剧技巧与电影超现实主义融为一体，讲述了人类在大自然的愤怒中陷入爱与愚蠢的水生世界末日寓言。
hook_en: Japanese New Wave renegade Masahiro Shinoda transforms a classic Kabuki tale with his own extravagant visual style in this dimension-shattering folk-horror fantasia. When a lone traveler (Tsutomu Yamazaki) stumbles upon a remote, drought-stricken village, he finds himself engulfed in a whirlpool of myth, mystery, and magic: in a nearby pond reside spirits who hold the fate of the town’s inhabitants—including lovers Akira (Go Kato) and Yuri (Kabuki legend Tamasaburo Bando, who also plays the ethereal princess reigning over the water)—in their hands. Set to the swirling strains of electronic-music pioneer Isao Tomita’s synth score, Demon Pond blends theatrical artifice with cinematic surrealism for an aquatic-apocalyptic fable of human love and folly caught in the current of nature’s wrath.

hook: 这部具有启发性的纪录片从哈瓦那的街道到卡内基音乐厅的舞台，捕捉到了古巴最聪明的音乐天才被遗忘的一代，他们与世界名声的意外邂逅。这些经验丰富的歌手和乐器演奏家与美国吉他手和根音乐冠军 Ry Cooder 合作组建了 Buena Vista Social Club，演奏了爵士乐风格的恰恰恰、曼波舞、波莱罗舞和其他传统拉丁美洲风格，并录制了一张赢得格莱美奖的专辑，使他们成为国际现象。取得这一成功后，导演维姆·文德斯 (Wim Wenders) 拍摄了乐团成员（包括金嗓子易卜拉欣·费雷尔 (Ibrahim Ferrer) 和钢琴演奏家鲁本·冈萨雷斯 (Rubén González)）的一系列富有启发性的采访和现场表演。其成果是 20 世纪 90 年代最受欢迎的纪录片之一，也是对古巴革命前遗产中一个被忽视的角落的富有感染力的颂歌。
hook_en: Traveling from the streets of Havana to the stage of Carnegie Hall, this revelatory documentary captures a forgotten generation of Cuba’s brightest musical talents as they enjoy an unexpected encounter with world fame. The veteran vocalists and instru­mentalists collaborated with American guitarist and roots-music champion Ry Cooder to form the Buena Vista Social Club, playing a jazz-inflected mix of cha-cha, mambo, bolero, and other traditional Latin American styles, and recording an album that won a Grammy and made them an international phenomenon. In the wake of this success, director Wim Wenders filmed the ensemble’s members—including golden-voiced Ibrahim Ferrer and piano virtuoso Rubén González—in a series of illuminating interviews and live performances. The result is one of the most beloved documentaries of the 1990s, and an infectious ode to a neglected corner of Cuba’s prerevolutionary heritage.

hook: 暴力如诗，出自大师之手。吴宇森这部灿烂而热情的《辣手神探》，讲述倦怠警探「龙」阿耀（周润发以克制的怒火出演）的故事。他穿过三合会、卧底与疯狂突袭的眩晕旅程，在令人窒息的医院长镜头里登顶。这不只是警察抓坏蛋，《辣手神探》不断以独创与黑色幽默让人吃惊。
hook_en: Violence as poetry, rendered by a master—brilliant and passionate, John Woo’s Hard Boiled tells the story of jaded detective “Tequila” Yuen (played with controlled fury by Chow Yun-fat). Woo’s dizzying odyssey through the world of Hong Kong Triads, undercover agents, and frenzied police raids culminates unforgettably in the breathless hospital sequence. More than a cops-and-bad-guys story, Hard Boiled continually startles with its originality and dark humor.

hook: 这部精心策划的影片融合了坚韧的犯罪片、揪心的母性情节剧和曼波音乐剧，是墨西哥电影黄金时代的瑰宝，为标志性明星尼农·塞维利亚带来了一场令人眼花缭乱的展示。她为自己扮演的伦贝拉（一名夜总会女舞者）角色带来了强烈的魅力和火热的力量，她放弃了一切来抚养一个被遗弃的男孩，她必须保护他免受他无情的黑帮父亲的侵害。 《罪恶的受害者》由电影制作巨头埃米利奥·费尔南德斯以令人眼花缭乱的节奏执导，由著名电影摄影师加布里埃尔·菲格罗亚以时尚的明暗对比方式在烟雾缭绕的舞厅和肮脏的黑社会出没的地方拍摄，是一部由女性主导的、充满娱乐性的黑​​色电影，伴随着拉丁美洲一些最具传奇色彩的音乐明星令人陶醉的节奏。
hook_en: A treasure of Mexico’s cinematic golden age, this deliriously plotted blend of gritty crime film, heart-tugging maternal melodrama, and mambo musical is a dazzling showcase for iconic star Ninón Sevilla. She brings fierce charisma and fiery strength to her role as a rumbera—a female nightclub dancer—who gives up everything to raise an abandoned boy, whom she must protect from his ruthless gangster father. Directed at a dizzying pace by filmmaking titan Emilio Fernández, and shot in stylish chiaroscuro by renowned cinematographer Gabriel Figueroa amid smoky dance halls and atmospherically seedy underworld haunts, Victims of Sin is a ferociously entertaining female-powered noir pulsing with the intoxicating rhythms of some of Latin America’s most legendary musical stars.

hook: 日本导演伊丹十三三执导的这部令人兴奋的“拉面西部片”讲述了一群古怪的烹饪浪人指导面馆老板的遗孀寻找完美食谱的故事，这是一部有趣的、跨类型的冒险片，巧妙地讽刺了社会习俗如何扭曲人类最自然的欲望——我们的胃口。坦波波（宫本信子饰）和朋友们的努力让她的咖啡馆取得了成功，再加上美食家黑帮的色情事业和高雅和低俗的饮食文化的一瞥，甜蜜、性感和超现实的坦波波是对营养感官享受的一场慷慨的赞歌，也是有史以来电影中最令人垂涎​​欲滴的食物例子之一。
hook_en: The tale of an eccentric band of culinary ronin who guide the widow of a noodle-shop owner on her quest for the perfect recipe, this rapturous “ramen western” by Japanese director Juzo Itami is an entertaining, genre-bending adventure underpinned by a deft satire of the way social conventions distort the most natural of human urges—our appetites. Interspersing the efforts of Tampopo (Nobuko Miyamoto) and friends to make her café a success with the erotic exploits of a gastronome gangster and glimpses of food culture both high and low, the sweet, sexy, and surreal Tampopo is a lavishly inclusive paean to the sensual joys of nourishment, and one of the most mouthwatering examples of food on film ever made.

hook: 荣获奥斯卡奖的《巴贝特的盛宴》既是对艺术创作的振奋人心的赞歌，也是对神圣恩典的微妙唤起，也是一部关于食物的终极电影，是深受人们喜爱的电影瑰宝。该片由加布里埃尔·阿克塞尔执导，改编自伊萨克·迪内森的小说，讲述了一位有着神秘过去的法国女管家的故事，她以一顿精致的大餐的形式，为 19 世纪末丹麦一群虔诚的村民带来了悄然的革命。 《巴贝特的盛宴》将质朴与崇敬结合在一起，对感官愉悦的描述令人难以形容，就像上等香槟一样冲入你的脑海。
hook_en: At once a rousing paean to artistic creation, a delicate evocation of divine grace, and the ultimate film about food, the Oscar-winning Babette’s Feast is a deeply beloved treasure of cinema. Directed by Gabriel Axel and adapted from a story by Isak Dinesen, it is the lovingly layered tale of a French housekeeper with a mysterious past who brings quiet revolution in the form of one exquisite meal to a circle of starkly pious villagers in late nineteenth-century Denmark. Babette’s Feast combines earthiness and reverence in an indescribably moving depiction of sensual pleasure that goes to your head like fine champagne.

hook: 在黑暗时代英格兰的污秽之中，一条可怕的龙在这片土地上徘徊，给可疑的布鲁诺王国投下了恐怖的阴影。除了丹尼斯·库珀（迈克尔·佩林饰）这个可爱又无知的乡巴佬，他偶然出现在现场并扮演了勇敢骑士的角色，谁应该成为唯一可能的救世主呢？特里·吉列姆首次以独立导演身份亮相，灵感源自刘易斯·卡罗尔的诗《Jabberwocky》，是在吉列姆作为标志性喜剧剧团巨蟒剧团成员获得成功后拍摄的，展示了他对喜剧废话的喜爱，演员阵容中充满了深受喜爱的英国角色演员。 《贾伯沃基》在血液和粪便中令人眼花缭乱地嬉戏，仍然是电影制片人对社会疯狂的最喧闹的想象之一。
hook_en: Amid the filth and muck of England in the Dark Ages, a fearsome dragon stalks the land, casting a shadow of terror upon the kingdom of Bruno the Questionable. Who should emerge as the only possible savior but Dennis Cooper (Michael Palin), an endearingly witless bumpkin who stumbles onto the scene and is flung into the role of brave knight? Terry Gilliam’s first outing as a solo director—inspired by Lewis Carroll’s poem “Jabberwocky” and made following Gilliam’s success as a member of the iconic comedy troupe Monty Python—showcases his delight in comic nonsense, with a cast chock-full of beloved British character actors. A giddy romp through blood and excrement, Jabberwocky remains one of the filmmaker’s most uproarious visions of society gone berserk.

hook: 通过这个充满激情的项目，编剧兼制片人兼导演马丁·罗森出色地实现了人们认为几乎不可能的任务：将理查德·亚当斯的经典英国反乌托邦小说忠实地搬上大银幕，讲述了一群兔子受到现代力量可怕威胁的故事。凭借其自然主义的手绘动画、梦幻般的表现主义风格、华丽的田园背景设计以及约翰·赫特、拉尔夫·理查森、理查德·布赖尔斯和丹霍姆·埃利奥特等英国一流演员的优雅配音，《沃特希普坠落》是一部扣人心弦、暗色调的关于政治动荡中的自由的寓言。
hook_en: With this passion project, screenwriter-producer-director Martin Rosen brilliantly achieved what had been thought nearly impossible: a faithful big-screen adaptation of Richard Adams’s classic British dystopian novel about a community of rabbits under terrible threat from modern forces. With its naturalistic hand-drawn animation, dreamily expressionistic touches, gorgeously bucolic background design, and elegant voice work from such superb English actors as John Hurt, Ralph Richardson, Richard Briers, and Denholm Elliott, Watership Down is an emotionally arresting, dark-toned allegory about freedom amid political turmoil.

hook: 无与伦比的三船俊郎（ Toshiro Mifune ）在黑泽明（ Akira Kurosawa ）的视觉震撼和黑暗漫画Yojimbo中扮演主角。为了摆脱恐怖村庄的腐败，狡猾的武士三十郎为了自己的利益，在两个邪恶家族之间进行了一场范围战争。由塞尔吉奥·莱昂内（ Sergio Leone ）和沃尔特·希尔（ Walter Hill ）两次重拍，这部令人振奋的流派电影仍然是有史以来最具影响力和娱乐性的电影之一。
hook_en: The incomparable Toshiro Mifune stars in Akira Kurosawa’s visually stunning and darkly comic Yojimbo. To rid a terror-stricken village of corruption, wily masterless samurai Sanjuro turns a range war between two evil clans to his own advantage. Remade twice, by Sergio Leone and Walter Hill, this exhilarating genre-twister remains one of the most influential and entertaining films of all time.

hook: 导演罗伯特·哈默执导的极其搞笑的《善良的心与皇冠》是伊林工作室最伟大的成就之一，也是有史以来最邪恶的黑色喜剧之一。丹尼斯·普莱斯饰演一位心怀怨恨的年轻平民，决心通过继承家族的爵位来为母亲不公正地剥夺继承权报仇。不幸的是，在他能够做到这一点之前，必须消灭由无与伦比的亚历克·吉尼斯扮演的八个亲戚。
hook_en: Director Robert Hamer’s fiendishly funny Kind Hearts and Coronets stands as one of Ealing Studios’ greatest triumphs, and one of the most wickedly black comedies ever made. Dennis Price is sublime as an embittered young commoner determined to avenge his mother’s unjust disinheritance by ascending to her family’s dukedom. Unfortunately, eight relatives, all played by the incomparable Alec Guinness, must be eliminated before he can do so.

hook: 曼·雷 (Man Ray) 旋转的超现实主义梦想是 20 年代前卫电影的顶峰，融合了神秘主题、黑暗色情和有趣的抽象。这四部短片——《回归理性》、《Emak bakia》、《L'étoile de mer》和《Les mystères du château du dé》似乎是从无意识的领域中摘录出来的，展现了这位富有远见的艺术家正在尝试蒙太奇、叠加、扭曲，甚至将物体直接应用到赛璐珞上的无限可能性。这些电影诗以吉姆·贾木许与卡特·洛根合作的 SQÜRL 的空灵配乐为背景，就像视觉上的嘉年华游乐设施，每个诱人的画面都令人惊喜、愉悦和不安。
hook_en: The swirling surrealist dreams of Man Ray are high-water marks of 1920s avant-garde cinema, a nexus of cryptic themes, dark eroticism, and playful abstraction. Seemingly plucked from an unconscious realm, these four shorts—Le retour à la raison, Emak bakia, L’étoile de mer, and Les mystères du château du dé—find the visionary artist experimenting with the limitless possibilities of montage, superimposition, distortion, and even the application of objects directly onto celluloid. Set here to an ethereal score by the Jim Jarmusch–Carter Logan collaboration SQÜRL, these cine-poems are optical carnival rides that surprise, delight, and unsettle with each tantalizing frame.

hook: 在大岛渚执导的这部引人入胜、歪曲二战的剧情片中，大卫·鲍伊 (David Bowie) 庄重地扮演了塞利尔斯 (Celliers)，一名被日本人关押为战俘的英国军官。摇滚明星坂本龙一（也是本片催眠配乐的创作者）扮演集中营指挥官，迷恋神秘的金发少校，而汤姆·康蒂扮演英国中校劳伦斯，试图弥合俘虏和囚犯之间的情感和语言鸿沟。演员兼导演北野武首次出演戏剧角色《圣诞快乐劳伦斯先生》是一部多层次、残酷、时而色情的文化冲突故事，也是大岛最成功的作品之一。
hook_en: In this captivating, skewed World War II drama from Nagisa Oshima, David Bowie regally embodies Celliers, a British officer interned by the Japanese as a POW. Rock star Ryuichi Sakamoto (who also composed this film’s hypnotic score) plays the camp commander, obsessed with the mysterious blond major, while Tom Conti is the British lieutenant colonel Lawrence, who tries to bridge the emotional and language divides between captor and prisoner. Also featuring actor-director Takeshi Kitano in his first dramatic role, Merry Christmas Mr. Lawrence is a multilayered, brutal, at times erotic tale of culture clash, and one of Oshima’s greatest successes.

hook: 当一个军阀死后，一个农盗被要求冒充他，然后发现自己被军阀的精神和他自己的野心所困扰。在他已故的彩色杰作《影武者》中，黑泽明回归了武士电影以及他职业生涯的一个主要主题——幻觉与现实之间的游戏。黑泽明华丽地再现了封建日本的辉煌和战争的壮丽，创作了一部历史史诗，同时也是对权力本质的思考。
hook_en: When a warlord dies, a peasant thief is called upon to impersonate him, and then finds himself haunted by the warlord’s spirit as well as his own ambitions. In his late color masterpiece Kagemusha, Akira Kurosawa returns to the samurai film and to a primary theme of his career—the play between illusion and reality. Sumptuously reconstructing the splendor of feudal Japan and the pageantry of war, Kurosawa creates a historical epic that is also a meditation on the nature of power.

hook: 当随和的准小说家佐格（让-休斯·安格拉德饰）在阳光炙烤的法国海滨小镇遇见暴躁的贝蒂（贝阿特丽斯·达勒饰）时，旋风般的爱情就此拉开序幕，两人背弃了传统社会，转而追求自由、冒险和肉欲的享乐主义。但随着越来越不稳定的贝蒂对现实的掌控开始动摇，佐格发现自己愿意做一些他从未想过的事情，以保护她脆弱的理智和他们脆弱的共同存在。让-雅克·贝内克斯的这部艺术大片改编自菲利普·吉安 (Philippe Djian) 的热门小说《37°2 le matin》，在此以导演剪辑版的形式呈现，这是一场性感、疯狂、倾斜的浪漫之旅，燃烧着全心全意的爱情的激情和超越理性的热情。
hook_en: When the easygoing would-be novelist Zorg (Jean-Hugues Anglade) meets the tempestuous Betty (Béatrice Dalle, in a magnetic breakout performance) in a sunbaked French beach town, it’s the beginning of a whirlwind love affair that sees the pair turn their backs on conventional society in favor of the hedonistic pursuit of freedom, adventure, and carnal pleasure. But as the increasingly erratic Betty’s grip on reality begins to falter, Zorg finds himself willing to do things he never expected to protect both her fragile sanity and their tenuous existence together. Adapted from the hit novel 37°2 le matin by Philippe Djian, Jean-Jacques Beineix’s art-house smash—presented here in its extended director’s cut—is a sexy, crazy, careening joyride of a romance that burns with the passion and beyond-reason fervor of all-consuming love.

hook: 韦斯·安德森 (Wes Anderson) 将他的冷幽默和视觉创意带入这部以两次世界大战期间欧洲旧世界辉煌为背景的精彩惊悚片中。在富丽堂皇的布达佩斯大饭店，礼宾 M. 古斯塔夫（拉尔夫·费因斯饰）和他年轻的门徒零（托尼·雷沃罗里饰）结下了坚定的纽带，因为他们卷入了一场涉及文艺复兴时期无价画作失窃和巨额家族财富争夺战的阴谋之中，而在他们周围，政治动荡席卷了整个欧洲大陆。 《布达佩斯大饭店》经过精心设计，是一部令人窒息的流浪汉，是对友谊和消失世界的壮丽的一首凄美赞歌，由包括 F. Murray Abraham、阿德里安·布罗迪、西尔莎·罗南、威廉·达福、裘德·洛、哈维·凯特尔、杰夫·高布伦、马蒂厄·阿马立克、蒂尔达·斯文顿和比尔·默里在内的全明星乐团精彩演绎。
hook_en: Wes Anderson brings his dry wit and visual inventiveness to this exquisite caper set amid the old-world splendor of Europe between the world wars. At the opulent Grand Budapest Hotel, the concierge M. Gustave (Ralph Fiennes) and his young protégé Zero (Tony Revolori) forge a steadfast bond as they are swept up in a scheme involving the theft of a priceless Renaissance painting and the battle for an enormous family fortune—while around them, political upheaval consumes the continent. Meticulously designed, The Grand Budapest Hotel is a breathless picaresque and a poignant paean to friendship and the grandeur of a vanished world, performed with panache by an all-star ensemble that includes F. Murray Abraham, Adrien Brody, Saoirse Ronan, Willem Dafoe, Jude Law, Harvey Keitel, Jeff Goldblum, Mathieu Amalric, Tilda Swinton, and Bill Murray.

hook: 对于伊朗导演阿巴斯·基亚罗斯塔米的最后一部电影，他给自己提出了一个挑战：在电影制作人和摄影师的工作之间建立对话，将他一生致力于的两种艺术形式联系起来。基亚罗斯塔米着手重建照片拍摄前后的瞬间，他选择了二十四张静态图像——其中大多数都是只有觅食的鸟类和其他野生动物栖息的荒凉景观——并用数字动画将每张图像制作成自己微妙演变的四分半钟的小插曲，创造了一系列关于运动、感知和时间的深刻研究。 《24 帧》是对图像制作过程的持续思考，是世界电影巨人之一优雅而哀伤的告别。
hook_en: For what would prove to be his final film, Iranian director Abbas Kiarostami gave himself a challenge: to create a dialogue between his work as a filmmaker and his work as a photographer, bridging the two art forms to which he had dedicated his life. Setting out to reconstruct the moments immediately before and after a photograph is taken, Kiarostami selected twenty-four still images—most of them stark landscapes inhabited only by foraging birds and other wildlife—and digitally animated each one into its own subtly evolving four-and-a-half-minute vignette, creating a series of poignant studies in movement, perception, and time. A sustained meditation on the process of image making, 24 Frames is a graceful and elegiac farewell from one of the giants of world cinema.

hook: 尽管与深爱的海伦娜幸福地结婚，并期待与她生下第二个孩子，但彻头彻尾的资产阶级高管弗雷德里克却无法将每天看到的迷人的巴黎女人从他的脑海中抹去。他的调情和幻想一直无害，直到克洛伊出现在他的办公室，克洛伊是一位大胆、无拘无束的旧情人，由令人着迷的佐佐扮演。 《午后之爱》是埃里克·侯麦《六个道德故事》中明亮的最后一章，是一部温柔、发人深省、完全成人的故事，它可能导致了整个系列中最激动人心的时刻。
hook_en: Though happily married to the adoring Hélène and expecting a second child with her, the thoroughly bourgeois executive Frédéric cannot banish from his mind the attractive Paris women he sees every day. His flirtations and fantasies remain harmless until the appearance at his office of Chloé, an audacious, unencumbered old flame played by the mesmerizing Zouzou. Love in the Afternoon, the luminous final chapter in Eric Rohmer’s Six Moral Tales, is a tender, sobering, and wholly adult affair that leads to perhaps the most overwhelmingly emotional moment in the entire series.

hook: 人死后还有爱吗？尖刻的普通人阿尔伯特·布鲁克斯在这部极其温暖且富有想象力的存在主义奇幻作品中担任编剧、导演和主演，在讽刺性的讽刺和浪漫喜剧的魅力之间找到了完美的平衡。不幸的广告主管丹尼尔·米勒（布鲁克斯饰）突然去世后，发现自己身处审判城，这是一个闪闪发光的中转站，新死者必须证明他们的生活有足够的勇气来推进他们的宇宙之旅。当自我怀疑的丹尼尔努力证明自己的观点时，与不羁的朱莉娅（梅丽尔·斯特里普饰）的萌芽关系为他提供了终于感受到自己活着的机会。在雷普·汤恩、李·格兰特和巴克·亨利等完美配角的支持下，《捍卫你的生命》是一部罕见的个人哲学电影制作壮举，同时又具有非凡的娱乐性。
hook_en: Is there love after death? Acerbic everyman Albert Brooks finds a perfect balance between satirical bite and romantic-comedy charm as the writer, director, and star of this wonderfully warm and imaginative existential fantasy. After he dies suddenly, the hapless advertising executive Daniel Miller (Brooks) finds himself in Judgment City, a gleaming way station where the newly deceased must prove they lived a life of sufficient courage to advance in their journey through the universe. As the self-doubting Daniel struggles to make his case, a budding relationship with the uninhibited Julia (Meryl Streep) offers him a chance to finally feel alive. Buoyed by a pitch-perfect supporting cast that includes Rip Torn, Lee Grant, and Buck Henry, Defending Your Life is a rare feat of personal, philosophical filmmaking that happens to also be divinely entertaining.

hook: 格蕾塔·葛韦格饰演的弗朗西斯容光焕发，她是一位生活在当代纽约的二十多岁的女人，她正在努力解决自己的抱负、财务状况，以及最重要的是，她与最好的朋友苏菲（米基·萨姆纳饰）之间亲密但不断变化的关系。诺亚·鲍姆巴赫 (Noah Baumbach) 精心执导，其轻松自在的氛围让人想起法国新浪潮最充满活力的电影，鲍姆巴赫 (Baumbach) 和葛韦格 (Gerwig) 编剧，轻松地将甜蜜与机智融为一体，弗朗西斯·哈 (Frances Ha) 既感受到了年轻时的挫败感，也感受到了年轻时不确定下一步该何去何从的快乐。这部讽刺而闪闪发光的城市爱情证明了美国独立电影的持续活力。
hook_en: Greta Gerwig is radiant as Frances, a woman in her late twenties in contemporary New York trying to sort out her ambitions, her finances, and, above all, her intimate but shifting bond with her best friend, Sophie (Mickey Sumner). Meticulously directed by Noah Baumbach with a free-and-easy vibe reminiscent of the French New Wave’s most spirited films, and written by Baumbach and Gerwig with an effortless combination of sweetness and wit, Frances Ha gets at both the frustrations and the joys of being young and unsure of where to go next. This wry and sparkling city romance is a testament to the ongoing vitality of independent American cinema.

hook: 小克莱伯·门东萨将充满动感的冲击力和哀伤的历史气息融为一体，将巴西二十世纪军事独裁统治下的生活与现实联系起来，呈现出一部令人共鸣的万花筒时代惊悚片。 1977 年，一名化名马塞洛的男子（瓦格纳·莫拉饰）来到累西腓，试图与年幼的儿子重新开始。然而，暴力威胁立即袭来，腐败的警察、肮脏的杀手、闹鬼的流放者和疯狂的都市传说在他周围盘旋，引发了公众的狂热。 《特工》不断地脱离时间轴和叙事轴，展开了一幅史诗般的画布，其中充满了对那些拒绝屈服于压迫制度的人的生命和爱。
hook_en: With an electrifying blend of kinetic punch and elegiac historical sweep, Kleber Mendonça Filho connects life under Brazil’s twentieth-century military dictatorship to the living present, delivering a kaleidoscopic period thriller pulsing with resonance. In 1977, under the alias Marcelo, a man (Wagner Moura) arrives in the city of Recife to try to make a fresh start with his young son. However, the threat of violence immediately encroaches, while around him swirl corrupt cops, grimy hit men, haunted exiles, and a wild urban legend that ignites a public frenzy. Continually spinning off its temporal and narrative axes, The Secret Agent unfurls an epic canvas teeming with life and love for those who refuse to submit to systems of oppression.

hook: 犯罪主谋马布斯医生（鲁道夫·克莱因-罗格饰）被关在精神病院十年，在生与死之间摇摇欲坠，他潦草写下了他最后的遗嘱：一份建立未来犯罪帝国的宣言。当文件中邪恶的文字开始与现实产生可怕的相似之处时，柏林的明星侦探洛曼探长（奥托·韦尼克，饰演《M》中的角色）就需要将这起与其他案件不同的案件中最支离破碎、最令人抓狂的线索联系起来。弗里茨·朗的《马布斯博士的遗嘱》是他大获成功的无声电影《马布斯博士：赌徒》的续集，让导演与那个实际上开启了他职业生涯的角色重聚。朗将纳粹阐述的口号和思想放入一个疯子的口中，警告他的听众即将到来的威胁，而这很快就会成为现实。纳粹信息部长约瑟夫·戈培尔将这部电影视为针对政府的恐怖行动的指导手册，并以“危害公共秩序和安全”为由禁止该影片。这是无数间谍和黑色惊悚片中神秘和悬疑的里程碑，这是完整的、未剪辑的原创导演版本，采用令人惊叹的全新转制。
hook_en: Locked away in an asylum for a decade and teetering between life and death, the criminal mastermind Doctor Mabuse (Rudolf Klein-Rogge) has scribbled his last will and testament: a manifesto establishing a future empire of crime. When the document’s nefarious writings start leading to terrifying parallels in reality, it’s up to Berlin’s star detective, Inspector Lohmann (Otto Wernicke, reprising his role from M) to connect the most fragmented, maddening clues in a case unlike any other. A sequel to his enormously successful silent film Dr. Mabuse: The Gambler, Fritz Lang's The Testament of Dr. Mabuse reunites the director with the character that had effectively launched his career. Lang put slogans and ideas expounded by the Nazis into the mouth of a madman, warning his audience of an imminent menace, which was soon to become a reality. Nazi Minister of Information Joseph Goebbels saw the film as an instruction manual for terrorist action against the government and banned it for “endangering public order and security.” A landmark of mystery and suspense for countless espionage and noir thrillers to come, this is the complete, uncut original director’s version in a stunning new transfer.

hook: 传奇制片人亚历山大·科达 (Alexander Korda) 的奇迹片《巴格达大盗》受到《一千零一夜》的启发，是有史以来最壮观的奇幻电影之一，是一部令人瞠目结舌的特效先锋，充满了想象力和技术魔法。当艾哈迈德王子（约翰·贾斯汀饰）被邪恶的贾法尔（康拉德·维特饰）弄瞎并逐出巴格达时，他与好斗的小偷阿布（无与伦比的萨布，在他的最终角色中）联手，赢回了他的王位，以及美丽公主（琼·杜普雷斯饰）的心。几十年来，《巴格达窃贼》以其绚丽的色彩、生动的布景和前所未有的视觉奇观吸引了各个年龄段的观众。
hook_en: Legendary producer Alexander Korda's marvel The Thief of Bagdad, inspired by The Arabian Nights, is one of the most spectacular fantasy films ever made, an eye-popping effects pioneer brimming with imagination and technical wizardry. When Prince Ahmad (John Justin) is blinded and cast out of Bagdad by the nefarious Jaffar (Conrad Veidt), he joins forces with the scrappy thief Abu (the incomparable Sabu, in his definitive role) to win back his royal place, as well as the heart of a beautiful princess (June Duprez). With its luscious Technicolor, vivid sets, and unprecedented visual wonders, The Thief of Bagdad has charmed viewers of all ages for decades.

hook: 澳大利亚导演布鲁斯·贝雷斯福德 (Bruce Beresford) 凭借《布雷克·莫兰特》(Breaker Morant) 取得突破十年后，又拍摄了另一部关于殖民主义对个人影响的广受好评的电影。梅纳德·埃齐亚什 (Maynard Eziashi) 的表演为他赢得了柏林电影节最佳男主角银熊奖，他扮演的主角是一位渴望为英国当局担任公务员的尼日利亚村民，其中包括一位富有同情心的地区官员（皮尔斯·布鲁斯南饰），希望这对他的未来有利。相反，他的野心导致了他的悲剧性垮台。 《约翰逊先生》改编自乔伊斯·卡里 1939 年的小说，是一部优雅而真挚的戏剧，讲述了理想主义的局限性，表演感人至深，拍摄精美。
hook_en: A decade after he broke through with Breaker Morant, Australian director Bruce Beresford made another acclaimed film about the effects of colonialism on the individual. In a performance that earned him the Berlin Film Festival’s Silver Bear for best actor, Maynard Eziashi plays the title character, a Nigerian villager eager to work as a civil servant for the British authorities, including a sympathetic district officer (Pierce Brosnan), in the hope that it will benefit him in the future. Instead, his ambition leads to his tragic downfall. Mister Johnson, based on the 1939 novel by Joyce Cary, is a graceful, heartfelt drama about the limits of idealism, affectingly acted and handsomely shot.

hook: 三船敏郎饰演富商权藤金吾，令人难忘：他的家庭成了冷血绑匪的目标。黑泽明这部影响深远的家庭剧兼警探程序片《天国与地狱》，改编自埃德·麦克贝恩的小说《国王的赎金》，从与时间赛跑的惊悚无缝滑向社会批判，写成关于阶级与当代日本社会的险恶专论。
hook_en: Toshiro Mifune is unforgettable as Kingo Gondo, a wealthy industrialist whose family becomes the target of a cold-blooded kidnapper in High and Low, the highly influential domestic drama and police procedural from director Akira Kurosawa. Adapting Ed McBain’s detective novel King’s Ransom, Kurosawa moves effortlessly from compelling race-against-time thriller to exacting social commentary, creating a diabolical treatise on class and contemporary Japanese society.

hook: 黑泽明的这部晚期作品以一系列八个神话小插曲的形式展开，其灵感来自这位深受喜爱的导演自己的夜间幻象以及日本民间传说的故事。在穿越大师想象力的视觉华丽之旅中，童趣奇观的故事被世界末日的幽灵所取代：一个小男孩偶然发现了森林里的狐狸婚礼；一名士兵面对战死者的鬼魂；一座发电厂的熔毁使海边的景观被放射性烟雾所笼罩。黑泽明的《梦》穿插了对创造的救赎力量的反思，包括对文森特·梵高（马丁·斯科塞斯饰演）的丰富致敬，既展示了其创作者最肆无忌惮的艺术才华，又对这个受人类无知摆布的世界表达了深深的个人哀悼。
hook_en: Unfolding in a series of eight mythic vignettes, this late work by Akira Kurosawa was inspired by the beloved director’s own nighttime visions, along with stories from Japanese folklore. In a visually sumptuous journey through the master’s imagination, tales of childlike wonder give way to apocalyptic apparitions: a young boy stumbles on a fox wedding in a forest; a soldier confronts the ghosts of the war dead; a power-plant meltdown smothers a seaside landscape in radioactive fumes. Interspersed with reflections on the redemptive power of creation, including a richly textured tribute to Vincent van Gogh (who is played by Martin Scorsese), Akira Kurosawa’s Dreams is both a showcase for its maker’s artistry at its most unbridled and a deeply personal lament for a world at the mercy of human ignorance.

hook: 约翰·福尔斯的小说《法国中尉的女人》改编成大银幕，众多才华横溢的人才齐聚一堂，这部被认为无法拍成电影的后现代杰作。英国新浪潮先驱卡雷尔·赖斯 (Karel Reisz) 凭​​借诺贝尔奖获得者剧作家哈罗德·品特 (Harold Pinter) 的巧妙剧本，将福尔斯的丑闻浪漫故事转变为一部引人入胜、极具娱乐性的电影电影。在品特的重新想象中，杰里米·艾恩斯和梅丽尔·斯特里普在平行的叙述中扮演主角，扮演一位维多利亚时代的绅士和社会弃儿，他冒着一切风险去爱，而当代演员则在电影制作中扮演这些角色，并沉浸在自己禁忌的恋情中。该片由精湛的电影摄影师弗雷迪·弗朗西斯 (Freddie Francis) 拍摄，受人尊敬的作曲家兼指挥家卡尔·戴维斯 (Carl Davis) 配乐，这是一部引人入胜、思维灵活的电影制作壮举，由两位传奇演员担任早期主角。
hook_en: An astounding array of talent came together for the big-screen adaptation of John Fowles’s novel The French Lieutenant’s Woman, a postmodern masterpiece that had been considered unfilmable. With an ingenious script by the Nobel Prize–winning playwright Harold Pinter, British New Wave trailblazer Karel Reisz transforms Fowles’s tale of scandalous romance into an arresting, hugely entertaining movie about cinema. In Pinter’s reimagining, Jeremy Irons and Meryl Streep star in parallel narratives, as a Victorian-era gentleman and the social outcast he risks everything to love, and as the contemporary actors playing those roles in a film production, and immersed in their own forbidden affair. Shot by the consummate cinematographer Freddie Francis and scored by the venerated composer and conductor Carl Davis, this is a beguiling, intellectually nimble feat of filmmaking, starring a pair of legendary actors in early leading roles.

hook: 费德里科·费里尼作为独立导演的第二次出镜取得了他的第一次商业成功，这部清晰的肖像描绘了五个徘徊在青春期后的困境中的年轻人，梦想着冒险并逃离他们的沿海小镇。费里尼借鉴了《阿玛科德》的童年怀旧和《甜蜜生活》的大城市宿醉之间的记忆，创作了一部半自传体杰作，人物素描清晰：追逐裙子的福斯托被迫娶了一个他让他怀孕的女孩；阿尔贝托，永远的孩子；莱奥波尔多，一位渴望名誉的作家；还有莫拉尔多，这个团体的良心。 《我维泰罗尼》获得了奥斯卡最佳原创剧本提名，以喜剧的洞察力和同情心捕捉了主角的疲倦和渴望。
hook_en: Federico Fellini’s second outing as a solo director yielded his first commercial success, a clear-eyed portrait of five young men lingering in a postadolescent limbo, dreaming of adventure and escape from their small coastal town. Drawing on memories tucked between the childhood nostalgia of Amarcord and the big-city hangover of La dolce vita, Fellini crafts a semiautobiographical masterpiece of sharply drawn character sketches: of skirt-chasing Fausto, forced to marry a girl he has impregnated; Alberto, the perpetual child; Leopoldo, a writer thirsting for fame; and Moraldo, the conscience of the group. An Oscar nominee for best original screenplay, I vitelloni captures the lassitude and longing of its protagonists with comic insight and compassion.

hook: 1959 年，年轻的让-吕克·戈达尔（纪尧姆·马贝克饰）是《电影手册》的影评人同行中唯一没有拍过故事片的人。他决心将其革命性的电影理念付诸实践，他带着自己的小团队和两位明星——一个热心的无名小卒让·保罗·贝尔蒙多（奥布里·杜林饰）和谨慎的好莱坞外籍人士让·塞伯格（佐伊·达奇饰）——来到巴黎街头拍摄《精疲力竭》，这是一场不受约束的创造力冒险，很快就会颠覆电影的制作方式。导演理查德·林克莱特在这封来自一位电影特立独行者写给另一位电影特立独行者的引人入胜的情书中，以轻松的幽默和轻松的魅力捕捉到了年轻时的令人陶醉的快乐，打破了所有规则，创造了无国界的艺术。
hook_en: It’s 1959, and a young Jean-Luc Godard (Guillaume Marbeck) is the only one among his film-critic peers at Cahiers du cinéma not to have made a feature film. Determined to put his revolutionary cinematic ideas into practice, he brings his small crew and two stars—an eager unknown named Jean-Paul Belmondo (Aubry Dullin) and wary Hollywood expat Jean Seberg (Zoey Deutch)—onto the streets of Paris to shoot Breathless, an adventure in unfettered creativity that would soon upend the way movies are made. With this enthralling love letter from one cinematic maverick to another, director Richard Linklater captures, with buoyant humor and effortless charm, the intoxicating joy of being young, breaking all the rules, and making art without boundaries.

hook: 在他们的朋友令人震惊地自杀后，一群三十多岁的人重聚参加他的葬礼，最后一起度过了周末，回忆他们作为六十年代孩子的共同过去，并面对他们作为八十年代成年人生活的不确定性。这部婴儿潮一代的里程碑作品既辛酸又温暖幽默，让编剧兼导演劳伦斯·卡斯丹成为明星，也许是十年来最具代表性的合奏电影，汤姆·贝伦杰、格伦·克洛斯、杰夫·高布伦、威廉·赫特、凯文·克莱恩、玫琳凯·普雷斯、梅格·蒂莉和乔贝斯·威廉姆斯的精彩表演令人难忘。 The Big Chill 凭借六十年代摇滚和 R&B 热门歌曲的播放列表，几乎发明了精心策划的配乐。
hook_en: After the shocking suicide of their friend, a group of thirtysomethings reunite for his funeral and end up spending the weekend together, reminiscing about their shared past as children of the sixties and confronting the uncertainty of their lives as adults of the eighties. Poignant and warmly humorous in equal measure, this baby boomer milestone made a star of writer-director Lawrence Kasdan and is perhaps the decade’s defining ensemble film, featuring memorable performances by Tom Berenger, Glenn Close, Jeff Goldblum, William Hurt, Kevin Kline, Mary Kay Place, Meg Tilly, and JoBeth Williams. And with its playlist of sixties rock and R&B hits, The Big Chill all but invented the consummately curated soundtrack.

hook: 自 20 世纪 70 年代以来，詹姆斯·L·布鲁克斯 (James L. Brooks) 这个名字一直是智能电视喜剧的代名词——他的节目对工作和爱情都有深刻的见解，并且始终紧扣时代精神。他也是大银幕上的讲故事大师，他的电影中没有一部比《广播新闻》更能体现布鲁克斯的精髓。霍莉·亨特在华盛顿新闻媒体中的刻薄外表中扮演了一个突破性的角色，她饰演一位精力旺盛的电视制片人，在雄心勃勃但阴暗的主播（威廉·赫特饰）和她最亲密的知己、愤世嫉俗的资深记者（阿尔伯特·布鲁克斯饰）之间左右为难。布鲁克斯这部诙谐、温和的预言性电影是对人际关系和媒体观念迅速变化的时代的引人入胜的传播。
hook_en: Since the 1970s, the name James L. Brooks has been synonymous with intelligent television comedy—his shows are insightful about work and love and always plugged in to the zeitgeist. He is also a master storyteller of the big screen, and none of his films was more quintessentially Brooks than Broadcast News. This caustic look inside the Washington news media stars Holly Hunter, in her breakout role, as a feisty television producer torn between an ambitious yet dim anchorman (William Hurt) and her closest confidant, a cynical veteran reporter (Albert Brooks). Brooks’s witty, gently prophetic film is a captivating transmission from an era in which ideas on relationships and the media were rapidly changing.

hook: 莱斯·布兰克 (Les Blank) 认为这部关于深受喜爱的歌手兼作曲家莱昂·拉塞尔 (Leon Russell) 的自由形式纪录片（于 1972 年至 1974 年间拍摄）是他最伟大的成就之一。但直到现在它还没有被发布。布兰克受拉塞尔雇佣在俄克拉荷马州东北部的录音室拍摄他的作品，最终为音乐家及其环境构建了一幅独特而亲密的肖像。这部独特的电影由拉塞尔和他的乐队在音乐会和录音室表演的迷人场景以及幕后的即兴时刻组成，其中还包括威利·尼尔森和乔治·琼斯的表演，多年来已经获得了传奇地位。这是一部粗犷之美的作品，证明了布兰克的电影大胆和拉塞尔巨大的音乐天赋。
hook_en: Les Blank considered this free-form feature documentary about beloved singer-songwriter Leon Russell, filmed between 1972 and 1974, to be one of his greatest accomplishments. Yet it has not been released until now. Hired by Russell to film him at his recording studio in northeast Oklahoma, Blank ended up constructing a unique, intimate portrait of a musician and his environment. Made up of mesmerizing scenes of Russell and his band performing, both in concert and in the studio, as well as off-the-cuff moments behind the scenes, this singular film—which also features performances by Willie Nelson and George Jones—has attained legendary status over the years. It’s a work of rough beauty that serves as testament to Blank’s cinematic daring and Russell’s immense musical talents.

hook: 《秋之绝唱》是英格玛与英格丽德·伯格曼的唯一一次合作，英格丽德是《北非谍影》中的女皇级巨星。这位大家闺秀饰演一位冰山般的钢琴家，与导演反复出现的女主角莉芙·乌曼饰演的她最大的女儿不相上下。在一段长时间的分离后，两人终于在一天和一个漫长痛苦的夜晚里，面对他们之间的苦涩矛盾。这部具有强烈象征意味的双人舞，以金黄的丰收色调拍摄，是导演的重要戏剧作品之一。
hook_en: Autumn Sonata was the only collaboration between cinema’s two great Bergmans: Ingmar and Ingrid, the monumental star of Casablanca. The grande dame, playing an icy concert pianist, is matched beat for beat in ferocity by the filmmaker’s recurring lead Liv Ullmann, as her eldest daughter. Over the course of a day and a long, painful night that the two spend together after an extended separation, they finally confront the bitter discord of their relationship. This cathartic pas de deux, evocatively shot in burnished harvest colors, ranks among the director’s major dramatic works.

hook: 被称为有史以来最好的摇滚电影，这部里程碑式的纪录片跟随滚石乐队在1969年的美国巡演。当六千多名“爱之代”成员与几十名地狱天使在旧金山阿尔塔蒙特赛车场发生冲突时，纪录片先驱大卫和阿道尔夫·迈尔斯以及查尔斯·泽温就在那里，用镜头记录下了那场导致一代人梦想变为失望的血腥割裂。
hook_en: Called the greatest rock film ever made, this landmark documentary follows the Rolling Stones on their notorious 1969 U.S. tour. When three hundred thousand members of the Love Generation collided with a few dozen Hells Angels at San Francisco’s Altamont Speedway, Direct Cinema pioneers David and Albert Maysles and Charlotte Zwerin were there to immortalize on film the bloody slash that transformed a decade's dreams into disillusionment.

hook: 在《之前三部曲》的结局中，席琳和杰西与双胞胎女儿和一群朋友一起在阳光斑驳的希腊度假胜地度过了几年的恋爱关系。然而，这对夫妇很快发现他们的假期被长期酝酿的问题打乱了。 《午夜降临之前》以林克莱特和他的演员们二十年来与这些角色磨练出来的情感深度、敏锐的智慧和丰富的对话为特点，探讨了长期亲密关系的复杂性，并询问当爱情无法诉诸过去的幻想时，爱情会变成什么样子。
hook_en: The conclusion of The Before Trilogy finds Celine and Jesse several years into a relationship and in the midst of a sun-dappled Greek retreat with their twin daughters and a group of friends. The couple soon find their vacation upended, however, by long-simmering problems that come to a boil. Marked by the emotional depth, piercing wit, and conversational exuberance that Linklater and his actors honed over two decades of abiding with these characters, Before Midnight grapples with the complexities of long-term intimacy, and asks what becomes of love when it has no recourse to its past illusions.

hook: 温尼伯是北美的地理中心，也是盖伊·马丁深受喜爱的出生地，是马丁“纪录片幻想曲”中冰冷而神秘的明星。这部电影是一部充满记忆和想象力的作品，深入探索了导演所说的这片大陆的“心脏中的心脏”，描绘了一座既令人愉快又令人恐惧的城市，里面住满了梦游者和曲棍球爱好者。参加温尼伯史诗般的年度寻宝游戏！向永远冻在河里的赛马致敬！帮助评判一年一度的金童选美大赛！在马丁的催眠式、精心构思的赞歌中，什么是真实，什么是幻想，留给观众去分辨，这个美妙而可怕的地方被称为“我的家乡”。
hook_en: The geographical dead center of North America and the beloved birthplace of Guy Maddin, Winnipeg is the frosty and mysterious star of Maddin’s “docu-fantasia.” A work of memory and imagination, the film burrows into what the director calls “the heart of the heart” of the continent, conjuring a city as delightful as it is fearsome, populated by sleepwalkers and hockey aficionados. Take part in Winnipeg’s epic annual scavenger hunt! Pay your respects to the racehorses forever frozen in the river! Help judge the yearly Golden Boy pageant! What is real and what is fantasy is left up to the viewer to sort out in Maddin’s hypnotic, expertly conceived paean to that wonderful and terrifying place known as My Hometown.

hook: 这部由导演艾米·赫克林和编剧卡梅伦·克罗执导的这部青春喜剧以新颖、聪明、坦率的视角捕捉到了青春期的狂野世界，这为他们两人开启了巨大成功的电影生涯。 《Fast Times at Ridgemont High》以克劳在南加州一所高中就读时的卧底经历为蓝本，将荷尔蒙驱动的欢闹与对 20 世纪 80 年代青少年经历的近乎社会学的审视融合在一起：购物中心的聚会、快餐工作、热闹的老师、尴尬的约会以及爱情和性的第一次经历。这个流行文化的试金石几乎让一整套默默无闻的演员都成为了明星——包括詹妮弗·杰森·李、菲比·凯茨、莱因霍尔德法官、福里斯特·惠特克、安东尼·爱德华兹、埃里克·斯托尔兹和西恩·潘扮演的瘾君子偶像杰夫·斯皮科利——并在对成长现实的原始而敏感的描述中开辟了新天地。
hook_en: The wild world of adolescence has rarely been captured with as sharp an observational eye as in this refreshingly smart, frank spin on the teen comedy by director Amy Heckerling and screenwriter Cameron Crowe—for each of whom it kicked off a hugely successful film career. Based on Crowe’s experiences going undercover as a student at a Southern California high school, Fast Times at Ridgemont High blends hormone-fueled hilarity with an almost sociological examination of the 1980s teenage experience: the shopping mall hangouts, fast-food jobs, buzzkill teachers, awkward dates, and first experiences of love and sex. This pop-culture touchstone launched to stardom practically an entire cast of unknowns—including Jennifer Jason Leigh, Phoebe Cates, Judge Reinhold, Forest Whitaker, Anthony Edwards, Eric Stoltz, and Sean Penn as stoner icon Jeff Spicoli—and broke new ground in its raw yet sensitive depiction of the realities of coming of age.

hook: 肯·洛奇的《凯斯》被英国电影学会评为本世纪十佳英国电影之一，是电影界对英格兰北部工人阶级的典型描绘。比利（大卫·布拉德利饰）是一位 15 岁矿工的儿子，他与一只野生红隼的亲密关系为他提供了逃离死胡同的精神逃离。凯斯将洛奇在 BBC 作品中建立的社会政治参与搬上了大银幕，并利用真实地点和非专业演员，将六十年代的英国“愤怒的年轻人”电影推向了真实性的新境界。洛奇这部令人心酸的成长剧仍然是这位传奇导演最受欢迎和最有影响力的电影。
hook_en: Named one of the ten best British films of the century by the British Film Institute, Ken Loach’s Kes, is cinema’s quintessential portrait of working-class Northern England. Billy (an astonishingly naturalistic David Bradley) is a fifteen-year-old miner’s son whose close bond with a wild kestrel provides him with a spiritual escape from his dead-end life. Kes brought to the big screen the sociopolitical engagement Loach had established in his work for the BBC, and pushed the British “angry young man” film of the sixties into a new realm of authenticity, using real locations and nonprofessional actors. Loach’s poignant coming-of-age drama remains the now legendary director’s most beloved and influential film.

hook: 游记、回忆录和令人震惊的电影奇观汇聚在这本万花筒般的情人节礼物中，由一位最具标志性的居民创作的永恒之城。费德里科·费里尼的这部都市幻想片，前一刻悠闲，后一刻令人喘不过气来，将导演对墨索里尼时代青年时代的回忆与当代罗马的印象派肖像交织在一起，他和他的摄制组正在拍摄罗马繁华的城市景观。性、美食、夜生活和一场幻觉式的教会时装秀的物质享受，都闪烁着不朽过去的光芒：被交通包围的罗马斗兽场、地铁隧道中出土的古代壁画、一尊被鸽子弄脏的凯撒雕像。 《罗马》将纪录片的即时性和奢华的技巧融为一体，令人眼花缭乱，深入了解了意大利传奇首都的神话和神秘，这座被费里尼称为“世界上最精彩的电影场景”的城市。
hook_en: Travelogue, memoir, and outrageous cinematic spectacle converge in this kaleidoscopic valentine to the Eternal City, composed by one of its most iconic inhabitants. Leisurely one moment and breathless the next, this urban fantasia by Federico Fellini interweaves recollections of the director’s young adulthood in the era of Mussolini with an impressionistic portrait of contemporary Rome, where he and his film crew are shooting footage of the bustling cityscape. The material delights of sex, food, nightlife, and one hallucinatory ecclesiastical fashion show are shot through with glimmers of a monumental past: the Colosseum encircled by traffic, ancient frescoes unearthed in a subway tunnel, a pigeon-befouled statue of Caesar. With a head-spinning mix of documentary immediacy and extravagant artifice, Roma penetrates the myth and mystique of Italy’s storied capital, a city Fellini called “the most wonderful movie set in the world.”

hook: 在这部开创性的音乐剧中，编剧兼导演、明星约翰·卡梅隆·米切尔和作曲家兼作词家斯蒂芬·特拉斯克将他们的标志性创作从舞台带到了银幕，这部电影就像它的主角一样无法归类。海德薇（米切尔饰）在东柏林长大，为了移民到美国，她经历了痛苦的个人转变，在那里她将自己重塑为一位“被国际忽视”但才华横溢的摇滚天后，米切尔形容她拥有“美丽的性别”。影片通过海德薇的音乐讲述了她的故事，她的音乐包括 Trask 创作的各种原创朋克歌曲和力量民谣，并与由音乐视频幻想、动画插曲和令人振奋的情感现实主义时刻组成的随心所欲的电影马赛克相匹配。 《海德薇和愤怒的英寸》是一首充满活力的歌曲和温柔的人物研究，是对摇滚乐超凡力量的致敬。
hook_en: With this trailblazing musical, writer-director-star John Cameron Mitchell and composer-lyricist Stephen Trask brought their signature creation from stage to screen for a movie as unclassifiable as its protagonist. Raised a boy in East Berlin, Hedwig (Mitchell) undergoes a traumatic personal transformation in order to emigrate to the U.S., where she reinvents herself as an “internationally ignored” but divinely talented rock diva, characterized by Mitchell as inhabiting a “beautiful gender of one.” The film tells Hedwig’s story through her music, an eclectic assortment of original punk anthems and power ballads by Trask, matching them with a freewheeling cinematic mosaic of music-video fantasies, animated interludes, and moments of bracing emotional realism. A hard-charging song cycle and a tender character study, Hedwig and the Angry Inch is a tribute to the transcendent power of rock and roll.

hook: 巴赫拉姆·贝扎伊 (Bahram Beyzaie) 的第一部作品风格大胆，引领了伊朗新浪潮。当不幸的知识分子赫克马蒂先生在一个新的社区找到一份教师的工作时，他发现自己就像一条离开了水的鱼。 《倾盆大雨》以发光的单色拍摄，并使用水银发明进行编辑，它是根据唯一已知的幸存印刷品精心修复的，以顽皮的幽默和极大的温柔捕捉了伊朗在关键历史时刻发生的文化冲突。
hook_en: With brash stylistic exuberance, this first feature from Bahram Beyzaie helped usher in the Iranian New Wave. When he takes a job as a schoolteacher in a new neighborhood, the hapless intellectual Mr. Hekmati finds that he is a fish out of water. Shot in luminous monochrome and edited with quicksilver invention, Downpour, which has been painstakingly restored from the only known surviving print, captures with puckish humor and great tenderness the cultural conflicts coursing through Iran at a pivotal historical moment.

hook: 这部由布鲁斯·罗宾逊 (Bruce Robinson) 执导的半自传式电影狂欢之作是英国终极邪典喜剧，由理查德·E·格兰特 (Richard E. Grant) 和保罗·麦克甘 (Paul McGann) 主演，他们分别饰演“威内钉”和“我”，他们以面无表情的津津有味地呈现出一场令人愉悦的华丽对话盛宴，这对 20 世纪 60 年代伦敦的一对永远沉浸在醉酒状态的失业演员，不顾一切地想要逃离他们噩梦般肮脏的公寓，踏上了一场滑稽的、叛逆的乡村度假，却被威胁所包围。当地人、光秃秃的橱柜和好色的叔叔——只要他们没有喝完酒，这一切他们也许都能忍受。虽然罗宾逊令人眼花缭乱的剧本产生了很多值得引用的时刻，但影片苦乐参半地唤起了一段逐渐瓦解的友谊，赋予了这个受人喜爱的青春终结的故事持久的辛酸。
hook_en: The ultimate cult British comedy, Bruce Robinson’s semi-autobiographical cinematic bender is a feast of delectably florid dialogue delivered with deadpan relish by stars Richard E. Grant and Paul McGann as, respectively, Withnail and “I,” a pair of perpetually soused, unemployed actors in 1960s London who, desperate to escape their nightmarishly grimy flat, embark on a hilariously misbegotten country getaway beset by menacing locals, bare cupboards, and a randy uncle—all of which they may be able to withstand as long as they don’t run out of alcohol. While Robinson’s dazzling script yields quotable moments galore, it’s the film’s bittersweet evocation of a friendship gradually unraveling that gives this beloved end-of-youth tale its lasting poignancy.

hook: 鲁莽的花花公子鲍勃·梅里克（罗克·哈德森饰）的突破性角色使他的快艇坠毁，需要镇上唯一的复苏者进行紧急救治——就在此时，一位受人爱戴的当地医生心脏病发作，在等待救生设备的过程中去世。道格拉斯·塞克（Douglas Sirk）最华丽的情节剧大师班之一就这样开始了，这是一场将肥皂水和精神融为一体的疯狂色彩混合体，鲍勃和医生的遗孀海伦（简·怀曼饰）发现自己在一系列日益狂野的曲折、转折、考验和磨难中密不可分。
hook_en: Reckless playboy Bob Merrick (Rock Hudson, in his breakthrough role) crashes his speedboat, requiring emergency attention from the town’s only resuscitator—at the very moment that a beloved local doctor has a heart attack and dies waiting for the lifesaving device. Thus begins one of Douglas Sirk’s most flamboyant master classes in melodrama, a delirious Technicolor mix of the sudsy and the spiritual in which Bob and the doctor’s widow, Helen (Jane Wyman), find themselves inextricably linked amid a series of increasingly wild twists, turns, trials, and tribulations.

hook: 鲍勃·迪伦 (Bob Dylan) 在 D. A. 彭尼贝克 (D. A. Pennebaker) 的这部开创性电影中以前所未有的方式出现在银幕上。这位传奇纪录片导演在 1965 年的英国巡演中找到了迪伦，这将是他最后一次作为声学艺术家。在这个二十世纪最伟大的艺术家之一的极其有趣的愿景中，迪伦被青少年粉丝包围，与记者展开激烈的哲学较量，并与其他音乐家琼·贝兹、多诺万和艾伦·普莱斯一起放松。 《Dont Look Back》收录了迪伦最著名的一些歌曲，包括《Subterranean Homesick Blues》、《The Times They Are A-Changin’》和《It's All Over Now, Baby Blue》，以激进的方式描绘了一位美国偶像，影响了数十年的真实幕后纪录片。
hook_en: Bob Dylan is captured on-screen as he never would be again in this groundbreaking film from D. A. Pennebaker. The legendary documentarian finds Dylan in England during his 1965 tour, which would be his last as an acoustic artist. In this wildly entertaining vision of one of the twentieth century’s greatest artists, Dylan is surrounded by teen fans, gets into heated philosophical jousts with journalists, and kicks back with fellow musicians Joan Baez, Donovan, and Alan Price. Featuring some of Dylan’s most famous songs, including “Subterranean Homesick Blues,” “The Times They Are A-Changin’,” and “It’s All Over Now, Baby Blue,” Dont Look Back is a radically conceived portrait of an American icon that has influenced decades of vérité behind-the-scenes documentaries.

hook: 在吴宇森成为布满弹孔的英雄悲剧大师之前，他通过这部旋风般的武侠奇观强化了他的标志性主题和动态动作编排。一对暴躁的剑客（伟白和刘松仁饰）不知道自己陷入了一场致命的欺骗游戏，他们联手帮助一位贵族（刘刚饰）报仇。吴宇森向他的导师、武术创新者张彻表达了激动人心的敬意，他不仅提供了精彩的剑术表演，还对这个忠诚买卖的世界中兄弟情谊和荣誉的意义进行了血腥的拷问。
hook_en: Before he became known as the master of the bullet-riddled heroic tragedy, John Woo sharpened his trademark themes and kinetic action choreography with this whirlwind wuxia spectacle. Unaware they are caught in a deadly game of deception, a pair of rambunctious swordsmen (Wai Pak and Damian Lau) join forces to help a nobleman (Lau Kong) in his quest for vengeance. Paying thrilling homage to his mentor, martial-arts innovator Chang Cheh, Woo delivers both bravura swordplay set pieces and a bloodstained interrogation of the meaning of brotherhood and honor in a world in which loyalty is bought and sold.

hook: 王颖的独立电影《陈失踪了》的后续作品是一部全家福，优雅地结合了导演标志性的温和人文主义和对辛酸细节的关注。王以一种苦乐参半的方式审视了一位年迈的移民寡妇和她忠诚的女儿之间的世代双人舞，在孝道责任和自己的愿望之间左右为难，为旧金山的华裔美国人社区提供了另一个全新的视角。受小津安二郎启发的《点心：一点点心》由现实生活中的周母女 Kim 和 Laurenen Chew 以及 Victor Wong 精心演绎，其制作工艺与其所推崇的家常菜一样精心。
hook_en: Wayne Wang’s follow-up to his watershed indie Chan Is Missing is a family portrait that gracefully combines the director’s signature gentle humanism and eye for poignant detail. Offering another fresh perspective on San Francisco’s Chinese American community, Wang takes a bittersweet look at the generational pas de deux between an aging immigrant widow and her devoted daughter, torn between filial duty and her own desires. Soulfully performed by an ensemble including real-life mother and daughter Kim and Laureen Chew and Victor Wong, the Yasujiro Ozu–inspired Dim Sum: A Little Bit of Heart is as lovingly made as the home-cooked cuisine it celebrates.

hook: 卡罗尔·隆巴德和威廉·鲍威尔在格雷戈里·拉·卡瓦创作的这部出色的怪诞喜剧中令人眼花缭乱——浪漫的妙语连珠和社会批判的有力鸡尾酒。艾琳（隆巴德饰）是一位性格古怪、富有的曼哈顿人，她在垃圾场发现了一个“被遗忘的人”（鲍威尔饰）——一个明显潦倒的流浪者——后赢得了一场社交舞会寻宝游戏。她让他担任家庭管家，很快就爱上了他。她试图既向戈弗雷求爱，又向他灌输家庭失调的观念，结果导致了一系列从未被击败的疯狂狂欢。拉卡瓦这部巧妙的电影是第一部获得奥斯卡所有四个表演类别提名的电影，也是好莱坞对大萧条时代阶级和社会动荡最伟大的评论之一。
hook_en: Carole Lombard and William Powell dazzle in this definitive screwball comedy by Gregory La Cava—a potent cocktail of romantic repartee and social critique. Irene (Lombard), an eccentric, wealthy Manhattanite, wins a society-ball scavenger hunt after finding a “forgotten man” (Powell)—an apparent down-and-out drifter—at a dump. She gives him work as the family butler and soon falls head over heels for him. Her attempts to both woo Godfrey and indoctrinate him in the household’s dysfunction make for a string of madcap high jinks that has never been bested. La Cava’s deft film was the first to garner Oscar nominations in all four acting categories, and it is one of Hollywood’s greatest commentaries on class and the social unrest of the Depression era.

hook: 埃罗尔·莫里斯将镜头对准了世界上最迷人的人物之一：天体物理学家先驱斯蒂芬·霍金，他患有一种使人衰弱的运动神经元疾病，导致他失去了声音或使用四肢。莫里斯的这部纪录片巧妙地讲述了个人逆境、职业成功和宇宙学探究的故事，探讨了霍金身体的崩溃是如何伴随着他的想象力不受限制地扩展的。 《时间简史》通过同事和亲人的声音讲述了这个人令人难以置信的故事，同时动态地提供了霍金同名畅销书中的一些理论，它既小如单个生命，又大如不断膨胀的宇宙。
hook_en: Errol Morris turns his camera on one of the most fascinating men in the world: the pioneering astrophysicist Stephen Hawking, afflicted by a debilitating motor neuron disease that has left him without a voice or the use of his limbs. An adroitly crafted tale of personal adversity, professional triumph, and cosmological inquiry, Morris’s documentary examines the way the collapse of Hawking’s body has been accompanied by the untrammeled broadening of his imagination. Telling the man’s incredible story through the voices of his colleagues and loved ones, while making dynamically accessible some of the theories in Hawking’s best-selling book of the same name, A Brief History of Time is at once as small as a single life and as big as the ever-expanding universe.

hook: 约翰·勒卡雷 (John le Carré) 创作的这本广受好评的畅销小说讲述了一名冷战间谍在东德执行最后一项危险任务的故事，导演马丁·里特 (Martin Ritt) 将这部小说改编成了一部与原著一样精确而残酷的电影。理查德·伯顿 (Richard Burton) 饰演亚历克·利马斯 (Alec Leamas)，他与克莱尔·布鲁姆 (Claire Bloom) 饰演的美丽图书管理员南 (Nan) 的关系使他的任务陷入危险。 《寒冬间谍》是一部棱角分明的悲剧惊悚片，充满了定义里特职业生涯的政治和社会意识。
hook_en: The acclaimed, best-selling novel by John le Carré, about a Cold War spy on one final dangerous mission in East Germany, is transmuted by director Martin Ritt into a film every bit as precise and ruthless as the book. Richard Burton is superb as Alec Leamas, whose relationship with the beautiful librarian Nan, played by Claire Bloom, puts his assignment in jeopardy. The Spy Who Came in from the Cold is a hard-edged and tragic thriller, suffused with the political and social consciousness that defined Ritt’s career.

hook: 韦斯·安德森（与合著者欧文·威尔逊）首先在这部视觉上诙谐而温暖的三个不合群的年轻人的肖像中展示了他细致入微、略带超现实的电影视觉。最好的朋友安东尼（卢克·威尔逊饰）、迪格南（欧文·威尔逊饰）和鲍勃（罗伯特·马斯格雷夫饰）对一家小书店实施了一场极其复杂、但取得了一定成功的抢劫，然后“逃亡”。在冒险过程中，安东尼爱上了南美管家伊内兹（卢米·卡瓦佐斯饰），并结识了当地的大盗亨利先生（詹姆斯·肯恩饰）。 《瓶子火箭》以迷人、搞笑、深情的方式展现了梦想家的愚蠢行为，以灿烂的西南背景为背景拍摄，这部影片让安德森和威尔逊兄弟名声大噪。
hook_en: Wes Anderson first illustrated his lovingly detailed, slightly surreal cinematic vision (with cowriter Owen Wilson) in this visually witty and warm portrait of three young misfits. Best friends Anthony (Luke Wilson), Dignan (Owen Wilson), and Bob (Robert Musgrave) stage a wildly complex, mildly successful robbery of a small bookstore, then go “on the lam.” During their adventures, Anthony falls in love with a South American housekeeper, Inez (Lumi Cavazos), and they befriend local thief extraordinaire Mr. Henry (James Caan). Bottle Rocket is a charming, hilarious, affectionate look at the folly of dreamers, shot against radiant southwestern backdrops, and the film that put Anderson and the Wilson brothers on the map.

hook: 二十世纪初，三名澳大利亚陆军中尉因涉嫌在南非作战时犯下战争罪而受到军事法庭审判。由于没有时间准备，一名被任命为辩护律师的澳大利亚少校必须证明他们只是执行命令，并被英帝国指挥部变成了政治棋子。导演布鲁斯·贝尔斯福德凭借这部引人入胜的剧情片赢得了国际赞誉，该剧以该国殖民历史的黑暗时期为背景，爱德华·伍德沃德、布莱恩·布朗和杰克·汤普森的精彩表演为主角；唐纳德·麦卡尔平 (Donald McAlpine) 的粗犷摄影；以及根据真实事件改编的奥斯卡提名剧本。
hook_en: At the turn of the twentieth century, three Australian army lieutenants are court-martialed for alleged war crimes committed while fighting in South Africa.
