With no time to prepare, an Australian major, appointed as defense attorney, must prove that they were just following orders and are being made into political pawns by the British imperial command. Director Bruce Beresford garnered international acclaim for this riveting drama set during a dark period in his country’s colonial history, and featuring passionate performances by Edward Woodward, Bryan Brown, and Jack Thompson; rugged cinematography by Donald McAlpine; and an Oscar-nominated script, based on true events.

hook: 在这部富有同情心、令人震惊的喜剧中，才华横溢的米兰达·朱莉揭示了一个既熟悉又陌生的世界——围绕着一对潜在恋人的一系列编织的小插曲中出现了一种关于创造力、性、童年和孤独的原创愿景：理查德，一个刚刚单身的鞋推销员和两个孩子的父亲（约翰·霍克斯饰），克里斯汀，一个孤独的视频艺术家和“Eldercab”司机（朱莉）。当理查德的儿子们在走向浪漫的道路上犹豫不决时，理查德的儿子们追随自己的好奇心，对他们在网上和现实生活中的第一次性经历进行探索，冒险进入未知的领域，试图与他人建立联系。 《我和你以及我们认识的每个人》充满了俏皮和深刻的越轨，以一种诗意的方式审视了我们在一个孤立的世界中走向亲密关系的曲折之路，以及将我们团结在一起的神奇和救赎的时刻。
hook_en: With this compassionate, startling comedy that could have come from no other artistic sensibility, the brilliant Miranda July reveals a world both familiar and strange—an original vision of creativity, sexuality, childhood, and loneliness that emerges from a series of braided vignettes around a pair of potential lovers: Richard, a newly single shoe salesman and father of two (John Hawkes), and Christine, a lonely video artist and “Eldercab” driver (July). While they take hesitant steps toward romance, Richard’s sons follow their own curiosity toward their first sexual experiences, online and in real life, venturing into uncharted territories in their attempts to connect with others. Playful and profoundly transgressive, Me and You and Everyone We Know is a poetic look at the tortuous routes we take to intimacy in an isolating world, and the moments of magic and redemption that unite us.

hook: 亚历克斯·考克斯这部独特的科幻喜剧是 20 世纪 80 年代典型的邪典电影，由总是迷人的哈利·戴恩·斯坦通 (Harry Dean Stanton) 饰演荒凉的洛杉矶中饱经风霜的回购人，埃米利奥·艾斯特维兹 (Emilio Estevez) 饰演他保护下的虚无主义中产阶级朋克。当他们参与重新拥有一辆神秘且超凡脱俗的雪佛兰马里布并获得丰厚奖励时，这份工作变得超出了他们的预期。这部粗俗搞笑的冒险之旅以八十年代早期洛杉矶朋克配乐为特色，也是对里根总统的国内外政策的政治尖锐诠释。
hook_en: A quintessential cult film of the 1980s, Alex Cox’s singular sci-fi comedy stars the always captivating Harry Dean Stanton as a weathered repo man in a desolate Los Angeles, and Emilio Estevez as the nihilistic middle-class punk he takes under his wing. The job becomes more than either of them bargained for when they get involved in repossessing a mysterious —and otherworldly—Chevy Malibu with a hefty reward attached to it. Featuring the ultimate early-eighties LA punk soundtrack, this grungily hilarious odyssey is also a politically trenchant take on President Reagan’s domestic and foreign policies.

hook: 这部由奥斯卡获奖导演阿方索·卡隆执导的精彩公路喜剧是一部罕见的将粗俗主题与情感温暖结合在一起的电影。盖尔·加西亚·贝纳尔 (Gael García Bernal) 和迭戈·卢纳 (Diego Luna) 饰演一对来自不同阶层的墨西哥城青少年，一举成为国际巨星。他们的女友飞往意大利过暑假后，被他们在婚礼上遇到的一位美丽的西班牙老妇人（玛丽贝尔·维杜饰）迷住了。当她同意陪他们去一个遥远的海滩旅行时，三人形成了一种日益激烈和感性的联盟，最终使他们在身体和情感上都变得赤裸裸。 《Y tu mamá también》由伟大的伊曼纽尔·卢贝兹基 (Emmanuel Lubezki) 优雅而灵巧地拍摄，以有趣而感人的方式展现了人类的欲望。
hook_en: This smash road comedy from Oscar-winning director Alfonso Cuarón is that rare movie to combine raunchy subject matter and emotional warmth. Gael García Bernal and Diego Luna shot to international stardom as a pair of horny Mexico City teenagers from different classes who, after their girlfriends jet off to Italy for the summer, are bewitched by a gorgeous older Spanish woman (Maribel Verdú) they meet at a wedding. When she agrees to accompany them on a trip to a faraway beach, the three form an increasingly intense and sensual alliance that ultimately strips them both physically and emotionally bare. Shot with elegance and dexterity by the great Emmanuel Lubezki, Y tu mamá también is a funny and moving look at human desire.

hook: 安德烈·塔可夫斯基（《潜行者》）对二十世纪俄罗斯历史的崇高反思，巧妙地穿越了时间和记忆的殿堂，令人心旷神怡，既是一部电影作品，也是一首用图像创作的诗，或者是一种催眠幻觉。在由不同电影胶片和新闻片片段组成的富有质感的拼贴画中，一位垂死诗人的回忆在我们眼前闪现，他的梦想与童年、战争和婚姻的场景交织在一起，所有这些都充满了恍惚的神秘力量。 《镜子》在上映时因其难以捉摸的叙事结构而在很大程度上受到苏联评论家的斥责，但此后它已成为导演最著名和最有影响力的作品之一，这是一位艺术家将内心深处的想法和感受直接从心灵传递到银幕的令人惊叹的个人陈述。
hook_en: A subtly ravishing passage through the halls of time and memory, this sublime reflection on twentieth-century Russian history by Andrei Tarkovsky (Stalker) is as much a poem composed in images, or a hypnagogic hallucination, as it is a work of cinema. In a richly textured collage of varying film stocks and newsreel footage, the recollections of a dying poet flash before our eyes, his dreams mingling with scenes of childhood, wartime, and marriage, all imbued with the mystical power of a trance. Largely dismissed by Soviet critics on its release because of its elusive narrative structure, Mirror has since taken its place as one of the director’s most renowned and influential works, a stunning personal statement from an artist transmitting his innermost thoughts and feelings directly from psyche to screen.

hook: 《最后的华尔兹》不仅仅是有史以来最伟大的音乐会电影之一，它是对美国摇滚乐一个重要时代的一次狂喜和挽歌的总结。 1976 年感恩节，马丁·斯科塞斯受邀拍摄传奇乐队 The Band 在旧金山 Winterland 宴会厅举行的告别表演，构思了一部新型音乐纪录片。斯科塞斯聘请了七名摄影师（由摄影指导迈克尔·查普曼领衔，还包括著名电影摄影师维尔莫斯·齐格蒙德和拉斯洛·科瓦奇）和美术指导鲍里斯·莱文来设计引人注目的戏剧布景，创造了一种盛大的身临其境的体验，将观众带入舞台并融入音乐本身。这些音乐——由乐队和许多其他一代定义艺术家演奏，包括鲍勃·迪伦、乔尼·米切尔、范·莫里森、Staple Singers、Muddy Waters 和尼尔·杨——作为摇滚乐超越可能性的近乎宗教的表达而继续存在。
hook_en: More than just one of the greatest concert films ever made, The Last Waltz is an at once ecstatic and elegiac summation of a vital era in American rock music. Invited to capture the farewell performance of the legendary group the Band at San Francisco’s Winterland Ballroom on Thanksgiving, 1976, Martin Scorsese conceived a new kind of music documentary. Enlisting seven camera operators (led by director of photography Michael Chapman, and also including renowned cinematographers Vilmos Zsigmond and László Kovács) and production designer Boris Leven to design the strikingly theatrical sets, Scorsese created a grandly immersive experience that brings viewers onstage and inside the music itself. That music—as performed by the Band and a host of other generation-defining artists, including Bob Dylan, Joni Mitchell, Van Morrison, the Staple Singers, Muddy Waters, and Neil Young—lives on as an almost religious expression of the transcendent possibilities of rock and roll.

hook: 安德烈·塔可夫斯基的最后一部苏联长片是一次穿越神秘的后世界末日景观的形而上学之旅，以及无与伦比的稀有电影体验。一名受雇的导游——“潜行者”——带领一名作家和一名教授进入了该区域的中心，这是很久以前一场灾难的禁区，三人最终将目标归零到了“房间”，传闻这里可以满足人们最深切的愿望。塔可夫斯基改编自阿尔卡季和鲍里斯·斯特鲁加茨基的科幻小说，创造了一个具有丰富物质细节和有机氛围感的沉浸式世界。一部宗教寓言、对当代政治焦虑的反映、对电影本身的思考——《潜行者》通过开启多种可能的含义来包围观众。
hook_en: Andrei Tarkovsky’s final Soviet feature is a metaphys­ical journey through an enigmatic postapocalyptic landscape, and a rarefied cinematic experience like no other. A hired guide—the Stalker—leads a writer and a professor into the heart of the Zone, the restricted site of a long-ago disaster, where the three men eventually zero in on the Room, a place rumored to fulfill one’s most deeply held desires. Adapting a science-fiction novel by Arkady and Boris Strugatsky, Tarkovsky created an immersive world with a wealth of material detail and a sense of organic atmosphere. A religious allegory, a reflection of contemporaneous political anxieties, a meditation on film itself—Stalker envelops the viewer by opening up a multitude of possible meanings.

hook: 《偷懒者》由理查德·林克莱特 (Richard Linklater) 执导，讲述了德克萨斯州奥斯汀市松散的一天生活，这里的亚文化群体中充满了古怪且受过过度教育的年轻人。编剧兼制片人兼导演林克莱特和他的朋友们采用 16 毫米胶片拍摄，成本仅为 23,000 美元，他们抛弃了任何传统情节的想法，而是选择创作一个由一百多个角色组成的挂毯，每个角色都一样引人注目。 《偷懒者》是对新兴一代激进的非参与者的先见之明，也是 20 世纪 90 年代美国独立电影运动的关键电影之一。
hook_en: Slacker, directed by Richard Linklater, presents a day in the life of a loose-knit Austin, Texas, subculture populated by eccentric and overeducated young people. Shooting on 16 mm for a mere $23,000, writer-producer-director Linklater and his crew of friends threw out any idea of a traditional plot, choosing instead to create a tapestry of over a hundred characters, each as compelling as the last. Slacker is a prescient look at an emerging generation of aggressive nonparticipants, and one of the key films of the American independent film movement of the 1990s.

hook: 作为二十世纪最伟大的艺术力量之一，表演者、编舞家和教师玛莎·葛兰姆影响了全世界的舞蹈。 Criterion 展示了她令人惊叹的工艺样本，所有这些都是与电视艺术节目先驱内森·克罗尔 (Nathan Kroll) 合作的。由格雷厄姆本人讲述的《舞者的世界》（1957）是对她的课堂作业和方法的一瞥。 《阿巴拉契亚之春》（1958）和《夜行》（1961）是两部完整的格雷厄姆芭蕾舞剧，第一部是由亚伦·科普兰创作的对美国先锋精神的颂扬，第二部是对俄狄浦斯神话的有力的物理渲染。这些是格雷厄姆的标志性作品，也是对人体艺术的致敬。
hook_en: One of the great artistic forces of the twentieth century, performer, choreographer, and teacher Martha Graham influenced dance worldwide. Criterion presents a sampling of her stunning craft, all collaborations with television arts-programming pioneer Nathan Kroll. A Dancer's World (1957), narrated by Graham herself, is a glimpse into her class work and methodology. Appalachian Spring (1958) and Night Journey (1961) are two complete Graham ballets, the first a celebration of the American pioneer spirit, scored by Aaron Copland, the second a powerfully physical rendering of the Oedipus myth. These are signature Graham works and tributes to the art of the human body.

hook: 二十六岁的史蒂文·索德伯格凭借其挑衅性的处女作，将注意力集中在现代人类亲密关系和欺骗的复杂性上。家庭主妇安（安迪·麦克道威尔饰）与她的律师丈夫约翰（彼得·加拉格尔饰）感到疏远，约翰正在和她的妹妹辛西娅（劳拉·圣贾科莫饰）上床。当约翰的老朋友格雷厄姆（充满魅力、曾获得戛纳电影节奖的詹姆斯·斯派德饰）来到小镇时，安被这个说话轻声细语的局外人所吸引，最终发现了他惊人的私人痴迷：在女性坦白她们最深的欲望时对她们进行录像。这是一部才华横溢、表演完美的室内乐作品，其中摄像机成为人物孤独的隐喻，荣获金棕榈奖的性、谎言和录像带改变了美国电影的面貌，为 20 世纪 90 年代蓬勃发展的独立电影铺平了道路。
hook_en: With his provocative feature debut, twenty-six-year-old Steven Soderbergh trained his focus on the complexities of human intimacy and deception in the modern age. Housewife Ann (Andie MacDowell) feels distant from her lawyer husband, John (Peter Gallagher), who is sleeping with her sister, Cynthia (Laura San Giacomo). When John’s old friend Graham (a magnetic, Cannes-award-winning James Spader) comes to town, Ann is drawn to the soft-spoken outsider, eventually uncovering his startling private obsession: videotaping women as they confess their deepest desires. A piercingly intelligent and flawlessly performed chamber piece, in which the video camera becomes a charged metaphor for the characters’ isolation, the Palme d’Or–winning sex, lies, and videotape changed the landscape of American film, helping pave the way for the thriving independent scene of the 1990s.

hook: 在这部拍摄精美、心理复杂的西部片中，范·赫夫林是一位性情温和的牧场主，他的任务是带领一名被俘的亡命之徒（由格伦·福特扮演，有着黄瓜般的冷静魅力）登上火车，将他送进监狱。这个看似简单的任务变成了一场令人伤脑筋的猫鼠游戏，考验着每个人独特的荣誉感。 《3:10 to Yuma》改编自埃尔莫尔·伦纳德的故事，是一部惊心动魄、人性化的动作片，由才华横溢的电影制片人德尔默·戴夫斯执导，情感强烈、精准。
hook_en: In this beautifully shot, psychologically complex western, Van Heflin is a mild-mannered cattle rancher who takes on the task of shepherding a captured outlaw (played with cucumber-cool charisma by Glenn Ford) to the train that will deliver him to prison. This apparently simple mission turns into a nerve-racking cat-and-mouse game that tests each man’s particular brand of honor. Based on a story by Elmore Leonard, 3:10 to Yuma is a thrilling, humane action movie, directed by the supremely talented studio filmmaker Delmer Daves with intense feeling and precision.

hook: 《潘神的迷宫》是一部获得奥斯卡奖的黑暗寓言，故事发生在西班牙内战结束五年后，它浓缩了吉列尔莫·德尔·托罗丰富的视觉风格和反流派的创作手法。十一岁的奥菲莉亚（伊万娜·巴克罗饰，成熟而温柔的表演）和她怀孕的母亲背井离乡，直面法西斯主义的恐怖。她的新继父（塞尔吉·洛佩兹饰）是弗朗西斯科·佛朗哥将军军队中的一名虐待狂上尉，她在那里追捕拒绝放弃战斗的共和党游击队。当奥菲莉亚在一个腐烂的迷宫中遇到一个农牧神时，她所生活的暴力现实与她奇幻的内心世界无缝地融合在一起，并开始了一段既可怕又美丽的奇怪、神话般的旅程。在重新审视西班牙历史上这段血腥时期时，德尔·托罗生动地描绘了战争的怪物渗透到孩子的想象中并威胁着年轻人的纯真。
hook_en: An Academy Award–winning dark fable set five years after the end of the Spanish Civil War, Pan’s Labyrinth encapsulates the rich visual style and genre-defying craft of Guillermo del Toro. Eleven-year-old Ofelia (Ivana Baquero, in a mature and tender performance) comes face to face with the horrors of fascism when she and her pregnant mother are uprooted to the countryside, where her new stepfather (Sergi López), a sadistic captain in General Francisco Franco’s army, hunts down Republican guerrillas refusing to give up the fight. The violent reality in which Ofelia lives merges seamlessly with her fantastical interior world when she meets a faun in a decaying labyrinth and is set on a strange, mythic journey that is at once terrifying and beautiful. In his revisiting of this bloody period in Spanish history, del Toro creates a vivid depiction of the monstrosities of war infiltrating a child’s imagination and threatening the innocence of youth.

hook: 继《粉红火烈鸟》和《女性麻烦》的肆无忌惮之后，导演约翰·沃特斯以这部反法西斯童话完美地扭曲了他臭名昭著的垃圾三部曲。歇斯底里的家庭主妇佩吉·格拉维尔（明克·斯托尔饰）在厌烦的管家（吉恩·希尔饰）的帮助下谋杀了自己的丈夫后，这对新发现的“犯罪姐妹”逃到莫特维尔奇异的棚户区，这是一个堕落的流放地，由专制女王（伊迪丝·马西饰）统治，她的暴政迫使她的臣民进行令人震惊的反抗。越轨警察、狗粮致死、DIY 手术——沃特斯以酷儿叛逆的无情扭曲和奇怪的道德愿景释放了这一切以及更多内容。
hook_en: Following the unrepentant outrageousness of Pink Flamingos and Female Trouble, director John Waters brought his notorious trash trilogy to a fittingly twisted close with this antifascist fairy tale. After hysterical housewife Peggy Gravel (Mink Stole) murders her husband with the help of her fed-up housekeeper (Jean Hill), the newfound “sisters in crime” escape to the bizarro shantytown of Mortville, a depraved penal colony presided over by a despotic queen (Edith Massey) whose tyranny pushes her subjects to shocking revolt. Deviant cops, death by dog food, DIY surgery—Waters unleashes all this and more in an at once relentlessly warped and oddly moral vision of queer rebellion.

hook: 《女性麻烦》的魅力从未如此怪诞，它为好莱坞情节剧注入了无政府主义的颓废气息。迪恩是导演约翰·沃特斯传奇般的缪斯女神，她饰演的道恩·达文波特以超凡的魅力席卷了银幕，她是电影中耸人听闻的口头禅“犯罪就是美”的活生生的化身，她从一个一心想在圣诞节穿恰恰鞋的噩梦少年，成长为一个因自大冲动而坐上电椅的名声怪物。这部影片以 16 毫米胶片在沃特斯的故乡巴尔的摩拍摄，演员阵容来自他心爱的梦境剧团常客（包括 Mink Stole、David Lochary、Mary Vivian Pearce、Edith Massey 和 Cookie Mueller），这部影片是导演与《Divine》合作的最爱，通过制作设计师 Vincent Peranio 和服装设计师/化妆师 Van Smith 的金属丝色调视觉效果，栩栩如生。 《Female Trouble》是深受粉丝喜爱的作品，它提供了永远不会满足的变态快感。
hook_en: Glamour has never been more grotesque than in Female Trouble, which injects the Hollywood melodrama with anarchic decadence. Divine, director John Waters’ larger-than-life muse, engulfs the screen with charisma as Dawn Davenport, the living embodiment of the film’s lurid mantra, “Crime is beauty,” who progresses from a teenage nightmare hell-bent on getting cha-cha heels for Christmas to a fame monster whose egomaniacal impulses land her in the electric chair. Shot in Waters’ native Baltimore on 16 mm, with a cast drawn from his beloved troupe of regulars, the Dreamlanders (including Mink Stole, David Lochary, Mary Vivian Pearce, Edith Massey, and Cookie Mueller), this film­—the director’s favorite of his work with Divine—comes to life through the tinsel-toned vision of production designer Vincent Peranio and costume designer/makeup artist Van Smith. An endlessly quotable fan favorite, Female Trouble offers up perverse pleasures that never fail to satisfy.

hook: 在他的第一部摄影棚影片中，肮脏大师约翰·沃特斯利用了他迄今为止最大的预算，让他的缪斯女神全力投入到一个与他以前扮演过的角色不同的角色：巴尔的摩家庭主妇弗朗辛·菲什爪，一个配得上道格拉斯·塞克情节剧的女主角。弗朗辛拥有敏锐的嗅觉，但却受到了一个花心的色情作家丈夫、一个寄生母亲和一对犯罪孩子的诅咒，长期受苦受难的弗朗辛在她的生活分崩离析时转向了瓶子——直到一个名叫托德·托莫罗（托德·托莫罗，老式万人迷塔布·亨特饰）的大块头出现，解救了她。聚酯是沃特斯最搞笑的发明之一，它充满了令人反胃的气味、虐待狂的修女、AA 会议和大量的跺脚。
hook_en: For his first studio picture, filth maestro John Waters took advantage of his biggest budget yet to allow his muse Divine to sink his teeth into a role unlike any he had played before: Baltimore housewife Francine Fishpaw, a heroine worthy of a Douglas Sirk melodrama. Blessed with a keen sense of smell and cursed with a philandering pornographer husband, a parasitic mother, and a pair of delinquent children, the long-suffering Francine turns to the bottle as her life falls apart—until deliverance appears in the form of a hunk named Todd Tomorrow (vintage heartthrob Tab Hunter). One of Waters’ most hilarious inventions, Polyester is replete with stomach-churning smells, sadistic nuns, AA meetings, and foot stomping galore.

hook: 在这部充满希望和信仰的史诗编年史中，两个普通的芝加哥市中心孩子敢于实现不可能的目标——职业篮球荣耀。 《篮球之梦》由史蒂夫·詹姆斯、弗雷德里克·马克思和彼得·吉尔伯特拍摄，历时五年，讲述了年轻的阿瑟·阿吉和威廉·盖茨及其家人的故事，孩子们在复杂、竞争激烈的学术体育世界中航行，同时应对家庭生活和社区的巨大压力。这部具有启发性的电影继续教育和激励观众，它被广泛认为是美国非虚构电影的伟大作品之一。
hook_en: Two ordinary inner-city Chicago kids dare to reach for the impossible—professional basketball glory—in this epic chronicle of hope and faith. Filmed over a five-year period, Hoop Dreams, by Steve James, Frederick Marx, and Peter Gilbert, follows young Arthur Agee and William Gates and their families as the boys navigate the complex, competitive world of scholastic athletics while dealing with the intense pressures of their home lives and neighborhoods. This revelatory film continues to educate and inspire viewers, and it is widely considered one of the great works of American nonfiction cinema.

hook: 在有史以来最重要的纪录片中，埃罗尔·莫里斯的《细细的蓝线》消除了艺术与行动主义之间的界限。这是一部细致的新闻报道和扣人心弦的戏剧性作品，讲述了兰德尔·戴尔·亚当斯 (Randall Dale Adams) 的令人不安的故事。兰德尔·戴尔·亚当斯 (Randall Dale Adams) 是一名流浪者，他被指控谋杀达拉斯一名警察并被送进死牢，尽管有证据表明他没有犯罪。莫里斯将风格化的重演、深入的采访和菲利普·格拉斯令人难忘的原创音乐融为一体，利用电影以法证方式构建案件，同时毫不费力地娱乐观众。 《细细的蓝线》影响了现实世界的变化，毫无疑问地证明了电影的力量。
hook_en: Among the most important documentaries ever made, The Thin Blue Line, by Errol Morris, erases the border between art and activism. A work of meticulous journalism and gripping drama, it recounts the disturbing tale of Randall Dale Adams, a drifter who was charged with the murder of a Dallas police officer and sent to death row, despite evidence that he did not commit the crime. Incorporating stylized reenactments, penetrating interviews, and haunting original music by Philip Glass, Morris uses cinema to build a case forensically while effortlessly entertaining his viewers. The Thin Blue Line effected real-world change, proving film’s power beyond the shadow of a doubt.

hook: 著名剧作家肯尼思·罗纳根 (Kenneth Lonergan) 首次将其丰富的人文主义视野搬上银幕，深情地审视了兄弟姐妹关系的复杂性，这种关系的根基既复杂又深厚。萨米（劳拉·琳妮饰）和她的弟弟特里（马克·鲁法洛饰）在一场车祸中失去了父母。多年后，小镇上的单身母亲萨米又陷入了另一场危机，陷入困境、漂泊不定的特里回家长住了——这可能会让他们的关系更加亲密，也可能会让他们分开。凭借无限的优雅和无与伦比的对话耳朵，罗纳根提供了一些在银幕上罕见的东西：有美丽缺陷的人类，他们的旅程提供了令人心痛的洞察力，让你了解长大后会发生什么变化，什么不会。
hook_en: Celebrated playwright Kenneth Lonergan first brought his rich, humanist vision to the screen with this soulful look at the complexities of a sibling relationship whose roots are as knotted as they are deep. Years after Sammy (Laura Linney) and her younger brother, Terry (Mark Ruffalo), lost their parents in a car crash, small-town single mother Sammy is plunged into another crisis when the troubled, adrift Terry comes home for what turns out to be an extended stay—one that could either bring them closer together or tear them apart. With infinite grace and his peerless ear for dialogue, Lonergan offers something all too rare on-screen: beautifully flawed human beings whose journeys offer achingly relatable insight into what changes when you grow up—and what doesn’t.

hook: 1999 年哥伦拜恩高中惨案发生后，勇敢的电影制片人迈克尔·摩尔 (Michael Moore) 开始调查美国人与枪支之间长期且不稳定的爱情故事，揭露让国家陷入困境的普遍恐惧文化。摩尔配备了相机和麦克风，沿着科罗拉多州利特尔顿和密歇根州弗林特的子弹轨迹，一路到达凯马特中西部总部和全国步枪协会主席查尔顿·赫斯顿位于比佛利山庄的豪宅，沿途会见了枪击幸存者、民兵成员、温文尔雅的加拿大人和摇滚煽动者玛丽莲·曼森。荣获奥斯卡奖的《哥伦拜恩保龄球》取得了空前的成功，开创了纪录片制作的新纪元，它是一次穿越美国心灵的喧闹、热情且仍然与悲剧相关的旅程。
hook_en: In the wake of the Columbine High School massacre in 1999, the intrepid filmmaker Michael Moore set out to investigate the long, often volatile love affair between Americans and their firearms, uncovering the pervasive culture of fear that keeps the nation locked and loaded. Equipped with a camera and a microphone, Moore follows the trail of bullets from Littleton, Colorado, and Flint, Michigan, all the way to Kmart’s midwestern headquarters and NRA president Charlton Heston’s Beverly Hills mansion, meeting shooting survivors, militia members, mild-mannered Canadians, and rock provocateur Marilyn Manson along the way. An unprecedented popular success that helped usher in a new era in documentary filmmaking, the Oscar-winning Bowling for Columbine is a raucous, impassioned, and still tragically relevant journey through the American psyche.

hook: 大卫·利恩（ David Lean ）的《伟大期望》（ Great Expectations ）是将文学作品翻译成电影的伟大作品之一，将查尔斯·狄更斯（ Charles Dickens ）的杰作带入了强大的屏幕生活。皮普（ Pip ）、马格维奇（ Magwitch ）、郝薇香小姐（ Miss Havisham ）和埃斯特拉（ Estella ）居住在精益（ Lean ）的宏伟微缩模型中，该微缩模型由盖伊·格林（ Guy Green
hook_en: One of the great translations of literature into film, David Lean's Great Expectations brings Charles Dickens's masterpiece to robust on-screen life. Pip, Magwitch, Miss Havisham, and Estella populate Lean’s magnificent miniature, beautifully photographed by Guy Green and designed by John Bryan.

hook: 《魔鬼的脊梁》是吉列尔莫·德尔·托罗最个人化的电影之一，也是他最令人恐惧和情感层次最丰富的电影之一。该剧以西班牙内战的最后一周为背景，讲述了一名 12 岁男孩在其为自由而战的父亲被杀后，被送往一座闹鬼的乡村孤儿院，里面充满了可怕的秘密。德尔·托罗巧妙地将哥特式鬼故事、谋杀之谜和历史情节剧巧妙地融合在一起，形成一种时尚的融合，就像他后来的《潘神的迷宫》一样，提醒我们最可怕的怪物往往是人类。
hook_en: One of the most personal films by Guillermo del Toro, The Devil’s Backbone is also among his most frightening and emotionally layered. Set during the final week of the Spanish Civil War, it tells the tale of a twelve-year-old boy who, after his freedom-fighting father is killed, is sent to a haunted rural orphanage full of terrible secrets. Del Toro expertly combines gothic ghost story, murder mystery, and historical melodrama in a stylish mélange that, like his later Pan’s Labyrinth, reminds us the scariest monsters are often the human ones.

hook: 《欲望之翼》是电影界最可爱的城市交响曲之一。布鲁诺·甘茨饰演达米尔，一位栖息在柏林高楼顶上的天使，他可以听到生活在下面的所有人的想法——恐惧、希望、梦想。但当他爱上一位美丽的空中飞人艺术家时，他愿意放弃自己的不朽，回到地球与她在一起。这部令人惊叹的声音和图像挂毯在柏林墙倒塌前不久制作，由传奇人物亨利·阿勒坎 (Henri Alekan) 以黑白和彩色拍摄，使导演维姆·文德斯 (Wim Wenders) 的名字永远成为电影艺术的代名词。
hook_en: Wings of Desire is one of cinema’s loveliest city symphonies. Bruno Ganz is Damiel, an angel perched atop buildings high over Berlin who can hear the thoughts—fears, hopes, dreams—of all the people living below. But when he falls in love with a beautiful trapeze artist, he is willing to give up his immortality and come back to earth to be with her. Made not long before the fall of the Berlin Wall, this stunning tapestry of sounds and images, shot in black and white and color by the legendary Henri Alekan, forever made the name of director Wim Wenders synonymous with film art.

hook: 备受赞誉的编剧兼导演劳伦斯·卡斯丹 (Lawrence Kasdan) 凭借其处女作，出色地将 20 世纪 40 年代黑色电影的惯例更新为 20 世纪 80 年代，成为有史以来最火爆、最具影响力的色情惊悚片之一。在闷热的南佛罗里达海岸，律师内德·拉辛（威廉·赫特饰）与婚姻不幸的家庭主妇马蒂·沃克（凯瑟琳·特纳饰）卷入了一段火热的恋情，不久之后他们就策划了谋杀她富有丈夫的计划。 《体热》以巧妙的情节曲折、令人难忘的冷酷对话以及令人回味的氛围为特色，是一部关于贪婪和欲望的慵懒诱人的故事，为美国犯罪电影铺平了一条新道路。
hook_en: With his debut feature, acclaimed writer-director Lawrence Kasdan brilliantly updated the conventions of 1940s film noir for the 1980s, resulting in one of the steamiest and most influential erotic thrillers ever made. On the sultry South Florida coast, lawyer Ned Racine (William Hurt) is drawn into a torrid affair with unhappily married housewife Matty Walker (Kathleen Turner, in a star-making performance)—and it’s not long before they’ve hatched a scheme to murder her wealthy husband. Featuring ingenious plot twists, memorable hard-boiled dialogue, and an atmosphere so evocative you can practically feel the humidity, Body Heat is a languorously seductive tale of greed and desire, one that paved a new path for American crime cinema.

hook: 在这部处女作中，索菲亚·科波拉宣布了她独特的愿景，探索女性美学，同时照亮年轻女性的内心生活。 《处女之死》改编自杰弗里·尤金尼德斯广受好评的第一部小说，在故事中，里斯本五姐妹因宗教父母过度保护的规定而窒息而亡，讲述了一群当时还是男孩、仍然渴望了解发生了什么的男人的集体记忆，在故事中唤起了青少年渴望和厌倦的不可言喻的忧郁。这部电影通过埃德·拉赫曼 (Ed Lachman) 的空灵摄影和 Air 大气的配乐，以及克尔斯滕·邓斯特 (Kirsten Dunst) 的精彩表演，唤起了 1970 年代的郊区场景，为导演在美国独立电影界赢得了一席之地，并成为了成长的试金石。
hook_en: With this debut feature, Sofia Coppola announced her singular vision, exploring the aesthetics of femininity while illuminating the interior lives of young women. An adaptation of Jeffrey Eugenides’s highly acclaimed first novel, The Virgin Suicides conjures the ineffable melancholy of teenage longing and ennui in its story of the suicides of the five Lisbon sisters, stifled by the rules of their overprotective religious parents—as told through the collective memory of a group of men who were boys at the time and still yearn to understand what happened. Evoking its 1970s suburban setting through ethereal cinematography by Ed Lachman and an atmospheric score by Air, and featuring a magnetic performance by Kirsten Dunst, the film secured a place for its director in the landscape of American independent cinema and has become a coming-of-age touchstone.

hook: 拉斯·冯·提尔凭借这部关于性和精神超越的现实主义寓言引起了国际轰动。在一部获得奥斯卡提名的表演中，艾米丽·沃森 (Emily Watson) 饰演的贝丝 (Bess) 令人惊叹。贝丝是苏格兰一个小村庄里的一位朴素、虔诚的新婚夫妇，在丈夫（斯特兰·斯卡斯加德饰）在一次石油钻井事故中瘫痪后，她以一种令人震惊的方式殉道。 《破浪》既厚颜无耻又温柔，既亵渎又纯粹，是对信仰的广阔性及其局限性的检验。
hook_en: Lars von Trier became an international sensation with this galvanizing realist fable about sex and spiritual transcendence. In an Oscar-nominated performance, Emily Watson stuns as Bess, a simple, pious newlywed in a tiny Scottish village who gives herself up to a shocking form of martyrdom after her husband (Stellan Skarsgård) is paralyzed in an oil rig accident. Breaking the Waves, both brazen and tender, profane and pure, is an examination of the expansiveness of faith and of its limits.

hook: 特里·吉列姆的无限想象力产生了令人眼花缭乱的史诗般的幻想。受到传说中的孟乔森男爵的奢侈功绩的启发，这部奇观诞生于一场著名的动荡制作中，讲述了异想天开的十八世纪贵族（约翰·内维尔饰），他开始了一次奇异的探索，从遥远的土地到月球，再到海怪的肚子，甚至更远的地方，同时与复仇心重的苏丹和逻辑暴政展开战斗。奥斯卡提名的《孟乔森男爵历险记》充满了特效、顽皮的智慧和丰富多彩的表演，包括年轻的莎拉·波莉饰演男爵严肃的助手，这是对虚构战胜现实的一场盛大庆祝。
hook_en: The boundless imagination of Terry Gilliam yields a dazzling fantasy of epic proportions. Inspired by the extravagant exploits of the fabled Baron Munchausen, this spectacle—born of a famously turbulent production—follows the whimsical eighteenth-century nobleman (John Neville) as he embarks on an outlandish quest that takes him from faraway lands to the moon to the belly of a sea monster and beyond, meanwhile waging battle against a vengeful sultan and the tyranny of logic. Packed frame to frame with special effects, mischievous wit, and colorful performances—including a young Sarah Polley as the Baron’s no-nonsense sidekick—the Oscar-nominated The Adventures of Baron Munchausen is a lavish celebration of the triumph of make-believe over reality.

hook: 氏族覆灭后，一名失业武士（仲代龙也饰）来到伊伊领主的庄园，请求允许在庄园内进行自杀仪式。伊伊的族人相信绝望的浪人只是在谋取新的地位，试图迫使他出手，让他自掏腰包——但他们低估了他的信仰和个人荣誉。小林正树执导的《切腹》获得了戛纳电影节评审团特别奖，在腐败和虚伪的制度面前强烈地唤起了个人的力量。
hook_en: Following the collapse of his clan, an unemployed samurai (Tatsuya Nakadai) arrives at the manor of Lord Iyi, begging to be allowed to commit ritual suicide on the property. Iyi’s clansmen, believing the desperate ronin is merely angling for a new position, try to force his hand and get him to eviscerate himself—but they have underestimated his beliefs and his personal brand of honor. Winner of the Cannes Film Festival’s Special Jury Prize, Harakiri, directed by Masaki Kobayashi is a fierce evocation of individual agency in the face of a corrupt and hypocritical system.

hook: 在这部具有里程碑意义的西部片中，黑色阴影蔓延到了边境，这是导演安东尼·曼和演员詹姆斯·斯图尔特之间的首次合作，以其道德和心理强度重新定义了这一类型。斯图尔特在职业生涯中期开始转变为越来越尖锐的角色，他扮演了一名复仇的神枪手，他被盗的步枪从一只注定要失败的手传递到另一只手，成为死亡的预兆。这部由暴力引发暴力的基本故事开辟了新天地，其中包括感人的雪莱·温特斯 (Shelley Winters)、令人震惊的肮脏丹·杜里亚 (Dan Duryea) 和未成名的罗克·哈德森 (Rock Hudson)，它开辟了新天地，将西方描绘成反英雄和恶棍的无人区。
hook_en: Noirish shadows spread across the frontier in this landmark western, the first of the celebrated collaborations between director Anthony Mann and actor James Stewart that redefined the genre with their moral and psychological intensity. Beginning his midcareer transition into increasingly edgy roles, Stewart portrays an avenging sharpshooter whose stolen rifle becomes a harbinger of death as it is passed from one doomed hand to the next. Featuring a stellar cast that includes a touching Shelley Winters, a sensationally sleazy Dan Duryea, and a pre-stardom Rock Hudson, this elemental tale of violence begetting violence broke new ground with its evocation of the West as a no-man’s-land of antiheroes and villains.

hook: 在伊朗导演贾法尔·帕纳西 (Jafar Panahi) 执导的这部金棕榈奖得主影片中，一次偶遇引发了一部紧迫的道德惊悚片。当一名被困的司机（易卜拉欣·阿齐兹饰）走进他的店里时，机械师瓦希德（瓦希德·莫巴塞里饰）相信他遇到了埃克巴尔，一个臭名昭著的残暴警卫，在他的政治监禁期间对他施以酷刑。瓦希德召集了一群前囚犯和其他盟友，着手将正义掌握在自己手中——但他找到了合适的人选吗？ 《这只是一次意外》是在帕纳西长期被禁止在祖国拍摄电影后秘密拍摄的，它是一部持续紧张和尖刻幽默的杰作，挑衅性地改变视角来审视创伤和复仇的重要问题。
hook_en: In this Palme d’Or winner from the Iranian auteur Jafar Panahi, a chance encounter sets in motion an urgent moral thriller. When a stranded driver (Ebrahim Azizi) walks into his shop, mechanic Vahid (Vahid Mobasseri) believes he has come face-to-face with Eqbal, a notoriously brutal guard who tortured him during his political imprisonment. Gathering a band of fellow former inmates and other allies, Vahid sets out to take justice into his own hands—but does he have the right man? Shot in secret after Panahi’s longtime ban from filmmaking in his home country, It Was Just an Accident is a tour de force of sustained tension and mordant humor, provocatively shifting perspectives to examine vital questions of trauma and revenge.

hook: 黑色电影中没有比这部关于恶行和报应的灼热故事更冷酷无情的了，在这部电影中，导演弗里茨·朗正处于好莱坞风格的顶峰——剥到骨头，沸腾着愤怒，骨子里是宿命论。身受重伤的格伦·福特饰演一名凶杀案侦探，他对一个庞大的犯罪集团的调查变成了一场令人震惊的个人、充满仇恨的复仇之旅。由标志性的格洛丽亚·格雷厄姆 (Gloria Grahame) 主演，饰演这位身着貂皮大衣的歹徒的情妇，一心一意，配角则由极其邋遢的李·马文 (Lee Marvin) 领衔，《大热火》以原始、不可阻挡的力量来袭。
hook_en: Noir doesn’t get any more hard-boiled than this scorching tale of vice and retribution, a film that finds director Fritz Lang working at the peak of his Hollywood style—stripped to the bone, simmering with outrage, and fatalistic to the core. A tightly wound Glenn Ford stars as a homicide detective whose investigation into a sprawling crime syndicate becomes a shockingly personal, hate-fueled quest for revenge. Costarring an iconic Gloria Grahame as the mink-coated gangster’s moll with her own axe to grind, and featuring a supporting cast led by a sensationally sleazy Lee Marvin, The Big Heat hits with raw, unstoppable force.

hook: 凭借对赫尔曼·梅尔维尔的《水手比利·巴德》的令人着迷的感性演绎，克莱尔·丹尼斯牢固地确立了自己作为我们这个时代最伟大的视觉音调诗人之一的地位。在吉布提蔚蓝的海水和阳光炙烤的沙漠景观中，一名法国外籍军团中士（丹尼斯·拉万特饰）播下了自己毁灭的种子，他对一名引人注目的年轻新兵（格雷瓜尔·科林饰）的痴迷在本杰明·布里顿雷鸣般的歌剧旋律中上演。丹尼斯和电影摄影师阿涅斯·戈达尔将军事和男性荣誉准则、殖民主义的遗产、破坏性的嫉妒和压抑的欲望融合在一起，形成闪闪发光、催眠的图像，最终在所有现代电影中最令人震惊和难忘的结局之一中爆炸。
hook_en: With her ravishingly sensual take on Herman Melville’s Billy Budd, Sailor, Claire Denis firmly established herself as one of the great visual tone poets of our time. Amid the azure waters and sunbaked desert landscapes of Djibouti, a French Foreign Legion sergeant (Denis Lavant) sows the seeds of his own ruin as his obsession with a striking young recruit (Grégoire Colin) plays out to the thunderous, operatic strains of Benjamin Britten. Denis and cinematographer Agnès Godard fold military and masculine codes of honor, colonialism’s legacy, destructive jealousy, and repressed desire into shimmering, hypnotic images that ultimately explode in one of the most startling and unforgettable endings in all of modern cinema.

hook: 南希·萨沃卡这部关于爱情和战争的有趣而敏感的故事描绘了 20 世纪 60 年代年轻人难以言喻的苦乐参半的形象，它刻画了两个生动鲜活的人物：有抱负的旧金山民谣歌手罗斯（莉莉·泰勒饰）和性情急躁、前往越南的海军陆战队员埃迪·伯莱斯（瑞弗·菲尼克斯饰）。但一开始的难忘之夜却出人意料地发展成为更有意义的事情。 《Dogfight》以民间传奇人物琼·贝兹 (Joan Baez)、鲍勃·迪伦 (Bob Dylan) 和皮特·西格 (Pete Seeger) 的音乐为特色，捕捉了人与人之间联系的奇迹，同时优雅地颠覆了有关大男子主义、爱国责任和美国本身意义的观念。
hook_en: An ineffably bittersweet portrait of youth in the 1960s, Nancy Savoca’s funny, sensitive tale of love and war etches two vividly alive characters: aspiring San Francisco folk singer Rose (Lili Taylor) and hotheaded, Vietnam-bound marine Eddie Birdlace (River Phoenix), who meet on the occasion of a cruelly misogynistic party where men compete to bring the most unattractive dates they can find. But what begins as a night to forget unexpectedly develops into something far more meaningful. Featuring music by folk legends Joan Baez, Bob Dylan, and Pete Seeger, Dogfight captures the miracle of human connection while gracefully subverting ideas surrounding machismo, patriotic duty, and the very meaning of America itself.

hook: 《Round Midnight》是导演 Bertrand Tavernier 写给比波普全盛时期以及在 20 世纪 50 年代巴黎烟雾缭绕的地下爵士俱乐部避难的美国黑人音乐家的一封情书。传奇萨克斯管演奏家德克斯特·戈登 (Dexter Gordon) 饰演戴尔·特纳 (Dale Turner)，一位才华横溢的纽约爵士乐老手，他的音乐因美丽而痛苦，但他的个人生活却因毒瘾而遭到破坏。为了在巴黎寻找新的开始，特纳与一位苦苦挣扎的单亲父亲和热心的爵士乐迷（弗朗索瓦·克鲁塞饰）建立了一段不太可能的友谊，当他试图帮助这位自我毁灭的音乐家时，他发现自己的生活发生了变化。赫比·汉考克 (Herbie Hancock) 荣获奥斯卡奖的令人回味的配乐为这部权威爵士乐电影奠定了基调，这是一部苦乐参半的作品，闪烁着鲜活、深情的真实性。
hook_en: ’Round Midnight is a love letter from director Bertrand Tavernier to the heyday of bebop and the Black American musicians who found refuge in the smoky underground jazz clubs of 1950s Paris. In a sui generis, Oscar-nominated fusion of performer and character, legendary saxophonist Dexter Gordon plays Dale Turner, a brilliant New York jazz veteran whose music aches with beauty but whose personal life is ravaged by addiction. Searching for a fresh start in Paris, Turner strikes up an unlikely friendship with a struggling single father and ardent jazz fan (François Cluzet) who finds his life transformed as he attempts to help the self-destructive musician. Herbie Hancock’s evocative, Oscar-winning score sets the mood for this definitive jazz film, a bittersweet opus that glows with lived-in, soulful authenticity.

hook: 在这部荣获奥斯卡奖的闹剧中，加里·格兰特（饰演最初定义了加里·格兰特形象的角色）和艾琳·邓恩散发着魅力、狡猾和天真无邪的感情，饰演一对温文尔雅的夫妇，他们厌倦了彼此的不忠，决定提出离婚。但尽管他们试图继续前进，顽皮的杰瑞还是忍不住插手了露西与一位以玉米为食的俄克拉荷马州商人（拉尔夫·贝拉米饰）的不般配的订婚，羞愧的露西开始意识到她可能要告别唯一一个能够跟随她的舞伴了。 《可怕的真相》由多才多艺的利奥·麦卡里执导，他是即兴创作和闹剧的大师，也是对人类愚蠢行为的敏锐而富有同情心的观察者，《可怕的真相》是一部温暖但无情的喜剧，讲述了两个人的缺点只会让他们更难以抗拒。
hook_en: In this Oscar-winning farce, Cary Grant (in the role that first defined the Cary Grant persona) and Irene Dunne exude charm, cunning, and artless affection as an urbane couple who, fed up with each other’s infidelities, resolve to file for divorce. But try as they might to move on, the mischievous Jerry can’t help meddling in Lucy’s ill-matched engagement to a corn-fed Oklahoma businessman (Ralph Bellamy), and a mortified Lucy begins to realize that she may be saying goodbye to the only dance partner capable of following her lead. Directed by the versatile Leo McCarey, a master of improvisation and slapstick as well as a keen and sympathetic observer of human folly, The Awful Truth is a warm but unsparing comedy about two people whose flaws only make them more irresistible.

hook: 当沟口健二制作《雨月》时，他已经是日本电影界的一位元老政治家，深受黑泽明和其他年轻一代导演的推崇。通过这个精致的鬼故事，一场源自上田明成和居伊·德·莫泊桑的故事的宿命论战时悲剧，他创造了自己艺术的试金石，他的长镜头和扫视镜头引导观众经历了一个关于两个村民的疯狂叙述，他们对名誉和财富的追求使他们远离了忠诚的妻子。游走于尘世与超凡脱俗之间，雨月揭示了有关战争的破坏、女性的困境和男性的骄傲的基本真相。电影基金会和角川公司在纽约的 Cineric 实验室修复了《雨月》。特别感谢宫岛正宏和马丁·斯科塞斯为本次修复提供的咨询。修复资金由好莱坞外国记者协会、电影基金会和角川公司联合提供。
hook_en: By the time he made Ugetsu, Kenji Mizoguchi was already an elder statesman of Japanese cinema, fiercely revered by Akira Kurosawa and other directors of a younger generation. And with this exquisite ghost story, a fatalistic wartime tragedy derived from stories by Akinari Ueda and Guy de Maupassant, he created a touchstone of his art, his long takes and sweeping camera guiding the viewer through a delirious narrative about two villagers whose pursuit of fame and fortune leads them far astray from their loyal wives. Moving between the terrestrial and the otherworldly, Ugetsu reveals essential truths about the ravages of war, the plight of women, and the pride of men. Ugetsu was restored by The Film Foundation and Kadokawa Corporation at Cineric Laboratories in New York. Special thanks to Masahiro Miyajima and Martin Scorsese for their consultation on this restoration. Restoration funding provided by the Hollywood Foreign Press Association in association with The Film Foundation and Kadokawa Corporation.

hook: 特吕弗的第一部长片，也是最私密的一部。透过他的银幕化身安托万·杜瓦内尔（让-皮埃尔·莱奥），《四百击》细腻重现特吕弗自己艰难的童年，并确立他为法国新浪潮开路的作者地位。
hook_en: François Truffaut’s first feature is also his most personal. Told through the eyes of Truffaut’s cinematic counterpart, Antoine Doinel (Jean-Pierre Léaud), The 400 Blows sensitively recreates the trials of Truffaut’s own difficult childhood. The film established Truffaut as a trailblazing auteur of the French New Wave.

hook: 在这部由编剧兼导演吉娜·普林斯-拜斯伍德（《老卫士》）执导的开创性长片中，场上场下都火花四射，该片诚实地表达了女性运动员在一个不平等的世界中面临的挑战，从而提升了成长的浪漫色彩。萨娜·莱森（《异形大战铁血战士》）和奥马尔·埃普斯（《高等教育》）是 2000 年代最具标志性的银幕情侣之一，他们是痴迷于篮球的邻居，通过调情的比赛找到了爱情，在大学篮球和家庭的压力下分崩离析，在追求职业生涯的双重愿望时，在彼此的生活中忽隐忽现。在出色的配角表演和不拘一格的 R&B 配乐的帮助下，《爱情与篮球》捕捉到了令人陶醉的激情、令人心碎的挫折和雄心勃勃的野心，这些标志着一位年轻女性走向巅峰和永恒爱情的旅程。
hook_en: Sparks fly both on and off the court in this groundbreaking feature debut by writer-director Gina Prince-Bythewood (The Old Guard), which elevated the coming-of-age romance by giving honest expression to the challenges female athletes face in a world that doesn’t see them as equal. Sanaa Lathan (Alien vs. Predator) and Omar Epps (Higher Learning) make for one of the most iconic screen couples of the 2000s as the basketball-obsessed next-door neighbors who find love over flirtatious pickup games, fall apart under the strain of high-pressure college hoops and families, and drift in and out of each other’s lives as they pursue their twin aspirations of playing professionally. Aided by stellar supporting performances and an eclectic R&B soundtrack, Love & Basketball captures the intoxicating passions, heartbreaking setbacks, and sky-high ambitions that mark a young woman’s journey to the top of her game and to lasting love.

hook: 在冷战最激烈的时期，苏联电影业开始以一部让世界眼花缭乱的作品来证明自己能够超越好莱坞：这部改编自列夫·托尔斯泰经典巨著的宏大而令人敬畏的电影，讲述了三个灵魂的命运——浮躁而善良的皮埃尔；英雄般的悲剧安德烈王子；和容光焕发、暴躁的娜塔莎——在拿破仑战争的喧嚣中碰撞。导演谢尔盖·邦达尔丘克 (Sergei Bondarchuk) 动用了数千名演员和一系列创新的摄影技术，塑造了一幅一览无遗的景象：闪烁着洛可可式美感的盛大舞会和压倒性表现主义力量的惊心动魄的战斗。作为苏联电影实力的体现，《战争与和平》取得了巨大成功，获得了奥斯卡最佳外语片奖，并为史诗电影制作树立了新标准。
hook_en: At the height of the Cold War, the Soviet film industry set out to prove it could outdo Hollywood with a production that would dazzle the world: a titanic, awe-inspiring adaptation of Leo Tolstoy’s classic tome in which the fates of three souls—the blundering, good-hearted Pierre; the heroically tragic Prince Andrei; and the radiant, tempestuous Natasha—collide amid the tumult of the Napoleonic Wars. Employing a cast of thousands and an array of innovative camera techniques, director Sergei Bondarchuk conjures a sweeping vision of grand balls that glitter with rococo beauty and breathtaking battles that overwhelm with their expressionistic power. As a statement of Soviet cinema’s might, War and Peace succeeded wildly, garnering the Academy Award for best foreign-language film and setting a new standard for epic moviemaking.

hook: 编剧兼导演布鲁斯·罗宾逊和主演理查德·E·格兰特，这两位深受观众喜爱的喜剧天才，重新联​​手打造了这部关于玛格丽特·撒切尔时代英国失控资本主义的邪恶黑暗讽刺剧。格兰特在片中饰演一位雄心勃勃的广告主管，他的最新任务——设计一款祛痘霜的广告系列——让他处于精神崩溃的边缘。当他的肩膀上长出一个巨大的肿块时——这个肿块不仅会说话，而且有着邪恶的野心——一场扭曲的意志之战随之而来。这部由言语争斗和肢体喜剧组成的杰作，具有令人难以置信的肉体恐怖效果和奇闻趣事超现实主义，是一部刻薄的杰基尔和海德故事，讲述了贪婪是好的 20 世纪 80 年代。
hook_en: Writer-director Bruce Robinson and star Richard E. Grant, the cracked comic geniuses behind the cult favorite Withnail and I, reteamed for this diabolically dark satire of runaway capitalism in Margaret Thatcher–era England. Grant gives a virtuosically crazed performance as an ambitious advertising exec whose latest assignment—devising a campaign for a pimple cream—has him on the edge of a nervous breakdown. When he sprouts an enormous boil on his shoulder—one that not only talks but has evil ambitions of its own—a twisted battle of wills ensues. With fantastically fleshy body-horror effects and flourishes of gonzo surrealism, this tour de force of verbal jousting and physical comedy is a caustic Jekyll-and-Hyde tale for the greed-is-good 1980s.

hook: 洛奇·克里根 (Lodge Kerrigan) 开始了他一系列完全独特、视觉和听觉上令人眼花缭乱的人物研究，其中包括原始的、具有破坏性的《Clean, Shaven》。凯里根的电影引人入胜地深入探讨了一位精神分裂症患者（由杰出的彼得·格林饰演）出院后试图寻找女儿的心境，巧妙地利用声音和图像引导观众进入一种可怕的主观性。没有人能够毫发无伤。
hook_en: Lodge Kerrigan began his succession of utterly unique, visually and aurally dazzling character studies with the raw, ravaging Clean, Shaven. A compelling headfirst dive into the mindscape of a schizophrenic (played by the remarkable Peter Greene) as he tries to track down his daughter after he is released from an institution, Kerrigan's film brilliantly uses sound and image to lead audiences into a terrifying subjectivity. No one is left unscathed.

hook: 鲍勃·霍斯金斯（ Bob Hoskins ）的可燃表演是这部黑社会传奇电影的导火索，这部传奇电影是英国犯罪电影的标志性建筑。霍斯金斯扮演哈罗德·尚德（ Harold Shand ） ，一个雄心勃勃的伦敦流氓，当他试图与美国黑手党达成一项重大房地产交易时，发现他的犯罪帝国被一系列袭击所震撼，于是他开始无情地寻找肇事者。在海伦·米伦（ Helen Mirren ）作为尚德的演员表演的冰冷表演的怂恿下…
hook_en: A combustible performance from Bob Hoskins is the fuse that lights this underworld saga, a landmark of British crime cinema. Hoskins plays Harold Shand, an ambitious London mobster who, just as he attempts to close a major real-estate deal with the American Mafia, finds his crime empire rocked by a string of attacks, sending him on a ruthless quest to find out who’s responsible. Abetted by an ice-cool performance from Helen Mirren as Shand’s in-command moll, The Long Good Friday is not only a gripping gangster thriller but also a vivid portrait of late-1970s Britain—a powder keg of cultural and political tensions on the verge of explosion.

hook: 好莱坞传奇人物芭芭拉·斯坦威克与编剧兼导演塞缪尔·富勒联手打造了这位通俗大师最大胆的西部片，这是对这一类型的大胆女权主义诠释，毫不费力地在粗俗幽默、发自内心的动作和令人放松的温柔之间摇摆。骑术高超的牧场主杰西卡·德拉蒙德（斯坦威克饰）指挥着四十名牛仔，毫无挑战地统治着亚利桑那州科奇斯县。当美国元帅格里夫·博内尔（巴里·沙利文饰）和他的兄弟带着对她雇佣的一把枪的搜查令来到镇上时，杰西卡开始爱上这位执法者，尽管他削弱了她的权威。 《四十支枪》凭借令人惊叹的宽银幕黑白摄影、夹杂着双关语的冷酷对话以及斯坦威克最专横的火热表演，充分展示了富勒的射击天赋。
hook_en: Hollywood legend Barbara Stanwyck saddled up with writer-director Samuel Fuller for the pulp maestro’s most audacious western, a boldly feminist spin on the genre that pivots effortlessly between ribald humor, visceral action, and disarming tenderness. High-riding rancher Jessica Drummond (Stanwyck) commands a forty-strong posse of cowboys, ruling Cochise County, Arizona, without challenge. When U.S. Marshal Griff Bonell (Barry Sullivan) and his brothers arrive in town with a warrant for one of her hired guns, Jessica begins to fall for the lawman even as he chips away at her authority. With astonishing black-and-white CinemaScope photography, hard-boiled dialogue laced with double entendres, and a fiery performance by Stanwyck at her most imperious, Forty Guns is a virtuoso display of Fuller’s sharpshooting talents.

hook: 通过撕裂的爱情故事Sid & Nancy ， Alex Cox重新构想了朋克最臭名昭著的自我毁灭海报儿童之间的崩溃和焚烧事件： Sex Pistols贝斯手Sid Vicious和他的女朋友Nancy Spungen通过Gary Oldman和Chloe Webb的精彩表演带来了内心的生活。考克斯将他无政府主义的电影制作风格转变为伦敦朋克舞台和70年代纽约堕落的街道的爆炸性能量，…
hook_en: With the lacerating love story Sid & Nancy, Alex Cox reimagines the crash-and-burn affair between punk’s most notorious self-destructive poster children: Sex Pistols bassist Sid Vicious and his girlfriend, Nancy Spungen—brought to visceral life by brilliant performances from Gary Oldman and Chloe Webb. Cox turns his anarchic filmmaking style on the explosive energy of the London punk scene and the degenerate streets of seventies New York, making for an eviscerating depiction of excess and addiction. Through the lens of cinematographer Roger Deakins, the imagery goes from swooning to grimy, and the film’s bleakness is balanced with surreal humor and genuine tenderness, making for an affecting, music-fueled vision of doomed love.

hook: 电影史上最炫目的处女作里，二十五岁的奥逊·威尔斯身兼编剧、制片、导演与主演，把有声片时代的可能熔成或可称作第一部真正现代的电影。讲述威廉·伦道夫·赫斯特式报业大亨查尔斯·福斯特·凯恩的骤起骤落时，他不但画出美国唯我狂的决定性肖像，还掀起风格创新的洪流——从拼图式叙事到格雷格·托兰惊人的景深摄影——确保每一代观众遇见《公民凯恩》，仍觉新鲜、仍被击中。
hook_en: In the most dazzling debut feature in cinema history, twenty-five-year-old writer-producer-director-star Orson Welles synthesized the possibilities of sound-era filmmaking into what could be called the first truly modern movie. In telling the story of the meteoric rise and precipitous fall of a William Randolph Hearst–like newspaper magnate named Charles Foster Kane, Welles not only created the definitive portrait of American megalomania, he also unleashed a torrent of stylistic innovations—from the jigsaw-puzzle narrative structure to the stunning deep-focus camera work of Gregg Toland—that have ensured that Citizen Kane remains fresh and galvanizing for every new generation of moviegoers to encounter it.

hook: 罗伯特·布列松用最简单的概念和最简单的技巧，制作了有史以来最悬疑的越狱电影之一《越狱者》。这部令人难以置信的紧张而有条理的奇迹以一位被监禁的法国抵抗运动领导人的叙述为基础，讲述了虚构的方丹对自由的一心一意的追求，以扣人心弦的精确度详细描述了他越狱的计划和执行。但布列松的电影不仅仅关乎过程，它也是一部充满强烈灵性和人性的作品。
hook_en: With the simplest of concepts and sparest of techniques, Robert Bresson made one of the most suspenseful jailbreak films of all time in A Man Escaped. Based on the account of an imprisoned French Resistance leader, this unbelievably taut and methodical marvel follows the fictional Fontaine’s single-minded pursuit of freedom, detailing the planning and execution of his escape with gripping precision. But Bresson’s film is not merely about process—it’s also a work of intense spirituality and humanity.

hook: 这部色彩缤纷、激动人心的浪漫故事席卷了戛纳电影节，勇敢地深入探讨了一位年轻女性的初恋和性觉醒经历。 《蓝色是最温暖的颜色》由著名新人阿黛尔·埃克萨霍普洛斯饰演一名高中生，令她自己惊讶的是，她与蕾雅·赛杜饰演的一名二十多岁的艺术女学生建立了一段惊心动魄的关系。这部由阿卜杜勒拉蒂夫·克西切 (Abdellatif Kechiche) 执导的史诗片细致入微、私密，敏感地呈现了青春时代的情欲放纵。它吸引了国际观众，并被广泛认为是新世纪的爱情故事。
hook_en: The colorful, electrifying romance that took the Cannes Film Festival by storm courageously dives into a young woman’s experiences of first love and sexual awakening. Blue Is the Warmest Color stars the remarkable newcomer Adèle Exarchopoulos as a high schooler who, much to her own surprise, plunges into a thrilling relationship with a female twentysomething art student, played by Léa Seydoux. Directed by Abdellatif Kechiche, this finely detailed, intimate epic sensitively renders the erotic abandon of youth. It has captivated international audiences and been widely embraced as a defining love story for the new century.

hook: 在 Sean Baker 和 Shih-Ching Tsou 的原始、真实的《外卖》中，美国梦似乎很少如此遥远，该片沉浸在一个无证中国移民在 9/11 后纽约市边缘挣扎的生活中。面对高利贷者的暴力报复，餐厅送货员明丁必须等到傍晚才能还清欠下的钱，他在疯狂的一天中争分夺秒地赚取足够的小费，同时遇到了沉重的挫折和意想不到的人性时刻。通过这个简单的设置，贝克和邹塑造了一种新现实主义的日常生活惊悚片，以富有同情心的方式揭示了维持纽约运转的、经常被忽视的生活和劳动。
hook_en: The American dream has rarely seemed so far away as in Sean Baker and Shih-Ching Tsou’s raw, vérité Take Out, an immersion in the life of an undocumented Chinese immigrant struggling to get by on the margins of post-9/11 New York City. Facing violent retaliation from a loan shark, restaurant deliveryman Ming Ding has until nightfall to pay back the money he owes, and he encounters both crushing setbacks and moments of unexpected humanity as he races against time to earn enough in tips over the course of a frantic day. From this simple setup, Baker and Tsou fashion a kind of neorealist survival thriller of the everyday, shedding compassionate light on the too often overlooked lives and labor that keep New York running.

hook: 这部悲剧杰作改编自约瑟夫·凯塞尔的小说，是黑社会诗人让-皮埃尔·梅尔维尔最个人化的电影，他本人也参加过法国抵抗运动，讲述了抵抗运动中的人们的斗争和牺牲。利诺·文图拉 (Lino Ventura)、保罗·默里斯 (Paul Meurisse)、让-皮埃尔·卡塞尔 (Jean-Pierre Cassel) 和无与伦比的西蒙·西涅莱 (Simone Signoret) 饰演勇敢的地下战士，他们在对抗希特勒政权的斗争中必须努力克服自己的荣誉观念。这部大气磅礴、扣人心弦的惊悚片《暗影军团》在法国长期不受重视，在美国也无人问津，现在被广泛认为是梅尔维尔职业生涯的顶峰，它借鉴了黑帮电影的精致极简主义，创造了一个面对看似不可克服的困难时毫不留情的反抗故事。
hook_en: The most personal film by the underworld poet Jean-Pierre Melville, who had participated in the French Resistance himself, this tragic masterpiece, based on a novel by Joseph Kessel, recounts the struggles and sacrifices of those who fought in the Resistance. Lino Ventura, Paul Meurisse, Jean-Pierre Cassel, and the incomparable Simone Signoret star as intrepid underground fighters who must grapple with their conception of honor in their battle against Hitler’s regime. Long underappreciated in France and unseen in the United States, the atmospheric and gripping thriller Army of Shadows is now widely recognized as the summit of Melville’s career, channeling the exquisite minimalism of his gangster films to create an unsparing tale of defiance in the face of seemingly insurmountable odds.

hook: 作为 20 世纪 90 年代最伟大的美国独立电影之一，由惠特·斯蒂尔曼 (Whit Stillman) 编剧兼导演的出人意料的热门电影《大都会》是一部精彩的喜剧编年史，讲述了一名年轻人在试图融入纽约初出茅庐的社会时所经历的浪漫不幸经历。斯蒂尔曼灵巧、富有文学性的对话和令人捧腹的高雅观察为第一部电影赢得了奥斯卡最佳原创剧本奖提名。然而，在机智和复杂的背后，隐藏着一个关于青春期焦虑的温柔故事。
hook_en: One of the great American independent films of the 1990s, the surprise hit Metropolitan, by writer-director Whit Stillman, is a sparkling comedic chronicle of a young man’s romantic misadventures while trying to fit in to New York City’s debutante society. Stillman’s deft, literate dialogue and hilariously highbrow observations earned this first film an Academy Award nomination for best original screenplay. Beneath the wit and sophistication, though, lies a tender tale of adolescent anxiety.

hook: 编剧让·谷克托 (Jean Cocteau) 和导演让-皮埃尔·梅尔维尔 (Jean-Pierre Melville) 联手制作了这部优雅的改编版，改编自谷克托广受欢迎的邪恶小说，讲述了兄妹之间完全邪恶的关系。伊丽莎白（妮可·斯特凡饰）和保罗（爱德华·德米特饰）与敢于进入他们巢穴的人进行一系列越来越激烈的心理游戏，从而将自己与世隔绝，直到浪漫和嫉妒侵入。梅尔维尔的歌剧般的镜头动作和科克托反常、诗意的人物塑造方式在《可怕的孩子们》中融合在一起，创造了法国电影最伟大、最令人惊讶的心灵交汇之一。
hook_en: Writer Jean Cocteau and director Jean-Pierre Melville joined forces for this elegant adaptation of Cocteau’s immensely popular, wicked novel about the wholly unholy relationship between a brother and sister. Elisabeth (a remarkable Nicole Stéphane) and Paul (Edouard Dermithe) close themselves off from the world by playing an increasingly intense series of mind games with the people who dare enter their lair—until romance and jealousy intrude. Melville’s operatic camera movements and Cocteau’s perverse, poetic approach to character merge in Les enfants terribles to create one of French cinema's greatest, and most surprising, meetings of the minds.

hook: 两个女人，一辆绿松石色雷鸟，一生难忘的旅程。在这部流行文化地标作品中，编剧卡莉·库里和动作导演雷德利·斯科特重写了公路电影的规则，讲述了两个最好的朋友在周末度假时意外变成逃犯的故事，带领他们在西南地区进行高速冒险，躲避警察并按照自己的方式发现自由。在苏珊·萨兰登和吉娜·戴维斯（加上布拉德·皮特的性感造星表演）令人难以抗拒的表演的推动下，并获得六项奥斯卡金像奖提名，库里赢得了一项奥斯卡金像奖，令人兴奋的宣泄性《塞尔玛与路易丝》成为电影界对不顾一切的女性友谊的终极颂歌。
hook_en: Two women, a turquoise Thunderbird, the ride of a lifetime. With this pop-culture landmark, screenwriter Callie Khouri and action auteur Ridley Scott rewrote the rules of the road movie, telling the story of two best friends who find themselves transformed into accidental fugitives during a weekend getaway gone wrong—leading them on a high-speed southwestern odyssey as they elude police and discover freedom on their own terms. Propelled by irresistible performances from Susan Sarandon and Geena Davis (plus Brad Pitt in a sexy, star-making turn)—and nominated for six Academy Awards, winning one for Khouri—the exhilaratingly cathartic Thelma & Louise stands as cinema’s ultimate ode to ride-or-die female friendship.

hook: 特里·茨维戈夫的第一部小说电影改编自丹尼尔·克劳斯的经典邪教漫画，以独特的方式描绘了青少年的疏离感，既荒凉又有趣，又非常可爱。 《幽灵世界》以高中毕业后充满不安的几个月为背景，讲述了骄傲、格格不入的伊妮德（索拉·伯奇饰）的故事，她在消费主义美国的文化荒原中面临着不确定的未来。当伊妮德的愤世嫉俗变得难以忍受时，即使是她最好的朋友丽贝卡（斯嘉丽·约翰逊饰）也无法忍受，伊妮德发现自己被一个意想不到的志趣相投的人所吸引：一个比她大很多年的悲伤唱片收藏家（史蒂夫·布西密饰）。 《幽灵世界》凭借其古怪的角色、值得引用的奥斯卡提名剧本以及不拘一格的老式默默无闻的配乐，成为二十一世纪最受欢迎的喜剧之一。
hook_en: Terry Zwigoff’s first fiction film, adapted from a cult-classic comic by Daniel Clowes, is an idiosyncratic portrait of adolescent alienation that is at once bleakly funny and wholly endearing. Set during the malaise-filled months following high-school graduation, Ghost World follows the proud misfit Enid (Thora Birch), who confronts an uncertain future amid the cultural wasteland of consumerist America. As her cynicism becomes too much to bear even for her best friend, Rebecca (Scarlett Johansson), Enid finds herself drawn to an unlikely kindred spirit: a sad-sack record collector many years her senior (Steve Buscemi). With its parade of oddball characters, quotable, Oscar-nominated script, and eclectic soundtrack of vintage obscurities, Ghost World is one of the twenty-first century’s most fiercely beloved comedies.

hook: 这部引人入胜的人物研究以一部坚韧不拔的黑社会惊悚片为幌子，雅克·奥迪亚在国际上的突破在于罗曼·杜里斯（Romain Duris）的爆炸性表演，他饰演一名房地产经纪人，在贫民窟老板父亲（尼尔斯·阿雷斯特鲁普饰）的肮脏交易和最近重新燃起对古典钢琴的热爱之间左右为难。音乐可以拯救罪恶的生活吗？这部对新好莱坞经典电影《手指》的大胆重新演绎，赢得了包括最佳影片在内的八项凯撒奖，展示了奥迪亚在平衡令人惊叹的紧张气氛和刺激的人类戏剧方面的天赋。
hook_en: A riveting character study in the guise of a gritty underworld thriller, Jacques Audiard’s international breakthrough features an explosive performance from Romain Duris as a real-estate broker torn between the dirty dealings of his slumlord father (Niels Arestrup) and his recently rekindled love for classical piano. Can music offer salvation from a life of sin? Winner of eight César Awards, including Best Film, this bold reimagining of the New Hollywood cult classic Fingers showcases Audiard’s gift for balancing breathtaking tension with galvanic human drama.

hook: 导演吉姆·贾木许继他的精彩突破电影《天堂怪客》之后，又推出了另一部同样受人喜爱的描绘美国风景中的孤独者和格格不入的人的故事。当命运将三个不幸的男人——失业的唱片骑师（汤姆·威茨饰）、小皮条客（约翰·卢里饰）和意志坚强的意大利游客（罗伯托·贝尼尼饰）——在路易斯安那州的监狱里聚集在一起时，一场奇异的冒险随之而来。贾木许将《Down by Law》描述为一部“新垮掉派黑色喜剧”，它一半是噩梦，一半是童话，由受人尊敬的罗比·穆勒 (Robby Müller) 提供一流的表演和清晰的黑白电影摄影。
hook_en: Director Jim Jarmusch followed up his brilliant breakout film Stranger Than Paradise with another, equally beloved portrait of loners and misfits in the American landscape. When fate brings together three hapless men—an unemployed disc jockey (Tom Waits), a small-time pimp (John Lurie), and a strong-willed Italian tourist (Roberto Benigni)—in a Louisiana prison, a singular adventure ensues. Described by Jarmusch as a “neo-Beat noir comedy,” Down by Law is part nightmare and part fairy tale, featuring sterling performances and crisp black-and-white cinematography by the esteemed Robby Müller.

hook: 在他广受好评的《Man Push Cart》续作中，拉明·巴赫拉尼 (Ramin Bahrani) 再次将镜头对准了银幕上很少出现的纽约市的一部分：皇后区的威利茨角 (Willets Point)，这是一片汽车修理店工业区，永远面临着被从地图上重新开发出来的风险。正是在这个不稳定的生态系统中，十二岁的阿勒（亚历杭德罗·波兰科饰）必须快速成长，在附近的肉铺里忙碌，为自己和妹妹（伊萨玛尔·冈萨雷斯饰）建立更稳定的生活，尽管他们脆弱的环境迫使他们与其他挣扎的人竞争并做出绝望的决定。这是一个深刻的人性故事，讲述了激烈但脆弱的兄弟情谊受到艰难现实的考验，《Chop Shop》用抒情和希望来调和其发人深省的真实性。
hook_en: For his acclaimed follow-up to Man Push Cart, Ramin Bahrani once again turned his camera on a slice of New York City rarely seen on-screen: Willets Point, Queens, an industrial sliver of automotive-repair shops that remains perpetually at risk of being redeveloped off the map. It’s within this precarious ecosystem that twelve-year-old Ale (Alejandro Polanco) must grow up fast, hustling in the neighborhood chop shops to build a more stable life for himself and his sister (Isamar Gonzales), even as their tenuous circumstances force each to compete with other struggling people and make desperate decisions. A deeply human story of a fierce but fragile sibling bond being tested by hardscrabble reality, Chop Shop tempers its sobering authenticity with flights of lyricism and hope.

hook: 南斯拉夫艺术煽动家杜尚·马卡维耶夫 (Dušan Makavejev) 将性解放主题推向沸点，继他的国际轰动作品《WR：有机体之谜》之后，面对资产阶级的自满情绪和电影观看，他大声疾呼。 《甜蜜电影》以万花筒般的狂热来解决个人和政治自由的限制，将观众从妇科选美比赛转移到充满粪便、打破禁忌的欢乐的怪异食物狂欢中。凭借其淫荡的放纵和喜剧小品的反常，《甜蜜电影》成为了 20 世纪 70 年代电影的热门电影和挑战极限的典范。
hook_en: Pushing his themes of sexual liberation to their boiling point, Yugoslavian art-house provocateur Dušan Makavejev followed his international sensation WR: Mysteries of the Organism with this full-throated shriek in the face of bourgeois complacency and movie watching. Sweet Movie tackles the limits of personal and political freedom with kaleidoscopic feverishness, shuttling viewers from a gynecological beauty pageant to a grotesque food orgy with scatological, taboo-shattering glee. With its lewd abandon and sketch-comedy perversity, Sweet Movie became both a cult staple and exemplar of the envelope pushing of 1970s cinema.

hook: 一个神秘人、一桩谋杀案和一大笔失踪的现金——王韦恩以讽刺的另类突破方式，为当代旧金山唐人街的街道更新了经典黑色电影的成分。当他们的商业伙伴带着原本打算用来取得出租车执照的钱失踪时，司机乔（伍德·莫伊饰）和他的侄子史蒂夫（马克·林饰）搜寻了城市的后巷、海滨和中餐馆来寻找他。但从寻找失踪男子开始，逐渐变成了对华裔美国人身份的复杂性和矛盾性的更深入、更难以捉摸的调查。 《陈失踪了》是亚裔美国电影制作人第一部广受好评并获得主流评论界赞赏的故事片，它是独立发明的一个持续新鲜且令人惊讶的里程碑，有趣地颠覆了几十年来的电影刻板印象。
hook_en: A mystery man, a murder, and a wad of missing cash—in his wryly offbeat breakthrough, Wayne Wang updates the ingredients of classic film noir for the streets of contemporary San Francisco’s Chinatown. When their business partner disappears with the money they had planned to use for a cab license, driver Jo (Wood Moy) and his nephew Steve (Marc Hayashi) scour the city’s back alleys, waterfronts, and Chinese restaurants to track him down. But what begins as a search for a missing man gradually turns into a far deeper and more elusive investigation into the complexities and contradictions of Chinese American identity. The first feature by an Asian American filmmaker to play widely and get mainstream critical appreciation, Chan Is Missing is a continuously fresh and surprising landmark of indie invention that playfully flips decades of cinematic stereotypes on their heads.

hook: 罗伯特·布列松在《穆谢特》中挖掘了丰富的情感，这是电影史上对人类绝望最灼热的描绘之一。母亲垂死，父亲酗酒缺席，还有一个需要照顾的弟弟，十几岁的穆谢特在法国乡村的自然环境和日常生活中寻求安慰和喘息。布列松在这部法国电影制作的重要作品中运用了他标志性的极简主义风格，达到了令人心碎的效果，这是一部充满同情心的戏剧，将被困的主角提升为电影界最令人难忘的悲剧人物之一。
hook_en: Robert Bresson plumbs great reservoirs of feeling with Mouchette, one of the most searing portraits of human desperation ever put on film. With a dying mother, an absent, alcoholic father, and a baby brother in need of care, the teenage Mouchette seeks solace and respite from her circumstances in the nature of the French countryside and daily routine. Bresson deploys his trademark minimalist style to heartbreaking effect in this essential work of French filmmaking, a hugely empathetic drama that elevates its trapped protagonist into one of the cinema’s most memorable tragic figures.

hook: 在德国导演 G. W. 帕布斯特（《潘多拉魔盒》）的执导下，这部改编自魏玛时代轰动戏剧的经典作品将作曲家库尔特·威尔的狡猾旋律和剧作家贝托尔特·布莱希特的大胆结合在银幕上。 《三便士歌剧》以维多利亚时代伦敦的贫困后巷为背景，讲述了黑社会反英雄麦基·梅塞尔（又名“小刀麦克”）试图追求波莉·皮彻姆并逃避当局的故事。 《三便士歌剧》明显地唤起了腐败和恐惧，再加上威尔令人难以抗拒的配乐，它仍然是早期有声电影的标杆。这里提供了著名的德语版本和罕见的法语版本。
hook_en: The sly melodies of composer Kurt Weill and the daring of dramatist Bertolt Brecht come together on-screen under the direction of German auteur G. W. Pabst (Pandora's Box) in this classic adaptation of the Weimar-era theatrical sensation. Set in the impoverished back alleys of Victorian London, The Threepenny Opera follows underworld antihero Mackie Messer (a.k.a. Mack the Knife) as he tries to woo Polly Peachum and elude the authorities. With its palpable evocation of corruption and dread, set to Weill's irresistible score, The Threepenny Opera remains a benchmark of early sound cinema. It is presented here in both its celebrated German and rare French versions.

hook: 伯恩哈德·威茨执导的令人惊叹的《桥》是二战后德国第一部重要的反战电影，也是德国第一部在国际上广泛放映的战后电影，甚至获得了奥斯卡提名。故事发生在冲突即将结束时，一群十几岁的男孩在一个小镇上处理学校、女孩和父母等日常事务，然后应征入伍，被迫在一场混乱而可怕的战斗中保卫自己的家乡。这部拍摄富有表现力、情感伤人的戏剧敢于在历史上的温柔时刻将年轻的德国士兵人性化，并被证明对下一代新德国电影导演产生了影响。
hook_en: Bernhard Wicki’s astonishing The Bridge was the first major antiwar film to come out of Germany after World War II, as well as the nation’s first postwar film to be widely shown internationally, even securing an Oscar nomination. Set near the end of the conflict, it follows a group of teenage boys in a small town as they contend with everyday matters like school, girls, and parents, before enlisting as soldiers and being forced to defend their home turf in a confused, terrifying battle. This expressively shot, emotionally bruising drama dared to humanize young German soldiers at a historically tender moment, and proved influential for the coming generation of New German Cinema auteurs.

hook: 迈克尔·鲍威尔 (Michael Powell) 和埃默里克·普莱斯伯格 (Emeric Pressburger) 深受喜爱的经典著作《坎特伯雷故事集》是一次前往鲍威尔田园诗般的出生地英国肯特郡的深刻个人之旅。影片以第二次世界大战的喧嚣为背景，节奏像摇篮曲一样微妙，讲述了乔叟朝圣者的三个现代化身——一个忧郁的“土地女郎”、一个直言不讳的美国大兵和一个足智多谋的英国中士——她们在前往神秘小镇的途中在英国乡村遭到伏击，被迫侦破一起离奇的乡村犯罪。令人眼花缭乱的《坎特伯雷故事集》达到了堪称电影制作二人组最伟大成就之一的宏伟高潮，吸引了一批热情的追随者，他们自己也有资格成为朝圣者。
hook_en: Michael Powell and Emeric Pressburger’s beloved classic A Canterbury Tale is a profoundly personal journey to Powell’s bucolic birthplace of Kent, England. Set amid the tumult of the Second World War, yet with a rhythm as delicate as a lullaby, the film follows three modern-day incarnations of Chaucer’s pilgrims—a melancholy “landgirl,” a plainspoken American GI, and a resourceful British sergeant—who are waylaid in the English countryside en route to the mythical town and forced to solve a bizarre village crime. Building to a majestic climax that ranks as one of the filmmaking duo’s finest achievements, the dazzling A Canterbury Tale has acquired a following of devotees passionate enough to qualify as pilgrims themselves.

hook: 马丁·斯科塞斯凭借这一令人惊叹的内心自我毁灭的男子气概肖像，创造了现代电影真正伟大而富有远见的作品之一。罗伯特·德尼罗为奥斯卡获奖角色杰克·拉莫塔倾注了自己的心血、汗水和野蛮的身体素质。杰克·拉莫塔是一位来自布朗克斯的新兴中量级拳击手，他的强烈野心推动他在拳击场上取得成功，但他肆无忌惮的偏执和嫉妒破坏了他与周围所有人的关系，包括他的兄弟兼经理（乔·佩西饰）和他华丽的街头妻子（凯茜·莫里亚蒂饰）。塞尔玛·斯库梅克 (Thelma Schoonmaker) 荣获奥斯卡奖的剪辑、迈克尔·查普曼 (Michael Chapman) 极具触觉的黑白电影摄影以及弗兰克·华纳 (Frank Warner) 巧妙的声音设计相结合，使《愤怒的公牛》成为对身体、情感、心理和精神等多个层面暴力的独特而有力的探索。
hook_en: With this stunningly visceral portrait of self-destructive machismo, Martin Scorsese created one of the truly great and visionary works of modern cinema. Robert De Niro pours his blood, sweat, and brute physicality into the Oscar-winning role of Jake La Motta, the rising middleweight boxer from the Bronx whose furious ambition propels him to success within the ring but whose unbridled paranoia and jealousy tatter his relationships with everyone in his orbit, including his brother and manager (Joe Pesci) and his gorgeous, streetwise wife (Cathy Moriarty). Thelma Schoonmaker’s Oscar-winning editing, Michael Chapman’s extraordinarily tactile black-and-white cinematography, and Frank Warner’s ingenious sound design combine to make Raging Bull a uniquely powerful exploration of violence on multiple levels—physical, emotional, psychic, and spiritual.

hook: 这部由杨德昌执导的台湾电影杰作，是所有当代电影中最受赞誉和追捧的影片之一，终于登陆美国的家庭录像。 《夏日灿烂》以六十年代初的台湾为背景，改编自一起震撼全国的犯罪故事。这部小说性的、耐心观察的史诗电影既广阔的范围又充满温柔的亲密感，以一个年轻的少年（陈畅，他的第一个角色）逐渐、不可阻挡地从天真到少年犯罪的故事为中心，并以躁动的青春、摇滚乐和政治动荡为背景。 2009年，博洛尼亚电影中心/L’Immagine恢复了《阳光明媚的夏日》 Ritrovata 实验室与电影基金会的世界电影项目、中央电影公司和杨德昌庄园合作。扫描在台北的 Digimax 实验室进行。修复工作由阿玛尼、卡地亚、卡塔尔航空公司和卡塔尔博物馆管理局资助。
hook_en: Among the most praised and sought-after titles in all contemporary film, this singular masterpiece of Taiwanese cinema, directed by Edward Yang, finally comes to home video in the United States. Set in the early sixties in Taiwan, A Brighter Summer Day is based on the true story of a crime that rocked the nation. A film of both sprawling scope and tender intimacy, this novelistic, patiently observed epic centers on the gradual, inexorable fall of a young teenager (Chen Chang, in his first role) from innocence to juvenile delinquency, and is set against a simmering backdrop of restless youth, rock and roll, and political turmoil.A Brighter Summer Day was restored in 2009 by the Cineteca di Bologna/L’Immagine Ritrovata laboratory, in association with The Film Foundation’s World Cinema Project, the Central Motion Picture Corporation, and the Edward Yang Estate. Scan performed at Digimax laboratories in Taipei. Restoration funded by Armani, Cartier, Qatar Airways, and Qatar Museum Authority.

hook: 克日什托夫·基斯洛夫斯基在国际上的突破仍然是他最受喜爱的电影之一，这是对身份、爱情和人类直觉的迷人而神秘的反思。艾琳·雅各布 (Irène Jacob) 饰演波兰合唱团女高音韦罗妮卡 (Weronika) 和她的替身法国音乐老师维罗尼克 (Véronique)。尽管彼此不认识，这两个女人却有着一种神秘的情感纽带，基斯洛夫斯基用华丽的倒影、色彩和动作详细描述了这一纽带。在斯瓦沃米尔·伊齐亚克 (Slawomir Idziak) 闪闪发光的电影摄影和兹比格涅夫·普莱斯纳 (Zbigniew Preisner) 令人难忘的歌剧配乐的帮助下，基斯洛夫斯基创作了电影中最纯粹的形而上学作品之一。 《维罗妮克的双重生活》是一首令人难忘的情感交响曲。
hook_en: Krzysztof Kieślowski's international breakthrough remains one of his most beloved films, a ravishing, mysterious rumination on identity, love, and human intuition. Irène Jacob is incandescent as both Weronika, a Polish choir soprano, and her double, Véronique, a French music teacher. Though unknown to each other, the two women share an enigmatic, emotional bond, which Kieślowski details in gorgeous reflections, colors, and movements. Aided by Slawomir Idziak's shimmering cinematography and Zbigniew Preisner's haunting, operatic score, Kieślowski creates one of cinema's most purely metaphysical works. The Double Life of Véronique is an unforgettable symphony of feeling.

hook: 芭芭拉·史翠珊 (Barbra Streisand) 在这部精彩的音乐剧中首次登上银幕，见证了一位电影明星的诞生。从幽默到感伤，她饰演的 20 年代流行歌手兼喜剧演员范妮·布莱斯 (Fanny Brice) 的每一个音符都恰到好处。范妮·布莱斯是一位年轻的犹太纽约人，她的精神和超新星才华使她在齐格菲歌舞团 (Ziegfeld Follies) 中声名鹊起，但她对不可靠赌徒（魅力超凡的奥马尔·沙里夫 (Omar Sharif) 饰）的忠诚给她的生活带来了戏剧性和心碎。 《风趣女孩》改编自热门百老汇剧目，由好莱坞大师威廉·惠勒执导，在《People》和《Don’t Rain on My Parade》等令人难忘的歌曲表演中达到了情感高潮，这些时刻为史翠珊赢得了奥斯卡历史上当之无愧的最佳女演员奖之一。
hook_en: Witness the birth of a movie star as Barbra Streisand makes a screen debut for the ages in this musical spectacular. From humor to pathos, she hits every note as popular 1920s singer-comedian Fanny Brice, a young Jewish New Yorker whose spirit and supernova talent propel her to fame in the Ziegfeld Follies, but whose devotion to an unreliable gambler (a charismatic Omar Sharif) brings drama and heartbreak into her life. Adapted from a hit Broadway show and directed by Hollywood master William Wyler, Funny Girl hits emotional highs in unforgettable performances of songs like “People” and “Don’t Rain on My Parade”—moments that won Streisand one of the most richly deserved Best Actress awards in Oscar history.

hook: 一个小Kansas镇上的年轻女子（Candace Hilligoss）在一场斗牛赛事故中幸存下来，然后同意在盐湖城担任教堂管风琴师的工作。在前往盐湖城的路上，她被一个奇异的幻象所困扰，驱使她走向一个废弃的湖边凉亭。这部由工业级电影人以小预算制作的诡异有效的B级经典电影《灵魂狂欢节》本意是要“有伯格曼的风格，有科克托的感觉”——而凭借其独特的拍摄地点和恐怖的管风琴配乐，它成功了。Herk Harvey的这部恐怖大师级作品在深夜电视上获得了 cult 粉丝，并且至今仍在激励着今天的电影人。
hook_en: A young woman (Candace Hilligoss) in a small Kansas town survives a drag race accident, then agrees to take a job as a church organist in Salt Lake City. En route, she is haunted by a bizarre apparition that compels her toward an abandoned lakeside pavilion. Made by industrial filmmakers on a small budget, the eerily effective B-movie classic Carnival of Souls was intended to have “the look of a Bergman and the feel of a Cocteau”—and, with its strikingly used locations and spooky organ score, it succeeds. Herk Harvey’s macabre masterpiece gained a cult following on late-night television and continues to inspire filmmakers today.

hook: 在这部由编剧兼导演雷金纳德·哈德林 (Reginald Hudlin) 执导的突破性长片处女作中，嘻哈二人组 Kid 'n Play 将他们的明星力量搬上大银幕，扮演有抱负的主持人，为年度派对做准备。当基德的父亲（罗宾·哈里斯饰）禁止他参加普莱的派对时，基德还是偷偷溜了出去，开始了一个充满舞蹈对决、说唱大战、与恶霸和警察的冲突以及一点浪漫的疯狂之夜。 《House Party》的演员阵容包括蒂莎·坎贝尔 (Tisha Campbell)、AJ Johnson、马丁·劳伦斯 (Martin Lawrence)、达里尔·“Chill”·米切尔 (Daryl “Chill” Mitchell) 以及音乐团体 Full Force 的成员，再加上热门配乐，《House Party》是 20 世纪 90 年代早期嘻哈文化深受喜爱、令人愉悦的缩影，它将黑人青少年的体验带入了主流，至今仍熠熠生辉。
hook_en: In this dazzlingly imaginative teen comedy, the breakthrough feature debut by writer-director Reginald Hudlin, hip-hop duo Kid ’n Play bring their star power to the big screen as aspiring MCs preparing for the party of the year. When Kid’s father (Robin Harris) forbids him from attending Play’s party, Kid sneaks out anyway, kicking off a wild night full of dance-offs and rap battles, run-ins with bullies and cops, and a bit of romance. With an ensemble cast that also includes Tisha Campbell, AJ Johnson, Martin Lawrence, Daryl “Chill” Mitchell, and members of the music group Full Force, plus a hit soundtrack, House Party is a beloved, feel-good snapshot of early-1990s hip-hop culture that brought Black teenage experience to the mainstream, and that shines bright to this day.

hook: 马丁·斯科塞斯在这部捕捉时代精神的女权主义故事中，将经典的母性情节剧与新好莱坞的傲慢精神融为一体，讲述了一个女人在父权世界中找到立足之地的故事。奥斯卡奖得主艾伦·伯斯汀 (Ellen Burstyn) 饰演爱丽丝·海厄特 (Alice Hyatt)，她是一位刚刚丧偶的母亲，带着早熟的儿子汤米 (Tommy) 跨越西南部去追求成为歌手的梦想，一路上学会按照自己的方式生活，尽管与粗犷牧场主 (克里斯·克里斯托弗森 (Kris Kristofferson) 饰) 的新恋情考验着她日益增长的独立性。黛安·拉德 (Diane Ladd)、哈维·凯特尔 (Harvey Keitel) 和朱迪·福斯特 (Jodie Foster) 的生动配角，这种无法抑制的重新开始的样子，在每个忙碌的画面中都洋溢着温暖和人性。
hook_en: Martin Scorsese infuses the classic maternal melodrama with the brash spirit of the New Hollywood in this zeitgeist-capturing feminist tale of a woman finding her footing in a patriarchal world. An Academy Award–winning Ellen Burstyn shines as Alice Hyatt, a newly widowed mother who, with her precocious son, Tommy, takes off across the Southwest to pursue her dream of becoming a singer, along the way learning to live on her own terms, even as a new romance with a rugged rancher (Kris Kristofferson) tests her growing independence. Boasting vivid supporting turns by Diane Ladd, Harvey Keitel, and Jodie Foster, this irrepressible look at starting anew overflows with warmth and humanity from each bustling frame.

hook: 在伍德斯托克音乐节和蒙特利流行音乐节之前，就有音乐节。从 1963 年到 1966 年，默里·勒纳 (Murray Lerner) 参观了一年一度的纽波特民谣音乐节，记录了一场蓬勃发展的理想主义音乐运动，当时它已成为一种流行现象，达到了顶峰。琼·贝兹 (Joan Baez)、鲍勃·迪伦 (Bob Dylan)、Howlin’ Wolf、约翰尼·卡什 (Johnny Cash)、Staple Singers、皮特·西格 (Pete Seeger)、Son House 以及彼得、保罗和玛丽 (Peter, Paul and Mary) 都是在纽波特同台演出的传奇人物，他们为观众带来了一系列民间音乐，涵盖了该流派的蓝调、乡村和福音音乐的根源，以及与摇滚乐的较新的调情。勒纳以华丽的黑白拍摄，将表演与对艺术家及其粉丝的快照采访并置，将四年来的音乐节镜头编织成音乐乃至整个美国文化关键时刻的亲密记录。
hook_en: Before Woodstock and Monterey Pop, there was Festival. From 1963 through 1966, Murray Lerner visited the annual Newport Folk Festival to document a thriving, idealistic musical movement as it reached its peak as a popular phenomenon. Joan Baez, Bob Dylan, Howlin’ Wolf, Johnny Cash, the Staple Singers, Pete Seeger, Son House, and Peter, Paul and Mary were just a few of the legends who shared the stage at Newport, treating audiences to a range of folk music that encompassed the genre’s roots in blues, country, and gospel as well as its newer flirtations with rock and roll. Shooting in gorgeous black and white, Lerner juxtaposes performances with snapshot interviews with artists and their fans, weaving footage from four years of the festival into an intimate record of a pivotal time in music—and in American culture at large.

hook: 《生活的每一天》是让-吕克·戈达尔的转折点，至今仍然是他最具活力的电影之一，将出色的视觉设计与悲剧人物研究结合在一起。可爱的安娜·卡里娜（Anna Karina）是戈达尔最伟大的缪斯，她饰演娜娜（Nana），一位年轻的巴黎人，渴望成为一名演员，但最终却沦为妓女，一系列离散的白日梦和舞蹈画面描绘了她的螺旋式下降。 《Vivre sa vie》展现了卡琳娜和戈达尔最具标志性的一些时刻——从她在《圣女贞德受难记》中在电影院守夜，到她在台球厅里迷人的姿态——《Vivre sa vie》是法国新浪潮的一个里程碑，至今仍处处令人惊喜。
hook_en: Vivre sa vie was a turning point for Jean-Luc Godard and remains one of his most dynamic films, combining brilliant visual design with a tragic character study. The lovely Anna Karina, Godard’s greatest muse, plays Nana, a young Parisian who aspires to be an actress but instead ends up a prostitute, her downward spiral depicted in a series of discrete tableaux of daydreams and dances. Featuring some of Karina and Godard’s most iconic moments—from her movie theater vigil with The Passion of Joan of Arc to her seductive pool-hall strut—Vivre sa vie is a landmark of the French New Wave that still surprises at every turn.

hook: 凭借令人眼花缭乱的复杂黑色情节和色彩缤纷的宽银幕图像，《美国制造》是让-吕克·戈达尔六十年代初一系列疯狂电影的最后爆发。然而，这部混乱的犯罪惊悚片和对消费主义尖酸刻薄的批判——由安娜·卡琳娜饰演电影史上衣着最鲜艳的私家侦探，寻找可能被暗杀的前情人——也指向了戈达尔的更具政治性的电影。这部波普艺术作品的主角包括理查德·尼克松、罗伯特·麦克纳马拉、大卫·古迪斯和多丽丝·沟口，还有闹剧让-皮埃尔·利奥德和甜美歌声的玛丽安·费斯福尔，这件流行艺术作品就像乐一通翻唱的《长眠不醒》的新浪潮。
hook_en: With its giddily complex noir plot and color-drenched widescreen images, Made in U.S.A was a final burst of exuberance from Jean-Luc Godard’s early sixties barrage of delirious movie-movies. Yet this chaotic crime thriller and acidly funny critique of consumerism—starring Anna Karina as the most brightly dressed private investigator in film history, searching for a former lover who might have been assassinated—also points toward the more political cinema that would come to define Godard. Featuring characters with names such as Richard Nixon, Robert McNamara, David Goodis, and Doris Mizoguchi, and appearances by a slapstick Jean-Pierre Léaud and a sweetly singing Marianne Faithfull, this piece of pop art is like a Looney Tunes rendition of The Big Sleep gone New Wave.

hook: 两年前，明星凯瑟琳·赫本、加里·格兰特和导演乔治·库克合作拍摄《费城故事》，他们将自己永恒的才华带到了这部 1930 年代浪漫喜剧的完美片段中，这是根据菲利普·巴里 1928 年热门戏剧改编的第二部电影。格兰特最有魅力的地方在于，他是一个杂技般的自由精神者，在一场旋风般的订婚之后，他真正地陷入了未婚妻贵族家庭的生活——与她古板的父亲产生了价值观冲突，同时激发了她傲慢、害群之马的妹妹（赫本饰）的叛逆想象力。 《假日》表面闪闪发光，暗流忧郁，是对各地不墨守成规者和天上掉馅饼梦想家的迷人颂歌，也是对美好生活真正含义的深思熟虑。
hook_en: Two years before stars Katharine Hepburn and Cary Grant and director George Cukor would collaborate on The Philadelphia Story, they brought their timeless talents to this delectable slice of 1930s romantic-comedy perfection, the second film adaptation of a hit 1928 play by Philip Barry. Grant is at his charismatic best as the acrobatically inclined free spirit who, following a whirlwind engagement, literally tumbles into the lives of his fiancée’s aristocratic family—setting up a clash of values with her staid father while firing the rebellious imagination of her brash, black-sheep sister (Hepburn). With a sparkling surface and an undercurrent of melancholy, Holiday is an enchanting ode to nonconformists and pie-in-the-sky dreamers everywhere, as well as a thoughtful reflection on what it truly means to live well.

hook: 朱尔斯和吉姆被誉为有史以来最好的电影之一，二十五年来，朱尔斯和吉姆描绘了两个朋友之间的关系以及他们共同迷恋的对象。传奇人物弗朗索瓦·特吕弗执导，珍妮·莫罗饰演迷人而任性的凯瑟琳，她神秘的微笑和热情的本性引诱朱尔斯（奥斯卡·维尔纳饰）和吉姆（亨利·塞尔饰）陷入电影界最迷人的三角关系之一。 《朱尔斯和吉姆》对自由、忠诚和爱情的坚韧进行了热烈而深刻的思考，1962 年风靡全球，时至今日依然大胆而迷人。
hook_en: Hailed as one of the finest films ever made, Jules and Jim charts, over twenty-five years, the relationship between two friends and the object of their mutual obsession. The legendary François Truffaut directs, and Jeanne Moreau stars as the alluring and willful Catherine, whose enigmatic smile and passionate nature lure Jules (Oskar Werner) and Jim (Henri Serre) into one of cinema’s most captivating romantic triangles. An exuberant and poignant meditation on freedom, loyalty, and the fortitude of love, Jules and Jim was a worldwide smash in 1962 and remains every bit as audacious and entrancing today.

hook: 好莱坞导演约翰·L·沙利文（乔尔·麦克雷饰）厌倦了制作轻量级喜剧，决定拍摄《兄弟，你在哪里？》——一部关于人类苦难的严肃且具有社会责任感的电影。在他的制片人指出他对苦难一无所知后，沙利文伪装成流浪汉上路了。在通往启蒙的路上，他遇到了一位可爱但严肃的年轻女子（维罗妮卡·莱克饰）——以及比他想象的更多的麻烦。普雷斯顿·斯特吉斯的这部喜剧杰作是好莱坞最优秀的讽刺作品之一，也是业内最受尊敬的滑稽演员之一的职业生涯的高峰。
hook_en: Tired of churning out lightweight comedies, Hollywood director John L. Sullivan (Joel McCrea) decides to make O Brother, Where Art Thou?—a serious, socially responsible film about human suffering. After his producers point out that he knows nothing of hardship, Sullivan hits the road disguised as a hobo. En route to enlightenment, he encounters a lovely but no-nonsense young woman (Veronica Lake)—and more trouble than he ever dreamed of. This comic masterpiece by Preston Sturges is among the finest Hollywood satires and a high-water mark in the career of one of the industry’s most revered funnymen.

hook: 没有任何其他作品看起来或感觉像雷内·拉卢克斯导演的动画奇迹《神奇星球》，这是一部具有政治头脑和视觉创意的科幻作品。影片以一颗名为 Ygam 的遥远星球为背景，在那里，被奴役的人类 (Oms) 是巨型蓝色原住民 (Draags) 的玩物。从小就被当作宠物饲养的特尔从他巨大的儿童俘虏手中逃脱后，他被一群反抗德拉格压迫和暴力的激进奥姆斯同胞所卷入。罗兰·托波尔 (Roland Topor) 制作的怪诞、超现实的剪纸动画；阿兰·戈拉格尔 (Alain Goraguer) 创作的精彩迷幻爵士乐配乐；这部 1973 年荣获戛纳电影节反主流文化经典作品，描绘了奇妙的生物和风景，始终是反对顺从和暴力的有力宣言。
hook_en: Nothing else has ever looked or felt like director René Laloux’s animated marvel Fantastic Planet, a politically minded and visually inventive work of science fiction. The film is set on a distant planet called Ygam, where enslaved humans (Oms) are the playthings of giant blue native inhabitants (Draags). After Terr, kept as a pet since infancy, escapes from his gigantic child captor, he is swept up by a band of radical fellow Oms who are resisting the Draags’ oppression and violence. With its eerie, coolly surreal cutout animation by Roland Topor; brilliant psychedelic jazz score by Alain Goraguer; and wondrous creatures and landscapes, this Cannes-awarded 1973 counterculture classic is a perennially compelling statement against conformity and violence.

hook: 贝蒂·米德勒 (Bette Midler) 在导演马克·莱德尔 (Mark Rydell) 执导的这部关于名气和毒瘾的经典电影中，凭借她毫不留情的表演在银幕上大放异彩。米德勒饰演摇滚歌手玛丽·罗斯·福斯特（被她的大批歌迷称为“玫瑰”），她的爱情关系和心理健康不断受到旅途生活的要求的危害。维尔莫斯·齐格蒙德 (Vilmos Zsigmond) 剧本精辟，摄影精美，康拉德·L·霍尔 (Conrad L. Hall)、拉兹洛·科瓦奇 (László Kovács)、欧文·罗伊兹曼 (Owen Roizman) 和哈斯克尔·韦克斯勒 (Haskell Wexler) 等其他世界级摄影师协助拍摄了令人眼花缭乱的音乐会场景，这是一部情节细腻、情感压倒性的情节剧，也使这位受欢迎的歌手成为了电影明星。
hook_en: Bette Midler exploded onto the screen with her take-no-prisoners performance in this quintessential film about fame and addiction from director Mark Rydell. Midler is the rock-and-roll singer Mary Rose Foster (known as the Rose to her legions of fans), whose romantic relationships and mental health are continuously imperiled by the demands of life on the road. Incisively scripted and beautifully shot—by Vilmos Zsigmond, with assistance on the dazzling concert scenes by a host of other world-class cinematographers, including Conrad L. Hall, László Kovács, Owen Roizman, and Haskell Wexler—this is a sensitively drawn and emotionally overwhelming melodrama that made the popular singer into a movie star as well.

hook: 这部真正令人恐惧、制作精良的超自然哥特式电影由黛博拉·蔻儿 (Deborah Kerr) 饰演一位情感脆弱的家庭教师，她开始怀疑自己早熟的新指控出了什么问题。 《无辜者》改编自亨利·詹姆斯的经典作品《螺丝在拧紧》，由杜鲁门·卡波特合写，杰克·克莱顿执导。《无辜者》是叙事经济和技术表现力的胜利，从令人毛骨悚然的声音设计到弗雷迪·弗朗西斯深邃的宽银幕摄影，都是叙事经济和技术表现力的胜利。
hook_en: This genuinely frightening, exquisitely made supernatural gothic stars Deborah Kerr as an emotionally fragile governess who comes to suspect that there is something very, very wrong with her precocious new charges. A psychosexually intensified adaptation of Henry James’s classic The Turn of the Screw, cowritten by Truman Capote and directed by Jack Clayton, The Innocents is a triumph of narrative economy and technical expressiveness, from its chilling sound design to the stygian depths of its widescreen cinematography by Freddie Francis.

hook: 来自伦敦的一对兄弟姐妹（雷·米兰德和露丝·赫西饰）在康沃尔郡购买了一栋价格惊人的、偏僻的悬崖顶房子，却发现它实际上价格惊人，很快他们就陷入了一场来自坟墓之外的奇异浪漫三角关系。由刘易斯·艾伦 (Lewis Allen) 执导的《不请自来》气氛浓郁，在对待鬼屋类型的严肃性方面具有开创性，并且以维克多·杨 (Victor Young) 的经典配乐为特色，它仍然是一种优雅而怪异的体验。悲惨的家庭过去、神秘上锁的房间、寒冷的寒意、夜晚的颠簸——这部哥特式好莱坞经典拥有这一切。
hook_en: A pair of siblings from London (Ray Milland and Ruth Hussey) purchase a surprisingly affordable, lonely cliff-top house in Cornwall, only to discover that it actually carries a ghostly price—and soon they’re caught up in a bizarre romantic triangle from beyond the grave. Rich in atmosphere, The Uninvited, directed by Lewis Allen, was groundbreaking for the seriousness with which it treated the haunted-house genre, and it remains an elegant and eerie experience, featuring a classic score by Victor Young. A tragic family past, a mysteriously locked room, cold chills, bumps in the night—this gothic Hollywood classic has it all.

hook: 弗莱彻·蒙森 (Fletcher Munson) 与牙医杰弗里·科尔切克 (Jeffrey Korchek) 博士有相似之处。在他迄今为止唯一的主演表演中，广受好评的导演史蒂文·索德伯格同时扮演了两个角色：蒙森，手淫的企业无人机和新时代大师 T. Azimuth Schwitters 的演讲撰稿人，以及摇摆不定的科尔切克，穆扎克爱好者和蒙森心灰意冷的妻子的情人。与此同时，疯狂的消灭者兼兼职名人首席女主角埃尔莫·奥西根 (Elmo Oxygen) 用暗码引诱当地家庭主妇，并密谋反对施维特斯。编剧、导演、剪辑师、摄影师索德伯格将责任完全放在观众身上（“如果你看不懂这部电影，那是你的错，而不是我们的”），编剧、导演、剪辑师、摄影师呈现了一部疯狂的喜剧，充满了身份混乱、双关语和紧张的企业阴谋，证实了他作为美国最大胆和不可预测的电影制片人之一的地位。
hook_en: Fletcher Munson has a doppelgänger in dentist Dr. Jeffrey Korchek. In his only starring performance to date, acclaimed director Steven Soderbergh inhabits both roles: Munson, onanistic corporate drone and speechwriter for New Age guru T. Azimuth Schwitters, and the swinging Korchek, Muzak enthusiast and lover to Munson’s disenchanted wife. Meanwhile, mad exterminator and part-time celebrity prima donna Elmo Oxygen seduces local housewives in secret code and plots against Schwitters. Placing the onus squarely on the viewer (“If you don’t understand this film, it’s your fault and not ours”), writer/director/editor/cameraman Soderbergh presents a deranged comedy of confused identity, doublespeak, and white-knuckled corporate intrigue, confirming his status as one of America’s most daring and unpredictable filmmakers.

hook: 这部关于精神与肉欲冲突的作品，是迈克尔·鲍伊尔和伊默克·普雷斯伯勒性感风格的巅峰之作。一群女修道院修女——包括英国最优秀的女演员黛博拉·蔻儿、凯瑟琳·布朗和弗洛拉·罗宾逊——努力在喜马拉雅山区建立修道院，然而孤立、极端的天气、海拔以及文化冲突都促使这些本意良好的传教士精神崩溃。这部黑暗宏伟的电影，获得了阿尔弗雷德·扬杰的美术设计和杰克·卡德威的摄影奖，黑仙人树是两位电影真正先驱者最伟大的成就之一。
hook_en: This explosive work about the conflict between the spirit and the flesh is the epitome of the sensuous style of Michael Powell and Emeric Pressburger. A group of nuns—played by some of Britain’s finest actresses, including Deborah Kerr, Kathleen Byron, and Flora Robson—struggle to establish a convent in the Himalayas, while isolation, extreme weather, altitude, and culture clashes all conspire to drive the well-intentioned missionaries mad. A darkly grand film that won Oscars for Alfred Junge's art direction and Jack Cardiff's cinematography, Black Narcissus is one of the greatest achievements by two of cinema’s true visionaries.

hook: 《霍布森的选择》是大卫·里恩的一部无名喜剧作品，由传奇人物查尔斯·劳顿 (Charles Laughton) 饰演爱吵闹的亨利·霍布森 (Henry Hobson)，他是维多利亚时代晚期英格兰北部一家靴子店的老板。当他傲慢、独立的女儿玛吉（布伦达·德·班齐饰）决定与亨利最珍视的靴匠威尔（约翰·米尔斯饰）一起开辟自己的浪漫和职业道路时，父女俩发现自己陷入了一场激烈的意志较量中。 《霍布森的选择》改编自哈罗德·布里格豪斯的著名戏剧，同样迷人而刻薄，充满了精彩的表演和优雅、富有创意的摄影作品。
hook_en: An unsung comic triumph from David Lean, Hobson’s Choice stars the legendary Charles Laughton as the harrumphing Henry Hobson, the owner of a boot shop in late Victorian northern England. When his haughty, independent daughter Maggie (Brenda De Banzie) decides to forge her own path, romantically and professionally, with none other than Henry’s prized bootsmith Will (a splendid John Mills), father and daughter find themselves head-to-head in a fiery match of wills. Equally charming and caustic, Hobson’s Choice, adapted from Harold Brighouse’s famous play, is filled to the brim with great performances and elegant, inventive camera work.

hook: 这部引人入胜的传记片由另一位墨西哥裔美国偶像、奇卡诺电影之父路易斯·瓦尔迪兹 (Luis Valdez) 拍摄，摇滚乐先驱里奇·瓦伦斯 (Ritchie Valens) 短暂而辉煌的一生永垂不朽。卢·戴蒙德·菲利普斯 (Lou Diamond Phillips) 甜美又傲慢，是 20 世纪 50 年代加州少年的化身，在极力支持他的母亲（罗莎娜·德索托饰）和叛逆的弟弟（埃塞·莫拉莱斯饰）的熏陶下，他从务农出身，在摇滚乐的早期名声大噪，直到一个影响音乐史的决定性的夜晚。在洛斯·洛博斯 (Los Lobos) 和卡洛斯·桑塔纳 (Carlos Santana) 的震撼配乐的推动下，拉班巴 (La Bamba) 捕捉到了一位艺术家的电力活力，这位艺术家在不同文化之间架起桥梁，创造了自己的美国梦。
