hook_en: The brief but incandescent life of rock-and-roll trailblazer Ritchie Valens is immortalized in this enthralling biopic from another Mexican American icon, Luis Valdez, the father of Chicano cinema. With sweetness and swagger, Lou Diamond Phillips embodies the 1950s California teenager who, forged by his fiercely supportive mother (Rosana DeSoto) and rebellious brother (Esai Morales), rises from his farm-working roots to chart-topping fame in the early days of rock—until one fateful night that haunts music history. Propelled by a hip-shaking soundtrack featuring Los Lobos and Carlos Santana, La Bamba captures the electric vitality of an artist who bridged cultures to create his own American dream.

hook: 独一无二的电影制片人兼哲学家泰伦斯·马利克创作了一些上世纪最具视觉冲击力的电影，其中以他的辉煌时代悲剧《天堂之日》（由内斯特·阿尔门德罗斯的奥斯卡获奖摄影为特色）脱颖而出。 1910 年代中期，一名芝加哥钢铁工人（理查·基尔饰）意外杀死了他的主管，并与女友（布鲁克·亚当斯饰）和妹妹（琳达·曼兹饰）逃到德克萨斯州的狭长地带，在那里他们找到了在一位坚忍的农民（萨姆·夏普德饰）的田里收割小麦的工作。一段三角恋、一群蝗虫、一场地狱般的大火——马利克以梦幻般的真实性捕捉到了这一切，创造了一个永恒的美国田园诗，同时也是对世纪之交劳动的坚韧的唤起。
hook_en: One-of-a-kind filmmaker-philosopher Terrence Malick has created some of the most visually arresting films of the last century, and his glorious period tragedy Days of Heaven, featuring Oscar-winning cinematography by Nestor Almendros, stands out among them. In the mid-1910s, a Chicago steelworker (Richard Gere) accidentally kills his supervisor, and flees with his girlfriend (Brooke Adams) and his little sister (Linda Manz) to the Texas panhandle, where they find work harvesting wheat in the fields of a stoic farmer (Sam Shepard). A love triangle, a swarm of locusts, a hellish fire—Malick captures it all with dreamlike authenticity, creating a timeless American idyll that is also a gritty evocation of turn-of-the-century labor.

hook: 在这部屡获殊荣的突破性电影中，导演吉莉安·阿姆斯特朗借鉴了青少年作家迈尔斯·富兰克林的小说，这是一部二十世纪初澳大利亚著名的成长故事，大胆地颠覆了时代浪漫的惯例。任性的年轻西比拉·梅尔文（朱迪·戴维斯，在一场明星表演中饰演）哀叹自己在偏远地区令人窒息的生活，在那里她的作家抱负几乎得不到鼓励，并且最渴望独立。当一位英俊的地主（山姆·尼尔饰）被她那难以驾驭的魅力解除了武装，开始向她求爱时，西比拉必须决定是否能够在婚姻的前景与她为自己想象的辉煌的一生工作之间取得平衡。 《我的辉煌职业生涯》充满了慷慨的幽默和年轻人对经验的渴望，是一幅热情奔放的自由精神的明亮肖像。
hook_en: For her award-winning breakthrough film, director Gillian Armstrong drew on teenage author Miles Franklin’s novel, a celebrated turn-of-the-twentieth-century Australian coming-of-age story, to brashly upend the conventions of period romance. Headstrong young Sybylla Melvyn (Judy Davis, in a star-making performance), bemoans her stifling life in the backcountry, where her writerly ambitions receive little encouragement, and craves independence above all else. When a handsome landowner (Sam Neill), disarmed by her unruly charms, begins to court her, Sybylla must decide whether she can reconcile the prospect of marriage with the illustrious life’s work she has imagined for herself. Suffused with generous humor and a youthful appetite for experience, My Brilliant Career is a luminous portrait of an ardently free spirit.

hook: 无声喜剧传奇人物哈罗德·劳埃德在这部融合了动作、浪漫和闹剧创意的不可抗拒的作品中向西行进。这位戴着眼镜的普通人扮演哈罗德·希科里（Harold Hickory）的最佳状态，他是一位著名执法者的温和儿子，生活在他那些打闹的兄弟的阴影下。当一场巡回医学展来到小镇时，它带来了兴奋、爱的可能性，以及哈罗德证明自己勇气的机会。 《小兄弟》巧妙地平衡了劳埃德出色的视觉笑料和惊心动魄的场景——包括在一艘废弃船上进行的一场史诗般的、令人震惊的、旷日持久的战斗——与这位演员兼电影制片人最充分实现的、支持弱势群体的叙述之一，《小兄弟》是早期银幕喜剧中搞笑又感人的高水位标志。
hook_en: Silent-comedy legend Harold Lloyd goes west in this irresistible blend of action, romance, and slapstick invention. The bespec­tacled everyman is at his inimitable best as Harold Hickory, the gentle son of a prominent lawman who lives in the shadow of his rough-and-tumble brothers. When a traveling medicine show rolls into town, it brings with it excitement, the possibility of love, and a chance for Harold to prove his mettle. Deftly balancing Lloyd’s brilliant sight gags and thrilling set pieces—including an epic, knock-down, drag-out fight aboard an abandoned ship—with one of the actor-filmmaker’s most fully realized, root-for-the-underdog narratives, The Kid Brother is a hilarious and heartwarming high-water mark of early screen comedy.

hook: 作为 20 世纪 60 年代轰动国际的艺术作品之一，《沙丘中的女人》（Suna no Onna）为许多人揭开了敕志原浩超现实、独特的世界的面纱。冈田英二饰演一位业余昆虫学家，他离开东京去研究在广阔的沙漠中发现的一种未分类的甲虫。当他错过了返回文明社会的巴士时，他被说服去与一位年轻寡妇（岸田恭子饰）在沙丘底部的小屋里过夜。结果是电影中最令人不安、最明显的性爱之战之一，以及对日常生活的噩梦般的描述，就像一场西西弗斯式的斗争——这一成就为弟子河原获得了奥斯卡最佳导演奖提名。
hook_en: One of the 1960s’ great international art-house sensations, Woman in the Dunes (Suna no onna) was for many the grand unveiling of the surreal, idiosyncratic world of Hiroshi Teshigahara. Eiji Okada plays an amateur entomologist who has left Tokyo to study an unclassified species of beetle found in a vast desert. When he misses his bus back to civilization, he is persuaded to spend the night with a young widow (Kyoko Kishida) in her hut at the bottom of a sand dune. What results is one of cinema’s most unnerving and palpably erotic battles of the sexes, as well as a nightmarish depiction of everyday life as a Sisyphean struggle—an achievement that garnered Teshigahara an Academy Award nomination for best director.

hook: 弗朗索瓦·特吕弗这部关于电影制作的欢乐与冲突的深情闹剧是他最喜爱的电影之一。特吕弗本人在一部无聊的情节剧中扮演一位忙碌的导演，该剧的拍摄受到神经质演员（让-皮埃尔·利奥德饰）、年老但仍然坚强的意大利女主角（瓦伦蒂娜·科特斯饰）和深受个人丑闻困扰的英国天真少女（杰奎琳·比塞特饰）的突发奇想的困扰。 《昼夜》是对平淡电影工艺的不敬赞歌，也是一部关于性和浪漫陷阱的令人愉快的人间喜剧，充满活力的表演和传奇人物乔治·德勒鲁 (Georges Delerue) 的精彩配乐为这部影片奠定了基础。
hook_en: This affectionate farce from François Truffaut about the joys and strife of moviemaking is one of his most beloved films. Truffaut himself appears as the harried director of a frivolous melodrama, the shooting of which is plagued by the whims of a neurotic actor (Jean-Pierre Léaud), an aging but still forceful Italian diva (Valentina Cortese), and a British ingenue haunted by personal scandal (Jacqueline Bisset). An irreverent paean to the prosaic craft of cinema as well as a delightful human comedy about the pitfalls of sex and romance, Day for Night is buoyed by robust performances and a sparkling score by the legendary Georges Delerue.

hook: 惠特·斯蒂尔曼（Whit Stillman）继《大都会》之后，推出了另一部聪明而饶舌的礼仪喜剧，这部作品带有更黑暗的边缘。一对预科生但体质不匹配的美国表兄弟——一名推销员和一名海军军官——在影片标题中美丽的西班牙城市工作时，就爱情和政治争论不休。以八十年代为背景，《巴塞罗那》探讨了令人兴奋的话题（美国例外论、冷战外交政策）和搞笑的话题（国际约会的来龙去脉、正确的剃须方法），同时保持了持续的诙谐乐趣，由泰勒·尼科尔斯、克里斯·艾吉曼和米拉·索维诺等年轻锐利的演员阵容主演。
hook_en: Whit Stillman followed his delightful indie breakthrough Metropolitan with another clever and garrulous comedy of manners, this one with a darker edge. A pair of preppy yet constitutionally mismatched American cousins—a salesman and a navy officer—argue about romance and politics while working in the beautiful Spanish city of the film’s title. Set during the eighties, Barcelona explores topics both heady (American exceptionalism, Cold War foreign policy) and hilarious (the ins and outs of international dating, the proper shaving method) while remaining a constantly witty delight, featuring a sharp young cast that includes Taylor Nichols, Chris Eigeman, and Mira Sorvino.

hook: 哥斯拉（又名哥斯拉）是所有怪物电影中咆哮的祖父。这也是一部非常人性化和忧郁的戏剧，制作于日本，当时该国正遭受太平洋核攻击和氢弹试验的困扰。它狂暴的放射性野兽是全体人民恐惧的深刻体现，成为受人喜爱的国际破坏标志，催生了三十多个续集。这里展示了 1954 年的原版日本版以及 1956 年“美国化”版本的《怪兽之王哥斯拉》，这是一场惊心动魄的触觉奇观，至今仍然是一种狂热现象。
hook_en: Godzilla (a.k.a. Gojira) is the roaring granddaddy of all monster movies. It’s also a remarkably humane and melancholy drama, made in Japan at a time when the country was reeling from nuclear attack and H-bomb testing in the Pacific. Its rampaging radioactive beast, the poignant embodiment of an entire population’s fears, became a beloved international icon of destruction, spawning more than thirty sequels. A thrilling, tactile spectacle that continues to be a cult phenomenon, the original 1954 Japanese version is presented here, along with Godzilla, King of the Monsters, the 1956 “Americanized” version.

hook: 让·雷诺阿的这部苦乐参半的电影根据居伊·德·莫泊桑的故事改编，是一部温柔的喜剧田园诗，讲述了一个城市家庭在法国乡村的野餐以及两个当地男人的母亲和成年女儿的浪漫故事。该项目最初是一部短片，1936 年几乎完成制作，当时雷诺阿因拍摄《底层》而被叫去。拍摄工作随后被放弃，但雷诺阿团队利用现有的镜头完成了这部电影，并于 1946 年以目前的形式上映，当时雷诺阿已经转战好莱坞。其结果是一个温暖的人文主义小插曲，成为雷诺阿最抒情的作品之一，对自然的热爱渗透到每一个美丽的画面中。
hook_en: This bittersweet film from Jean Renoir, based on a story by Guy de Maupassant, is a tenderly comic idyll about a city family’s picnic in the French countryside and the romancing of the mother and grown daughter by two local men. Conceived as a short feature, the project had nearly finished production in 1936 when Renoir was called away for The Lower Depths. Shooting was abandoned then, but the film was completed with the existing footage by Renoir’s team and released in its current form in 1946, after the director had already moved on to Hollywood. The result is a warmly humanist vignette that ranks among Renoir’s most lyrical works, with a love for nature imbuing its every beautiful frame.

hook: 才华横溢的导演兼编舞鲍勃·福斯将镜头对准了自己的生活，创作了这部充满疯狂想象力、自责的音乐杰作。罗伊·沙伊德 (Roy Scheider) 讲述了他饰演乔·吉迪恩 (Joe Gideon) 的职业生涯，乔·吉迪恩 (Joe Gideon) 的工作日程令人筋疲力尽，白天要上演百老汇作品，晚上要剪辑他的最新电影，而安非他明、酗酒和性行为的日常习惯使他的健康面临严重风险。福斯深入吉迪恩（和他自己）的思想，将他的内心世界描绘成奇幻的奇观。富有想象力的剪辑使舞蹈在银幕上前所未有地生动起来，并充满了 Ann Reinking、Leland Palmer 和 Ben Vereen 等人的精湛步法，《All That Jazz》将音乐流派推向了个人深度和艺术美学的高度。
hook_en: The preternaturally gifted director and choreographer Bob Fosse turned the camera on his own life for this madly imaginative, self-excoriating musical masterpiece. Roy Scheider gives the performance of his career as Joe Gideon, whose exhausting work schedule—mounting a Broadway production by day and editing his latest movie by night—and routine of amphetamines, booze, and sex are putting his health at serious risk. Fosse burrows into Gideon’s (and his own) mind, rendering his interior world as phantasmagoric spectacle. Assembled with visionary editing that makes dance come alive on-screen as never before, and overflowing with sublime footwork by the likes of Ann Reinking, Leland Palmer, and Ben Vereen, All That Jazz pushes the musical genre to personal depths and virtuosic aesthetic heights.

hook: 伴随着这场壮观的浪漫冒险，好莱坞虚张声势的新时代诞生了，一位名叫埃罗尔·弗林的邪恶明星也随之诞生。他为一位理想主义的爱尔兰医生角色带来了无限的魅力，他宣布自己是英国的叛徒，并被卖到新世界当奴隶，为了复仇，他变身为臭名昭著的海盗血船长。埃里希·沃尔夫冈·科恩戈尔德 (Erich Wolfgang Korngold) 创作的开创性交响乐配乐，标志着华纳兄弟音乐部门成为华纳兄弟电影制作中重要元素的崛起；弗林和奥利维娅·德·哈维兰在他们的第一对标志性配对中爆发出的化学反应；激动人心的海战结局——所有这些都在迈克尔·柯蒂斯的专业指导下汇集在一起​​，形成了全速前进的经典电影工艺的典范。
hook_en: With this spectacular romantic adventure, a new era of Hollywood swashbuckling was born, as was a devilishly dashing star named Errol Flynn. He brings boundless charisma to the role of an idealistic Irish physician who, declared a traitor to England and sold into slavery in the New World, takes his revenge by transforming himself into the notorious pirate Captain Blood. The groundbreaking symphonic score by Erich Wolfgang Korngold, marking the emergence of the Warner Bros. music department as a vital element in the studio’s moviemaking; the spitfire chemistry between Flynn and Olivia de Havilland in the first of their iconic pairings; the rousing naval-battle finale—all come together under the expert direction of Michael Curtiz to form an exemplar of classic film craftsmanship sailing full speed ahead.

hook: 在美国中西部某处烟雾缭绕的城市，一位刚刚出狱的年老犯罪主谋策划了一场价值百万美元的珠宝抢劫计划，并吸引了一位富有的律师和三名精心挑选的不法之徒加入他精心设计但不可避免的注定失败的计划。这部由约翰·休斯顿 (John Huston) 执导的犯罪经典影片，以才华横溢的演员斯特林·海登 (Sterling Hayden) 和性感的玛丽莲·梦露 (Marilyn Monroe) 等才华横溢的演员的精彩表演为基础，以对抢劫案细致入微的剖析达到高潮，此后在这一流派中引起了反响。 《沥青丛林》以一种不同寻常的自然主义视角描绘了阴暗的地下世界，煞费苦心地描绘了黑帮英雄的冷静专业精神和坚韧，同时对他们过于人性的脆弱表现出非凡的同情心，并展示了一位电影大师的巅峰之作。
hook_en: In a smog-choked city somewhere in the American Midwest, an aging criminal mastermind, newly released from prison, hatches a plan for a million-dollar jewel heist and draws a wealthy lawyer and a cherry-picked trio of outlaws into his carefully devised but inevitably doomed scheme. Anchored by an abundance of nuanced performances from a gifted ensemble—including a tight-jawed Sterling Hayden and a sultry Marilyn Monroe in her breakout role—this gritty crime classic by John Huston climaxes in a meticulously detailed anatomy of a robbery that has reverberated through the genre ever since. An uncommonly naturalistic view of a seamy underworld, The Asphalt Jungle painstakingly depicts the calm professionalism and toughness of its gangster heroes while evincing a remarkable depth of compassion for their all-too-human fragility, and it showcases a master filmmaker at the height of his powers.

hook: 导演惠特·斯蒂尔曼 (Whit Stillman) 执导的《迪斯科的最后时光》以 90 年代末的视角巧妙地以喜剧视角呈现 20 世纪 80 年代初的曼哈顿派对场景。影片中狂欢者们的中心人物是冰冷的夏洛特（凯特·贝金赛尔饰）和端庄的爱丽丝（科洛·塞维尼饰），她们白天在出版社助理中辛勤工作，晚上则在类似 Studio 54 的俱乐部寻找浪漫和娱乐。 《迪斯科的最后时光》充满了斯蒂尔曼标志性的冷幽默，以深情而又不伤感的方式描绘了一个时代的终结。
hook_en: The Last Days of Disco, from director Whit Stillman, is a cleverly comic look at the early 1980s Manhattan party scene from the vantage point of the late nineties. At the center of the film’s roundelay of revelers are the icy Charlotte (Kate Beckinsale) and the demure Alice (Chloë Sevigny), by day toiling as publishing house assistants and by night looking for romance and entertainment at a Studio 54–like club. Brimming with Stillman’s trademark dry humor, The Last Days of Disco is an affectionate yet unsentimental look at the end of an era.

hook: 胡安·布斯蒂略·奥罗 (Juan Bustillo Oro) 创作的这部风格生动、深沉而强烈的早期墨西哥声音情节剧以大胆的闪回结构为基础。当一位生病的僧侣在修道院里认出一位新兄弟时，他变得精神错乱并攻击了他。 《Dos monjes》从各自的角度讲述了这些人共同的悲惨过去，并利用德国表现主义语言中的视觉华丽，包括前卫摄影师阿古斯丁·希门尼斯 (Agustín Jiménez) 的摄影作品，增强了两个故事之间的对比。
hook_en: This vividly stylized, broodingly intense early Mexican sound melodrama by Juan Bustillo Oro hinges on an audacious flashback structure. When an ailing monk recognizes a new brother at his cloister, he becomes deranged and attacks him. Dos monjes recounts the men’s tragic shared past once from the point of view of each, heightening the contrasts between the two accounts with visual flourishes drawn from the language of German expressionism, including camera work by avant-garde photographer Agustín Jiménez.

hook: 当一位才华横溢但脾气一触即发的颓废编剧——汉弗莱·鲍嘉 (Humphrey Bogart)，在一场具有启发性、脆弱的表演中——成为好莱坞残酷谋杀案的头号嫌疑人时，唯一能为他提供不在场证据的人是一位有着迷人过去的迷人邻居（格洛丽亚·格雷厄姆饰）。充满情感的《孤独之地》改编自多萝西·休斯 (Dorothy B. Hughes) 的惊悚片，精彩纷呈，融合了悬疑的黑色电影和毁灭性的情节剧，并辅以精彩的表演。这是 20 世纪 50 年代最伟大的电影之一，也是经典好莱坞导演尼古拉斯·雷 (Nicholas Ray) 职业生涯的标杆，讲述了两个人渴望爱情却又与自己的恶魔和彼此作斗争的不妥协的故事。
hook_en: When a gifted but washed-up screenwriter with a hair-trigger temper—Humphrey Bogart, in a revelatory, vulnerable performance—becomes the prime suspect in a brutal Tinseltown murder, the only person who can supply an alibi for him is a seductive neighbor (Gloria Grahame) with her own troubled past. The emotionally charged In a Lonely Place, freely adapted from a Dorothy B. Hughes thriller, is a brilliant, turbulent mix of suspenseful noir and devastating melodrama, fueled by powerhouse performances. An uncompromising tale of two people desperate to love yet struggling with their demons and each other, this is one of the greatest films of the 1950s, and a benchmark in the career of the classic Hollywood auteur Nicholas Ray.

hook: 瑞典大师扬·特罗尔 (Jan Troell) 执导了深受人们喜爱的经典作品《移民》和《新大陆》，他带着《永恒的时刻》凯旋归来，讲述了二十世纪初一位被艺术解放的女性的生动而令人心碎的故事。尽管贫穷并受到酗酒丈夫的虐待，玛丽亚·拉尔森（玛丽亚·海斯卡宁饰）在摄影中找到了出路，这第一次打开了她的世界。 《永恒的时刻》取材于真实故事，其抛光的青铜色调让人想起褪色的照片，其宽广的调色板令人感同身受，是对图像制作力量的神奇致敬。
hook_en: Swedish master Jan Troell, director of the beloved classics The Emigrants and The New Land, returns triumphantly with Everlasting Moments, the vivid, heartrending story of a woman liberated by art at the beginning of the twentieth century. Though poor and abused by her alcoholic husband, Maria Larsson (Maria Heiskanen, in a beautifully nuanced portrayal) finds an outlet in photography, which opens up her world for the first time. With a burnished bronze tint that evokes faded photographs, and a broad empathetic palette, Everlasting Moments—based on a true story—is a miraculous tribute to the power of image making.

hook: 林赛·安德森的《如果……》以六十年代末英国的一所寄宿学校为背景，大胆描绘了英国社会的无政府主义景象。在库布里克在《发条橙》中塑造出他的恶作剧形象之前，马尔科姆·麦克道威尔饰演的漫不经心的米克·特拉维斯给人留下了深刻的印象，他和他的校友一起在每一个转折点上凌驾于权威之上，最终在学生和大师之间的恶毒游戏中成为一名暴力救世主。大胆地混合彩色和黑白，就像混合幻想和现实一样，如果……。仍然是电影界最令人难忘的叛逆呐喊之一。
hook_en: Lindsay Anderson’s If.... is a daringly anarchic vision of British society, set in a boarding school in late-sixties England. Before Kubrick made his mischief iconic in A Clockwork Orange, Malcolm McDowell made a hell of an impression as the insouciant Mick Travis, who, along with his school chums, trumps authority at every turn, finally emerging as a violent savior in the vicious games of one-upmanship played by both students and masters. Mixing color and black and white as audaciously as it mixes fantasy and reality, If…. remains one of cinema’s most unforgettable rebel yells.

hook: 在弗朗索瓦·特吕弗扣人心弦的人文主义人物研究中，杰拉尔·德帕迪约和凯瑟琳·德纳芙饰演二战期间生活在德国占领下的一家法国剧团的成员。尽管困难重重——一名犹太剧院经理躲藏起来；抵抗组织的领导人；纳粹的监督越来越严格——剧团认为演出必须继续下去。 《最后的地铁》（Le dernier métro）集浪漫、历史悲剧甚至喜剧于一身，是特吕弗对克服逆境的艺术的终极致敬。
hook_en: Gérard Depardieu and Catherine Deneuve star as members of a French theater company living under the German occupation during World War II in François Truffaut’s gripping, humanist character study. Against all odds—a Jewish theater manager in hiding; a leading man who’s in the Resistance; increasingly restrictive Nazi oversight—the troupe believes the show must go on. Equal parts romance, historical tragedy, and even comedy, The Last Metro (Le dernier métro) is Truffaut’s ultimate tribute to art overcoming adversity.

hook: 弗朗索瓦·特吕弗继朱尔斯和吉姆这一国际现象之后，讲述了这个紧张的不忠故事。谦逊的让·德塞利完美地扮演了一位著名的文学学者，看似婚姻幸福，却与弗朗索瓦丝·多莱克饰演的一位华丽的空姐发生了风流韵事，后者被他的魅力和声誉迷住了。随着他们的恋情变得严肃起来，影片变得焦虑，最终导致了一个沉重的结局。特吕弗在创作《柔软的皮肤》时正沉浸在阿尔弗雷德·希区柯克的作品中，在这部复杂、富有洞察力和未被忽视的法国新浪潮宝藏中，可以感受到这位大师的影响。
hook_en: François Truffaut followed up the international phenomenon Jules and Jim with this tense tale of infidelity. The unassuming Jean Desailly is perfectly cast as a celebrated literary scholar, seemingly happily married, who embarks on an affair with a gorgeous stewardess, played by Françoise Dorléac, who is captivated by his charm and reputation. As their romance gets serious, the film grows anxious, leading to a wallop of a conclusion. Truffaut made The Soft Skin at a time when he was immersing himself in the work of Alfred Hitchcock, and that master’s influence can be felt throughout this complex, insightful, and underseen French New Wave treasure.

hook: 乌斯马尔·伊斯梅尔的《宵禁之后》表达了一个为灵魂而战的国家的痛苦，讲述了一位前自由战士在印度尼西亚从荷兰独立的革命后无法重新适应平民生活的幻灭。这部电影充满了喜怒无常的气氛和紧张的心理，像一道闪电击中了全国电影院，首次以坚定的现实主义在银幕上照亮了印度尼西亚社会后殖民斗争所造成的情感损失。
hook_en: Giving voice to the anguish of a nation fighting for its soul, Usmar Ismail’s After the Curfew follows the descent into disillusionment of a former freedom fighter who is unable to readjust to civilian life following the revolution that gave Indonesia its independence from the Netherlands. Steeped in moody atmospherics and psychological tension, the film struck its national cinema like a bolt of lightning, illuminating on-screen, for the first time and with unflinching realism, the emotional toll of Indonesian society’s postcolonial struggles.

hook: 在一场可怕的海难后，一匹野马救了一个小男孩的命，两人在卡罗尔·巴拉德这部改编自沃尔特·法利经典儿童小说的电影杰作中成为了不太可能的朋友。从荒岛晶莹剔透的海岸到 20 世纪 40 年代美国郊区的绿草和尘土飞扬的道路，巴拉德和摄影指导凯莱布·丹斯切尔 (Caleb Deschanel) 创作了一部始终如一的视觉创新和纯粹的电影，其中还包括米基·鲁尼 (Mickey Rooney) 饰演退休骑师的获奖配角表演以及卡迈恩·科波拉 (Carmine Coppola) 的华丽配乐。
hook_en: A wild horse saves a young boy’s life after a terrifying shipwreck and the two become unlikely friends in Carroll Ballard’s cinematic tour de force, adapted from Walter Farley’s classic children’s novel. From the crystalline shores of a deserted island to the green grass and dusty roads of 1940s suburban America, Ballard and director of photography Caleb Deschanel create a film of consistent visual invention and purity, one that also features a winning supporting performance by Mickey Rooney as a retired jockey and a gorgeous score by Carmine Coppola.

hook: 吉洛·庞泰科尔沃 (Gillo Pontecorvo) 执导的《阿尔及尔之战》是历史上最具影响力的政治电影之一，生动地再现了 20 世纪 50 年代阿尔及利亚为摆脱法国占领而独立的动荡斗争中的关键一年。随着双方的暴力升级，儿童近距离向士兵开枪，妇女在咖啡馆里放置炸弹，法国士兵诉诸酷刑来摧毁叛乱分子的意志。这部电影以纪录片风格在阿尔及尔街头拍摄，是现代战争的案例研究，其中包括恐怖袭击和用于打击恐怖袭击的残酷手段。庞泰科尔沃的杰作在今天具有惊人的现实意义。
hook_en: One of the most influential political films in history, The Battle of Algiers, by Gillo Pontecorvo, vividly re-creates a key year in the tumultuous Algerian struggle for independence from the occupying French in the 1950s. As violence escalates on both sides, children shoot soldiers at point-blank range, women plant bombs in cafés, and French soldiers resort to torture to break the will of the insurgents. Shot on the streets of Algiers in documentary style, the film is a case study in modern warfare, with its terrorist attacks and the brutal techniques used to combat them. Pontecorvo’s tour de force has astonishing relevance today.

hook: “奇怪，爱情是做什么的。”一生的角色，好莱坞的谜团，一个陷入困境的女人。 。 。大卫·林奇的第一部数字拍摄长片富有远见地利用了这一媒介，对时间、身份和电影本身的谜题进行了广泛的思考。这部迷宫般的梦工厂噩梦以劳拉·邓恩 (Laura Dern) 饰演边缘演员的精彩表演为特色，它跌入一系列无尽的、深不可测、相互关联的兔子洞，带领观众踏上一场幻觉之旅，进入无意识心灵的最深处。
hook_en: “Strange, what love does.” The role of a lifetime, a Hollywood mystery, a woman in trouble . . . David Lynch’s first digitally shot feature makes visionary use of the medium to weave a vast meditation on the enigmas of time, identity, and cinema itself. Featuring a tour de force performance from Laura Dern as an actor on the edge, this labyrinthine Dream Factory nightmare tumbles down an endless series of unfathomably interconnected rabbit holes as it takes viewers on a hallucinatory odyssey into the deepest realms of the unconscious mind.

hook: 也许没有哪位导演比艾伦·J·帕库拉（Alan J. Pakula）更有效地利用了 20 世纪 70 年代普遍存在的恐惧和不信任感，他在其著名的偏执三部曲的第二部中描绘了肯尼迪家族和马丁·路德·金遇刺后的美国令人不寒而栗的景象，以及水门事件即将发生的震惊。在西雅图太空针塔上目睹了一位主要参议员被谋杀的三年后，记者约瑟夫·弗雷迪（沃伦·比蒂饰）开始深入调查这起谋杀案的神秘情况，并无意中发现了一个比他想象的更加险恶的迷宫阴谋。著名电影摄影师戈登·威利斯 (Gordon Willis) 创作的视差视图风格酷炫、阴影蚀刻的构图以视觉方式表达了一种情绪，这种情绪以焦虑的低语开始，以对虚空的尖叫结束。
hook_en: Perhaps no director tapped into the pervasive sense of dread and mistrust that defined the 1970s more effectively than Alan J. Pakula, who, in the second installment of his celebrated Paranoia Trilogy, offers a chilling vision of America in the wake of the assassinations of the Kennedys and Martin Luther King Jr., and about to be shocked by Watergate. Three years after witnessing the murder of a leading senator atop Seattle’s Space Needle, reporter Joseph Frady (Warren Beatty) begins digging into the mysterious circumstances surrounding the killing—and stumbles into a labyrinthine conspiracy far more sinister than he could have imagined. The Parallax View’s coolly stylized, shadow-etched compositions by acclaimed cinematographer Gordon Willis give visual expression to a mood that begins as an anxious whisper and ends as a scream into the void.

hook: 作为新一代黑暗、沉思的西部片的重要先驱，这部颠覆性的心理传奇很快给美国边疆民间传说蒙上了一层阴影，为亡命之徒英雄的神话敲响了丧钟。格利高里·派克饰演吉米·林戈（Jimmy Ringo），这是他道德上最复杂的角色之一，他是一位臭名昭著的枪手，想要挂起枪套并开始新的生活，但他的名声无情地将他卷入暴力和复仇的循环中，他无法逃脱。 《枪手》由多才多艺的制片厂时代工匠亨利·金 (Henry King) 高效执导，摄影大师阿瑟·C·米勒 (Arthur C. Miller) 以引人注目的深焦风格拍摄，《枪手》放弃了粗暴的动作场面，转而对罪恶感和悔恨进行了哀伤的探索，诉说着战后美国焦虑的灵魂。
hook_en: A key forerunner of the new breed of dark, brooding westerns that would soon cast a shadow over America’s frontier folklore, this subversive psychological saga sounds a death knell for the myth of the outlaw hero. In one of his most morally complex roles, Gregory Peck stars as Jimmy Ringo, an infamous gunslinger looking to hang up his holsters and start a new life, but whose reputation draws him inexorably into a cycle of violence and revenge from which he cannot escape. Directed with taut efficiency by the versatile studio-era craftsman Henry King, and shot in striking deep-focus style by master cinematographer Arthur C. Miller, The Gunfighter forgoes rough-and-tumble action in favor of an elegiac exploration of guilt and regret that speaks to the anxious soul of postwar America.

hook: 恩里克和罗莎兄妹逃离危地马拉家乡的迫害，向北出发，穿过墨西哥，到达美国，梦想着开始新生活。这是一个每天都在发生的故事，但在格雷戈里·纳瓦（Gregory Nava）开创性的《El Norte》（《北方》）之前，电影中从未以如此紧迫的人道主义来展现移民跨越边境进入美国的个人痛苦。 《北方》是一部充满梦幻意象的社会现实主义作品，是一个关于希望和生存的充满爱意、令人心碎的故事，评论家罗杰·艾伯特称之为“我们这个时代的愤怒的葡萄”。
hook_en: Brother and sister Enrique and Rosa flee persecution at home in Guatemala and journey north, through Mexico and on to the United States, with the dream of starting a new life. It’s a story that happens every day, but until Gregory Nava’s groundbreaking El Norte (The North), the personal travails of immigrants crossing the border to America had never been shown in the movies with such urgent humanism. A work of social realism imbued with dreamlike imagery, El Norte is a lovingly rendered, heartbreaking story of hope and survival, which critic Roger Ebert called “a Grapes of Wrath for our time.”

hook: 拉斯·冯·提尔 (Lars von Trier) 在 2009 年戛纳电影节上首映《反基督》，震惊了电影界。在这部生动的心理剧中，一对悲痛欲绝的男人和女人——灼热的威廉·达福和戛纳最佳女演员奖得主夏洛特·甘斯布——在他们的婴儿儿子意外死亡后，撤退到树林深处的小屋，却发现大自然以及最终彼此都遭受了恐怖和暴力。但当代电影界最具争议的艺术家之一的这部最具对抗性的作品不仅仅是挑衅。这是一次视觉上崇高、情感上摧残的旅程，直达被附身的人类心灵最黑暗的角落；一场令人不安的两性之战，将理性心理学与古老的迷信对立起来；和一部深刻有效的恐怖片。
hook_en: Lars von Trier shook up the film world when he premiered Antichrist at the 2009 Cannes Film Festival. In this graphic psychodrama, a grief-stricken man and woman—a searing Willem Dafoe and Cannes best actress winner Charlotte Gainsbourg—retreat to their cabin deep in the woods after the accidental death of their infant son, only to find terror and violence at the hands of nature and, ultimately, each other. But this most confrontational work yet from one of contemporary cinema’s most controversial artists is no mere provocation. It is a visually sublime, emotionally ravaging journey to the darkest corners of the possessed human mind; a disturbing battle of the sexes that pits rational psychology against age-old superstition; and a profoundly effective horror film.

hook: 小说家理查德·哈兰德（康奈尔·王尔德饰）似乎在艾伦（吉恩·蒂尔尼饰）身上找到了完美的女人，艾伦是一位美丽的社交名流，她发起了一场旋风般的浪漫，并在他犹豫不决之前就引导他结婚了。然而，艾伦玻璃般的忠诚很快就显露出了可怕的深度，理查德逐渐意识到他的妻子占有欲惊人，可能有能力摧毁他们之间的任何人。 《让她去天堂》是一部取材自女性电影和黑色电影的独特好莱坞杰作，由情节剧专家约翰·M·斯塔尔 (John M. Stahl) 精心执导，里昂·沙姆罗伊 (Leon Shamroy) 的绚丽彩色摄影，以及蒂尔尼 (Tierney) 令人不寒而栗的表演，蒂尔尼饰演的艾伦是一位与众不同的蛇蝎美人，她的爱情既纯洁又有毒。《让她去天堂》由二十世纪福克斯公司和学院电影资料馆在电影基金会。
hook_en: Novelist Richard Harland (Cornel Wilde) seems to have found the perfect woman in Ellen (Gene Tierney), a beautiful socialite who initiates a whirlwind romance and steers him into marriage before he can think twice. Yet the glassy surface of Ellen’s devotion soon reveals monstrous depths, as Richard comes to realize that his wife is shockingly possessive and may be capable of destroying anyone who comes between them. A singular Hollywood masterpiece that draws freely from the women’s picture and film noir alike, Leave Her to Heaven boasts elegant direction by melodrama specialist John M. Stahl, blazing Technicolor cinematography by Leon Shamroy, and a chilling performance by Tierney, whose Ellen is a femme fatale unlike any other—a woman whose love is as pure as it is poisonous.Leave Her to Heaven was restored by Twentieth Century Fox and the Academy Film Archive, with support from The Film Foundation.

hook: 特里·吉列姆以曼哈顿为背景的宏伟童话《渔王》是一个植根于辛酸现实的童话故事，杰夫·布里吉斯和罗宾·威廉姆斯扮演了他们最出色的两个角色。布里奇斯扮演一名前无线电冲击运动员，在丑闻后重建自己的生活，威廉姆斯扮演一名无家可归的人，正在寻找圣杯——他相信圣杯隐藏在上东区的某个地方。两人的过去在不知不觉中联系在一起，在通往人性的奇幻旅程中互相帮助。这部独特的美国冒险之旅由理查德·拉格拉文斯 (Richard LaGravenese) 编写的诙谐剧本、罗杰·普拉特 (Roger Pratt) 令人回味的摄影、阿曼达·普卢默 (Amanda Plummer) 和奥斯卡获奖者梅塞德斯·鲁尔 (Mercedes Ruehl) 的精彩配角表演组成，吉列姆将这一切演绎成一个富有同情心、有趣的现代神话。
hook_en: A fairy tale grounded in poignant reality, Terry Gilliam’s magnificent, Manhattan-set The Fisher King features Jeff Bridges and Robin Williams in two of their most brilliant roles. Bridges plays a former radio shock jock reconstructing his life after a scandal, and Williams a homeless man on a quest for the Holy Grail—which he believes to be hidden somewhere on the Upper East Side. Unknowingly linked by their pasts, the two men aid each other on a fanciful journey toward their own humanity. This singular American odyssey features a witty script by Richard LaGravenese, evocative cinematography by Roger Pratt, and superb supporting performances by Amanda Plummer and an Oscar-winning Mercedes Ruehl, all harnessed by Gilliam into a compassionate, funny modern-day myth.

hook: 富有远见的舞蹈家和编舞家乌代香卡 (Uday Shankar) 制作的唯一一部电影是文化复兴的乌托邦梦想，也是对各种印度舞蹈的庆祝。 《卡尔帕纳》以一部史诗般的电影形式展开，讲述了一位舞者（导演本人）决心开设一个文化中心并为印度传统艺术形式注入新生命的故事。与此同时，他和领舞之间明显的崇拜引起了他有进取心的同伴的嫉妒。一系列狂喜的图像——包括旋转的超现实主义舞蹈奇观——与反殖民、反资本主义的评论交织在一起，造就了一部激进的原始宝莱坞作品，成为印度电影中最具影响力的电影之一。
hook_en: The only film by the visionary dancer and choreographer Uday Shankar is a utopian dream of cultural renewal and a celebration of Indian dance in all its variety. Unfolding as an epic film within a film, Kalpana tells the story of a dancer (the director himself) who is determined to open a cultural center and breathe new life into India’s traditional artistic forms. Meanwhile, the visible adoration between him and his lead dancer arouses the jealousy of his enterprising companion. A riot of ecstatic imagery—including swirling surrealist dance spectacles—is interwoven with anticolonial, anticapitalist commentary, making for a radical, proto-Bollywood work that is one of the most influential films in Indian cinema.

hook: 《孩子们再见》讲述了生活在纳粹占领的法国的两个男孩关于友谊和毁灭性损失的令人心碎的故事。在一所省级天主教寄宿学校，早熟的年轻人享受着真正的友情——直到一个秘密被揭露。这部电影取材于编剧兼导演马勒自己的童年事件，是一个微妙、精确观察的关于勇气、怯懦和悲剧觉醒的故事。
hook_en: Au revoir les enfants tells a heartbreaking story of friendship and devastating loss concerning two boys living in Nazi-occupied France. At a provincial Catholic boarding school, the precocious youths enjoy true camaraderie—until a secret is revealed. Based on events from writer-director Malle’s own childhood, the film is a subtle, precisely observed tale of courage, cowardice, and tragic awakening.

hook: 当日本新浪潮坏男孩Seijun Suzuki向他工作室的高管们交付这部残酷、滑稽、视觉灵感的杰作时，他立即被解雇了。Branded to Kill （ Koroshi no rakuin ）讲述了一个狂喜的故事，讲述了一个狂热的黑帮刺客，他迷恋嗅蒸米饭（花栗鼠脸颊的超级巨星Joe Shishido ） ，他拙劣的工作并最终成为目标。这是最极端的铃木-惊人的圆周率…
hook_en: When Japanese New Wave bad boy Seijun Suzuki delivered this brutal, hilarious, and visually inspired masterpiece to the executives at his studio, he was promptly fired. Branded to Kill (Koroshi no rakuin) tells the ecstatically bent story of a yakuza assassin with a fetish for sniffing steamed rice (the chipmunk-cheeked superstar Joe Shishido) who botches a job and ends up a target himself. This is Suzuki at his most extreme—the flabbergasting pinnacle of his sixties pop-art aesthetic.

hook: 在这部关于控制动态的引人入胜的研究中，奥斯卡奖获得者导演迈克尔·哈内克 (Michael Haneke) 以诺贝尔奖获得者埃尔弗里德·耶利内克 (Elfriede Jelinek) 于 1983 年创作的备受争议的小说为背景，该小说讲述了反常的女性性行为和古典音乐世界。哈内克在伊莎贝尔·于佩尔身上找到了自己的对手，伊莎贝尔·于佩尔饰演埃里卡，她是维也纳音乐学院的钢琴教授，与母亲生活在一种幽闭恐怖的相互依赖关系中，她的表演冰冷但安静地激动人心。她受到严重压抑，只能偷窥满足自己的受虐冲动，直到她遇到了学生沃尔特（伯努瓦·马吉梅尔饰），他对埃里卡的渴望导致了毁灭性的迷恋，打破了她生活中精心平衡的平衡。 《钢琴老师》是哈内克的一项重大突破，它在戛纳电影节上赢得了大奖并为其明星赢得了两项表演奖，是一部形式主义的杰作，至今仍引起轰动。
hook_en: In this riveting study of the dynamics of control, Academy Award–winning director Michael Haneke takes on Nobel laureate Elfriede Jelinek’s controversial 1983 novel about perverse female sexuality and the world of classical music. Haneke finds his match in Isabelle Huppert, who delivers an icy but quietly seething performance as Erika, a piano professor at a Viennese conservatory who lives with her mother in a claustrophobically codepen­dent relation­ship. Severely repressed, she satisfies her mas­ochistic urges only voyeuristically until she meets Walter (Benoît Magimel), a student whose desire for Erika leads to a destructive infatuation that upsets the careful equilibrium of her life. A critical breakthrough for Haneke, The Piano Teacher—which won the Grand Prix as well as dual acting awards for its stars at Cannes—is a formalist masterwork that remains a shocking sensation.

hook: 几十年来，记者杰普·甘巴德拉 (Jep Gambardella) 一直在罗马光鲜亮丽的夜生活中魅力四射。自从他唯一一部小说获得传奇般的成功以来，他一直是这座城市的文学界和精英社交圈的常客。但在他六十五岁生日那天，杰普出人意料地发现自己正在审视自己的生活，用尖刻的智慧审视自己和同时代的人，并越过奢华的夜总会、派对和咖啡馆，发现罗马本身，在其所有的不朽荣耀中：一幅荒诞而精致之美的永恒风景。由杰出的意大利导演保罗·索伦蒂诺执导的这部感人至深的电影以感性的摄影、华丽的配乐和伟大的托尼·塞尔维略屡获殊荣的核心表演为特色，是一部关于颓废和失去爱情的令人惊叹的费里尼式故事​​。
hook_en: For decades, journalist Jep Gambardella has charmed and seduced his way through the glittering nightlife of Rome. Since the legendary success of his only novel, he has been a permanent fixture in the city’s literary and elite social circles. But on his sixty-fifth birthday, Jep unexpectedly finds himself taking stock of his life, turning his cutting wit on himself and his contemporaries, and looking past the lavish nightclubs, parties, and cafés to find Rome itself, in all its monumental glory: a timeless landscape of absurd, exquisite beauty. Featuring sensuous cinematography, a lush score, and an award-winning central performance by the great Toni Servillo, this transporting experience by the brilliant Italian director Paolo Sorrentino is a breathtaking Felliniesque tale of decadence and lost love.

hook: 克劳德·夏布洛尔的第四十九部故事片是他多产职业生涯的最高成就——对阶级动态、犯罪心理学以及潜伏在日常生活表象之下的肮脏秘密进行了冷静而引人入胜的研究。荣获凯撒奖的伊莎贝尔·于佩尔 (Isabelle Huppert) 是一位令人着迷、神秘莫测的人物，她是桑德琳·博内尔 (Sandrine Bonnaire) 紧密盘绕的阳气中混乱的阴气。他们分别是小镇的邮政工人和富裕家庭的女佣，一对外人组成了一个神秘的联盟，但逐渐地，几乎在不知不觉中，失控了。夏布洛尔凭借对声音、剪辑和悬念的大师级控制，打造了一场持续紧张的杰作，以冰镐般的精准度传递出每一次精彩的震撼。
hook_en: Claude Chabrol’s forty-ninth feature stands as the crowning achievement of his prolific career—a coolly riveting study of class dynamics, the psychology of crime, and the sordid secrets lurking beneath the veneer of everyday life. A fascinatingly enigmatic, César Award–winning Isabelle Huppert is the chaotic yin to Sandrine Bonnaire’s tightly coiled yang. They are, respectively, a small-town postal worker and a maid to a wealthy family, a pair of outsiders who form a mysterious alliance that gradually, almost imperceptibly, goes haywire. With a master’s control of sound, editing, and suspense, Chabrol constructs a tour de force of sustained tension that delivers each brilliant shock with ice-pick precision.

hook: 在罗伯特·奥尔德里奇执导的这部根据米基·斯皮兰小说改编的电影中，20 世纪 50 年代的良好礼仪被炸得粉碎。拉尔夫·米克 (Ralph Meeker) 饰演咆哮的私家侦探迈克·哈默 (Mike Hammer)，在一个漆黑、孤独的夜晚，他决定去接一位搭便车的女人，这让他走上了一些可怕的小道。 《致命吻我》是一部厚颜无耻、阴郁的黑色电影杰作，也是冷战偏执狂的重要作品，它的结局是美国电影中从未见过的紧张结局。
hook_en: In this atomic adaptation of Mickey Spillane’s novel, directed by Robert Aldrich, the good manners of the 1950s are blown to smithereens. Ralph Meeker stars as snarling private dick Mike Hammer, whose decision one dark, lonely night to pick up a hitchhiking woman sends him down some terrifying byways. Brazen and bleak, Kiss Me Deadly is a film noir masterwork as well as an essential piece of cold war paranoia, and it features as nervy an ending as has ever been seen in American cinema.

hook: 英国导演史蒂芬·弗雷尔斯 (Stephen Frears) 改编自廉价商店诗人吉姆·汤普森 (Jim Thompson) 的小说，这部令人振奋的电影将低俗的情节提升到了存在主义悲剧的境界，在洛杉矶明媚的阳光下，黑暗的新黑色电影沸腾了。一位占有欲很强的母亲（安杰丽卡·休斯顿饰）、她愤世嫉俗的儿子（约翰·库萨克饰）和他诡计多端、诱人的女友（安妮特·贝宁饰）是职业骗子，他们在一场精心设计的情感信任游戏中相互纠缠，随着爱情和信任变成背叛，俄狄浦斯情结的暗流浮出水面，这场游戏变得越来越反常。在弗雷尔斯的第一部好莱坞电影中，这位自信满满的导演和他三位魅力四射的演员让人联想到一种喜怒无常、不合时宜的有毒美国风情。
hook_en: A dark-hearted neonoir comes to a boil under the bright Los Angeles sun, in British director Stephen Frears’s rousing adaptation of the novel by dime-store bard Jim Thompson, a film that raises pulp to the realm of existential tragedy. A possessive mother (Anjelica Huston), her cynical son (John Cusack), and his scheming, seductive girlfriend (Annette Bening) are career swindlers circling one another in an elaborate emotional confidence game that grows increasingly perverse as love and trust turn to betrayal and Oedipal undercurrents rise to the surface. In Frears’s first film made in Hollywood, the ever-assured director and his trifecta of magnetic actors conjure a moody, unstuck-in-time vision of toxic Americana.

hook: 《东京物语》深刻地唤起了基本的人性和普遍的心碎，是无与伦比的小津安二郎的最高成就。这部电影讲述了一对老年夫妇在战后熙熙攘攘的东京看望成年子女的旅程，以导演一贯的细腻和对社会习俗的敏锐视角审视了丰富而复杂的家庭生活世界。 《东京物语》以小津常客柳智州和原节子的精彩表演为特色，深入探讨并深化了导演反复出现的代际冲突主题，创造了毫无疑问的电影最伟大的杰作之一。
hook_en: A profoundly stirring evocation of elemental humanity and universal heartbreak, Tokyo Story is the crowning achievement of the unparalleled Yasujiro Ozu. The film, which follows an aging couple’s journey to visit their grown children in bustling postwar Tokyo, surveys the rich and complex world of family life with the director’s customary delicacy and incisive perspective on social mores. Featuring lovely performances from Ozu regulars Chishu Ryu and Setsuko Hara, Tokyo Story plumbs and deepens the director’s recurring theme of generational conflict, creating what is without question one of cinema’s mightiest masterpieces.

hook: 弗朗索瓦·特吕弗在这部根据纸浆大师大卫·古迪斯的小说改编的随心所欲的电影中，将犯罪类型演绎得像爵士乐一样，这部电影将黑色宿命论与紧张的新思潮新鲜感融为一体。这部悲喜剧故事讲述了胆怯的舞厅钢琴家查理（查尔斯·阿兹纳沃尔饰）的冒险经历，他陷入了一场旋风般的恋情，并无意中被他的黑帮兄弟卷入了暴力的黑社会。影片令人眼花缭乱地融合了拉乌尔·库塔尔的手持摄影作品、乔治·德勒鲁充满渴望的配乐以及俏皮的锯齿状剪辑，特吕弗创造了一个令人遗憾的人物研究，贯穿了他标志性的痴迷：电影、创造力的难以捉摸的本质，以及浪漫遗憾的刺痛。
hook_en: François Truffaut plays the crime genre like jazz with this freewheeling adaptation of a novel by pulp master David Goodis, a film that infuses noir fatalism with a nervy nouvelle-vague freshness. The tragicomic story follows the adventures of timid dance-hall pianist Charlie (Charles Aznavour), who gets caught up in a whirlwind love affair and is inadvertently drawn into a violent underworld by his gangster brothers. With the film’s dazzling mix of Raoul Coutard’s handheld camera work, a wistful score by Georges Delerue, and playfully jagged editing, Truffaut creates a rueful character study shot through with his signature obsessions: cinema, the elusive nature of creativity, and the sting of romantic regret.

hook: 嘿，嘿，这是蒙基队。 。 。经历了美国电影六十年代最超现实的冒险之旅之一。鲍勃·拉菲尔森 (Bob Rafelson) 的创意，这是他的导演处女作；他的制作伙伴兼 Monkees 联合创始人伯特·施奈德 (Bert Schneider)；和该项目的共同编剧杰克·尼科尔森（Jack Nicholson）一起，《海德》是这个电视孕育的超级组合大银幕生涯的奇特的开始和可耻的结束。在这部影片中，米基·多伦茨、戴维·琼斯、迈克尔·内史密斯和彼得·托克陷入了一场千变万化的讽刺之中，电影致敬、媒体讽刺、音乐会电影和反战呐喊同时出现。 《海德》是一部超前于时代的、不断循环的、自我参照的恶搞作品，在发行时未能获得商业上的成功，但后来又被重新定位为那个时代最伟大的邪教对象之一。
hook_en: Hey, hey, it’s the Monkees . . . being catapulted through one of American cinema’s most surreal sixties odysseys. The brainchild of Bob Rafelson, making his directorial debut; his producing partner and Monkees cocreator Bert Schneider; and Jack Nicholson, a coscreenwriter on the project, Head was the fanciful beginning and ignominious end of the TV-bred supergroup’s big-screen career. In it, Micky Dolenz, Davy Jones, Michael Nesmith, and Peter Tork become trapped in a kaleidoscopic satire that’s movie homage, media send-up, concert movie, and antiwar cry all at once. A constantly looping, self-referential spoof that was ahead of its time, Head dodged commercial success on its release but has since been reclaimed as one of the great cult objects of its era.

hook: 这部 20 世纪 80 年代复兴的哥斯拉系列电影的第二部，深入到疯狂的想象领域，向新一代粉丝展示了这只高耸的野兽。这一次，哥斯拉的敌人是该系列中最奇妙的怪兽创造物之一：Biollante——一种由玫瑰细胞基因改造而成的突变植物、叛逆科学家死去的女儿和哥斯拉本身。 《哥斯拉大战比奥兰特》的狂野情节包括间谍、通灵儿童和疯狂的生物技术，以及日本电影史上一些最酷的特效，《哥斯拉大战比奥兰特》成为怪兽之王不断发展的神话中的一个高潮。
hook_en: Diving into delirious realms of imagination, this second film of the Godzilla franchise’s 1980s resurgence showcased the towering beast for a new generation of fans. This time, Godzilla’s foe is one of the series’ most wondrously strange kaiju creations: Biollante—a mutant plant genetically engineered from the cells of a rose, a renegade scientist’s dead daughter, and Godzilla itself. With a wild plot encompassing spies, psychic children, and bonkers biotechnology—and some of the coolest special effects in the history of Japanese cinema—Godzilla vs. Biollante stands as a high point in the ever-evolving mythology of the King of the Monsters.

hook: 在一个炎热的夏天，一群生活在日渐衰落的南方乡村的孩子们必须面临一系列艰难的选择。导演大卫·戈登·格林 (David Gordon Green) 执导的第一部长片，是一部构思雄心勃勃、拍摄精美的青春期沉思片，由屡获殊荣的演员阵容提供精彩表演。 《乔治·华盛顿》是当代美国独立电影的一部令人震惊且独特的作品。
hook_en: Over the course of one hot summer, a group of children in the decaying rural South must confront a tangle of difficult choices. An ambitiously constructed, elegantly photographed meditation on adolescence, the first full-length film by director David Gordon Green features remarkable performances from an award-winning ensemble cast. George Washington is a startling and distinct work of contemporary American independent cinema.

hook: 捷克斯洛伐克新浪潮反传统人士尤拉吉·赫兹 (Juraj Herz) 对极权主义意识形态的恐怖进行了可怕的黑色喜剧视角，鲁道夫·赫鲁辛斯基 (Rudolf Hrušínský) 饰演病态的卡雷尔·科普弗金格尔 (Karel Kopfrkingl)，他是 20 世纪 30 年代布拉格的一名火葬场经理，他坚信死亡是人类痛苦中唯一真正的解脱。当科普弗金格尔被纳粹招募时，他日益疯狂的世界观促使他制定了自己令人震惊的最终解决方案。将最黑色的绞刑架幽默与令人迷失方向的表现主义华丽融为一体——令人作呕的视点镜头、扭曲的镜头、刺耳的快速剪辑——备受争议、长期被禁的杰作《火葬场》是电影界对平庸邪恶最尖锐、最令人不安的描绘之一。《火葬场》的修复是在米拉达·库切洛娃夫人和爱德华·库切拉先生的捐赠下完成的，并由卡罗维发利国际电影节在UPP 和 Soundsquare 工作室与布拉格 Národní filmový archive 和捷克电影基金会合作。
hook_en: Czechoslovak New Wave iconoclast Juraj Herz’s terrifying, darkly comic vision of the horrors of totalitarian ideologies stars a supremely chilling Rudolf Hrušínský as the pathologically morbid Karel Kopfrkingl, a crematorium manager in 1930s Prague who believes fervently that death offers the only true relief from human suffering. When he is recruited by the Nazis, Kopfrkingl’s increasingly deranged worldview drives him to formulate his own shocking final solution. Blending the blackest of gallows humor with disorienting expressionistic flourishes—queasy point-of-view shots, distorting lenses, jarring quick cuts—the controversial, long-banned masterpiece The Cremator is one of cinema’s most trenchant and disturbing portraits of the banality of evil.This restoration of The Cremator was made possible by a donation from Mrs. Milada Kučerová and Mr. Eduard Kučera and was realized by Karlovy Vary IFF at the studios of UPP and Soundsquare, in cooperation with the Národní filmový archiv in Prague and the Czech Film Fund.

hook: 哈莫尼·科林的处女作以大胆、抒情的方式唤起了美国乡村的弱点，也是威廉·福克纳和威廉·埃格尔斯顿南方哥特式传统的挽歌。这部粗制滥造的电影在科林的家乡纳什维尔拍摄——代表遭受龙卷风蹂躏的俄亥俄州森尼亚——讲述了两个年轻朋友图姆勒和所罗门骑车在城镇里兜风、吸着胶水、捕猎流浪猫的故事，他们在当地的每一次遭遇都充满了杂耍般的无政府状态和深深的悲情。既叛逆又富有同情心，令人不安，又无可否认地美丽，古莫是一幅独一无二的肖像，描绘了陷入文化空虚的天使和魔鬼的灵魂，受到二十世纪末美国贫困和枯竭、疏远的精神生活的限制。
hook_en: Harmony Korine’s debut feature is an audacious, lyrical evocation of America’s rural underbelly, and an elegy in the southern-gothic tradition of William Faulkner and William Eggleston. Shot in Korine’s native Nashville—standing in for the tornado-ravaged Xenia, Ohio—the rough-hewn film follows two young friends, Tummler and Solomon, as they ride around town, huffing glue and hunting stray cats, their every local encounter charged with vaudevillian anarchy as well as deep pathos. At once transgressive and empathetic, disturbing and undeniably beautiful, Gummo is a one-of-a-kind portrait of angelic and devilish souls caught in a cultural void, circumscribed by poverty and the depleted, alienated spiritual life of late-twentieth-century America.

hook: 迷人的男主角转型为独特的导演科内尔·王尔德 (Cornel Wilde) 在 20 世纪 60 年代和 70 年代创作了一些对人性坚韧、暴力的探索，其中没有比《赤裸的猎物》更令人难忘的了。十九世纪初，一次象牙狩猎之旅冒犯了一群南非猎人，殖民主义者被抓获并遭受可怕的酷刑。一名孤独的神枪手（王尔德饰）被释放，没有衣服或武器，为了好玩而被猎杀，他开始了穿越稀树草原和丛林回到原始状态的痛苦旅程。 《赤裸的猎物》以生动的宽银幕摄影作品和毫不畏缩的凶猛动作序列为特色，既是一部推进性的、精简到骨子里的叙事，也是对文明概念的沉思。
hook_en: Glamorous leading man turned idiosyncratic auteur Cornel Wilde created in the 1960s and ’70s a handful of gritty, violent explorations of the nature of man, none more memorable than The Naked Prey. In the early nineteenth century, after an ivory-hunting safari offends a group of South African hunters, the colonialists are captured and hideously tortured. A lone marksman (Wilde) is released, without clothes or weapons, to be hunted for sport, and he begins a harrowing journey through savanna and jungle back to a primitive state. Distinguished by vivid widescreen camera work and unflinchingly ferocious action sequences, The Naked Prey is both a propulsive, stripped-to-the-bone narrative and a meditation on the concept of civilization.

hook: 这是一部与众不同的西部片，将最美国风格的神话范围与马龙·白兰度表演中灼热的自然主义结合在一起——所有这些都充满了弗洛伊德的暗示和男性的焦虑。在他唯一的一次导演生涯中，白兰度以华丽的宽银幕彩色图像捕捉了崎岖的海岸和沙漠景观，并引出了他的演员同事（包括卡尔·马尔登和皮娜·佩利瑟）对冲突角色的细致入微的描述。尽管这部作品因导演的完美主义而不知所措，并受到挫折和工作室重新剪辑的困扰，但《独眼杰克》仍然是白兰度的伟大成就之一，这首先要归功于他饰演的里奥的痛苦转变，里奥是一名一心想向他的前犯罪同伙复仇的银行抢劫犯。里约热内卢沉思而浪漫，是这位伟大演员在其整个职业生涯中如此强烈的标志性局外人中最后一个，也许是最温柔的。
hook_en: This is a western like no other, combining the mythological scope of that most American of genres with the searing naturalism of a performance by Marlon Brando—all suffused with Freudian overtones and masculine anxiety. In his only directing stint, Brando captures rugged coastal and desert landscapes in gorgeous widescreen, Technicolor images, and elicits from his fellow actors (including Karl Malden and Pina Pellicer) nuanced depictions of conflicted characters. Though the production was overwhelmed by its director’s perfectionism and plagued by setbacks and studio reediting, One-Eyed Jacks stands as one of Brando’s great achievements, thanks above all to his tortured turn as Rio, a bank robber bent on revenge against his former partner in crime. Brooding and romantic, Rio is the last and perhaps the most tender of the iconic outsiders that the great actor imbued with such intensity throughout his career.

hook: 瑞典电影制片人阿尔夫·舍伯格 (Alf Sjöberg) 凭借视觉创新、荣获戛纳电影节大奖的这部改编自奥古斯特·斯特林堡 (August Strindberg) 1888 年著名戏剧的作品，将这位舞台杰出观察者对男女关系中腐朽事物的严厉斥责话语生动地呈现出来。 《朱莉小姐》生动地描述了当一位富商的女儿（安妮塔·比约克，在一场激烈的情感表演中）爱上了她父亲的苦毒仆人时，随之而来的性别和阶级之战。舍伯格的电影以其独特的电影风格而闻名（在美国首次上映时因其成人内容而受到审查），是斯堪的纳维亚电影的一个重要转折点。
hook_en: Swedish filmmaker Alf Sjöberg's visually innovative, Cannes Grand Prix-winning adaptation of August Strindberg's renowned 1888 play brings to scalding life the excoriating words of the stage's preeminent surveyor of all things rotten in the state of male-female relations. Miss Julie vividly depicts the battle of the sexes and classes that ensues when a wealthy businessman's daughter (Anita Björk, in a fiercely emotional performance) falls for her father's bitter servant. Celebrated for its unique cinematic style (and censored upon its first release in the United States for its adult content), Sjöberg's film was an important turning point in Scandinavian cinema.

hook: 已故的花花公子亨利·范·克里夫（唐·阿米契饰）来到哈迪斯的外部办公室，请求困惑的撒旦允许他进入地狱之门。尽管魔鬼怀疑亨利的罪孽是否会让他受到永恒的诅咒，但亨利继续讲述了他一生追求女性的故事，尽管他与玛莎（吉恩·蒂尔尼饰）有着长久而幸福的婚姻。恩斯特·刘别谦 (Ernst Lubitsch) 的《天堂可以等待》(Heaven Can Wait) 获得奥斯卡最佳影片和导演奖提名，是一部经久不衰的经典之作，展示了这位电影制片人将机智、温文尔雅和优雅融为一体的标志性特征。
hook_en: Deceased playboy Henry Van Cleve (Don Ameche) presents himself to the outer offices of Hades, where he asks a bemused Satan for permission to enter through the gates of hell. Though the devil doubts that Henry’s sins qualify him for eternal damnation, Henry proceeds to recount a lifetime of wooing and pursuing women, his long, happy marriage to Martha (Gene Tierney) notwithstanding. Ernst Lubitsch’s Heaven Can Wait, nominated for Academy Awards for best picture and director, is an enduring classic that showcases the filmmaker’s trademark blend of wit, urbanity, and grace.

hook: 这部“厨房水槽现实主义”的基准电影是英国有史以来最优秀的电影之一，讲述了一位矿工出身的橄榄球运动员在单调的约克郡勉强维持生活的自我挫败的职业和浪漫追求。年轻的理查德·哈里斯 (Richard Harris) 有着令人惊叹、愤怒的表演，奥斯卡提名者雷切尔·罗伯茨 (Rachel Roberts) 扮演与他同住的遗孀，林赛·安德森 (Lindsay Anderson) 的精彩导演，在多年的纪录片工作之后的长片处女作中，《体育生活》仍然是一部戏剧性的巨作。
hook_en: One of the finest British films ever made, this benchmark of "kitchen-sink realism" follows the self-defeating professional and romantic pursuits of a miner turned rugby player eking out an existence in drab Yorkshire. With an astonishing, raging performance by a young Richard Harris, an equally blistering turn by fellow Oscar nominee Rachel Roberts as the widow with whom he lodges, and electrifying direction by Lindsay Anderson, in his feature-film debut following years of documentary work, This Sporting Life remains a dramatic powerhouse.

hook: 1971 年，记者拉乌尔·杜克 (Raoul Duke) 带着一箱违禁品和他那有点精神错乱的萨摩亚律师奇闻趣事 (Dr. Gonzo) 一路狂奔前往拉斯维加斯，报道一场摩托车比赛。本来应该是一成不变的新闻任务很快就变成了一场狂热的迷幻之旅。导演特里·吉列姆和以约翰尼·德普和本尼西奥·德尔·托罗为主角的全明星演员毫不留情地将亨特·S·汤普森对美国生活方式的严厉剖析搬上银幕，打造了一部既搞笑又野蛮的电影。
hook_en: It is 1971, and journalist Raoul Duke barrels toward Las Vegas—accompanied by a trunkful of contraband and his slightly unhinged Samoan attorney, Dr. Gonzo—to cover a motorcycle race. What should be a cut-and-dried journalistic assignment quickly descends into a feverish psychedelic odyssey. Director Terry Gilliam and an all-star cast, headlined by Johnny Depp and Benicio Del Toro, show no mercy in bringing Hunter S. Thompson’s excoriating dissection of the American way of life to the screen, creating a film both hilarious and savage.

hook: 这位二十世纪最激动人心的英雄之一在富有远见的导演斯派克·李的帮助下，获得了一部恰如其分的银幕传记片，充满了历史洞察力和推动性的电影风格。马尔科姆·艾克斯以丹泽尔·华盛顿的非凡表演为背景，借鉴这位标志性民权领袖的自传，追溯了他的赋权之旅，从被白人至上主义暴力撕裂的童年，到轻微犯罪的一生，再到皈依伊斯兰教，并重生为一名无畏的黑人解放战士，他的勇气和口才激励了世界各地受压迫的社区。由李和他最亲密的创意合作者精心打造，并受到安吉拉·巴塞特、德尔罗伊·林多、小艾尔·弗里曼等人精彩表演的鼓舞，这是一座充满激情的纪念碑，纪念一个一生继续充当原则性抵抗典范的人。
hook_en: One of the most electrifying heroes of the twentieth century receives an appropriately sweeping screen biopic, rich in both historical insight and propulsive cinematic style, courtesy of visionary director Spike Lee. Built around an extraordinary performance from Denzel Washington, Malcolm X draws on the iconic civil rights leader’s autobiography to trace his journey of empowerment, from a childhood riven by white-supremacist violence to a life of petty crime to his conversion to Islam and rebirth as a fearless fighter for Black liberation, whose courage and eloquence inspired oppressed communities the world over. Impeccably crafted by Lee and his closest creative collaborators, and buoyed by commanding performances from Angela Bassett, Delroy Lindo, Al Freeman Jr., and others, this is a passionate monument to a man whose life continues to serve as a model of principled resistance.

hook: 索菲亚·科波拉 (Sofia Coppola) 将糖果色的色调、梦幻般的合成流行配乐和匡威高帮鞋带入了 18 世纪的凡尔赛宫，为这部极具颠覆性、风格夸张的反传记电影讲述了历史上最臭名昭著（也可能是最被误解的）人物之一的故事。克尔斯滕·邓斯特 (Kirsten Dunst) 将玛丽·安托瓦内特 (Marie Antoinette) 描绘成一位叛逆的少女公主，她嫁给了即将加冕为国王路易十六 (Louis XVI) 的法国年轻王太子 (贾森·施瓦兹曼 (Jason Schwartzman))。玛丽·安托瓦内特在充满丑闻和阴谋的宫廷中感到孤立无援，她像摇滚明星一样生活，反抗皇室和平民，但这种生活只能持续很长时间。
hook_en: Sofia Coppola brings a candy-colored palette, a dreamy synth-pop soundtrack, and Converse high-tops to eighteenth-century Versailles for this exuberantly subversive, extravagantly stylized anti-biopic of one of history’s most infamous (and perhaps misunderstood) figures. Kirsten Dunst portrays Marie Antoinette as a rebellious teenage princess, who marries the awkward young dauphin of France (Jason Schwartzman), soon to be crowned King Louis XVI. Feeling isolated in a royal court rife with scandal and intrigue, Marie Antoinette defies both royalty and commoner by living like a rock star—which can work for only so long.

hook: 这部引人注目的犯罪剧改编自多萝西·B·休斯 (Dorothy B. Hughes) 的小说，由好莱坞演员转型为独特导演罗伯特·蒙哥马利 (Robert Montgomery) 执导并主演。他扮演一位说话强硬的前美国大兵，来到新墨西哥州的一个小镇，镇压杀害他最好朋友的歹徒；事情很快就会变得糟糕。 《骑粉红马》由弗雷德·克拉克 (Fred Clark)、万达·亨德里克斯 (Wanda Hendrix) 和托马斯·戈麦斯 (Thomas Gomez) 提供出色的配角表演，托马斯·戈麦斯成为第一位因其角色获得奥斯卡奖提名的西班牙裔演员。凭借其不懈的节奏、伟大的拉塞尔·梅蒂富有表现力的摄影，以及本·赫克特和查尔斯·莱德勒的有力而巧妙的剧本，这是 20 世纪 40 年代黑色电影全盛时期被忽视的瑰宝。
hook_en: Hollywood actor turned idiosyncratic auteur Robert Montgomery directs and stars in this striking crime drama based on a novel by Dorothy B. Hughes. He plays a tough-talking former GI who comes to a small New Mexico town to shake down a gangster who killed his best friend; things quickly turn nasty. Ride the Pink Horse features standout supporting performances by Fred Clark, Wanda Hendrix, and especially Thomas Gomez, who became the first Hispanic actor to receive an Academy Award nomination for his role here. With its relentless pace, expressive cinematography by the great Russell Metty, and punchy, clever script by Ben Hecht and Charles Lederer, this is an overlooked treasure from the heyday of 1940s film noir.

hook: 杜鲁门·卡波特的畅销书是对现实生活中犯罪与惩罚的突破性叙事，在编剧兼导演理查德·布鲁克斯手中成为一部同样令人毛骨悚然的电影。罗伯特·布莱克 (Robert Blake) 和斯科特·威尔逊 (Scott Wilson) 饰演的佩里·史密斯 (Perry Smith) 和迪克·希科克 (Dick Hickock) 于 1959 年在堪萨斯州一次拙劣的抢劫中谋杀了一家四口，罗伯特·布莱克 (Robert Blake) 和斯科特·威尔逊 (Scott Wilson) 饰演的佩里·史密斯 (Perry Smith) 和迪克·希科克 (Dick Hickock) 因与他们所扮演的杀手有着令人不安的相似之处而被选为演员。布鲁克斯对美国悲剧及其后果的毫不妥协的看法带来了一种超然的、纪录片般的直率。与此同时，从风格上看，《冷血》是一堂电影制作大师班，拥有临床精确的剪辑、伟大的康拉德·霍尔的明暗对比黑白电影摄影，以及昆西·琼斯的威胁性爵士配乐。
hook_en: Truman Capote’s best seller, a breakthrough narrative account of real-life crime and punishment, became an equally chilling film in the hands of writer-director Richard Brooks. Cast for their unsettling resemblances to the killers they play, Robert Blake and Scott Wilson give authentic, unshowy performances as Perry Smith and Dick Hickock, who in 1959 murdered a family of four in Kansas during a botched robbery. Brooks brings a detached, documentary-like starkness to this uncompromising view of an American tragedy and its aftermath; at the same time, stylistically In Cold Blood is a filmmaking master class, with clinically precise editing, chiaroscuro black-and-white cinematography by the great Conrad Hall, and a menacing jazz score by Quincy Jones.

hook: 《交通》将毒品问题视为政治、商业和生活方式。史蒂文·索德伯格采用创新的彩色电影处理方式来区分他交织的故事，让观众卷入了新任命的毒枭及其家人、西海岸头目妻子、关键线人以及美墨边境两侧警察的生活。这部电影在不牺牲任何能量或悬念的情况下，对一个具有国际重要性的问题进行了复杂而细致的阐述，是一部当代经典，并获得了四项奥斯卡奖，包括最佳导演、最佳剧本、最佳剪辑和最佳男配角（本尼西奥·德尔·托罗）。
hook_en: Traffic examines the question of drugs as politics, business, and lifestyle. With an innovative color-coded cinematic treatment to distinguish his interwoven stories, Steven Soderbergh embroils viewers in the lives of a newly appointed drug czar and his family, a West Coast kingpin’s wife, a key informant, and police officers on both sides of the U.S.-Mexico border. The film, which delivers a complex and nuanced take on an issue of international importance without sacrificing any energy or suspense, is a contemporary classic, and the winner of four Oscars, for best director, best screenplay, best editing, and best supporting actor for Benicio del Toro.

hook: 《欢乐精神》是大卫·里恩根据诺埃尔·科沃德的戏剧轰动作品改编而成的令人愉悦的电影版本（在舞台上，它在登陆百老汇之前打破了伦敦票房纪录），雷克斯·哈里森饰演一位小说家，他厚颜无耻地邀请一位灵媒（玛格丽特·卢瑟福饰）到他家举办降神会，希望这次经历能给他正在写的一本书带来灵感。当她召唤出他已故第一任妻子（凯·哈蒙德饰）的灵魂时，事情的发展显然没有按计划进行，这对他现任妻子（康斯坦斯·卡明斯饰）来说是一个严重的不便。 《欢乐精神》采用奥斯卡获奖特效来美化科沃德的戏剧闹剧，是一部精彩的超自然喜剧，表演获奖。
hook_en: Blithe Spirit, David Lean’s delightful film version of Noël Coward’s theater sensation (onstage, it broke London box-office records before hitting Broadway), stars Rex Harrison as a novelist who cheekily invites a medium (Margaret Rutherford) to his house to conduct a séance, hoping the experience will inspire a book he’s working on. Things go decidedly not as planned when she summons the spirit of his dead first wife (Kay Hammond), a severe inconvenience for his current one (Constance Cummings). Employing Oscar-winning special effects to spruce up Coward’s theatrical farce, Blithe Spirit is a sprightly supernatural comedy with winning performances.

hook: 两位骗子哈里·法比安（理查德·威德马克饰）渴望“安逸而充实的生活”。有着不光彩的无处可去的计划的历史，他试图与一位著名的摔跤手策划一个有利可图的计划。但在这个联盟不断变化、贪污无底、肉体饱受摧残的黑社会里，赚不到快钱——费边很快就知道了他的野心所要付出的可怕代价。 《夜晚与城市》在伦敦街头拍摄，当时家乡的好莱坞黑名单正在逼近导演朱尔斯·达辛，《夜晚与城市》也由吉恩·蒂尔尼主演，是一流的黑色电影，也是达辛的最高成就之一。
hook_en: Two-bit hustler Harry Fabian (Richard Widmark) longs for “a life of ease and plenty.” Trailed by an inglorious history of go-nowhere schemes, he tries to hatch a lucrative plan with a famous wrestler. But there is no easy money in this underworld of shifting alliances, bottomless graft, and pummeled flesh—and Fabian soon learns the horrible price of his ambition. Luminously shot in the streets of London while Hollywood blacklisters back home were closing in on director Jules Dassin, Night and the City, also starring Gene Tierney, is film noir of the first order, and one of Dassin’s crowning achievements.

hook: 费德里科·费里尼 (Federico Fellini) 与他的妻子兼缪斯演员朱丽叶塔·马西纳 (Giulietta Masina) 合作，拍摄了这部奇幻的人物研究，这是导演的第一部彩色电影。马西娜借鉴了她个人生活中的细节，扮演了一位涉足招魂术的女人，当她得知丈夫有外遇时，她对现实的把握开始下滑，让她踏上了一段自我发现的幻觉之旅，在这段旅程中，记忆、梦想和超自然力量融合成万花筒般的完形。凭借贾尼·迪·韦南佐精湛的摄影和马西纳无所畏惧的主演，《灵魂朱丽叶》是费里尼最有远见的电影之一，与《8.5》相反，后者从女性的角度审视了导演的核心关注点——性与爱、生与死、幻想与现实。
hook_en: Federico Fellini partnered with his wife and muse, actor Giulietta Masina, for this phantasmagoric character study, the director’s first color feature. Drawing on details from her personal life, Masina plays a woman dabbling in spiritualism whose hold on reality begins to slip when she learns that her husband is having an affair, sending her on a hallucinatory journey of self-discovery in which memories, dreams, and supernatural forces merge in a kaleidoscopic gestalt. With virtuosic cinematography from Gianni di Venanzo and a fearless lead performance by Masina, Juliet of the Spirits is one of Fellini’s most visionary films, an opposite number to 8½ that examines the director’s central preoccupations—sex and love, life and death, fantasy and reality—from a woman’s perspective.

hook: 米尔乔·曼切夫斯基的《雨前》是第一部在新独立的马其顿共和国拍摄的电影，讲述了一位正统基督教僧侣（格雷瓜尔·科林饰）、一位英国摄影经纪人（凯特琳·卡特利奇饰）和一位马其顿本土战地摄影师（拉德·谢尔贝季亚饰）的故事，描绘了即将达到沸点的种族和宗教仇恨的肖像。这部扣人心弦的爱情与暴力三联画是在九十年代饱受战争蹂躏的巴尔干国家的冲突期间制作的，也是对田园纯真丧失的永恒唤起，并且仍然是近年来电影对战争徒劳的最有力的哀叹之一。
hook_en: The first film made in the newly independent Republic of Macedonia, Milcho Manchevski's Before the Rain crosscuts the stories of an orthodox Christian monk (Grégoire Colin), a British photo agent (Katrin Cartlidge), and a native Macedonian war photographer (Rade Šerbedžija) to paint a portrait of simmering ethnic and religious hatred about to reach its boiling point. Made during the strife of the war-torn Balkan states in the nineties, this gripping triptych of love and violence is also a timeless evocation of the loss of pastoral innocence, and remains one of recent cinema's most powerful laments on the futility of war.

hook: 这是 20 世纪 40 年代最令人难忘、最反常的黑色电影之一，旅行嘉年华的明亮灯光背后潜藏着黑暗。 《梦魇巷》改编自威廉·林赛·格雷沙姆的丑闻畅销书，为泰隆·鲍尔提供了一个机会，通过无情的表演颠覆他的日场偶像形象，饰演斯坦顿·卡莱尔，一个三流的卡莱尔，他的油滑魅力使他成为江湖骗子唯心论者的名声，但他不受控制的野心使他走上了道德堕落和自我毁灭的道路。尽管其奇怪、肮脏的气氛震惊了当代观众，但这种长期以来难以看到的战后焦虑的反映现在已成为该时代的标志性黑色电影之一——一种宿命论的滑向存在主义的遗忘。
hook_en: Darkness lurks behind the bright lights of a traveling carnival in one of the most haunting and perverse film noirs of the 1940s. Adapted from the scandalous best seller by William Lindsay Gresham, Nightmare Alley gave Tyrone Power a chance to subvert his matinee-idol image with a ruthless performance as Stanton Carlisle, a small-time carny whose unctuous charm propels him to fame as a charlatan spiritualist, but whose unchecked ambition leads him down a path of moral degradation and self-destruction. Although its strange, sordid atmosphere shocked contemporary audiences, this long-difficult-to-see reflection of postwar angst has now taken its place as one of the defining noirs of its era—a fatalistic downward slide into existential oblivion.

hook: 在双峰镇，每个人都有自己的秘密，但劳拉·帕尔默 (Laura Palmer) 除外。在这部 90 年代开创性电视连续剧的前传中，大卫·林奇复活了节目开始时发现的被塑料包裹的少女，跟随她度过了她生命的最后一周，并揭开了围绕她被谋杀的谜团。劳拉白天是返校节女王，晚上则是吸毒成瘾的寻求刺激者，劳拉过着双重生活，当她拼凑出多年来一直恐吓她的袭击者的身份时，她的恐惧越来越深。 《双峰：与火同行》虽然讲述了一个无辜者被深不可测的力量撕裂的噩梦，但它仍然是林奇最人性化的电影之一，对饱受折磨的女主人公充满同情心——这个角色生前和死后一样令人着迷。
hook_en: In the town of Twin Peaks, everybody has their secrets—but no one more than Laura Palmer. In this prequel to his groundbreaking 1990s television series, David Lynch resurrects the teenager found wrapped in plastic at the beginning of the show, following her through the last week of her life and teasing out the enigmas that surround her murder. Homecoming queen by day and drug-addicted thrill seeker by night, Laura leads a double life that pulls her deeper and deeper into horror as she pieces together the identity of the assailant who has been terrorizing her for years. Nightmarish in its vision of an innocent torn apart by unfathomable forces, Twin Peaks: Fire Walk with Me is nevertheless one of Lynch’s most humane films, aching with compassion for its tortured heroine—a character as enthralling in life as she was in death.

hook: 这是一部以充满活力、多元文化的纽约市为背景的酷儿浪漫喜剧，吴爱丽的处女作令人难以抗拒，将活泼的对话、令人陶醉的爱情故事与母女之间相互妥协的辛酸叙述相结合，为这一类型注入了新鲜的活力。正当忙碌的年轻外科住院医生威尔（米歇尔·克鲁西克饰）与轻浮的舞者薇薇安（陈琳饰）开始了一段充满希望的恋情时，当她更传统的中国母亲（陈冲饰）——未婚且意外怀孕——搬来与她同住时，她的生活发生了翻天覆地的变化，迫使两位女性面对长期困扰她们关系的代际和文化障碍。吴宇森拥抱并巧妙地颠覆了浪漫喜剧的传统，向美国华裔侨民发出了慷慨的颂歌，并表达了活出真理的解放快乐。
hook_en: A queer romantic comedy set in vibrant, multicultural New York City, Alice Wu’s irresistible feature debut breathed fresh life into the genre by combining snappy dialogue and a swooning love story with a poignant narrative about a mother and daughter coming to terms with each other. Just as Wil (Michelle Krusiec), a harried young surgical resident, begins a promising romance with the flirtatious dancer Vivian (Lynn Chen), her life is turned upside down when her more traditional Chinese mother (Joan Chen)—unwed and unexpectedly pregnant—moves in with her, forcing both women to confront the generational and cultural barriers that have long troubled their relationship. Both embracing and cleverly subverting rom-com conventions, Wu delivers a bighearted ode to the Chinese American diaspora, and the liberating joy of living one’s truth.

hook: 偏僻的庄园；安静的烛光氛围；和颤抖，超自然的威胁。智利裔西班牙作家、导演兼作曲家亚历杭德罗·阿梅纳巴尔 (Alejandro Amenábar) 凭借他的第一部英语故事片，重新演绎了经典的哥特式冷酷风格，创作了一个引起不寻常情感共鸣的鬼故事。妮可·基德曼饰演一位二战时期的母亲，她的专横掩盖了可怕的痛苦，因为她把对光敏感的孩子们笼罩在乡村庄园的黑暗中。 The arrival of three new servants punctures her insular world—and seems to disturb the balance between the living and the dead.阿梅纳巴尔的每一个令人惊叹的转折都让我们更深入地沉浸在一个不仅被鬼魂困扰，而且还被内疚、创伤和压抑所困扰的境界中。
hook_en: A remote manor; hushed, candlelit atmosphere; and shivery, supernatural menace. With his first English-language feature, Chilean Spanish writer-director-composer Alejandro Amenábar resurrected the classic gothic chiller to create a ghost story of uncommon emotional resonance. Nicole Kidman stars as a World War II–era mother whose imperiousness masks a terrifying pain, as she keeps her light-sensitive children enshrouded in darkness on her country estate. The arrival of three new servants punctures her insular world—and seems to disturb the balance between the living and the dead. With each stunning twist and turn, Amenábar immerses us more deeply in a realm haunted not only by spirits but also by guilt, trauma, and repression.

hook: 戴安娜·古兹曼（米歇尔·罗德里格兹饰）在家里受到父亲的欺凌，在学校感到漂泊不定，她在家乡布鲁克林的一个意想不到的地方找到了庇护所——一个陈旧的拳击馆，在那里她学会了如何发挥自己的力量，发现了社区意识，并爱上了一位竞争对手。在卡琳·草间弥生的原始、低调的处女作中，罗德里格斯以一种紧密盘绕的强度和深深的脆弱掌控着银幕，扮演一名年轻女性，反击社会的期望和她自己的内心恶魔。草间弥生捕捉了戴安娜旅程的全部情感分量和运动中身体的动感快感，精心打造了一个毫不妥协的自我实现故事。
hook_en: Bullied by her father at home and feeling adrift at school, Diana Guzman (Michelle Rodriguez) finds refuge in an unexpected pocket of her native Brooklyn—a timeworn boxing gym, where she learns to channel her strength, discovers a sense of community, and falls for a rival fighter. In Karyn Kusama’s raw, understated feature debut, Rodriguez commands the screen with both tightly coiled intensity and deep wells of vulnerability as a young woman hitting back at society’s expectations and her own personal demons. Capturing the full emotional weight of Diana’s journey and the kinetic thrill of bodies in motion, Kusama crafts a singularly uncompromising story of self-realization.

hook: 在彼得·博格丹诺维奇的这部令人惊叹的处女作中，旧好莱坞与新好莱坞的碰撞，银幕恐怖与现实生活中的恐怖的碰撞。由罗杰·科曼制作，这部对美国制造的大屠杀的令人毛骨悚然的先见之明让鲍里斯·卡洛夫扮演了自己的一个版本：一个年迈的恐怖电影偶像，他的命运与一个看似普通的年轻人（蒂姆·奥凯利饰）的命运交织在一起，在洛杉矶周围发生了一场疯狂的疯狂枪击事件。 《目标》充满了关于大众媒体与大规模暴力之间关系的挑衅性想法，是用最少的预算制作最有效的电影的典范，也是美国新浪潮的决定性声音之一的有力的第一个声明。
hook_en: Old Hollywood collides with New Hollywood, and screen horror with real-life horror, in the startling debut feature from Peter Bogdanovich. Produced by Roger Corman, this chillingly prescient vision of American-made carnage casts Boris Karloff as a version of himself: an aging horror-movie icon whose fate intersects with that of a seemingly ordinary young man (Tim O’Kelly) on a psychotic shooting spree around Los Angeles. Charged with provocative ideas about the relationship between mass media and mass violence, Targets is a model of maximally effective filmmaking on a minimal budget and a potent first statement from one of the defining voices of the American New Wave.

hook: 这部被重新发现的伊朗电影瑰宝已重新成为该国革命前新浪潮中最令人惊叹的作品之一。 《风之棋》是一部充满时代氛围的催眠式谋杀悬疑小说，故事发生在一座烛光大宅内，贪婪、暴力和背叛的网络将潜在的继承人困在其中，争夺对女族长庄园的控制权。穆罕默德·礼萨·阿斯拉尼 (Mohammad Reza Aslani) 融合了欧洲现代主义、哥特式恐怖和古典波斯艺术的影响，创作了一部精致克制的情绪作品，最终爆发出颠覆性的最后一幕，阶级惯例、性别角色和时间本身都被令人震惊的凶猛颠覆。
hook_en: This rediscovered jewel of Iranian cinema has reemerged as one of the most astonishing works of the country’s prerevolutionary New Wave. A hypnotically stylized murder mystery awash in period atmosphere, Chess of the Wind unfolds inside a candlelit mansion, where a web of greed, violence, and betrayal ensnares potential heirs as they vie for control of their matriarch’s estate. Melding the influences of European modernism, gothic horror, and classical Persian art, Mohammad Reza Aslani crafts an exquisitely restrained mood piece that erupts into a subversive final act in which class conventions, gender roles, and time itself are upended with shocking ferocity.

hook: 在他们不朽的第五次合作中，费德里科·费里尼（ Federico Fellini ）和表现力十足的朱丽叶塔·马西纳（ Giulietta Masina ）完成了电影中最不可磨灭的角色之一的创作：卡比利亚（ Cabiria ） ，一个无法抑制、极度独立的性工作者，当她穿越罗马人性的海洋时，经历了逆境和心碎，必须依靠自己和她自己不屈不挠的精神来保持站立。坎恩最佳女演员奖得主…
hook_en: In the fifth of their immortal collaborations, Federico Fellini and the exquisitely expressive Giulietta Masina completed the creation of one of the most indelible characters in all of cinema: Cabiria, an irrepressible, fiercely independent sex worker who, as she moves through the sea of Rome’s humanity, through adversity and heartbreak, must rely on herself—and her own indomitable spirit—to stay standing. Winner of the best actress prize at Cannes for Masina and the Academy Award for best foreign-language film, Nights of Cabiria brought the early, neorealist-influenced phase of Fellini’s career to a transcendent close with its sublimely heartbreaking yet hopeful final image, which embodies, perhaps more than any other in the director’s body of work, the blend of the bitter and the sweet that define his vision of the world.

hook: 恩斯特·刘别谦 (Ernst Lubitsch) 著名的风格在这件性感的前法典珠宝中得到了精致的展现，闪烁着诙谐的暗示和优雅的喜剧发明。当上流社会小偷加斯顿·莫内斯库（赫伯特·马歇尔饰）和扒手莉莉·沃蒂埃（米丽娅姆·霍普金斯饰）在威尼斯运河中相遇并试图互相欺骗时，他们一开始就爱上了骗局。然后他们前往巴黎，在那里，两人遇到了他们最新的对手——非常时髦的科莱夫人（凯·弗朗西斯饰），她的财富令人难以置信，只有她的诱惑力才能超越。凭借令人愉快的下流对话、令人着迷的服装和高级装饰风格，《天堂里的麻烦》是喜剧浪漫复杂性的巅峰之作，就像最好的香槟一样嘶嘶作响。
hook_en: Ernst Lubitsch’s famed touch is on exquisite display in this sexy pre-Code jewel, glittering with witty innuendo and elegant comic invention. It’s love at first swindle when high-society thief Gaston Monescu (Herbert Marshall) and pickpocket Lily Vautier (Miriam Hopkins) cross paths amid the canals of Venice while attempting to con each other—and then it’s off to Paris, where the pair meet their match in their latest mark, the très chic Madame Colet (Kay Francis), whose fabulous fortune is exceeded only by her powers of seduction. With its delightfully risqué dialogue, swoonworthy couture, and high deco style, Trouble in Paradise is a pinnacle of comic-romantic sophistication that fizzes like the finest champagne.

hook: 《红鞋子》（ The Red Shoes ）是迈克尔·鲍威尔（ Michael Powell ）和埃默里克·普莱斯伯格（ Emeric Pressburger ）的独特幻想作品，是电影界典型的后台戏剧，也是有史以来为银幕制作的最辉煌的技术色彩盛宴之一。莫伊拉·希勒（ Moira Shearer ）是一位后起之秀芭蕾舞演员，在理想主义作曲家和追求完美的无情经理人之间徘徊。以杰出的表演、杰克·卡迪夫（ Jack Cardiff ）出色的电影摄影、奥斯卡获奖场景和音乐为特色…
hook_en: The Red Shoes, the singular fantasia from Michael Powell and Emeric Pressburger, is cinema’s quintessential backstage drama, as well as one of the most glorious Technicolor feasts ever concocted for the screen. Moira Shearer is a rising star ballerina torn between an idealistic composer and a ruthless impresario intent on perfection. Featuring outstanding performances, blazingly beautiful cinematography by Jack Cardiff, Oscar-winning sets and music, and an unforgettable, hallucinatory central dance sequence, this beloved classic, dazzlingly restored, stands as an enthralling tribute to the life of the artist. The Red Shoes was restored by the UCLA Film & Television Archive in association with the BFI, The Film Foundation, ITV Global Entertainment Ltd., and Janus Films. Restoration funding provided by the Hollywood Foreign Press Association, The Film Foundation, and the Louis B. Mayer Foundation.

hook: 在这部令人心酸的第二部电影中，大卫·林奇将他大气的视觉和声音调色板带入了一个以维多利亚时代英国为背景的臭名昭著的真实故事中。当伦敦外科医生弗雷德里克·特雷夫斯（安东尼·霍普金斯饰）遇到患有严重骨骼和软组织畸形的怪胎表演者约翰·梅里克（约翰·赫特饰）时，他认为他也一定有智力障碍。然而，随着两人相处的时间越来越多，梅里克展现出了他令人震惊的外表下隐藏的智慧、温柔的本性和深刻的尊严感，他和特里夫斯建立了友谊。 《象人》以华丽的黑白镜头拍摄，并拥有包括安妮·班克罗夫特、约翰·吉尔古德和温迪·希勒在内的明星配角，获得八项奥斯卡奖提名，巩固了林奇作为美国电影界最有远见的人才之一的声誉。
hook_en: With this poignant second feature, David Lynch brought his atmospheric visual and sonic palette to a notorious true story set in Victorian England. When the London surgeon Frederick Treves (Anthony Hopkins) meets the freak-show performer John Merrick (John Hurt), who has severe skeletal and soft-tissue deformities, he assumes that he must be intellectually disabled as well. As the two men spend more time together, though, Merrick reveals the intelligence, gentle nature, and profound sense of dignity that lie beneath his shocking appearance, and he and Treves develop a friendship. Shot in gorgeous black and white and boasting a stellar supporting cast that includes Anne Bancroft, John Gielgud, and Wendy Hiller, The Elephant Man was nominated for eight Academy Awards, cementing Lynch’s reputation as one of American cinema’s most visionary talents.

hook: 奥地利出生的未来奥斯卡奖得主弗莱德·齐尼曼 (Fred Zinnemann) 在其职业生涯早期与埃米利奥·戈麦斯·穆里尔 (Emilio Gómez Muriel) 共同执导了政治和情感上炙手可热的《雷德斯》(Redes)。在这部生动、类似纪录片的戏剧中，人们在墨西哥湾靠捕鱼谋生（大部分由现实生活中的渔民扮演），他们的日常辛苦工作被描述为一名工人的可怕损失，这在他和他的工友中激发了政治觉醒。 《Redes》是一群才华横溢的奇才，受进步的墨西哥政府委托，由传奇摄影师保罗·斯特兰德 (Paul Strand) 共同撰写和拍摄。
hook_en: Early in his career, the Austrian-born future Oscar winner Fred Zinnemann codirected with Emilio Gómez Muriel the politically and emotionally searing Redes. In this vivid, documentary-like dramatization of the daily grind of men struggling to make a living by fishing on the Gulf of Mexico (mostly played by real- life fishermen), one worker’s terrible loss instigates a political awakening among him and his fellow laborers. A singular coming together of talents, Redes, commissioned by a progressive Mexican government, was cowritten and gorgeously shot by the legendary photographer Paul Strand.

hook: 毛里塔尼亚导演梅德·洪多 (Med Hondo) 的这部长片处女作是对资本主义和殖民主义遗产的一次苦涩滑稽、令人眼花缭乱的实验性攻击，是反抗种族主义压迫的愤怒呐喊，也是政治电影的革命性里程碑。索雷尔·奥讲述了一位乐观的移民离开西非前往巴黎寻找工作、社区和知识分子的经历，但很快就发现了一个充满敌意的社会，他的存在就引起了恐惧和怨恨。通过这部随心所欲的杰作，洪多描绘了一个唤醒黑人意识的破碎愿景。
hook_en: A furious cry of resistance against racist oppression and a revolutionary landmark of political cinema, this feature debut from Mauritanian director Med Hondo is a bitterly funny, dazzlingly experimental attack on capitalism and the legacy of colonialism. Soleil Ô follows a starry-eyed immigrant as he leaves West Africa and journeys to Paris in search of a job, a community, and intellectual engagement—but soon discovers a hostile society where his very presence engenders fear and resentment. With this freewheeling masterpiece, Hondo crafts a shattering vision of awakening Black consciousness.

hook: 特伦斯·斯坦普饰演威利，一个黑帮的追随者，后来变成了“超级草”（告密者），试图安静地躲藏在一个偏远的西班牙村庄。然而，当两名杀手——一名没有灵魂的（约翰·赫特饰）和一名松散的大炮（年轻的蒂姆·罗斯饰）——前来召唤将威利带回处决时，阳光斑驳的幸福变成了令人神经紧张的悬念。斯蒂芬·弗雷尔斯这部时尚的早期瑰宝拥有英格兰最佳演员名单上精彩的冷酷表演、埃里克·克莱普顿和弗拉门戈吉他手帕科·德·卢西亚的音乐以及荒凉的西班牙地点的迷人摄影——这是一个相当肮脏的故事的辉煌背景。
hook_en: Terence Stamp is Willie, a gangster’s henchman turned “supergrass” (informer) trying to hide out peacefully in a remote Spanish village. Sun-dappled bliss turns to nerve-racking suspense, however, when two hit men—one soulless (John Hurt) and one a loose cannon (a youthful Tim Roth)—come calling to bring Willie back for execution. This stylish early gem from Stephen Frears boasts terrific hard-boiled performances from a roster of England’s best actors, music by Eric Clapton and virtuoso flamenco guitarist Paco de Lucía, and ravishing photography of its desolate Spanish locations—a splendid backdrop for a rather sordid story.

hook: 这部简短而基本的故事以土耳其和叙利亚边境为背景，讲述了走私者与不断变化的社会格局抗争的故事，将土耳其电影的两大巨头聚集在一起。导演吕特菲·奥。当阿卡德已经制作了一些土耳其最著名的电影时，伊尔马兹·古尼（Yılmaz Güney）——一位冉冉升起的动作明星，后来成为土耳其最重要和最有争议的电影制作人——找到他合作拍摄这部新西部片，讲述了一个安静的男人发现自己与其他不法之徒展开斗争的故事。 《边境的法则》将纪录片的真实性与强硬、简洁的诗意相结合，永远地改变了这个国家的电影——尽管多年来几乎看不到它。《边境的法则》由博洛尼亚电影中心/L’Immagine Ritrovata 实验室与电影基金会的世界电影项目、Dadaş Films 和土耳其文化部联合于 2013 年恢复。修复工作由多哈电影学院资助。
hook_en: Set along the Turkish-Syrian frontier, this terse, elemental tale of smugglers contending with a changing social landscape brought together two giants of Turkish cinema. Director Lütfi Ö. Akad had already made some of his country’s most notable films when he was approached by Yılmaz Güney—a rising action star who would become Turkey’s most important and controversial filmmaker—to collaborate on this neo-western about a quiet man who finds himself pitted against his fellow outlaws. Combining documentary authenticity with a tough, lean poetry, Law of the Border transformed the nation’s cinema forever—even though it was virtually impossible to see for many years.Law of the Border was restored in 2013 by the Cineteca di Bologna/L’Immagine Ritrovata laboratory, in association with The Film Foundation’s World Cinema Project, Dadaş Films, and the Turkish Ministry of Culture. Restoration funded by Doha Film Institute.

hook: 这场令人瞠目结舌的冒险故事围绕着一名科学家和他的末日机器，以及不惜一切代价夺取它的海盗展开。卡雷尔·泽曼自由地改编了儒勒·凡尔纳的小说，并受到维多利亚时代线条雕刻的启发，以令人惊叹的错综复杂的动画场景围绕着他的演员，构建了一个难以置信的生动的原始蒸汽朋克世界。 《毁灭性发明》于 20 世纪 60 年代初在国外上映，后来成为捷克斯洛伐克有史以来最成功的国际电影之一。
hook_en: This eye-popping escapade revolves around a scientist and his doomsday machine—and the pirates who will stop at nothing to gain possession of it. Freely adapting the fiction of Jules Verne, and inspired by Victorian line engravings, Karel Zeman surrounds his actors with animated scenery of breathtaking intricacy and complexity, constructing an impossibly vivid proto-steampunk world. Released abroad at the turn of the 1960s, Invention for Destruction went on to become one of the most internationally successful Czechoslovak films of all time.

hook: 恩斯特·刘别谦的这部怪异杰作既紧张又搞笑，由杰克·本尼主演，卡罗尔·隆巴德在她的最后一次银幕亮相中饰演纳粹占领的华沙的一对演员，他们卷入了危险的间谍阴谋。 《生存还是毁灭》是一部最具大胆黑色幽默的好莱坞电影，在美国加入第二次世界大战之前就开始制作。刘别谦成功地将政治讽刺、浪漫、闹剧和战时悬疑巧妙地平衡在了一场前所未有的滑稽高空走钢丝表演中。
hook_en: As nervy as it is hilarious, this screwball masterpiece from Ernst Lubitsch stars Jack Benny and, in her final screen appearance, Carole Lombard as husband-and-wife thespians in Nazi-occupied Warsaw who become caught up in a dangerous spy plot. To Be or Not to Be is a Hollywood film of the boldest black humor, which went into production right before the U.S. entered World War II. Lubitsch manages to brilliantly balance political satire, romance, slapstick, and wartime suspense in a comic high-wire act that has never been equaled.

hook: 彼得·法尔克 (Peter Falk) 和艾伦·阿金 (Alan Arkin) 在这部备受喜爱的美国侧劈片中组成了一支搞笑的梦之队。 《姻亲》由阿瑟·希勒执导，编剧为安德鲁·伯格曼，剧本巧妙，乍一看似乎只是一部普通的家长会喜剧，阿金饰演的温和牙医怀疑地注视着法尔克饰演的反复无常的神秘男子，而他的儿子已与女儿订婚。但很快，通过一系列过于曲折且令人惊讶而无法剧透的事件，这两个人因一项危险的任务而聚集在一起，从新泽西郊区前往洪都拉斯。凭借精心制作的特技动作和两位主演简洁、自然的魅力，《姻亲》当之无愧地成为一部疯狂的经典之作，并且自上映以来不断吸引着狂热的粉丝。
hook_en: Peter Falk and Alan Arkin make for a hilarious dream team in this beloved American sidesplitter. Directed by Arthur Hiller from an ingenious script by Andrew Bergman, The In-Laws may at first seem like a generic meet-the-parents comedy, as Arkin’s mild-mannered dentist suspiciously eyes Falk’s volatile mystery man, whose son is engaged to his daughter. But soon, through a series of events too serpentine and surprising to spoil, the two men are brought together by a dangerous mission that takes them from suburban New Jersey to Honduras. Fueled by elaborate stunt work and the laconic, naturalistic charms of its two stars, The In-Laws deserves its status as a madcap classic—and has continued to draw ardent fans in the years since its release.

hook: 来认识一下大伊迪·比尔和小伊迪·比尔：母女、上流社会的辍学生以及杰基·奥纳西斯隐居的亲戚。两人在纽约东汉普顿的豪宅破败和混乱中共同繁荣，与美国卡米洛特的摇摇欲坠的怪异相呼应。这部 1976 年由艾伯特·梅索斯 (Albert Maysles) 和大卫·梅索斯 (David Maysles) 拍摄、埃伦·霍夫德 (Ellen Hovde) 和穆菲·迈耶 (Muffie Meyer) 共同执导的纪录片，展现了一幅难以置信的亲密肖像，迅速成为一部邪典经典，并确立了小伊迪 (Little Edie) 时尚偶像和哲学家女王的地位。蓝光版收录了 2006 年电影《灰色花园的比尔斯》的续集，由电影制作人金库中数小时的额外镜头构建而成。
hook_en: Meet Big and Little Edie Beale: mother and daughter, high-society dropouts, and reclusive relatives of Jackie Onassis. The two manage to thrive together amid the decay and disorder of their East Hampton, New York, mansion, making for an eerily ramshackle echo of the American Camelot. An impossibly intimate portrait, this 1976 documentary by Albert and David Maysles, codirected by Ellen Hovde and Muffie Meyer, quickly became a cult classic and established Little Edie as a fashion icon and philosopher queen. The Blu-ray edition features the 2006 follow-up to the film, The Beales of Grey Gardens, constructed from hours of extra footage in the filmmakers’ vaults.

hook: 中代达也和三船敏郎主演了一个生活在暴力漩涡中的流浪武士的故事。龙之介（仲代饰）是一位天才剑客，在日本幕府统治的最后一段动荡的日子里发挥着自己的技艺，他毫不悔恨或怜悯地杀人。这是一种最终导致疯狂的生活方式。冈本喜八的经典剑术讲述了一个男人选择将一生奉献给邪恶的惊心动魄的故事。
hook_en: Tatsuya Nakadai and Toshiro Mifune star in the story of a wandering samurai who exists in a maelstrom of violence. A gifted swordsman plying his craft during the turbulent final days of shogunate rule in Japan, Ryunosuke (Nakadai) kills without remorse or mercy. It is a way of life that ultimately leads to madness. Kihachi Okamoto’s swordplay classic is the thrilling tale of a man who chooses to devote his life to evil.

hook: 维姆·文德斯以深度和风格更新了歌德 18 世纪末的小说，将其转移到 1970 年代的西德，为我们讲述了一位漫无目的的作家（吕迪格·沃格勒饰）离开家乡寻找自我并​​最终与一群其他旅行者成为朋友的故事。为了寻求灵感来帮助他摆脱创造性的恐惧，他反而发现了尝试重塑自己身份的局限性。 《错误的举动》是导演最不为人所知但最朴实、最具破坏性的灵魂探索之一，新德国电影的常客汉娜·许古拉 (Hanna Schygulla) 和彼得·科恩 (Peter Kern) 以及娜塔莎·金斯基 (Nastassja Kinski) 的出色配角表演，都是她在电影中的首次亮相。
hook_en: With depth and style, Wim Wenders updates a late-eighteenth-century novel by Goethe, transposing it to 1970s West Germany and giving us the story of an aimless writer (Rüdiger Vogler) who leaves his hometown to find himself and winds up befriending a group of other travelers. Seeking inspiration to help him escape his creative funk, he instead discovers the limits of attempts to refashion one’s identity. One of the director’s least seen but earthiest and most devastating soul searches, Wrong Move features standout supporting performances from New German Cinema regulars Hanna Schygulla and Peter Kern and, in her first film appearance, Nastassja Kinski.

hook: 《盗贼高速公路》生动地描绘了“长途男孩”的危险世界，他们在夜间开车将货物运往美国城市的市场。理查德·康特 (Richard Conte) 饰演前特种兵尼克·加科斯（Nick Garcos）是一名新手卡车司机，他一心想从导致他父亲残废的人——无情的市场经营者迈克·菲格利亚（李·J·科布 Lee J. Cobb 饰）那里得到满足。但当菲利亚明白了他的计划时，尼克发现自己陷入了背叛和心碎的网络中。 Criterion Collection 很荣幸地呈现大师朱尔斯·达辛 (Jules Dassin) 创作的这部灼热的情节剧。
hook_en: Thieves’ Highway vividly depicts the perilous world of “long-haul boys,” who drive by night to bring their goods to the markets of America’s cities. Richard Conte stars as ex-G.I. Nick Garcos, a tyro trucker bent on satisfaction from the man responsible for crippling his father—ruthless market operator Mike Figlia (Lee J. Cobb). But when Figlia gets wise to his plan, Nick finds himself in a web of treachery and heartbreak. The Criterion Collection is proud to present this searing melodrama from master Jules Dassin.

hook: 罗马尼亚电影制片人克里斯蒂安·蒙吉凭借这部荣获金棕榈奖的第二部长片，以严谨的写实手法赢得了国际声誉。 1987 年，尼古拉·齐奥塞斯库 (Nicolae Ceauşescu) 独裁统治期间，大学室友奥蒂莉亚 (Anamaria Marinca) 和加比察 (Laura Vasiliu) 为加比察寻求非法堕胎。影片以坚定而富有同情心的细节讲述了他们生命中二十四个危险小时的事件，最终他们遇到了一个善于操纵、具有威胁性的堕胎者（弗拉德·伊万诺夫饰）。 《4个月、3周和2天》通过强有力的表演凸显了角色人性的缺陷，深刻地讲述了女性在控制自己的身体意味着违法时所面临的不可能的选择。
hook_en: Romanian filmmaker Cristian Mungiu shot to international prominence with this rigorously realistic Palme d’Or–winning second feature. In 1987, during the dictatorship of Nicolae Ceaușescu, college roommates Otilia (Anamaria Marinca) and Găbița (Laura Vasiliu) seek an illegal abortion for Găbița. In unflinching but empathetic detail, the film recounts the events of twenty-four perilous hours in their lives, culminating in their encounter with a manipulative and menacing abortionist (Vlad Ivanov). With powerful performances that accentuate the characters’ flawed humanity, 4 Months, 3 Weeks and 2 Days is a gutting account of the impossible choices women face when taking control of their bodies means breaking the law.

hook: 罗伯特·布列松的《奥·哈萨德·巴尔萨扎》是电影史上最受尊敬的电影制作人之一的深刻杰作，讲述了驴子巴尔萨扎从一个主人传到另一个主人的过程，有些善良，有些残酷，但所有的动机都超出了他的理解。巴尔萨泽的生活与他的第一位守护者玛丽的生活相似，他确实是一头负重的野兽，承受着人类的罪恶。但尽管他无能为力，他还是高尚地接受了自己的命运。通过布列松对构图、声音和叙事的非传统方法，这个简单的故事变成了一个关于纯洁和超越的感人寓言。
hook_en: A profound masterpiece from one of the most revered filmmakers in the history of cinema, Robert Bresson’s Au hasard Balthazar follows the donkey Balthazar as he is passed from owner to owner, some kind and some cruel but all with motivations beyond his understanding. Balthazar, whose life parallels that of his first keeper, Marie, is truly a beast of burden, suffering the sins of humankind. But despite his powerlessness, he accepts his fate nobly. Through Bresson’s unconventional approach to composition, sound, and narrative, this simple story becomes a moving parable about purity and transcendence.

hook: 导演李沧东是一部情感丰富的人类戏剧大师，也是当代韩国电影的杰出人物，这部探讨悲伤和拯救的激动人心且难以预测的作品巩固了他在国际舞台上的地位。 《秘密阳光》（密阳）毫不费力地融合了光明与不妥协的黑暗，由戛纳最佳女主角得主全度妍饰演一位丧偶的钢琴老师，她带着年幼的儿子从首尔搬到已故丈夫的家乡，开始新的生活。安静的表现力、灵活的电影制作和崇高而微妙的表演使这部在悲剧中寻找恩典的非凡写照显得与众不同。
