hook_en: A master of intensely emotional human dramas, director Lee Chang-dong is a luminary of contemporary Korean cinema, and his place on the international stage was cemented by this stirring and unpredictable work examining grief and deliverance. An effortless mix of lightness and uncompromising darkness, Secret Sunshine (Miryang) stars Cannes best actress winner Jeon Do-yeon as a widowed piano teacher who moves with her young son from Seoul to her late husband’s provincial hometown for a fresh start. Quietly expressive, supple filmmaking and sublime, subtle performances distinguish this remarkable portrayal of the search for grace amid tragedy.

hook: 作为 20 世纪 90 年代最具代表性的独立电影之一，阿托姆·伊戈扬 (Atom Egoyan) 的这部令人着迷的国际突破影片将心理惊悚片的传统带入了大胆的新领域——令人不安、如梦似幻、感人至深。在片名中霓虹灯闪烁的多伦多脱衣舞俱乐部里，一群迷失和受损的灵魂——包括一个被悲伤困扰的男人、一个与他有着神秘联系的年轻女子、一个痴迷的主持人和一个走私珍稀鸟蛋的人——在性、痛苦、嫉妒和宣泄的强迫循环中，在他们神秘地相互关联的历史的创伤中寻找救赎。伊戈扬巧妙地将过去和现在编织在一起，构建了一个引人入胜的叙事谜题，直到最后一块拼图到位后，它的全部情感影响才会显现出来。
hook_en: One of the defining independent films of the 1990s, Atom Egoyan’s mesmerizing international breakthrough Exotica takes the conventions of the psychological thriller into bold new territory—unsettling, dreamlike, and empathetic. At the neon-drenched Toronto strip club of the film’s title, a coterie of lost and damaged souls—including a man haunted by grief, a young woman with whom he shares an enigmatic bond, an obsessive emcee, and a smuggler of rare bird eggs—search for redemption as they work through the traumas of their mysteriously interconnected histories in an obsessive cycle of sex, pain, jealousy, and catharsis. Masterfully weaving together past and present, Egoyan constructs a spellbinding narrative puzzle, the full emotional impact of which doesn’t hit until the last piece is in place.

hook: 在这部黑色喜剧杰作中，导演彼得罗·杰米对意大利家庭结构、天主教虔诚和大男子主义进行了恶魔般的颠覆性讽刺。马塞洛·马斯楚安尼 (Marcello Mastroianni) 展现了自己温文尔雅的形象，饰演西西里一个没落贵族家庭的中年后裔，他惦记着自己的表弟（斯特凡妮娅·桑德雷利 (Stefania Sandrelli) 饰）。问题是：他已经结婚了，而且在一个离婚是非法的国家。致命的幻想驱使他走上一条日益疯狂的自我欺骗和自我毁灭的道路。杰米用每一个大胆的转折都揭露了资产阶级道德的荒谬矛盾，尖锐地描绘了受传统束缚的文化与不可阻挡的现代性力量的碰撞。
hook_en: In this black-comic masterpiece, director Pietro Germi delivers a diabolically subversive satire of the Italian family structure, Catholic piety, and male chauvinism. Sending up his own suave image, Marcello Mastroianni stars as the middle-aged scion of a faded aristocratic Sicilian family who pines after his younger cousin (Stefania Sandrelli). The problem: he’s married, in a country where divorce is illegal. Cue the murderous fantasies that drive him down an increasingly deranged path of self-delusion and self-destruction. Laying bare the absurd contradictions of bourgeois morality with each audacious twist, Germi serves up an acerbic portrait of a tradition-bound culture colliding with the unstoppable force of modernity.

hook: 马丁·斯科塞斯 (Martin Scorsese) 凭借这部 1970 年代纽约市的真实写照，成为了一代人的电影制片人，也是美国独立电影最有影响力的作品之一。 《穷街陋巷》以斯科塞斯年轻时的偏僻小意大利社区为背景，讲述了深感愧疚的小混混头目查理（哈威·凯特尔饰）处理他危险且反复无常的好朋友约翰尼·博伊（罗伯特·德尼罗饰）欠下的债务，以及来自任性女友特蕾莎（艾米·罗宾逊饰）的压力。当他们交织在一起的生活失去控制时，斯科塞斯展示了他对电影风格的早熟掌握——从他推进的剪辑节奏到精心策划的配乐，一切都显而易见——创造了一个关于罪恶和救赎的激动人心的愿景。
hook_en: Martin Scorsese emerged as a generation-defining filmmaker with this gritty portrait of 1970s New York City, one of the most influential works of American independent cinema. Set in the insular Little Italy neighborhood of Scorsese’s youth, Mean Streets follows guilt-ridden small-time ringleader Charlie (Harvey Keitel) as he deals with the debts owed by his dangerously volatile best pal, Johnny Boy (Robert De Niro), and pressure from his headstrong girlfriend, Teresa (Amy Robinson). As their intertwined lives spiral out of control, Scorsese showcases his precocious mastery of film style—evident in everything from his propulsive editing rhythms to the lovingly curated soundtrack—to create an electrifying vision of sin and redemption.

hook: 奥斯卡·王尔德的喜剧宝石在安东尼·阿斯奎斯改编的电影《认真的重要性》中闪闪发光。迈克尔·雷德格瑞夫、琼·格林伍德和伊迪丝·埃文斯夫人的精彩表演为主角，讲述了两个年轻女子以为自己与同一个不存在的男人订婚的故事，故事经过了华丽的彩色处理。很少有经典的舞台喜剧能如此引人入胜地搬上银幕。
hook_en: Oscar Wilde’s comic jewel sparkles in Anthony Asquith’s film adaptation of The Importance of Being Earnest. Featuring brilliantly polished performances by Michael Redgrave, Joan Greenwood, and Dame Edith Evans, the enduringly hilarious story of two young women who think themselves engaged to the same nonexistent man is given the grand Technicolor treatment. Seldom has a classic stage comedy been so engagingly transferred to the screen.

hook: 在这部令人难以抗拒的音乐剧中，传奇舞蹈二人组弗雷德·阿斯泰尔和金杰·罗杰斯在他们的艺术巅峰中扮演了一个不负责任的赌徒和精明的舞蹈教练，他在其中完全不敌对手。导演乔治·史蒂文斯 (George Stevens) 将他们的浪漫与幽默融为一体，并为电影中令人惊叹的舞蹈场景做好了准备，阿斯泰尔和罗杰斯在舞厅和踢踏风格的精湛融合中看似毫不费力地飞翔。在多萝西·菲尔兹 (Dorothy Fields) 和杰罗姆·科恩 (Jerome Kern) 广受喜爱的歌曲（包括奥斯卡获奖经典《The Way You Look Tonight》）的鼓舞下，《摇摆时光》是对明星们在表演中的化学反应、优雅和纯粹快乐的热烈庆祝。
hook_en: In this irresistible musical, the legendary dancing duo Fred Astaire and Ginger Rogers are at the pinnacle of their art as a feckless gambler and the shrewd dancing instructor in whom he more than meets his match. Director George Stevens laces their romance with humor and clears the floor for the movie’s showstopping dance scenes, in which Astaire and Rogers take seemingly effortless flight in a virtuosic fusion of ballroom and tap styles. Buoyed by beloved songs by Dorothy Fields and Jerome Kern—including the Oscar-winning classic “The Way You Look Tonight”—Swing Time is an exuberant celebration of its stars’ chemistry, grace, and sheer joy in the act of performance.

hook: 通过这部浪漫喜剧的试金石，上流社会的老练大师恩斯特·刘别谦将他著名的优雅风格运用到了一个新的主题：布达佩斯一家简陋的皮具店员工们每天的希望、恐惧和心碎为他们的生活注入了活力。随着圣诞节的临近，争吵不断的同事阿尔弗雷德·克拉里克（詹姆斯·斯图尔特饰）和克拉拉·诺瓦克（玛格丽特·苏利文饰）彼此之间的关系越来越恼火，却没有意识到他们一直在以笔友的身份交换匿名情书。 《街角的商店》拥有令人难以抗拒的演员阵容，以辛酸而温暖的方式审视浪漫的期望与现实之间的差异。
hook_en: With this touchstone of romantic comedy, master of high-society sophistication Ernst Lubitsch applied his famously elegant style to a new subject: the everyday hopes, fears, and heartbreaks animating the lives of the employees at a humble leather-goods shop in Budapest. As Christmas approaches, battling coworkers Alfred Kralik (James Stewart) and Klara Novak (Margaret Sullavan) grow increasingly exasperated with each other—unaware that, all the while, they have been exchanging anonymous love letters as pen pals. Graced with an irresistible ensemble cast, The Shop Around the Corner is a poignant, warmhearted look at the difference between romantic expectation and reality.

hook: 《Poverty Row》中的一部电影也许比任何其他电影都更能体现黑色电影核心的黑暗宿命论。一位运气不佳的夜总会钢琴家（汤姆·尼尔饰）从纽约搭便车前往洛杉矶，发现自己手上躺着一具尸体，无处可逃——当他遇到电影史上最恶毒的蛇蝎美人——安·萨维奇饰演的咆哮、诡计多端的流浪者维拉时，一场清醒的噩梦变得越来越糟。导演埃德加·G·乌尔默 (Edgar G. Ulmer) 以低廉的预算与无名明星合作，将陈旧的制作价值和肮脏、廉价的氛围变成了不可磨灭的通俗诗歌。长期以来，《绕道》一直无法以一种可以充分欣赏其冷酷之美的形式出现，但它在第一次重大修复中再次出现。
hook_en: From Poverty Row came a movie that, perhaps more than any other, epitomizes the dark fatalism at the heart of film noir. As he hitchhikes his way from New York to Los Angeles, a down-on-his-luck nightclub pianist (Tom Neal) finds himself with a dead body on his hands and nowhere to run—a waking nightmare that goes from bad to worse when he picks up the most vicious femme fatale in cinema history, Ann Savage’s snarling, monstrously conniving drifter Vera. Working with no-name stars on a bargain-basement budget, B auteur Edgar G. Ulmer turned threadbare production values and seedy, low-rent atmosphere into indelible pulp poetry. Long unavailable in a format in which its hard-boiled beauty could be fully appreciated, Detour haunts anew in its first major restoration.

hook: 满月，纽约之夜，空气中弥漫着爱与音乐。 。 。有史以来最迷人的浪漫喜剧之一，集结了完美的演员阵容，以温柔而热闹的搞笑方式讲述了布鲁克林一个多代意大利裔美国家庭在人生每个阶段与爱情和婚姻的复杂性的斗争。这一切的中心人物是光芒四射的雪儿（饰演洛雷塔），洛雷塔是一位爱情不幸的簿记员，在遇到他热血的弟弟罗尼（尼古拉斯·凯奇饰）后，她对自己与古板的约翰尼（丹尼·艾罗饰）订婚的感觉受到了质疑，而在歌剧院的一个晚上改变了一切。这部现代童话故事荣获奥斯卡金像奖最佳女主角（雪儿）、最佳女配角（奥林匹亚·杜卡基斯）和原创剧本（剧作家约翰·帕特里克·尚利）奖，在充满激情的普契尼旋律中流传，由故事大师诺曼·杰维森执导，情感高度契合。
hook_en: A full moon, a New York City night, and love and music in the air . . . One of the most enchanting romantic comedies of all time assembles a flawless ensemble cast for a tender and boisterously funny look at a multigenerational Italian American family in Brooklyn, wrestling with the complexities of love and marriage at every stage of life. At the center of it all is a radiant Cher as Loretta, an unlucky-in-love bookkeeper whose feelings about her engagement to the staid Johnny (Danny Aiello) are thrown into question after she meets his hot-blooded brother, Ronny (Nicolas Cage), and one night at the opera changes everything. Winner of the Academy Awards for best actress (Cher), supporting actress (Olympia Dukakis), and original screenplay (by playwright John Patrick Shanley), this modern-day fairy tale is swept along on passionate Puccini melodies, and directed by master storyteller Norman Jewison with the heightened emotion to match.

hook: 在一个肮脏的南美石油小镇，四名绝望的男子签署了一项自杀任务，在一条险恶的山路上驾驶装满硝酸甘油的卡车。当他们将爆炸物运送到遥远的石油大火中时，每次碰撞和颠簸都会考验他们的勇气、友谊和神经。其结果是有史以来最伟大的惊悚片之一，来自法国传奇悬疑大师亨利-乔治…
hook_en: In a squalid South American oil town, four desperate men sign on for a suicide mission to drive trucks loaded with nitroglycerin over a treacherous mountain route. As they ferry their explosive cargo to a faraway oil fire, each bump and jolt tests their courage, their friendship, and their nerves. The result is one of the greatest thrillers ever committed to celluloid, a white-knuckle ride from France’s legendary master of suspense Henri-Georges Clouzot.

hook: 1969年7月，阿波罗11号完成了约翰·肯尼迪总统提出的“将人类送上月球并安全返回地球”的挑战，太空竞赛就此结束。“见证过登月的人都不会忘记。二十年后，阿尔·雷纳特（ Al Reinert ）制作了一部纪录片，讲述了24名宇航员作为美国宇航局阿波罗计划的一部分前往月球的难忘故事--用他们的话语和声音讲述，…
hook_en: In July 1969, the space race ended when Apollo 11 fulfilled President John F. Kennedy’s challenge of “landing a man on the moon and returning him safely to the earth.” No one who witnessed the lunar landing will ever forget it. Twenty years later, Al Reinert constructed a documentary that imparts the unforgettable story of the twenty-four astronauts who traveled to the moon as part of NASA’s Apollo program—told in their words and in their voices, using the images they captured. With its awe-inspiring, otherworldly footage and a haunting atmospheric soundtrack by Brian Eno, For All Mankind stirs us with a profound sense of compassion for the “pale blue dot” that is our home, and it remains the most radical, visually dazzling work of cinema that has been made about this earthshaking event.

hook: “裸体之城有八百万个故事”，正如旁白在这部生动得令人惊叹的电影结尾处不朽的说法一样——这就是其中之一。黑色电影大师朱尔斯·达辛 (Jules Dassin) 和新闻记者兼制片人马克·海灵格 (Mark Hellinger) 制作的令人眼花缭乱的警匪片《裸体城市》在纽约外景拍摄。受到意大利新现实主义和美国犯罪小说的影响，这位双料奥斯卡奖获得者仍然是黑色电影自然主义的标杆，生活和呼吸着纽约的承诺和危险，从最底层到最高的摩天大楼。
hook_en: “There are eight million stories in the Naked City,” as the narrator immortally states at the close of this breathtakingly vivid film—and this is one of them. Master noir craftsman Jules Dassin and newspaperman-cum-producer Mark Hellinger’s dazzling police procedural, The Naked City, was shot on location in New York. As influenced by Italian neorealism as by American crime fiction, this double Academy Award winner remains a benchmark for naturalism in noir, living and breathing in the promises and perils of the Big Apple, from its lowest depths to its highest skyscrapers.

hook: 《晚春》是小津安二郎最有力的全家福之一，讲述了一位丧偶父亲被迫将心爱的独生女嫁出去的故事。著名的小津演员龙智舟和原节子演绎了这个关于战后日本的爱与失落的凄美故事，至今仍然具有影响力，也是该片制作者跻身电影最伟大导演万神殿的有力理由。
hook_en: One of the most powerful of Yasujiro Ozu’s family portraits, Late Spring (Banshun) tells the story of a widowed father who feels compelled to marry off his beloved only daughter. Eminent Ozu players Chishu Ryu and Setsuko Hara command this poignant tale of love and loss in postwar Japan, which remains as potent today as ever—and a strong justification for its maker’s inclusion in the pantheon of cinema’s greatest directors.

hook: 当一位理想主义的总督违背封建领主的命令时，他就会被流放，他的妻子和孩子只能自生自灭，最终被邪恶的奴隶贩子肢解。在沟口健二令人眼花缭乱的导演下，这个经典的日本故事成为电影界最伟大的杰作之一，以不朽的、富有同情心的方式表达了人类面对邪恶时的坚韧不拔的精神。
hook_en: When an idealistic governor disobeys the reigning feudal lord, he is cast into exile, his wife and children left to fend for themselves and eventually wrenched apart by vicious slave traders. Under Kenji Mizoguchi’s dazzling direction, this classic Japanese story became one of cinema’s greatest masterpieces, a monumental, empathetic expression of human resilience in the face of evil.

hook: 这部充满科幻色彩的险恶快报揭露了破碎的 20 世纪 60 年代的洛克·赫德森 (Rock Hudson)。 《秒》由约翰·弗兰肯海默执导，讲述了一位中年银行家对郊区生活不满意的故事，他选择接受一项奇怪而复杂的手术，以赋予他新的生活。然而，在美国重新开始并不像听起来那么容易。这部由倾斜的摄像机角度（由著名电影摄影师詹姆斯·黄豪提供）、支离破碎的剪辑和分层的声音设计组成的偏执交响曲是一部极具冒险精神的好莱坞电影，在其传奇导演的成就清单中名列前茅。
hook_en: Rock Hudson is a revelation in this sinister, science-fiction-inflected dispatch from the fractured 1960s. Seconds, directed by John Frankenheimer, concerns a middle-aged banker who, dissatisfied with his suburban existence, elects to undergo a strange and elaborate procedure that will grant him a new life. Starting over in America, however, is not as easy as it sounds. This paranoiac symphony of canted camera angles (courtesy of famed cinematographer James Wong Howe), fragmented editing, and layered sound design is a remarkably risk-taking Hollywood film that ranks high on the list of its legendary director’s achievements.

hook: 乔治·史蒂文斯的《年度女性》以凯瑟琳·赫本在《费城故事》中的出色回归为基础，​​标志着赫本和斯宾塞·屈塞之间个人和职业联盟的开始，他们随后又一起制作了八部电影。这个故事讲述了两名报纸记者结婚后发现他们的职业不太相容的故事，这为婚姻带来了新鲜而现实的愿景。小林·拉德纳 (Ring Lardner Jr.) 和迈克尔·卡宁 (Michael Kanin) 创作的随心所欲但精准犀利的剧本获得了奥斯卡金像奖，赫本也因其表演获得了提名。 《年度女性》对男性和女性如何在工作场所和工作场所之外相处融洽进行了令人眼花缭乱、有趣而又令人遗憾的观察。
hook_en: George Stevens’s Woman of the Year, conceived to build on the smashing comeback Katharine Hepburn had made in The Philadelphia Story, marked the beginning of the personal and professional union between Hepburn and Spencer Tracy, who would go on to make eight more films together. This tale of two newspaper reporters who wed and then discover that their careers aren’t so compatible forges a fresh and realistic vision of what marriage can be. The freewheeling but pinpoint-sharp screenplay by Ring Lardner Jr. and Michael Kanin won an Academy Award, and Hepburn received a nomination for her performance. Woman of the Year is a dazzling, funny, and rueful observation of what it takes for men and women to get along—both in the workplace and outside of it.

hook: 在这部由资深演员兼导演比尔·杜克 (Bill Duke) 执导的时尚且颠覆性的黑社会冒险之旅中，黑色电影席卷了 90 年代洛杉矶的穷街陋巷。劳伦斯·菲什伯恩 (Laurence Fishburne) 饰演拉塞尔·史蒂文斯 (Russell Stevens)，一名警官，他以“约翰·赫尔”(John Hull) 的身份卧底，是一位野心勃勃的可卡因贩子（杰夫·高布伦饰）的合伙人，目的是渗透并捣毁一个在洛杉矶运作的强大拉丁美洲贩毒团伙。但史蒂文斯越深入这个充满金钱、暴力和权力的无情世界，他的幻想就越幻灭，也就越难区分对与错、犯罪与正义之间的界限。沉浸在阴暗、霓虹灯笼罩的氛围中，以 Dr. Dre 的首张个人单曲为特色，《Deep Cover》是九十年代黑人电影爆炸中的一颗无名宝石，它提供了引人入胜的人物研究和流畅的动作惊险，同时对美国和毒品战争的毁灭性失败进行了猛烈的道德控诉。
hook_en: Film noir hits the mean streets of 1990s Los Angeles in this stylish and subversive underworld odyssey from veteran actor-director Bill Duke. Laurence Fishburne stars as Russell Stevens, a police officer who goes undercover as “John Hull,” the partner of a dangerously ambitious cocaine trafficker (Jeff Goldblum), in order to infiltrate and bring down a powerful Latin American drug ring operating in LA. But the further Stevens descends into this ruthless world of money, violence, and power, the more disillusioned he becomes—and the harder it is to make out the line between right and wrong, crime and justice. Steeped in shadowy, neon-soaked atmosphere and featuring Dr. Dre’s debut solo single, Deep Cover is an unsung gem of the nineties’ Black cinema explosion that delivers a riveting character study and sleek action thrills alongside a furious moral indictment of America and the devastating failures of the war on drugs.

hook: 让·皮埃尔·梅尔维尔 (Jean-Pierre Melville) 的《杜洛斯》(Le doulos) 中阴暗的黑社会里的暗箭伤人的罪犯只有一个指导原则：“要么撒谎，要么死”。面无表情的让-保罗·贝尔蒙多 (Jean-Paul Belmondo) 饰演神秘黑帮西连 (Silien)，他可能对福格尔 (Serge Reggiani 饰) 尖叫负有责任，也可能不负有责任。福格尔刚刚从监狱中获释，已经参与了一场本应是简单的抢劫。在这个残酷、扭曲、多层次的政策结束时，谁还能信任呢？ 《Le doulos》（俚语“线人”）以梅尔维尔标志性的酷炫风格拍摄和剪辑，对话和表演风格巧妙，是这位电影制片人最扣人心弦的犯罪剧情片之一。
hook_en: The backstabbing criminals in the shadowy underworld of Jean-Pierre Melville's Le doulos have only one guiding principle: “Lie or die.” A stone-faced Jean-Paul Belmondo stars as enigmatic gangster Silien, who may or may not be responsible for squealing on Faugel (Serge Reggiani), just released from the slammer and already involved in what should have been a simple heist. By the end of this brutal, twisting, and multilayered policier, who will be left to trust? Shot and edited with Melville’s trademark cool and featuring masterfully stylized dialogue and performances, Le doulos (slang for "informant") is one of the filmmaker’s most gripping crime dramas.

hook: 编剧兼导演弗朗索瓦·吉拉德对打破传统的世界著名钢琴家格伦·古尔德进行了富有远见的描绘，这是一部罕见的传记电影，其大胆的非传统性和其主题一样，打破了形式的惯例，阐明了一位非凡艺术家的才华横溢的思想和内心深处的痴迷。 《关于格伦·古尔德的三十二部短片》通过三十二个小插曲，涵盖了从戏剧草图到纪录片采访再到前卫动画的所有内容，拼凑了古尔德从神童到著名音乐会钢琴家的故事，他放弃了公开表演，追求对录音技术的痴迷。在科姆·费奥雷的精彩表演的引领下，在古尔德里程碑式的巴赫《哥德堡变奏曲》录音的衬托下，吉拉德的电影大胆地解构了天才的谜团。
hook_en: A rare film biography as boldly unconventional as its subject, writer-director François Girard’s visionary portrait of iconoclastic, world-renowned pianist Glenn Gould explodes the conventions of the form to illuminate the brilliant mind and innermost obsessions of a singular artist. Across thirty-two vignettes encompassing everything from dramatic sketches to documentary interviews to avant-garde animation, Thirty Two Short Films About Glenn Gould pieces together the story of Gould’s trajectory from child prodigy to celebrated concert pianist who turned his back on public performance to pursue his all-consuming fascination with recording technology. Led by a tour-de-force performance by Colm Feore and underscored by Gould’s landmark recordings of Bach’s Goldberg Variations, Girard’s film daringly deconstructs the enigma of genius.

hook: 当五个陌生人在周六被拘留时会发生什么？坏脾气的姿态、兴高采烈的不当行为和强烈的焦虑。通过这部充满活力、坦诚得令人心旷神怡的电影，编剧兼导演约翰·休斯确立了自己作为美国青年吟游诗人的形象，生动而富有同情心地捕捉了青少年如何闲逛、表演和偷懒的方式。 《早餐俱乐部》汇集了各种各样的青少年典型人物——紧张的受欢迎女孩（莫莉·林沃德饰）、坚忍的运动员（埃米利奥·艾斯特维兹饰）、满嘴脏话的叛逆者（贾德·尼尔森饰）、处女书呆子（安东尼·迈克尔·霍尔饰）和古怪的隐士（艾莉·希迪饰）——看着他们摆脱自己的角色，结识了意想不到的友谊。凭借其广受引用的对话和明星表演，这种对青春期考验的探索成为一种定义时代的流行文化现象，其影响力现已跨越几代人。
hook_en: What happens when five strangers end up together in Saturday detention? Badass posturing, gleeful misbehavior, and a potent dose of angst. With this exuberant, disarmingly candid film, writer-director John Hughes established himself as the bard of American youth, vividly and empathetically capturing how teenagers hang out, act up, and goof off. The Breakfast Club brings together an assortment of adolescent archetypes—the uptight popular girl (Molly Ringwald), the stoic jock (Emilio Estevez), the foulmouthed rebel (Judd Nelson), the virginal bookworm (Anthony Michael Hall), and the kooky recluse (Ally Sheedy)—and watches them shed their personae and emerge into unlikely friendships. With its highly quotable dialogue and star-making performances, this exploration of the trials of adolescence became an era-defining pop-culture phenomenon, one whose influence now spans generations.

hook: 小镇警察局长（比尔·帕克斯顿饰）隐藏着一个爆炸性的秘密。一对冷酷无情的毒贩（比利·鲍勃·松顿和迈克尔·比奇饰）从洛杉矶前往阿肯色州，留下了血迹。一个神秘的女人（辛达·威廉姆斯饰）夹在中间。由于卡尔·富兰克林细致入微的指导，这些绝望的生活的交汇方式成为缓慢燃烧的紧张气氛中的大师级作品，他令人难忘的电影沿着一条弯曲的道路穿越了美国最令人担忧的地区——城市和乡村，黑人和白人——同时为黑色传统注入了令人痛苦的情感深度。
hook_en: A small-town police chief (Bill Paxton) concealing an explosive secret. A pair of ruthless drug dealers (cowriter Billy Bob Thornton and Michael Beach) who leave a bloody trail in their wake as they make their way from Los Angeles to Arkansas. And an enigmatic woman (Cynda Williams) caught in the middle. The way these desperate lives converge becomes a masterclass in slow-burn tension thanks to the nuanced direction of Carl Franklin, whose haunting film travels a crooked road across America’s most fraught divisions—urban and rural, Black and white—while imbuing noir conventions with a wrenching emotional depth.

hook: 《失落》是米开朗基罗·安东尼奥尼关于当代不适的非正式三部曲（继《奇遇》和《夜》之后）的最后一章，讲述了一位年轻女子（莫妮卡·维蒂饰）离开一个情人（弗朗西斯科·拉巴尔饰）并与另一个情人（阿兰·德龙饰）陷入一段关系的故事。安东尼奥尼以罗马建筑作为注定失败的事件的背景，通过回归他最关注的主题：在疏远的现代世界中建立联系的困难，实现了他的风格的顶峰。
hook_en: The concluding chapter of Michelangelo Antonioni’s informal trilogy on contemporary malaise (following L’avventura and La notte), L’eclisse tells the story of a young woman (Monica Vitti) who leaves one lover (Francisco Rabal) and drifts into a relationship with another (Alain Delon). Using the architecture of Rome as a backdrop for the doomed affair, Antonioni achieves the apotheosis of his style in this return to the theme that preoccupied him the most: the difficulty of connection in an alienating modern world.

hook: 弗兰克·卡普拉 (Frank Capra) 改编了一部热门舞台剧，演绎了这场疯狂与恐怖的奇妙邂逅。万圣节那天，新婚的戏剧评论家莫蒂默·布鲁斯特（加里·格兰特，在一场热闹而忙碌的表演中放松下来）回到布鲁克林的家，在那里，他那可爱的、脾气暴躁的阿姨（约瑟芬·赫尔和吉恩·阿代尔，都在百老汇作品中出演）用爱和甜蜜迎接他。 。 。还有一个可怕的惊喜：尸体埋在他们的地窖里。一个自以为是泰迪·罗斯福的吹号兄弟（约翰·亚历山大饰）、一个与鲍里斯·卡洛夫（雷蒙德·马西饰）一模一样的疯狂罪犯，以及一个狡猾的整形外科医生（彼得·洛尔饰），都是阿森尼克和老花边中的怪人，随着死亡人数的增加，这种恶魔般的快乐只会变得更加有趣。
hook_en: Frank Capra adapted a hit stage play for this marvelous screwball meeting of the madcap and the macabre. On Halloween, newly married drama critic Mortimer Brewster (Cary Grant, cutting loose in a hilariously harried performance) returns home to Brooklyn, where his adorably dotty aunts (Josephine Hull and Jean Adair, who both starred in the Broadway production) greet him with love, sweetness . . . and a grisly surprise: the corpses buried in their cellar. A bugle-playing brother (John Alexander) who thinks he’s Teddy Roosevelt, a crazed criminal who’s a dead ringer for Boris Karloff (Raymond Massey), and a seriously slippery plastic surgeon (Peter Lorre) are among the outré oddballs populating Arsenic and Old Lace, a diabolical delight that only gets funnier as the body count rises.

hook: 这本独特的《遗嘱》以令人难以忘怀的亲密方式讲述了一个经常引起轰动的主题，描绘了核灾难后一个家庭的日常生活。在加利福尼亚小镇附近发生原子弹袭击后，卡罗尔·韦瑟利（简·亚历山大饰演，她无所畏惧地脆弱，获得奥斯卡提名）必须找到力量来照顾她的三个孩子，因为全家人都在与辐射病作斗争，并意识到他们紧密团结的社区将永远不再一样。导演林恩·利特曼以日记形式关注难以想象的事件造成的情感损失，对继续生活在破碎的世界意味着什么提出了令人痛苦的人道愿景。
hook_en: Taking a hauntingly intimate approach to an often sensationalized subject, the singular Testament depicts one family’s daily life in the wake of nuclear devastation. After an atomic attack near her small California town, Carol Wetherly (Jane Alexander, in a fearlessly vulnerable, Oscar-nominated performance) must find the strength to care for her three children as the family contend with radiation sickness and the realization that their close-knit community will never be the same. With a diaristic focus on the emotional toll of unimaginable events, director Lynne Littman puts forth a wrenchingly humane vision of what it means to go on living in a shattered world.

hook: John Lurie对钓鱼一无所知，但这并不妨碍他与John一起进行一生的钓鱼冒险。约翰·卢里（ John Lurie ）与特邀嘉宾一起前往地球上最具异国情调和危险的地方，与吉姆·贾穆什（ Jim Jarmusch ）在长岛顶端与鲨鱼作战，与威廉·达福（ Willem Dafoe ）一起在缅因州最北端进行冰上钓鱼，与马特·狄龙（ Matt Dillon ）一起勇敢前往哥斯达黎加丛林，将汤姆·韦茨（ Tom Waits ）带到牙…
hook_en: John Lurie knows absolutely nothing about fishing, but that doesn’t stop him from undertaking the adventure of a lifetime in Fishing with John. Traveling with his special guests to the most exotic and dangerous places on earth, John Lurie battles sharks with Jim Jarmusch off the tip of Long Island, goes ice fishing with Willem Dafoe at Maine’s northernmost point, braves the Costa Rican jungle with Matt Dillon, takes Tom Waits to Jamaica, and searches for the elusive giant squid with Dennis Hopper in Thailand.

hook: 在革命后伊朗电影的一部决定性作品中，童年呈现出神话般的维度。 《奔跑者》的灵感源自导演阿米尔·纳德里自己的童年经历，马吉德·尼鲁曼德饰演一名在港口城市的街道上自力更生的年轻孤儿，决心超越自己的处境——打零工、与朋友消磨时间、学习阅读——并奔跑，永远奔跑，奔向未来。水、火、运动中的人体：在抒情力量的催眠图像中，纳德里在一个悬浮在现代性和基本自然力量之间的男孩的世界中发现了意想不到的荣耀，因为他追逐着自己的前进道路。
hook_en: Childhood takes on mythic dimensions in one of the defining works of postrevolutionary Iranian cinema. Inspired by director Amir Naderi’s own boyhood, The Runner is lit from within by Madjid Niroumand’s electrifying performance as a young orphan fending for himself on the streets of a port city, determined to rise above his circumstances—working odd jobs, passing time with friends, learning to read—and running, always running, toward the future. Water, fire, the human body in motion: in hypnotic images of lyrical power, Naderi finds unexpected glory in the world of a boy suspended between modernity and elemental natural forces as he chases his own path forward.

hook: 导演迈克·李 (Mike Leigh) 执导的精彩且颇具争议的《赤身裸体》由大卫·休里斯 (David Thewlis) 饰演约翰尼 (Johnny)，他是一位迷人、能言善辩，但恶毒无情的流浪者。火山约翰尼拒绝任何可能关心他的人，他在伦敦周围进行了一场夜间冒险，与一连串其他绝望和无依无靠的人相撞，并烧焦了他路上的每个人。凭借精湛的剧本和休里斯以及联合主演凯特琳·卡特里奇和莱斯利·夏普的原始表演，李对英格兰软肋的描绘是黑色喜剧和末日预言的混合体，并在 1993 年戛纳电影节上获得了最佳导演和最佳男演员奖。
hook_en: The brilliant and controversial Naked, from director Mike Leigh, stars David Thewlis as Johnny, a charming and eloquent but relentlessly vicious drifter. Rejecting anyone who might care for him, the volcanic Johnny hurls himself around London on a nocturnal odyssey, colliding with a succession of other desperate and dispossessed people and scorching everyone in his path. With a virtuoso script and raw performances from Thewlis and costars Katrin Cartlidge and Lesley Sharp, Leigh’s depiction of England’s underbelly is an amalgam of black comedy and doomsday prophecy that took the best director and best actor prizes at the 1993 Cannes Film Festival.

hook: 弗里茨·朗改编自格雷厄姆·格林的小说，充满了恐惧和偏执，陷入了一个因战争而颠倒的世界的怪异阴影中。从精神病院出院后，斯蒂芬·尼尔（雷·米兰德饰）在前往伦敦的途中，在一个看似无辜的乡村集市停留，之后他发现自己陷入了一个可能与纳粹有联系的险恶黑社会的网络中。朗是二战期间在好莱坞工作的最杰出的欧洲移民电影制片人之一，《恐惧部》是他最优秀的美国作品之一，是一部不可预测的惊悚片，风格不失时尚。
hook_en: Suffused with dread and paranoia, this Fritz Lang adaptation of a novel by Graham Greene is a plunge into the eerie shadows of a world turned upside down by war. En route to London after being released from a mental institution, Stephen Neale (Ray Milland) stops at a seemingly innocent village fair, after which he finds himself caught in the web of a sinister underworld with possible Nazi connections. Lang was among the most illustrious of the European émigré filmmakers working in Hollywood during World War II, and Ministry of Fear is one of his finest American productions, an unpredictable thriller with style to spare.

hook: 多产的德国电影制片人雷纳·维尔纳·法斯宾德 (Rainer Werner Fassbinder) 更新了他的电影英雄道格拉斯·瑟克 (Douglas Sirk) 1955 年的《天堂所允许的一切》(All That Heaven Allows)，以此向他致敬。暴雨期间，一位孤独的寡妇（布丽吉特·米拉饰）在酒吧里遇见了一位年轻得多的阿拉伯工人（艾尔·赫迪·本·塞勒姆饰）。他们坠入爱河，令他们自己感到惊讶，也让他们的家人、同事和酒友彻底震惊。在《阿里：恐惧吞噬灵魂》中，法斯宾德熟练地运用了经典好莱坞情节剧的情感力量，揭露了当代德国文化背后的种族紧张局势。
hook_en: The wildly prolific German filmmaker Rainer Werner Fassbinder paid homage to his cinematic hero Douglas Sirk with this update of that filmmaker’s 1955 All That Heaven Allows. A lonely widow (Brigitte Mira) meets a much younger Arab worker (El Hedi ben Salem) in a bar during a rainstorm. They fall in love, to their own surprise—and to the outright shock of their families, colleagues, and drinking buddies. In Ali: Fear Eats the Soul, Fassbinder expertly wields the emotional power of classic Hollywood melodrama to expose the racial tensions underlying contemporary German culture.

hook: 《堕落的偶像》是导演卡罗尔·里德和作家格雷厄姆·格林传奇性会面的三部杰作中的第一部，他们还共同创作了《第三个人》和《我们的人在哈瓦那》。这个故事优雅地平衡了悬念和闹剧，讲述了一个男孩和他心爱的管家之间令人担忧的关系，他怀疑自己被谋杀了，这是一部令人愉快的恐怖惊悚片，在视觉和语言上都令人眼花缭乱。
hook_en: The Fallen Idol was the first of three masterpieces to result from the legendary meeting of director Carol Reed and writer Graham Greene, who together would also create The Third Man and Our Man in Havana. Elegantly balancing suspense and farce, this tale of the fraught relationship between a boy and the beloved butler he suspects of murder is a delightfully macabre thriller of the first order and a visually and verbally dazzling knockout.

hook: 《49 度平行线》既是一部引人入胜的反孤立主义宣传片，又是一部机智的战时惊悚片，是迈克尔·鲍威尔 (Michael Powell) 和埃默里克·普雷斯伯格 (Emeric Pressburger) 等英国电影制作团队的经典早期作品。第二次世界大战最激烈的时期，以冷酷无情的埃里克·波特曼为首的纳粹潜艇船员被困在加拿大，他们为了逃避追捕，躲藏在一系列农村社区中，然后试图越过边境进入仍然中立的美国。 《49 度平行线》既扣人心弦，又充满娱乐性，由传奇演员劳伦斯·奥利维尔、雷蒙德·马西、安东·沃尔布鲁克和莱斯利·霍华德扮演的角色丰富多彩。
hook_en: At once a compelling piece of anti-isolationist propaganda and a quick-witted wartime thriller, 49th Parallel is a classic early work from the inimitable British filmmaking team of Michael Powell and Emeric Pressburger. When a Nazi U-boat crew, headed by the ruthless Eric Portman, is stranded in Canada during the thick of World War II, the men evade capture by hiding out in a series of rural communities, before trying to cross the border into the still-neutral United States. Both soul-stirring and delightfully entertaining, 49th Parallel features a colorful cast of characters played by larger-than-life actors Laurence Olivier, Raymond Massey, Anton Walbrook, and Leslie Howard.

hook: 《人群中的一张脸》记录了拉里·“孤独”·罗兹（安迪·格里菲斯饰）的兴衰，他是一位喧闹的艺人，在阿肯色州的一个喝醉酒的坦克里被当地广播电台制作人玛西娅·杰弗里斯（帕特里夏·尼尔饰）发现，她也有自己的野心。他的魅力和狡猾很快使他达到电视明星和政治煽动的高度，迫使玛西娅与她创造的控制欲强、反动的怪物作斗争。这部深刻的讽刺作品由埃利亚·卡赞执导，巴德·舒尔伯格担任编剧，格里菲斯在银幕处女作中展现了非凡的表演，在一个反常的险恶角色中展现了自己的魅力。尽管这部电影在首次上映时遭遇了失败，但后来的几代人都惊叹于它对美国生活中媒体与政治之间有毒的亲密关系的怪诞的先见之明的诊断。
hook_en: A Face in the Crowd chronicles the rise and fall of Larry “Lonesome” Rhodes (Andy Griffith), a boisterous entertainer discovered in an Arkansas drunk tank by Marcia Jeffries (Patricia Neal), a local radio producer with ambitions of her own. His charisma and cunning soon shoot him to the heights of television stardom and political demagoguery, forcing Marcia to grapple with the manipulative, reactionary monster she has created. Directed by Elia Kazan from a screenplay by Budd Schulberg, this incisive satire features an extraordinary debut screen performance by Griffith, who brandishes his charm in an uncharacteristically sinister role. Though the film was a flop on its initial release, subsequent generations have marveled at its eerily prescient diagnosis of the toxic intimacy between media and politics in American life.

hook: 一场激烈的误会导致一名执法人员死亡，墨西哥裔美国农民格雷戈里奥·科尔特斯 (Gregorio Cortez) 被迫逃离德克萨斯游骑兵队，数天骑马躲避大规模追捕，他绝望地逃亡。制片人兼明星爱德华·詹姆斯·奥尔莫斯 (Edward James Olmos) 试图对一段被收录在 Corrido（民歌）中的历史事件提供新的认识，因此聘请了社会参与现实主义的长期实践者罗伯特·M·杨 (Robert M. Young) 来执导这部开创性的独立电影，这是奇卡诺电影的里程碑。 《格雷戈里奥·科尔特斯之歌》将视角在追捕者和被追捕者之间转换，是一部惊心动魄的追逐电影，也是一部细致入微的程序片，揭开了围绕科尔特斯的层层偏见和神话，揭开了一个普通人遭受法律迫害并被传奇美化的真实故事。
hook_en: Forced to run from the Texas Rangers after a heated misunderstanding leads to the death of a lawman, Mexican American farmer Gregorio Cortez sets off in desperate flight, evading a massive manhunt on horseback for days. Producer-star Edward James Olmos, seeking to shed new light on a historical incident that had been enshrined in a corrido (folk song), enlisted director Robert M. Young, a longtime practitioner of socially engaged realism, to helm this trailblazing independent film, a landmark of Chicano cinema. Shifting its perspective between the pursuers and the pursued, The Ballad of Gregorio Cortez is a thrilling chase film and a nuanced procedural that peels away the layers of prejudice and myth surrounding Cortez, uncovering the true story of an ordinary man persecuted by the law and transfigured by legend.

hook: 戈弗雷·雷吉奥 (Godfrey Reggio) 在他的 Qatsi 三部曲的最后一章中掀起了数字革命。通过各种电影技术，包括慢动作、延时摄影、计算机生成的图像和找到的镜头，这部电影讲述了一个已经完成从自然到人工的转变的世界。全球化已经实现，我们所有的互动都以技术为媒介，所有图像都被操纵。从这个（虚拟）现实出发，雷吉奥塑造了一幅疯狂而又深思熟虑的时代肖像，在这个时代，“交流”的喧嚣使人类有效地陷入了后语言时代。
hook_en: Godfrey Reggio takes on the digital revolution in the final chapter of his Qatsi Trilogy. Through a variety of cinematic techniques, including slow motion, time-lapse, computer- generated imagery, and found footage, the film tells of a world that has completed the transition from the natural to the artificial. Globalization has been accomplished, all of our interactions are technologically mediated, and all images are manipulated. From this (virtual) reality, Reggio sculpts a frenetic yet ruminative portrait of an era in which the cacophony of “communication” has rendered humankind effectively postlanguage.

hook: 宏伟的《爱丽丝梦游城市》是维姆·文德斯职业生涯的第一部公路电影，是一部情感慷慨、拍摄精彩的冒险之旅。一位德国记者（鲁迪格·沃格勒饰）正开车穿越美国去研究一篇文章；这是一次令人失望的旅行，他无法真正理解他所看到的一切。然而，事情发生了变化，当他别无选择地带着一个名叫爱丽丝（耶拉·罗特兰德饰）的年轻女孩返回德国时，她的母亲（丽莎·克鲁泽饰）——他刚刚认识——把孩子交给了他照顾。尽管他们最初发现彼此存在分歧，但两人开始形成一种意想不到的友谊。
hook_en: The first of the road films that would come to define the career of Wim Wenders, the magnificent Alice in the Cities is an emotionally generous and luminously shot odyssey. A German journalist (Rüdiger Vogler) is driving across the United States to research an article; it’s a disappointing trip, in which he is unable to truly connect with what he sees. Things change, however, when he has no choice but to take a young girl named Alice (Yella Rottländer) with him on his return trip to Germany, after her mother (Lisa Kreuzer)—whom he has just met—leaves the child in his care. Though they initially find themselves at odds, the pair begin to form an unlikely friendship.

hook: 奥斯卡奖得主玛丽昂·歌迪亚 (Marion Cotillard) 在这部由比利时大师让·皮埃尔 (Jean-Pierre) 和吕克·达内 (Luc Dardenne) 执导的扣人心弦的影片中，凭借她在这部扣人心弦的影片中饰演一名渴望保住工厂工作的工人阶级女性的精彩表演而获得另一项提名。歌迪亚饰演桑德拉，一位患有抑郁症的妻子和母亲，她发现当她在家休病假时，大多数同事投票赞成解雇她，而不是放弃年度奖金。然后，她在周六和周日轮流拜访他们，试图说服他们改变主意。从这个简单的前提出发，达内兄弟创作了一部极具人性的戏剧，讲述了社区在日益非个人化的世界中的重要性。
hook_en: Oscar winner Marion Cotillard received another nomination for her searing, deeply felt performance as a working-class woman desperate to hold on to her factory job, in this gripping film from master Belgian directors Jean-Pierre and Luc Dardenne. Cotillard is Sandra, a wife and mother who suffers from depression and discovers that, while she was home on sick leave, a majority of her coworkers voted in favor of her being laid off over giving up their annual bonuses. She then spends a Saturday and Sunday visiting them each in turn, to try to convince them to change their minds. From this simple premise, the Dardennes create a powerfully humane drama about the importance of community in an increasingly impersonal world.

hook: 通过这个新的导演剪辑版，李安重建了他对《与魔鬼同行》的最初设想，这是一部令人痛苦的、非正统的内战史诗。影片以堪萨斯州和密苏里州边境战争为背景，讲述了杰克（托比·马奎尔饰）和杰克·布尔（斯基特·乌尔里奇饰）的故事，在杰克·布尔的父亲被废奴主义者松鸦霍克斯杀害后，他们加入了同情南部邦联的丛林砍伐者，并找到了一个不寻常的盟友霍尔特（杰弗里·赖特饰），尽管他曾经是一名奴隶，但他仍在为南方而战。 《与魔鬼同行》对政治和个人的身份和忠诚进行了反思，对人们对美国最血腥冲突的偏见提出了挑衅性的挑战。
hook_en: With this new director’s cut, Ang Lee reconstructs his original vision for Ride with the Devil, a harrowing, unorthodox Civil War epic. Set during the Kansas-Missouri border war, the film follows Jake (Tobey Maguire) and Jack Bull (Skeet Ulrich), who join the Confederate-sympathizing Bushwhackers after Jack Bull’s father is killed by abolitionist Jayhawkers, and find an unusual ally in Holt (Jeffrey Wright), who’s fighting for the South despite being a former slave. A rumination on identity and loyalty, both political and personal, Ride with the Devil is a provocative challenge to preconceptions about America’s bloodiest conflict.

hook: 在制作精美的《丽贝卡》中，浪漫变成了心理剧，这是阿尔弗雷德·希区柯克首次涉足好莱坞电影制作。该片梦幻般地改编自达芙妮·杜穆里埃 1938 年的小说，由迷人的琼·芳登 (Joan Fontaine) 饰演一位年轻女子，她相信自己在嫁给潇洒的贵族鳏夫马克西姆·德·温特 (Maxim de Winter)（由劳伦斯·奥利弗 (Laurence Olivier) 饰演，狡猾而脆弱) 后找到了自己内心的渴望。但搬到曼德利——她新郎的巴洛克式祖宅——后，她很快就发现，他已故的妻子不仅出没在庄园里，而且还出没于喜怒无常、沉思的马克西姆。希区柯克与制片人大卫·O·塞尔兹尼克传奇性合作的开始，由乔治·巴恩斯以令人惊叹的黑白镜头捕捉到的哀伤的哥特式视觉效果，赢得了奥斯卡最佳影片奖和最佳摄影奖。
hook_en: Romance becomes psychodrama in the elegantly crafted Rebecca, Alfred Hitchcock’s first foray into Hollywood filmmaking. A dreamlike adaptation of Daphne du Maurier’s 1938 novel, the film stars the enchanting Joan Fontaine as a young woman who believes she has found her heart’s desire when she marries the dashing aristocratic widower Maxim de Winter (played with cunning vulnerability by Laurence Olivier). But upon moving to Manderley—her groom’s baroque ancestral mansion—she soon learns that his deceased wife haunts not only the estate but the temperamental, brooding Maxim as well. The start of Hitchcock’s legendary collaboration with producer David O. Selznick, this elegiac gothic vision, captured in stunning black and white by George Barnes, took home the Academy Awards for best picture and best cinematography.

hook: 这部具有里程碑意义的航空史诗是冒险电影制作的壮举，也是霍华德·休斯大胆、不惜成本的愿景的证明，因其大胆的空中镜头和紧张的《守则》前的打击而仍然令人兴奋。第一次世界大战爆发后，两个被招募入皇家飞行队的英国兄弟（本·里昂和詹姆斯·霍尔饰）发现，他们对战争的不同态度和对同一个女人（让·哈洛在她的爆炸性突破中饰演）的爱，让他们的关系受到了考验。 《地狱天使》是一个众所周知的漫长而危险的制作过程的产物，导致多名船员死亡，它突破了新的技术领域，利用了早期的声音和色彩技术，并捕捉了一些有史以来最激动人心的混战场景。
hook_en: A high-flying feat of adventure filmmaking and a testament to the audacious, spare-no-expense vision of Howard Hughes, this landmark aviation epic remains exhilarating both for its daredevil aerial sequences and its nervy pre-Code punch. With the onset of World War I, two British brothers recruited into the Royal Flying Corps (Ben Lyon and James Hall) find their bond tested by their differing attitudes toward the war and their love for the same woman (Jean Harlow in her bombshell breakthrough). The product of a notoriously long and dangerous production that resulted in the deaths of multiple crew members, Hell’s Angels broke new technical ground, making use of early sound and color technologies, and capturing some of the most thrilling dogfight scenes ever filmed.

hook: 玛戈特·基德饰演黛拉，一位与双胞胎黛蒙妮分离的美丽模特。当一名记者（詹妮弗·萨尔特）怀疑黛蒙妮犯下了一起凶杀案时，她发现自己陷入了姐妹间的阴险纽带中。这部由布莱恩·德·帕斯卡执导的首部恐怖窥探作品，是对女性危机的恐怖剖析。影片融合了分屏效果、血淋淋的生日蛋糕以及阿尔弗雷德·希区柯克的常客伯纳德·赫尔曼的 chilling 音乐，是一部令人惊艳的作品。
hook_en: Margot Kidder is Danielle, a beautiful model separated from her Siamese twin, Dominique. When a hotshot reporter (Jennifer Salt) suspects Dominique of a brutal murder, she becomes dangerously ensnared in the sisters’ insidious sibling bond. A scary and stylish dissection of female crisis, Brian De Palma’s first foray into horror voyeurism is a stunning amalgam of split-screen effects, bloody birthday cakes, and a chilling score by frequent Alfred Hitchcock collaborator Bernard Herrmann.

hook: 《追逐阿米娅》是知名编剧导演基恩·史密斯（《克林克》、《购物中心》、《狗灵》）的“新泽西三部曲”系列的第三部作品。漫画艺术家霍尔登（本·阿弗莱克饰）爱上了同样是艺术家的阿米娅（乔伊·拉塞尔·阿德曼饰），但被她的性取向、好友巴尼（杰森·李饰）的轻视，以及自己对自我的怀疑所阻碍。影片充满了史密斯对对话和人际关系的独特洞察，《追逐阿米娅》以一种深刻而有趣的视角审视了观念如何改变人生，以及痴迷和自我怀疑如何扭曲现实。
hook_en: Chasing Amy is the third installment in the “New Jersey Trilogy” from award-winning writer-director Kevin Smith (Clerks, Mallrats, Dogma). Cult comic-book artist Holden (Ben Affleck) falls in love with fellow artist Alyssa (Joey Lauren Adams), only to be thwarted by her sexuality, the disdain of his best friend Banky (Jason Lee), and his own misgivings about himself. Filled with Smith's unique ear for dialogue and insight into relationships, Chasing Amy offers a thoughtful, funny look at how perceptions alter lives, and how obsession and self-doubt skew reality.

hook: 《极速》是哈罗德·劳埃德主演的最后一部无声电影，也是他最好的一部。这位闹剧传奇人物再次演绎了他的“眼镜角色”，这次是一个心地善良但心不在焉的纽约人，他无法保住工作。当他决心帮助拯救这座城市最后一辆马拉有轨电车时，他终于找到了自己真正的使命，这辆电车是由他心上人脾气暴躁的祖父经营的。从康尼岛的欢乐之旅，到令人难以置信的贝比·鲁斯客串，再到城市街道上令人毛骨悚然的高潮特技，《Speedy》是一封写给纽约的失控情书，会让你笑得合不拢嘴。
hook_en: Speedy was the last silent feature to star Harold Lloyd—and one of his very best. The slapstick legend reprises his “Glasses Character,” this time as a good-natured but scatterbrained New Yorker who can’t keep a job. He finally finds his true calling when he becomes determined to help save the city’s last horse-drawn streetcar, which is operated by his sweetheart’s crusty grandfather. From its joyous visit to Coney Island to its incredible Babe Ruth cameo to its hair-raising climactic stunts on the city’s streets, Speedy is an out-of-control love letter to New York that will have you grinning from ear to ear.

hook: 默片明星哈罗德·劳埃德的喜剧天才是永恒的。卓别林是可爱的天真烂漫的人，基顿是坚忍不拔的局外人，而劳埃德——一个追求成功的现代人——就是我们。凭借其完美的笑点和惊人的特技，安全最后！是对他的完美介绍。劳埃德扮演一个小镇乡巴佬，试图在大城市谋生，他找到了一份卑微的百货商店店员的工作。他想出了一个疯狂的宣传噱头来吸引人们对这家商店的注意，结果他的大胆举动令人难以置信，开始了成功之路。既搞笑又令人瞠目结舌，安全至上！这是一种卓越的电影体验，以真实的传奇为基础。
hook_en: The comic genius of silent star Harold Lloyd is eternal. Chaplin is the sweet innocent, Keaton the stoic outsider, but Lloyd—the modern guy striving for success—is us. And with its torrent of perfectly executed gags and astonishing stunts, Safety Last! is the perfect introduction to him. Lloyd plays a small-town bumpkin trying to make it in the big city, who finds employment as a lowly department-store clerk. He comes up with a wild publicity stunt to draw attention to the store, resulting in an incredible feat of derring-do on his part that gets him started on the climb to success. Laugh-out-loud funny and jaw-dropping in equal measure, Safety Last! is a movie experience par excellence, anchored by a genuine legend.

hook: 维罗妮卡·沃斯（罗塞尔·泽奇饰）是第三帝国时代一度受人喜爱的新星，她默默无闻地生活在战后的慕尼黑。她为生存而奋斗，并被过去的辉煌所困扰，在一个大雨倾盆的公园里遇到了体育记者罗伯特·克罗恩（希尔玛·塔特饰），并用她神秘的美丽吸引了他。随着他们不可思议的关系的发展，罗伯特逐渐发现了导致维罗妮卡职业生涯衰落的黑暗秘密。赖纳·维尔纳·法斯宾德 (Rainer Werner Fassbinder) 执导的《维罗妮卡·沃斯》(Veronika Voss) 改编自二战乌法明星的真实故事，是一部伪装成 20 世纪 50 年代情节剧的邪恶讽刺剧。
hook_en: A once-beloved Third Reich–era starlet, Veronika Voss (Rosel Zech) lives in obscurity in postwar Munich. Struggling for survival and haunted by past glories, she encounters sportswriter Robert Krohn (Hilmar Thate) in a rain-swept park and intrigues him with her mysterious beauty. As their unlikely relationship develops, Robert comes to discover the dark secrets that brought about the decline of Veronika’s career. Based on the true story of a World War II Ufa star, Rainer Werner Fassbinder’s Veronika Voss is wicked satire disguised as a 1950s melodrama.

hook: 奥利维尔从海军召集起来，拍摄了这部改编自莎士比亚历史的影片。在第二次世界大战中，英国人从这个国王的故事中鼓起勇气，他克服了巨大的困难并取得了胜利。这幅华丽的技术色彩渲染图以阿金库尔之战的惊心动魄再现为特色，劳伦斯爵士作为导演和演员的巅峰之作。
hook_en: Olivier mustered out of the navy to film this adaptation of Shakespeare’s history. Embroiled in World War II, Britons took courage from this tale of a king who surmounts overwhelming odds and emerges victorious. This sumptuous Technicolor rendering features a thrilling re-creation of the battle of Agincourt, and Sir Laurence in his prime as director and actor.

hook: 1957 年秋天的德国：洛拉（芭芭拉·苏科瓦饰）是一位迷人的歌舞表演歌手兼妓女，她为自己诱惑男人的力量而欢欣鼓舞，但她想要更多——金钱、财产和爱情。在腐败的建筑承包商（马里奥·阿多夫饰）与新任正直的建筑专员（阿明·穆勒-斯塔尔饰）的对立下，洛拉发起了一项令人震惊的计划，以在一个一切——所有人——都可以出售的世界中提升自己的地位。雷纳·维尔纳·法斯宾德的《洛拉》以童趣般的糖果色拍摄，向约瑟夫·冯·斯滕伯格的经典作品《蓝天使》致敬，也是对资本主义的精彩讽刺致敬。
hook_en: Germany in the autumn of 1957: Lola (Barbara Sukowa), a seductive cabaret singer–prostitute, exults in her power as a tempter of men, but she wants more—money, property, and love. Pitting a corrupt building contractor (Mario Adorf) against the new straight-arrow building commissioner (Armin Mueller-Stahl), Lola launches an outrageous plan to elevate herself in a world where everything—and everyone—is for sale. Shot in childlike candy colors, Rainer Werner Fassbinder’s Lola, an homage to Josef von Sternberg’s classic The Blue Angel, is a wonderfully satirical tribute to capitalism.

hook: 莫里斯·皮亚拉以其原始的电影制作风格被称为法国电影界的约翰·卡索维茨，而灼热的《爱情》是他最伟大的成就之一。在这部颇具启发性的电影处女作中，充满活力、面貌清新的桑德琳·博内尔 (Sandrine Bonnaire) 饰演苏珊娜 (Suzanne)，她是一名 15 岁的巴黎人，为了摆脱她专横而深爱的父亲（皮亚拉本人以惊人的吸引力饰演）、无能的母亲和野蛮的兄弟，她开始了性狂暴。 《爱情》是一部温柔的人物研究，可能会爆发出令人震惊的暴力，是八十年代法国电影的巅峰之作之一。
hook_en: With his raw style of filmmaking, Maurice Pialat has been called the John Cassavetes of French cinema, and the scorching À nos amours is one of his greatest achievements. In a revelatory film debut, the dynamic, fresh-faced Sandrine Bonnaire plays Suzanne, a fifteen-year-old Parisian who embarks on a sexual rampage in an effort to separate herself from her overbearing, beloved father (played with astonishing magnetism by Pialat himself), ineffectual mother, and brutish brother. A tender character study that can erupt in startling violence, À nos amours is one of the high-water marks of eighties French cinema.

hook: 在大卫·马梅特的电影中，一切都不是表面看上去那样——所以你最好知道自己在寻找什么。不幸的是，马梅噩梦般的城市冒险凶杀案的主角、市中心警探鲍比·戈尔德（乔·曼特纳饰）既不知道自己是谁，也不知道自己在追寻什么人（或什么）。戈尔德在一位年长的犹太糖果店老板被谋杀后进行了调查，引导他走上了一条充满晦涩遭遇和线索的道路，对自己的身份进行了深刻的反思。 《杀人案》充满了马梅特标志性的言语表演，并有威廉姆·H·梅西、文·瑞姆斯和丽贝卡·皮金的出色配角表演，是一部紧张、丰富的真正美国原创作品。
hook_en: In David Mamet’s cinema, nothing is as it seems—so you better know what you’re looking for. Unfortunately, the protagonist of Mamet’s nightmarish urban odyssey Homicide, inner-city police detective Bobby Gold (Joe Mantegna), is as bewildered about who he is as who (or what) he’s after. Gold’s investigation, following the murder of an elderly Jewish candy-shop owner, leads him down a path of obscure encounters and clues, to a profound reckoning with his own identity. Filled with Mamet’s trademark verbal play and featuring standout supporting performances from William H. Macy, Ving Rhames, and Rebecca Pidgeon, Homicide is a taut, rich work from a true American original.

hook: 世界著名艺术家村上隆的导演处女作《水母之眼》将他无限的想象力搬上银幕，讲述了一个关于友谊和忠诚的故事，同时也讲述了人类破坏的倾向。父亲去世后，一个小男孩随母亲搬到了一个乡村小镇，他与一个迷人的会飞的水母般的精灵成为了朋友，却发现他的同学也有类似的朋友，而他们和小镇本身都不是他们看上去的那样。村上隆的这部预算适中的特效盛宴以福岛后的世界为背景，拥有令人难忘的生物设计，并传达了所有年龄段的合作和希望的信息。
hook_en: The world-famous artist Takashi Murakami made his directorial debut with Jellyfish Eyes, taking his boundless imagination to the screen in a tale of friendship and loyalty that also addresses humanity’s propensity for destruction. After moving to a country town with his mother following his father’s death, a young boy befriends a charming, flying, jellyfish-like sprite—only to discover that his schoolmates have similar friends, and that neither they nor the town itself are what they seem to be. Pointedly set in a post-Fukushima world, Murakami’s modest-budgeted special effects extravaganza boasts unforgettable creature designs and carries a message of cooperation and hope for all ages.

hook: 这个关于社会崩溃的令人着迷的寓言是一个超越视觉、哲学和神秘共鸣的谜。 《韦克迈斯特和谐》改编自拉斯洛·克拉兹纳霍尔凯的小说，故事发生在一个未知的时间，在一个无名的村庄里，有一天，一个神秘的马戏团——包括一头巨大的毛鲸和一个被称为王子的神秘的、煽动者般的人物——来到了那里，似乎唤醒了公民中一种无情地走向暴力的疯狂。导演贝拉·塔尔 (Béla Tarr) 和联合导演兼剪辑师阿格尼丝·赫拉尼茨基 (Ágnes Hranitzky) 在三十九部以幽灵般的黑白形式呈现的催眠长镜头中，展现了梦幻般的恐惧和深不可测的美丽的世界末日景象。
hook_en: This mesmeric parable of societal collapse is an enigma of transcendent visual, philosophical, and mystical resonance. Adapted from a novel by László Krasznahorkai, Werckmeister Harmonies unfolds in an unknown time in an unnamed village, where, one day, a mysterious circus—complete with an enormous stuffed whale and a shadowy, demagogue-like figure known as the Prince—arrives and appears to awaken a kind of madness in the citizens that builds inexorably toward violence. In thirty-nine hypnotic long takes engraved in ghostly black and white, auteur Béla Tarr and codirector-editor Ágnes Hranitzky conjure an apocalyptic vision of dreamlike dread and fathomless beauty.

hook: 在这部以梦幻般永恒的塔尔萨为背景的两个叛逆兄弟之间的疏远与和解的深刻个人故事中，弗朗西斯·福特·科波拉为亲密而痛苦的情感赋予了神话般的维度。继风格更为古典的《局外人》之后，这位导演的“青少年艺术电影”是他在一年内第二次改编年轻成人小说家 S.E.辛顿的作品。以马特·狄龙、米基·洛克和黛安·莲恩为首的出色演员阵容；令人难以忘怀的黑白视觉效果让人回想起德国表现主义和科波拉自己的 Tetro；斯图尔特·科普兰 (Stewart Copeland) 强有力的打击乐配乐强调了电影的浪漫宿命论，《隆隆鱼》自始至终都充满了真挚的爱与恐惧。
hook_en: In this deeply personal tale of estrangement and reconciliation between two rebellious brothers, set in a dreamlike and timeless Tulsa, Francis Ford Coppola gives mythic dimensions to intimate, painful emotions. The director’s “art film for teenagers” was his second adaptation of young-adult novelist S. E. Hinton’s work in a single year, after the more classically styled The Outsiders. Graced with a remarkable cast headed by Matt Dillon, Mickey Rourke, and Diane Lane; haunting black-and-white visuals that hark back to German expressionism and forward to Coppola’s own Tetro; and a powerful percussive score by Stewart Copeland that underlines the movie’s romantic fatalism, Rumble Fish pulsates throughout with genuine love and dread.

hook: 《哈姆雷特》是劳伦斯·奥利维爵士赢得四项奥斯卡奖的作品，包括最佳影片和最佳男主角奖。劳伦斯·奥利维在这部莎士比亚 beloved 悲剧中最感人的版本中，既是导演又是忧郁的丹尼本人，他以一种新的生命气息复活了这位世界上最伟大的剧作家之一的词句。
hook_en: Winner of four Academy Awards, including Best Picture and Best Actor, Sir Laurence Olivier’s Hamlet continues to be the most compelling version of Shakespeare’s beloved tragedy. Olivier is at his most inspired—both as director and as the melancholy Dane himself—as he breathes new life into the words of one of the world’s greatest dramatists.

hook: 罗纳德·布朗斯坦 (Ronald Bronstein) 的这部发自肺腑、黑色幽默且完全自成一体的处女作，从纽约独立地下最肮脏的深处传来了噩梦般的信号，展现了一种令人恐惧的错位疏离感，达到了疯狂的极限。在一场几乎令人恐惧的承诺的疯狂表演中，多尔·曼扮演基思，一个令人不安的社会排斥者和自称为“巨魔”的人，他的神经症使他陷入了不可阻挡的自我毁灭的螺旋中，因为他糟糕的优惠券销售工作，可怜的生活状况（以来自布鲁克林时髦地狱的室友为特色），以及最后仅存的人际关系在他周围瓦解。正如肖恩·普莱斯·威廉姆斯（Sean Price Williams）幽闭恐怖摄影作品中肮脏的表现主义风格所捕捉到的那样，《Frownland》是最无畏、最不妥协、最令人难忘的 DIY 电影。
hook_en: A nightmare transmission from the grungiest depths of the New York indie underground, the visceral, darkly funny, and totally sui generis debut feature from Ronald Bronstein is a dread-inducing vision of misfit alienation at its unhinged extreme. In a maniacal performance of almost frightening commitment, Dore Mann plays Keith, a disturbingly maladjusted social outcast and self-described “troll” whose neuroses plunge him into an unstoppable spiral of self-obliteration as his crummy coupon-selling job, pitiful living situation (featuring the roommate from hipster Brooklyn hell), and last remaining human relationships disintegrate around him. As captured in the grimy expressionist grain of Sean Price Williams’s claustrophobic camera work, Frownland is DIY cinema at its most fearless, uncompromising, and unforgettable.

hook: 在《表兄弟》中，克洛德·夏布洛尔创作了一个狡猾的道德寓言，讲述了一个外省男孩来到巴黎与他精致的波西米亚表弟住在一起的故事。通过这些看似对立的事物，夏布洛尔塑造了一种黑色喜剧人物研究，质疑现代世界中的善与恶、爱与嫉妒以及成功的概念。 《表兄弟》是夏布洛尔的处女作《Le beau Serge》的镜像，以惊人的颠倒角色重新塑造了该片的主演让-克洛德·布里亚利 (Jean-Claude Brialy) 和杰拉德·布莱恩 (Gérard Blain)。这部尖锐的剧情片赢得了柏林电影节金熊奖，是法国新浪潮的重要早期作品。
hook_en: In Les cousins, Claude Chabrol crafts a sly moral fable about a provincial boy who comes to live with his sophisticated bohemian cousin in Paris. Through these seeming opposites, Chabrol conjures a darkly comic character study that questions notions of good and evil, love and jealousy, and success in the modern world. A mirror image of Le beau Serge, Chabrol’s debut, Les cousins recasts that film’s stars, Jean-Claude Brialy and Gérard Blain, in startlingly reversed roles. This dagger-sharp drama won the Golden Bear at the Berlin Film Festival and was an important early entry in the French New Wave.

hook: 比利·怀尔德的这部炙手可热的杰作是有史以来最受欢迎的电影之一，为好莱坞喜剧树立了新标准。目睹了一场暴民袭击后，芝加哥音乐家乔和杰瑞（托尼·柯蒂斯和杰克·莱蒙在具有里程碑意义的表演中饰演）乔装打扮，加入一支全女性乐队，逃离小镇，前往迈阿密。该乐队歌手糖·凯恩（玛丽莲·梦露，在她的爆炸性力量的巅峰时期）的魅力使他们进一步陷入奢侈的谎言，乔假装百万富翁的形象来追求她，而杰瑞的女性另一个自我最终与一位大亨订婚。凭借怀尔德和 I. A. L. 戴蒙德 (I. A. L. Diamond) 的精妙剧本，以及精心调配的演员阵容，《热情似火》在今天仍然像几十年前首次让观众惊叹不已时一样，令人着迷的有趣和新鲜。
hook_en: One of the most beloved films of all time, this sizzling masterpiece by Billy Wilder set a new standard for Hollywood comedy. After witnessing a mob hit, Chicago musicians Joe and Jerry (Tony Curtis and Jack Lemmon, in landmark performances) skip town by donning drag and joining an all-female band en route to Miami. The charm of the group’s singer, Sugar Kane (Marilyn Monroe, at the height of her bombshell powers), leads them ever further into extravagant lies, as Joe assumes the persona of a millionaire to woo her and Jerry’s female alter ego winds up engaged to a tycoon. With a whip-smart script by Wilder and I. A. L. Diamond, and sparking chemistry among its finely tuned cast, Some Like It Hot is as deliriously funny and fresh today as it was when it first knocked audiences out several decades ago.

hook: 《承诺》是吕克·达内和让-皮埃尔·达内的突破性作品，他们后来成为世界电影制作的一股力量。兄弟俩将早期纪录片中对细节的精准洞察力和对社会底层人士的同情心融入到这部引人入胜的剧情片中，讲述了一名青少年（杰雷米·雷尼尔饰）逐渐理解他父亲通过剥削无证工人谋生的影响。 《承诺》在达内兄弟的工业故乡比利时塞兰拍摄，讲述了一个男孩陷入困境的道德觉醒的精彩故事。
hook_en: La promesse is the breakthrough feature from Luc and Jean-Pierre Dardenne, who would go on to become a force in world filmmaking. The brothers brought the unerring eye for detail and the compassion for those on society’s lowest rungs developed in their earlier documentary work to this absorbing drama about a teenager (Jérémie Renier) gradually coming to understand the implications of his father’s making a living through the exploitation of undocumented workers. Filmed in the Dardennes’ industrial hometown of Seraing, Belgium, La promesse is a brilliantly economical and observant tale of a boy’s troubled moral awakening.

hook: 这是一部终极意大利公路喜剧，《Il sorpasso》由维托里奥·加斯曼 (Vittorio Gassman) 和让-路易斯·特林蒂尼昂 (Jean-Louis Trintignant) 这对不太可能的搭档主演，他们分别饰演一个滑稽、随心所欲的单身汉和一个拘谨的法律系学生，他带着他从罗马到托斯卡纳进行了一次疯狂的旅行。这部由迪诺·里西 (Dino Risi) 执导的电影是一段从闹剧到悲剧的不可预测的旅程，对美好生活的乐趣和后果进行了极其有趣的评论。 《Il sorpasso》是意大利即兴喜剧的圣杯，它是如此新鲜和令人兴奋，以至于人们很容易明白为什么它长期以来在意大利受到喜爱。
hook_en: The ultimate Italian road comedy, Il sorpasso stars the unlikely pair of Vittorio Gassman and Jean-Louis Trintignant as, respectively, a waggish, freewheeling bachelor and the straitlaced law student he takes on a madcap trip from Rome to Tuscany. An unpredictable journey that careers from slapstick to tragedy, this film, directed by Dino Risi, is a wildly entertaining commentary on the pleasures and consequences of the good life. A holy grail of commedia all’italiana, Il sorpasso is so fresh and exciting that one can easily see why it has long been adored in Italy.

hook: 这部令人心痛的历史剧由约翰·塞尔斯 (John Sayles) 编剧和导演，讲述了西弗吉尼亚州一个煤炭小镇的真实故事，1920 年，当地矿工组建工会的斗争升级为全面战争。当马特万的矿工罢工时，组织者乔·凯尼汉 (克里斯·库珀饰，在他的电影处女作中饰演) 赶来帮助他们，团结白人和黑人、阿巴拉契亚出生和移民工人，同时敦促人们在面对煤炭公司的罢工时保持耐心。暴力挑衅。凭借詹姆斯·厄尔·琼斯、大卫·斯特雷泽恩、玛丽·麦克唐纳和威尔·奥尔德姆等出色的演员阵容，以及哈斯克尔·韦克斯勒的奥斯卡提名摄影，马特万挖掘了美国文化的丰富脉络，并潜心关注当地的质感，发出了对正义的慷慨激昂的呐喊，至今仍然回响。
hook_en: Written and directed by John Sayles, this wrenching historical drama recounts the true story of a West Virginia coal town where the local miners’ struggle to form a union rose to the pitch of all-out war in 1920. When Matewan’s miners go on strike, organizer Joe Kenehan (Chris Cooper, in his film debut) arrives to help them, uniting workers white and black, Appalachia-born and immigrant, while urging patience in the face of the coal company’s violent provocations. With a crackerjack ensemble cast—including James Earl Jones, David Strathairn, Mary McDonnell, and Will Oldham—and Oscar-nominated cinematography by Haskell Wexler, Matewan taps into a rich vein of Americana with painstaking attention to local texture, issuing an impassioned cry for justice that still resounds today.

hook: 雅克·德米（Jacques Demy）继《瑟堡的雨伞》之后又创作了另一部关于错失联系和第二次机会的音乐剧，这部音乐剧更加令人兴奋。双胞胎德尔菲娜和索兰热，分别是舞蹈老师和音乐老师（由现实生活中的姐妹凯瑟琳·德纳芙和弗朗索瓦丝·多莱克饰演），渴望大城市生活；当集市来到他们安静的港口小镇时，逃离的可能性也随之增加。 《罗什福尔的年轻女孩》凭借米歇尔·罗格朗爵士乐曲、柔和的服装天堂和出色的配角（乔治·查基里斯、格罗弗·戴尔、丹妮尔·达里厄、米歇尔·皮科利和吉恩·凯利），是对六十年代法国电影杰出梦想家好莱坞乐观主义的致敬。
hook_en: Jacques Demy followed up The Umbrellas of Cherbourg with another musical about missed connections and second chances, this one a more effervescent confection. Twins Delphine and Solange, a dance instructor and a music teacher (played by real-life sisters Catherine Deneuve and Françoise Dorléac), long for big-city life; when a fair comes through their quiet port town, so does the possibility of escape. With its jazzy Michel Legrand score, pastel paradise of costumes, and divine supporting cast (George Chakiris, Grover Dale, Danielle Darrieux, Michel Piccoli, and Gene Kelly), The Young Girls of Rochefort is a tribute to Hollywood optimism from sixties French cinema’s preeminent dreamer.

hook: 戈弗雷·雷吉奥 (Godfrey Reggio) 的《Koyaanisqatsi》让观众震惊五年后，他再次与作曲家菲利普·格拉斯 (Philip Glass) 和其他合作者联手创作了第二章。在这里，雷吉奥将目光转向南半球的第三世界国家。 Powaqatsi 放弃了第一部电影的加速美学，采用了冥想式的慢动作，以揭示地球上这些地区传统生活方式的美丽，并展示那里的文化如何随着环境被工业占领而受到侵蚀。这是雷吉奥哲学和视觉上引人注目的 Qatsi 三部曲中最强烈的精神部分。
hook_en: Five years after Godfrey Reggio stunned audiences with Koyaanisqatsi, he again joined forces with composer Philip Glass and other collaborators for a second chapter. Here, Reggio turns his sights on third-world nations in the Southern Hemisphere. Forgoing the sped-up aesthetic of the first film, Powaqqatsi employs a meditative slow motion in order to reveal the beauty of the traditional ways of life in those parts of the planet, and to show how cultures there are being eroded as their environments are taken over by industry. This is the most intensely spiritual segment of Reggio’s philosophical and visually remarkable Qatsi Trilogy.

hook: 全明星阵容和爵士配乐凸显了这部迷人的喜剧，巧妙地讽刺了《Rififi》等经典惊悚电影。 《麦当娜街的大交易》以滑稽的方式详细描述了一群笨手笨脚的小偷的困境，以及他们不顾一切地试图完成完美抢劫的故事。
hook_en: An all-star cast and jazzy score highlight this charming comedy, a deft satire of classic caper films like Rififi. Big Deal on Madonna Street hilariously details the plight of a sad-sack group of bumbling thieves and their desperate attempts to pull off the perfect heist.

hook: 英国导演安德里亚·阿诺德 (Andrea Arnold) 凭借紧张而充满活力的《鱼缸》获得了戛纳评审团奖，该片讲述了 15 岁女孩米娅（令人兴奋的新人凯蒂·贾维斯饰）与母亲和妹妹住在埃塞克斯的住房项目中的故事。当米娅母亲的新男友（极具吸引力的迈克尔·法斯宾德饰）出现时，米娅的青春期冲突和新出现的性行为达到了沸点。在她年轻的职业生涯中，阿诺德已经证明了自己是社会现实主义大师，让人想起迈克·李和肯·洛奇的作品；她对死胡同的生活充满同情心的描绘充满了她自己的诗意、朴实的情感。 《鱼缸》预示着一位重要新电影制片人的正式到来。
hook_en: British director Andrea Arnold won the Cannes Jury Prize for the intense and invigorating Fish Tank, about a fifteen-year-old girl, Mia (electrifying newcomer Katie Jarvis), who lives with her mother and sister in the housing projects of Essex. Mia’s adolescent conflicts and emerging sexuality reach a boiling point when her mother’s new boyfriend (a lethally attractive Michael Fassbender) enters the picture. In her young career, Arnold has already proven herself to be a master of social realism, evoking the work of Mike Leigh and Ken Loach; and she invests her sympathetic portraits of dead-end lives with a poetic, earthy sensibility all her own. Fish Tank heralds the official arrival of a major new filmmaker.

hook: 诗意现实主义在《天堂之子》中达到了崇高的高度，被广泛认为是有史以来最伟大的法国电影之一。这部在二战期间拍摄的影片对 19 世纪巴黎戏剧中的上流社会进行了灵活的描绘，讲述了一位神秘女子（阿莱蒂饰）被四个不同的男人（全部取材于历史人物）所爱的故事：演员、罪犯、伯爵，以及最令人心酸的哑剧（让-路易斯·巴罗，在一场充满渴望的表演中为数个世纪）。导演马塞尔·卡内和编剧雅克·普雷维尔凭借敏感和戏剧性的活力，复活了一个充满小贩和贵族、小偷和交际花、皮条客和预言家的世界。得益于全新的重大修复，这款标志性经典的外观和声音比以往任何时候都更加丰富和细致。
hook_en: Poetic realism reached sublime heights with Children of Paradise, widely considered one of the greatest French films of all time. This nimble depiction of nineteenth-century Paris’s theatrical demimonde, filmed during World War II, follows a mysterious woman (Arletty) loved by four different men (all based on historical figures): an actor, a criminal, a count, and, most poignantly, a mime (Jean-Louis Barrault, in a longing-suffused performance for the ages). With sensitivity and dramatic élan, director Marcel Carné and screenwriter Jacques Prévert resurrect a world teeming with hucksters and aristocrats, thieves and courtesans, pimps and seers. And thanks to a major new restoration, this iconic classic looks and sounds richer and more detailed than ever.

hook: 编剧兼导演斯派克·李通过这部极其有趣、毫无歉意的对抗性讽刺作品，审视了美国流行文化中种族主义的过去、现在和未来，向创作者和消费者发出了大胆的挑衅。迫于重振电视网低收视率的压力，电视编剧皮埃尔·德拉克罗瓦（达蒙·韦恩斯饰）想到了一个极具攻击性的想法：通过《新千年吟游诗人秀》恢复黑脸。白人网络高管喜欢它，观众也喜欢它，这迫使皮埃尔和他的合作者面对公众对非人性刻板印象的贪得无厌的胃口。 《Bamboozled》主要以未经修饰的数字视频拍摄，并夸耀了 Wayans、Savion Glover、Jada Pinkett Smith、Tommy Davidson、Michael Rapaport、Mos Def 和 Paul Mooney 的现场表演，《Bamboozled》是对 21 世纪之交大众娱乐的尖锐控诉，而且随着时间的推移，这种控诉看起来越来越令人谴责。
hook_en: With this blisteringly funny, unapologetically confrontational satire, writer-director Spike Lee examined the past, present, and future of racism in American popular culture, issuing a daring provocation to creators and consumers alike. Under pressure to help revive his network’s low ratings, television writer Pierre Delacroix (Damon Wayans) hits on an explosively offensive idea: bringing back blackface with The New Millennium Minstrel Show. The white network executives love it, and so do audiences, forcing Pierre and his collaborators to confront their public’s insatiable appetite for dehumanizing stereotypes. Shot primarily on unvarnished digital video and boasting spot-on performances from Wayans, Savion Glover, Jada Pinkett Smith, Tommy Davidson, Michael Rapaport, Mos Def, and Paul Mooney, Bamboozled is a stinging indictment of mass entertainment at the turn of the twenty-first century that looks more damning with each passing year.

hook: 这部由法国当代伟大导演奥利维耶·阿萨亚斯创作的多层次、极具娱乐性的戏剧以独特的视角展现了高雅艺术与流行文化的交汇。一向非凡的朱丽叶·比诺什 (Juliette Binoche) 饰演的玛丽亚 (Maria) 令人激动不已，她是一位舞台和银幕偶像，正被邀请出演这部使她成名的戏剧的新作品，只不过这一次她必须扮演年长女性的角色。克里斯汀·斯图尔特 (Kristen Stewart) 饰演她陷入困境的助理，要求她为善变的老板提供专业和情感上的支持。科洛·莫瑞兹 (Chloë Grace Moretz) 是玛丽亚稚气未脱的新搭档，一位伺机而动的新星。 《锡尔斯玛丽亚的云》是一个无定形的、反省灵魂的故事，充满了瑞士阿尔卑斯山背景的空灵形象，出色地戏剧化了一个女人对自己和世界的思考。
hook_en: This multilayered, immensely entertaining drama from the great contemporary French director Olivier Assayas is a singular look at the intersection of high art and popular culture. The always extraordinary Juliette Binoche is stirring as Maria, a stage and screen icon who is being courted to star in a new production of the play that made her famous—only this time she must assume the role of the older woman. Kristen Stewart matches her punch for punch as her beleaguered assistant, called upon to provide support both professional and emotional for her mercurial boss. And Chloë Grace Moretz is Maria’s callow new castmate, a starlet waiting in the wings. An amorphous, soul-searching tale, filled with ethereal images of its Swiss Alps setting, Clouds of Sils Maria brilliantly dramatizes one woman’s reckoning with herself and the world.

hook: 佩德罗·阿尔莫多瓦对斯德哥尔摩综合症的快乐和危险进行了丰富多彩且颇具争议的致敬，《绑住我！》束缚我！是一部粗暴的黑色喜剧，由安东尼奥·班德拉斯（Antonio Banderas）饰演一位精神失常但迷人的前精神病患者，维多利亚·阿布里尔（Victoria Abril）饰演 B 级电影和前色情明星，他为了说服她嫁给他而将她俘虏。继阿莫多瓦轰动国际的《濒临崩溃的女人》之后，这部非传统的爱情片成为世界上最受欢迎、最具挑衅性的导演之一的职业生涯中一部引人瞩目、性感的核心作品，由这位导演的伟大摄影师何塞·路易斯·阿尔凯恩精心拍摄。
hook_en: Pedro Almodóvar’s colorful and controversial tribute to the pleasures and perils of Stockholm syndrome, Tie Me Up! Tie Me Down! is a rambunctious dark comedy starring Antonio Banderas as an unbalanced but alluring ex-mental-patient and Victoria Abril as the B-movie and former porn star he takes prisoner in the hopes of convincing her to marry him. A highly unconventional romance that came on the spike heels of Almodóvar’s international sensation Women on the Verge of a Nervous Breakdown, this is a splashy, sexy central work in the career of one of the world’s most beloved and provocative auteurs, radiantly shot by the director’s great cinematographer, José Luis Alcaine.

hook: 斯坦利·库布里克对一场雄心勃勃的赛马场抢劫案的描述是好莱坞最紧张、最曲折的黑色电影之一。凭借彻底的时间洗牌叙事、通俗小说家吉姆·汤普森犀利的对话，以及斯特林·海登、科琳·格雷、蒂莫西·凯里、小伊丽莎·库克和玛丽·温莎等出色的角色演员阵容，《谋杀》既是一部欢快的惊悚片，也是一部直击内心的冷血重拳。凭借其精确的跟踪镜头和令人满意的讽刺感，这就是库布里克的核心。
hook_en: Stanley Kubrick’s account of an ambitious racetrack robbery is one of Hollywood’s tautest, twistiest noirs. Aided by a radically time-shuffling narrative, razor-sharp dialogue from pulp novelist Jim Thompson, and a phenomenal cast of character actors, including Sterling Hayden, Coleen Gray, Timothy Carey, Elisha Cook Jr., and Marie Windsor, The Killing is both a jaunty thriller and a cold-blooded punch to the gut. And with its precise tracking shots and gratifying sense of irony, it’s Kubrick to the core.

hook: 在这部对西方神话的悄然颠覆性的重新想象中，一个家庭的没落成为美国边疆理想的一首鲜明的挽歌。在与进步派导演马丁·里特的六次合作中，保罗·纽曼创造了他迄今为止最黑暗的角色：哈德·班农（Hud Bannon），一个有魅力但无情无原则的牧场主。哈德想要从传统的父亲（梅尔文·道格拉斯饰）手中夺取陷入困境的养牛业的控制权，这导致整个家庭——包括他崇拜的侄子（布兰登·德·王尔德饰）和世故的管家（帕特里夏·尼尔饰）——走向崩溃。荣获奥斯卡最佳女主角奖（尼尔）、最佳男配角奖（道格拉斯）和最佳摄影奖（由詹姆斯·黄豪提供，他朴素的黑白镜头为荒凉的西部景色增添了心理维度），哈德大胆地为幻想破灭的一代人改写了英雄牛仔的形象。
hook_en: A family’s downfall becomes a stark elegy for the ideals of the American frontier in this quietly subversive reimagining of western myths. In the fourth of his six collaborations with the progressive director Martin Ritt, Paul Newman created his darkest role yet as Hud Bannon, a charismatic but ruthlessly unprincipled rancher. Hud’s ambition to seize control of an ailing cattle business from his tradition-bound father (Melvyn Douglas) drives the family—including his worshipful nephew (Brandon de Wilde) and worldly-wise housekeeper (Patricia Neal)—toward collapse. Winner of Academy Awards for Best Actress (Neal), Supporting Actor (Douglas), and Cinematography—courtesy of James Wong Howe, whose austere black-and-white lensing lends psychological dimension to the desolate western vistas—Hud daringly rewrites the image of the heroic cowboy for a disillusioned generation.

hook: 音乐偶像大卫·伯恩 (David Byrne) 受到小报头条新闻的启发，首次涉足故事片导演领域，这是对美国普通生活非凡的颂歌，也是对他自己独特思想的升华。会说话的头像主唱扮演一位德克萨斯州维吉尔市的游客，他在筹备特殊庆典期间向我们介绍了该镇的居民。在电影摄影师埃德·拉赫曼 (Ed Lachman) 的拍摄下，德克萨斯州变成了超现实主义的晚期资本主义景观，拥有无尽的远景、购物中心和预制金属建筑。在《真实故事》中，伯恩用他的歌曲将流行图像、巫毒仪式和独特的综艺节目拼接在一起——所有这些都是为了揭开潜伏在日常经历表面之下的丰富奥秘。
hook_en: Music icon David Byrne was inspired by tabloid headlines to make his sole foray into feature-film directing, an ode to the extraordinariness of ordinary American life and a distillation of what was in his own idiosyncratic mind. The Talking Heads front man plays a visitor to Virgil, Texas, who introduces us to the citizens of the town during preparations for its Celebration of Specialness. As shot by cinematographer Ed Lachman, Texas becomes a hyperrealistic late-capitalist landscape of endless vistas, shopping malls, and prefab metal buildings. In True Stories, Byrne uses his songs to stitch together pop iconography, voodoo rituals, and a singular variety show—all in the service of uncovering the rich mysteries that lurk under the surface of everyday experience.

hook: 梶芽衣子在藤田敏也的热门作品《雪血女士》的续集中回归。我们愤怒的女主人公被当局抓获，并因她犯下的各种杀戮罪被判处死刑；然而，如果她为政府执行危险的命令，她就有机会逃脱。 《雪血女士：复仇情歌》比原作更具政治色彩，充满了激动人心的情节转折和巧妙​​的动作场面。
hook_en: Meiko Kaji returns in Toshiya Fujita’s invigorating sequel to his own cult hit Lady Snowblood. Our furious heroine is captured by the authorities and sentenced to death for the various killings she has committed; however, she is offered a chance of escape—if she carries out dangerous orders for the government. More politically minded than the original, Lady Snowblood: Love Song of Vengeance is full of exciting plot turns and ingenious action sequences.

hook: 巴里·詹金斯 (Barry Jenkins) 的迷人处女作《忧郁之药》是一部低保真浪漫故事，以快速中产阶级化的旧金山为背景展开。在那里，两个年轻的波西米亚人米卡（怀亚特·塞纳克饰）和乔（特蕾西·赫金斯饰）之间的一夜情，逐渐演变成一场令人昏昏欲睡的一整天的恋情，在他们探索彼此之间、与城市以及他们自己的黑人身份的过程中，充满了温柔、摩擦、欢乐和智力争论。詹金斯在低饱和度的视频中拍摄，对疏离和联系进行了亲密的探索，并以令人回味的视觉调色板和同理心的情感来定义他的作品。
hook_en: Barry Jenkins’s captivating debut feature, Medicine for Melancholy, is a lo-fi romance that unfolds against the backdrop of a rapidly gentrifying San Francisco. There, a one-night stand between two young bohemians, Micah (Wyatt Cenac) and Jo’ (Tracey Heggins), spins off into a woozy daylong affair marked by moments of tenderness, friction, joy, and intellectual sparring as they explore their relationships to each other, the city, and their own Blackness. Shooting on desaturated video, Jenkins crafts an intimate exploration of alienation and connection graced with the evocative visual palette and empathetic emotional charge that have come to define his work.

hook: 《公主新娘》是一场真爱与不可思议的困难之间的激烈冒险，以其不敬的笑点、古怪的整体和令人眼花缭乱的剑术吸引了大批粉丝。一个孩子（弗雷德·萨维奇饰）放学回家，不情愿地允许祖父（彼得·法尔克饰）给他读一本落满灰尘的故事书——这就是我们如何认识无辜的毛茛（罗宾·怀特饰，她的突破性角色），她即将嫁给邪恶的汉珀丁克王子（克里斯·萨兰登饰），尽管她的心属于韦斯特利（加利·艾尔维斯饰）。然而，婚礼计划被神秘的海盗、复仇心重的西班牙人和善良的巨人打断，故事充满了虚张声势、浪漫和滑稽的恶搞。 《公主新娘》由罗布·莱纳 (Rob Reiner) 执导，改编自威廉·戈德曼 (William Goldman) 的经典剧本，堪称童话经典。
hook_en: A high-spirited adventure that pits true love against inconceivable odds, The Princess Bride has charmed legions of fans with its irreverent gags, eccentric ensemble, and dazzling swordplay. A kid (Fred Savage), home sick from school, grudgingly allows his grandfather (Peter Falk) to read him a dusty storybook—which is how we meet the innocent Buttercup (Robin Wright, in her breakout role), about to marry the nefarious Prince Humperdinck (Chris Sarandon) though her heart belongs to Westley (Cary Elwes). The wedding plans are interrupted, however, by a mysterious pirate, a vengeful Spaniard, and a good-natured giant, in a tale full of swashbuckling, romance, and outrageously hilarious spoofery. Directed by Rob Reiner from an endlessly quotable script by William Goldman, The Princess Bride reigns as a fairy-tale classic.

hook: L. Frank Baum 的永恒故事《绿野仙踪》在这部根据原著改编的、具有里程碑意义的百老汇演出的奢华改编版中得到了时髦的重新想象。戴安娜·罗斯 (Diana Ross) 为多萝西 (Dorothy) 角色带来了令人惊叹的明星魅力，多萝西是一位哈莱姆区的学校老师，她被神奇地传送到了一个类似于纽约市的超现实幻想世界，那里有食人垃圾桶和迪斯科天堂。在昆西·琼斯和包括迈克尔·杰克逊、理查德·普赖尔和莉娜·霍恩在内的全明星阵容的音乐贡献的推动下，这部由传奇导演西德尼·吕美特执导的令人眼花缭乱的灵魂电影通过美国黑人的经历重新演绎了一个受人喜爱的故事，创造了一场强有力的自决庆典。
hook_en: L. Frank Baum’s timeless story The Wonderful Wizard of Oz gets a funky reimagining in this lavish adaptation of a landmark Broadway show based on the book. Diana Ross brings her showstopping star power to the role of Dorothy, here a Harlem schoolteacher who is magically transported to a surreal fantasyland that resembles New York City, complete with man-eating trash cans and a disco paradise. Propelled by the musical contributions of Quincy Jones and an all-star cast that includes Michael Jackson, Richard Pryor, and Lena Horne, this dazzling soul spectacular from legendary director Sidney Lumet reframes a beloved tale through the Black American experience, creating a powerful celebration of self-determination.

hook: 特立独行的好莱坞造型师安德烈·德·托特 (André de Toth) 在祖国匈牙利磨练了自己的技艺，包括制作这部别致、动感十足的情节剧，其中充满了装饰风格和爵士音乐插曲。两名向上流动的职业女性——一个是女子乐队的音乐家，另一个是瓦工——齐心协力，试图在布达佩斯取得成功，在命运的改变、好色男人的追求、爱情的高潮和心碎中互相支持。充满活力的摄影作品、轻快的剪辑和前卫的图像在这部通常引人注目的现代颂歌中比比皆是，颂扬了工人阶级女性团结的力量。
hook_en: The maverick Hollywood stylist André de Toth sharpened his craft in his native Hungary, including making this chic, dynamic melodrama, studded with deco decor and jazzy musical interludes. Two upwardly mobile working women—one a musician in an all-girl band, the other a bricklayer—join forces in their attempts to make it in Budapest, supporting each other through changing fortunes, the advances of lecherous men, and the highs and heartbreaks of love. Kinetic camera work, brisk editing, and avant-garde imagery abound in this often strikingly modern ode to the power of working-class female solidarity.

hook: 埃罗尔·莫里斯凭借这部精彩的处女作脱颖而出，讲述了北加州的两个宠物墓地以及与它们有关的人们。然而，这样的描述很难公正地描述《天堂之门》这部迷人、有趣、神秘的电影，这部电影讲述的是我们与宠物、彼此以及我们自己的关系。既真诚又讽刺，这是对人性的一次令人惊奇的研究。
hook_en: Errol Morris burst out of the gate with this brilliant debut feature, about two pet cemeteries in Northern California and the people involved with them. Such a description, however, can hardly do justice to the captivating, funny, and enigmatic Gates of Heaven, a film that is about our relationships to our pets, each other, and ourselves. Both sincere and satirical, this is an endlessly surprising study of human nature.

hook: 本尼茨教授亨利·希金斯（列斯·霍华德饰）打了一个赌，他能在短短六个月的时间里，把东伦敦的贫民女艾丽莎·多利匹（温迪·希尔尔饰）培养成一位“ proper lady”。这是一部关于粗鲁举止的 delightful 喜剧，改编自乔治·伯纳德·肖的戏剧。这部为莱恩和洛伊的《窈窕淑女》赢得奥斯卡奖的灵感作品，由安东尼·阿什克利特执导，霍华德主演，戴维·莱恩剪辑，肖本人编剧。
hook_en: Cranky Professor Henry Higgins (Leslie Howard) takes a bet that he can turn Cockney guttersnipe Eliza Doolittle (Wendy Hiller) into a "proper lady" in a mere six months in this delightful comedy of bad manners, based on the play by George Bernard Shaw. This Academy Award–winning inspiration for Lerner and Loewe's My Fair Lady was directed by Anthony Asquith and star Howard, edited by David Lean, and scripted by Shaw himself.

hook: 迈克尔·鲍威尔和埃默里克·普雷斯伯格执导的《布林普上校的生与死》被许多人认为是有史以来最好的英国电影，是一部无与伦比的激动人心的杰作。罗杰·利弗西 (Roger Livesey) 饰演不可磨灭的克莱夫·坎迪将军 (General Clive Candy)，动态地体现了过时的英国军国主义，他勉强熬过了 1902 年至 1942 年四十年动荡的英国历史，却眼睁睁地看着世界在他眼前发生了不可逆转的变化。安东·沃尔布鲁克 (Anton Walbrook) 和黛博拉·克尔 (Deborah Kerr) 提供了令人难忘的支持，他作为德国敌人变成了坎迪的终生朋友，而她作为连续三代的年轻女性——一位热心社会的家庭教师、一位善良的战争护士和一位具有现代思维的军队司机——激励着他。 《布林普上校》既感人又巧妙地讽刺，是一部关于战争、爱情、衰老和过时的无与伦比的电影，以华丽的彩色胶片拍摄。
hook_en: Considered by many to be the finest British film ever made, The Life and Death of Colonel Blimp, by Michael Powell and Emeric Pressburger, is a stirring masterpiece like no other. Roger Livesey dynamically embodies outmoded English militarism as the indelible General Clive Candy, who barely survives four decades of tumultuous British history, 1902 to 1942, only to see the world change irrevocably before his eyes. Anton Walbrook and Deborah Kerr provide unforgettable support, he as a German enemy turned lifelong friend of Candy’s and she as young women of three consecutive generations—a socially committed governess, a sweet-souled war nurse, and a modern-thinking army driver—who inspire him. Colonel Blimp is both moving and slyly satirical, an incomparable film about war, love, aging, and obsolescence, shot in gorgeous Technicolor.

hook: 导演让·皮埃尔·梅尔维尔凭借一贯的克制和对细节的无情关注，追踪了法国黑社会罪犯顾（无与伦比的利诺·文图拉饰）越狱并卷入最后一次抢劫的平行轨迹，以及温文尔雅的督察布洛特（保罗·莫里斯饰）的不懈追捕。 《双重蛋奶酥》以有条不紊的悬念和令人痛苦的真实性捕捉到了阴影中生活的悲情、孤独和兴奋，包含了梅尔维尔拍摄过的最惊心动魄的抢劫场景之一。
hook_en: With his customary restraint and ruthless attention to detail, director Jean-Pierre Melville follows the parallel tracks of French underworld criminal Gu (the inimitable Lino Ventura), escaped from prison and roped into one last robbery, and the suave inspector, Blot (Paul Meurisse), relentlessly seeking him. The implosive Le deuxième souffle captures the pathos, loneliness, and excitement of a life in the shadows with methodical suspense and harrowing authenticity, and contains one of the most thrilling heist sequences Melville ever shot.

hook: 抒情而感人至深的《依然行走》（Aruitemo aruitemo）是当代日本大师是枝裕和迄今为止最具个人色彩的作品。这部影片是为了向他已故的母亲致敬而创作的，讲述了横山一家人聚集在一起进行纪念仪式的一天，其本质只是逐渐变得清晰。是枝裕和并没有专注于重大的戏剧性时刻，而是依靠简单的手势和家庭日常事务（尤其是烹饪）来唤起一个家庭的整个生活、深深的遗憾和日常的欢乐。 《依然行走》以生动、令人心碎的表演和温和的自然主义为特色，让人回想起导演早期的纪录片作品，是对我们之间纽带的非凡写照。
hook_en: The lyrical, profoundly moving Still Walking (Aruitemo aruitemo) is contemporary Japanese master Hirokazu Kore-eda's most personal work to date. Created as a tribute to his late mother, the film depicts one day in the life of the Yokoyamas, gathered together for a commemorative ritual whose nature only gradually becomes clear. Rather than focus on big dramatic moments, Kore-eda relies on simple gestures and domestic routines (especially cooking) to evoke a family’s entire life, its deep regrets and its daily joys. Featuring vivid, heartrending performances and a gentle naturalism that harks back to the director’s earlier, documentary work, Still Walking is an extraordinary portrayal of the ties that bind us.

hook: 20 世纪 60 年代初的革命性英国新浪潮电影因其对工人阶级生活和两性关系的毫不妥协的描述而闻名。 《蜂蜜的滋味》由这一运动的领军人物托尼·理查森执导，改编自当时最具争议的戏剧之一，丽塔·塔欣厄姆在她的明星处女作中饰演一个心怀不满的青少年，在工业曼彻斯特的经济绝望中寻找自己的出路，尽管她的母亲不在身边，自私自利。理查森的这部经典作品毫无歉意地认同社会弃儿，并对性和种族问题采取敏感、现代的态度，至今仍是一部令人震惊的现实主义标杆作品。
hook_en: The revolutionary British New Wave films of the early 1960s were celebrated for their uncompromising depictions of working-class lives and relations between the sexes. Directed by Tony Richardson, a leading light of that movement, and based on one of the most controversial plays of its time, A Taste of Honey features Rita Tushingham in her star-making debut role as a disaffected teenager finding her way amid the economic desperation of industrial Manchester, and despite her absent, self-absorbed mother. With its unapologetic identification with social outcasts and its sensitive, modern approach to matters of sexuality and race, Richardson’s classic is a still startling benchmark work of realism.

hook: 《最后一场电影》是美国七十年代电影复兴的重要影片之一，故事发生在五十年代初，德克萨斯州最偏僻的无处可去的地方，电影银幕上永远没有灰尘。这部关于濒临死亡的西部的痛苦肖像改编自拉里·麦克默特里的小说，聚焦于三个前途无量的青少年的日常洗牌——神秘的桑尼（蒂莫西·博特姆斯饰）、任性的运动员杜安（杰夫·布里吉斯饰）和渴望被崇拜的富家女杰西（赛比尔·谢泼德饰）——以及在夜里像漂流的风滚草一样撞到他们的衰老迷失的灵魂。这部对摇摇欲坠的美国价值观的安静描述以令人回味的黑白图像和深刻的表演为特色，仍然是无价的电影历史学家和导演彼得·博格丹诺维奇职业生涯中的关键作品。
hook_en: One of the key films of the American seventies cinema renaissance, The Last Picture Show is set in the early fifties, in the loneliest Texas nowheresville to ever dust up a movie screen. This aching portrait of a dying West, adapted from Larry McMurtry’s novel, focuses on the daily shuffles of three futureless teens—enigmatic Sonny (Timothy Bottoms), wayward jock Duane (Jeff Bridges), and desperate-to-be-adored rich girl Jacy (Cybill Shepherd)—and the aging lost souls who bump up against them in the night like drifting tumbleweeds. Featuring evocative black-and-white imagery and profoundly felt performances, this hushed depiction of crumbling American values remains the pivotal work in the career of invaluable film historian and director Peter Bogdanovich.

hook: 这部由苏联导演埃莱姆·克里莫夫 (Elem Klimov) 执导的传奇电影令人震撼地陷入了战争中非人性的恐怖之中。当纳粹军队侵占他位于现在的白俄罗斯的小村庄时，少年弗洛拉（阿列克谢·克拉夫琴科，阿列克谢·克拉夫琴科饰）急切地加入了苏联抵抗运动。他发现的并不是他想象中的冒险和荣耀，而是一场令人难以想象的大屠杀和残酷的噩梦——克里莫夫主观的摄影作品和表现主义的声音设计以狂热、超凡脱俗的强度呈现出来。苏联审查机构花了七年时间才批准其剧本，差点阻止其制作，《来看看》也许是有史以来最发自肺腑、最令人难忘的反战电影。
hook_en: This legendary film from Soviet director Elem Klimov is a senses-shattering plunge into the dehumanizing horrors of war. As Nazi forces encroach on his small village in what is now known as Belarus, teenage Flyora (Alexei Kravchenko, in a searing depiction of anguish) eagerly joins the Soviet resistance. Rather than the adventure and glory he envisioned, what he finds is a waking nightmare of unimaginable carnage and cruelty—rendered with a feverish, otherworldly intensity by Klimov’s subjective camera work and expressionistic sound design. Nearly blocked from being made by Soviet censors, who took seven years to approve its script, Come and See is perhaps the most visceral, impossible-to-forget antiwar film ever made.

hook: 沃尔克·施隆多夫 (Volker Schlöndorff) 将贝尔托·布莱希特 (Bertolt Brecht) 1918 年的处女作搬到当代西德，进行了近半个世纪以来罕见的恶毒改编实验。莱纳·维尔纳·法斯宾德浑身散发着野蛮的魅力，是同名无政府主义诗人的化身，他感到资产阶级社会拒绝了他，并开始了一场喝着杜松子酒的暴行。施伦多夫忠实地遵循布莱希特的文本，将散文的戏剧性与简单的手持式 16 毫米摄影作品并置，为这个野蛮的叛逆故事提供了直接性。 《巴尔》的配角阵容来自法斯宾德的戏剧演员团，其中还包括玛格丽特·冯·特罗塔，《巴尔》展示了其导演、德国新电影先驱者毫不妥协的愿景。
hook_en: Volker Schlöndorff transported Bertolt Brecht’s 1918 debut play to contemporary West Germany for this vicious experiment in adaptation, seldom seen for nearly half a century. Oozing with brutish charisma, Rainer Werner Fassbinder embodies the eponymous anarchist poet, who feels that bourgeois society has rejected him and sets off on a schnapps-soaked rampage. Hewing faithfully to Brecht’s text, Schlöndorff juxtaposes the theatricality of the prose with bare-bones, handheld 16 mm camera work, which gives immediacy to this savage story of rebellion. Featuring a supporting cast drawn from Fassbinder’s troupe of theater actors that also includes Margarethe von Trotta, Baal demonstrates the uncompromising vision of its director, a trailblazer of the New German Cinema.

hook: 奥利维耶·阿萨亚斯在这部风靡全球的电影中，由魅力四射的张曼玉饰演自己的另一个版本：一位香港动作片明星抵达巴黎，在翻拍自路易斯·弗亚德经典无声犯罪连续剧《吸血鬼》中扮演乳胶女主角。她发现幕后发生了一场几乎无法控制的混乱：自我冲突、浪漫吸引力酝酿，以及一位痴迷的导演（精明的演员让-皮埃尔·利奥饰）将自己推向边缘以实现他的愿景。阿萨亚斯在《Irma Vep》中将无声电影、武打电影以及《音速青年》和《露娜》的音乐融入到一种梦幻般的后现代酷感漩涡中，在《Irma Vep》中对九十年代的法国电影业以及艺术与商业娱乐之间长期存在的紧张关系进行了诙谐的批评。
hook_en: Olivier Assayas’s live-wire international breakthrough stars a magnetic Maggie Cheung as a version of herself: a Hong Kong action-movie star who arrives in Paris to play the latex-clad lead in a remake of Louis Feuillade’s classic silent crime serial Les vampires. What she finds is a behind-the-scenes tangle of barely controlled chaos as egos clash, romantic attractions simmer, and an obsessive director (a cannily cast Jean-Pierre Léaud) drives himself to the brink to realize his vision. Blending blasts of silent cinema, martial-arts flicks, and the music of Sonic Youth and Luna into a hallucinatory swirl of postmodern cool, Assayas composes in Irma Vep a witty critique of the nineties French film industry and the perennial tension between art and commercial entertainment.

hook: 比利·怀尔德的《底牌王牌》是好莱坞电影制片人对美国文化最严厉的控诉之一。柯克·道格拉斯 (Kirk Douglas) 演绎了他职业生涯中最激烈的表演，饰演查克·塔图姆 (Chuck Tatum)，一名不道德的报社记者，在阿尔伯克基的死胡同里被冲走，偶然发现了一生中难得一见的独家新闻，并会不择手段地继续成为耸人听闻的头条新闻。怀尔德的《日落大道》的后续作品是一个更加黑暗的愿景，毫无限制地揭露了美国媒体对轰动效应的追求，而随着时间的推移，这种追求只会变得更加重要。
hook_en: Billy Wilder’s Ace in the Hole is one of the most scathing indictments of American culture ever produced by a Hollywood filmmaker. Kirk Douglas gives the fiercest performance of his career as Chuck Tatum, an amoral newspaper reporter who washes up in dead-end Albuquerque, happens upon the scoop of a lifetime, and will do anything to keep getting the lurid headlines. Wilder’s follow-up to Sunset Boulevard is an even darker vision, a no-holds-barred exposé of the American media’s appetite for sensation that has gotten only more relevant with time.

hook: 这部引人回味、令人难忘的剧情片以 1945 年废墟遍地的柏林为背景，与其他讲述二战后犹太裔德国身份的电影不同。一位前歌舞表演歌手（妮娜·霍斯，在一场令人眼花缭乱、多层次的表演中）从奥斯维辛幸存下来后，她被毁容的脸被重建，并返回饱受战争蹂躏的家乡寻找她的外邦丈夫，他可能会也可能不会向纳粹出卖她。在没有认出她的情况下，他让她在一个离奇的破碎镜子大厅的故事中扮演他的妻子，这个故事既充满了丰富的隐喻，又极其引人入胜。复仇电影还是浪漫和解的故事？直到当代德国电影最重要的人物之一克里斯蒂安·佩措尔德（Christian Petzold）的这部奇迹的精彩结尾场景，人们才知道。
hook_en: This evocative and haunting drama, set in rubble-strewn Berlin in 1945, is like no other film about post–World War II Jewish-German identity. After surviving Auschwitz, a former cabaret singer (Nina Hoss, in a dazzling, multilayered performance) has her disfigured face reconstructed and returns to her war-ravaged hometown to seek out her gentile husband, who may or may not have betrayed her to the Nazis. Without recognizing her, he enlists her to play his wife in a bizarre hall-of-shattered-mirrors story that is as richly metaphorical as it is preposterously engrossing. Revenge film or tale of romantic reconciliation? One doesn’t know until the superb closing scene of this marvel from Christian Petzold, one of the most important figures in contemporary German cinema.

hook: 一个傲慢早熟的十岁女孩（凯瑟琳·德蒙杰特饰）和她放荡的叔叔（菲利普·诺瓦雷饰）来到巴黎度过一个旋风般的周末；然而，在路易斯·马勒的这部无政府主义喜剧中，他和观众得到的比他们预想的要多，这部喜剧对光之城进行了粗暴对待。马勒的大胆作品《地铁里的扎齐》改编自雷蒙德·格诺的一部被认为不合时宜的流行小说，充满了法国新浪潮尖端的天赋，充满了意识流闹剧，充满了视觉笑料、剪辑技巧和特效。
