hook_en: A brash and precocious ten-year-old (Catherine Demongeot) comes to Paris for a whirlwind weekend with her rakish uncle (Philippe Noiret); he and the viewer get more than they bargained for, however, in this anarchic comedy from Louis Malle, which rides roughshod over the City of Light. Based on a popular novel by Raymond Queneau that had been considered unadaptable, Malle’s audacious Zazie dans le métro, made with flair on the cusp of the French New Wave, is a bit of stream-of-consciousness slapstick, wall-to-wall with visual gags, editing tricks, and effects.

hook: 在这部由路易斯·马勒执导的引人入胜且富有哲理的电影中，演员兼剧作家华莱士·肖恩与他的朋友、戏剧导演安德烈·格雷戈里坐在纽约上西区的一家餐厅里，两人对爱、死亡、金钱以及其间的所有迷信进行了一段时而异想天开、时而绝望的忏悔。肖恩和格雷戈里（他们也共同撰写了剧本）根据自己在纽约磨练的角色扮演了不同的角色，带着内省的知识热情投入其中，而马勒以一种微妙、巧妙的超然捕捉到了这一切。 《我与安德烈的晚餐》是一部迷人的国际化文化定格画面，至今仍然是电影史上独一无二的作品。
hook_en: In this captivating and philosophical film directed by Louis Malle, actor and playwright Wallace Shawn sits down with his friend the theater director André Gregory at a restaurant on New York’s Upper West Side, and the pair proceed through an alternately whimsical and despairing confessional about love, death, money, and all the superstition in between. Playing variations on their own New York–honed personas, Shawn and Gregory, who also cowrote the screenplay, dive in with introspective intellectual gusto, and Malle captures it all with a delicate, artful detachment. A fascinating freeze-frame of cosmopolitan culture, My Dinner with André remains a unique work in cinema history.

hook: 让-皮埃尔·利奥德在令人愉悦的《偷吻》中回归，这是安东尼·杜瓦内尔系列的第三部。现在是 1968 年，顽皮且永远痴情的杜瓦内尔被不光彩地从军队退伍，并被释放到巴黎街头，在那里他偶然进入了看似不太可能的私人侦探职业，并开始了一系列不幸的冒险。异想天开、怀旧而又难以抑制的浪漫，《偷吻》是弗朗索瓦·特吕弗对青春的激情和冲动的永恒颂歌。
hook_en: Jean-Pierre Léaud returns in the delightful Stolen Kisses, the third installment in the Antoine Doinel series. It is now 1968, and the mischievous and perpetually lovestruck Doinel has been dishonorably discharged from the army and released onto the streets of Paris, where he stumbles into the unlikely profession of private detective and embarks on a series of misadventures. Whimsical, nostalgic, and irrepressibly romantic, Stolen Kisses is François Truffaut’s timeless ode to the passion and impetuosity of youth.

hook: 在《冲击走廊》中，伟大的美国作家兼导演兼制片人塞缪尔·富勒（ Samuel Fuller ）巧妙地描绘了理智和疯狂之间的不安地带。为了获得普利策奖，记者约翰尼·巴雷特（ Johnny Barrett ） （彼得·布雷克Peter Breck饰）亲自前往一家精神病院调查一起谋杀案。当他接近凶手时，精神错乱笼罩着他。Constance Towers扮演Johnny冷静的脱衣舞女友。它对种族主义和其他令人吃惊的评论…
hook_en: In Shock Corridor, the great American writer-director-producer Samuel Fuller masterfully charts the uneasy terrain between sanity and madness. Seeking a Pulitzer Prize, reporter Johnny Barrett (Peter Breck) has himself committed to a mental hospital to investigate a murder. As he closes in on the killer, insanity closes in on him. Constance Towers costars as Johnny’s coolheaded stripper girlfriend. With its startling commentary on racism and other hot-button issues in sixties America and its daring photography by Stanley Cortez, Shock Corridor has had far-reaching influence.

hook: 制片人 Val Lewton 为雷电华影业制作的第一部恐怖电影重新定义了这一类型，将最可怕的恐怖留给观众想象。西蒙·西蒙 (Simone Simon) 饰演曼哈顿的一名塞尔维亚移民，她相信，由于古老的诅咒，与她所爱的男人（肯特·史密斯饰）的任何身体亲密接触都会让她变成猫科掠食者。卢顿是一位完美的制片人兼导演，负责监督项目的各个方面，他在雅克·图尔尼尔身上找到了理想的导演，雅克·图尔尼尔是一位明暗对比造型师，擅长用令人震惊的构图和心理暗示让观众保持不平衡。他们共同避开了早期怪物电影的预设效果，转而采用微妙的阴影和创意音频提示来震撼人心。 《猫人》是该工作室 20 世纪 40 年代最成功的电影之一，将生物特征的复杂性和神秘性提升到了新的高度。
hook_en: The first of the horror films producer Val Lewton made for RKO Pictures redefined the genre by leaving its most frightening terrors to its audience’s imagination. Simone Simon stars as a Serbian émigré in Manhattan who believes that, because of an ancient curse, any physical intimacy with the man she loves (Kent Smith) will turn her into a feline predator. Lewton, a consummate producer-auteur who oversaw every aspect of his projects, found an ideal director in Jacques Tourneur, a chiaroscuro stylist adept at keeping viewers off-kilter with startling compositions and psychological innuendo. Together, they eschewed the canned effects of earlier monster movies in favor of shocking with subtle shadows and creative audio cues. One of the studio’s most successful movies of the 1940s, Cat People raised the creature feature to new heights of sophistication and mystery.

hook: 《一一》由已故台湾电影大师杨德昌执导，讲述了台北一个中产阶级家庭的故事，历时一年，从一场婚礼开始，到一场葬礼结束。无论是记录中年父亲 NJ 与旧情人的试探性调情，还是早熟的小儿子阳阳试图用他心爱的相机捕捉现实，电影制片人巧妙地为每一个华丽的画面注入了富有同情心的清晰度。这部温馨、宏大、令人眼花缭乱的史诗是二十一世纪无可争议的杰作之一。
hook_en: The extraordinary, internationally embraced Yi Yi, directed by the late Taiwanese master Edward Yang, follows a middle-class family in Taipei over the course of one year, beginning with a wedding and ending with a funeral. Whether chronicling middle-aged father NJ’s tentative flirtations with an old flame or precocious young son Yang-Yang’s attempts at capturing reality with his beloved camera, the filmmaker deftly imbues every gorgeous frame with a compassionate clarity. Warm, sprawling, and dazzling, this intimate epic is one of the undisputed masterworks of the twenty-first century.

hook: 如何描述大林信彦 1977 年难以形容的电影《豪斯》？作为一个迷幻的鬼故事？意识流睡前故事？马里奥·巴瓦 (Mario Bava) 执导的史酷比 (Scooby-Doo) 剧集？以上任何内容都适合这个幻觉的头部之旅，讲述的是一名女学生与六名同学前往她生病的姨妈破旧的乡间别墅，并与恶灵、一只恶魔家猫、一架嗜血的钢琴和其他可怕的景象面对面，所有这些都是由大林通过遮罩、动画和拼贴效果实现的。同样荒谬和噩梦的是，豪斯可能是从其他星球传送到地球的。这是多年来最激动人心的邪教发现之一，这在美国的家庭视频中从未出现过。
hook_en: How to describe Nobuhiko Obayashi’s indescribable 1977 movie House (Hausu)? As a psychedelic ghost tale? A stream-of-consciousness bedtime story? An episode of Scooby-Doo as directed by Mario Bava? Any of the above will do for this hallucinatory head trip about a schoolgirl who travels with six classmates to her ailing aunt’s creaky country home and comes face-to-face with evil spirits, a demonic house cat, a bloodthirsty piano, and other ghoulish visions, all realized by Obayashi via mattes, animation, and collage effects. Equally absurd and nightmarish, House might have been beamed to Earth from some other planet. Never before available on home video in the United States, it’s one of the most exciting cult discoveries in years.

hook: 约翰·沃特斯的第二部长片极其怪诞，充满了各种各样的堕落，从抢劫到谋杀，再到电影中最令人难忘的亵渎时刻之一。影片在沃特斯的家乡巴尔的摩制作，预算有限，几乎所有技术任务都由电影制作人承担，这部对那个时代和平与爱的精神的欢乐嘲讽以“变态行列”为特色，这是一部由一群格格不入的剧团组成的巡回演出，他们的令人震惊的癖好只有他们的领导者的才能最令人震惊：比华丽、传奇般的神圣，在发现她爱人的外遇后，开始流血。 《多重狂人》由沃特斯深受喜爱的常规演员“梦境者”（包括大卫·洛卡里、玛丽·维维安·皮尔斯、明克·斯托尔、苏珊·洛、伊迪丝·马西、乔治·费格斯和曲奇·米勒）主演，是一位艺术家数十年来顽强地测试高品味极限的无政府主义杰作。
hook_en: John Waters’ gloriously grotesque second feature is replete with all manner of depravity, from robbery to murder to one of cinema’s most memorably blasphemous moments. Made on a shoestring budget in Waters’ native Baltimore, with the filmmaker taking on nearly every technical task, this gleeful mockery of the peace-and-love ethos of its era features the Cavalcade of Perversion, a traveling show mounted by a troupe of misfits whose shocking proclivities are topped only by those of their leader: the glammer-than-glam, larger-than-life Divine, out for blood after discovering her lover’s affair. Starring members of Waters’ beloved regular cast, the Dreamlanders (including David Lochary, Mary Vivian Pearce, Mink Stole, Susan Lowe, Edith Massey, George Figgs, and Cookie Mueller), Multiple Maniacs is an anarchic masterwork from an artist who has doggedly tested the limits of good taste for decades.

hook: 多产的香港导演杜琪峰最具个人色彩的电影之一是一封写给黑泽明电影以及柔道艺术和哲学的激动人心的情书。在香港黑社会的霓虹灯笼罩的夜总会和赌博场所中，三个流浪灵魂的命运——前柔道冠军现在成为酒吧老板（古天乐饰）、一心想挑战他的年轻拳击手（郭富城饰）和追逐明星梦想的歌手（应采儿饰）——在人类痛苦、野心、毅力和毅力的歌剧爆炸中碰撞。救赎。 《To》向黑泽明的处女作《菅田三四郎》致敬，将狂野的喜剧、抒情的超现实主义和激动人心的武术动作融合在一起，最终成为一首感人至深的颂歌，颂扬友谊的治愈力量。
hook_en: One of the most personal films by the prolific Hong Kong auteur Johnnie To is a thrilling love letter to both the cinema of Akira Kurosawa and the art and philosophy of judo. Amid the neon-drenched nightclubs and gambling dens of Hong Kong’s nocturnal underworld, the fates of three wandering souls—a former judo champion now barely scraping by as an alcoholic bar owner (Louis Koo), a young fighter (Aaron Kwok) intent on challenging him, and a singer (Cherrie Ying) chasing dreams of stardom—collide in an operatic explosion of human pain, ambition, perseverance, and redemption. Paying offbeat homage to Kurosawa’s debut feature, Sanshiro Sugata, To scrambles wild comedy, flights of lyrical surrealism, and rousing martial-arts action into what is ultimately a disarmingly touching ode to the healing power of friendship.

hook: 1940年，阿尔弗雷德·希区柯克正式从英国电影业转向好莱坞。这是不平凡的一年：他的前两部美国电影《丽贝卡》和《外国记者》均获得奥斯卡最佳影片提名。尽管《丽贝卡》占了上风，但《外国记者》却是希奇电影中更为典型的一部。这是一部全力以赴的间谍惊悚片，由乔尔·麦克雷 (Joel McCrea) 主演，饰演一名被派往欧洲获取即将到来的战争独家新闻的美国扬克绿军记者。整部影片妙语连珠，情节曲折，扣人心弦，悬念迭出，其中包括具有惊人特效的海上飞机失事高潮。 《外国记者》值得与《三十九级台阶》和《西北偏北》并称为大师最伟大的冒险之一。
hook_en: In 1940, Alfred Hitchcock made his official transition from the British film industry to Hollywood. And it was quite a year: his first two American movies, Rebecca and Foreign Correspondent, were both nominated for the best picture Oscar. Though Rebecca prevailed, Foreign Correspondent is the more quintessential Hitch film. A full-throttle espionage thriller, starring Joel McCrea as a green Yank reporter sent to Europe to get the scoop on the imminent war, it’s wall-to-wall witty repartee, head-spinning plot twists, and brilliantly mounted suspense set pieces, including an ocean plane crash climax with astonishing special effects. Foreign Correspondent deserves to be mentioned alongside The 39 Steps and North by Northwest as one of the master’s greatest adventures.

hook: 罗伯特·米彻姆 (Robert Mitchum) 在彼得·耶茨 (Peter Yates) 改编的乔治·V·希金斯 (George V. Higgins) 广受好评的小说《埃迪·科伊尔之友》(The Friends of Eddie Coyle) 中饰演小军火走私者埃迪·“手指”·科伊尔 (Eddie “Fingers” Coyle)，这是罗伯特·米彻姆 (Robert Mitchum) 传奇职业生涯中最出色的表演之一。科伊尔厌倦了世俗，勉强糊口，在肮脏的波士顿黑社会的边缘工作，只是为了维持生计。但当他发现自己面临第二次困难时，他被迫权衡对犯罪同僚的忠诚和为了保持自由而告密。这部影片以敏锐的眼光拍摄了残酷的场景，并以开放的心态对待了不那么英雄的角色，这是 20 世纪 70 年代好莱坞电影制作的真正瑰宝之一——一部在严酷无情的阳光下拍摄的悬疑犯罪剧。
hook_en: In one of the best performances of his legendary career, Robert Mitchum plays small-time gunrunner Eddie “Fingers” Coyle in an adaptation by Peter Yates of George V. Higgins’s acclaimed novel The Friends of Eddie Coyle. World-weary and living hand to mouth, Coyle works on the sidelines of the seedy Boston underworld just to make ends meet. But when he finds himself facing a second stretch of hard time, he’s forced to weigh loyalty to his criminal colleagues against snitching to stay free. Directed with a sharp eye for its gritty locales and an open heart for its less-than-heroic characters, this is one of the true treasures of 1970s Hollywood filmmaking—a suspenseful crime drama in stark, unforgiving daylight.

hook: 路易斯·马勒 (Louis Malle) 在其突破性作品《绞刑架电梯》中展现了珍妮·莫罗 (Jeanne Moreau) 的自然之美。在他的后续作品《情人》（Les amants）中，他一劳永逸地让她成为了明星。 《恋人》是一部感人至深、拍摄精美的成人童话故事，介于古典电影和新浪潮电影之间，将莫罗描绘成一位焦躁不安的资产阶级妻子，她的目光从丈夫和情人身上转移到一个迷人的路过陌生人（让-马克·博里饰）身上。由于其坦率的性取向，《恋人》引起了不小的轰动，在世界各地因淫秽而受到审查和攻击。如果今天它的震撼已经消退，那么它闪闪发光的性感和诱人的故事讲述却丝毫没有变老。
hook_en: Louis Malle unveiled the natural beauty of Jeanne Moreau in his breakthrough, Elevator to the Gallows. With his follow-up, the scandalous smash The Lovers (Les amants), he made her a star once and for all. A deeply felt and luxuriously filmed fairy tale for grown-ups, perched on the edge between classical and New Wave cinemas, The Lovers presents Moreau as a restless bourgeois wife whose eye wanders from both her husband and her lover to an attractive passing stranger (Jean-Marc Bory). Thanks to its frank sexuality, The Lovers caused quite a stir, being censored and attacked for obscenity around the world. If today its shock has worn off, its glistening sensuality and seductive storytelling haven't aged a day.

hook: 迪孔格-皮帕在《穆纳莫托》中打造了一种新的非洲电影语言，这是一个微妙、情感共鸣的爱情故事。在喀麦隆的一个村庄里，求爱和婚姻的严格习俗意味着，一对订婚的夫妇虽然深爱着，但可能会因为缺乏嫁妆和另一个男人索要年轻女子而破裂——这种破裂为父权社会与现代一代之间的冲突奠定了基础。明亮的黑白电影摄影和华丽的风格在这部强有力的描述中产生了令人难以忘怀的力量，通过倒叙讲述了后殖民主义的挑战以及社区拒绝偏离传统的毁灭性后果。
hook_en: Dikongué-Pipa forged a new African cinematic language in Muna moto, a delicate, emotionally resonant love story. In a Cameroon village, the rigid customs governing courtship and marriage mean that a betrothed couple, though deeply in love, can be torn apart by the lack of a dowry and another man’s claiming the young woman—a rupture that sets the stage for a clash between a patriarchal society and a modern generation. Luminous black-and-white cinematography and stylistic flourishes yield images of haunting power in this potent depiction, told via flashback, of the challenges of postcolonialism and the devastating consequences of a community’s refusal to deviate from tradition.

hook: 弗朗索瓦·特吕弗在《食宿》中描写了热情洋溢、不合时宜的安托万·杜瓦内尔，在这部编年史的第四部分中，我们不幸的英雄再次陷入了危机。杜瓦内尔（让-皮埃尔·利奥德饰）即将迎来第一个孩子，但仍在努力寻找稳定的工作，他与一名美丽的日本女子发生了关系，这可能会破坏他的婚姻。 《食宿》略显滑稽，带有一丝滑稽色彩，苦乐参半地讲述了年轻婚姻生活的艰辛以及青春期和成年之间的微妙界限。
hook_en: The fourth installment in François Truffaut’s chronicle of the ardent, anachronistic Antoine Doinel, Bed and Board, finds our hapless hero once again in crisis. Expecting his first child and still struggling to find steady employment, Doinel (Jean-Pierre Léaud) involves himself in a relationship with a beautiful Japanese woman that threatens to destroy his marriage. Lightly comic, with a touch of the burlesque, Bed and Board is a bittersweet look at the travails of young married life and the fine line between adolescence and adulthood.

hook: 在伟大的黑泽明这部强有力的早期黑色电影中，三船敏郎在银幕上突然出现，饰演一名情绪不稳定的肺结核罪犯，他与志村隆的疲惫不堪的医生建立了一种不太可能的关系。 《醉天使》以战后东京的泥泞沼泽和后巷为背景，是一个令人回味的、喜怒无常的快照，描绘了一个危险的时间和地点，以导演最令人难忘的暴力高潮之一为特色。
hook_en: In this powerful early noir from the great Akira Kurosawa, Toshiro Mifune bursts onto the screen as a volatile, tubercular criminal who strikes up an unlikely relationship with Takashi Shimura's jaded physician. Set in and around the muddy swamps and back alleys of postwar Tokyo, Drunken Angel is an evocative, moody snapshot of a treacherous time and place, featuring one of the director's most memorably violent climaxes.

hook: 安托万·杜瓦内尔再次出击！在弗朗索瓦·特吕弗传奇的最后一章中，我们发现三十多岁的杜瓦内尔（让-皮埃尔·利奥饰）愉快地结束了自己的婚姻，作为一名小说家享有一定的成功，并坚持他的浪漫幻想。新单身的杜伊内尔在萨宾（Sabine）身上找到了自己的爱慕对象，萨宾是一位唱片店女售货员，他对她的追求充满了热切的信念：没有爱，一个人就什么都不是。一路上，他重新认识了以前的恋人，并面对自己混乱的过去。在《奔跑的爱情》中，安托万·杜瓦内尔仍然恋爱着，因为他仍然恋爱着，所以他还活着。
hook_en: Antoine Doinel strikes again! In the final chapter of François Truffaut’s saga, we find Doinel (Jean-Pierre Léaud), now in his thirties, convivially concluding his marriage, enjoying moderate success as a novelist, and clinging to his romantic fantasies. The newly single Doinel finds an object of his affections in Sabine, a record-store salesgirl whom he pursues with the fervid belief that without love, one is nothing. Along the way, he renews his acquaintance with previous loves and confronts his own chaotic past. In Love on the Run, Antoine Doinel is still in love, and because he’s still in love, he’s still alive.

hook: 在其祖国，弗朗齐谢克·弗拉西尔 (František Vláčil) 执导的《市场拉扎洛娃》 (Marketa Lazarová) 被誉为捷克有史以来最伟大的电影；对于许多美国观众来说，这将是一个启示。改编自弗拉迪斯拉夫·万库拉 (Vladislav Vančura) 的小说，这部激动人心且诗意的描绘了两个敌对的中世纪氏族之间的争斗，是一部激烈、史诗般且精心设计的作品，唤起了基督教与异教、人类与自然、爱与暴力之间的冲突。弗拉西尔的做法是重新创造很久以前生活方式的质感和心态，而不是制作一部传统的历史剧，其结果是令人眼花缭乱的。凭借其创造性的宽银幕摄影、剪辑和声音设计，《玛卡塔·拉扎洛娃》是一部实验性动作片。
hook_en: In its native land, František Vláčil’s Marketa Lazarová has been hailed as the greatest Czech film ever made; for many U.S. viewers, it will be a revelation. Based on a novel by Vladislav Vančura, this stirring and poetic depiction of a feud between two rival medieval clans is a fierce, epic, and meticulously designed evocation of the clashes between Christianity and paganism, humankind and nature, love and violence. Vláčil’s approach was to re-create the textures and mentalities of a long-ago way of life, rather than to make a conventional historical drama, and the result is dazzling. With its inventive widescreen cinematography, editing, and sound design, Marketa Lazarová is an experimental action film.

hook: 当一位无能的斯洛伐克农民被纳粹支持的镇上老板任命为一位犹太老寡妇纽扣店的“雅利安控制者”时，他在贪婪和罪恶感之间左右为难。在这部严厉的探索中，幽默与悲剧融为一体，探讨了一个懦弱的人在极权主义政权的恐怖中的共谋。 《大街上的商店》拍摄于苏联对捷克斯洛伐克的压迫最严重时期，剪辑和摄影工作十分紧张，并于 1965 年荣获奥斯卡最佳外语片奖。
hook_en: An inept Slovak peasant is torn between greed and guilt when the Nazi-backed bosses of his town appoint him “Aryan controller” of an old Jewish widow’s button shop. Humor and tragedy fuse in this scathing exploration of one cowardly man’s complicity in the horrors of a totalitarian regime. Made near the height of Soviet oppression in Czechoslovakia, The Shop on Main Street features intense editing and camera work which won it the Academy Award™ for Best Foreign Film in 1965.

hook: 路易斯·马勒凭借《恋人》和《地铁里的扎齐》等开创性的大众作品获得国际赞誉后，他的《内心之火》（Le feu follet）给他的歌迷带来了震撼，这是一部对个人和社会惯性的深入研究。莫里斯·罗内（《绞刑架电梯》）在一场内爆而闹鬼的表演中，扮演阿兰·勒罗伊，一位自我毁灭的作家，他决心自杀，并在接下来的二十四小时里试图与一群任性的朋友重新建立联系。 《内心之火》毫不留情地描绘了阿兰内心的混乱，拍摄极其清晰，是马勒最黑暗、最个人化的电影之一。
hook_en: After garnering international acclaim for such seminal crowd-pleasers as The Lovers and Zazie dans le métro, Louis Malle gave his fans a shock with The Fire Within (Le feu follet), a penetrating study of individual and social inertia. Maurice Ronet (Elevator to the Gallows), in an implosive, haunted performance, plays Alain Leroy, a self-destructive writer who resolves to kill himself and spends the next twenty-four hours trying to reconnect with a host of wayward friends. Unsparing in its portrait of Alain’s inner turmoil and shot with remarkable clarity, The Fire Within is one of Malle's darkest and most personal films.

hook: 保罗·莫里西（ Paul Morrissey ）对现代价值观的道德取向是幽默、恐怖和性的厚颜无耻的混合体，也是对这部恐怖电影粉丝的启示。在《Blood for Dracula》中，臭名昭著的伯爵在意大利搜索处女血。Criterion在宽屏转换中呈现了这一令人发指的邪教经典的长期压抑的导演剪辑。
hook_en: Paul Morrissey’s moralistic take on modern values is a brash mixture of humor, horror, and sex—and a revelation to fans of the horror film. In Blood for Dracula, the infamous count searches Italy for virgin blood. Criterion presents the long-suppressed director's cut of this outrageous cult classic in a widescreen transfer.

hook: 小骗子斯基普·麦考伊（理查德·威德马克饰）一心只想着大事。当这位自大的三犯犯拿起毫无戒心的坎迪（吉恩·彼得斯饰）的钱包时，他发现了比他想象的更惊人的收获：一张载有美国机密信息的缩微胶卷。在操纵欲强的联邦调查局和不知情的信使的共产主义傀儡的跟踪下，斯基普和坎迪发现自己陷入了一场危险的游戏，贪婪与救赎、正义与红色、激情与自我保护相互对立。 《南街上的搭讪》拥有令人眼花缭乱的演员阵容和编剧兼导演塞缪尔·富勒标志性的冷酷对答和原始能量，是美国最热情的电影工匠之一制作的真正的黑色电影经典。
hook_en: Petty crook Skip McCoy (Richard Widmark) has his eyes fixed on the big score. When the cocky three-time convict picks the pocketbook of unsuspecting Candy (Jean Peters), he finds a more spectacular haul than he could have imagined: a strip of microfilm bearing confidential U.S. information. Tailed by manipulative Feds and the unwitting courier’s Communist puppeteers, Skip and Candy find themselves in a precarious gambit that pits greed against redemption, right against Red, and passion against self-preservation. With its dazzling cast and writer-director Samuel Fuller’s signature hard-boiled repartee and raw energy, Pickup on South Street is a true film noir classic by one of America’s most passionate cinematic craftspeople.

hook: 在这部超自然的怪诞经典中，维罗妮卡·莱克饰演一位迷人的复仇女巫，施展了诱人的魔咒。在咒骂将她送上火刑柱的塞勒姆清教徒的男性后裔之后，这个拿着扫帚的金发美女发现自己被其中一个人所吸引——一位未来的州长（弗雷德里克·马奇饰）即将与一位被宠坏的社交名流（苏珊·海沃德饰）结婚。 《我嫁给了女巫》是富有创意的法国导演雷内·克莱尔在好莱坞拍摄的最令人愉悦的电影，它是一部喜剧甜点，充满了俏皮的特效和闪闪发光的俏皮话。
hook_en: Veronica Lake casts a seductive spell as a charmingly vengeful sorceress in this supernatural screwball classic. Many centuries after cursing the male descendants of the Salem puritan who sent her to the stake, this blonde bombshell with a broomstick finds herself drawn to one of them—a prospective governor (Fredric March) about to marry a spoiled socialite (Susan Hayward). The most delightful of the films the innovative French director René Clair made in Hollywood, I Married a Witch is a comic confection bursting with playful special effects and sparkling witticisms.

hook: 由阿尔弗雷德·希区柯克执导的心跳加速谍战片，《三十九级台阶》讲述了理查德·汉尼（罗伯特·邓特饰）如何偶然发现了一个阴谋，并卷入了一场在苏格兰高地的激烈追逐——在这场追逐中，他既是追捕者也是被追捕者，同时与冷静的帕梅拉（玛德琳·卡罗尔饰）之间也产生了意想不到的爱情。改编自约翰·布查克兰的小说，这部经典错认惊悚片预示了希区柯克最著名的作品（尤其是《西北偏北》），并且仍然是他最聪明、最有趣的一部电影。
hook_en: A heart-racing spy story by Alfred Hitchcock, The 39 Steps follows Richard Hannay (Robert Donat) as he stumbles upon a conspiracy that thrusts him into a hectic chase across the Scottish moors—a chase in which he is both the pursuer and the pursued—as well as into an unexpected romance with the cool Pamela (Madeline Carroll). Adapted from a novel by John Buchan, this classic wrong-man thriller from the Master of Suspense anticipates the director’s most famous works (especially North by Northwest), and remains one of his cleverest and most entertaining films.

hook: 吉米·亨德里克斯和奥蒂斯·雷丁抵达加州时几乎无人知晓。亨德里克斯从伦敦开始了他的音乐生涯，从伦敦返回美国后，他在蒙特利爆发了，用他疯狂的六弦烟火让毫无戒心的观众震惊。雷丁是孟菲斯 Stax 唱片公司的一位受人尊敬的明星，他在他最好的也是最后的表演之一中诱惑了“爱的人群”。吉米演奏蒙特利和摇摇！蒙特利的奥蒂斯 (Otis at Monterey) 汇聚了这些传奇音乐家的全部表演，他们的表演已进入摇滚乐神话。
hook_en: Jimi Hendrix and Otis Redding arrived in California virtually unknown. Returning stateside from London, where he had moved to launch his musical career, Hendrix exploded at Monterey, flooring an unsuspecting audience with his maniacal six-string pyrotechnics. Redding, a venerable star of Memphis's Stax record label, seduced the "love crowd" in one of his best—and last—performances. Jimi Plays Monterey and Shake! Otis at Monterey, feature the entire sets of these legendary musicians, performances that have entered rock-and-roll mythology.

hook: 让·皮埃尔·梅尔维尔的《火焰鲍勃》充满了讽刺幽默，将美国黑帮电影的强悍与高卢的精致融为一体，为法国新浪潮奠定了路线图。当霓虹灯熄灭，迎来又一个黎明时，一位上了年纪的赌徒在皮条客、金融家和天真的同伙组成的危险世界中穿梭，同时策划着最后的一桩——抢劫多维尔赌场。这部黑社会的礼仪喜剧拥有绿色粗呢呢的所有正式之美、技巧和诡谲的魅力。
hook_en: Suffused with wry humor, Jean-Pierre Melville’s Bob le flambeur melds the toughness of American gangster films with Gallic sophistication to lay the road map for the French New Wave. As the neon is extinguished for another dawn, an aging gambler navigates the treacherous world of pimps, moneymen, and naive associates while plotting one last score—the heist of the Deauville casino. This underworld comedy of manners possesses all the formal beauty, finesse, and treacherous allure of green baize.

hook: 设置是纯粹的纸浆：一名前妓女（饼干杰克Constance Towers ）搬迁到一个按钮式郊区，决心融入主流社会。但在作家兼导演兼制片人塞缪尔·富勒（ Samuel Fuller ）的陌生、幻觉的领域里，反常的秘密在健康的表面下酝酿。拥有激进的视觉触感，全速表演，斯坦利·科尔特斯（ Stanley Cortez ）出色的电影摄影，以及一个奇异美丽的音乐数字…
hook_en: The setup is pure pulp: A former prostitute (a crackerjack Constance Towers) relocates to a buttoned-down suburb, determined to fit in with mainstream society. But in the strange, hallucinatory territory of writer-director-producer Samuel Fuller, perverse secrets simmer beneath the wholesome surface. Featuring radical visual touches, full-throttle performances, brilliant cinematography by Stanley Cortez, and one bizarrely beautiful musical number, The Naked Kiss is among Fuller’s greatest, boldest entertainments.

hook: 尼古拉斯·雷 (Nicholas Ray) 的《比生命更伟大》(Bigger Than Life) 虽然在上映时被忽视，但现在已被公认为 20 世纪 50 年代最伟大的美国电影之一。当一位友好、成功的郊区教师兼父亲（詹姆斯·梅森扮演了他最不可磨灭的角色之一）因痛苦甚至可能致命的痛苦而服用可的松时，他对这种实验性药物上瘾了，导致他变成了一个精神病患者，最终变成了一个暴力的家庭暴君。这部艾森豪威尔时代的令人窒息的影片是在富有表现力的宽银幕电影中拍摄的，是对核心家庭的严厉批评。它发生在“父亲最了解”的日子，这使得它更加令人震惊，而且非常有趣。
hook_en: Though ignored at the time of its release, Nicholas Ray’s Bigger Than Life is now recognized as one of the great American films of the 1950s. When a friendly, successful suburban teacher and father (James Mason, in one of his most indelible roles) is prescribed cortisone for a painful, possibly fatal affliction, he grows dangerously addicted to the experimental drug, resulting in his transformation into a psychotic and ultimately violent household despot. This Eisenhower-era throat-grabber, shot in expressive CinemaScope, is an excoriating take on the nuclear family. That it came in the day of Father Knows Best makes it all the more shocking—and wildly entertaining.

hook: 导演约翰·布尔曼通过这部风格化的复仇惊悚片将黑帮戏剧带入了现代主义抽象的新领域，将锋芒毕露的低俗变成了万花筒般的心理谜题。李·马文扮演的神秘沃克是典型的酷派，在一次抢劫中被最好的朋友背叛并留下等死后，在一位疲惫不堪的前情妇（安吉·迪金森饰）的帮助下，他开始了残酷的复仇之旅，而她帮助他的动机也很复杂。布尔曼以超现实的波普艺术眼光捕捉洛杉矶的场景，发现了潜伏在城市阳光照射下的存在主义恐惧。
hook_en: Director John Boorman brought the gangster drama into new realms of modernist abstraction with this stylized revenge thriller, which transforms hard-edged pulp into a kaleidoscopic psychological puzzle. Lee Marvin is iconically cool as the enigmatic Walker, who, after he’s betrayed and left for dead by his best friend during a robbery, embarks on a brutal quest for vengeance, aided by a jaded ex-moll (a sensational Angie Dickinson) who has her own complex motives for helping him. Capturing Los Angeles locales with a surreal pop-art eye, Boorman locates the existential dread lurking beneath the city’s sunlit surface.

hook: 臭名昭著的佩佩·勒莫科（让·加宾在一场真正标志性的表演中饰演）是一名通缉犯：女人渴望他，竞争对手希望摧毁他，而法律却处处对他施加压力。在阿尔及尔迷宫般的卡斯巴监狱中，佩佩逃离了警察的追捕，直到一名巴黎花花公子迫使他冒着生命危险，一劳永逸地离开了监狱。朱利安·杜维维耶 (Julien Duvivier) 的《Pépé le moko》是 20 世纪最具影响力的电影之一，也是法国诗意现实主义的里程碑，在此以其完整版本呈现。
hook_en: The notorious Pépé le moko (Jean Gabin, in a truly iconic performance) is a wanted man: women long for him, rivals hope to destroy him, and the law is breathing down his neck at every turn. On the lam in the labyrinthine Casbah of Algiers, Pépé is safe from the clutches of the police--until a Parisian playgirl compels him to risk his life and leave its confines once and for all. One of the most influential films of the 20th century and a landmark of French poetic realism, Julien Duvivier's Pépé le moko is presented here in its full-length version.

hook: 谢尔盖·帕拉杰诺夫的杰作令人惊叹地融合了诗歌、民族志和电影，充满了令人难忘的图像和声音。在一系列融合触觉与抽象的画面中，《石榴的颜色》通过 18 世纪游吟诗人萨亚特·诺瓦 (Sayat-Nova) 的故事，复兴了亚美尼亚文化的辉煌，通过图像构图而非传统叙事描绘了他的智力、艺术和精神成长。这部电影的民间传说和隐喻背离了当时主导苏联电影的现实主义，导致当局阻止其发行，罕见的地下放映以重组的形式呈现。这个版本采用了最接近帕拉杰诺夫最初设想的剪辑，并通过修复为电影中对艺术和美最神秘的思考之一带来了新的生命。《石榴的颜色》由电影基金会的世界电影项目和博洛尼亚电影中心与亚美尼亚国家电影中心和俄罗斯电影基金会联合修复，并由物质世界慈善基金会资助。
hook_en: A breathtaking fusion of poetry, ethnography, and cinema, Sergei Parajanov’s masterwork overflows with unforgettable images and sounds. In a series of tableaux that blend the tactile with the abstract, The Color of Pomegranates revives the splendors of Armenian culture through the story of the eighteenth-century troubadour Sayat-Nova, charting his intellectual, artistic, and spiritual growth through iconographic compositions rather than traditional narrative. The film’s tapestry of folklore and metaphor departed from the realism that dominated the Soviet cinema of its era, leading authorities to block its distribution, with rare underground screenings presenting it in a restructured form. This edition features the cut closest to Parajanov’s original vision, in a restoration that brings new life to one of cinema’s most enigmatic meditations on art and beauty.The Color of Pomegranates was restored by The Film Foundation’s World Cinema Project and the Cineteca di Bologna, in association with the National Cinema Centre of Armenia and Gosfilmofond of Russia, and funded by the Material World Charitable Foundation.

hook: 由英格玛·伯格曼执导的《耻辱》（Skammen）既是对二战暴力遗产的审视，也是对越南冲突升级的严厉回应。马克斯·冯·赛多 (Max von Sydow) 和丽芙·乌尔曼 (Liv Ullmann) 饰演音乐家，生活在一个偏远岛屿农场的安静隐居处，直到将他们赶出城市的内战又赶上了他们。在烟火和电影摄影师斯文·尼克维斯特的手持摄影作品生动地唤起的军事斗争的混乱中，两人面临着不可能的道德选择，这撕裂了他们的关系结构。这部电影包含伯格曼作品中一些最具破坏性的场景，展示了战争对个人生活的影响。
hook_en: Directed by Ingmar Bergman, Shame (Skammen) is at once an examination of the violent legacy of World War II and a scathing response to the escalation of the conflict in Vietnam. Max von Sydow and Liv Ullmann star as musicians living in quiet retreat on a remote island farm, until the civil war that drove them from the city catches up with them there. Amid the chaos of the military struggle, vividly evoked by pyrotechnics and by cinematographer Sven Nykvist’s handheld camera work, the two are faced with impossible moral choices that tear at the fabric of their relationship. This film, which contains some of the most devastating scenes in Bergman’s oeuvre, shows the impact of war on individual lives.

hook: 1992 年的总统选举不仅是比尔·克林顿 (Bill Clinton) 的胜利，也是引导他入主白宫的新一代战略家的胜利，并在此过程中改变了政治面貌。为了这部激动人心的幕后竞选记录，著名电影制片人克里斯·赫格杜斯 (Chris Hegedus) 和 D. A. 彭尼贝克 (D. A. Pennebaker) 捕捉到了克林顿精干顾问团队的集思广益和公牛会议，尤其是詹姆斯·卡维尔 (James Carville) 和乔治·斯特凡诺普洛斯 (George Stephanopoulos)，他们在竞选过程中注入了精明、年轻的精神和自发性，凭借自己的能力成为媒体明星。 《作战室》动作敏捷、娱乐性强，是对政治时刻的生动记录，其真理（“这是经济，愚蠢的！”）仍然在我们耳边回响。
hook_en: The 1992 presidential election was a triumph not only for Bill Clinton but also for the new breed of strategists who guided him to the White House—and changed the face of politics in the process. For this thrilling, behind-closed-doors account of that campaign, renowned cinema verité filmmakers Chris Hegedus and D. A. Pennebaker captured the brainstorming and bull sessions of Clinton’s crack team of consultants—especially James Carville and George Stephanopoulos, who became media stars in their own right as they injected a savvy, youthful spirit and spontaneity into the process of campaigning. Fleet-footed and entertaining, The War Room is a vivid document of a political moment whose truths (“It’s the economy, stupid!”) still ring in our ears.

hook: 富有且情感疏远的投资银行家尼古拉斯·范·奥顿（迈克尔·道格拉斯饰）在四十八岁生日那天收到了他那无所事事的弟弟（西恩·潘饰）送来的一份奇怪的礼物：一张游戏代金券，如果他同意玩这款游戏，将会改变他的生活。这样，一段兔子洞之旅就开始了，这对尼古拉斯和观众来说都是令人困惑、恐惧和兴奋的。这种多层次的、黑色的堕落到一个人的个人地狱也是一次超现实的、元电影般的旅程，在《Se7en》现象出现两年后，进一步证明了导演大卫·芬奇是好莱坞真正的当代梦想家之一。
hook_en: The enormously wealthy and emotionally remote investment banker Nicholas Van Orton (Michael Douglas) receives a strange gift from his ne’er-do-well younger brother (Sean Penn) on his forty-eighth birthday: a voucher for a game that, if he agrees to play it, will change his life. Thus begins a trip down the rabbit hole that is puzzling, terrifying, and exhilarating for Nicholas and viewers alike. This multilayered, noirish descent into one man’s personal hell is also a surreal, metacinematic journey that, two years after the phenomenon Se7en, further demonstrated that director David Fincher was one of Hollywood’s true contemporary visionaries.

hook: 在凯利·雷查特 (Kelly Reichardt) 的这部突破性专题片中，两位老朋友重聚，进行了一次悄然透露出真相的过夜露营之旅，这是一部对人物和男子气概的微预算研究，向许多观众介绍了当代美国电影中最独立的艺术家之一。即将成为父亲的马克（丹尼尔·伦敦饰）和游牧民族科特（威尔·奥德姆饰）驾车和步行前往树林中寻找僻静的温泉，他们试图重新建立联系的尝试不断遇到友谊的极限，也面临着自年轻时起他们的道路已经发生了多大分歧的现实。 《旧欢乐》改编自乔纳森·雷蒙德的短篇小说，配以大气的 Yo La Tengo 配乐，是一部令人沉思、讽刺地观察到的胜利，其规模不大，却掩盖了其丰富的洞察力。
hook_en: Two old friends reunite for a quietly revelatory overnight camping trip in this breakout feature from Kelly Reichardt, a microbudget study of character and masculinity that introduced many viewers to one of contemporary American cinema’s most independent artists. As expectant father Mark (Daniel London) and nomadic Kurt (Will Oldham) travel by car and foot into the woods in search of some secluded hot springs, their fumbling attempts to reconnect keep butting up against the limits of their friendship and the reality of how much their paths have diverged since their shared youth. Adapted from a short story by Jonathan Raymond and accompanied by an atmospheric Yo La Tengo score, Old Joy is a contemplative, wryly observed triumph whose modest scale belies the richness of its insight.

hook: 汤姆·考特尼 (Tom Courtenay) 饰演比利·费舍尔 (Billy Fisher)，他是一位成绩不佳的殡仪馆助理，他不断的白日梦和缺乏事实真相的故事为他赢得了“比利骗子”的绰号。朱莉·克里斯蒂是一位挥舞着手提包的魅力者，她的自由精神可能会激励比利最终搬出父母的房子。 《比利说谎者》巧妙地从坚韧的现实主义转向华丽的幻想，是一部令人眼花缭乱、喧闹的经典之作。
hook_en: Tom Courtenay gives a flawlessly nuanced performance as Billy Fisher, the underachieving undertaker’s assistant whose constant daydreams and truth-deficient stories earn him the nickname “Billy Liar.” Julie Christie is the handbag-swinging charmer whose free spirit just might inspire Billy to finally move out of his parents’ house. Deftly veering from gritty realism to flamboyant fantasy, Billy Liar is a dazzling and uproarious classic.

hook: 特里·茨维戈夫 (Terry Zwigoff) 于 1995 年拍摄的具有里程碑意义的电影是对地下艺术家罗伯特·克拉姆 (Robert Crumb) 的亲密纪实肖像，他独特的绘画风格以及性和种族挑衅性的主题使他在美国流行艺术中家喻户晓。茨维戈夫坦率、生动地探讨了克拉姆令人难以置信的职业和生活的细节，包括他的隐居怪人家庭，他们是你在银幕上见过的最杰出的人。 《克拉姆》既是一部深刻的传记肖像，也是对一个男人有争议的艺术的激烈审视，也是对一个陷入困境的家庭的毁灭性审视，是真正的美国原创作品。
hook_en: Terry Zwigoff’s landmark 1995 film is an intimate documentary portrait of the underground artist Robert Crumb, whose unique drawing style and sexually and racially provocative subject matter have made him a household name in popular American art. Zwigoff candidly and colorfully delves into the details of Crumb’s incredible career and life, including his family of reclusive eccentrics, some of the most remarkable people you’ll ever see on-screen. At once a profound biographical portrait, a riotous examination of a man’s controversial art, and a devastating look at a troubled family, Crumb is a genuine American original.

hook: 让-吕克·戈达尔对商业电影制作的颠覆性尝试是一部众星云集的大银幕史诗。 《蔑视》（Le Mépris）由米歇尔·皮科利（Michel Piccoli）饰演一名编剧，他在一位骄傲的欧洲导演（由传奇导演弗里茨·朗饰演）、一位粗鲁傲慢的美国制片人（杰克·帕兰斯饰演）和他幻灭的妻子卡米尔（碧姬·芭铎饰演）的要求之间左右为难，他试图修改新电影版《奥德赛》的剧本。 Criterion Collection 很荣幸地在新的特别版中呈现这部关于婚姻破裂、艺术妥协和电影制作过程的精彩研究。
hook_en: Jean-Luc Godard’s subversive foray into commercial filmmaking is a star-studded Cinemascope epic. Contempt (Le Mépris) stars Michel Piccoli as a screenwriter torn between the demands of a proud European director (played by legendary director Fritz Lang), a crude and arrogant American producer (Jack Palance), and his disillusioned wife, Camille (Brigitte Bardot), as he attempts to doctor the script for a new film version of The Odyssey. The Criterion Collection is proud to present this brilliant study of marital breakdown, artistic compromise, and the cinematic process in a new special edition.

hook: 肮脏的黑社会犯罪和 20 世纪 60 年代末伦敦的享乐主义摇滚反主流文化在这场令人费解、万花筒般的怪异事件中发生碰撞。一名冷酷无情的黑帮成员（詹姆斯·福克斯饰）为了躲避复仇心重的老板，躲进了一位隐居的摇滚明星（米克·贾格尔饰）和他的同伴（安妮塔·帕伦伯格和米歇尔·布雷顿饰）在诺丁山的家中，现实与幻想、男性与女性、人格与自我之间的界限在迷幻的迷雾中消失，他们打开了他的感知之门。唐纳德·卡梅尔 (Donald Cammell) 和尼古拉斯·罗伊格 (Nicolas Roeg) 之间的这一富有远见的合作以贾格尔最具吸引力的叙事电影表演为基础，是一次大胆越轨、影响深远的波西米亚黑暗面之旅。
hook_en: The grimy criminal underworld and hedonistic rock-and-roll counterculture of late-1960s London collide in this mind-scrambling, kaleidoscopic freak-out. On the run from his vengeful boss, a ruthless gangster (James Fox) hides out in the Notting Hill home of a reclusive rock star (Mick Jagger) and his companions (Anita Pallenberg and Michele Breton), who open the doors of his perception as the lines between reality and fantasy, male and female, persona and self, dissolve in a hallucinogenic haze. Built around Jagger’s most magnetic narrative-film performance, this visionary collaboration between Donald Cammell and Nicolas Roeg is a daringly transgressive, endlessly influential journey to the dark side of bohemia.

hook: 在这个优雅令人不安的谋杀之谜中，斯泰兰·斯卡斯加（ Stellan Skarsga ）饰演一位神秘的瑞典侦探，带着方格过去的他来到挪威北部的一个小镇，调查一名十几岁的女孩的死亡。随着他深入挖掘令人发指的杀戮事实，他自己的恶魔和暴虐的午夜太阳开始造成伤害。Erik Skjoldbjærg令人不寒而栗的程序的成功预示着国际上对Scandi的渴望…
hook_en: In this elegantly unsettling murder mystery, Stellan Skarsgård plays an enigmatic Swedish detective with a checkered past who arrives in a small town in northern Norway to investigate the death of a teenage girl. As he digs deeper into the facts surrounding the heinous killing, his own demons and the tyrannical midnight sun begin to take a toll. The success of Erik Skjoldbjærg’s chilling procedural anticipated the international hunger for Scandinavian noirs and serial- killer fictions, and the film features one of Skarsgård’s greatest performances.

hook: 让·雷诺阿的第二部有声电影，讲述了残酷的三角恋故事，是他精彩而辛辣的《游戏规则》的真正先驱，展示了电影制片人所有的视觉天才，并充分体现了他深刻的人性。米歇尔·西蒙扮演了一个悲剧性的角色，他是一位婚姻不幸的收银员和业余画家，他对一名妓女如此着迷，以至于他拒绝看到显而易见的事实：她和她的皮条客男友正在利用他。雷诺阿优雅的构图和镜头运动将这种扭曲的叙事——对阶级和性别划分的尖锐评论——带到了一个令人难忘的讽刺结论。
hook_en: Jean Renoir’s ruthless love triangle tale, his second sound film, is a true precursor to his brilliantly bitter The Rules of the Game, displaying all of the filmmaker’s visual genius and fully imbued with his profound humanity. Michel Simon cuts a tragic figure as an unhappily married cashier and amateur painter who becomes so smitten with a prostitute that he refuses to see the obvious: that she and her pimp boyfriend are taking advantage of him. Renoir’s elegant compositions and camera movements carry this twisting narrative—a stinging commentary on class and sexual divisions—to an unforgettably ironic conclusion.

hook: 继杰克·尼科尔森在《逍遥骑士》中饰演配角后，导演鲍勃·拉菲尔森在《轻松骑士》中为这位新星设计了一个强有力的主角，在《轻松骑士》中扮演角色。尼克尔森饰演如今标志性的流氓鲍比·杜佩亚 (Bobby Dupea)，他是一名三十多岁的石油钻井工人，也是一位毫无责任感的前钢琴神童，他带着蓝领女友（凯伦·布莱克 (Karen Black)，获得奥斯卡提名）回到童年时的中上阶层家庭，去看他疏远、患病的父亲。 《五件简单的作品》以其简单而坚韧的质感而著称，是 20 世纪 70 年代初期美国疏离感的一个持久例子。
hook_en: Following Jack Nicholson’s breakout supporting turn in Easy Rider, director Bob Rafelson devised a powerful leading role for the new star in the searing character study Five Easy Pieces. Nicholson plays the now iconic cad Bobby Dupea, a shiftless thirtysomething oil rigger and former piano prodigy immune to any sense of responsibility, who returns to his upper-middle-class childhood home, blue-collar girlfriend (Karen Black, in an Oscar-nominated role) in tow, to see his estranged, ailing father. Moving in its simplicity and gritty in its textures, Five Easy Pieces is a lasting example of early-1970s American alienation.

hook: 米开朗基罗·安东尼奥尼 20 世纪 60 年代的当代疏离全景是十年来定义的艺术事件，而他的第一部彩色电影《红色沙漠》也许是他最具划时代意义的电影。这种对科技时代精神荒凉的挑衅性视角——由安东尼奥尼缪斯莫妮卡·维蒂出色地描绘了一位心怀不满的女人，在被发电厂和环境毒素困扰的荒凉工业景观中漫步，并试探性地与理查德·哈里斯扮演的丈夫的同事调情——继续让观众着迷。 《红色沙漠》以一幅又一幅令人惊叹的绘画构图——废弃的渔村、电塔、若隐若现的停靠船只——创造了那个时代近乎世界末日的形象，并证实了安东尼奥尼作为现代电影杰出诗人的地位。
hook_en: Michelangelo Antonioni’s 1960s panoramas of contemporary alienation were decade-defining artistic events, and Red Desert, his first color film, is perhaps his most epochal. This provocative look at the spiritual desolation of the technological age—about a disaffected woman, brilliantly portrayed by Antonioni muse Monica Vitti, wandering through a bleak industrial landscape beset by power plants and environmental toxins, and tentatively flirting with her husband’s coworker, played by Richard Harris—continues to keep viewers spellbound. With one startling, painterly composition after another—of abandoned fishing cottages, electrical towers, looming docked ships—Red Desert creates a nearly apocalyptic image of its time, and confirms Antonioni as cinema’s preeminent poet of the modern age.

hook: 这部意大利导演莉莉安·卡万的 unsettling 悬疑片中，一位集中营幸存者（Charlotte Rampling饰）在二战后的维也纳发现，她的前折磨者和爱人（Dirk Bogarde饰）正在一家酒店做行李员。当这对夫妇试图重新创造他们的恋慕关系时，前SS成员开始跟踪他们。这部作品歌剧般且令人不安，电影《夜女仆》巧妙地探讨了纳粹政权对社会和心理的持久影响。
hook_en: In this unsettling drama from Italian filmmaker Liliana Cavani, a concentration camp survivor (Charlotte Rampling) discovers her former torturer and lover (Dirk Bogarde) working as a porter at a hotel in postwar Vienna. When the couple attempt to re-create their sadomasochistic relationship, his former SS comrades begin to stalk them. Operatic and disturbing, The Night Porter deftly examines the lasting social and psychological effects of the Nazi regime.

hook: 普利策奖得主、剧作家兼编剧大卫·马梅特首次担任这部狡猾、无情的惊悚片的导演。林赛·克劳斯 (Lindsay Crouse) 饰演一位畅销书作家兼治疗师，她希望通过偿还欠赌徒的钱来帮助客户。在她遇到了迷人的牌手（乔·曼特纳饰）后，当他引诱她进入他的高风险欺骗世界时，她自己的冲动开始发作。 《游戏之家》中充满了由马梅特常客以平稳精准的方式进行的尖锐对话，游戏中充满了曲折和心理敏锐，丰富的人物研究讲述了职业骗子针对下一个目标的冷酷计算。
hook_en: The Pulitzer Prize–winning playwright and screenwriter David Mamet sat in the director’s chair for the first time for this sly, merciless thriller. Lindsay Crouse stars as a best-selling author and therapist who wants to help a client by making restitution for the money he owes to a gambler. After she meets the attractive cardsharp (Joe Mantegna), her own compulsions take hold as he lures her into his world of high-stakes deception. Packed with razor-edged dialogue delivered with even-keeled precision by a cast of Mamet regulars, House of Games is as psychologically acute as it is full of twists and turns, a rich character study told with the cold calculation of a career con artist targeting his next mark.

hook: 编剧兼导演约翰·赛尔斯是美国社会结构的敏锐观察者，在这部庞大的新西部悬疑片中，他揭开了埋藏在德克萨斯州边境小镇之下的闹鬼过去。当沙漠中发现一具骷髅时，当地传奇警长的儿子执法官萨姆·迪兹（克里斯·库珀饰）开始了一项调查，这对他个人和整个里约县都将产生深远的影响，因为这个地方仍在思考其种族暴力的历史。塞尔斯的这部杰作影片情节复杂，具有小说风格，演员阵容十分出色，包括乔·莫顿、伊丽莎白·佩纳和克里斯·克里斯托佛森，悄然颠覆了国家神话，揭露了边境生活的断层线。
hook_en: A keen observer of America’s social fabric, writer-director John Sayles uncovers the haunted past buried beneath a small Texas border town in this sprawling neowestern mystery. When a skeleton is discovered in the desert, lawman Sam Deeds (Chris Cooper), son of a legendary local sheriff, begins an investigation that will have profound implications both for him personally and for all of Rio County, a place still reckoning with its history of racial violence. Sayles’s masterful film—novelistic in its intricacy and featuring a brilliant ensemble cast, including Joe Morton, Elizabeth Peña, and Kris Kristofferson—quietly subverts national mythmaking and lays bare the fault lines of life at the border.

hook: 谢尔盖·帕拉杰诺夫的现代主义地标性作品融合了民俗传统、万物有灵论的神秘主义和幻觉的视觉发明，是世界电影的一项伟大成就。 《被遗忘的祖先的阴影》改编自乌克兰作家 Mykhailo Kotsiubynskyi 1911 年的中篇小说，讲述了年轻的胡楚尔农民伊万科 (Ivan Mykolaichuk 饰) 的故事，他在试图摆脱初恋情人 Marichka (拉里莎·卡多奇尼科娃 Larysa Kadochnykova 饰) 的束缚时，经历了深深的悲伤和一线希望。帕拉杰诺夫的电影沉浸在喀尔巴阡山脉的朴实氛围中，以尤里·伊连科 (Yuri Illienko) 充满活力、色彩缤纷的电影摄影和拼贴画般的实验配乐为特色，是一部独特的神话艺术作品。
hook_en: A towering achievement of world cinema, Sergei Parajanov’s modernist landmark fuses folkloric traditions, animistic mysticism, and hallucinatory visual invention. Adapted from a 1911 novella by Ukrainian writer Mykhailo Kotsiubynskyi, Shadows of Forgotten Ancestors follows Ivanko (Ivan Mykolaichuk), a young Hutsul peasant who experiences both the depths of grief and glimmers of hope as he attempts to move beyond his first love, Marichka (an ethereal Larysa Kadochnykova). Steeped in the earthy atmosphere of the Carpathian Mountains, and featuring kinetic, radiantly colorful cinematography by Yuri Illienko and a collagelike experimental soundtrack, Parajanov’s film is a singularly mythopoeic work of art.

hook: 华莱士·肖恩 (Wallace Shawn) 和安德烈·格雷戈里 (André Gregory) 在《第 42 街》进行了精彩的电影实验《万尼亚》(Vanya) 二十年后，再度联手制作了经典戏剧的另一部独特的电影版本，这一次是亨利克·易卜生 (Henrik Ibsen) 的《建筑大师索尼斯》(Bygmester Solness)。这部引人注目的抽象作品由乔纳森·戴米 (Jonathan Demme) 搬上银幕，将肖恩 (Shawn (他也是改编作品的编剧)) 塑造成一位富有远见但专制的中年建筑师，被过去的人物所困扰，其中最引人注目的是一位迷人、活泼的年轻女子 (令人惊叹的新人丽莎·乔伊斯 (Lisa Joyce)) 出现在他的家门口。朱莉·哈格蒂 (Julie Hagerty)、拉里·派恩 (Larry Pine) 和建筑师格雷戈里 (Gregory) 等人的出色配角表演，就像万尼亚一样，是多年排练的成果，是一部生动、有呼吸、不断变化的作品，将戏剧、电影和梦想融为一体。
hook_en: Twenty years after their brilliant cinema-theater experiment Vanya on 42nd Street, Wallace Shawn and André Gregory reunited to produce another idiosyncratic film version of a classic play, this time Henrik Ibsen’s Bygmester Solness (Master Builder Solness). Brought pristinely to the screen by Jonathan Demme, this compellingly abstract reimagining features Shawn (who also wrote the adaptation) as a visionary but tyrannical middle-aged architect haunted by figures from his past, most acutely an attractive, vivacious young woman (the breathtaking newcomer Lisa Joyce) who has appeared on his doorstep. Also featuring standout supporting performances by Julie Hagerty, Larry Pine, and Gregory, A Master Builder, like Vanya, is the result of many years of rehearsals, a living, breathing, constantly shifting work that unites theater, film, and dream.

hook: 有《气喘吁吁》之前，也有《气喘吁吁》之后。让-吕克·戈达尔 (Jean-Luc Godard) 于 1960 年踏入电影界，以这种爵士乐、自由形式和性感的方式向美国电影类型致敬，这启发了他成为《电影手册》(Cahiers du cinéma) 的作家。由于其缺乏修饰、过度的态度、随心所欲的犯罪叙事，以及热情洋溢的年轻明星让·保罗·贝尔蒙多和让·塞伯格，《屏息》帮助发起了法国新浪潮，并确保了电影永远不会一样。
hook_en: There was before Breathless, and there was after Breathless. Jean-Luc Godard burst onto the film scene in 1960 with this jazzy, free-form, and sexy homage to the American film genres that inspired him as a writer for Cahiers du cinéma. With its lack of polish, surplus of attitude, anything-goes crime narrative, and effervescent young stars Jean-Paul Belmondo and Jean Seberg, Breathless helped launch the French New Wave and ensured that cinema would never be the same.

hook: 凭借其令人兴奋的娱乐性导演处女作，西德尼·波蒂埃与演员兼制片人哈里·贝拉方特一起改写了西部片的历史，将黑人英雄带入了一个他们一直被严重低估的类型。将喧闹的兄弟喜剧与黑人权力时代的激烈政治愤怒结合在一起，波蒂埃和顽皮的贝拉方特主演，饰演一位强硬而沉默寡言的马车主人和一位肆无忌惮、携带手枪的“传教士”，他们联手对抗白人赏金猎人，他们威胁着刚刚从奴隶制中解放出来的向西行进的大篷车。 《巴克与传教士》是一部精心制作的修正主义地标，它在每一个转折点都颠覆了好莱坞的惯例，并以黑人解放的名义重新夺回了西部类型。
hook_en: With his rousingly entertaining directorial debut, Sidney Poitier, alongside actor-producer Harry Belafonte, helped rewrite the history of the western, bringing Black heroes to a genre in which they had always been sorely underrepresented. Combining boisterous buddy comedy with blistering, Black Power–era political fury, Poitier and a marvelously mischievous Belafonte star as a tough and taciturn wagon master and an unscrupulous, pistol-packing “preacher,” who join forces in order to take on the white bounty hunters threatening a westward-bound caravan of people recently emancipated from slavery. A superbly crafted revisionist landmark, Buck and the Preacher subverts Hollywood conventions at every turn and reclaims the western genre in the name of Black liberation.

hook: 在巴黎度过了一个夏天，导演雅克·里维特与他的明星兼同谋朱丽叶·贝托和多米尼克·拉布里埃密切合作，开始本着纯粹游戏的精神重写电影规则——电影制作就像在想象的迷宫中随心所欲地嬉戏。其结果是法国新浪潮中最具创意和最迷人的电影之一，其中朱莉（拉博里尔饰），一个做白日梦的图书管理员，遇到了塞琳（贝托饰），一个神秘的魔术师，他们一起成为了一场扭曲时间的冒险的女主角，涉及鬼屋、精神糖果和谋杀之谜情节剧。 《席琳和朱莉去划船》融合了从刘易斯·卡罗尔到路易斯·费亚德的各种典故，既是有史以来最精彩的聚会喜剧之一，也是一个完全独特、包罗万象的电影梦想空间，让故事充满无尽的乐趣和可能性。
hook_en: Whiling away a summer in Paris, director Jacques Rivette, working in close collaboration with his stars and coconspirators Juliet Berto and Dominique Labourier, set out to rewrite the rules of cinema in the spirit of pure play—moviemaking as an anything-goes romp through the labyrinths of imagination. The result is one of the most exuberantly inventive and utterly enchanting films of the French New Wave, in which Julie (Labourier), a daydreaming librarian, meets Céline (Berto), an enigmatic magician, and together they become the heroines of a time-warping adventure involving a haunted house, psychotropic candy, and a murder-mystery melodrama. Incorporating allusions to everything from Lewis Carroll to Louis Feuillade, Céline and Julie Go Boating is both one of the all-time-great hangout comedies and a totally unique, enveloping cinematic dream space that delights in the endless pleasures and possibilities of stories.

hook: 法国大师马克斯·奥菲尔斯 (Max Ophuls) 最珍视的作品《德夫人的耳环》。 。 。这是一个情感深刻、电影风格充满冒险精神的故事，讲述了欺骗性的富裕和悲剧性的浪漫。当一位贵族女子只被称为德夫人。 。 。为了偿还债务，她卖掉了丈夫（查尔斯·博耶饰）送给她的一对耳环，引发了经济和肉体后果的连锁反应，最终只能以绝望告终。奥菲尔斯改编自路易丝·德·维尔莫兰精辟的世纪末小说，采用了优雅而精确的摄影作品，取得了令人着迷的效果，而这位导演正是以此而闻名。
hook_en: The most cherished work from French master Max Ophuls, The Earrings of Madame de . . . is a profoundly emotional, cinematographically adventurous tale of deceptive opulence and tragic romance. When an aristocratic woman known only as Madame de . . . (Danielle Darrieux) sells a pair of earrings given to her by her husband (Charles Boyer) in order to pay some debts, she sets off a chain reaction of financial and carnal consequences that can end only in despair. Ophuls’s adaptation of Louise de Vilmorin’s incisive fin de siècle novel employs to ravishing effect the elegant and precise camera work for which the director is so justly renowned.

hook: 三船敏郎饰演笹原伊三郎，一位年迈的剑客，过着平静的生活，直到他的氏族领主命令他的儿子娶领主的情妇，而后者最近惹恼了统治者。父子不情愿地收留了这名女子，令家人惊讶的是，这对年轻夫妇坠入爱河。但领主很快改变了决定，要求情妇回来。出乎所有人的意料，伊三郎和他的儿子冒着全家覆灭的风险拒绝了。小林正树导演的《武士叛乱》讲述了一个扣人心弦的故事，讲述了一个爱好和平的人最终决定采取立场反对不公正现象的故事。
hook_en: Toshiro Mifune stars as Isaburo Sasahara, an aging swordsman living a quiet life until his clan lord orders that his son marry the lord's mistress, who has recently displeased the ruler. Reluctantly, father and son take in the woman, and, to the family’s surprise, the young couple fall in love. But the lord soon reverses his decision and demands the mistress’s return. Against all expectations, Isaburo and his son refuse, risking the destruction of their entire family. Director Masaki Kobayashi's Samurai Rebellion is the gripping story of a peaceful man who finally decides to take a stand against injustice.

hook: 保罗·施拉德 (Paul Schrader) 为日本著名作家兼剧作家三岛由纪夫（绪方健饰演）绘制了一幅令人惊叹的拼贴画肖像，探讨了一个试图在自我、艺术和社会之间找到和谐这一不可能完成的任务的男人内心的混乱和矛盾。影片发生在三岛生命的最后一天，当时他进行了著名的公开切腹手术，影片中不时出现对作家过去的大量闪回，以及对他的虚构作品的华丽风格的回忆。凭借约翰·贝利 (John Bailey) 丰富的摄影、石冈英子 (Eiko Ishioka) 精美的布景和服装，以及菲利普·格拉斯 (Philip Glass) 令人难忘且极具影响力的配乐，《三岛：四章人生》不仅是对其主题的致敬，而且本身就是一部大胆的调查性艺术作品。
hook_en: Paul Schrader’s visually stunning, collagelike portrait of the acclaimed Japanese author and playwright Yukio Mishima (played by Ken Ogata) investigates the inner turmoil and contradictions of a man who attempted the impossible task of finding harmony among self, art, and society. Taking place on the last day of Mishima’s life, when he famously committed public seppuku, the film is punctuated by extended flashbacks to the writer’s past as well as gloriously stylized evocations of his fictional works. With its rich cinematography by John Bailey, exquisite sets and costumes by Eiko Ishioka, and unforgettable, highly influential score by Philip Glass, Mishima: A Life in Four Chapters is a tribute to its subject and a bold, investigative work of art in its own right.

hook: 凭借其令人惊叹的处女作，敢于冒险的导演布鲁诺·杜蒙立即在法国电影前沿确立了他作为坚定的反传统者的声誉。 《耶稣的生活》将坚定不移的现实主义与令人惊叹、充满阳光的美丽瞬间融为一体，在弗雷迪（非专业的大卫·杜奇在一次具有启发性的一次性表演中）的小镇日常生活中发现了意想不到的哲学丰富性，弗雷迪是一个患有癫痫症的漫无目的的年轻人，在他孩子般的单纯中，既体现了极大的温柔，又体现了可怕的残酷。杜蒙将影片神秘的标题留给了诱人的解释空间，鼓励观众在一个看似死胡同的世界中看到神圣的事物。
hook_en: With his stunning debut feature, the risk-taking auteur Bruno Dumont immediately established his reputation as an uncompromising iconoclast on the cutting edge of French cinema. Blending unflinching realism with moments of startling, light-filled beauty, La vie de Jésus finds unexpected philosophical richness in the quotidian, small-town existence of Freddy (nonprofessional David Douche in a revelatory, one-off performance), an aimless young man with epilepsy who, in his childlike simplicity, embodies both great tenderness and terrifying brutality. Leaving the film’s cryptic title tantalizingly open to interpretation, Dumont dares viewers to see the divine in a seemingly dead-end world.

hook: 导演鲍勃·福斯这部紧张、随心所欲的演艺剧情片讲述了打破禁忌的喜剧演员莱尼·布鲁斯的真实故事，这位反主流文化先知以其未经过滤的风格开辟了自我表达的新领域。达斯汀·霍夫曼 (Dustin Hoffman) 饰演的布鲁斯 (Bruce) 从小型脱衣舞俱乐部主持人转变为言论自由的避雷针，为他对大嘴的布鲁斯 (Bruce) 的刻画注入了火热的激情，而瓦莱丽·佩里恩 (Valerie Perrine) 饰演布鲁斯的妻子哈尼 (Honey)，一个迷失在波西米亚阴暗面的无辜者，她感人至深的表演为这部电影注入了灵魂。福斯的电影巧妙地运用了鲜明的单色摄影和动态剪辑，生动地捕捉了布鲁斯烟雾缭绕、肮脏的后台世界，这是对一个反传统者和另一个反传统者的复杂写照。
hook_en: Director Bob Fosse’s nervy, freewheeling showbiz drama tells the real-life story of taboo-shattering comedian Lenny Bruce, the counterculture prophet whose unfiltered style opened up new frontiers in self-expression. Dustin Hoffman brings a live-wire intensity to his portrayal of the motormouthed Bruce as he goes from small-time strip-club emcee to free-speech lightning rod, while Valerie Perrine lends the film its soul with her deeply affecting performance as his wife, Honey, an innocent lost on the dark side of bohemia. A complex portrayal of one iconoclast by another, Fosse’s film makes deft use of stark monochrome photography and kinetic editing to vividly capture Bruce’s smoky, seedy backstage world.

hook: 毛里塔尼亚的法国煽动者 Med Hondo 在这部独一无二的音乐剧中对殖民主义本身进行了审判——这是一场规模空前、雄心勃勃的集体努力，被证明是非洲电影的分水岭。在一艘巨大的模拟奴隶船上，洪多上演了一系列富有想象力的重演和精心编排的音乐曲目，追溯了法国帝国主义几个世纪以来的奴役和不公正造成的破坏性影响。 《西印度群岛：自由的逃亡奴隶》不仅仅是一场盛大的演出，它是对泛非独立的激动人心的呼吁，也是对整个非洲人民的压迫和叛乱历史的令人眼花缭乱但批判性的重新认识。
hook_en: Mauritanian French firebrand Med Hondo puts colonialism itself on trial in this one-of-a-kind musical spectacular—a collective effort of unprecedented scale and ambition that proved a watershed event in African cinema. Aboard an enormous mock slave ship, Hondo stages a series of imaginative reenactments and intricately choreographed musical numbers that trace the devastating effects of French imperialism across centuries of enslavement and injustice. Beyond mere extravaganza, West Indies: The Fugitive Slaves of Liberty is a stirring call to Pan-African independence and a dazzling yet critical reconception of an entire people’s history of oppression and rebellion.

hook: 市川今是世界电影界独一无二的多产且变色龙般的人物，他在这部关于背叛和报应的错综复杂的故事中展现了一阵风格上的虚张声势。影片以 19 世纪歌舞伎剧院与世隔绝的世界为背景，讲述了一名女模仿者试图为父母报仇的故事，父母被三名腐败男子逼得精神错乱并自杀。市川采用了情节剧的惯例，并将其颠覆，通过大胆实验性的宽银幕作品，注入万花筒般的色彩、波普艺术的影响和一丝不苟的编舞，将英雄破碎的心灵带入生活。 《演员的复仇》以长谷川一夫雄伟的雌雄同体的表演为基础，重现了他三十年前在银幕上扮演的角色，令人瞠目结舌地审视了艺术的幻想如何与生活相交融。
hook_en: A uniquely prolific and chameleonic figure of world cinema, Kon Ichikawa delivered a burst of stylistic bravado with this intricate tale of betrayal and retribution. Set in the cloistered world of nineteenth-century kabuki theater, the film charts a female impersonator’s attempts to avenge the deaths of his parents, who were driven to insanity and suicide by a trio of corrupt men. Ichikawa takes the conventions of melodrama and turns them on their head, bringing the hero’s fractured psyche to life in boldly experimental widescreen compositions infused with kaleidoscopic color, pop-art influences, and meticulous choreography. Anchored by a magnificently androgynous performance by Kazuo Hasegawa, reprising a role he had played on-screen three decades earlier, An Actor’s Revenge is an eye-popping examination of how the illusions of art intersect with life.

hook: 这部引人注目、发人深省的奥斯卡获奖惊悚片是意大利电影制片人埃利奥·佩特里 (Elio Petri) 最受国际赞誉的作品。佩特里在荒诞与现实之间保持着微妙的平衡，讲述了一个卡夫卡式的故事，讲述了一名罗马警察督察（指挥吉安·玛丽亚·沃隆特饰）调查他自己犯下的滔天罪行的故事。佩特里对超现实官僚机构的动态描绘，既是令人信服的人物研究，也是对 20 世纪 60 年代末和 70 年代初意大利政府严厉镇压的令人不安的评论，是对受控混乱的反常令人愉悦的渲染。
hook_en: The provocative Italian filmmaker Elio Petri’s most internationally acclaimed work is this remarkable, visceral, Oscar-winning thriller. Petri maintains a tricky balance between absurdity and realism in telling the Kafkaesque tale of a Roman police inspector (a commanding Gian Maria Volontè) investigating a heinous crime—which he himself committed. Both a compelling character study and a disturbing commentary on the draconian government crackdowns in Italy in the late 1960s and early ’70s, Petri’s kinetic portrait of surreal bureaucracy is a perversely pleasurable rendering of controlled chaos.

hook: 在这部由艾伯特·布鲁克斯编剧和执导的歇斯底里讽刺里根时代价值观的影片中，一位成功的洛杉矶广告主管（布鲁克斯饰）和他的妻子（朱莉·哈格蒂饰）决定辞去工作，购买一辆温尼贝戈，并追随他们对自由和开放道路的逍遥骑士幻想。当拉斯维加斯的一站几乎让他们的计划脱轨时，他们被迫接受自己的局限性和美国梦的局限性。布鲁克斯尖刻的机智和自信的导演推动了《迷失美国》的发展，这是他不安分的喜剧的一个标志性例子，讲述了缺乏安全感的人物在现代世界中寻找满足感的故事，确立了他独特的喜剧声音，并改变了观察性幽默的艺术。
hook_en: In this hysterical satire of Reagan-era values, written and directed by Albert Brooks, a successful Los Angeles advertising executive (Brooks) and his wife (Julie Hagerty) decide to quit their jobs, buy a Winnebago, and follow their Easy Rider fantasies of freedom and the open road. When a stop in Las Vegas nearly derails their plans, they’re forced to come to terms with their own limitations and those of the American dream. Brooks’s barbed wit and confident direction drive Lost in America, an iconic example of his restless comedies about insecure characters searching for satisfaction in the modern world that established his unique comic voice and transformed the art of observational humor.

hook: 任性的司机和机械师（歌手兼作曲家詹姆斯·泰勒和海滩男孩的丹尼斯·威尔逊，仅担任表演角色）驾驶着一辆 55 年款雪佛兰从洛杉矶以东出发，在一名塔加隆女孩（劳里·伯德饰）的陪伴下进行飙车比赛。一路上，他们遇到了沃伦·奥茨 (Warren Oates) 驾驶的庞蒂亚克 GTO 流浪者，并向他发起越野比赛挑战。奖品：他们汽车的解雇通知书。但没有任何总结能够公正地评价《两车道柏油路》的存在主义冲击力。这部由特立独行的导演蒙特·赫尔曼 (Monte Hellman) 执导的简约叙事作品以其绚丽的宽银幕构图和对美国男性痴迷的精致视角，成为 20 世纪 70 年代电影的艺术巅峰之一，也可能是有史以来最伟大的公路电影。
hook_en: Drag racing east from Los Angeles in a souped-up ’55 Chevy are the wayward Driver and Mechanic (singer-songwriter James Taylor and the Beach Boys’ Dennis Wilson, in their only acting roles), accompanied by a tagalong Girl (Laurie Bird). Along the way, they meet Warren Oates’s Pontiac GTO–driving wanderer and challenge him to a cross-country race. The prize: their cars’ pink slips. But no summary can do justice to the existential punch of Two-Lane Blacktop. With its gorgeous widescreen compositions and sophisticated look at American male obsession, this stripped-down narrative from maverick director Monte Hellman is one of the artistic high points of 1970s cinema, and possibly the greatest road movie ever made.

hook: 科幻小说家约翰·亨德森（阿尔伯特·布鲁克斯饰）在第二次离婚后陷入困境，并与写作障碍作斗争，决心找出自己的生活出了问题，并想到了一个非正统的解决方案：搬回与他无情的反对、乐观消极攻击性的母亲（黛比·雷诺兹饰）住在一起，她最喜欢的儿子一直是约翰的弟弟杰夫（罗伯·莫罗饰）。这是一个无论多么轻率的实验，却带来了令人惊讶的结果。布鲁克斯的电影完美地将这位编剧兼导演兼明星的尖刻机智与洞察力和诱人的温暖融为一体，同时给他在令人愉快的雷诺兹中提供了强大的陪衬，在一个既刻薄又迷人的卷土重来的角色中取得了成功。
hook_en: Reeling after his second divorce and struggling with writer’s block, sci-fi novelist John Henderson (Albert Brooks) resolves to figure out where his life went wrong, and hits on an unorthodox solution: moving back in with his relentlessly disapproving, cheerfully passive-aggressive mother (Debbie Reynolds), whose favorite son has always been John’s younger brother, Jeff (Rob Morrow). It’s an experiment that, however harebrained, delivers surprising results. Brooks’s film perfectly blends the writer-director-star’s biting wit with insight and inviting warmth, while giving him a formidable foil in the delightful Reynolds, triumphant in a comeback role that’s equal parts caustic and charming.

hook: 《爱情琼斯》是编剧兼导演西奥多·巫师 (Theodore Witcher) 的聪明、性感、时尚的处女作，充满了芝加哥 90 年代黑人创意界的波西米亚风格，它是一个爱情故事，适合任何想知道的人：我怎么知道我何时找到了那个人？拉伦兹·泰特 (Larenz Tate) 和尼娅·朗 (Nia Long) 饰演的这对努力奋斗、有艺术天赋的二十多岁年轻人——他是诗人，她是摄影师——充满了吸引力和化学反应，他们激发了对文学和爵士乐的热爱，但他们都不愿投入一段感情，这让他们都陷入了困惑、嫉妒和遗憾的情感雷区。柔软的电影摄影；令人难忘、不拘一格的配乐；令人眼花缭乱的对话；以赛亚·华盛顿 (Isaiah Washington)、丽莎·妮可·卡森 (Lisa Nicole Carson)、比尔·贝拉米 (Bill Bellamy)、伯纳黛特·斯皮克斯 (Bernadette Speakes) 和伦纳德·罗伯茨 (Leonard Roberts) 等演员阵容打造的令人耳目一新的低调自然主义表演，共同演绎出令人陶醉、充满诱惑的喜怒无常的浪漫故事，令人心旷神怡。
hook_en: Steeped in the bohemian cool of Chicago’s 1990s Black creative scene, love jones—the smart, sexy, and stylish debut feature of writer-director Theodore Witcher—is a love story for anyone who has ever wondered: How do I know when I’ve found the one? Larenz Tate and Nia Long have magnetism and chemistry to burn as the striving, artistically talented twentysomethings—he’s a poet, she’s a photographer—who spark over their love of literature and jazz, but whose mutual reluctance to commit to a relationship leaves them both navigating an emotional minefield of confusion, jealousy, and regrets. Velvety cinematography; an unforgettable, eclectic soundtrack; dazzling dialogue; and refreshingly low-key, naturalistic performances by an ensemble cast that also includes Isaiah Washington, Lisa Nicole Carson, Bill Bellamy, Bernadette Speakes, and Leonard Roberts come together in an intoxicating, seductively moody romance that engages both the heart and the mind.

hook: 在加拿大邪教电影制作人盖伊·马丁的怪异而精彩的超级电影世界中，个人记忆与电影传说发生碰撞，带来彻底的感官超载。这场对马丁疯狂、想象中的哥特式童年的怪异之旅是一场无声的黑白漫画科幻噩梦，背景设定在严峻的黑凹口岛上的一座灯塔上，虚构的主角盖伊·马丁是由一位铁腕清教徒母亲抚养长大的。最初是作为一场戏剧活动（由现场管弦乐队、拟音艺术家和各种解说员伴奏），《大脑上的烙印！》这是一次不敬的、疯狂的旅行，深入了解当今电影界真正的怪人之一的思想。
hook_en: In the weird and wonderful supercinematic world of Canadian cult filmmaker Guy Maddin, personal memory collides with movie lore for a radical sensory overload. This eerie excursion into the Gothic recesses of Maddin’s mad, imaginary childhood is a silent, black-and-white comic science-fiction nightmare set in a lighthouse on grim Black Notch Island, where fictional protagonist Guy Maddin was raised by an ironfisted, puritanical mother. Originally mounted as a theatrical event (accompanied by live orchestra, Foley artists, and assorted narrators), Brand upon the Brain! is an irreverent, delirious trip into the mind of one of current cinema’s true eccentrics.

hook: 路易斯·马尔 (Louis Malle) 在这次奇异而迷人的兔子洞之旅中遇到了刘易斯·卡罗尔 (Lewis Carroll)。年轻漂亮的莉莉（凯瑟琳·哈里森饰）避开了乡村发生的一场神秘战争的恐怖，在一座偏僻的农舍避难，在那里她卷入了一个极其非传统家庭的超现实家庭生活。 《黑月》由电影摄影师斯文·尼克维斯特 (Sven Nykvist) 拍摄，讲述了弗洛伊德式的青少年性行为故事，故事发生在一个身份不断变化、动物会说话的后世界末日世界。这是马勒最具实验性的电影之一，也是独一无二的电影白日梦。
hook_en: Louis Malle meets Lewis Carroll in this bizarre and bewitching trip down the rabbit hole. After skirting the horrors of a mysterious war being waged in the countryside, beautiful young Lily (Cathryn Harrison) takes refuge in a remote farmhouse, where she becomes embroiled in the surreal domestic life of an extremely unconventional family. Evocatively shot by cinematographer Sven Nykvist, Black Moon is a Freudian tale of adolescent sexuality set in a postapocalyptic world of shifting identities and talking animals. It is one of Malle’s most experimental films and a cinematic daydream like no other.

hook: 小津安二郎饰演的男主角龙知秋饰演的修平是一位丧偶的高中教师，他发现自己越是努力为儿子的未来做最好的事情，他们就越分离。尽管《父亲有一个》主要讲述的是一个精心制作的父母之爱的故事，但它提供了牺牲的主题，在二战期间上映时，日本审查机构认为这些主题是适当的爱国主义，使其成为小津电影作品中独一无二的政治电影。
hook_en: Yasujiro Ozu’s frequent leading man Chishu Ryu is riveting as Shuhei, a widowed high school teacher who finds that the more he tries to do what is best for his son’s future, the more they are separated. Though primarily a delicately wrought story of parental love, _There Was a Father_ offers themes of sacrifice that were deemed appropriately patriotic by Japanese censors at the time of its release during World War II, making it a uniquely political film in Ozu’s body of work.

hook: 这部直接电影先驱大卫·梅索斯、艾伯特·梅索斯和夏洛特·兹韦林对美国梦和幻灭的极具影响力的描绘，以不可磨灭的人性捕捉了四位顽强的挨家挨户圣经推销员的世界，他们从波士顿前往佛罗里达，向工薪阶层的天主教徒推销豪华版的《好书》，这看似徒劳的追求。 《推销员》以廉价的汽车旅馆、烟雾缭绕的餐馆和郊区的客厅为背景，生动地再现了上世纪中叶的不景气，在揭示其主题的快速言说的虚张声势掩盖沮丧、失望和绝望的方式时，呈现出令人心酸的维度。这部具有里程碑意义的纪录片以其非评判性的观察风格彻底改变了非小说类叙事的艺术，是有史以来最具穿透力的电影之一，展示了消费主义在美国自身价值观中的根深蒂固。
hook_en: This radically influential portrait of American dreams and disillusionment from Direct Cinema pioneers David Maysles, Albert Maysles, and Charlotte Zwerin captures, with indelible humanity, the worlds of four dogged door-to-door Bible salesmen as they travel from Boston to Florida on a seemingly futile quest to sell luxury editions of the Good Book to working-class Catholics. A vivid evocation of midcentury malaise that unfolds against a backdrop of cheap motels, smoky diners, and suburban living rooms, Salesman assumes poignant dimensions as it uncovers the way its subjects’ fast-talking bravado masks frustration, disappointment, and despair. Revolutionizing the art of nonfiction storytelling with its nonjudgmental, observational style, this landmark documentary is one of the most penetrating films ever made about how deeply embedded consumerism is in America’s sense of its own values.

hook: 琼·米克林·西尔弗 (Joan Micklin Silver) 对这部浪漫喜剧的深情演绎为这一类型注入了新鲜的个人视角，讲述了一位未婚犹太女性在纽约寻找满足感的故事。幸福的独立书店经理伊兹（艾米·欧文饰）并不是在寻找爱情，但当她吸引了两个截然不同的男人的目光时，她被迫重新评估自己的欲望：一个以自我为中心的小说家（杰罗恩·克拉贝饰）和温文尔雅的下东区泡菜小贩（彼得·里格特饰），她的老式宝贝（抢镜的意第绪语戏剧明星雷兹尔）和他在一起Bozyk）陷害了她。 《穿越德兰西》是一封写给 20 世纪 80 年代曼哈顿的情书，以美丽的光泽、秋天的色调拍摄，优雅地捕捉到了这座城市的魔力，不同的文化、世代和传统在这里相互冲突又相互联系。
hook_en: Joan Micklin Silver’s wonderfully affectionate spin on the romantic comedy infuses the genre with a fresh, personal perspective, following an unmarried Jewish woman’s search for fulfillment in New York City. Happily independent bookstore manager Izzy (a luminous Amy Irving) isn’t looking for love, but she’s forced to reevaluate her desires when she catches the eye of two very different men: a self-centered novelist (Jeroen Krabbé) and the mild-mannered Lower East Side pickle seller (Peter Riegert) with whom her old-fashioned bubbie (scene-stealing Yiddish-theater star Reizl Bozyk) sets her up. A love letter to 1980s Manhattan shot in beautifully burnished, autumnal tones, Crossing Delancey gracefully captures the magic of a city where disparate cultures, generations, and traditions both clash and connect.

hook: 乔纳森·戴米把托马斯·哈里斯畅销小说改成紧绷的心理惊悚，对准美国的一种执念：连环谋杀。朱迪·福斯特饰演联邦探员学员克拉丽丝·史达琳，向臭名昭著的“食人魔”汉尼拔·莱克特求助，以洞察另一名杀手；她颠覆经典的性别动力学，交出职业生涯最难忘的表演之一。对手戏里，安东尼·霍普金斯是原型反英雄——有教养、机锋、残忍嗜杀——画出人性可怕走偏的肖像。既是抓人的警探程序剧，也是沉入扭曲心灵的不安旅程，《沉默的羔羊》横扫奥斯卡（最佳影片、导演、剧本、女主、男主），至今仍是文化坐标。
hook_en: In this chilling adaptation of the best-selling novel by Thomas Harris, the astonishingly versatile director Jonathan Demme crafted a taut psychological thriller about an American obsession: serial murder. As Clarice Starling, an FBI trainee who enlists the help of the infamous Hannibal “the Cannibal” Lecter to gain insight into the mind of another killer, Jodie Foster subverts classic gender dynamics and gives one of the most memorable performances of her career. As her foil, Anthony Hopkins is the archetypal antihero—cultured, quick-witted, and savagely murderous—delivering a harrowing portrait of humanity gone terribly wrong. A gripping police procedural and a disquieting immersion into a twisted psyche, The Silence of the Lambs swept the Academy Awards (Best Picture, Director, Screenplay, Actress, Actor) and remains a cultural touchstone.

hook: 这部由大卫·柯南伯格执导、改编自威廉·S·巴勒斯的幻觉小说、一度被认为无法拍成电影的《裸体午餐》中，一位名叫比尔·李（彼得·韦勒饰）的兼职消灭者兼全职吸毒者比尔·李（彼得·韦勒饰）陷入了噩梦般的Interzone，这是一个充满险恶阴谋和会说话的巨型虫子的地下世界。这部电影时而幽默，时而怪诞，而且总是超现实的，将巴勒斯小说的各个方面与作者自己生活中的事件混合在一起，产生了一种令人回味的偏执幻想，并对创作过程的奥秘进行了自我反省的调查。
hook_en: In this adaptation of William S. Burroughs’s hallucinatory, once-thought-unfilmable novel Naked Lunch, directed by David Cronenberg, a part-time exterminator and full-time drug addict named Bill Lee (Peter Weller) plunges into the nightmarish Interzone, a netherworld of sinister cabals and giant talking bugs. Alternately humorous and grotesque—and always surreal—the film mingles aspects of Burroughs’s novel with incidents from the writer’s own life, resulting in an evocative paranoid fantasy and a self-reflexive investigation into the mysteries of the creative process.

hook: 让·加本 (Jean Gabin) 在雅克·贝克尔 (Jacques Becker) 的杰作《Touchez pas au grisbi》（放开赃物！）中饰演年迈的黑帮老大马克斯·勒门特 (Max le Menteur)，这是他最疲惫的浪漫时期。麦克斯完成了一生的抢劫，他期待着与他美丽的年轻女友一起度过余生。但当麦克斯倒霉的搭档兼最好的朋友里顿（雷内·达里饰）将战利品的消息泄露给了两次口无遮拦的乔西（珍妮·莫罗饰）时，麦克斯不情愿地被拉回了黑社会。作为黑帮电影类型的试金石，《Touchez pas au grisbi》也是纯粹的贝克尔风格——低调、优雅、令人回味。
hook_en: Jean Gabin is at his most wearily romantic as aging gangster Max le Menteur in the Jacques Becker gem Touchez pas au grisbi (Hands Off the Loot!). Having pulled off the heist of a lifetime, Max looks forward to spending his remaining days relaxing with his beautiful young girlfriend. But when Riton (René Dary), Max’s hapless partner and best friend, lets word of the loot slip to loose-lipped, two-timing Josy (Jeanne Moreau), Max is reluctantly drawn back into the underworld. A touchstone of the gangster-film genre, Touchez pas au grisbi is also pure Becker—understated, elegant, evocative.

hook: 查尔斯·伯内特这部抒情的处女作安静地揭示了美国独立电影制作的情况，以洛杉矶瓦茨社区黑人生活的马赛克形式展开，斯坦（亨利·盖尔·桑德斯饰）是一位因在屠宰场工作而疲惫不堪的父亲，他和他的妻子（凯西·摩尔饰）在面对无数的失望时寻求温柔的时刻。身为导演、编剧、制片人、摄影师和剪辑师的伯内特同样关注儿童和成人的世界，他在日常生活中的挣扎中发现了诗意，这些画面闪烁着慈悲之美，不可磨灭。 《杀羊者》自 1977 年上映以来，几十年来一直无人问津，现在被认为是开创性的洛杉矶叛乱运动的试金石，也是一部以前所未有的电影般的方式将美国黑人的生活搬上银幕的杰作。《杀羊者》由加州大学洛杉矶分校电影电视档案馆、Milestone Films 和 Criterion Collection 进行了修复和重新制作。
hook_en: A quiet revelation of American independent filmmaking, Charles Burnett’s lyrical debut feature unfolds as a mosaic of Black life in the Watts neighborhood of Los Angeles, where Stan (Henry Gayle Sanders), a father worn down by his job in a slaughterhouse, and his wife (Kaycee Moore) seek moments of tenderness in the face of myriad disappointments. Equally attuned to the world of children and that of adults, Burnett—acting as director, writer, producer, cinematographer, and editor—finds poetry amid everyday struggles in indelible images that glow with compassionate beauty. Largely unseen for decades following its completion in 1977, Killer of Sheep is now recognized as a touchstone of the groundbreaking LA Rebellion movement, and a masterpiece that brought Black American lives to the screen with an aching intimacy like no film before.Killer of Sheep was restored and remastered by UCLA Film & Television Archive, Milestone Films, and the Criterion Collection.

hook: 1971 年 4 月 30 日，一群满座的纽约知识精英挤满了市政府的市政厅剧院，观看诺曼·梅勒与四位著名女性思想家和活动家：杰奎琳·塞巴洛斯、杰梅因·格里尔、吉尔·约翰斯顿和戴安娜·特里林的讨论。部分是智力死亡竞赛，部分是三环马戏团，伟大的纪录片 D.A. 彭尼贝克 (D. A. Pennebaker) 和一小群工作人员以噼啪作响、惊心动魄的方式即时捕捉到了这一事件，随后克里斯·赫格杜斯 (Chris Hegedus) 将这三个小时的事件浓缩为这一独特文化时刻的轻松有趣的快照。 《血腥镇》令人兴奋、激烈、搞笑，是由当时一些最有影响力的人物提供的女权主义火力的令人眼花缭乱的展示，梅勒显然很享受自己作为好斗的乌合之众煽动者和文学狮子的角色。
hook_en: On April 30, 1971, a standing-room-only crowd of New York’s intellectual elite packed the city’s Town Hall theater to see Norman Mailer—fresh from the controversy over his essay “The Prisoner of Sex” and the backlash it received from leaders of the women’s movement—tangle with a panel of four prominent female thinkers and activists: Jacqueline Ceballos, Germaine Greer, Jill Johnston, and Diana Trilling. Part intellectual death match, part three-ring circus, the event was captured with crackling, fly-on-the-wall immediacy by the documentary great D. A. Pennebaker and a small crew, with Chris Hegedus later condensing the three-hour affair into this briskly entertaining snapshot of a singular cultural moment. Heady, heated, and hilarious, Town Bloody Hall is a dazzling display of feminist firepower courtesy of some of the most influential figures of the era, with Mailer plainly relishing his role as the pugnacious rabble-rouser and literary lion at the center of it all.

hook: 恩戈齐·翁乌拉 (Ngozi Onwurah) 的极其超前的反乌托邦科幻电影《欢迎来到恐怖穹顶 (Welcome II the Terrordome)》是第一部由黑人女性在院线发行的英国故事片，强烈地描绘了在不久的将来，黑人被隔离在一个名为恐怖穹顶 (Terrordome) 的贫民窟中，在那里，一名小男孩被谋杀后，酝酿已久的暴力和愤怒有可能爆发。这部电影以公共敌人的一首煽动性单曲命名，使用说唱配乐来评论和推动其叙事，这是美国、英国和非洲文化碰撞以及过去、现在和未来崩溃的情感的一部分。在这部有先见之明的著作中，翁乌拉构建了一种富有远见的非洲未来主义宇宙论，将奴隶制的历史与现代系统性的种族暴行联系起来。
hook_en: Ngozi Onwurah’s radically ahead-of-its-time dystopian sci-fi film Welcome II the Terrordome—the first theatrically distributed British feature by a Black woman—furiously evokes a near future in which Black people are segregated within a slum called the Terrordome, where simmering violence and anger threaten to boil over in the wake of a young boy’s murder. Named after an incendiary single by Public Enemy, the film uses its rap soundtrack to both comment on and drive its narrative, part of a sensibility in which American, British, and African cultures collide and the past, present, and future collapse. In this prescient work, Onwurah builds a visionary, Afrofuturist cosmology that connects the history of slavery to modern-day systemic racial brutality.

hook: 罗伯托·罗西里尼的《意大利之旅》（意大利版《Viaggio》）是战后最具影响力的电影之一，讲述了一对来自英国的夫妇（英格丽·褒曼和乔治·桑德斯）在那不勒斯附近乡村旅行中婚姻走向衰落的故事。罗西里尼的杰作不仅仅是对关系的剖析，更是一部情感和灵性的令人心碎的作品。 《意大利之旅》被认为是米开朗基罗·安东尼奥尼存在主义作品的前身，并被传奇电影杂志《电影手册》誉为开创性的现代主义作品，是一个令人惊叹的电影标杆。
hook_en: Among the most influential films of the postwar era, Roberto Rossellini’s Journey to Italy (Viaggio in Italia) charts the declining marriage of a couple from England (Ingrid Bergman and George Sanders) on a trip in the countryside near Naples. More than just the anatomy of a relationship, Rossellini’s masterpiece is a heartrending work of emotion and spirituality. Considered a predecessor to the existentialist works of Michelangelo Antonioni and hailed as a groundbreaking modernist work by the legendary film journal Cahiers du cinéma, Journey to Italy is a breathtaking cinematic benchmark.

hook: 1950 年 7 月 5 日——西西里强盗萨尔瓦多·朱利亚诺 (Salvatore Giuliano) 的尸体被发现面朝下倒在卡斯特尔韦特拉诺 (Castelvetrano) 的一个庭院里，尸体上布满弹孔，身旁有一把手枪和步枪。当地和国际媒体纷纷赶到现场，希望揭开这位年轻人死亡背后的真实故事，这位二十七岁的年轻人已经成为意大利头号通缉犯和著名英雄。导演弗朗西斯科·罗西在准确的地点进行拍摄，并招募了曾经受到真正的朱利亚诺影响的西西里本地演员，利用围绕强盗死亡真实故事的事实和神话，令人震惊地揭露了西西里岛及其公民、黑手党和政府官员之间错综复杂的关系。萨尔瓦多·朱利亚诺是政治电影制作的开创性作品，奠定了罗西的声誉并确保了他在电影史上的地位。
hook_en: July 5, 1950—Sicilian bandit Salvatore Giuliano's bullet-riddled corpse is found facedown in a courtyard in Castelvetrano, a handgun and rifle by his side. Local and international press descend upon the scene, hoping to crack open the true story behind the death of this young man, who, at the age of twenty-seven, had already become Italy’s most wanted criminal and celebrated hero. Filming in the exact locations and enlisting a cast of native Sicilians once impacted by the real Giuliano, director Francesco Rosi harnessed the facts and myths surrounding the true story of the bandit's death to create a startling exposé of Sicily and the tangled relations between its citizens, the Mafia, and government officials. A groundbreaking work of political filmmaking, Salvatore Giuliano established Rosi’s reputation and assured his place in cinema history.

hook: 凭借他的第三部故事片《房客：伦敦雾的故事》，阿尔弗雷德·希区柯克向伟大迈出了重要一步，并成为他真正的导演处女作。这部令人难以忘怀的无声惊悚片讲述了一位神秘年轻人（日场偶像艾弗·诺韦洛饰）在伦敦的一所寄宿公寓居住的故事，与此同时，一名被称为“复仇者”的杀手降临到这座城市，掠夺金发女郎。这部电影由一位年轻造型师明显的活力所驱动，决定性地确立了导演对形式和主题的痴迷。在此版本中，《房客》伴随着《下坡》，这是另一部 1927 年的无声片，探讨了希区柯克的“错误的人”比喻，同样由诺韦洛主演——这是一部双片长片，揭示了这位恐怖大师刚刚步入正轨的过程。英国电影协会国家档案馆修复了《房客：伦敦雾的故事》。主要修复资金由好莱坞外国记者协会、电影基金会和西蒙·W·赫塞尔提供。英国电影分级委员会、Deluxe 142、Shivendra Singh Dungarpur 以及 Ian 和 Beth Mill 提供了额外资金。新乐谱由 Network Releeasing 与 BFI 合作委托制作。
hook_en: With his third feature film, The Lodger: A Story of the London Fog, Alfred Hitchcock took a major step toward greatness and made what he would come to consider his true directorial debut. This haunting silent thriller tells the tale of a mysterious young man (matinee idol Ivor Novello) who takes up residence at a London boardinghouse just as a killer known as the Avenger descends upon the city, preying on blonde women. The film is animated by the palpable energy of a young stylist at play, decisively establishing the director’s formal and thematic obsessions. In this release, The Lodger is accompanied by Downhill, another silent from 1927 that explores Hitchcock’s “wrong man” trope, also headlined by Novello—making for a double feature that reveals the master of the macabre as he was just coming into his own. The Lodger: A Story of the London Fog was restored by the BFI National Archive. Principal restoration funding provided by the Hollywood Foreign Press Association, The Film Foundation, and Simon W. Hessel. Additional funding provided by the British Board of Film Classification, Deluxe 142, Shivendra Singh Dungarpur, and Ian and Beth Mill. New score commissioned by Network Releasing in partnership with the BFI.

hook: 标志着 1930 年代残酷的黑帮传奇开始让位于 40 年代黑色电影的浪漫宿命论的那一刻，《High Sierra》还包含了汉弗莱·鲍嘉 (Humphrey Bogart) 的明星表演，他与票房最高的艾达·卢皮诺 (Ida Lupino) 一起，以强硬而温柔的角色罗伊·厄尔 (Roy Earle) 证明了他的男主角勇气。罗伊是一名职业罪犯，饱受曲折过去的困扰，渴望过上简单的生活，但在获得假释后，他在内华达山脉进行了最后一次抢劫，与一伙盗贼陷入了困境。这部扣人心弦的惊悚片由拉乌尔·沃尔什 (Raoul Walsh) 执导，充分利用了令人眩晕的山区环境，这部扣人心弦的惊悚片让罗伊和卢皮诺饰演的玛丽，一个同样被抛弃的人，也渴望逃离自己的过去，无情地冲向令人难忘的悬崖边高潮和与命运的会合。
hook_en: Marking the moment when the gritty gangster sagas of the 1930s began giving way to the romantic fatalism of ’40s film noir, High Sierra also contains the star-making performance of Humphrey Bogart, who, alongside top-billed Ida Lupino, proved his leading-man mettle with his tough yet tender turn as Roy Earle. A career criminal plagued by his checkered past, Roy longs for a simpler life, but after getting sprung on parole, he falls in with a band of thieves for one last heist in the Sierra Nevada. Directed with characteristic punch by Raoul Walsh—who makes the most of the vertiginous mountain location—this gripping thriller sends Roy and Lupino’s Marie, a fellow outcast also desperate to escape her past, hurtling inexorably toward an unforgettable cliffside climax and a rendezvous with destiny.

hook: 由于对婚姻和生活不满，费迪南德（让-保罗·贝尔蒙多饰）带着保姆、前情人玛丽安·雷诺阿（安娜·卡琳娜饰）踏上了上路，远离了资产阶级世界。然而，这并不是一次正常的公路旅行：天才导演让-吕克·戈达尔六年来的第十部故事片，是反消费主义讽刺、当代政治和漫画美学的时尚混搭，以及一个暴力、曲折的故事，正如戈达尔所说，他们是“最后的浪漫情侣”。电影摄影师拉乌尔·库塔尔 (Raoul Coutard) 以及贝尔蒙多 (Belmondo) 和卡琳娜 (Karina) 拍摄出最生动活泼的幸福色彩图像，《皮埃罗·狂人》是法国新浪潮的高潮之一，也是戈达尔进一步进军激进电影之前的最后一次嬉戏。
hook_en: Dissatisfied in marriage and life, Ferdinand (Jean-Paul Belmondo) takes to the road with the babysitter, his ex-lover Marianne Renoir (Anna Karina), and leaves the bourgeois world behind. Yet this is no normal road trip: the tenth feature in six years by genius auteur Jean-Luc Godard is a stylish mash-up of anticonsumerist satire, au courant politics, and comic-book aesthetics, as well as a violent, zigzag tale of, as Godard called them, “the last romantic couple.” With blissful color imagery by cinematographer Raoul Coutard and Belmondo and Karina at their most animated, Pierrot le fou is one of the high points of the French New Wave, and was Godard’s last frolic before he moved ever further into radical cinema.

hook: 《德雷克神庙的故事》大致改编自威廉·福克纳备受争议的小说，讲述了罪恶与救赎的悲惨景象，火爆的霍普金斯主演的精彩表演令人惊叹，霍普金斯穿越恐怖、创伤和救赎的过程堪称银幕表演的真正杰作。
hook_en: Loosely adapted from William Faulkner’s controversial novel The Story of Temple Drake is a harrowing vision of sin and salvation that boasts an astonishing lead performance from the fiery Hopkins, whose passage through the stations of terror, trauma, and redemption is a true tour de force of screen acting.

hook: 在唐·西格尔职业生涯的早期，他凭借这部以戒备森严的监狱为背景的耸人听闻、高强度但制作精良的剧情片而崭露头角。 《11 号牢房骚乱》是杰出制片人沃尔特·万格 (Walter Wanger) 的创意，是一部从头条新闻中摘录的社会问题影片，讲述囚犯的权利，灵感来自最近美国监狱发生的一系列起义。在西格尔的手中，这部电影在福尔瑟姆州立监狱拍摄，有真正的囚犯和狱警作为临时演员，既傲慢又人性化，展示了这位导演后来闻名的冷酷视觉天赋和大胆的故事讲述。
hook_en: Early in his career, Don Siegel made his mark with this sensational and high-octane but economically constructed drama set in a maximum-security penitentiary. Riot in Cell Block 11, the brainchild of producer extraordinaire Walter Wanger, is a ripped-from-the-headlines social-problem picture about inmates’ rights that was inspired by a recent spate of uprisings in American prisons. In Siegel’s hands, the film, shot on location at Folsom State Prison, with real inmates and guards as extras, is at once brash and humane, showcasing the hard-boiled visual flair and bold storytelling for which the director would become known.

hook: 第二次世界大战期间，著名剧作家诺尔·考沃德聘请了一位名叫大卫·里恩的年轻电影剪辑师，帮助他实现拍摄一部关于一群皇家海军水手（这些角色将由考沃德本人、伯纳德·迈尔斯和约翰·米尔斯等人担任）在地中海与德国人作战的动作片的愿景。考沃德和里恩最终共同执导了这个大型项目——这是一项令人印象深刻的事业，特别是考虑到他们之前都没有执导过大银幕（这将是考沃德唯一的这样的荣誉）。 《我们服务》（奥斯卡最佳影片提名）在一场重大海战和人们离家前生活的闪回之间切换，对电影制片人来说是一个重大突破，也是一部敏感而激动人心的宣传片。
hook_en: In the midst of World War II, the renowned playwright Noël Coward engaged a young film editor named David Lean to help him realize his vision for an action drama about a group of Royal Navy sailors (roles that would be filled by Coward himself, Bernard Miles, and John Mills, among others) fighting the Germans in the Mediterranean. Coward and Lean ended up codirecting the large-scale project—an impressive undertaking, especially considering that neither of them had directed for the big screen before (this would be Coward’s only such credit). Cutting between a major naval battle and flashbacks to the men’s lives before they left home, In Which We Serve (an Oscar nominee for best picture) was a major breakthrough for both filmmakers and a sensitive and stirring piece of propaganda.

hook: 英国皇家空军飞行员彼得·卡特（大卫·尼文饰）从着火的飞机上跳伞奇迹般生还，他遇到了刚刚向他表达临终遗愿的美国无线电报务员（金·亨特饰），在宁静的英国海滩上面对面，两人坠入爱河。当来自来世的使者到来纠正挽救他生命的官僚错误时，彼得必须为自己留在地球上的权利进行激烈的辩护——由制作设计师阿尔弗雷德·荣格和电影摄影师杰克·卡迪夫描绘为一个色彩丰富的伊甸园——爬上宽阔的楼梯，在一个极其美丽的、黑白现代主义的来世接受审判。为了缓和战时盟友英国和美国之间的紧张关系，迈克尔·鲍威尔和埃默里克·普雷斯伯格的富有人文主义色彩的《生与死的问题》穿越时空，论证了爱的超越价值。
hook_en: After miraculously surviving a jump from his burning plane, RAF pilot Peter Carter (David Niven) encounters the American radio operator (Kim Hunter) to whom he has just delivered his dying wishes, and, face-to-face on a tranquil English beach, the pair fall in love. When a messenger from the hereafter arrives to correct the bureaucratic error that spared his life, Peter must mount a fierce defense for his right to stay on earth—painted by production designer Alfred Junge and cinematographer Jack Cardiff as a rich Technicolor Eden—climbing a wide staircase to stand trial in a starkly beautiful, black-and-white modernist afterlife. Intended to smooth tensions between the wartime allies Britain and America, Michael Powell and Emeric Pressburger’s richly humanistic A Matter of Life and Death traverses time and space to make a case for the transcendent value of love.

hook: 这部面无表情的悲喜剧讲述了一群贫穷、被遗弃的艺术家在巴黎过着波西米亚生活的故事，是芬兰导演阿基·考里斯马基 (Aki Kaurismäki) 最迷人的电影之一。影片改编自亨利·穆格尔 (Henri Murger) 颇具影响力的 19 世纪中叶著作《波西米亚人的生活场景》(Scènes de la vie de bohème)（歌剧《波希米亚人》的基础）中的故事，影片讲述了考里斯马基 (Kaurismäki) 的三位常客——安德烈·威尔姆斯 (André Wilms)、马蒂·佩隆帕 (Matti Pellonpää) 和卡尔·瓦南宁 (Karl Väänänen)——作为作家、画家和作曲家，他们一起勉强度日，分享日常生活中的荒谬。 《波西米亚人的生活》以华丽的黑白镜头，生动活泼地演绎了一个受人喜爱的故事。
hook_en: This deadpan tragicomedy about a group of impoverished, outcast artists living the bohemian life in Paris is among the most beguiling films by Finnish director Aki Kaurismäki. Based on stories from Henri Murger’s influential mid-nineteenth-century book Scènes de la vie de bohème (the basis for the opera La bohème), the film features a marvelous trio of Kaurismäki regulars—André Wilms, Matti Pellonpää, and Karl Väänänen—as a writer, painter, and composer who scrape by together, sharing in life’s daily absurdities. Gorgeously shot in black and white, La vie de bohème is a vibrantly scrappy rendition of a beloved tale.

hook: 一部轻松的电影，探讨了导演 Yasujiro Ozu 经常探讨的主题——代际关系的挑战，《Good Morning》讲述的是两个年轻人因为父母拒绝买电视而停止说话的故事。Ozu 通过这部家庭肖像剧，巧妙地穿插了许多微妙的笑料，这部家庭肖像剧的丰富程度与他的戏剧电影不相上下。他通过孩子的视角，讽刺了成人的缺点。这部电影使用了鲜艳的色彩拍摄，背景设置在东京的一个郊区，那里主妇们在谈论邻居的新洗衣机，失业的丈夫则在做上门推销员。这部温馨的喜剧改编自 Ozu 的无声经典《我出生了，可是》，旨在温和地讽刺战后日本的消费主义。
hook_en: A lighthearted take on director Yasujiro Ozu’s perennial theme of the challenges of inter­generational relationships, Good Morning tells the story of two young boys who stop speaking in protest after their parents refuse to buy a television set. Ozu weaves a wealth of subtle gags through a family portrait as rich as those of his dramatic films, mocking the foibles of the adult world through the eyes of his child protagonists.
