Shot in stunning color and set in a suburb of Tokyo where housewives gossip about the neighbors’ new washing machine and unemployed husbands look for work as door-to-door salesmen, this charming comedy refashions Ozu’s own silent classic I Was Born, But . . . to gently satirize consumerism in postwar Japan.

hook: 正如其标题一样，《蛮力》是朱尔斯·达辛首次涉足犯罪类型的作品之一，这是一部监狱情节剧，其核心是对美国惩罚性监禁制度的严厉批评。伯特·兰卡斯特饰演老朽的乔·柯林斯，他和他的狱友们生活在施虐狂、权力绊倒的警卫队长蒙西（休姆·克罗宁饰演）的严厉控制下。只有柯林斯的逃跑梦想让他继续前行，但他怎么可能挣脱芒西的锁链呢？实事求是、凶猛的《蛮力》将故事推向了爆炸性的高潮，展现了人们在为自由而战时所付出的努力，并提出了一个问题：谁是社会上真正的野兽。
hook_en: As hard-hitting as its title, Brute Force was one of Jules Dassin’s first forays into the crime genre, a prison melodrama with a scathing critique of the punitive American incarceration system at its heart. Burt Lancaster is the timeworn Joe Collins, who, along with his fellow inmates, lives under the heavy thumb of the sadistic, power-tripping guard Captain Munsey (a riveting Hume Cronyn). Only Collins’s dreams of escape keep him going, but how can he possibly bust out of Munsey’s chains? Matter-of-fact and ferocious, Brute Force builds to an explosive climax that shows the lengths men will go to when fighting for their freedom, and asks the question of who society’s real brutes are.

hook: 芭芭拉·斯坦威克和沃尔特·休斯顿在好莱坞大师安东尼·曼执导的西部情节剧《复仇女神》中展现了他们最精彩的表演。 1870 年代的新墨西哥领地，狂妄自大、丧偶的牧场主 T.C. 杰福兹（休斯顿饰演的最后一个角色）与他煽动女儿万斯（斯坦威克饰）的嫁妆、丈夫的选择，以及最后的土地所有权问题发生冲突。 《复仇女神》以复杂的边疆定居视角和灼热的国内剧情，成为美国电影制作中经常被忽视的瑰宝，拥有获得奥斯卡提名的摄影和朱迪思·安德森、温德尔·科里和吉尔伯特·罗兰生动的配角。
hook_en: Barbara Stanwyck and Walter Huston are at their fierce finest in master Hollywood craftsman Anthony Mann’s crackling western melodrama The Furies. In 1870s New Mexico Territory, megalomaniacal widowed ranch owner T. C. Jeffords (Huston, in his final role) butts heads with his firebrand of a daughter, Vance (Stanwyck), over her dowry, choice of husband, and, finally, ownership of the land itself. Sophisticated in its view of frontier settlement and ablaze with searing domestic drama, The Furies is an often-overlooked treasure of American filmmaking, boasting Oscar–nominated cinematography and vivid supporting turns from Judith Anderson, Wendell Corey, and Gilbert Roland.

hook: Beastie Boys 是近二十年最具影响力的乐队之一。他们的音乐让嘻哈音乐面向更广泛的听众，并改变了其声音的边界，而他们雄心勃勃的音乐视频则将这种媒介带到了新的艺术表达水平。这部开创性的双CD合辑展示了DVD技术的巨大潜力，其中大部分十八个视频包含不同的视觉角度和多个音频轨道。有数百种可能的图像和声音组合，包括环绕混音、无伴奏版本、独奏音乐和超过四十个混音（包括马可·维奥洛、肥胖男孩和普林斯等艺术家的混音），其中包括许多专门为这次发行制作的新混音。该特别版还包含大量从未见过的镜头和未发布的音乐片段，以及乐队和视频导演的稀有照片和独家音频评论。最后的 coup de grâce 是纳撒尼尔·霍尔布雷的《星际旅行》衍生作品《机器人与章鱼怪传奇》的世界首映导演剪辑版。
hook_en: The Beastie Boys are among the most influential groups of the last two decades. As their music has opened hip-hop to a wider audience and changed the parameters of its sound, their ambitious music videos have carried the medium to new levels of artistic expression. This groundbreaking two-disc anthology showcases the vast potential of DVD technology, with most of the eighteen videos containing alternate visual angles and multiple audio tracks. There are hundreds of possible image and sound combinations, including new surround mixes, a cappella versions, instrumentals, and more than 40 remixes (by such artists as Moby, Fatboy Slim and the Prunes), including many new remixes created exclusively for this release. Loaded with never-before-seen footage and unreleased music tracks, this special edition also contains a trove of rare still photos and exclusive audio commentary by the band and the video directors. And the coup de grâce; the world-premiere director's cut of Nathanial Hornblower's "Intergalactic" spin-off "The Robot vs. the Octopus Monster Saga."

hook: 在卡里·福永（Cary Joji Fukunaga）失去纯真的悲惨景象中，通过最悲惨的伤亡者之一（一名儿童兵）的眼睛看到了战争的噩梦。 《无国之兽》改编自乌佐丁马·伊韦拉广受好评的小说，故事发生在一个饱受内战蹂躏的无名西非国家，年轻的阿古（亚伯拉罕·阿塔，在一场令人难忘的处女作中饰演）目睹了村庄里的大屠杀，然后被冷酷的指挥官（伊德里斯·艾尔巴饰）领导的一群叛军士兵俘虏，后者将男孩塑造成冷酷无情的杀手。福永不断变换的摄影作品和令人惊叹的视觉效果——如此强烈的现实主义，近乎超现实——让观众沉浸在一个难以想象的恐怖世界中，同时又不会忽视其中心的强大的人类故事。
hook_en: The nightmare of war is seen through the eyes of one of its most tragic casualties—a child soldier—in this harrowing vision of innocence lost from Cary Joji Fukunaga. Based on the acclaimed novel by Uzodinma Iweala, Beasts of No Nation unfolds in an unnamed, civil-war-torn West African country, where the young Agu (Abraham Attah, in a haunting debut performance) witnesses carnage in his village before falling captive to a band of rebel soldiers led by a ruthless commander (an explosive Idris Elba), who molds the boy into a hardened killer. Fukunaga’s relentlessly roving camera work and stunning visuals—realism so intensely visceral it borders on the surreal—immerse the viewer in a world of unimaginable horror without ever losing sight of the powerful human story at its center.

hook: 一群大学朋友因毕业后的倦怠而瘫痪，他们留在校园里，为自己拼凑出一个社区，以否认等待着他们的现实世界的未来。荣获奥斯卡金像奖提名的编剧诺亚·鲍姆巴赫的这部搞笑而感人的导演处女作是九十年代美国独立电影界的亮点之一，它直接向一代无法调和封闭的教育经历与日常责任的成年人对话，并提出了一个永恒的问题：我们该何去何从？鲍姆巴赫的突破性作品极其有趣且深刻，由明星演员阵容提供了无数被引用的对话。
hook_en: Paralyzed by postgraduation ennui, a group of college friends remain on campus, patching together a community for themselves in order to deny the real-world futures awaiting them. Academy Award–nominated screenwriter Noah Baumbach’s hilarious and touching directorial debut was one of the highlights of the American independent film scene of the nineties, speaking directly to a generation of adults-to-be unable to reconcile their hermetic educational experience with workaday responsibility, and posing the eternal question, where do we go from here? Stingingly funny and incisive, Baumbach’s breakthrough features endlessly quotable dialogue, delivered by a stellar ensemble cast.

hook: 《月出》是一部关于暴力和救赎的小镇寓言，是好莱坞最被忽视的大师之一弗兰克·博尔扎奇的最终胜利。年轻的丹尼（戴恩·克拉克饰）从小就因犯罪父亲的命运而蒙受耻辱，他受到了遍体鳞伤和欺凌，直到有一天晚上，他在盛怒之下杀死了最顽固的折磨者。当警察逼近丹尼时，丹尼不顾一切地寻求死者未婚妻（盖尔·拉塞尔饰）的爱，她是一名教师，看到了他的侵略行为背后受伤的灵魂。通过这次战后的回归，博尔扎奇重新获得了激发他漫长而大胆的早期职业生涯的灵感，将他浪漫情感的抒情力量与黑色电影的心理痛苦结合起来，令人震惊地证明了对爱的力量的信念。
hook_en: A small-town fable about violence and redemption, Moonrise is the final triumph of Frank Borzage, one of Hollywood’s most neglected masters. Stigmatized from infancy by the fate of his criminal father, young Danny (Dane Clark) is bruised and bullied until one night, in a fit of rage, he kills his most persistent tormentor. As the police close in around him, Danny makes a desperate bid for the love of the dead man’s fiancée (Gail Russell), a schoolteacher who sees the wounded soul behind his aggression. With this postwar comeback, Borzage recaptured the inspiration that had animated his long and audacious early career, marrying the lyrical force of his romantic sensibility with the psychological anguish of film noir, in a stunning vindication of faith in the power of love.

hook: 《沃克》是一部打破所有电影惯例的幻觉传记片，由英国导演亚历克斯·考克斯执导，讲述了 19 世纪美国冒险家威廉·沃克（艾德·哈里斯饰）的故事，他放弃了一系列法律、政治、新闻和医学职业，成为一名财富士兵，并在数月内担任尼加拉瓜独裁者。这部影片以疯狂的放纵和政治敏锐度制作而成，并得到了桑地诺军队和政府在反战期间的支持，利用这个真实的故事来讽刺美国的极端爱国主义和对“昭昭命运”的随心所欲的谴责。乔·斯特鲁默 (Joe Strummer) 的有力配乐和哈里斯 (Harris) 的强烈压抑愤怒的表演，《沃克》仍然是考克斯最大胆的作品之一。
hook_en: A hallucinatory biopic that breaks all cinematic conventions, Walker, from British director Alex Cox, tells the story of nineteenth-century American adventurer William Walker (Ed Harris), who abandoned a series of careers in law, politics, journalism, and medicine to become a soldier of fortune and, for many months, the dictator of Nicaragua. Made with mad abandon and political acuity—and the support of the Sandinista army and government during the contra war—the film uses this true tale as a satirical attack on American ultrapatriotism and a freewheeling condemnation of “manifest destiny.” Featuring a powerful score by Joe Strummer and a performance of intense, repressed rage by Harris, Walker remains one of Cox’s most daring works.

hook: 这部根据亨利·詹姆斯的热门舞台剧《华盛顿广场》改编而成的电影由威廉·惠勒执导，具有敏锐的模糊感，围绕动机问题展开。当纽约一位富有医生的女儿害羞、情感脆弱的凯瑟琳·斯洛珀（奥利维娅·德哈维兰饰）（奥利维娅·德·哈维兰饰）开始接到英俊的挥金如土的莫里斯·汤森德（蒙哥马利·克利夫特饰）打来的电话时，她就被浪漫的承诺所着迷。他闷烧的爱情表白是否如她所认为的那样真诚？或者凯瑟琳精于算计的父亲（拉尔夫·理查森饰）对莫里斯的判断是否正确？ 《女继承人》是一部优雅的客厅剧，由伊迪丝·海德 (Edith Head) 设计的荣获奥斯卡奖的服装设计，也是一部尖锐的人物研究，充满了情感上的不确定性和撕裂般的残酷，是经典好莱坞电影制作在心理上最细致入微的胜利。
hook_en: Directed with a keen sense of ambiguity by William Wyler, this film based on a hit stage adaptation of Henry James’s Washington Square pivots on a question of motive. When shy, emotionally fragile Catherine Sloper (Olivia de Havilland, in a heartbreaking, Oscar-winning turn), the daughter of a wealthy New York doctor, begins to receive calls from the handsome spendthrift Morris Townsend (Montgomery Clift), she becomes possessed by the promise of romance. Are his smoldering professions of love sincere, as she believes they are? Or is Catherine’s calculating father (Ralph Richardson) correct in judging Morris a venal fortune seeker? A graceful drawing-room drama boasting Academy Award–winning costume design by Edith Head, The Heiress is also a piercing character study riven by emotional uncertainty and lacerating cruelty, in a triumph of classic Hollywood filmmaking at its most psychologically nuanced.

hook: “我为什么要把自己绑在一个女人身上？” 《克莱尔的膝盖》中的杰罗姆问道，尽管他计划在夏末迎​​娶一位外交官的女儿。他在湖边的寄宿公寓里度过了七月，暗恋着十六岁的劳拉，更诱人的是她的长腿金发同父异母的姐姐克莱尔。克莱尔在盛开的樱桃树下的梯子上裸露膝盖，无意间引发了杰罗姆的道德危机，同时创造了一个既是埃里克·侯麦的六个道德故事的标志性象征，又是法国电影最持久的时刻之一的形象。
hook_en: “Why would I tie myself to one woman?” asks Jerôme in Claire’s Knee, though he plans to marry a diplomat’s daughter by summer’s end. He spends his July at a lakeside boardinghouse, nursing crushes on the sixteen-year-old Laura and, more tantalizingly, her long-legged, blonde, older half sister, Claire. Baring her knee on a ladder under a blooming cherry tree, Claire unwittingly incites a moral crisis for Jerôme while creating an image that is both the iconic emblem of Eric Rohmer’s Six Moral Tales and one of French cinema’s most enduring moments.

hook: 在带你来到一个遥远的星系之前，在带你与活生生、会呼吸的史前野兽面对面之前，未来九次获得奥斯卡奖的视觉效果艺术家（《星球大战》、《侏罗纪公园》）丹尼斯·穆伦（Dennis Muren）与一群才华横溢的年轻电影制作人联手，在怪诞的怪物大混战《春分》中向昔日的生物特征致敬。在加利福尼亚州的树林和峡谷深处，四名青少年偶然发现一本古书，其中包含一个与人类共存的奇怪而恶毒的世界的秘密。这部预算为 6,500 美元的奇幻电影（原名为《春分……超自然之旅》）被制片人杰克·H·哈里斯（《The Blob》）挑选发行，他与编剧兼导演杰克·伍兹一起为这部电影拍摄了新镜头，并于 1970 年以《春分》的名字发行。从那时起，这部电影就赢得了狂热的追随者，并激励了后代的恐怖/奇幻电影制作人。
hook_en: Before he took you to a galaxy far, far away, before he brought you face-to-face with living, breathing prehistoric beasts, Dennis Muren, the future nine-time Oscar-winning visual-effects artist (Star Wars, Jurassic Park), joined forces with a group of talented young filmmakers to create an homage to the creature features of yore in the eerie monster mash Equinox. Deep within the woods and canyons of California, four teenagers happen upon an ancient book containing the secrets of a strange, malevolent world that coexists with that of mankind. This $6,500-budget wonder (originally called The Equinox . . . A Journey into the Supernatural) was picked up for distribution by producer Jack H. Harris (The Blob), who shot new footage for the film with writer-director Jack Woods and released it in 1970 as Equinox. Since then, the film has gained a passionate cult following and inspired succeeding generations of horror/fantasy filmmakers.

hook: 前小联盟球员罗恩·谢尔顿凭借他的导演处女作获得了大满贯，成为有史以来最受尊敬的体育电影之一。达勒姆公牛队的忠实粉丝安妮·萨沃伊（苏珊·萨兰登饰）每年都会招收一名新球员（并进入她的床上），她特别挑选了松散的投手新星努克·拉鲁什（蒂姆·罗宾斯饰），他是一位成熟度最低的大联盟天才球员。但她无法撼动克拉什·戴维斯（凯文·科斯特纳饰），这位经验丰富的接球手是为了给 Nuke 一些场上的训练而请来的。 《达勒姆公牛》是三位主演的突破性电影，谢尔顿的剧本被高度引用，并获得奥斯卡提名，是一首对智慧、经验和美国消遣的随心所欲的赞歌，向所有热爱这项运动的人致敬。
hook_en: Former minor leaguer Ron Shelton hit a grand slam with his directorial debut, one of the most revered sports movies of all time. Durham Bulls devotee Annie Savoy (Susan Sarandon)—who every year takes a new player under her wing (and into her bed)—has singled out the loose-cannon pitching prospect Nuke LaLoosh (Tim Robbins), a big-league talent with a rock-bottom maturity level. But she’s unable to shake Crash Davis (Kevin Costner), the veteran catcher brought in to give Nuke some on-the-field seasoning. A breakthrough film for all three of its stars and an Oscar nominee for Shelton’s highly quotable screenplay, Bull Durham is a freewheeling hymn to wisdom, experience, and America’s pastime, tipping its cap to all those who grind it out for love of the game.

hook: 奥斯卡奖获奖电影制片人简·坎皮恩 (Jane Campion) 在《我餐桌上的天使》中，将新西兰最杰出作家珍妮特·弗雷姆 (Janet Frame) 的悲惨自传搬上了银幕。三位演员轮流担任主角（包括凯瑞·福克斯（Kerry Fox）饰演成年弗莱姆），影片描述了一段从充满悲剧的贫困童年，到被误诊为精神分裂症、接受电击治疗和险些被脑白质切除术，最终获得国际文学声誉的旅程。坎皮恩低调地捕捉了新西兰风景的美丽和力量，同时保持了影片对中心人物的关注，为世界各地的女性电影制片人开辟了新天地，并赢得了新西兰的多项电影奖项，以及威尼斯电影节评审团特别奖。
hook_en: With An Angel at My Table, Academy Award–winning filmmaker Jane Campion brought to the screen the harrowing autobiography of Janet Frame, New Zealand’s most distinguished author. Three actors in turn take on the lead role (including Kerry Fox in a marvelous performance as the adult Frame), as the film describes a journey from an impoverished childhood marked by tragedy to a misdiagnosis of schizophrenia resulting in electroshock therapy and a narrowly escaped lobotomy to, finally, international literary fame. Unobtrusively capturing the beauty and power of the New Zealand landscape while maintaining the film’s focus on the figure at its center, Campion broke new ground for female filmmakers everywhere and earned a sweep of her country’s film awards, along with the Special Jury Prize at the Venice Film Festival.

hook: 《吃拉乌尔》是 20 世纪 80 年代初的热门电影，讲述了一个关于炫耀性消费的淫荡、不道德的故事。沃霍尔巨星玛丽·沃罗诺夫和邪教传奇人物保罗·巴特尔（同时执导）描绘了一对拘谨的已婚夫妇，他们感觉自己被住在公寓楼里的浪荡公子欺骗了。一天晚上，他们偶然发现了一种方法，既可以摆脱大厅里的“变态”，又可以实现开餐馆的梦想。 《吃拉乌尔》融合了搞笑、随心所欲的闹剧和对我这一代自我放纵的辛辣讽刺，标志着性革命的结束。
hook_en: A sleeper hit of the early 1980s, Eating Raoul is a bawdy, gleefully amoral tale of conspicuous consumption. Warhol superstar Mary Woronov and cult legend Paul Bartel (who also directed) portray a prudish married couple who feel put upon by the swingers living in their apartment building. One night, by accident, they discover a way to simultaneously rid themselves of the “perverts” down the hall and realize their dream of opening a restaurant. A mix of hilarious, anything-goes slapstick and biting satire of me-generation self-indulgence, Eating Raoul marked the end of the sexual revolution with a thwack.

hook: 一名精神错乱的妇女正在一所偏远、神秘的机构接受彻底的心理治疗。与此同时，她五岁的女儿在分居的丈夫的照顾下，受到一群恶魔的恐吓。这两条故事线是如何联系在一起的，这是这部由大卫·柯南伯格执导、奥利弗·里德和萨曼莎·艾加主演的关于可怕的父母身份的血腥故事中令人震惊和怪诞的秘密。 《母巢》将心理恐怖和身体恐怖结合在一起，为导演后来的许多电影奠定了基础，但它本身就是一个个人的、异常恐怖的愿景。
hook_en: A disturbed woman is receiving a radical form of psychotherapy at a remote, mysterious institute. Meanwhile, her five-year-old daughter, under the care of her estranged husband, is being terrorized by a group of demonic beings. How these two story lines connect is the shocking and grotesque secret of this bloody tale of monstrous parenthood from David Cronenberg, starring Oliver Reed and Samantha Eggar. With its combination of psychological and body horror, The Brood laid the groundwork for many of the director’s films to come, but it stands on its own as a personal, singularly scary vision.

hook: 在这个星际警示故事中，傲慢的美国海军试飞员丹·普雷斯科特渴望名誉，将自己发射到地球大气层之外，结果却被宇宙尘埃包裹，并返回一个饮血怪物。
hook_en: In this interstellar cautionary tale, brash U.S. Navy test pilot Dan Prescott, hungry for fame, rockets himself beyond Earth’s atmosphere, only to become encrusted with cosmic dust and return a blood-drinking monster.

hook: 查理·卓别林这部关于前杂耍明星暮年的精彩剧情片是这位编剧兼导演最感人的电影之一。卓别林饰演卡尔韦罗，一位曾经深受人们喜爱的音乐喜剧演员，现在是一个住在伦敦一间小公寓里的酗酒者。当他遇到住在楼下的美丽但忧郁的芭蕾舞女演员（克莱尔·布鲁姆饰）时，一线希望降临。这部感人的电影将喜剧与悲剧优雅地融合在一起，巴斯特·基顿也在其中加长客串，这是这两位无声喜剧偶像唯一一次一起出现在电影中。 《Limelight》制作于卓别林受到美国媒体和极右翼攻击的时期，最初发行时几乎没有在美国发行，但现在它被认为是卓别林最重要、最个人化的作品之一。
hook_en: Charlie Chaplin’s masterful drama about the twilight of a former vaudeville star is among the writer-director’s most touching films. Chaplin plays Calvero, a once beloved musical-comedy performer, now a washed-up alcoholic who lives in a small London flat. A glimmer of hope arrives when he meets a beautiful but melancholy ballerina (Claire Bloom) who lives downstairs. An elegant mix of the comic and the tragic, this poignant movie also features Buster Keaton in an extended cameo, marking the only time the two silent comedy icons appeared in a film together. Made at a time when Chaplin was under attack by the American press and far right, Limelight was scarcely distributed in the United States upon its initial release, but it is now considered one of his essential and most personal works.

hook: 查理·卓别林的这部长期被忽视的默片杰作《巴黎的女人》因其心理上的细微差别和对独立女性寻求满足的大胆现代视角而引人注目，这是一个启示。卓别林出人意料地涉足严肃戏剧，并将聚光灯让给了他的长期银幕搭档埃德娜·珀薇安斯，这让 1923 年的观众感到困惑。她饰演的玛丽·圣克莱尔充满魅力，是一位“命运的女人”，她离开了狭隘的村庄，前往巴黎的魅力，在那里她发现自己处于爵士乐时代的香槟晚会、奢华的享乐、浪漫和悲剧的中心。抛开他的小流浪汉角色不谈，卓别林的第二部长片证明，他除了是一位喜剧天才之外，还是一位具有巨大敏感性和人类理解力的艺术家。
hook_en: Remarkable for its psychological nuance and its boldly modern perspective on an independent woman’s search for fulfillment, Charlie Chaplin’s long-overlooked silent masterpiece A Woman of Paris is a revelation. Chaplin confounded 1923 audiences with this unexpected foray into serious drama, and by ceding the spotlight to his longtime screen partner Edna Purviance. She is captivating as the vivacious Marie St. Clair, a “woman of fate” who leaves behind her small-minded village for the glamour of Paris, where she finds herself at the center of a Jazz Age whirl of champagne soirees, luxurious pleasure-seeking, romance, and tragedy. Putting aside his Little Tramp persona, Chaplin’s second feature proved that, beyond being a comic genius, he was an artist of immense sensitivity and human understanding.

hook: 在默片时代拍摄的最后一部电影中，查理·卓别林陶醉于马戏艺术，向那些激发了他的大师级表演灵感的杂技演员和哑剧演员致敬。卓别林扮演的流浪汉被误认为是扒手后，逃进了一个巡回马戏团的表演圈，很快就成为了节目的明星，并一路上爱上了马戏团的无鞍骑手。尽管其制作过程出了名的麻烦，这部充满笑料的喜剧仍跻身卓别林最优秀的喜剧之列，这要归功于这位导演兼表演者职业生涯中一些最大胆的布景，包括与狮子的亲密接触和与一桶猴子的高潮走钢丝。 《马戏团》于 1969 年重新上映，由卓别林创作了新配乐，这是一场喧闹的走钢丝表演，展示了无声电影界最受欢迎的艺人在喜剧能力巅峰时期的表现。
hook_en: In the last film he made during the silent era, Charlie Chaplin revels in the art of the circus, paying tribute to the acrobats and pantomimists who inspired his virtuoso pratfalls. After being mistaken for a pickpocket, Chaplin’s Tramp flees into the ring of a traveling circus and soon becomes the star of the show, falling for the troupe’s bareback rider along the way. Despite its famously troubled production, this gag-packed comedy ranks among Chaplin’s finest, thanks to some of the most audacious set pieces of the director-performer’s career, including a close brush with a lion and a climactic tightrope walk with a barrelful of monkeys. The Circus, which was rereleased in 1969 with a new score by Chaplin, is an uproarious high-wire act that showcases silent cinema’s most popular entertainer at the peak of his comic powers.

hook: 罗伯特·奥特曼的这部非正统的梦幻西部片可能是新美国电影中最美丽的电影。沃伦·比蒂和朱莉·克里斯蒂在片中饰演太平洋西北采矿小镇长老会教堂的两名新人，他们联手为矿工提供优质的妓院体验。然而，一家拥有自身利益的强大矿业公司代表的出现可能会导致他们的计划付诸东流。凭借其迷人而有缺陷的角色、伟大的维尔莫斯·齐格蒙德的令人回味的摄影、创新的重叠对话以及对伦纳德·科恩歌曲的令人难忘的使用，《麦凯布和米勒夫人》出色地消除了最具美国风格的魅力并使其焕发活力。
hook_en: This unorthodox dream western by Robert Altman may be the most radically beautiful film to come out of the New American Cinema. It stars Warren Beatty and Julie Christie as two newcomers to the raw Pacific Northwest mining town of Presbyterian Church, who join forces to provide the miners with a superior kind of whorehouse experience. The appearance of representatives for a powerful mining company with interests of its own, however, threatens to be the undoing of their plans. With its fascinating, flawed characters, evocative cinematography by the great Vilmos Zsigmond, innovative overlapping dialogue, and haunting use of Leonard Cohen songs, McCabe & Mrs. Miller brilliantly deglamorized and revitalized the most American of genres.

hook: 一位用毒笔写信的神秘作家，人们只知道他叫勒科博（乌鸦），他困扰着法国的一个省镇，揭露了社区平静表面下沸腾的集体猜疑和积怨。亨利·乔治·克鲁佐的《科尔博》制作于纳粹占领法国期间，受到右翼维希政权、左翼抵抗报刊和天主教会的攻击，解放后被禁。但包括让·谷克托和让-保罗·萨特在内的一些人认识到了克鲁佐反线人、反盖世太保寓言的强大潜台词，并在战后努力恢复他的导演声誉。勒·科尔博出色地捕捉到了偏执的琐碎和自我厌恶，正是这些让一个被占领的法国小镇变成了二十世纪的塞勒姆。
hook_en: A mysterious writer of poison-pen letters, known only as Le Corbeau (the Raven), plagues a French provincial town, exposing the collective suspicion and rancor seething beneath the community’s calm surface. Made during the Nazi occupation of France, Henri-Georges Clouzot’s Le Corbeau was attacked by the right-wing Vichy regime, the left-wing Resistance press, and the Catholic Church, and was banned after the liberation. But some—including Jean Cocteau and Jean-Paul Sartre—recognized the powerful subtext of Clouzot’s anti-informant, anti-Gestapo fable, and worked to rehabilitate his directorial reputation after the war. Le Corbeau brilliantly captures the paranoid pettiness and self-loathing that turn an occupied French town into a twentieth-century Salem.

hook: 在巴黎的一间监狱牢房里，五名囚犯使出浑身的坚韧和聪明才智，精心策划通向自由的隧道。雅克·贝克尔的《洞》改编自何塞·乔瓦尼的小说，在抒情的人文主义与迫在眉睫的危险的紧张、不可动摇的气氛之间取得了平衡。
hook_en: In a Paris prison cell, five inmates use every ounce of their tenacity and ingenuity in an elaborate attempt to tunnel to freedom. Based on the novel by José Giovanni, Jacques Becker’s Le trou (The Hole) balances lyrical humanism with a tense, unshakable air of imminent danger.

hook: 在路易斯·布努埃尔的大胆杰作《消灭天使》中，一群上流社会的朋友被邀请到一座豪宅吃晚饭，却莫名其妙地无法离开。这部充满怪诞喜剧荒诞的电影是在导演轰动国际的《维迪亚娜》上映一年后拍摄的，延续了布努埃尔对轻浮上层阶级的仪式和依赖性的邪恶破坏。
hook_en: A group of high-society friends are invited to a mansion for dinner and find themselves inexplicably unable to leave, in Luis Buñuel’s daring masterpiece The Exterminating Angel (El ángel exterminador). Made just one year after the director’s inter­na­tional sensation Viridiana, this film, full of eerie comic absurdity, continues Buñuel’s wicked takedown of the rituals and dependencies of the frivolous upper classes.

hook: 这部电影讲述了一个科学家的思绪化为一群隐形的脑形怪物（配有脊髓尾巴！），这些怪物在一场噩梦般的恐怖片中 terror 化了一个美国军事基地。这部科幻/恐怖混合类型的电影由 Arthur Crabtree 执导（他也是《黑博物馆恐怖片》的导演），这部作品是特效的大餐，也是英国类型电影的高峰。
hook_en: A scientist’s thoughts materialize as an army of invisible brain-shaped monsters (complete with spinal-cord tails!) who terrorize an American military base in this nightmarish chiller, directed by Arthur Crabtree (Horrors of the Black Museum). This outstanding sci-fi/horror hybrid is a special effects bonanza, and a high-water mark in British genre filmmaking.

hook: 唐娜·戴奇 (Donna Deitch) 的第一部令人着迷、感性的叙事长片《沙漠之心》于 1985 年上映，具有开创性：讲述了两个女人的爱情故事，由一名女性完全独立制作，预算有限。这部以 1959 年为背景的电影改编自简·鲁尔 (Jane Rule) 深受人们喜爱的小说，性格内向的东海岸教授维维安·贝尔 (海伦·谢弗饰) 来到里诺申请离婚，但最终吸引了新人、自由奔放的年轻凯伊 (帕特里夏·夏博诺饰) 的注意，在令人惊叹的沙漠景观中慢慢展开了诱惑。两位主角之间不可否认的化学反应、令人回味的自动点唱机配乐以及罗伯特·埃尔斯威特生动的摄影，《沙漠之心》精美地散发着温柔的向往和情感坦诚的感觉。
hook_en: Donna Deitch’s swooning and sensual first narrative feature, Desert Hearts, was groundbreaking upon its release in 1985: a love story about two women, made entirely independently, on a shoestring budget, by a woman. In this 1959-set film, adapted from a beloved novel by Jane Rule, straitlaced East Coast professor Vivian Bell (Helen Shaver) arrives in Reno to file for divorce but winds up catching the eye of someone new, the free-spirited young Cay (Patricia Charbonneau), touching off a slow seduction that unfolds against a breathtaking desert landscape. With undeniable chemistry between its two leads, an evocative jukebox soundtrack, and vivid cinematography by Robert Elswit, Desert Hearts beautifully exudes a sense of tender yearning and emotional candor.

hook: 让·雷诺阿的《人性之美》改编自埃米尔·佐拉的经典小说，是这位传奇导演最受欢迎的成功作品之一，并为明星让·加宾赢得了在同胞心中永久的地位。这部电影一半是诗意现实主义，一半是黑色电影，是一段深入工人痛苦心灵的冷酷而悬疑的旅程。
hook_en: Based on the classic Émile Zola novel, Jean Renoir's La bête humaine was one of the legendary director's greatest popular successes—and earned star Jean Gabin a permanent place in the hearts of his countrymen. Part poetic realism, part film noir, the film is a hard-boiled and suspenseful journey into the tormented psyche of a workingman.

hook: 贾贝兹·斯通是一位勤劳的农民，试图诚实地谋生，但一连串的坏运气诱使他做出了不可思议的事情：与魔鬼讨价还价。为了换取七年的好运，斯通向“刮痕先生”许诺了他的灵魂。但当这位陷入困境的农民开始意识到自己选择的错误时，他寻求了一个可能拯救他的人的帮助：传奇演说家和政治家丹尼尔·韦伯斯特。 《金钱能买的一切》由威廉·迪特勒 (William Dieterle) 执导，以时尚风格执导，以富有灵感的视觉效果、伯纳德·赫尔曼 (Bernard Herrmann) 令人难忘的奥斯卡获奖配乐以及沃尔特·休斯顿 (Walter Huston) 饰演的恶魔的真正恶魔般的表演，将斯蒂芬·文森特·贝内特 (Stephen Vincent Benét) 的经典短篇小说带入生活。
hook_en: Jabez Stone is a hardworking farmer trying to make an honest living, but a streak of bad luck tempts him to do the unthinkable: bargain with the devil himself. In exchange for seven years of good fortune, Stone promises “Mr. Scratch” his soul. But when the troubled farmer begins to realize the error of his choice, he enlists the aid of the one man who might save him: the legendary orator and politician Daniel Webster. Directed with stylish flair by William Dieterle, All That Money Can Buy brings the classic short story by Stephen Vincent Benét to life with inspired visuals, an unforgettable, Oscar-winning score by Bernard Herrmann, and a truly diabolical performance from Walter Huston as the devil.

hook: 《另一个人的面孔》是一部令人惊叹的存在主义科幻小说，它以外科医生的可靠之手剖析了身份。奥山（《Yojimbo》中达也饰）在一次工业事故中被烧伤、毁容，并与家人和朋友疏远后，同意了他的精神科医生的激进实验：用陌生人的模具进行面部移植。当奥山与周围的世界进一步疏远时，他发现自己屈服于黑暗的诱惑。弟子河原的电影以令人难忘的图像探索了获得新角色的限制和自由，并对个性本身的概念提出了质疑。
hook_en: A staggering work of existential science fiction, The Face of Another dissects identity with the sure hand of a surgeon. Okuyama (Yojimbo's Tatsuya Nakadai), after being burned and disfigured in an industrial accident and estranged from his family and friends, agrees to his psychiatrist's radical experiment: a face transplant, created from the mold of a stranger. As Okuyama is thus further alienated from the world around him, he finds himself giving in to his darker temptations. With unforgettable imagery, Teshigahara's film explores both the limits and freedom in acquiring a new persona, and questions the notion of individuality itself.

hook: 英格玛·伯格曼凭借《魔术师》这部引人入胜、构思精妙的诡计故事，同时也是艺术家作为骗子的象征性肖像，证明了自己是电影界首屈一指的魔术师之一。马克斯·冯·西多 (Max von Sydow) 饰演沃格勒博士 (Dr. Vogler)，他是一位 19 世纪的旅行催眠师和魔药小贩，他的魔法在斯德哥尔摩接受了残酷但极其理性的皇家医学顾问维杰鲁斯博士 (贡纳尔·比约恩斯特兰德 (Gunnar Björnstrand) 饰) 的考验。结果是一场邪恶而聪明的斗智斗勇，既可怕又有趣，由冈纳·费舍尔以丰富、华丽的哥特式黑白镜头拍摄。
hook_en: With The Magician, an engaging, brilliantly conceived tale of chicanery that doubles as a symbolic portrait of the artist as a deceiver, Ingmar Bergman proved himself to be one of cinema’s premier illusionists. Max von Sydow stars as Dr. Vogler, a nineteenth-century traveling mesmerist and peddler of potions whose magic is put to the test in Stockholm by the cruel, eminently rational royal medical adviser Dr. Vergérus (Gunnar Björnstrand). The result is a diabolically clever battle of wits that’s both frightening and funny, shot by Gunnar Fischer in rich, gorgeously gothic black and white.

hook: “神啊，你为何离弃我？”英格玛·伯格曼在《冬日之光》中探索了在无意义的存在中寻找救赎的过程。小镇牧师托马斯·埃里克森（古纳尔·比约恩斯特兰德饰）机械地在逐渐减少的会众面前履行自己的职责，其中包括他顽固忠诚的情人玛尔塔（英格丽德·图林饰）。当托马斯被要求平息一位陷入困境的教区居民（马克斯·冯·赛多饰）对核毁灭的恐惧时，他惊恐地发现自己除了自己的怀疑之外什么也无法提供。这张精美拍摄的《冬日之光》以令人不安的方式展现了人类在一个看似被上帝遗弃的世界中对个人认可的渴望。
hook_en: “God, why hast thou forsaken me?” With Winter Light, Ingmar Bergman explores the search for redemption in a meaningless existence. Small-town pastor Tomas Ericsson (Gunnar Björnstrand) performs his duties mechanically before a dwindling congregation, including his stubbornly devoted lover, Märta (Ingrid Thulin). When he is asked to assuage a troubled parishioner’s (Max von Sydow) debilitating fear of nuclear annihilation, Tomas is terrified to find that he can provide nothing but his own doubt. The beautifully photographed Winter Light is an unsettling look at the human craving for personal validation in a world seemingly abandoned by God.

hook: 洛林·汉斯伯里的不朽之作《阳光下的葡萄干》是第一部在百老汇演出的黑人女性戏剧。两年后，该作品搬上银幕，由丹尼尔·皮特里执导。包括西德尼·波蒂埃和鲁比·迪在内的原版明星在这部引起深刻共鸣的梦想推迟故事中，再次扮演居住在芝加哥狭小公寓中的非裔美国家庭成员。杨夫妇等待人寿保险支票，希望能改变他们的处境，但在如何使用这笔钱的问题上出现了紧张局势。皮特里的电影生动地呈现了汉斯伯里对代际冲突和住房歧视的敏锐观察，捕捉到了上世纪中叶美国黑人生活中的高风险、不断变化的潮流和各种经历。
hook_en: Lorraine Hansberry’s immortal A Raisin in the Sun was the first play by a black woman to be performed on Broadway. Two years later, the production came to the screen, directed by Daniel Petrie. The original stars—including Sidney Poitier and Ruby Dee—reprise their roles as members of an African American family living in a cramped Chicago apartment, in this deeply resonant tale of dreams deferred. The Youngers await a life-insurance check they hope will change their circumstances, but tensions arise over how to use the money. Vividly rendering Hansberry’s sharp observations on generational conflict and housing discrimination, Petrie’s film captures the high stakes, shifting currents, and varieties of experience within black life in midcentury America.

hook: 在纳粹空袭中，一名邮递员在英国一家乡村医院的手术台上死亡。但死亡是意外吗？英国作家兼导演西德尼·吉利亚特的《绿色危机》是一部令人愉快且完全出乎意料的谋杀悬疑剧，特雷弗·霍华德和莎莉·格雷饰演可疑医生，阿拉斯泰尔·西姆则奇妙地饰演苏格兰场漫不经心的督察科克里尔。吉利亚特是一位曾与希区柯克合作过《消失的女士》和《牙买加客栈》等电影的编剧，他巧妙地用智慧和风格颠覆了侦探片的惯例。
hook_en: In the midst of Nazi air raids, a postman dies on the operating table at a rural English hospital. But was the death accidental? A delightful and wholly unexpected murder mystery, British writer/director Sidney Gilliat's Green for Danger features Trevor Howard and Sally Gray as suspected doctors and Alastair Sim in a marvelous turn as Scotland Yard's insouciant Inspector Cockrill. A screenwriter who had worked with Hitchcock on such films as The Lady Vanishes and Jamaica Inn, Gilliat slyly upends whodunit conventions with wit and style.

hook: 琳恩·拉姆齐 (Lynne Ramsay) 在她令人惊叹且自信的处女作中，令人难以忘怀地回忆起格拉斯哥陷入困境的童年。 《捕鼠者》以 20 世纪 70 年代中期苏格兰的全国垃圾罢工为背景，探讨了一个贫穷的青春期男孩的经历，他努力调和自己的梦想、愧疚感和周围的落魄。拉姆齐利用美丽、难以捉摸的图像、坦率的表演和意想不到的幽默，巧妙地将城市的衰败与充满希望和毅力的丰富的室内景观进行对比，从而创作出一部既原始又充满诗意的作品。
hook_en: In her breathtaking and assured debut feature, Lynne Ramsay creates a haunting evocation of a troubled Glasgow childhood. Set during Scotland’s national garbage strike of the mid-1970s, Ratcatcher explores the experiences of a poor adolescent boy as he struggles to reconcile his dreams and his guilt with the abjection that surrounds him. Utilizing beautiful, elusive imagery, candid performances, and unexpected humor, Ramsay deftly contrasts urban decay with a rich interior landscape of hope and perseverance, resulting in a work at once raw and deeply poetic.

hook: 这幅对家庭动乱的毫不妥协的描绘详细描述了一位郊区家庭主妇的情感崩溃以及她的家人为拯救她而进行的斗争。吉娜·罗兰兹和彼得·法尔克饰演一对深爱的已婚夫妇，但无法用对方可以理解的方式表达他们的热情，他们的表演令人难忘。这部具有里程碑意义的美国电影也许是非凡的约翰·卡索维茨最受欢迎的作品。
hook_en: This uncompromising portrait of domestic turmoil details the emotional breakdown of a suburban housewife and her family’s struggle to save her from herself. Gena Rowlands and Peter Falk give unforgettably harrowing performances as a married couple deeply in love but unable to express their ardor in terms the other can understand. This landmark American film is perhaps the most beloved work from the extraordinary John Cassavetes.

hook: “密切关注他们，因为这是他们生命中的最后几个小时”，旁白宣布，他预言了当一群饱受战争蹂躏的祖国军抵抗战士试图通过华沙下水道逃离纳粹袭击时发生的悲剧。决心生存的男人和女人艰难地穿过地狱般的迷宫，用各自灵魂的力量刺穿黑暗。根据真实事件改编的《Kanal》是第一部关于华沙起义的电影，使导演安杰伊·瓦依达 (Andrzej Wajda) 受到国际观众的关注，并于 1957 年在戛纳电影节获得评审团特别奖。
hook_en: “Watch them closely, for these are the last hours of their lives,” announces a narrator, foretelling the tragedy that unfolds as a war-ravaged company of Home Army resistance fighters tries to escape the Nazi onslaught through the sewers of Warsaw. Determined to survive, the men and women slog through the hellish labyrinth, piercing the darkness with the strength of their individual spirits. Based on true events, Kanal was the first film ever made about the Warsaw Uprising and brought director Andrzej Wajda to the attention of international audiences, earning the Special Jury Prize in Cannes in 1957.

hook: 国际知名的伊朗电影制片人阿巴斯·基亚罗斯塔米 (Abbas Kiarostami) 创作了过去三十年来最具创意和超凡的电影，《特写》是他最激进、最精彩的作品。这部虚构与纪录片的混合体以一个轰动的现实生活事件为基础，对电影、身份、艺术创作和存在进行了令人震惊的、多层次的调查，其中案件中的真实人物扮演了自己。 《特写》以其普遍的主题和引人入胜的叙事结引起了世界各地观众的共鸣。
hook_en: Internationally revered Iranian filmmaker Abbas Kiarostami has created some of the most inventive and transcendent cinema of the past thirty years, and Close-up is his most radical, brilliant work. This fiction-documentary hybrid uses a sensational real-life event—the arrest of a young man on charges that he fraudulently impersonated the well-known filmmaker Mohsen Makhmalbaf—as the basis for a stunning, multilayered investigation into movies, identity, artistic creation, and existence, in which the real people from the case play themselves. With its universal themes and fascinating narrative knots, Close-up has resonated with viewers around the world.

hook: 伟大的阿巴斯·基亚罗斯塔米（ Abbas Kiarostami ）拍摄的这部严肃而复杂的戏剧是第一部赢得金棕榈奖的伊朗电影，讲述了神秘的巴迪（ Homayoun Ershadi ）先生在德黑兰丘陵郊区开车寻找一个同意在他自杀后埋葬他的人，这是伊斯兰教的禁忌。与三名乘客（一名士兵、一名神学院教师和一名标本皮肤科医生）的广泛对话引发了对死亡率和个人的不同看法…
hook_en: The first Iranian film to win the Palme d’Or, this austere, emotionally complex drama by the greatAbbas Kiarostami follows the enigmatic Mr. Badii (Homayoun Ershadi) as he drives around the hilly outskirts of Tehran looking for someone who will agree to bury him after he commits suicide, a taboo under Islam. Extended conversations with three passengers (a soldier, a seminarian, and a taxidermist) elicit different views on mortality and individual choice. Operating at once as a closely observed, realistic story and a fable populated by archetypal figures, Taste of Cherry challenges the viewer to consider what often goes unexamined in everyday life.

hook: 奥森·威尔斯的《审判》是对弗兰兹·卡夫卡小说的狂热演绎，安东尼·帕金斯饰演困惑的办公室无人机约瑟夫·K.，他因一项未指明的罪行被捕，使他陷入了罪恶、腐败和偏执的险恶官僚迷宫。威尔斯被好莱坞放逐，创意不受束缚，他将自己对制片厂系统、黑名单和各种形式的极权主义压迫的愤怒倾注到这部电影声明中——一部大胆的个人电影，他自己认为这是他最伟大的电影之一。令人眼花缭乱的镜头角度、表现主义的灯光、越来越超现实的场景——威尔斯充分发挥了他视觉才华的力量，传达了一个疯狂世界的噩梦般的迷失。
hook_en: A feverishly inspired take on Franz Kafka’s novel, Orson Welles’s The Trial casts Anthony Perkins as the bewildered office drone Josef K., whose arrest for an unspecified crime plunges him into a menacing bureaucratic labyrinth of guilt, corruption, and paranoia. Exiled from Hollywood and creatively unchained, Welles poured his ire at the studio system, the blacklist, and all forms of totalitarian oppression into this cinematic statement—a bold, personal film that he himself considered one of his greatest. Dizzying camera angles, expressionistic lighting, increasingly surreal locations—Welles unleashed the full force of his visual brilliance to convey the nightmarish disorientation of a world gone mad.

hook: 弗农是佛罗里达州狭长地带的一个小镇，周围环绕着沼泽。在这里，埃罗尔·莫里斯为他激动人心的处女作《天堂之门》的后续作品找到了安静迷人的主题。莫里斯一如既往地人道而专注，让他的镜头对象武断地巡视这个看似不起眼的小社区的周围环境。结果是一部奇怪的哲学作品，巩固了导演作为美国电影重要人物的地位。
hook_en: Vernon is a town in the Florida panhandle surrounded by swamps. Here, Errol Morris found the quietly fascinating subjects for the follow-up to his galvanizing debut, Gates of Heaven. As ever humane yet sharply focused, Morris lets his camera subjects pontificate and perambulate the environs of this seemingly unremarkable little community. The result is a strangely philosophical work that cemented its director’s standing as an important figure in American film.

hook: 在这个扭曲的爱情故事中，阿尔弗雷德·希区柯克通过让两位好莱坞最受喜爱的明星扮演截然不同的角色，唤起了更深层次的悬念和激情。英格丽·褒曼饰演艾丽西娅，一位有着曲折过去的迷人女人，被温文尔雅、神秘的情报特工德夫林（加里·格兰特饰）招募，为美国从事间谍活动。直到她爱上德夫林后，她才知道自己的任务是引诱躲藏在南美的纳粹实业家（克劳德·雷恩斯饰）。希区柯克将富有创意的电影摄影与令人着迷的主角的精彩微妙的转变相结合，精心策划了一段充满欺骗和道德模糊性的痛苦浪漫故事。 《美人计》是一部罕见的完美惊悚片，代表了其导演传奇生涯和经典好莱坞电影的顶峰。
hook_en: With this twisted love story, Alfred Hitchcock summoned darker shades of suspense and passion by casting two of Hollywood’s most beloved stars starkly against type. Ingrid Bergman plays Alicia, an alluring woman with a checkered past recruited by Devlin (Cary Grant), a suave, mysterious intelligence agent, to spy for the U.S. Only after she has fallen for Devlin does she learn that her mission is to seduce a Nazi industrialist (Claude Rains) hiding out in South America. Coupling inventive cinematography with brilliantly subtle turns from his mesmerizing leads, Hitchcock orchestrates an anguished romance shot through with deception and moral ambiguity. A thriller of rare perfection, Notorious represents a pinnacle of both its director’s legendary career and classic Hollywood cinema.

hook: 《失落的灵魂之岛》是好莱坞前《法典》恐怖全盛时期的扭曲宝藏，改编自 H. G. 威尔斯的小说《莫罗博士之岛》，是一个科学失控的警示故事。查尔斯·劳顿在他的第一个主要电影角色中扮演了一位疯狂的医生，他在南海的一个偏远岛屿上进行可怕的基因实验，这让发现自己被困在那里的海难男子（理查德·阿伦饰）感到恐惧和厌恶。这部恐怖电影的试金石由厄尔·C·肯顿 (Erle C. Kenton) 执导，采用卡尔·斯特鲁斯 (​​Karl Struss) 的表现主义摄影、启发了一代又一代怪物电影艺术家的突破性化妆效果，以及传奇人物贝拉·卢戈西 (Bela Lugosi) 扮演的最可怕的角色之一。
hook_en: A twisted treasure from Hollywood’s pre-Code horror heyday, Island of Lost Souls is a cautionary tale of science run amok, adapted from H. G. Wells’s novel The Island of Dr. Moreau. In one of his first major movie roles, Charles Laughton is a mad doctor conducting ghastly genetic experiments on a remote island in the South Seas, much to the fear and disgust of the shipwrecked man (Richard Arlen) who finds himself trapped there. This touchstone of movie terror, directed by Erle C. Kenton, features expressionistic photography by Karl Struss, groundbreaking makeup effects that have inspired generations of monster-movie artists, and the legendary Bela Lugosi in one of his most gruesome roles.

hook: 当一名扒手在拥挤的公共汽车上偷走他的枪时，年轻侦探村上的糟糕日子变得更糟。为了纠正错误，他开始卧底，在东京闷热的街道上搜寻一只流浪狗，这只流浪狗的绝望导致他走上了犯罪的道路。随着每一步的推进，警察和罪犯的生活变得更加交织在一起，调查也变成了对村上阴暗面的审视。由三船敏郎饰演新人警察，志村隆饰演经验丰富的侦探，让他走在法律正确的一边，《流浪狗》超越了犯罪惊悚片的范畴，探讨了战后日本的肮脏世界和犯罪心理的本质。
hook_en: A bad day gets worse for young detective Murakami when a pickpocket steals his gun on a crowded bus. Desperate to right the wrong, he goes undercover, scavenging Tokyo’s sweltering streets for the stray dog whose desperation has led him to a life of crime. With each step, cop’s and criminal’s lives become more intertwined and the investigation becomes an examination of Murakami’s own dark side. Starring Toshiro Mifune as the rookie cop and Takashi Shimura as the seasoned detective who keeps him on the right side of the law, Stray Dog goes beyond crime thriller, probing the squalid world of postwar Japan and the nature of the criminal mind.

hook: 特立独行的电影制作人保罗·莫里西（ Paul Morrissey ）的《弗兰肯斯坦的血肉》（ Flesh for Frankenstein ）重新评估了恐怖电影，将其注入了讽刺的智慧和性欲。Morrissey关于疯狂的弗兰肯斯坦男爵及其反常的创造性冲动的故事在最初发布时进行了大量编辑; Criterion以宽屏转移的方式呈现了恢复的导演在25年后完全完好无损。
hook_en: Maverick filmmaker Paul Morrissey’s Flesh for Frankenstein reevaluates the horror film, infusing it with satiric wit and sexuality. Morrissey’s tale of the mad Baron Frankenstein and his perverse creative urges was heavily edited upon initial release; Criterion presents the restored director’s cut—fully intact after 25 years—in a widescreen transfer.

hook: 这部根据杰奎琳·苏珊的耸人听闻且广受欢迎的小说改编的电影中，残酷的野心、狂野的性爱和凶猛的女主人公都一一呈现。帕蒂·杜克 (Patty Duke)、芭芭拉·帕金斯 (Barbara Parkins) 和莎朗·塔特 (Sharon Tate) 饰演三个朋友，试图在光鲜亮丽、充满压力的大型演艺界中遨游——“山谷”不是一个地方，而是一种麻醉的精神状态，而“娃娃”则是让他们早上醒来、晚上昏昏欲睡的药丸。导演马克·罗布森 (Mark Robson) 将老式的光鲜亮丽与麦迪逊大道的时髦风格融为一体，以巧妙的视角描绘了性解放的早期和娱乐业的分崩离析，票房大卖，并成为 1960 年代令人难忘的夸张时间胶囊。
hook_en: Cutthroat careerism, wild sex, and fierce female protagonists are all on offer in this adaptation of Jacqueline Susann’s sensational and wildly popular novel. Patty Duke, Barbara Parkins, and Sharon Tate star as three friends attempting to navigate the glamorous, pressurized world of big-time show business—the “valley” is not a place but a narcotized state of mind, and the “dolls” are the pills that rouse them in the morning and knock them out at night. Blending old-fashioned gloss with Madison Avenue grooviness, director Mark Robson’s slick look at the early days of sexual liberation and an entertainment industry coming apart was a giant box-office hit, and has become an unforgettably campy time capsule of the 1960s.

hook: 查理·卓别林在他最具争议性的电影中以惊人的反面表演，这是一部关于金钱、婚姻和谋杀的精彩而凄凉的黑色喜剧。卓别林是一位二十世纪的蓝胡子男人，一位神秘的顾家男人，他不遗余力地养活自己的妻子和孩子，试图摆脱一系列富有的寡妇（其中包括由不知疲倦的玛莎·雷伊扮演的一位寡妇，在一场滑稽的表演中）。这部充满哲理且极具娱乐性的电影是一部真正成熟的作品，无论是它敢于提出的道德问题，还是它解构巨星可爱的银幕形象的方式。
hook_en: Charlie Chaplin plays shockingly against type in his most controversial film, a brilliant and bleak black comedy about money, marriage, and murder. Chaplin is a twentieth-century bluebeard, an enigmatic family man who goes to extreme lengths to support his wife and child, attempting to bump off a series of wealthy widows (including one played by the indefatigable Martha Raye, in a hilarious performance). This deeply philosophical and wildly entertaining film is a work of true sophistication, both for the moral questions it dares to ask and for the way it deconstructs its megastar’s lovable on-screen persona.

hook: 1840 年代的伦敦，托马斯·博尔顿 (Thomas Bolton) 医生（鲍里斯·卡洛夫 (Boris Karloff) 饰）敢于梦想不可思议的事情：在不造成疼痛的情况下为患者进行手术。不幸的是，通向全身麻醉的道路被一个无情的杀手（克里斯托弗·李饰）以及博尔顿对自己化学实验的毁灭性沉迷所堵塞。
hook_en: In 1840s London, Dr. Thomas Bolton (Boris Karloff) dares to dream the unthinkable: to operate on patients without causing pain. Unfortunately, the road to general anesthesia is blocked by a ruthless killer (Christopher Lee), as well as Bolton’s devastating addiction to his own chemical experiments.

hook: 这是罗伯托·罗西里尼的启示，一部关于纳粹占领罗马以及少数勇敢的反抗者的悲惨戏剧。虽然故事情节比后来构成战争三部曲的电影更具戏剧性，并由一些知名演员主演——阿尔多·法布里兹饰演一名帮助游击队事业的牧师，安娜·马格纳尼饰演抵抗组织成员的未婚妻，这是一个突破性的角色，但罗马不设防的城市是一次令人震惊的真实体验，在第二次世界大战的废墟中构思和导演，每一帧都具有即时性。这部震撼人心的作品标志着意大利电影的分水岭，在全球范围内获奖，并开启了新电影运动的开端。
hook_en: This was Roberto Rossellini’s revelation, a harrowing drama about the Nazi occupation of Rome and the brave few who struggled against it. Though told with more melodramatic flair than the films that would follow it to form The War Trilogy and starring some well-known actors—Aldo Fabrizi as a priest helping the partisan cause and Anna Magnani in her breakthrough role as the fiancée of a resistance member—Rome Open City is a shockingly authentic experience, conceived and directed amid the ruin of World War II, with immediacy in every frame. Marking a watershed moment in Italian cinema, this galvanic work garnered awards around the globe and left the beginnings of a new film movement in its wake.

hook: 在弗兰克·卡普拉 (Frank Capra) 的这部浪漫公路旅行中，异性相吸，讲述了一位被宠坏的离家出走的社交名流（克劳黛特·考尔伯特饰）和一位恶毒的人民记者（克拉克·盖博饰）决心揭开她失踪丑闻的独家新闻。作为第一部横扫奥斯卡五项主要奖项（最佳影片、最佳男主角、最佳女主角、最佳导演和最佳剧本）的电影，《一夜发生》是早期有声时代构造和剪辑最精美的电影之一，充满了巧妙的场景和笑点，已进入好莱坞喜剧万神殿，并以两位顶尖演员为主角，迸发出前所未有的化学反应。
hook_en: Opposites attract with magnetic force in this romantic road-trip delight from Frank Capra, about a spoiled runaway socialite (Claudette Colbert) and a roguish man-of-the-people reporter (Clark Gable) who is determined to get the scoop on her scandalous disappearance. The first film to accomplish the very rare feat of sweeping all five major Oscar categories (best picture, best actor, best actress, best director, and best screenplay), It Happened One Night is among the most gracefully constructed and edited films of the early sound era, packed with clever situations and gags that have entered the Hollywood comedy pantheon and featuring two actors at the top of their game, sparking with a chemistry that has never been bettered.

hook: 《摩登时代》是查理·卓别林饰演小流浪汉的最后一部作品，剧中这个标志性人物扮演了一名无能的工厂员工，却迷上了一位美丽的女孩（保莱特·戈达德饰）。尽管《摩登时代》已经进入有声电影时代近十年，并且包含有声时刻（甚至是歌曲！），但凭借对大萧条时期阶级斗争的一系列令人难忘的笑料和狡猾的评论，它永恒地展示了卓别林作为无声喜剧导演的不可撼动的天才。
hook_en: Modern Times, Charlie Chaplin’s last outing as the Little Tramp, puts the iconic character to work as a giddily inept factory employee who becomes smitten with a gorgeous gamine (Paulette Goddard). With its barrage of unforgettable gags and sly commentary on class struggle during the Great Depression, Modern Times—though made almost a decade into the talkie era and containing moments of sound (even song!)—is a timeless showcase of Chaplin’s untouchable genius as a director of silent comedy.

hook: 《他的女孩星期五》是有史以来速度最快、最有趣、最受引用的电影之一，罗莎琳德·拉塞尔 (Rosalind Russell) 饰演记者希尔迪·约翰逊 (Hildy Johnson)，她是电影界有权势的女性中的佼佼者。希尔迪的力量与她相媲美的只有她纵容但魅力十足的编辑兼前夫沃尔特·伯恩斯（由无与伦比的加里·格兰特饰演），沃尔特·伯恩斯为她提供了一个机会，让她有机会用即将执行处决的故事来报道她的新闻撰稿人同事，以阻止她跳上本应带她去奥尔巴尼并开始家庭主妇新生活的火车。在改编本·赫克特和查尔斯·麦克阿瑟的热门戏剧《头版》时，导演霍华德·霍克斯灵机一动，将明星记者希尔迪·约翰逊变成了一名女性，结果是冷酷的新闻编辑室背景与热情洋溢的再婚喜剧的不朽结合。这里还展示了 1931 年电影《头版》的修复版，这是刘易斯·迈尔斯通 (Lewis Milestone) 对同一材料的著名前法典改编作品。
hook_en: One of the fastest, funniest, and most quotable films ever made, His Girl Friday stars Rosalind Russell as reporter Hildy Johnson, a standout among cinema’s powerful women. Hildy is matched in force only by her conniving but charismatic editor and ex-husband, Walter Burns (played by the peerless Cary Grant), who dangles the chance for her to scoop her fellow news writers with the story of an impending execution in order to keep her from hopping the train that’s supposed to take her to Albany and a new life as a housewife. When adapting Ben Hecht and Charles MacArthur’s smash-hit play The Front Page, director Howard Hawks had the inspired idea of turning star reporter Hildy Johnson into a woman, and the result is an immortal mix of hard-boiled newsroom setting with ebullient remarriage comedy. Also presented here is a restoration of the 1931 film The Front Page, Lewis Milestone’s famous pre-Code adaptation of the same material.

hook: 芭芭拉·斯坦威克试图让人心动的花花公子在一艘南美海岸航行的游轮上，与亨利·福顿这位笨拙的蛇形研究者相遇。这位研究者恰好继承了一家啤酒厂的财富。但当骗子爱上她的目标时，她的骗局变成了心的游戏——她决心赢得一切。这是普斯顿作为1940年代辉煌成就之一的众多无与伦比的喜剧奇迹之一，他既是编剧又是导演。这是一部性别反转的智慧对决喜剧，可能是他的情感满足度最高的一部作品，它巧妙地融合了斯坦尼威克试图让人心动的幽默，以及她事业巅峰时期令人惊叹的演技所赋予的温柔伤感。
hook_en: Barbara Stanwyck sizzles, Henry Fonda bumbles, and Preston Sturges runs riot in one of the all-time great screwballs, a pitch-perfect blend of comic zing and swoonworthy romance. Aboard a cruise liner sailing up the coast of South America, Stanwyck’s conniving card sharp sets her sights on Fonda’s nerdy snake researcher, who happens to be the heir to a brewery fortune. But when the con artist falls for her mark, her grift becomes a game of hearts—and she is determined to win it all. One in a string of matchless comedic marvels that Sturges wrote and directed as part of a dazzling 1940s run, this gender-flipped battle-of-wits farce is perhaps his most emotionally satisfying work, tempering its sparkling humor with a streak of tender poignancy supplied by the sensational Stanwyck at her peak.

hook: 约翰·福特 (John Ford) 演绎 O.K. 的传奇这部多层次、结构精良的西部片中的畜栏枪战，是导演最好的电影之一。亨利·方达塑造了一个标志性人物怀亚特·厄普，一位坚强的执法者，他着手整顿混乱的亚利桑那州墓碑镇小镇，而维克多·马彻则饰演酗酒、患有结核病的赌徒和枪手霍利迪医生。尽管最初目的不同，两人最终还是联手对抗暴力的克兰顿帮派。 《我亲爱的克莱门汀》震撼人心，拍摄精美，讲述了美国电影完美神话制造者讲述的文明战胜狂野西部的故事。
hook_en: John Ford takes on the legend of the O.K. Corral shoot-out in this multilayered, exceptionally well-constructed western, one of the director’s very best films. Henry Fonda cuts an iconic figure as Wyatt Earp, the sturdy lawman who sets about the task of shaping up the disorderly Arizona town of Tombstone, and Victor Mature gives the performance of his career as the boozy, tubercular gambler and gunman Doc Holliday. Though initially at cross-purposes, the pair ultimately team up to confront the violent Clanton gang. Affecting and stunningly photographed, My Darling Clementine is a story of the triumph of civilization over the Wild West from American cinema’s consummate mythmaker.

hook: 无论霍华德·霍克斯从事什么类型的作品，他都按照自己的规则行事，这一点在他的第一部西部片《喧闹而聪明的红河》中表现得最为明显。在这部影片中，约翰·韦恩找到了他最伟大的角色之一，饰演一位心怀怨恨、残暴的得克萨斯州牧场主，他与思想独立的养子（由蒙哥马利·克利夫特在一场突破性的表演中扮演）之间的紧张关系在前往密苏里州的一次赶牛过程中达到了史诗般的程度。这部电影是根据一部小说改编的，该小说戏剧性地描述了十九世纪末奇泽姆小道沿线的现实探险活动，但霍克斯对历史准确性的兴趣不大，他对调整推动美国西部神话的男性气概的准则更感兴趣。充满男子气概的韦恩和神经质、孩子气的克利夫特是一对不可思议的完美搭档，机智、多层次的剧本和霍克斯令人敬畏的导演将他们推向了巅峰。
hook_en: No matter what genre he worked in, Howard Hawks played by his own rules, and never was this more evident than in his first western, the rowdy and whip-smart Red River. In it, John Wayne found one of his greatest roles, as an embittered, tyrannical Texas rancher whose tensions with his independent-minded adopted son—played by Montgomery Clift, in a breakout performance—reach epic proportions during a cattle drive to Missouri. The film is based on a novel that dramatizes the real-life late nineteenth-century expeditions along the Chisholm Trail, but Hawks is less interested in historical accuracy than in tweaking the codes of masculinity that propel the myths of the American West. The unerringly macho Wayne and the neurotic, boyish Clift make for an improbably perfect pair, held aloft by a quick-witted, multilayered screenplay and Hawks’s formidable direction.

hook: 彼得·奥图尔 (Peter O’Toole) 饰演杰克，一个被“治愈”并相信自己是上帝的人，结果却成为了开膛手杰克的化身。改编自彼得·巴恩斯的不敬戏剧，这部黑色喜剧对英国阶级制度的控诉窥视着英国贵族的紧闭大门。彼得·梅达克 (Peter Medak) 执导的这部深受喜爱的邪教经典作品，充满了疯狂、虐待狂的讽刺和黑色喜剧，还带有一点好莱坞音乐剧的味道。
hook_en: Peter O’Toole gives a tour-de-force performance as Jack, a man “cured” of believing he’s God—only to become Jack the Ripper incarnate. Based on Peter Barnes's irreverent play, this darkly comic indictment of Britain’s class system peers behind the closed doors of English aristocracy. Insanity, sadistic sarcasm, and black comedy—with just a touch of the Hollywood musical—are all featured in this beloved cult classic directed by Peter Medak.

hook: 丹麦的 Dogme 95 运动以迅雷不及掩耳之势席卷了世界电影界，它始于托马斯·温特伯格 (Thomas Vinterberg) 的国际突破《庆典》(The Celebration)，这是一部撕心裂肺的室内剧，利用数字视频的经济和审美自由来实现毁灭性的情感强度。一名富翁的六十岁生日，一大群家人和朋友聚集在他的乡村庄园举行庆祝活动，但很快就陷入了混乱，因为爆炸性的爆料可能会撕掉资产阶级体面的外表，暴露其内心的创伤。动态的手持摄影机、颗粒状的自然光、刺耳的叙事声音和原始的表演风格，这些都成为了《Dogme》的标志，增强了这种对父权制失败的尖刻控诉的震撼性的内心冲击力，它在最黑色的喜剧和最惨淡的悲剧之间摇摆，因为它将一个家庭病态的灵魂彻底翻转。
hook_en: The Danish Dogme 95 movement that struck world cinema like a thunderbolt began with The Celebration, Thomas Vinterberg’s international breakthrough, a lacerating chamber drama that uses the economic and aesthetic freedoms of digital video to achieve annihilating emotional intensity. On a wealthy man’s sixtieth birthday, a sprawling group of family and friends convenes at his country estate for a celebration that soon spirals into bedlam, as bombshell revelations threaten to tear away the veneer of bourgeois respectability and expose the traumas roiling beneath. The dynamic handheld camera work, grainy natural lighting, cacophonous diegetic sound, and raw performance style that would become Dogme hallmarks enhance the shattering visceral impact of this caustic indictment of patriarchal failings, which swings between blackest comedy and bleakest tragedy as it turns the sick soul of a family inside out.

hook: 在经历了十余年的沉稳政治戏剧和社会意识浓厚的历史剧之后，日本导演小林宽之大胆地转变了风格，为这部四部鬼故事系列作品带来了热烈的风格化。这部作品色彩斑斓、充满奇幻的场景和明亮的摄影，改编自拉斐卡多·海恩斯的日本民间故事集，讲述的是恶魔的报应和精神考验的恐怖故事。这些故事存在主义地令人恐惧，并且精心制作。这部《怪谈》的版本是原版的三小时版本，从未在美国发行过。
hook_en: After more than a decade of sober political dramas and socially minded period pieces, the great Japanese director Masaki Kobayashi shifted gears dramatically for this rapturously stylized quartet of ghost stories. Featuring colorfully surreal sets and luminous cinematography, these haunting tales of demonic comeuppance and spiritual trials, adapted from writer Lafcadio Hearn’s collections of Japanese folklore, are existentially frightening and meticulously crafted. This version of Kwaidan is the original three-hour cut, never before released in the United States.

hook: 荣获奥斯卡奖的奥地利导演迈克尔·哈内克是世界上最具影响力和挑衅性的电影制作人之一，他以毁灭性的精确性和艺术性诊断了当代欧洲的社会弊病。他的剧情片《未知代码》是他在法国拍摄的众多电影中的第一部，可能是他最受启发的作品。哈内克的这部影片几乎全部由精彩拍摄的单镜头小片段组成，重点关注与巴黎街头看似微不足道的事件有关的人物，以朱丽叶·比诺什为主角的杰出国际演员阵容，对日益多元化的现代景观中的种族不平等和沟通失败进行了具有启发性的审视。
hook_en: One of the world’s most influential and provocative filmmakers, the Oscar–winning Austrian director Michael Haneke diagnoses the social maladies of contemporary Europe with devastating precision and artistry. His drama Code Unknown, the first of his many films made in France, may be his most inspired work. Composed almost entirely of brilliantly shot, single-take vignettes focusing on characters connected to one seemingly minor incident on a Paris street, Haneke’s film—with an outstanding international cast headlined by Juliette Binoche—is a revelatory examination of racial inequality and the failure of communication in an increasingly diverse modern landscape.

hook: 在意大利北部波河谷的播种季节，一位朴实的稻田工人（西尔瓦娜·曼加诺饰）遇到了一名计划大胆抢劫农作物的小罪犯（维托里奥·加斯曼饰），以及他的蛇蝎美人女友（由好莱坞明星多丽丝·道林饰演）。这部由杰出制片人迪诺·德·劳伦蒂斯 (Dino De Laurentiis) 和导演朱塞佩·德·桑蒂斯 (Giuseppe De Santis) 执导的早期大片，既以社会意识的视角审视了工资过低的现场工人所承受的艰辛，又是一部带有性和暴力色彩的情节剧，是一部带有大量低俗内容的新现实主义作品。
hook_en: During planting season in Northern Italy’s Po Valley, an earthy rice-field worker (Silvana Mangano) falls in with a small-time criminal (Vittorio Gassman) who is planning a daring heist of the crop, as well as his femme-fatale-ish girlfriend, played by the Hollywood star Doris Dowling. Both a socially conscious look at the hardships endured by underpaid field workers and a melodrama tinged with sex and violence, this early smash for producer extraordinaire Dino De Laurentiis and director Giuseppe De Santis is neorealism with a heaping dose of pulp.

hook: 《猪与战舰》以令人眼花缭乱、难以驾驭的方式描绘了战后的日本，以不断升级的荒谬性，详细描述了港口城市横须贺小流氓之间绝望的权力斗争。这部电影以构图华丽、热闹的宽银幕电影拍摄，讲述了一对年轻夫妇试图共同应对横须贺腐败商人、黑猩猩和他们自己不确定的未来的故事。凭借其惊人的节奏和不断创新的电影摄影，这部电影标志着今村翔平成为日本电影的主要代言人。
hook_en: A dazzling, unruly portrait of postwar Japan, Pigs and Battleships details, with escalating absurdity, the desperate power struggles between small-time gangsters in the port town of Yokosuka. Shot in gorgeously composed, bustling CinemaScope, the film follows a young couple as they try to navigate Yokosuka’s corrupt businessmen, chimpira, and their own unsure future together. With its breakneck pacing and constantly inventive cinematography, this film marked Shohei Imamura as a major voice in Japanese cinema.

hook: 《猎人之夜》——令人难以置信的是，伟大演员查尔斯·劳顿执导的唯一一部电影——确实是一部独立的杰作。这是一部带有格林童话色彩的恐怖电影，主角是极其险恶的罗伯特·米彻姆，他饰演一位名叫哈利·鲍威尔（指关节有纹身的人）的旅行传教士，哈利·鲍威尔娶了雪莱·温特斯饰演的脆弱寡妇，其邪恶动机被她惊恐的年幼的孩子们揭露。这部空灵、表现主义的美国经典影片以怪异之美的画面和偷偷摸摸的幽默感为特色，演员莉莲·吉什和作家詹姆斯·阿吉也参与其中，是电影中对善恶之战最古怪的呈现。 《猎人之夜》由加州大学洛杉矶分校电影电视档案馆与米高梅工作室合作修复，并由罗伯特·斯特姆和电影基金会提供资金。
hook_en: The Night of the Hunter—incredibly, the only film the great actor Charles Laughton ever directed—is truly a stand-alone masterwork. A horror movie with qualities of a Grimm fairy tale, it stars a sublimely sinister Robert Mitchum as a traveling preacher named Harry Powell (he of the tattooed knuckles), whose nefarious motives for marrying a fragile widow, played by Shelley Winters, are uncovered by her terrified young children. Graced by images of eerie beauty and a sneaky sense of humor, this ethereal, expressionistic American classic—also featuring the contributions of actress Lillian Gish and writer James Agee—is cinema’s most eccentric rendering of the battle between good and evil. The Night of the Hunter was restored by the UCLA Film & Television Archive in cooperation with Metro-Goldwyn-Mayer Studios, Inc., with funding provided by Robert Sturm and The Film Foundation.

hook: 《洗发水》让我们了解了乔治（沃伦·比蒂饰）的一天生活，他是比佛利山庄的一名理发师，同时也是个浪荡子，他在 1968 年总统大选前夕在镇上跑来跑去，试图弄清楚自己的经济和爱情纠葛。他试图凑钱开办自己的沙龙，但他的情人（由戈尔迪·霍恩、朱莉·克里斯蒂和李·格兰特（在奥斯卡获奖表演中饰演）出色地扮演）不断地让他分心。比蒂构思了这个项目，与罗伯特·汤恩共同编写了剧本，并聘请哈尔·阿什比担任导演，由此产生的注定失败的关系的旋转木马是一场七十年代的闹剧，尖锐地回顾了过去十年的性政治和自我陶醉。
hook_en: Shampoo gives us a day in the life of George (Warren Beatty), a Beverly Hills hairdresser and lothario who runs around town on the eve of the 1968 presidential election trying to make heads or tails of his financial and romantic entanglements. His attempts to scrape together the money to open his own salon are continually sidetracked by the distractions presented by his lovers—played brilliantly by Goldie Hawn, Julie Christie, and Lee Grant (in an Oscar-winning performance). Beatty dreamed up the project, cowrote the script with Robert Towne, and enlisted Hal Ashby as director, and the resulting carousel of doomed relationships is an essential seventies farce, a sharp look back at the sexual politics and self-absorption of the preceding decade.

hook: 在这部精心设计的电影中，夏洛特·兰普林和汤姆·康特尼饰演凯特和杰夫这对英国夫妇，他们在周年庆典前夕表演了一段微妙的不合时宜的双人舞，他们发现他们漫长的婚姻因收到一封给杰夫的信而动摇，这封信毫不客气地将杰夫的过去融入了他们共同的现在。导演安德鲁·海格 (Andrew Haigh) 在 45 年来将英国现实主义电影的传统巧妙地推向了新的高度，在两人的日常生活中将重大的事情融入到了平凡的生活中，而令人回味的平坦、寒冷的诺福克风景则勾勒出他们为维持日益难以维持的现状而进行的斗争。黑格随意地改编了大卫·康斯坦丁的短篇小说，将焦点从有点古怪的杰夫转移到了凯特身上，引出了兰普林对一个女人从镇定的妻子逐渐转变为失败的女人的非凡而细致的描绘。
hook_en: In this exquisitely calibrated film, Charlotte Rampling and Tom Courtenay perform a subtly off-kilter pas de deux as Kate and Geoff, an English couple who, on the eve of an anniversary celebration, find their long marriage shaken by the arrival of a letter to Geoff that unceremoniously collapses his past into their shared present. Director Andrew Haigh carries the tradition of British realist cinema to artful new heights in 45 Years, weaving the momentous into the mundane as the pair go about their daily lives, while the evocatively flat, wintry Norfolk landscape frames their struggle to maintain an increasingly untenable status quo. Loosely adapting a short story by David Constantine, Haigh shifts the focus from the slightly erratic Geoff to Kate, eliciting a remarkable, nuanced portrayal by Rampling of a woman’s gradual metamorphosis from unflappable wife to woman undone.

hook: 约翰·施莱辛格 (John Schlesinger) 是英国新浪潮中最多才多艺的导演之一，他于 20 世纪 60 年代末来到纽约拍摄《午夜牛仔》，这是一部关于友谊的流浪汉故事，讲述了一座陷入危机的城市，并引发了好莱坞电影的新时代。强·沃特 (Jon Voight) 饰演乔·巴克 (Joe Buck)，他是一位来自得克萨斯州的睁大眼睛的骗子，希望能在富有的城市女性中获得巨大成功。他在恩里科·“拉索”·里佐 (Enrico “Ratso” Rizzo) 中找到了同伴，恩里科·“拉特索”·里佐 (Enrico “Ratso” Rizzo) 是一位病重的骗子，腿上有一条腿，他怀揣着逃往佛罗里达的不切实际的幻想，由达斯汀·霍夫曼 (Dustin Hoffman) 饰演，这与他在《毕业生》中的突破截然不同。尽管美国电影协会 (MPAA) 所称的“同性恋参考框架”存在争议，《午夜牛仔》在评论界和商业上都取得了成功，成为第一部获得奥斯卡最佳影片奖的 X 级电影，几十年后，它的影响力仍然在电影界产生回响。
hook_en: One of the British New Wave’s most versatile directors, John Schlesinger came to New York in the late 1960s to make Midnight Cowboy, a picaresque story of friendship that captured a city in crisis and sparked a new era of Hollywood movies. Jon Voight delivers a career-making performance as Joe Buck, a wide-eyed hustler from Texas hoping to score big with wealthy city women; he finds a companion in Enrico “Ratso” Rizzo, an ailing swindler with a bum leg and a quixotic fantasy of escaping to Florida, played by Dustin Hoffman in a radical departure from his breakthrough in The Graduate. A critical and commercial success despite controversy over what the MPAA termed its “homosexual frame of reference,” Midnight Cowboy became the first X-rated film to receive the best picture Oscar, and decades on, its influence still reverberates through cinema.

hook: 这部由罗伯特·奥特曼 (Robert Altman) 执导的 20 世纪 70 年代美国电影制作的基石，以美国音乐之都为背景，展现了该国的政治和文化景观的全景。纳什维尔将 24 个角色的故事（从乡村明星到想成为明星的人，从记者到女服务员）编织成一部喜剧、悲剧和音乐剧并存的电影挂毯。令人惊叹的演员阵容中的许多成员都自己创作歌曲并在现场现场表演，这为影片的古怪真实性增添了另一层色彩。奥特曼通过奇特的方式深入美国生活核心的能力在这场盛大而欢快的胜利中得到了最好的发挥，并带来了一个令人难忘的结局。
hook_en: This cornerstone of 1970s American moviemaking from Robert Altman is a panoramic view of the country’s political and cultural landscapes, set in the nation’s music capital. Nashville weaves the stories of twenty-four characters—from country star to wannabe to reporter to waitress—into a cinematic tapestry that is equal parts comedy, tragedy, and musical. Many members of the astonishing cast wrote their own songs and performed them live on location, which lends another layer to the film’s quirky authenticity. Altman’s ability to get to the heart of American life via its eccentric byways was never put to better use than in this grand, rollicking triumph, which barrels forward to an unforgettable conclusion.

hook: 小林正树执导的这部宏大的人文主义戏剧是日本电影最惊人的成就之一。时长九个半小时的《人的境况》改编自后三川淳平的六卷本小说，最初分三期拍摄并发行，每期两集，讲述了由日本巨星仲代达也饰演的善意而天真的梶治郎从劳改营主管到帝国陆军士兵再到苏联战俘的旅程。加治不断地试图摆脱腐败的制度，他一次又一次地发现自己的道德成为一种障碍，而不是一种优势。小林这部引人入胜、拍摄华丽的史诗片是对日本战时心态的原始控诉，也是个人存在的悲剧，是小说电影的巅峰之作。
hook_en: This mammoth humanist drama by Masaki Kobayashi is one of the most staggering achievements of Japanese cinema. Originally filmed and released in three installments of two parts each, the nine-and-a-half-hour The Human Condition, adapted from Junpei Gomikawa’s six-volume novel, tells of the journey of the well-intentioned yet naive Kaji—played by the Japanese superstar Tatsuya Nakadai—from labor camp supervisor to Imperial Army soldier to Soviet prisoner of war. Constantly trying to rise above a corrupt system, Kaji time and again finds his morals to be an impediment rather than an advantage. A raw indictment of Japan’s wartime mentality as well as a personal existential tragedy, Kobayashi’s riveting, gorgeously filmed epic is novelistic cinema at its best.

hook: 时尚从何而来？到底什么是阴影？这部具有里程碑意义的纪录片通过纽约市非裔美国人和拉丁裔哈莱姆区变装舞会场景的视角，展现了 20 世纪 80 年代的生动快照。 《巴黎在燃烧》历时七年制作，对时尚“品牌”的竞争对手进行了亲密的描绘，从争夺奖杯的激烈竞争，到在恐同、恐跨、种族主义、艾滋病和贫困猖獗的世界中提供生计的“房妈妈”。 《巴黎燃烧》以传奇时尚人士、变装皇后和跨性别女性为主角，包括 Willi Ninja、Pepper LaBeija、Dorian Corey 和 Venus Xtravaganza，颂扬运动的乐趣、雄辩的力量和社区的吸引力。《巴黎燃烧》由加州大学洛杉矶分校电影电视档案馆与圣丹斯学院和 Outfest UCLA Legacy Project 联合修复。保护工作由圣丹斯协会、Outfest 和 Andrew J. Kuehn Jr. 基金会资助。
hook_en: Where does voguing come from, and what, exactly, is throwing shade? This landmark documentary provides a vibrant snapshot of the 1980s through the eyes of New York City’s African American and Latinx Harlem drag-ball scene. Made over seven years, Paris Is Burning offers an intimate portrait of rival fashion “houses,” from fierce contests for trophies to house mothers offering sustenance in a world rampant with homophobia, transphobia, racism, AIDS, and poverty. Featuring legendary voguers, drag queens, and trans women—including Willi Ninja, Pepper LaBeija, Dorian Corey, and Venus Xtravaganza—Paris Is Burning brings it, celebrating the joy of movement, the force of eloquence, and the draw of community.Paris Is Burning was restored by the UCLA Film & Television Archive in conjunction with Sundance Institute and Outfest UCLA Legacy Project. Preservation was funded by Sundance Institute, Outfest, and the Andrew J. Kuehn Jr. Foundation.

hook: 荒地宣布了一位重要天才的到来：泰伦斯·马力克。他对 20 世纪 50 年代末臭名昭著的查尔斯·斯塔克威瑟 (Charles Starkweather) 的杀人狂潮进行了印象派的演绎，以连环杀手的叙述为跳板，讲述了一段由马丁·辛 (Martin Sheen) 和茜茜·斯派塞克 (Sissy Spacek) 可爱而独特的青少年爱情故事。这部电影引入了许多为马利克赢得热情追随者的元素：神秘的叙事和人物处理方式、画外音的不同寻常的使用、人类暴力与自然美景的并置、对美国梦和噩梦的诗意探究。这一首次亮相引发了无数模仿，但没有一个能与它奇异的崇高相媲美。
hook_en: Badlands announced the arrival of a major talent: Terrence Malick. His impressionistic take on the notorious Charles Starkweather killing spree of the late 1950s uses a serial-killer narrative as a springboard for an oblique teenage romance, lovingly and idiosyncratically enacted by Martin Sheen and Sissy Spacek. The film introduced many of the elements that would earn Malick his passionate following: the enigmatic approach to narrative and character, the unusual use of voice-over, the juxtaposition of human violence with natural beauty, the poetic investigation of American dreams and nightmares. This debut has spawned countless imitations, but none have equaled its strange sublimity.

hook: 非凡的法国导演莫里斯·皮亚拉（Maurice Pialat）通过对一个受伤的养子的毁灭性描绘，在这部失落青春的电影中留下了自己独特的印记。我们看到十岁的弗朗索瓦（米歇尔·泰拉宗饰）被从一个家穿梭到另一个家，他的行为变得越来越不稳定，他与代孕父母的关系也常年紧张。在这部他的长片处女作中，皮亚拉以惊人的清醒和赤裸裸的现实主义来处理这种潜在的感伤场景。 《赤裸的童年》充满了情感和清醒的怀疑主义，是法国电影界最伟大的事业之一，并且仍然是皮亚拉最优秀的作品之一。
hook_en: The singular French director Maurice Pialat puts his distinctive stamp on the lost-youth film with this devastating portrait of a damaged foster child. We watch as ten-year-old François (Michel Terrazon) is shuttled from one home to another, his behavior growing increasingly erratic, his bonds with his surrogate parents perennially fraught. In this, his feature debut, Pialat treats that potentially sentimental scenario with astonishing sobriety and stark realism. With its full-throttle mixture of emotionality and clear-eyed skepticism, L’enfance nue (Naked Childhood) was advance notice of one of the most masterful careers in French cinema, and remains one of Pialat’s finest works.

hook: 武士三部曲开篇，三船敏郎如雷霆登场，饰演那个标志性的主人公。我们初见宫本，他还是个睁大眼睛的浪漫派，梦想在蹂躏十七世纪乡村的内战里立军功。命运转折却使他沦为逃犯；爱他的女子与一位狡黠的僧侣救了他，引他走上武士之路。虽是系列第一部，这部色彩华美的影片自成一体，并拿下1955年奥斯卡最佳外语片。
hook_en: In the first part of the epic Samurai Trilogy, Toshiro Mifune thunders onto the screen as the iconic title character. When we meet him, Miyamoto is a wide-eyed romantic, dreaming of military glory in the civil war that is ravaging the seventeenth-century countryside. Twists of fate, however, turn him into a fugitive. But he is saved by a woman who loves him and a cunning priest who guides him to the samurai path. Though the opening installment of a series, this film, lushly photographed in color, stands on its own, and won an Academy Award for the best foreign-language film of 1955.

hook: 三船敏郎狂暴地化身剑客宫本武藏，在武士三部曲动作密集的中段真正长大。《一乘寺之决斗》推他走向精神觉悟，也推他远离两个爱他的女人：忠贞的阿通（八千草薰）与心机却悲剧的阿绢（冈田茉莉子）。他还迎面撞上成群想砍倒他的对手，尤其是宿敌小次郎（鹤田浩二）。片名里的高潮是日本电影编排最激昂的冲突之一，安本淳的彩色摄影与团伊玖磨凯旋般的配乐为之加温。
hook_en: Toshiro Mifune furiously embodies swordsman Musashi Miyamoto as he comes into his own in the action-packed middle section of the Samurai Trilogy. Duel at Ichijoji Temple furthers Miyamoto along his path to spiritual enlightenment, as well as further from the arms of the two women who love him: loyal Otsu (Kaoru Yachigusa) and conniving yet tragic Akemi (Mariko Okada). The film also brings him face to face with hordes of rivals intent on cutting him down, especially his legendary rival Kojiro (Koji Tsuruta). The titular climax is one of Japanese cinema’s most rousingly choreographed conflicts, intensified by Jun Yasumoto’s color cinematography and Ikuma Dan’s triumphant score.

hook: 幻灭的宫本武藏（三船敏郎）背弃武士生涯，在偏远村子务农；宿敌小次郎（鹤田浩二）已为将军效力。情势迫使两人最后对决。虽以难忘的激烈终战著称，武士三部曲这振奋的收束也关乎心事：宫本必须自问，是什么造就一名武士，也造就一个人。
hook_en: A disillusioned Musashi Miyamoto (Toshiro Mifune) has turned his back on the samurai life, becoming a farmer in a remote village, while his nemesis Kojiro (Koji Tsuruta) now works for the shogun. Circumstances bring them back together for one final face-off. Though it’s marked by a memorably intense final battle sequence, the rousing conclusion to the Samurai Trilogy is engaged with matters of the heart as well, as Miyamoto must ask himself what it is that makes a warrior and a man.

hook: 巴斯特·基顿在《摄影师》中达到了他滑稽表演的巅峰，这是这位无声银幕传奇人物与米高梅签约后拍摄的第一部电影，也是他最后一部伟大的杰作。这部巧妙的闹剧是他保持创意控制的最后一部作品，是长达十年的非凡喜剧的顶峰，产生了一些有史以来最具创新性和持久的喜剧。基顿扮演一名倒霉的新闻片摄影师，他在曼哈顿来回穿梭，寻找独家新闻，不顾一切地想要给他的新雇主和他迷人的办公室恋人留下深刻的印象。一路上，他去游泳（结果浑身湿透），卷入了唐人街的帮派战争，并与一个令人难忘的猴子伙伴（著名的约瑟芬）合作。极具创意的电影中的电影设置让基顿的想象力得以发挥，既产生了对电影制作艰辛的巧妙洞察，也产生了令人心酸的情感回报。
hook_en: Buster Keaton is at the peak of his slapstick powers in The Cameraman—the first film that the silent-screen legend made after signing with MGM, and his last great masterpiece. The final work over which he maintained creative control, this clever farce is the culmination of an extraordinary, decade-long run that produced some of the most innovative and enduring comedies of all time. Keaton plays a hapless newsreel cameraman desperate to impress both his new employer and his winsome office crush as he zigzags up and down Manhattan hustling for a scoop. Along the way, he goes for a swim (and winds up soaked), becomes embroiled in a Chinatown Tong War, and teams up with a memorable monkey sidekick (the famous Josephine). The marvelously inventive film-within-a-film setup allows Keaton’s imagination to run wild, yielding both sly insights into the travails of moviemaking and an emotional payoff of disarming poignancy.

hook: 在他位于法国乡村的僻静城堡里，一位才华横溢、执着的医生（皮埃尔·布拉塞尔饰）尝试进行彻底的整容手术，以恢复女儿毁容面容的美丽，但代价却令人震惊。由才华横溢的乔治·弗兰朱执导的《无脸之眼》因其恐怖与抒情的奇怪混合而在恐怖电影中很少见，自上映以来的几十年里一直对这一类型产生了重大影响。这里有一些图像——恐怖的、血腥的、莫名其妙的美丽——一旦看过就永远不会忘记。
hook_en: At his secluded château in the French countryside, a brilliant, obsessive doctor (Pierre Brasseur) attempts a radical plastic surgery to restore the beauty of his daughter’s disfigured countenance—at a horrifying price. Eyes Without a Face, directed by the supremely talented Georges Franju, is rare in horror cinema for its odd mixture of the ghastly and the lyrical, and it has been a major influence on the genre in the decades since its release. There are images here—of terror, of gore, of inexplicable beauty—that once seen are never forgotten.

hook: 市川今的《平原之火》描绘了二战期间绝望的日本士兵被困在异国他乡的痛苦景象，令人在心理和身体上陷入遗忘。二等兵田村因肺结核而被拒绝住院治疗，并被抛弃到未知的地方，他长途跋涉穿过陌生的菲律宾风景，遇到了越来越堕落的帝国陆军士兵，他们最终屈服于最可怕的渴望。 《平原之火》既恐怖又富有诗意，是日本电影界最多才多艺的电影制片人之一最有力的作品之一。
hook_en: An agonizing portrait of desperate Japanese soldiers stranded in a strange land during World War II, Kon Ichikawa’s Fires on the Plain is a compelling descent into psychological and physical oblivion. Denied hospital treatment for tuberculosis and cast off into the unknown, Private Tamura treks across an unfamiliar Philippine landscape, encountering an increasingly debased cross section of Imperial Army soldiers, who eventually give in to the most terrifying craving of all. Grisly yet poetic, Fires on the Plain is one of the most powerful works from one of Japanese cinema’s most versatile filmmakers.

hook: 法国电影制片人雅克·欧迪亚凭借这部荣获金棕榈奖的剧情片巧妙地结合了看似不同的类型，巩固了他作为当代世界电影巨头的地位。在一场引人入胜的表演中，非专业演员安东尼萨桑·杰苏萨桑（Antonythasan Jesuthasan）（他本人曾是一名儿童兵）饰演一名泰米尔战士，他与一名冒充妻子和女儿的妇女和儿童一起逃离饱受战争蹂躏的斯里兰卡，却来到了毒品泛滥的巴黎郊区。随着这个临时家庭开始新的生活，迪潘进入了一种亲密的社会现实主义模式，然后又进入了一部充满活力的地盘争夺惊悚片，以及对战斗心理后果的令人不安的研究。奥迪亚的电影灼热而敏感，以独特的方式将难民经历描述为持续的身份危机。
hook_en: With this Palme d’Or–winning drama, which deftly combines seemingly disparate genres, French filmmaker Jacques Audiard cemented his status as a titan of contemporary world cinema. In an arresting performance, the nonprofessional actor Antonythasan Jesuthasan (himself a former child soldier) stars as a Tamil fighter who, along with a woman and a child posing as his wife and daughter, flees war-torn Sri Lanka only to land in a Paris suburb blighted by drugs. As the makeshift family embarks on a new life, Dheepan settles into an intimate social-realist mode before tightening into a dynamic turf-war thriller, as well as an unsettling study of the psychological aftereffects of combat. Searing and sensitive, Audiard’s film is a unique depiction of the refugee experience as a continuous crisis of identity.

hook: 伟大的安德烈·塔可夫斯基的处女作《伊凡的童年》是一段诗意的旅程，讲述了一个男孩饱受战争蹂躏的青春的碎片和阴影。塔可夫斯基的电影在二战的创伤性现实和冲突开始前家庭生活的平静时刻之间来回穿梭，仍然是战争对儿童影响最刺耳、最难忘的描述之一。
hook_en: The debut feature by the great Andrei Tarkovsky, Ivan’s Childhood is a poetic journey through the shards and shadows of one boy’s war-ravaged youth. Moving back and forth between the traumatic realities of World War II and serene moments of family life before the conflict began, Tarkovsky’s film remains one of the most jarring and unforgettable depictions of the impact of war on children.

hook: 雷内·克莱尔的《自由》是历史上的喜剧经典之一，讲述了路易斯的故事，他是一名逃犯，后来成为一名富有的实业家。不幸的是，他的过去（以老狱友埃米尔的形式出现）的出现打乱了他精心制定的计划。 《自由》以轻松的智慧、巨大的视觉创新和对声音的巧妙处理为特色，既是对机械化现代社会的有力控诉，也是令人捧腹的喜剧乐趣。
hook_en: One of the all-time comedy classics, René Clair's À nous la liberté tells the story of Louis, an escaped convict who becomes a wealthy industrialist. Unfortunately, his past returns (in the form of old jail pal Emile) to upset his carefully laid plans. Featuring lighthearted wit, tremendous visual innovation, and masterful manipulation of sound, À nous la liberté is both a potent indictment of mechanized modern society and an uproarious comic delight.

hook: 极具创新精神的导演让-吕克·戈达尔凭借《女人就是女人》（Une femme est une femme）呈现出“一部新现实主义音乐剧——也就是说，用词上的矛盾”。由人气巅峰时期的法国巨星安娜·卡里娜、让-保罗·贝尔蒙多和让-克洛德·布里亚利主演，《女人就是女人》是对美国音乐喜剧的狡猾、俏皮的致敬和审问，展示了戈达尔标志性的机智和智慧。影片讲述了异国舞者安吉拉（卡琳娜饰）试图与她不情愿的情人埃米尔（布里亚利饰）生孩子的故事。在此过程中，她发现自己在他和他最好的朋友阿尔弗雷德（贝尔蒙多饰）之间左右为难。 《女人就是女人》是一部令人眼花缭乱的色彩、幽默和著名作曲家米歇尔·罗格朗音乐的概要，发现年轻的戈达尔处于最温暖、最平易近人的状态，陶醉并审视着他最痴迷的机制：电影。
hook_en: With A Woman Is a Woman (Une femme est une femme), compulsively innovative director Jean-Luc Godard presents "a neorealist musical—that is, a contradiction in terms." Featuring French superstars Anna Karina, Jean-Paul Belmondo, and Jean-Claude Brialy at their peak of popularity, A Woman Is a Woman is a sly, playful tribute to—and interrogation of—the American musical comedy, showcasing Godard's signature wit and intellectual acumen. The film tells the story of exotic dancer Angéla (Karina) as she attempts to have a child with her unwilling lover Émile (Brialy). In the process, she finds herself torn between him and his best friend Alfred (Belmondo). A dizzying compendium of color, humor, and the music of renowned composer Michel Legrand, A Woman Is a Woman finds the young Godard at his warmest and most accessible, reveling in and scrutinizing the mechanics of his great obsession: the cinema.

hook: 玛琳·黛德丽在约瑟夫·冯·斯特恩伯格这部疯狂放荡的传记片中饰演被宠坏的公主索菲亚·弗雷德丽卡，她从小就被培养成伟大的人，渴望有一个英俊的丈夫。她被送往俄罗斯与彼得大公结婚，她震惊地发现她的未婚夫是个傻子，而她的新家是一座邪恶统治的可怕宫殿。然而不久之后，她就开始参与统治宫廷的虐待狂权力政治，为她转变为专横的浪荡子叶卡捷琳娜大帝铺平了道路。 《猩红女皇》是一部奢华的奇观，冯·斯滕伯格霸气的视觉天赋达到了华丽奢华的新高度，它是一幅反常的色情肖像，描绘了一个女人——也是一个电影明星——能够让无数军团屈服。
hook_en: Marlene Dietrich stars in Josef von Sternberg’s feverishly debauched biopic as the spoiled princess Sophia Frederica, who grows up being groomed for greatness and yearning for a handsome husband. Sent to Russia to marry the Grand Duke Peter, she is horrified to discover that her betrothed is a half-wit and her new home a macabre palace where depravity rules. Before long, however, she is initiated into the sadistic power politics that govern the court, paving the way for her transformation into the imperious libertine Catherine the Great. A lavish spectacle in which von Sternberg’s domineering visual genius reaches new heights of florid extravagance, The Scarlet Empress is a perversely erotic portrait of a woman—and a movie star—capable of bringing legions to heel.

hook: 埃尔曼诺·奥尔米 (Ermanno Olmi) 的《木鞋树》以绘画和感性的方式沉浸在 19 世纪末的意大利农场生活中，充满爱意地聚焦于贝加莫省一处偏僻庄园里为一位地主工作的四个家庭。奥尔米在一个废弃的农场拍摄了四个月，他采用新现实主义的技巧来讲述他的故事，让当地人像他们自己的祖先一样生活，用他们熟悉的地方的方言说话。通过季节的循环、繁重的劳动、爱情与婚姻、出生与死亡、信仰与迷信，奥尔米自然主义地唤起了一种非常接近自然的存在，歌颂它的美丽、幽默和简单，但也承认统治它的封建残酷。 《木鞋之树》荣获 1978 年戛纳金棕榈奖，其规模虽小，但范围宏大，是一部高耸入云、激动人心的人文主义电影作品。在电影基金会的资助下，博洛尼亚电影中心在 L’Immagine Ritrovata 修复了木鞋树。
hook_en: A painterly and sensual immersion in late nineteenth-century Italian farm life, Ermanno Olmi’s The Tree of Wooden Clogs lovingly focuses on four families working for one landowner on an isolated estate in the province of Bergamo. Filming on an abandoned farm for four months, Olmi adapted neorealist techniques to tell his story, enlisting local people to live as their own ancestors had, speaking in their native dialect on locations with which they were intimately familiar. Through the cycle of seasons, of backbreaking labor, love and marriage, birth and death, faith and superstition, Olmi naturalistically evokes an existence very close to nature, celebrating its beauty, humor, and simplicity but also acknowledging the feudal cruelty that governs it. Winner of the Palme d’Or at Cannes in 1978, The Tree of Wooden Clogs is intimate in scale but epic in scope—a towering, heart-stirring work of humanist filmmaking. The Tree of Wooden Clogs was restored by the Cineteca di Bologna at L’Immagine Ritrovata, with funding provided by The Film Foundation.

hook: 杰罗姆·克恩 (Jerome Kern) 和奥斯卡·汉默斯坦二世 (Oscar Hammerstein II) 改编自埃德娜·费伯 (Edna Ferber) 的长篇小说，在詹姆斯·鲸 (James Whale) 的优雅指导下，获得了最忠实、最持久的电影化处理。 《Show Boat》丰富地描绘了不断变化的美国娱乐传统和种族关系，跨越了五十年和三代人，讲述了热衷于舞台的木兰（艾琳·邓恩饰）的命运。木兰是一位有抱负的演员，她的旅程将她从 1880 年代南部家庭简陋的水上剧场带到了 1930 年代北部明亮的舞台。演艺界传奇人物包括海伦·摩根、海蒂·麦克丹尼尔、查尔斯·温宁格和伟大的保罗·罗伯逊，后者震撼人心的经典演绎《老曼河》是美国舞台和银幕的最高荣耀之一。
hook_en: Jerome Kern and Oscar Hammerstein II’s immortal musical adaptation of Edna Ferber’s sprawling novel receives its most faithful and enduring cinematic treatment under the elegant direction of James Whale. A rich portrait of changing American entertainment traditions and race relations, Show Boat spans five decades and three generations as it follows the fortunes of the stagestruck Magnolia (Irene Dunne), an aspiring actor whose journey takes her from her family’s humble floating playhouse in the 1880s South to the bright footlights of the 1930s North. The cast of show-business legends includes Helen Morgan, Hattie McDaniel, Charles Winninger, and the great Paul Robeson, whose iconic, soul-shaking rendition of “Ol’ Man River” is one of the crowning glories of the American stage and screen.

hook: 在黑泽明导演的严厉影片《睡不好》中，一位年轻的高管追捕杀害他父亲的凶手。黑泽明继续与演员三船敏郎的传奇合作，结合了哈姆雷特和美国黑色电影的元素，揭露了战后日本企业腐败的董事会，产生了令人不寒而栗的效果。
hook_en: A young executive hunts down his father’s killer in director Akira Kurosawa’s scathing The Bad Sleep Well. Continuing his legendary collaboration with actor Toshiro Mifune, Kurosawa combines elements of Hamlet and American film noir to chilling effect in exposing the corrupt boardrooms of postwar corporate Japan.

hook: 存在主义在这部原子时代科幻小说的标杆中流行起来，这是对传奇人物理查德·马西森小说的最高级改编，它让几代观众既敬畏又不安，提出了这样一个问题：人类在无限的宇宙中处于什么位置？暴露在神秘辐射云中六个月后，郊区的普通人斯科特·凯里（格兰特·威廉姆斯饰）发现自己变得越来越小。 。 。并且更小。 。 。变得更小——直到他被迫在一个普通的猫、捕鼠器和蜘蛛构成致命威胁的世界里自力更生，同时还要努力应对自我意识的减弱。由多产的生物特征经理人杰克·阿诺德执导，凭借巧妙的光学效果和超然的形而上学结局，《不可思议的缩小人》带着惊奇和恐惧凝视着不可知的浩瀚宇宙虚空。
hook_en: Existentialism goes pop in this benchmark of atomic-age science fiction, a superlative adaptation of a novel by the legendary Richard Matheson that has awed and unnerved generations of viewers with the question, What is humanity’s place amid the infinity of the universe? Six months after being exposed to a mysterious radiation cloud, suburban everyman Scott Carey (Grant Williams) finds himself becoming smaller . . . and smaller . . . and smaller—until he’s left to fend for himself in a world in which ordinary cats, mousetraps, and spiders pose a mortal threat, all while grappling with a diminishing sense of himself. Directed by the prolific creature-feature impresario Jack Arnold with ingenious optical effects and a transcendent metaphysical ending, The Incredible Shrinking Man gazes with wonder and trepidation into the unknowable vastness of the cosmic void.

hook: 当年轻的多梅尼科（桑德罗·潘塞里饰）从梅达小村庄冒险前往米兰寻找工作时，他发现自己在一家大而无名的公司中处于官僚阶梯的最底层。前景令人畏惧，但多梅尼科在迷人的安东尼埃塔（洛雷达娜·德托饰）身上找到了希望的理由。埃尔曼诺·奥尔米的《邮报》是一个温柔的成长故事，对非人性的企业企业进行了敏锐的观察，是一个感人而搞笑的故事，讲述了一个年轻人跌跌撞撞地陷入现代成年危险的故事。
hook_en: When young Domenico (Sandro Panseri) ventures from the small village of Meda to Milan in search of employment, he finds himself on the bottom rung of the bureaucratic ladder in a huge, faceless company. The prospects are daunting, but Domenico finds reason for hope in the fetching Antonietta (Loredana Detto). A tender coming-of-age story and a sharp observation of dehumanizing corporate enterprise, Ermanno Olmi’s Il posto is a touching and hilarious tale of one young man’s stumbling entrance into the perils of modern adulthood.

hook: 斯坦利·库布里克根据威廉·梅克皮斯·萨克雷的小说改编，在这部令人眼花缭乱的无情贵族景象中，按照自己的意愿改变了历史剧的惯例。巴里·林登以流浪汉的细节记录了一个不可救药的骗子（瑞恩·奥尼尔饰）的冒险经历，他的机会主义把他从爱尔兰农场带到了七年战争的战场和上流社会的客厅。库布里克在其职业生涯中制作最精美的电影中，再现了那个时期颓废的表面和错综复杂的社会规范，借助开创性的电影技术和奢华的服装和制作设计，唤起了十八世纪绘画的光线和质感，所有这些都赢得了奥斯卡奖。结果是一部杰作——对一个正在消失的世界进行了讽刺性的、毁灭性的描绘，这个世界的富裕掩盖了其内心的道德空虚。
hook_en: Stanley Kubrick bent the conventions of the historical drama to his own will in this dazzling vision of a pitiless aristocracy, adapted from a novel by William Makepeace Thackeray. In picaresque detail, Barry Lyndon chronicles the adventures of an incorrigible trickster (Ryan O’Neal) whose opportunism takes him from an Irish farm to the battlefields of the Seven Years’ War and the parlors of high society. For the most sumptuously crafted film of his career, Kubrick recreated the decadent surfaces and intricate social codes of the period, evoking the light and texture of eighteenth-century painting with the help of pioneering cinematographic techniques and lavish costume and production design, all of which earned Academy Awards. The result is a masterpiece—a sardonic, devastating portrait of a vanishing world whose opulence conceals the moral vacancy at its heart.

hook: 《历史是在夜晚创造的》充满了令人陶醉的浪漫主义色彩，是好莱坞经典的肉欲和精神欲望的至高诗人弗兰克·博尔扎奇对爱情的崇高赞歌。一位不幸的社交名流（吉恩·亚瑟饰）逃离她富有、占有欲极强的丈夫，穿越欧洲，命运的安排让她与一位温文尔雅的陌生人（查尔斯·博耶饰）走到了一起——很快，两人就陷入了一场跨越各大洲、看似不可能的、令人着迷的恋情，并将他们带到了灾难的边缘。主角之间的化学反应赋予了明显的色情色彩，这种被世界困扰的恋人的疯狂愿景经历了一系列令人眼花缭乱的色调转变——从情节剧到浪漫喜剧，从黑色到灾难惊悚片——在博尔扎奇对爱的力量坚定不移的忠诚的引导下，顺利地引导着。
hook_en: Suffused with intoxicating romanticism, History Is Made at Night is a sublime paean to love from Frank Borzage, classic Hollywood’s supreme poet of carnal and spiritual desire. On the run through Europe from her wealthy, cruelly possessive husband, an unhappy socialite (Jean Arthur) is thrown together by fate with a suave stranger (Charles Boyer)—and soon the two are bound in a consuming, seemingly impossible affair that stretches across continents and brings them to the very edge of catastrophe. Lent a palpable erotic charge by the chemistry between its leads, this delirious vision of lovers beset by the world passes through a dizzying array of tonal shifts—from melodrama to romantic comedy to noir to disaster thriller—smoothly guided by Borzage’s unwavering allegiance to the power of love.

hook: 这部充满狡猾智慧和欧陆式活力的浪漫欺骗轮盘赌，让怪诞喜剧变得毫不费力地优雅和欢快地不敬。身着高级定制服装的克劳黛·科尔伯特饰演一位身无分文的美国合唱团女孩，她冒充富有的匈牙利男爵夫人，闯入巴黎上流社会，但诡计多端的贵族（约翰·巴里摩尔饰）和迷恋的出租车司机（唐·阿米奇饰）很快就开始了她的游戏。比利·怀尔德和查尔斯·布拉克特精妙的剧本——童话般的逃避现实和刻薄的社会观察的典型颠覆性融合——以及大师级工匠米切尔·莱森的完美指导，打造出一个充满愤世嫉俗的颠倒灰姑娘故事。
hook_en: Screwball comedy doesn’t get any more effortlessly elegant and gleefully irreverent than this roulette wheel of romantic deception, gleaming with cunning wit and Continental élan. A couture-clad Claudette Colbert is divine as a penniless American chorus girl who crashes Parisian high society by posing as a wealthy Hungarian baroness—but both a scheming nobleman (John Barrymore) and a smitten taxi driver (Don Ameche) are soon on to her game.
