Billy Wilder and Charles Brackett’s sophisticated script—a typically subversive blend of fairy-tale escapism and caustic social observation—and the pitch-perfect direction of master craftsman Mitchell Leisen yield a topsy-turvy Cinderella story with a cynical bite.

hook: 艾伦·巴伦 (Allen Baron) 的纽约黑色电影《沉默的爆炸》迅速、残酷、黑心，令人震惊。这部低成本、精心制作的肖像画讲述了圣诞节期间在曼哈顿执行任务的杀手的故事，以机械精确的方式遵循其精简的叙述，但同时也对城市生活的奇怪细节和城市的壮丽之美进行了观察和倾听。视觉上的破烂和巧妙的构图，以及由莱昂内尔·斯坦德（Lionel Stander）表演和沃尔多·索尔特（Waldo Salt）（均未署名）撰写的粗犷而诗意的旁白，《沉默的爆炸》是一次时尚的胜利。
hook_en: Swift, brutal, and blackhearted, Allen Baron’s New York City noir Blast of Silence is a sensational surprise. This low-budget, carefully crafted portrait of a hit man on assignment in Manhattan during Christmastime follows its stripped-down narrative with mechanical precision, yet also with an eye and ear for the oddball details of urban ­living and the imposing beauty of the city. At once visually ragged and artfully composed, and featuring rough, poetic narration performed by Lionel Stander and written by Waldo Salt (both uncredited), Blast of Silence is a stylish triumph.

hook: 这部传奇的革命赞歌既是激进政治电影的里程碑，也是有史以来最具视觉冲击力的电影之一，它像一场叛逆的狂热梦想一样在银幕上闪烁。导演米哈伊尔·卡拉托佐夫的《我是古巴》是苏联和古巴电影业之间雄心勃勃的合作的成果，它以四个爆炸性的小片段展开，捕捉了处于转型边缘的古巴生活，压倒性的经济剥削和不平等让位于工人阶级起义。在卡洛斯·法里纳斯 (Carlos Fariñas) 激动人心的配乐的支持下，谢尔盖·乌鲁塞夫斯基 (Sergei Urusevsky) 令人眼花缭乱的摄影作品——为几代电影制作人提供了灵感——传达了电影的解放信息。
hook_en: Both a landmark of radical political cinema and one of the most visually ravishing films ever made, this legendary hymn to revolution shimmers across the screen like a fever dream of rebellion. The result of an extraordinarily ambitious collaboration between the Soviet and Cuban film industries, director Mikhail Kalatozov’s I Am Cuba unfolds in four explosive vignettes that capture Cuban life on the brink of transformation, as crushing economic exploitation and inequality give way to a working-class uprising. Backed by Carlos Fariñas’s stirring score, the dazzling camera work by Sergei Urusevsky—an inspiration for generations of filmmakers to follow—gives flight to the movie’s message of liberation.

hook: 由沃尔特·马修和格伦达·杰克逊组成的无与伦比的喜剧团队主演了英国电影大师罗纳德·尼姆这部讲述国际阴谋的灵活故事。这部轻松的惊悚片改编自布莱恩·加菲尔德的畅销小说，讲述了一位幻灭的退休中央情报局特工迈尔斯·肯迪格（马修饰）的故事，他在一位时尚精明的维也纳寡妇（杰克逊饰）的帮助下，威胁要出版他的回忆录，并揭露世界上每个主要情报机构的最内心秘密。尽管与他的前同事们陷入了激烈的争论，肯迪格还是拒绝排队——他玩得太开心了。这部轻松诙谐的讽刺剧以莫扎特的音乐为背景，讲述了那个时代的偏执戏剧，是对间谍电影精心制作的独特诠释。
hook_en: The inimitable comic team of Walter Matthau and Glenda Jackson star in this nimble tale of international intrigue from master British filmmaker Ronald Neame. Based on Brian Garfield’s best-selling novel, the blithe thriller centers on Miles Kendig (Matthau), a disillusioned retired CIA agent who, with the help of a chic and savvy Viennese widow (Jackson), threatens to publish his memoirs and expose the innermost secrets of every major intelligence agency in the world. Despite being in major hot water with his former colleagues, Kendig refuses to get in line—he’s having too much fun. Set to the sounds of Mozart, this lighthearted sendup of the paranoid dramas of its era is an expertly crafted, singular take on the spy movie.

hook: 约翰·卡索维茨 (John Cassavetes) 在《杀死一名中国赌徒》中以自己独特的风格涉足黑色电影。本·加扎拉 (Ben Gazzara) 出色地描绘了一位绅士俱乐部老板科斯莫·维泰利 (Cosmo Vitelli)，尽管他的环境肮脏且胃口不健康，但他仍拼命保持温文尔雅的外表。当科斯莫与高利贷者发生冲突时，他必须犯下可怕的罪行，否则就会失去他的生活方式。这部电影令人着迷且与众不同，是对男性身份的挑衅性审视。这里有两个版本：卡索维茨 1976 年的原始版本和他 1978 年的版本，缩短了近 30 分钟。
hook_en: John Cassavetes engages with film noir in his own inimitable style with The Killing of a Chinese Bookie. Ben Gazzara brilliantly portrays a gentleman’s club owner, Cosmo Vitelli, desperately committed to maintaining a facade of suave gentility despite the seediness of his environment and his own unhealthy appetites. When he runs afoul of loan sharks, Cosmo must carry out a terrible crime or lose his way of life. Mesmerizing and idiosyncratic, the film is a provocative examination of masculine identity. It is presented here in two versions: Cassavetes’s original 1976 edit and his 1978 one, nearly thirty minutes shorter.

hook: 阿瑟·佩恩 (Arthur Penn) 这部令人难忘的新黑色电影为幻想破灭、偏执的 20 世纪 70 年代重新演绎了冷酷侦探电影。吉恩·哈克曼在他最伟大的表演之一中流露出厌世的愤世嫉俗，他扮演一名私家侦探，寻找一位女演员失踪的女儿（梅兰妮·格里菲斯饰），他从好莱坞山来到佛罗里达群岛，在那里他被卷入了一场肮脏的家庭戏剧和一个他几乎无法理解的险恶阴谋。在艾伦·夏普（Alan Sharp）风格混乱的剧本和德德·艾伦（Dede Allen）省略的剪辑的支持下，大胆迷宫般的《夜行》是水门事件后电影的一部决定性作品——存在主义恐惧和道德败坏的无声尖叫，其传奇随着时间的推移而不断增长。
hook_en: Arthur Penn’s haunting neonoir reimagines the hard-boiled detective film for the disillusioned, paranoid 1970s. In one of his greatest performances, Gene Hackman oozes world-weary cynicism as a private investigator whose search for an actress’s missing daughter (Melanie Griffith) leads him from the Hollywood Hills to the Florida Keys, where he is pulled into a sordid family drama and a sinister conspiracy he can hardly grasp. Bolstered by Alan Sharp’s genre-scrambling script and Dede Allen’s elliptical editing, the daringly labyrinthine Night Moves is a defining work of post-Watergate cinema—a silent scream of existential dread and moral decay whose legend has only grown with time.

hook: 这部在反种族隔离运动最高潮时期制作的振奋人心的剧情片，导演尤占·帕尔西对南非的种族主义政府发出了毁灭性的控诉，并在此过程中创造了历史，成为第一位执导好莱坞电影的黑人女性。白人教师本·杜·托伊特（唐纳德·萨瑟兰饰）住在约翰内斯堡，他对黑人同胞的生活一直保持着幸福的态度，直到一波残酷对待袭击了他的园丁（温斯顿·恩索纳饰），杜·托伊特不得不面对严酷的政治现实。 《干白季节》改编自安德烈·布林克的一部著名小说，并植根于马提尼克·帕尔西在南非对种族隔离制度下黑人生活方式所做的第一手研究，它毫不犹豫地描绘了暴力和记录了不公正现象，向那些愿意牺牲一切来反抗压迫的人们致以强烈的敬意。
hook_en: With this bracing drama, made at the climax of the anti-apartheid movement, director Euzhan Palcy issued a devastating indict­ment of South Africa’s racist government—and made history in the process, becoming the first black woman to direct a Hollywood studio film. White schoolteacher Ben Du Toit (Donald Sutherland) lives in Johannesburg and remains blissfully incurious about the lives of his black countrymen until a wave of brutal treatment comes crashing down on his gardener (Winston Ntshona), bringing Du Toit face-to-face with harsh political realities. Based on a celebrated novel by André Brink and rooted in the first-hand research the Martinican Palcy did in South Africa into the way black people lived under apartheid, A Dry White Season is unflinching in its depiction of violence and its chronicling of injustice, making for a galvanizing tribute to those willing to sacrifice everything to fight oppression.

hook: 多萝西·阿兹纳 (Dorothy Arzner) 是 20 世纪 30 年代和 40 年代初好莱坞制片厂系统中唯一担任导演的女性，她为这部有趣的幕后情节剧带来了颠覆性的女权主义情感。 《舞蹈，女孩，舞蹈》讲述了残酷的演艺界中友谊、嫉妒和野心的幕后故事，讲述了两个合唱团女孩交织在一起的命运：一位梦想成为芭蕾舞演员的乐观舞者（莫琳·奥哈拉饰），以及一位黄铜淘金者（抢镜的露西尔·鲍尔饰），她在舞台上和爱情上都成为了对手。阿兹纳的电影是那个时代罕见的好莱坞电影，严肃地处理女性艺术斗争和自我实现的问题，是一位领先时代数十年的导演的丰富而迷人的陈述。
hook_en: Dorothy Arzner, the sole woman to work as a director in the Hollywood studio system of the 1930s and early ’40s, brings a subversive feminist sensibility to this juicily entertaining backstage melodrama. A behind-the-footlights look at friendship, jealousy, and ambition in the ruthless world of show business, Dance, Girl, Dance follows the intertwining fates of two chorus girls: a starry-eyed dancer (Maureen O’Hara) who dreams of making it as a ballerina, and the brassy gold digger (a scene-stealing Lucille Ball) who becomes her rival both on the stage and in love. The rare Hollywood picture of the era to deal seriously with issues of female artistic struggle and self-actualization, Arzner’s film is a rich, fascinating statement from an auteur decades ahead of her time.

hook: 普雷斯顿·斯特奇斯讲述的这个古怪婚姻的疯狂故事像火箭一样起飞，从未停歇。乔尔·麦克雷和克劳黛·科尔伯特饰演汤姆和格里，一对纽约已婚夫妇，经济和爱情都陷入困境。汤姆紧追不舍，格里前往佛罗里达执行一项任务，解决两人的金钱问题，她以一种非常非正统的方式完成了这一任务。 《棕榈滩的故事》将诙谐与荒诞融为一体，是斯特吉斯肢体喜剧和言语妙语连珠的典范，主演们的精彩表演以及鲁迪·瓦利和玛丽·阿斯特的搞笑配角，饰演陷入汤姆和格里狂欢的兄妹。
hook_en: This wild tale of wacky wedlock from Preston Sturges takes off like a rocket and never lets up. Joel McCrea and Claudette Colbert play Tom and Gerry, a married New York couple on the skids, financially and romantically. With Tom hot on her trail, Gerry takes off for Florida on a mission to solve the pair’s money troubles, which she accomplishes in a highly unorthodox manner. A mix of the witty and the utterly absurd, The Palm Beach Story is a high watermark of Sturges’s brand of physical comedy and verbal repartee, featuring sparkling performances from its leads as well as hilarious supporting turns from Rudy Vallee and Mary Astor as a brother and a sister ensnared in Tom and Gerry’s high jinks.

hook: 九十年代初，戏剧导演安德烈·格雷戈里在曼哈顿一座破旧的剧院里举办了一系列安东·契诃夫的《万尼亚叔叔》的私人演出。这一纯粹戏剧的实验——由华莱士·肖恩、朱丽安·摩尔、布鲁克·史密斯和乔治·盖恩斯等杰出演员组成——如果没有路易斯·马勒以微妙的电影光彩被记录在电影中，它可能会被时间所遗忘。 《42 街的万尼亚》是契诃夫杰作的银幕版本，令人难忘且感人至深，这是人们所希望看到的。这部电影是马勒的最后一部电影，是对这位剧作家毁灭性作品以及创作过程本身的致敬。
hook_en: In the early nineties, theater director André Gregory mounted a series of spare, private performances of Anton Chekhov’s Uncle Vanya in a crumbling Manhattan playhouse. This experiment in pure theater—featuring a remarkable cast of actors, including Wallace Shawn, Julianne Moore, Brooke Smith, and George Gaynes—would have been lost to time had it not been captured on film, with subtle cinematic brilliance, by Louis Malle. Vanya on 42nd Street is as memorable and emotional a screen version of Chekhov’s masterpiece as one could ever hope to see. This film, which turned out to be Malle’s last, is a tribute to the playwright’s devastating work as well as to the creative process itself.

hook: 朱丽安·摩尔 (Julianne Moore) 饰演卡罗尔·怀特 (Carol White)，她是 20 世纪 80 年代末洛杉矶的一位家庭主妇，患有一种使人衰弱的疾病。在她看的医生无法给她明确的诊断后，她开始相信自己患有可怕的极端环境过敏症。美国伟大导演托德·海恩斯的一部令人深感不安的作品，《安全》具有多个层面的功能：作为对自助文化的有先见之明的评论，作为艾滋病危机的隐喻，作为一部关于阶级和社会疏远的戏剧，以及作为一部关于你看不见的事物的恐怖电影。这部具有启发性的剧情片在乡村之声对 50 多名评论家进行的民意调查中被评为 20 世纪 90 年代最佳电影。
hook_en: Julianne Moore gives a breakthrough performance as Carol White, a Los Angeles housewife in the late 1980s who comes down with a debilitating illness. After the doctors she sees can give her no clear diagnosis, she comes to believe that she has frighteningly extreme environmental allergies. A profoundly unsettling work from the great American director Todd Haynes, Safe functions on multiple levels: as a prescient commentary on self-help culture, as a metaphor for the AIDS crisis, as a drama about class and social estrangement, and as a horror film about what you cannot see. This revelatory drama was named the best film of the 1990s in a Village Voice poll of more than fifty critics.

hook: 舞台和银幕上最伟大的演说家之一斯伯丁·格雷 (Spalding Gray) 与电影界最大胆的图像制作者之一、奥斯卡获奖导演史蒂文·索德伯格 (Steven Soderbergh) 携手合作，拍摄了《格雷的解剖》(Gray’s Anatomy)，这是一部引人入胜的改编自格雷 1993 年的同名独白（与蕾妮·沙夫兰斯基 (Renée Shafransky) 合写) 的作品。在书中，格雷以典型的讽刺风格，记录了他诊断和治疗一种罕见且令人震惊的眼部疾病的艰辛历程。对于独白者来说，这段经历引发了对疾病和死亡、医学和形而上学的思考；对于电影制作人来说，这是一个尝试如何将拍摄对象的话语带入精彩、令人大开眼界的生活的机会。
hook_en: One of the great raconteurs of stage and screen, Spalding Gray, came together with one of cinema’s boldest image-makers, Oscar-winning director Steven Soderbergh, for Gray’s Anatomy, a spellbinding adaptation of Gray’s 1993 monologue of the same name (cowritten with Renée Shafransky). In it, Gray, with typical sardonic relish, chronicles his arduous journey through the diagnosis and treatment of a rare and alarming ocular condition. For the monologist, this experience occasioned a meditation on illness and mortality, medicine and metaphysics; for the filmmaker, it was a chance to experiment with ways of bringing his subject’s words to brilliant, eye-opening life.

hook: 紧张的老处女夏洛特·维尔（贝蒂·戴维斯饰）在她清教徒式的波士顿婆罗门母亲（格拉迪斯·库珀饰）的管教下成长，发育迟缓，她始终坚信自己毫无价值，直到一位和蔼可亲的精神科医生（克劳德·雷恩斯饰）给了她信心，让她踏上南美游轮冒险闯荡世界。在船上，她在一位婚姻不幸的男人（保罗·亨里德饰）的帮助下找到了自己的立足点。他们受挫的恋情可能会帮助夏洛特摆脱母亲的控制，但她会找到满足感和独立吗？ 《航海者》是在戴维斯作为女性电影女王统治的鼎盛时期制作的，并得到了奥斯卡获奖者马克斯·斯坦纳的配乐的支持，如今，《航海者》是一部经典的情节剧，既是一部令人着迷的好莱坞爱情片，也是一部关于自我发现的辛酸传奇。
hook_en: Nervous spinster Charlotte Vale (Bette Davis) is stunted from growing up under the heel of her puritanical Boston Brahmin mother (Gladys Cooper), and remains convinced of her own unworthiness until a kindly psychiatrist (Claude Rains) gives her the confidence to venture out into the world on a South American cruise. On board, she finds her footing with the help of an unhappily married man (Paul Henreid). Their thwarted love affair may help Charlotte break free of her mother’s grip—but will she find fulfillment as well as independence? Made at the height of Davis’s reign as the queen of the woman’s picture and bolstered by an Oscar-winning Max Steiner score, Now, Voyager is a melodrama for the ages, both a rapturous Hollywood romance and a poignant saga of self-discovery.

hook: 考林·史密斯 (Cauleen Smith) 的《德利隆索》(Drylongso) 是 20 世纪 90 年代 DIY 电影制作中重新发现的瑰宝，在一部精心制作的兄弟电影/谋杀悬疑/浪漫电影中，对种族不平等现象进行了深刻的探讨。性格傲慢的加利福尼亚州奥克兰艺术学生皮卡（托比·史密斯饰）对周围年轻黑人的死亡速度感到震惊，她试图在宝丽莱照片中保留他们的存在，一路上与一名处于虐待关系中的女性（阿普丽尔·巴尼特饰）建立了友谊，并经历了爱情、心碎和日常的暴力威胁。史密斯捕捉了九十年代奥克兰充满活力的社区精神，制作了一部罕见的黑人女性创造力电影庆典，并为一代迷失的非洲裔美国男性写下了动人的挽歌。
hook_en: A rediscovered treasure of 1990s DIY filmmaking, Cauleen Smith’s Drylongso embeds an incisive look at racial injustice within a lovingly handmade buddy movie/murder mystery/romance. Alarmed by the rate at which the young Black men around her are dying, brash Oakland, California, art student Pica (Toby Smith) attempts to preserve their existence in Polaroid snapshots, along the way forging a friendship with a woman in an abusive relationship (April Barnett) and experiencing love, heartbreak, and the everyday threat of violence. Capturing the vibrant community spirit of Oakland in the nineties, Smith crafts both a rare cinematic celebration of Black female creativity and a moving elegy for a generation of lost African American men.

hook: 好莱坞大师迈克尔·柯蒂斯在这幅关于母亲牺牲的肖像中，情节剧投下了黑色的阴影。琼·克劳馥 (Joan Crawford) 饰演的米尔德里德 (Mildred) 是一位一心想让孩子们摆脱经济困难的单身母亲，她的标志性表演巩固了克劳馥的职业生涯，并为这位演员带来了她唯一的一座奥斯卡奖。但随着米尔德里德自力更生，先是成为一名镇定自若的女服务员，最终成为一家成功连锁餐厅的富有的老板，她的长子（邪恶的安·布莱斯饰）的忘恩负义变成了毒蛇的牙齿，引发了绝望的示好和无情的相互指责的无休止的循环。将詹姆斯·M·凯恩丰富的心理小说改造成一部谋杀悬疑小说，这部混合了盲目父母之爱和全美国野心的苦涩鸡尾酒，既冷酷无情，又情感丰富。
hook_en: Melodrama casts noirish shadows in this portrait of maternal sacrifice from Hollywood master Michael Curtiz. Joan Crawford’s iconic performance as Mildred, a single mother hell-bent on freeing her children from the stigma of economic hardship, solidified Crawford’s career comeback and gave the actor her only Oscar. But as Mildred pulls herself up by her bootstraps, first as an unflappable waitress and eventually as the well-heeled owner of a successful restaurant chain, the ingratitude of her materialistic firstborn (a diabolical Ann Blyth) becomes a venomous serpent’s tooth, setting in motion an endless cycle of desperate overtures and heartless recriminations. Recasting James M. Cain’s rich psychological novel as a murder mystery, this bitter cocktail of blind parental love and all-American ambition is both unremittingly hard-boiled and sumptuously emotional.

hook: 在这部由传奇作家兼导演普雷斯顿·斯特奇斯执导的黑色喜剧中，雷克斯·哈里森饰演阿尔弗雷德·德·卡特爵士，一位世界著名的交响乐指挥家，怀疑自己的妻子有外遇。在一场音乐会上，嫉妒的德卡特在三首独立的管弦乐作品中精心构思了复仇的愿景。但当他试图将他的杀人幻想付诸行动时，一切都没有按计划进行。 《不忠实的你》完美地融合了尖锐的对话和喧闹的闹剧，是银幕喜剧大师的真正经典之作。
hook_en: In this pitch-black comedy from legendary writer-director Preston Sturges, Rex Harrison stars as Sir Alfred De Carter, a world-famous symphony conductor consumed with the suspicion that his wife is having an affair. During a concert, the jealous De Carter entertains elaborate visions of vengeance, set to three separate orchestral works. But when he attempts to put his murderous fantasies into action, nothing works out quite as planned. A brilliantly performed mixture of razor-sharp dialogue and uproarious slapstick, Unfaithfully Yours is a true classic from a grand master of screen comedy.

hook: 哈维·米尔克是一位真正的二十世纪开拓者，是一位直言不讳的人权活动家，也是第一批公开同性恋身份并当选公职的美国政客之一。即使在 1978 年被暗杀之后，他仍然继续激励世界各地被剥夺权利的人们。荣获奥斯卡奖的《哈维·米尔克时代》由罗伯特·爱泼斯坦执导，理查德·施米钦担任制片人，与它的主题一样具有开创性。这是第一批关注美国同性恋生活的专题纪录片之一，它本身就是一部宣传作品，将米尔克的希望和平等信息带给了更广泛的观众。这些令人兴奋的原始纪录片材料和档案片段既是对某个时间和地点（旧金山七十年代历史悠久的卡斯特罗区）的生动写照，也是一位政治远见者遗产的证明。
hook_en: A true twentieth-century trailblazer, Harvey Milk was an outspoken human rights activist and one of the first openly gay U.S. politicians elected to public office; even after his assassination in 1978, he continues to inspire disenfranchised people around the world. The Oscar-winning The Times of Harvey Milk, directed by Robert Epstein and produced by Richard Schmiechen, was as groundbreaking as its subject. One of the first feature documentaries to address gay life in America, it’s a work of advocacy itself, bringing Milk’s message of hope and equality to a wider audience. This exhilarating trove of original documentary material and archival footage is as much a vivid portrait of a time and place (San Francisco’s historic Castro District in the seventies) as a testament to the legacy of a political visionary.

hook: 令人惊叹的阿尔卑斯外景摄影和年轻的罗伯特·雷德福（Robert Redford）扮演他最早的主演角色之一，只是迈克尔·里奇（Michael Ritchie）的发自肺腑的处女作《下坡赛车》（Downhill Racer）的视觉辉煌中的两个。雷德福在精彩低调的表演中饰演大卫·查佩莱 (David Chappellet)，一位雄心勃勃、雄心勃勃的滑雪运动员，在欧洲与一支处于劣势的美国队争夺奥运金牌，而吉恩·哈克曼 (Gene Hackman) 作为教练提供了强有力的支持，试图抑制这位暴发户对荣耀的自恋冲动。 《下坡赛车手》由著名小说家詹姆斯·索尔特 (James Salter) 精心编写，是一幅生动的人物肖像，令人惊叹的快速和激烈的图像将观众直接带入竞争对手的脑海中。
hook_en: Astonishing Alpine location photography and a young Robert Redford in one of his earliest starring roles are just two of the visual splendors of Downhill Racer, the visceral debut feature of Michael Ritchie. In a beautifully understated performance, Redford is David Chappellet, a ruthlessly ambitious skier competing for Olympic gold with an underdog American team in Europe, and Gene Hackman provides tough support as the coach who tries to temper the upstart’s narcissistic drive for glory. With a subtle screenplay by acclaimed novelist James Salter, Downhill Racer is a vivid character portrait buoyed by breathtakingly fast and furious imagery that brings the viewer directly into the mind of the competitor.

hook: 黑泽明的这部影片时而悲惨，时而超凡脱俗，讲述了一群人在东京郊区贫民窟勉强度日的日常生活。然而，尽管他们的处境十分绝望，但他们每个人——无家可归的父子都梦想着自己的梦想之家；被她叔叔虐待的年轻女子；那个想象自己是电车售票员的男孩找到了继续下去的理由。令人难忘的《Dodes'ka-den》是在黑泽明人生的一个动荡时刻创作的。他所有的希望、恐惧和艺术热情都在这部他精彩拍摄的第一部彩色电影中得到了热烈的展现。
hook_en: By turns tragic and transcendent, Akira Kurosawa’s film follows the daily lives of a group of people barely scraping by in a slum on the outskirts of Tokyo. Yet as desperate as their circumstances are, each of them—the homeless father and son envisioning their dream house; the young woman abused by her uncle; the boy who imagines himself a trolley conductor—finds reasons to carry on. The unforgettable Dodes’ka-den was made at a tumultuous moment in Kurosawa's life. And all of his hopes, fears, and artistic passion are on fervent display in this, his gloriously shot first color film.

hook: 在冷战时期维也纳的优雅颓废中，精神分析学家亚历克斯·林登博士（阿特·加芬克尔饰）陷入了与难以捉摸的米莱娜·弗莱厄蒂（特里萨·拉塞尔饰）的情欲之中。当他们全力以赴的激情演变为危及生命的转折点时，内图希尔探长（哈维·凯特尔饰）被指派去拼凑出肮脏的细节。尼古拉斯·罗伊格的《坏时机》因其创新的剪辑、原始的表演和激动人心的配乐（由汤姆·威茨、谁人乐队和比莉·哈乐黛主演）而广受赞誉，是对性痴迷的黑暗世界的一次巧妙而又令人深感不安的尝试。
hook_en: Amid the decaying elegance of cold-war Vienna, psychoanalyst Dr. Alex Linden (Art Garfunkel) becomes mired in an erotically charged affair with the elusive Milena Flaherty (Theresa Russell). When their all-consuming passion takes a life-threatening turn, Inspector Netusil (Harvey Keitel) is assigned to piece together the sordid details. Acclaimed for its innovative editing, raw performances, and stirring musical score—featuring Tom Waits, the Who, and Billie Holiday—Nicolas Roeg’s Bad Timing is a masterful, deeply disturbing foray into the dark world of sexual obsession.

hook: 在电视真人秀占据主导地位的几十年前，阿尔伯特·布鲁克斯的处女作《真实生活》是一部精彩的、面无表情、风格创新的讽刺作品，讲述了试图在电影中捕捉真相的危险和陷阱。这位编剧兼导演饰演“阿尔伯特·布鲁克斯”，一位自恋的好莱坞电影制片人，计划在凤凰城与沃伦·耶格尔和珍妮特·耶格尔（查尔斯·格罗丁和弗朗西斯·李·麦凯恩饰）以及他们的两个孩子一起度过一年，部署一系列尖端设备（包括头戴式 Ettinauer 226XL 摄像机）来捕捉美国家庭的日常生活。这部开创性的伪纪录片记录了该项目的灾难性后果，爱管闲事的阿尔伯特情不自禁地过于接近他的拍摄对象，在当今的媒体格局中，这部开创性的伪纪录片比以往任何时候都更加重要。
hook_en: Decades before reality television reigned supreme, there was Albert Brooks’s debut feature, Real Life, a brilliantly deadpan, stylistically innovative satire about the perils and pitfalls of trying to capture the truth on film. The writer-director plays “Albert Brooks,” a narcissistic Hollywood filmmaker who plans to spend the year in Phoenix embedded with Warren and Jeanette Yeager (Charles Grodin and Frances Lee McCain) and their two children, deploying an arsenal of cutting-edge equipment (including the over-the-head Ettinauer 226XL camera) to capture an American family’s ordinary day-to-day. Chronicling the project’s disastrous fallout, as the meddlesome Albert can’t help getting too close to his subjects, this pioneering mockumentary is more relevant than ever amid today’s media landscape.

hook: 第二次世界大战结束时，日本帝国陆军团在缅甸向英国军队投降，并通过歌曲找到了和谐。一名二等兵被认为已经死亡，他伪装成佛教僧侣并偶然获得了精神启蒙。市川今的《缅甸竖琴》以安静的黑白拍摄，雄辩地表达了对死亡与美共存的思考，至今仍然是日本电影中最具压倒性的反战情绪之一，在与日本战时遗产的斗争中既温柔又残酷。
hook_en: An Imperial Japanese Army regiment surrenders to British forces in Burma at the close of World War II and finds harmony through song. A private, thought to be dead, disguises himself as a Buddhist monk and stumbles upon spiritual enlightenment. Magnificently shot in hushed black and white, Kon Ichikawa’s The Burmese Harp is an eloquent meditation on beauty coexisting with death and remains one of Japanese cinema’s most overwhelming antiwar sentiments, both tender and brutal in its grappling with Japan’s wartime legacy.

hook: 芭芭拉·科普尔 (Barbara Kopple) 荣获奥斯卡金像奖的《美国哈兰县》毫不畏缩地记录了肯塔基州小镇的煤矿工人罢工。通过前所未有的接触，科普尔和她的团队捕捉到了矿工有时与破坏罢工者、当地警察和公司暴徒的暴力斗争。这部电影以令人难忘的配乐——由传奇乡村和蓝草艺术家黑兹尔·狄更斯、梅尔·特拉维斯、大卫·莫里斯、莎拉·奥根·冈宁和弗洛伦斯·里斯为主角——记录了一个为生存而奋斗的社区与一家致力于盈利的公司之间长达十三个月的令人心碎的斗争。
hook_en: Barbara Kopple’s Academy Award–winning Harlan County USA unflinchingly documents a coal miners’ strike in a small Kentucky town. With unprecedented access, Kopple and her crew captured the miners’ sometimes violent struggles with strikebreakers, local police, and company thugs. With a haunting soundtrack—featuring legendary country and bluegrass artists Hazel Dickens, Merle Travis, David Morris, Sarah Ogan Gunning, and Florence Reece—the film is a heartbreaking record of the thirteen-month struggle between a community fighting to survive and a corporation dedicated to the bottom line.

hook: 这部由阿根廷经典电影最重要导演之一马里奥·索菲奇 (Mario Soffici) 执导的社会现实主义作品在丛林中拍摄，充满了对工人压迫的愤怒。绝望的男人们被困在马黛茶种植园里，在残酷的工头科纳手下做契约劳工。科纳和一名名叫波德利的工人都爱上了集中营医生的可爱女儿安德里亚，这让情况变得更加紧张，最终演变成波德利领导的一场爆炸性叛乱。巴勃罗·塔伯内罗的表现主义电影摄影狂热地唤起了一个令人窒息的炎热、经济剥削和残酷无情地导致疯狂和暴力的地方。
hook_en: Shot on location in the jungle, this gut-punching work of social realism by Mario Soffici—one of classic Argentine cinema’s foremost directors—simmers with rage against worker oppression. Desperate men are entrapped into indentured labor on a yerba maté plantation under the brutal foreman Köhner—a situation made tenser by the fact that both Köhner and a worker named Podeley love Andrea, the sweet-spirited daughter of the camp’s doctor, and that eventually boils over into an explosive rebellion led by Podeley. The expressionistic cinematography of Pablo Tabernero feverishly evokes a place where suffocating heat, economic exploitation, and cruelty lead inexorably to madness and violence.

hook: 皮尔·保罗·帕索里尼 (Pier Paolo Pasolini) 将乔瓦尼·薄伽丘 (Giovanni Boccaccio) 的一些 14 世纪道德故事编织在这部风景如画的自由混战中。 《十日谈》探索了早期的欢乐和黑暗角落，正如电影制片人所见，不那么妥协的时间。主要的乐趣包括一个年轻人与一伙盗墓贼的英勇事迹，一群好色的修女与一个魁梧的园丁犯罪，以及帕索里尼作为画家乔托的学生在一幅巨大的壁画上工作。作为导演最受欢迎的电影之一，《十日谈》从薄伽丘笔下的佛罗伦萨搬到了那不勒斯，彻底摧毁了围绕宗教和性的虔诚。
hook_en: Pier Paolo Pasolini weaves together a handful of Giovanni Boccaccio’s fourteenth-century moral tales in this picturesque free-for-all. The Decameron explores the delectations and dark corners of an earlier and, as the filmmaker saw it, less compromised time. Among the chief delights are a young man’s exploits with a gang of grave robbers, a flock of randy nuns who sin with a strapping gardener, and Pasolini’s appearance as a pupil of the painter Giotto, at work on a massive fresco. One of the director’s most popular films, The Decameron, trans­posed to Naples from Boccaccio’s Florence, is a cutting takedown of the pieties surrounding religion and sex.

hook: 百老汇演员默特尔·戈登（吉娜·罗兰兹饰）在排练她的最新戏剧时，目睹了一位崇拜的年轻粉丝的意外死亡，此后她开始面对自己混乱的生活。约翰·卡索维茨的《开幕之夜》以罗兰兹的精湛表演为主角，揭露了一位表演者付出巨大的个人代价，将自己的角色变成自己的戏剧，它隐喻了导演独特的、发自内心的创作方法。
hook_en: While in the midst of rehearsals for her latest play, Broadway actor Myrtle Gordon (Gena Rowlands) witnesses the accidental death of an adoring young fan, after which she begins to confront the chaos of her own life. Headlined by a virtuoso performance by Rowlands, John Cassavetes’s Opening Night lays bare the drama of a performer who, at great personal cost, makes a part her own, and it functions as a metaphor for the director’s singular, wrenched-from-the-heart creative method.

hook: 悬浮在无忧无虑的青春和成人世界的严酷现实之间，一个十几岁的女孩在这种令人难以忘怀的纯真失落的幻象中经历了令人不安的觉醒。改编自乔伊斯·卡罗尔·奥茨的著名短篇小说《你要去哪里，你去过哪里？》，乔伊斯·乔普拉的这部叙事处女作以劳拉·邓恩 (Laura Dern) 的突破性表演为特色，她饰演康妮 (Connie)，她是家里 15 岁的害群之马，她夏天的海滩旅行、商场闲逛和天真的调情的田园诗般的生活被一个神秘陌生人 (令人难忘的威胁性特里特·威廉姆斯饰) 的遭遇打破了。 《Smooth Talk》获得了圣丹斯电影节评审团大奖，它捕捉到了青少年性探索的刺激和恐惧，并将成长故事的惯例转变为更加令人不安和深刻的东西。
hook_en: Suspended between carefree youth and the harsh realities of the adult world, a teenage girl experiences an unsettling awakening in this haunting vision of innocence lost. Based on Joyce Carol Oates’s celebrated short story “Where Are You Going, Where Have You Been?,” the narrative debut from Joyce Chopra features a revelatory breakout performance by Laura Dern as Connie, the fifteen-year-old black sheep of her family, whose summertime idyll of beach trips, mall hangouts, and innocent flirtations is shattered by an encounter with a mysterious stranger (a memorably menacing Treat Williams). Winner of the Grand Jury Prize at Sundance, Smooth Talk captures the thrill and terror of adolescent sexual exploration, and it transforms the conventions of a coming-of-age story into something altogether more troubling and profound.

hook: 五个城市。五辆出租车。夜里，陌生人众多。吉姆·贾木许召集了一批杰出的国际演员（包括吉娜·罗兰兹、薇诺娜·瑞德、阿明·穆勒-斯塔尔、比阿特丽斯·达勒和罗伯托·贝尼尼），讲述了这个关于城市流离失所和存在焦虑的转瞬即逝的故事，所有故事都以出租车司机和车夫之间的遭遇为背景。跨越时区、大陆、语言，
hook_en: Five cities. Five taxicabs. A multitude of strangers in the night. Jim Jarmusch assembled an extraordinary international cast of actors (including Gena Rowlands, Winona Ryder, Armin Mueller-Stahl, Béatrice Dalle, and Roberto Benigni) for this quintet of transitory tales of urban displacement and existential angst, all staged as encounters between cabbies and their fares. Spanning time zones, continents, and languages,

hook: 霍华德·布鲁克纳 (Howard Brookner) 于 1983 年拍摄的关于威廉·S·巴勒斯 (William S. Burroughs) 的纪录片由历时五年拍摄的这位非凡作家和诗人的私密、具有启发性的镜头组成，几十年来主要是传奇故事；当已故导演的侄子亚伦·布鲁克纳 (Aaron Brookner) 在 2011 年发现了这幅画的印刷品并带头进行修复后，情况发生了变化。现在，观众可以享受《巴勒斯：电影》中令人振奋的坦诚，这是一部独一无二的非小说类肖像，在包括吉姆·贾木许和汤姆·迪西洛在内的一群杰出朋友的帮助下，栩栩如生，巴勒斯的其他艺术家包括艾伦·金斯伯格、赫伯特·亨克、帕蒂·史密斯和特里·萨瑟恩等都在银幕上露面。
hook_en: Made up of intimate, revelatory footage of the singular author and poet filmed over the course of five years, Howard Brookner’s 1983 documentary about William S. Burroughs was for decades mainly the stuff of legend; that changed when Aaron Brookner, the late director’s nephew, discovered a print of it in 2011 and spearheaded a restoration. Now viewers can enjoy the invigorating candidness of Burroughs: The Movie, a one-of-a-kind nonfiction portrait that was brought to life with the help of a remarkable crew of friends, including Jim Jarmusch and Tom DiCillo, and that features on-screen appearances by fellow artists of Burroughs’s including Allen Ginsberg, Herbert Huncke, Patti Smith, and Terry Southern.

hook: 史蒂文·索德伯格（Steven Soderbergh）（其独立处女作《性、谎言和录像带》曾于几年前在戛纳电影节赢得金棕榈奖）在他的第一部好莱坞制片作品中精心制作了这部关于成长故事的小宝石。 《山丘之王》以大萧条时期的圣路易斯为背景，讲述了一个足智多谋、富有想象力的青少年的日常挣扎，他的弟弟被送往亲戚家，患有肺结核的母亲去了疗养院，而他的推销员父亲则长期出差，他必须在一家破旧的酒店里独自生存。这部令人回味的时代作品忠实地改编自 A. E. 霍奇纳 (A. E. Hotchner) 的回忆录，是多才多艺的索德伯格最感人、最令人惊讶的电影之一。
hook_en: For his first Hollywood studio production, Steven Soderbergh (whose independent debut, sex, lies, and videotape, had won the Palme d’Or at Cannes a few years earlier) crafted this small jewel of a growing-up story. Set in St. Louis during the Great Depression, King of the Hill follows the daily struggles of a resourceful and imaginative adolescent who, after his younger brother is sent to live with a relative and his tubercular mother to a sanitarium, must survive on his own in a run-down hotel during his salesman father’s long business trips. This evocative period piece, faithfully adapted from the A. E. Hotchner memoir, is among the versatile Soderbergh’s most touching and surprising films.

hook: 在凯利·雷查特 (Kelly Reichardt) 精心观察的这幅三联画中，广阔的美国西部占据了中心舞台。 《某些女人》改编自梅勒·梅洛伊的三篇短篇小说，以独立但环环相扣的情节展开，讲述了个人欲望和社会期望的微妙变化，这些变化扰乱了人物有限的生活：律师（劳拉·邓恩饰）被迫制服陷入困境的客户；一位妻子和母亲（米歇尔·威廉姆斯饰）计划建造自己的梦想家园，但她的婚姻却出现了裂痕；一名夜校老师（克里斯汀·斯图尔特饰）与一名孤独的牧场工人（莉莉·格拉德斯通饰）建立了脆弱的联系，后者对联系的渴望带来了意想不到的情感直接震撼。雷查特以低调的手法，通过这些精致的女性肖像捕捉了蒙大拿州小镇日常生活的节奏。
hook_en: The expanses of the American West take center stage in this intimately observed triptych from Kelly Reichardt. Adapted from three short stories by Maile Meloy and unfolding in self-contained but interlocking episodes, Certain Women navigates the subtle shifts in personal desire and social expectation that unsettle the circumscribed lives of its characters: a lawyer (Laura Dern) forced to subdue a troubled client; a wife and mother (Michelle Williams) whose plans to construct her dream home reveal fissures in her marriage; and a night-school teacher (Kristen Stewart) who forms a tenuous bond with a lonely ranch hand (Lily Gladstone), whose longing for connection delivers an unexpected jolt of emotional immediacy. With unassuming craft, Reichardt captures the rhythms of daily life in small-town Montana through these fine-grained portraits of women trapped within the landscape’s wide-open spaces.

hook: 法国著名电影制片人奥利维尔·阿萨亚斯 (Olivier Assayas) 凭借这部亲密的超自然戏剧，演绎了一个以名人和高级时装世界为背景的忧郁鬼故事。这部引人入胜的人物研究由克里斯汀·斯图尔特主演，她在阿萨亚斯的《锡尔斯玛丽亚的云》中的表演使她成为第一位获得凯撒奖的美国女演员。这部令人回味的人物研究讲述了一位年轻的时尚助理和精神媒介的故事，她住在巴黎，在双胞胎兄弟突然去世后寻找来世的迹象。 《私人购物者》以心理惊悚片的形式对悲伤进行了激动人心的描述，为阿萨亚斯赢得了戛纳电影节最佳导演奖，它是对现代沟通方式以及我们哀悼所爱之人的方式的令人不寒而栗的思考。
hook_en: With this intimate supernatural drama, the celebrated French filmmaker Olivier Assayas conjures a melancholy ghost story set in the world of celebrity and haute couture. Starring Kristen Stewart, whose performance in Assayas’s Clouds of Sils Maria made her the first American actress to win a César Award, this evocative character study tells the story of a young fashion assistant and spiritual medium who is living in Paris and searching for signs of an afterlife following the sudden death of her twin brother. A stirring depiction of grief in the form of a psychological thriller, Personal Shopper—which won Assayas the best director award at Cannes—is a chilling meditation on modern modes of communication and the way we mourn those we love.

hook: 罗伯特·汤森德 (Robert Townsend) 的这部处女作是一部巧妙的讽刺里程碑，它对 20 世纪 80 年代好莱坞黑人演员的类型塑造进行了激烈的抨击。这位编剧兼导演兼明星的超凡魅力推动了《好莱坞洗牌》的发展，这个搞笑的故事讲述了一位苦苦挣扎的演员试图闯入一个黑人演员只能扮演的角色似乎是骗子、管家和奴隶的行业——迫使他在出卖和维护自尊之间做出选择。汤森德和合著者基南·艾沃里·韦恩斯讽刺了从黑色电影、僵尸电影到情景喜剧等各种内容，巧妙地将这位黑人艺术家的挫败感转变成一种颠覆性的有趣的流行文化批评。
hook_en: This debut feature by Robert Townsend is an ingenious satirical landmark that takes riotous aim at the typecasting of Black actors in 1980s Hollywood. The writer-director-star’s megawatt charisma propels Hollywood Shuffle, the hilarious tale of a struggling actor attempting to break into an industry where the only roles available to Black performers seem to be hustlers, butlers, and slaves—forcing him to choose between selling out and maintaining his self-respect. Lampooning everything from film noir to zombie flicks to sitcoms, Townsend and cowriter Keenen Ivory Wayans cannily turn the frustrations of the Black artist into a subversively funny pop-culture critique.

hook: 无论是在瑞典、意大利还是好莱坞的电影中担任主角，英格丽·褒曼总是以一种独特的深情穿透银幕。通过这部在伯格曼诞辰一百周年之际制作的新纪录片，导演斯蒂格·比约克曼让我们前所未有地进入了她的世界，从最私人的档案材料中挑选了一些——信件、日记、照片以及伯格曼自己拍摄的 8 毫米和 16 毫米镜头——并跟随她从青年时代到动荡的婚姻生活和母亲身份。这部精心制作的肖像画亲密而巧妙，由演员艾丽西亚·维坎德 (Alicia Vikander) 担任旁白，为这位不朽传奇人物的生活和事业提供了清晰的见解。
hook_en: Whether headlining films in Sweden, Italy, or Hollywood, Ingrid Bergman always pierced the screen with a singular soulfulness. With this new documentary, made on the occasion of the one hundredth anniversary of Bergman’s birth, director Stig Björkman allows us unprecedented access to her world, culling from the most personal of archival materials—letters, diary entries, photographs, and 8 mm and 16 mm footage Bergman herself shot—and following her from youth to tumultuous married life and motherhood. Intimate and artful, this lovingly assembled portrait, narrated by actor Alicia Vikander, provides luminous insight into the life and career of an undiminished legend.

hook: 在米兰躲藏了近十年后，逃亡的黑帮头子阿贝尔·达沃斯（利诺·文图拉饰）不顾死刑判决，带着孩子偷偷回到巴黎。在指定监护人埃里克·斯塔克（让-保罗·贝尔蒙多，刚刚在《气喘吁吁》中出演明星）的陪伴下，阿贝尔开始了一段穿越战后巴黎黑社会的扣人心弦、反省的旅程，并受到前朋友的背后中伤的困扰。克洛德·索泰 (Claude Sautet) 执导的这部粗犷黑色电影对一名濒临绝境的职业罪犯进行了人物研究，是 20 世纪 60 年代法国电影的一大亮点。
hook_en: After hiding out in Milan for nearly a decade, fugitive gangland chief Abel Davos (Lino Ventura) sneaks back to Paris with his children, despite a death sentence hanging over his head. Accompanied by appointed guardian Eric Stark (Jean-Paul Belmondo, fresh off his star turn in Breathless) and beset by backstabbing former friends, Abel begins a throat-grabbing, soul-searching journey through the postwar Parisian underworld. A character study of a career criminal at the end of his rope, this rugged noir from Claude Sautet is a highlight of 1960s French cinema.

hook: 卡尔·德雷尔的最后一部电影巧妙地为他的职业生涯画上了圆满的句号：对悲剧、个人意志和拒绝妥协的沉思。一个女人离开了不圆满的婚姻，开始寻找理想的爱情，但无论是与年轻男人的热恋，还是旧日浪漫的回归，都无法提供她所寻求的答案。德雷尔始终是风格创新者，采用长镜头和戏剧舞台，专注于尼娜·彭斯·罗德 (Nina Pens Rode) 对骄傲而勇敢的格特鲁德 (Gertrud) 的崇高描绘。
hook_en: Carl Dreyer’s last film neatly crowns his career: a meditation on tragedy, individual will and the refusal to compromise. A woman leaves her unfulfilling marriage and embarks on a search for ideal love—but neither a passionate affair with a younger man nor the return of an old romance can provide the answer she seeks. Always the stylistic innovator, Dreyer employs long takes and theatrical staging to concentrate on Nina Pens Rode’s sublime portrayal of the proud and courageous Gertrud.

hook: 反文化导演哈尔·阿什比凭借独特的美国寓言《哈罗德和莫德》塑造了这部后来成为电影界最受欢迎的喜剧之一。阿什比根据科林·希金斯的剧本改编，讲述了一位来自富裕家庭、痴迷于死亡的年轻人（巴德·科特饰）和一位年长他 60 岁、不顾一切的波西米亚人（露丝·戈登饰）之间的情感和浪漫纽带。 《哈罗德与莫德》既充满幽默，又充满令人着迷的真诚，消除了黑暗与光明之间的界限，以及阶级、性别和年龄之间的界限，并以令人难忘的表演和卡特·史蒂文斯 (Cat Stevens) 的精彩配乐为特色。
hook_en: With the idiosyncratic American fable Harold and Maude, countercultural director Hal Ashby fashioned what would become one of cinema’s most beloved comedies. Working from a script by Colin Higgins, Ashby tells the story of the emotional and romantic bond between a death-obsessed young man from a wealthy family (Bud Cort) and a devil-may-care bohemian sixty years his senior (Ruth Gordon). Equal parts gallows humor and beguiling sincerity, Harold and Maude dissolves the line between darkness and light—along with those that separate people by class, gender, and age—and features indelible performances and a remarkable soundtrack by Cat Stevens.

hook: 约瑟夫·冯·斯滕伯格在《金发维纳斯》中让玛琳·黛德丽重返舞台，这既是一场闪闪发光的奇观，也是一部关于母亲奉献的震撼人心的情节剧。影片以情节形式展开，讲述了海伦（迪特里希饰）的故事，她曾经是一名德国歌手，现在是一名美国家庭主妇，在丈夫（赫伯特马歇尔饰）生病后，她重新开始了她的舞台生涯；然后，她成为百万富翁（加里·格兰特饰）的情妇，从慈爱的烈士变成了耻辱的女人。尽管海斯办公室在制作过程中遇到了困难，但导演的巴洛克视觉风格仍然闪闪发光，所有电影中最令人难忘的音乐剧之一以及冯·斯特恩伯格和迪特里希的长期合作者特拉维斯·班顿设计的一系列富有想象力的服装也是如此。
hook_en: Josef von Sternberg returned Marlene Dietrich to the stage in Blonde Venus, both a glittering spectacle and a sweeping melodrama about motherly devotion. Unfolding episodically, the film tells the story of Helen (Dietrich), once a German chanteuse, now an American housewife, who resurrects her stage career after her husband (Herbert Marshall) falls ill; she then becomes the mistress of a millionaire (Cary Grant), in a slide from loving martyr to dishonored woman. Despite production difficulties courtesy of the Hays Office, the director’s baroque visual style shines, as do one of the most memorable musical numbers in all of cinema and a parade of visionary costumes by von Sternberg and Dietrich’s longtime collaborator Travis Banton.

hook: 斯坦利·库布里克的事业巅峰之作《大开眼戒》以纽约市的梦幻景象展开，医生比尔·哈福德（汤姆·克鲁斯饰）和他的妻子爱丽丝（妮可·基德曼饰）直面威胁他们婚姻的潜意识欲望、嫉妒和恐惧。这部电影讲述了一个超现实的性地下世界的圣诞节冒险之旅，其隐藏的权力结构被暴露得令人恐惧，标志着导演数十年来改编阿瑟·施尼茨勒的中篇小说《梦境故事》的愿望的实现，以及他对机构权威与个人之间关系的痴迷兴趣的顶峰。这部电影于 1999 年上映，也是一个世纪电影的尾声，由最伟大的梦想家之一拍摄——这是一个无尽诱人的迷宫，其中无数的符号、神秘和意义仍在被解开。
hook_en: Stanley Kubrick’s career-capping Eyes Wide Shut unfolds in a dreamscape vision of New York City, where doctor Bill Harford (Tom Cruise) and his wife, Alice (Nicole Kidman), confront the unconscious desires, jealousies, and fears threatening their marriage. A Christmastime odyssey into a surreal sexual underworld whose hidden power structures are laid frighteningly bare, the film marks the fulfillment of the director’s decades-long desire to adapt Arthur Schnitzler’s novella Traumnovelle (Dream Story) and the culmination of his obsessive interest in the relationship between institutional authority and the individual. Released in 1999, the film also serves as a fitting coda to a century of cinema, by one of its greatest visionaries—an endlessly tantalizing labyrinth whose myriad symbols, mysteries, and meanings are still being unraveled.

hook: 影史上最惊心动魄的史诗之一。《七武士》（七人の侍）讲述十六世纪一座村庄，绝望的村民雇来七名武士，抵御来犯的强盗。黑泽明这部三小时有余的旅程，有三船敏郎与志村乔的传奇表演，把哲学与娱乐、细腻人情与凌厉动作织成一则关于勇气与希望、丰饶而难忘的故事。
hook_en: One of the most thrilling movie epics of all time, Seven Samurai (Shichinin no samurai) tells the story of a sixteenth-century village whose desperate inhabitants hire the eponymous warriors to protect them from invading bandits. This three-hour-plus ride from Akira Kurosawa—featuring legendary actors Toshiro Mifune and Takashi Shimura—seamlessly weaves philosophy and entertainment, delicate human emotions and relentless action, into a rich, evocative, and unforgettable tale of courage and hope.

hook: 在成为好莱坞主要演员的几年前，一群年轻的德国电影制片人——包括最终的黑色电影大师罗伯特·西奥德马克和埃德加·G·乌尔默以及未来的奥斯卡奖得主比利·怀尔德和弗雷德·津尼曼——共同制作了千载难逢的合作片《周日的人们》(Menschen am Sonntag)。这部充满活力、阳光明媚、安静的故事讲述了少数城市居民（一群迷人的非专业人士）享受周末郊游的故事，让我们难得一睹魏玛时代的柏林。 《周日人物》是纪录片和虚构故事的独特结合体，它既是一项实验，也是一个主流热门影片，影响了世界各地几代电影艺术家。
hook_en: Years before they became major players in Hollywood, a group of young German filmmakers—including eventual noir masters Robert Siodmak and Edgar G. Ulmer and future Oscar winners Billy Wilder and Fred Zinnemann—worked together on the once-in-a-lifetime collaboration People on Sunday (Menschen am Sonntag). This effervescent, sunlit silent, about a handful of city dwellers (a charming cast of nonprofessionals) enjoying a weekend outing, offers a rare glimpse of Weimar-era Berlin. A unique hybrid of documentary and fictional storytelling, People on Sunday was both an experiment and a mainstream hit that would influence generations of film artists around the world.

hook: 在阿尔贝托·拉图阿达 (Alberto Lattuada) 精彩的黑色喜剧《黑手党》(Mafioso) 中，汽车工厂工头尼诺 (阿尔贝托·索尔迪饰) 带着他现代的妻子 (诺玛·本格尔饰) 和两个金发女儿从工业米兰来到古老的西西里乡村探望家人，并找回自己的根源。但当安东尼奥发现了一些关于他的祖先和他自己的残酷真相时，他得到的比他预想的要多。拉图阿达是第一部坦诚审视黑手党的意大利电影之一，其极其有趣的人物研究既是文化冲突的闹剧，又是存在主义的噩梦。
hook_en: In Alberto Lattuada's brilliant dark comedy Mafioso, auto-factory foreman Nino (Alberto Sordi) takes his proper, modern wife (Norma Bengell) and two blonde daughters from industrial Milan to antiquated, rural Sicily to visit his family and get back in touch with his roots. But Antonio gets more than he bargained for when he discovers some harsh truths about his ancestors—and himself. One of the first Italian films to look frankly at the Mafia, Lattuada's devastatingly funny character study is equal parts culture-clash farce and existential nightmare.

hook: 《银河系》是路易斯·布努埃尔后来宣布的三部曲中的第一部（另外两部是《资产阶级的谨慎魅力》和《自由幻影》），讲述的是“寻找真理”。两名法国乞丐，当今正在前往西班牙圣城圣地亚哥德孔波斯特拉的朝圣者，作为布努埃尔的反教权异端历史的叙述者，讲述了荒谬的内容，充满了布努埃尔最难忘的图像（耻辱的孩子，被钉在十字架上的修女）和搞笑的（耶稣考虑好好刮胡子）。 《银河系》以一种恶魔般的娱乐方式审视了狂热主义的奥秘，仍然是电影界最伟大怀疑论者的一部备受争议的作品。
hook_en: The first of what Luis Buñuel later proclaimed a trilogy (along with The Discreet Charm of the Bourgeoisie and The Phantom of Liberty) about "the search for truth," The Milky Way (La voie lactee) daringly deconstructs contemporary and traditional views on Catholicism with ribald, rambunctious surreality. Two French beggars, present-day pilgrims en route to Spain's holy city of Santiago de Compostela, serve as Buñuel's narrators for an anticlerical history of heresy, told with absurdity and filled with images that rank among Buñuel's most memorable (stigmatic children, crucified nuns) and hilarious (Jesus considering a good shave). A diabolically entertaining look at the mysteries of fanaticism, The Milky Way remains a hotly debated work from cinema's greatest skeptic.

hook: 《狗心》是多媒体艺术家劳里·安德森三十年来的第一部故事片。这部电影是一首电影音诗，源于对死亡和其他形式的缺席的持续冥想，将藏传佛教、轮回、现代监视状态和狗的艺术生活的思想无缝地编织在一起，其核心是对电影制片人心爱的捕鼠梗洛拉贝尔的挽歌。安德森以她特有的诙谐幽默进行旁白，并由电影制片人创作了哀伤、自由的配乐，温柔而挑衅的《狗的心》延续了安德森四年半的职业生涯，让日常生活充满了梦幻般的奇迹感。
hook_en: Heart of a Dog marks the first feature film in thirty years by multimedia artist Laurie Anderson. A cinematic tone poem that flows from a sustained meditation on death and other forms of absence, the film seamlessly weaves together thoughts on Tibetan Buddhism, reincarnation, the modern surveillance state, and the artistic lives of dogs, with an elegy for the filmmaker’s beloved rat terrier, Lolabelle, at its heart. Narrated by Anderson with her characteristic wry wit, and featuring a plaintive, free-form score by the filmmaker, the tender and provocative Heart of a Dog continues Anderson’s four-and-a-half-decade career of imbuing the everyday with a sense of dreamlike wonder.

hook: 1964 年，芝加哥：对于有抱负的诗人普里奇和他最好的朋友科奇斯来说，高中即将结束，他们有各种各样的课外活动：摇摆舞会、深夜兜风，以及对浪漫的跌跌撞撞的追求。当然，当你是美国的一名年轻黑人时，并不能保证你的成长故事不会一帆风顺。导演迈克尔·舒尔茨 (Michael Schultz) 和编剧埃里克·蒙特 (Eric Monte) 借鉴了自己在芝加哥卡布里尼格林 (Cabrini-Green) 住房项目中的成长经历，在《库利高中》 (Cooley High) 中实现了 1970 年代电影中真正独特的东西：以可爱、有趣、温柔和真实的方式描绘了黑人青少年为更光明的未来而奋斗的故事，充满活力的演员阵容将其带入生活，并以摩城经典的天堂般的热门游行为背景。
hook_en: Chicago, 1964: it’s the end of high school for aspiring poet Preach and his best friend, Cochise, and they have a full slate of extracurricular activities: swinging dance parties, late-night joyrides, and the stumbling pursuit of romance. Of course, when you’re a young Black man in America, there’s no guarantee that your coming-of-age story will be free of complications. Director Michael Schultz and screenwriter Eric Monte—who drew on his own experiences growing up in Chicago’s Cabrini-Green housing project—arrived at something truly unique in 1970s cinema with Cooley High: an endearingly funny, tender, and authentic portrait of Black teens striving toward a brighter future, brought to life by a dynamic ensemble cast and set to a heavenly hit parade of Motown classics.

hook: 萨蒂亚吉特·雷 (Satyajit Ray) 的精彩故事讲述了一个女人对艺术和浪漫的向往，故事发生在 19 世纪末独立前的印度，在一位思想开明、工作狂的报纸编辑和他孤独的妻子查鲁拉塔 (马达哈比·穆克吉饰) 的温馨家里。当她丈夫的诗人表弟（苏米特拉·查特吉饰）来和他们住在一起时，查鲁拉塔发现自己既充满创造力，又被他危险地吸引着。 《查鲁拉塔》改编自伟大的罗宾德拉纳特·泰戈尔的中篇小说，是一部结构微妙的作品，讲述了一个关于处于危险之中的婚姻和一个女人迈出建立自己的声音的第一步的精致故事。
hook_en: Satyajit Ray’s exquisite story of a woman’s artistic and romantic yearning takes place in late nineteenth-century, pre-independence India, in the gracious home of a liberal-minded, workaholic newspaper editor and his lonely wife, Charulata (Madhabi Mukherjee). When her husband’s poet cousin (Soumitra Chatterjee) comes to stay with them, Charulata finds herself both creatively inspired and dangerously drawn to him. Based on a novella by the great Rabindranath Tagore, Charulata is a work of subtle textures, a delicate tale of a marriage in jeopardy and a woman taking the first steps toward establishing her own voice.

hook: 这部 existential 犯罪惊悚片中，法国电影传奇 Bertrand Tavernier 将吉米·汤普森的硬汉小说《Pop. 1280》改编成一部黑暗幽默、充满哲思的关于殖民主义残酷与荒谬的探索。将故事背景从美国南部转移到1930年代的法属西非，电影《Coup de torchon》中，菲利普·诺伊雷饰演的一位警察局长令人毛骨悚然地表现出色，他看似无能的行为背后隐藏着对复仇和控制的冷酷追求，这将他的势利情妇（一位火爆的伊莎贝尔·于佩尔）卷入了暴力升级的漩涡中。随着每一次 chilling 的揭露，Tavernier 将我们带入一个疯狂与腐败的深渊，揭示帝国衰朽的灵魂。
hook_en: With this existential crime thriller, legend of French cinema Bertrand Tavernier transforms Jim Thompson’s hard-boiled novel Pop. 1280 into a darkly comic, philosophically provocative exploration of the brutality and absurdity of colonialism. Moving the story’s setting from the American South to 1930s French West Africa, Coup de torchon features a frighteningly enigmatic performance from Philippe Noiret as a police chief whose seeming ineptitude masks a cold-blooded pursuit of revenge and control that draws his opportunistic mistress (a ﬁery Isabelle Huppert) into an escalating spiral of violence. With each chilling revelation, Tavernier plunges us ever deeper into an abyss of madness and corruption, laying bare the decaying soul of empire.

hook: 《近松的故事》（又名《被钉在十字架上的恋人》）是沟口健二在 20 世纪 50 年代上半叶创作的一系列职业生涯后期杰作之一，讲述了在迫害面前挣扎求生的禁忌之爱的精致感人故事。该片改编自十八世纪日本经典戏剧，讲述了一位京都卷轴制造商的妻子和他的学徒在各自被不公正地指控有不当行为后所遭受的不公正待遇。命运将他们束缚在一段不正当的、不幸的爱情中，他们开始逃亡，以寻求庇护，以逃避给他们规定的惩罚：死亡。这部由电影摄影师大师宫川和夫以华丽的绘画风格拍摄的影片，细腻地表达了对社会压迫的控诉，黑泽明将其誉为“只有沟口才能制作的伟大杰作”。 《近松的故事》由纽约 Cineric, Inc. 的角川公司和电影基金会修复，声音由 Audio Mechanics 提供，并与日本基金会合作。特别感谢宫岛正宏和马丁·斯科塞斯的咨询。
hook_en: One of a string of late-career masterworks made by Kenji Mizoguchi in the first half of the 1950s, A Story from Chikamatsu (a.k.a. The Crucified Lovers) is an exquisitely moving tale of forbidden love struggling to survive in the face of persecution. Based on a classic of eighteenth-century Japanese drama, the film traces the injustices that befall a Kyoto scroll maker’s wife and his apprentice after each is unfairly accused of wrongdoing. Bound by fate in an illicit, star-crossed romance, they go on the run in search of refuge from the punishment prescribed them: death. Shot in gorgeous, painterly style by master cinematographer Kazuo Miyagawa, this delicately delivered indictment of societal oppression was heralded by Akira Kurosawa as a “great masterpiece that could only have been made by Mizoguchi.” A Story from Chikamatsu was restored by Kadokawa Corporation and The Film Foundation at Cineric, Inc., in New York, with sound by Audio Mechanics and the cooperation of The Japan Foundation. Special thanks to Masahiro Miyajima and Martin Scorsese for their consultation.

hook: 导演萨蒂亚吉特·雷 (Satyajit Ray) 最伟大的成就之一始于一部兄弟喜剧看似轻松的优雅，但却让位于更黑暗的道德阴影。为了逃离城市的周末，四个来自加尔各答的朋友驾车前往乡村，在那里他们的城市权利和偏见逐渐暴露出来。在这些年轻的单身汉中，过度自信的阿希姆（苏米特拉·查特吉饰）发现自己的自信被阿帕娜（光芒四射的莎米拉·泰戈尔饰）动摇了，阿帕娜是一位神秘的年轻女子，她冷静的才智掩盖了动荡的情感深度。 《森林中的日日夜夜》在印度帕拉穆地区阳光斑驳的林地中明亮地拍摄，以优雅的复杂性解构了男性的自我和印度令人担忧的阶级划分。
hook_en: One of director Satyajit Ray’s greatest achievements begins with the deceptively easy grace of a buddy comedy—only to give way to darker moral shading. Seeking a weekend escape from the city, four friends from Kolkata embark on a driving trip to the countryside, where their urban entitlement and prejudices are gradually exposed. Among these young bachelors is the overconfident Ashim (Soumitra Chatterjee), who finds his self-assurance shaken by Aparna (the radiant Sharmila Tagore), an enigmatic young woman whose cool intellect conceals turbulent emotional depths. Filmed luminously amid the sun-dappled splendor of the woodlands of India’s Palamu region, Days and Nights in the Forest deconstructs the masculine ego and India’s fraught class divisions with elegant complexity.

hook: 《未来》是编剧 H. G. 威尔斯、制片人亚历山大·科达以及设计师兼导演威廉·卡梅伦·孟席斯之间具有里程碑意义的合作，是一部与众不同的科幻电影，也是一部有先见之明的政治作品，预言了一个世纪的动荡和进步。穿越时空，未来之事见证了世界大战、疾病、独裁，以及最后的乌托邦。这部巨额预算作品由威尔斯亲自构思、编剧和监制，是科达伦敦电影公司有史以来最雄心勃勃的作品，是想象力和技术大胆的胜利。
hook_en: A landmark collaboration between writer H. G. Wells, producer Alexander Korda, and designer and director William Cameron Menzies, Things to Come is a science fiction film like no other, a prescient political work that predicts a century of turmoil and progress. Skipping through time, Things to Come bears witness to world war, disease, dictatorship, and, finally, utopia. Conceived, written, and overseen by Wells himself as an adaptation of his own work, this megabudget production, the most ambitious ever from Korda’s London Films, is a triumph of imagination and technical audacity.

hook: 这部对乔治·奥威尔关于极权主义压迫的令人毛骨悚然的寓言的巧妙改编，为书中预言的反乌托邦提供了令人痛苦的电影表达。在一个废墟遍地的监视国家里，无休止的海外战争支撑着无所不知的老大哥的镇压政权，所有异议都被迅速镇压，一个极度疏远的公民温斯顿·史密斯（约翰·赫特饰）冒着一切风险与叛逆的朱莉娅（苏珊娜·汉密尔顿饰）发生不正当关系，面对令人心碎的顺从，公然维护自己的人性。迈克尔·雷德福的《1984》通过罗杰·迪金斯生动、冷酷的制作设计和表现主义的去饱和摄影，让人联想到战后英国作为法西斯噩梦的惨淡景象——一个与我们自己的世界太相似的世界。
hook_en: This masterly adaptation of George Orwell’s chilling parable about totalitarian oppression gives harrowing cinematic expression to the book’s prophetic dystopia. In a rubble-strewn surveillance state where an endless overseas war props up the repressive regime of the all-seeing Big Brother, and all dissent is promptly squashed, a profoundly alienated citizen, Winston Smith (thrillingly played by John Hurt), risks everything for an illicit affair with the rebellious Julia (Suzanna Hamilton), defiantly asserting his humanity in the face of soul-crushing conformity. Through vividly grim production design and expressionistically desaturated cinematography by Roger Deakins, Michael Radford’s 1984 conjures a bleak vision of postwar Britain as fascistic nightmare—a world all too recognizable as our own.

hook: 《洛拉·蒙特斯》是一部视觉上令人着迷、叙事上大胆的戏剧，讲述了由马丁·卡罗尔饰演的臭名昭著的交际花和歌舞女郎的生活。马克斯·奥菲尔斯以其一贯的电影风格和首次鲜明的色彩，通过对蒙特斯最终表演的美国马戏团夸夸其谈的马戏团领班（彼得·乌斯蒂诺夫饰）的召唤，描绘了蒙特斯丑闻的过去。奥菲尔斯的最后一部电影《洛拉·蒙特斯》既是一部宏伟的浪漫情节剧，也是对名人可怕迷恋的沉思，也是一场独一无二的电影奇观。
hook_en: Lola Montès is a visually ravishing, narratively daring dramatization of the life of the notorious courtesan and showgirl, played by Martine Carol. With his customary cinematographic flourish and, for the first time, vibrant color, Max Ophuls charts the course of Montès’s scandalous past through the invocations of the bombastic ringmaster (Peter Ustinov) of the American circus where she has ended up performing. Ophuls’s final film, Lola Montès is at once a magnificent romantic melodrama, a meditation on the lurid fascination with celebrity, and a one-of-a-kind movie spectacle.

hook: 姐弟被遗弃在严酷的澳大利亚内陆，必须在失去日常舒适后学会与自然共处。尼古拉斯·罗伊格这部催眠杰作里，他们遇见一位正在“徒步成人礼”的原住民少年——男孩独自走进荒野，完成成年仪式。《流浪者》既是惊险冒险，也是对时间与文明的挑衅沉思。
hook_en: A young sister and brother are abandoned in the harsh Australian outback and must learn to cope in the natural world, without their usual comforts, in this hypnotic masterpiece from Nicolas Roeg. Along the way, they meet an Aboriginal youth on his walkabout, a rite of passage in which adolescent boys are initiated into manhood by journeying into the wilderness alone. Walkabout is a thrilling adventure as well as a provocative rumination on time and civilization.

hook: 黑泽清引人注目的国际突破使他成为日本恐怖新浪潮的领导者之一，同时将这一类型推向哲学和存在主义探索的未知领域。一系列令人震惊、看似毫无动机的谋杀案——每起谋杀案都是由不同的人犯下的，但都带有相同的可怕特征——导致高部侦探（役所广司饰）进行了一场迷宫般的调查，以找出他们之间的联系，并与一个可能是邪恶化身的神秘失忆症患者（萩原正人饰）展开了一场令人不安的猫捉老鼠游戏。 《治愈》充满了安静、催眠般的恐惧，是一部心理紧张的杰作，也是一次进入人类心灵最黑暗深处的幻觉之旅。
hook_en: Kiyoshi Kurosawa’s arresting international breakthrough established him as one of the leaders of an emerging new wave of Japanese horror while pushing the genre into uncharted realms of philosophical and existential exploration. A string of shocking, seemingly unmotivated murders—each committed by a different person yet all bearing the same grisly hallmarks—leads Detective Takabe (Koji Yakusho) into a labyrinthine investigation to discover what connects them, and into a disturbing game of cat and mouse with an enigmatic amnesiac (Masato Hagiwara) who may be evil incarnate. Awash in hushed, hypnotic dread, Cure is a tour de force of psychological tension and a hallucinatory journey into the darkest recesses of the human mind.

hook: 这部邪恶的改编自奥克塔夫·米尔博小说的作品是路易斯·布努埃尔的经典之作。让娜·莫罗 (Jeanne Moreau) 饰演塞莱斯廷 (Celestine)，一位美丽的巴黎家庭佣人，刚到 20 世纪 30 年代法国外省的一处庄园开始新工作，就陷入了与她的花心雇主（布努埃尔常客米歇尔·皮科利 Michel Piccoli 饰）的性虚伪和丑闻之中。 《女仆日记》以豪华的黑白弗朗斯科胶片拍摄，是拜物教和谋杀的尖锐纠葛，也是对那个时代蓬勃发展的法国法西斯主义的严厉审视。
hook_en: This wicked adaptation of the Octave Mirbeau novel is classic Luis Buñuel. Jeanne Moreau is Celestine, a beautiful Parisian domestic who, upon arrival at her new job at an estate in provincial 1930s France, entrenches herself in sexual hypocrisy and scandal with her philandering employer (Buñuel regular Michel Piccoli). Filmed in luxurious black-and-white Franscope, Diary of a Chambermaid is a raw-edged tangle of fetishism and murder—and a scathing look at the burgeoning French fascism of the era.

hook: 《沙漠的西蒙》是路易斯·布努埃尔对虔诚的苦行僧圣西蒙·斯蒂利特 (Saint Simeon Stylites) 的生活的邪恶而狂野的诠释，他在一根被荒芜的土地包围的柱子上等待了六年零六个月零六天，以证明他对上帝的忠诚。然而，魔鬼以美丽的西尔维娅·皮纳尔的形象，蜷缩在下面，试图引诱他下来。布努埃尔的短小而甜蜜的讽刺作品是对人类信念的怀疑论者的看法，是这位电影大师最著名的超现实主义作品之一。
hook_en: Simon of the Desert is Luis Buñuel’s wicked and wild take on the life of devoted ascetic Saint Simeon Stylites, who waited atop a pillar surrounded by a barren landscape for six years, six months, and six days, in order to prove his devotion to God. Yet the devil, in the figure of the beautiful Silvia Pinal, huddles below, trying to tempt him down. A skeptic’s vision of human conviction, Buñuel’s short and sweet satire is one of the master filmmaker’s most renowned works of surrealism.

hook: 如果你只能选择一种记忆来永远保留，你会选择什么？这是是枝裕和这部具有启示意义的国际突破的核心问题，这是一部苦乐参半的幻想曲，其中刚去世的人发现自己处于一个地狱般的境界，他们必须从生命中选择一个珍贵的时刻，在电影中重现，以便他们进入下一个世界。 《After Life》的高概念前提是植根于是枝裕和通过对数百名日本公民的采访而形成的纪录片式的材料处理方式。随之而来的是对人类经历的全景视野——短暂的欢乐和挥之不去的遗憾——以及对记忆、我们的相互联系以及电影冻结时间的琥珀般力量的安静而深刻的冥想。
hook_en: If you could choose only one memory to hold on to for eternity, what would it be? That’s the question at the heart of Hirokazu Kore-eda’s revelatory international breakthrough, a bittersweet fantasia in which the recently deceased find themselves in a limbo realm where they must select a single cherished moment from their life to be recreated on film for them to take into the next world. After Life’s high-concept premise is grounded in Kore‑eda’s documentary-like approach to the material, which he shaped through interviews with hundreds of Japanese citizens. What emerges is a panoramic vision of the human experience—its ephemeral joys and lingering regrets—and a quietly profound meditation on memory, our interconnectedness, and the amberlike power of cinema to freeze time.

hook: 在 20 世纪 70 年代初的性革命和社会动荡中，著名导演迈克·尼科尔斯 (Mike Nichols) 对美国风俗进行了一次具有时代精神定义的审视。这部尖刻的戏剧由朱尔斯·费弗 (Jules Feiffer) 撰写，讲述了两个大学好友（杰克·尼科尔森 (Jack Nicholson) 和阿特·加芬克尔 (Art Garfunkel) 饰）二十多年的生活，他们随意的沙文主义充满乐趣和游戏，直到事实并非如此。坎迪斯·伯根、安·玛格丽特、丽塔·莫雷诺、卡罗尔·凯恩和辛西娅·奥尼尔作为遭受苦难并看穿朋友们不安全姿态的女性，组成了一个非凡的团队，赋予了这部电影灵魂。 《肉欲知识》饱受争议，卷入了一起淫秽案件，并一路上诉至最高法院，但它对战后男性气概的坦率直视令人不安，仍然令人震惊。
hook_en: Amid the sexual revolution and social upheaval of the early 1970s, acclaimed director Mike Nichols delivered a zeitgeist-defining examination of American mores. Sharply written by Jules Feiffer, this acerbic drama flashes through more than twenty years in the lives of two college buddies (Jack Nicholson and Art Garfunkel) whose casual chauvinism is all fun and games—until it’s not. As the women who suffer and see through the friends’ insecure posturing, Candice Bergen, Ann-Margret, Rita Moreno, Carol Kane, and Cynthia O’Neal form an extraordinary ensemble that gives the film its soul. So controversial it became embroiled in an obscenity case that went all the way to the Supreme Court, Carnal Knowledge remains startling for its unnervingly frank look at postwar masculinity.

hook: 泽纳布·艾琳·戴维斯 (Zeinabu irene Davis) 的影片生动地描绘了聋哑非裔美国人以及二十世纪两端爱情的复杂性，是一个关于包容性和可见性的开创性故事。在双重表演中，米歇尔·A·班克斯和约翰·厄尔·杰尔克斯分别扮演 1910 年代芝加哥的一位受过教育的裁缝和一位文盲移民，以及八年后生活在同一座城市的一位坚韧的图形艺术家和一位可爱的图书管理员。戴维斯运用档案摄影、融合拉格泰姆和非洲打击乐的原创乐谱以及抒情剪辑，巧妙地将这两对夫妇的故事以温柔和悲剧的方式交织在一起。补偿是美国独立电影的一个里程碑，它直面阻碍爱情的社会力量和偏见。
hook_en: A poignant portrait of Deaf African Americans and the complexities of love at both ends of the twentieth century, Zeinabu irene Davis’s film is a groundbreaking story of inclusion and visibility. In dual performances, Michelle A. Banks and John Earl Jelks play an educated dressmaker and an illiterate migrant in 1910s Chicago, and a resilient graphic artist and an endearing librarian living in the same city eight decades later. Employing archival photography, an original score blending ragtime and African percussion, and lyrical editing, Davis deftly intertwines the two couple’s stories, in ways both tender and tragic. Compensation is a landmark of American independent cinema that confronts the social forces and prejudices that hinder love.

hook: 1974 年，巴贝特·施罗德前往乌干达拍摄一部关于该国残酷、魅力十足的独裁者伊迪·阿明的电影。阿明的残暴政权造成了数十万乌干达人的死亡，三年后，阿明为电影制片人准备了胜利的问候，举办集会、军事演习和欢快的民族自豪感展示，并将这部电影设想为官方肖像，以装饰他的个人崇拜。然而，施罗德却有其他想法，他提出了一份针对阿明的令人不安、尖刻有趣的简报，其中独裁者自己源源不断的证词——时而迷人、时而险恶、时而荒谬——成为最具有说服力的证据。 《伊迪·阿明·达达将军：一幅自画像》是主题与电影制片人之间具有启发性的拉锯战，是纪录片艺术的里程碑，也是对权力自私主义的令人震惊的研究。
hook_en: In 1974, Barbet Schroeder went to Uganda to make a film about Idi Amin, the country’s ruthless, charismatic dictator. Three years into a murderous regime that would be responsible for the deaths of hundreds of thousands of Ugandans, Amin prepared a triumphal greeting for the filmmakers, staging rallies, military maneuvers, and cheery displays of national pride, and envisioning the film as an official portrait to adorn his cult of personality. Schroeder, however, had other ideas, emerging with a disquieting, caustically funny brief against Amin, in which the dictator’s own endless stream of testimony—by turns charming, menacing, and nonsensical—serves as the most damning evidence. A revelatory tug-of-war between subject and filmmaker, General Idi Amin Dada: A Self-Portrait is a landmark in the art of documentary and an appalling study of egotism in power.

hook: 1971年，作家兼电影学者唐纳德·里奇发表了一篇关于他探索日本内海岛屿的诗意游记，记录了他对传统生活方式痕迹的追寻以及自我发现的旅程。二十年后，电影制片人露西尔·卡拉 (Lucille Carra) 受到里奇当时的经典著作的启发，进行了一次平行旅行，捕捉了静谧之美的图像，并会见了那些仍然保留着里奇所观察到的逐渐衰落习俗的人们。 《内海》穿插着令人惊讶的绕道——拜访一位热爱弗兰克·辛纳屈的僧侣、一个麻风病人聚居地、一座由胶合板和石膏建造的人造寺庙——并由里奇的旁白和著名作曲家武满彻的配乐交织在一起，《内海》是一次令人大开眼界的航行，也是对作为一个外国人意味着什么的深刻思考。
hook_en: In 1971, author and film scholar Donald Richie published a poetic travelogue about his explorations of the islands of Japan’s Inland Sea, recording his search for traces of a traditional way of life as well as his own journey of self-discovery. Twenty years later, filmmaker Lucille Carra undertook a parallel trip inspired by Richie’s by-then-classic book, capturing images of hushed beauty and meeting people who still carried on the fading customs that Richie had observed. Interspersed with surprising detours—visits to a Frank Sinatra–loving monk, a leper colony, an ersatz temple of plywood and plaster—and woven together by Richie’s narration as well as a score by celebrated composer Toru Takemitsu, The Inland Sea is an eye-opening voyage and a profound meditation on what it means to be a foreigner.

hook: 在这次特里·吉列姆（ Terry Gilliam ）穿越时空的奇妙之旅中，一个名叫凯文（ Kevin ）的男孩（克雷格·沃诺克（ Craig Warnock ） ）逃离了他痴迷于小工具的父母，加入了一群时间旅行者。他们手持从至高者（拉尔夫·理查森）那里偷来的地图，从拿破仑（伊恩·霍尔姆）和阿伽门农（肖恩·康纳利）那里掠夺宝藏，但邪恶的天才（大卫·华纳）正在监视他们的一举一动。以Gilliam和他的Monty Python coho的黑暗俏皮剧本为特色…
hook_en: In this fantastic voyage through time and space from Terry Gilliam, a boy named Kevin (Craig Warnock) escapes his gadget-obsessed parents to join a band of time travelers. Armed with a map stolen from the Supreme Being (Ralph Richardson), they plunder treasure from Napoleon (Ian Holm) and Agamemnon (Sean Connery)—but the Evil Genius (David Warner) is watching their every move. Featuring a darkly playful script by Gilliam and his Monty Python cohort Michael Palin (who also appears in the film), Time Bandits is at once a giddy fairy tale, a revisionist history lesson, and a satire of technology gone awry.

hook: 莉齐·博登（Lizzie Borden）的爆炸性后朋克挑衅发出了响亮、清晰、毫无歉意的酷儿般的激昂战斗口号，这是一部以美国革命十年后女性叛逆的 DIY 幻想曲，这场革命据称将美国转变为社会民主乌托邦。事实上，种族主义、性别歧视和经济不平等一如既往地严重，以黑人、女同性恋和工人阶级女性为首的一群激进分子联手反击。 《生于火焰》通过电视新闻广播、盗版电台广播、宣传鼓动和纽约街头游击式的抗议活动等一系列激烈断裂、动态剪辑的故事讲述了女权主义未来主义的冲击波，它既是那个时代的重要文献，又远远领先于它。
hook_en: A blistering rallying cry issued loud, clear, and unapologetically queer, Lizzie Borden’s explosive postpunk provocation is a DIY fantasia of female rebellion set in America ten years after a revolution that supposedly transformed the country into a social-democratic utopia. In reality, racism, sexism, and economic inequality are as virulent as ever, and a band of radicals—led by Black, lesbian, and working-class women—join forces to fight back. Told through a furiously fractured, kinetically edited flurry of television news broadcasts, pirate radio transmissions, agitprop, and protests shot guerrilla-style on the streets of New York City, Born in Flames is a shock wave of feminist futurism that’s both an essential document of its time and radically ahead of it.

hook: 迈克·李的这部令人振奋的电影是他第一次引起国际轰动。这部电影时而忧郁，时而有趣，是对伦敦北部郊区一个工人阶级家庭的亲密写照——一位难以抑制的父母（艾莉森·斯特德曼和吉姆·布劳德本特饰）和他们昼夜不停的双胞胎，一个书生气十足的好女孩和一个麻烦不断、脾气暴躁的懒人（克莱尔·斯金纳和简·霍洛克斯饰）。费利和他典型的才华横溢的演员阵容，以非凡的敏感度和技巧，创造了一个关于平凡生活的生动、鲜活的故事，在这个故事中，即使是不起眼的梦想——比如父亲想要开一辆餐车的愿望——也承载着巨大的分量。
hook_en: This invigorating film from Mike Leigh was his first international sensation. Melancholy and funny by turns, it is an intimate portrait of a working-class family in a suburb just north of London—an irrepressible mum and dad (Alison Steadman and Jim Broadbent) and their night-and-day twins, a bookish good girl and a troubled, ill-tempered layabout (Claire Skinner and Jane Horrocks). Leigh and his typically brilliant cast create, with extraordinary sensitivity and craft, a vivid, lived-in story of ordinary existence, in which even modest dreams—such as the father’s desire to open a food truck—carry enormous weight.

hook: 《女人爬上楼梯时》可能是日本电影制作人成濑干雄最精彩的时刻——对一位女性惠子（由高峰秀子饰演，令人心碎）的细致而毁灭性的研究。惠子在东京战后非常现代化的银座区担任酒吧女招待，下班后招待商人。狡猾、足智多谋，但陷入困境的惠子体现了一名女性在男性主导的社会中试图建立独立的冲突和斗争。 《当一个女人登上楼梯时》展示了基本上不被歌颂但广受爱戴的成濑大师最严格的社交要求和最深沉的情感。
hook_en: When a Woman Ascends the Stairs might be Japanese filmmaker Mikio Naruse's finest hour—a delicate, devastating study of a woman, Keiko (played heartbreakingly by Hideko Takamine), who works as a bar hostess in Tokyo's very modern postwar Ginza district, who entertains businessmen after work. Sly, resourceful, but trapped, Keiko comes to embody the conflicts and struggles of a woman trying to establish her independence in a male-dominated society. When a Woman Ascends the Stairs shows the largely unsung yet widely beloved master Naruse at his most socially exacting and profoundly emotional.

hook: “诗人……不仅 Shed 了他们心中红血，也 Shed 了他们灵魂中的白血，”让·科克托 Jean Cocteau 如是宣称，关于他开创性的首部电影——一部探讨艺术家困境、比喻的力量以及艺术与梦境之间关系的探索。这是电影史上的伟大实验之一，这部 Orphic 三部曲的第一部努力将媒介推向极限，以捕捉诗人对生命与死亡之间斗争的痴迷。Criterion 为《诗人之血》（Le sang d’un poète）感到自豪。
hook_en: “Poets . . . shed not only the red blood of their hearts but the white blood of their souls,” proclaimed Jean Cocteau of his groundbreaking first film—an exploration of the plight of the artist, the power of metaphor and the relationship between art and dreams. One of cinema’s great experiments, this first installment of the Orphic Trilogy stretches the medium to its limits in an effort to capture the poet’s obsession with the struggle between the forces of life and death. Criterion is proud to present The Blood of a Poet (Le sang d’un poète).

hook: 在最后一部作品中，传奇作家/艺术家/导演让·科克托描绘了一位18世纪的诗人穿越时空，追寻神圣智慧的故事。在一片神秘荒野中，他遇到了几个象征性的幽灵，这些幽灵带来了他的死亡与复活。 eclectic cast包括了画家毕加索、让-皮埃尔·莱奥达、让·马拉塞尔和杰伊·布莱恩特，让·科克托的《奥菲斯的遗嘱》（Le Testament de Orphée）将他从《诗人之血》（Le Sang d'un Poète）中开始的旅程圆满结束，这部电影探索了艺术家与其创作之间的痛苦关系。
hook_en: In his last film, legendary writer/artist/filmmaker Jean Cocteau portrays an 18th-century poet who travels through time on a quest for divine wisdom. In a mysterious wasteland, he meets several symbolic phantoms that bring about his death and resurrection. With an eclectic cast that includes Pablo Picasso, Jean-Pierre Leáud, Jean Marais and Yul Brynner, Testament of Orpheus (Le Testament de Orphée) brings full circle the journey Cocteau began in The Blood of a Poet, an exploration of the torturous relationship between the artist and his creations.

hook: 加泰罗尼亚建筑师安东尼·高迪（1852-1926 年）设计了一些世界上最令人惊叹的建筑、室内设计和公园；日本导演敕志原宏创作了一些有史以来在美学上最大胆的电影。在安东尼奥·高迪的作品中，他们的艺术融入了独特、迷人的电影体验。与其说是一部纪录片，不如说是一部视觉诗，弟子原的电影带领观众参观了高迪真正壮观的建筑，包括他尚未完成的巨大杰作——巴塞罗那的圣家堂。弟子河原凭借与拍摄对象有机结构的曲线一样大胆而感性的摄影作品，使高迪在电影中永垂不朽。
hook_en: Catalan architect Antoni Gaudí (1852–1926) designed some of the world’s most astonishing buildings, interiors, and parks; Japanese director Hiroshi Teshigahara constructed some of the most aesthetically audacious films ever made. In Antonio Gaudí, their artistry melds in a unique, enthralling cinematic experience. Less a documentary than a visual poem, Teshigahara’s film takes viewers on a tour of Gaudí’s truly spectacular architecture, including his massive, still-unfinished master­piece, the Sagrada Família basilica in Barcelona. With camera work as bold and sensual as the curves of his subject’s organic structures, Teshigahara immortalizes Gaudí on film.

hook: 作为有史以来最受欢迎的美国电影之一，《毕业生》为迈克·尼科尔斯赢得了奥斯卡最佳导演奖，将西蒙和加芬克尔的音乐带给了更广泛的观众，并向世界介绍了一位名叫达斯汀·霍夫曼的年轻演员。本杰明·布拉多克（霍夫曼饰）刚刚大学毕业，当他与父母的朋友、不屈不挠的罗宾逊夫人（安妮·班克罗夫特饰）发生性关系时，他已经陷入了一片混乱和几乎无法抑制的焦虑之中，然后他将注意力转向了她上大学的女儿（凯瑟琳·罗斯饰）。 《毕业生》视觉上富有想象力，表演无可挑剔，加上巴克·亨利的巧妙且不断被引用的剧本（根据查尔斯·韦伯的小说改编），产生了一代人仅此一次的文化影响。
hook_en: One of the most beloved American films of all time, The Graduate earned Mike Nichols a best director Oscar, brought the music of Simon & Garfunkel to a wider audience, and introduced the world to a young actor named Dustin Hoffman. Benjamin Braddock (Hoffman) has just finished college and is already lost in a sea of confusion and barely contained angst when he becomes sexually involved with a friend of his parents’, the indomitable Mrs. Robinson (Anne Bancroft), before turning his attention to her college-age daughter (Katharine Ross). Visually imaginative and impeccably acted, with a clever, endlessly quotable script by Buck Henry (based on the novel by Charles Webb), The Graduate had the kind of cultural impact that comes along only once in a generation.

hook: 这部由克里斯蒂安·蒙吉 (Cristian Mungiu) 执导的戛纳获奖剧情片将严格的自然主义与惊悚片的精确结构融为一体，揭示了当代罗马尼亚生活的高风险和道德复杂性。女儿即将高中毕业，正直的医生罗密欧（阿德里安·蒂蒂尼饰）指望她能获得有竞争力的奖学金，送她去英国上大学。但当罗密欧因性侵犯而受伤，影响了她在一次重要考试中的表现时，罗密欧为她精心制定的计划面临着崩溃的危险，导致他在一个充斥着互不相让和贿赂的世界中寻求帮助。 《毕业》充满了无声的恐惧，以人道且极其模糊的方式审视猖獗的腐败对道德信念的腐蚀程度。
hook_en: Blending rigorous naturalism with the precise construction of a thriller, this Cannes award–winning drama from Cristian Mungiu sheds light on the high stakes and ethical complexities of life in contemporary Romania. As his daughter nears high-school graduation, Romeo (Adrian Titieni), an upstanding doctor, counts on her securing a competitive scholarship that will send her to university in England. But when an injury sustained during a sexual assault compromises her performance on an important exam, Romeo’s best-laid plans for her threaten to crumble, leading him to seek favors in a world that runs on back-scratching and bribery. Suffused with quiet dread, Graduation takes a humane and deeply ambiguous look at how corrosive rampant corruption is to moral convictions.

hook: 这部令人振奋的剧情片由著名电影制片人肯·洛奇 (Ken Loach) 创作，是对当代英国政治现实的紧急回应，通过一位谦逊的工人阶级英雄的视角，认真审视官僚主义的不公正和无能。丧偶木匠丹尼尔·布莱克（戴夫·琼斯饰）因心脏病发作而无法保住工作，他开始了一段漫长而孤独的旅程，穿越当地福利国家的卡夫卡式迷宫。一路上，他与一位单亲母亲（海莉·斯奎尔斯饰）和她的两个孩子建立了友谊，在被逐出家门后，她们受到同一个制度的摆布。荣获金棕榈奖的《我，丹尼尔·布莱克》充满了温和的幽默和平静的愤怒，旨在最大程度地产生现实世界的影响，证明了洛奇对社会参与电影的不懈承诺。
hook_en: An urgent response to the political realities of con­­tem­porary Britain, this bracing drama from celebrated filmmaker Ken Loach takes a hard look at bureaucratic injustice and ineptitude through the eyes of an unassuming working-class hero. After a heart attack leaves him unable to hold a job, the widowed carpenter Daniel Blake (Dave Johns) begins a long, lonely journey through the Kafkaesque labyrinth of the local welfare state. Along the way, he strikes up a friendship with a single mother (Hayley Squires) and her two children, at the mercy of the same system after being evicted from their home. Imbued with gentle humor and quiet rage and conceived for maximum real-world impact, the Palme d’Or–winning I, Daniel Blake is a testament to Loach’s tireless commitment to a cinema of social engagement.

hook: 当一艘核动力潜艇“虎鲨”号出发调查北极圈附近的一系列神秘失踪事件时，勇敢的船员发现自己被雷暴、不明浮碟和大量毛茸茸的触手围困。
hook_en: When a nuclear-powered submarine, the Tiger Shark, sets out to investigate a series of mysterious disappearances near the Arctic Circle, its fearless crew finds itself besieged by electrical storms, an Unidentified Floating Saucer, and lots of hairy tentacles.

hook: 在成为九十年代美国电影中最独特的声音之一之前，艾莉森·安德斯 (Allison Anders) 与联合导演和加州大学洛杉矶分校电影学院的学生库尔特·沃斯 (Kurt Voss) 和迪恩·伦特 (Dean Lent) 一起在 1987 年的边境电台 (Border Radio) 首次亮相。 《Border Radio》是一部低调、半即兴创作的后朋克日记，历时四年完成，讲述了食肉者乐队的传奇摇滚歌手克里斯·D. (Chris D.) 饰演一名歌手兼词曲作者，他从俱乐部偷了赃物后失踪，留下他的妻子 (卢安娜·安德斯饰)，一位严肃的摇滚记者，在朋友 (X 乐队的约翰·多伊；克里斯·希勒饰) 的帮助下追踪他。 《Border Radio》以令人回味的 16 毫米黑白镜头捕捉到广阔的南加州和墨西哥风景，成为美国独立电影爆炸式增长的独特 DIY 纪念品。
hook_en: Before carving out a niche as one of the most distinct voices in nineties American cinema, Allison Anders made her debut, alongside codirectors and fellow UCLA film school students Kurt Voss and Dean Lent, with 1987’s Border Radio. A low-key, semi-improvised postpunk diary that took four years to complete, Border Radio features legendary rocker Chris D., of the Flesh Eaters, as a singer/songwriter who has stolen loot from a club and gone missing, leaving his wife (Luanna Anders), a no-nonsense rock journalist, to track him down with the help of his friends (John Doe of the band X; Chris Shearer). With its sprawling Southern Californian and Mexican landscapes, captured in evocative 16mm black and white, Border Radio is a singular, DIY memento of the indie film explosion in America.

hook: 这部颠覆流派的恐怖音乐混搭片是波兰导演阿格涅斯卡·斯莫琴斯卡 (Agnieszka Smoczyńska) 的大胆处女作，讲述了一对食肉美人鱼姐妹被拖上岸，探索 20 世纪 80 年代波兰陆地生活的故事。他们诱人的海妖歌声和超凡脱俗的光环让他们在斯莫琴斯卡想象的半华丽、半破旧的世界中成为夜总会歌手，一夜之间轰动一时。导演对汉斯·克里斯蒂安·安徒生的《小美人鱼》中的本能感性和黑暗女权主义进行了猛烈的诠释，其中一位姐妹爱上人类后，女孩们的关系受到考验，她们的生存受到威胁。 《The Lure》是一部青春童话，有朗朗上口的合成音乐、令人震惊的歌舞和奢华肮脏的布景，探索了新兴女性性欲、剥削以及成年期与野蛮能量和原创性的妥协等主题。
hook_en: This genre-defying horror-musical mash-up—the bold debut of Polish director Agnieszka Smoczyńska—follows a pair of carnivorous mermaid sisters drawn ashore to explore life on land in an alternate 1980s Poland. Their tantalizing siren songs and otherworldly auras make them overnight sensations as nightclub singers in the half-glam, half-decrepit world of Smoczyńska’s imagining. The director gives fierce teeth to her viscerally sensual, darkly feminist twist on Hans Christian Andersen’s “The Little Mermaid,” in which the girls’ bond is tested and their survival threatened after one sister falls for a human. A coming-of-age fairy tale with a catchy synth-fueled soundtrack, outrageous song-and-dance numbers, and lavishly grimy sets, The Lure explores its themes of emerging female sexuality, exploitation, and the compromises of adulthood with savage energy and originality.

hook: 新媒体先驱 Shu Lea Cheang 的处女作将大胆的反抗愿景与蓬勃发展的早期互联网美学融为一体，讲述了一个令人不安的有先见之明的生态女权主义寓言和一部令人脑电波扰乱的赛博朋克幻想曲。在反乌托邦时尚的纽约，寿司店和有毒废物场并存，一对女同性恋夫妇（萨丽塔·乔杜里和艾琳·麦克默特里饰）向地下黑客求助，以解决女儿失踪的问题，在此过程中揭露了涉及企业洗绿和受污染鱼类的阴谋。 《新鲜杀戮》在极端讽刺和煽动之间摇摆，对资本主义制度敲响了警钟，它污染了我们的水道、身体和思想等一切事物。
hook_en: A disturbingly prescient ecofeminist parable and a brain-wave-scrambling cyberpunk fantasia, the debut feature from new-media pioneer Shu Lea Cheang merges a bold vision of resistance with an exuberant early-internet aesthetic. In a dystopian-chic New York where sushi joints and toxic-waste sites exist side by side, a lesbian couple (Sarita Choudhury and Erin McMurtry) turn to the hacker underground to solve their daughter’s disappearance, in the process exposing a conspiracy involving corporate greenwashing and tainted fish. Swinging between outré satire and agitprop, Fresh Kill sounds the alarm about a capitalist system that pollutes everything from our waterways to our bodies to our minds.

hook: 在饱受战争蹂躏的中世纪日本，风吹草动的沼泽深处，一位贫穷的老妇人和她的儿媳被谋杀，失去了武士，并变卖了自己的财产以换取微薄的生计。当一个浑身脏兮兮的邻居从战斗中归来时，欲望、嫉妒和愤怒威胁着三人脆弱的生存，而一个不祥的、来路不明的恶魔面具却决定了他们可怕的命运。在原始情感、黑暗色情、林光的疯狂配乐以及既抒情又恐怖的令人惊叹的图像的驱动下，新藤兼人令人毛骨悚然的民间故事《鬼婆》让人联想到人类最深层次的欲望和冲动的噩梦般的景象。
hook_en: Deep in the windswept marshes of war-torn medieval Japan, an impoverished older woman and her daughter-in-law murder lost samurai and sell their belongings for the most meager of sustenance. When a bedraggled neighbor returns from battle, lust, jealousy, and rage threaten to destroy the trio’s tenuous existence, before an ominous, ill-gotten demon mask seals their horrifying fate. Driven by primal emotions, dark eroticism, a frenzied score by Hikaru Hayashi, and stunning images both lyrical and macabre, Kaneto Shindo’s chilling folktale Onibaba conjures a nightmarish vision of humankind’s deepest desires and impulses.

hook: 艾莉·希迪 (Ally Sheedy) 在编剧兼导演丽莎·乔洛登科 (Lisa Cholodenko) 的处女作中出演了一场具有启发性的表演，以情感尖锐的酷儿浪漫为幌子，对纽约艺术界的政治进行了讽刺而深刻的审视。露西·柏林纳（希迪饰）是一位曾经的著名摄影师，现在和她的退色女演员情人（帕特里夏·克拉克森饰）一起过着吸食海洛因的生活，当她被一家摄影杂志的崭露头角的编辑西德（拉妲·米切尔饰）重新发现时，职业野心和个人吸引力危险地交织在一起。 《高雅艺术》剥离了艺术世界的魅力，讲述了一个关于复杂的人际关系的诱人而又令人不安的故事，是酷儿电影和 90 年代独立电影的重要作品。
hook_en: In a revelatory performance, Ally Sheedy stars in writer-director Lisa Cholodenko’s debut feature, a wry and incisive look at the politics of the New York art scene wrapped in the guise of an emotionally spiky queer romance. When Lucy Berliner (Sheedy), a once prominent photographer who has retreated into a life of heroin abuse with her faded-actress lover (Patricia Clarkson), is rediscovered by Syd (Radha Mitchell), an up-and-coming editor at a photography magazine, professional ambition and personal attraction become dangerously entwined. Stripping away art-world glamour to tell a seductive yet troubling story of complicated human connection, High Art stands as an essential work of both queer and 1990s independent cinema.

hook: 导演新藤兼人对日常斗争的纪录片式、无对话的描绘是一部令人惊叹的视觉美感和创造力的作品。对于日本最具创新精神的电影制作人之一来说，他在国际上取得了突破，他还制作了《鬼马》和《黑猫》等其他独特的杰作，《裸岛》讲述了一个家庭的故事，他们的家位于日本列岛的一个偏远小岛上。他们必须划很长一段距离到另一岸，用桶从井里取水，然后划回他们的岛屿——这是一项近乎艰苦的任务，对于这些人和他们的土地的生存至关重要。以林光 (Hikaru Hayashi) 非凡的现代主义配乐为特色，这是一次真正催眠的体验，其节奏不同于任何其他电影。
hook_en: Director Kaneto Shindo’s documentary-like, dialogue-free portrayal of daily struggle is a work of stunning visual beauty and invention. The international breakthrough for one of Japan’s most innovative filmmakers—who went on to make other unique masterworks such as Onibaba and Kuroneko—The Naked Island follows a family whose home is on a tiny, remote island in the Japanese archipelago. They must row a great distance to another shore, collect water from a well in buckets, and row back to their island—a nearly backbreaking task essential for the survival of these people and their land. Featuring a phenomenal modernist score by Hikaru Hayashi, this is a truly hypnotic experience, with a rhythm unlike that of any other film.

hook: 布鲁克林的一场拳击比赛；战后波斯尼亚和黑塞哥维那的生活；尼日利亚助产士的日常生活；与导演在家里度过的亲密家庭时刻：克尔斯滕·约翰逊将这些场景和其他场景编织到她的电影《摄影师》中，这是她作为纪录片摄影师二十五年的职业生涯中拍摄的镜头的挂毯。通过一系列情景并置，约翰逊探索了图像制作者与其拍摄对象之间的关系、客观性与相机干预之间的张力，以及未经过滤的现实与精心设计的叙事之间的复杂相互作用。 《摄影师》是一部结合了纪录片、自传和道德探究的作品，它是对一位电影制片人个人旅程的感人一瞥，也是对训练相机观​​察世界意味着什么的深思熟虑的审视。
hook_en: A boxing match in Brooklyn; life in postwar Bosnia and Herzegovina; the daily routine of a Nigerian midwife; an intimate family moment at home with the director: Kirsten Johnson weaves these scenes and others into her film Cameraperson, a tapestry of footage captured over her twenty-five-year career as a documentary cinematographer. Through a series of episodic juxtapositions, Johnson explores the relationships between image makers and their subjects, the tension between the objectivity and intervention of the camera, and the complex interaction of unfiltered reality with crafted narrative. A work that combines documentary, autobiography, and ethical inquiry, Cameraperson is a moving glimpse into one filmmaker’s personal journey and a thoughtful examination of what it means to train a camera on the world.

hook: “吉尔达，你还好吗？”丽塔·海华斯把头发甩到脑后，狡猾地回答：“我？”电影史上最伟大的明星入场之一。查尔斯·维多 (Charles Vidor) 执导的《吉尔达》(Gilda) 中，性感的海华斯 (Hayworth) 扮演了她最具代表性的角色，既是犯罪头目 (乔治·麦克雷迪 (George Macready) 饰) 梦寐以求的妻子，又是他苦毒追随者 (格伦·福特 (Glenn Ford) 饰) 的前情人，她的欲望和嫉妒让他们都发疯。一场不断变化的性别之战发生在布宜诺斯艾利斯赌场闪闪发光的地板和阴暗的后室里，吉尔达是所有好莱坞黑人中最感性的人之一。
hook_en: “Gilda, are you decent?” Rita Hayworth tosses her hair back and slyly responds, “Me?” in one of the great star entrances in movie history. Gilda, directed by Charles Vidor, features a sultry Hayworth in her most iconic role, as the much-lusted-after wife of a criminal kingpin (George Macready), as well as the former flame of his bitter henchman (Glenn Ford), and she drives them both mad with desire and jealousy. An ever-shifting battle of the sexes set on a Buenos Aires casino’s glittering floor and in its shadowy back rooms, Gilda is among the most sensual of all Hollywood noirs.

hook: 这部充满活力、怀旧色彩的犯罪剧取材于第一次世界大战和大萧条之间动荡时代的头条新闻，平衡了汤米枪行动和史诗般的历史横扫。传奇人物詹姆斯·卡格尼和汉弗莱·鲍嘉饰演战友，他们的命运随着命运的交集而起起落落，先是在第一次世界大战前线的散兵坑，然后在曼哈顿禁酒令时代的黑社会。 《咆哮的二十年代》由好莱坞大师拉乌尔·沃尔什执导，改编自多产记者、编剧兼制片人马克·海林格的故事，《咆哮的二十年代》为华纳兄弟 1930 年代著名的黑帮周期画上了句号，并且仍然是有史以来最伟大、最具影响力的犯罪电影之一。
hook_en: Ripped from the headlines of the turbulent era between the Great War and the Great Depression, this dynamic, nostalgia-tinged crime drama balances tommy-gun action with epic historical sweep. Legends James Cagney and Humphrey Bogart star as army buddies whose fortunes rise and fall as their fates intersect, first in a foxhole on the front lines of World War I, then in Manhattan’s Prohibition-era underworld. Directed by Hollywood master Raoul Walsh, and based on a story by prolific journalist turned screenwriter and producer Mark Hellinger, The Roaring Twenties brought to a close the celebrated Warner Bros. gangster cycle of the 1930s, and it remains one of the greatest and most influential crime films of all time.

hook: 《血色王座》是一部生动、发自肺腑的麦克白改编作品，由黑泽明执导，将莎士比亚关于野心和口是心非的最终故事设定在封建日本幽灵般的、雾气缭绕的风景中。作为一名残酷的武士，三船敏郎表现出了非凡的兽性表演，山田五十铃饰演他无情的妻子。 《血之王座》将西方古典悲剧与能剧中的正式元素融为一体，创造出令人难忘的电影体验。
hook_en: A vivid, visceral Macbeth adaptation, Throne of Blood, directed by Akira Kurosawa, sets Shakespeare’s definitive tale of ambition and duplicity in a ghostly, fog-enshrouded landscape in feudal Japan. As a hardened warrior who rises savagely to power, Toshiro Mifune gives a remarkable, animalistic performance, as does Isuzu Yamada as his ruthless wife. Throne of Blood fuses classical Western tragedy with formal elements taken from Noh theater to create an unforgettable cinematic experience.

hook: 黑泽明的《红胡子》（赤日饰）证明了人类的善良，记录了一位傲慢的年轻医生和一位富有同情心的诊所主任之间的混乱关系。三船敏郎在黑泽明的最后一个角色中，展现了一位威严而富有同理心的导演的精彩表演，他引导他的学生走向成熟，教导这位痛苦的实习生如何欣赏贫困患者的生活。黑泽明完美地捕捉了 19 世纪日本的面貌和感觉，编织了一幅时间、地点和情感的迷人挂毯。
hook_en: A testament to the goodness of humankind, Akira Kurosawa's Red Beard (Akahige) chronicles the tumultuous relationship between an arrogant young doctor and a compassionate clinic director. Toshiro Mifune, in his last role for Kurosawa, gives a powerhouse performance as the dignified yet empathic director who guides his pupil to maturity, teaching the embittered intern to appreciate the lives of his destitute patients. Perfectly capturing the look and feel of 19th-century Japan, Kurosawa weaves a fascinating tapestry of time, place, and emotion.

hook: 《生》是黑泽明最伟大的成就之一，它展现了导演最富有同情心的一面——通过对死亡的探索来肯定生命。志村隆精美地描绘了渡边宽二，一位患有胃癌的老年官僚，他被迫在生命的最后日子里寻找意义。 《生之留》以激进的两部分结构呈现，并以敏锐的、人文主义的清晰视野拍摄，从多方面审视了活着的意义。
hook_en: One of the greatest achievements by Akira Kurosawa, Ikiru shows the director at his most compassionate—affirming life through an explora­tion of death. Takashi Shimura beautifully portrays Kanji Watanabe, an aging bureaucrat with stomach cancer who is impelled to find meaning in his final days. Presented in a radically conceived two­part structure and shot with a perceptive, humanistic clarity of vision, Ikiru is a multifaceted look at what it means to be alive.

hook: 《米勒的十字路口》是一部只有科恩兄弟才能创作的咆哮的二十年代黑帮传奇故事，它将经典黑色小说的冷酷感性与电影制片人标志性的美味对话、丰富多彩的角色和精心设计的场景结合在一起。加布里埃尔·伯恩 (Gabriel Byrne) 为汤姆·里根 (Tom Reagan) 的角色带来了一种讽刺的庄重感，汤姆·里根是一位思维敏捷的得力助手，是强大的犯罪头目（阿尔伯特·芬尼饰）的得力助手。当汤姆开始向竞争对手提供服务时，他镇定自若的冷静受到了考验——引发了一连串的背叛、报复和日益疯狂的暴力。电影摄影师巴里·索南菲尔德 (Barry Sonnenfeld) 的霍珀式视觉效果、卡特·伯韦尔 (Carter Burwell) 庄严挽歌的配乐，以及约翰·特托罗 (John Turturro) 和马西娅·盖伊·哈登 (Marcia Gay Harden) 生动的配角表演，共同构成了一部完美的通俗作品，充满讽刺的智慧，同时探讨了有关自由意志和我们自身可怕的邪恶能力的存在问题。
hook_en: A Roaring Twenties gangster saga that only the Coen brothers could concoct, Miller’s Crossing marries the hard-boiled sensibility of classic noir fiction with the filmmakers’ trademark savory dialogue, colorful characters, and finely calibrated set pieces. Gabriel Byrne brings a wry gravitas to the role of Tom Reagan, the quick-thinking right-hand man to a powerful crime boss (Albert Finney). Tom’s unflappable cool is tested when he begins offering his services to a rival outfit—setting off a cascade of betrayals, reprisals, and increasingly berserk violence.
