The Hopperesque visuals of cinematographer Barry Sonnenfeld, majestically elegiac score by Carter Burwell, and vivid supporting performances from John Turturro and Marcia Gay Harden come together in a slice of pulp perfection that crackles with sardonic wit while plumbing existential questions about free will and our own terrifying capacity for evil.

hook: 当一个神秘的陌生人加入两个敌对的黑帮帮派时，东京的黑社会爆发了暴力事件。 《野兽之青春》（Yaju no Seishun）是导演铃木清顺的一次突破，引入了华丽的色彩、幻觉的图像和引人注目的构图，这些都成为了他的标志。 Criterion Collection 自豪地呈现这部重振黑帮类型并帮助定义传奇电影叛徒的独特风格的电影。
hook_en: When a mysterious stranger muscles into two rival yakuza gangs, Tokyo's underworld explodes with violence. Youth of the Beast (Yaju no Seishun) was a breakthrough for director Seijun Suzuki, introducing the flamboyant colors, hallucinatory images, and striking compositions that would become his trademark. The Criterion Collection proudly presents the film that revitalized the yakuza genre and helped define the inimitable style of a legendary cinematic renegade.

hook: 迈克尔·柯蒂兹以大师级的手法执导了这部惊悚片，这是好莱坞对欧内斯特·海明威的《有与无》的第二次尝试。约翰·加菲尔德 (John Garfield) 饰演哈利·摩根 (Harry Morgan)，他是一位诚实的包租船船长，面对困难，他承担了危险的货物来拯救他的船、养家糊口并维护自己的尊严。哈利被一名贪图便宜的乘客陷入了困境，他开始接受一名卑鄙律师（华莱士·福特饰）的犯罪提议，以及一个厚颜无耻的金发女郎（帕特里夏·尼尔饰）的顽皮挑逗，他做出了一系列妥协，这些妥协使他的道德和他的婚姻比他承认的更加严重。 《断裂点》比霍华德·霍克斯的鲍嘉-白考尔作品更接近海明威的小说，在柯蒂兹毫不费力的视觉流畅和加菲猫坚忍的、职业生涯巅峰的表演的指导下，描绘了一条穿越白天黑色和工人阶级悲剧的路线。
hook_en: Michael Curtiz brings a master skipper’s hand to the helm of this thriller, Hollywood’s second crack at Ernest Hemingway’s To Have and Have Not. John Garfield stars as Harry Morgan, an honest charter-boat captain who, facing hard times, takes on dangerous cargo to save his boat, support his family, and preserve his dignity. Left in the lurch by a freeloading passenger, Harry starts to enter­tain the criminal propositions of a sleazy lawyer (Wallace Ford), as well as the playful come-ons of a cheeky blonde (Patricia Neal), making a series of compromises that stretch his morality—and his marriage—further than he’ll admit. Hewing closer to Hemingway’s novel than Howard Hawks’s Bogart-Bacall vehicle does, The Breaking Point charts a course through daylight noir and working-class tragedy, guided by Curtiz’s effortless visual fluency and a stoic, career-capping performance from Garfield.

hook: 凭借低廉的预算和丰富的黑白图像，格斯·范·桑特的处女作《小夜曲》预示着美国独立电影中一种独特的、具有挑衅性的新声音。这部电影以范桑特的家乡俄勒冈州波特兰为背景，描绘了一个充满流动工人、没有出路的白班工人、沐浴在深夜的酒吧和破旧公寓的世界，讲述了一个浪漫的游手好闲者对一位英俊的墨西哥移民的任性迷恋。 《小夜曲》是九十年代新酷儿电影的重要前奏，是一个来自某个时间和地点的迷人胶囊，一直困扰着导演的作品。
hook_en: With its low budget and lush black-and-white imagery, Gus Van Sant's debut feature Mala Noche heralded an idiosyncratic, provocative new voice in American independent film. Set in Van Sant's hometown of Portland, Oregon, the film evokes a world of transient workers, dead-end day-shifters, and bars and seedy apartments bathed in a profound nighttime, as it follows a romantic deadbeat with a wayward crush on a handsome Mexican immigrant. Mala Noche was an important prelude to the New Queer Cinema of the nineties and is a fascinating capsule from a time and place that continues to haunt its director's work.

hook: 这部由艺术大师米哈伊尔·卡拉托佐夫 (Mikhail Kalatozov) 执导的里程碑式电影在后斯大林时代的苏联和国际电影界被誉为一个启示。它讲述了维罗妮卡（塔蒂安娜·萨莫伊洛娃饰）和鲍里斯（阿列克谢·巴塔洛夫饰）这对幸福相爱的情侣直到第二次世界大战将他们分开的故事。在鲍里斯的带领下，维罗妮卡必须努力避免精神上的麻木，并保护自己免受她男友逃避兵役的表弟日益强力的追求。 《鹤飞》荣获 1958 年戛纳电影节金棕榈奖，是一部精心制作的剧情片，由卡拉托佐夫的长期合作者谢尔盖·乌鲁塞夫斯基 (Sergei Urusevsky) 精心制作，表演热情洋溢，情感发自内心，反重力的摄影。
hook_en: This landmark film by the virtuosic Mikhail Kalatozov was heralded as a revelation in the post-Stalin Soviet Union and the international cinema community alike. It tells the story of Veronica (Tatiana Samoilova) and Boris (Alexei Batalov), a couple who are blissfully in love until World War II tears them apart. With Boris at the front, Veronica must try to ward off spiritual numbness and defend herself from the increasingly forceful advances of her beau’s draft-dodging cousin. Winner of the Palme d’Or at the 1958 Cannes Film Festival, The Cranes Are Flying is a superbly crafted drama with impassioned performances and viscerally emotional, gravity-defying cinematography by Kalatozov’s regular collaborator Sergei Urusevsky.

hook: 米洛什·福尔曼的第一部彩色电影《消防员舞会》（Horí, má panenko）是捷克新浪潮的里程碑，它既是一部令人眼花缭乱的喜剧，也是一部挑衅性的政治讽刺片。故事讲述了一场善意却被混淆的搞笑传奇，讲述了一场事与愿违的消防员舞会——从不情愿的参加者让组织者难堪的选美比赛，到几乎所有奖品都被偷走的彩票。这部电影被认为是对陷入困境的捷克领导层的评论，在俄罗斯入侵后，这部电影在捷克斯洛伐克被“永远禁映”，并促使福尔曼移居美国。
hook_en: A milestone of the Czech New Wave, Miloš Forman’s first color film The Firemen’s Ball (Horí, má panenko) is both a dazzling comedy and a provocative political satire. A hilarious saga of good intentions confounded, the story chronicles a firemen’s ball where nothing goes right—from a beauty pageant whose reluctant participants embarrass the organizers to a lottery from which nearly all the prizes are pilfered. Presumed to be a commentary on the floundering Czech leadership, the film was “banned forever” in Czechoslovakia following the Russian invasion and prompted Forman’s move to America.

hook: 在保罗·马祖斯基 (Paul Mazursky) 的这部极其坦率、有趣的编年史中，一位女性的自我发现之旅引发了一场关于女性解放的热烈的人类文化对话。当她结婚十六年的丈夫突然为了一个年轻的女人而离开她时，曼哈顿画廊工作人员艾丽卡（由获得奥斯卡提名的吉尔·克雷伯格扮演）发现自己孤独而漂泊，但当她尝试与一位魅力艺术家（艾伦·贝茨饰）建立新关系时，她也重新获得了探索自己需求和欲望的能力。 《一位未婚女人》从毫不掩饰的女权主义角度坦率地探讨了性、亲密、孤独和离婚等问题，她简单而激进地断言，女人最重要的关系是她与自己的关系。
hook_en: One woman’s journey of self-discovery brings about a warmly human cultural conversation about female liberation, in this wonderfully frank, funny chronicle of changing 1970s sexual politics by Paul Mazursky. When her husband of sixteen years abruptly leaves her for a younger woman, Manhattan gallery worker Erica (a fantastic, Oscar-nominated Jill Clayburgh in her defining role) finds herself alone and adrift—but also newly empowered to explore her needs and desires as she tests the waters of a new relationship with a charismatic artist (Alan Bates). Candidly addressing issues of sex, intimacy, loneliness, and divorce from an unabashedly feminist perspective, An Unmarried Woman makes the simple but radical assertion that a woman’s most important relationship is the one she has with herself.

hook: 类型爆炸大师奉俊昊将悲情、黑暗讽刺、动作和恐怖融入一个令人兴奋的二十一世纪童话故事中。包括蒂尔达·斯文顿、保罗·达诺、史蒂文·元和杰克·吉伦哈尔在内的全明星演员阵容由安瑞贤领衔主演，她饰演韩国女孩 Mija，与她的祖父和最好的朋友 Okja 一起在伊甸园般的山坡上长大。Okja 是一头巨大、富有同情心的“超级猪”，是秘密转基因实验的一部分。当玉子突然与她分离时，美佳开始了一项危险的营救任务，这使她陷入了险恶的公司阴谋的中心。奉俊昊标志性的精湛表演令人眼花缭乱，而玉子跳动的心则是一个女孩和她的超级猪之间的联系，而绚丽的特效让动物明星的生活变得令人难忘，这让这一点变得更加令人心酸。
hook_en: Master genre exploder Bong Joon Ho swirls pathos, dark satire, action, and horror into an exhilarating twenty-first-century fairy tale. An all-star cast including Tilda Swinton, Paul Dano, Steven Yeun, and Jake Gyllenhaal is led by An Seo Hyun as Mija, a South Korean girl growing up on an Edenic mountainside with her grandfather and best friend: Okja, a giant, empathetic “superpig” created as part of a secret GMO experiment. When Okja is abruptly torn away from her, Mija embarks on a perilous rescue mission that places her at the center of a sinister corporate conspiracy. While Bong’s trademark virtuosic set pieces dazzle, Okja’s beating heart is the connection between a girl and her superpig, made all the more poignant by the brilliant special effects that bring its animal star to unforgettable life.

hook: 由西德尼·吕美特执导的《十二怒汉》可能是电影史上最激进的法庭剧。这部改编自雷金纳德·罗斯电视剧的经典作品，由亨利·方达饰演白人陪审团中的持异议成员，准备对一名被控谋杀父亲的波多黎各少年做出判决。结果是一部史诗般的传奇故事在一个闷热的房间里在一个紧张的下午上演。吕美特以令人振奋的方式描绘了 20 世纪 50 年代处于变革边缘的美国，这是一部伟大的故事片处女作。
hook_en: 12 Angry Men, directed by Sidney Lumet, may be the most radical courtroom drama in cinema history. A behind-closed-doors look at the American legal system that is as riveting as it is spare, this iconic adaptation of Reginald Rose’s teleplay stars Henry Fonda as the dissenting member on a jury of white men ready to pass judgment on a Puerto Rican teenager charged with murdering his father. The result is a saga of epic proportions that plays out over a tense afternoon in one sweltering room. Lumet’s electrifying snapshot of 1950s America on the verge of change is one of the great feature-film debuts.

hook: 《乔丹先生来了》是一部复杂的超自然好莱坞喜剧，其影响力仍在继续，由多才多艺的罗伯特·蒙哥马利主演，饰演一名工人阶级拳击手和业余飞行员，他的飞机在一次离奇事故中坠毁。他发现自己身处天堂，但一位名叫乔丹先生（克劳德·雷恩斯饰）的天使告诉他，他的死是一个文书错误，他可以通过进入一个腐败（即将被谋杀）的金融家的身体返回地球——他的灵魂可以接受移植。亚历山大·霍尔 (Alexander Hall) 的《乔丹先生来了》获得了七项奥斯卡奖提名（赢得了两项），并为丽塔·海华斯 (Rita Hayworth) 拍摄的续集和两部翻拍片提供了灵感，这部充满喜剧色彩的作品堪称完美。
hook_en: A sophisticated supernatural Hollywood comedy whose influence continues to be felt, Here Comes Mr. Jordan stars the eminently versatile Robert Montgomery as a working-class boxer and amateur aviator whose plane crashes in a freak accident. He finds himself in heaven but is told, by a wry angel named Mr. Jordan (Claude Rains), that his death was a clerical error, and that he can return to Earth by entering the body of a corrupt (and about-to-be-murdered) financier—whose soul could use a transplant. Nominated for seven Oscars (it won two) and the inspiration for a sequel with Rita Hayworth and two remakes, Alexander Hall’s effervescent Here Comes Mr. Jordan is comic perfection.

hook: 威廉·弗里德金 (William Friedkin) 对悬疑经典《恐惧的代价》进行了一次令人心潮澎湃的重新想象，这是一场深入黑暗中心的幻觉之旅，在上映时就被驳回了，但几十年后才被认为是新好莱坞最大胆的导演声明之一。在一个偏远的拉丁美洲村庄，四名绝望的逃犯——一名新泽西黑帮（罗伊·谢德尔饰）、一名墨西哥刺客（弗朗西斯科·拉巴尔饰）、一名肆无忌惮的巴黎商人（布鲁诺·克莱默饰）和一名阿拉伯恐怖分子（阿米杜饰）——承担了一项注定失败的任务：运送两辆装满高爆炸性硝化甘油的卡车穿越危险的丛林。在 Tangerine Dream 超凡脱俗的合成乐的帮助下，弗里德金将道路上的每一个坎坷都变成了冷汗紧张的杰作——让人联想到一个由机会和命运统治的世界的令人难以忘怀的虚无主义景象。
hook_en: A hallucinatory journey into the heart of darkness, William Friedkin’s pulse-pounding reimagining of the suspense classic The Wages of Fear was dismissed upon its release, only to be recognized decades later as one of the New Hollywood’s boldest auteur statements. In a remote Latin American village, four desperate fugitives—a New Jersey gangster (Roy Scheider), a Mexican assassin (Francisco Rabal), an unscrupulous Parisian businessman (Bruno Cremer), and an Arab terrorist (Amidou)—take on a doomed mission: transporting two trucks full of highly explosive nitroglycerin through the treacherous jungle. Aided by Tangerine Dream’s otherworldly synth score, Friedkin turns each bump in the road into a tour de force of cold-sweat tension—conjuring a hauntingly nihilistic vision of a world ruled by chance and fate.

hook: 在冈本喜八执导的这部漆黑动作喜剧中，一对倒霉的剑客来到了一座尘土飞扬、风吹雨打的小镇，并卷入了当地的部落争端。一个曾经是农民的人渴望成为一名高贵的武士。另一个人是一名前武士，被自己的过去所困扰，更喜欢与歹徒匿名生活。但当两人发现邪恶部落首领的不法行为后，他们站在了一群被围困在偏远山间小屋的叛乱分子一边。改编自黑泽明的《杀戮三十郎》同源小说，巧妙地调整了武士电影的惯例，借鉴了著名的掸原经典元素，并加入了一点意大利西部片。
hook_en: In this pitch-black action comedy by Kihachi Okamoto, a pair of down-on-their-luck swordsmen arrive in a dusty, windblown town, where they become involved in a local clan dispute. One, previously a farmer, longs to become a noble samurai. The other, a former samurai haunted by his past, prefers living anonymously with gangsters. But when both men discover the wrongdoings of the nefarious clan leader, they side with a band of rebels who are under siege at a remote mountain cabin. Based on the same source novel as Akira Kurosawa’s _Sanjuro, Kill!_ playfully tweaks samurai film convention, borrowing elements from established chanbara classics and seasoning them with a little Italian western.

hook: 由于每个男人都有十六个女人，安杜拉在绝望地寻找爱情时遇到了困难——直到一位放荡的钢琴演奏家来到她的工厂小镇，暂时缓解了她的渴望。 《金发女郎之恋》（Lásky jedné plavovlásky）温柔而幽默地审视了安杜拉的旅程，从最初的浪漫痛苦到不可避免的失望，立即成为捷克新浪潮的经典，并为米洛什·福尔曼赢得了他的第一个奥斯卡金像奖提名。
hook_en: With sixteen women to each man, the odds are against Andula in her desperate search for love—that is, until a rakish piano player visits her small factory town and temporarily eases her longings. A tender and humorous look at Andula’s journey, from the first pangs of romance to its inevitable disappointments, Loves of a Blonde (Lásky jedné plavovlásky) immediately became a classic of the Czech New Wave and earned Miloš Forman the first of his Academy Award nominations.

hook: 《电线上的世界》是德国神童雷纳·沃纳·法斯宾德对未来的一种光彩偏执、无限创意的呈现。在斯坦利·库布里克、库尔特·冯内古特和菲利普·迪克的点缀下，法斯宾德讲述了一个不情愿的英雄弗雷德·斯蒂勒（克劳斯·洛维奇饰）的黑色故事，他是一名控制论工程师，揭露了一个巨大的企业阴谋。有危险吗？我们所知道的（虚拟）现实。这部时长三个半小时的迷宫最初是为德国电视台制作的，最近被重新发现，是电影界最变态的天才之一对未来世界的讽刺和超现实的观察。
hook_en: World on a Wire is a gloriously paranoid, boundlessly inventive take on the future from German wunderkind Rainer Werner Fassbinder. With dashes of Stanley Kubrick, Kurt Vonnegut, and Philip K. Dick, Fassbinder tells the noir-spiked tale of reluctant hero Fred Stiller (Klaus Löwitsch), a cybernetics engineer who uncovers a massive corporate conspiracy. At risk? (Virtual) reality as we know it. Originally made for German television, this recently rediscovered, three-and-a-half-hour labyrinth is a satiric and surreal look at the world of tomorrow from one of cinema’s kinkiest geniuses.

hook: 晴美在满洲前线志愿担任“慰安妇”，预计要为数百名士兵服务，她被残暴的成田中尉强占，却爱上了成田直属敏感的三上。铃木清顺的《妓女物语》讲述了一个悲剧性的爱情故事，也是对田村泰二郎流行小说的一次颠覆性演绎，从晴美的角度来看，挑战了军事和兄弟般的荣誉准则。
hook_en: Volunteering as a "comfort woman" on the Manchurian front, where she is expected to service hundreds of soldiers, Harumi is commandeered by the brutal Lieutenant Narita but falls for the sensitive Mikami, Narita's direct subordinate. Seijun Suzuki's Story of a Prostitute is a tragic love story as well as a rule-bending take on a popular Taijiro Tamura novel, challenging military and fraternal codes of honor, as seen through Harumi's eyes.

hook: 约翰·休斯顿的最后一部电影是一部哀伤的电影，这位传奇导演将他最喜欢的作家詹姆斯·乔伊斯的精彩短篇小说改编成对生活整体的深刻反思。二十世纪之交都柏林的一个下雪的冬天，一个大家庭的成员聚集在一起，度过了一个有酒有歌、庆祝的夜晚，但直到庆祝活动结束后，格蕾塔（安杰丽卡·休斯顿饰）才向她的丈夫（唐纳尔·麦肯饰）透露了一个秘密，这让整个夜晚都焕然一新。 《死者》洋溢着怀旧和忧郁的气息，由爱尔兰一流演员组成，优雅地唤起了时间的流逝和记忆中令人难以忘怀的力量。
hook_en: The elegiac last film by John Huston finds the legendary director adapting a masterly short story by his favorite writer, James Joyce, into a poignant reflection on the totality of life. During a snowy winter in turn-of-the-twentieth-century Dublin, the members of an extended family convene for a night of wine, song, and celebration—but it’s not until after the festivities that Gretta (Anjelica Huston) reveals a secret to her husband (Donal McCann) that casts the entire evening in a new light. Aglow with a mix of nostalgia and melancholy, and featuring a cast of stellar Irish actors, The Dead gracefully evokes the passage of time and the haunting power of memory.

hook: 在《战时生活》中，独立电影制片人托德·索隆兹以他一贯的冷幽默和令人作呕的精确性探索了当代美国的存在和宽恕的本质。这部电影是 Solondz 1998 年广受好评的黑色喜剧《幸福》的扭曲镜像，片中情感发育迟缓的角色现在正在探索 9/11 后世界变革的可能性。 《幸福》的严酷新泽西州背景主要转移到阳光明媚的佛罗里达州，但最大的转折是新演员填补了前部电影中的角色——包括雪莉·亨德森、艾莉森·珍妮和艾莉·希迪，饰演截然不同的姐妹，而塞伦·希德则令人难以忘怀地扮演一个改过自新的恋童癖者。索隆兹的电影由杰出电影摄影师埃德·拉赫曼 (Ed Lachman) 以表现主义风格拍摄，在悲剧中找到幽默，在日常生活中找到悲剧。
hook_en: In Life During Wartime, independent filmmaker Todd Solondz explores contemporary American existence and the nature of forgiveness with his customary dry humor and queasy precision. The film functions as a distorted mirror image of Solondz’s acclaimed 1998 dark comedy Happiness, its emotionally stunted characters now groping for the possibility of change in a post-9/11 world. Happiness’s grim New Jersey setting is transposed mainly to sunny Florida, but the biggest twist is that new actors fill the roles from the earlier film—including Shirley Henderson, Allison Janney, and Ally Sheedy as alarmingly dissimilar sisters, and Ciarán Hinds hauntingly embodying a reformed pedophile. Shot in expressionistic tones by cinematographer extraordinaire Ed Lachman, Solondz’s film finds the humor in the tragic and the tragic in the everyday.

hook: 伟大的苏联导演米哈伊尔·卡拉托佐夫以其精湛的、扣人心弦的电影而闻名，也许从未拍过比《未寄出的信》更令人惊叹的视觉效果的电影。这个引人入胜的探索和生存故事讲述了地质探险队的四名成员的故事，他们在执行寻找钻石的任务时被困在荒凉无情的西伯利亚荒野中。 《未寄出的信》充满了广角之美，并以一个又一个大胆的镜头为特色（精彩的摄影是由卡拉托佐夫的经常合作者谢尔盖·乌鲁塞夫斯基拍摄的），《未寄出的信》是电影史上一部引人入胜的作品，也是一次最高级别的普遍冒险。
hook_en: The great Soviet director Mikhail Kalatozov, known for his virtuosic, emotionally gripping films, perhaps never made a more visually astonishing one than Letter Never Sent. This absorbing tale of exploration and survival concerns the four members of a geological expedition, who are stranded in the bleak and unforgiving Siberian wilderness while on a mission to find diamonds. Luxuriating in wide-angle beauty and featuring one daring shot after another (the brilliant cinematography is by Kalatozov’s frequent collaborator Sergei Urusevsky), Letter Never Sent is a fascinating piece of cinematic history and a universal adventure of the highest order.

hook: 马丁·斯科塞斯的电影造诣在这部规模宏大的犯罪传奇中得到了充分展示，这是对他六年职业生涯的挽歌总结。被世界抛在身后的前杀手兼工会卡车司机弗兰克·希兰（罗伯特·德尼罗饰）在疗养院中回顾了自己在有组织犯罪队伍中的一生历程：从他与费城黑帮老大拉塞尔·布法利诺（乔·佩西饰）的关系，到他与卡车司机工会主席吉米·霍法（阿尔·帕西诺饰）的关系，再到迫使他在两者之间做出选择的裂痕。 《爱尔兰人》是一个关于忠诚与背叛的亲密故事，贯穿了二十世纪中叶美国史诗般的历史。《爱尔兰人》（改编自现实生活中的希兰的忏悔，正如《我听说你粉刷房子》一书的编剧查尔斯·勃兰特所讲述的那样）是一部独特的反映职业生涯晚期的胜利，它平衡了导演的大师级作品与对衰老、死亡以及塑造生活的决定和遗憾的深刻个人反思。
hook_en: Martin Scorsese’s cinematic mastery is on full display in this sweeping crime saga, which serves as an elegiac summation of his six-decade career. Left behind by the world, former hit man and union truck driver Frank Sheeran (Robert De Niro) looks back from a nursing home on his life’s journey through the ranks of organized crime: from his involvement with Philadelphia mob boss Russell Bufalino (Joe Pesci) to his association with Teamsters union head Jimmy Hoffa (Al Pacino) to the rift that forced him to choose between the two. An intimate story of loyalty and betrayal writ large across the epic canvas of mid-twentieth-century American history, The Irishman (based on the real-life Sheeran’s confessions, as told to writer Charles Brandt for the book I Heard You Paint Houses) is a uniquely reflective late-career triumph that balances its director’s virtuoso set pieces with a profoundly personal rumination on aging, mortality, and the decisions and regrets that shape a life.

hook: 电影界伟大的现代神话创造者吉列尔莫·德尔·托罗利用经典恐怖和奇幻的特点，讲述了一个关于局外人、联系和爱的超越的奇怪而崇高的寓言。莎莉·霍金斯 (Sally Hawkins) 扮演的伊莉莎 (Sally Hawkins) 饰演令人难以言喻的感人至深的角色，她是一家绝密政府实验室的一名沉默寡言的看门人，她发现自己被该设施的最新研究课题：一种类人两栖动物所吸引，在 20 世纪 60 年代美国令人窒息的墨守成规的环境中，她很快就为它冒着一切风险。这部令人惊叹的电影梦境是视觉想象力的胜利，融合了科幻、黑色和黄金时代音乐剧的元素，荣获包括最佳影片和最佳导演在内的四项奥斯卡奖，是一部充满人性的怪物电影。
hook_en: Cinema’s great modern mythmaker Guillermo del Toro uses the hallmarks of classic horror and fantasy to tell a strange and sublime fable about outsiderhood, connection, and love’s transcendence. An ineffably touching Sally Hawkins plays Elisa, a mute janitor at a top-secret government laboratory who finds herself drawn to the facility’s newest research subject: a humanoid amphibian—for whom she is soon risking everything, amid the stifling conformity of 1960s America. A triumph of visual imagination that combines elements of sci-fi, noir, and the golden-age musical, this swooning cinematic dreamscape—winner of four Academy Awards, including Best Picture and Best Director—is a monster movie with a human heart.

hook: 韦斯·安德森以神奇的定格动画展现了一个反乌托邦的未来日本。犬类病毒爆发后，美崎的狗被流放到一个巨大的岛上垃圾场。当 Atari（勇敢的 12 岁市长监护人）出发去拯救他心爱的 Spots 时，他遇到了一群杂种朋友，并开始了一场史诗般的探索。这部关于忠诚与不服从的寓言通过由布莱恩·科兰斯顿、格蕾塔·葛韦格、杰夫·高布伦、斯嘉丽·约翰逊、小野洋子和科尤·兰金等跨文化配音演员创新性地融合了英语和日语对白，结合了安德森的标志性主题——局外人之间的友谊、叛逆的冒险——以及动画故事讲述的无限可能性。
hook_en: Wes Anderson conjures a dystopian future Japan in magical stop-motion. After a canine virus outbreak, the dogs of Megasaki are exiled to a vast island garbage dump. When Atari (the daring twelve-year-old ward of the city’s mayor) sets out to rescue his beloved Spots, he meets a pack of mongrel friends and is launched on an epic quest. Innovatively blending English and Japanese dialogue through a cross-cultural voice cast that includes Bryan Cranston, Greta Gerwig, Jeff Goldblum, Scarlett Johansson, Yoko Ono, and Koyu Rankin, this fable of loyalty and disobedience combines Anderson’s signature themes—friendship among outsiders, the adventure of rebellion—with a delight in the boundless possibilities of animated storytelling.

hook: 迈克尔·雷德格雷夫在安东尼·阿斯奎斯改编的特伦斯·拉蒂根令人难忘的戏剧中展现了他职业生涯的表演。雷德格瑞夫饰演安德鲁·克罗克·哈里斯，一位心怀怨恨的中年校长，他开始觉得自己的生活很失败。由于健康状况不佳、婚姻破裂以及学生的嘲笑，这位曾经才华横溢的学者被迫重新审视自己的生活，因为一名年轻学生提出了意想不到的善意举动。 《勃朗宁版》讲述了一个关于悔恨和赎罪的令人心碎的故事，是英国现实主义的经典之作，并荣获 1951 年戛纳电影节最佳男主角和最佳编剧奖。
hook_en: Michael Redgrave gives the performance of his career in Anthony Asquith’s adaptation of Terence Rattigan’s unforgettable play. Redgrave portrays Andrew Crocker-Harris, an embittered, middle-aged schoolmaster who begins to feel that his life has been a failure. Diminished by poor health, a crumbling marriage, and the derision of his pupils, the once brilliant scholar is compelled to reexamine his life when a young student offers an unexpected gesture of kindness. A heartbreaking story of remorse and atonement, The Browning Version is a classic of British realism and the winner of best actor and best screenplay honors at the 1951 Cannes Film Festival.

hook: 在《小小：艾琳·布莱克威尔的一生》中，导演马丁·贝尔和摄影师玛丽·艾伦·马克讲述了他们与街头智慧中最不可磨灭的主题之一三十年的关系。现在，艾琳·布莱克威尔（Erin Blackwell，又名“小小”）是一位 44 岁的十个孩子的母亲，她与马克一起回顾了他们一起经历的旅程，从布莱克威尔与毒瘾的斗争到她的遗憾，再到她对自己孩子的梦想，即使她看到他们也像她一样走上了毒品和绝望的道路。这部作品将马克三十年来的照片和镜头交织在一起，其中包括以前从未见过的《Streetwise》中的片段，这是一幅令人心碎、充满同情心的肖像，描绘了一个试图摆脱创伤循环的家庭，也是对马克这一无可替代的艺术声音一生工作的总结。
hook_en: In Tiny: The Life of Erin Blackwell, director Martin Bell and photographer Mary Ellen Mark draw on their thirty-year relationship with one of the most indelible subjects of Streetwise. Now a forty-four-year-old mother of ten, Erin Blackwell, a.k.a. Tiny, reflects with Mark on the journey they’ve experienced together, from Blackwell’s battles with addiction to her regrets to her dreams for her own children, even as she sees them being pulled down the same path of drugs and desperation that she was. Interweaving three decades’ worth of Mark’s photographs and footage that includes previously unseen outtakes from Streetwise, this is a heartrending, deeply empathetic portrait of a family trying to break free of the cycle of trauma, as well as a summation of the life’s work of Mark, an irreplaceable artistic voice.

hook: W. C. Fields的 prolific 职业使他成为滑稽喜剧的先锋。这里汇集了六部杰作，展现了这位喜剧天才的巅峰状态：《高尔夫专家》、无声版《赌王》、《药剂师》、《啤酒杯致命》、《理发店》以及当然，那部臭名昭著的《牙医》。这部独特集锦将为新一辈观众带来 Fields 的滑稽讽刺表演带来的欢笑。
hook_en: W. C. Fields’s prolific career placed him at the forefront of slapstick comedy. Gathered here are six gems that feature the comic genius at his peak: The Golf Specialist, Pool Sharks (silent), The Pharmacist, The Fatal Glass of Beer, The Barber Shop, and, of course, the notorious The Dentist. This unique collection will delight new generations of viewers with Fields’s hilariously sardonic routines.

hook: 在这个充满诗意和气氛的恐怖寓言中，故事发生在饱受战争蹂躏的中世纪日本的一个村庄里，一个恶毒的灵魂一直在撕扯流动武士的喉咙。当一名军事英雄被派去消灭看不见的力量时，他发现自己也必须与自己内心的恶魔作斗争。 《黑猫》由恐怖经典电影《鬼婆》的导演新藤兼人执导，讲述了一个令人惊叹的诡异暮光故事，以令人震惊的女权主义角度，通过幽灵般的特效和精美的摄影来唤起人们的联想。
hook_en: In this poetic and atmospheric horror fable, set in a village in war-torn medieval Japan, a malevolent spirit has been ripping out the throats of itinerant samurai. When a military hero is sent to dispatch the unseen force, he finds that he must struggle with his own personal demons as well. From Kaneto Shindo, director of the terror classic Onibaba, Kuroneko (Black Cat) is a spectacularly eerie twilight tale with a shocking feminist angle, evoked through ghostly special effects and exquisite cinematography.

hook: 阿兰·雷奈（Alain Resnais）划时代的《去年在马里昂巴德》（L'année dernière à Marienbad）不仅是法国新浪潮的标志性作品，也是现代艺术中伟大而持久的谜团之一，几十年来一直让欣赏的观众感到困惑。这部超现实的狂热梦境或噩梦由激进的新小说大师阿兰·罗伯-格里耶 (Alain Robbe-Grillet) 创作，华丽地融合了过去与现在，讲述了一个男人和一个女人（乔治·阿尔贝塔齐 (Giorgio Albertazzi) 和德尔菲娜·塞里格 (Delphine Seyrig) 饰）的暧昧故事，他们一年前可能见过面，也可能没有见过面，也许他们现在发现自己在同一座大教堂般、布满镜子的城堡里徘徊。雷奈对记忆本质的研究令人难忘，其令人困惑的细节（镀金天花板、邪恶的客厅游戏、上膛的枪）和令人难忘的瞄准镜令人不安、浪漫，甚至可能是一个鬼故事。
hook_en: Not just a defining work of the French New Wave but one of the great, lasting mysteries of modern art, Alain Resnais’ epochal Last Year at Marienbad (L’année dernière à Marienbad) has been puzzling appreciative viewers for decades. Written by radical master of the New Novel Alain Robbe-Grillet, this surreal fever dream, or nightmare, gorgeously fuses the past with the present in telling its ambiguous tale of a man and a woman (Giorgio Albertazzi and Delphine Seyrig) who may or may not have met a year ago, perhaps at the very same cathedral-like, mirror-filled château they now find themselves wandering. Unforgettable in both its confounding details (gilded ceilings, diabolical parlor games, a loaded gun) and haunting scope, Resnais’ investigation into the nature of memory is disturbing, romantic, and maybe even a ghost story.

hook: 奥斯卡最佳外语片奖和戛纳电影节金棕榈奖得主马塞尔·加缪（ Marcel Camus ）的黑俄耳甫斯（ Orfeu negro ）将古希腊神话中的俄耳甫斯（ Orpheus ）和欧律狄斯（ Eurydice ）带到了里约热内卢狂欢节的二十世纪。黑色俄耳甫斯凭借其令人眼花缭乱的摄影和令人着迷的划时代配乐，是一项国际文化活动，它开启了BOSSA NOVA热潮，在整个AM设置了高保真…
hook_en: Winner of both the Academy Award for best foreign-language film and the Cannes Film Festival’s Palme d’Or, Marcel Camus’ Black Orpheus (Orfeu negro) brings the ancient Greek myth of Orpheus and Eurydice to the twentieth-century madness of Carnival in Rio de Janeiro. With its eye-popping photography and ravishing, epochal soundtrack, Black Orpheus was an international cultural event, and it kicked off the bossa nova craze that set hi-fis across America spinning.

hook: 凭借这部突破性的电影，费德里科·费里尼 (Federico Fellini) 使自己、妻子和合作者朱丽叶塔·马西纳 (Giulietta Masina) 跻身国际明星行列，打破了他早期职业生涯的新现实主义，转而将生活视为苦乐参半的狂欢节，呈现出个人诗意的愿景。表现力无限的马西娜既表现出孩子般的惊奇，又表现出令人心碎的绝望。吉尔索米娜是旅行大力士赞帕诺（安东尼·奎因，在身体表演中表现出色）的忠实伴侣，他的冷酷和残忍逐渐耗尽了她温柔的精神。作为第一届奥斯卡最佳外语片奖得主，《拉斯特拉达》拥有寓言般的纯粹性和永恒的共鸣，至今仍然是电影中最精美动人的人类在残酷的生活中挣扎求存的景象之一。由 Criterion Collection 与电影基金会和博洛尼亚电影中心合作修复。修复资金由好莱坞外国记者协会提供。
hook_en: With this breakthrough film, Federico Fellini launched both himself and his wife and collaborator Giulietta Masina to international stardom, breaking with the neorealism of his early career in favor of a personal, poetic vision of life as a bittersweet carnival. The infinitely expressive Masina registers both childlike wonder and heartbreaking despair as Gelsomina, loyal companion to the traveling strongman Zampanò (Anthony Quinn, in a toweringly physical performance), whose callousness and brutality gradually wear down her gentle spirit. Winner of the very first Academy Award for Best Foreign-Language Film, La strada possesses the purity and timeless resonance of a fable and remains one of cinema’s most exquisitely moving visions of humanity struggling to survive in the face of life’s cruelties.Restored by the Criterion Collection in collaboration with The Film Foundation and the Cineteca di Bologna. Restoration funding provided by the Hollywood Foreign Press Association.

hook: 马蒂厄·卡索维茨凭借《La haine》席卷了电影界，以坚韧、令人不安和视觉爆炸性的方式展现了现代法国的种族和文化波动，特别是巴黎郊区的低收入郊区。文茨（文森特·卡塞尔饰）、休伯特（休伯特·孔代饰）和萨伊德（萨伊德·塔格马乌伊饰）——分别是犹太人、非洲人和阿拉伯人——在死胡同郊区的水泥环境中漫无目的地度过了自己的日子，为法国移民人口提供了人性化的面孔，他们对自己被边缘化的强烈不满慢慢酝酿，直到达到沸点。 《海涅》是一部坚韧之美的作品，是 90 年代法国电影的里程碑，也是该国持续存在的身份危机的深刻反映。
hook_en: Mathieu Kassovitz took the film world by storm with La haine, a gritty, unsettling, and visually explosive look at the racial and cultural volatility in modern-day France, specifically the low-income banlieue districts on Paris’s outskirts. Aimlessly passing their days in the concrete environs of their dead-end suburbia, Vinz (Vincent Cassel), Hubert (Hubert Koundé), and Saïd (Saïd Taghmaoui)—Jewish, African, and Arab, respectively—give human faces to France’s immigrant populations, their bristling resentment at their marginalization slowly simmering until it reaches a climactic boiling point. A work of tough beauty, La haine is a landmark of 1990s French cinema and a gripping reflection of its country’s ongoing identity crisis.

hook: 雅克·德米的水晶般的处女作催生了一个虚构的宇宙，他的许多角色都在其中生活、玩耍和相爱。这是他感触最深的电影之一，讲述了南特（德米的家乡）纵横交错的生活故事，漂浮在渴望和欲望的浪潮中。影片主角是迷人的阿努克·艾梅（Anouk Aimée），她饰演的主角是一位歌舞女歌手，她正在等待失散已久的爱人归来，却不愿意接受另一个被爱情迷住的灵魂——流浪者罗兰（马克·米歇尔饰）的崇拜。萝拉充满人情味、充满渴望且机智，她证明了伤心欲绝的人的韧性。
hook_en: Jacques Demy’s crystalline debut gave birth to the fictional universe in which so many of his characters would live, play, and love. It’s among his most profoundly felt films, a tale of crisscrossing lives in Nantes (Demy’s hometown) that floats on waves of longing and desire. Heading the film’s ensemble is the enchanting Anouk Aimée as the title character, a cabaret chanteuse who’s awaiting the return of a long-lost lover and unwilling to entertain the adoration of another love-struck soul, the wanderer Roland (Marc Michel). Humane, wistful, and witty, Lola is a testament to the resilience of the heartbroken.

hook: 让-皮埃尔·梅尔维尔凭借这部改编自纳粹占领法国期间颇具影响力的地下小说的影片开始了他精湛的故事片制作生涯。一位有教养、天真理想主义的德国军官住在一位中年男子和他成年侄女的家里；他们对他的存在的反应——他们唯一的抵抗形式——是完全的沉默。 《大海的沉默》采用优雅的极简主义风格，由传奇人物亨利·德卡以平静的口才拍摄，为梅尔维尔后来关于抵抗和占领的电影（莱昂·莫兰、《牧师》、《影子军团》）指明了方向，但它本身仍然是一部异常怪异的杰作。
hook_en: Jean-Pierre Melville began his superb feature filmmaking career with this powerful adaptation of an influential underground novel written during the Nazi occupation of France. A cultured, naively idealistic German officer is billeted in the home of a middle-aged man and his grown niece; their response to his presence—their only form of resistance—is complete silence. Constructed with elegant minimalism and shot, by the legendary Henri Decaë, with hushed eloquence, Le silence de la mer points the way toward Melville’s later films about resistance and the occupation (Leon Morin, Priest; Army of Shadows) yet remains a singularly eerie masterwork in its own right.

hook: 这部由简·特罗尔 (Jan Troell) 创作的 19 世纪中期史诗巨制，通过两部电影讲述了一个瑞典农民家庭前往美国的旅程，以及他们为在这个美丽但险恶的新世界扎根而付出的努力。电影传奇人物马克斯·冯·西多和丽芙·乌尔曼以极其真实的方式饰演卡尔·奥斯卡和克里斯蒂娜，这对夫妇在艰难的旅程中经历了一次又一次的身体和情感考验。特罗尔以精确、细致的细节描述了这对夫妇的故事——这也是无数其他跨越大西洋寻求更好生活的人的故事——令人惊叹。 《移民》和《新大陆》的每一步都引人入胜，可能是关于美国定居的最伟大的银幕剧。
hook_en: This monumental mid-nineteenth-century epic from Jan Troell charts, over the course of two films, a Swedish farming family’s voyage to America and their efforts to put down roots in this beautiful but forbidding new world. Movie legends Max von Sydow and Liv Ullmann give remarkably authentic performances as Karl Oskar and Kristina, a couple who meet with one physical and emotional trial after another on their arduous journey. The precise, minute detail with which Troell depicts the couple’s story—which is also that of countless other people who sought better lives across the Atlantic—is a wonder to behold. Engrossing at every step of the way, the duo of The Emigrants and The New Land makes for perhaps the greatest screen drama about the settling of America.

hook: 安东尼·明格拉 (Anthony Minghella) 将迈克尔·翁达杰 (Michael Ondaatje) 的获奖小说改编成了银幕上最激动人心的爱情故事之一，这部电影既吸引了文化想象力，又赢得了奥斯卡金像奖（荣获包括最佳影片在内的九项奥斯卡奖）。第二次世界大战期间，一名身份不明的男子（拉尔夫·费因斯饰）从撒哈拉一架坠毁的飞机上被救出，并在一位富有同情心的护士（朱丽叶·比诺什饰）的照顾下，他拼凑起一段让他一生震惊的事件的记忆。 《英国病人》是一部史诗般的电影，充满了罕见的智慧和细腻，深刻地反映了战争造成的障碍和爱情超越的障碍。
hook_en: Anthony Minghella transforms Michael Ondaatje’s prizewinning novel into one of the most breathtaking romances ever put on-screen, a film that captured both the cultural imagination and the Academy Awards (winning nine Oscars, including Best Picture). Rescued from a crashed plane in the Sahara during World War II, a badly burned, unidentified man (Ralph Fiennes) comes under the care of a compassionate nurse (Juliette Binoche), as he pieces together the memories of an affair that led him to a life-shaking reckoning. The English Patient is epic filmmaking of rare intelligence and delicacy, and a piercing reflection on the barriers that war creates and love transcends.

hook: 这部心理敏锐、视觉震撼的现代主义作品是导演米开朗基罗·安东尼奥尼继划时代的《冒险》之后的作品。马塞洛·马斯楚安尼 (Marcello Mastroianni) 和让娜·莫罗 (Jeanne Moreau) 饰演一位小说家和他失意的妻子，他们在一晚的时间里面对彼此之间的疏远，以及他们所周游的米兰资产阶级圈子中极其空虚的情况。安东尼奥尼 (Antonioni) 的缪斯莫妮卡·维蒂 (Monica Vitti) 扮演一位实业家迷人的女儿。忧郁感性的电影摄影和微妙表现力的表演使《夜》成为浪漫和社会堕落的不可磨灭的例证。
hook_en: This psychologically acute, visually striking modernist work was director Michelangelo Antonioni’s follow-up to the epochal L’avventura. Marcello Mastroianni and Jeanne Moreau star as a novelist and his frustrated wife, who, over the course of one night, confront their alienation from each other and the achingly empty bourgeois Milan circles in which they travel. Antonioni’s muse Monica Vitti smolders as an industrialist’s tempting daughter. Moodily sensual cinematography and subtly expressive performances make La notte an indelible illustration of romantic and social deterioration.

hook: 里奥·麦卡里的《为明天让路》是好莱坞最伟大的无名杰作之一，它对大萧条时期的家庭、衰老和代沟的挫折进行了极其感人的描写。比尤拉·邦迪 (Beulah Bondi) 和维克多·摩尔 (Victor Moore) 主演了一群无与伦比的角色演员，饰演一对老年夫妇，在银行接管他们的家后，他们必须搬去与成年的孩子住在一起，但最终却分居并受到后代自私的一时兴起的影响。这是小津安二郎的《东京物语》的灵感来源，是美国电影中最纯粹的催泪片之一，一直到其坚定的结局，麦卡里尽管面临制片厂的压力，仍拒绝改变结局。
hook_en: Make Way for Tomorrow, by Leo McCarey, is one of the great unsung Hollywood masterpieces, an enormously moving Depression-era depiction of the frustrations of family, aging, and the generation gap. Beulah Bondi and Victor Moore headline a cast of incomparable character actors, starring as an elderly couple who must move in with their grown children after the bank takes their home, yet end up separated and subject to their offspring’s selfish whims. An inspiration for Yasujiro Ozu’s Tokyo Story, this is among American cinema’s purest tearjerkers, all the way to its unflinching ending, which McCarey refused to change despite studio pressure.

hook: 《火山之下》讲述了第二次世界大战前夕，自我毁灭的英国领事杰弗里·菲尔明（阿尔伯特·芬尼，奥斯卡提名杰作）生命中的最后一天。由于酗酒，菲尔明在亡灵节期间跌跌撞撞地穿过一个墨西哥小村庄，试图与分居的妻子（杰奎琳·比塞特饰）重新建立联系，但结果却进一步疏远了自己。约翰·休斯顿雄心勃勃地演绎了马尔科姆·洛瑞这部“不适应”的巨著，为无与伦比的芬尼提供了他最伟大的角色之一，也是传奇导演《马德雷山脉的宝藏》凯旋回归墨西哥电影制作的机会。
hook_en: Under the Volcano follows the final day in the life of self-destructive British consul Geoffrey Firmin (Albert Finney, in an Oscar-nominated tour de force) on the eve of World War II. Withering from alcoholism, Firmin stumbles through a small Mexican village amidst the Day of the Dead fiesta, attempting to reconnect with his estranged wife (Jacqueline Bisset) but only further alienating himself. John Huston's ambitious tackling of Malcolm Lowry's towering “unadaptable” novel gave the incomparable Finney one of his grandest roles and was the legendary The Treasure of the Sierra Madre director's triumphant return to filmmaking in Mexico.

hook: 在《神话般的孟乔森男爵》中，卡雷尔·泽曼讲述了这位传奇的、自吹自擂的男爵的冒险经历，他旋风般的事迹将他从月球带到了十八世纪的土耳其，再到鲸鱼的肚子，甚至更远的地方。泽曼的这部电影是一部万花筒般的奇迹，将真人动作与定格动画、剪纸拼贴、木偶、彩绘背景和古董调色等技术融为一体，带来令人兴奋的视觉享受，以及对过去那个令人着迷、不存在的时代的热情回旋。
hook_en: In The Fabulous Baron Munchausen, Karel Zeman conjures the adventures of the legendary, boastful baron, whose whirlwind exploits take him from the moon to eighteenth-century Turkey to the belly of a whale and beyond. A kaleidoscopic marvel that blends live action with techniques including stop-motion, cutout collage, puppetry, painted backdrops, and antique tinting, Zeman’s film is an exhilarating visual delight and a warmhearted whirl through a bygone age too entrancing to have existed.

hook: 芭芭拉·科普尔 (Barbara Kopple) 的《美国梦》荣获奥斯卡最佳纪录片奖，详细描述了 1985-86 年明尼苏达州奥斯汀荷美尔食品公司 (Hormel Foods) 发生的动荡劳工罢工。奥斯汀本地 P-9 厌倦了危险的工厂条件和大幅削减工资，不顾上级工会的建议，在一场损害这家肉类加工巨头声誉的激进运动的帮助下，进行了近一年的罢工。但随着罢工的拖延，一些工人发现自己绝望地越过了纠察线，分裂了一个已经因封锁、骚乱和国民警卫队干预而陷入混乱的社区。继她具有里程碑意义的纪录片《美国哈伦县》之后，科普尔又从美国工人阶级的战壕中进行了另一篇毫不妥协的报道，她捕捉到了里根时代不受约束的法团主义中组织劳工最重大挫折之一所造成的人力和政治成本。
hook_en: Winner of the Best Documentary Feature Oscar, Barbara Kopple’s American Dream details the tumultuous 1985–86 labor strike against Hormel Foods in Austin, Minnesota. Fed up with dangerous plant conditions and drastic wage cuts, Austin’s Local P-9 went against the advice of its parent union and, aided by an activist campaign to damage the meatpacking giant’s reputation, conducted a nearly yearlong walkout. But as the strike dragged on, some workers found themselves desperate enough to cross the picket line, dividing a community already roiled by blockades, riots, and the intervention of the National Guard. Following up her landmark documentary Harlan County USA with another uncompromising report from the trenches of working-class America, Kopple captures the human and political costs of one of the most significant setbacks to organized labor amid the unchecked corporatism of the Reagan era.

hook: 《大卫·林奇：艺术生活》难得一睹电影界最神秘的梦想家之一的思想，为这位艺术家提供了一幅引人入胜的肖像，并与他本人进行了一次亲密接触。从他位于好莱坞山僻静的家和绘画工作室，坦率的林奇唤起了他过去的人物和地点，从他的童年到他在艺术学校的经历，再到他电影制作生涯的开始——故事的展开就像他的电影场景一样。这部由乔恩·阮 (Jon Nguyen)、里克·巴恩斯 (Rick Barnes) 和奥利维亚·尼尔加德·霍尔姆 (Olivia Neergaard-Holm) 拍摄的精彩纪录片回顾了林奇早年作为一名画家和导演时对变幻莫测的事物所着迷，同时也阐明了他对他所谓的“艺术生活”的持久承诺：“你喝咖啡，抽烟，画画，仅此而已。”
hook_en: A rare glimpse into the mind of one of cinema’s most enigmatic visionaries, David Lynch: The Art Life offers an absorbing portrait of the artist, as well as an intimate encounter with the man himself. From his secluded home and painting studio in the Hollywood Hills, a candid Lynch conjures people and places from his past, from his boyhood to his experiences at art school to the beginnings of his filmmaking career—in stories that unfold like scenes from his movies. This remarkable documentary by Jon Nguyen, Rick Barnes, and Olivia Neergaard-Holm travels back to Lynch’s early years as a painter and director drawn to the phantasmagoric, while also illuminating his enduring commitment to what he calls “the art life”: “You drink coffee, you smoke cigarettes, and you paint, and that’s it.”

hook: 卡尔·德雷尔的《愤怒​​之日》（Vredens dag）拍摄于纳粹占领丹麦期间，悲惨地讲述了个人在面对日益严重的社会镇压和偏执时的无助。安娜是一位受人尊敬但年长得多的牧师的年轻第二任妻子，当她的继子回到他们的十七世纪小村庄时，她爱上了他。超越村庄严酷的道德准则会带来灾难性的后果。精美的摄影和充满激情的表演，《愤怒之日》仍然是一次紧张而难忘的体验。
hook_en: Filmed during the Nazi occupation of Denmark, Carl Dreyer’s Day of Wrath (Vredens dag) is a harrowing account of individual helplessness in the face of growing social repression and paranoia. Anna, the young second wife of a well-respected but much older pastor, falls in love with her stepson when he returns to their small seventeenth-century village. Stepping outside the bounds of the village’s harsh moral code has disastrous results. Exquisitely photographed and passionately acted, Day of Wrath remains an intense, unforgettable experience.

hook: 当伊丽莎白女王一世要求她的宫廷炼金术士向她展示未来的英格兰时，她穿越到了 400 年前的世界末日后的荒原，那里有流浪的女孩帮派、无所不能的媒体大亨、法西斯警察、散落的污物和扭曲的性。英国传奇电影制作人德里克·贾曼 (Derek Jarman) 在《Jubilee》中将政治异议和艺术大胆融入历史与奇幻、音乐与电影实验、讽刺与愤怒、时尚与哲学的革命性融合中。凭借其不羁的朋克脾气和口号，Jubilee 汇集了当时的许多文化和音乐偶像，包括 Jordan、Toyah Willcox、Little Nell、Wayne County、Adam Ant 和 Brian Eno（以及他的第一部原创电影配乐），创造了一个真正独特、令人难忘的愿景。它超前于时代，其预测往往极其准确，是一部引人入胜的历史文献，也是一部华丽的电影艺术作品。
hook_en: When Queen Elizabeth I asks her court alchemist to show her England in the future, she’s transported 400 years to a post-apocalyptic wasteland of roving girl gangs, an all-powerful media mogul, fascistic police, scattered filth, and twisted sex. With Jubilee, legendary British filmmaker Derek Jarman channeled political dissent and artistic daring into a revolutionary blend of history and fantasy, musical and cinematic experimentation, satire and anger, fashion and philosophy. With its uninhibited punk petulance and sloganeering, Jubilee brings together many cultural and musical icons of the time, including Jordan, Toyah Willcox, Little Nell, Wayne County, Adam Ant, and Brian Eno (with his first original film score), to create a genuinely unique, unforgettable vision. Ahead of its time and often frighteningly accurate in its predictions, it is a fascinating historical document and a gorgeous work of film art.

hook: 在 20 世纪 40 年代的密西西比三角洲，两个农业家庭——其中一个是白人地主，一个是黑人佃农——在第二次世界大战的动乱和南方黑人种族歧视的仇恨中挣扎求存，被他们所共有的无情的土壤所束缚。每个家庭都会派出一名年轻人去打仗；当他们带着伤痕累累地回到家并找到共同的纽带时，社区就被撕裂了。编剧兼导演迪·里斯与联合编剧维吉尔·威廉姆斯共同打造了一部独特的美国悲剧，为痛苦的历史现实注入了永恒的力量。 《泥土之界》改编自希拉里·乔丹的小说，由里斯的演员阵容（包括凯瑞·穆里根、玛丽·J·布莱姬、杰森·米切尔、罗布·摩根、加内特·赫德兰、杰森·克拉克和乔纳森·班克斯）倾情演绎，并以雷切尔·莫里森的暗黑摄影为背景，是一部关于遗产的灼热人文主义研究。
hook_en: In the Mississippi Delta of the 1940s, two farming families—one of white landholders, one of Black tenant farmers—are bound by the unforgiving soil they share as they struggle to survive amid the upheavals of World War II and the poisonous hatred of the Jim Crow South. Each family sends a young man off to battle; when they return home, scarred, and find a common bond, the community is ripped apart. Writer-director Dee Rees, with cowriter Virgil Williams, crafts a uniquely American tragedy, imbuing bitter historical realities with a timeless weight. Featuring bone-deep performances from Rees’s ensemble cast—including Carey Mulligan, Mary J. Blige, Jason Mitchell, Rob Morgan, Garrett Hedlund, Jason Clarke, and Jonathan Banks—and backed by Rachel Morrison’s darkly burnished cinematography, Mudbound is a searing humanist study of inheritance, based upon Hillary Jordan’s novel.

hook: 英格丽·褒曼饰演一位富有、自私的罗马社交名流，她因年幼儿子的惊人死亡而深感愧疚。作为应对悲伤和寻找生活意义的一种方式，她决定将时间和金钱奉献给这座城市的穷人和病人。她新发现的、一心一意的激进主义导致了她与丈夫的冲突以及人们对她理智的质疑。罗西里尼认为，激烈且经常被忽视的《欧洲 51》是从女性角度重述了他自己的《圣弗朗西斯之花》。这部毫不掩饰政治但又敏感地对现代圣徒身份进行的调查是导演最喜欢的电影。
hook_en: Ingrid Bergman plays a wealthy, self-absorbed Rome socialite racked by guilt over the shocking death of her young son. As a way of dealing with her grief and finding meaning in her life, she decides to devote her time and money to the city’s poor and sick. Her newfound, single-minded activism leads to conflicts with her husband and questions about her sanity. The intense, often overlooked Europe ’51 was, according to Rossellini, a retelling of his own The Flowers of St. Francis from a female perspective. This unabashedly political but sensitively conducted investigation of modern sainthood was the director’s favorite of his films.

hook: 卡罗尔·里德的《开往慕尼黑的夜行列车》是一部曲折、转弯、隐秘的欢乐，将喜剧、浪漫和惊险轻松地融为一体。 《夜行列车》的节奏就像失控的火车头，带领观众踏上从布拉格到英国再到瑞士阿尔卑斯山的旅程，纳粹追捕一名捷克科学家和他的女儿（玛格丽特·洛克伍德饰），而他们得到了雷克斯·哈里森饰演的温文尔雅的英国卧底特工的帮助。这部引人入胜、长期被忽视的冒险游戏由保罗·亨里德 (Paul Henreid) 主演，弗兰克·朗德 (Frank Launder) 和西德尼·吉利亚特 (Sidney Gilliat) 撰写了巧妙的剧本，西德尼·吉利亚特因创作阿尔弗雷德·希区柯克 (Alfred Hitchcock) 的《消失的女士》而闻名，是一款巧妙炮制的间谍游戏，可以与悬疑大师一较高下。
hook_en: Carol Reed’s Night Train to Munich is a twisting, turning, cloak-and-dagger delight, combining comedy, romance, and thrills with the greatest of ease. Paced like an out-of-control locomotive, Night Train takes viewers on a journey from Prague to England to the Swiss Alps as Nazis pursue a Czech scientist and his daughter (Margaret Lockwood), who are being aided by a debonair British undercover agent, played by Rex Harrison. This captivating, long-overlooked adventure—which features Paul Henreid and a clever screenplay by Frank Launder and Sidney Gilliat, best known for writing Alfred Hitchcock’s The Lady Vanishes—is a deftly concocted spy game that could give the Master of Suspense a run for his money.

hook: 在一个尘土飞扬、人烟稀少的加利福尼亚州度假小镇，天真的南方流浪者平基·罗丝（茜茜·斯派塞克饰）崇拜她的护士同事、自以为成熟、“彻底现代”的米莉·拉莫罗（雪莉·杜瓦尔饰），并与她成为朋友。当米莉接纳萍琪作为她的室友时，萍琪的英雄崇拜演变成一种比两人预想的更加奇怪和险恶的东西。罗伯特·奥尔特曼这部梦幻般的杰作以斯派塞克和杜瓦尔的精彩表演为特色，从幽默到令人毛骨悚然，再到超现实，成为 20 世纪 70 年代最不寻常、最引人注目的电影之一。
hook_en: In a dusty, underpopulated California resort town, a naive southern waif, Pinky Rose (Sissy Spacek), idolizes and befriends her fellow nurse, the would-be sophisticate and “thoroughly modern” Millie Lammoreaux (Shelley Duvall). When Millie takes Pinky in as her roommate, Pinky’s hero worship evolves into something far stranger and more sinister than either could have anticipated. Featuring brilliant performances from Spacek and Duvall, this dreamlike masterpiece from Robert Altman careens from the humorous to the chilling to the surreal, resulting in one of the most unusual and compelling films of the 1970s.

hook: 罗伯托·罗西里尼和英格丽·褒曼的首次合作以美丽而险峻的火山岛为背景，以毁灭性的方式描绘了一位女性的生存危机。第二次世界大战后，立陶宛难民（伯格曼饰）与她在战俘营中认识的一位朴素的意大利渔民（马里奥·维塔莱饰）结婚，并陪伴他回到西西里岛海岸附近岛屿上的偏僻村庄。与世隔绝的她发现自己在情感上崩溃了，但她注定会获得戏剧性的顿悟。斯特龙博利平衡了导演标志性的新现实主义——这里对渔民生活和工作的精彩描绘——与感人至深的情节剧相结合，是一种启示。
hook_en: The first collaboration between Roberto Rossellini and Ingrid Bergman is a devastating portrait of a woman’s existential crisis, set against the beautiful and forbidding backdrop of a volcanic island. After World War II, a Lithuanian refugee (Bergman) marries a simple Italian fisherman (Mario Vitale) she meets in a prisoner of war camp and accompanies him back to his isolated village on an island off the coast of Sicily. Cut off from the world, she finds herself crumbling emotionally, but she is destined for a dramatic epiphany. Balancing the director’s trademark neorealism—exemplified here in a remarkable depiction of the fishermen’s lives and work—with deeply felt melodrama, Stromboli is a revelation.

hook: 康斯坦斯·彼得森博士（英格丽·褒曼饰）是一位对人性有着深刻理解的精神科医生——至少她是这么认为的。当神秘的安东尼·爱德华兹博士（格利高里·派克饰）成为她所在机构的新任幕僚长时，书呆子气、冷漠的康斯坦斯陷入了错综复杂的身份和狂热的精神分析的旋风中，其中最大的风险就是坠入爱河。 《着迷》是一个充满紧张刺激和惊人意象的超凡爱情故事，是希区柯克的经典之作，具有令人惊叹的表演、米克洛斯·罗兹萨 (Miklos Rozsa) 获得奥斯卡奖的配乐以及超现实主义偶像萨尔瓦多·达利 (Salvador Dalí) 的迷人梦境片段。
hook_en: Dr. Constance Petersen (Ingrid Bergman) is a psychiatrist with a firm understanding of human nature—or so she thinks. When the mysterious Dr. Anthony Edwardes (Gregory Peck) becomes the new chief of staff at her institution, the bookish and detached Constance plummets into a whirlwind of tangled identities and feverish psychoanalysis, where the greatest risk is to fall in love. A transcendent love story replete with taut excitement and startling imagery, Spellbound is classic Hitchcock, featuring stunning performances, an Academy Award®-winning score by Miklos Rozsa, and a captivating dream sequence by Surrealist icon Salvador Dalí.

hook: 演员保罗·达诺的导演处女作展现了非凡智慧和克制的电影制作天赋。这部由达诺和佐伊·卡赞改编自理查德·福特的小说的这部精心描绘的危机中的美国核心家庭的电影，描绘了 20 世纪 60 年代蒙大拿州一个家庭中形成的裂痕，当时父亲和养家糊口的人（杰克·吉伦哈尔饰）突然离开去扑灭附近肆虐的森林大火，留下焦躁不安的妻子（凯瑞·穆里根，表现出无所畏惧的情感诚实）和十几岁的儿子（艾德·奥克森博尔德饰）来挑衅。了碎片。 《野生动物》以深刻的人性视角审视了妇女解放前时代女性走向自我实现的任性旅程，并以敏锐的观察力和童心的成长故事，深刻地揭示了家庭运作、破裂和寻找出路的复杂方式。
hook_en: The directorial debut of actor Paul Dano reveals a filmmaking talent of remarkable intelligence and restraint. Adapted by Dano and Zoe Kazan from the novel by Richard Ford, this meticulously crafted portrait of the American nuclear family in crisis charts the rift that forms within a 1960s Montana household when the father and breadwinner (Jake Gyllenhaal) abruptly departs to fight the forest fires raging nearby, leaving his restless wife (Carey Mulligan, in a performance of fearless emotional honesty) and teenage son (Ed Oxenbould) to pick up the pieces. A deeply human look at a woman’s wayward journey toward self-fulfillment in the pre-women’s-liberation era and a sensitively observed, child’s-eye coming-of-age tale, Wildlife poignantly illuminates the complex ways in which families function, fall apart, and find their way.

hook: 米拉·奈尔 (Mira Nair) 的《密西西比马沙拉》将印度、乌干达和美国南部充满活力的文化融为一体，以明亮的视角展现了现代大熔炉中爱情的复杂性。二十多岁的米娜（萨里塔·乔杜里饰）在密西西比州的一家印第安人经营的汽车旅馆里打扫房间。当她爱上迷人的黑人地毯清洁工德米特里厄斯（丹泽尔华盛顿饰）时，他们充满激情的浪漫挑战了双方家庭的偏见，并暴露了该地区印第安人和非裔美国人社区之间的裂痕。奈尔以慷慨的幽默和敏锐的洞察力解决了种族主义、肤色歧视、文化冲突和流离失所等棘手问题，为爱的力量提供了甜蜜、性感和令人深感满意的庆祝。
hook_en: The vibrant cultures of India, Uganda, and the American South come together in Mira Nair’s Mississippi Masala, a luminous look at the complexities of love in the modern melting pot. Years after her Indian family was forced to flee their home in Uganda by the dictatorship of Idi Amin, twentysomething Mina (Sarita Choudhury) spends her days cleaning rooms in an Indian-run motel in Mississippi. When she falls for the charming Black carpet cleaner Demetrius (Denzel Washington), their passionate romance challenges the prejudices of both of their families and exposes the rifts between the region’s Indian and African American communities. Tackling thorny issues of racism, colorism, culture clash, and displacement with bighearted humor and keen insight, Nair serves up a sweet, sexy, and deeply satisfying celebration of love’s power.

hook: 这是反传统导演卢奇诺·维斯康蒂 (Luchino Visconti) 最具野蛮颠覆性的电影，采用疯狂风格化情节剧的机制来描绘纳粹主义对灵魂的彻底腐败。希特勒上台后，富有的实业家冯·埃森贝克家族及其同伙——包括诡计多端的社会攀登者弗里德里希（德克·博加德饰）、纵容的女族长索菲（英格丽·图林饰）和残酷离经叛道的继承人马丁（赫尔穆特·伯杰，在他的突破性角色中令人印象深刻地扮演了玛琳·黛德丽那样的变装）——陷入了自我毁灭的颓废螺旋，他们在争夺权力、争夺家族企业和互相争夺权力时，充满了贪婪、变态和彻头彻尾的仇恨。精彩的表演和维斯康蒂对特艺色彩的可怕的表现主义运用，让人联想到一个腐朽的富裕的华而不实的世界，在这个世界中，一个家庭的没落就代表着一个国家道德的腐朽。
hook_en: The most savagely subversive film by the iconoclastic auteur Luchino Visconti employs the mechanics of deliriously stylized melodrama to portray Nazism’s total corruption of the soul. In the wake of Hitler’s ascent to power, the wealthy industrialist von Essenbeck family and their associates—including the scheming social climber Friedrich (Dirk Bogarde), the conniving matriarch Sophie (Ingrid Thulin), and the cruelly deviant heir Martin (Helmut Berger, memorably donning Marlene Dietrich–like drag in his breakthrough role)—descend into a self-destructive spiral of decadence, greed, perversion, and all-consuming hatred as they vie for power, over the family business and over one another. The heightened performances and Visconti’s luridly expressionistic use of Technicolor conjure a garish world of decaying opulence in which one family’s downfall comes to stand for the moral rot of a nation.

hook: 剧作家兼编剧哈罗德·品特 (Harold Pinter) 改编自伊恩·麦克尤恩 (Ian McEwan) 广受好评的小说，将他标志性的令人不安的对话和令人毛骨悚然的威胁气氛融入到这部引人入胜的研究中，探讨了权力、控制以及快乐与痛苦之间令人恐惧的细微界限。鲁珀特·艾弗雷特和娜塔莎·理查森是猎物，一对美丽的英国夫妇在威尼斯度假时正在努力维持他们的关系；克里斯托弗·沃肯 (Christopher Walken) 和海伦·米伦 (Helen Mirren) 是猎人，他们将他们引入了他们华丽的旧世界宫殿的险恶网络。电影摄影师但丁·斯皮诺蒂优雅的滑动跟踪镜头、安吉洛·巴达拉门蒂的华丽配乐、以及保罗·施拉德精心控制的方向，上演了一场令人不安的施虐受虐式诱惑，充满了华丽的恐惧气氛，他编排了一段持续的色情和情感紧张的令人着迷的四人舞。
hook_en: Adapting the acclaimed novel by Ian McEwan, playwright and screenwriter Harold Pinter lends his trademark unnerving dialogue and air of creeping menace to this spellbinding study of power, control, and the frighteningly thin line between pleasure and pain. Rupert Everett and Natasha Richardson are the prey, a beautiful British couple working on their relationship while on holiday in Venice; Christopher Walken and Helen Mirren are the hunters who draw them into the sinister web of their opulent, old-world palazzo. What plays out is an unsettling, sado­masochistic seduction imbued with an atmosphere of sumptuous dread by the elegantly gliding tracking shots of cinematographer Dante Spinotti, lush score by Angelo Badalamenti, and carefully controlled direction of Paul Schrader, who choreographs a mesmerizing pas de quatre of sustained erotic and emotional tension.

hook: 这是有史以来最接近神秘爵士乐梦想家塞隆尼斯·蒙克 (Thelonious Monk) 的胶片相机，这幅亲密的肖像揭示了辉煌而复杂的生活的角落。 《Thelonious Monk Straight，No Chaser》由 Direct Cinema 先驱 Charlotte Zwerin 根据 1960 年代珍贵的档案素材精心制作，捕捉了这位钢琴家、作曲家和波普创新者在台上和台下罕见的、毫无防备的时刻，揭示了他古怪而复杂的个性。这部爵士乐历史的重要片段与蒙克的艺术创作一样具有自由的精神，是对二十世纪最具革命性的艺术家之一的堂吉诃德式世界的独特一瞥。
hook_en: The closest a film camera ever got to enigmatic jazz visionary Thelonious Monk, this intimate portrait sheds light on the corners of a brilliant and complex life. Superbly crafted by Direct Cinema pioneer Charlotte Zwerin from a trove of precious 1960s archival footage, Thelonious Monk Straight, No Chaser captures the pianist, composer, and bebop innovator in rare, unguarded moments on- and offstage, revealing an eccentric and complicated personality. Made with the same freedom of spirit that defines Monk’s artistry, this essential slice of jazz history is a unique glimpse into the quixotic world of one of the twentieth century’s most revolutionary artists.

hook: 热拉尔·德帕迪约和沃伊切赫·普佐尼亚克主演了安杰伊·瓦伊达，这部作品有力而亲密地描绘了朴实、人民的乔治·丹东和冷酷的雅各宾派极端分子马克西米连·罗伯斯庇尔之间的意识形态冲突，他们都是法国大革命的关键人物。通过与波兰的“团结”运动进行类比，波兰的“团结”运动在电影投入制作时被政府镇压，瓦依达将历史拖到了现在。丹顿细致而热情，被誉为有史以来最伟大的恐怖电影之一。
hook_en: Gérard Depardieu and Wojciech Pszoniak star in Andrzej Wajda’s powerful, intimate depiction of the ideological clash between the earthy, man-of-the-people Georges Danton and icy Jacobin extremist Maximilien Robespierre, both key figures of the French Revolution. By drawing parallels to Polish “solidarity,” a movement that was being quashed by the government as the film went into production, Wajda drags history into the present. Meticulous and fiery, Danton has been hailed as one of the greatest films ever made about the Terror.

hook: 这部获得奥斯卡奖提名的黑色喜剧将情节剧与怪诞闹剧融为一体，是佩德罗·阿莫多瓦在国际上的突破，并奠定了他在现代西班牙电影先锋地位的地位。 《濒临崩溃边缘的女人》继续作者对女性心灵的探索，讲述了佩帕（由导演的经常合作者卡门·莫拉饰演）的故事，在情人离开她后，她决定用一批加了安眠药的西班牙凉菜汤自杀。幸运的是，她被一系列美妙而混乱的事件打断了。这位电影制作人将好莱坞的灵感融入了自己独特的视野中，形成了不敬的幽默和充满活力的视觉感，定义了他今天的作品。这部电影拥有安东尼奥·班德拉斯和罗西·德·帕尔马等出色的演员阵容，展现了一位艺术家对自己技艺的完全掌控。
hook_en: Melding melodrama with screwball farce, this Academy Award–nominated black comedy was Pedro Almodóvar’s international breakthrough and secured his place at the vanguard of modern Spanish cinema. Continuing the auteur’s exploration of the female psyche, Women on the Verge of a Nervous Breakdown tells the story of Pepa—played by the director’s frequent collaborator Carmen Maura—who resolves to kill herself with a batch of sleeping-pill-laced gazpacho after her lover leaves her. Fortunately, she is interrupted by a deliciously chaotic series of events. The filmmaker channeled Hollywood inspiration into his own unique vision, arriving at the irreverent humor and vibrant visual sense that define his work today. With an exceptional ensemble cast that also includes Antonio Banderas and Rossy de Palma, this film shows an artist in total control of his craft.

hook: 这部由导演尼古拉斯·罗伊格执导、改编自特里·约翰逊戏剧的引人入胜且极具视觉创意的作品，四个长相和声音都很像阿尔伯特·爱因斯坦、玛丽莲·梦露、乔·迪马吉奥和约瑟夫·麦卡锡的无名人物聚集在纽约市的一间酒店房间里。罗伊格将奇思妙想与恐惧结合在一起，创造了一幅五十年代美国的游乐场镜子形象，以反思名人的本质和挥之不去的冷战核噩梦。 《无足轻重》是一部疯狂而智慧的戏剧，由迈克尔·埃米尔饰演的教授、特里萨·拉塞尔饰演的女演员、加里·布塞饰演的棒球运动员和托尼·柯蒂斯饰演的参议员的精彩表演为特色。
hook_en: Four unnamed people who look and sound a lot like Albert Einstein, Marilyn Monroe, Joe DiMaggio, and Joseph McCarthy converge in one New York City hotel room in this compelling, visually inventive adaptation of Terry Johnson’s play, from director Nicolas Roeg. With a combination of whimsy and dread, Roeg creates a fun-house-mirror image of fifties America in order to reflect on the nature of celebrity and lingering cold-war nuclear nightmares. Insignificance is a delirious, intelligent drama, featuring magnetic performances by Michael Emil as the Professor, Theresa Russell as the Actress, Gary Busey as the Ballplayer, and Tony Curtis as the Senator.

hook: 克劳德·朗兹曼 (Claude Lanzmann) 这部长达九个多小时的作品经过十多年的创作，对难以想象的事件进行了一次里程碑式的调查：超过 600 万犹太人被纳粹杀害。朗兹曼没有使用档案镜头，而是专注于第一人称证词（幸存者和前纳粹分子以及其他证人），采用循环、自由联想的方法来组装它们。 《浩劫》既充满智慧，又充满情感，不是一部挖掘过去的电影，而是对过去始终存在的方式的深入描绘，毫无疑问，它是有史以来最重要的电影作品之一。
hook_en: Over a decade in the making, Claude Lanzmann’s nine-hour-plus opus is a monumental investigation of the unthinkable: the murder of more than six million Jews by the Nazis. Using no archival footage, Lanzmann instead focuses on first-person testimonies (of survivors and former Nazis, as well as other witnesses), employing a circular, free-associative method in assembling them. The intellectual yet emotionally overwhelming Shoah is not a film about excavating the past but an intensive portrait of the ways in which the past is always present, and it is inarguably one of the most important cinematic works of all time.

hook: 艾伦·鲁道夫 (Alan Rudolph) 的浪漫霓虹灯梦，对人类欲望奥秘的喜剧和剪裁探索，使他成为 20 世纪 80 年代最大胆、最独特的独立导演之一。在烟雾弥漫的夏娃休息室，一群陌生人——包括缺乏安全感的广播性专家（吉纳维芙·布约德饰）、害怕承诺的前性工作者（莱斯利·安·沃伦饰）和周游世界的神秘男子（基思·卡拉丁饰）——陷入了一张充满激情、嫉妒和自我发现的网络。 《选择我》以泰迪·潘德格拉斯 (Teddy Pendergrass) 性感的慢速即兴即兴音乐的节奏为节奏，以自己另类的波长存在——棘手、令人惊讶，并在其对被爱情伤害的迷失灵魂的愿景中深深地温柔，但仍然伸手寻求人与人之间的联系。
hook_en: An achingly romantic neon dream, Alan Rudolph’s comic and cutting exploration of the mysteries of human desire established him as one of the most boldly idiosyncratic independent auteurs of the 1980s. At the smoky dive Eve’s Lounge, a collection of strangers—including an insecure radio sexpert (Geneviève Bujold), a commitment-phobic former sex worker (Lesley Ann Warren), and a globe-trotting mystery man (Keith Carradine)—become entangled in a web of passion, jealousy, and self-discovery. Grooving to the rhythms of Teddy Pendergrass’s sexy slow jams, Choose Me exists on its own offbeat wavelength—knotty, surprising, and deeply tender in its vision of lost souls wounded by love yet still reaching out for human connection.

hook: 特立独行的编剧兼导演伊丹十三三在这部欢快又充满渴望的第一部长片中讲述了日本风格的死亡。在她好色的父亲突然去世后，一位成功的演员（伊丹的妻子和经常合作的宫本信子）和她的丈夫（山崎努）离开东京，回到他们的家中主持传统的葬礼。在三天的哀悼过程中，发生了在树林里的非法越轨行为、令人惊讶的唯物主义牧师（小津安二郎的常客龙智州饰），以及电影中最史诗般的三明治交接，公共礼节和私人虚伪之间的紧张关系暴露无遗。 《葬礼》巧妙地将黑色喜剧与辛酸的家庭剧交织在一起，无畏地讽刺了日本社会新旧之间的冲突，在这个社会中，没有什么是禁止的，甚至包括死亡的结局。
hook_en: It’s death, Japanese style, in the rollicking and wistful first feature from maverick writer-director Juzo Itami. In the wake of her lascivious father’s sudden passing, a successful actor (Itami’s wife and frequent collaborator, Nobuko Miyamoto) and her husband (Tsutomu Yamazaki) leave Tokyo and return to their family house to oversee a traditional funeral. Over the course of three days of mourning that bring illicit escapades in the woods, a surprisingly materialistic priest (Yasujiro Ozu regular Chishu Ryu), and cinema’s most epic sandwich handoff, the tensions between public propriety and private hypocrisy are laid bare. Deftly weaving dark comedy with poignant family drama, The Funeral is a fearless satire of the clash between old and new in Japanese society in which nothing, not even the finality of death, is off-limits.

hook: 西雅图，1983 年。电影制片人马丁·贝尔、摄影师玛丽·艾伦·马克和记者谢丽尔·麦考尔带着相机来到了这座被认为是美国最宜居城市的街道上，开始讲述社会留下的故事：生活在城市边缘的无家可归和离家出走的青少年。 《街头智慧》诞生于马克和麦考尔在《生活》杂志上的曝光，讲述了一群令人难忘的高危儿童的故事，其中包括意志坚强的十四岁小蒂尼，他后来成为该项目中最令人难以忘怀和最持久的人物，还有好斗但足智多谋的老鼠和和蔼可亲的流浪者德维恩，他们被逐出破碎的家庭，靠乞讨、乞讨和垃圾箱潜水生存。电影制片人获得了进入他们的世界的非凡机会，以极其坦率、富有同情心的方式描绘了一群迷失的年轻人在一个令他们失望的世界中过早成长的故事。
hook_en: Seattle, 1983. Taking their camera to the streets of what was supposedly America’s most livable city, filmmaker Martin Bell, photographer Mary Ellen Mark, and journalist Cheryl McCall set out to tell the stories of those society had left behind: homeless and runaway teenagers living on the city’s margins. Born from a Life magazine exposé by Mark and McCall, Streetwise follows an unforgettable group of at-risk children—including iron-willed fourteen-year-old Tiny, who would become the project’s most haunting and enduring figure, along with the pugnacious yet resourceful Rat and the affable drifter Dewayne—who, driven from their broken homes, survive by hustling, panhandling, and dumpster diving. Granted remarkable access to their world, the filmmakers craft a devastatingly frank, empathetic portrait of lost youth growing up far too soon in a world that has failed them.

hook: 国际著名海洋学家史蒂夫·齐苏（比尔·默里饰）和他的团队齐苏团队启航，去追捕神秘、难以捉摸、甚至可能根本不存在的美洲豹鲨，正是在他们最新的冒险纪录片拍摄过程中，美洲豹鲨杀死了齐苏的搭档。与他们一起航行的还有年轻的航空公司副驾驶（欧文·威尔逊饰）、怀孕的记者（凯特·布兰切特饰）和齐苏分居的妻子（安杰丽卡·休斯顿饰）。韦斯·安德森为这部原创冒险喜剧集结了全明星阵容，其中还包括威廉·达福、杰夫·高布伦、迈克尔·刚本、诺亚·泰勒、苏·豪尔赫和巴德·科特。
hook_en: Internationally famous oceanographer Steve Zissou (Bill Murray) and his crew, Team Zissou, set sail on an expedition to hunt down the mysterious, elusive, possibly nonexistent Jaguar Shark that killed Zissou’s partner during the documentary filming of their latest adventure. They are joined on their voyage by a young airline copilot (Owen Wilson), a pregnant journalist (Cate Blanchett), and Zissou’s estranged wife (Anjelica Huston). Wes Anderson has assembled an all-star cast that also includes Willem Dafoe, Jeff Goldblum, Michael Gambon, Noah Taylor, Seu Jorge, and Bud Cort for this wildly original adventure-comedy.

hook: 法国大师罗伯特·布列松在其冷酷而清醒的最后一部电影中，将他独特的精神沉思与形式严谨的融合推向了一个新的严谨水平。 《银色》将托尔斯泰的中篇小说搬到当代巴黎，讲述了一张假钞的故事，它最初是一个男生恶作剧的道具，然后像病毒一样在腐败和正直的人中传播，最后与一名年轻的卡车司机发生冲突，导致他被监禁和暴力。布列松通过残酷的经济手段，从鲜明的感知细节中构建了他对原罪的无情愿景，将他的人物扎根于一个非人性的物质世界，不抱任何超越的希望。
hook_en: In his ruthlessly clear-eyed final film, French master Robert Bresson pushed his unique blend of spiritual rumination and formal rigor to a new level of astringency. Transposing a Tolstoy novella to contemporary Paris, L’argent follows a counterfeit bill as it originates as a prop in a schoolboy prank, then circulates like a virus among the corrupt and the virtuous alike before landing with a young truck driver and leading him to incarceration and violence. With brutal economy, Bresson constructs his unforgiving vision of original sin out of starkly perceived details, rooting his characters in a dehumanizing material world that withholds any hope of transcendence.

hook: 这部抒情的改编自谷崎润一郎深受喜爱的小说，是导演市川昆晚年职业生涯的一次胜利。 《牧冈姐妹》（佐雨由纪）以季节变化为背景，讲述了太平洋战争前几年，四兄弟的生活，他们接手了家族的和服制造业务。两个大姐已经结婚有一段时间了，但根据传统，叛逆的小妹妹必须等到保守又害羞的老三找到丈夫后才能结婚。这部对处于历史转折点的家庭的优雅研究，以丰富、生动的色彩拍摄，深刻地唤起了时代的变迁和日渐衰落的习俗。
hook_en: This lyrical adaptation of the beloved novel by Junichiro Tanizaki was a late-career triumph for director Kon Ichikawa. Structured around the changing of the seasons, The Makioka Sisters (Sasame-yuki) follows the lives of four siblings who have taken on their family’s kimono manufacturing business, in the years leading up to the Pacific War. The two oldest have been married for some time, but according to tradition, the rebellious youngest sister cannot wed until the third, conservative and terribly shy, finds a husband. This graceful study of a family at a turning point in history is a poignant evocation of changing times and fading customs, shot in rich, vivid colors.

hook: 近五年来，著名的德国导演沃纳·赫尔佐格拼命地试图完成他职业生涯中最雄心勃勃、最困难的项目之一：《菲茨卡拉多》，讲述了一个人试图在亚马逊丛林深处建造一座歌剧院的故事。纪录片导演莱斯·布兰克捕捉到了这部作品的展开过程，赫尔佐格决定在没有模型或特效的情况下拍摄最令人畏惧的场景，这使得这部作品变得更加危险，其中包括需要数百名土著当地人拉着一艘全尺寸的 320 吨轮船越过一座小山的镜头。其成果是对电影制作过程的非凡记录，并对电影界最无畏的导演之一的一心一意的使命进行了独特的审视。
hook_en: For nearly five years, acclaimed German director Werner Herzog desperately tried to complete one of the most ambitious and difficult projects of his career­: Fitzcarraldo, the story of one man’s attempt to build an opera house deep in the Amazon jungle. Documentary filmmaker Les Blank captured the unfolding of this production, made more perilous by Herzog’s determination to shoot the most daunting scenes without models or special effects, including a sequence requiring hundreds of Indigenous locals to pull a full-size 320-ton steamship over a small mountain. The result is an extraordinary document of the filmmaking process and a unique look into the single-minded mission of one of cinema’s most fearless directors.

hook: 雷纳·沃纳·法斯宾德的最后一部电影源自两位反传统酷儿艺术家的邪恶相遇，大胆地将让·热内备受争议的小说提升到了神话的高度。在表现主义的法国海港小镇的摄影棚中——沐浴在火热的色调中，并配有阳具般的尖塔——一名身材魁梧的水手和顽固不化的罪犯（布拉德·戴维斯饰）登上岸边，在卷入他轨道的性欲居民中激起了激情、竞争和暴力。奎雷尔发现法斯宾德将他打破禁忌的同性恋欲望描述推向了疯狂的极端。
hook_en: Conjured from the unholy meeting of two iconoclastic queer artists, Rainer Werner Fassbinder’s final film audaciously raises Jean Genet’s controversial novel to the level of myth. In an expressionistic soundstage vision of a French seaport town—bathed in fiery hues and complete with phallic spires—a strapping sailor and unrepentant criminal (Brad Davis) comes ashore to arouse passion, rivalry, and violence among the libidinal denizens drawn into his orbit. Enacted with dreamlike stylization by a cast of international stars, including Jeanne Moreau and Franco Nero, Querelle finds Fassbinder pushing his taboo-shattering depiction of gay desire to delirious extremes.

hook: 赫克托·巴班科 (Héctor Babenco) 的《皮克斯特》(Pixote) 在国际上大获成功，融合了严酷的现实主义和痛苦的人性，以令人震惊的方式讲述了巴西社会底层年轻人为生存而奋斗的故事，并对该国的军事独裁和警察提出了尖锐的控诉。在一场令人心碎的表演中，费尔南多·拉莫斯·达席尔瓦扮演了一个小男孩，他逃离了噩梦般的感化院，结果却过上了暴力犯罪的生活，尽管他与一些被遗弃的同伴组成了一个临时家庭。
hook_en: With a blend of harsh realism and aching humanity, Héctor Babenco’s international breakout Pixote offers an electrifying look at youth fighting to survive on the bottom rung of Brazilian society, and a stinging indictment of the country’s military dictatorship and police. In a heartbreaking performance, Fernando Ramos da Silva plays a young boy who escapes a nightmarish reformatory only to resort to a life of violent crime, even as he forms a makeshift family with some fellow outcasts.

hook: 弗朗切斯科·罗西根据画家、医生和政治活动家卡洛·莱维的回忆录进行了精彩的改编，这是一首流亡挽歌，是对贝尼托·墨索里尼统治时期意大利乡村世界的史诗般的沉浸，以安静的优雅和庄严的美丽，将一座二十世纪自传的丰碑搬上银幕。利维（吉安·玛丽亚·沃隆特饰）因反法西斯观点而被流放到一个荒凉的南方小镇，他发现了一个他从未知道的意大利，一个古老的民俗和迷信仍然盛行的地方，这逐渐改变了他对自己和国家的理解。 《基督停在埃博利》首次在家庭录像中以原版全长、四部分的形式呈现，深刻地思考了意大利社会内部的政治和哲学裂痕——南北之间、传统与现代、法西斯主义与自由之间——以及超越一切的基本人性。
hook_en: An elegy of exile and an epic immersion in the world of rural Italy during the regime of Benito Mussolini, Francesco Rosi’s sublime adaptation of the memoirs of the painter, physician, and political activist Carlo Levi brings a monument of twentieth-century autobiography to the screen with quiet grace and solemn beauty. Banished to a desolate southern town for his anti-Fascist views, Levi (Gian Maria Volontè) discovers an Italy he never knew existed, a place where ancient folkways and superstitions still hold sway, and that gradually transforms his understanding of both himself and his country. Presented for the first time on home video in its original full-length, four-part version, Christ Stopped at Eboli ruminates profoundly on the political and philosophical rifts within Italian society—between North and South, tradition and modernity, Fascism and freedom—and the essential humanity that transcends all.

hook: 榎木岩男（绪方健饰）是一名小偷、杀人犯和迷人的女性杀手，正在躲避警方的追捕。导演今村翔平将这个基于事实的故事——讲述了一个来自虔诚天主教家庭的冷酷无情的男人长达七十八天的疯狂杀戮——变成了对原始与现代共存的冷酷、反常、有时甚至是恶魔般滑稽的审视。 《我的复仇》不仅仅是一个真实的犯罪故事，它还揭露了人类咆哮的本我。
hook_en: A thief, a murderer, and a charming lady-killer, Iwao Enokizu (Ken Ogata) is on the run from the police. Director Shohei Imamura turns this fact-based story—about the seventy-eight-day killing spree of a remorseless man from a devoutly Catholic family—into a cold, perverse, and at times diabolically funny examination of the primitive coexisting with the modern. More than just a true-crime tale, Vengeance Is Mine bares humanity’s snarling id.

hook: 具有开创性的琼·米克林·西尔弗（Joan Micklin Silver）是 20 世纪 70 年代为数不多的为好莱坞大型制片厂执导电影的女性之一，她在这部反浪漫喜剧中无畏地挖掘了一段棘手关系的心理，该喜剧改编自安·贝蒂的畅销小说，讲述了失恋的公务员查尔斯（约翰·赫德饰）和他已婚但分居的同事劳拉（玛丽·贝丝·赫特饰）的故事。他们的恋情结束几个月后，查尔斯被回忆所困扰，他拼命地试图重新点燃一段也许从未存在过的爱情。米克林·西尔弗巧妙地在过去和现在之间切换，将男性如愿以偿的幻想进行了尖锐的解构，超越了标准的电影浪漫比喻，使之变得更加复杂和真实。
hook_en: The trailblazing Joan Micklin Silver—one of only a handful of women to direct a film for a major Hollywood studio in the 1970s—digs fearlessly into the psychology of a thorny relationship in this anti–romantic comedy, based on Ann Beattie’s best-selling novel, about lovelorn civil servant Charles (John Heard) and his married-but-separated coworker Laura (Mary Beth Hurt). Months after their affair has ended, Charles is haunted by memories as he desperately attempts to rekindle a love that perhaps never was. Switching deftly between past and present, Micklin Silver guides this piercing deconstruction of male wish-fulfillment fantasy beyond standard movie-romance tropes into something more complicated and cuttingly truthful.

hook: 这部广受好评的改编自南方传奇作家弗兰纳里·奥康纳的第一部小说，约翰·休斯顿生动地展现了她美国怪诞的诗意世界。布拉德·道里夫（Brad Dourif）在一场充满激情的表演中饰演刚从军队退伍的黑兹尔·莫特斯（Hazel Motes），他试图在陶尔金纳姆小镇开设第一座没有基督的教堂。休斯顿的《智慧之血》充满了灵感十足的表演，这些表演似乎直接来自奥康纳的书页，是对灵性和福音主义的深刻描绘，也是对作家愿景的忠实、充满爱的唤起。
hook_en: In this acclaimed adaptation of the first novel by legendary Southern writer Flannery O’Connor, John Huston vividly brings to life her poetic world of American eccentricity. Brad Dourif, in an impassioned performance, is Hazel Motes, who, fresh out of the army, attempts to open the first Church Without Christ in the small town of Taulkinham. Populated with inspired performances that seem to spring right from O’Connor’s pages, Huston’s Wise Blood is an incisive portrait of spirituality and Evangelicalism, and a faithful, loving evocation of a writer’s vision.

hook: 马塞洛·马斯楚安尼 (Marcello Mastroianni) 饰演导演吉多·安塞尔米 (Guido Anselmi)，他的新项目和他的生活都在崩溃。费德里科·费里尼 (Federico Fellini) 的《8½》(Otto e mezzo) 是有史以来最伟大的电影电影之一，将一个人的艺术危机变成了一部伟大的电影史诗。 8½ 的早期暂定名称是《美丽的混乱》，而费里尼的杰作正是这样：一个闪闪发光的梦想、一个马戏团和一个魔术表演。此外，费里尼罕见的第一部电视电影《费里尼：导演笔记本》(1969) 也亮相。这部关于费里尼的“想象纪录片”由彼得·戈德法布制作，是一个未完成项目的万花筒，所有这些都为了解导演独特的创作过程提供了一个迷人而坦率的窗口。
hook_en: Marcello Mastroianni plays Guido Anselmi, a director whose new project is collapsing around him, along with his life. One of the greatest films about film ever made, Federico Fellini’s 8½ (Otto e mezzo) turns one man’s artistic crisis into a grand epic of the cinema. An early working title for 8½ was The Beautiful Confusion, and Fellini’s masterpiece is exactly that: a shimmering dream, a circus, and a magic act. Also featured is Fellini’s rarely seen first film for television, Fellini: A Director’s Notebook (1969). Produced by Peter Goldfarb, this “imagined documentary” of Fellini on Fellini is a kaleidoscope of unfinished projects, all of which provide a fascinating and candid window into the director’s unique creative process.

hook: 拉脱维亚，1919 年：俄罗斯内战结束。一位贵族年轻女子（由玛格丽特·冯·特罗塔出色饰演）与一名性压抑的普鲁士士兵发生了关系。当她被自己的爱人拒绝时，这位年轻女子就陷入了性心理抑郁、滥交和革命合作的恶性循环。沃尔克·施隆多夫的《致命一击》是一部以血腥革命为背景的令人震惊的心碎和暴力故事，是一部强有力的电影，探讨了私人激情和政治承诺之间的相互关系。
hook_en: Latvia, 1919: the end of the Russian Civil War. An aristocratic young woman (brilliantly played by Margarethe von Trotta) becomes involved with a sexually repressed Prussian soldier. When she is rejected by her love, the young woman is sent into a downward spiral of psychosexual depression, promiscuity, and revolutionary collaboration. A startling tale of heartbreak and violence set against the backdrop of bloody revolution, Volker Schlöndorff's Coup de grâce is a powerful film that explores the interrelation of private passion and political commitment.

hook: 意大利电影梦之队索菲亚·罗兰和马塞洛·马斯楚安尼在这部由埃托·斯科拉执导的感人至深、颠覆性的剧情片中，以迷人的风格演绎了他们职业生涯中最精彩的两场表演。虽然故事发生在 1938 年贝尼托·墨索里尼和这座城市首次为阿道夫·希特勒铺上红地毯的历史性日子，但这部电影完全发生在一栋工人阶级公寓楼里，一对没有参加庆祝活动的人之间意外地建立了友谊：一位保守的家庭主妇和母亲忙于家务，一位自由派电台广播员等待被驱逐出境。斯科拉用柔和的色调描绘了一幅精美的肖像，讲述了两个人面对法西斯主义崛起而无助的故事。
hook_en: Italian cinema dream team Sophia Loren and Marcello Mastroianni are cast against glamorous type and deliver two of the finest performances of their careers in this moving, quietly subversive drama from Ettore Scola. Though it’s set in Rome on the historic day in 1938 when Benito Mussolini and the city first rolled out the red carpet for Adolf Hitler, the film takes place entirely in a working-class apartment building, where an unexpected friendship blossoms between a pair of people who haven’t joined the festivities: a conservative housewife and mother tending to her domestic duties and a liberal radio broadcaster awaiting deportation. Scola paints an exquisite portrait in muted tones, a story of two individuals helpless in the face of Fascism’s rise.

hook: 在雷纳·沃纳·法斯宾德这部关于爱情和剥削的愤世嫉俗的经典著作中，中彩票并不会带来财务和情感自由，而是会带来社会束缚。导演一反常态，扮演了一个易受暗示的工人阶级无辜者，他让自己被资产阶级新男友和物质主义朋友圈所利用，导致了只有法斯宾德才能创造的那种共鸣的痛苦。 《福克斯和他的朋友们》对社会进行了无情的评论，对 20 世纪 70 年代西德的同性恋社区进行了有趣、无情、开创性但又颇具争议的描述。
hook_en: A lottery win leads not to financial and emotional freedom but to social captivity, in this wildly cynical classic about love and exploitation by Rainer Werner Fassbinder. Casting himself against type, the director plays a suggestible working-class innocent who lets himself be taken advantage of by his bourgeois new boyfriend and his circle of materialistic friends, leading to the kind of resonant misery that only Fassbinder could create. Fox and His Friends is unsparing social commentary, an amusingly pitiless and groundbreaking if controversial depiction of a gay community in 1970s West Germany.

hook: 哈罗德·劳埃德 (Harold Lloyd) 票房最高的作品是这部无声喜剧瑰宝，讲述了一个困惑的普通人作为一名新大学生的热切状态。尽管他梦想成为校园里的大人物，但这位新生的精心计划不可避免地会出现滑稽的错误，无论是在足球场上还是在秋季嬉戏中。但他得到了一个绝佳的机会来证明自己的勇气，并给他所爱的可爱女孩留下深刻的印象，这是有史以来拍摄的最著名的体育镜头之一。这部取悦观众的作品愉快地展示了劳埃德的闹剧才华和炽热魅力，并配有卡尔·戴维斯的新管弦乐配乐。
hook_en: Harold Lloyd’s biggest box-office hit was this silent comedy gem, featuring the befuddled everyman at his eager best as a new college student. Though he dreams of being a big man on campus, the freshman’s careful plans inevitably go hilariously awry, be it on the football field or at the Fall Frolic. But he gets a climactic chance to prove his mettle—and impress the sweet girl he loves—in one of the most famous sports sequences ever filmed. This crowd-pleaser is a gleeful showcase for Lloyd’s slapstick brilliance and incandescent charm, and it is accompanied here by a new orchestral score by Carl Davis.

hook: 彼得·戴维斯 (Peter Davis) 于 1974 年拍摄的具有里程碑意义的纪录片《心与思想》(Hearts and Minds) 是一部令人震惊且勇敢的电影，在围绕越南的争议最激烈的时候，毫不畏惧地直面美国对越南的介入。戴维斯利用大量资料——从采访到新闻短片，再到冲突及其在国内引发的动乱的镜头——构建了一幅关于战争灾难性影响的强有力的图景。 《心灵与思想》具有爆炸性、说服力和痛苦，是一种压倒性的情感体验，也是有史以来关于这段毁灭性历史时期的最重要的非虚构电影。
hook_en: A startling and courageous film, Peter Davis’s landmark 1974 documentary Hearts and Minds unflinchingly confronted the United States’ involvement in Vietnam at the height of the controversy that surrounded it. Using a wealth of sources—from interviews to newsreels to footage of the conflict and the upheaval it occasioned on the home front—Davis constructs a powerfully affecting picture of the disastrous effects of war. Explosive, persuasive, and wrenching, Hearts and Minds is an overwhelming emotional experience and the most important nonfiction film ever made about this devastating period in history.

hook: 这部由简·特罗尔 (Jan Troell) 创作的 19 世纪中期史诗巨制，通过两部电影讲述了一个瑞典农民家庭前往美国的旅程，以及他们为在这个美丽但险恶的新世界扎根而付出的努力。电影传奇人物马克斯·冯·西多和丽芙·乌尔曼以极其真实的方式饰演卡尔·奥斯卡和克里斯蒂娜，这对夫妇在艰难的旅程中经历了一次又一次的身体和情感考验。特罗尔以精确、细致的细节描述了他们的故事——这也是无数其他跨越大西洋寻求更好生活的人的故事——令人惊叹。 《移民》和《新大陆》的每一步都引人入胜，可能是关于美国定居的最伟大的银幕剧。
hook_en: This monumental mid-nineteenth-century epic from Jan Troell charts, over the course of two films, a Swedish farming family’s voyage to America and their efforts to put down roots in this beautiful but forbidding new world. Movie legends Max von Sydow and Liv Ullmann give remarkably authentic performances as Karl Oskar and Kristina, a couple who meet with one physical and emotional trial after another on their arduous journey. The precise, minute detail with which Troell depicts their story—which is also that of countless other people who sought better lives across the Atlantic—is a wonder to behold. Engrossing at every step of the way, the duo of The Emigrants and The New Land makes for perhaps the greatest screen drama about the settling of America.

hook: 路易斯·马勒广受好评的《心的呢喃》优雅地结合了喜剧、戏剧和自传的元素，坦率地描绘了一个早熟男孩性成熟的过程。这既令人震惊又令人心酸，是有史以来最优秀的成长电影之一。
hook_en: Louis Malle’s critically acclaimed Murmur of the Heart gracefully combines elements of comedy, drama, and autobiography in a candid portrait of a precocious adolescent boy’s sexual maturation. Both shocking and deeply poignant, this is one of the finest coming-of-age films ever made.

hook: 在韩国大师金基英的这部恶毒情节剧中，性痴迷、复仇和背叛的洪流在同一个屋檐下释放。 《女佣》一上映就在本国广受欢迎，讲述了一个令人兴奋、有时令人瞠目结舌的故事，讲述了一位不稳定的女佣对一位资产阶级、道德可疑的音乐老师、他忠诚的妻子和他们早熟的孩子的家庭茧造成的毁灭性影响。金的电影冷酷而紧张，却又处于荒诞的边缘，讲述了一个关于阶级斗争和家庭解体的引人入胜的故事，对新一代韩国电影制片人产生了巨大影响。 2008 年，韩国电影资料馆 (KOFA) 与电影基金会的世界电影项目和 HFR 数字电影实验室合作修复了《女仆》。其他修复工作由阿玛尼、卡地亚、卡塔尔航空公司和卡塔尔博物馆管理局资助。
hook_en: A torrent of sexual obsession, revenge, and betrayal is unleashed under one roof in this venomous melodrama from South Korean master Kim Ki-young. Immensely popular in its home country when it was released, The Housemaid is the thrilling, at times jaw-dropping story of the devastating effect an unstable housemaid has on the domestic cocoon of a bourgeois, morally dubious music teacher, his devoted wife, and their precocious young children. Grim and taut yet perched on the border of the absurd, Kim’s film is an engrossing tale of class warfare and familial disintegration that has been hugely influential on the new generation of South Korean filmmakers.The Housemaid was restored in 2008 by the Korean Film Archive (KOFA), in association with The Film Foundation’s World Cinema Project and HFR-Digital Film laboratory. Additional restoration funded by Armani, Cartier, Qatar Airways, and Qatar Museum Authority.

hook: 通过性高潮获得的能量与 1971 年左右共产主义南斯拉夫的状况有什么关系？只有杰出的反文化电影制作人杜尚·马卡维耶夫（Dušan Makavejev）才能找到答案（或问题）。他的超现实纪实小说碰撞作品《WR：有机体之谜》一开始是对颇具争议的心理学家和哲学家威廉·赖希 (Wilhelm Reich) 的生活和工作的调查，然后以自由形式讲述了一位美丽的年轻斯拉夫女孩的性解放。艺术电影大片《WR》在导演的家乡被禁上映，它异想天开，大胆地将政治与性爱融合在一起。
hook_en: What does the energy harnessed through orgasm have to do with the state of communist Yugoslavia circa 1971? Only counterculture filmmaker extraordinaire Dušan Makavejev has the answers (or the questions). His surreal documentary-fiction collision WR: Mysteries of the Organism begins as an investigation into the life and work of controversial psychologist and philosopher Wilhelm Reich and then explodes into a free-form narrative of a beautiful young Slavic girl’s sexual liberation. Banned upon its release in the director’s homeland, the art-house smash WR is both whimsical and bold in its blending of politics and sexuality.

hook: 约瑟夫·冯·斯滕伯格的引人入胜的突破被广泛认为是这部影片开创了我们所知的美国黑帮类型。乔治·班克罗夫特 (George Bancroft) 饰演重度犯罪头目布尔·韦德 (Bull Weed)，他对情人费瑟斯 (伊芙琳·布伦特饰) 的嫉妒心让他陷入了竞争对手的困境，并最终惹恼了当局。让事情变得更加复杂的是羽毛和酗酒的前律师（克莱夫·布鲁克饰）之间产生的吸引力。凭借其灵活、表现力无穷的摄影作品和基于传奇文士本·赫克特（本·赫克特在颁奖第一年就凭借该片获得奥斯卡奖）故事改编的紧凑剧本，《黑夜传说》巩固了冯·斯登伯格作为好莱坞最令人兴奋的新星之一的地位。
hook_en: Josef von Sternberg’s riveting breakthrough is widely considered the film that launched the American gangster genre as we know it. George Bancroft plays heavy Bull Weed, a criminal kingpin whose jealous devotion to his moll, Feathers (Evelyn Brent), gets him into hot water with a rival hood and, ultimately, the authorities. Further complicating matters is the attraction that blossoms between Feathers and an alcoholic former lawyer (Clive Brook). With its supple, endlessly expressive camera work and tightly wound screenplay based on a story by legendary scribe Ben Hecht (who won an Oscar for it the first year the awards were given), Underworld solidified von Sternberg’s place as one of Hollywood’s most exciting new talents.

hook: 《西瓜人》是梅尔文·范·皮布尔斯唯一一次涉足好莱坞电影制作的作品，是 20 世纪 70 年代美国一家大型电影公司资助的最大胆、构思最激进的作品之一。喜剧演员戈弗雷·剑桥 (Godfrey Cambridge) 演绎了精湛的表演（最初是白脸），饰演杰夫·格伯 (Jeff Gerber)，他是一位大声说话、偏执的白人保险推销员，在弗朗兹·卡夫卡 (Franz Kafka) 的《变形记》中，当他醒来发现自己变成了一名黑人时，他的情景喜剧般的郊区生活被彻底颠覆了。接下来是对社会种族主义双重标准的猛烈讽刺，逐渐转变为一幅觉醒的黑人意识的有力肖像，由无情的颠覆性范皮布尔斯以尖刻的不敬和极其严肃的政治评论来执行。
hook_en: Melvin Van Peebles’s only foray into Hollywood filmmaking, Watermelon Man is one of the most audacious, radically conceived works to be financed by a major American studio in the 1970s. Comedian Godfrey Cambridge delivers a virtuoso performance (initially in whiteface) as Jeff Gerber, a loudmouthed, bigoted white insurance salesman whose sitcomlike suburban existence is jarringly upended when he wakes up to discover, in a wild spin on Franz Kafka’s The Metamorphosis, that he has become a Black man. What ensues is a ferocious satire of society’s racist double standards that gradually transforms into an empowering portrait of awakening Black consciousness, executed with a mix of acerbic irreverence and deadly serious political commentary by a relentlessly subversive Van Peebles.

hook: 现在是 1968 年，全世界都在关注。随着美国社会动荡，著名电影摄影师哈斯克尔·韦克斯勒决定拍摄一部讲述到底发生了什么的电影。他的处女作《Medium Cool》让我们沉浸在这一刻。这部对电视摄影师（罗伯特·福斯特饰）的工作世界和浪漫生活的描述融合了虚构故事和纪录片技巧，是那个时代的真实电影快照，以芝加哥民主党全国代表大会周围骚乱中间的一个长镜头镜头达到高潮。 《Medium Cool》对使用相机的乐趣和危险进行了创造性的评论，是好莱坞制作的一部最具先见之明的政治电影。
hook_en: It’s 1968, and the whole world is watching. With the U.S. in social upheaval, famed cinematographer Haskell Wexler decided to make a film about what the hell was going on. Medium Cool, his debut feature, plunges us into the moment. With its mix of fictional storytelling and documentary technique, this depiction of the working world and romantic life of a television cameraman (Robert Forster) is a visceral cinematic snapshot of the era, climaxing with an extended sequence shot right in the middle of the riots surrounding the Democratic National Convention in Chicago. An inventive commentary on the pleasures and dangers of wielding a camera, Medium Cool is as prescient a political film as Hollywood has ever produced.

hook: 1967 年六月一个美丽的周末，爱之夏伊始，蒙特利国际流行音乐节呼啸而至，捕捉了十年的精神，开创了摇滚乐的新时代。蒙特利的演出包括吉米·亨德里克斯、詹尼斯·乔普林和奥蒂斯·雷丁的职业生涯表演，但他们只是众多表演者中的一小部分，其中包括西蒙和加芬克尔、妈妈和爸爸、谁人乐队、伯兹乐队、休·马塞克拉和非凡的拉维·香卡。凭借其特有的真实风格，以及包括阿尔伯特·梅索斯 (Albert Maysles) 和理查德·利科克 (Richard Leacock) 等人在内的摄制组，D. A. Pennebaker 捕捉到了这一切，那些成为传奇的不朽时刻：Pete Townshend 砸碎了他的吉他，Jimi Hendrix 烧了他的吉他，Mama Cass 敬畏地看着 Janis Joplin 的表演。该五十周年纪念版以全新 4K 修复版呈现蒙特利流行音乐。
hook_en: On a beautiful June weekend in 1967, at the beginning of the Summer of Love, the Monterey International Pop Festival roared forward, capturing a decade’s spirit and ushering in a new era of rock and roll. Monterey featured career-making performances by Jimi Hendrix, Janis Joplin, and Otis Redding, but they were just a few of the performers in a wildly diverse lineup that included Simon and Garfunkel, the Mamas and the Papas, the Who, the Byrds, Hugh Masekela, and the extraordinary Ravi Shankar. With his characteristic vérité style—and a camera crew that included the likes of Albert Maysles and Richard Leacock—D. A. Pennebaker captured it all, immortalizing moments that have become legend: Pete Townshend smashing his guitar, Jimi Hendrix burning his, Mama Cass watching Janis Joplin’s performance in awe. This fiftieth-anniversary edition presents Monterey Pop in a new 4K restoration.

hook: 阿方索·卡隆在他的第八部也是最具个人色彩的电影中，重现了他童年时的 20 世纪 70 年代初的墨西哥城，通过负责维持家庭运转的土著家庭佣工克莱奥（雅利扎·阿帕里西奥，首次亮相银幕）的经历，讲述了一个中产阶级家庭生活中的动荡时期。克莱奥负责照顾四个被父亲遗弃的小孩，尽管她自己的生活因个人和政治动荡而动摇，但她仍照顾家庭。 《罗马》由卡隆编剧、导演、拍摄和联合剪辑，是电影史上少有的一部充满爱的作品，它采用了不朽的黑白电影摄影、身临其境的配乐以及专业和非专业表演的混合，将作者的记忆塑造成一个充满质感的世界，并向养育他的女人致敬。
hook_en: With his eighth and most personal film, Alfonso Cuarón recreated the early-1970s Mexico City of his childhood, narrating a tumultuous period in the life of a middle-class family through the experiences of Cleo (Yalitza Aparicio, in a revelatory screen debut), the indigenous domestic worker who keeps the household running.
