Charged with the care of four small children abandoned by their father, Cleo tends to the family even as her own life is shaken by personal and political upheavals. Written, directed, shot, and coedited by Cuarón, Roma is a labor of love with few parallels in the history of cinema, deploying monumental black-and-white cinematography, an immersive soundtrack, and a mixture of professional and nonprofessional performances to shape its author’s memories into a world of enveloping texture, and to pay tribute to the woman who nurtured him.

hook: 在这部以南特工人罢工为背景的音乐情节剧中，多米尼克·桑达饰演一名年轻女子，她希望离开残暴的丈夫（米歇尔·皮科利饰），嫁给一个朴实的钢铁工人（理查德·贝瑞饰），尽管他已经与另一个人有关系。女孩不知道的是，她的爱慕对象与她严肃的男爵夫人母亲（丹妮尔·达里厄）同在。 《Une chambre en ville》是雅克·德米 (Jacques Demy) 职业生涯晚期的杰作，获得了九项凯撒奖提名，并由米歇尔·科隆比尔 (Michel Colombier) 创作了丰富的歌剧配乐。
hook_en: In this musical melodrama set against the backdrop of a workers’ strike in Nantes, Dominique Sanda plays a young woman who wishes to leave her brutish husband (Michel Piccoli) for an earthy steelworker (Richard Berry), though he is involved with another. Unbeknownst to the girl, the object of her affection boards with her no-nonsense baroness mother (Danielle Darrieux). A late-career triumph from Jacques Demy, Une chambre en ville received nine César Award nominations and features a rich, operatic score by Michel Colombier.

hook: 维尔戈特·舍曼的《我好奇——黄色》在进入美国时被海关扣押，引发了一场激烈的法庭斗争，并在许多城市被禁，是有史以来最具争议的电影之一。这份瑞典社会在性革命期间的里程碑式文件被宣布为淫秽和革命性的。该剧讲述了莉娜（莉娜·尼曼饰），一位富有探索精神和叛逆精神的年轻女性的故事，以及她个人对了解 20 世纪 60 年代瑞典社会和政治状况的追求，以及她对自己性别身份的大胆探索。 《我很好奇——黄色》是戏剧和纪录片技巧的颠覆性结合，攻击资本主义的不公正现象并坦率地讨论性政治。
hook_en: Seized by customs upon entry to the United States, subject of a heated court battle, and banned in numerous cities, Vilgot Sjöman's I Am Curious—Yellow is one of the most controversial films of all time. This landmark document of Swedish society during the sexual revolution has been declared both obscene and revolutionary. It tells the story of Lena (Lena Nyman), a searching and rebellious young woman, and her personal quest to understand the social and political conditions in 1960s Sweden, as well as her bold exploration of her own sexual identity. I Am Curious—Yellow is a subversive mix of dramatic and documentary techniques, attacking capitalist injustices and frankly addressing the politics of sexuality.

hook: 当雅克·塔蒂笔下古怪、老式的主人公于洛先生在阿佩尔别墅（他姐夫几何形的、令人压抑的超现代住宅）以及他在抗菌塑料软管工厂找到工作时，闹剧再次上演。 《我的叔叔》是于洛的第二部电影，也是塔蒂的第一部彩色电影，是一部关于机械化生活和消费社会的极其有趣的讽刺电影，为这位导演赢得了奥斯卡最佳外语片奖。
hook_en: Slapstick prevails again when Jacques Tati’s eccentric, old-fashioned hero, Monsieur Hulot, is set loose in Villa Arpel, the geometric, oppressively ultramodern home of his brother-in-law, and in the antiseptic plastic hose factory where he gets a job. The second Hulot movie and Tati’s first color film, Mon oncle is a supremely amusing satire of mechanized living and consumer society that earned the director the Academy Award for best foreign-language film.

hook: 在这部由蒙特·赫尔曼执导、卡罗尔·伊士曼（《五部简单作品》）编剧的怪异存在主义西部片中，沃伦·奥茨和威尔·哈钦斯扮演一名赏金猎人和他的助手，他们被一位神秘女子（米莉·珀金斯饰）说服，带她进入沙漠，执行一项动机不明的复仇任务。船员中加入了一位神秘的漂泊者（杰克·尼科尔森饰），事情变得更加复杂，他似乎很喜欢虐待这两个人。海尔曼的奇特冒险之旅是对怪异的旧西部的想象，与其他作品不同，这是一部朴素而富有挑战性的作品，通向一个挑衅性的结局。
hook_en: In this eerie, existential western directed by Monte Hellman and written by Carole Eastman (Five Easy Pieces), Warren Oates and Will Hutchins play a bounty hunter and his sidekick who are talked by a mysterious woman (Millie Perkins) into leading her into the desert on a murkily motivated revenge mission. Things are further complicated by the addition to their crew of an enigmatic drifter (Jack Nicholson) who seems to delight in sadistically toying with the two men. Hellman’s singular odyssey is a vision of the weird old west unlike any other, a spare and challenging work leading to a provocative ending.

hook: Subu 制作色情电影。他认为这没有什么问题。它们是对受压迫社会的援助，他用这些钱来养活他的女房东哈鲁和她的家人。哈鲁有时会与苏布同睡一张床，尽管她相信转世为鲤鱼的死去的丈夫并不同意。导演今村昌平一直对下层社会的变态行为很感兴趣，在这部 1966 年的经典电影中，他在 Haru 的奇异动态中发现了颠覆性的幽默，Haru 是她的恋母情结的儿子和女儿，也是她的色情摄影师兼男友痴迷的真正对象。今村对偷窥和乱伦等禁忌的喜剧处理在电影上映时引发了争议，但《色情作家》比批评者更长久，现在看来坦率地说是超前于时代的。
hook_en: Subu makes pornographic films. He sees nothing wrong with it. They are an aid to a repressed society, and he uses the money to support his landlady, Haru, and her family. From time to time, Haru shares her bed with Subu, though she believes her dead husband, reincarnated as a carp, disapproves. Director Shohei Imamura has always delighted in the kinky exploits of lowlifes, and in this 1966 classic, he finds subversive humor in the bizarre dynamics of Haru, her Oedipal son, and her daughter, the true object of her pornographer-boyfriend's obsession. Imamura's comic treatment of such taboos as voyeurism and incest sparked controversy when the film was released, but The Pornographers has outlasted its critics, and now seems frankly ahead of its time.

hook: 高中生南部喜六向往古板的天主教美智子，但她唯一的愿望是改变喜六的罪恶倾向。荷尔蒙汹涌澎湃，喜六将自己未满足的欲望引向唯一可用的出口：野蛮、疯狂的暴力。 《战斗挽歌》（Kenka Erejii）是铃木清顺多元化职业生涯中的一部独特杰作，将导演标志性的大胆视觉风格与对大男子主义和法西斯主义的精彩讽刺结合起来。
hook_en: High schooler Kiroku Nanbu yearns for the prim, Catholic Michiko, but her only desire is to reform Kiroku's sinful tendencies. Hormones raging, Kiroku channels his unsatisfied lust into the only outlet available: savage, crazed violence. Fighting Elegy (Kenka Erejii) is a unique masterpiece in the diverse career of Seijun Suzuki, combining the director’s signature bravura visual style with a brilliantly focused satire of machismo and fascism.

hook: 克劳德·鲁鲁修 (Claude Lelouch) 荣获奥斯卡金像奖，轰动全球，是令人着迷的电影浪漫主义和 20 世纪 60 年代时尚的典范。在诺曼底海岸大雨倾盆的背景下，两位丧偶的单亲父母——赛车手让-路易斯（让-路易斯·特林蒂尼昂饰）和电影剧本总监安妮（阿努克·艾梅饰）——发现自己爱上了对方。但他们准备好摆脱前情人的阴影了吗？陶醉于明星之间的化学反应，并以不断变化的胶片、旋转的摄影工作和时空崩溃的剪辑的壮丽漩涡展开——所有这些都以弗朗西斯·赖令人难忘的配乐为背景——《一对男人和一个女人》作为有史以来最令人陶醉的爱情故事之一而经久不衰。
hook_en: Claude Lelouch’s Academy Award–winning international sensation is a paragon of swooning cinematic romanticism and 1960s chic. Against the rain-swept backdrop of the Normandy coast, two widowed single parents—race-car driver Jean-Louis (Jean-Louis Trintignant) and film-script supervisor Anne (Anouk Aimée)—find themselves falling for each other. But are they ready to move on from the shadows of their former lovers? Reveling in its stars’ chemistry and unfolding as a sublime swirl of shifting film stocks, whirling camera work, and time- and space-collapsing editing—all set to Francis Lai’s unforgettable score—A Man and a Woman endures as one of the most intoxicating love stories ever told.

hook: 猎枪婚礼、绑架、谋杀未遂、紧急牙科治疗——唐·文森佐将做这些事来恢复家人的荣誉！彼得罗·杰米的《诱惑与遗弃》是他享誉国际的《意大利式离婚》的续作，从很多方面来说，它更加大胆——一系列欢闹而又原始的喜剧灾难不断升级，故事发生在一个小村庄，十六岁的阿格尼丝（美丽的斯特凡妮娅·桑德雷利饰）在姐姐好色的未婚夫手中失去了童贞。无情而欢快，《诱惑与遗弃》以狡猾、邪恶的笑容串烧了西西里的社会习俗和浮夸的父权制。
hook_en: Shotgun weddings, kidnapping, attempted murder, emergency dental work—the things Don Vincenzo will do to restore his family's honor! Pietro Germi's Seduced and Abandoned was the follow-up to his international sensation Divorce Italian Style, and in many ways it's even more audacious—a rollicking yet raw series of escalating comic calamities that ensue in a small village when sixteen-year-old Agnese (the beautiful Stefania Sandrelli) loses her virginity at the hands of her sister's lascivious fiance. Merciless and mirthful, Seduced and Abandoned skewers Sicilian social customs and pompous patriarchies with a sly, devilish grin.

hook: 1956 年，弗兰克·塔什林 (Frank Tashlin) 将他作为动画大师磨练出来的滑稽视觉搞笑和荒诞流行文化讽刺才能，以华丽的奢华色彩捕捉了一种全新的热潮：摇滚乐。这部欢乐而疯狂的点唱机音乐剧讲述了黑帮重磅女友——唯一的杰恩·曼斯菲尔德 (Jayne Mansfield)，在首部引人注目的主要电影角色中扮演的角色，以及没落的人才经纪人（汤姆·尤厄尔 (Tom Ewell) 饰）的故事，后者试图通过将她打造成音乐界的轰动来重振自己的事业。问题是：她真的会唱歌吗？ 《The Girl Can't Help It》是一场令人瞠目结舌的中世纪设计盛宴，伴随着摇滚先驱者们的表演，包括 Little Richard、Fats Domino、Julie London、Eddie Cochran、the Platters 和 Gene Vincent，他们用即将征服世界的独特美国声音照亮了银幕。
hook_en: In 1956, Frank Tashlin brought the talent for zany visual gags and absurdist pop-culture satire that he’d honed as a master of animation to the task of capturing, in glorious De Luxe Color, a brand-new craze: rock and roll. This blissfully bonkers jukebox musical tells the story of a mobster’s bombshell girlfriend—the one and only Jayne Mansfield, in a showstopping first major film role—and the washed-up talent agent (Tom Ewell) who seeks to revive his career by turning her into a musical sensation. The question is: Can she actually sing? A CinemaScope feast of eye-popping midcentury design, The Girl Can’t Help It bops along to a parade of performances by rock-and-roll trailblazers—including Little Richard, Fats Domino, Julie London, Eddie Cochran, the Platters, and Gene Vincent—who light up the screen with the uniquely American sound that was about to conquer the world.

hook: 作为香港电影黄金时代最大胆的成就之一，这部独特的发自肺腑的武侠电影为独臂剑客的故事注入了全新的色彩，单臂剑客自 1967 年被邵氏兄弟工作室推出以来，一直是一个标志性人物。《刀锋》以身临其境的特写镜头和支离破碎的剪辑组成，讲述了年轻的剑匠鼎安（赵文卓饰）在一次伏击中失去一只手臂后，将自己变成了一个愤怒的复仇者。凭借其故意迷失方向的风格和赤裸裸的残酷基调，《刀锋》在商业上令徐克罕见地失望，但此后它被认为是导演最激进的愿景之一——一部动作表现主义的杰作，对武侠类型的男性气质进行了严厉的重新评价，达到了狂热的强度。
hook_en: Among the boldest accomplishments of Hong Kong cinema’s golden age, this uniquely visceral martial-arts movie puts a gritty new spin on the story of the one-armed swordsman, an iconic figure from the moment he was introduced by the Shaw Brothers studio in 1967. Composed in a whirlwind of immersive close-ups and fractured editing, The Blade follows the young sword-maker Ding On (Vincent Zhao), who, after losing an arm in an ambush, transforms himself into a furious avenger. With its intentionally disorienting stylization and starkly brutal tone, The Blade was a rare commercial disappointment for Tsui Hark, but it has since been reclaimed as one of the director’s most radical visions—a tour de force of action expressionism, and a scathing reappraisal of the wuxia genre’s code of masculinity, that achieves a feverish intensity.

hook: 这部由 Aki Kaurismäki 创作的讽刺、忧郁喜剧是对当前全球难民危机的回应，讲述了两个人寻找一个可以称之为家的地方的故事。哈立德（谢尔万·哈吉饰）是一名流离失所的叙利亚人，以偷渡者的身份登陆赫尔辛基；与此同时，中年芬兰推销员维克斯特罗姆（萨卡里·库斯曼宁饰）离开了妻子和工作，买下了一家明显不盈利的餐厅。哈立德的庇护被拒绝，但他决定不再返回阿勒颇——两人的道路偶然交叉。 《希望的另一面》就像导演最好的作品一样面无表情，对那些穷困但不落魄的角色（其中许多是由 Kaurismäki 忠诚的股票公司的成员扮演）充满了深切的同情，是对一个不受欢迎的世界中人类善良的苦乐参半的庆祝。
hook_en: This wry, melancholic comedy from Aki Kaurismäki, a response to the ongoing global refugee crisis, follows two people searching for a place to call home. Khaled (Sherwan Haji), a displaced Syrian, lands in Helsinki as a stowaway; meanwhile, middle-aged Finnish salesman Wikström (Sakari Kuosmanen) leaves his wife and his job and buys a conspicuously unprofitable restaurant. Khaled is denied asylum but decides not to return to Aleppo—and the paths of the two men cross fortuitously. As deadpan as the best of the director’s work, and with a deep well of empathy for its down-but-not-out characters (many of them played by members of Kaurismäki’s loyal stock company), The Other Side of Hope is a bittersweet celebration of pockets of human kindness in an unwelcoming world.

hook: 约瑟夫·冯·斯滕伯格和玛琳·黛德丽在他们的最后一部电影《魔鬼是女人》中大放异彩，这是一个以二十世纪之交的西班牙狂欢节喧嚣为背景的关于色情激情和危险的超现实故事。通过一系列的倒叙，科斯特拉船长（莱昂内尔·阿特威尔饰）向年轻的安东尼奥·加尔万（塞萨尔·罗梅罗饰）讲述了他与臭名昭著的诱惑者孔查·佩雷斯（迪特里希饰）的悲惨恋情，并警告听众要警惕她的魅力。尽管有他的劝告，加尔文还是中了孔查的魔咒，导致了暴力结局。作为一位华丽的视觉造型师，冯·斯滕伯格以一种令人毛骨悚然的奇幻色彩唤起了西班牙文化，特拉维斯·班顿华丽的服装设计和冯·斯滕伯格本人屡获殊荣的摄影进一步提升了这一点。
hook_en: Josef von Sternberg and Marlene Dietrich went out with a bang in their final film together, The Devil Is a Woman, a surreal tale of erotic passion and danger set amid the tumult of carnival in turn-of-the-twentieth-century Spain. Through a series of flashbacks, Captain Costelar (Lionel Atwill) recounts to the young Antonio Galvan (Cesar Romero) the story of his harrowing affair with the notorious seductress Concha Perez (Dietrich), warning his listener to gird himself against her charms. Despite his counsel, Galvan falls under Concha’s spell, leading to a violent denouement. Ever the ornate visual stylist, von Sternberg evokes Spanish culture with a touch of the luridly fantastic, further elevated by Travis Banton’s opulent costume design and award-winning cinematography by von Sternberg himself.

hook: Tomé 1918 年出生于一个乡村，经历了数十年的日本社会动荡，以及各种男人的虐待和奴役。然而，曾经的电影“昆虫学家”Shohei Imamura 拒绝成为她的受害者，而是将 Tomé（由非凡的 Sachiko Hidari 饰演）视为 20 世纪日本的迷人、务实的生物。 《昆虫女》描绘了三代女性的机会主义和韧性，是今村最广阔的电影，而《Tomé》则是他的终极女英雄。
hook_en: Born in a rural farming village in 1918, Tomé survives decades of Japanese social upheaval, as well as abuse and servitude at the hands of various men. Yet Shohei Imamura, ever the cinematic “entomologist,” refuses to make a victim of her, instead observing Tomé (played by the extraordinary Sachiko Hidari) as a fascinating, pragmatic creature of twentieth-century Japan. A portrait of opportunism and resilience in three generations of women, The Insect Woman is Imamura’s most expansive film, and Tomé his ultimate heroine.

hook: 多产且充满挑衅性的约瑟夫·洛西（Joseph Losey）被列入好莱坞黑名单，生活在英国，他对阶级、性和权力的令人着迷的剖析给英国电影体系带来了冷静的现代主义冲击。一个放荡的上流社会后裔（詹姆斯·福克斯饰）找到了一个看似完美的男仆（一个恶魔般的德克·博加德，在他从日场偶像到艺术馆偶像的转变过程中）来管理他在伦敦的新联排别墅。但并非一切都像看上去的那样，传统的社会等级制度正在逐渐地、令人不安地不稳定。光彩夺目的令人迷惑的电影摄影和剧作家哈罗德·品特的精湛剧本融合在《仆人》中，这是一部不断升级的性心理威胁的杰作。
hook_en: The prolific, ever-provocative Joseph Losey, blacklisted from Hollywood and living in England, delivered a coolly modernist shock to the system of that nation’s cinema with this mesmerizing dissection of class, sexuality, and power. A dissolute scion of the upper crust (James Fox) finds the seemingly perfect manservant (a diabolical Dirk Bogarde, during his transition from matinee idol to art-house icon) to oversee his new London town house. But not all is as it seems, as traditional social hierarchies are gradually, disturbingly destabilized. Lustrously disorienting cinematography and a masterful script by playwright Harold Pinter merge in The Servant, a tour de force of mounting psychosexual menace.

hook: 在台伯河沿岸发现了一名罗马妓女被虐待的尸体。警方围捕了几名可能的嫌疑人，并逐一审讯他们，每一个陈述都让他们更接近凶手。在这部令人惊叹的处女作中，贝尔纳多·贝托鲁奇根据皮尔·保罗·帕索里尼的故事改编，利用一系列相互关联的倒叙来探索真理的本质和叙事的可靠性。 Criterion Collection 很荣幸地呈现一位传奇人才的首次实现。
hook_en: The brutalized corpse of a Roman prostitute is found along the banks of the Tiber River. The police round up a handful of possible suspects and interrogate them, one by one, each account bringing them closer to the killer. In this, his stunning debut feature—based on a story by Pier Paolo Pasolini—Bernardo Bertolucci utilizes a series of interconnected flashbacks to explore the nature of truth and the reliability of narrative. The Criterion Collection is proud to present the first realization of a legendary talent.

hook: 在法国导演塞尔日·布吉尼翁 (Serge Bourguignon) 执导的这部具有挑衅性的奥斯卡奖得主影片中，一名心理受损的退伍军人和一个被忽视的孩子开始了一段令人震惊的亲密友谊，这种友谊最终引发了他在巴黎郊区的朋友和邻居的怀疑和愤怒。布吉尼翁的电影从潜在的煽动性主题中打造出深思熟虑、人性化的戏剧，在亨利·德卡敏感的摄影和莫里斯·雅尔细腻的配乐的帮助下，《星期日与西贝尔》成为两个陷入困境的灵魂之间联盟的激动人心的沉思。
hook_en: In this provocative Academy Award winner from French director Serge Bourguignon, a psychologically damaged war veteran and a neglected child begin a startlingly intimate friendship—one that ultimately ignites the suspicion and anger of his friends and neighbors in suburban Paris. Bourguignon’s film makes thoughtful, humane drama out of potentially incendiary subject matter, and with the help of the sensitive cinematography of Henri Decaë and a delicate score by Maurice Jarre, Sundays and Cybèle becomes a stirring contemplation of an alliance between two troubled souls.

hook: 诡计。欺骗。魔法。在奥森·威尔斯（Orson Welles）制作的一部形式自由的纪录片《F for Fake》中，这位传奇电影制片人（自称江湖骗子）兴高采烈地重新审视了他职业生涯的核心关注点：幻觉与真相、艺术与谎言之间的微妙界限。从世界著名的艺术伪造者埃尔米尔·德·霍里和他同样狡猾的传记作家克利福德·欧文的肖像开始，威尔斯踏上了一段令人眼花缭乱的旅程，同时揭露和陶醉于各种各样的伪造品和造假者——其中最重要的是威尔斯本人。 《F for Fake》迷人且富有创意，是一个充满灵感的恶作剧，也是对电影本质上的口是心非的巧妙审视。
hook_en: Trickery. Deceit. Magic. In F for Fake, a free-form sort-of documentary by Orson Welles, the legendary filmmaker (and self-described charlatan) gleefully reengages with the central preoccupation of his career: the tenuous lines between illusion and truth, art and lies. Beginning with portraits of the world- renowned art forger Elmyr de Hory and his equally devious biographer, Clifford Irving, Welles embarks on a dizzying journey that simultaneously exposes and revels in fakery and fakers of all stripes—not the least of whom is Welles himself. Charming and inventive, F for Fake is an inspired prank and a clever examination of the essential duplicity of cinema.

hook: 雅克·里维特 (Jacques Rivette) 是推动法国新浪潮的最初影评人之一，后来转型为电影制片人，他于 1958 年开始拍摄他的处女作，远早于电影革命《四百击》和《气喘吁吁》正式拉开帷幕。最终于 1961 年发布的丰富而神秘的《巴黎属于我们》提供了一些定义该运动的激进风格，并带有特别的 Rivettian 风格。影片讲述了一位年轻的文学系学生（贝蒂·施奈德饰）在巴黎与一群二十多岁的松散团体的成员成为朋友的故事，他们因一位熟人的自杀事件而团结在一起。 《巴黎属于我们》充满了二战后挥之不去的幻灭感，同时也表现出对戏剧表演和阴谋的俏皮和迷恋，这将成为导演的标志，《巴黎属于我们》标志着辉煌导演生涯的挑衅性开始。
hook_en: One of the original critics turned filmmakers who helped jump-start the French New Wave, Jacques Rivette began shooting his debut feature in 1958, well before that cinema revolution officially kicked off with The 400 Blows and Breathless. Ultimately released in 1961, the rich and mysterious Paris Belongs to Us offers some of the radical flavor that would define the movement, with a particularly Rivettian twist. The film follows a young literature student (Betty Schneider) who befriends the members of a loose-knit group of twentysomethings in Paris, united by the apparent suicide of an acquaintance. Suffused with a lingering post–World War II disillusionment while also evincing the playfulness and fascination with theatrical performance and conspiracy that would become hallmarks for the director, Paris Belongs to Us marked the provocative start to a brilliant directorial career.

hook: 电影大师萨蒂亚吉特·雷 (Satyajit Ray) 在《女神》中探讨了狂热与自由意志之间的冲突，对宗教正统观念和父权权力结构提出了颠覆性的现代挑战。十九世纪下半叶的印度乡村，在儿子（苏米特拉·查特吉饰）前往加尔各答完成学业后，一位富有的封建地主（查比·比斯瓦斯饰）突然意识到他心爱的儿媳（眼神令人难以忘怀的悲伤的莎米拉·泰戈尔饰）是母亲女神的化身——这种错觉对这位年轻女子和她周围的人来说是毁灭性的。电影摄影师 Subrata Mitra 的优雅风格构图和明暗对比灯光增强了这场家庭悲剧的表现主义强度，营造出一种既崇高又震撼的体验。
hook_en: Master filmmaker Satyajit Ray explores the conflict between fanaticism and free will in Devi (The Goddess), issuing a subversively modern challenge to religious orthodoxy and patriarchal power structures. In rural India in the second half of the nineteenth century, after his son (Soumitra Chatterjee) leaves for Kolkata to complete his studies, a wealthy feudal landlord (Chhabi Biswas) is seized by the notion that his beloved daughter-in-law (a hauntingly sad-eyed Sharmila Tagore) is an incarnation of the Mother Goddess—a delusion that proves devastating to the young woman and those around her. The elegantly stylized compositions and the chiaroscuro lighting by cinematographer Subrata Mitra heighten the expressionistic intensity of this domestic tragedy, making for an experience that is both sublime and shattering.

hook: 在罗纳德·尼姆的《荣耀之调》中，无与伦比的亚历克·吉尼斯饰演乔克·辛克莱——一位喝着威士忌、自力更生的和平时期苏格兰营指挥官。辛克莱一生都是军人，他希望得到部下的尊重和忠诚。但当巴兹尔·巴罗（约翰·米尔斯饰）——一个受过良好教育、循规蹈矩的军人世家的后裔——作为辛克莱的继任者出现时，这两个人为了控制整个营和士兵的心灵而展开了激烈的斗争。 《荣耀之调》改编自詹姆斯·肯纳威的小说，由吉尼斯和米尔斯的完美演绎，以军旅生活中僵化的分层来评论英国社会的制度性矛盾和阶级等级，打造出一部出人意料的感人剧。
hook_en: In Ronald Neame’s Tunes of Glory, the incomparable Alec Guinness plays Jock Sinclair—a whiskey-drinking, up-by-the-bootstraps commanding officer of a peacetime Scottish battalion. A lifetime military man, Sinclair expects respect and loyalty from his men. But when Basil Barrow (John Mills)—an educated, by-the-book scion of a military family—enters the scene as Sinclair’s replacement, the two men engage in a fierce struggle for control of both the battalion and the hearts and minds of its men. Based on the novel by James Kennaway and featuring flawless performances by Guinness and Mills, Tunes of Glory uses the rigid stratification of military life to comment on the institutional contradictions and class hierarchies of English society, making for an unexpectedly moving drama.

hook: 在精彩的表演中，维托里奥·德·西卡饰演埃马努埃莱·巴尔多内，他是战时热那亚的一个投机取巧的恶棍，他欺骗他的意大利同胞，利用他们的悲剧，承诺帮助寻找失踪的亲人以换取金钱。但当纳粹强迫他在监狱里冒充一名死去的游击队将军以从狱友那里获取信息时，巴多内发现自己第一次与自己的良心作斗争。罗伯托·罗西里尼这部扣人心弦的戏剧是这位传奇新现实主义者罕见的票房突破，进一步证明了这位电影界最重要声音之一的富有同情心的艺术才华。
hook_en: In a magnetic performance, Vittorio De Sica is Emanuele Bardone, an opportunistic rascal in wartime Genoa, conning his fellow Italians and exploiting their tragedies by promising to help find their missing loved ones in exchange for money. But when the Nazis force him to impersonate a dead partisan general in prison to extract information from fellow inmates, Bardone finds himself wrestling with his conscience for the first time. Roberto Rossellini’s gripping drama, a rare box-office breakthrough for the legendary neorealist, is further evidence of the compassionate artistry of one of cinema’s most important voices.

hook: 法国电影界的两位杰出人物克莱尔·丹尼斯和朱丽叶·比诺什首次联手，以尖锐的视角审视真爱的难以捉摸的本质，以及我们在追求真爱时愿意背叛自己的程度。在层次丰富的表演中，比诺什扮演伊莎贝尔，一位巴黎成功的画家，她表面上的独立掩盖了她最渴望的东西：真正的浪漫满足。当伊莎贝尔与所有错误的男人建立关系时，她显露出深深的渴望、脆弱和坚韧。 《让阳光照进来》由丹尼斯的长期合作者阿涅斯·戈达尔以明亮的色调拍摄，杰拉尔·德帕迪约以顽皮的姿态出现，在残酷的现实中找到了暗淡的幽默：无论年龄大小，我们都是爱情的傻瓜。
hook_en: Two luminaries of French cinema, Claire Denis and Juliette Binoche, unite for the first time in this piercing look at the elusive nature of true love, and the extent to which we are willing to betray ourselves in its pursuit. In a richly layered performance, Binoche plays Isabelle, a successful painter in Paris whose apparent independence belies what she desires most: real romantic fulfillment. Isabelle reveals deep wells of yearning, vulnerability, and resilience as she tumbles into relationships with all the wrong men. Shot in burnished tones by Denis’s longtime collaborator Agnès Godard and featuring a mischievous appearance by Gérard Depardieu, Let the Sunshine In finds bleak humor in a cutting truth: we are all, no matter our age, fools for love.

hook: 在斯大林主义的政治暗流中，爱森斯坦完成了他关于十六世纪将俄罗斯统一起来的君主的三部曲中的两部。这部电影视觉效果惊人，表演精彩，讲述了这个实际上的独裁者权力的崛起和恐怖的堕落。虽然他对第一部感到满意，但斯大林却对第二部电影中的画像——其中包含有秘密警察的总结处决——深恶痛绝，并立即禁止了它。
hook_en: Navigating the deadly waters of Stalinist politics, Eisenstein was able to film two parts of his planned trilogy about the troubled sixteenth-century tsar who united Russia. Visually stunning and powerfully acted, Ivan the Terrible charts the rise to power and descent into terror of this veritable dictator. Though pleased with the first installment, Stalin detested the portrait in the second film—with its summary executions and secret police—and promptly banned it.

hook: 在罗纳德·尼姆根据乔伊斯·卡里的经典小说改编的电影中，亚历克·吉尼斯将自己变成了电影界最难以磨灭的喜剧人物之一：可爱的邋遢画家格利·吉姆森。当行为不端的吉姆森寻找完美的画布时，他决定不让任何事情妨碍他实现他的崇高愿景。 《马嘴》是对艺术创作斗争的敏锐审视，也是尼姆的喜剧杰作。
hook_en: In Ronald Neame’s film of Joyce Cary’s classic novel, Alec Guinness transforms himself into one of cinema’s most indelible comic figures: the lovably scruffy painter Gulley Jimson. As the ill-behaved Jimson searches for a perfect canvas, he determines to let nothing come between himself and the realization of his exalted vision. A perceptive examination of the struggle of artistic creation, The Horse’s Mouth is also Neame’s comic masterpiece.

hook: 《马赛三部曲》开场的微妙浪漫主义在本部中遇到了严酷的现实，故事发生在马吕斯为了一名水手而离开他未来的妻子范妮之后。他离开后不久，范妮得知自己怀上了他的孩子，这让她的母亲和马吕斯的父亲塞萨尔感到失望。为了让未出生的孩子过上更好的生活，她接受了年迈的鳏夫奥诺雷·帕尼斯的求婚。这部关于心碎及其后果的肖像时而感人，时而令人心旷神怡，帕尼奥尔对他的角色的开放态度，以及导演马克·阿莱格雷特对色彩缤纷的马赛的生动而自信的描绘，为这幅作品奠定了基础。
hook_en: The delicate romanticism of The Marseille Trilogy’s opening encounters harsh reality in this installment, which picks up moments after Marius has left his would-be wife, Fanny, for a sailor’s existence. Soon after his departure, Fanny learns that she is pregnant with his child, to the disappointment of her mother and of Marius’s father, César. To secure a better life for her unborn child, she accepts a marriage proposal from the aging widower Honoré Panisse. By turns moving and disarmingly funny, this portrait of heartbreak and its aftermath is buoyed by Pagnol’s openheartedness toward his characters, and by director Marc Allégret’s vivid and assured depiction of colorful Marseille.

hook: 这部由卢基诺·维斯康蒂 (Luchino Visconti) 创作的绚丽多彩的悲剧爱情片由阿莉达·瓦利 (Alida Valli) 饰演一位 19 世纪的意大利伯爵夫人，在奥地利占领她的国家期间，她冒着婚姻和政治原则与法利·格兰杰 (Farley Granger) 饰演的一位潇洒的奥地利中尉发生了一段火热的恋情。这部歌剧情节剧以华丽的服装和布景、丰富的古典配乐和无所畏惧的表演为特色，非凡地唤起了电影界伟大的感性主义者之一的不计后果的情感和疯狂的欲望。 Senso 由 StudioCanal、Centro Sperimentale di Cinematografia-Cineteca Nazionale 和 Cineteca di Bologna at L’Immagine Ritrovata 修复。修复资金由 Gucci、电影基金会和 Comitato Italia 150 提供。
hook_en: This lush, Technicolor tragic romance from Luchino Visconti stars Alida Valli as a nineteenth-century Italian countess who, during the Austrian occupation of her country, puts her marriage and political principles on the line by engaging in a torrid affair with a dashing Austrian lieutenant, played by Farley Granger. Gilded with ornate costumes and sets and a rich classical soundtrack, and featuring fearless performances, this operatic melodrama is an extraordinary evocation of reckless emotions and deranged lust, from one of the cinema’s great sensualists. Senso was restored by StudioCanal, Centro Sperimentale di Cinematografia-Cineteca Nazionale, and the Cineteca di Bologna at L’Immagine Ritrovata. Restoration funding provided by Gucci, The Film Foundation, and Comitato Italia 150.

hook: 马塞洛·马斯楚安尼（Marcello Mastroianni）扮演一个孤独的城市移民，玛丽亚·谢尔（Maria Schell）扮演一个被爱人的承诺所困扰的受庇护女孩，在运河桥上偶然相遇，并开始了一段试探性的浪漫，很快他们就陷入了渴望和自欺欺人的网络中。卢奇诺·维斯康蒂的《白夜》是对陀思妥耶夫斯基《白夜》的精妙改编，将这个关于两个不安的灵魂的浪漫而破碎的故事转化为一个迷人的黑白梦境。
hook_en: Marcello Mastroianni, as a lonely city transplant, and Maria Schell, as a sheltered girl haunted by a lover’s promise, meet by chance on a canal bridge and begin a tentative romance that quickly entangles them in a web of longing and self-delusion. Luchino Visconti’s Le notti bianche, an exquisite adaptation of Dostoyevsky’s “White Nights,” translates this romantic, shattering tale of two restless souls into a ravishing black-and-white dream.

hook: 格伦·福特 (Glenn Ford)、欧内斯特·博格宁 (Ernest Borgnine) 和罗德·斯泰格 (Rod Steiger) 的三位出色表演构成了《朱巴尔》(Jubal) 的中心，这是流派大师德尔默·戴夫斯 (Delmer Daves) 创作的被忽视的好莱坞瑰宝。在这个关于嫉妒和背叛的莎士比亚故事中，福特是一位光荣的流动牧民，尽管他不愿意谈论自己的过去，但他还是被博格宁慷慨的牧场主所雇用并成为朋友。当他成为老板无聊的妻子（瓦莱丽·弗伦奇饰）关注的对象，并被委以工头的职责时，他的出现开始激怒了由斯泰格扮演的狡猾的牛工伙伴。由此产生的情感对决为这部生动的西部情节剧带来了无与伦比的心理强度，以特艺彩色和宽银幕电影中富有表现力的外景摄影为特色。
hook_en: A trio of exceptional performances by Glenn Ford, Ernest Borgnine, and Rod Steiger form the center of Jubal, an overlooked Hollywood treasure from genre master Delmer Daves. In this Shakespearean tale of jealousy and betrayal, Ford is an honorable itinerant cattleman, befriended and hired by Borgnine’s bighearted ranch owner despite his unwillingness to talk about his past. When he becomes the object of the attentions of the owner’s bored wife (Valerie French) and is entrusted with a foreman’s responsibilities, his presence starts to rankle a shifty fellow cowhand, played by Steiger. The resulting emotional showdown imparts unparalleled psychological intensity to this vivid western melodrama, featuring expressive location photography in Technicolor and CinemaScope.

hook: 开创性的电影制片人玛莎·柯立芝凭借这部毫不畏缩的个人纪录片和小说的混合体首次亮相。这部电影以柯立芝在青春期被强奸的经历为中心，以米歇尔·马南蒂（也是幸存者）为主角，扮演导演年轻时的自己，并观察演员和她的演员们进行深刻的对话，探讨重现这些创伤记忆意味着什么，以及他们对同意和自责的态度。 《不是一张漂亮的照片》是元电影领域的一次高风险实验，通过对约会强奸的毫不妥协的审视开辟了新天地，它以令人惊叹的直接方式回答了有关性暴力在银幕上的表现和艺术宣泄的局限性的问题。
hook_en: Trailblazing filmmaker Martha Coolidge made her feature debut with this unflinchingly personal hybrid of documentary and fiction. Centered on an intense reenactment of Coolidge’s experience of rape in her adolescence, the film casts Michele Manenti (also a survivor) as the director’s younger self, and observes the actor and her castmates as they engage in a profound dialogue about what it means to recreate these traumatic memories, and about their attitudes concerning consent and self-blame. A high-stakes experiment in metacinema that broke new ground with its uncompromising examination of date rape, Not a Pretty Picture brings a stunning immediacy to questions about the on-screen representation of sexual violence and the limits of artistic catharsis.

hook: 这部由道格拉斯·西克对1950年代美国风尚的痛心疾首的控诉电影，讲述了富有的寡妇（简·西蒙兹饰）与她英俊淳朴的园丁（罗伊·豪斯曼饰）之间的爱情萌芽。当他们的恋情引发她孩子的鄙视和俱乐部朋友们的轻蔑时，她必须决定是追求自己的幸福，还是为了迎合他人的认可而过着孤独压抑的生活。在优秀摄影师罗素·梅特的帮助下，西克几乎每一帧画面都充满了鲜明而独特的感情色彩。这是一部关于美国小镇上阶级和同化的深刻影片，《天堂之家》是表现主义好莱坞戏剧的巅峰之作。
hook_en: This heartbreakingly beautiful indictment of 1950s American mores by Douglas Sirk follows the blossoming love between a well-off widow (Jane Wyman) and her handsome and earthy younger gardener (Rock Hudson). When their romance prompts the scorn of her children and country club friends, she must decide whether to pursue her own happiness or carry on a lonely, hemmed-in existence for the sake of the approval of others. With the help of ace cinematographer Russell Metty, Sirk imbues nearly every shot with a vivid and distinct emotional tenor. A profoundly felt film about class and conformity in small-town America, All That Heaven Allows is a pinnacle of expressionistic Hollywood melodrama.

hook: 斯塔赫是一个任性的青少年，生活在纳粹占领的华沙郊区的肮脏环境中。在一位慈祥的共产主义组织者的引导下，他认识了地下抵抗组织，也认识了美丽的多罗塔。很快，他就投入到对抗压迫和侮辱的危险努力中，随着他对他人的生活承担责任，他变得成熟起来。 《一代人》讲述了关于生存和毁灭性损失的成长故事，描绘了战争给人类造成的残酷代价。
hook_en: Stach is a wayward teen living in squalor on the outskirts of Nazi-occupied Warsaw. Guided by an avuncular Communist organizer, he is introduced to the underground resistance—and to the beautiful Dorota. Soon he is engaged in dangerous efforts to fight oppression and indignity, maturing as he assumes responsibility for others’ lives. A coming-of-age story of survival and shattering loss, A Generation delivers a brutal portrait of the human cost of war.

hook: 在《理查三世》中，导演、制片人和主演劳伦斯·奥利维尔将莎士比亚的马基雅维利式恶行杰作带入了令人着迷的电影生活中。奥利维尔饰演的格洛斯特公爵理查德有着恶魔般的魅力，他通过一系列谋杀阴谋，从他的兄弟爱德华手中窃取了王冠。他周围都是皇家配角，其中包括拉尔夫·理查森、约翰·吉尔古德和克莱尔·布鲁姆。 《理查三世》采用 VistaVision 和 Technicolor 拍摄，是所有大银幕巴德改编作品中最具视觉灵感的作品之一。修复资金由好莱坞外国记者协会和电影基金会提供。由电影基金会和 Janus Films 与 BFI 国家档案馆、ITV Studios Global Entertainment Ltd.、现代艺术博物馆和 Romulus Films 联合修复。
hook_en: In Richard III, director, producer, and star Laurence Olivier brings Shakespeare’s masterpiece of Machiavellian villainy to ravishing cinematic life. Olivier is diabolically captivating as Richard, Duke of Gloucester, who, through a series of murderous machinations, steals the crown from his brother Edward. And he surrounds himself with a royal supporting cast, which includes Ralph Richardson, John Gielgud, and Claire Bloom. Filmed in VistaVision and Technicolor, Richard III is one of the most visually inspired of all big-screen Bard adaptations. Restoration funding provided by the Hollywood Foreign Press Association and The Film Foundation. Restored by The Film Foundation and Janus Films, in association with the BFI National Archive, ITV Studios Global Entertainment Ltd., the Museum of Modern Art, and Romulus Films.

hook: 木下圭介的《二十四眼》是一部优雅而充满情感的编年史，讲述了一位教师对学生、职业和道德感坚定不移的承诺。木下的电影以一个偏远的乡村岛屿社区为背景，跨越了日本数十年的历史，从 1928 年到第二次世界大战及其后的历史，木下的电影以清醒而感伤的方式审视衰老、战争和死亡等史诗主题，所有这一切都从大志久子（高峰英子饰）亲切亲密的视角出发，她看着自己的学生成长并应对生活的严酷现实。虽然《二十四眼》在美国鲜为人知，但却是日本最受欢迎和经久不衰的经典之作之一。
hook_en: Keisuke Kinoshita’s Twenty-Four Eyes (Nijushi no hitomi) is an elegant, emotional chronicle of a teacher’s unwavering commitment to her students, her profession, and her sense of morality. Set in a remote, rural island community and spanning decades of Japanese history, from 1928 through World War II and beyond, Kinoshita’s film takes a simultaneously sober and sentimental look at the epic themes of aging, war, and death, all from the lovingly intimate perspective of Hisako Oshi (Hideko Takamine), as she watches her pupils grow and deal with life’s harsh realities. Though little known in the United States, Twenty-Four Eyes is one of Japan’s most popular and enduring classics.

hook: 西班牙超现实主义大师路易斯·布努埃尔这部关于爱情出错的恶魔故事是他在墨西哥流亡二十年期间拍摄的最反常、最令人不安的电影之一。布努埃尔将自己的神经症融入到梅赛德斯·平托自传体小说的改编中，精心打造了一场表现主义风格的噩梦，其中一位年轻女子（迪莉娅·加尔塞斯饰）发现她的新丈夫（阿图罗·德·科尔多瓦饰）外表成熟，却隐藏着令人不安的嫉妒和偏执。 《El》是对宗教和社会虚伪的典型的原始控诉，是导演对情节剧的最伟大的探索，生动地描绘了社会无法抑制人类本我的非理性冲动。
hook_en: Spanish surrealist master Luis Buñuel’s fiendish tale of love gone wrong is among the most perverse and unsettling films he made during his two decades of exile in Mexico. Folding his own neuroses into an adaptation of Mercedes Pinto’s autobiographical novel, Buñuel crafts an expressionistically stylized nightmare in which a young woman (Delia Garcés) discovers that the outward sophistication of her new husband (Arturo de Córdova) masks disturbing depths of jealousy and paranoia. A characteristically raw indictment of religious and social hypocrisy, Él stands as the director’s greatest excursion into melodrama, a vivid portrayal of society’s inability to restrain the irrational urges of the human id.

hook: 《地狱之门》荣获奥斯卡最佳外语片奖和最佳服装设计奖，是衣笠贞之助的一部视觉华丽、心理深刻的作品。在十二世纪日本史诗般的暴力阴谋中，一位帝国武士爱上了一位侍女；当他发现她结婚后，他变得疯狂地试图赢得她的爱。衣笠的电影是日本彩色电影的早期胜利，是一个关于痴迷和单相思的令人难忘的悲剧故事。
hook_en: A winner of Academy Awards for best foreign-language film and best costume design, Gate of Hell is a visually sumptuous, psychologically penetrating work from Teinosuke Kinugasa. In the midst of epic, violent intrigue in twelfth-century Japan, an imperial warrior falls for a lady-in-waiting; after he discovers she is married, he becomes frenzied in his attempts to win her love. Kinugasa’s film, an early triumph of color cinematography in Japan, is an unforgettable, tragic story of obsession and unrequited passion.

hook: 马克斯·奥菲尔斯 (Max Ophuls) 带着令人眼花缭乱的移动相机，在 19 世纪末法国生活的颓废舞厅、田园乡村静修处、城市妓院和画家工作室中漫游，在这部由盖伊·德·莫泊桑 (Guy de Maupassant) 创作的关于精神和身体愉悦极限的三联故事中，展现了他惊人的视觉灵巧和讲故事的勇气。 《快乐》以令人惊叹的法国明星阵容（包括丹妮尔·达里厄、让·加宾和西蒙·西蒙）为主角，以迷人而精致的轻松感精准地指出了生活中的残酷讽刺和幸福妥协。
hook_en: Roving with his dazzlingly mobile camera around the decadent ballrooms, bucolic countryside retreats, urban bordellos, and painter's studios of late nineteenth-century French life, Max Ophuls brings his astonishing visual dexterity and storytelling bravura to this triptych of tales by Guy de Maupassant about the limits of spiritual and physical pleasure. Featuring a stunning cast of French stars (including Danielle Darrieux, Jean Gabin, and Simone Simon), Le plaisir pinpoints the cruel ironies and happy compromises of life with a charming and sophisticated breeziness.

hook: 费德里科·费里尼凭借漫画家的背景创作了他的第一部个人长片，这是一部关于幻想的诱惑和诱惑的陷阱的迷人漫画寓言。在罗马度蜜月时，一位睁大眼睛的新婚夫妇（布鲁内拉·博沃饰）偷偷离开了拘谨的新郎（莱奥波尔多·特里雅斯特饰），去寻找白酋长（阿尔贝托·索尔迪饰），他是一部她所迷恋的漫画中的帅气英雄，但很快发现她的浪漫理想可能只是一种幻觉。朱丽叶塔·马西纳（Giulietta Masina）（饰演她将在《卡比利亚之夜》中再次扮演的角色）令人难忘的出场以及费里尼与作曲家尼诺·罗塔（Nino Rota）的首次合作，《白酋长》发现导演已经开始采用他最喜欢的主题之一：生活与艺术、想象与现实之间的炼金术相互作用。
hook_en: Federico Fellini drew upon his background as a cartoonist for his first solo feature, a charming comic fable about the lure of fantasy and the pitfalls of temptation. In Rome for her honeymoon, a wide-eyed newlywed (Brunella Bovo) sneaks away from her straitlaced groom (Leopoldo Trieste) and goes in search of the White Sheik (Alberto Sordi), the dashing hero of a photographed comic strip of which she is enamored—but soon discovers that her romantic ideal may be only an illusion. Featuring a memorable appearance by Giulietta Masina (playing the character she would reprise in Nights of Cabiria) and Fellini’s first collaboration with composer Nino Rota, The White Sheik finds the director already taking up one of his favorite themes: the alchemical interplay between life and art, imagination and reality.

hook: 沟口健二是一位无与伦比的心灵编年史家，专注于拍摄有关日本社会女性处境的极其情感丰富、视觉精美的电影，自 1952 年拍摄《大春的一生》以来，他已经导演了几十年的电影。但是，这部史诗般的描绘了不可避免的失宠的故事，由田中绢代主演，饰演一位逐渐堕落到街头卖淫的帝国侍女，这部电影为这位导演赢得了国际关注，开创了新的黄金时代。对他来说的时期。
hook_en: A peerless chronicler of the soul who specialized in supremely emotional, visually exquisite films about the circumstances of women in Japanese society, Kenji Mizoguchi had already been directing movies for decades when he made The Life of Oharu in 1952. But this epic portrait of an inexorable fall from grace, starring the astounding Kinuyo Tanaka as an imperial lady-in-waiting who gradually descends to street prostitution, was the movie that gained the director international attention, ushering in a new golden period for him.

hook: 一位新牧师（克洛德·莱杜饰）抵达法国乡村安布里库尔，开始管理他的第一个教区。冷漠而充满敌意的农村会众立即拒绝了他。通过他的日记，这位受苦的年轻人传达了一种信仰危机，这种危机有可能使他远离村庄和上帝。在他的第四部电影中，罗伯特·布列松开始贯彻他作为电影制片人的风格哲学，从他的作品、对话和音乐中剔除所有无关紧要的元素，严格要求图像和声音的纯粹性。
hook_en: A new priest (Claude Laydu) arrives in the French country village of Ambricourt to attend to his first parish. The apathetic and hostile rural congregation rejects him immediately. Through his diary entries, the suffering young man relays a crisis of faith that threatens to drive him away from the village and from God. With his fourth film, Robert Bresson began to implement his stylistic philosophy as a filmmaker, stripping away all inessential elements from his compositions, the dialogue and the music, exacting a purity of image and sound.

hook: 著名电影制作人维托里奥·德·西卡继其在国际上大获成功的《偷自行车贼》之后，又推出了这部迷人而有趣的新现实主义童话故事，他在其中将著名的生活片段诗歌与优雅的喜剧和童话般的幻想结合起来。在米兰郊区，一群流浪汉共同建立了一个棚户区。然而，当人们发现他们占据的土地上蕴藏着石油时，天真的孤儿托托（弗朗西斯科·戈利萨诺饰）就需要在神的帮助下，从贪婪的开发商手中拯救他们的社区。向查尔斯·卓别林和雷内·克莱尔的想象力致敬，德·西卡和编剧切萨雷·扎瓦蒂尼改编了他自己的小说，为普通人的贵族创作了一首慷慨的颂歌。
hook_en: Renowned filmmaker Vittorio De Sica followed up his international triumph Bicycle Thieves with this enchantingly playful neorealist fairy tale, in which he combines his celebrated slice-of-life poetry with flights of graceful comedy and storybook fantasy. On the outskirts of Milan, a band of vagabonds work together to form a shantytown. When it is discovered that the land they occupy contains oil, however, it’s up to the cherubic orphan Totò (Francesco Golisano)—with some divine help—to save their community from greedy developers. Tipping their hats to the imaginative whimsy of Charles Chaplin and René Clair, De Sica and screenwriter Cesare Zavattini, adapting his own novel, craft a bighearted ode to the nobility of everyday people.

hook: 由阿尔贝托·拉蒂乌与费德里科·费里尼的合作完成，费里尼的导演处女作在杂耍小剧团五彩斑斓的背景下展开，该小剧团的理想主义老板（佩普利诺·迪·菲利波）被一位有抱负的年轻舞者（卡拉·德尔·波乔）的魅力所吸引，诱惑他离开了他忠实的情人（朱丽叶塔·马辛娜）。尽管两位导演之间的分工细节不明确，但这部生动的幕后趣事无疑是费里尼式的，它在梦幻般的现实、狂欢节人物和演艺界的异国情调方面，对表演世界充满了 whimsical 兴趣。在她与她导演丈夫的首次备受赞誉的合作中，朱丽叶塔·马辛娜展示了她很快成为电影情感主义典范的活力与脆弱。
hook_en: Made in collaboration with Alberto Lattuada, Federico Fellini’s directorial debut unfolds amid the colorful backdrop of a traveling vaudeville troupe whose quixotic impresario (Peppino De Filippo) is tempted away from his faithful mistress (Giulietta Masina) by the charms of an ambitious young dancer (Carla Del Poggio). Though the details of what the division of duties was between the two directors are unclear, this lively backstage capriccio is unmistakably Felliniesque in its whimsical fascination with the heightened reality, carnivalesque characters, and exotic allure of the world of show business. In the first of her celebrated collaborations with her director husband, Giulietta Masina displays the spirited vulnerability that would soon become an archetype of cinematic emotiveness.

hook: 在阿巴斯·基亚罗斯塔米最伟大的电影成就之一中，日常生活的奥秘成为令人惊讶的焦点。 《风将载着我们》是对导演自身艺术实践的一种狡猾的自我反省评论，以不紧不慢的威严展开，讲述了一位卧底纪录片导演（贝扎德·多拉尼饰）的故事，他负责报道一个小村庄的葬礼，却因一位老妇拒绝死亡而不断受挫。然而，一路走来，他与他遇到的人建立了令人惊讶、不安和启发性的联系。这部冥想杰作充满了基亚罗斯塔米对人民、诗歌和伊朗乡村干旱之美的热爱，以极其优雅的方式反映了亲密与疏远、传统与现代之间的界限。
hook_en: The mysteries of everyday life come into astonishing focus in one of Abbas Kiarostami’s greatest cinematic achievements. A slyly self-reflexive commentary on the director’s own artistic practice, The Wind Will Carry Us unfolds with unhurried majesty as it follows an undercover documentarian (Behzad Dorani) whose assignment to cover a small village’s funeral rites is continually frustrated by an elderly woman’s refusal to die. Along the way, though, he forges surprising, unsettling, and enlightening connections with those he meets. Suffused with Kiarostami’s love for people, poetry, and the arid beauty of rural Iran, this meditative masterpiece reflects upon the boundaries between intimacy and alienation, tradition and modernity, with the utmost grace.

hook: 《卡洛斯》由奥利维尔·阿萨亚斯执导，是一部史诗般的、极其详细的故事，讲述了臭名昭著的国际恐怖分子伊利奇·拉米雷斯·桑切斯（也被称为“豺狼卡洛斯”）的一生。卡洛斯是二十世纪头号通缉犯之一，在整个七八十年代致力于暴力左翼激进主义，在欧洲和中东策划了爆炸、绑架和劫持事件。阿萨亚斯没有将他描绘成一个犯罪主谋，而是将他描绘成世界各地剧烈政治变革的象征，而富有魅力的埃德加·拉米雷斯则出色地将他描绘成一个趾高气扬的全球黑帮。 Criterion 呈现了完整的、未剪辑的、导演认可的、五个半小时的卡洛斯版本。
hook_en: Carlos, directed by Olivier Assayas, is an epic, intensely detailed account of the life of the infamous international terrorist Ilich Ramírez Sánchez—also known as Carlos the Jackal. One of the twentieth century’s most wanted fugitives, Carlos was committed to violent left-wing activism throughout the seventies and eighties, orchestrating bombings, kidnappings, and hijackings in Europe and the Middle East. Assayas portrays him not as a criminal mastermind but as a symbol of seismic political shifts around the world, while the magnetic Édgar Ramírez brilliantly embodies him as a swaggering global gangster. Criterion presents the complete, uncut, director-approved, five-and-a-half-hour version of Carlos.

hook: 卡罗尔·里德这部黑色心理小说主要发生在一个紧张的夜晚，故事发生在不知名的贝尔法斯特，詹姆斯·梅森饰演一名有革命前科的犯人，领导了一场严重的抢劫。他受伤并遭到警察追捕，他在整个城市寻求庇护，而他所爱的女人（凯瑟琳·瑞安饰）则在阴影中寻找他。里德和电影摄影师罗伯特·克拉斯克（他将在《第三人》中再次合作）为这部对一个人与自己的终极对抗的激烈而精神的描绘创造了令人惊叹的深度图像。
hook_en: Taking place largely over the course of one tense night, Carol Reed’s psychological noir, set in an unnamed Belfast, stars James Mason as a revolutionary ex-con leading a robbery that goes horribly wrong. Injured and hunted by the police, he seeks refuge throughout the city, while the woman he loves (Kathleen Ryan) searches for him among the shadows. Reed and cinematographer Robert Krasker (who would collaborate again on The Third Man) create images of stunning depth for this fierce, spiritual depiction of a man’s ultimate confrontation with himself.

hook: 维托里奥·德·西卡的奥斯卡获奖影片是新现实主义的国际突破，讲述了在 20 世纪 40 年代意大利的贫困现实中迷失的纯真寓言。在罗马的街道上，两个男孩——最好的朋友朱塞佩（里纳尔多·斯莫多尼饰）和帕斯夸莱（弗兰科·因特伦吉饰）——开始通过擦鞋来筹集资金购买一匹马。当他们无意中陷入抢劫并被送往残酷的少管所时，他们对彼此的忠诚受到了严峻的考验。 《擦鞋》以孩童的视角描绘了经济斗争的毁灭性景象，成为战后意大利电影制作的决定性成就之一。
hook_en: An international breakthrough for neorealism, Vittorio De Sica’s Academy Award–winning film is an indelible fable of innocence lost amid the hardscrabble reality of 1940s Italy. On the streets of Rome, two boys—best friends Giuseppe (Rinaldo Smordoni) and Pasquale (Franco Interlenghi)—set out to raise the money to buy a horse by shining shoes. When they are inadvertently caught up in a robbery and sent to a brutal juvenile detention center, their loyalty to each other is severely tested. A devastating portrait of economic struggle made all the more haunting by its child’s-eye perspective, Shoeshine stands as one of the defining achievements of postwar Italian filmmaking.

hook: 在保罗·罗伯逊的 11 部主演电影表演中，迄今为止，他最具标志性的作品是他在改编自尤金·奥尼尔的《琼斯皇帝》（1933 年）的大银幕上取得的突破。他在舞台上扮演的布鲁图斯·琼斯已经成为传奇人物，布鲁图斯·琼斯是一名普尔曼搬运工，凭借自己的力量统治了加勒比海岛屿，但在这个有声时代的电影角色中，他的帝王形象与他洪亮的声音永远结合在一起。凭借《琼斯皇帝》，罗伯逊成为主流电影中第一位非裔美国男主角，他说，他对电影改变种族误解的潜力有了更深入的了解。之前经过审查的《琼斯皇帝》以最完整的形式呈现在这里。
hook_en: Of all Paul Robeson's eleven starring film performances, by far his most iconic was his breakthrough in the big-screen adaptation of Eugene O'Neill's The Emperor Jones (1933). He was already a legend for his stage incarnation of Brutus Jones, a Pullman porter who powers his way to the rule of a Caribbean island, but with this, his first sound-era film role, his regal image was married to his booming voice for eternity. With The Emperor Jones, Robeson became the first African-American leading man in mainstream movies and, he said, gained a deeper understanding of cinema's potential to change racial misconceptions. Previously censored, The Emperor Jones is presented here in its most complete form.

hook: 市川昆执导的《东京奥林匹克运动会》呈现出宏伟的规模和非凡的亲密感，仍然是有史以来最伟大的体育电影之一。市川带领着一支庞大的技术人员团队，使用数十台摄像机，以绚丽的宽银幕图像捕捉了 1964 年东京夏季奥运会的画面，并使用尖端的长焦镜头和精致的慢动作，从他周围汹涌澎湃的体育戏剧中创造出了抒情而独特的诗篇。市川对失败者和胜利者的心理同样着迷，其中包括传奇的埃塞俄比亚马拉松运动员阿贝贝·比基拉（Abebe Bikila），他在影片中获得了最崇高的敬意。他以独特的人文视野捕捉了竞争的胜利、激情和痛苦，从而对纪录片制作艺术产生了变革性的影响。
hook_en: A spectacle of magnificent proportions and remarkable intimacy, Kon Ichikawa’s Tokyo Olympiad remains one of the greatest films ever made about sports. Supervising a vast team of technicians using scores of cameras, Ichikawa captured the 1964 Summer Games in Tokyo in glorious widescreen images, using cutting-edge telephoto lenses and exquisite slow motion to create lyrical, idiosyncratic poetry from the athletic drama surging all around him. Drawn equally to the psychology of losers and winners—including the legendary Ethiopian marathoner Abebe Bikila, who receives the film’s most exalted tribute—Ichikawa captures the triumph, passion, and suffering of competition with a singular humanistic vision, and in doing so effected a transformative influence on the art of documentary filmmaking.

hook: 好莱坞黄金时代的人文主义大师利奥·麦卡里将他优雅的笔触和轻松的自然主义带入了这部崇高的浪漫故事中，成为电影中最令人陶醉、催人泪下的影片之一。艾琳·邓恩（Irene Dunne）和查尔斯·博耶（Charles Boyer）是时尚的陌生人，他们在一艘开往纽约的远洋客轮上相遇并坠入爱河。尽管他们都与其他人有关系，但他们还是约定六个月后在帝国大厦的顶层重新联系——直到命运之手使他们不幸的恋情悲剧性地偏离了轨道。令人陶醉的激情和温柔的喜剧在精致温柔的《爱情事件》（获得六项奥斯卡提名）中完美和谐地共存，这个故事是如此永恒，以至于多年来它被多位电影制片人翻拍——包括麦卡里本人，他将其更新为同样受人喜爱的《难忘的事件》。
hook_en: Golden-age Hollywood’s humanist master Leo McCarey brings his graceful touch and relaxed naturalism to this sublime romance, one of cinema’s most intoxicating tear-wringers. Irene Dunne and Charles Boyer are chic strangers who meet and fall in love aboard an ocean liner bound for New York. Though they are both involved with other people, they make a pact to reconnect six months later at the top of the Empire State Building—until the hand of fate throws their star-crossed affair tragically off course. Swooning passion and gentle comedy coexist in perfect harmony in the exquisitely tender Love Affair (nominated for six Oscars), a story so timeless that it has been remade by multiple filmmakers over the years—including McCarey himself, who updated it as the no less beloved An Affair to Remember.

hook: 电影中最潇洒的二人组之一，现实生活中的夫妻费雯·丽和劳伦斯·奥利弗在这部由传奇制片人兼导演亚历山大·科达执导的视觉上令人眼花缭乱的悲剧爱情故事中，演绎了他们最伟大的银幕爱情故事。 《汉密尔顿的女人》以十八世纪末拿破仑战争为背景，扣人心弦地讲述了英国皇家海军军官霍雷肖·纳尔逊勋爵与英国大使夫人、著名美女艾玛·汉密尔顿夫人之间的丑闻通奸事件。 《汉密尔顿的女人》（温斯顿·丘吉尔最喜欢的电影，他声称自己看过八十多次）凭借其宏伟的海战和令人惊叹的明星表演，将历史带入生动、迷人的生活。
hook_en: One of cinema’s most dashing duos, real-life spouses Vivien Leigh and Laurence Olivier live their greatest on-screen romance in this visually dazzling tragic love story from legendary producer-director Alexander Korda. Set against the backdrop of the Napoleonic Wars of the late eighteenth century, That Hamilton Woman is a gripping account of the scandalous adulterous affair between the British Royal Navy officer Lord Horatio Nelson and the renowned beauty Emma, Lady Hamilton, the wife of a British ambassador. With its grandly designed sea battles and formidable star performances, That Hamilton Woman (Winston Churchill’s favorite movie, which he claimed to have seen over eighty times) brings history to vivid, glamorous life.

hook: 玛琳·黛德丽和詹姆斯·斯图尔特在这部精彩的喜剧西部片中表现出色，既是一场热闹的恶搞，也是该类型的光辉典范。迪特里希饰演爱吵闹、打闹的酒馆歌手弗朗奇，摆脱了异国情调的爱情女神形象，成功卷土重来，而斯图尔特在他的众多西部片中的第一部中，巩固了他和蔼可亲的普通人形象，以迷人的转变，饰演一名厌恶枪支的副警长，利用自己的智慧为边境小镇瓶颈带来了法律和秩序。闪闪发光的剧本、技艺精湛的角色演员的配角阵容，以及充满魅力的迪特里希以无与伦比的虚张声势演绎的欢快的音乐片段，共同创造了一个令人难以抗拒、经常被模仿的工作室时代工艺奇迹。
hook_en: Marlene Dietrich and James Stewart ride high in this superb comedic western, both a boisterous spoof and a shining example of its genre. As the brawling, rough-and-tumble saloon singer Frenchy, Dietrich shed her exotic love-goddess image and launched a triumphant career comeback, while Stewart cemented his amiable everyman persona, in his first of many westerns, with a charming turn as a gun-abhorring deputy sheriff who uses his wits to bring law and order to the frontier town of Bottleneck. A sparkling script, a supporting cast of virtuoso character actors, and rollicking musical numbers—delivered with unmatched bravado by the magnetic Dietrich—come together to create an irresistible, oft-imitated marvel of studio-era craftsmanship.

hook: 《只有天使有翅膀》由霍华德·霍克斯的精彩对话和视觉技巧所震撼，让·亚瑟饰演一位旅行艺人，在南美港口小镇中途停留时，她得到了超出她预期的收获。在那里，她遇到了一位英俊而冷漠的勇敢飞行员，由卡里·格兰特饰演，他经营着一家航空邮件公司，在为危险山区的城镇提供服务时，他直视着死亡。她既被他浪漫的危险感所吸引，又被他所排斥，尽管他提出抗议，她还是决定留下来。这部精湛而神秘的冒险片采用了奥斯卡提名的特效、高空钢丝航空摄影，丽塔·海华斯扮演了一个小而突破的角色，探索了霍克斯反复出现的男性准则和质疑这些准则的坚强女性的主题。
hook_en: Electrified by crackling dialogue and visual craftsmanship of the great Howard Hawks, Only Angels Have Wings stars Jean Arthur as a traveling entertainer who gets more than she bargained for during a stopover in a South American port town. There she meets a handsome and aloof daredevil pilot, played by Cary Grant, who runs an airmail company, staring down death while servicing towns in treacherous mountain terrain. Both attracted to and repelled by his romantic sense of danger, she decides to stay on, despite his protestations. This masterful and mysterious adventure, featuring Oscar-nominated special effects, high-wire aerial photography, and Rita Hayworth in a small but breakout role, explores Hawks’s recurring themes of masculine codes and the strong-willed women who question them.

hook: 很少有美国历史人物像亚伯拉罕·林肯那样受到尊敬，也很少有导演与明星的合作能够像约翰·福特和亨利·方达之间的合作那样完美地体现经典好莱坞电影。这部电影是他们的第一部合作电影，是福特继开创性的西部片《驿马车》之后同样富有诗意和重要的后续作品，方达在这部电影中展现了他职业生涯中最精彩的表演之一，饰演年轻的未来总统，一名与燃烧性谋杀案作斗争的新手律师。 《年轻的林肯先生》由福特的长期合作者伯特·格伦农 (Bert Glennon) 以华丽的黑白照片拍摄，是一部充满同情心和自信的作品，也是不可磨灭的美国精神的一部分。
hook_en: Few American historical figures are as revered as Abraham Lincoln, and few director-star collaborations embody classic Hollywood cinema as beautifully as the one between John Ford and Henry Fonda. This film, their first together, was Ford’s equally poetic and significant follow-up to the groundbreaking western Stagecoach, and in it Fonda gives one of the finest performances of his career, as the young president-to-be, a novice lawyer struggling with an incendiary murder case. Photographed in gorgeous black and white by Ford’s frequent collaborator Bert Glennon, Young Mr. Lincoln is a compassionate and assured work and an indelible piece of Americana.

hook: 著名剧作家兼电影导演马塞尔·帕尼奥尔的温暖和智慧在这部迷人的生活喜剧中熠熠生辉。回到他熟悉的普罗旺斯乡村，帕尼奥尔生动地描绘了一个紧密联系的村庄，在那里，一位甜蜜迷惑的面包师（无与伦比的雷穆，被奥森·威尔斯称赞为“有史以来最伟大的演员”）的婚姻困境像滚雪球一样发展成席卷整个小镇的丑闻。 《面包师的妻子》结合了导演对普通人经历的持久关注和低调但审慎的视觉风格，在描述人际关系的复杂性时既非常滑稽又具有敏锐的洞察力。
hook_en: The warmth and wit of celebrated playwright turned cinema auteur Marcel Pagnol shine in this enchanting slice-of-life comedy. Returning to the Provençal countryside he knew intimately, Pagnol draws a vivid portrait of a close-knit village where the marital woes of a sweetly deluded baker (the inimitable Raimu, praised by no less than Orson Welles as “the greatest actor who ever lived”) snowball into a scandal that engulfs the town. Marrying the director’s abiding concern for the experiences of ordinary people with an understated but superbly judged visual style, The Baker’s Wife is at once wonderfully droll and piercingly perceptive in its depiction of the complexities of human relationships.

hook: 在《马赛三部曲》的最后一章中，马塞尔·帕尼奥尔将富有同情心的目光重新投向他那些饱经风霜的人物，因为他们发现了和解的可能性和爱情的持久性。跨越二十年，三部曲随着范妮的丈夫帕尼斯的去世以及她的儿子塞萨里奥发现她的秘密而继续。年轻人决心寻找他的亲生父亲马吕斯，他的生活充满了灾难和贫困。三部曲中唯一一部专门为银幕创作的电影，由帕尼奥尔执导，《凯撒》以饶舌的智慧和低调的自然主义解决了主角们命运多舛的命运，使这部史诗般的爱情故事成为人文主义电影制作的里程碑。
hook_en: In the final chapter of The Marseille Trilogy, Marcel Pagnol returns his compassionate gaze to his weathered characters as they discover the possibility of reconciliation and the durability of love. Leaping forward twenty years, the trilogy continues with the death of Fanny’s husband, Panisse, and the discovery of her secret by her son, Césariot. The young man resolves to track down his biological father, Marius, whose life has been fraught with calamity and poverty. The only film in the trilogy written expressly for the screen and directed by Pagnol, César resolves the protagonists’ star-crossed destinies with the garrulous wit and understated naturalism that have made this epic love story a landmark of humanist filmmaking.

hook: 有史以来最受欢迎的意大利电影制片人的最大热门作品《甜蜜的生活》通过对明星文化提出了严厉的批评，使费德里科·费里尼迅速获得了国际主流的成功。影片讲述了一位臭名昭著的名人记者（极其酷的马塞洛·马斯楚安尼饰）在聚光灯下度过的忙碌的一周，讲述了罗马富有和迷人的生活方式背后的黑暗。这张辛辣的图画是对当代欧洲日益加深的颓废的尖锐评论，它让我们看到了我们的社会将变得如何痴迷于八卦和名誉。
hook_en: The biggest hit from the most popular Italian filmmaker of all time, La dolce vita rocketed Federico Fellini to international mainstream success—ironically, by offering a damning critique of the culture of stardom. A look at the darkness beneath the seductive lifestyles of Rome’s rich and glamorous, the film follows a notorious celebrity journalist (a sublimely cool Marcello Mastroianni) during a hectic week spent on the peripheries of the spotlight. This mordant picture was an incisive commentary on the deepening decadence of contemporary Europe, and it provided a prescient glimpse of just how gossip- and fame-obsessed our society would become.

hook: 尚塔尔·阿克曼 (Chantal Akerman) 饰演的珍妮·迪尔曼 (Jeanne Dielman)，23 岁，布鲁塞尔 1080 号商业街，是电影史上的一部非凡之作，带着一种厄运即将来临的感觉，细致地详细描述了一位中年寡妇的日常生活，她的家务包括铺床、为儿子做饭，以及偶尔变戏法。阿克曼的电影看似简单，但却涵盖了整个世界。无论是被视为严格的人物研究，还是电影中对时空最催眠、最完整的描述之一，《珍妮·迪尔曼》都是一部令人惊叹、引人入胜的电影实验，几十年来一直被分析和争论。
hook_en: A singular work in film history, Chantal Akerman’s Jeanne Dielman, 23, quai du Commerce, 1080 Bruxelles meticulously details, with a sense of impending doom, the daily routine of a middle-aged widow, whose chores include making the beds, cooking dinner for her son, and turning the occasional trick. In its enormous spareness, Akerman’s film seems simple, but it encompasses an entire world. Whether seen as an exacting character study or as one of cinema’s most hypnotic and complete depictions of space and time, Jeanne Dielman is an astonishing, compelling movie experiment, one that has been analyzed and argued over for decades.

hook: 桑德琳·布诺内尔凭借在《浪迹儿》中饰演的反叛青年莫娜赢得了最佳女主角凯萨奖，莫娜在电影开头被发现死在路边的水沟里。阿涅斯·瓦尔达通过那些曾遇到过莫娜的人的闪回故事拼凑出莫娜的故事，这部电影（无家可归，无依无靠）中的非专业演员阵容几乎全由非专业演员组成，从而呈现出一个神秘女性的破碎肖像。凭借其简洁而诗意的画面，《浪迹儿》是一部令人惊叹的作品，还赢得了威尼斯电影节的最高荣誉。
hook_en: Sandrine Bonnaire won the Best Actress César for her portrayal of the defiant young drifter Mona, found frozen to death in a ditch at the beginning of Vagabond. Agnès Varda pieces together Mona’s story through flashbacks told by those who encountered her (played by a largely nonprofessional cast), producing a splintered portrait of an enigmatic woman. With its sparse, poetic imagery, Vagabond (Sans toit ni loi) is a stunner, and won Varda the top prize at the Venice Film Festival.

hook: 奥森·威尔斯的《阿卡丁先生》（又名《机密报告》）讲述了一位难以捉摸的亿万富翁的故事，他雇佣了一名美国走私犯来调查他的过去，导致他陷入冷战时期的欧洲景观。这部电影的历史也以这种眩晕为标志。至少有八个阿卡丁先生：三部广播剧、一部小说、几部失传已久的剪辑，以及备受争议的欧洲版本《机密报告》。 Criterion Collection 汇集了所有这些元素，打造了这套具有里程碑意义的套装，其中还包括片段、幕后花絮和电影的综合版本，最终揭开了电影的一大谜团。
hook_en: Orson Welles’s Mr. Arkadin (a.k.a. Confidential Report) tells the story of an elusive billionaire who hires an American smuggler to investigate his past, leading to a dizzying descent into a Cold War European landscape. The film’s history is also marked by this vertigo. There are at least eight Mr. Arkadins: three radio plays, a novel, several long-lost cuts, and the controversial European release known as Confidential Report. The Criterion Collection gathered all of these elements to create this landmark box set—which also includes outtakes, behind-the-scenes footage, and a comprehensive version of the film—at last unraveling one of cinema’s great mysteries.

hook: 帕维·帕夫利科夫斯基创作的这部波澜壮阔、疯狂的浪漫故事始于波兰乡村，维克托（托马斯·科特饰）是一位执行国家资助的民歌收集任务的音乐家，在那里发现了一位迷人的年轻歌手祖拉（乔安娜·库利格饰），在一场永恒的表演中。在接下来的十五年里，他们动荡的关系将在他逃往的颓废波西米亚巴黎的爵士乐俱乐部和她留在的腐败、专制的共产主义集团之间的偷偷时刻上演——他们对音乐和彼此的热情将这两个世界联系起来。帕夫利科夫斯基的永恒故事以甜美的单色照片拍摄，充满了简单民歌的忧郁，这为这对夫妇的命运般的恋情提供了主题，受他自己父母的启发，这是一个令人心碎的宏大愿景，讲述了不幸的爱情卷入了历史的浪潮。
hook_en: This sweeping, delirious romance by Paweł Pawlikowski begins in the Polish countryside, where Wiktor (Tomasz Kot), a musician on a state-sponsored mission to collect folk songs, discovers a captivating young singer named Zula (Joanna Kulig, in a performance for the ages). Over the next fifteen years, their turbulent relationship will play out in stolen moments between the jazz clubs of decadent bohemian Paris, to which he escapes, and the corrupt, repressive Communist Bloc, where she remains—universes bridged by their passion for music and for each other. Photographed in luscious monochrome and suffused with the melancholy of the simple folk song that provides a motif for the couple’s fateful affair, Pawlikowski’s timeless story—inspired by that of his own parents—is a heart-stoppingly grand vision of star-crossed love caught up in the tide of history.

hook: “梦幻”才刚刚开始描述这部中国电影和武侠电影的杰作。胡金铨的《侠女》描绘了杨贵妃的旅程，她是一位乔装打扮的逃亡贵妇，到一个偏远且据说闹鬼的村庄寻求庇护。当一名邪恶的剑客揭露了她的身份时，她和她的三个同伴与一位害羞的学者找到的庇护所被打破了，五人与大量挥舞着剑的对手展开了对决。 《侠女》既是一部武侠电影，也是一部关于精神探索的故事，也是一部对人性的研究，是胡锦涛伟大事业中无与伦比的作品，也是一部最高级别的史诗，其特点是令人惊叹的动作编排、令人惊叹的宽银幕风景和创新的剪辑。
hook_en: “Visionary” barely begins to describe this masterpiece of Chinese cinema and martial arts moviemaking. A Touch of Zen (Xia nu) by King Hu depicts the journey of Yang, a fugitive noblewoman in disguise who seeks refuge in a remote, and allegedly haunted, village. The sanctuary she and her three companions find with a shy scholar is shattered when a nefarious swordsman uncovers her identity, pitting the five against legions of blade-wielding opponents. At once a wuxia film, the tale of a spiritual quest, and a study in human nature, A Touch of Zen is an unparalleled work in Hu’s formidable career and an epic of the highest order, characterized by breathtaking action choreography, stunning widescreen landscapes, and innovative editing.

hook: 传奇导演尼古拉斯·雷以这部抒情黑色电影开始了他的职业生涯，这是一系列充满对美国被排斥者和弱势群体的同情的存在主义类型电影中的第一部。当与银行劫匪一起越狱的睁大眼睛的逃犯鲍伊（法利·格兰杰饰）遇到无辜的基奇（凯茜·奥唐纳饰）时，两人都认识到对方身上有一些别人从未有过的东西。这对年轻恋人憧憬着一起过上新的、体面的生活，但当他们逃离警察并与鲍伊的不法之徒同伙抗争时，他们不打算放过鲍伊，他们意识到无处可逃。雷将在戏剧中磨练出来的局外人的感性带到了这部处女作中，使用革命性的摄影技术和自然主义的表演打造了一部深刻浪漫的犯罪剧，为数十年来的逃亡恋人惊悚片铺平了道路。
hook_en: Legendary director Nicholas Ray began his career with this lyrical film noir, the first in a series of existential genre films overflowing with sympathy for America’s outcasts and underdogs. When the wide-eyed fugitive Bowie (Farley Granger), having broken out of prison with some bank robbers, meets the innocent Keechie (Cathy O’Donnell), each recognizes something in the other that no one else ever has. The young lovers envision a new, decent life together, but as they flee the cops and contend with Bowie’s fellow outlaws, who aren’t about to let him go straight, they realize there’s nowhere left to run. Ray brought an outsider’s sensibility honed in the theater to this debut, using revolutionary camera techniques and naturalistic performances to craft a profoundly romantic crime drama that paved the way for decades of lovers-on-the-run thrillers to come.

hook: 迈克尔·鲍威尔 (Michael Powell) 和埃默里克·普莱斯伯格 (Emeric Pressburger) 在这部独一无二的经典故事中创造了电影与歌剧的梦幻结合。在雅克·奥芬巴赫的奇幻歌剧《霍夫曼的故事》中，一位诗人梦见了三个女人——一个机械表演娃娃、一个戴着珠宝的塞壬和一位著名作曲家的肺病女儿——她们都以不同的方式让他心碎。鲍威尔和普莱斯伯格的这部狂热浪漫的改编作品是一场音乐、舞蹈和视觉效果的盛宴，也是有史以来最令人兴奋的歌剧电影之一。
hook_en: Michael Powell and Emeric Pressburger create a phantasmagoric marriage of cinema and opera in this one-of-a-kind take on a classic story. In Jacques Offenbach’s fantasy opera The Tales of Hoffmann, a poet dreams of three women—a mechanical performing doll, a bejeweled siren, and the consumptive daughter of a famous composer—all of whom break his heart in different ways. Powell and Pressburger’s feverishly romantic adaptation is a feast of music, dance, and visual effects, and one of the most exhilarating opera films ever produced.

hook: 谢丽尔·邓耶 (Cheryl Dunye) 的这部讽刺而深刻的处女作为电影带来了令人振奋的全新和突破性的东西：一位黑人女同性恋电影制片人对黑人女同性恋身份的生动表现。邓耶饰演谢丽尔，一位音像店店员和有抱负的导演，她对被遗忘的黑人女演员的兴趣促使她调查一位被称为“西瓜女人”的 20 世纪 30 年代默默无闻的表演者，事实证明，当谢丽尔与白人女友（吉妮薇尔·特纳饰）建立新关系时，她的故事与谢丽尔自己的生活产生了惊人的共鸣。 《西瓜女人》平衡了轻松的浪漫喜剧与对好莱坞黑人和酷儿女性历史的严肃探究，巧妙地改写了银幕上长期存在的种族和性观念，在美国电影中引入了一个重要的声音。
hook_en: The wry, incisive debut feature by Cheryl Dunye gave cinema something bracingly new and groundbreaking: a vibrant representation of Black lesbian identity by a Black lesbian filmmaker. Dunye stars as Cheryl, a video-store clerk and aspiring director whose interest in forgotten Black actresses leads her to investigate an obscure 1930s performer known as the Watermelon Woman, whose story proves to have surprising resonances with Cheryl’s own life as she navigates a new relationship with a white girlfriend (Guinevere Turner). Balancing breezy romantic comedy with a serious inquiry into the history of Black and queer women in Hollywood, The Watermelon Woman slyly rewrites long-standing constructions of race and sexuality on-screen, introducing an important voice in American cinema.

hook: 在他独一无二的小说/纪录片混合体《共生精神共生体：Take One》中，先锋威廉·格里夫斯在纽约中央公园主持着陷入困境的电影摄制组，让他们试图弄清楚他们正在制作什么样的电影。一对情侣一遍又一遍地上演分手场景，纪录片摄制组拍摄摄制组拍摄整个摄制组，当地人随意地走进画面：该项目难以简单描述。然而，这部六十年代反主流文化的疯狂创新的里程碑仍然是有史以来关于电影制作最集中和最有洞察力的电影之一，三十五年后，它的非常规后续作品《共生精神趋向性：采取》进一步扩展。在这部“续集”中，《Take One》演员奥黛丽·亨宁安 (Audrey Henningham) 和香农·贝克 (Shannon Baker) 重聚，以更加个人化、元戏剧的方式探索时间流逝对技术、艺术过程和关系（真实的和虚构的）的影响。
hook_en: In his one-of-a-kind fiction/documentary hybrid Symbiopsychotaxiplasm: Take One, the pioneering William Greaves presides over a beleaguered film crew in New York’s Central Park, leaving them to try to figure out what kind of movie they’re making. A couple enacts a breakup scenario over and over, a documentary crew films a crew filming the crew, locals wander casually into the frame: the project defies easy description. Yet this wildly innovative sixties counterculture landmark remains one of the most tightly focused and insightful movies ever made about making movies, expanded thirty-five years later by its unconventional follow-up, Symbiopsychotaxiplasm: Take . The “sequel” sees Take One actors Audrey Henningham and Shannon Baker reunited in a more personal, metatheatrical exploration of the effects of the passage of time on technology, the artistic process, and relationships—real and fabricated.

hook: 雷纳托（乌戈·托格纳齐饰）和阿尔宾（米歇尔·塞罗饰）是一对中年同性恋夫妇，他们是圣特罗佩一家华丽变装俱乐部的经理和明星表演者。当雷纳托儿子未婚妻的极端保守的父母来拜访时，他们同意隐藏自己的性别身份、华丽的个性和家居装饰。这个优雅的喜剧场景拉开了一场狂野而温暖的法国闹剧的序幕，这场闹剧讲述了不墨守成规和忠于自我的重要性。爱德华·莫利纳罗 (Edouard Molinaro) 的《La Cage aux Folles》在美国取得了突破性的艺术成就，为百老汇大型音乐剧和重拍版《鸟笼》提供了灵感。但凭借其搞笑的表演和超前的社会信息，没有什么比这部大胆、令人眼花缭乱的原创电影更好的了。
hook_en: Renato (Ugo Tognazzi) and Albin (Michel Serrault)—a middle-aged gay couple who are the manager and star performer at a glitzy drag club in Saint-Tropez—agree to hide their sexual identities, along with their flamboyant personalities and home decor, when the ultraconservative parents of Renato’s son’s fiancée come for a visit. This elegant comic scenario kicks off a wild and warmhearted French farce about the importance of nonconformity and being true to oneself. A breakout art-house smash in America, Edouard Molinaro’s La Cage aux Folles inspired a major Broadway musical and the blockbuster remake The Birdcage. But with its hilarious performances and ahead-of-its-time social message, there’s nothing like the audacious, dazzling original movie.

hook: 这部由英格玛·貝格曼改编的莫扎特经典歌剧《魔笛》，以其对音乐的深刻理解和电影化的表达，展示了欧洲最优秀的独唱演员，如约瑟夫·柯斯特利格、乌尔里克·科尔斯特、哈坎·哈格加德和比 Rita·诺丁等，生动再现了瑞典图林根宫的巴洛克剧院，讲述了王子塔米诺和他的乐观小伙伴帕帕吉诺被派去营救被邪恶势力束缚的美丽公主的故事。这是一部赞美爱与宽恕的电影，它对戏剧的技艺和表演的壮观表现得淋漓尽致，《魔笛》是迄今为止最精致的歌剧电影之一。
hook_en: This scintillating screen version of Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart’s beloved opera showcases Ingmar Bergman’s deep knowledge of music and gift for expressing it cinematically. Casting some of Europe’s finest soloists—Josef Köstlinger, Ulrik Cold, Håkan Hagegård, and Birgit Nordin among them—the director lovingly recreated the baroque theater of Sweden’s Drottningholm Palace to stage the story of the prince Tamino and his zestful sidekick Papageno, who are sent on a mission to save a beautiful princess from the clutches of evil. A celebration of love and forgiveness that exhibits a profound appreciation for the artifice and spectacle of the theater, The Magic Flute is among the most exquisite opera films ever made.

hook: Criterion 很荣幸地推出维克多·埃里切 (Víctor Erice) 引人入胜的《蜂巢精神》(El espíritu de la colmena)，该片被广泛认为是 20 世纪 70 年代最伟大的西班牙电影。 1940 年，卡斯蒂利亚的一个小村庄，该国毁灭性的内战结束后，六岁的安娜观看了弗兰肯斯坦的巡回电影放映，并被这段记忆所吸引。 《蜂巢之灵》是在佛朗哥的长期统治接近尾声时制作的，它对一个孩子的内心生活进行了迷人的描绘，也是有史以来最具视觉吸引力的电影之一。
hook_en: Criterion is proud to present Víctor Erice’s spellbinding The Spirit of the Beehive (El espíritu de la colmena), widely regarded as the greatest Spanish film of the 1970s. In a small Castilian village in 1940, in the wake of the country's devastating civil war, six-year-old Ana attends a traveling movie show of Frankenstein and becomes possessed by the memory of it. Produced as Franco’s long regime was nearing its end, The Spirit of the Beehive is a bewitching portrait of a child’s haunted inner life and one of the most visually arresting movies ever made.

hook: 路易斯·布努埃尔对乞丐宴会生活的不敬想象被许多人视为他的杰作，该片在西班牙被禁，首映后受到梵蒂冈的谴责。影片中，修女维里迪亚娜（西尔维娅·皮纳尔饰）竭尽全力维护自己的天主教原则，但她好色的叔叔（费尔南多·雷伊饰）和一群形形色色的乞丐迫使她面对理想主义的局限性。维莉迪亚娜 (Viridiana) 荣获 1961 年戛纳电影节金棕榈奖，如今她的大胆尝试一如既往。
hook_en: Banned in Spain and denounced by the Vatican upon its premiere, Luis Buñuel’s irreverent vision of life as a beggar’s banquet is regarded by many as his masterpiece. In it, novice nun Viridiana (Silvia Pinal) does her utmost to maintain her Catholic principles, but her lecherous uncle (Fernando Rey) and a motley assemblage of paupers force her to confront the limits of her idealism. Winner of the Palme d’Or at the 1961 Cannes Film Festival, Viridiana is as audacious today as ever.

hook: 这部黑色幽默的杰作在西班牙深受喜爱，但在其他地方却很少见，它通过一场可怕的闹剧对佛朗哥时代的价值观进行了严厉的批评，讲述了一名殡仪员娶了刽子手的女儿，并不情愿地接替了她父亲的工作，以便一家人能够保住政府分配的公寓。路易斯·加西亚·贝尔兰加 (Luis García Berlanga) 与长期担任编剧的拉斐尔·阿斯科纳 (Rafael Azcona) 之间的早期合作，在今天和 1963 年一样刻薄，准确无误地描述了贝尔兰加所说的“社会为我们设置的无形陷阱”。 《刽子手》对死刑进行了极其滑稽的人身攻击，避开了试图压制它的国家审查机构，如今被认为是有史以来最伟大的西班牙电影之一。
hook_en: This masterpiece of black humor, beloved in Spain but too little seen elsewhere, threads a scathing critique of Franco-era values through a macabre farce about an undertaker who marries an executioner’s daughter and reluctantly takes over her father’s job so the family can keep their government-allotted apartment. As caustic today as it was in 1963, this early collaboration between Luis García Berlanga and his longtime screenwriter Rafael Azcona is an unerring depiction of what Berlanga called “the invisible traps that society sets up for us.” A furiously funny personal attack on capital punishment, The Executioner evaded the state censors who sought to suppress it, and today is regarded as one of the greatest Spanish films of all time.

hook: 《夜间访客》是一部充满诗意和黑色幽默的作品，是法国伟大导演马塞尔·卡尔内的抒情中世纪奇幻作品。两个装扮成吟游诗人的陌生人（阿莱蒂和阿兰·库尼饰）在宫廷庆祝活动之前到达一座城堡，并发现他们是魔鬼的使者，被派去散布心碎和痛苦。然而，他们的计划因意想不到的入侵而受阻：人类的爱。 《晚间访客》经常被解读为纳粹占领法国的寓言，由雅克·普雷维尔和皮埃尔·拉罗什机智地创作，亚历山大·特劳纳优雅地设计，罗杰·休伯特拍摄，《晚间访客》是一部关于爱征服一切的感人故事。
hook_en: A work of poetry and dark humor, Les visiteurs du soir is a lyrical medieval fantasy from the great French director Marcel Carné. Two strangers dressed as minstrels (Arletty and Alain Cuny) arrive at a castle in advance of court festivities—and are revealed to be emissaries of the devil, dispatched to spread heartbreak and suffering. Their plans, however, are thwarted by an unexpected intrusion: human love. Often interpreted as an allegory for the Nazi occupation of France, during which it was made, Les visiteurs du soir—wittily written by Jacques Prévert and Pierre Laroche, and elegantly designed by Alexandre Trauner and shot by Roger Hubert—is a moving tale of love conquering all.

hook: 米拉·奈尔的第一部叙事长片《祝你孟买！》以万花筒般的方式描绘了孟买热闹的街头生活，将纪录片般的地方感与对日常恢复力的深刻探索结合在一起。年轻的克里希纳（沙菲克·赛义德 Shafiq Syed 饰）被家人抛弃后，他来到了这座城市，在那里他遇到了爱情、友谊和面对极端贫困的悲剧。奈尔从主要由她在街上遇到的孩子组成的演员阵容中汲取了令人信服的自然主义表演，创作了一部亲密的人性戏剧，时而令人心碎，时而肯定生命，这是一首对童年的颂歌，充满了丰富多彩的城市混乱和对生活在社会边缘的人们的深切同情。
hook_en: A kaleidoscopic portrait of Bombay’s teeming street life, Mira Nair’s first narrative feature, Salaam Bombay!, combines a documentary-like sense of place with a poignant exploration of everyday resilience. After the young Krishna (Shafiq Syed) is cast out by his family, he makes his way to the city, where he encounters love, friendship, and tragedy in the face of extreme poverty. Drawing compellingly naturalistic performances from a cast consisting largely of children she met on the streets, Nair creates an intimate human drama that is by turns heartbreaking and life-affirming, an ode to childhood that overflows with colorful urban chaos and a deep compassion for those who live on society’s margins.

hook: “我杀死父亲的那个夏天，我十岁……”卡西·莱蒙斯 (Kasi Lemmons) 引人入胜的处女作就此开始，这是一场令人回味的记忆迷宫之旅，沉浸在芬芳的南方哥特式氛围中。 1960 年代的路易斯安那州，一名年轻女孩（朱尼·斯莫利特饰）眼睁睁地看着她富裕的家庭因她迷人的父亲（塞缪尔·L·杰克逊饰）的不忠而分崩离析——引发了一系列欺骗和背叛，这将颠覆她的世界并挑战她对现实的理解。 《夏娃河口》植根于克里奥尔历史、民间传说和神秘主义，精彩地展示了强大的黑人女演员阵容——包括林恩·惠特菲尔德、黛比·摩根和扮演巫毒女祭司的传奇人物戴汉·卡罗尔——以及对创伤、宽恕和真理的难​​以捉摸本质的深刻宣泄探索。
hook_en: “The summer I killed my father, I was ten years old . . .” So begins Kasi Lemmons’s spellbinding feature debut, an evocative journey into the maze of memory, steeped in fragrant southern-gothic atmosphere. In 1960s Louisiana, a young girl (Jurnee Smollett) sees her well-to-do family unravel in the wake of the infidelities of her charming father (Samuel L. Jackson)—setting in motion a series of deceptions and betrayals that will upend her world and challenge her understanding of reality. Rooted in Creole history, folklore, and mysticism, Eve’s Bayou is a scintillating showcase for a powerhouse ensemble of Black actresses—including Lynn Whitfield, Debbi Morgan, and the legendary Diahann Carroll as a voodoo priestess—as well as a profoundly cathartic exploration of trauma, forgiveness, and the elusive nature of truth.

hook: 让·雷诺阿 (Jean Renoir) 讲述了世界著名的红磨坊开业的激动人心的故事，十九世纪的巴黎变得生机勃勃。让·加本 (Jean Gabin) 扮演狡猾的经理人丹格拉德 (Danglard)，他让康康舞风靡一时，同时还要兼顾两个美丽女人的爱情——一位是埃及肚皮舞演员，另一位是天真的工作女孩，后来成为康康舞明星。这部对生活、艺术和光之城的颂扬（伊迪丝·琵雅芙客串）是一位现代电影大师的彩色杰作。
hook_en: Nineteenth-century Paris comes vibrantly alive in Jean Renoir’s exhilarating tale of the opening of the world-renowned Moulin Rouge. Jean Gabin plays the wily impresario Danglard, who makes the cancan all the rage while juggling the love of two beautiful women—an Egyptian belly-dancer and a naive working girl turned cancan star. This celebration of life, art and the City of Light (with a cameo by Edith Piaf) is a Technicolor tour de force by a master of modern cinema.

hook: 导演让·雷诺阿的第一部引人入胜的彩色长片完全在印度拍摄，是一部视觉杰作。这部电影根据鲁默·戈登的小说改编，雄辩地将三名年轻女性成长的烦恼与她们日常生活周围的孟加拉河的一成不变进行了对比。雷诺阿对印度及其人民的微妙理解和欣赏丰富了《河流》，它优雅地探索了短暂的情感与永恒的创作之间的脆弱联系。学院电影资料馆与 BFI 和 Janus Films 联合修复了《河流》，修复资金由好莱坞外国记者协会和电影基金会提供。
hook_en: Director Jean Renoir’s entrancing first color feature—shot entirely on location in India—is a visual tour de force. Based on the novel by Rumer Godden, the film eloquently contrasts the growing pains of three young women with the immutability of the Bengal river around which their daily lives unfold. Enriched by Renoir’s subtle understanding and appreciation for India and its people, The River gracefully explores the fragile connections between transitory emotions and everlasting creation. The River was restored by the Academy Film Archive in association with the BFI and Janus Films, with restoration funding provided by the Hollywood Foreign Press Association and The Film Foundation.

hook: 在导演韦斯·安德森的《大吉岭有限公司》中，三个关系疏远的兄弟在父亲去世一年后重聚，进行了一次精心策划、反思灵魂的穿越印度的火车之旅。带着十一个手提箱、一份叠好的行程单、一罐胡椒喷雾、一批非处方止痛药，以及一系列即将爆发的家庭冲突，弗朗西斯、彼得和杰克最终发现自己被困在沙漠中央——此时，他们的旅程开始了意想不到的新篇章。 《大吉岭极限》由欧文·威尔逊、艾德里安·布洛迪、詹森·舒瓦兹曼和安杰丽卡·休斯顿等出色演员组成，是一部令人眼花缭乱、搞笑的电影，将安德森带入了前所未有的更深层次。
hook_en: In director Wes Anderson’s The Darjeeling Limited, three estranged brothers reunite for a meticulously planned, soul-searching train voyage across India one year after the death of their father. Armed with eleven suitcases, a laminated itinerary, a can of pepper spray, a supply of over-the-counter painkillers, and a host of family conflicts ready to erupt, Francis, Peter, and Jack eventually find themselves stranded alone in the middle of the desert—at which point an unexpected new chapter in their journey begins. Featuring a sensational cast including Owen Wilson, Adrien Brody, Jason Schwartzman, and Anjelica Huston, The Darjeeling Limited is a dazzling and hilarious film that takes Anderson to deeper places than ever before.

hook: 让·科克托对奥菲斯神话的更新描绘了一位被左岸青年轻视的著名诗人（让·马耶斯），以及他同时爱着的妻子伊俄刻（玛丽·德·埃丝）和一位神秘的公主（玛利亚·卡萨雷斯）。为了寻求灵感，诗人从现实世界穿越到死神的国度，通过科克托著名的镜面门户。奥菲斯无与伦比的视觉诗和梦幻般的叙事代表了这位传奇的科克托在艺术巅峰的状态。
hook_en: Jean Cocteau’s update of the Orpheus myth depicts a famous poet (Jean Marais), scorned by the Left Bank youth, and his love for both his wife, Eurydice (Marie Déa), and a mysterious princess (Maria Casarès). Seeking inspiration, the poet follows the princess from the world of the living to the land of the dead, through Cocteau’s famous mirrored portal. Orpheus’s peerless visual poetry and dreamlike storytelling represent the legendary Cocteau at the height of his powers.

hook: 与维尔戈特·索曼备受争议的《我好奇——黄色，我好奇——蓝色》平行的电影也讲述了年轻的莉娜的自我发现之旅。在《蓝色》中，莉娜面对宗教、性和监狱系统的问题，同时探索自己的个人关系。与《黄色》一样，《蓝色》采用戏剧和纪实技术的结合，自由地穿越事实与虚构之间的界限。
hook_en: A parallel film to Vilgot Sjöman's controversial I Am Curious—Yellow, I Am Curious—Blue also follows young Lena on her journey of self-discovery. In Blue, Lena confronts issues of religion, sexuality, and the prison system, while at the same time exploring her own personal relationships. Like Yellow, Blue freely traverses the lines between fact and fiction, employing a mix of dramatic and documentary techniques.

hook: 1900 年代初，在奥地利的一所男子寄宿学校，害羞、聪明的托勒斯观察到同学们的虐待行为，却没有采取任何措施来帮助受害的同学，直到酷刑变得太过分。 《年轻的托勒斯》改编自罗伯特·穆齐尔广受好评的小说，发起了新德国电影运动，并为首次担任导演的沃尔克·施隆多夫赢得了 1966 年戛纳电影节国际影评人奖。
hook_en: At an Austrian boys' boarding school in the early 1900s, shy, intelligent Törless observes the sadistic behavior of his fellow students, doing nothing to help a victimized classmate—until the torture goes too far. Adapted from Robert Musil's acclaimed novel, Young Törless launched the New German Cinema movement and garnered the 1966 Cannes Film Festival International Critics' Prize for first-time director Volker Schlöndorff.

hook: 在这部爵士黑帮电影中，改过自新的杀手Tetsu试图直截了当的尝试被挫败了，因为他的前同伙把他叫回东京，帮助他与对手帮派作战。导演Seijun Suzuki对程式化暴力和艳丽色彩的猛烈抨击是Russ Meyer、Samuel Fuller和Nagisa Oshima的平等部分--无论发生什么事情，都会在你面前横冲直撞。《东京流浪者》是六十年代日本电影的精彩亮点。
hook_en: In this jazzy gangster film, reformed killer Tetsu’s attempt to go straight is thwarted when his former cohorts call him back to Tokyo to help battle a rival gang. Director Seijun Suzuki’s onslaught of stylized violence and trippy colors is equal parts Russ Meyer, Samuel Fuller, and Nagisa Oshima—an anything-goes, in-your-face rampage. Tokyo Drifter is a delirious highlight of the brilliantly excessive Japanese cinema of the sixties.

hook: 许多电影都借鉴了经典的日本戏剧形式，但导演真岛昌宏的《双美自杀》却以惊人的视觉效果脱颖而出。这部电影是根据歌舞伎傀儡戏改编的（配乐由著名作曲家武满彻创作），一个纸商为了对一名妓女的性瘾，牺牲了家庭、财富，最终也牺牲了生命。Criterion 为《双美自杀》呈现了一次令人惊叹的数字修复版，并提供了新的、改进的英语字幕翻译。
hook_en: Many films have drawn from classic Japanese theatrical forms, but none with such shocking cinematic effect as director Masahiro Shinoda's Double Suicide. In this striking adaptation of a Bunraku puppet play (featuring the music of famed composer Toru Takemitsu), a paper merchant sacrifices family, fortune, and ultimately life for his erotic obsession with a prostitute. Criterion is proud to present Double Suicide in a stunning digital transfer, with a new and improved English subtitle translation.

hook: 在路易斯·布努埃尔辛辣讽刺的杰作中，一群上流中产阶级的人坐下来吃饭，但饭局一直被各种实际和想象中的滑稽事件拖延，包括恐怖袭击、军事演习和幽灵出现。布努埃尔和他的编剧搭档让-克劳德·卡里埃将一系列荒诞的场景片段串联起来，通过一个充满欲望被推迟、受挫和中断的欧洲电影巨匠的迷宫，如费尔南多·雷耶、斯特芬妮·奥兰、德龙妮·西莉格、让-皮埃尔·卡塞尔和布勒·奥吉尔。布努埃尔凭借这部获得奥斯卡奖的杰作，达到了职业生涯晚期作为备受推崇的艺术电影大师的地位，《布 Bourgeois 礼物》也是他对统治阶级价值观最得意的反叛。
hook_en: In Luis Buñuel’s deliciously satiric masterpiece, an upper-middle-class sextet sits down to a dinner that is continually delayed, their attempts to eat thwarted by vaudevillian events both actual and imagined, including terrorist attacks, military maneuvers, and ghostly apparitions. Stringing together a discontinuous, digressive series of absurdist set pieces, Buñuel and his screenwriting partner Jean-Claude Carrière send a cast of European-film greats—including Fernando Rey, Stéphane Audran, Delphine Seyrig, Jean-Pierre Cassel, and Bulle Ogier—through a maze of desire deferred, frustrated, and interrupted. The Oscar-winning pinnacle of Buñuel’s late-career ascent as a feted maestro of the international art house, The Discreet Charm of the Bourgeoisie is also one of his most gleefully radical assaults on the values of the ruling class.

hook: 侯孝贤的这部华丽的时代遐想，沐浴在油灯的金色光芒中，笼罩在鸦片的烟雾中，令人陶醉，时光倒流，追溯了围绕十九世纪末上海四座“花楼”的浪漫阴谋、嫉妒和紧张，在那里，妓女们生活在镀金的笼子里，身处华丽的辉煌中，但被迫工作以买回她们的自由。常客中包括沉默寡言的王师傅（梁朝伟饰），他与长期情妇（羽田美智子饰）的关系因被视为背叛行为而陷入混乱。 《海上花》由一连串令人着迷的长镜头组成，唤起了一个已经消失的颓废和残酷的世界，一个与世隔绝的宇宙，其中大部分戏剧性的动作仍然在银幕之外诱人地存在——尽管它的情感影响却伴随着安静的毁灭。
hook_en: An intoxicating, time-bending experience bathed in the golden glow of oil lamps and wreathed in an opium haze, this gorgeous period reverie by Hou Hsiao-hsien traces the romantic intrigue, jealousies, and tensions swirling around four late-nineteenth-century Shanghai “flower houses,” where courtesans live confined to a gilded cage, ensconced in opulent splendor but forced to work to buy back their freedom. Among the regular clients is the taciturn Master Wang (Tony Leung Chiu-wai), whose relationship with his longtime mistress (Michiko Hada) is roiled by a perceived act of betrayal. Composed in a languorous procession of entrancing long takes, Flowers of Shanghai evokes a vanished world of decadence and cruelty, an insular universe where much of the dramatic action remains tantalizingly offscreen—even as its emotional fallout registers with quiet devastation.

hook: 约翰·施莱辛格 (John Schlesinger) 继他标志性的《午夜牛仔》之后，对爱情和性进行了深刻的个人诠释。 《星期日血腥星期日》描绘了两个伦敦人的浪漫生活，一个是中年医生，另一个是易怒的三十多岁的离婚女人——由彼得·芬奇和格伦达·杰克逊饰演，他们非常敏感——他们正在和同一个英俊的年轻艺术家（默里·海德饰演）上床。这在当时是一个启示，它可能是七十年代关于浪漫关系复杂性的最聪明、最具有多重质感的电影。
hook_en: John Schlesinger followed his iconic Midnight Cowboy with this deeply personal take on love and sex. Sunday Bloody Sunday depicts the romantic lives of two Londoners, a middle-aged doctor and a prickly thirtysomething divorcée—played with great sensitivity by Peter Finch and Glenda Jackson—who are sleeping with the same handsome young artist (Murray Head). A revelation in its day, this may be the seventies’ most intelligent, multitextured film about the complexities of romantic relationships.

hook: 雅克·塔蒂在他迷人的处女作中饰演一位小题大做的邮递员，当一个旅行集市来到他的村庄时，他陷入了困境。即使在这部早期作品中，塔蒂也出色地玩弄了设备（无声的视觉笑料、最小但巧妙部署的音效）并探索了定义他的电影的主题（我们日益依赖技术的荒谬）。
hook_en: In his enchanting debut feature, Jacques Tati stars as a fussbudget of a postman who is thrown for a loop when a traveling fair comes to his village. Even in this early work, Tati was brilliantly toying with the devices (silent visual gags, minimal yet deftly deployed sound effects) and exploring the theme (the absurdity of our increasing reliance on technology) that would define his cinema.

hook: 沟口健二的这部关于生活与艺术之间的取舍的令人心碎的杰作，标志着催眠式长镜头和雄辩的镜头运动的首次完全实现，这将定义导演的电影。菊之助（花柳翔太郎饰）是一位传奇歌舞伎演员的养子，他正努力通过掌握女性角色来成为明星，他向弟弟的乳母寻求支持和感情，而她很快就为了心爱的创作荣耀放弃了一切。 《最后一朵菊花的故事》提供了十九世纪末歌舞伎剧院幕后的迷人一瞥，批判了对妇女的压迫和她们所需做出的牺牲，代表了沟口早期职业生涯的顶峰。
hook_en: This heartrending masterpiece by Kenji Mizoguchi about the give-and-take between life and art marked the first full realization of the hypnotic long takes and eloquent camera movements that would come to define the director’s films. Kikunosuke (Shotaro Hanayagi), the adopted son of a legendary kabuki actor who is striving to achieve stardom by mastering female roles, turns to his infant brother’s wet nurse for support and affection—and she soon gives up everything for her beloved’s creative glory. Offering a fascinating glimpse behind the scenes of kabuki theater in the late nineteenth century, The Story of the Last Chrysanthemum provides a critique of the oppression of women and the sacrifices required of them, and represents the pinnacle of Mizoguchi’s early career.

hook: 在《红舞鞋》的华丽彩色表演结束后，英国电影制作人迈克尔·鲍威尔和埃默里克·普雷斯伯格退回到这部喜怒无常、噼啪作响的人物研究中，隐秘的、阴暗的角落里。 《小密室》改编自奈杰尔·巴尔钦的广受好评的小说，详细讲述了陷入困境、酗酒的研究科学家和军事炸弹处理专家萨米·赖斯（大卫·法勒饰）在职业和个人上的痛苦经历。萨米·赖斯一边与秘书女友苏珊（凯瑟琳·拜伦饰）的复杂关系作斗争，一边受雇于政府，为一种危险的新型德国武器提供建议。 《小密室》巧妙地融合了悬疑和浪漫，是一部大气的二战后瑰宝。
hook_en: After the lavish Technicolor spectacle of The Red Shoes, British filmmakers Michael Powell and Emeric Pressburger retreated into the inward, shadowy recesses of this moody, crackling character study. Based on the acclaimed novel by Nigel Balchin, The Small Back Room details the professional and personal travails of troubled, alcoholic research scientist and military bomb-disposal expert Sammy Rice (David Farrar), who, while struggling with a complex relationship with secretary girlfriend Susan (Kathleen Byron), is hired by the government to advise on a dangerous new German weapon. Deftly mixing suspense and romance, The Small Back Room is an atmospheric, post–World War II gem.

hook: 在《白色材料》中，伟大的当代法国电影制片人克莱尔·丹尼斯以不安分、亲密的戏剧而闻名，她介绍了一个令人难忘的疯狂角色。玛丽亚由凶猛的伊莎贝尔·于佩尔饰演，是一位生活在非洲的白人妇女，尽管内战迫在眉睫，她却极度不愿放弃家族摇摇欲坠的咖啡种植园。 《白色材料》以丹尼斯标志性的全速视觉风格创作，将观众置于漩涡的中心，扣人心弦地唤起了欧洲殖民主义的垂死挣扎，并以迷人的方式描绘了一个迷失在自己头脑中的女人。
hook_en: In White Material, the great contemporary French filmmaker Claire Denis, known for her restless, intimate dramas, introduces an unforgettably crazed character.
