Played by a ferocious Isabelle Huppert, Maria is an entitled white woman living in Africa, desperately unwilling to give up her family’s crumbling coffee plantation despite the civil war closing in on her. Created with Denis’ signature full-throttle visual style, which places the viewer at the center of the maelstrom, White Material is a gripping evocation of the death throes of European colonialism and a fascinating look at a woman lost in her own mind.

hook: 在这部怪异而神秘的电影白日梦中，一个即将成为女性的女孩发现自己身处一个充满吸血鬼、巫术和其他威胁的感性幻想世界。 《瓦莱丽和她的奇迹周》讲述了一个无限循环、非线性的童话故事，背景设定在准中世纪的风景中。导演雅罗米尔·吉雷什 (Jaromil Jireš) 执导的这部引人入胜的奇幻作品，令人着迷的拍摄、迷人的配乐以及超现实的幻想，是捷克斯洛伐克新浪潮中最美丽的奇异作品之一。
hook_en: A girl on the verge of womanhood finds herself in a sensual fantasyland of vampires, witchcraft, and other threats in this eerie and mystical movie daydream. Valerie and Her Week of Wonders serves up an endlessly looping, nonlinear fairy tale, set in a quasi-medieval landscape. Ravishingly shot, enchantingly scored, and spilling over with surreal fancies, this enticing phantasmagoria from director Jaromil Jireš is among the most beautiful oddities of the Czechoslovak New Wave.

hook: 让（让·加宾 Jean Gabin 饰）沿着一条雾气弥漫、荒凉的道路前往港口城市勒阿弗尔，他是一名逃兵，正在寻找另一次过上好日子的机会。然而命运对他有不同的计划，复仇和仁慈的行为使他成为新闻头条。 《阴影之港》（Le Quai des brumes）还由蓝眼睛现象级人物米歇尔·摩根（Michèle Morgan）首次主演，以及险恶的米歇尔·西蒙（Michel Simon）主演，赤裸裸地描绘了一个由孤独的灵魂与自己的命运角力的地下世界。根据皮埃尔·麦克·奥兰的小说改编，由导演马塞尔·卡内和作家雅克·普雷维尔组成的无与伦比的团队打造了诗意现实主义的典型范例和法国电影黄金时代的经典电影。
hook_en: Down a foggy, desolate road to the port city of Le Havre travels Jean (Jean Gabin), an army deserter looking for another chance to make good on life. Fate, however, has a different plan for him, as acts of both revenge and kindness render him front-page news. Also starring the blue-eyed phenomenon Michèle Morgan in her first major role, and the menacing Michel Simon, Port of Shadows (Le Quai des brumes) starkly portrays an underworld of lonely souls wrestling with their own destinies. Based on the novel by Pierre Mac Orlan, the inimitable team of director Marcel Carné and writer Jacques Prévert deliver a quintessential example of poetic realism and a classic film from the golden age of French cinema.

hook: 导演迈克·李 (Mike Leigh) 将吉尔伯特和沙利文的 1885 年传奇喜歌剧《天皇》戏剧化，将吉尔伯特和沙利文的世界演绎得栩栩如生。吉姆·布劳德本特和艾伦·科杜纳出色地扮演了世界著名的维多利亚时代剧作家和作曲家的角色，他们和他们的喜怒无常的演员剧团一起，在制作这部大型作品时必须与个人和职业的恶魔作斗争。 《Topsy-Turvy》是一部制作精良的史诗片，讲述了创意表达的严酷现实，以精彩的表演和荣获奥斯卡奖的服装设计和化妆为特色，是当代电影伟大艺术家之一的意外惊喜。
hook_en: The world of Gilbert and Sullivan comes to vivid life in director Mike Leigh’s extraordinary dramatization of the staging of the duo’s legendary 1885 comic opera The Mikado. Jim Broadbent and Allan Corduner brilliantly inhabit the roles of the world-famous Victorian librettist and composer, who, along with their troupe of temperamental actors, must battle personal and professional demons while mounting this major production. A lushly produced epic about the harsh realities of creative expression, featuring bravura performances and Oscar-winning costume design and makeup, Topsy-Turvy is an unexpected period delight from one of contemporary cinema’s great artists.

hook: 在马可·贝洛基奥 (Marco Bellocchio) 1965 年的这部令人惊叹的处女作中，一位年轻人饱受扭曲欲望的折磨，采取极端措施来摆脱他那支离奇、功能失调的家庭的各种痛苦。 《口袋里的拳头》（I pugni in tasca）以其冷静自信的风格、令人震惊的反常和野蛮的绞刑架幽默，成为资产阶级家庭价值观和天主教道德眼中闪闪发光的冰锥，是一部真正独特的作品，至今仍然被列为意大利电影的伟大成就之一。
hook_en: Tormented by twisted desires, a young man takes drastic measures to rid his grotesquely dysfunctional family of its various afflictions, in this astonishing 1965 debut from Marco Bellocchio. With its coolly assured style, shocking perversity, and savage gallows humor, Fists in the Pocket (I pugni in tasca) was a gleaming ice pick in the eye of bourgeois family values and Catholic morality, a truly unique work that continues to rank as one of the great achievements of Italian cinema.

hook: 俄罗斯士兵阿廖沙·斯克沃尔佐夫在单枪匹马击退两辆敌方坦克后获准探望他的母亲。在回家的路上，阿辽沙目睹了饱受战争蹂躏的国家的废墟，目睹了人民的希望之光，并坠入了爱河。格里戈里·丘赫莱的《士兵之歌》以其诗意的视觉意象，对战争影响进行了非传统的思考，也是俄罗斯电影的里程碑。
hook_en: Russian soldier Alyosha Skvortsov is granted a visit with his mother after he single-handedly fends off two enemy tanks. As he journeys home, Alyosha encounters the devastation of his war-torn country, witnesses glimmers of hope among the people, and falls in love. With its poetic visual imagery, Grigori Chukhrai's Ballad of a Soldier is an unconventional meditation on the effects of war, and a milestone in Russian cinema.

hook: 凭借在《柳巷芳草》中的奥斯卡获奖表演，简·方达将自己重塑为新型电影明星。布丽·丹尼尔斯是一名应召女郎，也是一位有抱负的演员，当侦探约翰·克鲁特（唐纳德·萨瑟兰饰）出现在她家门口时，布丽·丹尼尔斯成为了失踪人员调查的焦点。方达将神经质的大胆和反主流文化风格融入到她的角色中，将这部电影打造成了她自己的电影，在银幕上呈现了一位独立的女性和护卫，其坦率在好莱坞还没有尝试过。阴谋惊悚片专家艾伦·J·帕库拉 (Alan J. Pakula) 充满偏执，摄影大师戈登·威利斯 (Gordon Willis) 担任镜头，《克鲁特》是一部充满恐惧的人物研究作品，捕捉了 20 世纪 70 年代早期纽约的情绪，以及一名试图在社会边缘寻找自己出路的女性的困境。
hook_en: With her Oscar-winning turn in Klute, Jane Fonda reinvented herself as a new kind of movie star. Bringing nervy audacity and counterculture style to the role of Bree Daniels—a call girl and aspiring actor who becomes the focal point of a missing-person investigation when detective John Klute (Donald Sutherland) turns up at her door—Fonda made the film her own, putting an independent woman and escort on-screen with a frankness that had not yet been attempted in Hollywood. Suffused with paranoia by the conspiracy-thriller specialist Alan J. Pakula, and lensed by master cinematographer Gordon Willis, Klute is a character study thick with dread, capturing the mood of early-1970s New York and the predicament of a woman trying to find her own way on the fringes of society.

hook: 对于一个陷入残酷监狱制度的家庭来说，时间流逝的压力是怎样的？加勒特·布拉德利 (Garrett Bradley) 获得奥斯卡金像奖提名的这部纪录片处女作既是一个令人惊叹的电影爱情故事，也是对美国不公正现象的残酷控诉，讲述了西比尔·福克斯·理查森 (Sibil Fox Richardson) 长达数十年的追求。西比尔·福克斯·理查森是一位六个孩子的母亲，也是一位直言不讳的废奴主义者，她的丈夫因抢劫而在路易斯安那州立监狱服刑 60 年，她的丈夫正在监狱中服刑。布拉德利优雅地将理查森自己二十年来的亲密家庭电影与她当今的欢乐和挣扎的明亮表现力的单色镜头交织在一起，在《时代》中以一种超然的诗意、震撼心灵的视角展现了大规模监禁造成的毁灭性损失以及一个家庭为保持完整所付出的非凡努力。
hook_en: What does the weight of time’s passage feel like for a family caught in the jaws of a brutal carceral system? Both a breathtaking cinematic love story and a bruising indictment of American injustice, Garrett Bradley’s Academy Award–nominated feature documentary debut traces the decades-long quest of Sibil Fox Richardson, an indefatigable mother of six and a fiercely outspoken prison abolitionist, to free her husband from the Louisiana State Penitentiary, where he is serving a sixty-year sentence for robbery. Gracefully interweaving twenty years’ worth of Richardson’s own intimate home movies with luminously expressive monochrome footage of her present-day joys and struggles, Bradley crafts in Time a transcendentally poetic, soul-shaking look at the devastating toll of mass incarceration and one family’s extraordinary efforts to stay whole.

hook: 瑞凡·菲尼克斯和基努·里维斯在格斯·范·桑特的这部令人难忘的故事中主演，讲述了两个年轻的街头骗子：迈克·沃特斯，一个敏感的嗜睡症患者，梦想着抛弃他的母亲；斯科特·法沃尔，波特兰市长任性的儿子，也是迈克的欲望对象。迈克带领斯科特在太平洋西北地区肮脏的街道和开放的高速公路上探索一个充满吸毒者、小偷和嫖客的动荡世界，寻找一个被称为家的难以捉摸的地方。 《我自己的私人爱达荷》视觉上令人眼花缭乱，主题上具有开创性，对社会边缘的单恋和生活进行了深刻感人的审视。
hook_en: River Phoenix and Keanu Reeves star in this haunting tale from Gus Van Sant about two young street hustlers: Mike Waters, a sensitive narcoleptic who dreams of the mother who abandoned him, and Scott Favor, the wayward son of the mayor of Portland and the object of Mike’s desire. Navigating a volatile world of junkies, thieves, and johns, Mike takes Scott on a quest along the grungy streets and open highways of the Pacific Northwest, in search of an elusive place called home. Visually dazzling and thematically groundbreaking, My Own Private Idaho is a deeply moving look at unrequited love and life on society’s margins.

hook: 多年的战争以德川幕府统一的日本结束，武士间谍猿飞佐助厌倦了冲突，渴望和平。然而，当一位名叫立胁郡山的高级间谍从幕府将军叛逃到敌对家族时，剑客世界陷入了混乱。佐助无意中卷入冲突后，他追踪立胁，而一个戴着白兜帽的神秘人物似乎正在追捕他们两人。到故事结束时，没有人是他们表面上的样子，而真相比任何人怀疑的都更加个人化。筱田正宏导演的《武士间谍》充满了氏族阴谋、忍者间谍和多重双重交叉，标志着与剑侠电影惯例的大胆风格背离。
hook_en: Years of warfare end in a Japan unified under the Tokugawa shogunate, and samurai spy Sasuke Sarutobi, tired of conflict, longs for peace. When a high-ranking spy named Tatewaki Koriyama defects from the shogun to a rival clan, however, the world of swordsmen is thrown into turmoil. After Sasuke is unwittingly drawn into the conflict, he tracks Tatewaki, while a mysterious, white-hooded figure seems to hunt them both. By tale’s end, no one is who they seemed to be, and the truth is far more personal than anyone suspected. Director Masahiro Shinoda’s Samurai Spy, filled with clan intrigue, ninja spies, and multiple double crosses, marks a bold stylistic departure from swordplay film convention.

hook: 传奇剑侠电影制作人 Hideo Gosha 的《野兽之剑》记录了低级剑客源之介的飞行故事，他在改革阴谋中杀死了一名大臣。他以前的战友随后背叛了他，这种背叛极大地动摇了他的荣誉感，他决定像动物一样生活在野外。在那里，他加入了一个非法开采幕府将军黄金的乌合之众，并在另一位剑客的帮助下，不仅获得了生存的机会，还获得了恢复自己名声和荣誉的机会。
hook_en: Legendary swordplay filmmaker Hideo Gosha's _Sword of the Beast_ chronicles the flight of the low-level swordsman Gennosuke, who kills one of his ministers as part of a reform plot. His former comrades then turn on him, and this betrayal so shakes his sense of honor that he decides to live in the wild, like an animal. There he joins up with a motley group who are illegally mining the shogun’s gold, and, with the aid of another swordsman, gets a chance not just at survival but to recover his name and honor.

hook: 如果整个世界都是坏的，我们为什么不应该呢？一对享乐主义的年轻女性（伊万娜·卡尔巴诺娃和吉特卡·切尔霍娃饰）以这种傲慢的态度为指导思想，她们都名叫玛丽，踏上了一场充满暴食、令人眼花缭乱的破坏和反父权抵抗的放荡之旅，在她们对快乐的虚无主义追求中，没有什么是安全的。但是当乐趣结束时会发生什么呢？导演维拉·奇蒂洛娃 (Věra Chytilová) 在电影摄影师雅罗斯拉夫·库切拉 (Jaroslav Kučera) 的密切合作下，将她的无政府主义信息与同样激进的美学相结合，引发了一场视觉风暴，其中包括波动的胶片、万花筒般的蒙太奇、卡通定格动画剪纸以及由埃斯特·克鲁巴乔娃 (Ester Krumbachová) 设计的超现实服装（剧本也由埃斯特·克鲁巴乔娃设计）。其结果是《雏菊》，这是对捷克斯洛伐克新浪潮最挑衅的挑衅，强烈呼吁叛乱，直接针对那些支持任何形式的独裁压迫的人。
hook_en: If the entire world is bad, why shouldn’t we be? Adopting this insolent attitude as their guiding philosophy, a pair of hedonistic young women (Ivana Karbanová and Jitka Cerhová), both named Marie, embark on a gleefully debauched odyssey of gluttony, giddy destruction, and antipatriarchal resistance, in which nothing is safe from their nihilistic pursuit of pleasure. But what happens when the fun is over? Matching her anarchic message with an equally radical aesthetic, director Věra Chytilová, with the close collaboration of cinematographer Jaroslav Kučera, unleashes an optical storm of fluctuating film stocks, kaleidoscopic montages, cartoonish stop-motion cutouts, and surreal costumes designed by Ester Krumbachová, who also cowrote the script. The result is Daisies, the most defiant provocation of the Czechoslovak New Wave, an exuberant call to rebellion aimed squarely at those who uphold authoritarian oppression in any form.

hook: 一名寻求冒险的年轻乡下人因卷入巴黎公寓入室盗窃案而误入施虐受虐的地下世界。公寓的女主人经营着两层楼，楼上是受人尊敬的人，楼下则是寻求惩罚的客户的地牢。当年轻人成为她楼上的情人后，她发现她精心控制的两个层面的存在开始相互干扰。巴贝特·施罗德 (Barbet Schroeder) 的《Maîtresse》探讨了幻想与现实、颓废与匮乏之间的界限，以及一个人为爱所走的距离。
hook_en: A young provincial in search of adventure stumbles into the subterranean world of sadomasochism when he is implicated in a burglary of a Paris apartment. The apartment's mistress runs a two-floor operation, all respectability above and a dungeon of punishment-seeking clients below. After the young man becomes her upstairs lover, she finds that the two levels of her carefully controlled existence begin to interfere with each other. Barbet Schroeder's Maîtresse examines the line between fantasy and reality, decadence and deprivation, and the distance one will go for love.

hook: 米开朗基罗·安东尼奥尼早期的这一重大成就标志着他改变电影风格的最初迹象，他很快就因此而闻名于世。 《女朋友》从五位都灵女性的角度对现代资产阶级生活进行了精彩的观察和片段的描绘。当四个朋友试图弄清楚第五个朋友的自杀企图时，他们发现自己正在审视自己陷入困境的浪漫生活。安东尼奥尼的电影暗示了现代疏离的主题和挑剔的视觉抽象，这些都定义了他后来的杰作，如《奇遇》、《落日》和《红色沙漠》，这部影片对注定的爱情和令人担忧的友谊进行了毁灭性的诠释。 《Le amiche》由博洛尼亚电影中心 (Cineteca di Bologna) 在 L’Immagine Ritrovata 进行了修复。古驰和电影基金会提供修复资金。
hook_en: This major early achievement by Michelangelo Antonioni bears the first signs of the cinema-changing style for which he would soon be world-famous. Le amiche (The Girlfriends) is a brilliantly observed, fragmentary depiction of modern bourgeois life, conveyed from the perspective of five Turinese women. As four of the friends try to make sense of the suicide attempt of the fifth, they find themselves examining their own troubled romantic lives. With suggestions of the theme of modern alienation and the fastidious visual abstraction that would define his later masterpieces such as L’avventura, L’eclisse, and Red Desert, Antonioni’s film is a devastating take on doomed love and fraught friendship. Le amiche was restored by the Cineteca di Bologna at L’Immagine Ritrovata. Restoration funding provided by Gucci and The Film Foundation.

hook: 这是具有颠覆性的墨西哥导演阿图罗·里普斯坦（Arturo Ripstein）的局外人电影的巅峰之作之一，这部对痴迷爱情的疯狂而反常的描绘让观众敢于在最肮脏的反英雄身上看到人性。一则孤独之心广告将精力充沛的护士科拉尔（雷吉娜·奥罗斯科饰）引向了骗子尼古拉斯（丹尼尔·希梅内斯·卡乔饰），两人在 20 世纪 40 年代的墨西哥穿梭，抢劫并谋杀了他所引诱的女性，两人之间的关系日益紧密、扭曲。里普斯坦将宏大的情节剧与令人毛骨悚然的幽默和疯狂暴力的爆发融为一体，将二十世纪最臭名昭著的真实犯罪故事之一转变为关于爱情如何让位于疯狂的令人难忘的愿景。
hook_en: One of the peaks of subversive Mexican director Arturo Ripstein’s cinema of outsiders, this deliriously perverse portrait of obsessive love dares audiences to see the humanity in the most sordid of antiheroes. A lonely hearts advertisement leads lusty nurse Coral (Regina Orozco) to Nicolás (Daniel Giménez Cacho), a con man with whom she forges an increasingly intense, twisted bond as they crisscross 1940s Mexico, robbing and murdering the women he seduces. Blending sweeping melodrama with macabre humor and eruptions of berserk violence, Ripstein transforms one of the most infamous true-crime stories of the twentieth century into a haunting vision of how love can give way to madness.

hook: 在《男性女性》中，无情的造型师和反传统者让-吕克·戈达尔通过一群热衷于音乐、革命和彼此的无望爱情的年轻人，向世界介绍了“马克思和可口可乐的孩子”。法国新浪潮偶像让-皮埃尔·利奥德 (Jean-Pierre Léaud) 饰演保罗，一位理想主义的准知识分子，努力与可爱的流行歌星玛德琳 (现实生活中的混混女孩尚塔尔·戈雅饰) 建立关系。通过他们的暴风雨事件，戈达尔对 20 世纪 60 年代巴黎的青年文化进行了坦率而有趣的自由审视，将讽刺和悲剧融为一体，只有戈达尔才能做到这一点。
hook_en: With Masculin féminin, ruthless stylist and iconoclast Jean-Luc Godard introduces the world to “the children of Marx and Coca-Cola,” through a gang of restless youths engaged in hopeless love affairs with music, revolution, and one another. French New Wave icon Jean-Pierre Léaud stars as Paul, an idealistic would-be intellectual struggling to forge a relationship with the adorable pop star Madeleine (real-life yé-yé girl Chantal Goya). Through their tempestuous affair, Godard fashions a candid and wildly funny free-form examination of youth culture in pulsating 1960s Paris, mixing satire and tragedy as only Godard can.

hook: 阿巴斯·基亚罗斯塔米在《科克三部曲》的最后一部中将元叙事技巧提升到了精湛的新高度。这部电影讲述了《生活继续》的“幕后花絮”，追溯了其中一位演员的浪漫不幸——一名年轻男子对扮演他妻子的女人的思念，尽管在现实生活中，她与他没有任何关系——的浪漫不幸，在片场制造了混乱，让倒霉的导演陷入了困境。 《穿过橄榄树》是一部沉浸在伊朗乡村生活民俗中的难以言喻的可爱、温柔的人间喜剧，在探讨电影与现实之间难以捉摸的炼金术关系时，剥去了一层又一层的技巧。
hook_en: Abbas Kiarostami takes meta­narrative gamesmanship to masterful new heights in the final installment of The Koker Trilogy. Unfolding “behind the scenes” of And Life Goes On, this film traces the complications that arise when the romantic misfortune of one of the actors—a young man who pines for the woman cast as his wife, even though, in real life, she will have nothing to do with him—creates turmoil on set and leaves the hapless director caught in the middle. An ineffably lovely, gentle human comedy steeped in the folkways of Iranian village life, Through the Olive Trees peels away layer after layer of artifice as it investigates the elusive, alchemical relationship between cinema and reality.

hook: 这种纯粹的电影肾上腺素的震撼证实了导演乔什和本尼·萨夫迪是马丁·斯科塞斯和约翰·卡索维茨坚韧、高度现实主义的继承人。亚当·桑德勒 (Adam Sandler) 饰演霍华德·拉特纳 (Howard Ratner)，他是一位语速很快的纽约珠宝商和赌徒，不懈地追求下一个大比分。当他拥有了一颗稀有的蛋白石时，霍华德的船似乎终于来了——只要他能领先一步，避开恨他的妻子（伊迪娜·门泽尔饰）、无法离开他的情妇（朱莉娅·福克斯饰），以及疯狂的高利贷者和杀手逼近他。 《原钻》以一部动感惊悚片生动地展现了曼哈顿钻石区的老式犹太世界，为我们呈现了现代电影中最伟大的人物之一：一位悲剧英雄，他为了超越自己的命运而不断追求射月的冲动。
hook_en: This jolt of pure cinematic adrenaline affirmed directors Josh and Benny Safdie as heirs to the gritty, heightened realism of Martin Scorsese and John Cassavetes. Adam Sandler delivers an almost maniacally embodied performance as Howard Ratner, a fast-talking New York jeweler and gambler in relentless pursuit of the next big score. When he comes into possession of a rare opal, it seems Howard’s ship has finally come in—as long as he can stay one step ahead of a wife (Idina Menzel) who hates him, a mistress (Julia Fox) who can’t quit him, and a frenzy of loan sharks and hit men closing in on him. Wrapping a vivid look at the old-school Jewish world of Manhattan’s Diamond District within a kinetic thriller, Uncut Gems gives us one of the great characters in modern cinema: a tragic hero of competing compulsions on a shoot-the-moon quest to transcend his destiny.

hook: 优素福·查因凭借这部杰作奠定了他的国际声誉，虽然最初在埃及商业上失败了，但后来成为所有阿拉伯电影中最有影响力和最著名的作品之一。导演本人饰演基纳维，一个残疾的报纸小贩，他对性感饮料小贩（被誉为“阿拉伯的玛丽莲·梦露”的辛德·罗斯托姆）的痴迷导致了开罗街头上演歌剧般的悲剧。 《开罗站》将新现实主义元素与挑衅性的黑色情节剧融为一体，是一部原始的民粹主义诗歌作品，探讨了个人在埃及新的后革命政治秩序中寻找一席之地的过程。
hook_en: Youssef Chahine established his international reputation with this masterpiece, which, though initially a commercial failure in Egypt, would become one of the most influential and celebrated works in all of Arab cinema. The director himself stars as Kenawi, a disabled newspaper hawker whose obsession with a sultry drink seller (Hind Rostom, known as the “Marilyn Monroe of Arabia”) leads to tragedy of operatic proportions on the streets of Cairo. Blending elements of neorealism with provocative noir-melodrama, Cairo Station is a work of raw populist poetry that explores the individual’s search for a place in Egypt’s new postrevolutionary political order.

hook: 皮尔·保罗·帕索里尼前往非洲、尼泊尔和中东，完成这部根据传奇故事《一千零一夜》精选故事改编的雄心勃勃的电影化处理。但这并不是山鲁佐德或阿拉丁的童话世界。相反，导演专注于书中更色情的故事，以一个年轻人寻求与他心爱的女奴重新建立联系的故事为框架。 《一千零一夜》充满了光彩夺目的布景和服装以及令人惊叹的外景摄影，是对人类性欲的激烈而欢乐的探索。
hook_en: Pier Paolo Pasolini traveled to Africa, Nepal, and the Middle East to realize this ambitious cinematic treatment of a selection of stories from the legendary The Thousand and One Nights. This is not the fairy-tale world of Scheherazade or Aladdin, though. Instead, the director focuses on the book’s more erotic tales, framed by the story of a young man’s quest to reconnect with his beloved slave girl. Full of lustrous sets and costumes and stunning location photography, Arabian Nights is a fierce and joyous exploration of human sexuality.

hook: 英格玛·伯格曼的第十部电影触及了他余下职业生涯的许多主题——孤独、表演、不可避免的过去——是一个向真正大师的温和转变。布里特·尼尔森少校饰演一位出色的芭蕾舞演员，年轻时与一位害羞英俊的学生（比尔格·马尔姆斯滕饰）的悲惨恋情一直困扰着她。她对斯德哥尔摩外群岛阳光明媚、岩石海岸的记忆与她在剧院表演时的阴郁场景交织在一起。 《夏日插曲》是一部被导演视为创意转折点的电影，它是一部关于生与死的遐想，将伯格曼对戏剧和电影的热爱结合在一起。
hook_en: Touching on many of the themes that would define the rest of his career—isolation, performance, the inescapability of the past— Ingmar Bergman’s tenth film was a gentle drift toward true mastery. Maj-Britt Nilsson beguiles as an accomplished ballet dancer haunted by her tragic youthful affair with a shy, handsome student (Birger Malmsten). Her memories of the sunny, rocky shores of Stockholm’s outer archipelago mingle with scenes from her gloomy present at the theater where she performs. A film that the director considered a creative turning point, Summer Interlude is a reverie about life and death that unites Bergman’s love of theater and cinema.

hook: 1976 年的经典电影《灰色花园》以非凡的特写镜头记录了古怪的东汉普顿隐士大伊迪·比尔和小伊迪·比尔的生活，它催生了从午夜电影狂热追随者到百老汇音乐剧，再到即将上映的好莱坞改编版的各种电影。然后，电影制片人回到他们的素材库中创作了第二部分《灰色花园的比尔斯》，向这些不屈不挠的女性和这部具有里程碑意义的原创纪录片的大批粉丝致敬，正是他们使她们成为了美国反主流文化的偶像。
hook_en: The 1976 cinema vérité classic Grey Gardens, which captured in remarkable close-up the lives of the eccentric East Hampton recluses Big and Little Edie Beale, has spawned everything from a midnight-movie cult following to a Broadway musical, to an upcoming Hollywood adaptation. The filmmakers then went back to their vaults of footage to create part two, The Beales of Grey Gardens, a tribute both to these indomitable women and to the original landmark documentary’s legions of fans, who have made them American counterculture icons.

hook: 詹姆斯·格雷的这部黑色优雅的处女作以黑帮剧的形式讲述了陀思妥耶夫斯基式的家庭悲剧，预示着当代美国电影中独特声音的到来。 《小敖德萨》隐藏在纽约黑社会的阴影下，讲述了约书亚（蒂姆·罗斯饰）的故事，约书亚是一位性格反复无常的杀手，他的最新任务将他带回了他长大的布鲁克林社区。回家后，他的犯罪生活与虐待他的父亲（马克西米利安·谢尔饰）、患病的母亲（凡妮莎·雷德格瑞夫饰）和忠诚的十几岁的兄弟（爱德华·福隆饰）严峻的家庭世界发生了冲突。年仅二十五岁就获得威尼斯电影节银狮奖的格雷传达了经典黑色电影中令人沉思的宿命论，对始于家庭并向外蔓延的暴力进行了令人难忘的反思。
hook_en: A Dostoevskian family tragedy in the form of a gangster drama, the darkly elegant debut feature by James Gray heralded the arrival of a singular voice in contemporary American cinema. Cloaked in the shadows of New York’s underworld, Little Odessa follows Joshua (Tim Roth), a volatile hit man whose latest assignment takes him back to the Brooklyn neighborhood where he grew up. After his return home, his criminal life collides with the grim domestic world of his abusive father (Maximilian Schell), ailing mother (Vanessa Redgrave), and loyal teenage brother (Edward Furlong). Channeling the brooding fatalism of classic noir, Gray—who won the Venice Film Festival’s Silver Lion at just twenty-five—composes a haunting reflection on violence that begins at home and ripples ever outward.

hook: 托马斯·古铁雷斯·阿利亚的这部影片是古巴电影史上最著名的作品。资产阶级知识分子塞尔吉奥（塞尔吉奥·科里耶里饰）的妻子和家人因猪湾入侵而逃离家园，他在哈瓦那闲逛度过了闲适的时光，他的爱情纠葛和政治矛盾逐渐让位于一种日益强烈的疏离感。这部改编自埃德蒙多·德斯诺斯 (Edmundo Desnoes) 的创新小说的作品，古铁雷斯·阿利亚 (Gutiérrez Alea) 发展了一种与他所记录的时代一样激进的电影风格，通过使用实验性剪辑技术、档案材料和即兴拍摄的街景，创造出生动印象的拼贴画。 《不发达的记忆》亲密而层次丰富，控诉了主人公的脱离现实，并让我们得以一睹革命后古巴的非凡生活。《不发达的记忆》是由博洛尼亚电影中心 L'Immagine Ritrovata 实验室与古巴艺术与工业电影学院 (ICAIC) 联合修复的。修复工作由乔治·卢卡斯家族基金会和电影基金会的世界电影项目资助。
hook_en: This film by Tomás Gutiérrez Alea is the most renowned work in the history of Cuban cinema. After his wife and family flee in the wake of the Bay of Pigs invasion, the bourgeois intellectual Sergio (Sergio Corrieri) passes his days wandering Havana in idle reflection, his amorous entanglements and political ambivalence gradually giving way to a mounting sense of alienation. With this adaptation of an innovative novel by Edmundo Desnoes, Gutiérrez Alea developed a cinematic style as radical as the times he was chronicling, creating a collage of vivid impressions through the use of experimental editing techniques, archival material, and spontaneously shot street scenes. Intimate and densely layered, Memories of Underdevelopment provides an indictment of its protagonist’s disengagement and an extraordinary glimpse of life in postrevolutionary Cuba.Memories of Underdevelopment was restored by the Cineteca di Bologna at L’Immagine Ritrovata laboratory in association with Instituto Cubano del Arte e Industria Cinematográficos (ICAIC). Restoration funded by the George Lucas Family Foundation and The Film Foundation’s World Cinema Project.

hook: 格斯·范·桑特的第二部长片梦幻般、飘忽不定、面无表情，是一部根据詹姆斯·福格尔的自传小说改编的成瘾剧，捕捉了生活中的迷幻纹理和近乎超现实的荒谬。马特·狄龙 (Matt Dillon) 在毒品引发的脱节和前卫偏执之间摇摆不定，饰演一个乌合之众（凯莉·林奇、希瑟·格雷厄姆和詹姆斯·勒格罗）的领导者，他们抢劫药店获取药品，在 20 世纪 70 年代的太平洋西北地区航行，同时试图摆脱清醒和命运。凭借反主流文化大祭司威廉·S·巴勒斯 (William S. Burroughs) 的出色支持，以及对范桑特家乡俄勒冈州波特兰市街景的抒情感情，《药店牛仔》巩固了导演作为杰出局外诗人的地位。
hook_en: Gus Van Sant’s dreamy, drifty, deadpan second feature—an addiction drama based on James Fogle’s autobiographical novel—captures the zonked-out textures and almost surreal absurdity of a life lived fix to fix. Swinging between dope-fueled disconnection and edgy paranoia, Matt Dillon plays the leader of a ragtag crew (also featuring Kelly Lynch, Heather Graham, and James Le Gros) that robs pharmacies for pills, coasting across the 1970s Pacific Northwest while trying to outrun sobriety and fate. With a brilliant supporting turn from counterculture high priest William S. Burroughs and a lyrical feeling for the streetscapes of Van Sant’s hometown of Portland, Oregon, Drugstore Cowboy cemented the director’s status as a preeminent poet of outsiderhood.

hook: 莉娜·杜纳姆 (Lena Dunham) 开始制作 YouTube 视频，但由于这部异常犀利的喜剧取得了突破性的成功，她成为了一位重要的天才，该喜剧让这位 24 岁的编剧兼导演兼演员与伍迪·艾伦 (Woody Allen) 等人相提并论。邓纳姆饰演奥拉，一名刚毕业的大学毕业生，她回到纽约并搬回与她的母亲和妹妹（由电影制片人现实生活中的母亲和妹妹扮演）住在一起。尽管奥拉对自己的未来感到停滞和困惑，但邓纳姆在她的困境中找到了无穷无尽的令人耳目一新的幽默来源。 《小家具》既痛苦又有趣，真实而深刻地描绘了一个处于十字路口的年轻女性。
hook_en: Lena Dunham got her start making YouTube videos, but she emerged as a major talent thanks to the breakthrough success of this exceptionally sharp comedy, which garnered the twenty-four-year-old writer-director-actor comparisons to the likes of Woody Allen. Dunham plays Aura, a recent college graduate who returns to New York and moves back in with her mother and sister (played by the filmmaker’s real-life mother and sister). Though Aura is gripped by stasis and confusion about her future, Dunham locates endless sources of refreshing humor in her plight. As painfully confessional as it is amusing, Tiny Furniture is an authentic, incisive portrait of a young woman at a crossroads.

hook: 当一名年轻女子与一名所谓的恐怖分子共度良宵时，她平静有序的生活陷入了毁灭。 《凯瑟琳娜·布鲁姆失去的荣誉》描绘了战后政治共识摇摇欲坠的西德的一个焦虑时代。卡塔琳娜虽然表面上无辜，却突然成为嫌疑人，成为警方和无情小报记者恶意抹黑的牺牲品，这考验了她的尊严和理智的极限。沃尔克·施隆多夫 (Volker Schlöndorff) 和玛格丽特·冯·特罗塔 (Margarethe von Trotta) 创作了 20 世纪 70 年代政治电影中最通俗易懂、最直接的作品之一，对海因里希·伯尔 (Heinrich Böll) 的小说进行了强有力的改编，对国家权力、个人自由和媒体操纵进行了尖锐的评论，无论在今天还是在上映时都具有现实意义。
hook_en: When a young woman spends the night with an alleged terrorist, her quiet, ordered life falls into ruins. The Lost Honor of Katharina Blum portrays an anxious era in West Germany amid a crumbling postwar political consensus. Katharina, though apparently innocent, suddenly becomes a suspect, falling prey to a vicious smear campaign by the police and a ruthless tabloid journalist that tests the limits of her dignity and her sanity. Crafting one of the most accessible and direct works of 1970s political filmmaking, Volker Schlöndorff and Margarethe von Trotta deliver a powerful adaptation of Heinrich Böll’s novel, a stinging commentary on state power, individual freedom, and media manipulation that is as relevant today as when it was released.

hook: 奥逊·威尔斯的《奥赛罗》尽管预算很少，但电影效果却十分出色，它证明了这位电影制片人执着地追求自己的愿景，直到天涯海角。威尔斯对莎士比亚的想象力有着无与伦比的热情认同，他将他创造性的视觉方法带入了这场由嫉妒、偏执和愤怒组成的持久悲剧中，并以出色的表演演绎了威尼斯的摩尔人，与苏珊娜·克劳蒂埃一起饰演无辜的苔丝狄蒙娜，米歇尔·麦克利亚莫尔饰演诡计多端的伊阿古。这部极其独立的电影历时三年在意大利和摩洛哥拍摄，并受到许多后勤问题的困扰，与《麦克白》和《午夜钟声》一起，证明了威尔斯是电影界对吟游诗人最大胆的诠释者。
hook_en: Gloriously cinematic despite its tiny budget, Orson Welles’s Othello is a testament to the filmmaker’s stubborn willingness to pursue his vision to the ends of the earth. Unmatched in his passionate identification with Shakespeare’s imagination, Welles brings his inventive visual approach to this enduring tragedy of jealousy, bigotry, and rage, and also gives a towering performance as the Moor of Venice, alongside Suzanne Cloutier as the innocent Desdemona, and Micheál MacLiammóir as the scheming Iago. Shot over the course of three years in Italy and Morocco and plagued by many logistical problems, this fiercely independent film joins Macbeth and Chimes at Midnight in making the case for Welles as the cinema’s most audacious interpreter of the Bard.

hook: 编剧兼导演米娅·汉森-洛夫踏上了前往英格玛·伯格曼故乡的精彩夏季冒险之旅，这是她的第七部长片，讲述了一个优雅、变形的故事，讲述了生活与艺术的相互作用以及故事的诞生方式。为了寻找当前电影制作项目的灵感，克里斯（维基·克里普斯饰）和她的搭档（蒂姆·罗斯饰）前往瑞典偏远的法罗岛，伯格曼在那里生活和工作了几十年。在那里，当克里斯面对她与工作、男人、母亲以及她的艺术影响的复杂关系时，电影大师的精神若隐若现。 《伯格曼岛》还以米娅·华希科沃斯卡 (Mia Wasikowska) 和安德斯·丹尼尔森·利 (Anders Danielsen Lie) 的精彩表演为特色，对创作过程的奥秘以及每部电影从思想到页面再到银幕的旅程进行了丰富的解构。
hook_en: Writer-director Mia Hansen-Løve embarks on a luminous summertime odyssey to the home of Ingmar Bergman for her seventh feature, a graceful, shape-shifting tale about the interplay of life and art and the ways in which stories are born. In search of inspiration for their current filmmaking projects, Chris (Vicky Krieps) and her partner (Tim Roth) travel to the remote island of Fårö, Sweden, where Bergman lived and worked for decades. There, the spirit of the cinema master looms as Chris confronts her complicated relationships to work, men, motherhood, and her artistic influences. Also featuring radiant performances from Mia Wasikowska and Anders Danielsen Lie, Bergman Island is a rich deconstruction of the mysteries of the creative process and the journey that every film takes from thought to page to screen.

hook: 雷纳·沃纳·法斯宾德根据阿尔弗雷德·德布林伟大的现代主义小说改编的长达 15 小时的备受争议的《柏林亚历山大广场》是一位多产导演的最高成就，他在 34 岁时已经拍摄了 30 多部电影。这部身临其境的史诗片讲述了法斯宾德的身临其境般的史诗故事，讲述了身材魁梧、天真烂漫的刑满释放人员弗兰茨·比伯科普夫（君特·兰普雷希特饰）在魏玛时代德国腐蚀的城市景观中试图“成为一个诚实的灵魂”的故事。法斯宾德带着愤世嫉俗和人性，详细描绘了一个普通人在一个极其不寻常的时代为生存而奋斗的巨大肖像。
hook_en: Rainer Werner Fassbinder’s controversial, fifteen-hour Berlin Alexanderplatz, based on Alfred Döblin’s great modernist novel, was the crowning achievement of a prolific director who, at age thirty-four, had already made over thirty films. Fassbinder’s immersive epic follows the hulking, childlike ex-convict Franz Biberkopf (Günter Lamprecht) as he attempts to “become an honest soul” amid the corrosive urban landscape of Weimar-era Germany. With equal parts cynicism and humanity, Fassbinder details a mammoth portrait of a common man struggling to survive in a viciously uncommon time.

hook: 罗曼·波兰斯基在这部 20 世纪 60 年代导演黄金时期的偏执狂故事中，精心策划了三人心理故事。唐纳德·普利森斯和弗朗索瓦丝·多莱克饰演一对性格孤僻的夫妇，他们与世隔绝的房子被莱昂内尔·斯坦德饰演的一个粗鲁、魁梧的美国逃犯入侵。三人玩着性羞辱和情感羞辱的角色扮演游戏。 《死胡同》是一个令人回味、幽闭恐怖且病态有趣的故事，讲述了混乱的现代世界。
hook_en: Roman Polanski orchestrates a mental ménage à trois in this slyly absurd tale of paranoia from the director’s golden 1960s period. Donald Pleasence and Françoise Dorléac star as a withdrawn couple whose isolated house is invaded by a rude, burly American gangster on the run, played by Lionel Stander. The three engage in role-playing games of sexual and emotional humiliation. Cul-de-sac is an evocative, claustrophobic, and morbidly funny tale of the modern world in chaos.

hook: 英格玛·伯格曼在《锯末与金属丝》中将性别之战呈现为一场摇摇欲坠、怪诞的羞辱狂欢节，这是这位大师最生动的早期作品之一，也是他与伟大电影摄影师斯文·尼克维斯特的众多合作中的第一部。影片讲述了 20 世纪之交的马戏团老板（奥克·格伦伯格饰）和他的年轻情妇（哈里特·安德森饰）之间的紧张关系，后者是巡回演出中的一名骑马者。影片以梦幻般的绕道和扭曲的性心理权力表演为特色，对身体和精神的堕落进行了尖锐而精彩的描述。
hook_en: Ingmar Bergman presents the battle of the sexes as a ramshackle, grotesque carnival of humiliation in Sawdust and Tinsel, one of the master’s most vivid early works and his first of many collaborations with the great cinematographer Sven Nykvist. The story of the charged relationship between a turn-of-the-twentieth-century circus owner (Åke Grönberg) and his younger mistress (Harriet Andersson), a horseback rider in the traveling show, the film features dreamlike detours and twisted psychosexual power plays, making for a piercingly brilliant depiction of physical and spiritual degradation.

hook: 受到哈里特·安德森朴实色情的启发，英格玛·伯格曼在为他扮演的众多角色中的第一个角色中，上演了这部令人惊叹的成熟作品，讲述了一个关于年轻爱情的感性而残酷的故事。来自斯德哥尔摩工人阶级家庭的女孩（安德森饰）和男孩（拉尔斯·艾克伯格饰）离家出走，在海滩度过一个僻静浪漫的夏天。不可避免的是，没过多久，两人就被迫回到现实。尽管《莫妮卡的夏天》一开始并没有引起多少反响，但它的声誉在整个 20 世纪 50 年代逐渐升温，并引起了国际轰动。
hook_en: Inspired by the earthy eroticism of Harriet Andersson, in the first of many roles for him, Ingmar Bergman turned in this work of stunning maturity, a sensual and ravaging tale of young love. A girl (Andersson) and boy (Lars Ekborg) from working-class families in Stockholm run away from home to spend a secluded, romantic summer at the beach. Inevitably, it is not long before the pair are forced to return to reality. Although Summer with Monika was initially quietly received, its reputation gathered steam throughout the 1950s, and it became an international sensation.

hook: 安娜·马格纳尼饰演罗马妈妈，一位中年妓女，为了儿子而试图摆脱肮脏的过去。 《罗马妈妈》突出了导演皮埃尔·保罗·帕索里尼对边缘化和被剥夺者一生的迷恋，以坚定的新现实主义视角展现了战后意大利的生存斗争。尽管最初因淫秽而在该国被禁，但如今这部电影仍然是一部经典，由电影界最伟大的演员之一的精彩表演组成，让我们得以一睹帕索里尼寻找自己风格的过程。
hook_en: Anna Magnani is Mamma Roma, a middle-aged prostitute who attempts to extricate herself from her sordid past for the sake of her son. Highlighting director Pier Paolo Pasolini’s lifelong fascination with the marginalized and dispossessed, Mamma Roma offers an unflinching, neorealistic look at the struggle for survival in postwar Italy. Though initially banned in the country for obscenity, today the film remains a classic, featuring a powerhouse performance by one of cinema’s greatest actors and offering a glimpse at Pasolini in the process of finding his style.

hook: 四位奥斯卡获奖演员——马龙·白兰度、安娜·马格纳尼、乔安妮·伍德沃德和莫琳·斯特普尔顿——在这部引人入胜的电影中大放异彩，影片还汇集了导演西德尼·吕美特和编剧田纳西·威廉姆斯的传奇才华。穿着蛇皮夹克的白兰度扮演的是瓦尔·泽维尔，一个试图直行的漂流者。他在南方小镇一家杂货店里找到了工作和安慰，这家杂货店的经营者是已婚、性生活受挫的托兰斯夫人（马格纳尼饰），她对瓦尔的诱惑就像当地的野孩子卡罗尔·库特雷（伍德沃德饰）一样。吕美特用他一贯的克制捕捉到了激烈、无所畏惧的表演以及威廉姆斯热血的故事讲述和社会批判，从而打造出了一部异常复杂和精湛的戏剧。
hook_en: Four Oscar-winning actors—Marlon Brando, Anna Magnani, Joanne Woodward, and Maureen Stapleton—shine in this enthralling film, which also brings together the legendary talents of director Sidney Lumet and writer Tennessee Williams. A smoldering, snakeskin-jacketed Brando is Val Xavier, a drifter trying to go straight. He finds work and solace in a small-town southern variety store run by the married, sexually frustrated Lady Torrance (Magnani), who proves as much a temptation for Val as does local wild child Carol Cutrere (Woodward). Lumet captures the intense, fearless performances and Williams’s hot-blooded story­telling and social critique with his customary restraint, resulting in a drama of uncommon sophistication and craft.

hook: 情节剧大师约翰·M·斯塔尔 (John M. Stahl) 将他精致的克制和近乎精神上纯净的视觉风格带入了这个具有毁灭性、持久相关的母女故事中。 《模仿生活》探讨了两位苦苦挣扎的单身母亲之间的友谊：一位（克劳黛特·科尔伯特饰）是一位工人阶级白人女性，登上了商界的顶峰，另一位（路易斯·比弗斯饰）是她的黑人管家，她的生活因她叛逆的白人女儿（弗雷迪·华盛顿饰）的拒绝而支离破碎。正是后一种关系——适应了美国痛苦的种族现实，并由黑人演员比弗斯和华盛顿令人心碎地演绎——赋予了这部电影超凡的情感力量。这部改编自范妮·赫斯特畅销小说的首部作品大胆直面种族身份、经济剥削和美国梦的局限性等复杂性和矛盾性。
hook_en: Melodrama master John M. Stahl brings his exquisite restraint and almost spiritually pure visual style to this devastating, enduringly relevant story of mothers and daughters. Imitation of Life explores the friendship between two struggling single mothers: one (Claudette Colbert) a working-class white woman who ascends to the top of the business world, the other (Louise Beavers) her Black housekeeper, whose life is shattered by the rejection of her rebellious, white-passing daughter (Fredi Washington). It is this latter relationship—attuned to America’s bitter racial realities and heartbreakingly enacted by trailblazing Black performers Beavers and Washington—that lends the film its transcendent emotional power. This first adaptation of Fannie Hurst’s best-selling novel boldly confronts the complexities and contradictions of racial identity, economic exploitation, and the limits of the American dream.

hook: 塞缪尔·富勒 (Samuel Fuller) 对美国种族主义的令人揪心的揭露在八十年代初拍摄时遭到了误解并被禁止上映。如今，这部臭名昭著的电影因其大胆的隐喻和扣人心弦的低俗电影制作而受到赞誉。克里斯蒂·麦克尼科尔饰演一位年轻女演员，她收养了一只失踪的德国牧羊犬，却在一系列可怕的事件中发现这只狗被训练来攻击黑人，保罗·温菲尔德饰演试图治愈它的动物训练师。 《白狗》是一种咆哮、不妥协的愿景，是最腐败的动物——人类所犯下的罪恶的悲剧写照。
hook_en: Samuel Fuller’s throat-grabbing exposé on American racism was misunderstood and withheld from release when it was made in the early eighties; today, the notorious film is lauded for its daring metaphor and gripping pulp filmmaking. Kristy McNichol stars as a young actress who adopts a lost German shepherd, only to discover through a series of horrifying incidents that the dog has been trained to attack black people, and Paul Winfield plays the animal trainer who tries to cure him. A snarling, uncompromising vision, White Dog is a tragic portrait of the evil done by that most corruptible of animals: the human being.

hook: 米拉·奈尔 (Mira Nair) 的《季风婚礼》充满了文化和家庭的冲突，这部喜剧和混乱的情节剧混合在一起，讲述了现代印度中上层阶级家庭唯一的女儿阿蒂蒂 (Aditi) 的包办婚姻的准备工作。当然，也有一些麻烦——阿迪蒂一直与一位已婚电视主持人有染；她从未见过她住在休斯敦的丈夫；这场婚礼加剧了她父亲隐藏的经济问题；就连婚礼策划师也变得精神崩溃，并埋藏了家庭秘密。但奈尔的庆祝活动最终是快乐和宣泄的：一首献给她的家乡德里和她自己的旁遮普家庭的情歌。
hook_en: Cultures and families clash in Mira Nair’s exuberant Monsoon Wedding, a mix of comedy and chaotic melodrama concerning the preparations for the arranged marriage of a modern upper-middle-class Indian family’s only daughter, Aditi. Of course there are hitches—Aditi has been having an affair with a married TV host; she’s never met her husband to be, who lives in Houston; the wedding has worsened her father’s hidden financial troubles; even the wedding planner has become a nervous wreck—as well as buried family secrets. But Nair’s celebration is ultimately joyful and cathartic: a love song to her home city of Delhi and her own Punjabi family.

hook: 一个农民的家庭因信仰、圣洁和爱而分裂——一个孩子相信自己是耶稣基督，第二个孩子宣称自己是不可知论者，第三个孩子爱上了原教旨主义者的女儿。 Ordet（The Word）揭穿了“有组织的宗教”一词的谎言，它是对简单事实和教条正统观念的挑战。德雷叶根据卡伊·蒙克的戏剧改编的作品将多个关于信仰和叛逆的故事分层，悄然走向了令人震惊的奇迹高潮。
hook_en: A farmer’s family is torn apart by faith, sanctity, and love—one child believes he’s Jesus Christ, a second proclaims himself agnostic, and the third falls in love with a fundamentalist’s daughter. Putting the lie to the term “organized religion,” Ordet (The Word) is a challenge to simple facts and dogmatic orthodoxy. Layering multiple stories of faith and rebellion, Dreyer’s adaptation of Kaj Munk’s play quietly builds towards a shattering, miraculous climax.

hook: 在这部黑色喜剧里，一群罪犯 relentlessly地追逐一位年轻的美国人，由奥黛丽·赫本饰演，她穿着华丽的Givenchy服装在巴黎穿梭，试图追回她已故丈夫偷来的财富。她唯一可以信任的人是凯瑞·格里菲斯的优雅、神秘的陌生人。导演斯坦利·杜恩为《Charade》这部闪耀着1960年代风格和阴暗机智的象征，带来了令人愉悦的黑暗。
hook_en: In this comedic thriller, a trio of crooks relentlessly pursue a young American, played by Audrey Hepburn in gorgeous Givenchy, through Paris in an attempt to recover the fortune her dead husband stole from them. The only person she can trust is Cary Grant’s suave, mysterious stranger. Director Stanley Donen goes deliciously dark for Charade, a glittering emblem of 1960s style and macabre wit.

hook: 传奇波兰导演耶齐·斯科利莫夫斯基根据罗伯特·格雷夫斯的短篇小说改编而成，是一部精神恐惧的杰作，从周围的低语开始，逐渐发展成存在主义的尖叫，这是一部与未知事物的幻觉对抗。在英国的一个小村庄里，一位实验作曲家（约翰·赫特饰）和他的妻子（苏珊娜·约克饰）发现他们的日常生活被一个神秘的陌生人（阴险诱人的艾伦·贝茨饰）的到来所颠覆，这个陌生人声称拥有原住民魔法的知识，并且有能力用致命的尖叫来杀人——这种力量让他成为恐惧和欲望的对象。凭借其谜盒结构、令人不安的模糊性和超凡脱俗的电子声音设计，这部戛纳电影节获奖作品因对神秘和无法控制的力量的原始恐惧而颤抖。
hook_en: A tour de force of psychic dread that begins as an ambient murmur and builds to an existential shriek, legendary Polish director Jerzy Skolimowski’s provocative adaptation of a short story by Robert Graves is a hallucinatory confrontation with the unknown. In a small English village, an experimental composer (John Hurt) and his wife (Susannah York) see their routine existence upended by the arrival of an enigmatic stranger (a seductively sinister Alan Bates), who claims to possess knowledge of Aboriginal magic and the ability to kill using a deadly scream—a power that makes him an object of both terror and desire. With its puzzle-box structure, unnerving ambiguity, and otherworldly electronic sound design, this Cannes Film Festival award winner quivers with the primal fear of mysterious and uncontrollable forces.

hook: 凭借《蜂巢之灵》在西班牙电影界崭露头角十年后，维克多·埃里斯凭借这部改编自阿黛莱达·加西亚·莫拉莱斯的中篇小说的电影重返电影制作领域，加深了导演对童年、奇幻和国家内战遗产的迷恋。在西班牙北部，埃斯特雷拉长大了，她的父亲是一位拥有神秘力量的医生，而他在南部的童年却充满了谜团，这是一个近乎神话的地区，随着时间的推移，埃斯特雷拉的秘密越来越多地困扰着埃斯特雷拉。尽管埃里斯最初的构想也包含了以南方为背景的部分，这些场景从未被拍摄过，但《南边》仍然是一种罕见的完美和满足的体验，它借鉴了何塞·路易斯·阿尔凯恩的绘画电影摄影来唤起记忆的魅力和过去难以接近、无法逃避的神秘。
hook_en: Ten years after making his mark on Spanish cinema with The Spirit of the Beehive, Víctor Erice returned to filmmaking with this adaptation of a novella by Adelaida García Morales, which deepens the director’s fascination with childhood, fantasy, and the legacy of his country’s civil war. In the North of Spain, Estrella grows up captivated by her father, a doctor with mystical powers—and by the enigma of his youth in the South, a near-mythical region whose secrets haunt Estrella more and more as time goes on. Though Erice’s original vision also encompassed a section set in the South itself, scenes that were never shot, El Sur remains an experience of rare perfection and satisfaction, drawing on painterly cinematography by José Luis Alcaine to evoke the enchantments of memory and the inaccessible, inescapable mysteries of the past.

hook: 吉姆·贾木许将他对让-皮埃尔·梅尔维尔和铃木清顺的冰冷犯罪剧的喜爱与武士神话的哲学维度结合起来，为这部杀手惊悚片带来了一种古怪的后现代视角。福里斯特·惠特克（Forest Whitaker）在他的一个决定性角色中，为一个为笨手笨脚的黑帮组织工作的禅宗合同杀手的形象带来了一种威严的平静，一个现代人，即使混乱和暴力在他周围盘旋，仍坚定地坚持日本武士准则的理想。伟大的罗比·穆勒 (Robby Müller) 的喜怒无常的摄影、武当派 (Wu-Tang Clan) 的 RZA 的精彩配乐以及众多色彩缤纷的角色演员（包括令人难忘的石脸亨利·席尔瓦 (Henry Silva)），《鬼狗：武士之道》就像一部流行文化采样电影混音带，围绕一位独一无二的悲剧英雄展开。
hook_en: Jim Jarmusch combined his love for the ice-cool crime dramas of Jean-Pierre Melville and Seijun Suzuki with the philosophical dimensions of samurai mythology for an eccentrically postmodern take on the hit-man thriller. In one of his defining roles, Forest Whitaker brings a commanding serenity to his portrayal of a Zen contract killer working for a bumbling mob outfit, a modern man who adheres steadfastly to the ideals of the Japanese warrior code even as chaos and violence spiral around him. Featuring moody cinematography by the great Robby Müller, a sublime score by the Wu-Tang Clan’s RZA, and a host of colorful character actors (including a memorably stone-faced Henry Silva), Ghost Dog: The Way of the Samurai plays like a pop-culture-sampling cinematic mixtape built around a one-of-a-kind tragic hero.

hook: 当黑人权力运动正在重塑美国时，开拓性的导演戈登·帕克斯拍摄了这部开创性的大片，帮助开启了黑人剥削时代，并引入了一种新的比坏人更坏的动作英雄约翰·沙夫特（理查德·朗德特里，饰演职业生涯的决定性角色），他是一位纽约市街头私家侦探，对罪犯严厉，对情人温柔。沙夫特被招募去营救哈林区黑帮老大被意大利黑帮绑架的女儿后，他发现自己陷入了一场迅速升级的住宅区与市中心的地盘争夺战之中。原版《Shaft》是七十年代曼哈顿的生动时光胶囊，为续集和多媒体重启提供了灵感，原版《Shaft》充满了不可磨灭的元素——从 Roundtree 的时尚皮革时装到 Isaac Hayes 的标志性放克和灵魂音乐。
hook_en: While the Black Power movement was reshaping America, trailblazing director Gordon Parks made this groundbreaking blockbuster, which helped launch the blaxploitation era and introduced a new kind of badder-than-bad action hero in John Shaft (Richard Roundtree, in a career-defining role), a streetwise New York City private eye who is as tough with criminals as he is tender with his lovers. After Shaft is recruited to rescue the kidnapped daughter of a Harlem mob boss from Italian gangsters, he finds himself in the middle of a rapidly escalating uptown vs. downtown turf war. A vivid time capsule of gritty seventies Manhattan that has inspired sequels and multimedia reboots galore, the original Shaft is studded with indelible elements—from Roundtree’s sleek leather fashions to the iconic funk and soul score by Isaac Hayes.

hook: “这整个世界本质上是狂野的，表面上却很奇怪。”大卫·林奇根据巴里·吉福德的小说进行了这部火热的改编，将他对噩梦般的美国的想象推向了疯狂的放纵和狂热的浪漫主义的新境界。劳拉·邓恩 (Laura Dern) 和尼古拉斯·凯奇 (Nicolas Cage) 饰演卢拉 (Lula) 和水手 (Sailor)，这对不法之徒的恋人充满了性欲的放纵，不计后果的激情让他们穿越了险恶的南方，在那里，他们的自由梦想与暴力和堕落的漩涡发生了冲突。这部电影将从《猫王》到《绿野仙踪》等全美国的形象融入到一部扭曲的南方哥特式肥皂剧中，并以威廉·达福和黛安·拉德令人难忘的配角为特色，让人联想到一个充满危险、欲望和幻想的黑暗梦境，这也许是 20 世纪 90 年代最超然反常的爱情故事。
hook_en: “This whole world is wild at heart and weird on top.” With this torrid adaptation of the novel by Barry Gifford, David Lynch pushed his vision of nightmarish Americana into new realms of delirious excess and feverish romanticism. Burning with libidinal abandon, Laura Dern and Nicolas Cage are Lula and Sailor, outlaw lovers whose reckless passion sends them on the run through a menacing South, where their dream of freedom collides with a vortex of violence and depravity. Blending all-American iconography ranging from Elvis to The Wizard of Oz into a twisted southern-gothic soap opera, and featuring memorable supporting turns by Willem Dafoe and Diane Ladd, the film conjures a dark dreamscape of danger, desire, and fantasy that stands as perhaps the most transcendently perverse love story of the 1990s.

hook: 伟大的伊朗导演阿巴斯·基亚罗斯塔米 (Abbas Kiarostami) 前往托斯卡纳，拍摄一部明亮而挑衅的浪漫故事，但一切都并非表面看上去那样。乍一看，这似乎是一个直截了当的故事，讲述了两个人——由奥斯卡获奖女演员朱丽叶·比诺什和歌剧歌手威廉·希梅尔饰演——在一个下午的过程中相互了解的过程，逐渐揭示出更丰富、更陌生、更棘手的东西：对艺术和人际关系中真实性的令人费解的反思。无论是在大脑上还是情感上，《认证副本》都提醒我们，爱本身就是一个谜。
hook_en: The great Iranian director Abbas Kiarostami travels to Tuscany for a luminous and provocative romance in which nothing is as it appears. What seems at first to be a straightforward tale of two people—played by Oscar-winning actress Juliette Binoche and opera singer William Shimell—getting to know each other over the course of an afternoon gradually reveals itself as something richer, stranger, and trickier: a mind-bending reflection on authenticity, in art as well as in relationships. Both cerebrally and emotionally engaging, Certified Copy reminds us that love itself is an enigma.

hook: 痛苦的年轻恋人、堕落的女人、通缉犯，以及形形色色的社会遗弃者：这些都是巴黎北酒店的声名狼藉的居民，这是一座位于巴黎繁华的圣马丁运河岸边、气氛肮脏的寄宿公寓，他们的生活在马塞尔·卡内关于浪漫、背叛、狂欢和暴力的苦乐参半的狂想曲中相互碰撞。 《北方旅馆》由著名的亚历山大·特劳纳 (Alexandre Trauner) 担任令人回味的制作设计，并由一些法国古典电影最杰出的明星组成，包括安娜贝拉 (Annabella)、路易·茹韦 (Louis Jouvet) 以及在她最具标志性的角色之一中扮演的极其放荡的阿莱蒂 (Arletty)，它是电影中的瑰宝，也是卡内著名诗学的崇高典范，为工人阶级的生活和戏剧注入了动人的贵族气息。
hook_en: Anguished young lovers, fallen women, wanted criminals, and all manner of social castoffs: these are the disreputable denizens of the Hôtel du Nord, an atmospherically seedy boardinghouse on the bustling banks of the Canal Saint-Martin in Paris, whose lives collide in Marcel Carné’s bittersweet rhapsody of romance, betrayal, revelry, and violence. Featuring evocative production design by the famed Alexandre Trauner and a colorful ensemble cast of some of classical French cinema’s most illustrious stars—including Annabella, Louis Jouvet, and a divinely dissolute Arletty in one of her most iconic roles—Hôtel du Nord is a jewel of a film and a sublime exemplar of Carné’s celebrated poetics, imbuing working-class lives and dramas with a touching nobility.

hook: 一位夸夸其谈、好色的艺术品经销商和他的画家朋友前往里维埃拉的一座 17 世纪别墅享受轻松的夏日度假。但他们的田园诗般的生活因波西米亚人海黛的出现而受到干扰，她被指控为男人的“收藏家”。埃里克·侯麦的第一部彩色电影《La Collectionneuse》将《六个道德故事》推向了新的、更黑暗的领域，同时展示了聪明、令人愉快的讽刺性的性别之战（由侯麦和三位主要演员编写的剧本）和毫不费力的性感摄影，这将定义该系列的其余部分。
hook_en: A bombastic, womanizing art dealer and his painter friend go to a seventeenth-century villa on the Riviera for a relaxing summer getaway. But their idyll is disturbed by the presence of the bohemian Haydée, accused of being a “collector” of men. Eric Rohmer’s first color film, La collectionneuse pushes Six Moral Tales into new, darker realms while showcasing the clever, delectably ironic battle-of-the-sexes repartee (in a script written by Rohmer and the three main actors) and effortlessly luscious Nestor Almendros photography that would define the remainder of the series.

hook: 在法国新浪潮、性革命和 1968 年 5 月的剧变之后，让·尤斯塔什 (Jean Eustache) 创作了近乎宗教般的巨著。在他长期未见的作品中，从有关他家乡的纪录片到紧密的自传体叙事电影，尤斯塔什开创了一种直率、无畏的现实主义风格。 《母亲与妓女》是这种创新风格的顶峰之作，讲述了巴黎伪知识分子亚历山大（让-皮埃尔·利奥德饰）与脾气暴躁的女友玛丽（贝尔纳黛特·拉丰饰）生活在一起的故事，同时他也开始与性自由的维罗妮卡（弗朗索瓦丝·勒布伦饰）调情，导致三人陷入情感上动荡的三角恋。通过大胆的持续长镜头和忏悔式对话，尤斯塔什捕捉到了 1970 年代幻灭时期的一代人的故事，并在这个过程中实现了一种如此深刻的亲密感。
hook_en: After the French New Wave, the sexual revolution, and the upheavals of May 1968 came the near religiously revered magnum opus by Jean Eustache. In his long-unavailable body of work, ranging from documentaries about his native village to closely autobiographical narrative films, Eustache pioneered a forthright and fearless brand of realism. The pinnacle of this innovative style, The Mother and the Whore follows Alexandre (Jean-Pierre Léaud), a Parisian pseudo-intellectual who lives with his tempestuous girlfriend, Marie (Bernadette Lafont), even as he begins a dalliance with the sexually liberated Veronika (Françoise Lebrun), leading the three into an emotionally turbulent love triangle. Through daringly sustained long takes and confessional dialogue, Eustache captures a generation navigating the disillusionment of the 1970s, and in the process achieves an intimacy so deep it cuts.

hook: 在《莫德家的一夜》中，《六个道德故事》系列的出色核心作品中，让·路易斯·特林蒂尼昂 (Jean-Louis Trintignant) 饰演让·路易斯 (Jean-Louis)，他是 20 世纪 60 年代电影中最伟大的矛盾人物之一。作为一名三十出头的天主教工程师，他遵循严格的道德准则，并沉浸在数学和布莱斯·帕斯卡的哲学中。在弥撒中发现娇弱的弗朗索瓦丝后，他发誓要娶她为妻，尽管当他在大胆的离婚女人莫德的公寓里度过一个计划外的夜晚时，他严格的标准受到了挑战。
hook_en: In My Night at Maud’s, the brilliantly accomplished centerpiece of the Six Moral Tales series, Jean-Louis Trintignant plays Jean-Louis, one of the great conflicted figures of 1960s cinema. A Catholic engineer in his early thirties, he lives by a strict moral code and immerses himself in mathematics and the philosophy of Blaise Pascal. After spotting the delicate Françoise at Mass, he vows to make her his wife, although when he spends an unplanned night at the apartment of the bold divorcée Maud, his rigid standards are challenged.

hook: 纪录片导演刘冰的这部非凡处女作将滑板、友谊和父子的故事编织成勇敢脆弱的成长之旅。在几年的时间里，刘带着他随时准备好的相机，记录了凯尔和扎克成年后的崎岖道路，这两个朋友来自他自己位于伊利诺伊州罗克福德的滑板社区。当他这样做时，更深层次的相似之处出现了，最终使电影制作人与自己的过去进行了令人心碎的对抗。 《Minding the Gap》以令人振奋的诗歌形象和敏锐的情感敏感性，有力地宣泄了在创伤中形成的、为挣脱束缚而奋斗的初出茅庐的生活。
hook_en: This extraordinary debut from documentarian Bing Liu weaves a story of skateboarding, friendship, and fathers and sons into a coming-of-age journey of courageous vulnerability. Over the course of several years and with his camera always at the ready, Liu records the rocky paths into adulthood of Keire and Zack, two friends from his own skateboarding community in Rockford, Illinois. As he does so, deeper parallels emerge that ultimately draw the filmmaker into a heartrending confrontation with his own past. With images of exhilarating poetry and a keen emotional sensitivity, Minding the Gap is a powerfully cathartic portrait of fledgling lives forged in trauma and fighting to break free.

hook: 骑士（马克斯·冯·叙多）从十字军东征精疲力尽归来，中世纪瑞典正被瘟疫笼罩；他与戴兜帽的死神对峙，挑战一盘棋。棋局推进，骑士与扈从遇见绝望社会里的一群弃儿。伯格曼以此深刻追问信仰的本质与死亡的折磨。《第七封印》是当时影响最大的影片之一，是人寻找意义的惊人寓言，也是冷峻的视觉诗。
hook_en: Returning exhausted from the Crusades to find medieval Sweden gripped by the Plague, a knight (Max von Sydow) suddenly comes face-to-face with the hooded figure of Death, and challenges him to a game of chess. As the fateful game progresses, and the knight and his squire encounter a gallery of outcasts from a society in despair, Ingmar Bergman mounts a profound inquiry into the nature of faith and the torment of mortality. One of the most influential films of its time, The Seventh Seal is a stunning allegory of man’s search for meaning and a work of stark visual poetry.

hook: 大岛将色情与恐怖融为一体，将观众带入了《激情帝国》（Ai no Borei）中一个关于罪恶感和报应的噩梦般的故事。影片以十九世纪末的一个日本村庄为背景，详细描述了一位已婚妇女和她年轻的情人决定谋杀她的丈夫并将他的尸体扔进井里后的情感和身体上的崩溃。 《激情帝国》是大岛唯一一部真正的怪谈（日本鬼故事），这部电影充满了野蛮、无情的经历，为他赢得了戛纳电影节最佳导演奖。
hook_en: With an arresting mix of eroticism and horror, Oshima plunges the viewer into a nightmarish tale of guilt and retribution in Empire of Passion (Ai no borei). Set in a Japanese village at the end of the nineteenth century, the film details the emotional and physical downfall of a married woman and her younger lover following their decision to murder her husband and dump his body in a well. Empire of Passion was Oshima’s only true kaidan (Japanese ghost story), and the film, a savage, unrelenting experience, earned him the best director award at the Cannes Film Festival.

hook: 你有没有想过成为别人？或者，更具体地说，您是否曾想爬过隐藏在匿名办公楼中的门户，从而进入约翰·马尔科维奇的大脑皮层十五分钟，然后被吐到新泽西州收费公路的一侧？那么导演斯派克·琼斯和编剧查理·考夫曼将为您准备这部电影。忧郁的木偶、办公室的苦差事、卷发的卡梅隆·迪亚兹——但这还不是全部！超现实主义、占有、约翰·库萨克、驯化灵长类动物、弗洛伊德、凯瑟琳·基纳、不合逻辑的逻辑，绝对没有浪漫！但是等等：现在就开始你的《成为约翰·马尔科维奇》吧，我们会加入阉割、闹剧、阿伯拉德和海洛伊丝，还有额外的马尔科维奇、马尔科维奇、马尔科维奇！
hook_en: Have you ever wanted to be someone else? Or, more specifically, have you ever wanted to crawl through a portal hidden in an anonymous office building and thereby enter the cerebral cortex of John Malkovich for fifteen minutes, before being spat out on the side of the New Jersey Turnpike? Then director Spike Jonze and writer Charlie Kaufman have the movie for you. Melancholy marionettes, office drudgery, a frizzy-haired Cameron Diaz—but that’s not all! Surrealism, possession, John Cusack, a domesticated primate, Freud, Catherine Keener, non sequiturs, and absolutely no romance! But wait: get your Being John Malkovich now and we’ll throw in emasculation, slapstick, Abelard and Heloise, and extra Malkovich, Malkovich, Malkovich!

hook: 一个关于离婚的爱情故事。婚姻破裂，家庭重聚。 《婚姻故事》是一部由广受好评的编剧兼导演诺亚·鲍姆巴赫 (Noah Baumbach) 执导的一部搞笑而悲惨、观察敏锐且富有同情心的电影。亚当·德赖弗 (Adam Driver) 和斯嘉丽·约翰逊 (Scarlett Johansson) 演绎了精彩的表演，分别饰演查理（Charlie）和妮可（Nicole），查理是一位热爱自己工作的富有魅力的纽约戏剧导演，而妮可则是一名准备改变自己生活的演员。当他们被卷入一个使他们相互对立并迫使他们重新定义他们的关系和家庭的体系时，他们对友好离婚的希望逐渐破灭。 《婚姻故事》（获得包括最佳影片在内的六项奥斯卡奖提名）由艾伦·阿尔达、​​雷·利奥塔和劳拉·邓恩（因在此片中的表演获得奥斯卡金像奖）饰演的律师三人组主持了一场法律战，场面大胆、精心绘制，是一部既亲密又宏大的作品，最终在废墟中唤起了希望。
hook_en: A love story about divorce. A marriage coming apart and a family coming together. Marriage Story is a hilarious and harrowing, sharply observed and deeply compassionate film from the acclaimed writer-director Noah Baumbach. Adam Driver and Scarlett Johansson deliver tour-de-force performances as Charlie, a charismatic New York theater director wedded to his work, and Nicole, an actor, who is ready to change her own life. Their hopes for an amicable divorce fade as they are drawn into a system that pits them against each other and forces them to redefine their relationship and their family. Featuring bravura, finely drawn supporting turns from Alan Alda, Ray Liotta, and Laura Dern—who won an Academy Award for her performance here—as the trio of lawyers who preside over the legal battle, Marriage Story (nominated for six Academy Awards including best picture) is a work of both intimacy and scope that ultimately invokes hope amid the ruins.

hook: “我是在不寻常的情况下出生的……”奥斯卡获奖影片《本杰明·巴顿奇事》由此开始，布拉德·皮特饰演一位八十多岁、年龄倒退的男人，凯特·布兰切特饰演他注定永远爱的女人。 《本杰明·巴顿奇事》是一段不朽的旅程，既不寻常，又史诗般，讲述了本杰明从第一次世界大战结束到二十一世纪的浪漫与救赎的非凡冒险。 《本杰明·巴顿奇事》由大卫·芬奇执导，是对生与死、爱与失的有力证明。
hook_en: “I was born under unusual circumstances . . .” Thus begins The Curious Case of Benjamin Button, the Academy Award–winning film starring Brad Pitt as a man who is born in his eighties and ages backward, and Cate Blanchett as the woman he is destined to love forever. The Curious Case of Benjamin Button is a monumental journey—as unusual as it is epic—that follows Benjamin’s remarkable adventure of romance and redemption from the end of World War I through the twenty-first century. Directed by David Fincher, The Curious Case of Benjamin Button is a powerful testament to life and death, love and loss.

hook: 在这部由惊悚片专家雅克·德雷 (Jacques Deray) 和传奇编剧让-克洛德·卡里埃尔 (Jean-Claude Carrière) 创作的缓慢悬念的迷人作品中，法国里维埃拉的明媚阳光具有欺骗性。阿兰·德龙和罗密·施奈德曾经是欧洲电影界最具标志性的现实情侣之一，他们在这部电影中重聚，在他们的表演中带来了明显的情色化学反应，他们扮演的是古铜色、美丽的度假者，他们在蔚蓝海岸的暑假被老熟人（莫里斯·罗内饰）和他十八岁的女儿（简·伯金饰）的到来打断——释放出一波不断聚集的性紧张浪潮，嫉妒和突然的暴力。凭借毫不费力的别致服装和米歇尔·勒格朗 (Michel Legrand) 的慵懒配乐，《鱼》成为 20 世纪 60 年代现代主义酷感的典范，深入揭示其诱人表面下翻滚的险恶暗流。
hook_en: The bright sun of the French Riviera is deceptive in this alluring work of slow-burn suspense from thriller specialist Jacques Deray and legendary screenwriter Jean-Claude Carrière. Formerly one of European cinema’s most iconic real-life couples, Alain Delon and Romy Schneider reunited for this film, bringing a palpable erotic chemistry to their performances as the bronzed and beautiful vacationers whose summer holiday on the Côte d’Azur is interrupted by the arrival of an old acquaintance (Maurice Ronet) and his eighteen-year-old daughter (Jane Birkin)—unleashing a gathering wave of sexual tension, jealousy, and sudden violence. A paragon of 1960s modernist cool thanks to effortlessly chic clothes and a loungy Michel Legrand score, La piscine dives deep to reveal sinister undercurrents roiling beneath its seductive surfaces.

hook: 贞子（春川真澄 饰）受到前几代人的诅咒，并受到同居丈夫的忽视，她成为了残酷的家庭入侵者的牺牲品。但她并没有成为受害者，而是为自己的觉醒开辟了一条道路。这种对家庭苦役和性暴力的令人不安和无情的唤起也是对一位女性决心的迷人而冷静的描述。 《谋杀意图》充满了导演今村昌平特有的倒叙和梦境片段，描绘了一个扣人心弦、大胆的女人在男人的世界中闯入自己的世界的故事。
hook_en: Sadako (Masumi Harukawa), cursed by generations before her and neglected by her common-law husband, falls prey to a brutal home intruder. But rather than become a victim, she forges a path to her own awakening. This disturbing and pitiless evocation of domestic drudgery and sexual violence is also a fascinating, unsentimental account of one woman’s determination. Filled with director Shohei Imamura’s characteristic flashbacks and dream sequences, Intentions of Murder is a gripping, audacious portrait of a woman coming into her own in a man’s world.

hook: 奉俊昊这部风格混乱的黑色喜剧惊悚片轰动了时代精神，将全球对阶级不平等的反思提炼为流行电影颠覆的杰作，证实了他作为世界上最重要的电影制片人之一的地位。首尔的两个家庭——一个在低洼社区潮湿的半地下室勉强度日，另一个则住在俯瞰整座城市的现代建筑奇迹中的奢华家庭——卷入了一种危险的关系中，这种关系将以令人震惊的凶猛程度暴露出资本主义的黑暗矛盾。 《寄生虫》展示了导演精心打造的布景，辅以出色的演员阵容和令人惊叹的制作设计，横扫了从戛纳电影节到奥斯卡金像奖的几乎所有主要奖项，巩固了新韩国电影作为不可否认的国际力量的地位，并创造了历史，成为第一部赢得最佳影片的非英语电影。
hook_en: A zeitgeist-defining sensation that distilled a global reckoning over class inequality into a tour de force of pop-cinema subversion, Bong Joon Ho’s genre-scrambling black-comic thriller confirms his status as one of the world’s foremost filmmakers. Two families in Seoul—one barely scraping by in a dank semibasement in a low-lying neighborhood, the other living in luxury in a modern architectural marvel overlooking the city—become entwined in a dangerous relationship that will lay bare the dark contradictions of capitalism with shocking ferocity. A bravura showcase for its director’s meticulously constructed set pieces, bolstered by a brilliant ensemble cast and stunning production design, Parasite cemented the New Korean Cinema as an undeniable international force when it swept almost every major prize from Cannes to the Academy Awards, where it made history as the first non-English-language film to win best picture.

hook: 《万王之王》是有史以来最伟大的故事，只有塞西尔·B·德米尔 (Cecil B. DeMille) 才能讲述。 1927 年，德米尔利用好莱坞历史上最大的预算之一，将基督的生平和受难故事改编成了一部默片时代的大片。 《万王之王》的文本直接取材于《圣经》，演员阵容达数千人，再加上这位伟大表演者独特的电影技巧，《万王之王》既壮观又令人肃然起敬——一半是福音，一半是彩色史诗。 Criterion Collection 很荣幸地以两张光盘的形式呈现这部深受喜爱的电影，其中包括 112 分钟的普通发行版和在格劳曼中国剧院盛大开幕时首映的罕见的 155 分钟剪辑版。
hook_en: The King of Kings is the Greatest Story Ever Told as only Cecil B. DeMille could tell it. In 1927, working with one of the biggest budgets in Hollywood history, DeMille spun the life and Passion of Christ into a silent-era blockbuster. Featuring text drawn directly from the Bible, a cast of thousands, and the great showman’s singular cinematic bag of tricks, The King of Kings is at once spectacular and deeply reverent—part Gospel, part Technicolor epic. The Criterion Collection is proud to present this beloved film in a two-disc edition featuring both the 112-minute general-release version and the rarely seen 155-minute cut that premiered at the grand opening of Grauman’s Chinese Theatre.

hook: 在这部荣获金棕榈奖的大胆讽刺作品中，社会不适大师鲁本·奥斯特伦德以毫不留情的镜头观察财富、美丽和特权的世界。一对模特网红夫妇（哈里斯·迪金森和查尔比·迪恩饰）受邀登上一艘免费游轮，与一群富人和残忍的人一起享受奢华生活，但命运的安排却让他们在 Instagram 上的完美世界发生了翻天覆地的变化。奥斯特伦德将每一个具有挑衅性的场景推向极端，以现代路易斯·布努埃尔的不敬态度和电影人类学家的敏锐描绘了不断变化的社会等级制度。
hook_en: Master of social discomfort Ruben Östlund trains his unsparing lens on the world of wealth, beauty, and privilege in this audacious, Palme d’Or–winning satire of our status-obsessed culture. A model-influencer couple (Harris Dickinson and Charlbi Dean) get a ticket to the luxe life when they’re invited aboard an all-expenses-paid cruise alongside a coterie of the rich and ghoulish—but an act of fate turns their Insta-perfect world upside down. Pushing each provocative set piece to its outré extreme, Östlund maps the shifting social hierarchies with the irreverence of a modern-day Luis Buñuel and the incisiveness of a cinematic anthropologist.

hook: 编剧兼导演格雷格·莫托拉 (Greg Mottola) 的长片处女作以其滑稽的幽默和苦乐参半的情感分量，宣告了 20 世纪 90 年代独立电影界一位低调而机智的新人的到来。当她发现一封未知情人写给她丈夫（斯坦利·图齐饰）的情书时，心烦意乱的伊丽莎（霍普·戴维斯饰）向她关系密切的长岛家人寻求建议。很快，全家人——意志坚强的妈妈（安妮·米拉饰）、沉默寡言的爸爸（帕特·麦克纳马拉饰）、疲惫不堪的妹妹（帕克·波西饰）和自命不凡的男友（列维·施瑞博尔饰）——挤进一辆旅行车，前往曼哈顿寻找真相，开始了一场疯狂的一天冒险之旅，充满了意想不到的弯路和改变生活的启示。 《一日游者》由顶级演员阵容以面无表情的精湛表演，以讽刺和尖锐的方式审视了濒临崩溃的家庭纽带。
hook_en: With its droll humor and bittersweet emotional heft, the feature debut of writer-director Greg Mottola announced the arrival of an unassumingly sharp-witted new talent on the 1990s indie film scene. When she discovers a love letter written to her husband (Stanley Tucci) by an unknown paramour, the distraught Eliza (Hope Davis) turns to her tight-knit Long Island family for advice. Soon the entire clan—strong-willed mom (Anne Meara), taciturn dad (Pat McNamara), and jaded sister (Parker Posey) with pretentious boyfriend (Liev Schreiber) in tow—has squeezed into a station wagon and headed into Manhattan to find out the truth, kicking off a one-crazy-day odyssey full of unexpected detours and life-changing revelations. Performed with deadpan virtuosity by a top-flight ensemble cast, The Daytrippers is a wry and piercing look at family bonds stretched to the breaking point.

hook: 亨利·乔治·克鲁佐因其大胆的“反法”杰作《Le Corbeau》而被列入黑名单，四年后，他凭借 1947 年犯罪小说改编版《Quai des Orfèvres》重返影坛。 《Quai des Orfèvres》以 20 世纪 40 年代巴黎充满活力的舞厅和犯罪走廊为背景，讲述了雄心勃勃的表演者珍妮·拉莫尔（苏西·德莱尔饰）、她贪婪的丈夫莫里斯·马蒂诺（伯纳德·布利尔饰）以及他们忠诚的红颜知己多拉·莫尼尔（西蒙妮·雷南特饰）的故事，当一名性狂欢的上流社会熟人被谋杀时，他们试图掩盖彼此的踪迹。侦探安托万（路易斯·茹韦饰）登场，他经验丰富的直觉带领他在这部经典的侦探谋杀悬疑剧中走上了一条迂回的道路。
hook_en: Blacklisted for his daring "anti-French" masterpiece Le corbeau, Henri-Georges Clouzot returned to cinema four years later with the 1947 crime-fiction adaptation Quai des Orfèvres. Set within the vibrant dance halls and crime corridors of 1940s Paris, Quai des Orfèvres follows ambitious performer Jenny Lamour (Suzy Delair), her covetous husband Maurice Martineau (Bernard Blier), and their devoted confidante Dora Monier (Simone Renant) as they attempt to cover one another's tracks when a sexually orgreish high-society acquaintance is murdered. Enter Inspector Antoine (Louis Jouvet), whose seasoned instincts lead him down a circuitous path in this classic whodunit murder mystery.

hook: 这部独特的爱情故事改编自丹尼斯·狄德罗的中篇小说，并由让·谷克托撰写对话，讲述了一位上流社会女士的阴谋，她密谋在她的贵族前情人和一名妓女之间发起了一场丑闻。在他的第二部长片中，导演罗伯特·布列松已经在锻造他非凡的电影制作技巧，对复仇的力量和真爱的力量进行了感人的研究。
hook_en: This unique love story, based on a novelette by Denis Diderot and with dialogue written by Jean Cocteau, follows the maneuverings of a society lady as she connives to initiate a scandalous affair between her aristocratic ex-lover and a prostitute. With his second feature film, director Robert Bresson was already forging his singularly brilliant filmmaking technique as he created a moving study of the power of revenge and the strength of true love.

hook: 阿格妮丝·瓦拉多用这部电影生动地捕捉了六十年代的巴黎，这是一部歌手（科琳妮·马尚）在城市中迷失，等待活检结果的实时肖像。《克洛依从5到7》是一部记录一位女性生活的瞬间的活力写实与戏剧的混合体，配乐由米歇尔·让·勒布朗（《樱桃的滋味》）创作，还有让-吕克·戈达尔和安娜·卡兰娜的 cameo。
hook_en: Agnès Varda eloquently captures Paris in the sixties with this real-time portrait of a singer (Corinne Marchand) set adrift in the city as she awaits test results of a biopsy. A chronicle of the minutes of one woman’s life, Cléo from 5 to 7 is a spirited mix of vivid vérité and melodrama, featuring a score by Michel Legrand (The Umbrellas of Cherbourg) and cameos by Jean-Luc Godard and Anna Karina.

hook: 《漫长的一天结束》是特伦斯·戴维斯独特情感的最辉煌的电影表达，他被誉为英国最伟大的在世电影制片人。这部充满魅力和忧郁的自传电影以 20 世纪 50 年代在利物浦长大的一个安静、孤独的男孩的视角。但戴维斯并没有采用直截了当的叙述方式，而是在时间中跳进跳出，陷入幻想和恐惧，唤起记忆和梦想。 《长日将至》是一幅独特的电影挂毯，描绘了艺术家年轻时对电影和音乐的痴迷，令人回味。
hook_en: The Long Day Closes is the most gloriously cinematic expression of the unique sensibility of Terence Davies, widely celebrated as Britain’s greatest living filmmaker. Suffused with both enchantment and melancholy, this autobiographical film takes on the perspective of a quiet, lonely boy growing up in Liverpool in the 1950s. But rather than employ a straightforward narrative, Davies jumps in and out of time, swoops into fantasies and fears, summons memories and dreams. A singular filmic tapestry, The Long Day Closes is an evocative, movie- and music-besotted portrait of the artist as a young man.

hook: 阿巴斯·基亚罗斯塔米 (Abbas Kiarostami) 的精彩交错的《科克三部曲》中的第一部电影以一个简单的前提为基础：一个男孩寻找同学的家，他不小心拿走了同学的学校笔记本，并将其转变为一场神奇的儿童眼中的日常生活冒险。当我们年轻的英雄在他所遇到的人的帮助（有时甚至是误导）下坚定地蜿蜒穿过两个城镇时，他的探索既揭示了伊朗农村社会的丰富性和复杂性，又成为一个关于个人责任意义的感人寓言。敏感而深刻，朋友的家在哪里？充满了一天所能包含的所有美丽、紧张和奇迹。
hook_en: The first film in Abbas Kiarostami’s sublime, interlacing Koker Trilogy takes a simple premise—a boy searches for the home of his classmate, whose school notebook he has accidentally taken—and transforms it into a miraculous child’s-eye adventure of the everyday. As our young hero zigzags determinedly across two towns, aided (and sometimes misdirected) by those he encounters, his quest becomes both a revealing portrait of rural Iranian society in all its richness and complexity and a touching parable about the meaning of personal responsibility. Sensitive and profound, Where Is the Friend’s House? is shot through with all the beauty, tension, and wonder a single day can contain.

hook: 在阿方索·卡隆执导轰动国际的影片《Y tu mamá también》之前，他曾凭借粗鄙且快如闪电的当代社会讽刺片《Sólo con tu pareja》在墨西哥电影界留下了自己的印记。唐璜式的雅皮士托马斯·托马斯（丹尼尔·吉梅内斯·卡乔饰，来自《不良教育》）整晚都在与许多美丽的女人打交道，以至于他无法记清她们的名字——直到他的众多征服者之一，一个被拒绝的护士，让他尝到了自己的苦果。卡隆的这部大获成功的长片处女作（从未在美国上映）由无与伦比的伊曼纽尔·卢贝兹基（《新世界》）以宽银幕拍摄，为在银幕上基本上不露面的墨西哥中产阶级发出了声音，并以不失风格的方式审视了当代都市的性习俗。
hook_en: Before Alfonso Cuarón helmed the international sensation Y tu mamá también, he made his mark on Mexican cinema with the ribald and lightning-quick contemporary social satire Sólo con tu pareja. Don Juan–ish yuppie Tomás Tomás (Daniel Giménez Cacho, from Bad Education) spends his nights juggling so many beautiful women that he can’t keep their names straight—until one of his many conquests, a spurned nurse, gives him a taste of his own medicine. Beautifully filmed in widescreen by the inimitable Emmanuel Lubezki (The New World), Cuarón’s wildly successful feature debut (which has never been released in the U.S.) gave voice to a Mexican middle-class that had remained largely unseen onscreen, and surveys contemporary urban sexual mores with style to spare.

hook: 雷内·克莱门特的《禁忌游戏》永恒地唤起了被腐蚀的童年纯真，讲述了一个因战争而成为孤儿的年轻女孩和一个农场男孩的故事，她加入了一个充满恐怖游戏的奇幻世界。这部独特的电影既神秘又令人心碎，其童星们的表演令人惊叹，并于 1952 年荣获奥斯卡特别外语片奖。
hook_en: A timeless evocation of childhood innocence corrupted, René Clément’s Forbidden Games tells the story of a young girl orphaned by war and the farm boy she joins in a fantastical world of macabre play. At once mythical and heartbreakingly real, this unique film features astonishing performances by its child stars and was honored with a special foreign language film Academy Award in 1952.

hook: 马克斯·奥菲尔斯 (Max Ophuls) 改编自阿瑟·施尼茨勒 (Arthur Schnitzler) 备受争议的世纪之交戏剧《雷根》(Reigen)，这部精彩而尖刻的影片由西蒙·西涅莱 (Simone Signoret)、安东·沃尔布鲁克 (Anton Walbrook) 和西蒙·西蒙 (Simone Simon) 领衔，由法国明星主演。士兵、女服务员、诗人、妓女、贵族——在这部充满爱情和不忠的多角色旋转木马中，所有人都处于平等的地位，导演以一种全面的欢乐，故意轻浮又迷人，并以奥菲尔斯标志性的流畅摄影拍摄。
hook_en: Simone Signoret, Anton Walbrook, and Simone Simon lead a roundelay of French stars in Max Ophuls's delightful, acerbic adaptation of Arthur Schnitzler's controversial turn-of-the-century play Reigen. Soldiers, chambermaids, poets, prostitutes, aristocrats—all are on equal footing in this multicharacter merry-go-round of love and infidelity, directed with a sweeping gaiety as knowingly frivolous as it is enchanting, and shot with Ophuls's trademark mellifluous cinematography.

hook: 名誉扫地的理查德·米尔豪斯·尼克松总统被隔离在家里，他用一瓶苏格兰威士忌和一把枪武装自己，记录无人会听到的回忆录。他周围是林肯、艾森豪威尔、基辛格和他母亲的无声肖像，他复活了自己的过去，热情地试图捍卫自己和他的政治遗产。 《罗伯特·奥尔特曼的秘密荣誉》改编自唐纳德·弗里德和阿诺德·M·斯通的原创剧本，由菲利普·贝克·霍尔主演，是一场精彩的独奏表演，罗伯特·奥尔特曼的《秘密荣誉》是对尼克松神秘面纱的尖锐审问，也是对不受控制的偏执狂的大胆描述。
hook_en: Sequestered in his home, a disgraced President Richard Milhous Nixon arms himself with a bottle of scotch and a gun to record memoirs that no one will hear. He is surrounded by the silent portraits of Lincoln, Eisenhower, Kissinger, and his mother, as he resurrects his past in a passionate attempt to defend himself and his political legacy. Based on the original play by Donald Freed and Arnold M. Stone, and starring Philip Baker Hall in a tour de force solo performance, Robert Altman’s Secret Honor is a searing interrogation of the Nixon mystique and an audacious depiction of unchecked paranoia.

hook: 维尔纳·赫尔佐格永远被不妥协的生活梦想家所吸引，通过这部电影，他进入了他最难忘的主题之一的不切实际的世界：蒂莫西·特雷德韦尔，一位自封的环保主义者，在阿拉斯加荒野中与灰熊生活在一起，与这些动物建立了密切的联系，并最终失去了生命。赫尔佐格借鉴了特雷德韦尔拍摄的一百多个小时的视频，在悲剧中寻找意义，对人类与自然的关系以及我们在一个往往冷漠的世界中寻找目标的动力进行了令人着迷的思考。 《灰熊人》是有史以来最深刻的纪录片之一，它对一位敢于超越文明界限的探索者的欣喜若狂的生活进行了扣人心弦的调查。
hook_en: Forever drawn to dreamers living on their own uncompromising terms, Werner Herzog journeyed, with this film, into the quixotic world of one of his most unforgettable subjects: Timothy Treadwell, a self-styled environmentalist who, for thirteen summers, lived among grizzly bears in the Alaskan wilderness, forging an intense bond with the animals and ultimately losing his life to one of them. Drawing on more than one hundred hours of video shot by Treadwell, Herzog searches for meaning within the tragedy, offering a mesmerizing meditation on humanity’s relationship to nature, and our drive to find purpose in an often indifferent world. One of the most profound documentaries ever made, Grizzly Man is a gripping investigation into the ecstatic life of a seeker who dared to live beyond the boundaries of civilization.

hook: 《地狱》（Jigoku，又名《地狱罪人》）令人震惊、令人震惊且富有诗意，是日本恐怖电影之父中川伸夫最具创新性的作品。一名年轻的神学学生逃离了一场肇事逃逸事故后，他既受到自己愧疚的良心的困扰，又受到神秘、恶魔般的分身的困扰。但所有可能的逃生路线都直通地狱——字面意义上的。在影片血腥的最后三分之一中，中川在一场酷刑和堕落的杰作中展现了他对黑社会的看法。 《地狱》与传统的日本鬼故事截然不同，以其真正令人瞠目结舌（和挖苦）的图像，所造成的余震至今仍在当代世界恐怖电影中回响。
hook_en: Shocking, outrageous, and poetic, Jigoku (Hell, a.k.a. The Sinners of Hell) is the most innovative creation from Nobuo Nakagawa, the father of the Japanese horror film. After a young theology student flees a hit-and-run accident, he is plagued by both his own guilt-ridden conscience and a mysterious, diabolical doppelgänger. But all possible escape routes lead straight to hell—literally. In the gloriously gory final third of the film, Nakagawa offers up his vision of the underworld in a tour de force of torture and degradation. A striking departure from traditional Japanese ghost stories, Jigoku, with its truly eye-popping (and -gouging) imagery, created aftershocks that are still reverberating in contemporary world horror cinema.

hook: 拉里萨·舍皮特科 (Larisa Shepitko) 的最后一部电影在 1977 年柏林电影节上赢得了金熊奖，并被誉为苏联晚期电影最优秀的作品之一，这是悲剧性缩短的职业生涯的最高胜利。在第二次世界大战最黑暗的日子里，两名游击队员冒着纳粹占领的白俄罗斯的暴风雪肆虐，出发去寻找物资来维持他们陷入困境的部队。当他们落入德国军队手中并面临死亡时，每个人都必须在殉难和背叛之间做出选择，在一场精神考验中，将电影的朴实戏剧提升到宗教寓言的层面。 《攀登》以赤裸裸的电影摄影，将令人眼花缭乱的白雪与漆黑的绝望进行对比，在战争的痛苦考验中找到了诗意和超越。
hook_en: The crowning triumph of a career cut tragically short, the final film from Larisa Shepitko won the Golden Bear at the 1977 Berlin Film Festival and went on to be hailed as one of the finest works of late Soviet cinema. In the darkest days of World War II, two partisans set out for supplies to sustain their beleaguered outfit, braving the blizzard-swept landscape of Nazi-occupied Belorussia. When they fall into the hands of German forces and come face-to-face with death, each must choose between martyrdom and betrayal, in a spiritual ordeal that lifts the film’s earthy drama to the plane of religious allegory. With stark, visceral cinematography that pits blinding white snow against pitch-black despair, The Ascent finds poetry and transcendence in the harrowing trials of war.

hook: 艾哈迈德·埃尔·马努尼 (Ahmed El Maanouni) 拍摄了这部独一无二的迷人纪录片，以突破性的摩洛哥乐队 Nass El Ghiwane 为主题，他拍摄了这四位音乐家在突尼斯、摩洛哥和法国进行的一系列激动人心的现场表演；卡萨布兰卡的街头；以及在亲密的谈话中。该乐队通过歌曲和传统乐器讲述故事，并与政治戏剧有联系，凭借其叛逆的歌词和崇高的全原声声音，吸收了柏柏尔节奏、马尔洪诗歌和格纳瓦舞蹈，成为当地现象和国际轰动。 《恍惚》既是一部音乐会电影，又是一场自由形式的视听实验，辅以乐队全神贯注的观众形象，是纯粹的电影诗歌。
hook_en: The groundbreaking Moroccan band Nass El Ghiwane is the dynamic subject of this captivating, one-of-a-kind documentary by Ahmed El Maanouni, who filmed the four musicians during a series of electrifying live performances in Tunisia, Morocco, and France; on the streets of Casablanca; and in intimate conversations. Storytellers through song and traditional instruments, and with connections to political theater, the band became a local phenomenon and an international sensation, thanks to its rebellious lyrics and sublime, fully acoustic sound, which draws on Berber rhythms, Malhun sung poetry, and Gnawa dances. Both a concert movie and a free-form audiovisual experiment, bolstered by images of the band’s rapt audience, Trances is pure cinematic poetry.

hook: 这部令人不安的程序惊悚片煞费苦心地详细描述了一个看似合理的噩梦场景：一次机械故障堵塞了美国军方的指挥系统，并导致该国迅速走向与苏联的核战争。编剧沃尔特·伯恩斯坦和导演西德尼·吕美特以当代畅销书为蓝本，从冷战时代的末日恐惧中扭转出令人痛苦的悬念，充分利用有限的预算和有限的布景，营造出一种潮湿的幽闭恐惧症和天文数字般的高风险氛围。由亨利·方达饰演一位冷静的美国总统，沃尔特·马修饰演一位好战的政治理论家，《安全保险》是一部长期被低估的电影警钟，对相互确保毁灭的致命逻辑发出了紧急警告。
hook_en: This unnerving procedural thriller painstakingly details an all-too-plausible nightmare scenario in which a mechanical failure jams the United States military’s chain of command and sends the country hurtling toward nuclear war with the Soviet Union. Working from a contemporary best seller, screenwriter Walter Bernstein and director Sidney Lumet wrench harrowing suspense from the doomsday fears of the Cold War era, making the most of a modest budget and limited sets to create an atmosphere of clammy claustrophobia and astronomically high stakes. Starring Henry Fonda as a coolheaded U.S. president and Walter Matthau as a trigger-happy political theorist, Fail Safe is a long-underappreciated alarm bell of a film, sounding an urgent warning about the deadly logic of mutually assured destruction.

hook: 在《金属之声》这个关于声音、愤怒和自我发现的故事中，里兹·艾哈迈德 (Riz Ahmed) 饰演情绪不稳定的鲁本 (Ruben)，他在噪音金属二人组中找到了鼓手的新目标，与歌手女友卢 (Lou)（奥利维亚·库克 (Olivia Cooke) 饰）一起进行了激烈的现场表演。当鲁本突然失去大部分听力时，他开始了一场深刻的冒险之旅——经历否认、愤怒、悲伤，然后逐渐接受——因为他开始理解作为一个聋人生活意味着什么，并发现耳聋不是一种残疾，而是一种丰富的文化和社区。通过令人惊叹的沉浸式、荣获奥斯卡奖的声音设计，导演达柳斯·马德尔邀请我们像鲁本一样体验世界，捕捉一个声波谱，其中沉默有千种色调。
hook_en: In Sound of Metal, a tale of sound, fury, and self-discovery, Riz Ahmed delivers an intensely committed performance as the volatile Ruben, who has found new purpose as a drummer in a noise-metal duo, playing blistering live shows with his singer girlfriend, Lou (Olivia Cooke). When Ruben suddenly loses much of his hearing, he is launched on a profound odyssey—through denial, anger, grief, and, gradually, acceptance—as he comes to understand what it means to live as a deaf person and to discover deafness as not a disability but a rich culture and community. Through stunningly immersive, Academy Award–winning sound design, director Darius Marder invites us to experience the world as Ruben does, capturing a sonic spectrum in which silence comes in a thousand shades.

hook: 间宫一家正在为女儿纪子寻找丈夫，但她有自己的想法。由非凡的原节子扮演的纪子冲动地选择了她儿时的朋友，既满足​​了家人的愿望，又拆散了他们。 《初夏》是一个看似简单的故事，是小津安二郎最复杂的作品之一——对三代人生活的变化进行了细致入微的审视。 Criterion Collection 很荣幸能够呈现这位导演最经久不衰的经典作品之一。
hook_en: The Mamiya family is seeking a husband for their daughter, Noriko, but she has ideas of her own. Played by the extraordinary Setsuko Hara, Noriko impulsively chooses her childhood friend, at once fulfilling her family's desires while tearing them apart. A seemingly simple story, Early Summer is one of Yasujiro Ozu's most complex works—a nuanced examination of life's changes across three generations. The Criterion Collection is proud to present one of the director's most enduring classics.

hook: 凭借这段充满浪漫渴望的苦乐参半的故事，导演大卫·利恩（ David Lean ）留下了英国音乐舞台，以灿烂的Technicolor色彩捕捉夏季高峰期威尼斯阳光灿烂的辉煌。凯瑟琳·赫本（ Katharine Hepburn ）描绘了一个孤独的中年美国游客的矛盾情绪，她被迫面对自己的不安全感，因为她被卷入了一个看似无能为力的…
hook_en: With this sublimely bittersweet tale of romantic longing, director David Lean left behind the British soundstage to capture in radiant Technicolor the sun-splashed glory of Venice at the height of summer. In a tour de force of fearless vulnerability, Katharine Hepburn portrays the conflicting emotions that stir the heart of a lonely, middle-aged American tourist who is forced to confront her insecurities when she is drawn into a seemingly impossible affair with a charming Italian shopkeeper (Rossano Brazzi) amid the ancient city’s canals and piazzas. Lean’s personal favorite among his own films, Summertime is an exquisitely tender evocation of the magic and melancholy of a fleeting, not-quite-fairy-tale romance.

hook: 安杰伊·瓦依达的这部轰动国际的电影是波兰电影的里程碑，是他著名的战争三部曲中的最后一部电影，将一个人的道德危机的故事与一个国家的命运交织在一起。第二次世界大战的最后一天，在波兰的一个小镇，地下反共抵抗运动的战士马切克（冷静而有魅力的兹比格涅夫·西布尔斯基饰）奉命刺杀即将上任的政委。但当他遇见并爱上一位年轻的酒吧女招待（埃娃·克日热夫斯卡 Ewa Krzyżewska 饰）时，他开始质疑自己对一项需要他冒生命危险的事业的承诺。 《灰烬与钻石》明亮的单色电影摄影——笼罩在阴影、烟雾和雾气中——以及精心设计的布景，为这个处于争取自决斗争十字路口的国家的紧迫、煽动性的愿景提供了令人惊叹的视觉活力。
hook_en: A milestone of Polish cinema, this electrifying international sensation by Andrzej Wajda—the final film in his celebrated war trilogy—entwines the story of one man’s moral crisis with the fate of a nation. In a small Polish town on the final day of World War II, Maciek (the coolly charismatic Zbigniew Cybulski), a fighter in the underground anti-Communist resistance movement, has orders to assassinate an incoming commissar. But when he meets and falls for a young barmaid (Ewa Krzyżewska), he begins to question his commitment to a cause that requires him to risk his life. Ashes and Diamonds’ lustrous monochrome cinematography—wreathed in shadows, smoke, and fog—and spectacularly choreographed set pieces lend a breathtaking visual dynamism to this urgent, incendiary vision of a country at a crossroads in its struggle for self-determination.

hook: 鲍勃·拉菲尔森 (Bob Rafelson) 继大获成功的《五件简单作品》之后，又推出了令人兴奋的续作，他更深入地挖掘了任性的美国破碎的梦想。杰克·尼科尔森和布鲁斯·邓恩饰演关系疏远的大卫和杰森兄妹，前者是一位抑郁的深夜广播脱口秀主持人，后者是一个外向的骗子；当杰森把他的弟弟拖到一个沉闷的大西洋城并陷入一场房地产骗局时，事件逐渐走向悲剧。 《马文花园之王》由才华横溢的艾伦·伯斯汀主演，饰演杰森苦涩的衰老选美皇后，是七十年代最具毁灭性的人物研究之一。
hook_en: For his electrifying follow-up to the smash success Five Easy Pieces, Bob Rafelson dug even deeper into the crushed dreams of wayward America. Jack Nicholson and Bruce Dern play estranged siblings David and Jason, the former a depressive late-night-radio talk show host, the latter an extroverted con man; when Jason drags his younger brother to a dreary Atlantic City and into a real-estate scam, events spiral toward tragedy. The King of Marvin Gardens, also starring a brilliant Ellen Burstyn as Jason’s bitter aging beauty-queen squeeze, is one of the most devastating character studies of the seventies.

hook: 小津安二郎的最后一部电影也是他最后的杰作，讲述了一个男人对生活瞬息万变和社会现代化的庄严顺从的故事，讲述了一个令人心碎的故事。尽管鳏夫周平（小津常任男主角柳智秋饰）多年来一直与已成年的女儿过着舒适的生活，但一系列事件导致他接受并鼓励她结婚并离开家。 《秋日的午后》与日本大师的电影一样，构图优雅，温柔至极，是电影中最温馨的告别之一。
hook_en: The last film by Yasujiro Ozu was also his final masterpiece, a gently heartbreaking story about a man’s dignified resignation to life’s shifting currents and society’s modernization. Though the widower Shuhei (frequent Ozu leading man Chishu Ryu) has been living comfortably for years with his grown daughter, a series of events leads him to accept and encourage her marriage and departure from their home. As elegantly composed and achingly tender as any of the Japanese master’s films, An Autumn Afternoon is one of cinema’s fondest farewells.

hook: 2004 年美国戏剧演员兼独白学家斯伯丁·格雷去世后，导演史蒂文·索德伯格将格雷的生平故事拼凑起来，创作了纪录片《一切顺利》。这本书完全根据格雷的镜头、从他整个职业生涯的采访和个人表演中精彩而敏感地组合而成，这是一部丰富、完整的肖像——一部自传——描绘了一个从来不亚于坦率但又保留着神秘气氛的人物。
hook_en: After the death in 2004 of American theater actor and monologist Spalding Gray, director Steven Soderbergh pieced together a narrative of Gray’s life to create the documentary And Everything Is Going Fine. Brilliantly and sensitively assembled entirely from footage of Gray, taken from interviews and one-man shows from throughout his career, it is a rich, full portrait—an autobiography of sorts—of a figure who was never less than candid but retained an air of mystery.

hook: 让-吕克·戈达尔在其打破惯例的处女作《屏息》首映之前就开始了他的第二部长片的制作，这部惊悚片将探讨法国最具争议的主题：阿尔及利亚战争中使用酷刑。尽管缺乏政治信念，摄影记者布鲁诺·福雷斯蒂尔（米歇尔·苏博饰）还是被拉进了一个准军事组织，该组织在日内瓦对阿尔及利亚独立运动发动了一场影子战争。安娜·卡里娜（安娜·卡里娜）（这是她与戈达尔的第一次合作，戈达尔的相机显然对她着迷）饰演福雷斯蒂尔迷恋的神秘女人。 《小士兵》因其对法国政府和阿尔及利亚战士的残酷战术的描述而被法国审查机构禁止两年半，《小士兵》发现年轻的戈达尔已经将电影重新改造为存在主义探究、政治争论和短暂肖像的载体——换句话说，作为传递“每秒二十四次真相”的媒介。
hook_en: Before his convention-shattering debut, Breathless, had even premiered, Jean-Luc Godard leapt into the making of his second feature, a thriller that would tackle the most controversial subject in France: the use of torture in the Algerian War. Despite his lack of political convictions, photojournalist Bruno Forestier (Michel Subor) is roped into a paramilitary group waging a shadow war in Geneva against the Algerian independence movement. Anna Karina (in her first collaboration with Godard, whose camera is visibly besotted with her) is beguiling as the mysterious woman with whom Forestier becomes infatuated. Banned for two and a half years by French censors for its depiction of brutal tactics on the part of the French government and the Algerian fighters alike, Le petit soldat finds the young Godard already retooling cinema as a vehicle for existential inquiry, political argument, and ephemeral portraiture—in other words, as a medium for delivering “truth twenty-four times per second.”

hook: 在二十世纪之交的都灵，一家纺织厂发生的事故煽动工人们举行罢工。但直到他们意外地得到了一位旅行教授（马塞洛·马斯楚安尼饰）的帮助，他们才找到了自己的声音、团结起来并为自己挺身而出。马里奥·莫尼切利的这部历史剧充满了幽默和诚实，是一首优美动人的人民力量颂歌，具有引人入胜、自然主义的表演；伟大的朱塞佩·罗图诺 (Giuseppe Rotunno) 的摄影；莫尼切利、阿吉诺·因克罗奇和福里奥·斯卡佩利创作的多层奥斯卡提名剧本。
hook_en: In turn-of-the-twentieth-century Turin, an accident in a textile factory incites workers to stage a walkout. But it’s not until they receive unexpected aid from a traveling professor (Marcello Mastroianni) that they find their voice, unite, and stand up for themselves. This historical drama by Mario Monicelli, brimming with humor and honesty, is a beautiful and moving ode to the power of the people, and features engaging, naturalistic performances; cinematography by the great Giuseppe Rotunno; and a multilayered, Oscar-nominated screenplay by Monicelli, Agenore Incrocci, and Furio Scarpelli.

hook: 让-吕克·戈达尔的第一部英语叙事长片是对莎士比亚杰作的彻底反改编，这位富有远见的电影制片人继续重塑电影的句法。在文化失落的后切尔诺贝利世界中，小威廉·莎士比亚五世（由戏剧导演彼得·塞拉斯饰演）在包括莫莉·林沃德、伯吉斯·梅雷迪思和戈达尔本人在内的演员阵容的怂恿下，试图重建他祖先的戏剧。通过声音、图像和思想的密集层次，从语言到电影制作的经济学，再到毁灭世界中艺术的意义，戈达尔塑造了一个顽皮而深刻的元电影之谜，供人们无休止地分析、争论和品味。
