hook_en: Jean-Luc Godard’s first English-language narrative feature is a radical anti-adaptation of Shakespeare’s masterpiece that finds the visionary filmmaker continuing to reinvent the syntax of cinema. In a post-Chernobyl world where culture has been lost, William Shakespeare Jr. V (played by theater director Peter Sellars) attempts to reconstruct his ancestor’s play, abetted by a cast that includes Molly Ringwald, Burgess Meredith, and Godard himself as a crazed avant savant. Through a dense layering of sounds, images, and ideas about everything from language to the economics of filmmaking to the very meaning of art in a ruined world, Godard fashions a puckish and profound metacinematic riddle to be endlessly analyzed, argued over, and savored.

hook: 由维托里奥·德·西卡执导的荣获奥斯卡金像奖的《偷自行车者》在全世界被誉为有史以来最伟大的电影之一，定义了一个电影时代。在战后陷入贫困的罗马，一名男子在第一天开始新工作，这为他绝望的家庭带来了拯救的希望，但他工作所需的自行车被偷了。他带着年幼的儿子，出发去追捕小偷。 《偷自行车者》结构简单，蕴藏着丰富的人类洞察力，体现了意大利新现实主义运动的最大优势：情感清晰、社会正直和残酷的诚实。
hook_en: Hailed around the world as one of the greatest movies ever made, the Academy Award–winning Bicycle Thieves, directed by Vittorio De Sica, defined an era in cinema. In poverty-stricken postwar Rome, a man is on his first day of a new job that offers hope of salvation for his desperate family when his bicycle, which he needs for work, is stolen. With his young son in tow, he sets off to track down the thief. Simple in construction and profoundly rich in human insight, Bicycle Thieves embodies the greatest strengths of the Italian neorealist movement: emotional clarity, social rectitude, and brutal honesty.

hook: 大卫·里恩 (David Lean) 为诺埃尔·考沃德 (Noël Coward) 的一部史诗般的编年史，讲述了伦敦郊区一个工人阶级家庭二十年来的生动情感生活。罗伯特·牛顿和西莉亚·约翰逊饰演弗兰克·吉本斯和埃塞尔·吉本斯，这对夫妇有三个孩子，从第一次世界大战末期到第二次世界大战开始，他们的朴素家庭充满了欢乐和悲剧。 《幸福的品种》将政治和情节剧融为一体，是一部典型的英国家庭剧，由罗纳德·尼姆 (Ronald Neame) 巧妙表现的彩色电影摄影以及包括约翰·米尔斯 (John Mills)、斯坦利·霍洛威 (Stanley Holloway) 和凯·沃尔什 (Kay Walsh) 在内的出色配角演员组成。
hook_en: David Lean brings to vivid emotional life Noël Coward’s epic chronicle of a working-class family in the London suburbs over the course of two decades. Robert Newton and Celia Johnson are surpassingly affecting as Frank and Ethel Gibbons, a couple with three children whose modest household is touched by joy and tragedy from the tail end of the First World War to the beginning of the Second. With its mix of politics and melodrama, This Happy Breed is a quintessential British domestic drama, featuring subtly expressive Technicolor cinematography by Ronald Neame and a remarkable supporting cast including John Mills, Stanley Holloway, and Kay Walsh.

hook: 米歇尔·安东尼奥尼在这部杰作中发明了一种新的电影语法。这是一部挑战性的1960年代电影的标志性作品，也是一个独立的故事叙述。《旅愁》讲述了在西西里海岸的一次游艇旅行中，一位年轻女子神秘失踪的故事，以及她失意的恋人（加布里埃尔·费雷塞蒂）和好友（莫妮卡·维蒂，在她的处女作中）展开的搜寻。安东尼奥尼的争议性国际现象是一部关于现代空虚和精神孤立的美丽故事。
hook_en: Michelangelo Antonioni invented a new film grammar with this masterwork. An iconic piece of challenging 1960s cinema and a gripping narrative on its own terms, L’avventura concerns the enigmatic disappearance of a young woman during a yachting trip off the coast of Sicily, and the search taken up by her disaffected lover (Gabriele Ferzetti) and best friend (Monica Vitti, in her breakout role). Antonioni’s controversial international sensation is a gorgeously shot tale of modern ennui and spiritual isolation.

hook: 卡洛斯·绍拉（Carlos Saura）精致的Críacuervos。 。 。预示着西班牙的一个转折点：在佛朗哥将军临终之际拍摄，这部电影融合了个人和政治，描绘了法西斯主义的遗产及其对中产阶级家庭的影响（片名源自西班牙谚语：“养大乌鸦，它们会啄出你的眼睛”）。安娜·托伦特（《蜂巢之灵》中的黑眼美女）描绘了心神不安的八岁女孩安娜，她和两个姐妹住在马德里，哀悼母亲的去世，她将母亲召唤为鬼魂（空灵的杰拉丁·卓别林饰）。影片在幻想与现实之间无缝切换，巧妙地唤起了童年的复杂情感和一个国家走出阴影的斗争。
hook_en: Carlos Saura's exquisite Cría cuervos . . . heralded a turning point in Spain: shot while General Franco was on his deathbed, the film melds the personal and the political in a portrait of the legacy of fascism and its effects on a middle-class family (the title derives from the Spanish proverb: “Raise ravens and they’ll peck out your eyes”). Ana Torrent (the dark-eyed beauty from The Spirit of the Beehive) portrays the disturbed eight-year-old Ana, living in Madrid with her two sisters and mourning the death of her mother, whom she conjures as a ghost (an ethereal Geraldine Chaplin). Seamlessly shifting between fantasy and reality, the film subtly evokes both the complex feelings of childhood and the struggles of a nation emerging from the shadows.

hook: 1934 年，让·雷诺阿走下摄影棚，前往法国南部，在乡村的田园风光和日常社交仪式中捕捉到了生动的人间戏剧。改编自真实故事，背景设定在法国社会边缘生活、工作和恋爱的移民社区，托尼讲述了同名的意大利移民（查尔斯·布拉维特饰），他与两个女人——忠诚的玛丽（珍妮·赫莉亚饰）和轻浮的约瑟法（西莉亚·蒙塔尔万饰）的风流韵事，引发了一场悲剧。雷诺阿利用非专业演员、外景拍摄以及伟大的马塞尔·帕尼奥尔普罗旺斯工作室的资源，打造了一部预示意大利新现实主义的诗意奇迹，成为法国新浪潮导演的最爱
hook_en: In 1934, Jean Renoir stepped off the soundstage and headed to the South of France, where he captured vivid human drama amid the bucolic splendor and everyday social rituals of the countryside. Based on a true story and set in a community of immigrants living, working, and loving on the margins of French society, Toni follows the eponymous Italian migrant (Charles Blavette), whose tempestuous affairs with two women—the faithful Marie (Jenny Hélia) and the flirtatious Josefa (Celia Montalván)—unleash a wave of tragedy. Making use of nonprofessional actors, on-location shooting, and the resources of the great Marcel Pagnol’s Provence studio, Renoir crafted a marvel of poetic feeling that anticipated Italian neorealism and became a favorite of the directors of the French New Wave

hook: 小津安二郎的第一部有声电影《独子》是这位日本导演最伟大的作品之一。在这个简单的故事中，一位善良的母亲放弃了一切以确保儿子的教育和未来，小津触及了牺牲、家庭、爱情和失望等普遍主题。 《独生子》跨越多年，是一部微缩版的全家福，拍摄和剪辑都遵循了制作者一贯的精致控制。
hook_en: Yasujiro Ozu’s first talkie, the uncommonly poignant _The Only Son_ is among the Japanese director’s greatest works. In its simple story about a good-natured mother who gives up everything to ensure her son’s education and future, Ozu touches on universal themes of sacrifice, family, love, and disappointment. Spanning many years, _The Only Son_ is a family portrait in miniature, shot and edited with its maker’s customary exquisite control.

hook: 开创性的独立导演约翰·卡索维茨在这部毫不畏缩地描绘危机中的男性气质的作品中，将他原始、不妥协的情感现实主义发挥到了极致。卡索维茨与本·加扎拉和彼得·法尔克（两人后来成为导演的主要合作者）一起扮演长岛的三名中年男人，在他们共同的亲密朋友突然去世后，他们将悲伤转化为一场史诗般的多日狂欢，从曼哈顿到伦敦，绝望、放荡地寻求活着的感觉。这部“关于生命、死亡和自由的喜剧”（正如其口号所述）时而令人痛苦地搞笑，时而伤人的洞察力，也许是电影史上对美国男子气概最无所畏惧、最令人痛心的诚实解构。
hook_en: The trailblazing independent auteur John Cassavetes pushes his raw, uncompromising emotional realism to its limit in this unflinching portrait of masculinity in crisis. Cassavetes joins Ben Gazzara and Peter Falk—both of whom would become key collaborators of the director’s—playing a trio of middle-aged Long Island family men who, following the sudden death of their close mutual friend, channel their grief into an epic, multiday bender that takes them from Manhattan to London in a desperate, debauched quest to feel alive. By turns painfully funny and woundingly perceptive, this “comedy about life, death, and freedom” (as its tagline stated) stands as perhaps the most fearless, harrowingly honest deconstruction of American manhood ever committed to film.

hook: 电子电影制作天才约翰·卡索维茨和他才华横溢的妻子兼合作者吉娜·罗兰兹以明亮而脆弱的表演演绎了两个紧密相连、情感受伤的灵魂，他们在分开多年后重逢。 《爱情溪流》既令人兴奋又充满风险，将清醒的现实主义与超现实的华丽融为一体，是一部非凡的电影，给观众带来一股美丽而飘忽不定的感觉。对各种形式的爱的本质的探究是卡索维茨最后一部真正的个人作品。
hook_en: The electric filmmaking genius John Cassavetes and his brilliant wife and collaborator Gena Rowlands give luminous, fragile performances as two closely bound, emotionally wounded souls who reunite after years apart. Exhilarating and risky, mixing sober realism with surreal flourishes, Love Streams is a remarkable film that comes at the viewer in a torrent of beautiful, erratic feeling. This inquiry into the nature of love in all its forms was Cassavetes’s last truly personal work.

hook: 恩斯特·刘别谦 (Ernst Lubitsch) 完成的最后一部电影，这部滑稽、活泼的礼仪喜剧以二战风口浪尖上的英国为背景，是这位博学多才的导演最激动人心的作品之一。詹妮弗·琼斯 (Jennifer Jones) 饰演克鲁尼·布朗 (Cluny Brown)，她是一位对管道工充满热情、难以抑制的女英雄，在这部罕见的喜剧中大放异彩。她被派到一座闷热的乡村庄园当客厅女仆，在亚当·贝林斯基（查尔斯·博耶饰）的大力帮助下，她开始让这个家庭发生翻天覆地的变化。亚当·贝林斯基是一位古怪的大陆流亡者，逃离了纳粹，但仍然担心下一顿饭从哪里来。 《克鲁尼·布朗》以刘别谦著名的轻松手法提升了英国的阶级等级制度，是一部颠倒黑白的闹剧，对松鼠说疯子，对松鼠说疯子。
hook_en: The final film completed by Ernst Lubitsch, this zany, zippy comedy of manners, set in England on the cusp of World War II, is one of the worldly-wise director’s most effervescent creations. Jennifer Jones shines in a rare comedic turn as Cluny Brown, an irrepressible heroine with a zeal for plumbing. Sent to work as a parlormaid at a stuffy country manor, she proceeds to turn the household upside down—with plenty of help from Adam Belinski (Charles Boyer), an eccentric Continental exile who has fled the Nazis but is still worried about where his next meal is coming from. Sending up British class hierarchy with Lubitsch’s famously light touch, Cluny Brown is a topsy-turvy farce that says nuts to the squirrels and squirrels to the nuts.

hook: 埃米尔·詹宁斯 (Emil Jannings) 凭借在片中扮演一位富有同情心的暴君而获得首届奥斯卡最佳男主角奖：一名流亡的俄罗斯将军摇身一变，成为好莱坞的临时演员，他扮演了前沙皇时期的自己，却导致了他的情感崩溃。约瑟夫·冯·斯滕伯格
hook_en: Emil Jannings won the first best actor Academy Award for his performance as a sympathetic tyrant: an exiled Russian general turned Hollywood extra who lands a role playing a version of his former tsarist self, bringing about his emotional downfall. Josef von Sternberg’s

hook: 年轻的丈夫兼父亲弗朗索瓦（让-克洛德·德鲁奥饰）虽然嫁给了善良美丽的泰蕾兹（克莱尔·德鲁奥饰），但他毫无疑问地发现自己与一位迷人的邮政工人发生了风流韵事。 《幸福》是阿涅斯·瓦尔达最具煽动性的电影之一，它以令人迷惑的欢快色调和莫扎特的激昂旋律，探讨了现代、以自我为中心的世界中的忠诚和幸福理念。
hook_en: Though married to the good-natured, beautiful Thérèse (Claire Drouot), young husband and father François (Jean-Claude Drouot) finds himself falling unquestioningly into an affair with an attractive postal worker. One of Agnès Varda's most provocative films, Le bonheur examines, with a deceptively cheery palette and the spirited strains of Mozart, the ideas of fidelity and happiness in a modern, self-centered world.

hook: 激情在艺术家和她的拍摄对象之间悄悄酝酿，直到他们共同创造了一个可以短暂繁荣的空间，在这部由法国当代电影最受好评的导演之一席琳·席安玛 (Céline Sciamma) 创作的这部华丽的 18 世纪浪漫故事中。玛丽安（诺米·梅兰特饰）被召唤到一处偏僻的海滨庄园执行一项秘密任务，她必须找到一种方法，通过偷偷地观察反对动产婚姻的爱洛伊丝（阿黛尔·哈内尔饰）来为她绘制结婚肖像。在微妙的张力中展开的是持续的目光交流，两个女人以令人兴奋的亲密了解彼此的手势、表情和身体，最终形成了颠覆性的创造性合作以及疯狂的浪漫。 《燃烧女子的肖像》充满了一种几乎超越时空的渴望，挖掘了当女性在没有男性的世界中自由地生活在一起并彼此见面时所出现的情感和艺术可能性。
hook_en: Passion brews quietly between an artist and her subject, until together they create a space in which it can briefly flourish, in this sumptuous eighteenth-century romance from Céline Sciamma, one of contemporary French cinema’s most acclaimed auteurs. Summoned to an isolated seaside estate on a secret assignment, Marianne (Noémie Merlant) must find a way to paint a wedding portrait of Héloïse (Adèle Haenel), who is resisting chattel marriage, by furtively observing her. What unfolds in exquisite tension is an exchange of sustained gazes in which the two women come to know each other’s gestures, expressions, and bodies with rapturous intimacy, ultimately forging a subversive creative collaboration as well as a delirious romance. Charged with a yearning that almost transcends time and space, Portrait of a Lady on Fire mines the emotional and artistic possibilities that emerge when women can freely live together and see one another in a world without men.

hook: 让·雷诺阿的疯狂浪漫喜剧《埃琳娜和她的男人》(Elena et les hommes)以世纪之交法国的军事演习和四月节狂欢节为背景，由英格丽·褒曼主演，饰演一位美丽但贫穷的波兰公主，她让各阶层的男人陷入绝望的爱情。当埃琳娜引起了一位著名将军的迷恋时，她发现自己处于浪漫阴谋和政治阴谋的中心，几个男人的心以及法国的未来都掌握在她的手中。
hook_en: Set amid the military maneuvers and Quatorze Juillet carnivals of turn-of-the-century France, Jean Renoir’s delirious romantic comedy Elena and her Men (Elena et les hommes) stars a radiant Ingrid Bergman as a beautiful, but impoverished, Polish princess who drives men of all stations to fits of desperate love. When Elena elicits the fascination of a famous general, she finds herself at the center of romantic machinations and political scheming, with the hearts of several men—as well as the future of France—in her hands.

hook: 米开朗基罗·安东尼奥尼的《女人的身份》是一次深入男人艺术和情欲意识的身体和灵魂之旅。妻子离开他后，一位电影导演发现自己陷入了与两个神秘女人的风流韵事中：同时，他为下一部电影寻找合适的主题和女演员。这部引人入胜的反浪漫片是这位意大利传奇电影制片人职业生涯后期的一次妙招，以其露骨的性爱和在雾气笼罩的高速公路上的长镜头而闻名，这是导演最伟大的布景。
hook_en: Michelangelo Antonioni’s Identification of a Woman is a body- and soul-baring voyage into one man’s artistic and erotic consciousness. After his wife leaves him, a film director finds himself drawn into affairs with two enigmatic women: at the same time, he searches for the right subject and actress for his next film. This spellbinding antiromance was a late-career coup for the legendary Italian filmmaker, and is renowned for its sexual explicitness and an extended scene on a fog-enshrouded highway that stands with the director’s greatest set pieces.

hook: 皮埃尔·保罗·帕索里尼（Pier Paolo Pasolini）的《定理》是对资产阶级精神空虚的冷静而神秘的探索，超越了最初为他赢得声誉的诗意、无产阶级的朴实。特伦斯·斯坦普饰演一个神秘的陌生人——也许是天使，也许是魔鬼——他一一引诱米兰一个富裕家庭的成员（包括欧洲电影偶像西尔瓦娜·曼加诺、马西莫·吉罗蒂、劳拉·贝蒂和安妮·维亚泽姆斯基），在他们每个人的生活中引发了一场生存危机。这个诱人的形而上之谜几乎无言地展开，因为天主教会因堕落而被禁止公开，它既是一篇关于性、宗教和艺术的马克思主义论文，也是对虚空的原始尖叫。
hook_en: With Teorema, a coolly cryptic exploration of bourgeois spiritual emptiness, Pier Paolo Pasolini moved beyond the poetic, proletarian earthiness that first won him renown. Terence Stamp stars as the mysterious stranger—perhaps an angel, perhaps a devil—who, one by one, seduces the members of a wealthy Milanese family (including European cinema icons Silvana Mangano, Massimo Girotti, Laura Betti, and Anne Wiazemsky), precipitating an existential crisis in each of their lives. Unfolding nearly wordlessly, this tantalizing metaphysical riddle—blocked from exhibition by the Catholic Church for degeneracy—is at once a blistering Marxist treatise on sex, religion, and art and a primal scream into the void.

hook: 皮尔·保罗·帕索里尼（ Pier Paolo Pasolini ）、萨洛（ Salò ）或《所多玛的120天》（ The 120 Days of Sodom ）这部臭名昭著的最后一部电影被称为令人作呕、令人震惊、堕落、色情……这也是一件杰作。这位备受争议的诗人、小说家和电影制片人于1944年将萨德侯爵18世纪的酷刑和堕落作品转换为法西斯意大利，仍然是有史以来最激烈的辩论电影之一，是对政治，政治，…
hook_en: The notorious final film from Pier Paolo Pasolini, Salò, or The 120 Days of Sodom has been called nauseating, shocking, depraved, pornographic . . . It’s also a masterpiece. The controversial poet, novelist, and filmmaker’s transposition of the Marquis de Sade’s eighteenth-century opus of torture and degradation to Fascist Italy in 1944 remains one of the most passionately debated films of all time, a thought-provoking inquiry into the political, social, and sexual dynamics that define the world we live in.

hook: 开创性的制作公司 BBS 的发现之一是导演亨利·雅格洛姆 (Henry Jaglom)。这位性格极其独特的电影制片人在长达数十年的职业生涯中一直从事独立制作的女性角色研究，他凭借《安全之地》首次在电影界崭露头角。在这部充满奇幻元素的精致、内省的戏剧中，周二·韦尔德饰演纽约一位脆弱的年轻女子，她无法调和自己模糊的过去和不稳定的现在；奥森·威尔斯饰演一位迷人的中央公园魔术师，杰克·尼科尔森饰演一位神秘的前情人。
hook_en: One of the discoveries of the groundbreaking production company BBS was director Henry Jaglom. The fiercely idiosyncratic filmmaker—who would go on to have a decades-spanning career making independently produced female character studies—was first revealed to the film world with A Safe Place. In this delicate, introspective drama, laced with fantasy elements, Tuesday Weld stars as a fragile young woman in New York, unable to reconcile her ambiguous past with her unmoored present; Orson Welles as an enchanting Central Park magician and Jack Nicholson as a mysterious ex-lover round out the cast.

hook: 当一名矿工离开雇主，带着年幼的儿子长途跋涉，成为一名农民工时，他发现自己从一个怪异的风景移动到另一个怪异的风景，间歇性地被一个穿着干净的白色西装的神秘男人跟踪（并拍照），并最终面对他不可避免的命运。 《陷阱》是敕志原浩的处女作，也是与小说家阿部公房的首次合作，它包含了很多内容：一个神秘、令人不安的鬼故事，一幅人类疏离的肖像，以及对毫无灵魂的工业的令人信服的超现实批评，以优雅的黑白镜头拍摄。
hook_en: When a miner leaves his employers and treks out with his young son to become a migrant worker, he finds himself moving from one eerie landscape to another, intermittently followed (and photographed) by an enigmatic man in a clean, white suit, and eventually coming face-to-face with his inescapable destiny. Hiroshi Teshigahara’s debut feature and first collaboration with novelist Kobo Abe, Pitfall is many things: a mysterious, unsettling ghost story, a portrait of human alienation, and a compellingly surreal critique of soulless industry, shot in elegant black and white.

hook: 1977 年，著名导演巴贝特·施罗德 (Barbet Schroeder) 和电影摄影师内斯特·阿尔门德罗斯 (Nestor Almendros) 进入世界上最著名的灵长类动物的世界，拍摄了引人入胜的纪录片《科科：会说话的大猩猩》。影片向我们介绍了科科被彭妮·帕特森博士从旧金山动物园带到斯坦福大学进行一项有争议的实验后不久——她将通过美国手语学习人类交流的基础知识。 《科科：一只会说话的大猩猩》是一部有趣、令人不安但仍然具有现实意义的纪录片，它揭示了有关动物个人权利的持续伦理和哲学辩论，并让我们面对面地看到了一只夹在中间的令人惊奇的大猩猩。
hook_en: In 1977, acclaimed director Barbet Schroeder and cinematographer Nestor Almendros entered the universe of the world’s most famous primate to create the captivating documentary Koko: A Talking Gorilla. The film introduces us to Koko soon after she was brought from the San Francisco Zoo to Stanford University by Dr. Penny Patterson for a controversial experiment—she would be taught the basics of human communication through American Sign Language. An entertaining, troubling, and still relevant documentary, Koko: A Talking Gorilla sheds light on the ongoing ethical and philosophical debates over the individual rights of animals and brings us face-to-face with an amazing gorilla caught in the middle.

hook: 为了向作家和侨民致敬，韦斯·安德森的第十部长片以《法国快讯》的最终版形式出现，这是一本记录法国布拉塞河畔恩努伊市生活的周刊（面向美国读者）。这本结构精美的选集由三个特色故事组成——一位饱受折磨的艺术家的简介、一篇关于学生革命者的报道，以及一篇带有美食扭曲的小报绑架事件的叙述——再加上一篇讣告和一篇游记，这部结构令人眼花缭乱的选集混合了从戏剧插曲到生动的场景再到漫画动画的一切内容。精湛的演员阵容包括阿德里安·布洛迪、蒂莫西·柴勒梅德、本尼西奥·德尔·托罗、弗朗西斯·麦克多蒙德、蕾雅·赛杜、欧文·威尔逊和杰弗里·怀特。
hook_en: A salute to writers and expatriates, Wes Anderson’s tenth feature takes the form of the final edition of The French Dispatch, a weekly magazine chronicling life in the city of Ennui-sur-Blasé, France (for American readers). Made up of three featured stories—a profile of a tortured artist, a report on student revolutionaries, and a recounting of a tabloid kidnapping with a gourmet twist—plus an obituary and a travelogue, this dazzlingly constructed anthology mixes everything from theatrical interludes to tableaux vivants to comic-book animation. The superb ensemble cast includes Adrien Brody, Timothée Chalamet, Benicio del Toro, Frances McDormand, Léa Seydoux, Owen Wilson, and Jeffrey Wright.

hook: 地下丝绒乐队 (Velvet Underground) 诞生于 1960 年代纽约地下文化的魅力、低俗肮脏和狂热创造力的原始汤中，以其原始而崇高的实验与艺术破坏的摇滚乐融合，重新定义了音乐。在他的万花筒纪录片《地下丝绒》中，托德·海恩斯生动地描绘了乐队的炽热世界：双胞胎梦想家卢·里德和约翰·凯尔的创意起源、安迪·沃霍尔的传奇工厂，以及流行音乐和前卫音乐之间的爆炸性张力，推动了乐队的发展并最终消灭了它。前所未见的表演、采访、罕见的录音和来自那个时代实验电影场景的令人兴奋的传输汇集在一起​​，形成令人欣喜若狂的声音和图像漩涡，这对传统音乐纪录片来说是天鹅绒乐队所要摇滚的：完全革命性的。
hook_en: Emerging from the primordial soup of glamour, gutter sleaze, and feverish creativity that was New York’s 1960s underground culture, the Velvet Underground redefined music with its at once raw and exalted blend of experimentation and art-damaged rock and roll. In his kaleidoscopic documentary The Velvet Underground, Todd Haynes vividly evokes the band’s incandescent world: the creative origins of the twin visionaries Lou Reed and John Cale, Andy Warhol’s fabled Factory, and the explosive tension between pop and the avant-garde that propelled the group and ultimately consumed it. Never-before-seen performances, interviews, rare recordings, and mind-blowing transmissions from the era’s experimental cinema scene come together in an ecstatic swirl of sound and image that is to the traditional music documentary what the Velvets were to rock: utterly revolutionary.

hook: 在雷内·克莱尔对巴黎拥挤的公寓的令人难以抑制的浪漫描绘中，一名街头歌手和一名歹徒争夺一名美丽年轻女子的爱情。这部主要通过歌曲讲述的对爱情和人类弱点的诙谐探索，通过精致的视觉效果和对电影声音新技术的突破性运用，捕捉了这座城市的华丽氛围。 《巴黎屋檐下》一经上映就引起了国际轰动，它是一场令人振奋的电影制作庆典，也是法国最受欢迎的电影出口之一。
hook_en: In René Clair's irrepressibly romantic portrait of the crowded tenements of Paris, a street singer and a gangster vie for the love of a beautiful young woman. This witty exploration of love and human foibles, told primarily through song, captures the flamboyant atmosphere of the city with sophisticated visuals and groundbreaking use of the new technology of movie sound. An international sensation upon its release, Under the Roofs of Paris is an exhilarating celebration of filmmaking and one of France's most beloved cinematic exports.

hook: 伟大的阿涅斯·瓦尔达的电影生涯始于这部以地中海小渔村为背景、对一段触礁婚姻的优雅而深刻的研究。瓦尔达这部漫无目的、华丽的处女作既以风格化的方式描绘了一对已婚夫妇（由西尔维娅·蒙福特和菲利普·诺瓦雷饰演）之间复杂的关系，又以纪录片般的方式描绘了当地人的日常挣扎，瓦尔达的这部漫无目的、华丽的电影处女作足够激进，后来被认为是即将到来的法国新浪潮的先驱之一。
hook_en: The great Agnès Varda's film career began with this graceful, penetrating study of a marriage on the rocks, set against the backdrop of a small Mediterranean fishing village. Both a stylized depiction of the complicated relationship between a married couple (played by Silvia Monfort and Philippe Noiret) and a documentary-like look at the daily struggles of the locals, Varda's discursive, gorgeously filmed debut was radical enough to later be considered one of the progenitors of the coming French New Wave.

hook: 阿兰·雷奈 (Alain Resnais) 的《穆里尔》(Muriel) 或《回归之时》是导演继《去年在马里昂巴德》之后的续作，与前作一样，对时间和记忆的本质进行了彻底的反思。总是光彩照人的德尔菲娜·塞里格 (Delphine Seyrig) 饰演滨海布洛涅 (Boulogne-sur-Mer) 的一位古董店老板和寡妇，当一位前情人重新进入她的生活时，她的过去又回来困扰着她。与此同时，她的继子受到自己的鬼魂的折磨，这与他在法国最近结束的阿尔及利亚战争中的服役有关。让·凯罗尔 (Jean Cayrol) 编写了多层次的剧本，并经过创造性的编辑，以唤起中产阶级角色的政治和个人现实，支离破碎、情感强大的穆里尔 (Muriel) 提醒观众，过去永远存在。
hook_en: Alain Resnais’s Muriel, or The Time of Return, the director’s follow-up to Last Year at Marienbad, is as radical a reflection on the nature of time and memory as its predecessor. The always luminous Delphine Seyrig stars as an antique shop owner and widow in Boulogne-sur-Mer, whose past comes back to haunt her when a former lover reenters her life. Meanwhile, her stepson is tormented by his own ghosts, related to his service in France’s recently ended war in Algeria. Featuring a multilayered script by Jean Cayrol and inventively edited to evoke its middle-class characters’ political and personal realities, the fragmented, emotionally powerful Muriel reminds viewers that the past is always present.

hook: 《罗生门》是一部引人入胜的心理惊悚片，探讨了真理的本质和正义的意义，被广泛认为是有史以来最伟大的电影之一。四个人对一名男子被谋杀及其妻子被强奸给出了不同的描述，导演黑泽明以引人注目的图像和巧妙地运用倒叙的方式呈现了这一点。这部雄辩的杰作和国际轰动彻底改变了电影语言，并将日本电影和一位名叫三船敏郎的新星引入了西方世界。罗生门由学院电影资料馆、东京国立近代美术馆国家电影中心和角川电影公司修复。角川文化振兴基金会和电影基金会提供资金。
hook_en: A riveting psychological thriller that investigates the nature of truth and the meaning of justice, Rashomon is widely considered one of the greatest films ever made. Four people give different accounts of a man’s murder and the rape of his wife, which director Akira Kurosawa presents with striking imagery and an ingenious use of flashbacks. This eloquent masterwork and international sensation revolutionized film language and introduced Japanese cinema—and a commanding new star by the name of Toshiro Mifune—to the Western world. Rashomon was restored by the Academy Film Archive, the National Film Center of the National Museum of Modern Art, Tokyo, and Kadokawa Pictures, Inc. Funding provided by Kadokawa Culture Promotion Foundation and The Film Foundation.

hook: 朱利安·施纳贝尔 (Julian Schnabel) 向他的朋友兼画家同行让·米歇尔·巴斯奎特 (Jean-Michel Basquiat) 致敬，与其说是一部传统的传记片，不如说是一部印象派的感官沉浸式作品，让您沉浸在 20 世纪 80 年代曼哈顿市中心艺术世界的神话中。杰弗里·怀特 (Jeffrey Wright) 在他的首部主演电影中饰演一位富有远见的艺术家，他从涂鸦涂鸦者成长为艺术明星，迫使他面对突然成名的眩光、种族主义、他自己与毒瘾的斗争，以及在美国实现自决和自由的困难。施纳贝尔的导演处女作在演员阵容的支持下，其中包括大卫·鲍伊模仿安迪·沃霍尔的精彩表演，以电影制片人自己的明亮黑白翻拍版呈现，是对短暂的光辉生命的深刻表现力的挽歌。
hook_en: Julian Schnabel’s tribute to his friend and fellow painter Jean-Michel Basquiat is less a conventional biopic than an impressionistic, sensory immersion into the much-mythologized downtown-Manhattan art world of the 1980s. Jeffrey Wright, in his first lead film role, stars as the visionary artist whose rise from graffiti tagger to art star forces him to confront the glare of sudden fame, along with racism, his own struggles with addiction, and the difficulties of being self-determining and free in America. Bolstered by an ensemble cast that includes a sublime performance by David Bowie channeling Andy Warhol, Schnabel’s directorial debut—presented here in the filmmaker’s own luminous black-and-white remastering—is a profoundly expressive elegy for a radiant life cut short.

hook: 亚历杭德罗·G·伊纳里图 (Alejandro G. Iñárritu) 的这部精彩长片处女作给墨西哥电影业和全世界带来了冲击，将导演令人惊叹的视觉风格和大胆的多股故事讲述带上了银幕，带来了令人心碎的原始尖叫声。在墨西哥城，三个陌生人的生活——一个混迹于残酷的斗殴地下世界的年轻人，一个似乎拥有一切的迷人女人，以及一个渴望与疏远的女儿重新联系的神秘刺客——在悲剧性的命运转折中碰撞，永远改变了他们的个人旅程。 《Amores perros》是一部充满动感手持摄影作品的暴力和情感杰作，令人难忘地陷入了一个充满残酷和痛苦、相互关联的人性世界。
hook_en: Sending shock waves through the Mexican film industry and the world, this blistering feature debut from Alejandro G. Iñárritu brought the director’s electrifying visual style and bravura multistrand storytelling to the screen with the heart-stopping impact of a primal scream. In Mexico City, the lives of three strangers—a young man mixed up in the gritty underworld of dogfighting, a glamorous woman who seems to have it all, and a mysterious assassin who is desperate to reconnect with his estranged daughter—collide in a tragic twist of fate that forever alters their personal journeys. A tour de force of violence and emotion captured in a rush of kinetic handheld camera work, Amores perros is an unforgettable plunge into a world of brutality and aching, interconnected humanity.

hook: 在一场定义职业生涯的表演中，阿兰·德龙饰演杰夫·科斯特洛，一个具有武士本能的合​​同杀手。在执行了一次完美无缺的袭击后，杰夫发现自己夹在坚持不懈的警察调查员和无情的雇主之间，甚至连他的软呢帽和风衣盔甲也无法保护他。 《武士》是特立独行的导演让·皮埃尔·梅尔维尔 (Jean-Pierre Melville) 创作的优雅风格的酷炫杰作，它是 20 世纪 40 年代美国黑帮电影和 1960 年代法国流行文化的尖锐鸡尾酒，还融入了日本独行侠神话。
hook_en: In a career-defining performance, Alain Delon plays Jef Costello, a contract killer with samurai instincts. After carrying out a flawlessly planned hit, Jef finds himself caught between a persistent police investigator and a ruthless employer, and not even his armor of fedora and trench coat can protect him. An elegantly stylized masterpiece of cool by maverick director Jean‑Pierre Melville, Le samouraï is a razor-sharp cocktail of 1940s American gangster cinema and 1960s French pop culture —with a liberal dose of Japanese lone-warrior mythology.

hook: 《绿茶饭之味》是小津安二郎在其巅峰时期创作的难以言喻的可爱家庭传奇之一，以极其尖锐的方式描绘了一场悄然破裂的婚姻。秘密和欺骗让一对没有孩子的中年夫妇本已脆弱的关系变得紧张，妻子在城市长大的成熟与丈夫在小镇的简单发生了冲突，而代际的巨变——以她任性、现代的侄女的形式——席卷了他们的家庭。导演对家庭动态的持久关注得到了最热烈的处理之一，以一种讽刺、温柔的幽默和轻松的扩张，将故事从家庭转移到战后东京的棒球场、弹珠机店和拉面店。
hook_en: One of the ineffably lovely domestic sagas made by Yasujiro Ozu at the height of his mastery, The Flavor of Green Tea over Rice is a sublimely piercing portrait of a marriage coming quietly undone. Secrets and deceptions strain the already tenuous relationship of a childless, middle-aged couple, as the wife’s city-bred sophistication bumps up against the husband’s small-town simplicity, and a generational sea change—in the form of her headstrong, modern niece—sweeps over their household. The director’s abiding concern with family dynamics receives one of its most spirited treatments, with a wry, tender humor and buoyant expansiveness that moves the action from the home into the baseball stadiums, pachinko parlors, and ramen shops of postwar Tokyo.

hook: 这部身临其境的纪录片将战争档案镜头与虚构的叙事无缝地交织在一起，讲述了一个二十岁的年轻人从基础训练到诺曼底登陆前线的旅程，以令人震惊的真实性生动地展现了战争的所有恐怖和孤立。 《霸主》由斯图尔特·库珀执导，由斯坦利·库布里克的长期摄影师约翰·奥尔科特以印象派方式拍摄，既是一部关于二战的纪录片，也是对人类在一台巨大的、难以理解的机器中的渺小的梦幻般的思考。
hook_en: Seamlessly interweaving archival war footage with a fictional narrative, this immersive account of one twenty-year-old’s journey from basic training to the front lines of D-day brings to life all the terrors and isolation of war with jolting authenticity. Overlord, directed by Stuart Cooper and impressionistically shot by Stanley Kubrick’s longtime cinematographer John Alcott, is both a document of World War II and a dreamlike meditation on human smallness in a large, incomprehensible machine.

hook: 路易·马勒 (Louis Malle) 勇敢而富有争议的《拉科姆》(Lacombe) 是最早探讨德国占领期间合作问题的法国电影之一，《吕西安》追溯了一名年轻农民从潜在的抵抗组织成员到盖世太保新兵的旅程。这部电影讲述了一个国家和一个陷入困境的男孩的故事，是对失去的纯真和罪恶感的令人不安的描绘。
hook_en: One of the first French films to address the issue of collaboration during the German occupation, Louis Malle’s brave and controversial Lacombe, Lucien traces a young peasant’s journey from potential Resistance member to Gestapo recruit. At once the story of a nation and one troubled boy, the film is a disquieting portrait of lost innocence and guilt.

hook: 阿兰·雷乃的第一部长片是法国新浪潮的基石，也是有史以来最具影响力的电影之一。法国女演员（艾曼纽·丽娃饰）和日本建筑师（冈田英二饰）在战后的广岛发生了一段短暂而激烈的恋情，他们强烈的相互迷恋迫使他们驱散自己对爱情和痛苦的伤痕累累的记忆。 《广岛之恋》采用创新的倒叙结构，并由小说家玛格丽特·杜拉斯提名奥斯卡金像奖剧本，是一部喜怒无常的杰作，巧妙地将过去与现在、个人痛苦与公众痛苦交织在一起。
hook_en: A cornerstone of the French New Wave, the first feature from Alain Resnais is one of the most influential films of all time. A French actress (Emmanuelle Riva) and a Japanese architect (Eiji Okada) engage in a brief, intense affair in postwar Hiroshima, their consuming mutual fascination impelling them to exorcise their own scarred memories of love and suffering. With an innovative flashback structure and an Academy Award–nominated screenplay by novelist Marguerite Duras, Hiroshima mon amour is a moody masterwork that delicately weaves past and present, personal pain and public anguish.

hook: 1964 年 2 月 9 日，披头士乐队首次在美国电视节目《埃德·沙利文秀》中进行现场表演，激起了粉丝群的狂热，他们对乐队的狂热热爱预示着青年文化的爆炸性新浪潮。 《我想握着你的手》回顾了那个决定命运的周末，讲述了六名新泽西青少年的故事，每个人都有不同的理由想要看到披头士四人组，他们疯狂地前往曼哈顿与乐队见面并获得演出门票。通过这部欢快的首部故事片，导演罗伯特·泽米吉斯和联合编剧鲍勃·盖尔确立了自己作为卓越电影制作团队的地位，擅长挖掘美国喜剧和冒险的文化记忆，将甜蜜的怀旧和俏皮的不敬融为一体。
hook_en: On February 9, 1964, the Beatles made their first live appearance on American television on The Ed Sullivan Show, ratcheting up the frenzy of a fan base whose ecstatic devotion to the band heralded an explosive new wave of youth culture. I Wanna Hold Your Hand looks back to that fateful weekend, following six New Jersey teenagers, each with different reasons for wanting to see the Fab Four, on a madcap mission to Manhattan to meet the band and score tickets to the show. With this rollicking first feature, director Robert Zemeckis and cowriter Bob Gale established themselves as a film­making team par excellence, adept at mining America’s cultural memory for comedy and adventure with a winning mixture of sweet nostalgia and playful irreverence.

hook: 被肯·罗素称为“自《大都会》以来最伟大的科幻电影” ，备受争议的导演保罗·弗霍文（ Paul Verhoeven ）的《机器人警察》（ RoboCop ）是一个充满特效的邪教现象。这部电影讲述了一个复活的机器人英雄（彼得·韦勒）在一个新的，超级充电的机器人身体里，努力恢复他的记忆并为自己的死亡报仇。这部电影由爱德华·诺伊梅尔（ Edward Neumeier ）和迈克尔·迈纳（ Michael Miner ）撰写，是一部成熟的超级英雄幻想，生动而血腥。
hook_en: Called by Ken Russell “the greatest science-fiction film since Metropolis,” controversial director Paul Verhoeven’s RoboCop is a special effects-laden cult phenomenon. The film features a resurrected and roboticized hero (Peter Weller) in a new, supercharged cyborg body, struggling to reclaim his memory and avenge his own death. Written by Edward Neumeier and Michael Miner, this film is a grown-up superhero fantasy come to vivid, bloody life.

hook: 崭露头角的导演雷纳·沃纳·法斯宾德受委托为公共电视台制作一部工人阶级家庭剧，他接受了这个任务并参演，从批判性但远非愤世嫉俗的角度描绘了西德的社会现实，从而避开了人们的期望。在五集的故事中，这个庞大的故事讲述了年轻工具制造商乔亨（戈特弗里德·约翰饰）和他世界里的许多人每天的胜利和艰辛，包括他所爱的女人（汉娜·施古拉饰）、他古怪的家庭和他的工友，他与他们一起改善工厂车间的条件。 《八小时不成一天》自广受欢迎但颇具争议的首播以来就很少上映，被评为一个真正的发现，是法斯宾德对情节剧可能性最早、最温柔的实验之一。
hook_en: Commissioned to make a working-class family drama for public television, up-and-coming director Rainer Werner Fassbinder took the assignment and ran, dodging expectations by depicting social realities in West Germany from a critical—yet far from cynical—perspective. Over the course of five episodes, the sprawling story tracks the everyday triumphs and travails of the young toolmaker Jochen (Gottfried John) and many of the people populating his world, including the woman he loves (Hanna Schygulla), his eccentric family, and his fellow workers, with whom he bands together to improve conditions on the factory floor. Rarely screened since its popular but controversial initial broadcast, Eight Hours Don’t Make a Day rates as a true discovery, one of Fassbinder’s earliest and most tender experiments with the possibilities of melodrama.

hook: 电影梦想编织者吉列尔莫·德尔·托罗（Guillermo del Toro）与马克·古斯塔夫森（Mark Gustafson）联袂执导，凭借其充满灵感的想象力，经典故事得以重生。通过突破界限、复杂得令人惊叹的定格动画，这部对木偶男孩和他的制作者的寓言的黑暗渲染——获得了奥斯卡最佳动画长片奖——大胆地将故事转移到法西斯意大利，在那里，无法抑制的匹诺曹通过战争、死亡和牺牲的经历逐渐了解了作为人类的意义。这部匹诺曹由伊万·麦格雷戈、凯特·布兰切特、蒂尔达·斯文顿和克里斯托夫·瓦尔兹配音，为这个广为人知的故事注入了关于勇敢和同情地生活的大胆新共鸣。
hook_en: A classic tale is reborn through the inspired imagination of cinematic dream-weaver Guillermo del Toro, directing alongside Mark Gustafson. Realized through boundary-pushing, breathtakingly intricate stop-motion animation, this dark rendering of the fable of the puppet boy and his maker—which won the Academy Award for Best Animated Feature—daringly transfers the story to Fascist Italy, where the irrepressible Pinocchio gradually learns what it means to be human through his experiences of war, death, and sacrifice. Featuring the voices of Ewan McGregor, Cate Blanchett, Tilda Swinton, and Christoph Waltz, this Pinocchio imbues the oft-told tale with a bold new resonance about living with courage and compassion.

hook: 路易斯·布努埃尔对人类社会仪式固有的荒谬性的看法在他最具道德颠覆性和形式上最大胆的作品中达到了消除禁忌的极端。从拿破仑时代一直到今天，《自由魅影》以流浪汉的姿态穿越时空，人物在一系列达达主义不合逻辑的场景中穿梭。不受叙事逻辑法则的束缚，布努艾尔让他的超现实主义者的本我在对资产阶级理性的强烈反抗中肆虐，这似乎直接从他的无意识传递到了银幕上。
hook_en: Luis Buñuel’s vision of the inherent absurdity of human social rituals reaches its taboo-annihilating extreme in what may be his most morally subversive and formally audacious work. Zigzagging across time and space, from the Napoleonic era to the present day, The Phantom of Liberty unfolds as a picaresque, its characters traveling between tableaux in a series of Dadaist non sequiturs. Unbound by the laws of narrative logic, Buñuel lets his surrealist’s id run riot in an exuberant revolt against bourgeois rationality that seems telegraphed directly from his unconscious to the screen.

hook: 在转向圣女贞德的故事之前，丹麦电影天才卡尔·西奥多·德雷叶对家庭生活进行了超前的审视。这是一部温柔复仇的巧妙喜剧，讲述了一位家庭主妇在狡猾的保姆的帮助下扭转了专制丈夫的故事。在其中，德雷尔将轻松、幽默与他一贯的细致技巧和正直感结合在一起。 《一家之主》在当时取得了巨大的票房成功，是无声电影的瑰宝。
hook_en: Before he turned to the story of Joan of Arc, the Danish cinema genius Carl Theodor Dreyer fashioned this ahead-of-its-time examination of domestic life. A deft comedy of gentle revenge, it is the story of a housewife who, with the help of a wily nanny, turns the tables on her tyrannical husband. In it, Dreyer combines lightness and humor with his customary meticulous craft and sense of integrity. Master of the House, an enormous box-office success in its day, is a jewel of the silent cinema.

hook: 在由《电影手册》评论家转变为电影制作人、改变了法国电影史的神圣群体中，克洛德·夏布洛尔是第一个导演自己的故事片的人。他引人入胜的里程碑式处女作《美丽的塞尔日》讲述了一位成功但体弱多病的年轻人（让·克洛德·布里亚利饰）回到自己长大的小村庄的故事。在那里，他发现自己与他以前的密友（杰拉德·布莱恩饰）——现在婚姻不幸，而且是一个可怜的酒鬼——以及他所代表的外省生活产生了分歧。非凡而鲜明的 Le beau Serge 预示着一位电影巨人的到来，他将在接下来的五年里继续制作具有挑衅性、娱乐性的电影。
hook_en: Of the hallowed group of Cahiers du cinéma critics turned filmmakers who transformed French film history, Claude Chabrol was the first to direct his own feature. His absorbing landmark debut, Le beau Serge, follows a successful yet sickly young man (Jean‑Claude Brialy) who returns home to the small village where he grew up. There, he finds himself at odds with his former close friend (Gérard Blain)—now unhappily married and a wretched alcoholic—and the provincial life he represents. The remarkable and stark Le beau Serge heralded the arrival of a cinematic titan who would go on to craft provocative, entertaining films for five more decades.

hook: 《奥索斯》是佩德罗·科斯塔关于里斯本贫困地区丰泰尼亚斯的变革三部曲中的第一部，讲述了年轻生命因绝望而支离​​破碎的故事。一名有自杀倾向的少女生下孩子后，她错误地把孩子的安全托付给了陷入困境、游手好闲的父亲，他的暴力行为带领观众参观了他们所居住的不祥、摇摇欲坠的棚户区。凭借伊曼纽尔·马丘埃尔（Emmanuel Machuel）（他与布列松在《银色》中合作）的保守、阴暗的摄影，《奥索斯》展现了一个被毁坏的社区的令人难忘的景象。
hook_en: The first film in Pedro Costa’s transformative trilogy about Fontainhas, an impoverished quarter of Lisbon, Ossos is a tale of young lives torn apart by desperation. After a suicidal teenage girl gives birth, she misguidedly entrusts her baby’s safety to the troubled, deadbeat father, whose violent actions take the viewer on a tour of the foreboding, crumbling shantytown in which they live. With its reserved, shadowy cinematography by Emmanuel Machuel (who collaborated with Bresson on L’argent), Ossos is a haunting look at a devastated community.

hook: 在这部精心制作、极其古怪的经典法国童话改编作品中，雅克·德米将凯瑟琳·德纳芙饰演一位公主，她必须躲藏起来，当一名洗碗女仆，以抵御来自她自己的父亲、国王（让·马莱饰）的求婚。 《驴皮》是一部由米歇尔·罗格朗 (Michel Legrand) 创作的歌曲，讲述了一个从富到穷的颠倒黑白寓言故事，创造了一个介于真诚与讽刺之间的触觉奇幻世界，德尔菲娜·塞里格 (Delphine Seyrig) 则扮演时尚仙女教母的美妙配角。
hook_en: In this lovingly crafted, wildly eccentric adaptation of a classic French fairy tale, Jacques Demy casts Catherine Deneuve as a princess who must go into hiding as a scullery maid in order to fend off an unwanted marriage proposal—from her own father, the king (Jean Marais). A topsy-turvy riches-to-rags fable with songs by Michel Legrand, Donkey Skin creates a tactile fantasy world that’s perched on the border between the earnest and the satiric, and features Delphine Seyrig in a delicious supporting role as a fashionable fairy godmother.

hook: 黛安·卡罗尔 (Diahann Carroll) 在这部获得奥斯卡提名的令人难忘的表演中光芒四射，饰演克劳丁 (Claudine)，一位意志坚强的单亲母亲，在哈莱姆区抚养着六个孩子，她与一位爱交际的垃圾收集者（同样出色的詹姆斯·厄尔·琼斯 (James Earl Jones) 饰）的萌芽关系因在压迫性制度中生存的困难而受到压力。这部具有社会良知的浪漫喜剧由前黑名单左翼电影制片人约翰·贝里 (John Berry) 执导，巧妙地平衡了温暖的幽默与对塑造人物现实的无数问题（从贫困循环到福利制度的侮辱）的严肃审视。其结果是一部充满同情心的黑人工人阶级斗争和黑人欢乐的编年史，一部苦乐参半、充满热情的家庭和社区庆祝活动，配以柯蒂斯·梅菲尔德 (Curtis Mayfield) 创作、格拉迪斯·奈特 (Gladys Knight & the Pips) 演唱的阳光灵魂配乐。
hook_en: Diahann Carroll is radiant in an unforgettable, Oscar-nominated performance as Claudine, a strong-willed single mother, raising six kids in Harlem, whose budding relationship with a gregarious garbage collector (an equally fantastic James Earl Jones) is stressed by the difficulty of getting by in an oppressive system. As directed by the formerly blacklisted leftist filmmaker John Berry, this romantic comedy with a social conscience deftly balances warm humor with a serious look at the myriad issues—from cycles of poverty to the indignities of the welfare system—that shape its characters’ realities. The result is an empathetic chronicle of both Black working-class struggle and Black joy, a bittersweet, bighearted celebration of family and community set to a sunny soul soundtrack composed by Curtis Mayfield and performed by Gladys Knight & the Pips.

hook: 在英国电影最热情的创作者迈克尔·鲍伊和伊默克·普雷斯布里奇的魔幻风情中，爱在苏格兰赫布里底群岛绽放。自立门户、事业有成的琼·韦伯斯特（温迪·希尔）在前往与富商联姻的途中，直到一场狂风暴雨将她的计划吹散，让她被困在苏格兰海岸的一座岛上，与一位英俊的海军军官相遇。这部电影用一种增强其神秘氛围的近乎魔幻的黑白摄影，记录了这个传说与诅咒仍然主宰的世界。这部深受喜爱的爱情故事，是电影史上最激动人心的关于理智与情感之间永恒冲突的表达。
hook_en: Love flourishes in the Scottish Hebrides in this windswept enchantment from British cinema’s most passionate visionaries, Michael Powell and Emeric Pressburger. “I know where I’m going!” declares headstrong, upwardly mobile Joan Webster (Wendy Hiller) en route to her marriage to a wealthy industrialist—until her carefully laid plans are blown away by a raging storm that leaves her stranded on an island off the Scottish coast with a dashing naval officer (Roger Livesey). Shot in ethereal black and white that enhances the almost mystical air of its setting—a folkloric world where legends and curses still hold sway—this beloved romance is one of cinema’s most stirring expressions of the eternal conflict between the head and the heart.

hook: 《金马车》（Le Carrosse d’or）是一部令人着迷的 18 世纪喜剧奇幻作品，讲述了一位总督收到一辆精致的金马车，并将其送给一家巡回喜剧公司的暴躁明星的故事。大师导演让·雷诺阿 (Jean Renoir) 对剧院的华丽致敬，以他最喜欢的英文版本呈现，以安东尼奥·维瓦尔第 (Antonio Vivaldi) 的音乐为背景，围绕活泼而反复无常的明星安娜·马格纳尼 (Anna Magnani) 展开。
hook_en: The Golden Coach (Le Carrosse d’or) is a ravishing eighteenth-century comic fantasy about a viceroy who receives an exquisite golden coach, and gives it to the tempestuous star of a touring commedia dell’arte company. Master director Jean Renoir’s sumptuous tribute to the theater, presented here in the English version he favored, is set to the music of Antonio Vivaldi and built around vivacious and volatile star Anna Magnani.

hook: 在费德里科·费里尼（ Federico Fellini ）的晚期职业生涯亮点中，这位环形领袖在公海上以古怪、富有想象力的寓言故事为背景，将他的习惯眼镜--电影、马戏团和综艺表演舞台--换成了歌剧。一群杂乱无章的欧洲贵族（还有一只相思病的犀牛！ ）在第一次世界大战前夕登上一艘豪华的远洋班轮，撒下心爱的女主角的骨灰，当他们…
hook_en: In this late-career highlight from Federico Fellini, the ringmaster-auteur trades his customary spectacles—the cinema, the circus, and the variety-show stage—for that of the opera, in a quirky, imaginative fable set on the high seas. A motley crew of European aristocrats (and a lovesick rhinoceros!) board a luxurious ocean liner on the eve of World War I to scatter the ashes of a beloved diva, only to sail into the headwinds of history when they cross paths with a group of Serbian refugees and an Austro-Hungarian warship. Fabricated entirely in Rome’s famed Cinecittà studios with the help of production designer Dante Ferretti, And the Ship Sails On reaches spectacular new visual heights with its stylized re-creation of a decadent, bygone era.

hook: 在一系列简单而欢乐的小插曲中，导演罗伯托·罗西里尼和合著者费德里科·费里尼亲切地传达了人民圣人的普遍教义：谦卑、同情、信仰和牺牲。 《圣弗朗西斯之花》的精美摄影让人想起圣弗朗西斯时代的中世纪绘画，并由下诺切拉修道院的僧侣们主演，《圣弗朗西斯之花》是一幅永恒而动人的寻求精神启蒙的肖像。
hook_en: In a series of simple and joyous vignettes, director Roberto Rossellini and co-writer Federico Fellini lovingly convey the universal teachings of the People’s Saint: humility, compassion, faith, and sacrifice. Gorgeously photographed to evoke the medieval paintings of Saint Francis’s time, and cast with monks from the Nocera Inferiore Monastery, The Flowers of St. Francis is a timeless and moving portrait of the search for spiritual enlightenment.

hook: 在这部六十年代末令人难以理解的杰作中，欧洲电影最独特的导演之一马可·费雷里（Marco Ferreri）带领我们透过镜子，了解了一位意大利防毒面具设计师生活中看似例行公事的夜晚，由新浪潮偶像米歇尔·皮科利（Michel Piccoli）在一场精彩的表演中扮演。在他幽闭恐怖的现代化家里，他纵容他吸药的妻子，引诱他的女仆，并发现了一把可能曾经属于约翰·迪林格的枪——然后事情变得更加奇怪。 《迪林杰已死》（Dillinger è morto）是一篇关于社会弊病的超现实政治信件，在平凡中发现了荒谬。这是一种奇特的体验，既不合逻辑，又极其存在。
hook_en: In this magnificently inscrutable late-sixties masterpiece, Marco Ferreri, one of European cinema’s most idiosyncratic auteurs, takes us through the looking glass to one seemingly routine night in the life of an Italian gas mask designer, played, in a tour de force performance, by New Wave icon Michel Piccoli. In his claustrophobic mod home, he pampers his pill-popping wife, seduces his maid, and uncovers a gun that may have once been owned by John Dillinger—and then things get even stranger. A surreal political missive about social malaise, Dillinger Is Dead (Dillinger è morto) finds absurdity in the mundane. It is a singular experience, both illogical and grandly existential.

hook: 这部轻松酷炫的犯罪惊悚片由乔治·弗兰朱 (Georges Franju) 执导，是巧妙的情节和视觉创意的奇迹。 《Judex》旨在向 Louis Feuillade 1916 年的同名邪教无声连续剧致敬，以一名腐败的银行家被一位神秘的犯罪斗士（美国魔术师查宁·波洛克饰演）神秘绑架为开场，随后展开了一个令人惊心动魄、错综复杂的欺骗网络。 《Judex》将六十年代的时尚现代主义与无声电影的风格，甚至一些意想不到的科幻口音相结合，是一部令人愉快的低俗小说，也是幻觉艺术的证明。
hook_en: This effortlessly cool crime caper, directed by Georges Franju, is a marvel of dexterous plotting and visual invention. Conceived as an homage to Louis Feuillade’s 1916 cult silent serial of the same name, Judex kicks off with the mysterious kidnapping of a corrupt banker by a shadowy crime fighter (American magician Channing Pollock) and spins out into a thrillingly complex web of deceptions. Combining stylish sixties modernism with silent-cinema touches and even a few unexpected sci-fi accents, Judex is a delightful bit of pulp fiction and a testament to the art of illusion.

hook: 作为 20 世纪 80 年代最古怪的喜剧之一，《皮威大冒险》是流行文化的试金石，它帮助将一个名叫皮威·赫尔曼 (Pee-wee Herman) 的狂躁怪人（演员兼喜剧演员保罗·雷宾斯 (Paul Reubens) 的创造者和另一个自我) 打造成了各年龄段局外人眼中的偶像。这也奠定了导演蒂姆·伯顿的独特风格，令人瞠目结舌的视觉感在这部他的第一部长片中得到了充分的展现。影片讲述了欢快不敬的皮威踏上公路旅行，找回他心爱的被盗自行车的故事，电影以真人卡通的滑稽发明展开，将一系列令人难忘的古怪人物、色彩缤纷、俗气的美国风格和超现实的幻想结合在一起，成为一首对创造力和童年精神的欢乐、不羁的赞歌。
hook_en: One of the most eccentric comedies of the 1980s, Pee-wee’s Big Adventure is a pop-culture touchstone that helped make a manic oddball named Pee-wee Herman—the creation and alter ego of actor-comedian Paul Reubens—into an icon for outsiders of all ages. It also established the distinctive style of director Tim Burton, whose eye-popping visual sense is already on full display in this, his first feature film. Following the gleefully irreverent Pee-wee as he embarks on a road trip to recover his beloved stolen bicycle, the movie unfolds with the antic invention of a live-action cartoon, combining a gallery of memorably wacky characters, colorful, kitschy Americana, and surreal flights of fancy into a joyously uninhibited paean to creativity and the spirit of childhood.

hook: 皮尔·保罗·帕索里尼勇敢而疯狂的《坎特伯雷故事集》将杰弗里·乔叟的八个精彩故事搬上银幕，该片在英国拍摄，以朴实的方式再现了中世纪时代。从一个贵族在娶了一个年轻得多、滥交的新娘后双目失明的故事，到前往充满修道士和恶魔的地狱的高潮之旅（这无疑是电影史上构思和实现最离奇的场景之一），这是一部充满想象力的欢乐亵渎之作，以帕索里尼对乔叟本人的描绘为框架。
hook_en: Eight of Geoffrey Chaucer’s lusty tales come to life on-screen in Pier Paolo Pasolini’s gutsy and delirious The Canterbury Tales, which was shot in England and offers a remarkably earthy re-creation of the medieval era. From the story of a nobleman struck blind after marrying a much younger and promiscuous bride to a climactic trip to a hell populated by friars and demons (surely one of the most outrageously conceived and realized sequences ever committed to film), this is an endlessly imaginative work of merry blasphemy, framed by Pasolini’s portrayal of Chaucer himself.

hook: 十二岁的阿奈斯很胖。她的妹妹，十五岁的埃琳娜，是个美人。当女孩们和父母一起度假时，安娜伊斯跟随埃琳娜探索这个沉闷的海滨小镇。埃琳娜遇见了意大利法律系学生费尔南多；他用爱的承诺引诱她，而时刻警惕的阿奈斯见证了她姐姐的纯真被腐蚀。 《胖女孩》不仅是对女性青春期性行为和兄弟姐妹之间复杂关系的写照，而且也是一直备受争议的凯瑟琳·布雷拉特（Catherine Breillat）令人震惊的断言，即暴力压迫存在于男女关系的核心。
hook_en: Twelve-year-old Anaïs is fat. Her sister, fifteen-year-old Elena, is a beauty. While the girls are on vacation with their parents, Anaïs tags along as Elena explores the dreary seaside town. Elena meets Fernando, an Italian law student; he seduces her with promises of love, and the ever-watchful Anaïs bears witness to the corruption of her sister’s innocence. Fat Girl is not only a portrayal of female adolescent sexuality and the complicated bond between siblings but also a shocking assertion by the always controversial Catherine Breillat that violent oppression exists at the core of male-female relations.

hook: 拉明·巴赫拉尼 (Ramin Bahrani) 广受好评的处女作堪称二十一世纪新现实主义的奇迹，它平静而深刻地讲述了那些生活在美国梦边缘的人们的经历。回到他的祖国巴基斯坦，艾哈迈德（艾哈迈德·拉兹维，他自己的生活故事的元素被融入到剧本中）是一位著名的摇滚明星。现在，他是一名鳏夫，与儿子失散，在纽约漂泊，他长时间工作，在曼哈顿中城的一辆餐车上卖咖啡和百吉饼，西西弗斯式地寻找人与人之间的联系和似乎永远遥不可及的使命感。 《推车人》以罕见的移民视角描绘了 9/11 后的城市，充满了微妙的偏执和仇外心理，对人类忍耐力的日常戏剧给予了同情和清晰的表达。
hook_en: A modest miracle of twenty-first-century neorealism, the acclaimed debut feature by Ramin Bahrani speaks quietly but profoundly to the experiences of those living on the margins of the American dream. Back in his home country of Pakistan, Ahmad (Ahmad Razvi, elements of whose own life story were woven into the script) was a famous rock star. Now a widower separated from his son and adrift in New York, he works long hours selling coffee and bagels from a Midtown Manhattan food cart, engaged in a Sisyphean search for human connection and a sense of purpose that seems perpetually just out of reach. A rare immigrant’s-eye view of a post-9/11 city suffused with subtle paranoia and xenophobia, Man Push Cart gives at once empathetic and clear-eyed expression to the everyday drama of human endurance.

hook: 杰克·尼科尔森刚刚在《五部简单作品》取得成功后，就开始了他极其不敬的导演处女作。 《他说》改编自杰里米·拉纳的畅销小说，时而自由奔放，时而清醒，勾画了一位心怀不满的大学篮球运动员（威廉·泰珀饰）和他日益激进的室友（迈克尔·马戈塔饰）的事迹，同时也是对七十年代初期的疯狂拍摄和剪辑的快照（其中一些是在一次真实的校园抗议期间拍摄的）。尼克尔森这部大胆的喜剧（由布鲁斯·邓恩和凯伦·布莱克主演）受到越战时期焦虑的推动，处于彻底疯狂的边缘，是直接来自时代精神的令人震惊的嚎叫。
hook_en: Fresh off of his Five Easy Pieces success, Jack Nicholson mounted his enormously irreverent directorial debut. Based on the best-selling novel by Jeremy Larner, Drive, He Said, free-spirited and sobering by turns, is a sketch of the exploits of a disaffected college basketball player (William Tepper) and his increasingly radical roommate (Michael Margotta), as well as a feverishly shot and edited snapshot of the early seventies (some of it was filmed during an actual campus protest). Fueled by Vietnam-era anxieties and perched on the edge of utter insanity, Nicholson’s audacious comedy (also starring Bruce Dern and Karen Black) is a startling howl direct from the zeitgeist.

hook: 1970 年，二十世纪福克斯公司对“裸体之王”拉斯·迈耶 (Russ Meyer) 为廉价剥削电影带来的视觉效果留下了深刻的印象，向这位导演提供了一份制片厂预算和其最热门影片之一《玩偶谷》(Valley of the Dolls) 的片名。 《超越玩偶谷》由罗杰·艾伯特撰写讽刺剧本，讲述了三位年轻的女摇滚歌手在一位华丽的制片人的迷惑下，以六十年代风格顽固地走向好莱坞的故事——制片人颓废的抨击展示了迈耶标志性的性欲旺盛。这部放荡的午夜电影的大制片厂版本越轨且令人发指，是电影界伟大的局外艺术家之一的一部令人上瘾的娱乐闹剧。
hook_en: In 1970, Twentieth Century-Fox, impressed by the visual zing “King of the Nudies” Russ Meyer had been bringing to bargain-basement exploitation fare, handed the director a studio budget and the title to one of its biggest hits, Valley of the Dolls. With a satirical screenplay by Roger Ebert, Beyond the Valley of the Dolls follows three young female rockers going Hollywood, in hell-bent sixties style, under the spell of a flamboyant producer—whose decadent bashes showcase Meyer’s trademark libidinal exuberance. Transgressive and outrageous, this big-studio version of a debaucherous midnight movie is an addictively entertaining romp from one of cinema’s great outsider artists.

hook: 德国现代舞先驱皮娜·鲍什 (Pina Bausch) 的无限想象力和身体奇迹在维姆·文德斯 (Wim Wenders) 的这部充满活力的致敬作品中跃然银幕上。鲍什于 2009 年去世时，导演和编舞者之间计划已久的电影合作正在进行预制作。两年后，文德斯决定继续这个项目，并将其重新构思为向他已故的朋友致敬。其成果以令人惊叹的 3D 格式拍摄，带来了非凡的视觉体验，生动地展现了鲍什的艺术，由她的公司乌珀塔尔舞蹈剧院皮娜·鲍什 (Tanztheater Pina Bausch) 的一群才华横溢的舞者表演。 《皮娜》是一部充满冒险精神的电影作品，凸显了世界上真正的创意梦想家之一的大胆遗产。
hook_en: The boundless imagination and physical marvels of the work of the German modern-dance pioneer Pina Bausch leap off the screen in this exuberant tribute by Wim Wenders. A long-planned film collaboration between the director and the choreographer was in preproduction when Bausch died in 2009. Two years later, Wenders decided to go ahead with the project, reconceiving it as an homage to his late friend. The result, shot in stunning 3D, is a remarkable visual experience and a vivid representation of Bausch’s art, enacted by a group of staggeringly talented dancers from her company, the Tanztheater Wuppertal Pina Bausch. Pina is an adventurous work of cinema that highlights the bold legacy of one of the world’s true creative visionaries.

hook: 盗墓、酷刑、着魔的修女和撒旦的安息日：本杰明·克里斯滕森的传奇无声电影使用一系列戏剧性的小插曲来探索一个科学假设，即中世纪和现代早期的女巫与电影时代被诊断为歇斯底里症的精神病患者患有同样的疾病。这部电影远不是关于这个主题的枯燥论文，它本身就是一部恐怖、粗俗和黑色幽默的女巫酿造的电影。克里斯滕森对类型的混合搭配方法预见了哥特式恐怖、纪录片再创作和散文电影，创造了电影史上与众不同的体验。
hook_en: Grave robbing, torture, possessed nuns, and a satanic Sabbath: Benjamin Christensen’s legendary silent film uses a series of dramatic vignettes to explore the scientific hypothesis that the witches of the Middle Ages and early modern era suffered from the same ills as psychiatric patients diagnosed with hysteria in the film's own time. Far from a dry dissertation on the topic, the film itself is a witches’ brew of the scary, the gross, and the darkly humorous. Christensen’s mix-and-match approach to genre anticipates gothic horror, documentary re-creation, and the essay film, making for an experience unlike anything else in the history of cinema.

hook: 1975 年，在即将到来的二百周年纪念的自我神话盛况和持续的社会政治动荡所定义的美国，鲍勃·迪伦 (Bob Dylan) 和一群游吟诗人——包括琼·贝兹 (Joan Baez)、艾伦·金斯伯格 (Allen Ginsberg) 和乔尼·米切尔 (Joni Mitchell) 等名人——开始了一场如今已成为传奇的巡演，名为“滚雷滑稽剧”(Rolling Thunder Revue)，这是一档随心所欲的综艺节目，一半是反主流文化嘉年华，一半是精神层面的朝圣。导演马丁·斯科塞斯将幕后档案片段、采访和叙事恶作剧与魔术师的手法融合在一起，形成了一部定义时代精神的文化记录，它既是一部音乐会“纪录片”，也是对记忆、时间、真相和幻觉的狡猾、虚幻的调查。这一切的中心是充满魅力的迪伦，一位狮身人面像的哲学家诗人，以令人振奋的信念，向一个焦虑的国家的灵魂歌唱。
hook_en: In 1975, in an America defined by both the self-mythologizing pomp of the upcoming bicentennial and ongoing sociopolitical turmoil, Bob Dylan and a band of troubadours—including luminaries such as Joan Baez, Allen Ginsberg, and Joni Mitchell—embarked on a now-legendary tour known as the Rolling Thunder Revue, a freewheeling variety show that was part traveling counterculture carnival, part spiritual pilgrimage. Director Martin Scorsese blends behind-the-scenes archival footage, interviews, and narrative mischief, with a magician’s sleight of hand, into a zeitgeist-defining cultural record that is as much a concert “documentary” as it is a slippery, chimerical investigation into memory, time, truth, and illusion. At the center of it all is the magnetic Dylan, a sphinxlike philosopher-poet singing, with electrifying conviction, to the soul of an anxious nation.

hook: 20 世纪 60 年代初，正值英国新浪潮的鼎盛时期，导演托尼·理查森 (Tony Richardson) 和剧作家约翰·奥斯本 (John Osborne) 开始探索更加奇幻的领域，而不是他们帮助建立的新浪潮运动的坚韧现实主义。汤姆·琼斯为亨利·菲尔丁这部经典的 18 世纪小说注入了戏剧天赋，热闹地记录了弃儿（阿尔伯特·芬尼，在一场决定其职业生涯的表演中）的不幸遭遇，他随性的魅力似乎每次都让他误入歧途，远离他所爱的、出身名门的索菲·韦斯特（苏珊娜·约克饰）。这部充满活力的流浪汉电影在英格兰漫无目的的乡村拍摄，并拥有非凡的演员阵容，随后轰动全球，赢得了奥斯卡最佳影片奖，并巩固了其作为不敬机智和俏皮电影表达经典的地位。
hook_en: In the early 1960s, at the height of the British New Wave, director Tony Richardson and playwright John Osborne set out for more fanciful territory than the gritty realism of the movement they’d helped establish. Tom Jones brings a theatrical flair to Henry Fielding’s canonical eighteenth-century novel, boisterously chronicling the misadventures of the foundling of the title (Albert Finney, in a career-defining performance), whose easy charm seems to lead him astray at every turn from his beloved, the wellborn Sophie Western (Susannah York). This spirited picaresque, evocatively shot in England’s rambling countryside and featuring an extraordinary ensemble cast, went on to become a worldwide sensation, winning the Oscar for best picture on the way to securing its status as a classic of irreverent wit and playful cinematic expression.

hook: 在这部以电视为媒介、痴迷于真实犯罪的时代的讽刺作品中，美国人对名人的痴迷变得可怕。妮可·基德曼在事业上取得了突破，饰演一名当地电视台气象记者，对邻家女孩进行了恶魔般的解构，她完美活泼的外表下隐藏着一颗凶残的心，她对名誉的无情追求让三个心怀不满的青少年陷入了一场肮脏的小报丑闻中。导演格斯·范·桑特巧妙地运用了多变的视角、虚假的纪录片采访以及由华金·菲尼克斯、马特·狄龙和卡西·阿弗莱克等人组成的配角，为这部对郊区社会病态的黑色滑稽的审视增添了挑衅性的意义。
hook_en: The all-American obsession with celebrity turns monstrous in this deliciously subversive (and disturbingly prescient) satire of our television-mediated, true-crime-obsessed age. In a career breakthrough, Nicole Kidman delivers a diabolical deconstruction of the girl next door as a local TV weather reporter whose perfectly perky facade belies a murderous heart, as her ruthless pursuit of fame ensnares three disaffected teens in a sordid, tabloid-ready scandal. Deftly deploying shifting perspectives, faux-documentary interviews, and a supporting cast featuring Joaquin Phoenix, Matt Dillon, and Casey Affleck, director Gus Van Sant adds provocative layers of meaning to this darkly funny examination of suburban sociopathy.

hook: 路易斯·布努埃尔的最后一部电影充分体现了导演一生对欲望阴暗面的关注。布努埃尔的常客费尔南多·雷伊饰演马蒂厄，一个温文尔雅的鳏夫，饱受对难以捉摸的孔奇塔的欲望的折磨。凭借颠覆性的天赋，布努埃尔在后一个角色中使用了两位不同的演员——精致的法国美女卡罗尔·布盖和西班牙风骚女郎安吉拉·莫利纳。 《那个模糊的欲望对象》取材于超现实主义者最爱的皮埃尔·路易斯的经典情色小说《女人与木偶》（La femme et le pantin，1898），是一场令人眼花缭乱的性政治游戏，其间夹杂着恐怖，让人回想起布努埃尔前卫的开端。
hook_en: Luis Buñuel’s final film brings full circle the director’s lifelong preoccupation with the darker side of desire. Buñuel regular Fernando Rey plays Mathieu, an urbane widower, tortured by his lust for the elusive Conchita. With subversive flair, Buñuel uses two different actors in the latter role—Carole Bouquet, a sophisticated French beauty, and Ángela Molina, a Spanish coquette. Drawn from the surrealist favorite Pierre Louÿs’s classic erotic novel La femme et le pantin (The Woman and the Puppet, 1898), That Obscure Object of Desire is a dizzying game of sexual politics punctuated by a terror that harks back to Buñuel’s avant-garde beginnings.

hook: 1955 年，随着萨蒂亚吉特·雷 (Satyajit Ray) 的处女作上映，帕瑟·潘查利 (Pather Panchali) 这一雄辩而重要的新电影声音传遍了全世界。以受意大利新现实主义启发的风格描绘孟加拉乡村生活，这种自然主义而又诗意的方式唤起了多年来的家庭生活，向我们介绍了小阿普，以及同样本质上帮助塑造他的女性：他独立的姐姐杜尔加;他的母亲萨巴贾亚 (Sarbajaya) 十分忙碌，丈夫不在身边，她必须维持家庭的团结。还有他善良而顽皮的年长“阿姨”英迪尔——一个个生动、多面的人物。荣获戛纳电影节最佳人类纪录片奖的《帕瑟·潘查利》凭借其年轻主人公永恒的探索意识，呈现出绚丽的摄影效果，是一部身临其境的电影体验，也是一部充满元素力量的电影。
hook_en: With the release in 1955 of Satyajit Ray’s debut, Pather Panchali, an eloquent and important new cinematic voice made itself heard all over the world. A depiction of rural Bengali life in a style inspired by Italian neorealism, this naturalistic but poetic evocation of a number of years in the life of a family introduces us to both little Apu and, just as essentially, the women who will help shape him: his independent older sister, Durga; his harried mother, Sarbajaya, who, with her husband away, must hold the family together; and his kindly and mischievous elderly “auntie,” Indir—vivid, multifaceted characters all. With resplendent photography informed by its young protagonist’s perpetual sense of discovery, Pather Panchali, which won an award for Best Human Document at the Cannes Film Festival, is an immersive cinematic experience and a film of elemental power.

hook: 在除夕夜十二点钟敲响之前死去的最后一个人，注定要驾驭死亡战车，孜孜不倦地为来年收集新鲜的灵魂。由瑞典电影之父 Victor Sjöström 执导的《幻影马车》（Körkarlen）的传奇人物如是说。这个故事改编自诺贝尔文学奖获得者塞尔玛·拉格洛夫的小说，讲述了一个酗酒、虐待狂的无能者（斯约斯特罗姆本人），他被揭露了自己的错误，以及一位心地纯洁的救世军姐妹相信他的救赎。这部极其丰富和创新的无声经典（激发了英格玛·伯格曼制作电影的灵感）是狄更斯式的鬼故事和感人至深的道德故事，也是突破性特效的展示。
hook_en: The last person to die on New Year’s Eve before the clock strikes twelve is doomed to take the reins of Death’s chariot and work tirelessly collecting fresh souls for the next year. So says the legend that drives The Phantom Carriage (Körkarlen), directed by the father of Swedish cinema, Victor Sjöström. The story, based on a novel by Nobel Prize winner Selma Lagerlöf, concerns an alcoholic, abusive ne’er-do-well (Sjöström himself) who is shown the error of his ways, and the pure-of-heart Salvation Army sister who believes in his redemption. This extraordinarily rich and innovative silent classic (which inspired Ingmar Bergman to make movies) is a Dickensian ghost story and a deeply moving morality tale, as well as a showcase for groundbreaking special effects.

hook: 作为黑人和美国独立电影的里程碑，Sweet Sweetback 的《Baadassssssssss》是梅尔文·范·皮布尔斯的第二部长片，此前他放弃了与哥伦比亚的合同，以自己的方式制作下一部电影。作为制片人、导演、作家、作曲家、剪辑师和明星，范·皮布尔斯创造了好莱坞最终塑造的黑人剥削英雄的原型：一个沉默寡言、永远面无表情的性爱表演演员，当他被两名种族主义警察逼得太紧时，他试图陷害他并没有犯下的罪行，于是他在一个由骑车人、革命者、性工作者和嬉皮士组成的无法无天的地下世界中奔跑。一种从白人压迫中解放出来的杀戮或被杀的追求。 Sweet Sweetback 的《Baadasssss Song》的煽动性政治与 Van Peebles 的革命性风格相匹配，其中锯齿状的跳切、万花筒般的叠加和迷幻的声音设计结合在一起，形成了持续的愤怒和反抗的嚎叫。
hook_en: A landmark of Black and American independent cinema that would send shock waves through the culture, Sweet Sweetback’s Baadasssss Song was Melvin Van Peebles’s second feature film, after he walked away from a contract with Columbia in order to make his next film on his own terms. Acting as producer, director, writer, composer, editor, and star, Van Peebles created the prototype for what Hollywood would eventually co-opt and make into the blaxploitation hero: a taciturn, perpetually blank-faced performer in a sex show, who, when he’s pushed too far by a pair of racist cops looking to frame him for a crime he didn’t commit, goes on the run through a lawless underground of bikers, revolutionaries, sex workers, and hippies in a kill-or-be-killed quest for liberation from white oppression. Sweet Sweetback’s Baadasssss Song’s incendiary politics are matched by Van Peebles’s revolutionary style, in which jagged jump cuts, kaleidoscopic superimpositions, and psychedelic sound design come together in a sustained howl of rage and defiance.

hook: 乔什和本尼·萨夫迪挖掘了他们自己破碎的童年的情感记忆，描绘了一幅时而富有同情心、时而令人不安的肖像，描绘了在强烈的爱和可怕的不负责任之间平衡的父母功能障碍。狂躁的曼哈顿电影院放映员莱尼（共同编剧兼萨夫迪的长期合作者罗纳德·布朗斯坦饰）也许是最不应该抚养孩子的人，但他却在这里，试图（但失败了）保持一切正常，因为他的生活在旋风般的两周里分崩离析，在这两周里，他负责抚养两个年幼的儿子（现实生活中的兄弟塞奇和弗雷·拉纳尔多），一次即兴的公路旅行，一次安眠药事故，以及在监狱里度过的一夜，所有这些都是混乱的一部分。 《长腿爸爸》中真实的纽约自然主义被超现实的抒情主义所取代，这是一个朦胧的印象派反童话故事，在看似最无可救药的父亲身上发现了意想不到的人性。
hook_en: Mining the emotional sense memories of their own fractured childhoods, Josh and Benny Safdie craft a by turns empathetic and disquieting portrait of parental dysfunction poised between fierce love and terrifying irresponsibility. Manic Manhattan movie theater projectionist Lenny (cowriter and longtime Safdie collaborator Ronald Bronstein) is perhaps the last person who should be raising kids, yet here he is, trying (and failing) to keep it together as his life unravels over the two whirlwind weeks in which he has custody of his young boys (real-life brothers Sage and Frey Ranaldo), with an impromptu road trip, a sleeping-pill mishap, and a night in jail all part of the chaos. Vérité New York naturalism gives way to flights of surreal lyricism in Daddy Longlegs, a blearily impressionistic anti–fairy tale that finds unexpected humanity in the seemingly most irredeemable of fathers.

hook: 英国喜剧 legends Monty Python 的荒诞不羁在这部 brilliant 的圣经史诗讽刺中达到了顶峰。在古代耶路撒冷的一个马厩里，一个孩子降生了——一个将成长为一个平凡犹太人，最终过上非凡生活的人，卷入了一场推翻罗马帝国的阴谋，还被误认为是救世主，以及其他许多不可能发生的事情。这部电影中充满了粗俗的罗马双关语、尖锐的政治评论，以及一场大胆的以十字架为主题的音乐表演，Monty Python 的这部最雄心勃勃的电影是一部对教义和盲目信仰的 hilarious 笑剧，没有任何东西是神圣的。
hook_en: The anarchic irreverence of British comedy legends Monty Python is at its most inspired in this brilliant send-up of the blockbuster biblical epic. In a stable in ancient Jerusalem, a child is born—a child who will grow up to be . . . Brian (Graham Chapman), an ordinary Judean who goes on to live an extraordinary life, becoming entangled in a plot to overthrow the Roman empire and being mistaken for the Messiah, among other unlikely events. Featuring ribald Roman puns, sharp political commentary, and an audacious crucifixion-themed musical number, the Pythons’ most ambitious film is a hilarious satire of dogma and blind faith in which nothing is sacred.

hook: 弗朗西斯科·罗西 (Francesco Rosi) 的《移交城市》(Hands over the City) 中，罗德·斯泰格 (Rod Steiger) 饰演一位心狠手辣、心怀鬼胎的土地开发商，这是一部社会现实主义的精彩作品，荣获 1963 年威尼斯电影节金狮奖。这场对政治驱动的房地产投机行为的揭露，摧毁了那不勒斯的平民景观，从灾难性的建筑倒塌到公民领导人在市议会选举中争夺权力的幕后谈判，充满热情和愤怒地揭露了腐败的内部运作。
hook_en: Rod Steiger is ferocious as a scheming land developer in Francesco Rosi's Hands over the City, a blistering work of social realism and the winner of the 1963 Venice Film Festival Golden Lion. This expose of the politically driven real-estate speculation that has devastated Naples's civilian landscape moves breathlessly from a cataclysmic building collapse to the backroom negotiations of civic leaders vying for power in a city council election, laying bare the inner workings of corruption with passion and outrage.

hook: 卢克雷西亚·马特尔 (Lucrecia Martel) 执导的《La Ciénaga》的上映，预示着阿根廷电影界将迎来一个充满活力和原创性的声音。凭借激进而令人不安的叙事方式、精美的摄影以及对银幕内外声音的高度复杂的运用，马特尔将她关于一个放荡的资产阶级大家庭消磨一个汗流浃背的夏天的故事变成了一部电影奇迹。这种对阶级、自然、性以及政治动荡和社会停滞在人际关系中的表现方式的发自内心的看法是一部具有非凡触感的戏剧，也是当代最伟大的电影处女作之一。
hook_en: The release of Lucrecia Martel’s La Ciénaga heralded the arrival of an astonishingly vital and original voice in Argentine cinema. With a radical and disturbing take on narrative, beautiful cinematography, and a highly sophisticated use of on- and offscreen sound, Martel turns her tale of a dissolute bourgeois extended family, whiling away the hours of one sweaty, sticky summer, into a cinematic marvel. This visceral take on class, nature, sexuality, and the ways that political turmoil and social stagnation can manifest in human relationships is a drama of extraordinary tactility, and one of the great contemporary film debuts.

hook: 在他的最后一部电影中，雅克·塔蒂带着相机来到马戏团，导演亲自担任司仪。虽然《Parade》有许多奇观，包括小丑、杂耍演员、杂技演员、柔术演员等等，但《游行》也以观众为中心，使这部精简的作品成为观众与娱乐之间交流的证明。 《Parade》是为瑞典电视台创作的（英格玛·伯格曼的传奇摄影指导古纳尔·费舍尔担任其电影摄影师之一），是一部感人的职业送别影片，让人回想起其制作者作为默剧和戏剧表演者的出身。
hook_en: For his final film, Jacques Tati takes his camera to the circus, where the director himself serves as master of ceremonies. Though it features many spectacles, including clowns, jugglers, acrobats, contortionists, and more, Parade also focuses on the spectators, making this stripped-down work a testament to the communion between audience and entertainment. Created for Swedish television (with Ingmar Bergman’s legendary director of photography Gunnar Fischer serving as one of its cinematographers), Parade is a touching career send-off that recalls its maker’s origins as a mime and theater performer.

hook: 总是充满挑衅性的日本导演大岛渚执导的《感官之国》（Ai no corrida）仍然是有史以来最具争议的电影之一。该剧取材于真实事件，生动地描绘了生活在帝国主义和政府控制不断升级的时代的一对男女（藤龙也和松田英子饰）之间倾尽全力、超然但最终具有毁灭性的爱情。与其说《感官王国》是一部色情作品，不如说它是一部政治作品，它是一部勇敢的、打破禁忌的里程碑，但在自己的国家仍然受到审查。
hook_en: In the Realm of the Senses (Ai no corrida), by the always provocative Japanese director Nagisa Oshima, remains one of the most controversial films of all time. Based on a true incident, it graphically depicts the all-consuming, transcendent—but ultimately destructive—love of a man and a woman (Tatsuya Fuji and Eiko Matsuda) living in an era of ever escalating imperialism and governmental control. Less a work of pornography than of politics, In the Realm of the Senses is a brave, taboo-breaking milestone, still censored in its own country.

hook: 这部由传奇人物 Hideo Gosha 执导的第一部故事片是最受欢迎的武士电影之一。 《三武士》是日本同名电视剧的衍生故事，其本身就是一部经典之作。一名无所事事的流浪浪人（丹波哲朗饰）卷入了另外两名武士（长门勇和平干二郎饰）的危险事业，他们受雇处决一群绑架腐败法官女儿的农民。凭借出色的叙事结构和惊心动魄的动作场面，这是一个精心编排的复仇和忠诚的故事。
hook_en: This first feature by the legendary Hideo Gosha is among the most beloved chanbara (sword-fighting) films. An origin-story offshoot of a Japanese television phenomenon of the same name, Three Outlaw Samurai is a classic in its own right. A wandering, seen-it-all ronin (Tetsuro Tamba) becomes entangled in the dangerous business of two other samurai (Isamu Nagato and Mikijiro Hira), hired to execute a band of peasants who have kidnapped the daughter of a corrupt magistrate. With remarkable storytelling economy and thrilling action scenes, this is an expertly mounted tale of revenge and loyalty.

hook: 梅廷·埃尔克桑 (Metin Erksan) 荣获 1964 年柏林国际电影节金熊奖，这部情节剧讲述了一位顽固自私的烟草农民的阴谋，他建造了一座水坝，以防止水从山上流到邻居的庄稼上。除了这个吞噬灵魂的竞争故事之外，还有一个过热的欲望，农民、他更正派的兄弟和后者娶的美丽的村民之间展开了三角恋。这是土耳其电影的标杆，它以发自内心、创新的拍摄和生动的表演描绘了贪婪的恐怖。《干燥的夏天》于 2008 年由博洛尼亚电影中心/L'Immagine Ritrovata 实验室与电影基金会的世界电影项目、Ulvi Dogan 和 Fatih Akim 联合修复。其他元素由 Friedrich Wilhelm Murnau Stiftung 提供。修复工作由阿玛尼、Cariter、卡塔尔航空公司和卡塔尔博物馆管理局资助。
hook_en: Winner of the prestigious Golden Bear at the 1964 Berlin International Film Festival, Metin Erksan’s wallop of a melodrama follows the machinations of an unrepentantly selfish tobacco farmer who builds a dam to prevent water from flowing downhill to his neighbors’ crops. Alongside this tale of soul-devouring competition is one of overheated desire, as a love triangle develops between the farmer, his more decent brother, and the beautiful villager the latter takes as his bride. A benchmark of Turkish cinema, this is a visceral, innovatively shot and vibrantly acted depiction of the horrors of greed.Dry Summer was restored in 2008 by the Cineteca di Bologna/L’Immagine Ritrovata laboratory, in association with The Film Foundation’s World Cinema Project, Ulvi Dogan, and Fatih Akim. Additional elements provided by the Friedrich Wilhelm Murnau Stiftung. Restoration funded by Armani, Cariter, Qatar Airways, and Qatar Museum Authority.

hook: 《克莱因先生》是被列入黑名单的好莱坞导演约瑟夫·洛西在欧洲流亡期间的最高成就之一，它是一部引人入胜的现代主义悬疑片，为这部错误的惊悚片带来了令人毛骨悚然的转折。阿兰·德龙 (Alain Delon) 饰演罗伯特·克莱因 (Robert Klein)，他是二战期间巴黎一位颓废的艺术品经销商，他从绝望的犹太客户那里购买画作，赚取了可观的利润。当克莱因寻找一个被误认为是同名的犹太人时，他发现自己陷入了卡夫卡式的噩梦中，他的身份似乎消失了，历史的力量正在向他逼近。这部令人难忘、令人不安的美丽电影在上映时因描绘维希政府现实生活中的错误行为而受到相当大的争议，它在追踪一个社会陷入法西斯恐惧和不人道的过程中，因存在主义的恐惧而颤抖。
hook_en: One of the crowning achievements of blacklisted Hollywood director Joseph Losey’s European exile, Mr. Klein is a spellbinding modernist mystery that puts a chilling twist on the wrong-man thriller. Alain Delon delivers a standout performance as Robert Klein, a decadent art dealer in Paris during World War II who makes a tidy profit buying up paintings from his desperate Jewish clients. As Klein searches for a Jewish man with the same name for whom he has been mistaken, he finds himself plunged into a Kafkaesque nightmare in which his identity seems to dissolve and the forces of history to close in on him. Met with considerable controversy on its release for its portrayal of the real-life wrongdoings of the Vichy government, this haunting, disturbingly beautiful film shivers with existential dread as it traces a society’s descent into fascistic fear and inhumanity.

hook: 大卫·柯南伯格这部颇具挑衅性的电影是他最著名的电影之一，但在这部影片中，一切并不像最初看起来的那样。在与导演的众多合作中，维果·莫腾森首次饰演汤姆·斯托尔 (Tom Stall)，他是一位小镇丈夫和父亲，因杀死了暴力抢劫的潜在凶手而被誉为英雄。但这个普通的居家男人，怎么能如此熟练地消灭他们呢？柯南伯格与包括玛丽亚·贝洛、艾德·哈里斯和威廉·赫特在内的杰出演员合作，狡猾地解构了美国动作英雄的神话，提出了关于身份、人性以及我们都憎恶且无法回避的暴力的基本问题。
hook_en: In David Cronenberg’s subtly provocative film, one of his most celebrated, all is not as it initially seems. In his first of many collaborations with the director, Viggo Mortensen delivers a highly nuanced performance as Tom Stall, a small-town husband and father who is hailed as a hero when he kills the would-be perpetrators of a violent robbery. But how did this ordinary family man dispatch them with such skill? Working with an exceptional cast that also includes Maria Bello, Ed Harris, and William Hurt, Cronenberg slyly deconstructs the mythos of the American action hero, posing elemental questions about identity, human nature, and the violence that we both abhor and can’t look away from.

hook: 伊莱恩·梅在米奇和尼基的夜间奥德赛中精心打造了一部与众不同的黑帮电影，利用经常合作的约翰·卡索维茨和彼得·福尔克之间的化学反应，将他们塑造成一生关系已经恶化的小黑帮。这部不安的戏剧以一个晚上为背景，尼基（卡索维茨饰）在偷钱的老板对他进行了打击后，躲在一家酒店里。吓坏了的他向米奇（法尔克饰）求救，他认为这是一个可以拯救他的人。这部由梅儿时的现实生活中的角色启发的影片，与明星们的活力能量相匹配，还有配角内德·巴蒂、乔伊斯·范·帕顿和卡罗尔·格蕾丝，这部由男性友谊演变为悲剧的肆无忌惮的肖像是美国电影的一部无名杰作。
hook_en: Elaine May crafted a gangster film like no other in the nocturnal odyssey Mikey and Nicky, capitalizing on the chemistry between frequent collaborators John Cassavetes and Peter Falk by casting them together as small-time mobsters whose lifelong relationship has turned sour. Set over the course of one night, this restless drama finds Nicky (Cassavetes) holed up in a hotel after the boss he stole money from puts a hit out on him. Terrified, he calls on Mikey (Falk), the one person he thinks can save him. Scripted to match the live-wire energy of its stars—alongside supporting players Ned Beatty, Joyce Van Patten, and Carol Grace—and inspired by real-life characters from May’s own childhood, this unbridled portrait of male friendship turned tragic is an unsung masterpiece of American cinema.

hook: 《云顶之星》由富有远见的孟加拉电影制片人 Ritwik Ghatak 执导，讲述了一个因印度分治而流离失所的家庭的故事，他们开始依赖大女儿尼塔（苏普里亚·乔杜里饰）的自我牺牲精神。她无助地看着自己的希望和欲望一次又一次被兄弟姐妹和父母推到一边，直到所有幸福的机会都消失殆尽，让她感到沮丧和痛苦。加塔克尝试了不平衡的构图、不连续的剪辑和层次丰富的配乐，为这部情节剧设计了一种在智力上雄心勃勃、在情感上具有毁灭性的新形式，哀叹印度历史的悲剧和传统性别角色的不平等，同时为追随他的几代印度电影制片人开辟了一条正式的道路。 《云顶之星》是与电影基金会的世界电影项目和博洛尼亚电影中心合作修复的，内容来自印度国家电影资料馆保存的元素。
hook_en: Directed by the visionary Bengali filmmaker Ritwik Ghatak, The Cloud-Capped Star tells the story of a family who have been uprooted by the Partition of India and come to depend on their eldest daughter, the self-sacrificing Neeta (Supriya Choudhury). She watches helplessly as her own hopes and desires are pushed aside time and again by those of her siblings and parents, until all her chances for happiness evaporate, leaving her crushed and ailing. Experimenting with off-balance compositions, discontinuous editing, and a densely layered soundtrack, Ghatak devised an intellectually ambitious and emotionally devastating new shape for the melodrama, lamenting the tragedies of Indian history and the inequities of traditional gender roles while blazing a formal trail for the generations of Indian filmmakers who have followed him. The Cloud-Capped Star was restored in partnership with The Film Foundation’s World Cinema Project and the Cineteca di Bologna, from elements preserved by the National Film Archive of India.

hook: 这部动作史诗片是有史以来最激动人心的冒险故事之一，讲述了二战期间德国战俘营中 250 名男子试图通过隧道逃亡的计划、执行和后果。在这个巩固了他的超级巨星地位的角色中，史蒂夫·麦奎因扮演了一位摩托车赛车冒险家，他决心挫败纳粹分子，而全明星演员阵容包括查尔斯·布朗森、詹姆斯·科伯恩、詹姆斯·加纳和唐纳德·普利森斯。约翰·斯特奇斯的专业指导、令人赞叹的埃尔默·伯恩斯坦配乐和惊心动魄的特技结合在一起，这可能是有史以来最精彩有趣的越狱电影，一首对普通英雄的决心、友情和勇气的振奋人心的颂歌。
hook_en: One of the most exciting adventure tales ever told, this action epic recounts the planning, execution, and aftermath of a daring true-life escape from a German prisoner-of-war camp during World War II, in which 250 men attempted to tunnel their way to freedom. In the role that cemented his superstar status, Steve McQueen plays the motorcycle-racing daredevil who sets out to foil the Nazis, alongside an all-star cast that includes Charles Bronson, James Coburn, James Garner, and Donald Pleasence. The expert direction of John Sturges, eminently hummable Elmer Bernstein score, and rip-roaring stunts come together in what may just be the most spectacularly entertaining prison-break movie of all time, a rousing ode to the determination, camaraderie, and courage of everyday heroes.

hook: 地面控制中心一直在接收来自索拉里斯空间站剩余三名居民的神秘信号。当宇航员兼心理学家克里斯·凯尔文（Kris Kelvin）被派去调查时，他经历了困扰索拉里斯号船员的同样奇怪的现象，使他踏上了意识最黑暗的深处的旅程。俄罗斯传奇电影制片人安德烈·塔可夫斯基凭借《索拉里斯》创作了一部精彩的原创科幻史诗，挑战了我们对爱、真理和人性本身的观念。
hook_en: Ground control has been receiving mysterious transmissions from the three remaining residents of the Solaris space station. When cosmonaut and psychologist Kris Kelvin is dispatched to investigate, he experiences the same strange phenomena that afflict the Solaris crew, sending him on a voyage into the darkest recesses of his consciousness. With Solaris, the legendary Russian filmmaker Andrei Tarkovsky created a brilliantly original science-fiction epic that challenges our conceptions about love, truth, and humanity itself.

hook: 《我了解她》讲述了华丽、看似自由的阿德里亚娜（《离婚意大利风格》的斯特凡妮娅·桑德雷利饰演）在罗马的甜蜜生活中追逐梦想的故事，它既令人愉快地沉浸在六十年代意大利的流行音乐和风格中，又对意大利的性政治和名人文化进行了尖锐的批评。在一系列亲密的剧集中，几乎每一集都有一个不同的男人、新的发型和相配的服装，无名的意大利大师安东尼奥·皮特兰杰利(Antonio Pietrangeli)根据他与埃托雷·斯科拉(Ettore Scola)共同编写的剧本，创作了一部灵巧、严肃的人物研究，从不偏离其复杂的中心人物。 《我很了解她》是一次令人兴奋的重新发现，时而有趣，时而悲惨，时而令人瞠目结舌。
hook_en: Following the gorgeous, seemingly liberated Adriana (Divorce Italian Style’s Stefania Sandrelli) as she chases her dreams in the Rome of La dolce vita, I Knew Her Well is at once a delightful immersion in the popular music and style of Italy in the sixties and a biting critique of its sexual politics and the culture of celebrity. Over a series of intimate episodes, just about every one featuring a different man, a new hairstyle, and an outfit to match, the unsung Italian master Antonio Pietrangeli, working from a script he cowrote with Ettore Scola, composes a deft, seriocomic character study that never strays from its complicated central figure. I Knew Her Well is a thrilling rediscovery, by turns funny, tragic, and altogether jaw-dropping.

hook: 通过十岁亚历山大的眼睛，我们目睹了二十世纪初瑞典一个庞大的资产阶级家族埃克达尔家族的欢乐和冲突。英格玛·伯格曼打算将《范妮和亚历山大》作为他的绝唱，这是这位导演最温暖、最具自传性的电影，一部获得奥斯卡奖的胜利，将他标志性的忧郁和情感强度与巨大的欢乐和性感结合在一起。伯格曼将范妮和亚历山大描述为“我作为电影制片人生活的总和”。
hook_en: Through the eyes of ten-year-old Alexander, we witness the delights and conflicts of the Ekdahl family, a sprawling bourgeois clan in turn-of-the-twentieth-century Sweden. Ingmar Bergman intended Fanny and Alexander as his swan song, and it is the director’s warmest and most autobiographical film, an Academy Award–winning triumph that combines his trademark melancholy and emotional intensity with immense joy and sensuality. Bergman described Fanny and Alexander as “the sum total of my life as a filmmaker.”

hook: 天使般美丽的凯瑟琳·德纳芙 (Catherine Deneuve) 因雅克·德米 (Jacques Demy) 的这部令人眼花缭乱的音乐剧而一举成名。她扮演雨伞店老板娇嫩的女儿，对尼诺·卡斯泰尔诺沃 (Nino Castelnuovo) 饰演的英俊车库机械师充满初恋。当男孩被送往阿尔及利亚作战时，两个恋人必须迅速成长。 《瑟堡的雨伞》以万花筒般的色彩精心设计，完全通过伟大作曲家米歇尔·勒格朗轻快的歌曲讲述，是有史以来最受尊敬和非正统的电影音乐剧之一。
hook_en: The angelically beautiful Catherine Deneuve was launched to stardom by this dazzling musical heart-tugger from Jacques Demy. She plays an umbrella-shop owner’s delicate daughter, glowing with first love for a handsome garage mechanic, played by Nino Castelnuovo. When the boy is shipped off to fight in Algeria, the two lovers must grow up quickly. Exquisitely designed in a kaleidoscope of colors, and told entirely through lilting songs by the great composer Michel Legrand, The Umbrellas of Cherbourg is one of the most revered and unorthodox movie musicals of all time.

hook: 黑色宿命论很少像这种将世界视为一场令人灵魂厌恶的腐败狂欢节那样诱人。寓言大师吉列尔莫·德尔·托罗在威廉·林赛·格雷沙姆的经典冷酷小说中融入了自己华丽的风格化诠释，描绘了一幅二战风口浪尖上的美国肮脏而诱人的肖像。影片讲述了斯坦·卡莱尔（布莱德利·库珀饰）的故事，他是一个巡回杂耍节目中的杂耍演员，他利用魅力和欺骗成为一个欺骗富人和有权势的骗子，但代价是什么？ 《噩梦巷》由凯特·布兰切特、托妮·科莱特、威廉·达福和鲁妮·玛拉等全明星阵容打造，并获得四项奥斯卡提名（包括最佳影片），影片讲述了美国梦的虚幻深渊的令人难以忘怀的坠落。
hook_en: Noir fatalism has rarely been so alluring as in this vision of the world as a soul-sick carnival of corruption. Putting his own luxuriantly stylized spin on the classic hard-boiled novel by William Lindsay Gresham, master fabulist Guillermo del Toro conjures a sordid, seductive portrait of America on the cusp of World War II. The film follows Stan Carlisle (Bradley Cooper), a roustabout in a traveling sideshow who uses charm and deception to become a phony mentalist preying on the rich and powerful—but at what cost? Brought to life by an all-star cast that includes Cate Blanchett, Toni Collette, Willem Dafoe, and Rooney Mara, and nominated for four Oscars (including Best Picture), Nightmare Alley is a haunting descent into the illusory abyss of the American dream.

hook: 作为莎士比亚的伟大改编作品之一，佛朗哥·泽菲雷利 (Franco Zeffirelli) 对莎士比亚不朽的浪漫悲剧进行了精彩演绎，通过让真实的青少年扮演主角，为这个广为人知的故事注入了新的活力。在文艺复兴时期的维罗纳，这对年轻恋人的风流韵事可能会加剧他们不和的家庭之间的紧张关系，奥利维亚·赫西和伦纳德·怀廷生动地捕捉到了青春期的热情和混乱，助长了他们命运驱动的联系。得益于尼诺·罗塔细腻的配乐以及荣获奥斯卡奖的精美服装和摄影，《罗密欧与朱丽叶》是一场感官盛宴，是莎士比亚最深刻、最充满激情的作品。
hook_en: One of the great Shakespeare adaptations, Franco Zeffirelli’s sublime take on the Bard’s immortal romantic tragedy breathed new life into the oft-told tale by casting actual teenagers in the title roles. As the young lovers whose affair threatens to inflame the tensions between their feuding families in Renaissance Verona, Olivia Hussey and Leonard Whiting vividly capture the mix of adolescent ardor and turmoil that fuels their destiny-driven liaison. A sensory banquet thanks to Nino Rota’s delicate score and the exquisite, Oscar-winning costumes and cinematography, Romeo and Juliet is Shakespeare at its most deeply felt and passionately alive.

hook: 简·坎皮恩 (Jane Campion) 回归了那种充满自由与威胁的神话般的边疆风景，她之前在《钢琴》中曾穿越过这种风景，以便在《狗的力量》中探索男性的心灵。影片以 20 年代蒙大拿州荒凉的平原为背景，电影制片人根据托马斯·萨维奇 (Thomas Savage) 的小说改编。敏感的寡妇（克尔斯滕·邓斯特饰）和她神秘又深爱的儿子（柯蒂·斯密特-麦菲饰）搬进了温柔的新婚丈夫（杰西·普莱蒙饰），他们和他粗暴的兄弟（本尼迪克特·康伯巴奇饰）之间展开了一场紧张的意志之战。弟弟的可怕的反复无常隐藏着秘密的折磨，而他的温柔能力一旦被重新唤醒，可能会给他带来救赎，也可能意味着毁灭。坎皮恩因执导该片而获得奥斯卡金像奖，她以大师在权力巅峰时的令人着迷的控制力，描绘了这些角色中压抑的欲望和精神暴力。
hook_en: Jane Campion returns to the kind of mythic frontier landscape—pulsating with both freedom and menace—that she previously traversed in The Piano in order to plumb the masculine psyche in The Power of the Dog, set against the desolate plains of 1920s Montana and adapted by the filmmaker from Thomas Savage’s novel. After a sensitive widow (Kirsten Dunst) and her enigmatic, fiercely loving son (Kodi Smit-McPhee) move in with her gentle new husband (Jesse Plemons), a tense battle of wills plays out between them and his brutish brother (Benedict Cumberbatch), whose frightening volatility conceals a secret torment, and whose capacity for tenderness, once reawakened, may offer him redemption or spell his destruction. Campion, who won an Academy Award for her direction here, charts the repressed desire and psychic violence coursing among these characters with the mesmerizing control of a master at the height of her powers.

hook: 蒙特·海尔曼根据杰克·尼科尔森深思熟虑的剧本，创作了这部喜怒无常、紧张的西部片，讲述了三名牧牛工被误认为是强盗，必须在犹他州荒野中躲避一群嗜血的义务警员的故事。 《旋风之旅》是一个关于机会和盲目边境正义的残酷而扣人心弦的故事，由尼科尔森、卡梅隆·米切尔、米莉·帕金斯和哈利·戴恩·斯坦通等引人注目的演员阵容演绎。
hook_en: Working from a thoughtful script by Jack Nicholson, Monte Hellman fashioned this moody and tense western about a trio of cowhands who are mistaken for robbers and must outrun and hide from a posse of bloodthirsty vigilantes in the wilds of Utah. A grim yet gripping tale of chance and blind frontier justice, Ride in the Whirlwind is brought to life by a compelling cast, including Nicholson, Cameron Mitchell, Millie Perkins, and Harry Dean Stanton.

hook: 《大城市》是伟大的萨蒂亚吉特·雷 (Satyajit Ray) 对家乡加尔各答当代生活的第一部写照，讲述了阿拉蒂 (马达哈比·慕克吉饰) 的个人成功和挫折，尽管她的银行职员丈夫最初反对，她还是决定找一份工作来养家糊口。凭借对工人阶级日常生活细节的非凡敏感性和关注，雷打造了一部强大的人类戏剧，它既是一个充满希望的道德故事，也是对现代印度女性身份的评论。
hook_en: The Big City, the great Satyajit Ray’s first portrayal of contemporary life in his native Kolkata, follows the personal triumphs and frustrations of Arati (Madhabi Mukherjee), who decides, despite the initial protests of her bank-clerk husband, to take a job to help support their family. With remarkable sensitivity and attention to the details of everyday working-class life, Ray builds a powerful human drama that is at once a hopeful morality tale and a commentary on the identity of the modern Indian woman.

hook: 这部由雅克·德米 (Jacques Demy) 精心打造、情感渗透的浪漫剧，主要以尼斯赌场为背景，是一部视觉上可爱但又黑暗现实的对爱情和痴迷的调查。金发碧眼的珍妮·莫罗 (Jeanne Moreau) 饰演一名华丽的赌博成瘾者，而克劳德·曼 (Claude Mann) 则是一名被卷入她的危险世界的银行职员。 《天使湾》以米歇尔·勒格朗 (Michel Legrand) 的迷人配乐为特色，是德米最忧郁的作品之一。
hook_en: This precisely wrought, emotionally penetrating romantic drama from Jacques Demy, set largely in the casinos of Nice, is a visually lovely but darkly realistic investigation into love and obsession. A bottle-blonde Jeanne Moreau is at her blithe best as a gorgeous gambling addict, and Claude Mann is the bank clerk drawn into her risky world. Featuring a mesmerizing score by Michel Legrand, Bay of Angels is among Demy’s most somber works.

hook: 作为政治惊悚片的大师，科斯塔-加夫拉斯在《Z》取得巨大成功后立即成为现象级人物，他很快又推出了同样引人入胜的《忏悔录》。影片改编自苏联集团审判时代的一个令人痛心的真实故事，伊夫·蒙当饰演一名捷克斯洛伐克共产党官员，他在五十年代初被绑架、监禁和审讯，时间长得可怕，而且对绑架者的动机一无所知。这部电影同样由西蒙·西涅莱和加布里埃莱·费泽蒂主演，从一个困惑的男人的角度讲述了二十世纪最黑暗的章节之一。
