hook_en: The master of the political thriller, Costa-Gavras became an instant phenomenon after the mammoth success of Z, and he quickly followed it with the equally riveting The Confession. Based on a harrowing true story from the era of Soviet bloc show trials, the film stars Yves Montand as a Czechoslovak Communist Party official who, in the early fifties, is abducted, imprisoned, and interrogated over a frighteningly long period, and left in the dark about his captors’ motives. Also starring Simone Signoret and Gabriele Ferzetti, the film is an unflinching, intimate depiction of one of the twentieth century’s darkest chapters, told from one bewildered man’s point of view.

hook: 伊萨克·博格教授（由资深电影制片人和演员维克多·舍斯特罗姆精心饰演）前往接受荣誉学位，他被迫面对自己的过去，接受自己的错误，并接受不可避免的死亡。通过闪回和幻想、梦想和噩梦，《野草莓》戏剧化地讲述了一个人非凡的自我发现之旅。这部富有人情味的杰作，充满了标志性的意象，是英格玛·伯格曼最受好评和影响力的电影之一。
hook_en: Traveling to accept an honorary degree, Professor Isak Borg—masterfully played by the veteran filmmaker and actor Victor Sjöström—is forced to face his past, come to terms with his faults, and make peace with the inevitability of his approaching death. Through flashbacks and fantasies, dreams and nightmares, Wild Strawberries dramatizes one man’s remarkable voyage of self-discovery. This richly humane masterpiece, full of iconic imagery, is one of Ingmar Bergman’s most widely acclaimed and influential films.

hook: 维托里奥·德·西卡与著名编剧兼长期合作伙伴切萨雷·扎瓦蒂尼首次合作，探讨了成年人的愚蠢行为对无辜儿童造成的灾难性后果。 《孩子们在看着我们》预示了两人随后创作的一些意大利新现实主义杰作，它生动、富有人性地描绘了一个家庭的解体。
hook_en: In his first collaboration with renowned screenwriter and longtime partner Cesare Zavattini, Vittorio De Sica examines the cataclysmic consequences of adult folly on an innocent child. Heralding the pair’s subsequent work on some of the masterpieces of Italian neorealism, The Children Are Watching Us is a vivid, deeply humane portrait of a family’s disintegration.

hook: 在这部酷炫、诱人的日本新浪潮瑰宝中，一名刚出狱的黑帮与一名美丽而神秘的赌瘾者纠缠在一起；起初看似救赎的关系最终导致他进一步走上犯罪道路。这部黑帮爱情片经过令人着迷的拍摄和剪辑，并配上武光彻狂热梦幻般的配乐，对性格独特的筱田正宏来说是一个突破。漆黑的淡花（Kawaita hana）是一次令人难忘的地下世界之旅。
hook_en: In this cool, seductive jewel of the Japanese New Wave, a yakuza, fresh out of prison, becomes entangled with a beautiful and enigmatic gambling addict; what at first seems a redemptive relationship ends up leading him further down the criminal path. Bewitchingly shot and edited, and laced with a fever-dream-like score by Toru Takemitsu, this gangster romance was a breakthrough for the idiosyncratic Masahiro Shinoda. The pitch-black Pale Flower (Kawaita hana) is an unforgettable excursion into the underworld.

hook: 开创性的导演玛尔塔·梅萨罗斯在这部敏感而引人入胜的剧情片中表达了 20 世纪 70 年代匈牙利女性的痛苦经历，该片成为第一部获得柏林电影节金熊奖的女性导演电影。通过亲密的摄影作品，《收养》让观众沉浸在两个女人的世界中，每个女人都在寻找满足：卡塔（卡塔林·贝雷克饰）是一位中年工厂工人，她想和她已婚的情人生一个孩子；而安娜（吉翁吉维尔·维格饰）是一名受国家监护的青少年，决心解放自己以便与男友结婚。两人之间形成的纽带安静而有力地诉说着塑造女性生活的社会和政治力量，因为她们各自在追求自决的过程中探索着爱情、婚姻和母性的现实。
hook_en: Trailblazing auteur Márta Mészáros gives aching expression to the experiences of women in 1970s Hungary in this sensitive and absorbing drama, which became the first film directed by a woman to win the Golden Bear at the Berlin Film Festival. Through intimate camera work, Adoption immerses the viewer in the worlds of two women, each searching for fulfillment: Kata (Katalin Berek), a middle-aged factory worker who wants to have a child with her married lover, and Anna (Gyöngyvér Vígh), a teenage ward of the state determined to emancipate herself in order to marry her boyfriend. The bond that forms between the two speaks quietly but powerfully to the social and political forces that shape women’s lives, as each navigates the realities of love, marriage, and motherhood in her quest for self-determination.

hook: 美丽却陷入困境的多米尼克·玛索（碧姬·芭杜 饰）来到波西米亚巴黎，逃离令人窒息的乡下生活，结果却被送上法庭，被指控犯有可怕的罪行：谋杀了她的情人（萨米·弗雷 饰）。随着审判开始，律师们开始争论多米尼克的命运，亨利·乔治·克鲁佐的奥斯卡提名影片《真实》深入探究了她的过去，重现了她在这座城市寻找立足点的斗争。影片细致入微地描绘了一位冲动的年轻女子被周围人误解和虐待的故事，以及她最终与一位崭露头角的指挥家的悲惨恋情。凭借芭杜的惊人表演，克鲁佐这部感人至深、结构复杂的电影——这位法国大师职业生涯后期的巨大成功——对虚伪和道德主义的社会做出了严厉的裁决。由索尼影视娱乐公司与电影基金会和 RT Features 合作修复。
hook_en: Beautiful, troubled Dominique Marceau (Brigitte Bardot) came to bohemian Paris to escape the suffocation of provincial life, only to wind up in a courtroom, accused of a terrible crime: the murder of her lover (Sami Frey). As the trial commences and the lawyers begin tangling over Dominique’s fate, Henri-Georges Clouzot’s Oscar-nominated La vérité delves into her past, reconstructing her struggle to find a foothold in the city. What emerges is a nuanced portrait of an impulsive young woman misunderstood and mistreated by those around her, and of her ultimately tragic affair with an up-and-coming conductor. With an astonishing performance by Bardot, Clouzot’s affecting and intricately constructed film—a huge late-career success for the French master—renders a harsh verdict against a hypocritical and moralistic society.Restored by Sony Pictures Entertainment in partnership with The Film Foundation and RT Features.

hook: 在导演雅克·奥迪亚的这部早期杰作中，两个被遗弃的人因犯罪和激情而聚集在一起。卡拉（艾曼纽·德沃斯，凭借出色的表演获得凯撒奖）是一家不起眼的建筑公司的一名耳背员工，不受赏识。当她聘请了一位新助手保罗（文森特·卡塞尔饰）时，她孤独的生活变得兴奋起来：保罗（文森特·卡塞尔饰）是一名前科犯，很快就让她（和她的唇读能力）参与了一个危险的计划。凭借发自肺腑的摄影作品和声音设计，奥迪亚让观众沉浸在二人组日益动荡的世界中，将黑色传统与复杂的角色发展融为一体，打造出一部具有独特深度和情感的惊悚片。
hook_en: Two outcasts are drawn together by crime and passion in this early tour de force from director Jacques Audiard. Carla (Emmanuelle Devos, who won a César Award for her performance) is an unappreciated, hard-of-hearing employee at a nondescript construction company. Her lonely life gets a jolt of excitement when she hires a new assistant: Paul (Vincent Cassel), an ex-con who soon enlists her (and her lip-reading ability) in a risky scheme. With visceral camera work and sound design, Audiard immerses viewers in the duo’s increasingly turbulent world, blending noir conventions with complex character development for a thriller of unique depth and emotion.

hook: 危地马拉导演杰罗·布斯塔曼特将民间恐怖与尖锐的政治评论融为一体，影片的灵感来自现实生活中对独裁者埃夫拉因·里奥斯·蒙特犯下反人类罪的指控，一个国家的血腥历史玷污了当下。一位臭名昭著、现已年迈的前军事独裁者因对危地马拉玛雅社区犯下的暴行而受审。在与法律后果和人民伸张正义的诉求作斗争的同时，他和他的家人却被一系列日益奇怪和令人不安的事件所困扰，这些事件似乎是由一位神秘的新管家（玛丽亚·梅赛德斯·科罗伊饰）引起的。布斯塔曼特的克制让影片的震撼力更加强烈，他塑造了一个令人不寒而栗的景象：一个国家正面临着集体伤害和不愿消亡的过去的不安的幽灵。
hook_en: A country’s bloody history stains the present in the Guatemalan auteur Jayro Bustamante’s transfixing fusion of folk horror and searing political commentary, inspired by the real-life indictment of the authoritarian Efraín Ríos Montt for crimes against humanity. A notorious, now aging former military dictator stands trial for atrocities committed against Guatemala’s Maya communities. While battling legal repercussions and the people’s demands for justice, he and his family are plagued by a series of increasingly strange and disturbing occurrences, seemingly brought on by an enigmatic new housekeeper (María Mercedes Coroy). With a restraint that renders the film’s shocks all the more potent, Bustamante crafts a chilling vision of a nation reckoning with collective harms and the restless ghosts of a past that refuses to die.

hook: 勒莫汉·耶利米·摩西以诗人对场所、光线和日常生活精神层面的眼光，对故乡概念进行了沉思，并为因进步而迷失的事物谱写了一首超然的挽歌。丈夫和孩子去世后，年长的曼托亚（玛丽·特瓦拉·姆隆戈饰）感到悲痛而孤独，她准备迎接自己的死亡，并与她的祖先一起埋葬。当内陆王国莱索托她的村庄附近修建新水坝的计划威胁到她所珍视的一切时，曼托亚采取了最后的立场，动员她的邻居为他们的土地和生活方式而战。观看摩西富有远见、备受赞誉的《这不是埋葬，这是复活》的体验就像这片土地本身一样永恒和基本。
hook_en: With a poet’s eye for place, light, and the spiritual dimensions of everyday existence, Lemohang Jeremiah Mosese crafts a meditation on the concept of homeland and a transcendent elegy for what is lost in the name of progress. Grieving and alone following the deaths of her husband and children, elderly Mantoa (Mary Twala Mhlongo, in a soul-shaking end-of-life performance) prepares for her own death and to be buried alongside her ancestors. When plans for a new dam near her village in the landlocked kingdom of Lesotho threaten to literally wash away all she holds dear, Mantoa takes a last stand, mobilizing her neighbors to fight for their land and their way of life. The experience of watching Mosese’s visionary, much-lauded This Is Not a Burial, It’s a Resurrection is as timeless and elemental as the land itself.

hook: 这是绝对的反文化大片。前干净利落的青少年明星丹尼斯·霍珀 (Dennis Hopper) 的粗鄙导演处女作《逍遥骑士》预示着电影中新声音的到来，一个愤怒地反对主流的声音。影片的跨国之旅——激进的新浪潮风格的剪辑、局外人摇滚的配乐、年轻的杰克·尼科尔森的启发性表演以及爆炸性的结局——之后的美国公路之旅将不再一样。
hook_en: This is the definitive counterculture blockbuster. The down-and-dirty directorial debut of former clean-cut teen star Dennis Hopper, Easy Rider heralded the arrival of a new voice in film, one pitched angrily against the mainstream. After the film’s cross-country journey—with its radical, New Wave–style editing, outsider-rock soundtrack, revelatory performance by a young Jack Nicholson, and explosive ending—the American road trip would never be the same.

hook: 法国传奇影星热拉尔·菲利普 (Gérard Philipe) 在克里斯蒂安·雅克 (Christian-Jaque) 的浪漫动作喜剧片中饰演农民兵凡凡 (Fanfan)，以虚张声势的姿态载入电影史。在 18 世纪的法国，范范加入了国王路易十五的军队，以避免与当地少女的强迫婚姻，并在参加七年战争的途中与吉娜·劳洛勃丽吉达的冒充算命师艾德琳发生了激烈的冲突。 《郁金香迷》充满了令人眼花缭乱的特技和淫荡的影射，赢得了戛纳电影节最佳导演奖，并在首映后大受欢迎，至今仍然是法国有史以来最受欢迎的电影之一。
hook_en: Legendary French star Gérard Philipe swashbuckled his way into film history as the peasant soldier Fanfan in Christian-Jaque’s devil-may-care romantic action-comedy. In eighteenth-century France, Fanfan joins King Louis XV’s army to avoid a forced marriage to a local lass and gets himself into close scrapes and tight squeezes with Gina Lollobrigida’s impostor fortune-teller, Adeline, on his way to fighting in the Seven Years’ War. Filled to the brim with dazzling stunts and randy innuendo, Fanfan la Tulipe, which won the best director prize at Cannes and was a smash hit upon its initial release, remains one of France’s all-time most beloved films.

hook: 一名生活在纳粹占领的巴黎的犹太男孩被父母送到乡村与一对年长的天主教夫妇住在一起，直到法国解放。八岁的克劳德（由首次担任演员的阿兰·科恩饰演）被迫隐藏自己的身份，他与脾气暴躁、坚决反犹太主义的爷爷（米歇尔·西蒙饰演）建立了联系，后者不可思议地成为了他的朋友和知己。 《我们两个人》是广受好评的导演克劳德·贝里根据自己童年经历改编的处女作，既辛酸又轻松，为传奇人物西蒙在职业生涯的暮年赋予了他最难忘的角色之一。
hook_en: A young Jewish boy living in Nazi-occupied Paris is sent by his parents to the countryside to live with an elderly Catholic couple until France's liberation. Forced to hide his identity, the eight-year-old, Claude (played delicately by first-time actor Alain Cohen), bonds with the irascible, staunchly anti-Semitic Grampa (Michel Simon), who improbably becomes his friend and confidant. Poignant and lighthearted, The Two of Us was acclaimed director Claude Berri's debut feature, based on own childhood experiences, and gave the legendary Simon one of his most memorable roles in the twilight of his career.

hook: 这部根据欧文·威尔士小说改编的黑色幽默电影，让肾上腺素飙升，直击 20 世纪 90 年代英国电影的核心，对导演丹尼·博伊尔、制片人安德鲁·麦克唐纳和编剧约翰·霍奇来说是一项重大突破。 《猜火车》以火热的能量和风格的神韵跨越了苏格兰海洛因瘾君子马克·伦顿（伊万·麦格雷戈饰）的生活和时代，他和他不合群的伙伴们一起吸毒、陷入麻烦、戒毒、再次吸毒，所有这一切都是为了摆脱现代生活的平庸。这个独立音乐现象以充满动感的技术、摇滚和英伦流行乐的标志性配乐为背景，选择了生活中丑陋、美丽、令人恐惧的兴奋。
hook_en: A jolt of adrenaline shot straight to the heart of 1990s British cinema, this darkly funny adaptation of Irvine Welsh’s novel was a major breakthrough for director Danny Boyle, producer Andrew Macdonald, and screenwriter John Hodge. With live-wire energy and stylistic verve, Trainspotting bounces across the life and times of Mark Renton (Ewan McGregor), a Scottish heroin addict who, along with his misfit mates, gets high, gets in trouble, gets clean, and gets high again, all in a bid to outrun the banality of modern existence. Kinetically cut to an iconic soundtrack of techno, rock, and Brit-pop, this indie phenomenon chooses life in all its ugly, beautiful, terrifying exhilaration.

hook: 20 世纪 60 年代初的巴黎，两位年轻女性成为了朋友。 Pomme 是一位有抱负的歌手。苏珊娜是一名怀孕的乡村女孩，无力抚养第三个孩子。波姆借给苏珊娜非法堕胎的钱，但一场突如其来的悲剧很快将他们分开。十年后，她们在一次示威活动中重聚，并承诺通过明信片保持联系，因为她们每个人的生活都被妇女解放运动不可逆转地改变了。 《一个歌唱，另一个不歌唱》是阿涅斯·瓦尔达最温暖、最具政治尖锐性的电影之一，是一部历久弥新的女权主义音乐剧，是一首对根植于一代女性来之不易的胜利的姐妹团结的欢快赞歌。
hook_en: In the early 1960s in Paris, two young women become friends. Pomme is an aspiring singer. Suzanne is a pregnant country girl unable to support a third child. Pomme lends Suzanne the money for an illegal abortion, but a sudden tragedy soon separates them. Ten years later, they reunite at a demonstration and pledge to keep in touch via postcard, as each of their lives is irrevocably changed by the women’s liberation movement. A buoyant hymn to sisterly solidarity rooted in the hard-won victories of a generation of women, One Sings, the Other Doesn’t is one of Agnès Varda’s warmest and most politically trenchant films, a feminist musical for the ages.

hook: 理查德·普赖尔是有史以来最伟大的喜剧演员之一，他在这幅滑稽又令人心碎的自画像中表现得原始而真实。在发生了因吸食可卡因而自焚、几乎丧命的臭名昭著的事件之后，普赖尔通过编写、制作、导演和主演这部令人眼花缭乱的镜厅传记片和幕后剧来驱除内心的恶魔，该剧追溯了一位年轻喜剧演员的成名历程，从他在妓院长大的童年，到塑造他尖锐的滑稽声音的丰富多彩的经历，再到将他带到死亡边缘的毒瘾斗争。正如他在传奇的单口喜剧中所做的那样，普赖尔在这里无所畏惧地将自己的灵魂翻了个底朝天，揭示了使他的艺术如此引人注目的深层脆弱性。
hook_en: One of the greatest comedians of all time, Richard Pryor gets raw and real in this brutally funny and lacerating self-portrait. Following the notorious incident in which he caught on fire while high on cocaine, nearly losing his life, Pryor exorcised his inner demons by writing, producing, directing, and starring in this dizzying hall-of-mirrors biopic and backstage drama, which traces a young comedian’s rise to fame, from his childhood growing up in a brothel to the colorful experiences that shaped his edgy comic voice to the addiction struggles that brought him to the brink of death. As he did in his legendary stand-up sets, here Pryor fearlessly turns his soul inside out, revealing the deep vulnerability that made his art so compelling.

hook: “我们以前见过面，不是吗？”大卫·林奇的第七部长片《失落的高速公路》对身份的神秘本质进行了令人着迷的思考，是这位电影制片人最有力的电影梦境之一。这部电影由帕特丽夏·阿奎特和比尔·普尔曼主演，拓展了媒体的视野，带领观众踏上一段穿越未知和不可知的旅程。当这部后现代黑色电影绕道进入科幻小说领域时，很明显唯一的确定性就是不确定性。
hook_en: “We’ve met before, haven’t we?” A mesmerizing meditation on the mysterious nature of identity, Lost Highway, David Lynch’s seventh feature film, is one of the filmmaker’s most potent cinematic dreamscapes. Starring Patricia Arquette and Bill Pullman, the film expands the horizons of the medium, taking its audience on a journey through the unknown and the unknowable. As this postmodern noir detours into the realm of science fiction, it becomes apparent that the only certainty is uncertainty.

hook: 11 岁的西里尔（托马斯·多雷饰）住在集体之家，内心充满愤怒和愤怒，但他拒绝相信自己被单亲父亲（杰瑞米·雷尼尔饰）拒绝了。他整天都在疯狂地试图通过电话或骑着他心爱的自行车联系到那个男人。只有陌生人萨曼莎（塞西尔·德·弗朗斯饰）的耐心和同情心同意照顾他，才给男孩提供了继续前进的机会。 《骑自行车的孩子》朴素、不带感情，但却深深地充满了令人心碎的温柔，是伟大的比利时导演让-皮埃尔和吕克·达内的一部引人入胜的作品，他们是感人动作片的大师。
hook_en: Eleven-year-old Cyril (Thomas Doret), all coiled anger and furious motion, is living in a group home but refuses to believe he has been rejected by his single father (Jérémie Renier). He spends his days frantically trying to reach the man, over the phone or on his beloved bicycle. It is only the patience and compassion of Samantha (Cécile de France), the stranger who agrees to care for him, that offers the boy the chance to move on. Spare and unsentimental but deeply imbued with a heart-rending tenderness, The Kid with a Bike is an arresting work from the great Belgian directors Jean-Pierre and Luc Dardenne, masters of the empathetic action film.

hook: 让-保罗·贝尔蒙多 (Jean-Paul Belmondo) 在让-皮埃尔·梅尔维尔 (Jean-Pierre Melville) 执导的热辣的《莱昂·莫兰，牧师》(Léon Morin, prêtre) 中展现了微妙的性感表演。这位法国巨星扮演一个忠诚的男人，纳粹占领的法国一个小村庄的所有妇女都渴望他。他发现自己最吸引的是一位在性方面受挫的寡妇——由埃曼纽尔·里瓦饰演——一位宗教怀疑论者，她与忏悔神父的关系变成了与上帝和她自己压抑的欲望的对抗。莱昂·莫兰《神父》在气氛、背景和影射方面取得了胜利，是法国电影大师之一的不敬之作。
hook_en: Jean-Paul Belmondo delivers a subtly sensual performance in the hot-under-the-collar Léon Morin, Priest (Léon Morin, prêtre), directed by Jean-Pierre Melville. The French superstar plays a devoted man of the cloth who is desired by all the women of a small village in Nazi-occupied France. He finds himself most drawn to a sexually frustrated widow—played by Emmanuelle Riva—a religious skeptic whose relationship with her confessor turns into a confrontation with both God and her own repressed desire. A triumph of mood, setting, and innuendo, Léon Morin, Priest is an irreverent pleasure from one of French cinema’s towering virtuosos.

hook: 科克托把勒普兰斯·德·博蒙夫人的童话杰作化为银幕奇迹：美丽姑娘的纯爱融化一头野性却温柔的野兽。《美女与野兽》是奇幻电影的里程碑，让·马雷与约瑟特·戴的浪漫表演难忘；片中关于魅惑、欲望与死亡的壮观幻象，已成为电影奇观的永恒意象。
hook_en: Jean Cocteau’s sublime adaptation of Mme. Leprince de Beaumont’s fairy-tale masterpiece—in which the pure love of a beautiful girl melts the heart of a feral but gentle beast—is a landmark of motion picture fantasy, with unforgettably romantic performances by Jean Marais and Josette Day. The spectacular visions of enchantment, desire, and death in Beauty and the Beast (La Belle et la Bête) have become timeless icons of cinematic wonder.

hook: 凯瑟琳·德纳芙瓷器般的完美掩盖了这位女演员最具标志性的角色之一的内部裂纹：塞芙琳，一位巴黎家庭主妇，开始秘密地在妓院打工度过下午的时光。路易斯·布努埃尔（Luis Buñuel）的这部六十年代末的超现实和色情白日梦是对欲望和拜物教快乐（其角色和观众）的审视，也是对当代社会习俗和阶级划分的温和荒诞主义的诠释。幻想与现实在这片电影中的突破中交织在一起，这是布努埃尔最卖座的作品之一。
hook_en: Catherine Deneuve’s porcelain perfection hides a cracked interior in one of the actress’s most iconic roles: Séverine, a Paris housewife who begins secretly spending her after­noon hours working in a bordello. This surreal and erotic late-sixties daydream from provocateur for the ages Luis Buñuel is an examination of desire and fetishistic pleasure (its characters’ and its viewers’), as well as a gently absurdist take on contemporary social mores and class divisions. Fantasy and reality commingle in this burst of cinematic transgression, which was one of Buñuel’s biggest hits.

hook: 奥利维尔·阿萨亚斯 (Olivier Assayas) 的早期广受好评的作品《冷水》(Cold Water) 久违的、感人至深的成长剧终于可以在美国上映了。阿萨亚斯从自己的年轻经历中汲取灵感，重访 20 世纪 70 年代初的巴黎郊区，讲述了青少年恋人吉尔斯（西普里安·福盖饰）和克里斯汀（维吉妮·拉多延饰）的故事，他们对家庭和社会的叛逆威胁着他们的分离。电影叙事的本能现实主义和近乎实验主义的摄影作品毫不费力地结合在一起，这在一定程度上要归功于生动地唤起了那个时代的摇滚配乐。 《冷水》的核心是电影史上最令人难忘的派对场景之一，它令人心碎地沉浸在年轻人的情感骚动中。
hook_en: An acclaimed early work by Olivier Assayas, the long-unavailable, deeply felt coming-of-age drama Cold Water can at last be seen in the United States. Drawing from his own youthful experiences, Assayas revisits the outskirts of Paris in the early 1970s, telling the story of teenage lovers Gilles (Cyprien Fouquet) and Christine (Virginie Ledoyen), whose rebellions against family and society threaten to tear them apart. The visceral realism of the movie’s narrative and the near experimentalism of its camera work come together effortlessly thanks in part to a rock soundtrack that vividly evokes the period. Cold Water, whose centerpiece is one of the most memorable party sequences ever committed to film, is a heartbreaking immersion in the emotional tumult of being young.

hook: 尽管简·坎皮恩后来创作了一系列精彩的电影，但人们将永远记住她令人惊叹的处女作《甜甜》，该片聚焦于保守、迷信的凯和她狂暴、不顾一切的妹妹甜甜之间的危险关系，以及他们家庭根深蒂固的腐朽根源。一场丰富多彩的摄影盛宴和迷人而独特的角色，坚韧而温柔的甜心预示着这位才华横溢的导演的出现，也预示着澳大利亚电影的复兴，这将在九十年代席卷电影界。
hook_en: Though she went on to create a string of brilliant films, Jane Campion will always be remembered for her stunning debut feature, Sweetie, which focuses on the hazardous relationship between the buttoned-down, superstitious Kay and her rampaging, devil-may-care sister, Sweetie—and on their family's profoundly rotten roots. A feast of colorful photography and captivating, idiosyncratic characters, the tough and tender Sweetie heralded the emergence of this gifted director, as well as a renaissance of Australian cinema, which would take the film world by storm in the nineties.

hook: 布鲁诺·杜蒙的第二部长片超凡脱俗，通过一个极度疏远的警探（眼神难以磨灭的悲伤的伊曼纽尔·肖特，因首次电影表演而获得戛纳电影节最佳男主角奖）的故事，探讨了人类状况的奇妙和恐怖。他在调查一名年轻女孩的谋杀案时，经历了情感和身体联系的震撼和顿悟时刻。 《人道》展示了杜蒙对非演员的娴熟技巧，以及对身体和性的毫不留情的坦率描述，它既是一部独特的警察程序，也是对人类同情心与我们卑鄙、有时是野蛮的动物本能之间紧张关系的挑衅性探索。
hook_en: The transcendent second feature by Bruno Dumont probes the wonder and horror of the human condition through the story of a profoundly alienated police detective (the indelibly sad-eyed Emmanuel Schotté, winner of an upset best actor prize at Cannes for his first film performance) who, while investigating the murder of a young girl, experiences jolting, epiphanous moments of emotional and physical connection. Demonstrating Dumont’s deftness with nonactors and relentlessly frank depiction of bodies and sexuality, L’humanité is at once an idiosyncratic police procedural and a provocative exploration of the tension between humankind’s capacity for compassion and our base, sometimes barbarous animal instincts.

hook: 这部由克尔斯滕·约翰逊 (Kirsten Johnson) 创作的这部俏皮、深刻且极其感人的纪录片幻想曲是对导演深爱的父亲迪克·约翰逊 (Dick Johnson) 的情人节礼物，这部作品是在她开始面对因痴呆症而失去父亲的现实时制作的。约翰逊利用电影语言来反抗死亡和正面面对死亡，顽皮地想象了她在世界上最爱的男人可能会以多种方式死去，上演了一系列时而黑色喜剧，时而丰富多彩的富有想象力的场景，与原始的真实镜头交织在一起，捕捉了两人温柔但日益脆弱的关系。 《迪克·约翰逊之死》以颠覆性的幽默和令人惊讶的优雅来解决衰老、死亡和悲伤等禁忌问题，最终是对生命的胜利庆祝，也是对中心人物温柔、有趣、令人难忘的男人的胜利庆祝。迪克·约翰逊万岁。
hook_en: This playful, profound, and immensely moving docu-fantasia by Kirsten Johnson is a valentine to the director’s beloved father, Dick Johnson, made as she is beginning to face the reality of losing him to dementia. Using the language of cinema both to defy death and to confront it head-on, Johnson mischievously envisions an array of ways in which the man she loves most in the world might die, staging a series of alternately darkly comic and colorfully imaginative tableaux interwoven with raw vérité footage capturing the pair’s tender but increasingly fragile bond. Tackling taboo questions of aging, mortality, and grief with subversive humor and surprising grace, Dick Johnson Is Dead is ultimately a triumphant celebration of life, and of the gentle, funny, unforgettable man at its center. Long live Dick Johnson.

hook: 电影制片人埃卡瓦·姆桑吉 (Ekwa Msangi) 在她精彩的处女作中，以同理心和洞察力记录了一个破碎家庭走向完整的旅程。纽约出租车司机（恩塔尔·古马·姆巴霍·姆维恩饰）因安哥拉内战与家人离散十七年后，终于能够跟随他前往美国，与虔诚的宗教妻子（扎伊纳布·贾饰）和十几岁的女儿（杰米·劳森饰）团聚。但在相隔千里生活了这么久之后，三人发现他们必须发现彼此的优点，原谅彼此的弱点，弥合文化和代沟，才能共同建设生活。 《告别爱情》分三个视角转变的章节讲述了构成移民经历的众多挣扎和情感，苦乐参半，富有同情心地唤起了当你的心和你的家在不同地方时的感受。
hook_en: In her luminous feature debut, filmmaker Ekwa Msangi chronicles a broken family’s journey to wholeness with empathy and insight. Seventeen years after his family was separated by the civil war in Angola, a New York taxi driver (Ntare Guma Mbaho Mwine) is reunited with his now devoutly religious wife (Zainab Jah) and teenage daughter (Jayme Lawson) when they are finally able to follow him to America. But after living thousands of miles apart for so long, the three find they must discover one another’s strengths, forgive one another’s weaknesses, and bridge cultural and generational divides in order to build a life together. Told in three perspective-shifting chapters that honor the multitude of struggles and emotions that make up the immigrant experience, Farewell Amor is a bittersweet, compassionate evocation of how it feels when your heart and your home are in different places.

hook: 马龙·白兰度在这部都市诗歌杰作中演绎了他职业生涯中的精彩表演，饰演坚强的职业拳击手特里·马洛伊 (Terry Malloy)。 《海滨》是一个关于个人失败和社会腐败的充满情感的故事，讲述了特里日益加深的道德危机，当当局逼近他们时，他必须决定是否继续忠于与黑帮有联系的工会老板约翰尼·弗兰德利（李·科布饰）和约翰尼的得力助手、特里的兄弟查理（罗德·斯泰格饰）。在埃利亚·卡赞生动自然的导演和巴德·舒尔伯格精彩的街头对话的推动下，《海滨》立即引起轰动，赢得了八项奥斯卡奖，包括最佳影片奖、最佳导演奖、最佳男主角奖、最佳女配角奖（爱娃·玛丽·圣特）和最佳剧本奖。
hook_en: Marlon Brando gives the performance of his career as the tough prizefighter-turned-longshoreman Terry Malloy in this masterpiece of urban poetry. A raggedly emotional tale of individual failure and social corruption, On the Waterfront follows Terry’s deepening moral crisis as he must decide whether to remain loyal to the mob-connected union boss Johnny Friendly (Lee J. Cobb) and Johnny’s right-hand man, Terry’s brother, Charley (Rod Steiger), as the authorities close in on them. Driven by the vivid, naturalistic direction of Elia Kazan and savory, streetwise dialogue by Budd Schulberg, On the Waterfront was an instant sensation, winning eight Oscars®, including for best picture, director, actor, supporting actress (Eva Marie Saint), and screenplay.

hook: 德国新电影先驱维姆·文德斯 (Wim Wenders) 将他对风景的敏锐眼光带到德克萨斯州巴黎的美国西南部，这是一部由普利策奖获奖剧作家萨姆·谢泼德 (Sam Shepard) 撰写的深刻感人的人物研究作品。 《德克萨斯州巴黎》讲述了神秘、近乎沉默的漂流者特拉维斯（哈利·戴恩·斯坦通饰，他的脸本身就是一道风景），他试图与年幼的儿子和失踪的妻子（娜塔莎·金斯基饰）重新建立联系，儿子和弟弟（迪恩·斯托克韦尔饰）住在洛杉矶。通过这个简单的设置，文德斯和谢泼德对男性气概和美国家庭的神话做出了强有力的陈述，并对广阔、破碎的峡谷和霓虹世界进行了精致的视觉探索。
hook_en: New German Cinema pioneer Wim Wenders brings his keen eye for landscape to the American Southwest in Paris, Texas, a profoundly moving character study written by Pulitzer Prize–winning playwright Sam Shepard. Paris, Texas follows the mysterious, nearly mute drifter Travis (a magnificent Harry Dean Stanton, whose face is a landscape all its own) as he tries to reconnect with his young son, living with his brother (Dean Stockwell) in Los Angeles, and his missing wife (Nastassja Kinski). From this simple setup, Wenders and Shepard produce a powerful statement on codes of masculinity and the myth of the American family, as well as an exquisite visual exploration of a vast, crumbling world of canyons and neon.

hook: 作家、演员兼导演萨沙·吉特里 (Sacha Guitry) 从剧院脱颖而出，成为法国最著名、最具创造力的电影制片人之一，《毒药》标志着他与另一位银幕巨头、表现力无与伦比的米歇尔·西蒙 (Michel Simon) 的首次重大合作。凭借吉特里诙谐的对话和快速的节奏，这部黑色喜剧是对婚姻变坏的典型描述：在一起三十年后，一位乡村园丁（西蒙饰）和他的妻子（杰曼·鲁弗饰）发现自己在考虑如何消灭彼此，前者甚至计划如何谈判他最终的刑事审判。受吉特里自己在二战后与法律的纠葛——对通敌主义的错误指控——的启发，《毒药》是对法国法律体系和一个急于利用他人不幸的社会的一种轻松而尖刻的猛烈抨击。
hook_en: The writer, actor, and director Sacha Guitry emerged from the theater to become one of France’s best-known and most inventive filmmakers, and La poison marked his first major collaboration with another titan of the screen, the incomparably expressive Michel Simon. With Guitry’s witty dialogue and fleet pacing, this black comedy is the quintessential depiction of a marriage gone sour: after thirty years together, a village gardener (Simon) and his wife (Germaine Reuver) find themselves contemplating how to do away with each other, with the former even planning how he’ll negotiate his eventual criminal trial. Inspired by Guitry’s own post–World War II tangle with the law—a wrongful charge of collaborationism—La poison is a blithely caustic broadside against the French legal system and a society all too eager to capitalize on the misfortunes of others.

hook: 奥斯卡 1924 年出生于德国，智力超群。由于厌恶成年人的虚伪和社会的不负责任，他在三岁生日后拒绝变老。当他周围的混乱世界走向第二次世界大战的疯狂和愚蠢时，奥斯卡不断地敲打他心爱的锡鼓，完善他那不可思议的刺耳的尖叫声。 《铁皮鼓》荣获戛纳金棕榈奖和奥斯卡最佳外语片奖，是沃尔克·施隆多夫根据诺贝尔奖获得者君特·格拉斯广受赞誉的小说改编的富有远见的作品，其特点是超现实的意象、引人注目的色情内容和清晰的讽刺。
hook_en: Oskar is born in Germany in 1924 with an advanced intellect. Repulsed by the hypocrisy of adults and the irresponsibility of society, he refuses to grow older after his third birthday. While the chaotic world around him careers toward the madness and folly of World War II, Oskar pounds incessantly on his beloved tin drum and perfects his uncannily piercing shrieks. The Tin Drum, which earned the Palme d’Or at Cannes and the Academy Award for best foreign-language film, is Volker Schlöndorff’s visionary adaptation of Nobel laureate Günter Grass’s acclaimed novel, characterized by surreal imagery, arresting eroticism, and clear-eyed satire.

hook: 雷纳特·雷因斯夫 (Renate Reinsve) 凭借富有启发性、复杂的表演赢得了戛纳电影节最佳女主角奖，这部由挪威导演约阿希姆·特里尔 (Joachim Trier) 执导的大型小说电影对一位三十多岁的女性进行了情感错综复杂、令人兴奋的人物研究。在现代世界看似无限的可能性中，朱莉（雷因斯维饰）在艺术热情和职业、母性问题以及与两个截然不同的男人的关系上摇摆不定：一位成功的漫画艺术家（特里尔常客安德斯·丹尼尔森·李饰）和一位魅力十足的咖啡师（赫伯特·诺德鲁姆饰）。特里尔和他的常年合著者埃斯基尔·沃格特与一群长期合作者合作，创作了《世界上最糟糕的人》，这是他们非官方的奥斯陆三部曲中获得奥斯卡提名的第三部作品，一部关于自我发现的自由肖像，并对这部浪漫喜剧进行了令人振奋的当代演绎。
hook_en: Renate Reinsve won the Best Actress prize at Cannes for the revelatory, complex performance that anchors this sprawlingly novelistic film by Norwegian auteur Joachim Trier, an emotionally intricate and exhilarating character study of a woman entering her thirties. Amid the seemingly endless possibilities of the modern world, Julie (Reinsve) wavers over artistic passions and professions, the question of motherhood, and relationships with two very different men: a successful comic-book artist (Trier regular Anders Danielsen Lie) and a charismatic barista (Herbert Nordrum). Working with a team of longtime collaborators, Trier and his perennial cowriter Eskil Vogt construct in The Worst Person in the World, the Oscar-nominated third entry in their unofficial Oslo Trilogy, a liberating portrait of self-discovery and a bracingly contemporary spin on the romantic comedy.

hook: 通过这部电影，大胆的肯·拉塞尔登上了国际舞台，利用 D. H. 劳伦斯经典小说中的性心理激进主义打破了他那个时代的禁忌。 《恋爱中的女人》以现代性顶峰的英国采矿社区为背景，追溯了将获得解放的布兰文姐妹（珍妮·林登和奥斯卡获奖者格伦达·杰克逊饰）与自由思想的梦想家（艾伦·贝茨饰）和意志坚强的实业家（奥利弗·里德饰）联系在一起的不断变化的欲望潮流，以及男人们自己充满情欲的友谊。罗素将朴实的感性与万花筒风格化的图像结合起来，将这四重奏追求到痛苦和狂喜的高度，打造出一部关于人类性行为最自由、最主导和最具破坏性的极端的令人惊叹的戏剧。
hook_en: With this film, the audacious Ken Russell vaulted onto the international stage, drawing on the psychosexual radicalism of D. H. Lawrence’s classic novel to shatter taboos in his own time. Set in an English mining community on the crest of modernity, Women in Love traces the shifting currents of desire that link the emancipated Brangwen sisters (Jennie Linden and an Oscar-winning Glenda Jackson) to a freethinking dreamer (Alan Bates) and a hard-willed industrialist (Oliver Reed)—as well as the men’s own erotically charged friendship. Coupling earthy sensuality with kaleidoscopically stylized images, Russell pursues this quartet to the heights of agony and ecstasy, crafting a breathtaking drama of human sexuality at its most liberating, dominating, and destructive extremes.

hook: 玛丽亚（汉娜·许古拉饰）在第二次世界大战的最后几天与赫尔曼·布劳恩结婚，但他却在战争中失踪。玛丽亚独自一人利用自己的美貌和野心，在 20 世纪 50 年代德国的“经济奇迹”中寻求繁荣。 《玛丽亚·布劳恩的婚姻》是雷纳·沃纳·法斯宾德最成功的国际票房作品，它是一部令人心碎的作品，讲述了一个女人如何从自己生活的废墟中重新站起来，同时也对一个决心忘记过去的社会进行了尖锐的隐喻攻击。
hook_en: Maria (Hanna Schygulla) marries Hermann Braun in the last days of World War II, only for him to go missing in the war. Alone, Maria puts to use her beauty and ambition in order to find prosperity during Germany’s “economic miracle” of the 1950s. Rainer Werner Fassbinder’s biggest international box-office success, The Marriage of Maria Braun is a heartbreaking study of a woman picking herself up from the ruins of her own life, as well as a pointed metaphorical attack on a society determined to forget its past.

hook: 查尔斯·基斯利亚克的《永恒的锻造——约翰·卡索维茨的生活与艺术》详细讲述了这位电影最伟大的先驱者和反传统者之一的职业生涯。这部电影汇集了对卡索维茨的合作者和朋友的坦诚采访、罕见的照片、档案片段和导演自己的话语，描绘了一个具有启发性的男人的肖像，他强烈的爱、勇气和奉献精神永远改变了电影的面貌。
hook_en: Charles Kiselyak’s A Constant Forge—The Life and Art of John Cassavetes is a detailed journey through the career of one of film’s greatest pioneers and iconoclasts. Assembled from candid interviews with Cassavetes’ collaborators and friends, rare photographs, archival footage, and the director’s own words, the film paints a revealing portrait of a man whose fierce love, courage, and dedication changed the face of cinema forever.

hook: 托本·斯科约特·延森 (Torben Skjødt Jensen) 这部优雅的纪录片是对电影最伟大导演之一的回忆和反思的拼贴。 Carl Th. 视觉效果丰富且层次丰富。德雷叶——我的梅蒂埃（Dreyer-My Metier）阐释了一位艺术家的理解太少，但又太重要而不容忽视。通过采访、历史著作和罕见的档案片段，德雷尔的肖像浮现出来：是的，他是一位严肃的完美主义者，但也是一位充满激情、拥有真正幽默感的人。 Criterion Collection 很荣幸首次在家庭视频中呈现对德雷尔生活和工作的深入研究。
hook_en: Torben Skjødt Jensen's elegant documentary is a collage of memories and reflections on one of cinema's greatest directors. Visually rich and densely layered, Carl Th. Dreyer—My Metier illuminates an artist too little understood and too important to overlook. Through interviews, historical writings, and rare archival footage, a portrait of Dreyer emerges: an austere perfectionist, yes, but also a passionate man possessing a genuine sense of humor. The Criterion Collection is proud to present this in-depth study of Dreyer's life and work for the first time on home video.

hook: 埃尔曼诺·奥尔米 (Ermanno Olmi) 的精彩长片讲述了两个米兰未婚夫的温柔故事，当两人接受西西里岛的新工作时，他们紧张的关系受到了考验。分离带来了孤独、怀旧，或许还有一些新的视角可以让他们的爱情焕发活力。奥尔米深刻的人文主义精神对普通男女以及人心的陷阱进行了动人的描绘。
hook_en: Ermanno Olmi’s masterful feature is the tender story of two Milanese fiancés whose strained relationship is tested when the man accepts a new job in Sicily. With the separation come loneliness, nostalgia, and, perhaps, some new perspectives that might rejuvenate their love. Olmi’s deep humanism charges this moving depiction of ordinary men and women, and the pitfalls of the human heart.

hook: 卢奇诺·维斯康蒂 (Luchino Visconti) 的这部晚期职业杰作改编自托马斯·曼 (Thomas Mann) 的经典中篇小说，是对艺术本质、美的诱惑和死亡的不可避免性的沉思。古斯塔夫·冯·阿申巴赫（德克·博加德饰）是一位挑剔的作曲家，在一场灾难性的音乐会中深受打击，他前往威尼斯恢复体力。在那里，他被一个名叫塔齐奥（比约恩·安德森饰）的小男孩的纯粹之美所震撼，即使瘟疫的谣言在整个城市蔓延，他的迷恋也发展成了一种痴迷。将曼恩关于酷儿欲望和身体腐烂的故事与古斯塔夫·马勒的崇高音乐相映衬，
hook_en: Based on the classic novella by Thomas Mann, this late-career masterpiece from Luchino Visconti is a meditation on the nature of art, the allure of beauty, and the inescapability of death. A fastidious composer reeling from a disastrous concert, Gustav von Aschenbach (Dirk Bogarde, in an exquisitely nuanced performance) travels to Venice to recover. There, he is struck by a vision of pure beauty in the form of a young boy named Tadzio (Björn Andrésen), his infatuation developing into an obsession even as rumors of a plague spread through the city. Setting Mann’s story of queer desire and bodily decay against the sublime music of Gustav Mahler,

hook: 这部由坎普·鲍尔斯 (Kemp Powers) 广受好评的戏剧改编而成的导演处女作，由奥斯卡奖得主演员雷吉娜·金 (Regina King) 执导，观众将置身于一个房间里，周围有美国黑人文化最前沿的四位偶像，他们在民权运动的彻底变革中狂欢、冲突、袒露自己的灵魂，并努力寻找自己的位置。 1964 年 2 月 25 日，傲慢的年轻拳击手穆罕默德·阿里（当时称为卡修斯·克莱）击败桑尼·利斯顿这一天被载入史册，但比赛后发生的事情也许更令人难以置信：阿里、民权领袖马尔科姆·X、NFL 伟大的吉姆·布朗和“灵魂之王”山姆·库克齐聚在迈阿密的一家汽车旅馆。充满伟大想法和激进精神的电动，迈阿密之夜。 。 。让我们陷入一场亲密、持续的对话之中——这也是美国历史上的一个决定性时刻。
hook_en: Adapted by Kemp Powers from his acclaimed play, the feature directorial debut of Academy Award–winning actor Regina King puts viewers in a room with four icons at the forefront of Black American culture as they carouse, clash, bare their souls, and grapple with their places within the sweeping change of the civil rights movement. February 25, 1964, has gone down in history as the day that the brash young boxer Muhammad Ali (then known as Cassius Clay) defeated Sonny Liston, but what happened after the fight was perhaps even more incredible: Ali, civil rights leader Malcolm X, NFL great Jim Brown, and “King of Soul” Sam Cooke all came together at a Miami motel. Electric with big ideas and activist spirit, One Night in Miami . . . plunges us into the midst of an intimate, ongoing conversation—and a defining moment in American history.

hook: 这部由联合导演（双胞胎兄弟）阿里·埃西里 (Arie Esiri) 和楚科·埃西里 (Chuko Esiri) 执导的这部具有启发性且屡获殊荣的处女作，描绘了尼日利亚拉各斯的日常生活，令人心碎又充满希望。 《埃伊莫夫》（《这是我的愿望》）采用质感丰富的 16 毫米胶片拍摄，充满了新现实主义精神，讲述了两个疏远的陌生人的旅程：莫夫（裘德·阿库乌迪克饰）是一名处理家庭悲剧后果的电工，罗莎（泰米·阿米-威廉姆斯饰）是一名理发师，支持她怀孕的十几岁的妹妹，他们各自追求在欧洲开始新生活的梦想，同时也遇到了严峻的经济形势。现实世界中的每一次互动都是一次交易。这些亲密的故事展现了当代拉各斯生活的生动写照，其社会结构充满活力和复杂性。
hook_en: This revelatory, award-winning debut feature from codirec­tors (and twin brothers) Arie and Chuko Esiri is a heartrending and hopeful portrait of everyday human endurance in Lagos, Nigeria. Shot on richly textured 16 mm film and infused with the spirit of neorealism, Eyimofe (This Is My Desire) traces the journeys of two distantly connected strangers—Mofe (Jude Akuwudike), an electrician dealing with the fallout of a family tragedy, and Rosa (Temi Ami-Williams), a hairdresser supporting her pregnant teenage sister—as they each pursue their dream of starting a new life in Europe while bumping up against the harsh economic realities of a world in which every interaction is a transaction. From these intimate stories emerges a vivid snapshot of life in contemporary Lagos, whose social fabric is captured in all its vibrancy and complexity.

hook: 这部令人欣喜若狂的纪录片改编自大卫·伯恩广受好评的美国乌托邦巡演，并改编自百老汇舞台，大卫·伯恩以歌曲的超凡力量迎接了美国难以驾驭的政治时刻。导演斯派克·李以身临其境的方式捕捉到这一令人振奋的场面，将二十一首新歌和经典歌曲与伯恩对国家状况（其危险、承诺和转型的可能性）的独特观察交织在一起。大卫·伯恩 (David Byrne) 的美国乌托邦由安妮-B·帕森 (Annie-B Parson) 编排，其创造性的极简主义已成为伯恩现场表演的标志，它在公共繁荣和赞美诗般的优雅时刻之间移动，证明音乐是抗议、变革、最重要的是团结的推动者。
hook_en: David Byrne meets America’s fractious political moment with the transcendent power of song in this ecstatic documentary of the Broadway adaptation of his acclaimed American Utopia tour. Captured with immersive immediacy by director Spike Lee, this uplifting spectacle interweaves twenty-one songs, both new and classic, with Byrne’s singular observations on the state of the nation—its perils, promises, and possibility for transformation. Choreographed by Annie-B Parson with the inventive minimalism that has become a signature of Byrne’s live performances, David Byrne’s American Utopia moves between moments of communal exuberance and hymnlike grace, making the case for music as an agent of protest, change, and above all unity.

hook: 罗伯特·弗莱厄蒂（ Robert Flaherty ）的经典电影讲述了因纽特猎人纳努克（ Nanook ）及其家人在加拿大哈德逊湾地区的恶劣条件下挣扎求生的故事。Nanook of the North在1922年发行时非常受欢迎，是一个电影里程碑，继续吸引着观众。Criterion自豪地展示了原始导演剪辑，恢复到适当的帧速率，并根据Flaherty的个人印刷品进行着色。
hook_en: Robert Flaherty’s classic film tells the story of Inuit hunter Nanook and his family as they struggle to survive in the harsh conditions of Canada’s Hudson Bay region. Enormously popular when released in 1922, Nanook of the North is a cinematic milestone that continues to enchant audiences. Criterion is proud to present the original director’s cut, restored to the proper frame rate and tinted according to Flaherty’s personal print.

hook: 格劳伯·罗查 (Glauber Rocha) 是巴西社会责任新电影运动的先驱，在一部激烈的存在主义西部片中，神话、神秘主义和革命相互碰撞。牧场工人马诺埃尔（杰拉尔多·德尔雷饰）杀死了诈骗老板后，与妻子罗莎（约纳·马加良斯饰）一起逃亡。在荒凉的腹地，他们与武装土匪联手，宣誓效忠一位自封的圣人，这位圣人鼓吹反抗富有的地主，同时对无辜者实施难以形容的暴力行为。这部具有里程碑意义的激进电影作品充满了反独裁的热情和沙漠生活的强度，是一部关于盲目狂热和死胡同意识形态诱惑的焦土寓言。
hook_en: Myth, mysticism, and revolution collide in a blistering existential western from Glauber Rocha, a pioneer of Brazil’s socially committed Cinema Novo movement. After killing his swindling boss, ranch hand Manoel (Geraldo Del Rey) goes on the run with his wife, Rosa (Yoná Magalhães). In the stark hinterlands, they join forces with armed bandits and pledge allegiance to a self-styled holy man who preaches revolt against rich landowners while perpetrating unspeakable acts of violence against the innocent. Suffused with antiauthoritarian fervor and the intensity of life in the desert, this landmark work of radical cinema is a scorched-earth allegory about mindless fanaticism and the allure of dead-end ideologies.

hook: 在反乌托邦的杰作《巴西》中，乔纳森·普赖斯（ Jonathan Pryce ）扮演一个白日梦中的每个人，他发现自己陷入了噩梦般的官僚主义的压垮灵魂的齿轮中。特里·吉列姆（ Terry Gilliam ）的这个警示故事是20世纪80年代最伟大的电影之一，与乔治·奥威尔（ George Orwell ）、奥尔德斯·赫胥黎（ Aldous Huxley ）和库尔特·冯内古特（ Kurt Vonnegut ）等人的反极权主义作品一起受到尊重。在布景设计、电影摄影、音乐和效果方面，巴西是一个不间断的…
hook_en: In the dystopian masterpiece Brazil, Jonathan Pryce plays a daydreaming everyman who finds himself caught in the soul-crushing gears of a nightmarish bureaucracy. This cautionary tale by Terry Gilliam, one of the great films of the 1980s, has come to be esteemed alongside antitotalitarian works by the likes of George Orwell, Aldous Huxley, and Kurt Vonnegut. And in terms of set design, cinematography, music, and effects, Brazil is a nonstop dazzler.

hook: 传奇的吉尔伯特和沙利文剧团 D’Oyly Carte Opera Company 与好莱坞联手制作了 1939 年深受喜爱的喜歌剧《天皇》的彩色版，这是这对著名二人组首次被搬上银幕的作品。该片由音乐家兼奥斯卡提名电影制作人维克多·谢辛格 (Victor Schertzinger) 执导，以华丽的电影形式重述了以异国情调的日本为背景的英国政治讽刺剧，其中包括《魔杖吟游诗人 I》和《学校的三个小女仆》等经久不衰的歌曲，并由美国歌手肯尼·贝克 (Kenny Baker) 以及马丁·格林 (Martyn Green) 和西德尼·格兰维尔 (Sydney Granville) 等众多著名的 D’Oyly Carte 表演者主演。
hook_en: The legendary Gilbert and Sullivan troupe the D’Oyly Carte Opera Company joined forces with Hollywood for this 1939 Technicolor version of the beloved comic opera The Mikado, the first work by the famed duo to be adapted for the screen. Directed by musician and Oscar-nominated filmmaker Victor Schertzinger, it is a lavish cinematic retelling of the British political satire set in exotic Japan, with such enduringly popular numbers as “A Wand’ring Minstrel I” and “Three Little Maids from School,” and featuring American singer Kenny Baker as well as a host of renowned D’Oyly Carte performers, including Martyn Green and Sydney Granville.

hook: 巴里·詹金斯 (Barry Jenkins) 改编自科尔森·怀特海德 (Colson Whitehead) 2016 年普利策奖获奖小说，对美国历史进行了具有里程碑意义的重新想象，讲述了一段令人痛苦而狂想曲的旅程，穿越了至今回响的过去。 《地下铁路》将历史小说与魔幻现实主义的时刻交织在一起，让您完全沉浸在科拉（图索·姆贝杜饰）的世界中。科拉逃离奴隶制，开始了对自由的危险追求，并受到暴力的威胁，受到争取解放的秘密社区的支持，并被一路上失去的人所困扰。凭借灼热力量的图像和激动人心的诗歌，詹金斯讲述了一个关于生存和恢复的史诗传奇，将限量系列格式推向了电影超越的新高度。
hook_en: A monumental reimagining of American history, Barry Jenkins’s adaptation of Colson Whitehead’s Pulitzer Prize–winning 2016 novel is a harrowing and rhapsodic journey through a still-echoing past. Weaving together historical fiction with moments of magical realism, The Underground Railroad is a full sensory immersion into the world of Cora (Thuso Mbedu), who, fleeing slavery, embarks on a treacherous quest for freedom—and is menaced by violence, supported by a clandestine community fighting for liberation, and haunted by the people she loses along the way. With images of searing power and stirring poetry, Jenkins delivers an epic saga of survival and resilience that pushes the limited-series format to new heights of cinematic transcendence.

hook: 雅克·贝克尔在这部注定浪漫的经典故事中，深情地唤起了美好时代的巴黎花花公子。当黑帮情妇玛丽（西蒙·西涅莱饰）爱上改过自新的罪犯曼达（塞尔吉·雷吉亚尼饰）时，他们的激情激起了黑社会的竞争，最终导致背叛和悲剧。 《Casque d'or》（《金色玛丽》）凭借令人心酸、细致入微的表演和感性的黑白摄影，成为贝克尔电影力量的顶峰——一部浪漫的杰作。
hook_en: Jacques Becker lovingly evokes the belle epoque Parisian demimonde in this classic tale of doomed romance. When gangster's moll Marie (Simone Signoret) falls for reformed criminal Manda (Serge Reggiani), their passion incites an underworld rivalry that leads inexorably to treachery and tragedy. With poignant, nuanced performances and sensuous black-and-white photography, Casque d'or (Golden Marie) is Becker at the height of his cinematic powers—a romantic masterpiece.

hook: 粤语流行巨星梅艳芳和张国荣在这部由先锋酷儿情节剧大师关锦鹏执导的香港第二次新浪潮的标志性电影中，展现了他们作为命中注定的恋人的标志性雌雄同体的魅力。 《胭脂扣》讲述了一个卑微的妓女和任性的富家子弟之间的悲惨爱情故事，他们在 20 世纪 30 年代的香港豪华茶馆里接受自杀协议，在过去和现在之间架起桥梁。五十年后，她回到城邦寻找他，吸引了一对年轻的当代夫妇（文志良和朱宝仪饰）加入她的追寻，以重新点燃可能与时间本身一样虚幻的激情。这部感性的鬼故事以其华丽的场景和超凡的忧郁情绪，为失去的爱情和消失的历史写下了一首精致而持久的挽歌。
hook_en: Cantopop superstars Anita Mui Yim-fong and Leslie Cheung Kwok-wing display their iconic androgynous magnetism as doomed lovers in this emblematic film of Hong Kong’s Second New Wave, directed by pioneering queer melodrama master Stanley Kwan. Rouge bridges past and present in its tragic romance between a humble courtesan and the wayward scion of a wealthy family, who embrace death by suicide pact amid the opulent teahouses of 1930s Hong Kong. Fifty years later, she returns to the city-state to find him, drawing a young contemporary couple (Alex Man Chi-leung and Emily Chu Bo-yee) into her quest to rekindle a passion that may be as illusory as time itself. With its lush mise-en-scène and transcendently melancholy mood, this sensuous ghost story is an exquisite, enduringly resonant elegy for both lost love and vanishing history.

hook: 康涅狄格州郊区，1973 年。当理查德·尼克松 (Richard Nixon) 的“我不是骗子”的演讲在电视上嗡嗡作响时，胡德 (Hood) 和卡弗 (Carver) 一家人正试图度过感恩节假期，心中充满了不言而喻的怨恨、性紧张和文化困惑。奥斯卡奖得主导演李安以清晰、微妙和邪恶的幽默，将里克·穆迪这部广受赞誉的小说描绘了美国中上层阶级的萎靡不振，将其描绘成一幅对迷失灵魂的尖锐、悲惨的电影肖像。 《冰风暴》拥有众多知名演员（凯文·克莱恩、琼·艾伦、西格妮·韦弗）和新星（托比·马奎尔、克里斯蒂娜·里奇、伊利亚·伍德、凯蒂·霍尔姆斯），是 20 世纪 90 年代最优秀的电影之一。
hook_en: Suburban Connecticut, 1973. While Richard Nixon’s “I am not a crook” speech drones from the TV, the Hood and Carver families try to navigate a Thanksgiving break simmering with unspoken resentment, sexual tension, and cultural confusion. With clarity, subtlety, and a dose of wicked humor, Academy Award–winning director Ang Lee renders Rick Moody’s acclaimed novel of upper-middle-class American malaise as a trenchant, tragic cinematic portrait of lost souls. Featuring a tremendous cast of established actors (Kevin Kline, Joan Allen, Sigourney Weaver) and rising stars (Tobey Maguire, Christina Ricci, Elijah Wood, Katie Holmes) The Ice Storm is among the finest films of the 1990s.

hook: 传奇演员兼导演洪金宝在这部最具娱乐性的香港动作电影典范中，带来了令人肾上腺素飙升的火箭筒爆炸。 《东方秃鹰》的灵感来自《十二金刚》等好莱坞战争电影，讲述了一群乌合之众的亚裔美国囚犯被派往越南执行一项秘密自杀任务，以防止一批武器落入已做好战斗准备的越共手中。在充满活力的演员阵容的推动下，其中包括饰演黑市商人的魅力无穷的元彪和饰演咯咯笑的武术怪物的超人元华，这场咆哮的奇观提供了不间断的涡轮增压场景，挑战死亡、逻辑和重力本身。
hook_en: Legendary actor-director Sammo Hung delivers a bazooka blast of pure adrenaline in this exemplar of Hong Kong action cinema at its most entertaining. Drawing inspiration from Hollywood war films like The Dirty Dozen, Eastern Condors follows a ragtag band of Asian American prisoners dropped into Vietnam on a secret suicide mission to prevent a cache of weapons from falling into the hands of the Viet Cong, who are more than ready for a fight. Propelled by a dynamic ensemble cast that includes the ever-charismatic Yuen Biao as a black-market trader and a superhuman Yuen Wah as a giggling martial-arts monster, this rip-roaring spectacle offers a nonstop barrage of turbocharged set pieces that defy death, logic, and gravity itself.

hook: 这部由法国大师罗伯特·布列松创作的无与伦比的犯罪与救赎故事讲述了年轻的扒手米歇尔的故事，他整天在巴黎的街道、地铁车厢和火车站工作。然而，随着他对偷窃刺激的不断追求，他也越来越担心自己的运气即将耗尽。 《扒手》是这位最节俭、精神最深刻的电影制片人职业生涯的基石，是一部精心制作、精心编排的对人性恶作剧和优雅的研究，是一位导演巅峰之作。
hook_en: This incomparable story of crime and redemption from the French master Robert Bresson follows Michel, a young pickpocket who spends his days working the streets, subway cars, and train stations of Paris. As his compulsive pursuit of the thrill of stealing grows, however, so does his fear that his luck is about to run out. A cornerstone of the career of this most economical and profoundly spiritual of filmmakers, Pickpocket is an elegantly crafted, tautly choreographed study of humanity in all its mischief and grace, the work of a director at the height of his powers.

hook: 约翰·沃特斯（John Waters）凭借永远令人震惊的反主流文化轰动一时的《粉红火烈鸟》（Pink Flamingos），将低俗品味变得异常超然，这是他最臭名昭著、最大胆的电影越轨行为。异类天后Divine 是一位标志性人物，饰演一名通缉犯和她的堕落家庭躲在巴尔的摩郊外的一辆拖车里，同时陶醉于小报“最肮脏的人”的恶名。当一对习惯于绑架妇女以使她们怀孕的反社会者（明克·斯托尔和大卫·洛卡里饰）试图挑战她的头衔时，迪维恩决心向他们和世界展示“污秽”这个词的真正含义。乱伦、同类相食、捕虾和电影史上最具传奇色彩的恶心结局——沃特斯和他的快乐的梦境者乐队在这部欢快的颠覆性歌颂局外人的颂歌中，没有打破任何禁忌，其中营地奇观和漆黑讽刺对尊严的全面攻击。
hook_en: John Waters made bad taste perversely transcendent with the forever shocking counterculture sensation Pink Flamingos, his most infamous and daring cinematic transgression. Outré diva Divine is iconic as the wanted criminal hiding out with her family of degenerates in a trailer outside Baltimore while reveling in her tabloid notoriety as the “Filthiest Person Alive.” When a pair of sociopaths (Mink Stole and David Lochary) with a habit of kidnapping women in order to impregnate them attempt to challenge her title, Divine resolves to show them and the world the true meaning of the word “filth.” Incest, cannibalism, shrimping, and film history’s most legendary gross-out ending—Waters and his merry band of Dreamlanders leave no taboo unsmashed in this gleefully subversive ode to outsiderhood, in which camp spectacle and pitch-black satire are wielded in an all-out assault on respectability.

hook: 两位伟大的美国艺术家的作品融合在《捷径》中，这是由特立独行的导演罗伯特·奥尔特曼根据著名作家雷蒙德·卡佛的故事改编而成的万花筒。这部电影规模宏大，但观察细致，交织了 22 个角色在当代洛杉矶努力寻找安慰和意义的故事。非凡的演员阵容包括蒂姆·罗宾斯、朱丽安·摩尔、小罗伯特·唐尼、杰克·莱蒙和詹妮弗·杰森·李，所有人都在这部奥特曼最富有同情心的作品之一中进行了无所畏惧的表演。
hook_en: The work of two great American artists merges in Short Cuts, a kaleidoscopic adaptation of the stories of renowned author Raymond Carver by maverick director Robert Altman. Epic in scale yet meticulously observed, the film interweaves the stories of twenty-two characters as they struggle to find solace and meaning in contemporary Los Angeles. The extraordinary ensemble cast includes Tim Robbins, Julianne Moore, Robert Downey Jr., Jack Lemmon, and Jennifer Jason Leigh—all giving fearless performances in what is one of Altman’s most compassionate creations.

hook: 道格拉斯·席尔的彩色表现主义达到了高潮，这部歌剧式的悲剧发现导演将他的浓烈视觉和对美国文化的批判推向了颠覆性的极端。酒精依赖、淫荡、阳痿和致命的嫉妒——这些都是一个极度堕落的德克萨斯石油家族中的毒素。当一个理智的秘书（劳伦·巴克）不幸嫁给了这个家族的神经质继承人（罗伯特·史考特），它在她和她一生最好的朋友（罗克·哈德逊）之间造成了裂痕，引发了心理性情的愤怒和风暴。这部作品中，黛博拉·莫兰的无与伦比的放荡、奥斯卡获奖的配角表演和席尔最引人注目的布景设计，使《风吹过的地方》成为有史以来最令人厌恶的家庭肖像。
hook_en: The Technicolor expressionism of Douglas Sirk reached a fever pitch with this operatic tragedy, which finds the director pushing his florid visuals and his critiques of American culture to their subversive extremes. Alcoholism, nymphomania, impotence, and deadly jealousy—these are just some of the toxins coursing through a massively wealthy, degenerate Texan oil family. When a sensible secretary (Lauren Bacall) has the misfortune of marrying the clan’s neurotic scion (Robert Stack), it drives a wedge between him and his lifelong best friend (Rock Hudson) that unleashes a maelstrom of psychosexual angst and fury. Featuring an unforgettably debauched, Oscar-winning supporting performance by Dorothy Malone and some of Sirk’s most eye-popping mise-en-scène, Written on the Wind is as perverse a family portrait as has ever been splashed across the screen.

hook: 乔尔·科恩 (Joel Coen) 和伊桑·科恩 (Ethan Coen) 改编自科马克·麦卡锡 (Cormac McCarthy) 的小说，以 20 世纪 80 年代初德克萨斯州西部的严峻背景为背景，上演了一场机会与命运的致命游戏。当一名退休焊工和越战老兵（乔什·布洛林饰）偶然从一场毒品交易中赚到超过两百万美元后，他便发起了一波毫无意义、无情的暴力浪潮，同时他在平原上被一位疲惫不堪的警长（汤米·李·琼斯饰）和一个精神变态的杀手（哈维尔·巴登饰）跟踪。这部黑暗、面无表情的黑色边境电影获得了四项奥斯卡奖，包括最佳影片奖和最佳男配角奖，每一个残酷讽刺的命运转折都让紧张气氛和存在的不安不断加剧。
hook_en: A deadly game of chance and destiny plays out against the stark backdrop of early-1980s West Texas in Joel and Ethan Coen’s powerful adaptation of Cormac McCarthy’s novel. When he happens upon more than two million dollars from a drug deal turned desert massacre, a retired welder and Vietnam veteran (Josh Brolin) sets into motion a wave of senseless, inexorable violence as he’s stalked across the plains by a soul-weary sheriff (Tommy Lee Jones) and a psychopathic hit man (Javier Bardem). Winner of four Academy Awards—including Best Picture, and Best Supporting Actor for the indelibly disturbing Bardem—this darkly deadpan borderlands noir keeps both the tension and the existential unease mounting through each cruelly ironic twist of fate.

hook: 电影制作传奇人物罗伯托·罗西里尼将他对现实主义的热情和对日常生活的敏锐洞察力融入到这部描绘法国“太阳王”统治初期的作品中，并在此过程中重塑了古装剧。首席大臣马扎林红衣主教的去世、凡尔赛宫的修建、宫廷的奢侈膳食：所有这些都以罗西里尼在他的战后意大利当代肖像中所采用的同样细致的日常细节进行了叙述。路易十四的夺权敢于将一个具有传奇色彩的人物置于凡人的层面上。
hook_en: Filmmaking legend Roberto Rossellini brings his passion for realism and unerring eye for the everyday to this portrait of the early years of the reign of France’s “Sun King,” and in the process reinvents the costume drama. The death of chief minister Cardinal Mazarin, the construction of the palace at Versailles, the extravagant meals of the royal court: all are recounted with the same meticulous quotidian detail that Rossellini brought to his contemporary portraits of postwar Italy. The Taking of Power by Louis XIV dares to place a larger-than-life figure at the level of mere mortal.

hook: 认识披头士乐队！约翰、保罗、乔治和林戈在《埃德·沙利文秀》中亮相，在美国舞台上崭露头角。仅仅一个月后，约翰、保罗、乔治和林戈就开始致力于一个项目，将他们的革命性才华搬上大银幕。在这部影片中，乐队成员们扮演着自己的闹剧版本，捕捉到了他们正式成为这一代人中独一无二的、不敬的偶像并永远改变了音乐的惊人时刻。由理查德·莱斯特（《The Knack ...》和《How to Get It》）执导，充满喧闹、无所不包的魅力，并收录了一系列标志性流行歌曲，包括主打歌《Can't Buy Me Love》、《I Should Have Known Better》和《If I Fell》，《A Hard Day's Night》重新构思了音乐剧电影，并对音乐视频产生了不可估量的影响，是最令人疯狂的娱乐之一有史以来的电影。
hook_en: Meet the Beatles! Just one month after they exploded onto the U.S. scene with their Ed Sullivan Show appearance, John, Paul, George, and Ringo began working on a project that would bring their revolutionary talent to the big screen. This film, in which the bandmates play slapstick versions of themselves, captured the astonishing moment when they officially became the singular, irreverent idols of their generation and changed music forever. Directed with raucous, anything-goes verve by Richard Lester (The Knack . . . and How to Get It) and featuring a slew of iconic pop anthems—including the title track, “Can’t Buy Me Love,” “I Should Have Known Better,” and “If I Fell”—A Hard Day’s Night, which reconceived the movie musical and exerted an incalculable influence on the music video, is one of the most deliriously entertaining movies of all time.

hook: 在约瑟夫·L·曼凯维奇这部极具幽默感的好莱坞经典影片中，真正的戏剧是在后台上演的。一天晚上，玛戈·查宁（贝蒂·戴维斯饰）招待了一位惊喜的更衣室访客：她最崇拜的粉丝，害羞、睁大眼睛的伊芙·哈林顿（安妮·巴克斯特饰）。但随着伊芙成为玛戈生活中的固定人物，这位百老汇传奇人物很快意识到，她所谓的仰慕者打算利用她和她圈子里的每个人，包括乔治桑德斯的尖酸刻薄的批评家，作为明星之路的垫脚石。凭借曼凯维奇犀利的对话和导演，以及令人难忘的戴维斯扮演的角色，该角色重振了她的职业生涯并定义了她的职业生涯，多次获得奥斯卡奖的《关于夏娃的一切》是有史以来关于演艺界残酷性的最精彩有趣的电影。
hook_en: In Joseph L. Mankiewicz’s devastatingly witty Hollywood classic, backstage is where the real drama plays out. One night, Margo Channing (Bette Davis) entertains a surprise dressing-room visitor: her most adoring fan, the shy, wide-eyed Eve Harrington (Anne Baxter). But as Eve becomes a fixture in Margo’s life, the Broadway legend soon realizes that her supposed admirer intends to use her and everyone in her circle, including George Sanders’s acid-tongued critic, as stepping-stones to stardom. Featuring stiletto-sharp dialogue and direction by Mankiewicz, and an unforgettable Davis in the role that revived her career and came to define it, the multiple-Oscar-winning All About Eve is the most deliciously entertaining film ever made about the ruthlessness of show business.

hook: 利诺·布洛卡 (Lino Brocka) 凭借这部对 20 世纪 70 年代马尼拉的坦率描绘而获得了国际赞誉，这是这位导演在他称之为“肥皂剧”的主流电影上建立了自己的职业生涯后转向更加严肃的电影制作的一个突破性例子。一名来自省级村庄的年轻渔夫来到首都寻找他的女朋友，他的女朋友被工作的承诺引诱到那里，从此杳无音讯。与此同时，他在建筑工地做着一份低薪工作，目睹了街头的生活，毫无预警的死亡袭击、腐败和剥削司空见惯，抗议活动暗示着内乱的升级。 《光之爪中的马尼拉》将发自内心的纪录片式现实主义与好莱坞黑色电影和情节剧的叙事焦点融为一体，是菲律宾电影界最著名人物之一的痛苦嚎叫。 2013 年，菲律宾电影发展委员会、Cineteca di Bologna/L’Immagine Ritrovata 实验室与电影基金会的世界电影项目、LVN、菲律宾电影艺术家协会和 Mike De Leon 合作修复了该项目。修复工作由多哈电影学院资助。
hook_en: Lino Brocka achieved international acclaim with this candid portrait of 1970s Manila, a breakout example of the more serious-minded filmmaking the director had turned to after building a career on mainstream movies he described as “soaps.” A young fisherman from a provincial village arrives in the capital on a quest to track down his girlfriend, who was lured there with the promise of work and hasn’t been heard from since. In the meantime, he takes a low-wage job at a construction site and witnesses life on the streets, where death strikes without warning, corruption and exploitation are commonplace, and protests hint at escalating civil unrest. Mixing visceral, documentary-like realism with the narrative focus of Hollywood noir and melodrama, Manila in the Claws of Light is a howl of anguish from one of the most celebrated figures in Philippine cinema. was restored in 2013 by the Film Development Council of the Philippines and the Cineteca di Bologna/L’Immagine Ritrovata laboratory, in association with The Film Foundation’s World Cinema Project, LVN, Cinema Artists Philippines, and Mike De Leon. Restoration funded by Doha Film Institute.

hook: 凭借这个充满欲望和创造力的激动人心的寓言，简·坎皮恩 (Jane Campion) 成为第一位在戛纳电影节赢得金棕榈奖的女性。霍莉·亨特 (Holly Hunter) 在她饰演的艾达 (Ada) 中饰演一位沉默寡言的苏格兰女性艾达 (Ada)，她通过她心爱的钢琴表达了内心深处的感受，并获得了奥斯卡金像奖。当一场包办婚姻将艾达和她活泼的女儿（安娜·帕奎因，她的奥斯卡获奖处女作）带到了 19 世纪新西兰的荒野时，她发现自己与控制欲强的丈夫（萨姆·尼尔饰）和粗犷的边疆人（哈维·凯特尔饰）陷入了一场意志之战，她对他产生了一种禁忌的吸引力。凭借感性的喜怒无常的电影摄影、戏剧性的海岸风景和震撼人心的配乐，这部独特而永恒的女性觉醒之作是一种令人陶醉的感官体验，在音乐和色情激情的双生火焰中燃烧。
hook_en: With this sublimely stirring fable of desire and creativity, Jane Campion became the first woman to win a Palme d’Or at Cannes. Holly Hunter is achingly eloquent through silence in her Academy Award–winning performance as Ada, an electively mute Scottish woman who expresses her innermost feelings through her beloved piano. When an arranged marriage brings Ada and her spirited daughter (Anna Paquin, in her Oscar-winning debut) to the wilderness of nineteenth-century New Zealand, she finds herself locked in a battle of wills with both her controlling husband (Sam Neill) and a rugged frontiersman (Harvey Keitel) to whom she develops a forbidden attraction. With its sensuously moody cinematography, dramatic coastal landscapes, and sweeping score, this uniquely timeless evocation of a woman’s awakening is an intoxicating sensory experience that burns with the twin fires of music and erotic passion.

hook: 剧作家兼小说家三岛由纪夫用这部引人入胜的短片预示了他自己的暴力自杀，这是他唯一一次涉足电影制作，但却具有真正电影艺术家的表现力和自信。 1970 年三岛由纪夫去世后，所有描绘一名军官切腹的《爱国主义》(Yûkoku) 的照片都被销毁，但底片被保存下来，而这部电影在 35 年后重新出现。新观众将会惊叹于三岛由纪夫视觉的深度和清晰度，以及他对性和死亡的生动描述。该影片在此放映，可选择日语或英语字幕。
hook_en: Playwright and novelist Yukio Mishima foreshadowed his own violent suicide with this ravishing short feature, his only foray into filmmaking, yet made with the expressiveness and confidence of a true cinema artist. All prints of Patriotism (Yûkoku), which depicts the seppuku of an army officer, were destroyed after Mishima's death in 1970, though the negative was saved, and the film resurfaced thirty-five years later. New viewers will be stunned at the depth and clarity of Mishima's vision, as well as his graphic depictions of sex and death. The film is presented here with a choice of Japanese or English intertitles.

hook: 上流社会的几何学教授胡安和他富有的已婚情妇玛丽亚·何塞在深夜约会开车回来时，不小心撞到了一个骑自行车的人，然后逃跑了。由此产生的、关于内疚、不忠和勒索的精美故事揭示了西班牙贫富之间的巨大差距，并调查了一个被颓废诱惑的社会的腐败道德。胡安·安东尼奥·巴登 (Juan Antonio Bardem) 的情节剧《自行车手之死》(Muerte de un ciclista) 是对 20 世纪 50 年代佛朗哥统治下的西班牙社会的直接攻击。尽管它受到审查制度的影响，但它的刺痛永远不会减弱。
hook_en: Upper-class geometry professor Juan and his wealthy, married mistress, Maria José, driving back from a late-night rendezvous, accidentally hit a cyclist, and run. The resulting, exquisitely shot tale of guilt, infidelity, and blackmail reveals the wide gap between the rich and the poor in Spain, and surveys the corrupt ethics of a society seduced by decadence. Juan Antonio Bardem's charged melodrama Death of a Cyclist (Muerte de un ciclista) was a direct attack on 1950s Spanish society under Franco’s rule. Though it was affected by the dictates of censorship, its sting could never be dulled.

hook: 理查德·张伯伦 (Richard Chamberlain) 饰演澳大利亚律师大卫·伯顿 (David Burton)，他为一群被指控杀害自己人的原住民辩护。他怀疑受害人因违反部落禁忌而被杀，但被告否认与部落有任何联系。受到水的世界末日幻象困扰的伯顿慢慢意识到自己与原住民的关系……以及他们的预言。
hook_en: Richard Chamberlain stars as Australian lawyer David Burton, who takes on the defense of a group of aborigines accused of killing one of their own. He suspects the victim has been killed for violating a tribal taboo, but the defendants deny any tribal association. Burton, plagued by apocalyptic visions of water, slowly realizes his own involvement with the aborigines…and their prophecies.

hook: 作为香港新浪潮的杰出作品之一，《船民》通过令人难以忘怀、令人难忘的力量形象，讲述了越南战争后驱使数十万越南难民逃离家园的情况。共产党接管三年后，一名日本摄影记者（林子祥饰）前往越南，记录该国看似胜利的重生。然而，当他与一个十几岁的女孩（马季饰）和她贫困的家人成为朋友时，他开始发现政府不想让他看到的事情：在这个国家，政治镇压和贫困迫使许多人采取绝望的措施来生存，这是残酷的、常常令人震惊的现实生活。著名导演许鞍华超越了争论，以深刻的人文主义方式探讨了一个令人痛心且紧迫的主题，引起了强烈的当代共鸣。
hook_en: One of the preeminent works of the Hong Kong New Wave, Boat People is a shattering look at the circumstances that drove hundreds of thousands of Vietnamese refugees to flee their homeland in the wake of the Vietnam War, told through images of haunting, unforgettable power. Three years after the Communist takeover, a Japanese photo­journalist (George Lam) travels to Vietnam to document the country’s seemingly triumphant rebirth. When he befriends a teenage girl (Season Ma) and her destitute family, however, he begins to discover what the government doesn’t want him to see: the brutal, often shocking reality of life in a country where political repression and poverty have forced many to resort to desperate measures in order to survive. Transcending polemic, renowned director Ann Hui takes a deeply humanistic approach to a harrowing and urgent subject with searing contemporary resonance.

hook: 1972 年的慕尼黑，八位著名电影制片人各自将自己独特的艺术才华带入了奥运会的盛况中，捕捉了比赛的欢乐与痛苦以及身体运动中的动感快感，打造出了一部与众不同的美学冒险体育电影。 《八人愿景》是为了记录夏季奥运会这一最终因恐怖袭击悲剧而蒙上阴影的事件，由米洛什·福尔曼、市川昆、克劳德·勒鲁什、尤里·奥泽罗夫、阿瑟·佩恩、迈克尔·普弗莱格哈、约翰·施莱辛格和麦·泽特林共同参与制作，每个人都全权创作一部短片，重点关注奥运会中任何能激发他或她想象力的方面。由此产生的电影——从佩恩对撑杆跳运动员纯粹电影研究的引人注目的抽象，到福尔曼对十项全能音乐的俏皮不敬，再到施莱辛格对马拉松运动员一心一意的孤独的令人难忘的描绘——都是个人的、诗意的视觉的胜利，应用于人类成就的顶峰之一。
hook_en: In Munich in 1972, eight renowned filmmakers each brought their singular artistry to the spectacle of the Olympic Games, capturing the joy and pain of competition and the kinetic thrill of bodies in motion for an aesthetically adventurous sports film unlike any other. Made to document the Olympic Summer Games—an event that was ultimately overshadowed by the tragedy of a terrorist attack—Visions of Eight features contributions from Miloš Forman, Kon Ichikawa, Claude Lelouch, Juri Ozerov, Arthur Penn, Michael Pfleghar, John Schlesinger, and Mai Zetterling, each given carte blanche to create a short film focusing on any aspect of the Games that captured his or her imagination. The resulting films—ranging from the arresting abstraction of Penn’s pure cinema study of pole-vaulters to the playful irreverence of Forman’s musical take on the decathlon to Schlesinger’s haunting portrait of the single-minded solitude of a marathon runner—are triumphs of personal, poetic vision applied to one of the pinnacles of human achievement.

hook: 在约瑟夫·冯·斯滕伯格对间谍惊悚片的大气演绎中，玛琳·黛德丽进一步发展了她精明的明星形象，她扮演了一个寡妇变身的街头妓女，在第一次世界大战期间被招募为奥地利从事间谍活动。黛德丽的狡猾女主角采用代号 X-27，将她的诱惑和口是心非的天赋以及她的音乐天赋奉献给了爱国事业，直到她找到一个有价值的对手一位恶作剧的俄罗斯上校（维克多·麦克拉格伦饰）将她带入了一场致命的猫鼠游戏，并考验了她的忠诚度。冯·斯滕伯格以一贯的奢华方式重新想象了他的家乡维也纳，将这个间谍故事演绎成一场迷人的化装舞会，在这场化装舞会上，没有人是他们表面上的那个人，死亡只差一个错误的音符。
hook_en: In Josef von Sternberg’s atmospheric spin on the espionage thriller, Marlene Dietrich further develops her shrewd star persona in the role of a widow turned streetwalker who is recruited to spy for Austria during World War I. Adopting the codename X-27, Dietrich’s wily heroine devotes her gifts for seduction and duplicity—as well as her musical talents—to the patriotic cause, until she finds a worthy adversary in a roguish Russian colonel (Victor McLaglen), who draws her into a fatal game of cat and mouse and tests the strength of her loyalties. Reimagining his native Vienna with customary extravagance, von Sternberg stages this story of spycraft as a captivating masquerade in which no one is who they seem and death is only a wrong note away.

hook: 特效神童和流派大师拜伦·哈斯金（《世界大战》、《外部极限》）凭借这部精心设计的未知之旅，在世界各地的奇幻电影爱好者心中赢得了一席之地。当美国宇航员指挥官“基特”德雷珀（保罗·曼蒂饰）的宇宙飞船迫降在火星贫瘠的荒地上时，他必须为生存而战，一只宠物猴子似乎是他唯一的伙伴。但他一个人吗？ 《火星上的鲁滨逊漂流记》采用巨大的技术镜头和绚丽的彩色技术拍摄而成，是经典科幻小说中富有想象力且深受喜爱的技术奇迹。
hook_en: Special-effects wunderkind and genre master Byron Haskin (The War of the Worlds, The Outer Limits) won a place in the hearts of fantasy-film lovers everywhere with this gorgeously designed journey into the unknown. When his spaceship crash-lands on the barren wastelands of Mars, U.S. astronaut Commander “Kit” Draper (Paul Mantee) must fight for survival, with a pet monkey seemingly his only companion. But is he alone? Shot in vast Techniscope and blazing Technicolor, Robinson Crusoe on Mars is an imaginative and beloved techni-marvel of classic science fiction.

hook: 在阿基·考里斯马基 (Aki Kaurismäki) 创作的这部温暖人心的喜剧故事中，命运将年轻的非洲难民伊德里萨 (布隆丁·米格尔饰) 推向了马塞尔·马克思 (安德烈·威尔姆斯饰) 的道路，马塞尔·马克思是一位善良的波西米亚老人，在法国港口城市勒阿弗尔以擦鞋为生。凭借与生俱来的乐观精神和紧密团结的社区的支持，马塞尔勇敢地面对官员顽强地追捕男孩并将其驱逐出境。 《勒阿弗尔》是一部介于当代法国现实和过去经典法国电影之间的政治童话故事，是一部迷人而面无表情的影片，也是这位芬兰导演最好的电影之一。
hook_en: In this warmhearted comic yarn from Aki Kaurismäki, fate throws the young African refugee Idrissa (Blondin Miguel) into the path of Marcel Marx (André Wilms), a kindly old bohemian who shines shoes for a living in the French harbor city Le Havre. With inborn optimism and the support of his tight-knit community, Marcel stands up to the officials doggedly pursuing the boy for deportation. A political fairy tale that exists somewhere between the reality of contemporary France and the classic French cinema of the past, Le Havre is a charming, deadpan delight and one of the Finnish director’s finest films.

hook: 在迪·里斯 (Dee Rees) 的这部具有启发性、自信的长片处女作中，通往真实自我的道路上铺满了考验和磨难——这是一个非常罕见的成长故事，诚实地代表了酷儿黑人女性的经历。 《Pariah》以里斯剧本的细致入微和巧妙的人物塑造为基础，并围绕阿德佩罗·奥杜耶 (Adepero Oduye) 精美的层次感表演展开，讲述了布鲁克林青少年阿利克 (Alike) 的故事，她在初恋和心痛的情感雷区中航行，当她在一个不为他们提供空间的系统中表达自己的性别和性身份时，她正在经历初恋、心痛和家人的反对。通过布拉德福德·杨富有表现力的摄影技术，这部感人至深的肖像画在脆弱中找到了力量，在放手中获得了解放。
hook_en: The path to living as one’s authentic self is paved with trials and tribulations in this revelatory, assured feature debut by Dee Rees—the all-too-rare coming-of-age tale to honestly represent the experiences of queer Black women. Grounded in the fine-grained specificity and deft characterizations of Rees’s script and built around a beautifully layered performance from Adepero Oduye, Pariah follows Brooklyn teenager Alike, who is navigating the emotional minefields of first love and heartache and the disapproval of her family as she expresses her gender and sexual identities within a system that does not make space for them. Achieving an aching intimacy with its subject through the expressive cinematography of Bradford Young, this deeply felt portrait finds strength in vulnerability and liberation in letting go.

hook: 在以史诗系列片《十诫》和《三色》三部曲震惊电影界之前，伟大的波兰电影制片人克日什托夫·基斯洛夫斯基制作了他的第一部形而上天才作品《盲目的机会》，这是一部引人入胜的戏剧，讲述了调和政治理想与个人幸福的困难。这部令人难忘的电影讲述了维特克（博古斯瓦夫·琳达饰）的故事，她是一名在共产主义波兰前途未卜的医科学生；基斯洛夫斯基将维特克的旅程戏剧化地描述为一系列不同的可能性，表明机会和选择一样主宰着我们的生活。首先受到波兰政府的镇压，然后又受到审查，《盲目的机会》在这里以其完整的原始形式呈现。
hook_en: Before he stunned the cinematic world with the epic series The Decalogue and the Three Colors trilogy, the great Polish filmmaker Krzysztof Kieślowski made his first work of metaphysical genius, Blind Chance, a compelling drama about the difficulty of reconciling political ideals with personal happiness. This unforgettable film follows Witek (the magnetic Bogusław Linda), a medical student with an uncertain future in Communist Poland; Kieślowski dramatizes Witek’s journey as a series of different possibilities, suggesting that chance rules our lives as much as choice does. First suppressed and then censored by the Polish government, Blind Chance is here presented in its complete original form.

hook: 一位在意大利度假的美国家庭主妇（詹妮弗·琼斯饰）不情愿地决定结束她与一位意大利学者（蒙哥马利·克利夫特饰）的短暂恋情。她逃到罗马特米尼车站，在那里向他告别，但他恳求她留下来。影片的情节很简单；它的生产却不是。导演维托里奥·德·西卡和制片人大卫·O·塞尔兹尼克之间的合作陷入困境，导致同一部电影被剪辑成两个版本。德西卡的版本《终点站》放映了一个半小时，但在预演令人失望后，塞尔兹尼克在未经德西卡许可的情况下对其进行了严格的重新剪辑，并将标题改为《美国妻子的不检点》。 Criterion Collection 很荣幸地推出这个备受争议的版本的两个版本。
hook_en: An American housewife (Jennifer Jones) vacationing in Italy reluctantly decides to put an end to her brief affair with an Italian academic (Montgomery Clift). She flees to Rome’s Stazione Termini, where she bids him farewell, but he begs her to stay. The film’s plot is simple; its production was not. The troubled collaboration between director Vittorio De Sica and producer David O. Selznick resulted in two cuts of the same film. De Sica’s version, Terminal Station, was screened at a length of one-and-a-half hours, but after disappointing previews, Selznick severely re-edited it and changed the title to Indiscretion of an American Wife without De Sica’s permission. The Criterion Collection is proud to present both versions of this controversial release.

hook: 贝尔纳多·贝托鲁奇的《末代皇帝》赢得了九项奥斯卡金像奖，出人意料地包揽了所有提名类别的奖项——对于一部由意大利人执导、国际演员阵容主演的具有挑战性、多层次的史诗片来说，这是一项壮举。然而，这部电影的题材无论过去还是现在都无可否认地强大——讲述了溥仪的一生。溥​​仪于 1908 年登基，时年三岁，随后亲眼目睹了紫禁城城墙内外数十年的文化和政治剧变。电影摄影师维托里奥·斯托拉罗和美术指导费迪南多·斯卡菲奥蒂以惊人的细节和无与伦比的工艺再现了清朝中国，《末代皇帝》也是对一个人调和个人责任和政治遗产的亲密人物研究。
hook_en: Bernardo Bertolucci’s The Last Emperor won nine Academy Awards, unexpectedly sweeping every category in which it was nominated—quite a feat for a challenging, multilayered epic directed by an Italian and starring an international cast. Yet the scope of the film was, and remains, undeniably powerful—the life of Emperor Puyi, who took the throne in 1908, at age three, before witnessing decades of cultural and political upheaval within and without the walls of the Forbidden City. Recreating Qing-dynasty China with astonishing detail and unparalleled craftsmanship by cinematographer Vittorio Storaro and production designer Ferdinando Scarfiotti, The Last Emperor is also an intimate character study of one man reconciling personal responsibility and political legacy.

hook: 克洛德·尤特拉 (Claude Jutra) 对 20 世纪 40 年代寒冷的魁北克乡村中一个男孩的成长进行了令人回味的描绘，一直被评论家和学者视为有史以来最伟大的加拿大电影。精致、自然，带着怀旧和威胁的鲜明混合色彩，《我的安托万叔叔》讲述了伯努瓦第一次遭遇性和死亡的双重恐惧，以及生活在当地石棉矿主控制下的村民们的故事。 《我的安托万叔叔》以一个不祥的圣诞节为背景，是一部与众不同的假日电影，真实细致地描绘了童年的黄昏。
hook_en: Claude Jutra's evocative portrait of a boy's coming of age in wintry 1940s rural Quebec has been consistently cited by critics and scholars as the greatest Canadian film of all time. Delicate, naturalistic, and tinged with a striking mix of nostalgia and menace, Mon oncle Antoine follows Benoit, as he first encounters the twin terrors of sex and death, and his fellow villagers, who are living under the thumb of the local asbestos mine owner. Set during one ominous Christmas, Mon oncle Antoine is a holiday film unlike any other, and an authentically detailed illustration of childhood’s twilight.

hook: 席琳·席安玛 (Céline Sciamma) 的《燃烧女子肖像》的后续作品超越时空，编织了一个关于悲伤、家庭和代际联系的精致寓言。祖母去世后，八岁的耐莉（约瑟芬·桑斯饰）陪着心烦意乱的母亲（尼娜·默里斯饰）回到了童年的家。在那里，耐莉遇到了另一个年轻女孩（加布里埃尔·桑斯饰），母女俩以一种谁都无法想象的方式走到了一起。 《娇小的妈妈》通过明亮、质感丰富的图像唤起了童年永恒的好奇状态，带领观众踏上一段内心之旅，体验一个安静、神奇的情感时间旅行故事。
hook_en: Céline Sciamma’s follow-up to Portrait of a Lady on Fire transcends time and space to weave a delicate fable about grief, family, and connection across generations. In the wake of her grandmother’s death, eight-year-old Nelly (Joséphine Sanz) accompanies her distraught mother (Nina Meurisse) to her childhood home. There, Nelly’s encounter with another young girl (Gabrielle Sanz) brings mother and daughter together in a way neither could have ever imagined. Evoking childhood’s perpetual state of wonder through luminous, richly textured images, Petite maman takes viewers on a journey inward for a quietly miraculous tale of emotional time travel.

hook: 乡村牙买加音乐家伊万，一个乡村牙买加音乐家，为了 fame 和 fortune 前往城市金斯敦。阴险的唱片制作人和腐败的警察将他推到了绝望的境地。最终，他以一名杀人逃犯的身份获得了名声。《更艰难的来临》展示了牙买加最伟大的音乐之一，这首歌在 20 世纪 70 年代早期将雷鬼的 catchy 和 subversive 节奏带到了美国。
hook_en: Reggae superstar Jimmy Cliff is Ivan, a rural Jamaican musician who journeys to the city of Kingston in search of fame and fortune. Pushed to desperate circumstances by shady record producers and corrupt cops, he finally achieves notoriety—as a murderous outlaw. Boasting some of the greatest music ever produced in Jamaica, The Harder They Come brought the catchy and subversive rhythms of the Rastas to the U.S. in the early 1970s.

hook: 约翰·卡索维茨在《灼热的面孔》中将一段正在分崩离析的婚姻置于显微镜下。影片以高对比度 16 毫米黑白镜头拍摄，讲述了工业领袖理查德（约翰·马利饰）和他的妻子玛丽亚（林恩·卡林饰）试图摆脱在他人怀抱中空虚关系的痛苦，但徒劳无功的故事。 《面孔》以马利、卡林和卡索维茨的常客吉娜·罗兰兹和西摩·卡塞尔令人惊叹的紧张表演为特色，以电影中罕见的残酷诚实和同情心面对现代疏离和性别之战。
hook_en: John Cassavetes puts a disintegrating marriage under the microscope in the searing Faces. Shot in high-contrast 16 mm black and white, the film follows the futile attempts of the captain of industry Richard (John Marley) and his wife, Maria (Lynn Carlin), to escape the anguish of their empty relationship in the arms of others. Featuring astonishingly nervy performances from Marley, Carlin, and Cassavetes regulars Gena Rowlands and Seymour Cassel, Faces confronts modern alienation and the battle of the sexes with a brutal honesty and compassion rarely matched in cinema.

hook: 只有滨口龙介对人与人之间互动的神秘共鸣有着非凡的敏感度，他才能横扫国际奖项（包括奥斯卡最佳国际影片奖），并以一部关于安东·契诃夫戏剧的实验性上演的、以九种语言呈现、改编自村上春树故事的三小时电影来激励世界各地的观众。这位日本导演凭借《驾驶我的车》确立了自己在当代电影最重要声音中的地位。妻子意外去世两年后，一福佑介（西岛秀俊饰）来到广岛，为一个戏剧节执导一部《万尼亚叔叔》，通过与与他有着复杂历史的演员（冈田将树饰）和与他建立了令人惊讶的融洽关系的司机（三浦东子饰）的关系，他发现自己正面临着自己的情感伤痕。这个关于爱、艺术、悲伤和治愈的安静迷人的故事最终是对在似乎没有路可走的情况下继续生活意味着什么的宣泄探索。
hook_en: Only Ryusuke Hamaguchi, with his extraordinary sensitivity to the mysterious resonances of human interactions, could sweep up international awards (including the Oscar for Best International Feature) and galvanize audiences everywhere with a pensive three-hour movie—presented in nine languages and adapted from Haruki Murakami stories—about an experimental staging of an Anton Chekhov play. With Drive My Car, the Japanese director has confirmed his place among contemporary cinema’s most vital voices. Two years after his wife’s unexpected death, Yusuke Kafuku (Hidetoshi Nishijima) arrives in Hiroshima to direct a production of Uncle Vanya for a theater festival and, through relationships with an actor (Masaki Okada) with whom he shares a tangled history and a chauffeur (Toko Miura) with whom he develops a surprising rapport, finds himself facing up to his emotional scars. This quietly mesmerizing tale of love, art, grief, and healing is ultimately a cathartic exploration of what it means to go on living when there seems to be no road ahead.

hook: 《之前》三部曲的第一部以两个孤独的年轻陌生人之间的偶然相遇开始，这是对浪漫可能性的兴奋的精致低调的颂歌。巴黎大学生席琳和好斗的美国游客杰西在开往维也纳的火车上一拍即合，冲动地决定在他第二天早上返回美国之前一起度过一天。当两人漫步在这座庄严城市的街道上时，理查德·林克莱特温柔观察的目光捕捉到了年轻爱情的不确定性和陶醉，从最初尴尬的吸引力到席琳和杰西在不可避免的分离时做出的充满希望的承诺。
hook_en: An exquisitely understated ode to the thrill of romantic possibility, the inaugural installment of The Before Trilogy opens with a chance encounter between two solitary young strangers. After they hit it off on a train bound for Vienna, the Paris university student Celine and the scrappy American tourist Jesse impulsively decide to spend a day together before he returns to the U.S. the next morning. As the pair roam the streets of the stately city, Richard Linklater’s tenderly observant gaze captures the uncertainty and intoxication of young love, from the first awkward stirrings of attraction to the hopeful promise that Celine and Jesse make upon their inevitable parting.

hook: 加里·库珀、弗雷德里克·马奇和米里亚姆·霍普金斯在这部欧陆前法典喜剧中饰演三个在巴黎签订了成人“绅士协议”的美国人，这部喜剧由本·赫克特自由改编自诺埃尔·科沃德的戏剧，由恩斯特·刘别谦执导。这部电影讲述了一个下流的关系故事和对创造性追求的诙谐看法，讲述了一位商业艺术家（霍普金斯饰）无法或不愿意在她在前往光之城的火车上遇到的同样风度翩翩的画家（库珀饰）和剧作家（马奇饰）之间做出选择的故事。 《生活设计》是刘别谦最性感的作品，是一场既温文尔雅又充满活力的娱乐节目，由三位最具魅力的明星主演。
hook_en: Gary Cooper, Fredric March, and Miriam Hopkins play a trio of Americans in Paris who enter into a very adult “gentleman’s agree­ment” in this continental pre-Code comedy, freely adapted by Ben Hecht from a play by Noël Coward and directed by Ernst Lubitsch. A risqué relationship story and a witty take on creative pursuits, the film concerns a commercial artist (Hopkins) unable—or unwilling—to choose between the equally dashing painter (Cooper) and playwright (March) she meets on a train en route to the City of Light. Design for Living is Lubitsch at his sexiest, an entertainment at once debonair and racy, featuring three stars at the height of their allure.

hook: 让·雷诺阿的《游戏规则》被认为是有史以来最伟大的电影之一，它以一部礼仪喜剧的形式对腐败的法国社会进行了严厉的批评，影片中在侯爵乡村城堡度过的周末揭露了一群上流资产阶级熟人的丑陋真相。这部电影有着一段动荡的历史：1939年首映时观众的强烈反应导致该片被剪辑，原版底片在二战期间被毁；直到 1959 年才被重建。这个版本几十年来一直让观众惊叹不已，现在就在这里展示。
hook_en: Considered one of the greatest films ever made, Jean Renoir’s The Rules of the Game is a scathing critique of corrupt French society cloaked in a comedy of manners in which a weekend at a marquis’s country château lays bare some ugly truths about a group of haut-bourgeois acquaintances. The film has had a tumultuous history: it was subjected to cuts after the violent response of the audience at its 1939 premiere, and the original negative was destroyed during World War II; it wasn’t reconstructed until 1959. That version, which has stunned viewers for decades, is presented here.

hook: 墨西哥埃塞俄比亚电影制片人杰西卡·贝希尔 (Jessica Beshir) 的处女作是一部个人愿景的崇高作品，是一部沉浸在埃塞俄比亚奥罗莫和哈拉里社区世界的催眠纪录片，在这些地方，一种商品——卡塔叶，一种令人欣快的植物，曾经因其所谓的神秘特性而备受推崇——主宰着日常生活的仪式和节奏。仿佛在药物本身的影响下，法亚·达伊展开了令人陶醉的恍惚状态电影，捕捉了每个人存在的亲密时刻，从庄稼的收割者到迷失在麻醉烟雾中的人们，再到绝望但坚定的年轻一代，寻求逃离该地区的政治冲突。导演精致的单色电影摄影——每一帧都是光影雕刻的杰作——以及影片中时间弯曲的椭圆形剪辑，创造了一种徘徊在意识和梦境之间的令人陶醉的感官体验。
hook_en: A sublime work of personal vision, the debut feature by the Mexican Ethiopian filmmaker Jessica Beshir is a hypnotic documentary immersion in the world of Ethiopia’s Oromo and Harari communities, places where one commodity—khat, a euphoria-inducing plant once prized for its supposedly mystical properties—holds sway over the rituals and rhythms of everyday life. As if under the influence of the drug itself, Faya dayi unfurls as intoxicating, trance-state cinema, capturing intimate moments in the existence of everyone from the harvesters of the crop to people lost in its narcotic haze to a desperate but determined younger generation searching for an escape from the region’s political strife. The director’s exquisite monochrome cinematography—each frame a masterpiece sculpted from light and shadow—and the film’s time-bending, elliptical editing create a ravishing sensory experience that hovers between consciousness and dreaming.

hook: 作为最早的越狱片之一，《大幻影》常被奉为影史杰作。让·雷诺阿这部反战杰作里，让·迦本与皮埃尔·弗雷内饰演一战德军战俘营里的法国士兵，埃里希·冯·施特罗海姆则是令人难忘的劳芬斯坦上尉。
hook_en: One of the very first prison escape movies, Grand Illusion is hailed as one of the greatest films ever made. Jean Renoir's antiwar masterpiece stars Jean Gabin and Pierre Fresnay as French soldiers held in a World War I German prison camp, and Erich von Stroheim as the unforgettable Captain von Rauffenstein.

hook: 吉布里尔·迪奥普·曼贝蒂 (Djibril Diop Mambéty) 将超现实主义与自然主义令人惊叹地融合在一起，描绘了 20 世纪 70 年代初塞内加尔独立后的幻灭的支离破碎的肖像。在这部流浪汉奇幻剧中，心怀不满的年轻恋人安塔和莫里厌倦了达喀尔，渴望逃离他们想象中的法国所提供的魅力和舒适，但他们的计划因实际和神秘的障碍而受挫。时而狂躁，时而沉思，Touki bouki 具有前卫的情感，其特点是生动的图像、阴郁的幽默、非传统的剪辑和锯齿状的音景，它体现了 Mambéty 以新方式讲述非洲故事的承诺。
hook_en: With a stunning mix of the surreal and the naturalistic, Djibril Diop Mambéty paints a fractured portrait of the disenchantment of postindependence Senegal in the early 1970s. In this picaresque fantasy-drama, the disaffected young lovers Anta and Mory, fed up with Dakar, long to escape to the glamour and comforts they imagine France has to offer, but their plan is confounded by obstacles both practical and mystical. Alternately manic and meditative, Touki bouki has an avant-garde sensibility characterized by vivid imagery, bleak humor, unconventional editing, and jagged soundscapes, and it demonstrates Mambéty’s commitment to telling African stories in new ways.

hook: 于洛先生，雅克·塔蒂笔下可爱的小丑，在海滨度假胜地度假，他的出现引发了一场又一场的灾难。塔蒂的温柔闹剧杰作是一系列毫不费力地精心设计的视觉笑话，涉及狗、船和鞭炮；这是于洛先生系列的第一部作品，也是该系列的第一部作品，也使该系列的制作者跻身国际明星行列。
hook_en: Monsieur Hulot, Jacques Tati’s endearing clown, takes a holiday at a seaside resort, where his presence provokes one catastrophe after another. Tati’s masterpiece of gentle slapstick is a series of effortlessly well-choreographed sight gags involving dogs, boats, and firecrackers; it was the first entry in the Hulot series and the film that launched its maker to international stardom.

hook: 灵性狂喜与体制的虚伪，在无声时代的巅峰之作中达到了强烈的现实感。电影记录了乔安·德·芳汀在被处决前的审判过程，丹麦大师卡尔·托尔·德雷尔用惊人的 immediacy 描绘了她的痛苦，运用了各种技巧——如表现主义的照明、相互关联的场景、令人痛苦的亲密特写——将观众带入她的主观体验中。支撑德雷尔大胆的形式实验的是传奇女演员 Renée Falconetti 的表演，她那带着幽灵般面容的表演，既传达了殉道的痛苦，也传达了殉道的喜悦。
hook_en: Spiritual rapture and institutional hypocrisy come to stark, vivid life in one of the most transcendent masterpieces of the silent era. Chronicling the trial of Joan of Arc in the hours leading up to her execution, Danish master Carl Theodor Dreyer depicts her torment with startling immediacy, employing an array of techniques—expressionistic lighting, interconnected sets, painfully intimate close-ups—to immerse viewers in her subjective experience. Anchoring Dreyer’s audacious formal experimentation is a legendary performance by Renée Falconetti, whose haunted face channels both the agony and the ecstasy of martyrdom.

hook: 费里尼回到童年的外省风景，用这场嘉年华般的追忆，在罗马电影城的摄影棚里重建故乡里米尼：日常成了社会仪式、青春期欲望、男性幻想与政治暗流的马戏团。他以一串温暖的漫画式人物，深情唤起被记忆光晕笼罩的消逝世界，同时又嘲弄教会与国家的权威，讽刺被法西斯麻木的国度。第四次拿下奥斯卡最佳外语片的《阿玛柯德》，仍是费里尼最受喜爱的作品之一：罗图诺的彩色摄影、多纳蒂铺张的服装布景，与尼诺·罗塔带着乡愁的配乐，织在一起。
hook_en: Federico Fellini returned to the provincial landscape of his childhood with this carnivalesque reminiscence, recreating his hometown of Rimini in Cinecittà’s studios and rendering its daily life as a circus of social rituals, adolescent desires, male fantasies, and political subterfuge. Sketching a gallery of warmly observed comic caricatures, Fellini affectionately evokes a vanished world haloed with the glow of memory, even as he sends up authority figures representing church and state, satirizing a country stultified by Fascism. Winner of Fellini’s fourth Academy Award for best foreign-language film, Amarcord remains one of the director’s best-loved creations, beautifully weaving together Giuseppe Rotunno’s colorful cinematography, Danilo Donati’s extravagant costumes and sets, and Nino Rota’s nostalgia-tinged score.

hook: 在被占领的捷克斯洛伐克的一个乡村火车站，一名笨手笨脚的调度员学徒渴望摆脱童贞。这位年轻人无视战争和周围的抵抗，踏上了性觉醒和自我发现的旅程，在他沉睡的死水仓库里遇到了一个充满挫折、色情和冒险的宇宙。荣获奥斯卡金像奖的《密切关注的列车》幽默而温柔，是人类观察的杰作，也是捷克新浪潮中最受欢迎的电影之一。
hook_en: At a village railway station in occupied Czechoslovakia, a bumbling dispatcher’s apprentice longs to liberate himself from his virginity. Oblivious to the war and the resistance that surrounds him, this young man embarks on a journey of sexual awakening and self-discovery, encountering a universe of frustration, eroticism, and adventure within his sleepy backwater depot. Wry and tender, Academy Award™-winning Closely Watched Trains is a masterpiece of human observation and one of the best-loved films of the Czech New Wave.

hook: 约翰·卡索维茨的导演处女作围绕纽约市浅肤色黑人女性莱莉娅（莱利亚·戈多尼饰）和白人托尼（安东尼·雷饰）之间的爱情故事展开。当托尼遇到莱莉娅的深色皮肤爵士乐歌手兄弟休（休·赫德饰）时，托尼发现她的种族血统并不像他想象的那样，两人的关系陷入危险。 《影子》在曼哈顿外景拍摄，演员和工作人员大多是非专业演员和工作人员，这是一部具有深刻意义的作品，被广泛认为是美国独立电影运动的先驱。
hook_en: John Cassavetes’s directorial debut revolves around a romance in New York City between Lelia (Lelia Goldoni), a light- skinned black woman, and Tony (Anthony Ray), a white man. The relationship is put in jeopardy when Tony meets Lelia’s darker-skinned jazz singer brother, Hugh (Hugh Hurd), and discovers that her racial heritage is not what he thought it was.
