Shot on location in Manhattan with a mostly nonprofessional cast and crew, Shadows is a penetrating work that is widely considered the forerunner of the American independent film movement.

hook: 这部感性、观察力强、表演精美的奇迹是英国作家兼导演兼编辑安德鲁·黑格的突破性长片。很少有电影像这部关于性的故事那样诚实地描述和讨论，讲述了两个截然不同的年轻人（令人兴奋的银幕新人汤姆·卡伦和克里斯·纽）在英国中部地区的一夜情，后来发展成周末的田园诗。这是一部情感上赤裸裸的电影，既是当代同性恋生活复杂性的无价快照，也是对爱情的普遍共鸣的描绘。
hook_en: This sensual, remarkably observed, beautifully acted wonder is the breakout feature from British writer-director-editor Andrew Haigh. Rarely has a film been as honest about sexuality—in both depiction and discussion—as this tale of a one-night stand that develops into a weekend-long idyll for two very different young men (exciting screen newcomers Tom Cullen and Chris New) in the English Midlands. It’s an emotionally naked film that’s at once an invaluable snapshot of the complexities of contemporary gay living and a universally resonant portrait of a love affair.

hook: 杰弗里·博蒙特（凯尔·麦克拉克伦饰）从大学回家后发现了一个令人不安的发现：田野里躺着一只被割断的人耳。在接下来的谜团中，编剧兼导演大卫·林奇深入探究了小镇生活如画的表面之下，时而恐怖，时而黑色幽默。在调查的驱使下，杰弗里发现自己越来越接近他的业余侦探同伴桑迪·威廉姆斯（劳拉·邓恩饰），以及他们感兴趣的休闲歌手多萝西·瓦伦斯（伊莎贝拉·罗西里尼饰），并面对弗兰克·布斯（丹尼斯·霍珀饰）的愤怒，他是一个不惜一切代价想要抓住多萝西的精神病患者。凭借激烈的表演和令人难以忘怀的强大场景和图像，《蓝丝绒》展现了令人难忘的失落纯真景象，也是二十世纪末最具影响力的美国电影之一。
hook_en: Home from college, Jeffrey Beaumont (Kyle MacLachlan) makes an unsettling discovery: a severed human ear, lying in a field. In the mystery that follows, by turns terrifying and darkly funny, writer-director David Lynch burrows deep beneath the picturesque surfaces of small-town life. Driven to investigate, Jeffrey finds himself drawing closer to his fellow amateur sleuth, Sandy Williams (Laura Dern), as well as their person of interest, lounge singer Dorothy Vallens (Isabella Rossellini)—and facing the fury of Frank Booth (Dennis Hopper), a psychopath who will stop at nothing to keep Dorothy in his grasp. With intense performances and hauntingly powerful scenes and images, Blue Velvet is an unforgettable vision of innocence lost, and one of the most influential American films of the late twentieth century.

hook: 到六十年代中期，英格玛·伯格曼已经塑造了许多电影中最令人难忘的形象。但凭借激进的角色，他达到了视觉诗歌的新水平。在伯格曼一系列传奇表演的第一场中，丽芙·乌尔曼饰演一位莫名其妙地哑了的舞台演员。同样迷人的比比·安德森（Bibi Andersson）是一位饶舌的年轻护士，在偏远的岛屿小屋里照顾她。当她们被隔离在一起时，她们经历了一种神秘的精神和情感转移。颇具影响力的《女神异闻录》由斯文·尼克维斯特以惊人的细微差别表演，并以鲜明的对比和柔和的光线拍摄，是一部具有深刻心理深度的穿透性、梦幻般的作品。
hook_en: By the midsixties, Ingmar Bergman had already conjured many of the cinema’s most unforgettable images. But with the radical Persona, he attained new levels of visual poetry. In the first of a series of legendary performances for Bergman, Liv Ullmann plays a stage actor who has inexplicably gone mute; an equally mesmerizing Bibi Andersson is the garrulous young nurse caring for her in a remote island cottage. While isolated together there, the women undergo a mysterious spiritual and emotional transference. Performed with astonishing nuance and shot in stark contrast and soft light by Sven Nykvist, the influential Persona is a penetrating, dreamlike work of profound psychological depth.

hook: 在《爱在黎明破晓前》惊心动魄的续集中，席琳在巴黎新书巡演即将结束时找到了杰西，他现在是一名作家，距离他登上返回美国的航班只剩下几个小时了。两人在维也纳短暂恋情近十年后相遇，两人就职业挫折、婚姻失望和成年妥协等问题进行了越来越坦诚的交流，发现他们的化学反应重新燃起。在对人与人之间联系的短暂性的紧迫感的推动下，《日落之前》仍然是理查德·林克莱特对时间无情流逝以及爱情似乎阻止时间前进的最诱人的实验。
hook_en: In the breathtaking follow-up to Before Sunrise, Celine tracks down Jesse, now an author, at the tail end of his book tour in Paris, with only a few hours left before he is to board a flight back home to the States. Meeting almost a decade after their short-lived romance in Vienna, the pair find their chemistry rekindled by increasingly candid exchanges about professional setbacks, marital disappointments, and the compromises of adulthood. Impelled by an urgent sense of the transience of human connection, Before Sunset remains Richard Linklater’s most seductive experiment with time’s inexorable passage and the way love can seem to stop it in its tracks.

hook: 罗伯托·罗西里尼的战争三部曲的最后一章是最具毁灭性的，通过一个十二岁男孩的眼睛看到了被毁灭的柏林的肖像。年轻的埃德蒙与生病的父亲和两个年长的兄弟姐妹住在一栋被炸毁的公寓楼里，他大部分时间都在无人监管的情况下流浪，陷入一群青少年的黑市计划中，并受到一位同情纳粹的前教师的邪恶影响。 《德国零年》大胆而令人心碎地审视了法西斯主义对社会和个人造成的后果。
hook_en: The concluding chapter of Roberto Rossellini’s War Trilogy is the most devastating, a portrait of an obliterated Berlin, seen through the eyes of a twelve-year-old boy. Living in a bombed-out apartment building with his sick father and two older siblings, young Edmund is mostly left to wander unsupervised, getting ensnared in the black-market schemes of a group of teenagers and coming under the nefarious influence of a Nazi-sympathizing ex-teacher. Germany Year Zero is a daring, gut-wrenching look at the consequences of fascism, for society and the individual.

hook: 纳粹集中营解放十年后，电影制片人阿兰·雷乃在《夜与雾》（Nuit et brouillard）中记录了奥斯维辛和马伊达内克的废弃场地，这是最早反映大屠杀的电影之一。雷奈将废弃营地空荡荡的建筑的寂静与令人难忘的战时镜头放在一起，调查了人类的暴力能力，并提出了毁灭性的暗示，即这种恐怖可能会再次发生。
hook_en: Ten years after the liberation of the Nazi concentration camps, filmmaker Alain Resnais documented the abandoned grounds of Auschwitz and Majdanek in Night and Fog (Nuit et brouillard), one of the first cinematic reflections on the Holocaust. Juxtaposing the stillness of the abandoned camps’ empty buildings with haunting wartime footage, Resnais investigates humanity’s capacity for violence, and presents the devastating suggestion that such horrors could occur again.

hook: 很少有电影能像韩国流行音乐《恶魔猎手》那样风靡全球，这部荣获奥斯卡奖的电影充满了令人眼花缭乱的动画、令人难忘的角色和朗朗上口的歌曲。影片的中心是排行榜上名列前茅的女子组合 HUNTR/X，其三名成员——鲁米、米拉和佐伊——一直忙于应对明星压力，同时承担保护粉丝免受超自然力量侵害的秘密职责。当他们的恶魔敌人突然以敌对男孩乐队的形式出现时，三人组必须克服最深的自我怀疑，并用他们的音乐来保护人类。这种跨越代际的现象充分借鉴了古代和现代的韩国文化，以其友谊和自我接纳的信息激励了数百万粉丝。
hook_en: Few films have taken the world by storm quite like KPop Demon Hunters, an Academy Award–winning sensation overflowing with dazzling animation, unforgettable characters, and tenaciously catchy songs. At the film’s center is the chart-topping girl group HUNTR/X, whose three members—Rumi, Mira, and Zoey—have been busy juggling the pressures of stardom with their secret duty to shield their fans from supernatural forces. When their demon enemies suddenly take the form of a rival boy band, the trio must overcome their deepest self-doubts and use their music to protect humanity. Richly layered with references to Korean culture both ancient and modern, this generation-bridging phenomenon has inspired millions of fans with its message of friendship and self-acceptance.

hook: 《迷迭香的婴儿》是罗曼·波兰斯基的好莱坞处女作，既恐怖又黑色喜剧。这部极其有趣的噩梦忠实地改编自艾拉·莱文的畅销书，由米娅·法罗主演，她饰演一位年轻的准妈妈，她越来越怀疑她过于友好的年长邻居（由西德尼·布莱克默和奥斯卡获奖者露丝·戈登饰演）和自私自利的丈夫（约翰·卡萨维茨饰演）正在策划针对她和她的孩子的邪恶阴谋。波兰斯基这部不敬虔的杰作催生了数十年的神秘电影，它从未因纯粹的心理恐怖而被超越。
hook_en: Horrifying and darkly comic, Rosemary’s Baby was Roman Polanski’s Hollywood debut. This wildly entertaining nightmare, faithfully adapted from Ira Levin’s best seller, stars a revelatory Mia Farrow as a young mother-to-be who grows increasingly suspicious that her overfriendly elderly neighbors (played by Sidney Blackmer and an Oscar-winning Ruth Gordon) and self-involved husband (John Cassavetes) are hatching a satanic plot against her and her baby. In the decades of occult cinema that Polanski’s ungodly masterpiece has spawned, it has never been outdone for sheer psychological terror.

hook: 保罗·托马斯·安德森 (Paul Thomas Anderson) 的这部浪漫喜剧令人眼花缭乱，每个角落都潜藏着混乱。新奇马桶塞推销员巴里·伊根（亚当·桑德勒，在他的第一个戏剧角色中展现了非凡的多才多艺）努力应对自己反复无常的脾气，整天收集飞行常客优惠券并躲避七个姐妹的侮辱。当巴里无意中吸引了一位名叫莉娜（艾米丽·沃森饰）的神秘女子时，新生活的希望出现了，但当他成为性电话诈骗接线员和她精神错乱的老板（菲利普·塞默·霍夫曼饰）的牺牲品时，他们刚刚萌芽的关系受到了威胁。在乔恩·布里昂 (Jon Brion) 巴洛克未来主义配乐的强劲动力的推动下，荣获戛纳电影节大奖的《醉酒爱情》将经典好莱坞精神和雅克·塔蒂的奇思怪想融入到一首对新浪漫的狂热的独特颂歌中。
hook_en: Chaos lurks in every corner of this giddily off-kilter foray into romantic comedy by Paul Thomas Anderson. Struggling to cope with his erratic temper, novelty-toilet-plunger salesman Barry Egan (Adam Sandler, demonstrating remarkable versatility in his first dramatic role) spends his days collecting frequent-flier-mile coupons and dodging the insults of his seven sisters. The promise of a new life emerges when Barry inadvertently attracts the affection of a mysterious woman named Lena (Emily Watson), but their budding relationship is threatened when he falls prey to the swindling operator of a phone sex line and her deranged boss (played with maniacal brio by Philip Seymour Hoffman). Fueled by the careening momentum of a baroque-futurist score by Jon Brion, the Cannes-award-winning Punch-Drunk Love channels the spirit of classic Hollywood and the whimsy of Jacques Tati into an idiosyncratic ode to the delirium of new romance.

hook: 芭芭拉·洛登凭借她的第一部也是唯一一部故事片——一部由她自编、导演和主演的倒霉剧情片——成为美国独立电影的开创性作品，将一种在银幕上很少见到的角色带入了生活。影片以烟尘缭绕的宾夕法尼亚州为背景，以极其亲密的真实风格拍摄，讲述了性格冷漠、说话轻声细语的万达（洛登饰），她离开了丈夫，失去了孩子的监护权，现在发现自己孤身一人，在肮脏的酒吧和汽车旅馆之间漂泊，在那里她成为了一系列冷酷男人的牺牲品，其中包括一名银行劫匪，他将她卷入了他的下一个犯罪计划。 《旺达》是一部迄今难以一睹的杰作，但却对一代又一代的艺术家和电影制片人产生了巨大的影响，它描绘了一个被困在社会边缘的女性的富有同情心和痛苦的肖像。万达由加州大学洛杉矶分校电影电视档案馆修复。古驰和电影基金会提供修复资金。
hook_en: With her first and only feature film—a hard-luck drama she wrote, directed, and starred in—Barbara Loden turned in a groundbreaking work of American independent cinema, bringing to life a kind of character seldom seen on-screen. Set amid a soot-choked Pennsylvania landscape, and shot in an intensely intimate vérité style, the film takes up with distant and soft-spoken Wanda (Loden), who has left her husband, lost custody of her children, and now finds herself alone, drifting between dingy bars and motels, where she falls prey to a series of callous men—including a bank robber who ropes her into his next criminal scheme. An until now difficult-to-see masterpiece that has nonetheless exerted an outsize influence on generations of artists and filmmakers, Wanda is a compassionate and wrenching portrait of a woman stranded on society’s margins. Wanda was restored by the UCLA Film & Television Archive. Restoration funding provided by Gucci and The Film Foundation.

hook: G. W. 帕布斯特（G. W. Pabst）凭借他的第一部有声电影将战争电影带入了一个新时代，无情地现实地描绘了德国及其他地区一代人的噩梦。第一次世界大战的最后几个月，帕布斯特与驻扎在法国的四名步兵一起深入战壕，以前所未有的自然主义手法描绘了战争中的痛苦磨难，这些士兵在身体和精神上都被交火、炮击和在后方迎接他们的幻灭所折磨。
hook_en: G. W. Pabst brought the war movie into a new era with his first sound film, a mercilessly realistic depiction of the nightmare that scarred a generation, in Germany and beyond. Digging into the trenches with four infantrymen stationed in France in the final months of World War I, Pabst illustrates the harrowing ordeals of battle with unprecedented naturalism, as the men are worn away in body and spirit by firefights, shelling, and the disillusion that greets them on the home front.

hook: 1972 年，新近激进的好莱坞明星简·方达与电影创新者让-吕克·戈达尔和合作者让-皮埃尔·戈林结成邪恶的艺术联盟，最终诞生了《一切都好》。这部对消费资本主义和左翼建制派的自由攻击讲述了一位美国记者（方达饰）和她的新浪潮电影导演丈夫（伊夫·蒙当饰）目睹的香肠工厂野猫罢工的故事。 Criterion Collection 很荣幸地呈现这部激进电影的杰作，对 1968 年后法国的社会、婚姻和革命进行了尖锐的批评。
hook_en: In 1972, newly radicalized Hollywood star Jane Fonda joined forces with cinematic innovator Jean-Luc Godard and collaborator Jean-Pierre Gorin in an unholy artistic alliance that resulted in Tout va bien (Everything’s All Right). This free-ranging assault on consumer capitalism and the establishment left tells the story of a wildcat strike at a sausage factory as witnessed by an American reporter (Fonda) and her has-been New Wave film director husband (Yves Montand). The Criterion Collection is proud to present this masterpiece of radical cinema, a caustic critique of society, marriage, and revolution in post-1968 France.

hook: 科幻、纸浆人物与超现实主义诗意的歪斜熔合——戈达尔这场通往神秘阿尔法城的不敬旅程，仍是影史上最不按常规的片子之一。艾迪·康斯坦丁饰演星际英雄莱米·考欣，奉命除掉法西斯计算机阿尔法60的发明者。
hook_en: A cockeyed fusion of science fiction, pulp characters, and surrealist poetry, Godard’s irreverent journey to the mysterious Alphaville remains one of the least conventional films of all time. Eddie Constantine stars as intergalactic hero Lemmy Caution, on a mission to kill the inventor of fascist computer Alpha 60.

hook: 《精疲力尽》四年后，戈达尔更激进地重想黑帮片，拍出《法外之徒》（Bande à part）。两个坐立不安的年轻人（萨米·弗雷与克洛德·布拉瑟尔）拉上他们共同的意中人（安娜·卡里娜），去她自己家里抢劫。这部大胆又极好玩的新浪潮宝石，既感伤又漫不经心，既冒泡般浪漫又忧郁，并有戈达尔最难忘的场面：卢浮宫里的狂奔，与酷到纹丝不动的麦迪逊舞。
hook_en: Four years after Breathless, Jean-Luc Godard reimagined the gangster film even more radically with Band of Outsiders (Bande à part). In it, two restless young men (Sami Frey and Claude Brasseur) enlist the object of both of their fancies (Anna Karina) to help them commit a robbery—in her own home. This audacious and wildly entertaining French New Wave gem is at once sentimental and insouciant, effervescently romantic and melancholy, and it features some of Godard’s most memorable set pieces, including the headlong race through the Louvre and the unshakably cool Madison dance sequence.

hook: 在《我对她了解的两三件事》（2 ou 3 Chooses que je sais d’elle）中，让-吕克·戈达尔以叙述者的身份在我们耳边低语，让我们更加靠近。关于什么？金钱、性、时尚、城市、爱情、语言、战争：总而言之，一切。这位法国传奇电影制片人最出色的成就之一是，这部电影表面上以朱丽叶·詹森（玛丽娜·弗拉迪饰）的日常生活为主题，她是一位来自巴黎郊区的家庭主妇，为了赚外快而卖淫。然而，这只是戈达尔的一个模板，可以将其衍生为具有挑衅性的哲学离题和华丽的图像。 《我对她了解的两三件事》也许是戈达尔对消费文化最具启发性的作品，由拉乌尔·库塔尔 (Raoul Coutard) 以迷人的宽银幕色彩拍摄。
hook_en: In 2 or 3 Things I Know About Her (2 ou 3 choses que je sais d’elle), Jean-Luc Godard beckons us ever closer, whispering in our ears as narrator. About what? Money, sex, fashion, the city, love, language, war: in a word, everything. Among the legendary French filmmaker’s finest achievements, the film takes as its ostensible subject the daily life of Juliette Janson (Marina Vlady), a housewife from the Paris suburbs who prostitutes herself for extra money. Yet this is only a template for Godard to spin off into provocative philosophical tangents and gorgeous images. 2 or 3 Things I Know About Her is perhaps Godard’s most revelatory look at consumer culture, shot in ravishing widescreen color by Raoul Coutard.

hook: 让-吕克·戈达尔这部六十年代末的讽刺作品是电影中最伟大的无政府主义作品之一。一对资产阶级夫妇决心从垂死的亲戚那里继承遗产，他们穿越法国乡村，而他们周围的文明却在崩溃和燃烧。 《周末》以一个著名的镜头镜头沿着看似无尽的交通堵塞的镜头为特色，并充满了历史和文学参考，是对革命的超现实有趣和令人不安的呼吁，描绘了社会回归野蛮，以及——根据片尾字幕——电影本身的终结。
hook_en: This scathing late-sixties satire from Jean-Luc Godard is one of cinema’s great anarchic works. Determined to collect an inheritance from a dying relative, a bourgeois couple travel across the French countryside while civilization crashes and burns around them. Featuring a justly famous sequence in which the camera tracks along a seemingly endless traffic jam, and rich with historical and literary references, Weekend is a surreally funny and disturbing call for revolution, a depiction of society reverting to savagery, and— according to the credits—the end of cinema itself.

hook: 在卡洛斯·雷加达斯 (Carlos Reygadas) 的这部异常自信的长片处女作中，一名男子（亚历杭德罗·费雷蒂斯饰）从墨西哥城前往一个偏僻的村庄自杀。然而，一到那里，他就遇到了一位虔诚的老妇人（玛格达莱娜·弗洛雷斯饰），她安静的人性激起了他的欲望。雷加达斯招募了一批非演员，并在精美的 16 毫米宽银幕电影中进行拍摄，以朴实的触感探索墨西哥乡村的严酷之美，营造出一种宗教与性交融、生命与死亡共存、人类体验中动物性和精神性的一面变得难以区分的心灵景观。 《Japón》是一部充满雄心壮志和令人惊叹的视觉诗意的作品，是一次穿越未知电影领域的存在主义之旅，确立了导演独特的声音。
hook_en: In this preternaturally assured feature debut by Carlos Reygadas, a man (Alejandro Ferretis) travels from Mexico City to an isolated village to commit suicide; once there, however, he meets a pious elderly woman (Magdalena Flores) whose quiet humanity incites a reawakening of his desires. Recruiting a cast of nonactors and filming in sublime 16 mm CinemaScope, Reygadas explores the harsh beauty of the Mexican country­side with earthy tactility, conjuring a psychic landscape where religion mingles with sex, life coexists with death, and the animal and spiritual sides of human experience become indistinguishable. A work of soaring ambition and startling visual poetry, Japón is an existential journey through uncharted cinematic territory that established the singular voice of its director.

hook: 《蒙索的面包店女孩》是《六个道德故事》系列的第一部，精致而爵士，展现了埃里克·侯麦风格的一些元素：不繁琐的自然主义拍摄、讽刺的第一人称画外音和一个“不可知”的女人。一名法学院学生（由制片人兼未来导演巴贝特·施罗德饰演）目光飘忽，胃口大，每天都吃甜甜的糕点，以博取在巴黎一家古色古香的面包店工作的黑发美女的芳心。但他真的感兴趣，还是她只是一个甜蜜的消遣？
hook_en: Delicate and jazzy, The Bakery Girl of Monceau, the first entry in the Six Moral Tales series, evinces stirrings of what would become the Eric Rohmer style: unfussy naturalistic shooting, ironic first-person voice-over, and an “unknowable” woman. A law student (played by producer and future director Barbet Schroeder) with a roving eye and a large appetite stuffs himself with sugary pastries daily in order to gain the affection of a pretty brunette who works in a quaint Paris bakery. But is he truly interested, or is she just a sweet diversion?

hook: 一对在瑞士度假的普通英国夫妇突然发现自己卷入了一起国际阴谋案件，他们的女儿被密谋政治暗杀的间谍绑架。这部惊心动魄、扣人心弦的电影是悬疑大师阿尔弗雷德·希区柯克早期惊悚片中的第一部，他在高蒙英国电影公司度过了他职业生涯的丰沛阶段。除了肯定了希区柯克的天才之外，它还为才华横溢的彼得·洛尔提供了他的第一个英语角色，饰演一个狡猾的恶棍。影片充满张力和残酷的幽默，是纯粹的希区柯克风格，也为《三十九级台阶》和《消失的女士》等电影定下了基调。
hook_en: An ordinary British couple vacationing in Switzerland suddenly find themselves embroiled in a case of international intrigue when their daughter is kidnapped by spies plotting a political assassination. This fleet and gripping film is the first of the early thrillers the Master of Suspense, Alfred Hitchcock, made during the fertile phase of his career spent at the Gaumont-British Picture Corporation. Besides affirming Hitchcock’s genius, it gave the brilliant Peter Lorre his first English-speaking role, as a slithery villain. With its tension and gallows humor, it’s pure Hitchcock, and it set the tone for such films as The 39 Steps and The Lady Vanishes.

hook: 萨蒂亚吉特·雷 (Satyajit Ray) 在《音乐室》(Jalsaghar) 中出色地展现了一位堕落贵族（深受喜爱的演员查比·比斯瓦斯 (Chhabi Biswas) 饰）拼命坚持日渐衰落的生活方式的摇摇欲坠的富裕世界。他最大的乐趣是音乐室，多年来他曾在其中举办过奢华的音乐会，但现在它已不再是以前生动的样子了。 《音乐室》生动地描绘了传统与现代之间的冲突，展示了当今印度一些最受欢迎的音乐家，是这位伟大的孟加拉电影制片人的一部决定性作品。
hook_en: With The Music Room (Jalsaghar), Satyajit Ray brilliantly evokes the crumbling opulence of the world of a fallen aristocrat (the beloved actor Chhabi Biswas) desperately clinging to a fading way of life. His greatest joy is the music room in which he has hosted lavish concerts over the years—now a shadow of its former vivid self. An incandescent depiction of the clash between tradition and modernity, and a showcase for some of India’s most popular musicians of the day, The Music Room is a defining work by the great Bengali filmmaker.

hook: 马丁·斯科塞斯根据大卫·格兰的真实犯罪畅销书精心改编而成，是一部关于贪婪、背叛和谋杀的史诗挽歌，故事发生在 20 年代的俄克拉荷马州，石油的发现为奥色治人民带来了非凡的财富。无所事事的退伍军人欧内斯特·伯克哈特（莱昂纳多·迪卡普里奥饰）闯入了他们的世界，他与他奸诈的叔叔（罗伯特·德尼罗饰）一起实施了一项可怕的计划，旨在掠夺奥色治族的金钱和土地。莉莉·格拉德斯通 (Lily Gladstone) 凭借她在片中出色的表演赢得了观众的青睐，她饰演伯克哈特 (Burkhart) 的奥塞奇 (Osage) 妻子莫莉·凯尔 (Mollie Kyle)，她逐渐意识到周围的邪恶。在《花月杀手》中，斯科塞斯以扣人心弦的叙事力量和对系统性不公正的沉重感受，将美国历史的黑暗篇章搬上银幕。
hook_en: An epic elegy of greed, betrayal, and murder, Martin Scorsese’s masterly adaptation of David Grann’s true-crime best seller unfolds in 1920s Oklahoma, where the discovery of oil brings extraordinary wealth to the Osage people. Into their world comes ne’er-do-well army veteran Ernest Burkhart (Leonardo DiCaprio), who joins his duplicitous uncle (Robert De Niro) in a horrifying scheme to rob the Osage of their money and land. Lily Gladstone charges the film with her transcendent performance as Burkhart’s Osage wife, Mollie Kyle, gradually awakening to the evil that surrounds her. With Killers of the Flower Moon, Scorsese brings a dark chapter of American history to the screen with gripping narrative power and a profound feeling for the weight of systemic injustice.

hook: 《奥索斯》和《万达的房间》中许多迷失的灵魂在《巨大的青春》的幽灵景观中回归，这为佩德罗·科斯塔的方丹哈斯电影带来了新的戏剧性、悲剧性的宏伟。这次，科斯塔聚焦于文图拉，一位来自佛得角的老年移民，住在里斯本的一个廉价住宅区，他被妻子抛弃，整天拜访他的邻居，他认为邻居是他的“孩子”。结果是一种鬼故事的形式，一个关于同时生活在过去和现在的被遗弃的、被剥夺的人们的故事，由科斯塔以同理心和惊人的光芒拍摄。
hook_en: Many of the lost souls of Ossos and In Vanda’s Room return in the spectral landscape of Colossal Youth, which brings to Pedro Costa’s Fontainhas films a new theatrical, tragic grandeur. This time, Costa focuses on Ventura, an elderly immigrant from Cape Verde living in a low-cost housing complex in Lisbon, who has been abandoned by his wife and spends his days visiting his neighbors, whom he considers his “children.” What results is a form of ghost story, a tale of derelict, dispossessed people living in the past and present at the same time, filmed by Costa with empathy and startling radiance.

hook: 2004 年，美国导演约书亚·马斯顿 (Joshua Marston) 凭借一部荣获奥斯卡提名的惊心动魄的《玛丽亚充满恩典》(Maria Full of Grace) 崭露头角，该片讲述了一位年轻的哥伦比亚妇女充当毒骡的故事。在他出色的后续作品《血的宽恕》中，他将镜头转向了世界的另一个角落：当代的阿尔巴尼亚北部，一个仍然受到家族间血仇古老习俗困扰的地方。马斯顿从这个现实出发，虚构了一个关于一对十几岁的兄妹在身体和情感上陷入暴力循环的虚构故事，这是由于他们的父亲与敌对部落为了一块土地而纠缠在一起的结果。 《血的宽恕》是对一个传统与进步不安共存的地方的紧张而敏锐的描绘，也是一部充满活力的成长剧。
hook_en: American director Joshua Marston emerged in 2004 with the jolting, Oscar-nominated Maria Full of Grace, about a young Colombian woman working as a drug mule. In his remarkable follow-up, The Forgiveness of Blood, he turns his camera on another corner of the world: contemporary northern Albania, a place still troubled by the ancient custom of interfamilial blood feuds. From this reality, Marston sculpts a fictional narrative about a teenage brother and sister physically and emotionally trapped in a cycle of violence, a result of their father’s entanglement with a rival clan over a piece of land. The Forgiveness of Blood is a tense and perceptive depiction of a place where tradition and progress coexist uneasily, as well as a dynamic coming-of-age drama.

hook: 在《Psycho》、《Peeping Tom》和《Repulsion》之前，还有《Diabolique》。这部来自Henri-Georges Clouzot的惊悚片震惊了欧洲和美国的观众，讲述了两个女人的故事-一个脆弱的妻子和一个男孩寄宿学校的虐待狂校长的任性情妇-他们策划了一个大胆的复仇阴谋。凭借其前所未有的叙事扭曲和可怕的图像， Diabolique是恐怖电影制作中令人心碎的基准，…
hook_en: Before Psycho, Peeping Tom, and Repulsion, there was Diabolique. This thriller from Henri‑Georges Clouzot, which shocked audiences in Europe and the U.S., is the story of two women—the fragile wife and the willful mistress of the sadistic headmaster of a boys' boarding school—who hatch a daring revenge plot. With its unprecedented narrative twists and terrifying images, Diabolique is a heart-grabbing benchmark in horror filmmaking, featuring outstanding performances by Simone Signoret, Véra Clouzot, and Paul Meurisse.

hook: 阿卜杜拉蒂夫·柯西胥的《谷物的秘密》荣获四项凯撒奖，包括最佳影片奖和最佳导演奖，这部激动人心的剧情片讲述了一个熙熙攘攘的法国-阿拉伯家庭的日常欢乐和挣扎。它具有纪录片的质感，但却是经典的、近乎莎士比亚式的结构：当族长斯利曼按照自己的愿望，开设一家左舷餐厅，专门供应前妻的蒸粗麦粉和鱼时，大家族的激情和问题爆发了，导致了引人入胜、悬疑的高潮。 《谷物的秘密》以敏感和毅力颂扬了食物在家庭生活中所扮演的角色，并触及了当代移民经历的核心。
hook_en: The winner of four César awards, including best picture and director, Abdellatif Kechiche’s The Secret of the Grain is a stirring drama about the daily joys and struggles of a bustling French-Arab family. It has the texture of a documentary but a classic, almost Shakespearean structure: when patriarch Slimane acts on his wish to open a portside restaurant specializing in his ex-wife’s couscous and fish, the extended clan’s passions and problems explode, leading to an engrossing, suspenseful climax. With sensitivity and grit, The Secret of the Grain celebrates the role food plays in family life and gets to the core of contemporary immigrant experience.

hook: 屡获殊荣的《夏日时光》受到评论家的普遍好评，是法国当代伟大电影制片人奥利维尔·阿萨亚斯迄今为止最具个人色彩的电影。由朱丽叶·比诺什、查尔斯·柏林和杰瑞米·雷尼尔饰演的三兄弟必须决定如何处理他们从母亲那里继承的乡村庄园和物品。阿萨亚斯从这个简单的故事出发，创作了一部关于全球化现代生活物质的精致细腻的戏剧。 《夏日时光》自然而朴实，是一部罕见的以诚实对待家庭来尊重家庭的电影。
hook_en: Universally acclaimed by critics, the multiple award-winning Summer Hours is the great contemporary French filmmaker Olivier Assayas’s most personal film to date. Three siblings, played by Juliette Binoche, Charles Berling, and Jérémie Rénier, must decide what to do with the country estate and objects they’ve inherited from their mother. From this simple story, Assayas creates an exquisitely nuanced drama about the material of globalized modern living. Naturalistic and unsentimental, Summer Hours is that rare film that pays respect to family by treating it with honesty.

hook: 克日什托夫·基斯洛夫斯基的这部杰作是二十世纪视觉叙事领域最伟大的成就之一。 《十诫》最初是为波兰电视台制作的，主要讲述了共产主义晚期波兰的一个住宅区的居民，他们的生活因面临着深刻的个人化和普遍人类的情感困境而微妙地交织在一起。其时长十小时的电影以《十诫》为主题灵感和总体结构，巧妙地解决了有关生、死、爱、恨、真理和时间流逝的复杂道德和存在主义问题。 《十诫》由九位不同的电影摄影师拍摄，兹比格涅夫·普莱斯纳 (Zbigniew Preisner) 的激动人心的音乐以及知名演员和不知名演员的精彩表演，引人注目地探索了塑造我们生活的不可知力量。还放映了该系列第五部和第六部电影的较长剧场版：《关于杀戮的短片》和《关于爱的短片》。
hook_en: This masterwork by Krzysztof Kieślowski is one of the twentieth century’s greatest achievements in visual storytelling. Originally made for Polish television, Dekalog focuses on the residents of a housing complex in late-Communist Poland, whose lives become subtly intertwined as they face emotional dilemmas that are at once deeply personal and universally human. Its ten hour-long films, drawing from the Ten Commandments for thematic inspiration and an overarching structure, grapple deftly with complex moral and existential questions concerning life, death, love, hate, truth, and the passage of time. Shot by nine different cinematographers, with stirring music by Zbigniew Preisner and compelling performances from established and unknown actors alike, Dekalog arrestingly explores the unknowable forces that shape our lives. Also presented are the longer theatrical versions of the series’ fifth and sixth films: A Short Film About Killing and A Short Film About Love.

hook: 《霍华德庄园》是制片人伊斯梅尔·麦昌特 (Ismail Merchant) 与导演詹姆斯·伊沃里 (James Ivory) 长达数十年合作的巅峰之作，它是对 E. M. Forster 1910 年有关爱德华时代英国阶级分裂的小说的鲜明想象。艾玛·汤普森凭借对玛格丽特·施莱格尔的生动刻画获得奥斯卡奖。玛格丽特·施莱格尔是一位轻浮而富有同情心的中产阶级知识分子，她与富有的资本家亨利·威尔科克斯（安东尼·霍普金斯饰）垂死的妻子（凡妮莎·雷德格瑞夫饰）的友谊开启了一个错综复杂的金钱、爱情和死亡的故事，涵盖了这个国家最高和最低的社会阶层。 《霍华德庄园》由露丝·普劳尔·贾布瓦拉（Ruth Prawer Jhabvala）（也获得过奥斯卡奖）编写的精彩、层次分明的剧本和一系列扣人心弦的表演组成，是一部既美丽又生动的黑暗的作品，也是电影中最好的文学改编作品之一。
hook_en: The pinnacle of the decades-long collaboration between producer Ismail Merchant and director James Ivory, Howards End is a luminous vision of E. M. Forster’s cutting 1910 novel about class divisions in Edwardian England. Emma Thompson won an Academy Award for her dynamic portrayal of Margaret Schlegel, a flighty yet compassionate middle-class intellectual whose friendship with the dying wife (Vanessa Redgrave) of rich capitalist Henry Wilcox (Anthony Hopkins) commences an intricately woven tale of money, love, and death that encompasses the country’s highest and lowest social echelons. With a brilliant, layered script by Ruth Prawer Jhabvala (who also won an Oscar) and a roster of gripping performances, Howards End is a work of both great beauty and vivid darkness, and one of cinema’s best literary adaptations.

hook: 《狂野之物》对创伤对身体和情感的影响进行了复杂的探索，卡罗尔·贝克在多层次的表演中饰演一名大学生，他在遭受残酷的性侵犯后试图自杀，但被一名机械师（拉尔夫·米克饰）制止——然而，机械师的善良很快就发生了令人不安的转变。这部电影的坦率和心理现实主义具有惊人的现代性，它代表了纽约演员工作室周围艺术家亲密群体的情感最纯粹的银幕表达之一，它改变了二十世纪中叶的美国电影。杰克·加芬的这部影片拥有令人惊叹的外景和由尤金·舒夫坦 (Eugene Schüfftan) 拍摄的幽闭恐怖室内摄影、无与伦比的索尔·巴斯 (Saul Bass) 的片头片段以及亚伦·科普兰 (Aaron Copland) 的节奏配乐，堪称独立电影的杰作。
hook_en: A complex exploration of the physical and emotional effects of trauma, Something Wild stars Carroll Baker, in a layered performance, as a college student who attempts suicide after a brutal sexual assault but is stopped by a mechanic (Ralph Meeker)—whose kindness, however, soon takes an unsettling turn. Startlingly modern in its frankness and psychological realism, the film represents one of the purest on-screen expressions of the sensibility of the intimate community of artists around New York’s Actors Studio, which transformed American cinema in the mid-twentieth century. With astonishing location and claustrophobic interior photography by Eugene Schüfftan, an opening-title sequence by the inimitable Saul Bass, and a rhythmic score by Aaron Copland, Jack Garfein’s film is a masterwork of independent cinema.

hook: 画外一个简单、萦绕的口哨旋律告诉我们：一个小女孩将被杀害。“谁是凶手？”附近的告示牌恳求着，连环杀手汉斯·贝克特（彼得·洛尔）逼近小埃尔茜·贝克曼……在这部令人心悸的杰作《M》里，弗里茨·朗把犀利的社会评论与冰冷悬念合在一起，画出私人疯狂与公众歇斯底里的全景；时至今日，它仍是心理惊悚片的蓝图。
hook_en: A simple, haunting musical phrase whistled offscreen tells us that a young girl will be killed. “Who Is the Murderer?” pleads a nearby placard as serial killer Hans Beckert (Peter Lorre) closes in on little Elsie Beckmann . . . In his harrowing masterwork M, Fritz Lang merges trenchant social commentary with chilling suspense, creating a panorama of private madness and public hysteria that to this day remains the blueprint for the psychological thriller.

hook: 维托里奥·德·西卡的这部新现实主义杰作讲述了一位老年养老金领取者在意大利战后经济复苏期间努力维持收支平衡的故事。除了他的狗弗莱克（Flike）之外，翁贝托（Umberto）独自在这座人类善良似乎已被现代化力量吞噬的城市中努力维护自己的尊严。他对满足基本需求（食物、住所、陪伴）的简单追求，造就了有史以来最令人心碎的故事之一，也是世界电影的重要经典。
hook_en: This neorealist masterpiece by Vittorio De Sica follows an elderly pensioner as he strives to make ends meet during Italy’s postwar economic recovery. Alone except for his dog, Flike, Umberto struggles to maintain his dignity in a city where human kindness seems to have been swallowed up by the forces of modernization. His simple quest to satisfy his basic needs—food, shelter, companionship—makes for one of the most heartbreaking stories ever filmed, and an essential classic of world cinema.

hook: 1965 年夏天，新英格兰海岸附近的一座岛屿。两个 12 岁的孩子萨姆和苏西坠入爱河，签订了秘密契约，然后一起逃进了荒野。当地方当局试图追捕他们时，一场猛烈的风暴正在近海酝酿。 。 。韦斯·安德森的《月出王国》由贾里德·吉尔曼和卡拉·海沃德饰演逃亡中的年轻夫妇，布鲁斯·威利斯饰演岛上警察夏普队长，爱德华·诺顿饰演卡其色童子军队长童子军大师沃德，比尔·默里和弗兰西斯·麦克多蒙德饰演苏西的律师父母沃尔特和劳拉·毕肖普。演员阵容还包括蒂尔达·斯文顿、詹森·舒瓦兹曼和鲍勃·巴拉班。神奇的配乐以本杰明·布里顿的音乐为特色。
hook_en: An island off the New England coast, summer of 1965. Two twelve-year-olds, Sam and Suzy, fall in love, make a secret pact, and run away together into the wilderness. As local authorities try to hunt them down, a violent storm is brewing offshore . . . Wes Anderson’s Moonrise Kingdom stars Jared Gilman and Kara Hayward as the young couple on the run, Bruce Willis as Island Police Captain Sharp, Edward Norton as Khaki Scout troop leader Scout Master Ward, and Bill Murray and Frances McDormand as Suzy’s attorney parents, Walt and Laura Bishop. The cast also includes Tilda Swinton, Jason Schwartzman, and Bob Balaban. The magical soundtrack features the music of Benjamin Britten.

hook: 当马克斯·雷恩为他肮脏的有线电视台寻找前卫的新素材时，他偶然发现了一个名为“Videodrome”的超级暴力酷刑节目的盗版广播。他试图挖掘该程序的起源，结果却踏上了一段幻觉之旅，进入了一个充满右翼阴谋、施虐受虐性游戏和身体改造的影子世界。 《Videodrome》由詹姆斯·伍兹和黛博拉·哈利主演，是编剧兼导演大卫·柯南伯格最具原创性和挑衅性的作品之一，并具有奥斯卡奖得主里克·贝克的开创性化妆效果。
hook_en: When Max Renn goes looking for edgy new material for his sleazy cable TV station, he stumbles across the pirate broad­­cast of a hyperviolent torture show called “Videodrome.” His attempts to unearth the program’s origins send him on a hallucinatory journey into a shadow world of right-wing conspiracies, sado­masochistic sex games, and bodily trans­formation. Starring James Woods and Deborah Harry, Videodrome is one of the most original and provocative works from writer-director David Cronenberg, and features ground­breaking makeup effects by Academy Award winner Rick Baker.

hook: 1990 年伊朗地震造成 5 万人死亡，阿巴斯·基亚罗斯塔米 (Abbas Kiarostami) 回到科克 (Koker)，在那里，他的相机不仅观察了灾难，还观察了震后生机勃勃的景象。 《生活继续》将虚构与现实融合成一部俏皮、辛酸的公路电影，讲述了一位电影导演和他的儿子长途跋涉来到该地区，希望找出出演《朋友的房子在哪里》的小男孩是否是这样的情况？是幸存者之一，并发现一个有弹性的社区在面对悲剧时奋力前行。基亚罗斯塔米在最凄凉的环境中寻找美，为人类精神的精华创作了一首安静而雄伟的颂歌。
hook_en: In the aftermath of the 1990 earthquake in Iran that left fifty thousand dead, Abbas Kiarostami returned to Koker, where his camera surveys not only devastation but also the teeming life in its wake. Blending fiction and reality into a playful, poignant road movie, And Life Goes On follows a film director who, along with his son, makes the trek to the region in hopes of finding out if the young boys who acted in Where Is the Friend’s House? are among the survivors, and discovers a resilient community pressing on in the face of tragedy. Finding beauty in the bleakest of circumstances, Kiarostami crafts a quietly majestic ode to the best of the human spirit.

hook: 罗杰·瓦迪的《上帝创造女性》取得了巨大成功，不仅重塑了外国电影市场，还将布丽姬·都柏翠推上了国际巨星的地位。布丽姬在剧中饰演朱丽叶，一个18岁的孤儿，她放纵的享乐欲望搅动了圣特罗佩的一切；她温柔但纯真的丈夫米歇尔（让-吕克·让-马修）试图驯服她放荡的行为，却遭受了殴打、侮辱和玛bo的折磨。
hook_en: The astounding success of Roger Vadim’s And God Created Woman revolutionized the foreign film market and turned Brigitte Bardot into an international star. Bardot stars as Juliette, an 18-year-old orphan whose unbridled appetite for pleasure shakes up all of St. Tropez; her sweet but naïve husband Michel (Jean-Louis Trintignant) endures beatings, insults, and mambo in his attempts to tame her wild ways.

hook: 罗伯托·罗西里尼继《罗马开放城市》大获成功之后，推出了雄心勃勃、感人至深的《派桑》，该剧由六集组成，以二战末期意大利解放期间为背景，故事发生在全国各地，从西西里岛到波谷北部。凭借其纪录片式的视觉效果以及演员和非专业人士、意大利人和美国解放者的混合阵容，这部影片对不同文化之间的沟通斗争以及人们在极端环境下的日常生活进行了审视，既充满了迷人的情感，又充满了生动的现实。 《Paisan》是意大利电影中久违的瑰宝，在这里可以找到其完整的原始发行版本。
hook_en: Roberto Rossellini’s follow-up to his breakout Rome Open City was the ambitious, enormously moving Paisan, which consists of six episodes set during the liberation of Italy at the end of World War II, and taking place across the country, from Sicily to the northern Po valley. With its documentary-like visuals and intermingled cast of actors and nonprofessionals, Italians and their American liberators, this look at the struggles of different cultures to communicate and of people to live their everyday lives in extreme circumstances is equal parts charming sentiment and vivid reality. A long-missing treasure of Italian cinema, Paisan is available here in its full original release version.

hook: 1962 年的香港：周慕云（梁朝伟饰）和苏丽珍（张曼玉饰）在同一天搬进了邻近的公寓。他们的相遇是正式而礼貌的——直到他们的配偶的发现在他们之间建立了亲密的联系。王家卫的《花样年华》兼具精致的举止和视觉上的奢华，巧妙地唤起了浪漫的渴望和转瞬即逝的时刻。凭借克里斯托弗·道尔 (Christopher Doyle) 和马克·李屏宾 (Mark Lee Ping Bing) 制作的令人心痛的配乐和精美抽象的电影摄影，这部电影对过去二十年的电影风格产生了重大影响，也是王家卫令人敬畏的职业生涯中的一个里程碑。
hook_en: Hong Kong, 1962: Chow Mo-Wan (Tony Leung Chiu Wai) and Su Li-Zhen (Maggie Cheung Man Yuk) move into neighboring apartments on the same day. Their encounters are formal and polite—until a discovery about their spouses creates an intimate bond between them. At once delicately mannered and visually extravagant, Wong Kar Wai’s In the Mood for Love is a masterful evocation of romantic longing and fleeting moments. With its aching soundtrack and exquisitely abstract cinematography by Christopher Doyle and Mark Lee Ping Bing, this film has been a major stylistic influence on the past two decades of cinema, and is a milestone in Wong’s redoubtable career.

hook: 尼基亚图·尤苏 (Nikyatu Jusu) 的处女作融合了社会观察和巧妙的震撼，引人入胜，深入探讨了塞内加尔移民艾莎 (安娜·迪奥普饰) 日益破碎的意识，她在纽约市一个富裕的白人家庭担任保姆。与自己的儿子分离，并被雇主随意剥削，艾莎发现自己被令人不安的幻象和日益增长的愤怒所吞噬——这可能会摧毁她，也可能会赋予她力量。这部视觉上引人入胜的杰作——第一部获得圣丹斯电影节评审团大奖的恐怖电影——将有关母性、不平等和文化错位的复杂想法提炼成一部梦幻般的恐怖作品。
hook_en: A spellbinding blend of social observation and artful shocks, the debut feature from Nikyatu Jusu plunges into the increasingly fractured consciousness of Aisha (Anna Diop), a Senegalese immigrant who takes a job as a nanny for a wealthy white family in New York City. Separated from her own son and casually exploited by her employers, Aisha finds herself consumed by unsettling visions and a growing rage—one that could either destroy or empower her. This visually captivating tour de force—the first horror movie to win the Grand Jury Prize at the Sundance Film Festival—distills complex ideas about motherhood, inequality, and cultural dislocation into a work of dreamlike dread.

hook: 《不朽的故事》是奥逊·威尔斯的第一部彩色电影，也是最后一部完成的虚构故事，改编自伊萨克·迪内森的故事，改编自伊萨克·迪内森的故事，情节感人至深，充满渴望。威尔斯饰演一位十九世纪澳门的富商，他痴迷于将一个经常被提及的轶事变成现实：一个富翁给了一个贫穷的水手一小笔钱，让他的妻子怀孕。这部宝石般的电影同样由空灵的珍妮·莫罗 (Jeanne Moreau) 主演，由威利·库兰特 (Willy Kurant) 梦幻般地拍摄，并充满了埃里克·萨蒂 (Erik Satie) 的音乐，是威尔斯艺术兴趣的深沉而令人回味的升华——一个关于讲故事的本质以及幻想与现实之间的微妙界限的故事。
hook_en: Orson Welles’s first color film and final completed fictional feature, The Immortal Story is a moving and wistful adaptation of a tale by Isak Dinesen. Welles stars as a wealthy merchant in nineteenth-century Macao, who becomes obsessed with bringing to life an oft-related anecdote about a rich man who gives a poor sailor a small sum of money to impregnate his wife. Also starring an ethereal Jeanne Moreau, this jewel-like film, dreamily shot by Willy Kurant and suffused with the music of Erik Satie, is a brooding, evocative distillation of Welles’s artistic interests—a story about the nature of storytelling and the fine line between illusion and reality.

hook: 很少有电影能像《夏日编年史》那样对电影史进程产生如此大的影响。这部被莫林称为“真实电影”的先锋作品是电影制片人兼人类学家让·鲁什和社会学家埃德加·莫林合作的令人着迷的成果，它是对法国六十年代初期社会政治诊断的巧妙构思和实现。 1960 年夏天，我们简单地采访了一群巴黎居民，从“你幸福吗？”这一具有挑衅性且永恒的问题开始。并扩展到政治问题，包括正在进行的阿尔及利亚战争——鲁什和莫林揭示了从艺术家到工厂工人、从意大利移民到非洲学生的各种人的希望和梦想。 《一个夏天的编年史》以富有洞察力的方式为我们提供了一份具有非凡情感深度的时间和地点的记录。
hook_en: Few films can claim as much influence on the course of cinema history as Chronicle of a Summer. The fascinating result of a collaboration between filmmaker-anthropologist Jean Rouch and sociologist Edgar Morin, this vanguard work of what Morin termed cinéma- vérité is a brilliantly conceived and realized sociopolitical diagnosis of the early sixties in France. Simply by interviewing a group of Paris residents in the summer of 1960—beginning with the provocative and eternal question “Are you happy?” and expanding to political issues, including the ongoing Algerian War—Rouch and Morin reveal the hopes and dreams of a wide array of people, from artists to factory workers, from an Italian émigré to an African student. Chronicle of a Summer’s penetrative approach gives us a document of a time and place with extraordinary emotional depth.

hook: 一对在火车站偶遇的已婚医生（特维·霍华德）和郊区家庭主妇（西莉亚·约翰逊）开始了一段含蓄但热烈、最终却注定要失败的爱情。这部电影以其迷人的雾气笼罩的背景、优美的拉赫马尼诺夫配乐以及两位杰出的表演（约翰逊因此获得了奥斯卡提名），巧妙地探讨了非法恋情中的兴奋、痛苦和温柔，并对许多银幕短暂邂逅产生了影响。
hook_en: After a chance meeting on a train platform, a married doctor (Trevor Howard) and a suburban housewife (Celia Johnson) begin a muted but passionate, and ultimately doomed, love affair. With its evocatively fog-enshrouded setting, swooning Rachmaninoff score, and pair of remarkable performances (Johnson was nominated for an Oscar), this film, directed by David Lean and based on Noël Coward’s play Still Life deftly explores the thrill, pain, and tenderness of an illicit romance, and has influenced many a cinematic brief encounter since its release.

hook: 卡尔·富兰克林的《蓝裙魔鬼》改编自沃尔特·莫斯利的冷酷小说，战后黑色电影的深刻幻灭成为探索美国种族不平等的有力工具。丹泽尔·华盛顿 (Denzel Washington) 饰演失业的前大兵伊伊·罗林斯 (Easy Rawlins)，他充满魅力，在 20 世纪 40 年代末的洛杉矶被招募去寻找一位富有的市长候选人失踪的情人（詹妮弗·比尔斯 (Jennifer Beals) 饰）时，他看到了快速赚钱的机会，却发现自己卷入了谋杀、政治阴谋和一桩跨越种族隔离社会危险肤色界限的丑闻。这部时尚悬疑剧以唐·钱德尔 (Don Cheadle) 的突破性作品为主角，饰演罗林斯的开朗好战的伙伴，揭露了美国梦背后的痛苦种族现实，既传达又颠覆了经典的黑色比喻。
hook_en: The bone-deep disillusionment of postwar film noir becomes a powerful vehicle to explore America’s racial injustices in Carl Franklin’s richly atmospheric Devil in a Blue Dress, an adaptation of the hard-boiled novel by Walter Mosley. Denzel Washington has charisma to burn as the jobless ex-GI Easy Rawlins, who sees a chance to make some quick cash when he’s recruited to find the missing lover (Jennifer Beals) of a wealthy mayoral candidate in late-1940s Los Angeles—only to find himself embroiled in murder, political intrigue, and a scandal that crosses the treacherous color lines of a segregated society. Featuring breakout work by Don Cheadle as Rawlins’s cheerfully trigger-happy sidekick, this stylish mystery both channels and subverts classic noir tropes as it exposes the bitter racial realities underlying the American dream.

hook: 理查德·林克莱特导演的电影从未有过像《少年时代》这样的电影。这是一部极其谦虚的事件电影，在导演的家乡德克萨斯州拍摄了十二年，记录了一个名叫梅森的孩子（埃拉·科尔特兰饰）、他离婚的父母（因表演获得奥斯卡奖的帕特里夏·阿奎特和伊桑·霍克饰）以及他的姐姐（罗蕾莱·林克莱特饰）所经历的身体和情感变化。林克莱特不是着眼于里程碑，而是着眼于构成生活的微小的、中间的时刻，塑造了一幅完美的表演，常常很有趣的肖像，毫不费力地从一年到下一年。 《少年时代》让我们以纪实现实主义的方式在电影中观看人们的衰老过程，同时以精致的日常生活的虚构叙事来吸引我们，《少年时代》拥有只有电影艺术才能驾驭的力量。
hook_en: There has never been another movie like Boyhood, from director Richard Linklater. An event film of the utmost modesty, it was shot over the course of twelve years in the director’s native Texas and charts the physical and emotional changes experienced by a child named Mason (Ellar Coltrane), his divorced parents (Patricia Arquette, who won an Oscar for her performance, and Ethan Hawke), and his older sister (Lorelei Linklater). Alighting not on milestones but on the small, in-between moments that make up lives, Linklater fashions a flawlessly acted, often funny portrait that flows effortlessly from one year to the next. Allowing us to watch people age on film with documentary realism while gripping us in a fictional narrative of exquisite everydayness, Boyhood has a power that only the art of cinema could harness.

hook: 莱斯·布兰克是一位毫不妥协的独立电影制片人，他制作了近五十年的纪录片，优雅地带着相机消失在银幕上很少见的文化景点——主要是在美国的边远地区，但偶尔也会在国外。这些电影看似即兴创作，却富有诗意，充满人性，有时甚至是讽刺，总是向音乐、美食和各种特定地区的乐趣致敬。该收藏集对莱斯·布兰克的大量作品进行了多样化的调查，包括他的十四部最著名的作品和八部相关短片。有关各部电影的更多信息，请单击此处。
hook_en: An uncompromisingly independent filmmaker, Les Blank made documentaries for nearly fifty years, elegantly disappearing with his camera into cultural spots rarely seen on-screen—mostly on the peripheries of the United States, but also occasionally abroad. Seemingly off-the-cuff yet poetically constructed, these films are humane, sometimes wry, always engaging tributes to music, food, and all sorts of regionally specific delights. This collector’s set provides a diverse survey of Les Blank’s vast output, including fourteen of his best-known works and eight related short films. For more information on the individual films, click here.

hook: 在这部由中平幸导演执导的影响深远的《太阳部落》电影中，两兄弟在一个充满赌博、划船和饮酒的海边夏天争夺一位年轻女子的芳心。 《疯狂的水果》改编自石原慎太郎备受争议的小说，因其对日本年轻人和特权阶层战后性革命的耸人听闻的描述而受到批评，《疯狂的水果》是对传统和老一辈人的无政府主义抗议。
hook_en: Two brothers compete for the amorous favors of a young woman during a seaside summer of gambling, boating, and drinking, in this seminal Sun Tribe (taiyozoku) film from director Kô Nakahira. Adapted from the controversial novel by Shintarô Ishihara, and critically savaged for its lurid portrayal of the postwar sexual revolution among Japan’s young and privileged, Crazed Fruit is an anarchic outcry against tradition and the older generation.

hook: 在二战后东京阴暗的黑市和被炸毁的茅屋里，一群强硬的妓女勉强度日，在混乱的世界中维持着脆弱的友谊和表面上的秩序。但当一名叛变的退伍军人无意中闯入他们中间时，欲望与忠诚发生冲突，带来了悲惨的结果。在《血肉之门》中，富有远见的导演铃木清顺以绚丽的色彩和原始的情感展现了社会批判和通俗戏剧的旋风。
hook_en: In the shady black markets and bombed-out hovels of post–World War II Tokyo, a tough band of prostitutes eke out a dog-eat-dog existence, maintaining tenuous friendships and a semblance of order in a world of chaos. But when a renegade ex-soldier stumbles into their midst, lusts and loyalties clash, with tragic results. With Gate of Flesh, visionary director Seijun Suzuki delivers a whirlwind of social critique and pulp drama, shot through with brilliant colors and raw emotions.

hook: 十九世纪的英国作家詹姆斯·兰金（鲍里斯·卡洛夫饰）相信二十年前因一系列谋杀案而被绞死的人是错误的，但他的调查让他发现了一个可怕的、对他来说是不可避免的秘密。
hook_en: Nineteenth-century English author James Rankin (Boris Karloff) believes that the wrong man was hanged twenty years earlier for a series of murders, but his investigations lead him to a horrible and, for him, gruesomely inescapable secret.

hook: 贝特朗与纪尧姆保持着一种充满敌意和嫉妒的友谊，等待着时机。但当纪尧姆似乎在为精力充沛、独立的苏珊娜做戏时，伯特兰不以为然地看着。 《苏珊娜的职业生涯》是埃里克·侯麦《六个道德故事》中的第二部，凭借粗糙的 16 毫米黑白摄影和强烈的 20 世纪 60 年代巴黎风情，精彩地描绘了青春的天真以及友谊和浪漫的复杂纽带。
hook_en: Bertrand bides his time in a casually hostile and envious friendship with Guillaume. But when Guillaume seems to be making a play for the spirited, independent Suzanne, Bertrand watches disapprovingly. With its ragged black-and-white 16 mm photography and strong sense of 1960s Paris, Suzanne’s Career, the second of Eric Rohmer’s Six Moral Tales, is a wonderfully evocative portrait of youthful naivete and the complicated bonds of friendship and romance.

hook: 导演弗朗西斯科·罗西 (Francesco Rosi) 执导的《真理时刻》(Il momento della verità) 深入探讨了一位著名斗牛士的生活——由现实生活中的斗牛传奇人物米格尔·马特奥 (Miguel Mateo)（又名米盖林）扮演。这部电影以一心一意地关注眼前的血腥事件来描绘他的兴衰，既坚韧又具有歌剧性，将观众置于拳击场的最激烈的动作中，尽可能接近死亡。就像所有伟大的意大利真理探索者的电影一样，这不仅是一部激动人心的戏剧，也是对暴力世界的深刻而感人的探究——它可能是有史以来最伟大的斗牛电影。
hook_en: The Moment of Truth (Il momento della verità), from director Francesco Rosi, is a visceral plunge into the life of a famous torero—played by real-life bullfighting legend Miguel Mateo, known as Miguelín. Charting his rise and fall with a single-minded focus on the bloody business at hand, the film is at once gritty and operatic, placing the viewer right in the thick of the ring’s action, as close to death as possible. Like all of the great Italian truth seeker’s films, this is not just an electrifying drama but also a profound and moving inquiry into a violent world—and it’s perhaps the greatest bullfighting movie ever made.

hook: 古怪的美国作家乔尔和伊桑·科恩的富有远见的编年史家在勒文·戴维斯 (Llewyn Davis) 上演了他们最伟大的创作之一，这位歌手在六十年代初繁荣的格林威治村民谣舞台的边缘勉强维持生计。正如奥斯卡·伊萨克 (Oscar Isaac) 在一场具有启发性的表演中所体现的那样，卢恩 (Llewyn)（大致以乡村民间传奇人物戴夫·范·朗克 (Dave Van Ronk) 为蓝本）才华横溢，但也暴躁、粗鲁和弄巧成拙。电影摄影师布鲁诺·德尔邦内尔 (Bruno Delbonnel) 生动地捕捉到了他在无情的冬季城市景观中的循环冒险之旅，并以辛酸的幽默和偶尔的超现实触感实现了这一点。 《Inside Llewyn Davis》以 T Bone Burnett 策划的民谣配乐为特色，提醒我们在科恩兄弟的世界里，历史不一定是由胜利者书写的。
hook_en: The visionary chroniclers of eccentric Americana Joel and Ethan Coen present one of their greatest creations in Llewyn Davis, a singer barely eking out a living on the peripheries of the flourishing Greenwich Village folk scene of the early sixties. As embodied by Oscar Isaac in a revelatory performance, Llewyn (loosely modeled on the Village folk legend Dave Van Ronk) is extraordinarily talented but also irascible, rude, and self-defeating. His circular odyssey through an unforgiving winter cityscape, evocatively captured by cinematographer Bruno Delbonnel, is realized with poignant humor and the occasional surreal touch. Featuring a folk soundtrack curated by T Bone Burnett, Inside Llewyn Davis reminds us that in the Coens’ world, history isn’t necessarily written by the winners.

hook: 尽管 20 年代保罗·罗伯森 (Paul Robeson) 作为舞台演员和歌手而广受赞誉，但他仍然需要证明自己是一名可行的银幕表演者。然而，主流途径是有限的，他的第一部电影是在电影业的边缘拍摄的。由传奇非裔美国电影制片人奥斯卡·米肖 (Oscar Micheaux) 执导的《肉体与灵魂》直接批判了布料的力量，让罗伯森扮演了双重角色：杰克腿传教士和善意的发明家。
hook_en: Although the 1920s brought him acclaim as a stage actor and singer, Paul Robeson still had to prove himself as a viable screen performer. Mainstream avenues were limited, however, and his first films were made on the peripheries of the film business. Body and Soul, directed by the legendary African American filmmaker Oscar Micheaux, is a direct critique of the power of the cloth, casting Robeson in dual roles as a jackleg preacher and a well-meaning inventor.

hook: 为了寻求新的艺术发展途径，保罗·罗伯森 (Paul Robeson) 于 1928 年举家迁往伦敦。在接下来的 12 年里，他主演了六部英国电影，开拓了黑人演员的未知领域，并达到了好莱坞难以想象的声望。然而，罗伯逊的第一部英国作品佐尔坦·科尔达的《河中桑德斯》最终让这位演员感到尴尬，它讲述非洲部落领袖的故事变成了对大英帝国的庆祝。
hook_en: Seeking out new avenues for his artistry, Paul Robeson moved his family to London in 1928. During the next twelve years, he headlined six British films, pioneering uncharted territory for black actors and reaching a level of prominence unthinkable in Hollywood. Robeson's first British production, Zoltán Korda's Sanders of the River, however, ended up being an embarrassment for the actor, its story of an African tribal leader transformed into a celebration of the British Empire.

hook: 在《阿兰布里斯塔！》中，一名墨西哥农场工人偷偷越过边境来到加利福尼亚州赚钱寄给家人。这是一个每天都在发生的故事，由美国独立电影制片人罗伯特·M·杨 (Robert M. Young) 在这部毫不妥协、开创性的现实主义作品中讲述。杨的影片生动而简洁，与其他有关非法移民的电影可能会多愁善感的地方不同，它既是亲密的人物研究，又是扣人心弦的公路电影，这是一部永远不会忽视核心复杂人物的政治作品。 ¡《Alambrista!》于 1978 年荣获戛纳电影节首届金摄影机奖，至今仍然是围绕这个永恒相关话题制作的最佳影片之一。
hook_en: In ¡Alambrista!, a Mexican farmworker sneaks across the border to California to make money to send to his family back home. It is a story that happens every day, told here in an uncompromising, groundbreaking work of realism from American independent filmmaker Robert M. Young. Vivid and spare where other films about illegal immigration might sentimentalize, Young’s take is equal parts intimate character study and gripping road movie, a political work that never loses sight of the complex man at its center. ¡Alambrista!, winner of the Cannes Film Festival’s inaugural Caméra d’Or in 1978, remains one of the best films ever made on this perennially relevant topic.

hook: 第二次世界大战开始时，保罗·罗伯逊放弃了利润丰厚的主流工作，转而参与更具社会进步性的电影和舞台制作。在热门英国电视剧《骄傲的山谷》中，罗伯逊饰演大卫·歌利亚（David Goliath），他是一个典型的普通人，一名美国水手，加入了威尔士普通矿工的行列，组织起来对抗当权者。
hook_en: By the start of World War II, Paul Robeson had given up his lucrative mainstream work to participate in more socially progressive film and stage productions. As David Goliath, in the popular British drama The Proud Valley, Robeson is the quintessential everyman, an American sailor who joins rank-and-file Welsh miners organizing against the powers that be.

hook: 在他的《方丹哈斯》三部曲中极其美丽的第二部电影中，佩德罗·科斯塔抛弃了他早期电影中较大的工作人员，转而更深入地探索里斯本贫民窟及其绝望居民的生活。 《在万达的房间》带着纪录片的亲密感和维米尔画作的质感，以坚定、零碎的方式审视了少数自我毁灭、边缘化的人，但以海洛因成瘾者万达·杜阿尔特为中心。科斯塔以令人消除戒备的实事求是的方式展现了万达和她邻居的日常生活，通过他的镜头，许多人认为一次性的人变得生动而充满活力。这是科斯塔第一次使用数字视频，他创作的令人回味的图像仍然是该媒体最令人惊叹的图像之一。
hook_en: For the extraordinarily beautiful second film in his Fontainhas trilogy, Pedro Costa jettisoned his earlier films’ larger crews to burrow even deeper into the Lisbon ghetto and the lives of its desperate inhabitants. With the intimate feel of a documentary and the texture of a Vermeer painting, In Vanda’s Room takes an unflinching, fragmentary look at a handful of self-destructive, marginalized people, but is centered around the heroin-addicted Vanda Duarte. Costa presents the daily routines of Vanda and her neighbors with disarming matter-of-factness, and through his camera, individuals whom many would deem disposable become vivid and vital. This was Costa’s first use of digital video, and the evocative images he created remain some of the medium’s most astonishing.

hook: Crumb 导演 Terry Zwigoff 的第一部电影是一场真正的享受：一部关于默默无闻的乡村布鲁斯音乐家和独特的视觉艺术家霍华德“Louie Bluie”阿姆斯特朗的纪录片，他是美国最后一个已知的黑人弦乐队的成员。路易是一位饶舌的演员，也是一位令人着迷的演员，他创造了一个非常有趣的电影主题，茨维戈夫以一种不带感情色彩但充满深情的敬意向他致敬。 《Louie Bluie》充满了富有感染力的音乐和喜剧，是对茨维戈夫在未来几年将继续挖掘的那种流行文化旁注的人性化唤起。
hook_en: Crumb director Terry Zwigoff’s first film is a true treat: a documentary about the obscure country-blues musician and idiosyncratic visual artist Howard “Louie Bluie” Armstrong, member of the last known black string band in America. As beguiling a raconteur as he is a performer, Louie makes for a wildly entertaining movie subject, and Zwigoff honors him with an unsentimental but endlessly affectionate tribute. Full of infectious music and comedy, Louie Bluie is a humane evocation of the kind of pop-cultural marginalia that Zwigoff would continue to excavate in the coming years.

hook: 这部由 DIY 导演肖恩·贝克 (Sean Baker) 创作的一部原始而感人的新现实主义片子，讲述了西非移民拉基 (阿杜王子饰) 和他的亚美尼亚籍黎巴嫩老板莱文 (凯伦·卡拉古利安饰) 的世界，这两个不太可能的朋友在曼哈顿的批发区兜售仿冒名牌商品。当一位早已被遗忘的前任强迫他照顾一个他甚至不知道自己有年幼的儿子时，幸运儿必须弄清楚如何成为一名父亲，同时又不失去在假冒商品游戏中的优势。 《百老汇王子》通过富有表现力的手持摄影作品、极其自然主义的表演和闪烁的狂躁幽默捕捉了城市生活的混乱，是贝克对美国梦的虚幻本质最生动的探索之一。
hook_en: A raw, disarmingly moving slice of neorealism, this early-career triumph from DIY auteur Sean Baker plunges into the world of West African immigrant Lucky (Prince Adu) and his Armenian Lebanese boss Levon (Karren Karagulian), two unlikely friends who peddle knockoff designer goods in Manhattan’s wholesale district. When a long-forgotten ex forces him to take care of a young son he didn’t even know he had, Lucky must figure out how to become a father without losing his edge in the counterfeit-merch game. Capturing the chaos of urban life through expressive handheld camera work, remarkably naturalistic performances, and flashes of manic humor, Prince of Broadway is one of Baker’s most vivid explorations of the illusory nature of the American dream.

hook: 莎拉·马尔多罗的这一革命性重磅炸弹记录了安哥拉独立运动的觉醒。 《Sambizanga》根据真实故事改编，讲述了一名年轻女子从罗安达郊区前往市中心寻找被葡萄牙当局逮捕的丈夫的故事，这一事件最终将引发全国起义。这部具有里程碑意义的政治电影以非专业演员阵容为主角——其中许多人本身就参与了反殖民抵抗——颂扬了女性在全球解放斗争中的重要作用，以及她们所承受的艰辛。
hook_en: This revolutionary bombshell by Sarah Maldoror chronicles the awakening of Angola’s independence movement. Based on a true story, Sambizanga follows a young woman as she makes her way from the outskirts of Luanda toward the city’s center looking for her husband after his arrest by the Portuguese authorities—an incident that will ultimately help to ignite a national uprising. Featuring a cast of nonprofessionals—many of whom were themselves involved in anticolonial resistance—this landmark work of political cinema honors the essential roles of women, as well as the hardships they endure, in the global struggle for liberation.

hook: 一名年轻人开始痴迷于寻找在这对夫妇进行阳光明媚的假期旅行时神秘失踪的女友，他为期三年的调查引起了绑架者的注意，绑架者是一位性格温和的教授，但心智却异常邪恶。荷兰电影制片人乔治·斯鲁泽的《消失》是一个非正统的爱情故事，也是一部真正令人不安的惊悚片，以一丝不苟的强度展开，带来令人难忘的结局，让世界各地的观众感到不安。
hook_en: A young man embarks on an obsessive search for the girlfriend who mysteriously disappeared while the couple were taking a sunny vacation trip, and his three-year investigation draws the attention of her abductor, a mild-mannered professor with a clinically diabolical mind. An unorthodox love story and a truly unsettling thriller, Dutch filmmaker George Sluizer’s The Vanishing unfolds with meticulous intensity, leading to an unforgettable finale that has unnerved audiences around the world.

hook: 在执导了 20 世纪 70 年代最非凡的两部电影《荒原》和《天堂之日》后，美国艺术家泰伦斯·马力克从电影界消失了 20 年，直到 1998 年凭借这部根据詹姆斯·琼斯 1962 年小说改编的影片重新出现，该小说讲述了第二次世界大战瓜达尔卡纳尔岛战役的故事。 《细细的红线》是一部耗资巨大、场面壮观的史诗片，也是好莱坞主要制片厂发行的最深刻的哲学电影之一，是对人、自然和暴力的发人深省的思考。 《细细的红线》由西恩·潘、吉姆·卡维泽、尼克·诺尔特、埃利亚斯·科泰斯和伍迪·哈里森等当代电影界最优秀的演员组成，以万花筒般的方式再现了战争经历，堪称有史以来最伟大的战争电影之一。
hook_en: After directing two of the most extraordinary movies of the 1970s, Badlands and Days of Heaven, American artist Terrence Malick disappeared from the film world for twenty years, only to resurface in 1998 with this visionary adaptation of James Jones’s 1962 novel about the World War II battle for Guadalcanal. A big-budget, spectacularly mounted epic, The Thin Red Line is also one of the most deeply philosophical films ever released by a major Hollywood studio, a thought-provoking meditation on man, nature, and violence. Featuring a cast of contemporary cinema’s finest actors—Sean Penn, Jim Caviezel, Nick Nolte, Elias Koteas, and Woody Harrelson among them—The Thin Red Line is a kaleidoscopic evocation of the experience of combat that ranks as one of the greatest war films ever produced.

hook: 《上海快车》将冒险、浪漫和《守则》之前的情色令人陶醉地融合在一起，标志着这一标志性合作的商业巅峰。玛琳·黛德丽 (Marlene Dietrich) 饰演上海百合，她是一名邪恶的妓女，她的名声给穿越饱受战争蹂躏的中国的三天火车之旅带来了一丝丑闻的暗示。在船上，她周围都是一群外国人和下等人，其中包括一个堕落的女人（黄柳霜饰）、一个旧情人（克莱夫·布鲁克饰）和一个被当局通缉的叛乱领袖（华纳·奥兰饰）。随着紧张局势达到白热化，导演约瑟夫·冯·斯特恩伯格呈现出一幅又一幅令人惊叹的画面，将他的明星笼罩在大量羽毛、毛皮和香烟烟雾中。其结果是工作室电影制作的胜利，并证明了好莱坞魅力的神话力量。
hook_en: An intoxicating mix of adventure, romance, and pre-Code salaciousness, Shanghai Express marks the commercial peak of an iconic collaboration. Marlene Dietrich is at her wicked best as Shanghai Lily, a courtesan whose reputation brings a hint of scandal to a three-day train ride through war-torn China. On board, she is surrounded by a motley crew of foreigners and lowlifes, including a fellow fallen woman (Anna May Wong), an old flame (Clive Brook), and a rebel leader wanted by the authorities (Warner Oland). As tensions come to a boil, director Josef von Sternberg delivers one breathtaking image after another, enveloping his star in a decadent profusion of feathers, furs, and cigarette smoke. The result is a triumph of studio filmmaking and a testament to the mythic power of Hollywood glamour.

hook: 轰动一时的黑帮电影《疤面煞星》在银幕上枪林弹雨，为未来几十年的此类电影设定了标准。保罗·穆尼（Paul Muni）趾高气扬、可怕而又出人意料地迷人，他饰演的托尼·卡蒙特（Tony Camonte）是一个冷酷、手持机枪的黑帮分子，他在走私帝国的行列中崛起，人数不断增加，但他与野孩子妹妹（安·德沃夏克饰）的占有关系可能会导致他的毁灭。导演霍华德·霍克斯凭借对剪辑和对话的精准掌控以及他标志性的气派，创造了一种势不可挡的活力感，同时将银幕上的暴力推向了新的残酷高度。
hook_en: Blazing across the screen in a spray of bullets, the gangster-film sensation Scarface helped set the standard for the genre for decades to come. Swaggering, scary, and unexpectedly charming, Paul Muni gives an iconic portrayal of criminal sociopathy as Tony Camonte, the ruthless, machine-gun-toting mobster who rises through the ranks of a bootlegging empire atop an ever-increasing body count, but whose possessive relationship with his wild-child sister (Ann Dvorak) threatens to be his undoing. With rat-a-tat command of editing and dialogue, and his trademark panache, director Howard Hawks creates an unstoppable sense of dynamism while pushing on-screen violence to new heights of brutality.

hook: 卡雷尔·泽曼 (Karel Zeman) 的这部早期故事片融合了自然历史和科幻小说，令人着迷，讲述了四个男生踏上一次令人惊叹的穿越时空探险之旅，在那里他们看到了早已从地球上消失的风景和生物。 《时间之源之旅》密切关注那个时代的科学知识，通过定格动画、木偶和真人大小模型等多种创新技术，让史前野兽栩栩如生，营造出一种纯粹的惊奇氛围。
hook_en: A beguiling mix of natural history and science fiction, this early feature by Karel Zeman follows four schoolboys on an awe-inspiring expedition back through time, where they behold landscapes and creatures that have long since vanished from the earth. Hewing closely to the scientific knowledge of its era, Journey to the Beginning of Time brings its prehistoric beasts alive through a number of innovative techniques—including stop-motion, puppetry, and life-size models—creating an atmosphere of pure wonderment.

hook: 《我的狗的生活》（Mitt liv som hund）讲述了来自工人阶级家庭的十二岁男孩英格玛的故事，当他的母亲生病时，他被送到一个乡村与叔叔一起生活。在那里，在镇上热心怪人的帮助下，男孩找到了躲避不幸的避难所，也遇到了意想不到的冒险。这部电影由年轻的安东·格兰泽利乌斯以令人难以置信的成熟和不做作的表演为特色，奥斯卡提名导演莱塞·霍尔斯特罗姆对童年的挣扎和欢乐进行了深爱和苦乐参半的回忆。
hook_en: My Life as a Dog (Mitt liv som hund) tells the story of Ingemar, a twelve-year-old from a working-class family sent to live with his uncle in a country village when his mother falls ill. There, with the help of the warmhearted eccentrics who populate the town, the boy finds both refuge from his misfortunes and unexpected adventure. Featuring an incredibly mature and unaffected performance by the young Anton Glanzelius, this film is a beloved and bittersweet evocation of the struggles and joys of childhood from Oscar-nominated director Lasse Hallström.

hook: 为了这部血肉与机器冰冷的色情融合，大卫·柯南伯格将 J.G.巴拉德 20 世纪 70 年代的未来震撼小说改编成 20 世纪 90 年代最奇特、最具挑衅性的电影之一。心怀不满的商业制片人詹姆斯（詹姆斯·斯派德饰）和神秘的医生海伦（霍利·亨特饰）发生了一场交通事故，他们和詹姆斯的妻子凯瑟琳（黛博拉·卡拉·安格饰）一起陷入了鲜血和碎玻璃的严酷考验中——不久之后，他们就都进入了一个充满施虐受虐式车祸的变态、痴迷于死亡的地下世界。对于恋物癖者来说，扭曲的金属和疤痕组织是最终的刺激点。 《撞车》从在戛纳首映的那一刻起就备受争议，并因“原创性、大胆性和无畏性”而获得评审团特别奖。此后，《撞车》已成为二十世纪后期电影的关键文本，一部关于人性与技术、性与暴力之间关系的令人不安的诱人论文，既令人不安，又令人着迷。
hook_en: For this icily erotic fusion of flesh and machine, David Cronenberg adapted J. G. Ballard’s future-shock novel of the 1970s into one of the most singular and provocative films of the 1990s. A traffic collision involving a disaffected commercial producer, James (James Spader), and an enigmatic doctor, Helen (Holly Hunter), brings them, along with James’s wife, Catherine (Deborah Kara Unger, in a sublimely detached performance), together in a crucible of blood and broken glass—and it’s not long before they are all initiated into a kinky, death-obsessed underworld of sadomasochistic car-crash fetishists for whom twisted metal and scar tissue are the ultimate turn-ons. Controversial from the moment it premiered at Cannes—where it won a Special Jury Prize “for originality, for daring, and for audacity”—Crash has since taken its place as a key text of late-twentieth-century cinema, a disturbingly seductive treatise on the relationships between humanity and technology, sex and violence, that is as unsettling as it is mesmerizing.

hook: 在约瑟夫·冯·斯特恩伯格对工人阶级海滨人民的生动描绘中，粗脖子司炉员比尔·罗伯茨（乔治·班克罗夫特饰）在短暂的上岸休假期间，爱上了梅（贝蒂·康普森饰），一个聪明而疲惫的舞厅女孩，他陷入了各种各样的麻烦。哈罗德·罗森（《日落大道》）的雾气笼罩的摄影，以及班克罗夫特和康普森的感性表演，使本片成为这位传奇导演最好的作品之一，也是那个时代制作最精美的电影之一。
hook_en: Roughneck stoker Bill Roberts (George Bancroft) gets into all sorts of trouble during a brief shore leave when he falls hard for Mae (Betty Compson), a wise and weary dance-hall girl, in Josef von Sternberg’s evocative portrait of working-class waterfront folk. Fog-enshrouded cinematography by Harold Rosson (Sunset Boulevard), and sensual performances by Bancroft and Compson make this one of the legendary director’s finest works, and one of the most exquisitely crafted films of the era.

hook: 《Blob》是一部充满胶质感的佳作，讲述了一个外星怪兽在小城镇中 wreak havoc 的故事，该怪兽既没有灵魂也没有脊椎。史蒂夫·麦奎因饰演了一名试图警告居民关于这种胶状入侵者的叛逆青少年。强档的表演和巧妙的特效帮助《Blob》超越了它诞生的低俗科幻和青少年犯罪类型。这部作品是由一位独立制片人和一支以宗教和教育短片为主的团队制作的，好莱坞之外的作品。史蒂夫·麦奎因和作曲家布特·巴赫拉奇的职业生涯也因此得到了提升，他们的活泼主题曲只是这部影片众多意外之喜中的一个。
hook_en: A cult classic of gooey greatness, The Blob follows the havoc wreaked on a small town by an outer-space monster with neither soul nor vertebrae, with Steve McQueen playing the rebel teen who tries to warn the residents about the jellylike invader. Strong performances and ingenious special effects help The Blob transcend the schlock sci-fi and youth delinquency genres from which it originates. Made outside of Hollywood by a maverick film distributor and a crew whose credits mostly comprised religious and educational shorts, The Blob helped launch the careers of McQueen and composer Burt Bacharach, whose bouncy title song is just one of this film’s many unexpected pleasures.

hook: 大岛渚的第二部长片讲述了有毒世界中有毒爱情的灼热故事，标志着日本电影史上最激进声音之一的艺术突破。陷入战后东京的残酷竞争中，十几岁的恋人诚（桑野美雪饰）和清志（河津佑介饰）转而走上犯罪之路，诱骗好色的中年男子以勒索他们的钱财。但任性的年轻人又能摆脱命运多久呢？这部视觉上闪烁、极度虚无主义的电影充满了鲜艳的色彩，对一个一切——爱、性和年轻理想主义——都被腐蚀的社会发出了愤怒的咆哮。
hook_en: A scorching tale of toxic love in a toxic world, Nagisa Oshima’s second feature film marked the artistic breakthrough of one of the most radical voices in the history of Japanese cinema. Caught in the dog-eat-dog crucible of postwar Tokyo, teenage lovers Makoto (Miyuki Kuwano) and Kiyoshi (Yusuke Kawazu) turn to a life of crime, entrapping lecherous middle-aged men in order to extort their money. But how long can the wayward youths outrun their fate? Bursting with vivid color, this visually scintillating, furiously nihilistic film howls with rage at a society in which everything—love, sex, and youthful idealism—has been corrupted.

hook: 温贝托·索拉斯 (Humberto Solás) 创作的歌剧史诗《露西亚》是古巴电影史上令人眼花缭乱的里程碑，它通过三位同名女性的视角讲述了一个不断变化的国家的历史。 1895年，露西娅是一位悲惨的贵妇，她无意中为了爱情而背叛了自己的国家。 1932年，她是资产阶级的一员，卷入了反对独裁者的工人起义。在革命后的 20 世纪 60 年代，她是一位与父权压迫作斗争的农村新婚夫妇。索拉斯庞大的三联画以一系列独特、令人回味的视觉风格拍摄，是激进进步的重要文献。
hook_en: A formally dazzling landmark of Cuban cinema by Humberto Solás, the operatic epic Lucía recounts the history of a changing country through the eyes of three eponymous women. In 1895, Lucía is a tragic noblewoman who inadvertently betrays her country for love. In 1932, she is a member of the bourgeoisie drawn into the workers’ uprising against the dictator. And in the postrevolutionary 1960s, she is a rural newlywed struggling against patriarchal oppression. Shot in an array of distinct, evocative visual styles, Solás’s sprawling triptych is a vital document of radical progress.

hook: 《复仇》是一部扣人心弦的惊悚片，也是一部近乎希腊风格的悲剧剧，是奥地利电影制片人格茨·斯皮尔曼 (Götz Spielmann) 获得奥斯卡提名的令人惊叹的国际突破作品。在维也纳的一个破烂不堪的地区，铁石心肠的前科犯亚历克斯（迷人的约翰内斯·克里施饰）在一家妓院工作，在那里他爱上了乌克兰妓女塔玛拉。他们绝望的逃跑计划意外地与一名乡村警察和他看似满足的妻子的生活交织在一起。斯皮尔曼以细致、优雅的导演手法，塑造了一幅紧张的、存在主义的、令人惊讶的复仇与救赎的肖像，以及一段进入人性最黑暗的森林的旅程，其中暴力与美丽并存。
hook_en: A gripping thriller and a tragic drama of nearly Greek proportions, Revanche is the stunning, Oscar-nominated international breakthrough of Austrian filmmaker Götz Spielmann. In a ragged section of Vienna, hardened ex-con Alex (the mesmerizing Johannes Krisch) works in a brothel, where he falls for Ukrainian hooker Tamara. Their desperate plans for escape unexpectedly intersect with the lives of a rural cop and his seemingly content wife. With meticulous, elegant direction, Spielmann creates a tense, existential, and surprising portrait of vengeance and redemption, and a journey into the darkest forest of human nature, in which violence and beauty exist side by side.

hook: 马泰奥·加洛尼 (Matteo Garrone) 的《蛾摩拉》展现了当代黑帮的赤裸裸、令人震惊的景象，也是电影中对有组织犯罪最真实的描述之一。在这部根据意大利卧底记者罗伯托·萨维亚诺揭露那不勒斯黑手党黑社会（即卡莫拉）的畅销书改编而成的杰作中，加隆将五个不同的故事联系在一起，在这些故事中，男人和孩子都陷入了从住房项目到高级时装世界的腐败体系中。 《蛾摩拉》以一种精致的超然态度拍摄，但又被爆发的暴力打断，是一部由意大利电影界新锐人物打造的令人震惊、社会参与的真实犯罪故事。
hook_en: Matteo Garrone’s Gomorrah is a stark, shocking vision of contemporary gangsterdom, and one of cinema’s most authentic depictions of organized crime. In this tour de force adaptation of undercover Italian reporter Roberto Saviano’s best-selling exposé of Naples’ Mafia underworld (known as the Camorra), Garrone links five disparate tales in which men and children are caught up in a corrupt system that extends from the housing projects to the world of haute couture. Filmed with an exquisite detachment interrupted by bursts of violence, Gomorrah is a shattering, socially engaged true-crime story from a major new voice in Italian cinema.

hook: 在阿诺·德斯普勒钦 (Arnaud Desplechin) 的引人入胜的《圣诞节故事》(Un conte de Noël) 中，凯瑟琳·德纳芙 (Catherine Deneuve) 将她传奇般的泰然自若演绎为朱农 (Junon) 的角色。然而，这种简单的家庭团聚设置并不能开始描述这部电影中不可预测的、情绪波动的经历，这是一部充满创意、神奇的戏剧，一半是欢乐，一半是忧郁。童年单相思的爱和盲目的怨恨，残酷的爆发和突然的闹剧，音乐，电影和诗歌，《圣诞故事》将所有这些都捆绑在一个极其混乱的包裹中。
hook_en: In Arnaud Desplechin’s beguiling A Christmas Tale (Un conte de Noël), Catherine Deneuve brings her legendary poise to the role of Junon, matriarch of the troubled Vuillard family, who come together at Christmas after she learns she needs a bone marrow transplant from a blood relative. That simple family reunion setup, however, can’t begin to describe the unpredictable, emotionally volatile experience of this film, an inventive, magical drama that’s equal parts merriment and melancholy. Unrequited childhood loves and blinding grudges, brutal outbursts and sudden slapstick, music, movies, and poetry, A Christmas Tale ties it all together in a marvelously messy package.

hook: 安德烈·塔可夫斯基（ Andrei Tarkovsky ）的第二部作品追溯了著名偶像画家的生活，生动地让人联想到中世纪俄罗斯的阴暗世界。这部梦幻般且非常有触觉的电影跟随安德烈·鲁布列夫（ Andrei Rublev ）穿过一系列诗意相连的场景--雪落在一个未完成的教堂里，裸露的异教徒在火炬仪式中穿过灌木丛，一个男孩监督泥土的清理，以锻造一个巨大的铃铛…
hook_en: Tracing the life of a renowned icon painter, the second feature by Andrei Tarkovsky vividly conjures the murky world of medieval Russia. This dreamlike and remarkably tactile film follows Andrei Rublev as he passes through a series of poetically linked scenes—snow falls inside an unfinished church, naked pagans stream through a thicket during a torchlit ritual, a boy oversees the clearing away of muddy earth for the forging of a gigantic bell—gradually emerging as a man struggling mightily to preserve his creative and religious integrity. Appearing here in the director’s preferred 183-minute cut as well as the version that was originally suppressed by Soviet authorities, the masterwork Andrei Rublev is one of Tarkovsky’s most revered films, an arresting meditation on art, faith, and endurance.

hook: 当《Apur Sansar》上映时，萨蒂亚吉特·雷不仅执导了前两部 Apu 电影，还执导了杰作《音乐室》，并且正在成为传奇。这个非凡的最后一章让我们主角的旅程圆满了。阿普现在二十岁出头，大学毕业，希望以作家的身份生活。除了他的职业抱负之外，这部电影还描绘了他的浪漫觉醒，这是由于一次最不可能的事件转变而发生的，以及他最终令人担忧的父亲身份。 《Apur Sansar》由即将成为 Ray 常客的苏米特拉·查特吉 (Soumitra Chatterjee) 和莎米拉·泰戈尔 (Sharmila Tagore) 进行明星表演，展示了雷作为纯电影图像制作者令人印象深刻的技巧，《阿普尔·桑萨尔》为这部不朽三部曲画上了一个动人的句号。
hook_en: By the time Apur Sansar was released, Satyajit Ray had directed not only the first two Apu films but also the masterpiece The Music Room, and was well on his way to becoming a legend. This extraordinary final chapter brings our protagonist’s journey full circle. Apu is now in his early twenties, out of college, and hoping to live as a writer. Alongside his professional ambitions, the film charts his romantic awakening, which occurs as the result of a most unlikely turn of events, and his eventual, fraught fatherhood. Featuring soon-to-be Ray regulars Soumitra Chatterjee and Sharmila Tagore in star-making performances, and demonstrating Ray’s ever more impressive skills as a crafter of pure cinematic imagery, Apur Sansar is a moving conclusion to this monumental trilogy.

hook: 经过四十年的传奇职业生涯，泰伦斯·马利克实现了他迄今为止最令人欣喜的愿景，将童年、奇迹和悲伤的故事追溯到时间和空间的外部界限。马利克追溯至创世之初，讲述了一个普世性的童年记忆故事，描绘了 20 世纪 50 年代得克萨斯州一个充满敬畏的孩子（新人亨特·麦克拉肯饰）的成长过程，他学会了如何驾驭自然与优雅的极端，而他的父亲（布拉德·皮特饰）是苦涩且专横的，而母亲则是空灵而有教养的母亲（杰西卡·查斯坦饰）。荣获金棕榈奖的《生命之树》是在电影摄影师伊曼纽尔·卢贝兹基和美术指导杰克·菲斯克的帮助下完成的，标志着马利克独特的电影制作方法在个人性和宇宙性方面达到了顶峰。
hook_en: Four decades into an already legendary career, Terrence Malick realized his most rapturous vision to date, tracing a story of childhood, wonder, and grief to the outer limits of time and space. Reaching back to the dawn of creation, Malick sets a story of boyhood memories on a universal scale, charting the coming of age of an awestruck child (newcomer Hunter McCracken) in Texas in the 1950s, as he learns to navigate the extremes of nature and grace represented by his bitter, often tyrannical father (Brad Pitt) and his ethereal, nurturing mother (Jessica Chastain, in her breakout role). Achieved with the aid of cinematographer Emmanuel Lubezki and production designer Jack Fisk, the Palme d’Or–winning The Tree of Life marks the intimately personal, cosmically ambitious culmination of Malick’s singular approach to filmmaking.

hook: 萨蒂亚吉特·雷原本没有计划拍摄《帕瑟·潘查利》的续集，但在影片在国际上取得成功后，他决定继续阿普的叙述。阿帕拉吉托接续第一部电影的结尾，阿普和他的家人离开乡村，住在繁华的圣城瓦拉纳西（当时称为贝拿勒斯）。随着阿普从睁大眼睛的孩子成长为求知欲旺盛的青少年，最终在加尔各答学习，我们见证了他的学术和道德教育，以及他与母亲的关系日益复杂。这部表达温柔、常常令人心碎的电影在威尼斯电影节上获得了包括金狮奖在内的三项最高奖项，不仅延伸了阿普的故事，而且在精神上加深了阿普的故事。
hook_en: Satyajit Ray had not planned to make a sequel to Pather Panchali, but after the film’s international success, he decided to continue Apu’s narrative. Aparajito picks up where the first film leaves off, with Apu and his family having moved away from the country to live in the bustling holy city of Varanasi (then known as Benares). As Apu progresses from wide-eyed child to intellectually curious teenager, eventually studying in Kolkata, we witness his academic and moral education, as well as the growing complexity of his relationship with his mother. This tenderly expressive, often heart-wrenching film, which won three top prizes at the Venice Film Festival, including the Golden Lion, not only extends but also spiritually deepens the tale of Apu.

hook: 一个神秘的流星状物体降落在加利福尼亚州的一个小镇上。所有的时钟都停止了。一群发光的绿色不明飞行物险恶地盘旋在整个地球上空。火星对地球的入侵已经开始，无论是军事力量还是核物理学家克莱顿·福雷斯特博士（吉恩·巴里饰）的科学知识似乎都无法阻止它。在流派专家乔治·帕尔和拜伦·哈斯金的专业指导下，H.G.威尔斯的这部文明末日经典影片获得了令人毛骨悚然的冷战时代更新，并配有幻觉的彩色技术和富有远见的、荣获奥斯卡奖的特效。 《世界大战》充满了 20 世纪 50 年代科幻小说的图像，既是视觉想象力的一次有影响力的胜利，也是一部至今仍然令人不安的原子时代奇迹和恐怖的记录。
hook_en: A mysterious, meteorlike object has landed in a small California town. All clocks have stopped. A fleet of glowing green UFOs hovers menacingly over the entire globe. The Martian invasion of Earth has begun, and it seems that nothing—neither military might nor the scientific know-how of nuclear physicist Dr. Clayton Forrester (Gene Barry)—can stop it. In the expert hands of genre specialists George Pal and Byron Haskin, H. G. Wells’s end-of-civilization classic receives a chilling Cold War–era update, complete with hallucinatory Technicolor and visionary, Oscar-winning special effects. Emblazoned with iconographic images of 1950s science fiction, The War of the Worlds is both an influential triumph of visual imagination and a still-disquieting document of the wonder and terror of the atomic age.

hook: 当加里·格兰特和凯瑟琳·赫本在有史以来最快、最有趣的电影之一中尽情发挥时，火花四溅——这一高走钢丝的发明行为将美国银幕喜剧推向了荒谬的新高度。一位倒霉的古生物学家（格兰特饰）希望从一位富有的社会名流那里为他的博物馆获得一百万美元的捐赠，但他发现自己与一位头晕目眩的女继承人（赫本饰）纠缠在一起，而疯狂的不幸事件却越来越多——一块失踪的恐龙骨头，一只逍遥法外的豹子，以及其中大量的性别扭曲混乱。 《抚养婴儿》中复杂的对话、自发的表演和令人眼花缭乱的影射，在导演霍华德·霍克斯的《瓶中闪电》的精彩演绎中，形成了一场喜剧混乱的旋风。
hook_en: Screwball sparks fly when Cary Grant and Katharine Hepburn let loose in one of the fastest and funniest films ever made—a high-wire act of invention that took American screen comedy to new heights of absurdity. Hoping to procure a million-dollar endowment from a wealthy society matron for his museum, a hapless paleontologist (Grant) finds himself entangled with a dizzy heiress (Hepburn) as the manic misadventures pile up—a missing dinosaur bone, a leopard on the loose, and plenty of gender-bending mayhem among them. Bringing Up Baby’s sophisticated dialogue, spontaneous performances, and giddy innuendo come together in a whirlwind of comic chaos captured with lightning-in-a-bottle brio by director Howard Hawks.

hook: 《城市之光》是查理·卓别林最喜爱的电影，也是他最终的《小流浪汉》编年史。这位编剧兼导演兼明星在这部无声的故事中，无论是肢体喜剧还是戏剧性的辛酸，都达到了新的优雅水平，讲述了一个可爱的流浪汉爱上了一个在街上卖花的年轻盲人女子（神奇的弗吉尼亚·切里尔饰），并把他误认为是百万富翁的故事。尽管这部大萧条时期的热门作品是在有声电影出现之后才制作的，但卓别林仍然坚定地热爱着有声电影前形式的表现力之美。其成果是他艺术的缩影，也是无声喜剧的最高成就。
hook_en: City Lights, the most cherished film by Charlie Chaplin, is also his ultimate Little Tramp chronicle. The writer-director-star achieved new levels of grace, in both physical comedy and dramatic poignancy, with this silent tale of a lovable vagrant falling for a young blind woman who sells flowers on the street (a magical Virginia Cherrill) and mistakes him for a millionaire. Though this Depression-era smash was made after the advent of sound, Chaplin remained steadfast in his love for the expressive beauty of the pre-talkie form. The result was the epitome of his art and the crowning achievement of silent comedy.

hook: 梅尔文·范·皮布尔斯 (Melvin Van Peebles) 将自己获得托尼奖提名的百老汇音乐剧改编成电影，大胆融合了戏剧和紧张的新浪潮电影发明。埃丝特·罗尔、梅布尔·金和埃文·朗等黑人舞台和银幕明星在这部迷人的另类、寓言般的奇幻作品中主演，其中一对被撒旦派出的恶作剧恶魔蝙蝠化身为人类，目的是在哈莱姆区周六晚上的家庭聚会上造成严重破坏，却发现他们的邪恶计划被主人富有感染力的慷慨精神所挫败。范·皮布尔斯 (Van Peebles) 的原创蓝调和福音歌曲在热情洋溢的舞台上爆发，在对黑人欢乐、温柔、坚韧和力量的肯定生命的庆祝中爆发。
hook_en: Melvin Van Peebles’s film version of his own Tony Award–nominated Broadway musical is a bold blend of theater and nervy, New Wave–inflected cinematic invention. A cast of Black stage and screen luminaries including Esther Rolle, Mabel King, and Avon Long stars in this charmingly offbeat, fablelike fantasy in which a pair of mischief-making devil-bats dispatched by Satan assume human form in order to wreak havoc on a Saturday-night house party in Harlem—only to find their diabolical plan thwarted by their hosts’ infectious generosity of spirit. Staged with ebullience, the original blues- and gospel-infused songs by Van Peebles burst forth in a life-affirming celebration of Black joy, tenderness, resilience, and strength.

hook: 作为德国早期电影大师之一，G.W.帕布斯特似乎具有发掘女演员的天赋。也许他手下的女明星中没有一个比堪萨斯人、曾经是齐格菲女郎的路易丝·布鲁克斯更耀眼，帕布斯特耸人听闻、颇具争议的情节剧《潘多拉魔盒》定义了她的传奇人物。这部电影极具现代感，讲述了火热、傲慢但天真的歌舞女郎露露的螺旋式下降，她的性活力对她周围的每个人都有毁灭性的影响。 《潘多拉魔盒》大胆而时尚，是无声电影的伟大杰作之一，也是布鲁克斯耀眼个性的证明。
hook_en: One of the masters of early German cinema, G. W. Pabst seemed to have an innate talent for discovering actresses. And perhaps none of his female stars shone brighter than Kansas native and onetime Ziegfeld girl Louise Brooks, whose legendary persona was defined by Pabst’s lurid, controversial melodrama Pandora’s Box. Sensationally modern, the film follows the downward spiral of the fiery, brash, yet innocent showgirl Lulu, whose sexual vivacity has a devastating effect on everyone around her. Daring and stylish, Pandora’s Box is one of silent cinema’s great masterworks and a testament to Brooks’s dazzling individuality.

hook: 在成龙这部极具创意的武侠喜剧中，令人瞠目结舌的布景飞速而激烈，这部轰动一时的作品使他成为了世界范围内的勇敢动作奇观的偶像。导演/明星/单人特技机器扮演香港警务督察家驹，他为了打倒毒枭并保护该案的明星证人（中国电影传奇人物林青霞）免受报复而变得流氓。 《警察故事》充满了迷人的傻瓜闹剧和令人惊叹的杂技打斗编排，包括拳头飞舞和玻璃破碎的购物中心史诗般的混战，为摇滚混乱树立了新标准，影响了从香港到好莱坞的一代电影制片人。
hook_en: The jaw-dropping set pieces fly fast and furious in Jackie Chan’s breathtakingly inventive martial-arts comedy, a smash hit that made him a worldwide icon of daredevil action spectacle. The director/star/one-man stunt machine plays Ka-Kui, a Hong Kong police inspector who goes rogue to bring down a drug kingpin and protect the case’s star witness (Chinese cinema legend Brigitte Lin) from retribution. Packed wall-to-wall with charmingly goofball slapstick and astoundingly acrobatic fight choreography—including an epic shopping-mall melee of flying fists and shattered glass—Police Story set a new standard for rock-’em-sock-’em mayhem that would influence a generation of filmmakers from Hong Kong to Hollywood.

hook: 拉斯·冯·提尔的惊人首部剧情片，是一部粗犷的表现主义幻觉，通过破碎的记忆进行了一次 trance 式的探索，是一部悬疑片，也是文化漂泊者精神的迷宫。在埃及的流亡生活中，前警察调查员（迈克尔·埃尔菲克）通过催眠来重温他对欧洲的记忆以及他为了抓住针对儿童的连环杀手而采取危险措施进入对方心灵的经历。在硫磺色的黄色光晕中，只有令人震惊的电蓝色和红色的闪光，电影《犯罪现场》结合了硬汉派黑帮片、反乌托邦科幻片和令人炫目的歌剧式装饰，产生了一种可怕的美丽的精神错乱影像。
hook_en: Lars von Trier’s stunning debut feature is a grungily expressionistic hallucination—a trancelike trawl through fractured memories, a murder mystery, and the psychic limbo of cultural displacement. From his exile in Cairo, a former police investigator (Michael Elphick) undergoes hypnosis in order to relive his memories of Europe and his last case, for which he went to dangerous lengths to enter into the mind of and catch a serial killer targeting children. Bathed in a sulfurous yellow glow pierced only by startling flashes of electric blue and red, The Element of Crime combines hard-boiled noir, dystopian science fiction, and dazzling operatic flourishes to yield a celluloid nightmare of terrifying beauty.

hook: 第二次世界大战使欧洲分裂，十六岁的德国犹太人所罗门（马可·霍夫施奈德饰）随家人逃往波兰后与家人失散，并发现自己不情愿地承担了各种意识形态身份，以隐藏自己犹太身份的致命秘密。他从苏联孤儿院被赶出来，在那里他扮演一个尽职尽责的斯大林主义者，到俄罗斯前线，在那里他作为德国军队的翻译躲在众目睽睽之下，然后回到他的祖国，在那里他扮演了他最危险的角色：希特勒青年团的成员。阿格涅斯卡·霍兰德的战时杰作《欧罗巴欧罗巴》取材于所罗门·佩雷尔的真实经历，讲述了一个令人窒息的生存故事，充满了喜剧冒险的活力，讽刺性地驳斥了纳粹的种族纯洁观念，描绘了一个陷入变幻莫测的历史灾难并为生存而挣扎的年轻人的复杂肖像。
hook_en: As World War II splits Europe, sixteen-year-old German Jew Salomon (Marco Hofschneider) is separated from his family after fleeing with them to Poland, and finds himself reluctantly assuming various ideological identities in order to hide the deadly secret of his Jewishness. He is bounced from a Soviet orphanage, where he plays a dutiful Stalinist, to the Russian front, where he hides in plain sight as an interpreter for the German army, and back to his home country, where he takes on his most dangerous role: a member of the Hitler Youth. Based on the real-life experiences of Salomon Perel, Agnieszka Holland’s wartime tour de force Europa Europa is a breathless survival story told with the verve of a comic adventure, an ironic refutation of the Nazi idea of racial purity, and a complex portrait of a young man caught up in shifting historical calamities and struggling to stay alive.

hook: 伍迪·艾伦饰演一个失业、被老婆管教得严苛的酒鬼，大部分时间都在黑猫咖啡厅消磨时光。当他无意中抓住了一个银行劫匪并获得了一份保安工作时，一切变得荒诞不经。这部电影是以伍迪·艾伦的笔名Mahatma Kane Jeeves所写的，也是他最搞笑的表演之一。《银行抢劫犯》是美国喜剧无可争议的经典之作。
hook_en: W.C. Fields stars as an unemployed, henpecked drunk who spends most of his time at the Black Pussy Cat café. Things take a turn for the absurd when he unwittingly captures a bank robber and lands a job as a security guard. Written by Fields under the pseudonym Mahatma Kane Jeeves and featuring one of his most hilarious performances, The Bank Dick is an undisputed classic of American comedy.

hook: 查理·卓别林在备受争议的杰作《大独裁者》中，既对阿道夫·希特勒进行了讽刺性的讽刺，又对他自己的喜剧角色进行了巧妙的调整。卓别林在他的第一部纯有声电影中，将他崇高的肉体表现在两个角色上：残酷而滑稽的“托曼尼式”独裁者和被误认为是他的善良的犹太理发师。 《大独裁者》由杰克·奥基和保莱特·戈达德主演，在美国正式加入第二次世界大战之前大胆追击法西斯领导人，是一部政治与闹剧的大胆融合，最终以卓别林著名的热情洋溢的演讲达到高潮。
hook_en: In his controversial masterpiece The Great Dictator, Charlie Chaplin offers both a cutting caricature of Adolf Hitler and a sly tweaking of his own comic persona. Chaplin, in his first pure talkie, brings his sublime physicality to two roles: the cruel yet clownish “Tomainian” dictator and the kindly Jewish barber who is mistaken for him. Featuring Jack Oakie and Paulette Goddard in stellar supporting turns, The Great Dictator, boldly going after the fascist leader before the U.S.’s official entry into World War II, is an audacious amalgam of politics and slapstick that culminates in Chaplin’s famously impassioned speech.

hook: 在这部引人入胜的惊悚片中，科斯塔-加夫拉斯将美国对拉丁美洲政治的参与置于显微镜下。一个城市游击队对中央情报局在他们国家秘密组织的反叛乱和酷刑训练感到愤怒（影片中未透露姓名），绑架了一名美国官员（伊夫·蒙当饰），以换取释放政治犯的条件；绑架事件很快引起媒体轰动，并导致暴力事件。由佛朗哥·索利纳斯 (Franco Solinas) 合写的《戒严状态》尖锐地批评美国政府支持外国独裁政权，同时也对激进暴力行为反对此类政权的有效性提出了棘手的问题。
hook_en: Costa-Gavras puts the United States’ involvement in Latin American politics under the microscope in this arresting thriller. An urban guerrilla group, outraged at the counterinsurgency and torture training clandestinely organized by the CIA in their country (unnamed in the film), abducts a U.S. official (Yves Montand) to bargain for the release of political prisoners; soon the kidnapping becomes a media sensation, leading to violence. Cowritten by Franco Solinas, the electrifying State of Siege piercingly critiques the American government for supporting foreign dictatorships, while also asking difficult questions about the efficacy of radical violent acts to oppose such regimes.

hook: 我们看得越仔细，我们对贾斯汀·特里特 (Justine Triet) 精湛的奥斯卡奖获奖作品《摔倒的解剖》(Anatomy of a Fall) 的了解就越少，这是一部引人入胜的法庭惊悚片，探讨了真相变成虚构和虚构变成真相的界限。桑德拉·沃伊特（桑德拉·惠勒饰演，桑德拉·惠勒饰）是一名作家，她将自己的生活素材写成自传小说，她的丈夫因跳出窗外的可疑死亡（或者是自杀？）而受到审判，这开启了一场调查，将彻底改变一个陷入困境的家庭。特里特利用室内剧的极简主义强度，并使用复杂的、省略的剪辑，构建了一个谜团，最终与其说是关于死亡，不如说是关于我们隐藏的生活。
hook_en: The closer we look, the less we know in Justine Triet’s masterful, Oscar-winning Anatomy of a Fall, an eerily riveting courtroom thriller that examines the line where truth becomes fiction and fiction becomes truth. When Sandra Voyter (a transfixing Sandra Hüller), a writer who turns the material of her life into autofiction, is put on trial for the suspicious death by defenestration—or was it suicide?—of her husband, it opens up an inquiry that will turn a troubled home inside out. Tapping into the minimalist intensity of a chamber drama—and using intricate, elliptical editing—Triet constructs a mystery that is ultimately less about a death than about the hidden lives we lead.

hook: 迈克尔·罗默 (Michael Roemer) 开创性的首部故事片由他的亲密合作者罗伯特·M·杨 (Robert M. Young) 精心拍摄，展现了面对恶毒偏见时仍能引起共鸣的人性表达。 《无非是一个人》制作于民权运动的鼎盛时期，通过诚实地描绘了一位南方黑人铁路工人（伊万·迪克森饰）每天面临着歧视和经济不稳定的挑战，试图与他的新婚妻子（爵士乐大师阿比·林肯饰）安定下来并寻找他的父亲（朱利叶斯·哈里斯饰），揭示了系统性种族主义的代价。这部温柔的电影受到马尔科姆·X 的赞赏，现已被公认为美国电影的里程碑，其社会批判的基础是人物令人难忘的复杂性和真实性。
hook_en: Michael Roemer’s groundbreaking first feature, sensitively shot by his close collaborator Robert M. Young, is a still-resonant expression of humanity in the face of virulent prejudice.
