Made at the height of the civil rights movement, Nothing but a Man reveals the toll of systemic racism through its honest portrait of a southern Black railroad worker (Ivan Dixon) confronting the daily challenges of discrimination and economic precarity, as he attempts to settle down with his new wife (jazz great Abbey Lincoln) and track down his father (Julius Harris). Admired by Malcolm X and now recognized as a landmark of American cinema, this tender film grounds its social critique in characters of unforgettable complexity and truth.

hook: 凭借这部温柔而清晰的成长之旅，著名摄影师出身的电影制片人戈登·帕克斯不仅成为第一位制作好莱坞电影的美国黑人导演，还担任编剧、制片人和作曲家，取得了深刻的个人艺术成就。 《学习之树》改编自帕克斯自己的半自传体小说，讲述了纽特·温格 (Newt Winger) 的旅程，他是 1920 年代在堪萨斯州乡村长大的逃亡者的青少年后裔，经历了苦乐参半的初恋，发现自己与亲密朋友的关系受到考验，并应对种族主义法律和教育体系中的不公正现象。这部具有里程碑意义的电影精美地捕捉了其背景下的田园风光，通过对严酷现实、来之不易的教训以及塑造以年轻黑人为中心的自决之路的经常痛苦的道德选择的深刻理解，缓和了怀旧之情。
hook_en: With this tender and clear-eyed coming-of-age odyssey, the renowned photographer turned filmmaker Gordon Parks not only became the first Black American director to make a Hollywood studio film, he also served as writer, producer, and composer, resulting in a deeply personal artistic achievement. Based on Parks’s own semi-autobiographical novel, The Learning Tree follows the journey of Newt Winger, a teenage descendant of Exodusters growing up in rural Kansas in the 1920s, as he experiences the bittersweet flowering of first love, finds his relationship with a close friend tested, and navigates the injustices embedded within racist legal and educational systems. Exquisitely capturing the bucolic splendor of its setting, this landmark film tempers nostalgia with an incisive understanding of the harsh realities, hard-won lessons, and often wrenching moral choices that shape the road to self-determination of the young Black man at its center.

hook: 吉姆·贾木许在他的第一部时代作品《死人》中，将 19 世纪的美国西部想象成一片存在主义荒原，对工业化的破坏、国家的暴力和偏见遗产以及生与死的自然循环进行了超现实的思考。会计师威廉·布莱克（约翰尼·德普饰）刚抵达被遗弃的机器前哨基地，就陷入了一场致命的恋人争吵之中。受伤并在逃的布莱克受到了被遗弃的无名小卒（加里·法默饰）的看护，无名小卒引导他的同伴踏上精神之旅，并教会他沿途施行诗意的正义。 《死人》以罗比·穆勒 (Robby Müller) 拍摄的简朴美丽的黑白摄影和尼尔·杨 (Neil Young) 的现场配乐为特色，是对西部片类型的深刻而独特的修订。
hook_en: With Dead Man, his first period piece, Jim Jarmusch imagined the nineteenth-century American West as an existential wasteland, delivering a surreal reckoning with the ravages of industrialization, the country’s legacy of violence and prejudice, and the natural cycle of life and death. Accountant William Blake (Johnny Depp) has hardly arrived in the godforsaken outpost of Machine before he’s caught in the middle of a fatal lovers’ quarrel. Wounded and on the lam, Blake falls under the watch of the outcast Nobody (Gary Farmer), who guides his companion on a spiritual journey, teaching him to dispense poetic justice along the way. Featuring austerely beautiful black-and-white photography by Robby Müller and a live-wire score by Neil Young, Dead Man is a profound and unique revision of the western genre.

hook: 本片设定在布鲁克林的贝D-Street Do or Die 社区的一个街区，在炎炎夏日，斯派克·李在1989年导演的这部杰作确认了他作为卓越视野和充满激情的社会参与者的作家和导演身份。在一天的时间里，一群难忘的角色——大市长、母亲姐妹、先生爱 Daddy、蒂娜、甜迪威利、Buggin’ Out、Radio Raheem、萨利、皮诺、维托和李的Mookie 等——之间的轻松互动逐渐让位于紧张关系沿着种族界线加剧后的激烈冲突，最终演变成暴力。伴随着公共 Enemy 的“Fight the Power”这首励志的旋律，“Do the Right Thing”是美国电影史上的里程碑，它在政治和情感上同样具有冲击力，与它首次在大银幕上映时一样相关。
hook_en: Set on one block of Brooklyn’s Bed-Stuy Do or Die neighborhood, at the height of summer, this 1989 masterpiece by Spike Lee confirmed him as a writer and filmmaker of peerless vision and passionate social engagement. Over the course of a single day, the easygoing interactions of a cast of unforgettable characters—Da Mayor, Mother Sister, Mister Señor Love Daddy, Tina, Sweet Dick Willie, Buggin Out, Radio Raheem, Sal, Pino, Vito, and Lee’s Mookie among them—give way to heated confrontations as tensions rise along racial fault lines, ultimately exploding into violence. Punctuated by the anthemic refrain of Public Enemy’s “Fight the Power,” Do the Right Thing is a landmark in American cinema, as politically and emotionally charged and as relevant now as when it first hit the big screen.

hook: 编剧兼导演爱丽丝·迪奥普将纪录片导演的开放式探究意识带入她的第一部叙事长片中，构建了一部与众不同的道德和情感分层法庭剧。小说家拉玛（卡伊杰·卡加梅饰）前往法国圣奥梅尔，参加对一名被控谋杀年幼女儿的年轻塞内加尔妇女（古斯拉吉·马兰达饰）的审判，她发现自己被这起与她自己的生活产生深刻共鸣的案件深深震撼。迪奥普将母女关系、移民疏远和后殖民创伤等复杂主题交织成两个神秘联系的女性的尖锐肖像，他放弃了单纯的有罪和清白问题，以探究人类灵魂令人不安的不可知性。
hook_en: Bringing a documentarian’s sense of open-ended inquiry to her first narrative feature, writer-director Alice Diop constructs a morally and emotionally layered courtroom drama unlike any other. When she travels to Saint-Omer, France, to attend the trial of a young Senegalese woman (Guslagie Malanda) accused of murdering her infant daughter, novelist Rama (Kayije Kagame) finds herself shaken to the core by a case that proves to have profound resonances with her own life. Interweaving complex themes of mother-daughter bonds, immigrant alienation, and postcolonial trauma into a piercing portrait of two mysteriously connected women, Diop forgoes mere questions of guilt and innocence in order to plumb the unsettling unknowability of the human soul.

hook: 艺术大师詹姆斯·斯图尔特 (James Stewart) 饰演一位密歇根小镇的律师，他接手了一个棘手的案件：为一名年轻的陆军中尉（本·加扎拉 (Ben Gazzara) 饰）辩护，该中尉被指控谋杀当地一家酒馆老板，他认为该酒馆老板强奸了他的妻子（李·雷米克 (Lee Remick) 饰）。这部扣人心弦的挑战者是好莱坞挑衅者奥托·普雷明格最受欢迎的电影，它对性的坦率讨论具有开创性，但最重要的是，它对言语的力量进行了引人注目的描述。 《解剖谋杀案》拥有出色的配角——年轻的乔治·C·斯科特饰演火热的检察官，传奇律师约瑟夫·N·韦尔奇饰演法官——以及艾灵顿公爵极具影响力的配乐，是美国电影的里程碑，获得了包括最佳影片在内的七项奥斯卡提名。
hook_en: A virtuoso James Stewart plays a small-town Michigan lawyer who takes on a difficult case: the defense of a young army lieutenant (Ben Gazzara) accused of murdering a local tavern owner who he believes raped his wife (Lee Remick). This gripping envelope-pusher, the most popular film by Hollywood provocateur Otto Preminger, was groundbreaking for the frankness of its discussion of sex—but more than anything else, it is a striking depiction of the power of words. Featuring an outstanding supporting cast—with a young George C. Scott as a fiery prosecutor and the legendary attorney Joseph N. Welch as the judge—and an influential score by Duke Ellington, Anatomy of a Murder is an American movie landmark, nominated for seven Oscars, including best picture.

hook: 在凭借《黑客帝国》震惊世界之前，拉娜·沃卓斯基和莉莉·沃卓斯基在她们超时尚的处女作中带来了纯粹的低俗快感，为精彩的喜剧故事注入了美妙的蓝宝石色彩。当男性水管工科基（吉娜·格申饰）吸引了迷人女人维奥莱特（詹妮弗·提莉饰）的注意时，她几乎不知道自己即将卷入一场火热的婚外情和一场高风险的抢劫案中，两人将与暴徒展开对抗。凭借爆裂的对话、甜美的新黑色电影摄影以及格森、蒂莉和乔·潘托里亚诺的现场表演，《束缚》是一场重新想象类型的欢乐之旅，在每一个疯狂的倾斜转折中，紧张和情欲的热度都不断上升。
hook_en: Before they blew the world’s mind with The Matrix, Lana and Lilly Wachowski delivered a jolt of pure pulp pleasure with their hyperstylish debut, which puts a deliciously sapphic spin on a crackerjack caper premise. When butch plumber Corky (Gina Gershon) catches the eye of alluring femme (fatale) Violet (Jennifer Tilly), little does she know she’s about to be drawn into both a torrid affair and a high-stakes heist that will pit the pair against the mob. With crackling dialogue, luscious neonoir cinematography, and live-wire performances by Gershon, Tilly, and Joe Pantoliano, Bound is a genre-reimagining joyride that keeps both the tension and the erotic heat rising through each crazily careening twist.

hook: 唐纳德·萨瑟兰和朱莉·克里斯蒂扮演一对英国已婚夫妇，在一场家庭悲剧后前往威尼斯进行长途旅行。在这座优雅衰败的城市里，他们经历了一系列莫名其妙、恐怖且越来越危险的经历。尼古拉斯·罗伊格的杰作《别看现在》改编自达芙妮·杜穆里埃的故事，是一个精彩而令人不安的超自然故事，以其创新的剪辑和令人难忘的摄影、自然主义的色情和令人难忘的高潮和结局而闻名——恐怖史上最伟大的结局之一。
hook_en: Donald Sutherland and Julie Christie mesmerize as a British married couple on an extended trip to Venice following a family tragedy. While in that elegantly decaying city, they have a series of inexplicable, terrifying, and increasingly dangerous experiences. A masterpiece from Nicolas Roeg, Don’t Look Now, adapted from a story by Daphne du Maurier, is a brilliantly disturbing tale of the supernatural, as renowned for its innovative editing and haunting cinematography as for its naturalistic eroticism and its unforgettable climax and denouement—one of the great endings in horror history.

hook: 孟加拉电影制片人里特维克·加塔克 (Ritwik Ghatak) 这部美丽而哀伤的传奇故事讲述了分治前的东孟加拉邦蒂塔斯河沿岸渔村里人们的动荡生活。加塔克聚焦于一系列迷人人物（尤其是不屈不挠的寡妇巴桑蒂）的悲惨交织命运，讲述了整个社区正在消失的生活方式的辛酸故事。孟加拉国成为独立国家后不久制作的这部椭圆形、绘画性的《提塔斯河》是一部宏大的史诗，出自一位数十年来拥有忠实追随者的导演之手。
hook_en: The Bengali filmmaker Ritwik Ghatak’s stunningly beautiful, elegiac saga concerns the tumultuous lives of people in fishing villages along the banks of the Titas River in pre-Partition East Bengal. Focusing on the tragic intertwining fates of a series of fascinating characters—in particular, the indomitable widow Basanti—Ghatak tells the poignant story of an entire community’s vanishing way of life. Made soon after Bangladesh became an independent nation, the elliptical, painterly A River Called Titas is a grand epic from a director who has had a devoted following for decades.

hook: 在拍摄了《蛮力》和《裸体城市》等美国黑色经典影片后，列入黑名单的导演朱尔斯·达辛前往巴黎，开始了他的杰作：讲述了四名前科犯在光之城策划最后一次光荣抢劫的曲折故事。 《Rififi》是一部终极抢劫电影，融合了悬疑、残酷和黑色幽默，在国际上大受欢迎，为达辛赢得了戛纳电影节最佳导演奖，并证明对随后数十年的抢劫惊悚片产生了巨大影响。
hook_en: After making such American noir classics as Brute Force and The Naked City, the blacklisted director Jules Dassin went to Paris and embarked on his masterpiece: a twisting, turning tale of four ex-cons who hatch one last glorious robbery in the City of Light. Rififi is the ultimate heist movie, a mélange of suspense, brutality, and dark humor that was an international hit, earned Dassin the best director prize at the Cannes Film Festival, and has proven wildly influential on the decades of heist thrillers that have come in its wake.

hook: 这部对里根时代唯物主义的讽刺作品是对流行音乐的狡猾颠覆，令人难以抗拒。汤姆·克鲁斯在他的明星诞生突破中饰演一名芝加哥郊区的预科生，当他的父母出城一周，而一个有进取心的应召女郎（丽贝卡·德·莫妮饰）邀请他去疯狂地走一走时，他的大学生活失去了控制。虽然克鲁斯穿着内裤的嘘声成为 20 世纪 80 年代最具标志性的流行文化时刻之一，但影片出人意料地融合了温柔的浪漫（由 Tangerine Dream 的喜怒无常的合成器配乐增强）和尖锐的资本主义批判仍然新鲜而大胆。
hook_en: A sly piece of pop subversion, this irresistible satire of Reagan-era materialism features Tom Cruise in his star-is-born breakthrough as a Chicago suburban prepster whose college-bound life spirals out of control when his parents go out of town for the week and an enterprising call girl (Rebecca De Mornay) invites him to walk on the wild side. While Cruise boogying in his briefs yielded one of the most iconic pop-cultural moments of the 1980s, it is the film’s unexpected mix of tender romance (enhanced by a moody synth score by Tangerine Dream) and sharp-witted capitalist critique that remains fresh and daring.

hook: 斯坦利·库布里克对冷战焦虑的痛苦搞笑的诠释是好莱坞有史以来对人类愚蠢行为最激烈的讽刺之一。无与伦比的变形者彼得·塞勒斯扮演三个截然不同的角色：英国皇家空军上尉莱昂内尔·曼德拉克，胆怯地试图阻止一位精神错乱的将军（斯特林·海登饰）下令对苏联进行核攻击；无能且永远目瞪口呆的美国总统默金·马弗利，他必须向苏联总理传达非常坏的消息；还有名义上的奇爱本人，一位坐轮椅的总统顾问，有纳粹的过去。 《奇爱博士》或《我如何学会停止担忧并热爱炸弹》几乎在每一个难以想象的场景中都能找到不可思议的欢笑，这是一部颠覆性的杰作，正式宣布库布里克是一位无与伦比的造型师和漆黑的讽刺家。
hook_en: Stanley Kubrick’s painfully funny take on Cold War anxiety is one of the fiercest satires of human folly ever to come out of Hollywood. The matchless shape-shifter Peter Sellers plays three wildly different roles: Royal Air Force Captain Lionel Mandrake, timidly trying to stop a nuclear attack on the USSR ordered by an unbalanced general (Sterling Hayden); the ineffectual and perpetually dumbfounded U.S. President Merkin Muffley, who must deliver the very bad news to the Soviet premier; and the titular Strangelove himself, a wheelchair-bound presidential adviser with a Nazi past. Finding improbable hilarity in nearly every unimaginable scenario, Dr. Strangelove, or: How I Learned to Stop Worrying and Love the Bomb is a subversive masterpiece that officially announced Kubrick as an unparalleled stylist and pitch-black ironist.

hook: 阿彼察邦·韦拉斯哈古 (Apichatpong Weerasethakul) 的处女作给泰国电影带来了尝试的欲望，这是一部无法归类的作品，通过精致的尸体游戏的超现实主义概念折射了对他祖国的纪实印象。阿彼查邦邀请当地人为一个简单的故事提供即兴叙述，描绘了小说的集体构建，因为每次新的遭遇都给它注入了不可预测的幻想和悲伤的色彩。 《正午的神秘物体》历时两年以 16 毫米黑白镜头拍摄，确立了导演对真实与想象之间的多孔界限的迷恋。
hook_en: Apichatpong Weerasethakul brought an appetite for experimen­tation to Thai cinema with his debut feature, an uncategorizable work that refracts documentary impressions of his homeland through the surrealist concept of the exquisite corpse game. Enlisting locals to contribute improvised narration to a simple tale, Apichatpong charts the collective construction of the fiction as each new encounter imbues it with unpredictable shades of fantasy and pathos. Shot over the course of two years in 16 mm black and white, Mysterious Object at Noon established the director’s fascination with the porous boundaries between the real and the imagined.

hook: 在希区柯克最机智也最淘气的喜剧惊悚片里，美丽的玛格丽特·洛克伍德搭火车横穿欧洲，遇见一位迷人的老姑娘（梅·惠蒂夫人），对方却像凭空消失。年轻女子转而追查，卷入复杂的谜团与冒险。迈克尔·雷德格雷夫也出演；《失踪的女人》仍是这位大师最纯粹的乐趣之一。
hook_en: In Alfred Hitchcock's most quick-witted and devilish comic thriller, the beautiful Margaret Lockwood, traveling across Europe by train, meets a charming spinster (Dame May Whitty), who then seems to disappear into thin air. The younger woman turns investigator and finds herself drawn into a complex web of mystery and high adventure. Also starring Michael Redgrave, The Lady Vanishes remains one of the great filmmaker's purest delights.

hook: 苏珊·塞德曼 (Susan Seidelman) 在这部处女作中确立了她对纽约市的独特看法，这是她重塑自我的女性充满活力的肖像的低保真原创作品。逃离新泽西后，典型的朋克雷恩（苏珊·伯曼饰）——一个渔网火花塞——带着成名的使命搬到了这座城市。当她不贴自我推销传单或在薄荷酒廊闲逛时，她就会与保罗（布拉德·林恩饰）和埃里克（理查德·赫尔饰）交往，保罗是住在高速公路旁货车里最好的人，而埃里克则是一个冷漠的摇滚乐手。 《碎片》是第一部角逐金棕榈奖的美国独立电影，采用 16 毫米胶片拍摄，捕捉了 20 世纪 80 年代市中心的坚毅与魅力，配以由 Feelies 等人创作的时而喜怒无常、时而狂热的配乐，是第一部角逐金棕榈奖的美国独立电影，是对过去时代的不褪色的快照。
hook_en: Susan Seidelman established her distinctive vision of New York City with this debut feature, the lo-fi original for her vibrant portraits of women reinventing themselves. After escaping New Jersey, the quintessentially punk Wren (Susan Berman)—a spark plug in fishnets—moves to the city with the mission of becoming famous. When not pasting up self-promotional flyers or hanging at the Peppermint Lounge, she’s getting involved with Paul (Brad Rinn), the nicest guy to ever live in a van next to the highway, and Eric (Richard Hell), an aloof rocker. Shot on 16 mm film that captures the grit and glam of downtown in the 1980s, with an alternately moody and frenetic soundtrack by the Feelies and others, Smithereens—the first American independent film to compete for the Palme d’Or—is an unfaded snapshot of a bygone era.

hook: 罗亚尔·特南鲍姆（吉恩·哈克曼饰）和他的妻子艾瑟琳（安杰丽卡·休斯顿饰）育有三个孩子：查斯、玛戈特和里奇，然后他们分居了。查斯（本·斯蒂勒饰）在十几岁的时候就开始购买房地产，似乎对国际金融有着近乎超自然的理解。玛戈特（格温妮丝·帕特洛饰）是一位剧作家，在九年级时获得了布雷弗曼助学金，金额为 5 万美元。里奇（卢克·威尔逊饰）是一名青少年网球冠军，并连续三年赢得美国国民赛冠军。事实上，所有关于年轻特南鲍姆家族辉煌的记忆都被二十年的背叛、失败和灾难抹去了。 《皇家特南鲍姆一家》是韦斯·安德森对忧郁和救赎的一部搞笑、感人、风格出色的研究作品。
hook_en: Royal Tenenbaum (Gene Hackman) and his wife, Etheline (Anjelica Huston), had three children—Chas, Margot, and Richie—and then they separated. Chas (Ben Stiller) started buying real estate in his early teens and seemed to have an almost preternatural understanding of international finance. Margot (Gwyneth Paltrow) was a playwright and received a Braverman Grant of $50,000 in the ninth grade. Richie (Luke Wilson) was a junior champion tennis player and won the U.S. Nationals three years in a row. Virtually all memory of the brilliance of the young Tenenbaums was subsequently erased by two decades of betrayal, failure, and disaster. The Royal Tenenbaums is a hilarious, touching, and brilliantly stylized study of melancholy and redemption from Wes Anderson.

hook: 性格开朗、成绩优异的高中生特雷西·弗利克（瑞茜·威瑟斯彭饰）一开始就让社会研究老师吉姆·麦卡利斯特（马修·布罗德里克饰）感到不安，但在她发起学生会主席竞选活动后，他的个人生活开始崩溃，事情逐渐失控。在亚历山大·佩恩（Alexander Payne）的讽刺作品《选举》中，这位老师病态地沉迷于贬低他的学生，暗中支持一位破坏性的候选人以阻止她取得胜利，并实施了一系列肮脏的伎俩和鲁莽的承诺，这些与现实世界的政治有着惊人的相似之处。改编自汤姆·佩罗塔当时尚未出版的小说，佩恩将他的中心动态的荒谬性建立在可识别的基础上——背景是他的家乡内布拉斯加州奥马哈，出色的演员阵容由非专业人士组成——并将他对存在严重缺陷的人性的密切观察提炼成其痛苦但暗中同情的本质。
hook_en: Perky, overachieving high schooler Tracy Flick (Reese Witherspoon) gets on the nerves of social-studies teacher Jim McAllister (Matthew Broderick) to begin with, but after she launches her campaign for student-body president and his personal life starts to fall apart, things spiral out of control. In Alexander Payne’s satire Election, the teacher becomes unhealthily obsessed with cutting his student down to size, covertly backing a spoiler candidate to stop her from steamrolling to victory, and putting in motion a series of dirty tricks and reckless promises with uncanny real-world political parallels. Adapting a then-unpublished novel by Tom Perrotta, Payne grounds the absurdity of his central dynamic in the recognizable—the setting is his hometown of Omaha, Nebraska, and the accomplished cast is rounded out with nonprofessionals—and distills his closely observed take on deeply flawed humanity to its bitter but stealthily sympathetic essence.

hook: 查尔斯·伯内特 (Charles Burnett) 的第三部长片是 20 世纪 90 年代初缓慢燃烧的杰作，是美国神话的独特作品。在一场精彩的表演中，丹尼·格洛弗扮演神秘的南方漂流者哈利，一个邪恶的魅力者，突然出现在洛杉矶中南部他老朋友的家门口。很快，哈利的出现似乎给一个看似平静的家庭蒙上了混乱的魔咒，暴露了父母与孩子、传统与变革、美德与诱惑之间阴燃的紧张关系。 《带着愤怒入睡》将令人回味的福音音乐和布鲁斯音乐与丰富的诗意现实主义图像交织在一起，是一部来自自主艺术情感的震撼人心的电影，描绘了浸透在非裔美国神秘主义和民间传说传统中的家庭复原力。
hook_en: A slow-burning masterwork of the early 1990s, this third feature by Charles Burnett is a singular piece of American mythmaking. In a towering performance, Danny Glover plays the enigmatic southern drifter Harry, a devilish charmer who turns up out of the blue on the South Central Los Angeles doorstep of his old friends. In short order, Harry’s presence seems to cast a chaotic spell on what appeared to be a peaceful household, exposing smoldering tensions between parents and children, tradition and change, virtue and temptation. Interweaving evocative strains of gospel and blues with rich, poetic-realist images, To Sleep with Anger is a sublimely stirring film from an autonomous artistic sensibility, a portrait of family resilience steeped in the traditions of African American mysticism and folklore.

hook: 布鲁斯·威利斯（ Bruce Willis ）和全明星演员粗糙的石油钻探人员在迈克尔·贝（ Michael Bay ）的末日太空史诗中执行拯救地球的任务。
hook_en: Bruce Willis and an all-star cast of roughneck oil drillers blast off on a mission to save the planet in Michael Bay’s doomsday space epic.

hook: 导演阿尔伯特·休斯和艾伦·休斯以及编剧泰格·威廉姆斯刚满二十岁，就在 20 世纪 90 年代洛杉矶瓦茨街头以这种宿命论、坚定不移的生死观震惊了美国电影和嘻哈文化。在那里，在 1965 年和 1992 年骚乱的阴影下，年轻的凯恩（泰林·特纳饰）在他残忍的贩毒父亲（塞缪尔·L·杰克逊饰）和他好朋友 O-Dog（拉伦兹·泰特饰）的影响下长大，导致他陷入暴力犯罪的漩涡，尽管他的祖父母和警察尽了最大努力，但他不确定自己是否想逃脱。坚定的罗尼（贾达·萍克特饰）。 《威胁 II 社会》将残酷的现实主义与休斯兄弟在说唱视频中磨练出来的时尚美学融为一体，是一个关于绝望给人类带来毁灭性损失的灼热警示故事。
hook_en: Directors Albert and Allen Hughes and screenwriter Tyger Williams were barely into their twenties when they sent shock waves through American cinema and hip-hop culture with this fatalistic, unflinching vision of life and death on the streets of Watts, Los Angeles, in the 1990s. There, in the shadow of the riots of 1965 and 1992, young Caine (Tyrin Turner) is growing up under the influence of his ruthless, drug-dealing father (Samuel L. Jackson, in a chilling cameo) and his loose-cannon best friend, O-Dog (Larenz Tate), leading him into a spiral of violent crime from which he is not sure he wants to escape, despite the best efforts of his grandparents and the steadfast Ronnie (Jada Pinkett). Fusing grim realism with a propulsively stylish aesthetic honed through the Hughes brothers’ work on rap videos, Menace II Society is a searing cautionary tale about the devastating human toll of hopelessness.

hook: 大卫·柯南伯格通过《扫描仪》将我们带入他最恐怖、最惊心动魄的科幻世界之一。一名具有非凡且具有可怕破坏性的心灵感应能力的人被一个神秘流氓公司的特工逮捕后，他发现自己远不是唯一拥有这种奇怪力量的人，其他一些“扫描者”一心想要统治世界，而其他人则试图阻止他们。这部关于人类思维的广度和局限性的极其可怕和挑衅的电影是柯南伯格标志性的本能和理智的结合，是这位加拿大导演在美国的突破性卖座。
hook_en: With Scanners, David Cronenberg plunges us into one of his most terrifying and thrilling sci-fi worlds. After a man with extraordinary—and frighteningly destructive—telepathic abilities is nabbed by agents from a mysterious rogue corporation, he discovers he is far from the only possessor of such strange powers, and that some of the other “scanners” have their minds set on world domination, while others are trying to stop them. A trademark Cronenberg combination of the visceral and the cerebral, this phenomenally gruesome and provocative film about the expanses and limits of the human mind was the Canadian director’s breakout hit in the United States.

hook: 在《替身》里，大卫·柯南伯格讲述一对同卵双胞胎妇科医生的寒意故事——风流的艾略特与敏感的贝弗利，像同一个人的两极——他们共用诊所、公寓，也共用女人。当新病人、光鲜女演员克莱尔·尼沃挑战这诡异纽带，两人坠入性混乱、毒品与疯狂的漩涡。杰里米·艾恩斯一人分饰双生的精湛表演，提出关于个人身份本质的不安问题。
hook_en: In Dead Ringers, David Cronenberg tells the chilling story of identical twin gynecologists—suave Elliot and sensitive Beverly, bipolar sides of one personality—who share the same practice, the same apartment, the same women. When a new patient, glamorous actress Claire Niveau, challenges their eerie bond, they descend into a whirlpool of sexual confusion, drugs, and madness. Jeremy Irons’s tour-de-force performance—as both twins—raises disturbing questions about the nature of personal identity.

hook: 这部关于太空竞赛的不朽记述向人类的成就和未知的奇迹致敬，向那些带领人类超越地球界限的先驱飞行员致敬。从试飞员查克·耶格尔（山姆·夏普德饰）突破音障的探索，到艾伦·谢泼德（斯科特·格伦饰）和约翰·格伦（艾德·哈里斯饰）等七名水星宇航员划时代的航行，《正确的东西》生动地描述了美国蓬勃发展的太空计划中的胜利、挫折和性格冲突。导演菲利普·考夫曼将惊人的实际效果与美国宇航局的档案镜头融合在一起，产生了宇宙威严的图像，揭示了美国进入轨道背后的勇气、竞争和错误的结合。
hook_en: An awe-inspiring salute to human achievement and the wonder of the unknown, this monumental account of the space race celebrates the pioneering pilots who took mankind beyond the bounds of Earth. From the quest that test pilot Chuck Yeager (Sam Shepard) undertakes to break the sound barrier to the epochal voyages of the seven Mercury astronauts, including Alan Shepard (Scott Glenn) and John Glenn (Ed Harris), The Right Stuff vividly details the triumphs, setbacks, and clashes of personality in America’s burgeoning space program. Fusing astonishing practical effects with NASA archival footage to yield images of cosmic majesty, director Philip Kaufman reveals the combination of courage, competition, and fallibility behind America’s launch into orbit.

hook: 奥斯曼·塞姆贝内 (Ousmane Sembène) 是有史以来最伟大、最具开创性的电影制作人之一，也是二十世纪最著名的非洲导演，但他的名字仍然值得世界其他地方更加知名。 1966年，他凭借才华横溢、激动人心的《黑人女孩》首次亮相。塞姆贝纳在家乡塞内加尔也是一位广受赞誉的小说家，他将一个看似简单的情节——讲述了一位年轻的塞内加尔妇女搬到法国为一个富裕的白人家庭工作，发现她们的小公寓里的生活无论是象征性还是字面意义上都变成了一座监狱——变成了对所谓的后殖民世界中挥之不去的殖民主义心态的复杂层次的批判。 《黑女孩》以 M’Bissine Thérèse Diop 的感人至深的表演为特色，是一部令人痛心的人类戏剧，同时也是一种激进的政治宣言，也是 20 世纪 60 年代最重要的电影之一。 INA，国家视听研究所；闪电泡芙；和国家电影中心。修复工作由电影基金会的世界电影项目资助。
hook_en: Ousmane Sembène was one of the greatest and most groundbreaking filmmakers who ever lived, as well as the most renowned African director of the twentieth century—and yet his name still deserves to be better known in the rest of the world. He made his feature debut in 1966 with the brilliant and stirring Black Girl. Sembène, who was also an acclaimed novelist in his native Senegal, transforms a deceptively simple plot—about a young Senegalese woman who moves to France to work for a wealthy white family and finds that life in their small apartment becomes a prison, both figuratively and literally—into a complexly layered critique of the lingering colonialist mind-set of a supposedly postcolonial world. Featuring a moving central performance by M’Bissine Thérèse Diop, Black Girl is a harrowing human drama as well as a radical political statement—and one of the essential films of the 1960s.Black Girl was restored by the Cineteca di Bologna/L’Immagine Ritrovata laboratory, in association with the Sembène Estate; INA, Institut National de l’Audiovisuel; Éclair; and the Centre National de Cinématographie. Restoration funded by The Film Foundation’s World Cinema Project.

hook: 美国，1976 年。学校的最后一天。水枪在燃烧，喇叭裤在响，摇滚乐也很摇滚。作为有史以来最好的青少年电影之一，《年少轻狂》偷听了一群准高年级学生和即将入学的新生的谈话。理查德·林克莱特 (Richard Linklater) 的第一部工作室作品是许多未来明星的跳板，还具有无数可引用的对话和震撼人心的体育场配乐。避开怀旧情绪，《年少轻狂》讲述的不是“我们生命中最美好的时光”，而是青少年等待的无聊、焦虑和兴奋。 。 。为了某事发生。
hook_en: America, 1976. The last day of school. Bongs blaze, bell-bottoms ring, and rock and roll rocks. Among the best teen films ever made, Dazed and Confused eavesdrops on a group of seniors-to-be and incoming freshmen. A launching pad for a number of future stars, the first studio effort by Richard Linklater also features endlessly quotable dialogue and a blasting, stadium-ready soundtrack. Sidestepping nostalgia, Dazed and Confused is less about “the best years of our lives” than the boredom, angst, and excitement of teenagers waiting . . . for something to happen.

hook: 《Moonage Daydream》是对大卫·鲍伊 (David Bowie) 创作和精神世界的一次欣喜若狂的旅程，是对这位变形摇滚反传统者及其独特声音和视觉的完美致敬。导演布雷特·摩根打破了音乐纪录片的惯例，重新混合了艺术家整个职业生涯中令人眼花缭乱、前所未见的镜头，陶醉于他超凡脱俗的存在，同时揭示了引导他无数变形的不安的哲学探究。在鲍伊深情的旁白的衬托下，这种身临其境的视听冲击传达了一种无法解释、只能体验的现象的本质。
hook_en: An ecstatic voyage through the creative and spiritual universe of David Bowie, Moonage Daydream is a fittingly unclassifiable tribute to the shape-shifting rock iconoclast and his singular sound and vision. Exploding the conventions of the music documentary, director Brett Morgen remixes dazzling, never-before-seen footage of the artist throughout his career, reveling in his otherworldly presence while revealing the restless philosophical inquiry that guided his myriad metamorphoses. Graced with soulful narration by Bowie, this immersive audiovisual head rush transmits the essence of a phenomenon that cannot be explained—only experienced.

hook: 在《Tootsie》中，迈克尔·多尔西 (Michael Dorsey) 获得了一生难忘的角色，扮演他的演员达斯汀·霍夫曼 (Dustin Hoffman) 也是如此。这部由西德尼·波拉克 (Sydney Pollack) 执导的多层次喜剧讲述了一位运气不佳的纽约演员为了获得肥皂剧演出而乔装成女人的精心欺骗故事。当“多萝西·迈克尔斯”名声大噪时，迈克尔发现自己正在学习如何成为一个更好的人。在达布尼·科尔曼、查尔斯·德宁、特瑞·加尔、乔治·盖恩斯、比尔·默里以及杰西卡·兰格的突破性表演等一流演员的支持下，《图西》是一部有趣、尖锐而辛酸的电影，讲述了一个以社会和性别身份转变为特征的美国时代。
hook_en: In Tootsie, Michael Dorsey lands the role of a lifetime—as did the actor playing him, Dustin Hoffman. This multilayered comedy from Sydney Pollack follows the elaborate deception of a down-on-his-luck New York actor who poses as a woman to get a soap opera gig; while “Dorothy Michaels” skyrockets to fame, Michael finds himself learning to be a better man. Given support by a stellar cast that includes Dabney Coleman, Charles Durning, Teri Garr, George Gaynes, Bill Murray, and, in a breakthrough performance, Jessica Lange, Tootsie is a funny, cutting, and poignant film from an American moment defined by shifting social and sexual identities.

hook: 这部令人难忘的肖像影片深入 20 世纪 70 年代的柏林地下，是有史以来关于毒瘾的最令人痛苦的电影之一。这部令人振奋的剧情片根据克里斯蒂娜·费尔斯切里诺的真实故事改编，她的令人震惊的回忆录让她成为了一代陷入困境的德国年轻人的代言人。这部令人振奋的剧情片讲述了被疏远的 13 岁克里斯蒂安·费尔斯切里诺 (Christiane Felscherinow) 的真实故事，讲述了她在西柏林臭名昭著的俱乐部场景中从吸食药丸到吸食海洛因的故事，青春期放纵的高潮让位于城市荒凉边缘的痛苦生活。由于真实的肮脏外景拍摄和大卫·鲍伊 (David Bowie) 的震撼配乐，《克里斯蒂安·F.》(Christiane F.) 立即引起了狂热的追捧，它仍然是一个自由落体的年轻生命的令人难以忘怀的景象。
hook_en: Plunging into the 1970s Berlin underground, this unforgettable portrait stands as one of the most harrowing films ever made about drug addiction. Based on the true story of Christiane Felscherinow—whose shocking memoir made her the face of a generation of troubled German youth—this bracing dramatization follows the alienated thirteen-year-old Christiane (Natja Brunckhorst) as she goes from popping pills to shooting heroin amid West Berlin’s infamous club scene, the highs of adolescent abandon giving way to an agonizing existence on the city’s desolate margins. An instant cult sensation on account of its authentically grimy location shooting and electrifying soundtrack by David Bowie, Christiane F. remains a haunting vision of a young life in free fall.

hook: 梅尔文·范·皮布尔斯（Melvin Van Peebles）的第一部故事片前卫、焦虑、浪漫，根本不可能在美国制作。由于无法闯入种族隔离的好莱坞，范·皮布尔斯逃往法国，自学了法语，并用法语写了许多书，其中一本经许可成为风格创新的《三天通行证的故事》。特纳（哈里·贝尔德饰）是一名驻扎在法国的非裔美国士兵，他的种族主义指挥官给予了他升职和三天的休假，然后他前往巴黎，在那里他与一名白人女子（妮可·伯杰饰）发现了旋风般的恋情——但是当他的休假结束后，他们的爱情会发生什么变化呢？范·皮布尔斯借用了法国新浪潮的傲慢热情，对跨种族关系的心理进行了探索，并对法国对种族的矛盾态度进行了有趣、讽刺和尖锐颠覆的评论，这为他几年后发起的焦土电影革命奠定了基础。
hook_en: Melvin Van Peebles’s edgy, angsty, romantic first feature could never have been made in America. Unable to break into segregated Hollywood, Van Peebles decamped to France, taught himself the language, and wrote a number of books in French, one of which, La permission, would become the stylistically innovative The Story of a Three Day Pass. Turner (Harry Baird), an African American soldier stationed in France, is granted a promotion and a three-day leave from base by his casually racist commanding officer and heads to Paris, where he finds whirlwind romance with a white woman (Nicole Berger)—but what happens to their love when his furlough is over? Channeling the brash exuberance of the French New Wave, Van Peebles creates an exploration of the psychology of an interracial relationship as well as a commentary on France’s contradictory attitudes about race that is playful, sarcastic, and stingingly subversive by turns, and that laid the foundation for the scorched-earth cinematic revolution he would let loose just a few years later.

hook: 查理·卓别林的喜剧杰作讲述了一位探矿者在克朗代克寻找财富并发现他（与美丽的乔治亚·黑尔）的浪漫故事，永远巩固了卓别林和他的小流浪汉角色的标志性地位。 《淘金热》部分在内华达山脉拍摄，并以晚餐卷的舞蹈和煮熟的鞋皮大餐等永恒的笑料为特色，是一部令人难忘的温馨欢闹之作。这个特别版包含了卓别林 1942 年的最终版本（导演为其添加了新的音乐和旁白），以及对 1925 年原版无声电影的全新修复。
hook_en: Charlie Chaplin’s comedic masterwork—which charts a prospector’s search for fortune in the Klondike and his discovery of romance (with the beautiful Georgia Hale)—forever cemented the iconic status of Chaplin and his Little Tramp character. Shot partly on location in the Sierra Nevadas and featuring such timeless gags as the dance of the dinner rolls and the meal of boiled shoe leather, The Gold Rush is an indelible work of heartwarming hilarity. This special edition features both Chaplin’s definitive 1942 version, for which the director added new music and narration, and a new restoration of the original 1925 silent film.

hook: 莉齐·博登 (Lizzie Borden) 对社会上最受污名化的职业的节奏和仪式进行了身临其境、丰富细致的观察，以激进的不带偏见的方式描绘了性工作。受到博登在制作她的地下女权主义地标《生于火焰》时遇到的性工作者的经历的启发，《打工女孩》揭示了莫莉（路易斯·史密斯饰）的一天生活的纹理，莫莉是一名在曼哈顿妓院兼职的摄影师，她要应付源源不断的客户，平衡与同事的关系和一位雄心勃勃的女士的要求，最重要的是，在一个个人与职业之间界限很分明的行业中，她努力保持自我意识。太容易模糊了。通过劳动的视角来看待卖淫，波登大胆地淡化了这个主题，对女性进行了富有同情心、人性化、常常幽默的描绘，对她们来说，这项工作只是办公室的又一天。
hook_en: Sex work is portrayed with radical nonjudgment in Lizzie Borden’s immersive, richly detailed look at the rhythms and rituals of society’s most stigmatized profession. Inspired by the experiences of the sex workers Borden met while making her underground feminist landmark Born in Flames, Working Girls reveals the textures of a day in the life of Molly (Louise Smith), a photographer working part-time in a Manhattan brothel, as she juggles a steady stream of clients, balances nurturing relationships with her coworkers with the demands of an ambitious madam, and above all fights to maintain her sense of self in a business in which the line between the personal and the professional is all too easily blurred. In viewing prostitution through the lens of labor, Borden boldly desensationalizes the subject, offering an empathetic, humanizing, often humorous depiction of women for whom this work is just another day at the office.

hook: 瑞典伟大导演扬·特罗尔的这部令人着迷的处女作是一部史诗般的成长小说，也是二十世纪初瑞典的多层次代表。 《这就是你的生活》改编自诺贝尔奖获得者艾文德·约翰逊的一系列自传小说，讲述了一个工人阶级男孩的成长历程，从天真的少年到求知欲旺盛的年轻人，从伐木工到电影放映员再到热心政治的人民人士——所有这一切都以缓慢工业化的乡村景观为背景。这部引人入胜的电影融合了现代主义视觉独创性和结构优雅的故事叙述，以近三个小时的原版剪辑呈现，提醒人们特罗尔是欧洲电影中对人类状况最优秀、最敏感的阐释者之一。
hook_en: This mesmerizing debut by the great Swedish director Jan Troell is an epic bildungsroman and a multilayered representation of early twentieth-century Sweden. Based on a series of autobiographical novels by Nobel Prize winner Eyvind Johnson, Here Is Your Life follows a working-class boy’s development, from naive teenager to intellectually curious young adult, from logger to movie projectionist to politically engaged man of the people—all set against the backdrop of a slowly industrializing rural landscape. With its mix of modernist visual ingenuity and elegantly structured storytelling, this enchanting film—presented here in its original nearly three-hour cut—is a reminder that Troell is one of European cinema’s finest and most sensitive illuminators of the human condition.

hook: 奥森·威尔斯的第二部长片美丽而充满怀旧气息，是电影界最伟大的缺失镜头悲剧之一的主题，让人回想起二十世纪之交的印第安纳波利斯，记录了一个富裕家庭的命运不可避免的衰退。这部影片改编自布斯·塔金顿广受好评的小说，以充满创意的摄影作品和约瑟夫·科顿、蒂姆·霍尔特和艾格尼丝·摩尔黑德等演员的精彩表演为特色，讲述了安伯森家族内部日益加深的裂痕，同时进步的力量开始改变他们曾经统治的城市。尽管雷电华删除了四十多分钟的镜头（现已消失在历史中），并添加了一个不协调的乐观结局，但《伟大的安伯森一家》是一部情感丰富的家庭传奇，也是对美国生活已逝篇章的绝妙挽歌。
hook_en: Orson Welles’s beautiful, nostalgia-suffused second feature—the subject of one of cinema’s greatest missing-footage tragedies—harks back to turn-of-the-twentieth-century Indianapolis, chronicling the inexorable decline of the fortunes of an affluent family. Adapted from an acclaimed Booth Tarkington novel and featuring restlessly inventive camera work and powerful performances from a cast including Joseph Cotten, Tim Holt, and Agnes Moorehead, the film traces the rifts deepening within the Amberson clan—at the same time as the forces of progress begin to transform the city they once ruled. Though RKO excised over forty minutes of footage, now lost to history, and added an incongruously upbeat ending, The Magnificent Ambersons is an emotionally rich family saga and a masterful elegy for a bygone chapter of American life.

hook: 斯坦利·库布瑞指导了一众银幕传奇，包括克里特·道格拉斯饰演的罗马奴隶起义领袖，带领奴隶反抗罗马统治者，这是一部气势恢宏的史诗巨作，定义了一个电影类型，并帮助 ushered in 了一个新的好莱坞电影时代。影片的精湛演技、华丽的彩色摄影、大胆的服装设计以及震撼的战斗场面赢得了斯巴达克斯广泛的赞誉，包括四座奥斯卡奖，而其将政治与性暗示结合的风格则让观众感到震惊。如今，这部电影——作为好莱坞黑名单的首个公开挑战者，通过雇佣编剧道尔顿·特鲁姆博而问世——仍然是电影艺术与历史上的里程碑。但尽管获得了赞誉，库布瑞的制作过程对雇佣兵库布瑞来说却是令人沮丧的，而且这也是他最后一次在大制作中拥有完全的创作控制权，也是他最后一次在好莱坞拍摄电影。
hook_en: Stanley Kubrick directed a cast of screen legends—including Kirk Douglas as the indomitable gladiator who led a Roman slave revolt—in this sweeping epic, which defined a genre and helped usher in a new era of Hollywood filmmaking. The film’s assured acting, lush Technicolor cinematography, bold costumes, and visceral fight sequences won Spartacus widespread recognition, including four Oscars, while its blend of politics and sexual suggestion scandalized audiences. Today the film—the first to openly defy Hollywood’s blacklist, by employing screenwriter Dalton Trumbo—remains a landmark of cinematic artistry and history. But despite its acclaim, the production was a dispiriting one for hired gun Kubrick, and it proved to be the last major studio feature of his on which he lacked full creative control, and his last time shooting in Hollywood.

hook: 海尔先生（米歇尔·西蒙饰）骄傲、古怪、反社会，总是独来独往。但当一名女子在他居住的巴黎郊区被发现死亡后，他被一名年轻漂亮的新来者（维维安·罗曼丝饰）所吸引，发现他的邻居们已经准备好怀疑他最坏的一面，并被陷害为谋杀案。朱利安·杜维维耶 (Julien Duvivier) 从好莱坞返回法国后的第一部电影改编自乔治·西蒙农 (Georges Simenon) 的小说，讲述了这位广受赞誉的诗意现实主义者将他精湛的技艺运用到更黑暗、更阴郁的结局。在两部深刻细致的主演表演的推动下，紧张的黑色电影《帕尼克》揭露了暴徒心态的危险，同时也对杜维维耶的同胞在战争期间的行为提出了尖锐的寓言。
hook_en: Proud, eccentric, and antisocial, Monsieur Hire (Michel Simon) has always kept to himself. But after a woman turns up dead in the Paris suburb where he lives, he feels drawn to a pretty young newcomer to town (Viviane Romance), discovers that his neighbors are only too ready to suspect the worst of him, and is framed for the murder. Based on a novel by Georges Simenon, Julien Duvivier’s first film after his return to France from Hollywood finds the acclaimed poetic realist applying his consummate craft to darker, moodier ends. Propelled by its two deeply nuanced lead performances, the tensely noirish Panique exposes the dangers of the knives-out mob mentality, delivering as well a pointed allegory for the behavior of Duvivier’s countrymen during the war.

hook: 斯坦利·库布里克的《光荣之路》是有史以来最有力的反战电影之一。性格暴躁的柯克·道格拉斯饰演一位第一次世界大战期间的法国上校，当他的部下因无法执行一项不可能完成的任务而被指责为懦弱时，他与军队中冷酷无情的高级官员正面交锋。这部令人难忘、拍摄精美的影片对军事机器的荒谬性和非人化能力进行了剖析（这是库布里克在他的整个职业生涯中不断探索的主题），从紧张的堑壕战序列到扣人心弦的法庭高潮，再到毁灭性的最后一幕，以其传奇导演一贯的精确性组装而成。
hook_en: Stanley Kubrick's Paths of Glory is among the most powerful antiwar films ever made. A fiery Kirk Douglas stars as a World War I French colonel who goes head-to-head with the army’s ruthless top brass when his men are accused of cowardice after being unable to carry out an impossible mission. This haunting, exquisitely photographed dissection of the military machine in all its absurdity and capacity for dehumanization (a theme Kubrick would continue to explore throughout his career) is assembled with its legendary director’s customary precision, from its tense trench warfare sequences to its gripping courtroom climax to its ravaging final scene.

hook: 在亚历山大·麦肯德里克执导的这部迅速而愤世嫉俗的《成功的甜蜜滋味》中，伯特·兰卡斯特饰演恶毒的百老汇八卦专栏作家 J·J·洪塞克，托尼·柯蒂斯饰演西德尼·法尔科，无原则的新闻经纪人洪塞克怂恿抹黑这位崭露头角的爵士音乐家与他心爱的妹妹的恋情。 《成功的味道》是一部来自 20 世纪 50 年代曼哈顿杀戮或被杀的荒野的残酷报道，由克利福德·奥德茨 (Clifford Odets) 和欧内斯特·雷曼 (Ernest Lehman) 设计的尖酸刻薄的剧本，以及奥斯卡获奖电影摄影师詹姆斯·黄豪 (James Wong Howe) 的黑色霓虹城市景观，以令人愉悦的令人厌恶的对话为特色。
hook_en: In the swift, cynical Sweet Smell of Success, directed by Alexander Mackendrick, Burt Lancaster stars as the vicious Broadway gossip columnist J. J. Hunsecker, and Tony Curtis as Sidney Falco, the unprincipled press agent Hunsecker ropes into smearing the up-and-coming jazz musician romancing his beloved sister. Featuring deliciously unsavory dialogue, in an acid, brilliantly structured script by Clifford Odets and Ernest Lehman, and noirish neon cityscapes from Oscar-winning cinematographer James Wong Howe, Sweet Smell of Success is a cracklingly cruel dispatch from the kill-or-be-killed wilds of 1950s Manhattan.

hook: 一首恰逢其时的完美歌曲、阳光透过树叶的嬉戏、大都市中人与人之间短暂的联系：在维姆·文德斯这部感人至深的电影中，日常生活的奇迹成为令人惊叹的焦点。役所浩二在这部荣获戛纳电影节大奖的表演中，言语不多，但表现力非凡，他在片中饰演一名东京的公共厕所清洁工，他丰富的内心世界通过与周围人和城市本身的微小交流逐渐显露出来。文德斯效仿他的偶像小津安二郎，为此时此地的奇迹创作了一首宁静的极简主义颂歌。
hook_en: A perfect song that hits at just the right moment, the play of sunlight through leaves, a fleeting moment of human connection in a vast metropolis: the wonders of everyday life come into breath­taking focus in this profoundly moving film by Wim Wenders. In a radiant, Cannes-award-winning performance of few words but extraordinary expressiveness, Koji Yakusho plays a public-toilet cleaner in Tokyo whose rich inner world is gradually revealed through his small exchanges with those around him and with the city itself. Channeling his idol Yasujiro Ozu, Wenders crafts a serenely minimalist ode to the miracle that is the here and now.

hook: 一位功勋卓著的退役美国海军陆战队将军（艾德·哈里斯饰）缴获了一批化学武器，并占领了旧金山湾岛上的恶魔岛，并把 81 名游客扣为人质。他的要求是：向在秘密行动中死亡的士兵的家人提供赔偿。回应：一支精英海豹突击队在联邦调查局化学战专家（尼古拉斯·凯奇饰）和一名前恶魔岛逃亡者（肖恩·康纳利饰）的支持下，集结起来，渗透恐怖分子在岛上的防御工事，并在时间耗尽之前消除威胁。结果是：一部快节奏、令人紧张的惊悚片，演员阵容一流，由迈克尔·贝执导，唐·辛普森和杰瑞·布鲁克海默担任制片。
hook_en: A highly decorated, retired U.S. Marine general (Ed Harris) seizes a stockpile of chemical weapons and takes over Alcatraz, with eighty-one tourists as hostages on the San Francisco Bay isle. His demand: Restitution to families of soldiers who died in covert operations. The response: An elite Navy SEAL team, with support from an FBI chemical-warfare expert (Nicolas Cage) and a former Alcatraz escapee (Sean Connery), is assembled to penetrate the terrorists’ defenses on the island and neutralize the threat before time runs out. The result: A fast-paced, edge-of-your-seat thriller with a first-rate cast, directed by Michael Bay and produced by Don Simpson and Jerry Bruckheimer.

hook: 凭借这部极其诙谐的礼仪喜剧，凯瑟琳·赫本重振了她的事业，巩固了她作为那个时代最具标志性的女主角的地位——这在很大程度上要归功于她自己精明的编排。在主演菲利普·巴里的舞台剧《费城故事》时，赫本获得了电影版权，并亲自挑选了她的朋友乔治·库克执导。唐纳德·奥格登·斯图尔特在这部令人陶醉的剧本中，令人敬畏的费城社交名流特雷西·洛德（赫本，在她最辉煌的时期）与各种浪漫的陪衬者展开了对抗，其中最主要的是她富有魅力的前夫（加里·格兰特饰），后者拜访了她的家族庄园，扰乱了她即将到来的婚姻，并陪同一名小报记者奉命报道年度婚礼（詹姆斯·斯图尔特，这是他唯一获得奥斯卡奖的表演）。这是一部语速快的怪诞喜剧，也是一个关于遗憾与和解的故事，这部黄金时代才华的汇聚是有史以来最伟大的美国电影之一。
hook_en: With this furiously witty comedy of manners, Katharine Hepburn revitalized her career and cemented her status as the era’s most iconic leading lady—thanks in great part to her own shrewd orchestrations. While starring in the Philip Barry stage play The Philadelphia Story, Hepburn acquired the screen rights, handpicking her friend George Cukor to direct. The intoxicating screenplay by Donald Ogden Stewart pits the formidable Philadelphia socialite Tracy Lord (Hepburn, at her most luminous) against various romantic foils, chief among them her charismatic ex-husband (Cary Grant), who disrupts her imminent marriage by paying her family estate a visit, accompanied by a tabloid reporter on assignment to cover the wedding of the year (James Stewart, in his only Academy Award–winning performance). A fast-talking screwball comedy as well as a tale of regret and reconciliation, this convergence of golden-age talent is one of the greatest American films of all time.

hook: 天才挑衅者大岛渚是 20 世纪 60 年代日本新浪潮中的一位有影响力的人物，他以引人入胜的黑色讽刺小说《绞死》发表了他最令人震惊的政治声明之一。在这场令人毛骨悚然的闹剧中，一名韩国男子在日本被判处死刑，但在被处决后幸存下来，这让当局陷入了下一步该怎么办的恐慌之中。大岛这部不断令人惊讶的电影既令人不安又奇怪有趣，是对死刑和韩国移民在韩国所受待遇的颠覆性和超现实的控诉。
hook_en: Genius provocateur Nagisa Oshima, an influential figure in the Japanese New Wave of the 1960s, made one of his most startling political statements with the compelling pitch-black satire Death by Hanging. In this macabre farce, a Korean man is sentenced to death in Japan but survives his execution, sending the authorities into a panic about what to do next. At once disturbing and oddly amusing, Oshima’s constantly surprising film is a subversive and surreal indictment of both capital punishment and the treatment of Korean immigrants in his country.

hook: 当这部典型的六十年代政治惊悚片上映时，约翰·弗兰肯海默这个名字永远成为了令人心碎的电影制作的代名词。这部根据理查德·康登的小说改编的电影以五十年代初为背景，讲述了功勋卓著的美国陆军中士雷蒙德·肖（劳伦斯·哈维饰）在朝鲜战争期间作为战俘被洗脑，成为共产主义阴谋中的潜伏刺客，以及一名战俘战友（弗兰克·西纳特拉饰）慢慢揭开这个险恶阴谋的故事。在一场令人难忘的表演中，安吉拉·兰斯伯里扮演雷蒙德邪恶的母亲，她是一名猎巫反共参议员的控制欲很强的妻子，他的目光瞄准了白宫。 《满洲候选人》是一部罕见的电影，它瞄准了麦卡锡时代的狂热，同时也充满了冷战偏执，《满洲候选人》仍然是强有力的、令人震惊的美国电影制作。
hook_en: The name John Frankenheimer became forever synonymous with heart-in-the-throat filmmaking when this quintessential sixties political thriller was released. Set in the early fifties, this razor-sharp adaptation of the novel by Richard Condon concerns the decorated U.S. Army sergeant Raymond Shaw (Laurence Harvey), who as a prisoner during the Korean War is brainwashed into becoming a sleeper assassin in a Communist conspiracy, and a fellow POW (Frank Sinatra) who slowly uncovers the sinister plot. In an unforgettable performance, Angela Lansbury plays Raymond’s villainous mother, the controlling wife of a witch-hunting anti-Communist senator with his eyes on the White House. The rare film that takes aim at the frenzy of the McCarthy era while also being suffused with its Cold War paranoia, The Manchurian Candidate remains potent, shocking American moviemaking.

hook: 梦见黑暗和令人不安的事情。 。 。大卫·林奇 (David Lynch) 1977 年的处女作《橡皮头》既引起了持久的狂热追捧，又是一部工艺精湛、美感非凡的作品。凭借弗雷德里克·埃尔姆斯和赫伯特·卡德威尔令人着迷的黑白摄影、令人回味的声音设计以及杰克·南斯令人难忘的神秘表演，这部梦幻般的夜间奥德赛继续像其他电影一样困扰着美国电影。
hook_en: A dream of dark and troubling things . . . David Lynch’s 1977 debut feature, Eraserhead, is both a lasting cult sensation and a work of extraordinary craft and beauty. With its mesmerizing black-and-white photography by Frederick Elmes and Herbert Cardwell, evocative sound design, and unforgettably enigmatic performance by Jack Nance, this visionary nocturnal odyssey continues to haunt American cinema like no other film.

hook: 《午夜钟声》是奥森·威尔斯非凡电影生涯的最高成就，是电影制片人对莎士比亚的终极恶棍约翰·福斯塔夫爵士一生痴迷的顶峰。福斯塔夫通常是一个喜剧配角，他是国王亨利四世任性的儿子哈尔王子的忠实朋友，经常被灌醉，但在这里却成为了焦点：威尔斯以若隐若现、笨拙的优雅扮演了一个极其有趣但最终悲剧性的银幕反英雄。威尔斯融合了《亨利四世》戏剧以及《理查二世》、《亨利五世》和《温莎的风流娘儿们》中的元素，创作了一部坚韧且非正统的莎士比亚电影，他说，作为“对快乐英格兰之死的哀悼”。 《午夜钟声》充满诗意、哲学和发自肺腑，其核心的动态战斗场面可与导演的任何作品相媲美，就像其核心人物一样具有里程碑意义。
hook_en: The crowning achievement of Orson Welles’s extraordinary cinematic career, Chimes at Midnight was the culmination of the filmmaker’s lifelong obsession with Shakespeare’s ultimate rapscallion, Sir John Falstaff. Usually a comic supporting figure, Falstaff—the loyal, often soused friend of King Henry IV’s wayward son Prince Hal—here becomes the focus: a robustly funny and ultimately tragic screen antihero played by Welles with looming, lumbering grace. Integrating elements from both Henry IV plays as well as Richard II, Henry V, and The Merry Wives of Windsor, Welles created a gritty and unorthodox Shakespeare film as a lament, he said, “for the death of Merrie England.” Poetic, philosophical, and visceral—with a kinetic centerpiece battle sequence that rivals anything in the director’s body of work—Chimes at Midnight is as monumental as the figure at its heart.

hook: 这部荣获奥斯卡奖的情节剧是佩德罗·阿莫多瓦最受欢迎的电影之一，对母性的意义进行了令人眼花缭乱、感人至深的探索。瞬间，护士曼努埃拉（塞西莉亚·罗斯饰）失去了自己抚养的十几岁的儿子。悲痛欲绝的她出发前往巴塞罗那寻找男孩失散已久的父亲，在那里她重新觉醒，成为了一个新的母亲角色，成为一个代孕家庭的户主，其中包括一名怀孕的艾滋病毒阳性修女（佩内洛普·克鲁兹饰）；一位杰出的舞台明星（玛丽莎·帕雷德斯）；和一名变性性工作者（安东尼娅·圣胡安）。 《关于我母亲的一切》表演精美，充满电影元素，是对女性坚韧的充满活力的致敬，是一幅独一无二的全家福，也是一部充满无限同情心的作品。
hook_en: This Oscar-winning melodrama, one of Pedro Almodóvar’s most beloved films, provides a dizzying, moving exploration of the meaning of motherhood. In an instant, nurse Manuela (Cecilia Roth) loses the teenage son she raised on her own. Grief-stricken, she sets out to search for the boy’s long-lost father in Barcelona, where she reawakens into a new maternal role, at the head of a surrogate family that includes a pregnant, HIV-positive nun (Penélope Cruz); an illustrious star of the stage (Marisa Paredes); and a transgender sex worker (Antonia San Juan). Beautifully performed and bursting with cinematic references, All About My Mother is a vibrant tribute to female fortitude, a one-of-a-kind family portrait, and a work of boundless compassion.

hook: 恶魔惊悚片《浅坟》是导演丹尼·博伊尔、制片人安德鲁·麦克唐纳和编剧约翰·霍奇（猜火车背后的粉碎团队）的第一部电影。影片中，三个自私自利的爱丁堡室友——由凯里·福克斯、克里斯托弗·埃克莱斯顿和伊万·麦克格雷格饰演，这是他第一次担任主角——收留了一位沉思的寄宿生，当他因吸毒过量去世，留下装满钱的手提箱时，三人做出了一系列非常糟糕的决定，给所有人带来了极其严峻的后果。这部充满罪恶感和精神错乱的故事令人毛骨悚然，但又带有一丝另类的幽默，在风格上颇具影响力，是希区柯克式肮脏的全部。
hook_en: The diabolical thriller Shallow Grave was the first film from director Danny Boyle, producer Andrew Macdonald, and screenwriter John Hodge (the smashing team behind Trainspotting). In it, three self-involved Edinburgh roommates—played by Kerry Fox, Christopher Eccleston, and Ewan McGregor, in his first starring role—take in a brooding boarder, and when he dies of an overdose, leaving a suitcase full of money, the trio embark on a series of very bad decisions, with extraordinarily grim consequences for all. Macabre but with a streak of offbeat humor, this stylistically influential tale of guilt and derangement is a full-throttle bit of Hitchcockian nastiness.

hook: 《坠落地球的人》是对科幻小说作为一种艺术形式的大胆探索。外星人执行精心营救任务的故事为尼古拉斯·罗伊格的视觉杰作提供了出发点，这是对当代生活中异化现象的正式冒险审视。摇滚传奇人物大卫·鲍伊 (David Bowie) 在他的首次表演中完美体现了主角的角色，而坎迪·克拉克 (Candy Clark)、巴克·亨利 (Buck Henry) 和雷普·汤恩 (Rip Torn) 则奉献了完美的配角表演。这部电影的幻觉在美国院线上映时被掩盖了，删除了近二十分钟的关键场景和细节。 Criterion Collection 很荣幸地以这部经导演批准的独家新高清宽银幕传输形式呈现罗伊格的完整未剪辑版本。
hook_en: The Man Who Fell to Earth is a daring exploration of science fiction as an art form. The story of an alien on an elaborate rescue mission provides the launching pad for Nicolas Roeg’s visual tour de force, a formally adventurous examination of alienation in contemporary life. Rock legend David Bowie, in his acting debut, completely embodies the title role, while Candy Clark, Buck Henry, and Rip Torn turn in pitch-perfect supporting performances. The film’s hallucinatory vision was obscured in the American theatrical release, which deleted nearly twenty minutes of crucial scenes and details. The Criterion Collection is proud to present Roeg’s full uncut version, in this exclusive new director-approved high-­definition widescreen transfer.

hook: 奥斯曼·塞姆贝内的第二部长片主要以沃洛夫语拍摄，是第一部用非洲语言制作的故事片，这是这位塞内加尔电影制片人为实现他的梦想而迈出的重要一步，即为他的祖国大陆的居民创建一部由其居民、关于其居民并为他们服务的电影。失业的易卜拉希马·迪昂收到一位在巴黎工作的侄子寄来的 25,000 法郎的汇票后，他发横财的消息很快就在他的邻居中传开，邻居们纷纷向他寻求贷款，尽管他试图兑现这笔汇票却遇到了重重官僚障碍，新的麻烦也如雨点般降临在他头上。 《曼达比》是塞姆本最搞笑、最愤慨的电影之一，改编自导演本人的中篇小说，对一个饱受殖民主义伤痕、腐败、贪婪和贫困困扰的社会进行了极其讽刺的描绘。
hook_en: Shot primarily in Wolof, this second feature by Ousmane Sembène was the first ever made in an African language—a major step toward the realization of the trailblazing Senegalese filmmaker’s dream of creating a cinema by, about, and for the inhabitants of his home continent. After jobless Ibrahima Dieng receives a money order for 25,000 francs from a nephew who works in Paris, news of his windfall quickly spreads among his neighbors, who flock to him for loans even as his attempts to cash the order are stymied in a maze of bureaucratic obstacles, and new troubles rain down on his head. One of Sembène’s most coruscatingly funny and indignant films, Mandabi—an adaptation of a novella by the director himself—is a bitterly ironic depiction of a society scarred by colonialism and plagued by corruption, greed, and poverty.

hook: 在这部可能是萨姆·佩金帕最具争议的电影中，年轻的美国数学家大卫（达斯汀·霍夫曼饰）和他的英国妻子艾米（苏珊·乔治饰）搬到了她长大的村庄。当大卫雇佣来修理他们的房子的当地人更感兴趣地斜视艾米和恐吓大卫时，他们的安全感瓦解了，开始痛苦地接受统治佩金帕世界的暴力男子气概的铁律。这位电影制片人首次在美国以外的地方工作，在《稻草狗》中，他将西部边境的残酷空运到了康沃尔郡，当这些人残酷地对待艾米和大卫时，他的角色被逼到了崩溃的边缘，而他也发现了自己会为了保护自己的家园而付出多大的努力——最终在一个令人痛苦的高潮中展现了这位电影策划者雄辩而血腥的人性愿景。
hook_en: In this thriller, perhaps Sam Peckinpah’s most controversial film, David (Dustin Hoffman), a young American mathematician, moves with his English wife, Amy (Susan George), to the village where she grew up. Their sense of safety unravels as the local men David has hired to repair their house prove more interested in leering at Amy and intimidating David, beginning an agonizing initiation into the iron laws of violent masculinity that govern Peckinpah’s world. Working outside the U.S. for the first time, the filmmaker airlifts the ruthlessness of the western frontier into Cornwall in Straw Dogs, pushing his characters to their breaking points as the men brutalize Amy and David discovers how far he’ll go to protect his home—culminating in a harrowing climax that lays out this cinematic mastermind’s eloquent and bloody vision of humanity.

hook: 这部精致而大胆的室内剧对酷儿爱情和孤独、家庭悲伤和治愈进行了形而上的探索，证实了导演安德鲁·黑格将复杂情感搬上银幕的天赋。伦敦编剧亚当（安德鲁·斯科特饰）被隔离在一栋看似空荡荡的新高楼里，他与冲动的哈利（保罗·梅斯卡饰）开始了一段充满激情的浪漫，随后又与父母（杰米·贝尔和克莱尔·福伊饰）在一次超越时空限制的重聚中与父母重新取得了联系，他发现自己孤独的存在被颠覆了。海格在日本作家山田太一的小说中留下了深刻的个人印记，他达到了宇宙的高度，同时也从未忽视故事中令人痛苦的人心。
hook_en: A metaphysical exploration of queer love and loneliness, familial grief and healing, this delicate but audacious chamber drama confirms director Andrew Haigh’s gift for bringing complicated emotions to the screen. Isolated in a seemingly empty new high-rise, London screenwriter Adam (Andrew Scott) finds his solitary existence upended when he begins a passionate romance with the impulsive Harry (Paul Mescal), then reconnects with his parents (Jamie Bell and Claire Foy) in a reunion that pushes beyond the limits of time and space. Putting a deeply personal imprint on a novel by Japanese writer Taichi Yamada, Haigh reaches cosmic heights while never losing sight of the story’s achingly human heart.

hook: 这就是一切的开始。约翰·福特 (John Ford) 的红极一时、经久不衰的杰作《驿马车》(Stagecoach) 彻底改变了西部片，将其从 B 级片提升为一线片，并确立了我们今天所熟知的这一类型。 《驿马车》讲述了一群陌生人被抛入非凡境地的典型故事，好莱坞大咖克莱尔·特雷弗 (Claire Trevor)、约翰·卡拉丁 (John Carradine) 和托马斯·米切尔 (Thomas Mitchell) 都有精彩表演，当然，还有约翰·韦恩 (John Wayne)，他首次在福特担任主角，饰演胆大妄为的亡命之徒林戈小子 (Ringo Kid)。 《驿马车》（福特首次纪念碑谷之旅）拍摄精美，剪辑严谨，是好莱坞故事讲述的巅峰之作。
hook_en: This is where it all started. John Ford’s smash hit and enduring masterpiece Stagecoach revolutionized the western, elevating it from B movie to the A-list and establishing the genre as we know it today. The quintessential tale of a group of strangers thrown together into extraordinary circumstances, Stagecoach features outstanding performances from Hollywood stalwarts Claire Trevor, John Carradine, and Thomas Mitchell, and, of course, John Wayne, in his first starring role for Ford, as the daredevil outlaw the Ringo Kid. Superbly shot and tightly edited, Stagecoach (Ford’s first trip to Monument Valley) is Hollywood storytelling at its finest.

hook: 对话是否比这更冷酷无情？有蛇蝎美人像芭芭拉·斯坦威克一样邪恶吗？ 20 世纪 40 年代的洛杉矶曾经看起来如此肮脏而诱人吗？导演比利·怀尔德与联合编剧雷蒙德·钱德勒合作，凭借这部取自詹姆斯·M·凯恩低俗小说的黑色电影宿命论缩影，跻身好莱坞一线明星行列。当狡猾的推销员沃尔特·内夫（弗莱德·麦克莫瑞饰）走进心怀不满的家庭主妇菲利斯·迪特里克森（斯坦威克饰）豪华的家时，他打算推销保险，但最终以一种更加险恶的方式与她纠缠在一起。 《双重赔偿》以爱德华·G·罗宾逊的抢镜配角和电影摄影师约翰·F·塞茨的明暗对比为特色，是有史以来最有趣的反常故事之一，也是衡量所有黑色电影的标准。
hook_en: Has dialogue ever been more perfectly hard-boiled? Has a femme fatale ever been as deliciously wicked as Barbara Stanwyck? And has 1940s Los Angeles ever looked so seductively sordid? Working with cowriter Raymond Chandler, director Billy Wilder launched himself onto the Hollywood A-list with this epitome of film-noir fatalism from James M. Cain’s pulp novel. When slick salesman Walter Neff (Fred MacMurray) walks into the swank home of dissatisfied housewife Phyllis Dietrichson (Stanwyck), he intends to sell insurance, but he winds up becoming entangled with her in a far more sinister way. Featuring scene-stealing supporting work from Edward G. Robinson and the chiaroscuro of cinematographer John F. Seitz, Double Indemnity is one of the most entertainingly perverse stories ever told and the standard by which all noir must be measured.

hook: 在著名的实验剧院导演彼得·布鲁克（ Peter Brook ）的手中，威廉·戈尔丁（ William Golding ）关于潜伏在文明之下的原始主义的传奇小说变成了一部电影，就像失落的男孩一样原始而粗糙。布鲁克采用创新的纪录片般的方法，以即兴的自然主义拍摄了《苍蝇王》，似乎记录了角色身份证的自发爆发。结果是一个惊心动魄的杰作，作为挑衅…
hook_en: In the hands of the renowned experimental theater director Peter Brook, William Golding’s legendary novel about the primitivism lurking beneath civilization becomes a film as raw and ragged as the lost boys at its center. Taking an innovative documentary-like approach, Brook shot Lord of the Flies with an off-the-cuff naturalism, seeming to record a spontaneous eruption of its characters’ ids. The result is a rattling masterpiece, as provocative as its source material.

hook: 1988 年，叛逆的电影制片人罗伯特·奥尔特曼 (Robert Altman) 和普利策奖得主杜恩斯伯里漫画家加里·特鲁多 (Garry Trudeau) 创造了一位总统候选人，在初选期间将他与其他候选人一起推选，并将他们的媒体宣传活动呈现为肥皂剧和电视新闻的结合体。结果就是开创性的《Tanner’88》，一部对媒体时代美国政治的尖锐讽刺，其中演员迈克尔·墨菲（饰演竞争者杰克·坦纳）和辛西娅·尼克松（饰演他的女儿）在竞选过程中与现实生活中的政治人物杰西·杰克逊、加里·哈特、鲍勃·多尔、拉尔夫·纳德、基蒂·杜卡基斯和格洛丽亚·斯泰纳姆等人擦肩而过。 Criterion Collection 很荣幸地推出完整的十一集电视连续剧——在今天比以往任何时候都更有意义。
hook_en: In 1988, renegade filmmaker Robert Altman and Pulitzer Prize–winning Doonesbury cartoonist Garry Trudeau created a presidential candidate, ran him alongside the other hopefuls during the primary season, and presented their media campaign as a cross between a soap opera and TV news. The result was the groundbreaking Tanner ’88, a piercing satire of media-age American politics, in which actors Michael Murphy (as contender Jack Tanner) and Cynthia Nixon (as his daughter) rub elbows on the campaign trail with real-life political players Jesse Jackson, Gary Hart, Bob Dole, Ralph Nader, Kitty Dukakis, and Gloria Steinem, among many others. The Criterion Collection is proud to present the complete eleven-episode television series—more relevant today than ever.

hook: 通过十岁亚历山大的眼睛，我们目睹了二十世纪初瑞典一个庞大的资产阶级家族埃克达尔家族的欢乐和冲突。英格玛·伯格曼打算将《范妮和亚历山大》作为他的绝唱，这是这位导演最温暖、最具自传性的电影，一部获得奥斯卡奖的胜利，将他标志性的忧郁和情感强度与巨大的欢乐和性感结合在一起。伯格曼将《范妮和亚历山大》的戏剧版和五个小时的电视版描述为“我作为电影制片人的一生的总和”。在他胜利告别演说的完整长度（312 分钟）版本中，他的愿景得到了最充分的表达。
hook_en: Through the eyes of ten-year-old Alexander, we witness the delights and conflicts of the Ekdahl family, a sprawling bourgeois clan in turn-of-the-twentieth-century Sweden. Ingmar Bergman intended Fanny and Alexander as his swan song, and it is the director’s warmest and most autobiographical film, an Academy Award–winning triumph that combines his trademark melancholy and emotional intensity with immense joy and sensuality. Bergman described Fanny and Alexander, presented here in both the theatrical and the five-hour television versions, as “the sum total of my life as a filmmaker.” And in this, the full-length (312-minute) version of his triumphant valediction, his vision is expressed at its fullest.

hook: 大卫·林奇这个扭曲的童话，跟着年轻女演员贝蒂往下坠落。她由娜奥米·沃茨出演，是一次改写职业生涯的表演。贝蒂刚到洛杉矶，就撞进一桩危险、像迷宫一样的谜。片子里到处是分身，是林奇最阴暗、最可怕的电影之一，也是情感上最沉重的之一。它还是讲好莱坞的杰作：那是一面黑镜子，梦会变成噩梦。也因此，它是林奇最带自传色彩的作品之一。
hook_en: David Lynch’s perverse fairy tale tracks the downward spiral of a bright-eyed young actress, Betty — a revelatory Naomi Watts in a career-defining performance — who stumbles into a dangerous, labyrinthine mystery shortly after arriving in Los Angeles. Filled with doubles, this is one of Lynch’s bleakest and most terrifying films, and among his most emotionally devastating. It’s also one of the great movies about Hollywood, a dark mirror world where dreams turn into nightmares, which means that it’s one of Lynch’s most autobiographical works, too.

hook: 《纽约黑帮》的时代过去一个多世纪，马丁·斯科塞斯又在下曼哈顿找到一群行为不端的男人。莱昂纳多·迪卡普里奥演臭名昭著的股票交易员乔丹·贝尔福特，剧本根据他的回忆录。他很少在银幕上这么好笑，不管是朝烦人的联邦探员扔龙虾，还是因为安定剂吃多了腿软。垮台当然会来。如果看起来贝尔福特受的罚太轻，那不也正像华尔街吗？
hook_en: More than a century after the days of “Gangs of New York,” Martin Scorsese finds more Lower Manhattan bros behaving badly. Playing the notorious stock trader Jordan Belfort (whose memoir the movie is based on), Leonardo DiCaprio has rarely been funnier onscreen, whether it’s chucking lobsters at pesky F.B.I. agents or going rubber-legged from one too many quaaludes. There’s inevitably a downfall, but if it seems as if Belfort gets off pretty easy — well, doesn’t that sound like Wall Street?

hook: 皮克斯形式上最新的一部，第一幕基本没有台词。地球上最后一个机器人还在忠实地替已经离开的人类打扫。镜头转到天上之后，《机器人总动员》成了一则关于过度消费和气候的寓言，现在看起来更像真的。结尾表面欢快，底下是一个我们还没听进去的冷警告。
hook_en: Pixar’s most formally inventive movie is basically wordless for the first act, in which the last robot on earth is faithfully cleaning up after absent humans. Once it pivots to the sky, though, “Wall-E” is a fable about overconsumption and the climate that’s only gotten more real-feeling. The ending, seemingly cheery on the surface, also serves up a bleak warning that we’ve yet to heed.

hook: 这部韩国警察片不受好莱坞类型规矩束缚，第一条线索在开场就来了：侦探（宋康昊）被叫去一座乡下地方查一具尸体，他是搭一辆慢慢开的拖拉机到的。别的笨拙的调查员简直是跌进犯罪现场，阴沉的笑还在继续。导演奉俊昊对男人面对无法理解的恶有多有限，有很强的想法。他用自己标志性的、没想到的幽默和看得很准的戏剧去探这些想法。
hook_en: The first clue that this Korean police procedural isn’t bound by Hollywood genre conventions comes in the opening moments: A detective (played by Song Kang Ho) summoned to investigate a dead body in a rural outpost arrives by hitching a ride on a plodding tractor. The grim laughs continue when other hapless investigators fall quite literally into the crime scene. The director Bong Joon Ho has strong ideas about the limits of men facing unfathomable evil, and he explores them with his hallmark mix of unexpected humor and sharply observed drama.

hook: 彼得·杰克逊用《指环王》三部曲的第一部，做了几乎不可能的事：他在新西兰的山里把 J·R·R·托尔金的中土做成了真的，老读者买账，对精灵和半兽人那些术语心存警惕的新观众也买账。化妆和特效现在还站得住，大场面让人进去，有时也吓人，给奇幻商业片立了新的标准。霍华德·肖的配乐一响，就很难不被带走。
hook_en: With the first installment of his “Lord of the Rings” trilogy, Peter Jackson did the almost impossible: He brought J.R.R. Tolkien’s Middle-earth to life in the hills of New Zealand, appealing to longtime fans and newcomers who might be wary of the jargon about elves and orcs. The film set a new bar for fantasy blockbusters with makeup and effects that still hold up, and set pieces that are immersive and occasionally terrifying. As soon as Howard Shore’s score kicks in, it’s hard not to feel transported.

hook: 韦斯·安德森糖果色的画面会骗人。标题里那家华丽的旅馆是一座粉色的点心，里面的赌注却是真的：法西斯正在逼近，在一个虚构的欧洲国家，难民有理由害怕边境上的当局。故事发生在两次大战之间。人人喜爱的礼宾员（拉尔夫·费因斯好极了）把男人和女人都叫“亲爱的”，也和所有朋友上床。到最后，它非常动人。
hook_en: Wes Anderson’s candy-colored visions can be deceptive. The magnificent inn of the title is a glorious pink confection, but there are real stakes at play: Fascism is fast approaching and refugees have good reason to fear the authorities at the borders of a fictional European country. This between-the-wars tale of a beloved concierge (a terrific Ralph Fiennes) who calls men and women alike “darling” and sleeps with all his friends is in the end deeply moving.

hook: “你拆过多少颗炸弹？”一名军官问詹姆斯上士（杰里米·雷纳）。他刚扑灭一辆着火的车，并处理掉后备箱里的炸药。“八百七十三颗，长官。”他回答。凯瑟琳·毕格罗凭这部关于美军在伊拉克拆弹小组的、把神经撕开的电影，成为第一个拿到奥斯卡最佳导演的女人。它拍的是 21 世纪的战争：叛乱者和路边的简易爆炸装置。它也在看一个肾上腺素上瘾的人的心理。他待在防爆服里，比待在超市麦片货架前更自在。
hook_en: “How many bombs have you disarmed?” an officer asks Staff Sgt. James (Jeremy Renner), who has just extinguished a flaming car and neutralized its trunkful of explosives. “Eight hundred seventy-three, sir,” he answers. Kathryn Bigelow became the first woman to win the best director Oscar for this nerve-shredding film about a U.S. ordnance team in Iraq. In capturing the 21st-century warfare of insurgents and roadside I.E.D.s, “The Hurt Locker” also looks at the psyche of an adrenaline junkie more at home in a blast suit than in the cereal aisle.

hook: 格蕾塔·葛韦格自己出去拍《伯德小姐》之前，她上升的第一个迹象是《弗兰西丝·哈》。剧本是她和导演诺亚·鲍姆巴赫一起写的。葛韦格也出演弗兰西丝，一个二十多岁末尾的女人，抓着自己的青春，方式既压不住地快乐，又很不成熟。黑白画面带着怀旧。《弗兰西丝·哈》是一次人物研究，抓住的是成年抓住人的那个时刻。
hook_en: Before Greta Gerwig struck out on her own to make “Lady Bird,” the first sign of her ascension was “Frances Ha,” which she co-wrote with the director Noah Baumbach. Gerwig also stars as Frances, a woman in her late 20s who is holding onto her youth in a way that is both irrepressibly joyful and deeply immature. Shot in nostalgic black and white, “Frances Ha” is a character study that captures the moment adulthood takes hold.

hook: 约书亚·奥本海默这部纪录长片的杰作，对象是 1965 到 1966 年印尼大屠杀的施行者。真正的主题，是人的头脑有多能把对别人的残忍行为隔开、合理化。奥本海默的做法，让电影看起来像心理恐怖，而因为它是非虚构的，就更吓人。
hook_en: Joshua Oppenheimer’s documentary masterpiece concerns the perpetrators of the Indonesian mass killings of 1965-66. Really, though, the subject is the incredible capacity of the human mind to compartmentalize and rationalize monstrous acts of cruelty toward other people. The way Oppenheimer goes about it makes for a movie that plays like psychological horror — all the more petrifying because it is nonfiction.

hook: 科恩兄弟把他们 1960 年代末在明尼苏达的童年，拧成一部像塔木德段落一样打结的黑色喜剧。迈克尔·斯图尔巴格演物理教授拉里·戈普尼克。不高兴的学生、不成器的弟弟、终身教职委员会、儿子的成人礼，以及一个叫赛·埃布尔曼的男人引起的分居，同时压过来。是上帝在试他吗？拉比那个关于“外邦人的牙”的故事里有答案吗？这是科恩兄弟最犹太的电影。除了《谋杀绿脚趾》，它也最适合被拿来引用。
hook_en: The Coen brothers spin memories of their childhood in late-1960s Minnesota into a dark comedy as knotty as a Talmudic passage. Michael Stuhlbarg plays Larry Gopnik, a physics professor simultaneously beset by a disgruntled student, a wayward brother, a tenure committee, a son’s bar mitzvah and a separation spurred by a guy named Sy Ableman. Is God testing him? Does a rabbi’s story about a “goy’s teeth” hold the answer? It’s the Coens’ most Jewish film — and, “The Big Lebowski” aside, a good candidate for their most quotable.

hook: 宫崎骏这部手绘的青春期童话，是我们这个时代的《爱丽丝梦游仙境》。废弃的神奇澡堂里不断冒出忘不掉的角色：锅炉爷爷和他的煤灰精灵、戴面具的无脸、少年龙白龙，以及把这一切走通的勇敢的千寻。她那对糊涂父母被女巫变成了猪。片子把宫崎骏一直在想的事合在一起：人怎样败坏自然、天真怎样失去、吓人的生物其实不是看上去那样。《千与千寻》是一场少有对手的奇幻冒险，在动画里如此，在动画之外也如此。
hook_en: Hayao Miyazaki’s hand-drawn fairy tale of adolescence is the “Alice in Wonderland” of our age. Unforgettable characters keep spilling out of an abandoned magical bathhouse — the boilerman and his soot sprites, the masked spirit No-Face, Haku the boy-dragon and, navigating it all, brave Chihiro, whose clueless parents have been turned into pigs by a witch. Beautifully uniting the master animator’s preoccupations — man’s corruption of nature, the loss of innocence, intimidating creatures who aren’t what they seem — “Spirited Away” is a spellbinding adventure with few peers in animation or elsewhere.

hook: 这部是给局外人的。托马斯·阿尔弗雷德森的戏大部分时候冷冷地平静，讲一个疏离的男孩奥斯卡（卡雷·赫德布兰特）和他古怪的邻居伊莱（莉娜·林德森）的友谊。伊莱也许是吸血鬼。片子有节制，该见血的时候见血，但对主角的难处有同情，也大方地写他们的联系。它把吸血鬼电影推向了新的方向。
hook_en: This one is for the outcasts. Unfolding for the most part with a chilly sense of calm, Tomas Alfredson’s drama follows a friendship between a detached boy, Oskar (Kare Hedebrant), and his offbeat neighbor, Eli (Lina Leandersson), who just might be a vampire. The film is tempered, bloody when it needs to be, but sympathetic to the challenges of its lead characters and generous in how it portrays their connection as it pushes the vampire movie in fresh directions.

hook: 科恩兄弟这部染了棕褐色的冒险片，自称改编自荷马的《奥德赛》。这条线最多是松的，它端上来的却是一大锅民间故事、吹牛和幻想。尘土飞扬的大萧条时期的密西西比，三个不太聪明的逃犯出发去寻宝。接下来是一趟任性、热闹的路。把这次追寻抬成关于自由、宽恕、希望，以及我们天生有多少缺陷的寓言的，是他们用的美国音乐：福音、三角洲布鲁斯和蓝草。
hook_en: This sepia-toned Coen brothers adventure is presented as an adaptation of Homer’s “Odyssey,” and while that thread is loose at best, it delivers a hearty stew of folklore, tall tales and even fantasy. In dusty Depression-era Mississippi, three dimwitted escaped convicts take off on a treasure hunt. A whimsical, rollicking ride ensues, but it’s the filmmakers’ use of Americana music including gospel, Delta blues and bluegrass that elevates this quest into an allegory about freedom, forgiveness, hope and the many ways we are inherently flawed.

hook: 这部片子上映时，克里斯托弗·盖斯特已经用《等待古夫曼》把伪纪录片做熟了。他在精英犬展这个荒唐的世界里找到了最合适的题材。他那组靠即兴的演员，把对狗着迷的人做成忘不掉的角色：帕克·波西演的雅皮士戴着牙套、爱目录，养着一只魏玛犬；尤金·列维演的梗犬主人会唱歌，而且真的有两只左脚。尽管一切都疯，对这些笨蛋和他们的狗，片子是温柔的。
hook_en: By the time this was released, Christopher Guest had already mastered the mockumentary with “Waiting for Guffman.” But he found the perfect subject matter in the wacky world of elite dog shows. His trusty group of improvisers created indelible characters out of canine obsessives, like Parker Posey’s catalog-loving yuppie with braces and a Weimaraner, and Eugene Levy’s singing terrier-owner who quite literally has two left feet. For as mad as it all is, there’s a sweetness directed at these goofballs and their pooches.

hook: 阿方索·卡隆这部成长故事想的事情很多：欲望、阶级、男人之间的友谊、死亡，但主要是欲望。高中生特诺奇（迭戈·卢纳）和胡利奥（盖尔·加西亚·贝纳尔）好像只为性活着，和自己的女友，和对方的女友，也和一个吸引他们的姻亲。这个人让他们上路，去一座海滩。卡隆拍性的方式和角色感受它的方式一样：热，占满一切，世界的重量就在镜头外面。像青春本身，看完会眨着眼走出来，分不清方向，在记忆里筛，像沙子里夹着金子。
hook_en: Alfonso Cuarón’s bildungsroman has much on its mind — lust, class, male friendship, mortality, but mainly lust. Sex is all that high schoolers Tenoch (Diego Luna) and Julio (Gael García Bernal) seem to live for — with their girlfriends, with each other’s girlfriends, with an alluring in-law who inspires a road trip to a beach. Cuarón shoots sex the way his characters feel it: hot, all-consuming, the weight of the world just off-camera. Like youth itself, we stumble out of the film blinking, disoriented, sifting through memories like sand strewn with gold.

hook: 这是皮克斯最敢冒险的时候。一个 78 岁、脾气坏的鳏夫抓着过去，丧妻的悲痛让他没法建立新的关系。前面有些场面是黑白的，有些没有对白。有几段里，导演皮特·多克特更想要一种感觉，而不是顺着讲故事。后半段，房子飘走之后，变得更商业：一个话多的小孩、一条有魔法项圈的狗、一只传说中的鸟，和一个没想到的反派，负责冒险和搞笑。
hook_en: Pixar at its risk-taking height. A cranky, 78-year-old widower clings to the past as he struggles to process grief that’s preventing new connections. Some early scenes are in black-and-white; others have no dialogue. In certain sections, the director Pete Docter is interested in a feeling more than linear storytelling. The film’s second half — after the house floats away — becomes more overtly commercial, with a young chatterbox, a dog with a magic collar, a mythical bird and an unexpected antagonist providing adventure and comedic relief.

hook: 一个放在佛朗哥时代西班牙的黑暗童话。它把吉尔莫·德尔·托罗从恐怖片和漫画改编推进了所谓的正经电影，他标志性的人道、魔幻现实和出色的生物设计都还在。年幼的奥菲莉亚躲开灰暗的处境，尤其是新来的法西斯继父，走进一个想象的空间。神秘的羊首神给她任务，让她证明自己的价值。这则视觉耀眼的寓言，把德尔·托罗确定为我们这个时代最好的电影作者之一。
hook_en: A dark fairy tale set in Franco-era Spain, this was the film that propelled Guillermo del Toro from horror movies and comic-book adaptations into the world of prestige filmmaking, albeit with his signature humanism, magical realism and superb creature creations intact. Young Ofelia escapes her bleak circumstances — particularly life under her fascist new stepfather — by entering an imaginary space where a mystical faun sets her on a quest to prove her worth. The visually dazzling allegory affirmed del Toro as one of our finest filmmakers today.

hook: “那部同性恋牛仔片”做的不止是让办公室有话说，也不止是拿了好几座奥斯卡。它把最佳影片输给《撞车》，至今仍是奥斯卡历史上出了名的一桩。李安这部节制、节奏很慢的西部片，把怀俄明两个牧场工人（希斯·莱杰和杰克·吉伦哈尔）的秘密恋情，拍成电影里少有的悲剧爱情。好看，也伤人。
hook_en: “The gay cowboy movie” did more than start water-cooler conversations and win several Oscars (its best picture loss to “Crash” remains a notorious bugaboo of Oscar lore). Ang Lee’s austere, gently paced western turned a clandestine romance between two Wyoming ranch hands (Heath Ledger and Jake Gyllenhaal) into one of cinema’s great tragic love stories, as aesthetically beautiful as it was emotionally shattering.

hook: 这只猫和老鼠的黑帮片，终于让马丁·斯科塞斯拿到奥斯卡，也是本世纪最好看的电影之一。他把香港片《无间道》搬到波士顿，配上 Dropkick Murphys 的歌。法律一边，是莱昂纳多·迪卡普里奥演的毛糙警察，假装成罪犯。另一边，是马特·达蒙演的好学生警察，实际为黑手党工作。中间是杰克·尼科尔森演的爱尔兰黑帮老大，笑得像柴郡猫。游戏开始。
hook_en: The cat-and-rat gangster picture that finally won Martin Scorsese his Oscar happens to be one of the most downright entertaining of the century. Scorsese takes the Hong Kong flick “Infernal Affairs” and plops it in Boston, Dropkick Murphys soundtrack and all. On one side of the law there’s Leonardo DiCaprio’s rough-around-the-edges cop posing as a criminal. On the other there’s Matt Damon’s golden-boy police officer working for the Mafia. In the middle there’s Jack Nicholson’s Irish mob boss, smiling like the Cheshire Cat. Let the games begin.

hook: 李安这部武侠片由杨紫琼、周润发和章子怡主演。上映时东西方观众都买账，这在当时很少见，票房纪录也被它打破。动作戏把轻功和压住的爱情、不被允许的前途放在一起。忘不掉的是杨紫琼的剑客和章子怡演的贼用一堆兵器对打，以及周润发和章子怡在竹林里那场像芭蕾一样的剑斗。
hook_en: When Ang Lee debuted this wuxia masterpiece starring Michelle Yeoh, Chow Yun-fat and Zhang Ziyi, the film appealed to Western and Eastern audiences alike, a rarity at the time, and demolished box-office records. This action drama marries acrobatic, aerodynamic martial arts with repressed love and forbidden futures. Seared in memory: the showdown between Yeoh’s swordswoman and the thief played by Zhang using a multitude of weapons, and the balletic sword fight between Chow’s warrior and Zhang in a bamboo forest.

hook: 斯派克·琼斯这部数字时代的爱情片，不用大多数科幻片那种硬而发亮的表面，换成更歪、更苦甜的东西。近未来的洛杉矶，孤独、留着胡子的内向男人（华金·菲尼克斯）爱上一个会适应人的操作系统，声音是斯嘉丽·约翰逊。这是真的和机器恋爱，还是一个成年男人在病理性地躲开亲密？《她》不给简单答案。它提出的许多问题，放在今天，可惜已经不像 2013 年那么像假设了。
hook_en: Eschewing the hard, gleaming surfaces of most speculative sci-fi for something more off-kilter and bittersweet, Spike Jonze’s digital romance follows a lonely, mustachioed introvert (Joaquin Phoenix) in near-future Los Angeles as he falls head-over-code for an adaptive operating system voiced by Scarlett Johansson. Is it real machine love or just a grown man’s pathological avoidance of intimacy? “Her” refuses easy answers, though the many questions it raises, alas, feel a lot less theoretical today than they did in 2013.

hook: 索菲亚·科波拉的第二部长片像一个电影奇迹：轻松地有新意，被反复引用，没法复制。它在东京柏悦酒店拍摄，科波拉自己在第一段婚姻要结束时住过那里。鲍勃和夏洛特（比尔·默里和斯嘉丽·约翰逊）一个是过气影星，一个是读哲学却不知道往哪走的人，他们相交的时间，刚好够认出一个同类。《迷失东京》让科波拉拿到奥斯卡，也把她定成美国电影里一个不能没有的新声音。
hook_en: Sofia Coppola’s sophomore feature is a cinematic miracle — effortlessly inventive, endlessly quoted, impossible to replicate. Shot at the Park Hyatt Tokyo (where Coppola had stayed while contemplating the end of her first marriage), it follows the enigmatic duo of Bob and Charlotte (Bill Murray and Scarlett Johansson), a fading movie star and a floundering philosophy grad whose paths intersect for just as long as it takes to recognize a soul mate. “Lost in Translation” won Coppola an Oscar and cemented her status as an essential new voice in American film.

hook: 对超级英雄无所谓，并不是拍好他们的前提。克里斯托弗·诺兰讨厌漫画逻辑，迷的是成人犯罪片，尤其是《盗火线》和《教父》。他把一个还陷在《蝙蝠侠与罗宾》那团雾里的角色重新做活了。这是他“黑暗骑士”三部曲的第二部，也是最高点。它问主角那套道德是不是太天真。片子最大的本钱是希斯·莱杰，他演的小丑把后来的超级反派的标准定死了。
hook_en: Indifference to superheroes isn’t a prerequisite for making a great film about them. But Christopher Nolan’s allergy to comic-book logic and his infatuation with the grown-up crime movie canon (especially “Heat” and “The Godfather”) revitalized a character still laboring to emerge from the miasma of “Batman & Robin.” The second entry and high-water mark of Nolan’s “Dark Knight” trilogy poses fruitful questions about the naïveté of its protagonist’s moral code. But the film’s greatest asset is Heath Ledger, whose staggering performance as the Joker set the bar for subsequent supervillains forever.

hook: 克里斯托弗·诺兰这部耀眼、野心很大的太空史诗，情节是一个到今天仍然把脑子拧弯的谜，正好对应我们有多不明白自己在宇宙的哪里、为什么存在。中心是马修·麦康纳演的一个鳏夫。他留下孩子、岳父，和一颗被气候变化毁掉的地球，加入一支 NASA 队伍，去找一颗新的行星。尽管远方的地平线都在，片子最好的地方，是在探家这个不稳、却诱人的概念。
hook_en: The plot of Christopher Nolan’s dazzling, ambitious space epic is a puzzle that even today remains mind-bending, mirroring how little we understand about where we are in the universe and why we exist. At its center is Matthew McConaughey as a widower who leaves behind his children, father-in-law and an Earth ravaged by climate change to join a NASA team trying to find a new planet. For all the far-off horizons, the movie is at its best exploring the precarious yet seductive concept of home.

hook: 明星的光很少比史蒂文·索德伯格这次重拍更亮。原作是 1960 年鼠帮那部抢劫片。这一版把最潇洒的乔治·克鲁尼和一个头发刺起来、带点顽皮的布拉德·皮特配在一起。紧张一直在，样子却始终光滑、有型。丹尼·奥申队伍里的每一个人都让人高兴，包括戴着过大眼镜的艾略特·古尔德，和一口英国口音的唐·钱德尔。索德伯格给拉斯维加斯的那层梦，和银幕上的名人是配得上的。
hook_en: Star power has never been more glittery than in Steven Soderbergh’s remake of the 1960 Rat Pack heist picture. This version pairs George Clooney at his most suave with an impish, spiky-haired Brad Pitt for a romp that keeps tension high while remaining impeccably sleek and stylish. Each member of Danny Ocean’s team is an utter delight, including Elliott Gould in oversize glasses and Don Cheadle with a British accent. And Soderbergh gives Las Vegas a dreamy aura that matches the celebrities onscreen.

hook: 昆汀·塔伦蒂诺这个二战复仇故事又大又近：生死可以取决于一个手势、一块甜点上的浇头、一口糟糕的口音。不是布拉德·皮特那口田纳西口音，那一口很好笑。克里斯托夫·瓦尔兹在一群好演员里最突出，拿了奥斯卡最佳男配角。改写过的历史把片子烧成一片之后，最后一句话留给皮特，听着也很像塔伦蒂诺自己在说：“我觉得这可能就是我的代表作。”
hook_en: Quentin Tarantino’s World War II revenge tale is epic but intimate: Life and death turn on a hand gesture, a dessert topping, a bad accent (not whatever Tennessee accent Brad Pitt is using — that one’s hilarious). Christoph Waltz stands out in a stacked ensemble cast, and won the best supporting actor Oscar. But after a conflagration of revisionist history has burned this movie to the ground, Pitt gets the last word, and it’s hard not to hear it in Tarantino’s voice: “I think this just might be my masterpiece.”

hook: 萨曼莎·莫顿几乎剃光了头，喊出“跑！”这个画面只是一个原因，说明史蒂文·斯皮尔伯格改编菲利普·K·迪克的这部片子仍然让人难忘。在这个反乌托邦里，犯罪在发生之前就被拦住，靠的是像莫顿这样的人类“预知者”的预见。汤姆·克鲁斯演一个被冤枉的警察，紧张得正好。他越靠近一个大阴谋的中心，动作里就越有深的悲伤。一种啃着人的痛苦推动着斯皮尔伯格的黑色片，世界的颜色几乎被抽干了。
hook_en: The image of a nearly bald Samantha Morton shouting “Run!” is just one reason Steven Spielberg’s Philip K. Dick adaptation is still haunting. In this dystopia, crime is stopped before it happens thanks to the foresight of human “precogs” like Morton’s character. Tom Cruise is appropriately on edge as a falsely accused police officer, infusing a deep sadness into his actions as he draws closer to the center of a huge conspiracy. A gnawing agony powers Spielberg’s noir in which color has almost been drained from the world.

hook: “做梦的人，日子不好过。”这句台词出自这部意外大热的片子。人们主要记得它把爱情喜剧和魔法效果拌在一起。先把心碎的女人化成一摊水这类场面放到一边。导演让-皮埃尔·热内看人和看爱都很清醒，也很好笑。那句台词，是一个色情商店店员说的。追求者对喜欢的人说“你脸红的时候很美”，她回答：“那是我消化不良。”
hook_en: “Times are hard for dreamers,” a character says in this surprise smash hit that’s mainly remembered as a mash-up of rom-com and magical effects. But set aside moments like a heartbroken woman dissolving into a puddle. The director Jean-Pierre Jeunet takes a clear-eyed, very funny view of both people and love. That line, for instance, is uttered by a porn emporium clerk. And when a would-be suitor tells the object of his affection, “You’re beautiful when you blush,” she replies, “It’s my dyspepsia.”

hook: 这部票房并不好的戏，看的是执念。标题里的连环杀手执着于造一个自己的形象。被官僚程序绊住的警察（马克·鲁法洛和安东尼·爱德华兹）执着地追线索，报社记者也一样，包括小罗伯特·唐尼演的那个爱喝酒的跑线记者。片尾字幕出来时你会觉得满足，尽管十二宫是谁仍是个谜。这要归给大卫·芬奇对细节和技术同样执着的注意。
hook_en: This drama, which sputtered at the box office, functions as an examination of obsession. The titular serial killer is obsessive in the creation of a persona. The bureaucracy-hindered cops (Mark Ruffalo and Anthony Edwards) obsessively chase leads, while newspaper journalists, including Robert Downey Jr.’s boozy beat reporter, do the same. That you feel satisfied by the time the credits roll — even though the Zodiac’s identity remains a mystery — speaks to David Fincher’s obsessive attention to detail and technique.

hook: 一只卡通老鼠、巴黎的背景、一个弱者（好吧，弱鼠）的故事：很多动画都是这个开头。把老一套再煮一遍，和把一道经典菜做高，是不一样的，就像片名这道菜本身的路径。雷米是乡下的老鼠，味觉精，也相信自己。他进城去实现做菜的梦，由此开始一场迷人、机智、让人动心的冒险。关于重新点燃热情，哪怕热情早就变成苦差，它留下的东西在宴席结束之后还在。
hook_en: A cartoon rodent, a Paris backdrop, an underdog (OK, under-rat) story: It’s the setup for many animated tales. But there’s a difference between rehashing the same-old and elevating a classic, much like the trajectory of this movie’s titular dish. Remy, a country rat with a sophisticated palate and a belief in himself, heads to the city to make his culinary dreams come true — setting off an enchanting, witty and touching adventure. Its lessons about reigniting our passions, even when they have long turned to drudgery, linger well after the feast.

hook: 不可靠叙述的一个标准例子。《消失的爱人》把“他说、她说”推到新的高度。编剧吉莉安·弗琳就是原著畅销小说的作者。电影给出都市的艾米和中西部的尼克这段婚姻互相矛盾的版本，罗莎蒙德·派克和本·阿弗莱克演得很准，让我们一直猜谁是英雄、谁是恶棍。到最后，在有毒的家庭生活这块地上，还有赢家吗？
hook_en: A perfect example of the unreliable narrator, “Gone Girl” takes the he said/she said tale to new heights. Written by Gillian Flynn, author of the best-selling novel on which it’s based, the movie gives contradictory accounts of the marriage between urbane Amy and Midwestern Nick, played with pitch-perfect precision by Rosamund Pike and Ben Affleck, and keeps us guessing over who is the hero and who is the villain. In the end, are there any winners in the land of toxic domesticity?

hook: 这个故事的轮廓并不让人意外：一个少年进了监狱，出来时成了硬起来的罪犯。可惜的是，这种轮廓太平常。雅克·欧迪亚尔在乎的是具体的事，甚至用虹膜式的圈镜头把我们的注意力指过去。马利克是个不识字的法国少年，阿拉伯裔。他用脑子不只是混过去，而是往上走。塔哈尔·拉希姆把他演得很收。马利克也代表法国郊区那些面对偏见、缺少机会的年轻穆斯林。这部戏上映之后的这些年，只是更贴现在了。
hook_en: Sadly, the outlines of this story — a teenager is sent to prison and emerges a hardened criminal — aren’t surprising. But Jacques Audiard is all about specifics, even deploying iris shots to direct our attention as Malik, an illiterate French teenager of Arab descent, uses his smarts not just to get by but to get ahead. Malik (a terrifically subtle Tahar Rahim) is also a stand-in for young Muslims dealing with prejudice and a lack of opportunity in France’s banlieues. In the years since this drama’s release, it has only grown more relevant.

hook: 死亡、复活、家庭的纽带，以及佩内洛普·克鲁兹一场带电的表演，构成佩德罗·阿莫多瓦这颗戏剧的宝石。几代女人在一个又一个障碍前面拿出决断。它让人觉得有力量，滴着美和热情，阿莫多瓦的许多电影都是这样，还撒了一点魔幻现实，把叙事打开到新的地方。
hook_en: Death, resurrection, family bonds and an electrifying performance by Penélope Cruz make up this gem of a drama from Pedro Almodóvar. Multiple generations of women show resolve as they navigate obstacle after obstacle. It’s an empowering work, dripping with beauty and passion (as so many of Almodóvar’s films are), and sprinkled with a dash of magical realism that opens up its narrative to new realms.

hook: 开枪、刀刺、殴打、斩首、开膛、截肢、致残、挖眼、切开、剁碎和咬，从来没有这么有戏仿的好玩。乌玛·瑟曼演的新娘从昏迷中醒来，发誓向那些用代号的袭击者复仇。其中有穿和服、使刀的棉嘴蛇（刘玉玲），也有看起来普通的铜头蛇（薇薇卡·A·福克斯），枪藏在女儿的麦片盒里。昆汀·塔伦蒂诺满心喜欢地用 B 级片的样式讲这个暗的故事：意大利西部片、功夫、动画、磨坊电影。
hook_en: Never before have shootings, stabbings, beatings, beheadings, disembowelings, amputations, mutilations, gougings, slicings, choppings and bitings been so much campy fun. Uma Thurman’s character, the Bride, awakens from a coma and vows revenge on her code-named assailants; they include the kimono-wearing, katana-wielding Cottonmouth (Lucy Liu) and the seemingly ordinary Copperhead (Vivica A. Fox), who keeps a gun in her daughter’s cereal box. Quentin Tarantino lovingly uses B-movie styles — spaghetti western, kung fu, anime, grindhouse — to tell his dark story.

hook: 讲青春期女孩的电影，很少这么生、这么敢。安德里亚·阿诺德的故事里，女孩（凯蒂·贾维斯）拼命想当嘻哈舞者，母亲的新男友（迈克尔·法斯宾德）鼓励这件事。片子真正讲的是她正在醒来的热情，性的、家庭的，以及其他的，也讲这个看起来很硬的女孩有多容易受伤。它无畏，带电，是阿诺德最好的作品之一。
hook_en: Few movies about adolescent girls are quite this raw or daring. Andrea Arnold’s story concerns a girl (Katie Jarvis) who desperately wants to be a hip-hop dancer, a pursuit her mother’s new boyfriend (Michael Fassbender) encourages. But really the film is about her awakening passions, sexual and familial and more, and the ways in which this seemingly tough girl is achingly vulnerable. It’s fearless and electric, one of Arnold’s finest.

hook: 一个来自地狱的音乐老师（J·K·西蒙斯）和他傲慢的学生（迈尔斯·特勒）进行一场让人看入迷的意志较量。导演达米恩·查泽尔说，他从斯坦利·库布里克的《全金属外壳》里取了灵感，想的是：卓越像战斗一样，要求完全的纪律和交出自我。极度紧张的《爆裂鼓手》，最后那段鼓独奏会让你出汗。它拿了三座奥斯卡，包括西蒙斯那座，也把当时只有 29 岁的查泽尔定成他那一代最有希望的电影作者之一。
hook_en: A music teacher from hell (J.K. Simmons) and his arrogant disciple (Miles Teller) engage in a spellbinding battle of wills. The director Damien Chazelle has said that he drew inspiration from Stanley Kubrick’s “Full Metal Jacket” as he explored the idea that excellence, like combat, demands total discipline and surrender of self. The ultra-intense “Whiplash” — the final drum solo will make you work up a sweat — won three Oscars, including one for Simmons, and established Chazelle, then just 29, as one of the most promising filmmakers of his generation.

hook: 杨德昌自编自导的这部几代人的家庭史诗，把安静的诗和爆开的戏放在一起。它在台湾和日本拍得很美，跟着简家三个人，从他们的女家长昏迷开始。他们面对生活里那些平的部分，试着用音乐、记忆，尤其是照片，找出意思。八岁的孩子聪明得不像这个年纪，他拍人的后脑勺，好让他们看见自己看不见的东西。杨德昌用这部独一无二的电影，做的就是这件事。
hook_en: This multigenerational family epic, written and directed by Edward Yang, balances sublime poetry with explosive drama. Beautifully shot in Taiwan and Japan, the film follows three members of the Jian family after their matriarch falls into a coma.
